// Semaglutide (Ozempic / Wegovy) — 4114 Da peptide, GLP-1 RA.
// 7 epistemic parameters parallel to rapamycin (same indices).
// PK sources: Overgaard 2019, Kapitza 2015, Lau 2015.
//
// Idx | parameter        | mean    | CV    | σ      | σ²
//   0 | cl_proteolytic   | 0.077   | 0.30  | 0.0231 | 0.000534
//   1 | cl_renal         | 0.000   | —     | —      | — (negligible for peptide; fixed 0)
//   2 | fu_plasma        | 0.010   | 0.30  | 0.003  | 0.000009  (99% albumin-bound; Tougaard 2022)
//   3 | kp_brain         | 0.05    | 0.40  | 0.020  | 0.000400  (vascular-confined; PS=1)
//   4 | kp_liver         | 0.50    | 0.25  | 0.125  | 0.015625
//   5 | kp_kidney        | 0.60    | 0.25  | 0.150  | 0.022500
//   6 | kp_adipose       | 0.10    | 0.40  | 0.040  | 0.001600
//
// Note: cl_renal is effectively 0 for semaglutide (proteolytic clearance only).
// The prior sets mean=0, variance=0 so it does not contribute to Sobol / GUM.
pub fn ep28_semaglutide_priors() -> EpPrior28 with Mut {
    var m: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    var v: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    var c: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]

    // 0: cl_proteolytic (Overgaard 2019, n=12; CV=30%)
    m[0] = 0.077;   v[0] = 0.000534;  c[0] = 0.60

    // 1: cl_renal — negligible for peptide; fixed at 0
    m[1] = 0.000;   v[1] = 0.0;       c[1] = 0.50

    // 2: fu_plasma (99% albumin-bound; Tougaard 2022; CV=30%)
    m[2] = 0.010;   v[2] = 0.000009;  c[2] = 0.65

    // 3: kp_brain (vascular-confined; BBB impermeable; CV=40%)
    m[3] = 0.05;    v[3] = 0.000400;  c[3] = 0.55

    // 4: kp_liver (Kapitza 2015; CV=25%)
    m[4] = 0.50;    v[4] = 0.015625;  c[4] = 0.58

    // 5: kp_kidney (CV=25%)
    m[5] = 0.60;    v[5] = 0.022500;  c[5] = 0.55

    // 6: kp_adipose (CV=40%)
    m[6] = 0.10;    v[6] = 0.001600;  c[6] = 0.40

    // Knowledge<f64> declarations (value+variance+ε+provenance) — see ep28_rapamycin_priors.
    var kn: [Knowledge[f64]; 8] = [Knowledge(0.0, ε=1.0, prov="unused"); 8]
    kn[0] = Knowledge { value: m[0], variance: v[0], epsilon: c[0], provenance: "Overgaard2019_n12_CV30" }
    kn[1] = Knowledge { value: m[1], variance: v[1], epsilon: c[1], provenance: "cl_renal_negligible_peptide" }
    kn[2] = Knowledge { value: m[2], variance: v[2], epsilon: c[2], provenance: "Tougaard2022_albumin_CV30" }
    kn[3] = Knowledge { value: m[3], variance: v[3], epsilon: c[3], provenance: "BBB_impermeable_CV40" }
    kn[4] = Knowledge { value: m[4], variance: v[4], epsilon: c[4], provenance: "Kapitza2015_CV25" }
    kn[5] = Knowledge { value: m[5], variance: v[5], epsilon: c[5], provenance: "kp_kidney_CV25" }
    kn[6] = Knowledge { value: m[6], variance: v[6], epsilon: c[6], provenance: "kp_adipose_CV40" }

    EpPrior28 { kn: kn, n: 7 }
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN — TEST SUITE (8 tests)
// ============================================================================

fn ep28_selftest_main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic, Epistemic {
    println("======================================================================")
    println("  Epistemic PBPK28 — GUM Uncertainty Propagation (first-order)")
    println("  Drug: Rapamycin (Sirolimus)")
    println("  Kernel: Rannacher-started Crank-Nicolson 28-state permeability-limited PBPK")
    println("  Method: Central-difference Jacobian (JCGM 100:2008 SS 5.1.3)")
    println("  Epistemic parameters: 7 (CL, fu, Kp_brain, Kp_liver, ...)")
    println("======================================================================")
    println("")

    let prm     = ep28_rapamycin_params()
    let priors  = ep28_rapamycin_priors()
    let dose_mg = 5.0
    let t_end   = 168.0

    let ep = ep28_run(prm, priors, dose_mg, t_end)

    var passed: i32 = 0
    var failed: i32 = 0

    // TEST 1: simulation completes
    println("TEST 1: Epistemic analysis completes (reference + 14 perturbations)")
    if ep.success {
        println("  [PASS]")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  FAIL: Simulation failed")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // TEST 2: AUC_blood > 0 with variance
    println("TEST 2: AUC_blood > 0 with non-zero variance")
    let auc_sd = ep28_sqrt(ep.auc_blood_var)
    print("  AUC_blood(0-168h) mean (mg.h/L): ")
    print_f64(ep.auc_blood_mean)
    println("")
    print("  AUC_blood SD:                    ")
    print_f64(auc_sd)
    println("")
    if ep.auc_blood_mean > 0.0 && ep.auc_blood_var > 0.0 {
        println("  [PASS]")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // TEST 3: C_brain@24h << C_blood (P-gp efflux, kp_brain=0.10)
    println("TEST 3: C_brain@24h << C_blood (P-gp efflux)")
    print("  C_brain at 24h (mg/L): ")
    print_f64(ep.c_brain_mean)
    println("")
    let c_blood_est = if t_end > 0.0 { ep.auc_blood_mean / t_end } else { 0.0 }
    print("  C_blood estimate (AUC/168h, mg/L): ")
    print_f64(c_blood_est)
    println("")
    let ratio = if c_blood_est > 1.0e-12 { ep.c_brain_mean / c_blood_est } else { 0.0 }
    print("  brain/blood ratio (approx): ")
    print_f64(ratio)
    println("")
    if ratio < 0.25 {
        println("  [PASS] P-gp efflux correctly limits CNS penetration")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  FAIL: brain/blood ratio expected < 0.25 (kp_brain=0.10)")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // TEST 4: CV(AUC_blood) > 0
    println("TEST 4: CV(AUC_blood) > 0 (GUM propagates)")
    let cv_auc = if ep.auc_blood_mean > 1.0e-12 { auc_sd / ep.auc_blood_mean } else { 0.0 }
    print("  CV(AUC_blood): ")
    print_f64(cv_auc)
    println("")
    if cv_auc > 0.001 {
        println("  [PASS] GUM uncertainty propagates through 28-state model")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  FAIL: expected CV > 0.1%")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // TEST 5: Sensitivity SPECTRUM - per-parameter, not only the aggregate
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------
    // The previous form of this test asserted only sum(sensitivity) == 1.0 and
    // max(sensitivity) > 0.3. Both hold BY CONSTRUCTION after the normalisation
    // loop in ep28_run, however many components are zero. So when issue #1497
    // zeroed four of the seven Jacobian columns under Madaros, this test still
    // printed a sum of 1.000000, a max ABOVE the reference (missing mass is
    // redistributed by the normalisation), and reported 9/9 PASSED. A test that
    // cannot fail on the defect it covers is worse than no test. These can:
    //   (a) the three clearance-channel columns (cl_hepatic, cl_renal, fu) may
    //       not be exactly 0.0; nor may kp_brain / kp_liver / kp_kidney's
    //       share of their own organ endpoint's variance (C_brain_24h,
    //       AUC_liver, AUC_kidney), where those columns carry real signal;
    //   (b) the two dominant components are PINNED to their analytic values,
    //       so redistribution of lost mass - which leaves the sum at 1.0 and
    //       only raises the max - surfaces as a magnitude failure;
    //   (c) the Kp tail of the AUC_blood spectrum must stay below 1e-12.
    // Why the pins moved on 2026-09-26: the old references (0.697376,
    // 0.301837, tail 5.23e-8 / 3.24e-8) were measured through
    // pbpk28_full_cn_step, whose negativity floors injected mass and made
    // AUC_blood depend on Kp. Under the exact mass identity of the
    // Rannacher-started step, AUC_blood(0-168h) = (Dose − M(168h))/CL with
    // M(168h)/Dose ~ 4e-18, so to first order
    //   c_clh = c_clr = −Dose/CL²,  c_fu = −Dose/(CL·fu_ref)   (fu scales CL)
    //   s_clh : s_clr : s_fu = v_clh : v_clr : v_fu·CL²/fu_ref²
    // and the Kp columns are rounding noise: |ΔAUC| ≲ steps·ε·AUC ≈ 3e-13
    // bounds a Kp fraction by ~1e-20. The floor artefact put them at ≥ 5e-8,
    // so (c) at 1e-12 separates the two by four orders either way. The FD
    // truncation of the dominant pair is O((h/CL)²) ≈ 1.4e-5, inside the
    // unchanged 1e-4 band; the #1497 deviation (3.3e-4) stays outside it.
    // kp_adipose has no reported endpoint where it matters, so a lost
    // kp_adipose column is not detectable here.
    println("TEST 5: Sensitivity spectrum (per-parameter, not just the sum)")
    print("  sens[0] cl_hepatic: ")
    print_f64(ep.sensitivity[0])
    println("")
    print("  sens[1] cl_renal:   ")
    print_f64(ep.sensitivity[1])
    println("")
    print("  sens[2] fu_plasma:  ")
    print_f64(ep.sensitivity[2])
    println("")
    print("  sens[3] kp_brain:   ")
    print_f64(ep.sensitivity[3])
    println("")
    print("  sens[4] kp_liver:   ")
    print_f64(ep.sensitivity[4])
    println("")
    print("  sens[5] kp_kidney:  ")
    print_f64(ep.sensitivity[5])
    println("")
    print("  sens[6] kp_adipose: ")
    print_f64(ep.sensitivity[6])
    println("")

    var s_sum = 0.0
    var si: i32 = 0
    while si < 7 {
        s_sum = s_sum + ep.sensitivity[si]
        si = si + 1
    }
    print("  sum(sensitivity): ")
    print_f64(s_sum)
    println("")
    var s_max = 0.0
    var sk: i32 = 0
    while sk < 7 {
        if ep.sensitivity[sk] > s_max { s_max = ep.sensitivity[sk] }
        sk = sk + 1
    }
    print("  max(sensitivity): ")
    print_f64(s_max)
    println("")

    // (a) STRUCTURAL: a lost Jacobian column shows up as an exact 0.0 here.
    var n_zero = 0.0
    var sz: i32 = 0
    while sz < 3 {
        if ep.sensitivity[sz] == 0.0 { n_zero = n_zero + 1.0 }
        sz = sz + 1
    }
    if ep.kp_share_brain == 0.0 { n_zero = n_zero + 1.0 }
    if ep.kp_share_liver == 0.0 { n_zero = n_zero + 1.0 }
    if ep.kp_share_kidney == 0.0 { n_zero = n_zero + 1.0 }
    print("  kp_brain share of Var(C_brain_24h): ")
    print_f64(ep.kp_share_brain)
    println("")
    print("  kp_liver share of Var(AUC_liver):   ")
    print_f64(ep.kp_share_liver)
    println("")
    print("  kp_kidney share of Var(AUC_kidney): ")
    print_f64(ep.kp_share_kidney)
    println("")
    print("  zeroed components (must be 0): ")
    print_f64(n_zero)
    println("")

    // (b) MAGNITUDE: dominant pair against its analytic value (see above).
    // Tolerance is 1.0e-4 relative, unchanged.
    let a_cl = prm.cl_central
    let a_fu = ep28_fu_ref()
    let a_v0 = priors.kn[0].variance
    let a_v1 = priors.kn[1].variance
    let a_v2 = priors.kn[2].variance * a_cl * a_cl / (a_fu * a_fu)
    let ref_s0 = a_v0 / (a_v0 + a_v1 + a_v2)
    let ref_s2 = a_v2 / (a_v0 + a_v1 + a_v2)
    let rel_s0 = ep28_abs(ep.sensitivity[0] - ref_s0) / ref_s0
    let rel_s2 = ep28_abs(ep.sensitivity[2] - ref_s2) / ref_s2
    print("  analytic sens[0]: ")
    print_f64(ref_s0)
    println("")
    print("  analytic sens[2]: ")
    print_f64(ref_s2)
    println("")
    print("  rel dev sens[0] vs analytic: ")
    print_f64(rel_s0)
    println("")
    print("  rel dev sens[2] vs analytic: ")
    print_f64(rel_s2)
    println("")

    // (c) Kp tail of the AUC_blood spectrum, scaled so both engines' fixed
    // print shows it.
    var tail_max = 0.0
    var st5: i32 = 3
    while st5 < 7 {
        if ep.sensitivity[st5] > tail_max { tail_max = ep.sensitivity[st5] }
        st5 = st5 + 1
    }
    print("  max Kp tail fraction x 1e12 (must be < 1): ")
    print_f64(tail_max * 1.0e12)
    println("")

    let sum_ok = s_sum > 0.999999 && s_sum < 1.000001
    let dom_ok = s_max > 0.3
    let nz_ok  = n_zero < 0.5
    let pin_ok = rel_s0 < 1.0e-4 && rel_s2 < 1.0e-4
    let tail_ok = tail_max < 1.0e-12
    if sum_ok && dom_ok && nz_ok && pin_ok && tail_ok {
        println("  [PASS] no lost column; dominant pair matches analytic; no Kp leak into AUC_blood")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        if nz_ok == false {
            println("  FAIL: a sensitivity component is EXACTLY 0.0 (Jacobian column lost)")
        }
        if pin_ok == false {
            println("  FAIL: dominant components deviate from the analytic spectrum")
        }
        if tail_ok == false {
            println("  FAIL: Kp leaks into AUC_blood (solver mass artefact?)")
        }
        if sum_ok == false || dom_ok == false {
            println("  FAIL: sensitivity fractions malformed")
        }
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // TEST 6: Evidence-weighted confidence in [0.20, 0.90]
    // Fabrication detector (Madaros, 2026-08-17): print_f64 has been measured
    // emitting ~4.6e18 (IEEE bits of a plausible ~0.67 confidence re-read as an
    // integer then printed as f64). Refuse any confidence outside (0,1] and name
    // bit-pattern scale so the lie cannot look like a green probability.
    println("TEST 6: Confidence in [0.20, 0.90]")
    let conf = ep.auc_blood_conf
    print("  AUC confidence: ")
    print_f64(conf)
    println("")
    let in_band = conf > 0.20 && conf < 0.90
    let conf_gt_one = conf > 1.0
    let conf_bitpat = conf > 1.0e15
    if conf_gt_one {
        println("  EPISTEMIC_FABRICATION: confidence > 1.0 (not a probability)")
    }
    if conf_bitpat {
        println("  EPISTEMIC_FABRICATION: confidence looks like f64 bit-pattern-as-integer")
    }
    if in_band && conf_gt_one == false && conf_bitpat == false {
        println("  [PASS]")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  FAIL: expected confidence in [0.20, 0.90]")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // TEST 7: Mass balance — the exact discrete identity at the production dt.
    // Every θ-step conserves M(T) + CL·AUC_blood = M(0) in real arithmetic
    // (theta_pbpk28 header), so only rounding remains. Bound: max(1e-12,
    // steps·1e-15) relative to the dose, a ~4.5 ulp-per-sub-step rounding
    // budget (pbpk28_mass_tol_rel; heuristic, see its comment). The old one-sided check (M_final < M_init) passed
    // with 1.41 mg injected by the CN floors. Negative concentrations are not
    // floored; their mass is booked and must stay below
    // pbpk28_neg_mass_bound_mg() = 5e-7 mg.
    println("TEST 7: Mass balance (exact discrete identity, production dt)")
    print("  Initial mass (mg): ")
    print_f64(ep.mass_init)
    println("")
    print("  Final mass (mg):   ")
    print_f64(ep.mass_final)
    println("")
    let mb_tol_rel = pbpk28_mass_tol_rel(ep.steps)
    let mb_rel = ep28_abs(ep.mass_residual) / ep.mass_init
    print("  |M(T) + CL*AUC - M(0)| / M(0) x 1e12: ")
    print_f64(mb_rel * 1.0e12)
    println("")
    print("  bound x 1e12: ")
    print_f64(mb_tol_rel * 1.0e12)
    println("")
    print("  booked negative mass x 1e12 (mg): ")
    print_f64(ep.neg_mass * 1.0e12)
    println("")
    if mb_rel <= mb_tol_rel && ep.neg_mass <= pbpk28_neg_mass_bound_mg() && ep.mass_final >= 0.0 {
        println("  [PASS] mass identity closes to rounding; no floor, no visible negativity")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  FAIL: discrete mass identity violated or negative mass visible")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // TEST 8: AUC_liver > AUC_blood (hepatic sequestration: kp_liver=5.40)
    println("TEST 8: AUC_liver > AUC_blood (hepatic sequestration)")
    print("  AUC_liver:  ")
    print_f64(ep.auc_liver_mean)
    println("")
    print("  AUC_blood:  ")
    print_f64(ep.auc_blood_mean)
    println("")
    if ep.auc_liver_mean > ep.auc_blood_mean {
        println("  [PASS] High kp_liver=5.40 drives hepatic sequestration")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  FAIL: expected AUC_liver > AUC_blood for rapamycin")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // TEST 9: dt-convergence.
    // (a) Order, on an endpoint that carries discretisation error. Every AUC
    //     over 0..168 h is dt-independent here: a linear, exactly conservative
    //     method booked with its own quadrature sums to -A^-1(x_N - x_0 - Σ dt·b),
    //     so AUC diffs are rounding and say nothing about order. The point value
    //     C_brain(24 h) does carry the transient error. Halving dt twice, a
    //     second-order method gives a diff ratio -> 4 and a first-order one -> 2.
    //     The gate is ratio >= 2·√2, i.e. observed order p = log2(ratio) >= 1.5,
    //     the midpoint that separates the two. Rannacher start-up keeps CN
    //     globally second order after the bolus (Giles & Carter 2006).
    // (b) Production and fine dt match Dose/CL (mass identity; below).
    println("TEST 9: dt-convergence (order on C_brain(24h); AUC vs Dose/CL)")
    let br1 = ep28_brain24_dt(prm, dose_mg, t_end, 0.05)
    let br2 = ep28_brain24_dt(prm, dose_mg, t_end, 0.025)
    let br4 = ep28_brain24_dt(prm, dose_mg, t_end, 0.0125)
    let bd1 = ep28_abs(br1 - br2)
    let bd2 = ep28_abs(br2 - br4)
    let b_ratio = if bd2 > 0.0 { bd1 / bd2 } else { 0.0 }
    print("  C_brain(24h) x 1e6 at dt=0.05/0.025/0.0125: ")
    print_f64(br1 * 1.0e6); print(" / "); print_f64(br2 * 1.0e6); print(" / "); print_f64(br4 * 1.0e6); println("")
    print("  |diff| x 1e12, dt/2 and dt/4: "); print_f64(bd1 * 1.0e12); print(" / "); print_f64(bd2 * 1.0e12); println("")
    print("  diff ratio (2nd order -> 4, gate >= 2.828427): "); print_f64(b_ratio); println("")
    let order_ok = b_ratio >= 2.8284271247461903
    let m_dt1 = ep28_simulate(prm, dose_mg, t_end)           // dt=0.05
    let m_dt2 = ep28_simulate_dt(0.025, prm, dose_mg, t_end) // dt/2
    let m_dt4 = ep28_simulate_dt(0.0125, prm, dose_mg, t_end) // dt/4
    let rel_diff = if m_dt1.auc_blood > 1.0e-12 {
        ep28_abs(m_dt1.auc_blood - m_dt2.auc_blood) / m_dt1.auc_blood
    } else { 0.0 }
    let diff1 = ep28_abs(m_dt1.auc_blood - m_dt2.auc_blood)
    let diff2 = ep28_abs(m_dt2.auc_blood - m_dt4.auc_blood)
    let ratio = if diff2 > 1.0e-12 { diff1 / diff2 } else { 0.0 }
    print("  AUC dt=0.05:  "); print_f64(m_dt1.auc_blood); println("")
    print("  AUC dt=0.025: "); print_f64(m_dt2.auc_blood); println("")
    print("  AUC dt=0.0125:"); print_f64(m_dt4.auc_blood); println("")
    // Explicit Knowledge<CHEBI:9168> tagging + provenance carried into dt-conv evidence
    // (convergence evidence now carries the ChEBI ontology tag from chemistry for rapamycin).
    print("  Knowledge<CHEBI:9168> tagged AUC at dt=0.05: "); print_f64(m_dt1.auc_blood); println(" (rapamycin)")
    print("  Knowledge<CHEBI:9168> tagged AUC at dt=0.025: "); print_f64(m_dt2.auc_blood); println(" (rapamycin)")
    print("  Knowledge<CHEBI:9168> tagged AUC at dt=0.0125: "); print_f64(m_dt4.auc_blood); println(" (rapamycin)")
    print("  rel diff (dt/2): "); print_f64(rel_diff); println("")
    print("  AUC diff ratio (rounding only, no order information): "); print_f64(ratio); println("")
    // SOTA lit validation (Ferron 1997 + CN theory):
    // lit AUC = dose/CL = 5/12.4 ≈ 0.403226. CN is A-stable O(Δt²) (Hairer/Wanner 1996).
    // dt-conv + convergence to lit value demonstrates discr. error << GUM, bounding higher-order remainder.
    let lit_auc = 5.0 / 12.4
    let e_fine = ep28_abs(m_dt4.auc_blood - lit_auc)
    // The production dt is gated too, at the same bound: until 2026-09-26 only
    // the finest dt was checked, while dt=0.05 sat 0.114 (28%) above Dose/CL.
    let e_prod = ep28_abs(m_dt1.auc_blood - lit_auc)
    print("  SOTA lit AUC (Ferron 1997): "); print_f64(lit_auc); println("  e_fine="); print_f64(e_fine); println("")
    print("  e_prod (dt=0.05): "); print_f64(e_prod); println("")
    if e_fine < 0.01 && e_prod < 0.01 && order_ok {
        println("  [PASS] C_brain(24h) converges at second order; production and fine dt match Dose/CL")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        if order_ok == false { println("  FAIL: C_brain(24h) dt-halving ratio below 2*sqrt(2) (not second order)") }
        if e_fine >= 0.01 || e_prod >= 0.01 { println("  FAIL: not close to lit AUC (Ferron 1997)") }
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    println("======================================================================")
    println("  EPISTEMIC PBPK28 — TEST SUMMARY")
    println("======================================================================")
    print("  Passed: ")
    print_f64(passed as f64)
    println("")
    print("  Failed: ")
    print_f64(failed as f64)
    println("")
    if failed == 0 {
        println("")
        println("  ALL 9 TESTS PASSED")
        println("")
        println("  First-order GUM (JCGM 100:2008) + Rannacher-started CN + invariants verified.")
        println("  dt-convergence + h-choice bound higher-order remainder numerically.")
        println("  Dissertation Section 4.10 numerical epistemic stack: CONFIRMED.")
        println("  (Full symbolic higher-order/stiffness proof lives in formal/Lean if present.)")
        println("  PASS")
    } else {
        println("  SOME TESTS FAILED")
    }
    println("======================================================================")

    return failed
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic, Epistemic {
    ep28_selftest_main()
}


// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/epistemic_pbpk28_hessian.sio ===
// stdlib/darwin_pbpk/epistemic_pbpk28_hessian.sio — Second-Order GUM (PBPK28)
//
// Second-order GUM correction through the 28-state permeability-limited PBPK
// model. Dissertation §4.10 (§4.9 method ported to PBPK28 kernel).
//
// First-order GUM (epistemic_pbpk28.sio):
//   Var(y) ≈ Σᵢ cᵢ² σᵢ²         where cᵢ = ∂y/∂xᵢ
//
// Second-order correction (JCGM 100:2008 §F; JCGM 101 §B.4):
//   Var(y) ≈ Σᵢ cᵢ² σᵢ²  +  ½ Σᵢⱼ Hᵢⱼ² σᵢ² σⱼ²
//   E[y]   ≈ y(μ)         +  ½ Σᵢ Hᵢᵢ σᵢ²
//
// Finite-difference stencils (same as epistemic_pbpk14_hessian.sio):
//   Diagonal   Hᵢᵢ = [y(+h) - 2y(0) + y(-h)] / h²
//   Off-diag   Hᵢⱼ = [y(++)-y(+-)-y(-+)+y(--)] / (4 hᵢ hⱼ)
//
// Step size: h = max(1e-6 · |μ|, 1e-2 · σ)
//
// Scope: AUC_blood endpoint only (primary clinical target for rapamycin DES
// dosing; most non-linear in clearance). Same scope rationale as §4.9.
//
// Simulation path: Crank-Nicolson fixed dt=0.1h (coarser than the 1st-order
// module's dt=0.05h — acceptable here because only relative FD differences
// matter, not absolute trajectory accuracy). Total evals: 1 + 2n + n(n-1)/2×4
// = 1 + 14 + 84 = 99 ODE runs for n=7.

use darwin_pbpk::core::pbpk28_params::*
use darwin_pbpk::tsit5_pbpk28::*
use darwin_pbpk::theta_pbpk28::*
use darwin_pbpk::epistemic_pbpk28::{EpPrior28, ep28_rapamycin_params, ep28_rapamycin_priors}

// ============================================================================
// MATH HELPERS (local copies — not re-exported by PBPK28 imports)
// ============================================================================

fn h28_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn h28_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    return y
}

fn h28_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { return a }
    return b
}

fn h28_finite(x: f64) -> bool {
    if x != x { return false }
    return h28_abs(x) < 1.0e12
}

// ============================================================================
// STEP SIZE
// ============================================================================

fn h28_step(mean: f64, variance: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let h_rel = 1.0e-6 * h28_abs(mean)
    let h_abs = 0.01 * h28_sqrt(variance)
    h28_max(h_rel, h_abs)
}

// ============================================================================
// AUC-ONLY SIMULATION (coarser dt for Hessian FD)
// ============================================================================
// Uses CN at dt=0.1h. For the Hessian we only need the FD *differences*
// to be accurate; the absolute AUC trajectory is allowed to be ~0.5%
// off from the fine-grid reference.

// Bolus run at the Hessian's dt = 0.1 h: Rannacher-started clamp-free CN
// (theta_pbpk28). Shared by h28_simulate_auc and the mass-balance gate.
// Until 2026-09-26 this was pbpk28_full_cn_step, whose floors biased AUC_blood
// by +52% at this dt (0.611694 vs Dose/CL = 0.403226).
pub fn h28_simulate_ledger(prm: PBPKParams28, dose_mg: f64, t_end: f64,
                           st: &!PBPKState28, led: &!PBPK28Ledger) -> bool with Mut, Div {
    return pbpk28_bolus_run_mut(prm, dose_mg, 0.1, t_end, 5000, st, led)
}

// A stencil AUC is usable iff finite and > 0 (0.0 is h28_simulate_auc's
// failure value).
fn h28_solve_ok(auc: f64) -> bool {
    return h28_finite(auc) && auc > 0.0
}

fn h28_simulate_auc(prm: PBPKParams28, dose_mg: f64, t_end: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var st = pbpk28_state_zero()
    var led = pbpk28_ledger_zero()
    if !h28_simulate_ledger(prm, dose_mg, t_end, &!st, &!led) { return 0.0 }
    let auc = led.auc[0]
    if !h28_finite(auc) { return 0.0 }
    return auc
}

// ============================================================================
// PARAMETER PERTURBATION (mirrors ep28_perturb in epistemic_pbpk28.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn h28_perturb(prm: PBPKParams28, idx: i32, delta: f64) -> PBPKParams28 with Mut, Div {
    var p = prm
    let fu_ref = 0.08
    if idx == 0 { p.cl_central = p.cl_central + delta }
    if idx == 1 { p.cl_central = p.cl_central + delta }
    if idx == 2 {
        if fu_ref > 0.0 {
            let scale = (fu_ref + delta) / fu_ref
            p.cl_central = p.cl_central * scale
        }
    }
    if idx == 3 { p.kp[3] = p.kp[3] + delta }
    if idx == 4 { p.kp[1] = p.kp[1] + delta }
    if idx == 5 { p.kp[2] = p.kp[2] + delta }
    if idx == 6 { p.kp[7] = p.kp[7] + delta }
    return p
}

fn h28_perturb2(prm: PBPKParams28, i: i32, di: f64, j: i32, dj: f64) -> PBPKParams28 with Mut, Div {
    let p1 = h28_perturb(prm, i, di)
    h28_perturb(p1, j, dj)
}

// ============================================================================
// HESSIAN BUDGET RECORD
// ============================================================================

pub struct Pbpk28HessianBudget {
    n:                  i32,
    auc_ref:            f64,
    auc_mean_corrected: f64,       // y(μ) + ½ Σ Hᵢᵢ σᵢ²
    pub sensitivity:        [f64; 8],  // 1st-order: cᵢ = ∂AUC/∂xᵢ
    pub hessian:            [f64; 64], // 8×8 row-major
    pub var_first_order:    f64,
    pub var_second_order:   f64,       // 1st order + Hessian correction
    pub success:            bool,
}

fn h28_budget_zero() -> Pbpk28HessianBudget {
    Pbpk28HessianBudget {
        n: 0,
        auc_ref: 0.0,
        auc_mean_corrected: 0.0,
        sensitivity: [0.0; 8],
        hessian: [0.0; 64],
        var_first_order: 0.0,
        var_second_order: 0.0,
        success: false,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN HESSIAN COMPUTATION
// ============================================================================

pub fn hessian_pbpk28_auc(
    base_prm: PBPKParams28,
    priors:   EpPrior28,
    dose_mg:  f64,
    t_end:    f64,
) -> Pbpk28HessianBudget with Mut, Div, Panic, Epistemic {
    let n = priors.n
    var bud = h28_budget_zero()
    bud.n = n

    let auc0 = h28_simulate_auc(base_prm, dose_mg, t_end)
    if !h28_finite(auc0) || auc0 <= 0.0 {
        return bud
    }
    bud.auc_ref = auc0

    // Every stencil solve must succeed. h28_simulate_auc returns 0.0 for a
    // rejected trajectory (non-finite, runaway, or booked negative mass above
    // pbpk28_neg_mass_bound_mg()); a valid AUC is > 0. One rejected solve
    // fails the whole budget instead of entering a difference quotient as 0.
    var all_ok = true

    // Step sizes per parameter
    var hs: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < n {
        hs[i] = h28_step(priors.kn[i].value, priors.kn[i].variance)
        i = i + 1
    }

    // First-order sensitivities + diagonal Hessian (3-point central)
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        let h = hs[i]
        if h > 0.0 {
            let p_p = h28_perturb(base_prm, i, h)
            let p_n = h28_perturb(base_prm, i, 0.0 - h)
            let f_p = h28_simulate_auc(p_p, dose_mg, t_end)
            let f_n = h28_simulate_auc(p_n, dose_mg, t_end)
            if !h28_solve_ok(f_p) || !h28_solve_ok(f_n) { all_ok = false }
            let ci  = (f_p - f_n) / (2.0 * h)
            bud.sensitivity[i] = ci
            let hii = (f_p - 2.0 * auc0 + f_n) / (h * h)
            bud.hessian[i * 8 + i] = hii
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Off-diagonal Hessian (4-point central)
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        var j: i32 = i + 1
        while j < n {
            let hi = hs[i]
            let hj = hs[j]
            if hi > 0.0 && hj > 0.0 {
                let f_pp = h28_simulate_auc(h28_perturb2(base_prm, i, hi,        j, hj),        dose_mg, t_end)
                let f_pn = h28_simulate_auc(h28_perturb2(base_prm, i, hi,        j, 0.0 - hj), dose_mg, t_end)
                let f_np = h28_simulate_auc(h28_perturb2(base_prm, i, 0.0 - hi, j, hj),        dose_mg, t_end)
                let f_nn = h28_simulate_auc(h28_perturb2(base_prm, i, 0.0 - hi, j, 0.0 - hj), dose_mg, t_end)
                if !h28_solve_ok(f_pp) || !h28_solve_ok(f_pn) || !h28_solve_ok(f_np) || !h28_solve_ok(f_nn) { all_ok = false }
                let hij  = (f_pp - f_pn - f_np + f_nn) / (4.0 * hi * hj)
                bud.hessian[i * 8 + j] = hij
                bud.hessian[j * 8 + i] = hij
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    if !all_ok { return h28_budget_zero() }

    // First-order variance
    var v1: f64 = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        let ci = bud.sensitivity[i]
        v1 = v1 + ci * ci * priors.kn[i].variance
        i = i + 1
    }
    bud.var_first_order = v1

    // Second-order variance correction: ½ Σᵢⱼ Hᵢⱼ² σᵢ² σⱼ²
    var v2_corr: f64 = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        var j: i32 = 0
        while j < n {
            let h_ij = bud.hessian[i * 8 + j]
            let vi   = priors.kn[i].variance
            let vj   = priors.kn[j].variance
            v2_corr = v2_corr + 0.5 * h_ij * h_ij * vi * vj
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    bud.var_second_order = v1 + v2_corr

    // Mean correction: y(μ) + ½ Σ Hᵢᵢ σᵢ²
    var mean_shift: f64 = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        let h_diag = bud.hessian[i * 8 + i]
        mean_shift = mean_shift + 0.5 * h_diag * priors.kn[i].variance
        i = i + 1
    }
    bud.auc_mean_corrected = auc0 + mean_shift
    bud.success = true
    bud
}

// ============================================================================
// NONLINEARITY RATIO ρᵢ — dual emission (JCGM 101 §B.4)
// ============================================================================
// Literal  ρᵢ = |½ Hᵢᵢ σᵢ²| / |cᵢ σᵢ|  (JCGM 101 §B.4 in physical units)
// Normalised ρ̃ᵢ = ½ ρᵢ²                  (as computed below; see its comment)
//
// For a perfectly linear function: Hᵢᵢ = 0 → both ratios vanish.
// Resolvability (see the two *_resolvable helpers). Both terms are finite
// differences with their own rounding floors:
//   - first-order and second-order effects both unresolved → the parameter
//     has no measurable effect at either order: both ratios report 0.0;
//   - first order unresolved but second order resolved → a curvature with no
//     measurable slope; the ratio is undefined and both functions return the
//     sentinel -1.0 (never a valid ratio, which is ≥ 0);
//   - first order resolved → the ratio as defined.
// Under the exact mass identity AUC_blood(0-168h) = (Dose − M(168h))/CL the
// four Kp columns are pure rounding at both orders (|cᵢ|σᵢ ~ 1e-13,
// ½|Hᵢᵢ|σᵢ² ~ 1e-12, against AUC_ref ~ 0.4); unguarded, their ratio of two
// noise terms printed as ρ_literal(kp_brain) = 8.2, ρ̃ = 33.6.
// For AUC ~ 1/CL (convex), M6 CV(CL)=38% gives ρ_literal(CL) ≈ 0.38
// and ρ̃(CL) ≈ 0.07. The legacy CV=58% prior gave ρ_literal≈0.58 and
// ρ̃≈0.17. Threshold for "weakly nonlinear": ρ̃ < 0.20 per dissertation §4.9.

// |cᵢ|σᵢ must exceed 1e-9·|AUC_ref| to be a measured effect. The central
// difference of an AUC accumulated over n ≲ 1700 sub-steps carries absolute
// rounding ~ n·ε·|AUC| ≈ 4e-13·|AUC|; with h = 0.01σ that puts the noise in
// |cᵢ|σᵢ near 2e-11·|AUC|, 50× below this floor, while the smallest real
// first-order effect here (cl_renal, |c|σ ≈ 4e-3 vs 4e-10) is 10⁷× above it.
fn h28_first_order_resolvable(bud: Pbpk28HessianBudget, priors: EpPrior28, i: i32) -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic, Epistemic {
    let c_i = bud.sensitivity[i]
    let s_i = h28_sqrt(priors.kn[i].variance)
    return h28_abs(c_i) * s_i > 1.0e-9 * h28_abs(bud.auc_ref)
}

// ½|Hᵢᵢ|σᵢ² must exceed 1e-7·|AUC_ref| to be a measured effect. The
// three-point second difference divides ~4 rounding errors of ≈ 4e-13·|AUC|
// by h² = (0.01σ)², so its noise in ½|Hᵢᵢ|σᵢ² is ≈ 8e-9·|AUC|, 12× below this
// floor; the smallest real second-order term here (cl_renal,
// ½·0.0052·0.0144 ≈ 4e-5 vs 4e-8) is 10³× above it.
fn h28_second_order_resolvable(bud: Pbpk28HessianBudget, priors: EpPrior28, i: i32) -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic, Epistemic {
    let h_ii = bud.hessian[i * 8 + i]
    let v_i = priors.kn[i].variance
    return 0.5 * h28_abs(h_ii) * v_i > 1.0e-7 * h28_abs(bud.auc_ref)
}

// 0.0 when neither order is resolvable, -1.0 (undefined) when only the
// second order is, and 1.0 when the ratio is well defined.
fn h28_ratio_status(bud: Pbpk28HessianBudget, priors: EpPrior28, i: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic, Epistemic {
    if h28_first_order_resolvable(bud, priors, i) { return 1.0 }
    if h28_second_order_resolvable(bud, priors, i) { return 0.0 - 1.0 }
    return 0.0
}

pub fn h28_nonlinearity_ratio_literal(
    bud:    Pbpk28HessianBudget,
    priors: EpPrior28,
    i:      i32,
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic, Epistemic {
    let c_i  = bud.sensitivity[i]
    let h_ii = bud.hessian[i * 8 + i]
    let v_i  = priors.kn[i].variance
    let s_i  = h28_sqrt(v_i)
    let num  = 0.5 * h28_abs(h_ii) * v_i
    let den  = h28_abs(c_i) * s_i
    let status = h28_ratio_status(bud, priors, i)
    if status < 0.5 { return status }
    if den < 1.0e-30 { return 0.0 }
    num / den
}

// ρ̃_i = ½ ρ²_literal, which is what this function returns (0.0722 for M6
// CL_hep, ρ_literal = 0.380; editorial range [0.05, 0.20]).
// It is NOT the per-parameter second-order-to-first-order variance ratio.
// That ratio, for a normal input, is
//   ½ H_ii² σ_i⁴ / (c_i² σ_i²) = ½ (H_ii σ_i / c_i)² = 2 ρ²_literal = 4 ρ̃_i
// (0.2888 for M6 CL_hep, 0.125 for fu). An earlier version of this comment
// derived 2ρ² and then labelled ½ρ² with it, a factor of 4 (caught in PR
// #2696 review, 2026-09-26). The value and the [0.05, 0.20] range are left
// as they are: redefining ρ̃ as the variance ratio would move CL_hep past the
// editorial 0.20 threshold, which is a decision for the dissertation author.
// Do not describe ρ̃ as "the fraction of variance the Hessian adds".
pub fn h28_nonlinearity_ratio_normalized(
    bud:    Pbpk28HessianBudget,
    priors: EpPrior28,
    i:      i32,
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic, Epistemic {
    let c_i  = bud.sensitivity[i]
    let h_ii = bud.hessian[i * 8 + i]
    let v_i  = priors.kn[i].variance
    let s_i  = h28_sqrt(v_i)
    let den  = h28_abs(c_i)
    let status = h28_ratio_status(bud, priors, i)
    if status < 0.5 { return status }
    if den < 1.0e-30 { return 0.0 }
    let rho = 0.5 * h28_abs(h_ii) * s_i / den
    0.5 * rho * rho
}

// ============================================================================
// CSV EMIT (matches §4.9 hessian_emit_budget_csv format for GUM Table H.1)
// ============================================================================

pub fn h28_emit_csv_header() with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    println("kind,i,j,value,units")
}

// Emit GUM Table H.1 CSV.  rho_literal: JCGM 101 §B.4 in physical units;
// rho_normalized: dimensionless analogue scaled to σ-units.
pub fn h28_emit_budget_csv(bud: Pbpk28HessianBudget, priors: EpPrior28) with IO, Mut, Panic, Div, Epistemic {
    let n = bud.n
    print("ref,0,0,"); print_f64(bud.auc_ref); println(",mg.h/L")
    print("mean_corr,0,0,"); print_f64(bud.auc_mean_corrected); println(",mg.h/L")
    print("var_o1,0,0,"); print_f64(bud.var_first_order); println(",(mg.h/L)^2")
    print("var_o2,0,0,"); print_f64(bud.var_second_order); println(",(mg.h/L)^2")

    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < n {
        print("sens,"); print_f64(i as f64); print(",0,"); print_f64(bud.sensitivity[i])
        println(",mg.h/L/unit")
        i = i + 1
    }

    i = 0
    while i < n {
        var j: i32 = i
        while j < n {
            print("hess,"); print_f64(i as f64); print(","); print_f64(j as f64); print(",")
            print_f64(bud.hessian[i * 8 + j])
            println(",mg.h/L/unit2")
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    i = 0
    while i < n {
        let rho_lit  = h28_nonlinearity_ratio_literal(bud, priors, i)
        let rho_norm = h28_nonlinearity_ratio_normalized(bud, priors, i)
        print("rho_literal,"); print_f64(i as f64); print(",0,"); print_f64(rho_lit)
        println(",dimensionless")
        print("rho_normalized,"); print_f64(i as f64); print(",0,"); print_f64(rho_norm)
        println(",dimensionless")
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN — TEST SUITE (7 tests)
// ============================================================================

fn h28_selftest_main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic, Epistemic {
    println("======================================================================")
    println("  Epistemic PBPK28 — Second-Order GUM (Hessian correction)")
    println("  Drug: Rapamycin (Sirolimus)")
    println("  Method: 3-point + 4-point central FD Hessian (JCGM 101 SS B.4)")
    println("======================================================================")
    println("")

    let prm     = ep28_rapamycin_params()
    let priors  = ep28_rapamycin_priors()
    let dose_mg = 5.0
    let t_end   = 168.0

    let bud = hessian_pbpk28_auc(prm, priors, dose_mg, t_end)

    var passed = 0
    var failed = 0

    // TEST 1: Hessian computation completes
    println("TEST 1: Hessian computation completes")
    if bud.success {
        println("  [PASS]")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  FAIL: Hessian computation failed")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // TEST 2: Reference AUC > 0
    println("TEST 2: Reference AUC > 0")
    print("  AUC_ref (mg.h/L): ")
    print_f64(bud.auc_ref)
    println("")
    if bud.auc_ref > 0.0 {
        println("  [PASS]")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // TEST 3: Second-order variance >= first-order variance (Hessian adds)
    println("TEST 3: var_second_order >= var_first_order")
    print("  var_first_order:  ")
    print_f64(bud.var_first_order)
    println("")
    print("  var_second_order: ")
    print_f64(bud.var_second_order)
    println("")
    if bud.var_second_order >= bud.var_first_order {
        println("  [PASS] Hessian correction is non-negative (quadratic term)")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  FAIL: second-order variance should be >= first-order")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // TEST 4: Diagonal Hessian for CL (idx=0) is negative (AUC ~ 1/CL is convex upward)
    println("TEST 4: H_00 (CL diagonal) has expected sign")
    print("  H[0][0] (d2AUC/dCL2): ")
    print_f64(bud.hessian[0])
    println("")
    // AUC = Dose/CL (linear PK approx) → d2AUC/dCL2 = 2·Dose/CL3 > 0 at first order
    // For the 28-comp model AUC is more complex but CL sensitivity still dominant.
    // The sign may vary; just check it is non-zero and finite.
    let h00_ok = h28_finite(bud.hessian[0]) && (bud.hessian[0] != 0.0)
    if h00_ok {
        println("  [PASS] H_00 is finite and non-zero")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  FAIL: H_00 is zero or non-finite")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // TEST 5: Mean correction is physically bounded (< 60% of AUC_ref)
    // AUC ~ 1/CL is convex, so by Jensen E[1/CL] ≥ 1/E[CL] and the Hessian
    // mean correction ½ Σ Hᵢᵢ σᵢ² is positive and grows with the priors' CVs:
    // measured |shift| / AUC_ref = 0.207 under the M6 prior (CV(CL_hep) 38%)
    // and 0.400 under the legacy prior (σ/CL = 58%). The 60% threshold is
    // prior-independent: it flags pathological values (> 100% shifts) and
    // accepts either measured correction.
    println("TEST 5: Mean correction physically bounded (< 60% of AUC_ref)")
    let mean_shift = bud.auc_mean_corrected - bud.auc_ref
    let rel_shift = if bud.auc_ref > 1.0e-12 {
        h28_abs(mean_shift) / bud.auc_ref
    } else {
        0.0
    }
    print("  |mean_shift| / AUC_ref: ")
    print_f64(rel_shift)
    println("")
    if rel_shift < 0.60 {
        println("  [PASS] Hessian mean correction below 60% of AUC_ref")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  FAIL: mean correction too large (> 60%)")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // TEST 6: CSV emit runs without panic
    println("TEST 6: CSV emit (GUM Table H.1 format with dual-rho columns)")
    h28_emit_csv_header()
    h28_emit_budget_csv(bud, priors)
    println("  [PASS] CSV emitted without error")
    passed = passed + 1
    println("")

    // TEST 7: Mass balance at the production dt — exact discrete identity
    // M(T) + CL·AUC − M(0) = 0 to rounding (theta_pbpk28 gate bounds).
    println("TEST 7: Mass balance at production dt (dt=0.1h, 5 mg bolus)")
    var mb_st = pbpk28_state_zero()
    var mb_led = pbpk28_ledger_zero()
    let mb_run = h28_simulate_ledger(prm, dose_mg, t_end, &!mb_st, &!mb_led)
    let mb_ok = mb_run && pbpk28_mass_gate_report(mb_led, mb_st, prm, dose_mg)
    if mb_ok {
        println("  [PASS] mass identity closes to rounding; no floor, no visible negativity")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  FAIL: discrete mass identity violated or negative mass visible")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    println("======================================================================")
    println("  HESSIAN PBPK28 — TEST SUMMARY")
    println("======================================================================")
    print("  Passed: ")
    print_f64(passed as f64)
    println("")
    print("  Failed: ")
    print_f64(failed as f64)
    println("")
    if failed == 0 {
        println("")
        println("  ALL 7 TESTS PASSED")
        println("")
        println("  Second-order GUM through 28-state PBPK for rapamycin.")
        println("  Dissertation Section 4.10 Hessian stack: CONFIRMED.")
        println("  PASS")
    } else {
        println("  SOME TESTS FAILED")
    }
    println("======================================================================")

    return failed
}

// ============================================================================
// DUAL-RHO SELFTEST (5 tests)
// ============================================================================

fn h28_dual_rho_selftest_main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic, Epistemic {
    println("======================================================================")
    println("  Epistemic PBPK28 — Dual-Rho Nonlinearity Test")
    println("  ρ_literal (JCGM 101 §B.4) and ρ̃_normalized (dimensionless)")
    println("======================================================================")
    println("")

    let prm    = ep28_rapamycin_params()
    let priors = ep28_rapamycin_priors()
    let bud    = hessian_pbpk28_auc(prm, priors, 5.0, 168.0)

    var passed = 0
    var failed = 0

    // TEST 1: ρ_literal recovers a value in physical-unit range (CL_hep, idx=0).
    // AUC ~ 1/CL is convex → Hessian term is positive → ρ_literal > 0.
    // The M6 benchmark is 0.380; allow [0.20, 1.50] to keep the check
    // focused on physical-unit curvature, not on a single rounded prior.
    println("TEST 1: rho_literal(CL_hep) in [0.20, 1.50]")
    let rho_lit_cl = h28_nonlinearity_ratio_literal(bud, priors, 0)
    print("  rho_literal(CL_hep): "); print_f64(rho_lit_cl); println("")
    if rho_lit_cl > 0.20 && rho_lit_cl < 1.50 {
        println("  [PASS]")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  FAIL: outside expected range")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // TEST 2: ρ̃_normalized in M6 editorial range [0.05, 0.20].
    // ρ̃ = ½ρ² (not the variance ratio, which is 2ρ² = 4ρ̃; see
    // h28_nonlinearity_ratio_normalized). For ρ_literal(CL_hep)=0.380 → 0.072.
    println("TEST 2: rho_normalized(CL_hep) in [0.05, 0.20]")
    let rho_norm_cl = h28_nonlinearity_ratio_normalized(bud, priors, 0)
    print("  rho_normalized(CL_hep): "); print_f64(rho_norm_cl); println("")
    if rho_norm_cl > 0.05 && rho_norm_cl < 0.20 {
        println("  [PASS] rho_normalized = rho_literal^2/2 in editorial range [0.05, 0.20]")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  FAIL: outside [0.05, 0.20]")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // TEST 3: Both ratios vanish for a synthetic zero-curvature budget.
    // A perfectly linear function has H_ii = 0 → both ρ_literal = ρ̃ = 0.
    println("TEST 3: Both ratios = 0 for zero-curvature (linear) budget")
    var linear_bud = h28_budget_zero()
    linear_bud.n = 7
    linear_bud.sensitivity[0] = 1.0
    linear_bud.hessian[0] = 0.0
    let rho_lit_lin  = h28_nonlinearity_ratio_literal(linear_bud, priors, 0)
    let rho_norm_lin = h28_nonlinearity_ratio_normalized(linear_bud, priors, 0)
    print("  rho_literal (linear):    "); print_f64(rho_lit_lin); println("")
    print("  rho_normalized (linear): "); print_f64(rho_norm_lin); println("")
    if rho_lit_lin == 0.0 && rho_norm_lin == 0.0 {
        println("  [PASS] both vanish for linear model")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  FAIL: expected 0.0 for linear model")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // TEST 4: A purely quadratic response (zero slope, resolvable curvature)
    // has no defined ratio: both functions return the -1.0 sentinel, never
    // 0.0, which would read as "linear".
    println("TEST 4: Both ratios = -1 (undefined) for a purely quadratic budget")
    var quad_bud = h28_budget_zero()
    quad_bud.n = 7
    quad_bud.auc_ref = 0.4
    quad_bud.sensitivity[0] = 0.0
    quad_bud.hessian[0] = 1.0
    let rho_lit_quad  = h28_nonlinearity_ratio_literal(quad_bud, priors, 0)
    let rho_norm_quad = h28_nonlinearity_ratio_normalized(quad_bud, priors, 0)
    print("  rho_literal (quadratic):    "); print_f64(rho_lit_quad); println("")
    print("  rho_normalized (quadratic): "); print_f64(rho_norm_quad); println("")
    if rho_lit_quad == 0.0 - 1.0 && rho_norm_quad == 0.0 - 1.0 {
        println("  [PASS] both report the undefined sentinel")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  FAIL: expected -1.0 for a purely quadratic response")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // TEST 5: Neither order resolvable (slope and curvature below their
    // rounding floors against AUC_ref = 0.4): both ratios report 0.0.
    println("TEST 5: Both ratios = 0 when neither order is resolvable")
    var flat_bud = h28_budget_zero()
    flat_bud.n = 7
    flat_bud.auc_ref = 0.4
    flat_bud.sensitivity[0] = 0.0
    flat_bud.hessian[0] = 0.0
    let rho_lit_flat  = h28_nonlinearity_ratio_literal(flat_bud, priors, 0)
    let rho_norm_flat = h28_nonlinearity_ratio_normalized(flat_bud, priors, 0)
    print("  rho_literal (flat):    "); print_f64(rho_lit_flat); println("")
    print("  rho_normalized (flat): "); print_f64(rho_norm_flat); println("")
    if rho_lit_flat == 0.0 && rho_norm_flat == 0.0 {
        println("  [PASS] both report 0 (no measurable effect)")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  FAIL: expected 0.0 when neither order is resolvable")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    println("======================================================================")
    println("  DUAL-RHO TEST SUMMARY")
    println("======================================================================")
    print("  Passed: "); print_f64(passed as f64); println("")
    print("  Failed: "); print_f64(failed as f64); println("")
    if failed == 0 {
        println("")
        println("  ALL 5 DUAL-RHO TESTS PASSED")
        println("")
        println("  HESSIAN_PBPK28_DUAL_RHO_PASS")
    } else {
        println("  SOME DUAL-RHO TESTS FAILED")
    }
    println("======================================================================")

    return failed
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic, Epistemic {
    let r1 = h28_selftest_main()
    let r2 = h28_dual_rho_selftest_main()
    r1 + r2
}


// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/epistemic_sim.sio ===
// darwin_pbpk/epistemic_sim.sio — 4-Compartment Epistemic PBPK Simulation
//
// Self-contained 4-compartment oral PBPK model (gut, central, peripheral,
// eliminated) with GUM uncertainty propagation via RK4 integration.
//
// Compartment ODE system:
//   d(gut)/dt        = -ka * gut
//   d(central)/dt    = ka * gut - (ke + k12) * central + k21 * peripheral
//   d(peripheral)/dt = k12 * central - k21 * peripheral
//   d(eliminated)/dt = ke * central
//
// Uncertainty propagated analytically via GUM linearization at each RK4 step.
// AUC computed by trapezoidal rule; Cmax/Tmax tracked over integration window.
//
// Reference: JCGM 100:2008 (GUM), §13.3 — linearized uncertainty propagation.

// ============================================================================
// MATH HELPERS (self-contained)
// ============================================================================

pub fn sim_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 {
        y = (y + x / y) * 0.5
        i = i + 1
    }
    return y
}

fn sim_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn sim_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { return a }
    return b
}

fn sim_min(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a < b { return a }
    return b
}

// ln(2) — used for half-life = ln(2)/ke
fn ln2() -> f64 { 0.6931471805599453 }

// ============================================================================
// GUM BUILDING BLOCKS (inlined — no cross-module dependency required)
// ============================================================================

pub struct GUMResult {
    pub value: f64,
    pub std_uncertainty: f64,
    pub degrees_of_freedom: f64,
    pub coverage_factor_95: f64,
    pub expanded_uncertainty_95: f64,
}

fn gum_k95() -> f64 { 1.96 }

fn sim_gum_simple(value: f64, std_u: f64) -> GUMResult {
    let u = sim_abs(std_u)
    let k = gum_k95()
    GUMResult {
        value: value,
        std_uncertainty: u,
        degrees_of_freedom: 1.0e9,
        coverage_factor_95: k,
        expanded_uncertainty_95: k * u,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// PBPK PARAMETER STRUCT
// ============================================================================

pub struct PBPKParams {
    pub dose: f64,               // mg — administered dose
    pub dose_unc: f64,           // mg — standard uncertainty on dose
    pub ka: f64,                 // 1/h — absorption rate constant
    pub ka_unc: f64,
    pub ke: f64,                 // 1/h — elimination rate constant
    pub ke_unc: f64,
    pub vd: f64,                 // L — volume of distribution (central)
    pub vd_unc: f64,
    pub k12: f64,                // 1/h — central→peripheral transfer rate
    pub k12_unc: f64,
    pub k21: f64,                // 1/h — peripheral→central transfer rate
    pub k21_unc: f64,
    pub bioavailability: f64,    // F — oral bioavailability [0,1]
    pub bioavailability_unc: f64,
}

// ============================================================================
// PBPK STATE STRUCT
// ============================================================================

pub struct PBPKState {
    pub gut: f64,
    pub cen: f64,
    pub peripheral: f64,
    pub eliminated: f64,
    pub gut_unc: f64,
    pub central_unc: f64,
    pub peripheral_unc: f64,
    pub eliminated_unc: f64,
    pub time: f64,
}

// ============================================================================
// PBPK RESULT STRUCT
// ============================================================================

pub struct PBPKResult {
    pub cmax: GUMResult,
    pub tmax: f64,
    pub auc: GUMResult,
    pub half_life: GUMResult,
    pub clearance: GUMResult,
    pub final_state: PBPKState,
    pub time_points: [f64; 256],
    pub concentrations: [f64; 256],
    pub conc_uncertainties: [f64; 256],
    pub n_points: i32,
}

// ============================================================================
// DEFAULT PARAMETERS — Typical small-molecule oral drug
// dose=100mg±5, ka=1.0±0.1/h, ke=0.1±0.01/h, Vd=50L±5
// k12=0.3±0.03/h, k21=0.2±0.02/h, F=0.8±0.05
// ============================================================================

pub fn pbpk_params_default() -> PBPKParams {
    PBPKParams {
        dose: 100.0,
        dose_unc: 5.0,
        ka: 1.0,
        ka_unc: 0.1,
        ke: 0.1,
        ke_unc: 0.01,
        vd: 50.0,
        vd_unc: 5.0,
        k12: 0.3,
        k12_unc: 0.03,
        k21: 0.2,
        k21_unc: 0.02,
        bioavailability: 0.8,
        bioavailability_unc: 0.05,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// INITIAL STATE — dose * F in gut, rest zero
// u(gut₀)² = (F * u_dose)² + (dose * u_F)²
// ============================================================================

pub fn pbpk_state_initial(params: &PBPKParams) -> PBPKState with Mut, Div {
    let gut0 = params.dose * params.bioavailability
    let u_gut0 = sim_sqrt(
        params.bioavailability * params.bioavailability * params.dose_unc * params.dose_unc
      + params.dose * params.dose * params.bioavailability_unc * params.bioavailability_unc
    )
    // Use computed zero to force the compiler to emit explicit zero stores
    // (SRET buffer is stack-allocated and not pre-zeroed, so literal 0.0 fields
    // may be skipped by the native compiler)
    let z = gut0 - gut0
    PBPKState {
        gut: gut0,
        cen: z,
        peripheral: z,
        eliminated: z,
        gut_unc: u_gut0,
        central_unc: z,
        peripheral_unc: z,
        eliminated_unc: z,
        time: z,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// DERIVATIVE HELPERS — each compartment value + GUM uncertainty
// ============================================================================

fn dgut_val(gut: f64, ka: f64) -> f64 {
    return 0.0 - ka * gut
}

pub fn dgut_unc(gut: f64, gut_unc: f64, ka: f64, ka_unc: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    let t1 = ka * gut_unc
    let t2 = gut * ka_unc
    return sim_sqrt(t1 * t1 + t2 * t2)
}

fn dcentral_val(gut: f64, central: f64, peripheral: f64,
                ka: f64, ke: f64, k12: f64, k21: f64) -> f64 {
    return ka * gut - (ke + k12) * central + k21 * peripheral
}

pub fn dcentral_unc(gut: f64, gut_unc: f64, central: f64, central_unc: f64,
                peripheral: f64, peripheral_unc: f64,
                ka: f64, ka_unc: f64, ke: f64, ke_unc: f64,
                k12: f64, k12_unc: f64, k21: f64, k21_unc: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    let u_kag = sim_sqrt((ka * gut_unc) * (ka * gut_unc) + (gut * ka_unc) * (gut * ka_unc))
    let kk = ke + k12
    let u_kkc = sim_sqrt(
        (central * ke_unc) * (central * ke_unc)
      + (central * k12_unc) * (central * k12_unc)
      + (kk * central_unc) * (kk * central_unc)
    )
    let u_k21p = sim_sqrt(
        (k21 * peripheral_unc) * (k21 * peripheral_unc)
      + (peripheral * k21_unc) * (peripheral * k21_unc)
    )
    return sim_sqrt(u_kag * u_kag + u_kkc * u_kkc + u_k21p * u_k21p)
}

fn dperipheral_val(central: f64, peripheral: f64, k12: f64, k21: f64) -> f64 {
    return k12 * central - k21 * peripheral
}

pub fn dperipheral_unc(central: f64, central_unc: f64, peripheral: f64, peripheral_unc: f64,
                   k12: f64, k12_unc: f64, k21: f64, k21_unc: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    let u_k12c = sim_sqrt(
        (k12 * central_unc) * (k12 * central_unc)
      + (central * k12_unc) * (central * k12_unc)
    )
    let u_k21p = sim_sqrt(
        (k21 * peripheral_unc) * (k21 * peripheral_unc)
      + (peripheral * k21_unc) * (peripheral * k21_unc)
    )
    return sim_sqrt(u_k12c * u_k12c + u_k21p * u_k21p)
}

fn delim_val(central: f64, ke: f64) -> f64 {
    return ke * central
}

pub fn delim_unc(central: f64, central_unc: f64, ke: f64, ke_unc: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    let t1 = ke * central_unc
    let t2 = central * ke_unc
    return sim_sqrt(t1 * t1 + t2 * t2)
}

// Build derivative state at the given state/params
pub fn deriv_at(st: PBPKState, ka: f64, ke: f64, k12: f64, k21: f64,
            ka_unc: f64, ke_unc: f64, k12_unc: f64, k21_unc: f64) -> PBPKState with Mut, Div {
    let dg = dgut_val(st.gut, ka)
    let dc = dcentral_val(st.gut, st.cen, st.peripheral, ka, ke, k12, k21)
    let dp = dperipheral_val(st.cen, st.peripheral, k12, k21)
    let de = delim_val(st.cen, ke)

    let ug = dgut_unc(st.gut, st.gut_unc, ka, ka_unc)
    let uc = dcentral_unc(
        st.gut, st.gut_unc, st.cen, st.central_unc,
        st.peripheral, st.peripheral_unc,
        ka, ka_unc, ke, ke_unc, k12, k12_unc, k21, k21_unc
    )
    let up = dperipheral_unc(
        st.cen, st.central_unc, st.peripheral, st.peripheral_unc,
        k12, k12_unc, k21, k21_unc
    )
    let ue = delim_unc(st.cen, st.central_unc, ke, ke_unc)

    PBPKState {
        gut: dg, cen: dc, peripheral: dp, eliminated: de,
        gut_unc: ug, central_unc: uc, peripheral_unc: up, eliminated_unc: ue,
        time: 0.0,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// RK4 STEP WITH GUM UNCERTAINTY PROPAGATION
//
// State: y_{n+1} = y_n + dt/6 * (k1 + 2*k2 + 2*k3 + k4)
//
// Uncertainty: u(y_{n+1})² ≈ u(y_n)² + (dt/6)² * (u_k1² + 4*u_k2² + 4*u_k3² + u_k4²)
// (uncorrelated derivative uncertainties — standard GUM assumption)
// ============================================================================

pub fn rk4_step_pbpk(st: PBPKState, dt: f64,
                 ka: f64, ke: f64, k12: f64, k21: f64,
                 ka_unc: f64, ke_unc: f64, k12_unc: f64, k21_unc: f64) -> PBPKState with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let k1 = deriv_at(st, ka, ke, k12, k21, ka_unc, ke_unc, k12_unc, k21_unc)

    let h = dt * 0.5
    let st2 = PBPKState {
        gut:            st.gut            + h * k1.gut,
        cen:            st.cen            + h * k1.cen,
        peripheral:     st.peripheral     + h * k1.peripheral,
        eliminated:     st.eliminated     + h * k1.eliminated,
        gut_unc:        st.gut_unc,
        central_unc:    st.central_unc,
        peripheral_unc: st.peripheral_unc,
        eliminated_unc: st.eliminated_unc,
        time:           st.time + h,
    }
    let k2 = deriv_at(st2, ka, ke, k12, k21, ka_unc, ke_unc, k12_unc, k21_unc)

    let st3 = PBPKState {
        gut:            st.gut            + h * k2.gut,
        cen:            st.cen            + h * k2.cen,
        peripheral:     st.peripheral     + h * k2.peripheral,
        eliminated:     st.eliminated     + h * k2.eliminated,
        gut_unc:        st.gut_unc,
        central_unc:    st.central_unc,
        peripheral_unc: st.peripheral_unc,
        eliminated_unc: st.eliminated_unc,
        time:           st.time + h,
    }
    let k3 = deriv_at(st3, ka, ke, k12, k21, ka_unc, ke_unc, k12_unc, k21_unc)

    let st4 = PBPKState {
        gut:            st.gut            + dt * k3.gut,
        cen:            st.cen            + dt * k3.cen,
        peripheral:     st.peripheral     + dt * k3.peripheral,
        eliminated:     st.eliminated     + dt * k3.eliminated,
        gut_unc:        st.gut_unc,
        central_unc:    st.central_unc,
        peripheral_unc: st.peripheral_unc,
        eliminated_unc: st.eliminated_unc,
        time:           st.time + dt,
    }
    let k4 = deriv_at(st4, ka, ke, k12, k21, ka_unc, ke_unc, k12_unc, k21_unc)

    let sixth = dt / 6.0
    let s2    = sixth * sixth

    let gut_new        = st.gut        + sixth * (k1.gut        + 2.0 * k2.gut        + 2.0 * k3.gut        + k4.gut)
    let central_new    = st.cen        + sixth * (k1.cen        + 2.0 * k2.cen        + 2.0 * k3.cen        + k4.cen)
    let peripheral_new = st.peripheral + sixth * (k1.peripheral + 2.0 * k2.peripheral + 2.0 * k3.peripheral + k4.peripheral)
    let eliminated_new = st.eliminated + sixth * (k1.eliminated + 2.0 * k2.eliminated + 2.0 * k3.eliminated + k4.eliminated)

    let gut_uvar = st.gut_unc * st.gut_unc + s2 * (
        k1.gut_unc * k1.gut_unc + 4.0 * k2.gut_unc * k2.gut_unc
      + 4.0 * k3.gut_unc * k3.gut_unc + k4.gut_unc * k4.gut_unc
    )
    let central_uvar = st.central_unc * st.central_unc + s2 * (
        k1.central_unc * k1.central_unc + 4.0 * k2.central_unc * k2.central_unc
      + 4.0 * k3.central_unc * k3.central_unc + k4.central_unc * k4.central_unc
    )
    let periph_uvar = st.peripheral_unc * st.peripheral_unc + s2 * (
        k1.peripheral_unc * k1.peripheral_unc + 4.0 * k2.peripheral_unc * k2.peripheral_unc
      + 4.0 * k3.peripheral_unc * k3.peripheral_unc + k4.peripheral_unc * k4.peripheral_unc
    )
    let elim_uvar = st.eliminated_unc * st.eliminated_unc + s2 * (
        k1.eliminated_unc * k1.eliminated_unc + 4.0 * k2.eliminated_unc * k2.eliminated_unc
      + 4.0 * k3.eliminated_unc * k3.eliminated_unc + k4.eliminated_unc * k4.eliminated_unc
    )

    PBPKState {
        gut:            gut_new,
        cen:            central_new,
        peripheral:     peripheral_new,
        eliminated:     eliminated_new,
        gut_unc:        sim_sqrt(gut_uvar),
        central_unc:    sim_sqrt(central_uvar),
        peripheral_unc: sim_sqrt(periph_uvar),
        eliminated_unc: sim_sqrt(elim_uvar),
        time:           st.time + dt,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN SIMULATION FUNCTION
// ============================================================================

pub fn pbpk_simulate(params: &PBPKParams, t_end: f64, n_steps: i32) -> PBPKResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let max_pts = 256
    let steps = if n_steps > max_pts { max_pts } else { n_steps }
    let steps_f = steps as f64
    let dt = t_end / steps_f

    // Extract scalar params to avoid reference-through-struct ABI issues
    let p_ka      = params.ka
    let p_ke      = params.ke
    let p_k12     = params.k12
    let p_k21     = params.k21
    let p_ka_unc  = params.ka_unc
    let p_ke_unc  = params.ke_unc
    let p_k12_unc = params.k12_unc
    let p_k21_unc = params.k21_unc
    let vd        = params.vd
    let vd_unc    = params.vd_unc
    let p_dose    = params.dose
    let p_dose_unc = params.dose_unc
    let p_bioa    = params.bioavailability
    let p_bioa_unc = params.bioavailability_unc

    var st = pbpk_state_initial(params)

    var time_pts: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var conc_pts: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var unc_pts:  [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]

    // t=0: concentration = central/Vd = 0 (all drug in gut initially)
    let conc0 = 0.0
    let unc0  = 0.0
    time_pts[0] = 0.0
    conc_pts[0] = conc0
    unc_pts[0]  = unc0

    var cmax     = conc0
    var cmax_unc = unc0
    var tmax     = 0.0
    var auc      = 0.0
    var auc_var  = 0.0
    var prev_c   = conc0
    var prev_u   = unc0

    var i = 1
    while i <= steps {
        st = rk4_step_pbpk(st, dt, p_ka, p_ke, p_k12, p_k21, p_ka_unc, p_ke_unc, p_k12_unc, p_k21_unc)

        let conc = st.cen / vd
        // u(C) = u(cen/Vd): GUM division by uncertain Vd
        let u_conc = sim_sqrt(
            (st.central_unc / vd) * (st.central_unc / vd)
          + (st.cen * vd_unc / (vd * vd)) * (st.cen * vd_unc / (vd * vd))
        )

        if i < max_pts {
            time_pts[i] = st.time
            conc_pts[i] = conc
            unc_pts[i]  = u_conc
        }

        if conc > cmax {
            cmax     = conc
            cmax_unc = u_conc
            tmax     = st.time
        }

        // Trapezoidal AUC
        let trap = (prev_c + conc) * 0.5 * dt
        let trap_var = (dt * 0.5) * (dt * 0.5) * (prev_u * prev_u + u_conc * u_conc)
        auc     = auc     + trap
        auc_var = auc_var + trap_var

        prev_c = conc
        prev_u = u_conc
        i = i + 1
    }

    let auc_result  = sim_gum_simple(auc, sim_sqrt(auc_var))
    let cmax_result = sim_gum_simple(cmax, cmax_unc)

    // Half-life = ln(2)/ke; u(t½) = ln(2) * u_ke / ke²
    let hl    = ln2() / p_ke
    let hl_u  = ln2() * p_ke_unc / (p_ke * p_ke)
    let hl_result = sim_gum_simple(hl, hl_u)

    // Clearance = dose*F / AUC
    let dose_f   = p_dose * p_bioa
    let u_dose_f = sim_sqrt(
        (p_bioa * p_dose_unc) * (p_bioa * p_dose_unc)
      + (p_dose * p_bioa_unc) * (p_dose * p_bioa_unc)
    )
    let cl_result = if auc > 1.0e-15 {
        let cl_val = dose_f / auc
        let cl_unc = sim_sqrt(
            (u_dose_f / auc) * (u_dose_f / auc)
          + (dose_f * sim_sqrt(auc_var) / (auc * auc)) * (dose_f * sim_sqrt(auc_var) / (auc * auc))
        )
        sim_gum_simple(cl_val, cl_unc)
    } else {
        sim_gum_simple(0.0, 0.0)
    }

    let n_pts = if steps + 1 < max_pts { steps + 1 } else { max_pts }

    PBPKResult {
        cmax: cmax_result,
        tmax: tmax,
        auc: auc_result,
        half_life: hl_result,
        clearance: cl_result,
        final_state: st,
        time_points: time_pts,
        concentrations: conc_pts,
        conc_uncertainties: unc_pts,
        n_points: n_pts,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// THERAPEUTIC WINDOW ANALYSIS
//
// effective_conc_low  = conc - 1.96 * u_conc  (lower 95% CI bound)
// effective_conc_high = conc + 1.96 * u_conc  (upper 95% CI bound)
//
// time_above_mec: duration where lower bound > mec (drug certainly therapeutic)
// time_below_mtc: duration where upper bound < mtc (drug certainly safe)
// ============================================================================

pub fn pbpk_therapeutic_window(result: &PBPKResult, mec: f64, mtc: f64) -> (f64, f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n = result.n_points
    if n < 2 {
        return (0.0, 0.0)
    }

    var time_above_mec = 0.0
    var time_below_mtc = 0.0

    var idx = 1
    while idx < n {
        let t0 = result.time_points[idx - 1]
        let t1 = result.time_points[idx]
        let dt_seg = t1 - t0
        if dt_seg < 1.0e-15 {
            idx = idx + 1
            continue
        }

        let c0    = result.concentrations[idx - 1]
        let u0    = result.conc_uncertainties[idx - 1]
        let c1    = result.concentrations[idx]
        let u1    = result.conc_uncertainties[idx]
        let c_mid = (c0 + c1) * 0.5
        let u_mid = (u0 + u1) * 0.5

        let c_low  = c_mid - 1.96 * u_mid
        let c_high = c_mid + 1.96 * u_mid

        if c_low > mec {
            time_above_mec = time_above_mec + dt_seg
        }
        if c_high < mtc {
            time_below_mtc = time_below_mtc + dt_seg
        }

        idx = idx + 1
    }

    return (time_above_mec, time_below_mtc)
}


// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/export/brain_plasma_measurements.sio ===
// darwin_pbpk/export/brain_plasma_measurements.sio — measurement-table export
//
// Emits a compact PEtab-style measurement table for the canonical
// brain/plasma trajectory workflow.

use darwin_pbpk::brain_plasma_tac::*
use io::scientific::{sci_print_f64}

// Clamp sub-precision residuals to 0.0 at print time: enforces the
// physical invariant c >= 0 for reported concentrations (suppresses
// IEEE negative zero and tiny-negative RK step artifacts) without
// corrupting the upstream finite-difference uncertainty propagation
// that needs the unclamped tail values.
fn bpm_clamp_eps(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ax = if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
    if ax < 1.0e-12 { 0.0 } else { x }
}

pub fn print_brain_plasma_measurements_csv(table: BrainPlasmaTacTable) with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    println("observableId,simulationConditionId,time,measurement,measurementUncertainty")

    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < table.n_points {
        let idx = i as usize

        print("blood_plasma,rapamycin_iv_bolus_ref,")
        sci_print_f64(table.times_h[idx], 6)
        print(",")
        sci_print_f64(bpm_clamp_eps(table.blood_values[idx]), 6)
        print(",")
        sci_print_f64(table.blood_uncertainties[idx], 6)
        println("")

        print("brain_tissue,rapamycin_iv_bolus_ref,")
        sci_print_f64(table.times_h[idx], 6)
        print(",")
        sci_print_f64(bpm_clamp_eps(table.brain_values[idx]), 6)
        print(",")
        sci_print_f64(table.brain_uncertainties[idx], 6)
        println("")

        i = i + 1
    }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/export/petab_conditions.sio ===
// darwin_pbpk/export/petab_conditions.sio — PEtab-style condition table

use io::scientific::{sci_print_f64}

pub fn print_rapamycin_petab_conditions_csv() with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    println("conditionId,dose_mg_per_kg,route,compound,targetCompartment")
    print("rapamycin_iv_bolus_ref,")
    sci_print_f64(1.0, 6)
    println(",iv_bolus,rapamycin,blood")
}


// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/export/petab_measurements.sio ===
// darwin_pbpk/export/petab_measurements.sio — PEtab-style measurements table

use darwin_pbpk::schema::observation::*
use io::scientific::{sci_print_f64}

pub fn print_petab_measurements_csv(
    table: NormalizedObservationTable
) with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    println("observableId,simulationConditionId,time,measurement,measurementUncertainty")

    var i: usize = 0
    while i < normalized_observation_count(table) {
        let row = normalized_observation_get(table, i)
        print(row.observable_id)
        print(",")
        print(row.simulation_condition_id)
        print(",")
        sci_print_f64(row.time_h, 6)
        print(",")
        sci_print_f64(row.measurement, 6)
        print(",")
        sci_print_f64(row.measurement_uncertainty, 6)
        println("")
        i = i + 1
    }
}

    println("observableId,observableFormula,noiseFormula,observableName")
    println("blood_plasma,blood_plasma_concentration,sigma_blood_plasma,Blood plasma concentration")
    println("brain_tissue,brain_tissue_concentration,sigma_brain_tissue,Brain tissue concentration")
}


// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/export/petab_parameters.sio ===
// darwin_pbpk/export/petab_parameters.sio — PEtab-style parameters table

use darwin_pbpk::epistemic_pbpk14::{ep14_rapamycin_priors}
use io::scientific::{sci_print_f64}

fn ppar_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 12 {
        y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
        i = i + 1
    }
    y
}

fn petab_param_name(idx: i32) -> string {
    if idx == 0 { return "cl_hepatic" }
    if idx == 1 { return "cl_renal" }
    if idx == 2 { return "fu_plasma" }
    if idx == 3 { return "kp_brain" }
    if idx == 4 { return "kp_liver" }
    if idx == 5 { return "kp_kidney" }
    if idx == 6 { return "kp_adipose" }
    "param_unknown"
}

fn petab_lower_bound(idx: i32, mean: f64, sd: f64) -> f64 {
    var lower = mean - 3.0 * sd
    if idx == 2 {
        if lower < 0.0 { lower = 0.0 }
    } else {
        if lower < 0.000001 { lower = 0.000001 }
    }
    lower
}

fn petab_upper_bound(idx: i32, mean: f64, sd: f64) -> f64 {
    var upper = mean + 3.0 * sd
    if idx == 2 && upper > 1.0 {
        upper = 1.0
    }
    if upper < mean {
        upper = mean
    }
    upper
}

pub fn print_rapamycin_petab_parameters_csv() with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let priors = ep14_rapamycin_priors()
    println("parameterId,nominalValue,estimate,lowerBound,upperBound")

    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < priors.n {
        let idx = i as usize
        let mean = priors.mean[idx]
        let sd = ppar_sqrt(priors.variance[idx])

        print(petab_param_name(i))
        print(",")
        sci_print_f64(mean, 6)
        print(",1,")
        sci_print_f64(petab_lower_bound(i, mean, sd), 6)
        print(",")
        sci_print_f64(petab_upper_bound(i, mean, sd), 6)
        println("")

        i = i + 1
    }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/fit/objective.sio ===
// darwin_pbpk/fit/objective.sio — objective summary for TAC calibration

use darwin_pbpk::brain_plasma_tac::*
use darwin_pbpk::fit::problem::*
use darwin_pbpk::fit::residuals::{CalibrationResidualTable, calibration_residuals}

pub struct CalibrationObjective {
    n_points: i32,
    sse: f64,
    chi2: f64,
    rmse: f64,
    mean_abs_weighted_residual: f64,
    success: bool,
}

fn obj_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 12 {
        y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
        i = i + 1
    }
    y
}

fn obj_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

pub fn calibration_objective_from_residuals(
    residuals: CalibrationResidualTable
) -> CalibrationObjective with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if residuals.success == false || residuals.overflowed {
        return CalibrationObjective {
            n_points: 0,
            sse: 0.0,
            chi2: 0.0,
            rmse: 0.0,
            mean_abs_weighted_residual: 0.0,
            success: false,
        }
    }

    var sse = 0.0
    var chi2 = 0.0
    var abs_weighted = 0.0
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < residuals.count {
        let residual = residuals.residuals[i]
        let weighted = residuals.weighted_residuals[i]
        sse = sse + residual * residual
        chi2 = chi2 + weighted * weighted
        abs_weighted = abs_weighted + obj_abs(weighted)
        i = i + 1
    }

    let n = residuals.count as i32
    let n_f = n as f64
    let rmse = if n > 0 { obj_sqrt(sse / n_f) } else { 0.0 }
    let mean_abs_weighted = if n > 0 { abs_weighted / n_f } else { 0.0 }

    CalibrationObjective {
        n_points: n,
        sse: sse,
        chi2: chi2,
        rmse: rmse,
        mean_abs_weighted_residual: mean_abs_weighted,
        success: true,
    }
}

pub fn calibration_objective(
    problem: CalibrationProblem,
    tac: BrainPlasmaTacTable
) -> CalibrationObjective with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let residuals = calibration_residuals(problem, tac)
    calibration_objective_from_residuals(residuals)
}


// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/fit/problem.sio ===
// darwin_pbpk/fit/problem.sio — calibration problem definition

use darwin_pbpk::schema::observation::*

pub struct CalibrationProblem {
    observations: NormalizedObservationTable,
    simulation_condition_id: string,
}

pub fn calibration_problem_new(
    observations: NormalizedObservationTable,
    simulation_condition_id: string
) -> CalibrationProblem {
    CalibrationProblem {
        observations: observations,
        simulation_condition_id: simulation_condition_id,
    }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/fit/residuals.sio ===
// darwin_pbpk/fit/residuals.sio — residual evaluation against TAC predictions

use darwin_pbpk::brain_plasma_tac::*
use darwin_pbpk::fit::problem::*
use darwin_pbpk::io::mapping::{map_observation_prediction}
use darwin_pbpk::schema::observation::{normalized_observation_count, normalized_observation_get}

pub struct CalibrationResidualRow {
    observable_id: string,
    time_h: f64,
    measurement: f64,
    prediction: f64,
    sigma: f64,
    residual: f64,
    weighted_residual: f64,
}

pub struct CalibrationResidualTable {
    observable_ids: [string; 128],
    times_h: [f64; 128],
    measurements: [f64; 128],
    predictions: [f64; 128],
    sigmas: [f64; 128],
    residuals: [f64; 128],
    weighted_residuals: [f64; 128],
    count: usize,
    success: bool,
    overflowed: bool,
}

fn residual_table_new() -> CalibrationResidualTable with Mut {
    CalibrationResidualTable {
        observable_ids: [""; 128],
        times_h: [0.0; 128],
        measurements: [0.0; 128],
        predictions: [0.0; 128],
        sigmas: [0.0; 128],
        residuals: [0.0; 128],
        weighted_residuals: [0.0; 128],
        count: 0,
        success: false,
        overflowed: false,
    }
}

fn residual_table_add(
    table: CalibrationResidualTable,
    observable_id: string,
    time_h: f64,
    measurement: f64,
    prediction: f64,
    sigma: f64,
    residual: f64,
    weighted_residual: f64
) -> CalibrationResidualTable with Mut {
    var out = table
    if out.count >= 128 {
        out.overflowed = true
        return out
    }

    let idx = out.count
    out.observable_ids[idx] = observable_id
    out.times_h[idx] = time_h
    out.measurements[idx] = measurement
    out.predictions[idx] = prediction
    out.sigmas[idx] = sigma
    out.residuals[idx] = residual
    out.weighted_residuals[idx] = weighted_residual
    out.count = idx + 1
    out
}

fn residual_sigma(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x > 1.0e-12 { x } else { 1.0 }
}

pub fn calibration_residuals(
    problem: CalibrationProblem,
    tac: BrainPlasmaTacTable
) -> CalibrationResidualTable with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var out = residual_table_new()
    if tac.success == false {
        return out
    }

    var i: usize = 0
    while i < normalized_observation_count(problem.observations) {
        let obs = normalized_observation_get(problem.observations, i)
        let prediction = map_observation_prediction(tac, obs)
        let sigma = residual_sigma(obs.measurement_uncertainty)
        let residual = prediction - obs.measurement
        let weighted = residual / sigma

        out = residual_table_add(
            out,
            obs.observable_id,
            obs.time_h,
            obs.measurement,
            prediction,
            sigma,
            residual,
            weighted
        )
        i = i + 1
    }

    out.success = true
    out
}


// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/io/mapping.sio ===
// darwin_pbpk/io/mapping.sio — map normalized observations onto TAC predictions

use darwin_pbpk::brain_plasma_tac::*
use darwin_pbpk::schema::observation::*

fn map_linear(t0: f64, y0: f64, t1: f64, y1: f64, t: f64) -> f64 with Div, Panic {
    let dt = t1 - t0
    if dt == 0.0 {
        return y0
    }
    y0 + (y1 - y0) * (t - t0) / dt
}

fn map_series_value(
    times: [f64; 16],
    values: [f64; 16],
    n_points: i32,
    time_h: f64
) -> f64 with Div, Panic {
    if n_points <= 0 {
        return 0.0
    }
    if time_h <= times[0] {
        return values[0]
    }

    let last_idx = (n_points - 1) as usize
    if time_h >= times[last_idx] {
        return values[last_idx]
    }

    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < n_points - 1 {
        let idx0 = i as usize
        let idx1 = (i + 1) as usize
        let t0 = times[idx0]
        let t1 = times[idx1]
        if time_h >= t0 && time_h <= t1 {
            return map_linear(t0, values[idx0], t1, values[idx1], time_h)
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    values[last_idx]
}

pub fn map_observation_prediction(
    tac: BrainPlasmaTacTable,
    row: NormalizedObservationRow
) -> f64 with Div, Panic {
    if row.observable_id == "brain_tissue" {
