pub fn normalized_observation_count(table: NormalizedObservationTable) -> usize {
    table.count
}

pub fn normalized_observation_table_add(
    table: NormalizedObservationTable,
    subject_id: string,
    simulation_condition_id: string,
    observable_id: string,
    time_h: f64,
    measurement: f64,
    measurement_uncertainty: f64,
    value_unit: string,
    matrix: string,
    organ: string,
    compartment: string,
    assay: string,
    source: string
) -> NormalizedObservationTable with Mut {
    var out = table
    if out.count >= 128 {
        out.overflowed = true
        return out
    }

    let idx = out.count
    out.subject_ids[idx] = subject_id
    out.simulation_condition_ids[idx] = simulation_condition_id
    out.observable_ids[idx] = observable_id
    out.times_h[idx] = time_h
    out.measurements[idx] = measurement
    out.measurement_uncertainties[idx] = measurement_uncertainty
    out.value_units[idx] = value_unit
    out.matrices[idx] = matrix
    out.organs[idx] = organ
    out.compartments[idx] = compartment
    out.assays[idx] = assay
    out.sources[idx] = source
    out.count = idx + 1
    out
}

pub fn normalized_observation_get(
    table: NormalizedObservationTable,
    idx: usize
) -> NormalizedObservationRow with Panic {
    NormalizedObservationRow {
        subject_id: table.subject_ids[idx],
        simulation_condition_id: table.simulation_condition_ids[idx],
        observable_id: table.observable_ids[idx],
        time_h: table.times_h[idx],
        measurement: table.measurements[idx],
        measurement_uncertainty: table.measurement_uncertainties[idx],
        value_unit: table.value_units[idx],
        matrix: table.matrices[idx],
        organ: table.organs[idx],
        compartment: table.compartments[idx],
        assay: table.assays[idx],
        source: table.sources[idx],
    }
}

pub fn normalized_observation_table_concat(
    left: NormalizedObservationTable,
    right: NormalizedObservationTable
) -> NormalizedObservationTable with Mut, Panic {
    var out = normalized_observation_table_new()

    var i: usize = 0
    while i < normalized_observation_count(left) {
        let row = normalized_observation_get(left, i)
        out = normalized_observation_table_add(
            out,
            row.subject_id,
            row.simulation_condition_id,
            row.observable_id,
            row.time_h,
            row.measurement,
            row.measurement_uncertainty,
            row.value_unit,
            row.matrix,
            row.organ,
            row.compartment,
            row.assay,
            row.source
        )
        i = i + 1
    }

    var j: usize = 0
    while j < normalized_observation_count(right) {
        let row = normalized_observation_get(right, j)
        out = normalized_observation_table_add(
            out,
            row.subject_id,
            row.simulation_condition_id,
            row.observable_id,
            row.time_h,
            row.measurement,
            row.measurement_uncertainty,
            row.value_unit,
            row.matrix,
            row.organ,
            row.compartment,
            row.assay,
            row.source
        )
        j = j + 1
    }

    if left.overflowed || right.overflowed {
        out.overflowed = true
    }
    out
}


// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/simulation.sio ===
// simulation.sio — Darwin PBPK simulation module
// Rewritten in Sounio syntax

fn dpbpk_simulation_exp(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i < 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); result = result + term; i = i + 1 }
    result
}

fn dpbpk_simulation_abs(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }
fn dpbpk_simulation_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }
fn dpbpk_simulation_min(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }
fn dpbpk_simulation_clamp(x: f64, lo: f64, hi: f64) -> f64 { if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x } }

struct Simulation_State {
    concentration: f64,
    flow_in: f64,
    flow_out: f64,
    volume: f64,
    kp: f64,
}

fn simulation_state_new(vol: f64, kp: f64) -> Simulation_State {
    Simulation_State { concentration: 0.0, flow_in: 0.0, flow_out: 0.0, volume: vol, kp: kp }
}

fn simulation_compute_flux(c_arterial: f64, c_tissue: f64, kp: f64, blood_flow: f64) -> f64 {
    blood_flow * (c_arterial - c_tissue / kp)
}

fn simulation_update(state: Simulation_State, c_arterial: f64, blood_flow: f64, dt: f64) -> Simulation_State with Div, Panic, Mut {
    let flux = simulation_compute_flux(c_arterial, state.concentration, state.kp, blood_flow)
    var new_state = state
    new_state.concentration = state.concentration + dt * flux / state.volume
    if new_state.concentration < 0.0 { new_state.concentration = 0.0 }
    new_state.flow_in = dpbpk_simulation_max(flux, 0.0)
    new_state.flow_out = dpbpk_simulation_abs(dpbpk_simulation_min(flux, 0.0))
    new_state
}

fn test_simulation_flux_positive() -> bool with Div, Panic, Mut {
    let flux = simulation_compute_flux(10.0, 5.0, 2.0, 90.0)
    flux > 0.0
}

fn test_simulation_zero_init() -> bool {
    let s = simulation_state_new(1.5, 5.0)
    s.concentration == 0.0 && s.volume == 1.5
}


// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/simulation_real.sio ===
// darwin_pbpk::simulation_real — executable PBPK reference-case pipeline.
//
// This module provides a deterministic real-execution wrapper on the active
// tsit5 PBPK surface for fail-closed science gating.

use tsit5_pbpk14::*;

struct SimulationResult {
    cmax: f64,
    auc: f64,
    half_life: f64,
    clearance: f64,
    vdss: f64,
    final_state: PBPKState14,
    success: bool,
}

fn simulation_result_empty() -> SimulationResult {
    SimulationResult {
        cmax: 0.0,
        auc: 0.0,
        half_life: 0.0,
        clearance: 0.0,
        vdss: 0.0,
        final_state: pbpk_state_zero(),
        success: false,
    }
}

struct PbpkInvariantReport {
    non_negative_state: bool,
    finite_outputs: bool,
    route_constraints_ok: bool,
    success: bool,
}

fn pbpk_invariant_report_empty() -> PbpkInvariantReport {
    PbpkInvariantReport {
        non_negative_state: false,
        finite_outputs: false,
        route_constraints_ok: false,
        success: false,
    }
}

fn pbpk_total_volume(prm: PBPKParams14) -> f64 {
    prm.v_blood + prm.v_liver + prm.v_kidney + prm.v_brain + prm.v_heart + prm.v_lung +
    prm.v_muscle + prm.v_adipose + prm.v_gut + prm.v_skin + prm.v_bone + prm.v_spleen +
    prm.v_pancreas + prm.v_other
}

fn finite_like(x: f64) -> bool {
    // NaN check: NaN is the only value not equal to itself.
    if x != x {
        return false
    }
    let ax = abs_f64(x)
    ax < 1e12
}

fn state_non_negative(st: PBPKState14) -> bool {
    st.blood >= 0.0 && st.liver >= 0.0 && st.kidney >= 0.0 && st.brain >= 0.0 &&
    st.heart >= 0.0 && st.lung >= 0.0 && st.muscle >= 0.0 && st.adipose >= 0.0 &&
    st.gut >= 0.0 && st.skin >= 0.0 && st.bone >= 0.0 && st.spleen >= 0.0 &&
    st.pancreas >= 0.0 && st.other >= 0.0
}

fn state_finite(st: PBPKState14) -> bool {
    finite_like(st.blood) && finite_like(st.liver) && finite_like(st.kidney) && finite_like(st.brain) &&
    finite_like(st.heart) && finite_like(st.lung) && finite_like(st.muscle) && finite_like(st.adipose) &&
    finite_like(st.gut) && finite_like(st.skin) && finite_like(st.bone) && finite_like(st.spleen) &&
    finite_like(st.pancreas) && finite_like(st.other)
}

fn run_pbpk_reference_case(case_id: i32) -> SimulationResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if case_id != 1 {
        return simulation_result_empty()
    }

    let prm = default_pbpk_params()
    let t_end = 24.0
    let dose = 500.0
    let dt = 0.05

    var st = pbpk_state_zero()
    st.blood = dose / prm.v_blood

    var t = 0.0
    var cmax = st.blood
    var auc = 0.0
    var c_prev = st.blood

    while t < t_end {
        let dt_use = if t + dt > t_end { t_end - t } else { dt }
        let step = tsit5_step_pbpk(st, t, dt_use, prm)
        let st_next = step.state_new
        let c_now = st_next.blood

        if c_now > cmax {
            cmax = c_now
        }

        auc = auc + ((c_prev + c_now) / 2.0) * dt_use
        c_prev = c_now

        st = st_next
        t = t + dt_use
    }

    let clearance = if auc > 1e-12 { dose / auc } else { 0.0 }
    let vdss = pbpk_total_volume(prm)
    let half_life = if clearance > 1e-12 {
        0.693 * vdss / clearance
    } else {
        0.0
    }

    SimulationResult {
        cmax: cmax,
        auc: auc,
        half_life: half_life,
        clearance: clearance,
        vdss: vdss,
        final_state: st,
        success: cmax > 0.0 && auc > 0.0 && clearance > 0.0,
    }
}

fn pbpk_invariant_report(result: SimulationResult) -> PbpkInvariantReport with Mut {
    var out = pbpk_invariant_report_empty()

    out.non_negative_state = state_non_negative(result.final_state)
    out.finite_outputs =
        finite_like(result.cmax) && finite_like(result.auc) && finite_like(result.half_life) &&
        finite_like(result.clearance) && finite_like(result.vdss) && state_finite(result.final_state)

    // Reference case 1 is IV bolus: concentration should not increase above Cmax at end.
    out.route_constraints_ok = result.cmax >= result.final_state.blood && result.final_state.blood >= 0.0

    out.success = result.success && out.non_negative_state && out.finite_outputs && out.route_constraints_ok
    out
}


// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/theta_pbpk28.sio ===
// stdlib/darwin_pbpk/theta_pbpk28.sio — clamp-free θ-method PBPK28 step,
// Rannacher start-up, and an exact mass ledger
//
// Why this module exists
// ----------------------
// `pbpk28_full_cn_step` (tsit5_pbpk28.sio) is Crank–Nicolson: A-stable, not
// L-stable. Its amplification factor R(z) = (1 − z)/(1 + z) tends to −1 as
// z = (dt/2)·λ grows, and the PBPK28 vascular↔interstitial exchange blocks are
// very stiff ((Q+PS)/V_v up to ~4·10⁴ /h). After a non-smooth event — an IV
// bolus, or an input switching on from a zero state — those modes ring with
// alternating sign and drive compartments negative. The kernel's
// `if c < 0 { 0 }` floors then add mass that was never dosed: 50 mg in a closed
// system becomes 89.1 mg after 8 steps at dt = 0.5 h
// (docs/audit/PBPK28_CN_RANNACHER_MASS_BALANCE_2026-09-26.md).
//
// That kernel is left untouched: its parity gates and golden outputs depend
// on it bit for bit. This module is the corrected path for consumers that
// step at production dt.
//
// The θ-method
// ------------
// For the linear system ẋ = A·x + b (blood row + 13 × 2×2 organ blocks,
// arrow-shaped), one θ-step of length dt is
//     (I − θ·dt·A)·x_{n+1} = (I + (1−θ)·dt·A)·x_n + dt·b
// θ = 1/2 is Crank–Nicolson (the published kernel's algebra); θ = 1 is
// backward Euler (L-stable, R(∞) = 0). The implicit solve is the same
// per-organ Schur elimination as `pbpk28_full_cn_step_mut` with the implicit
// weight h_i = θ·dt and the explicit weight h_e = (1−θ)·dt in place of the
// shared h = dt/2.
//
// No negativity floor. Under the volume weights W every Q- and PS-coupling
// column of A telescopes, leaving only the blood elimination and the organ
// sink, so ANY θ-step conserves
//     M_{n+1} = M_n + dt·rel − cl_central·dt·(θ·C_b,n+1 + (1−θ)·C_b,n)
//                              − cl_sink·dt·(θ·C_avg,k,n+1 + (1−θ)·C_avg,k,n)
// to rounding. A floor is a non-conservative projection and breaks that
// identity; it is therefore absent here. Any negative concentration the step
// produces is BOOKED in the ledger, never repaired: `min_conc` / `neg_mass`
// cover every returned state (the state a caller sees after each θ,
// Rannacher or TR-BDF2 step), and `stage_min_conc` / `stage_neg_mass` cover
// TR-BDF2's internal stage x_γ, which is not returned but does enter the AUC,
// elimination and sink quadrature. The gates (`pbpk28_mass_gate_ok`,
// `pbpk28_bolus_run_mut`) test the returned-state fields.
//
// Rannacher start-up (Rannacher 1984; Giles & Carter 2006)
// --------------------------------------------------------
// Right after a dosing event, replace the CN step by two backward-Euler half
// steps. Backward Euler damps the stiff modes the non-smooth data excites
// (R → 0 instead of −1); CN then carries the smooth remainder at second order.
// The caller decides which steps are start-up steps (`startup = true` for the
// `pbpk28_rannacher_startup_steps()` steps after each bolus / input switch-on).
// After the start-up the step is plain CN again, so a stiff mode re-excited
// away from any dosing event (e.g. by a strong organ sink on a smooth tail)
// rings again: use the L-stable TR-BDF2 step below for such problems.
//
// Quadrature: the ledger accumulates ∫C dt with the method's OWN weights
// (dt·(θ·C_{n+1} + (1−θ)·C_n)). For CN that is the trapezoid; for a
// backward-Euler half step it is the right-endpoint rule. Using the trapezoid
// across a backward-Euler sub-step would break M(T) + CL·AUC = Dose.
//
// Madaros multimodule native workarounds carried over from tsit5_pbpk28.sio
// (docs/audit/MADAROS_IMPORTED_PBPK28_CN_SIGSEGV_2026-08-16.md): state is
// advanced in place through `&!`, and every second loop over a local
// `[f64; 14]` lives in its own function behind a `&[f64; 14]` parameter.
//
// Literature (cited from the author's knowledge; verify before quoting):
//   Rannacher R. Finite element solution of diffusion problems with irregular
//     data. Numer. Math. 43 (1984) 309–327.
//   Giles MB, Carter R. Convergence analysis of Crank–Nicolson and Rannacher
//     time-marching. J. Comput. Finance 9(4) (2006) 89–112.
//   Shampine LF. Conservation laws and the numerical solution of ODEs.
//     Comput. Math. Appl. 12B (1986) 1287–1296.

use darwin_pbpk::core::pbpk28_params::*

// Running mass account for one PBPK28 state advanced by the steps below.
// Every flow is integrated with the stepping method's own quadrature, so
//     pbpk28_total_mass(state) + eliminated + sink_removed − administered
// equals the initial body mass to rounding (`pbpk28_ledger_residual`).
pub struct PBPK28Ledger {
    pub administered: f64,       // Σ dt·rel_mid into blood (mg)
    pub eliminated:   f64,       // cl_central · ∫C_b dt (mg)
    pub sink_removed: f64,       // cl_sink · ∫C_avg,k dt (mg), organ sink
    pub auc:          [f64; 14], // ∫C_avg,i dt (mg·h/L); i = 0 is blood
    pub min_conc:     f64,       // most negative concentration of any returned state (≤ 0)
    pub neg_mass:     f64,       // largest Σ V·min(C, 0) magnitude of any returned state (mg)
    pub stage_min_conc: f64,     // same, for TR-BDF2's internal stage x_γ (≤ 0)
    pub stage_neg_mass: f64,     // same, for TR-BDF2's internal stage x_γ (mg)
    pub rejected_input: f64,     // Σ dt·rel_mid refused by a routed step (mg); see p28t_route_rejected
    pub steps:        i32,       // θ sub-steps taken
}

pub fn pbpk28_ledger_zero() -> PBPK28Ledger {
    PBPK28Ledger {
        administered: 0.0,
        eliminated:   0.0,
        sink_removed: 0.0,
        auc:          [0.0; 14],
        min_conc:     0.0,
        neg_mass:     0.0,
        stage_min_conc: 0.0,
        stage_neg_mass: 0.0,
        rejected_input: 0.0,
        steps:        0,
    }
}

// Routed input into a vascular space below the degenerate-volume floor is
// refused. The step divides the forcing by the floored 1e-30 while
// pbpk28_total_mass / p28t_organ_avgs weigh C_v by the raw V_i·f_v,i, so
// the space holds (almost) no mass. Measured 2026-09-27 before this refusal
// (venlafaxine parent, liver f_v = 0, 3 mg/h for 8 Rannacher steps of
// 0.5 h, 12 mg booked): with the liver's Q and PS the implicit solve passed
// the input straight on to blood and tissue and the identity closed
// (residual -1.8e-13 mg); with Q = PS = 0 it had nowhere to go and all
// 12 mg were lost (body mass 0, residual -12 mg). A zero-volume space is not
// a meaningful administration target either way, so the step injects
// nothing, books dt·rel_mid as `rejected_input` instead of `administered`
// (the identity then closes in both cases), and pbpk28_mass_gate_ok fails
// on any rejected input.
fn p28t_route_rejected(p: PBPKParams28, input_organ: i32) -> bool {
    if input_organ < 1 || input_organ >= 14 { return false }
    let vv_raw = p.v_ref[input_organ] * p.vasc_frac[input_organ]
    return !(vv_raw >= 1.0e-30)
}

// Organ-average concentrations C_avg,i = (V_v·C_v + V_t·C_t)/V_i into `*out`
// (blood: C_v[0]). Same volumes as `pbpk28_organ_average` / `pbpk28_total_mass`.
fn p28t_organ_avgs(s: &PBPKState28, p: PBPKParams28, out: &![f64; 14]) with Mut, Div {
    (*out)[0] = (*s).cv[0]
    var i: i32 = 1
    while i < 14 {
        let vi = p.v_ref[i]
        let vf = p.vasc_frac[i]
        let vv = vi * vf
        let vt = vi * (1.0 - vf)
        (*out)[i] = (vv * (*s).cv[i] + vt * (*s).ct[i]) / vi
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Reconstruct the new state from the Schur coefficients. No floor: see header.
fn p28t_apply_schur(
    state: &!PBPKState28,
    cb_new: f64,
    a_v: &[f64; 14],
    b_v: &[f64; 14],
    a_t: &[f64; 14],
    b_t: &[f64; 14]
) with Mut, Div {
    (*state).cv[0] = cb_new
    var i: i32 = 1
    while i < 14 {
        (*state).cv[i] = (*a_v)[i] + (*b_v)[i] * cb_new
        (*state).ct[i] = (*a_t)[i] + (*b_t)[i] * cb_new
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Add w · C_avg to every organ AUC and the matching elimination / organ-sink
// mass to the ledger. `w` is one quadrature weight times the step length.
// Returns the sink mass booked (0.0 when sink_organ is outside 1..13).
fn p28t_accum(
    ledger: &!PBPK28Ledger,
    avgs: &[f64; 14],
    w: f64,
    cl_central: f64,
    sink_organ: i32,
    cl_sink: f64
) -> f64 with Mut {
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 14 {
        (*ledger).auc[i] = (*ledger).auc[i] + w * (*avgs)[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    (*ledger).eliminated = (*ledger).eliminated + cl_central * (w * (*avgs)[0])
    var sink = 0.0
    if sink_organ >= 1 && sink_organ < 14 {
        sink = cl_sink * (w * (*avgs)[sink_organ])
    }
    (*ledger).sink_removed = (*ledger).sink_removed + sink
    return sink
}

// Book any negative concentration in `*state` (no repair: see header).
fn p28t_negativity(ledger: &!PBPK28Ledger, state: &PBPKState28, p: PBPKParams28) with Mut {
    var neg = 0.0
    var cmin = (*ledger).min_conc
    let cb = (*state).cv[0]
    if cb < 0.0 {
        neg = neg + p.v_ref[0] * cb
        if cb < cmin { cmin = cb }
    }
    var i: i32 = 1
    while i < 14 {
        let vi = p.v_ref[i]
        let vf = p.vasc_frac[i]
        let cv = (*state).cv[i]
        let ct = (*state).ct[i]
        if cv < 0.0 {
            neg = neg + vi * vf * cv
            if cv < cmin { cmin = cv }
        }
        if ct < 0.0 {
            neg = neg + vi * (1.0 - vf) * ct
            if ct < cmin { cmin = ct }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    (*ledger).min_conc = cmin
    let neg_abs = 0.0 - neg
    if neg_abs > (*ledger).neg_mass { (*ledger).neg_mass = neg_abs }
}

// One clamp-free θ-step with an optional first-order organ sink
// (flux = cl_sink · C_avg,k on organ k = sink_organ ∈ 1..13; any other
// sink_organ, or cl_sink ≤ 0, means no sink) and an optional input route.
// The sink enters organ k's 2×2 block with rate k_s = cl_sink / V_k on both
// C_v,k and C_t,k: implicit diagonal +θ·dt·k_s, explicit diagonal
// −(1−θ)·dt·k_s. The input `rel_mid` (mg/h, held over the step) enters blood
// when `input_organ` is outside 1..13, otherwise the vascular space of organ
// `input_organ` (e.g. the liver for portal first-pass): the forcing term
// dt·rel_mid/V moves from the blood row to that organ's vascular row. It is
// forcing, not a rate, so it is not θ-weighted, and 1ᵀ·W·b = rel_mid
// wherever it lands, so the ledger identity is unchanged -- except into a
// vascular space below the degenerate-volume floor, where the input is
// refused and booked as `rejected_input` (p28t_route_rejected). Advances `*state`,
// books the step into `*ledger`, and returns the sink mass (mg) removed over
// the step.
pub fn pbpk28_theta_step_routed_sink_mut(
    state: &!PBPKState28,
    p: PBPKParams28,
    rel_mid: f64,
    input_organ: i32,
    dt: f64,
    theta: f64,
    sink_organ: i32,
    cl_sink: f64,
    ledger: &!PBPK28Ledger
) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    var old_avg: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    p28t_organ_avgs(state, p, &!old_avg)

    var a_v: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var b_v: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var a_t: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var b_t: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    let hi = theta * dt
    let he = (1.0 - theta) * dt
    let vb = p.v_ref[0]
    let has_sink = sink_organ >= 1 && sink_organ < 14 && cl_sink > 0.0
    let routed = input_organ >= 1 && input_organ < 14
    let reject_input = p28t_route_rejected(p, input_organ)

    var sum_q = 0.0
    var i: i32 = 1
    while i < 14 {
        sum_q = sum_q + p.q[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    // Blood-row out-rate (Σ Q + CL)/V_b.
    let k0 = (sum_q + p.cl_central) / vb
    let big_s = hi * k0

    let cb_old = (*state).cv[0]
    // Unrouted: exactly the sink/input-free expression, so the wrappers below
    // stay bit-identical to the pre-routing step.
    var rhs0 = if routed { (1.0 - he * k0) * cb_old } else { (1.0 - he * k0) * cb_old + dt * rel_mid / vb }

    var sum_beta_a = 0.0
    var sum_beta_b = 0.0

    i = 1
    while i < 14 {
        let vi = p.v_ref[i]
        let vf = p.vasc_frac[i]
        let vv_raw = vi * vf
        let vt_raw = vi * (1.0 - vf)
        // Same degenerate-volume floor as the CN kernel (parity-gate case 2).
        let vv = if vv_raw < 1.0e-30 { 1.0e-30 } else { vv_raw }
        let vt = if vt_raw < 1.0e-30 { 1.0e-30 } else { vt_raw }
        let kp = p.kp[i]
        let ps = p.ps[i]
        let qi = p.q[i]
        let ks = if has_sink && i == sink_organ { cl_sink / vi } else { 0.0 }

        let kv  = (qi + ps) / vv      // vascular out-rate
        let kvt = ps / (vv * kp)      // tissue → vascular
        let ktv = ps / vt             // vascular → tissue
        let kt  = ps / (vt * kp)      // tissue out-rate

        let beta_i  = hi * qi / vb
        let gamma_i = hi * qi / vv
        let pp  = 1.0 + hi * (kv + ks)
        let qq  = hi * kvt
        let rr  = hi * ktv
        let sb  = 1.0 + hi * (kt + ks)
        let det = pp * sb - qq * rr

        let cv_old = (*state).cv[i]
        let ct_old = (*state).ct[i]
        rhs0 = rhs0 + (he * qi / vb) * cv_old

        let rhs_v0 = (he * qi / vv) * cb_old + (1.0 - he * (kv + ks)) * cv_old + (he * kvt) * ct_old
        let rhs_v = if routed && i == input_organ && !reject_input { rhs_v0 + dt * rel_mid / vv } else { rhs_v0 }
        let rhs_t = (he * ktv) * cv_old + (1.0 - he * (kt + ks)) * ct_old

        let av = (sb * rhs_v + qq * rhs_t) / det
        let bv = (sb * gamma_i) / det
        a_v[i] = av
        b_v[i] = bv
        a_t[i] = (rr * rhs_v + pp * rhs_t) / det
        b_t[i] = (rr * gamma_i) / det

        sum_beta_a = sum_beta_a + beta_i * av
        sum_beta_b = sum_beta_b + beta_i * bv
        i = i + 1
    }

    let cb_new = (rhs0 + sum_beta_a) / ((1.0 + big_s) - sum_beta_b)
    p28t_apply_schur(state, cb_new, &a_v, &b_v, &a_t, &b_t)

    // Book with the θ-method's own quadrature: dt·((1−θ)·C_n + θ·C_{n+1}).
    var new_avg: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    p28t_organ_avgs(state, p, &!new_avg)
    let sink_org = if has_sink { sink_organ } else { 0 }
    let s_old = p28t_accum(ledger, &old_avg, he, p.cl_central, sink_org, cl_sink)
    let s_new = p28t_accum(ledger, &new_avg, hi, p.cl_central, sink_org, cl_sink)
    p28t_negativity(ledger, state, p)
    if reject_input {
        (*ledger).rejected_input = (*ledger).rejected_input + dt * rel_mid
    } else {
        (*ledger).administered = (*ledger).administered + dt * rel_mid
    }
    (*ledger).steps = (*ledger).steps + 1
    return s_old + s_new
}

// θ-step with the input into blood (the original entry point).
pub fn pbpk28_theta_step_sink_mut(
    state: &!PBPKState28,
    p: PBPKParams28,
    rel_mid: f64,
    dt: f64,
    theta: f64,
    sink_organ: i32,
    cl_sink: f64,
    ledger: &!PBPK28Ledger
) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    return pbpk28_theta_step_routed_sink_mut(state, p, rel_mid, 0, dt, theta, sink_organ, cl_sink, ledger)
}

// Sink-free θ-step.
pub fn pbpk28_theta_step_mut(
    state: &!PBPKState28,
    p: PBPKParams28,
    rel_mid: f64,
    dt: f64,
    theta: f64,
    ledger: &!PBPK28Ledger
) with Mut, Div {
    let _none = pbpk28_theta_step_sink_mut(state, p, rel_mid, dt, theta, 0, 0.0, ledger)
}

// One step of length dt under Rannacher time-marching: two backward-Euler half
// steps when `startup` (a step right after a dosing event), otherwise one
// clamp-free CN step. `rel_mid` is held over the whole step either way, so the
// administered mass is dt·rel_mid in both branches; `input_organ` routes it as
// in `pbpk28_theta_step_routed_sink_mut`. Returns the organ-sink mass removed
// over the step.
pub fn pbpk28_rannacher_step_routed_sink_mut(
    state: &!PBPKState28,
    p: PBPKParams28,
    rel_mid: f64,
    input_organ: i32,
    dt: f64,
    startup: bool,
    sink_organ: i32,
    cl_sink: f64,
    ledger: &!PBPK28Ledger
) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    if startup {
        let half = 0.5 * dt
        let s1 = pbpk28_theta_step_routed_sink_mut(state, p, rel_mid, input_organ, half, 1.0, sink_organ, cl_sink, ledger)
        let s2 = pbpk28_theta_step_routed_sink_mut(state, p, rel_mid, input_organ, half, 1.0, sink_organ, cl_sink, ledger)
        return s1 + s2
    }
    return pbpk28_theta_step_routed_sink_mut(state, p, rel_mid, input_organ, dt, 0.5, sink_organ, cl_sink, ledger)
}

// Rannacher step with the input into blood (the original entry point).
pub fn pbpk28_rannacher_step_sink_mut(
    state: &!PBPKState28,
    p: PBPKParams28,
    rel_mid: f64,
    dt: f64,
    startup: bool,
    sink_organ: i32,
    cl_sink: f64,
    ledger: &!PBPK28Ledger
) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    return pbpk28_rannacher_step_routed_sink_mut(state, p, rel_mid, 0, dt, startup, sink_organ, cl_sink, ledger)
}

// Sink-free Rannacher step.
pub fn pbpk28_rannacher_step_mut(
    state: &!PBPKState28,
    p: PBPKParams28,
    rel_mid: f64,
    dt: f64,
    startup: bool,
    ledger: &!PBPK28Ledger
) with Mut, Div {
    let _none = pbpk28_rannacher_step_sink_mut(state, p, rel_mid, dt, startup, 0, 0.0, ledger)
}

// Number of steps after a dosing event that take the backward-Euler start-up
// (Giles & Carter 2006: two CN steps → four half steps). Measured on the
// rapamycin 5 mg bolus at dt = 0.5 h: one start-up step leaves a booked
// negative mass of 2.7e-5 mg, two leave 3.1e-10 mg
// (docs/audit/repro/pbpk28_rannacher_consumers_probe.sio).
pub fn pbpk28_rannacher_startup_steps() -> i32 { return 2 }

// ─── TR-BDF2 (Bank et al. 1985; Hosea & Shampine 1996) ─────────────────────
// L-stable (R(∞) = 0) and second-order throughout, for problems where stiff
// modes are re-excited away from any dosing event — e.g. an organ sink with
// θ·dt·k_s ≫ 1 on a smooth decaying tail, where Rannacher's plain-CN
// continuation rings again. γ = 2 − √2, so both stages share the implicit
// weight γ·dt/2 = d·dt:
//   stage 1 (trapezoid over γ·dt):  x_γ = θ-step(x_n; θ = 1/2, length γ·dt)
//   stage 2 (BDF2):  (I − d·dt·A)·x_{n+1} = a·x_γ − (a−1)·x_n + d·dt·b
//                    = θ-step(a·x_γ − (a−1)·x_n; θ = 1, length d·dt)
// with d = (1−γ)/(2−γ) = 1 − 1/√2 and a = 1/(γ(2−γ)) = (1 + √2)/2.
// Its mass identity carries the b-weights (w, w, d), w = 1/(2(2−γ)) = 1/(2√2):
//   M_{n+1} = M_n + dt·rel − dt·(w·c(x_n) + w·c(x_γ) + d·c(x_{n+1})),
// c(x) = cl_central·C_b + cl_sink·C_avg,k. The ledger is booked with exactly
// those weights; the stage-internal bookings go to a scratch ledger that is
// discarded.
fn p28t_trbdf2_gamma() -> f64 { return 0.5857864376269049 }   // 2 − √2
fn p28t_trbdf2_d() -> f64 { return 0.2928932188134524 }       // 1 − 1/√2
fn p28t_trbdf2_w() -> f64 { return 0.3535533905932738 }       // 1/(2√2)
fn p28t_trbdf2_a() -> f64 { return 1.2071067811865475 }       // (1 + √2)/2

fn p28t_save(state: &PBPKState28, xv: &![f64; 14], xt: &![f64; 14]) with Mut {
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 14 {
        (*xv)[i] = (*state).cv[i]
        (*xt)[i] = (*state).ct[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// *state ← a·(*state) − (a−1)·x_n
fn p28t_bdf2_combine(state: &!PBPKState28, xv: &[f64; 14], xt: &[f64; 14], a: f64) with Mut {
    let am1 = a - 1.0
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 14 {
        (*state).cv[i] = a * (*state).cv[i] - am1 * (*xv)[i]
        (*state).ct[i] = a * (*state).ct[i] - am1 * (*xt)[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// One TR-BDF2 step of length dt with an optional organ sink and input route
// (same conventions as `pbpk28_theta_step_routed_sink_mut`). `rel_mid` is
// held over the step and enters both stages the same way. Returns the sink
// mass (mg) removed over the step.
pub fn pbpk28_trbdf2_step_routed_sink_mut(
    state: &!PBPKState28,
    p: PBPKParams28,
    rel_mid: f64,
    input_organ: i32,
    dt: f64,
    sink_organ: i32,
    cl_sink: f64,
    ledger: &!PBPK28Ledger
) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    let gamma = p28t_trbdf2_gamma()
    let d = p28t_trbdf2_d()
    let w = p28t_trbdf2_w()
    var old_avg: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    p28t_organ_avgs(state, p, &!old_avg)
    var xn_v: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var xn_t: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    p28t_save(state, &!xn_v, &!xn_t)

    var scratch = pbpk28_ledger_zero()
    let _s1 = pbpk28_theta_step_routed_sink_mut(state, p, rel_mid, input_organ, gamma * dt, 0.5, sink_organ, cl_sink, &!scratch)
    // The scratch ledger has booked x_γ's negativity; carry it into the
    // caller's stage fields before stage 2 books x_{n+1} into the scratch too.
    let g_min = scratch.min_conc
    let g_neg = scratch.neg_mass
    if g_min < (*ledger).stage_min_conc { (*ledger).stage_min_conc = g_min }
    if g_neg > (*ledger).stage_neg_mass { (*ledger).stage_neg_mass = g_neg }
    var mid_avg: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    p28t_organ_avgs(state, p, &!mid_avg)
    p28t_bdf2_combine(state, &xn_v, &xn_t, p28t_trbdf2_a())
    let _s2 = pbpk28_theta_step_routed_sink_mut(state, p, rel_mid, input_organ, d * dt, 1.0, sink_organ, cl_sink, &!scratch)
    var new_avg: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    p28t_organ_avgs(state, p, &!new_avg)

    let has_sink = sink_organ >= 1 && sink_organ < 14 && cl_sink > 0.0
    let sink_org = if has_sink { sink_organ } else { 0 }
    let k0 = p28t_accum(ledger, &old_avg, w * dt, p.cl_central, sink_org, cl_sink)
    let k1 = p28t_accum(ledger, &mid_avg, w * dt, p.cl_central, sink_org, cl_sink)
    let k2 = p28t_accum(ledger, &new_avg, d * dt, p.cl_central, sink_org, cl_sink)
    // The returned state x_{n+1} goes into min_conc / neg_mass. The stage x_γ
    // was booked into stage_min_conc / stage_neg_mass above: right after a
    // bolus its CN stage rings negative, and the quadrature carries that
    // exactly (the identity above still holds).
    p28t_negativity(ledger, state, p)
    // Both stages refused the input iff p28t_route_rejected (they injected
    // nothing), so the whole step's dt·rel_mid is rejected, not administered.
    if p28t_route_rejected(p, input_organ) {
        (*ledger).rejected_input = (*ledger).rejected_input + dt * rel_mid
    } else {
        (*ledger).administered = (*ledger).administered + dt * rel_mid
    }
    (*ledger).steps = (*ledger).steps + scratch.steps
    return k0 + k1 + k2
}

// TR-BDF2 step with the input into blood (the original entry point).
pub fn pbpk28_trbdf2_step_sink_mut(
    state: &!PBPKState28,
    p: PBPKParams28,
    rel_mid: f64,
    dt: f64,
    sink_organ: i32,
    cl_sink: f64,
    ledger: &!PBPK28Ledger
) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    return pbpk28_trbdf2_step_routed_sink_mut(state, p, rel_mid, 0, dt, sink_organ, cl_sink, ledger)
}

// Sink-free TR-BDF2 step.
pub fn pbpk28_trbdf2_step_mut(
    state: &!PBPKState28,
    p: PBPKParams28,
    rel_mid: f64,
    dt: f64,
    ledger: &!PBPK28Ledger
) with Mut, Div {
    let _none = pbpk28_trbdf2_step_sink_mut(state, p, rel_mid, dt, 0, 0.0, ledger)
}

// Mass-balance residual (mg): body now + everything that left − everything
// that entered − body at the start. Zero to rounding for any sequence of
// θ / Rannacher / TR-BDF2 steps booked into `ledger`.
pub fn pbpk28_ledger_residual(ledger: PBPK28Ledger, s: PBPKState28, p: PBPKParams28, m0: f64) -> f64 with Mut {
    let body = pbpk28_total_mass(s, p)
    return body + ledger.eliminated + ledger.sink_removed - ledger.administered - m0
}

// ─── Gate bounds ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Relative bound on |residual| / scale after `steps` sub-steps. The identity
// is exact in real arithmetic, so only rounding remains; the budget is ~4.5
// ulp of 1.0 per sub-step (steps·1e-15), floored at 1e-12 for the O(30)-term
// mass sums themselves. This is a heuristic rounding budget, not a proven
// floating-point error bound (the Schur solve's conditioning grows with
// dt·(Q+PS)/V_v, up to ~2·10⁴ at dt = 0.5 h). Measured residuals sit 3–30×
// below it on both engines; a real conservation defect is 10⁹× above it.
// Never widen it to admit an observed failure.
pub fn pbpk28_mass_tol_rel(steps: i32) -> f64 {
    let t = (steps as f64) * 1.0e-15
    if t > 1.0e-12 { return t }
    return 1.0e-12
}

// Booked negative mass (mg) a run may carry and still count as clean: half
// the last digit of a 6-decimal mg print. No second-order linear method is
// positivity-preserving at these dt (Bolley & Crouzeix 1978), so this is a
// resolution bound, not a rounding bound; the ledger records the real value.
pub fn pbpk28_neg_mass_bound_mg() -> f64 { return 5.0e-7 }

// Mass-balance gate: residual within `pbpk28_mass_tol_rel(steps)`·scale and no
// negativity above `pbpk28_neg_mass_bound_mg()`. `scale` is the mass the run
// handled (dose, or administered mass for a depot).
pub fn pbpk28_mass_gate_ok(ledger: PBPK28Ledger, s: PBPKState28, p: PBPKParams28, m0: f64, scale: f64) -> bool with Mut {
    let r = pbpk28_ledger_residual(ledger, s, p, m0)
    let ra = if r < 0.0 { 0.0 - r } else { r }
    return ra <= pbpk28_mass_tol_rel(ledger.steps) * scale && ledger.neg_mass <= pbpk28_neg_mass_bound_mg() && ledger.rejected_input == 0.0
}

// Print the gate's inputs (scaled so they read on both engines' fixed-point
// print) and return its verdict. `m0` is the initial body mass and the scale.
pub fn pbpk28_mass_gate_report(ledger: PBPK28Ledger, s: PBPKState28, p: PBPKParams28, m0: f64) -> bool with IO, Mut {
    let r = pbpk28_ledger_residual(ledger, s, p, m0)
    let ra = if r < 0.0 { 0.0 - r } else { r }
    print("  sub-steps: ")
    println(ledger.steps)
    print("  |M(T) + eliminated + sink_removed - administered - M(0)| / M(0) x 1e12: ")
    println(ra / m0 * 1.0e12)
    print("  bound x 1e12: ")
    println(pbpk28_mass_tol_rel(ledger.steps) * 1.0e12)
    print("  booked negative mass (mg) x 1e12: ")
    println(ledger.neg_mass * 1.0e12)
    // Printed only when non-zero, so runs without routed input print as before.
    if ledger.rejected_input != 0.0 {
        print("  rejected routed input (mg): ")
        println(ledger.rejected_input)
    }
    return pbpk28_mass_gate_ok(ledger, s, p, m0, m0)
}

// x is a finite number: x - x is 0 for finite x and NaN for NaN or ±inf.
fn p28t_finite(x: f64) -> bool {
    let d = x - x
    return d == d
}

// ─── Bolus-IV run ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Shared by the dissertation GUM / Hessian / cumulant / MC / Sobol layers:
// `dose_mg` into blood at t = 0 (the dosing event), Rannacher start-up, fixed
// dt with the last step clipped to t_end. `*st` must be a zero state. Returns
// false — the caller treats the run as failed — on a non-finite or runaway
// (|C_b| > 1e12 mg/L) blood value, when t_end needs more than `max_steps`
// steps, or when the
// booked negative mass exceeds `pbpk28_neg_mass_bound_mg()` (fail loudly
// instead of flooring). State and ledger are left where the run stopped.
pub fn pbpk28_bolus_run_mut(
    p: PBPKParams28,
    dose_mg: f64,
    dt: f64,
    t_end: f64,
    max_steps: i32,
    st: &!PBPKState28,
    led: &!PBPK28Ledger
) -> bool with Mut, Div {
    // dt <= 0 or NaN: refuse up front instead of relying on the step cap
    // (dt <= 0) or the non-finite check (NaN) to reject the run later. dt =
    // +inf passes `dt > 0` and the clip below would turn it into one
    // full-horizon step, so non-finite dt is refused as well.
    // t_end <= 0 or NaN would skip the loop and return true after zero
    // steps; refuse it too (an infinite t_end stops at max_steps -> false).
    if !(dt > 0.0) || !p28t_finite(dt) { return false }
    if !(t_end > 0.0) { return false }
    (*st).cv[0] = dose_mg / p.v_ref[0]
    let n_start = pbpk28_rannacher_startup_steps()
    var t = 0.0
    var k: i32 = 0
    while t < t_end {
        if k >= max_steps { return false }
        let dt_use = if t + dt > t_end { t_end - t } else { dt }
        pbpk28_rannacher_step_mut(st, p, 0.0, dt_use, k < n_start, led)
        let cb = (*st).cv[0]
        if cb != cb { return false }
        if cb > 1.0e12 || cb < -1.0e12 { return false }
        t = t + dt_use
        k = k + 1
    }
    return (*led).neg_mass <= pbpk28_neg_mass_bound_mg()
}


// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/tmdd/fkbp12_mtorc1.sio ===
// stdlib/darwin_pbpk/tmdd/fkbp12_mtorc1.sio — FKBP12 / mTORC1 TMDD layer
//
// Target-mediated drug disposition for rapamycin binding FKBP12 in liver,
// heart, and gut compartments (the dissertation's three rapamycin TMDD organs,
// matching website/src/lib/pbpk28_core.mjs and tests/run-pass/
// dissertation_pbpk28_parity_ref_rapamycin.sio).
//
// Per-organ ODE block (Mager 2004):
//
//   dC_t / dt   = -k_on · C_t · R_free + k_off · DR
//   dR_free / dt =  k_syn - k_deg · R_free - k_on · C_t · R_free + k_off · DR
//   dDR / dt    =  k_on · C_t · R_free - (k_off + k_int) · DR
//
// All concentrations in nmol/L (the drug-side C_t is exposed in mg/L on the
// PBPK28 state vector — the helper `mg_per_l_to_nmol_per_l` converts using the
// drug's molecular weight).
//
// Stepping strategy: Newton-linearize the bilinear k_on·C_t·R_free product at
// (C_t_old, R_free_old) and apply one implicit Crank-Nicolson half-step on the
// resulting 3×3 system. A-stable, 2nd-order, one 3×3 invert per organ per step
// — matches the parity-ref `tmdd_step_organ` math byte-for-byte at IEEE-754
// double precision.
//
// Extracted from tests/run-pass/dissertation_pbpk28_parity_ref_rapamycin.sio
// (Stage G-ε-11, gap-report claim `tmdd_rapamycin_path`).

// ─── Drug constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Sirolimus, free acid, Mw = 914.17 Da (PubChem CID 5284616).
fn fkbp12_mw_rapamycin_da() -> f64 { return 914.17 }

// ─── Literature parameters per dissertation §4.5 ────────────────────────────
// Same numbers as the parity reference (which in turn match
// pbpk28_core.mjs).
//   Liver (organ index 1), Heart (4 — coronary_smc proxy), Gut (8).
//   K_d = k_off / k_on = 0.10 nmol/L for the rapamycin-FKBP12 affinity
//   (Banaszynski 2005 SPR fits, refined Sehgal 1998 EC50). The same K_d is
//   reused across all three organs; only R_total varies.

fn fkbp12_kdeg() -> f64 { return 0.05 }    // 1/h, receptor turnover
fn fkbp12_kon()  -> f64 { return 0.10 }    // L/(nmol·h), binding rate
fn fkbp12_kd()   -> f64 { return 0.10 }    // nmol/L
fn fkbp12_kint() -> f64 { return 0.010 }   // 1/h, drug-receptor internalisation
fn fkbp12_koff() -> f64 { return fkbp12_kon() * fkbp12_kd() }

// Total FKBP12 receptor at baseline (nmol/L of tissue volume).
//   Liver  i=1 → 50.0 nmol/L (FKBP12 abundance per Banaszynski 2005)
//   Heart  i=4 → 25.0 nmol/L (coronary SMC proxy; conservative half-of-liver)
//   Gut    i=8 → 30.0 nmol/L (enterocyte FKBP12 — Lampen 1998)
fn fkbp12_rtotal0_at(i: i64) -> f64 {
    if i == 1 { return 50.0 }
    if i == 4 { return 25.0 }
    if i == 8 { return 30.0 }
    return 0.0
}

// At equilibrium, k_syn = k_deg · R_total_0.
fn fkbp12_ksyn_at(i: i64) -> f64 {
    return fkbp12_kdeg() * fkbp12_rtotal0_at(i)
}

// Whether an organ index participates in the rapamycin TMDD layer.
fn fkbp12_is_tmdd_organ(i: i64) -> bool {
    if i == 1 { return true }
    if i == 4 { return true }
    if i == 8 { return true }
    return false
}

// ─── State record ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Per-organ TMDD state. Drug concentration `ct_mass` carried in mg/L (the
// PBPK28 native unit on the interstitial side); receptor and complex in
// nmol/L. Conversions handled inside tmdd_step.
pub struct TmddState {
    ct_mass: f64,
    rfree:   f64,
    dr:      f64,
}

// Per-organ TMDD parameter pack. Holds everything tmdd_step needs in one
// struct so callers can swap rapamycin/FKBP12 ↔ semaglutide/GLP-1R without
// changing the stepping math.
struct TmddOrganParams {
    k_on:  f64,    // L/(nmol·h)
    k_off: f64,    // 1/h
    k_int: f64,    // 1/h, DR internalisation
    k_deg: f64,    // 1/h, R-turnover
    k_syn: f64,    // nmol/(L·h), de-novo R synthesis
    mw_da: f64,    // Da, drug molecular weight (mg/L ↔ nmol/L bridge)
}

// Populate `TmddOrganParams` for rapamycin at the named organ index.
fn fkbp12_params_at(i: i64) -> TmddOrganParams {
    TmddOrganParams {
        k_on:  fkbp12_kon(),
        k_off: fkbp12_koff(),
        k_int: fkbp12_kint(),
        k_deg: fkbp12_kdeg(),
        k_syn: fkbp12_ksyn_at(i),
        mw_da: fkbp12_mw_rapamycin_da(),
    }
}

// ─── Step kernel ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Newton-linearized implicit-CN half-step on the 3-state (C_t, R_free, DR).
// Pure function: takes current state + parameters + Δt, returns new state.
// Identical math to parity-ref tmdd_step_organ (lines 364-438 of
// dissertation_pbpk28_parity_ref_rapamycin.sio) — no Pbpk28 dependency.
fn tmdd_step(s: TmddState, p: TmddOrganParams, dt: f64) -> TmddState with Mut, Div {
    let h = 0.5 * dt
    let mass_to_nm = 1.0e6 / p.mw_da
    let nm_to_mass = p.mw_da * 1.0e-6
    let ct_old_mass = s.ct_mass
    let ct_old_nm = if ct_old_mass < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { ct_old_mass * mass_to_nm }
    let rf_old = s.rfree
    let dr_old = s.dr

    let kon_rf  = p.k_on * rf_old
    let kon_ct  = p.k_on * ct_old_nm
    let bil_old = p.k_on * ct_old_nm * rf_old

    // M (3×3) Jacobian Newton-linearized at (ct_old_nm, rf_old):
    let m00 = 0.0 - kon_rf
    let m01 = 0.0 - kon_ct
    let m02 = p.k_off
    let m10 = 0.0 - kon_rf
    let m11 = (0.0 - p.k_deg) - kon_ct
    let m12 = p.k_off
    let m20 = kon_rf
    let m21 = kon_ct
    let m22 = 0.0 - (p.k_off + p.k_int)

    // Constant terms from the Newton expansion:
    //   k_on·C_t·R_free ≈ k_on·(C_t_old·R_free + R_free_old·C_t - C_t_old·R_free_old)
    let f0 = bil_old
    let f1 = p.k_syn + bil_old
    let f2 = 0.0 - bil_old

    // RHS = (I + h·M)·x_old + dt·f
    let rhs0 = (1.0 + h*m00) * ct_old_nm + (h*m01) * rf_old      + (h*m02) * dr_old + dt * f0
    let rhs1 = (h*m10)       * ct_old_nm + (1.0 + h*m11) * rf_old + (h*m12) * dr_old + dt * f1
    let rhs2 = (h*m20)       * ct_old_nm + (h*m21) * rf_old      + (1.0 + h*m22) * dr_old + dt * f2

    // A = I - h·M
    let a00 = 1.0 - h*m00
    let a01 = 0.0 - h*m01
    let a02 = 0.0 - h*m02
    let a10 = 0.0 - h*m10
    let a11 = 1.0 - h*m11
    let a12 = 0.0 - h*m12
    let a20 = 0.0 - h*m20
    let a21 = 0.0 - h*m21
    let a22 = 1.0 - h*m22

    // 3×3 invert via cofactor expansion.
    let c00 = a11*a22 - a12*a21
    let c01 = a12*a20 - a10*a22
    let c02 = a10*a21 - a11*a20
    let det = a00*c00 + a01*c01 + a02*c02

    let c10 = a02*a21 - a01*a22
    let c11 = a00*a22 - a02*a20
    let c12 = a01*a20 - a00*a21
    let c20 = a01*a12 - a02*a11
    let c21 = a02*a10 - a00*a12
    let c22 = a00*a11 - a01*a10

    let ct_new_nm = (c00*rhs0 + c10*rhs1 + c20*rhs2) / det
    let rf_new    = (c01*rhs0 + c11*rhs1 + c21*rhs2) / det
    let dr_new    = (c02*rhs0 + c12*rhs1 + c22*rhs2) / det

    let ct_new_clamped = if ct_new_nm < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { ct_new_nm }
    TmddState {
        ct_mass: ct_new_clamped * nm_to_mass,
        rfree:   if rf_new < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { rf_new },
        dr:      if dr_new < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { dr_new },
    }
}

// Convenience: receptor occupancy DR / (R_free + DR), guarded against 0/0.
fn tmdd_occupancy(s: TmddState) -> f64 with Div {
    let total = s.rfree + s.dr
    if total < 1.0e-12 { return 0.0 }
    return s.dr / total
}

// stdlib/darwin_pbpk/tmdd/glp1r.sio — GLP-1 receptor TMDD layer (semaglutide)
//
// Target-mediated drug disposition for semaglutide binding the GLP-1 receptor
// at three sites: brain (arcuate nucleus — appetite suppression), gut
// (L-cells / enteric neurons — gastric emptying / satiety), and pancreas
// (β-cells — glucose-dependent insulin secretion). Matches the dissertation's
// three semaglutide TMDD organs and the JS engine
// `website/src/lib/pbpk28_core.mjs` + the parity ref
// `tests/run-pass/dissertation_pbpk28_parity_ref_semaglutide.sio`.
//
// The Newton-linearized implicit-CN step kernel is **identical** to the one
// in `fkbp12_mtorc1.sio` — same Mager 2004 3-state ODE, same matrix shape, same
// 3×3 cofactor invert. Only the literature constants and the per-organ
// R_total schedule differ. Callers compose a TmddOrganParams via
// `glp1r_params_at(i)` and step it with `tmdd_step` (imported from the FKBP12
// module — the kernel is drug-agnostic).

// Extracted from tests/run-pass/dissertation_pbpk28_parity_ref_semaglutide.sio
// (Stage G-ε-12, gap-report claim `tmdd_semaglutide_path`).

use darwin_pbpk::tmdd::fkbp12_mtorc1::*

// ─── Drug constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Semaglutide, MW = 4113.58 Da (Novo Nordisk product monograph; sequence
// includes the C-18 fatty diacid and γGlu spacer on Lys26 — UniProt P01275
// glucagon precursor 92-128 fragment + the acylation modifications).
fn glp1r_mw_semaglutide_da() -> f64 { return 4113.58 }

// ─── Literature parameters per dissertation §4.5.5 ──────────────────────────
// Peptide-GPCR rates are *kinetically faster* than small-molecule-FKBP12:
// k_on ≈ 5× higher reflects the high-affinity peptide-receptor association
// (Lau 2015 SPR + Knudsen 2019). k_int ≈ 5× higher reflects β-arrestin-mediated
// GPCR internalisation. k_deg ≈ same order (GPCR turnover ~hours).
//   Brain     i=3  → R_total_0 = 1 nM  (arcuate nucleus, low density)
//   Gut       i=8  → R_total_0 = 2 nM  (L-cells, moderate)
//   Pancreas  i=12 → R_total_0 = 5 nM  (β-cells, dominant TMDD sink)

fn glp1r_kdeg() -> f64 { return 0.05 }    // 1/h, GPCR turnover
fn glp1r_kon()  -> f64 { return 0.50 }    // L/(nmol·h), peptide-GPCR association
fn glp1r_kd()   -> f64 { return 0.40 }    // nmol/L (Lau 2015 EC50 vs liraglutide)
fn glp1r_kint() -> f64 { return 0.050 }   // 1/h, β-arrestin internalisation
fn glp1r_koff() -> f64 { return glp1r_kon() * glp1r_kd() }

// Total GLP-1R receptor density at baseline (nmol/L of tissue volume).
fn glp1r_rtotal0_at(i: i64) -> f64 {
    if i ==  3 { return 1.0 }
    if i ==  8 { return 2.0 }
    if i == 12 { return 5.0 }
    return 0.0
}

// At equilibrium, k_syn = k_deg · R_total_0.
fn glp1r_ksyn_at(i: i64) -> f64 {
    return glp1r_kdeg() * glp1r_rtotal0_at(i)
}

// Whether an organ index participates in the semaglutide TMDD layer.
fn glp1r_is_tmdd_organ(i: i64) -> bool {
    if i ==  3 { return true }
    if i ==  8 { return true }
    if i == 12 { return true }
    return false
}

// Populate `TmddOrganParams` for semaglutide at the named organ index. Returns
// a zero-R_total params pack for non-TMDD organs (callers gate via
// glp1r_is_tmdd_organ before stepping).
fn glp1r_params_at(i: i64) -> TmddOrganParams {
    TmddOrganParams {
        k_on:  glp1r_kon(),
        k_off: glp1r_koff(),
        k_int: glp1r_kint(),
        k_deg: glp1r_kdeg(),
        k_syn: glp1r_ksyn_at(i),
        mw_da: glp1r_mw_semaglutide_da(),
    }

// ============================================================================
// HELPER FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn max_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { return a }
    return b
}

fn min_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a < b { return a }
    return b
}

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    return y
}

fn fifth_root(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = 1.0
    y = y - (y * y * y * y * y - x) / (5.0 * y * y * y * y)
    y = y - (y * y * y * y * y - x) / (5.0 * y * y * y * y)
    y = y - (y * y * y * y * y - x) / (5.0 * y * y * y * y)
    y = y - (y * y * y * y * y - x) / (5.0 * y * y * y * y)
    y = y - (y * y * y * y * y - x) / (5.0 * y * y * y * y)
    y = y - (y * y * y * y * y - x) / (5.0 * y * y * y * y)
    y = y - (y * y * y * y * y - x) / (5.0 * y * y * y * y)
    y = y - (y * y * y * y * y - x) / (5.0 * y * y * y * y)
    return y
}

// ============================================================================
// 14-COMPARTMENT STATE VECTOR
// ============================================================================
// Indices: 0=blood, 1=liver, 2=kidney, 3=brain, 4=heart, 5=lung,
//          6=muscle, 7=adipose, 8=gut, 9=skin, 10=bone, 11=spleen,
//          12=pancreas, 13=other

pub struct PBPKState14 {
    blood: f64,
    liver: f64,
    kidney: f64,
    brain: f64,
    heart: f64,
    lung: f64,
    muscle: f64,
    adipose: f64,
    gut: f64,
    skin: f64,
    bone: f64,
    spleen: f64,
    pancreas: f64,
    other: f64
}

pub fn pbpk_state_zero() -> PBPKState14 {
    return PBPKState14 {
        blood: 0.0,
        liver: 0.0,
        kidney: 0.0,
        brain: 0.0,
        heart: 0.0,
        lung: 0.0,
        muscle: 0.0,
        adipose: 0.0,
        gut: 0.0,
        skin: 0.0,
        bone: 0.0,
        spleen: 0.0,
        pancreas: 0.0,
        other: 0.0
    }
}

fn pbpk_state_add(a: PBPKState14, b: PBPKState14) -> PBPKState14 {
    return PBPKState14 {
        blood: a.blood + b.blood,
        liver: a.liver + b.liver,
        kidney: a.kidney + b.kidney,
        brain: a.brain + b.brain,
        heart: a.heart + b.heart,
        lung: a.lung + b.lung,
        muscle: a.muscle + b.muscle,
        adipose: a.adipose + b.adipose,
        gut: a.gut + b.gut,
        skin: a.skin + b.skin,
        bone: a.bone + b.bone,
        spleen: a.spleen + b.spleen,
        pancreas: a.pancreas + b.pancreas,
        other: a.other + b.other
    }
}

fn pbpk_state_scale(s: PBPKState14, factor: f64) -> PBPKState14 {
    return PBPKState14 {
        blood: s.blood * factor,
        liver: s.liver * factor,
        kidney: s.kidney * factor,
        brain: s.brain * factor,
        heart: s.heart * factor,
        lung: s.lung * factor,
        muscle: s.muscle * factor,
        adipose: s.adipose * factor,
        gut: s.gut * factor,
        skin: s.skin * factor,
        bone: s.bone * factor,
        spleen: s.spleen * factor,
        pancreas: s.pancreas * factor,
        other: s.other * factor
    }
}

pub fn pbpk_state_total_mass(s: PBPKState14, prm: PBPKParams14) -> f64 {
    return s.blood * prm.v_blood + s.liver * prm.v_liver + s.kidney * prm.v_kidney
         + s.brain * prm.v_brain + s.heart * prm.v_heart + s.lung * prm.v_lung
         + s.muscle * prm.v_muscle + s.adipose * prm.v_adipose + s.gut * prm.v_gut
         + s.skin * prm.v_skin + s.bone * prm.v_bone + s.spleen * prm.v_spleen
         + s.pancreas * prm.v_pancreas + s.other * prm.v_other
}

// ============================================================================
// PBPK PARAMETERS
// ============================================================================

pub struct PBPKParams14 {
    // Volumes (L) - 70kg adult reference
    v_blood: f64,
    v_liver: f64,
    v_kidney: f64,
    v_brain: f64,
    v_heart: f64,
    v_lung: f64,
    v_muscle: f64,
    v_adipose: f64,
    v_gut: f64,
    v_skin: f64,
    v_bone: f64,
    v_spleen: f64,
    v_pancreas: f64,
    v_other: f64,

    // Blood flows (L/h)
    q_liver: f64,
    q_kidney: f64,
    q_brain: f64,
    q_heart: f64,
    q_lung: f64,
    q_muscle: f64,
    q_adipose: f64,
    q_gut: f64,
    q_skin: f64,
    q_bone: f64,
    q_spleen: f64,
    q_pancreas: f64,
    q_other: f64,

    // Partition coefficients (Kp)
    kp_liver: f64,
    kp_kidney: f64,
    kp_brain: f64,
    kp_heart: f64,
    kp_lung: f64,
    kp_muscle: f64,
    kp_adipose: f64,
    kp_gut: f64,
    kp_skin: f64,
    kp_bone: f64,
    kp_spleen: f64,
    kp_pancreas: f64,
    kp_other: f64,

    // Clearance (L/h)
    cl_hepatic: f64,
    cl_renal: f64,

    // Blood binding
    fu_plasma: f64,
    rb_ratio: f64
}

// Default parameters for 70kg adult
pub fn default_pbpk_params() -> PBPKParams14 {
    return PBPKParams14 {
        // Volumes (L)
        v_blood: 5.0,
        v_liver: 1.8,
        v_kidney: 0.31,
        v_brain: 1.4,
        v_heart: 0.33,
        v_lung: 0.5,
        v_muscle: 30.0,
        v_adipose: 15.0,
        v_gut: 1.1,
        v_skin: 3.3,
        v_bone: 10.0,
        v_spleen: 0.18,
        v_pancreas: 0.1,
        v_other: 5.0,

        // Blood flows (L/h)
        q_liver: 90.0,
        q_kidney: 60.0,
        q_brain: 50.0,
        q_heart: 20.0,
        q_lung: 300.0,
        q_muscle: 75.0,
        q_adipose: 12.0,
        q_gut: 45.0,
        q_skin: 10.0,
        q_bone: 5.0,
        q_spleen: 15.0,
        q_pancreas: 5.0,
        q_other: 20.0,

        // Partition coefficients (default = 1.0)
        kp_liver: 1.0,
        kp_kidney: 1.0,
        kp_brain: 0.5,   // BBB limits penetration
        kp_heart: 1.0,
        kp_lung: 1.0,
        kp_muscle: 0.8,
        kp_adipose: 0.2, // Lipophilicity dependent
        kp_gut: 1.0,
        kp_skin: 0.7,
        kp_bone: 0.3,
        kp_spleen: 1.0,
        kp_pancreas: 1.0,
        kp_other: 1.0,

        // Clearance
        cl_hepatic: 10.0,  // L/h
        cl_renal: 5.0,     // L/h

        // Blood binding
        fu_plasma: 0.5,    // 50% unbound
        rb_ratio: 1.0      // Blood:Plasma = 1 (no RBC binding)
    }
}

// Validate PBPK parameters are physically plausible.
// Returns 0 if valid, or a positive error code indicating the first violation.
pub fn pbpk_params_validate(prm: PBPKParams14) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if prm.v_blood    <= 0.0 { return 1 }
    if prm.v_liver    <= 0.0 { return 2 }
    if prm.v_kidney   <= 0.0 { return 3 }
    if prm.v_brain    <= 0.0 { return 4 }
    if prm.v_heart    <= 0.0 { return 5 }
    if prm.v_lung     <= 0.0 { return 6 }
    if prm.v_muscle   <= 0.0 { return 7 }
    if prm.v_adipose  <= 0.0 { return 8 }
    if prm.v_gut      <= 0.0 { return 9 }
    if prm.v_skin     <= 0.0 { return 10 }
    if prm.v_bone     <= 0.0 { return 11 }
    if prm.v_spleen   <= 0.0 { return 12 }
    if prm.v_pancreas <= 0.0 { return 13 }
    if prm.v_other    <= 0.0 { return 14 }

    if prm.q_liver    < 0.0 { return 15 }
    if prm.q_kidney   < 0.0 { return 16 }
    if prm.q_brain    < 0.0 { return 17 }
    if prm.q_heart    < 0.0 { return 18 }
    if prm.q_lung     < 0.0 { return 19 }
    if prm.q_muscle   < 0.0 { return 20 }
    if prm.q_adipose  < 0.0 { return 21 }
    if prm.q_gut      < 0.0 { return 22 }
    if prm.q_skin     < 0.0 { return 23 }
    if prm.q_bone     < 0.0 { return 24 }
    if prm.q_spleen   < 0.0 { return 25 }
    if prm.q_pancreas < 0.0 { return 26 }
    if prm.q_other    < 0.0 { return 27 }

    if prm.kp_liver    <= 0.0 { return 28 }
    if prm.kp_kidney   <= 0.0 { return 29 }
    if prm.kp_brain    <= 0.0 { return 30 }
    if prm.kp_heart    <= 0.0 { return 31 }
    if prm.kp_lung     <= 0.0 { return 32 }
    if prm.kp_muscle   <= 0.0 { return 33 }
    if prm.kp_adipose  <= 0.0 { return 34 }
    if prm.kp_gut      <= 0.0 { return 35 }
    if prm.kp_skin     <= 0.0 { return 36 }
    if prm.kp_bone     <= 0.0 { return 37 }
    if prm.kp_spleen   <= 0.0 { return 38 }
    if prm.kp_pancreas <= 0.0 { return 39 }
    if prm.kp_other    <= 0.0 { return 40 }

    if prm.cl_hepatic < 0.0 { return 41 }
    if prm.cl_renal   < 0.0 { return 42 }

    if prm.fu_plasma <= 0.0 || prm.fu_plasma > 1.0 { return 43 }
    if prm.rb_ratio  <= 0.0 { return 44 }

    0
}

// ============================================================================
// PBPK ODE SYSTEM
// ============================================================================

pub fn pbpk_ode(st: PBPKState14, t: f64, prm: PBPKParams14) -> PBPKState14 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let c_blood = st.blood
    let c_plasma = c_blood / prm.rb_ratio
    let c_unbound = c_plasma * prm.fu_plasma

    // Derivatives for each compartment
    var d_blood = 0.0

    // Liver: dC/dt = (Q/V)(C_plasma - C/Kp)
    let d_liver = (prm.q_liver / prm.v_liver) * (c_plasma - st.liver / prm.kp_liver)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_liver / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.liver / prm.kp_liver)

    // Kidney
    let d_kidney = (prm.q_kidney / prm.v_kidney) * (c_plasma - st.kidney / prm.kp_kidney)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_kidney / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.kidney / prm.kp_kidney)

    // Brain
    let d_brain = (prm.q_brain / prm.v_brain) * (c_plasma - st.brain / prm.kp_brain)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_brain / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.brain / prm.kp_brain)

    // Heart
    let d_heart = (prm.q_heart / prm.v_heart) * (c_plasma - st.heart / prm.kp_heart)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_heart / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.heart / prm.kp_heart)

    // Lung
    let d_lung = (prm.q_lung / prm.v_lung) * (c_plasma - st.lung / prm.kp_lung)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_lung / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.lung / prm.kp_lung)

    // Muscle
    let d_muscle = (prm.q_muscle / prm.v_muscle) * (c_plasma - st.muscle / prm.kp_muscle)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_muscle / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.muscle / prm.kp_muscle)

    // Adipose
    let d_adipose = (prm.q_adipose / prm.v_adipose) * (c_plasma - st.adipose / prm.kp_adipose)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_adipose / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.adipose / prm.kp_adipose)

    // Gut
    let d_gut = (prm.q_gut / prm.v_gut) * (c_plasma - st.gut / prm.kp_gut)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_gut / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.gut / prm.kp_gut)

    // Skin
    let d_skin = (prm.q_skin / prm.v_skin) * (c_plasma - st.skin / prm.kp_skin)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_skin / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.skin / prm.kp_skin)

    // Bone
    let d_bone = (prm.q_bone / prm.v_bone) * (c_plasma - st.bone / prm.kp_bone)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_bone / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.bone / prm.kp_bone)

    // Spleen
    let d_spleen = (prm.q_spleen / prm.v_spleen) * (c_plasma - st.spleen / prm.kp_spleen)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_spleen / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.spleen / prm.kp_spleen)

    // Pancreas
    let d_pancreas = (prm.q_pancreas / prm.v_pancreas) * (c_plasma - st.pancreas / prm.kp_pancreas)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_pancreas / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.pancreas / prm.kp_pancreas)

    // Other
    let d_other = (prm.q_other / prm.v_other) * (c_plasma - st.other / prm.kp_other)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_other / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.other / prm.kp_other)

    // Hepatic clearance (unbound drug)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.cl_hepatic / prm.v_blood) * c_unbound * prm.rb_ratio

    // Renal clearance (unbound drug)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.cl_renal / prm.v_blood) * c_unbound * prm.rb_ratio

    return PBPKState14 {
        blood: d_blood,
        liver: d_liver,
        kidney: d_kidney,
        brain: d_brain,
        heart: d_heart,
        lung: d_lung,
        muscle: d_muscle,
        adipose: d_adipose,
        gut: d_gut,
        skin: d_skin,
        bone: d_bone,
        spleen: d_spleen,
        pancreas: d_pancreas,
        other: d_other
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// TSIT5 STEP FOR 14-COMPARTMENT SYSTEM
// ============================================================================

pub struct Tsit5StepResult14 {
    state_new: PBPKState14,
    err: PBPKState14
}

pub fn tsit5_step_pbpk(st_in: PBPKState14, t: f64, dt: f64, prm: PBPKParams14) -> Tsit5StepResult14 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Stage 1
    let k1 = pbpk_ode(st_in, t, prm)

    // Stage 2
    let stage2_state = pbpk_state_add(st_in, pbpk_state_scale(k1, dt * tsit5_a21()))
    let k2 = pbpk_ode(stage2_state, t + tsit5_c2() * dt, prm)

    // Stage 3
    let stage3_state = pbpk_state_add(st_in,
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k1, dt * tsit5_a31()),
                       pbpk_state_scale(k2, dt * tsit5_a32())))
    let k3 = pbpk_ode(stage3_state, t + tsit5_c3() * dt, prm)

    // Stage 4
    let stage4_state = pbpk_state_add(st_in,
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k1, dt * tsit5_a41()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k2, dt * tsit5_a42()),
                       pbpk_state_scale(k3, dt * tsit5_a43()))))
    let k4 = pbpk_ode(stage4_state, t + tsit5_c4() * dt, prm)

    // Stage 5
    let stage5_state = pbpk_state_add(st_in,
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k1, dt * tsit5_a51()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k2, dt * tsit5_a52()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k3, dt * tsit5_a53()),
                       pbpk_state_scale(k4, dt * tsit5_a54())))))
    let k5 = pbpk_ode(stage5_state, t + tsit5_c5() * dt, prm)

    // Stage 6
    let stage6_state = pbpk_state_add(st_in,
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k1, dt * tsit5_a61()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k2, dt * tsit5_a62()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k3, dt * tsit5_a63()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k4, dt * tsit5_a64()),
                       pbpk_state_scale(k5, dt * tsit5_a65()))))))
    let k6 = pbpk_ode(stage6_state, t + tsit5_c6() * dt, prm)

    // Stage 7
    let stage7_state = pbpk_state_add(st_in,
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k1, dt * tsit5_a71()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k2, dt * tsit5_a72()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k3, dt * tsit5_a73()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k4, dt * tsit5_a74()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k5, dt * tsit5_a75()),
                       pbpk_state_scale(k6, dt * tsit5_a76())))))))
    let k7 = pbpk_ode(stage7_state, t + tsit5_c7() * dt, prm)

    // 5th order solution (same as stage 7 position for FSAL)
    let state_new = stage7_state

    // Error estimate
    let err = pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k1, dt * tsit5_e1()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k2, dt * tsit5_e2()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k3, dt * tsit5_e3()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k4, dt * tsit5_e4()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k5, dt * tsit5_e5()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k6, dt * tsit5_e6()),
                       pbpk_state_scale(k7, dt * tsit5_e7())))))))

    return Tsit5StepResult14 { state_new: state_new, err: err }
}

// ============================================================================
// ERROR NORM AND STEP SIZE CONTROL
// ============================================================================

pub fn compute_error_norm_14(
    err: PBPKState14,
    state_old: PBPKState14,
    state_new: PBPKState14,
    rtol: f64,
    atol: f64
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // RMS error norm: sqrt(1/N * sum((err_i / scale_i)^2))
    // scale_i = atol + rtol * max(|old_i|, |new_i|)

    let s0 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.blood), abs_f64(state_new.blood))
    let s1 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.liver), abs_f64(state_new.liver))
    let s2 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.kidney), abs_f64(state_new.kidney))
    let s3 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.brain), abs_f64(state_new.brain))
    let s4 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.heart), abs_f64(state_new.heart))
    let s5 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.lung), abs_f64(state_new.lung))
    let s6 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.muscle), abs_f64(state_new.muscle))
    let s7 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.adipose), abs_f64(state_new.adipose))
    let s8 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.gut), abs_f64(state_new.gut))
    let s9 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.skin), abs_f64(state_new.skin))
    let s10 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.bone), abs_f64(state_new.bone))
    let s11 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.spleen), abs_f64(state_new.spleen))
    let s12 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.pancreas), abs_f64(state_new.pancreas))
    let s13 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.other), abs_f64(state_new.other))

    let e0 = err.blood / s0
    let e1 = err.liver / s1
    let e2 = err.kidney / s2
    let e3 = err.brain / s3
    let e4 = err.heart / s4
    let e5 = err.lung / s5
    let e6 = err.muscle / s6
    let e7 = err.adipose / s7
    let e8 = err.gut / s8
    let e9 = err.skin / s9
    let e10 = err.bone / s10
    let e11 = err.spleen / s11
    let e12 = err.pancreas / s12
    let e13 = err.other / s13

    let sum_sq = e0*e0 + e1*e1 + e2*e2 + e3*e3 + e4*e4 + e5*e5 + e6*e6
               + e7*e7 + e8*e8 + e9*e9 + e10*e10 + e11*e11 + e12*e12 + e13*e13

    return sqrt_f64(sum_sq / 14.0)
}

pub fn optimal_step_14(dt: f64, err_norm: f64, safety: f64, max_growth: f64, min_shrink: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if err_norm <= 0.0 {
        return dt * max_growth
    }
    let factor = safety * fifth_root(1.0 / err_norm)
    let factor_limited = max_f64(min_shrink, min_f64(max_growth, factor))
    return dt * factor_limited
}

// ============================================================================
// SOLVER CONFIGURATION AND SOLUTION
// ============================================================================

pub struct ODEConfig14 {
    rtol: f64,
    atol: f64,
    dt_init: f64,
    dt_min: f64,
    dt_max: f64,
    max_steps: i64,
    safety: f64,
    max_growth: f64,
    min_shrink: f64
}

pub fn default_ode_config() -> ODEConfig14 {
    return ODEConfig14 {
        rtol: 0.01,            // 1% relative tolerance (looser for PBPK)
        atol: 0.0001,          // 1e-4
        dt_init: 0.01,         // Larger initial step
        dt_min: 0.0000001,     // 1e-7
        dt_max: 1.0,
        max_steps: 100000,
        safety: 0.9,
        max_growth: 10.0,      // Allow faster growth
        min_shrink: 0.1
    }
}

// tight_ode_config: pharmacologically-motivated tolerances for
// tail-phase accuracy (e.g., brain/plasma TAC).  atol=1e-10 keeps the
// error norm sensitive to trace concentrations ~ng/mL; rtol=1e-6
// matches Simcyp / NONMEM defaults for PBPK integration.  Use when
// the workflow exposes tail-phase concentrations (> ~24h for
// rapamycin), where the default config's atol=1e-4 drifts the error
// norm below its intended relative regime and produces spurious
// non-monotone decay + tiny negative concentrations from RK step
// error.
pub fn tight_ode_config() -> ODEConfig14 {
    return ODEConfig14 {
        rtol: 0.000001,        // 1e-6
        atol: 0.0000000001,    // 1e-10
        dt_init: 0.001,
        dt_min: 0.0000000001,  // 1e-10
        dt_max: 0.5,
        max_steps: 10000000,   // 1e7
        safety: 0.9,
        max_growth: 5.0,
        min_shrink: 0.1
    }
}

pub struct PBPKSolution14 {
    success: bool,
    nsteps: i64,
    nfeval: i64,
    nreject: i64,
    t_final: f64,
    state_final: PBPKState14
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN SOLVER
// ============================================================================

pub fn solve_pbpk14(
    dose_mg: f64,
    t_end: f64,
    prm: PBPKParams14,
    cfg: ODEConfig14
) -> PBPKSolution14 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Initial condition: all drug in blood compartment
    let c0_blood = dose_mg / prm.v_blood
    var st = PBPKState14 {
        blood: c0_blood,
        liver: 0.0,
        kidney: 0.0,
        brain: 0.0,
        heart: 0.0,
        lung: 0.0,
        muscle: 0.0,
        adipose: 0.0,
        gut: 0.0,
        skin: 0.0,
        bone: 0.0,
        spleen: 0.0,
        pancreas: 0.0,
        other: 0.0
    }

    var t = 0.0
    var dt = cfg.dt_init
    var nsteps = 0
    var nfeval = 0
    var nreject = 0

    while t < t_end && nsteps < cfg.max_steps {
        let dt_use = if t + dt > t_end { t_end - t } else { dt }

        let result = tsit5_step_pbpk(st, t, dt_use, prm)
        nfeval = nfeval + 7

        let err_norm = compute_error_norm_14(result.err, st, result.state_new, cfg.rtol, cfg.atol)

        if err_norm <= 1.0 {
            // Accept step
            t = t + dt_use
            st = result.state_new
            nsteps = nsteps + 1
            dt = optimal_step_14(dt_use, err_norm, cfg.safety, cfg.max_growth, cfg.min_shrink)
        } else {
            // Reject step
            nreject = nreject + 1
            dt = optimal_step_14(dt_use, err_norm, cfg.safety, cfg.max_growth, cfg.min_shrink)
        }

        dt = max_f64(cfg.dt_min, min_f64(cfg.dt_max, dt))

        // Fail-safe: if too many rejections, something is wrong
        if nreject > 1000 {
            return PBPKSolution14 {
                success: false,
                nsteps: nsteps,
                nfeval: nfeval,
                nreject: nreject,
                t_final: t,
                state_final: st
            }
        }
    }

    let success = t >= t_end - cfg.dt_min

    return PBPKSolution14 {
        success: success,
        nsteps: nsteps,
        nfeval: nfeval,
        nreject: nreject,
        t_final: t,
        state_final: st
    }
}

// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/tsit5_pbpk28.sio ===
// stdlib/darwin_pbpk/tsit5_pbpk28.sio — PBPK28 fully-coupled Crank-Nicolson step
//
// One A-stable, 2nd-order, fully-coupled implicit step on the 27-active-state
// arrow matrix (blood C_v[0] + 13 × (C_v_i, C_t_i)). Per-organ Schur
// complement, O(N) per step, no operator-splitting bias.
//
// The structure of the matrix:
//   - Blood (organ 0) couples to all 13 peripheral C_v through Q-transport.
//   - Each peripheral organ has a 2×2 block (C_v_i, C_t_i) coupled to blood
//     through Q_i·C_b and to its own interstitium through PS_i·Kp_i.
//   - All blocks are eliminated against the central blood-row in closed form;
//     a single scalar equation for C_b_new closes the step.
//
// Derivation (Schur complement):
//   For each peripheral organ i ∈ {1..13}, the CN step on (C_v_i, C_t_i) at
//   frozen blood midpoint gives a 2×2 system:
//       [ p  -q ] [Cv_i_new]   [rhs_v + γ·C_b_mid]
//       [-r   s ] [Ct_i_new] = [rhs_t            ]
//   where p, q, r, s are the local mass-balance coefficients (functions of
//   Q_i, PS_i, V_v_i, V_t_i, K_p_i, h). Solving for (Cv_i, Ct_i) yields
//       Cv_i = a_v_i + b_v_i · C_b_new
//       Ct_i = a_t_i + b_t_i · C_b_new
//   Substituting into the blood-row equation closes the step:
//       C_b_new = (rhs_0 + Σ_i β_i · a_v_i) / ((1 + S) - Σ_i β_i · b_v_i)
//   where β_i = h·Q_i/V_b and S = h·(ΣQ_i + CL)/V_b.
//
// Math byte-for-byte preserved from the semaglutide parity ref's
// `full_cn_step` (lines 269-343), generalised over `PBPKParams28` so the
// same kernel drives both rapamycin (with rel_mid = 0 in the bolus-IV
// reference case) and semaglutide (rel_mid > 0 under SC depot release).
//
// Stage G-ε-15. gap-report claim `parity_ref_path` (the PBPK14 ref) is
// adjacent to but distinct from this PBPK28 stdlib promotion.

use darwin_pbpk::core::pbpk28_params::*

// One fully-coupled implicit-CN step at midpoint release rate `rel_mid` (mg/h
// — set to 0.0 for bolus-IV scenarios). Pure function: takes current state +
// drug-specific params + rel_mid + dt, returns new state. Does not touch
// TMDD or PD layers — those compose at the scenario level.
fn pbpk28_full_cn_step(state: PBPKState28, p: PBPKParams28, rel_mid: f64, dt: f64)
    -> PBPKState28 with Mut, Div
{
    let h = 0.5 * dt
    let vb = p.v_ref[0]

    // Big-S = h · (Σ Q + CL) / V_b — diagonal of the blood row.
    var sum_q = 0.0
    var i = 1
    while i < 14 {
        sum_q = sum_q + p.q[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    let big_s = h * (sum_q + p.cl_central) / vb

    let cb_old = state.cv[0]
    var rhs0 = (1.0 - big_s) * cb_old + dt * rel_mid / vb

    // Per-organ Schur-complement coefficients.
    var a_v: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var b_v: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var a_t: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var b_t: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var sum_beta_a = 0.0
    var sum_beta_b = 0.0

    i = 1
    while i < 14 {
        let vi = p.v_ref[i]
        let vf = p.vasc_frac[i]
        let vv_raw = vi * vf
        let vt_raw = vi * (1.0 - vf)
        // Floor to avoid division by zero in degenerate (vasc_frac=0 or =1)
        // configurations — used by case 2 of the parity gate (PBPK28 → QSS).
        let vv = if vv_raw < 1.0e-30 { 1.0e-30 } else { vv_raw }
        let vt = if vt_raw < 1.0e-30 { 1.0e-30 } else { vt_raw }
        let kp = p.kp[i]
        let ps = p.ps[i]
        let qi = p.q[i]

        let beta  = h * qi / vb
        let gamma = h * qi / vv
        let pp    = 1.0 + h * (qi + ps) / vv
        let qq    = h * ps / (vv * kp)
        let rr    = h * ps / vt
        let sb    = 1.0 + h * ps / (vt * kp)
        let det   = pp * sb - qq * rr

        rhs0 = rhs0 + beta * state.cv[i]

        let rhs_v = gamma * cb_old + (1.0 - h * (qi + ps) / vv) * state.cv[i] + qq * state.ct[i]
        let rhs_t = rr * state.cv[i] + (1.0 - h * ps / (vt * kp)) * state.ct[i]

        let av = (sb * rhs_v + qq * rhs_t) / det
        let bv = (sb * gamma) / det
        let at = (rr * rhs_v + pp * rhs_t) / det
        let bt = (rr * gamma) / det

        a_v[i] = av
        b_v[i] = bv
        a_t[i] = at
        b_t[i] = bt

        sum_beta_a = sum_beta_a + beta * av
        sum_beta_b = sum_beta_b + beta * bv
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Close the step: scalar equation for C_b_new.
    let cb_new = (rhs0 + sum_beta_a) / ((1.0 + big_s) - sum_beta_b)

    // Reconstruct peripheral organs from C_b_new.
    var out = pbpk28_state_zero()
    out.cv[0] = if cb_new < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { cb_new }
    i = 1
    while i < 14 {
        let cv = a_v[i] + b_v[i] * cb_new
        let ct = a_t[i] + b_t[i] * cb_new
        out.cv[i] = if cv < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { cv }
        out.ct[i] = if ct < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { ct }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return out
}

// Convenience: organ-average concentration C_avg,i = (V_v · C_v + V_t · C_t) / V_i
// used by the visual encoding and the parity-gate's case 1 RMSE
// computation. Blood (i=0) is just C_v[0].
fn pbpk28_organ_average(s: PBPKState28, p: PBPKParams28, i: i64) -> f64 with Div {
    if i == 0 { return s.cv[0] }
    let vi = p.v_ref[i]
    let vf = p.vasc_frac[i]
    let vv = vi * vf
    let vt = vi * (1.0 - vf)
    return (vv * s.cv[i] + vt * s.ct[i]) / vi
}


// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/validation/cross_drug_iso_budget.sio ===
// darwin_pbpk/validation/cross_drug_iso_budget.sio
//
// Cross-Drug ISO Uncertainty Budget — Dissertation Synthesis
//
// For each of the four PBPK-with-GUM drugs in the dissertation, this
// file computes the JCGM 100:2008 first-order GUM uncertainty budget on
// the clinically relevant endpoint and prints the dominant variance
// source. Numbers are *computed inline* — no hardcoded percentages.
//
// Endpoint per drug:
//   Rapamycin    : AUC(IV bolus, 1-comp) = D / CL_eff
//                   sources: CL_eff (CV ≈ 60%), fu (CV ≈ 25%), F (CV ≈ 20%)
//   Haloperidol  : C_isf_steady = (F·D·fu_plasma·kp_brain)/(V·CL_eff)
//                   sources: CL (CV ≈ 40%), fu (CV ≈ 30%), kp_brain (CV ≈ 50%)
//   Vancomycin   : AUC/MIC   = (D·τ/CL_eff) / MIC
//                   sources: CL (CV ≈ 25%), Vc (CV ≈ 15%), MIC (CV ≈ 50%)
//   Tacrolimus   : C24h trough = F·D / Vc / (exp(CL·τ/Vc) − 1) · 1000 ng/mL
//                   sources: CL (CV ≈ 45%), Vc (CV ≈ 25%), F (CV ≈ 50%)
//
// Dissertation argument (embedded as the closing comment block):
//   Dominant uncertainty is drug-class-dependent. For antibiotics dosed
//   by AUC/MIC, microbiological assay variability dominates. For oral
//   CYP3A4 substrates, F_oral and CL_hepatic compete. For CNS-active
//   substrates with active efflux, tissue partitioning dominates.
//   Therefore a uniform TDM threshold policy is mis-specified.
//
// Gate suite:
//   G1: each drug's budget completes successfully (no NaN / blow-up)
//   G2: each drug identifies one dominant source > 30% of total variance
//   G3: the dominant source DIFFERS across drug classes (key claim)
//   G4: total variance fractions per drug sum to 1.0 ± 0.01

// ============================================================================
// MATH HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn xd_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 15 { y = (y + x / y) * 0.5; i = i + 1 }
    y
}

fn xd_abs(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

fn xd_exp(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 64.0 { return 0.0 }
    if x < 0.0 - 64.0 { return 0.0 }
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var kf = x / ln2
    var k: i32 = 0
    if kf >= 0.0 { k = kf as i32 } else { k = (kf as i32) - 1 }
    let r = x - (k as f64) * ln2
    var sum: f64 = 1.0
    var term: f64 = 1.0
    var n: i32 = 1
    while n < 24 {
        term = term * r / (n as f64)
        sum = sum + term
        n = n + 1
    }
    var result = sum
    if k >= 0 {
        var ii: i32 = 0
        while ii < k { result = result * 2.0; ii = ii + 1 }
    } else {
        var jj: i32 = 0
        while jj < (0 - k) { result = result / 2.0; jj = jj + 1 }
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// CLOSED-FORM ENDPOINTS
// ============================================================================

fn xd_auc_iv(dose: f64, cl_eff: f64) -> f64 with Div, Panic {
    if cl_eff <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    dose / cl_eff
}

fn xd_c_isf(dose: f64, cl_eff: f64, fu: f64, kp_brain: f64) -> f64 with Div, Panic {
    if cl_eff <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    fu * kp_brain * dose / cl_eff
}

fn xd_auc_mic(dose: f64, tau_h: f64, cl_eff: f64, mic: f64) -> f64 with Div, Panic {
    if cl_eff <= 0.0 || mic <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    (dose * tau_h) / cl_eff / mic
}

fn xd_c_trough_oral(f_oral: f64, dose: f64, vc: f64, cl: f64, tau_h: f64)
    -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic
{
    if vc <= 0.0 || cl <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    let theta = cl * tau_h / vc
    if theta <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    let edenom = xd_exp(theta) - 1.0
    if edenom <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    (f_oral * dose / vc) / edenom * 1000.0    // ng/mL
}

// ============================================================================
// GUM BUDGET — generic finite-difference Jacobian for N sources.
// Returns the variance fractions array (length 4).
// ============================================================================

fn xd_h(mean: f64, variance: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let h_rel = 1.0e-6 * xd_abs(mean)
    let h_abs = 0.01 * xd_sqrt(variance)
