module data::csv_loader

extern "C" {
    fn sqrt(x: f64) -> f64;
}

// ============================================================================
// DATA STRUCTURES
// ============================================================================

// Single edge in the network
pub struct Edge {
    pub source: usize,
    pub target: usize,
    pub weight: f64,
}

pub struct WeightedEdge {
    pub neighbor: usize,
    pub weight: f64,
}

// Loaded network data
pub struct NetworkData {
    pub num_nodes: usize,
    pub edges: [Edge],
    pub node_labels: [string],
    pub weighted: bool,
}

fn network_data_new() -> NetworkData {
    var edges: [Edge] = []
    var labels: [string] = []
    NetworkData {
        num_nodes: 0,
        edges: edges,
        node_labels: labels,
        weighted: false,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// HELPER FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

fn abs_i64(x: i64) -> i64 {
    if x < 0 { -x } else { x }
}

fn max_usize(a: usize, b: usize) -> usize {
    if a > b { a } else { b }
}

// Parse string as integer
fn parse_i64(s: string) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    var result: i64 = 0
    var i: usize = 0
    var neg = false

    // Check for negative sign
    if i < s.len() {
        let c = s.char_at(0)
        if c == '-' {
            neg = true
            i = 1
        } else if c == '+' {
            i = 1
        }
    }

    // Parse digits
    while i < s.len() {
        let c = s.char_at(i)
        if c >= '0' && c <= '9' {
            let digit = (c as i64) - ('0' as i64)
            result = result * 10 + digit
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    if neg { -result } else { result }
}

// Parse string as float
fn parse_f64(s: string) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    var result: f64 = 0.0
    var i: usize = 0
    var neg = false
    var found_dot = false
    var decimal_places = 0

    // Check for negative sign
    if i < s.len() {
        let c = s.char_at(0)
        if c == '-' {
            neg = true
            i = 1
        } else if c == '+' {
            i = 1
        }
    }

    // Parse digits and decimal point
    while i < s.len() {
        let c = s.char_at(i)
        if c == '.' {
            found_dot = true
        } else if c >= '0' && c <= '9' {
            let digit = ((c as i64) - ('0' as i64)) as f64
            result = result * 10.0 + digit
            if found_dot {
                decimal_places = decimal_places + 1
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Apply decimal scaling
    var scale = 1.0
    var j = 0
    while j < decimal_places {
        scale = scale * 0.1
        j = j + 1
    }
    result = result * scale

    if neg { -result } else { result }
}

// Split string by delimiter
fn split_string(s: string, delimiter: string) -> [string] with Mut, Div {
    var parts: [string] = []
    var current: string = ""
    var i: usize = 0

    while i < s.len() {
        if i + delimiter.len() <= s.len() {
            // Check if delimiter matches at position i
            var matches = true
            var j: usize = 0
            while j < delimiter.len() {
                if s.char_at(i + j) != delimiter.char_at(j) {
                    matches = false
                }
                j = j + 1
            }

            if matches {
                parts.push(current)
                current = ""
                i = i + delimiter.len()
                continue
            }
        }

        current = current ++ s.char_at(i)
        i = i + 1
    }

    if current.len() > 0 {
        parts.push(current)
    }

    parts
}

// Trim whitespace from string
fn trim_string(s: string) -> string with Mut, Div {
    var start: usize = 0
    var end: usize = s.len()

    // Find first non-whitespace
    while start < s.len() {
        let c = s.char_at(start)
        if c != ' ' && c != '\t' && c != '\n' && c != '\r' {
            break
        }
        start = start + 1
    }

    // Find last non-whitespace
    while end > start {
        let c = s.char_at(end - 1)
        if c != ' ' && c != '\t' && c != '\n' && c != '\r' {
            break
        }
        end = end - 1
    }

    if end > start {
        var result: string = ""
        var i = start
        while i < end {
            result = result ++ s.char_at(i)
            i = i + 1
        }
        result
    } else {
        ""
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN PARSING FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

// Parse edge list from CSV content string
pub fn parse_edge_list(csv_content: string) -> NetworkData with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var net = network_data_new()

    var max_node: usize = 0
    var lines = split_string(csv_content, "\n")

    var line_idx: usize = 0
    while line_idx < lines.len() {
        let line = trim_string(lines[line_idx])

        // Skip empty lines and comments
        if line.len() == 0 || (line.len() > 0 && line.char_at(0) == '#') {
            line_idx = line_idx + 1
            continue
        }

        // Parse CSV line
        let parts = split_string(line, ",")

        if parts.len() >= 2 {
            let source_str = trim_string(parts[0])
            let target_str = trim_string(parts[1])

            let source = (parse_i64(source_str) as usize)
            let target = (parse_i64(target_str) as usize)

            var weight = 1.0
            if parts.len() >= 3 {
                let weight_str = trim_string(parts[2])
                weight = parse_f64(weight_str)
                net.weighted = true
            }

            // Track maximum node ID to determine graph size
            max_node = max_usize(max_node, source)
            max_node = max_usize(max_node, target)

            // Add edge
            var edge = Edge {
                source: source,
                target: target,
                weight: weight,
            }
            net.edges.push(edge)
        }

        line_idx = line_idx + 1
    }

    // Number of nodes is max_node + 1
    net.num_nodes = max_node + 1

    net
}

// Load edge list from file
pub fn load_edge_list(filepath: string) -> NetworkData with IO {
    var net = network_data_new()
    // Note: File I/O not implemented in interpreter; would need stdlib::fs module
    net
}

// ============================================================================
// GRAPH CONVERSION FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

// Convert NetworkData to adjacency list (undirected, unweighted)
pub fn to_adjacency_list(net: &NetworkData) -> [[usize]] with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var adj: [[usize]] = []

    // Initialize adjacency list with empty vectors
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < net.num_nodes {
        var empty: [usize] = []
        adj.push(empty)
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Add edges (both directions for undirected graph)
    i = 0
    while i < net.edges.len() {
        let edge = net.edges[i]
        let src = edge.source
        let tgt = edge.target

        // Add forward edge
        if src < net.num_nodes {
            adj[src].push(tgt)
        }

        // Add reverse edge (unless self-loop)
        if tgt < net.num_nodes && src != tgt {
            adj[tgt].push(src)
        }

        i = i + 1
    }

    adj
}

// Convert NetworkData to weighted adjacency list
pub fn to_weighted_adjacency(net: &NetworkData) -> [[WeightedEdge]] with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var adj: [[WeightedEdge]] = []

    // Initialize adjacency list with empty vectors
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < net.num_nodes {
        var empty: [WeightedEdge] = []
        adj.push(empty)
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Add edges (both directions for undirected graph)
    i = 0
    while i < net.edges.len() {
        let edge = net.edges[i]
        let src = edge.source
        let tgt = edge.target
        let w = edge.weight

        // Add forward edge
        if src < net.num_nodes {
            var we = WeightedEdge {
                neighbor: tgt,
                weight: w,
            }
            adj[src].push(we)
        }

        // Add reverse edge (unless self-loop)
        if tgt < net.num_nodes && src != tgt {
            var we_rev = WeightedEdge {
                neighbor: src,
                weight: w,
            }
            adj[tgt].push(we_rev)
        }

        i = i + 1
    }

    adj
}

// ============================================================================
// VALIDATION FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

// Validate that edge list is consistent
pub fn validate_edge_list(net: &NetworkData) -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var valid = true

    // Check for invalid node indices
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < net.edges.len() {
        let edge = net.edges[i]
        if edge.source >= net.num_nodes || edge.target >= net.num_nodes {
            valid = false
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    valid
}

// ============================================================================
// TESTS
// ============================================================================

// Test: Parse simple unweighted edge list
pub fn test_parse_simple_edge_list() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let csv = "0,1\n1,2\n2,0\n"
    let net = parse_edge_list(csv)

    // Should have 3 nodes and 3 edges
    net.num_nodes == 3 && net.edges.len() == 3 && !net.weighted
}

// Test: Parse weighted edge list
pub fn test_parse_weighted_edge_list() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let csv = "0,1,0.5\n1,2,0.7\n2,0,0.3\n"
    let net = parse_edge_list(csv)

    // Should have 3 nodes, 3 edges, and be marked as weighted
    net.num_nodes == 3 && net.edges.len() == 3 && net.weighted
}

// Test: Adjacency list conversion
pub fn test_adjacency_list_conversion() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let csv = "0,1\n1,2\n"
    let net = parse_edge_list(csv)
    let adj = to_adjacency_list(&net)

    // Check adjacency list structure
    adj.len() == 3 && adj[0].len() >= 1 && adj[2].len() >= 1
}

// Test: Handle comments and empty lines
pub fn test_parse_with_comments() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let csv = "# Comment\n0,1\n\n1,2\n"
    let net = parse_edge_list(csv)

    net.num_nodes == 3 && net.edges.len() == 2
}

// Master test function
pub fn run_csv_loader_tests() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    test_parse_simple_edge_list() &&
    test_parse_weighted_edge_list() &&
    test_adjacency_list_conversion() &&
    test_parse_with_comments()
}


// === FILE: stdlib/data/dataframe.sio ===
// stdlib/data/dataframe.sio
// Dense DataFrame — flat fixed-array tabular storage
//
// Row-major layout: data[row * MAX_COLS + col]
// Max 64 columns, 1024 rows = 65536 f64 slots.
//
// Design: all ops are free functions over the DataFrame struct.
// Mutation uses the struct-wrapper pattern to work around
// the JIT &![T; N] visibility bug (see KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md).

extern "C" {
    fn sqrt(x: f64) -> f64
}

fn df_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    return sqrt(x)
}

fn df_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

// ============================================================================
// CONSTANTS
// ============================================================================

fn df_max_cols() -> i64 { 64 }
fn df_max_rows() -> i64 { 1024 }
fn df_max_cells() -> i64 { 65536 }

// ============================================================================
// DATAFRAME STRUCT
// ============================================================================

pub struct DataFrame {
    data: [f64; 65536],
    col_names: [i64; 64],
    n_rows: i64,
    n_cols: i64,
}

// ============================================================================
// CONSTRUCTION
// ============================================================================

// Create an empty DataFrame with the given number of columns.
pub fn df_new(n_cols: i64) -> DataFrame {
    var nc = n_cols
    if nc < 0 { nc = 0 }
    if nc > 64 { nc = 64 }
    DataFrame {
        data: [0.0; 65536],
        col_names: [0; 64],
        n_rows: 0,
        n_cols: nc,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// ELEMENT ACCESS
// ============================================================================

// Set a single cell value.
pub fn df_set(df: &!DataFrame, row: i64, col: i64, val: f64) with Mut, Panic {
    if row < 0 { return }
    if col < 0 { return }
    if row >= df.n_rows { return }
    if col >= df.n_cols { return }
    let idx = row * 64 + col
    df.data[idx] = val
}

// Get a single cell value.
pub fn df_get(df: &DataFrame, row: i64, col: i64) -> f64 with Panic {
    if row < 0 { return 0.0 }
    if col < 0 { return 0.0 }
    if row >= df.n_rows { return 0.0 }
    if col >= df.n_cols { return 0.0 }
    let idx = row * 64 + col
    return df.data[idx]
}

// ============================================================================
// ROW OPERATIONS
// ============================================================================

// Append a row of values. Reads up to n_cols values from the input array.
pub fn df_add_row(df: &!DataFrame, values: &[f64; 64]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if df.n_rows >= 1024 { return }
    let row = df.n_rows
    var col: i64 = 0
    while col < df.n_cols {
        let idx = row * 64 + col
        df.data[idx] = values[col]
        col = col + 1
    }
    df.n_rows = df.n_rows + 1
}

// ============================================================================
// COLUMN STATISTICS
// ============================================================================

// Column mean.
pub fn df_col_mean(df: &DataFrame, col: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if col < 0 { return 0.0 }
    if col >= df.n_cols { return 0.0 }
    if df.n_rows == 0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 0.0
    var row: i64 = 0
    while row < df.n_rows {
        sum = sum + df.data[row * 64 + col]
        row = row + 1
    }
    return sum / (df.n_rows as f64)
}

// Column standard deviation (sample, Bessel-corrected).
pub fn df_col_std(df: &DataFrame, col: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if col < 0 { return 0.0 }
    if col >= df.n_cols { return 0.0 }
    if df.n_rows < 2 { return 0.0 }
    let mean = df_col_mean(df, col)
    var sum_sq = 0.0
    var row: i64 = 0
    while row < df.n_rows {
        let diff = df.data[row * 64 + col] - mean
        sum_sq = sum_sq + diff * diff
        row = row + 1
    }
    let variance = sum_sq / ((df.n_rows - 1) as f64)
    return df_sqrt(variance)
}

// Column minimum.
pub fn df_col_min(df: &DataFrame, col: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if col < 0 { return 0.0 }
    if col >= df.n_cols { return 0.0 }
    if df.n_rows == 0 { return 0.0 }
    var m = df.data[0 * 64 + col]
    var row: i64 = 1
    while row < df.n_rows {
        let v = df.data[row * 64 + col]
        if v < m { m = v }
        row = row + 1
    }
    return m
}

// Column maximum.
pub fn df_col_max(df: &DataFrame, col: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if col < 0 { return 0.0 }
    if col >= df.n_cols { return 0.0 }
    if df.n_rows == 0 { return 0.0 }
    var m = df.data[0 * 64 + col]
    var row: i64 = 1
    while row < df.n_rows {
        let v = df.data[row * 64 + col]
        if v > m { m = v }
        row = row + 1
    }
    return m
}

// Column sum.
pub fn df_col_sum(df: &DataFrame, col: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if col < 0 { return 0.0 }
    if col >= df.n_cols { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 0.0
    var row: i64 = 0
    while row < df.n_rows {
        sum = sum + df.data[row * 64 + col]
        row = row + 1
    }
    return sum
}

// ============================================================================
// FILTERING
// ============================================================================

// Return a new DataFrame containing only rows where column col > threshold.
pub fn df_filter_gt(df: &DataFrame, col: i64, threshold: f64) -> DataFrame with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var result = df_new(df.n_cols)
    if col < 0 { return result }
    if col >= df.n_cols { return result }
    var row: i64 = 0
    while row < df.n_rows {
        let v = df.data[row * 64 + col]
        if v > threshold {
            // Copy this row into result
            if result.n_rows < 1024 {
                let dst_row = result.n_rows
                var c: i64 = 0
                while c < df.n_cols {
                    result.data[dst_row * 64 + c] = df.data[row * 64 + c]
                    c = c + 1
                }
                result.n_rows = result.n_rows + 1
            }
        }
        row = row + 1
    }
    // Copy column name IDs
    var ci: i64 = 0
    while ci < df.n_cols {
        result.col_names[ci] = df.col_names[ci]
        ci = ci + 1
    }
    return result
}

// ============================================================================
// COLUMN PROJECTION
// ============================================================================

// Select a subset of columns. cols contains column indices, n_sel is the
// number of columns to select.
pub fn df_select_cols(df: &DataFrame, cols: &[i64; 64], n_sel: i64) -> DataFrame with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var ns = n_sel
    if ns < 0 { ns = 0 }
    if ns > 64 { ns = 64 }
    var result = df_new(ns)
    var row: i64 = 0
    while row < df.n_rows {
        if result.n_rows < 1024 {
            let dst_row = result.n_rows
            var s: i64 = 0
            while s < ns {
                let src_col = cols[s]
                if src_col >= 0 {
                    if src_col < df.n_cols {
                        result.data[dst_row * 64 + s] = df.data[row * 64 + src_col]
                    }
                }
                s = s + 1
            }
            result.n_rows = result.n_rows + 1
        }
        row = row + 1
    }
    // Map column name IDs
    var ci: i64 = 0
    while ci < ns {
        let src_col = cols[ci]
        if src_col >= 0 {
            if src_col < df.n_cols {
                result.col_names[ci] = df.col_names[src_col]
            }
        }
        ci = ci + 1
    }
    return result
}

// ============================================================================
// SORTING
// ============================================================================

// Sort rows by a column value (ascending). Returns a new DataFrame.
// Uses insertion sort for simplicity and correctness.
pub fn df_sort_by(df: &DataFrame, col: i64) -> DataFrame with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var result = df_new(df.n_cols)
    if col < 0 { return result }
    if col >= df.n_cols { return result }

    // Copy all data into result first
    var row: i64 = 0
    while row < df.n_rows {
        var c: i64 = 0
        while c < df.n_cols {
            result.data[row * 64 + c] = df.data[row * 64 + c]
            c = c + 1
        }
        row = row + 1
    }
    result.n_rows = df.n_rows

    // Copy column names
    var ci: i64 = 0
    while ci < df.n_cols {
        result.col_names[ci] = df.col_names[ci]
        ci = ci + 1
    }

    // Insertion sort by column col
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < result.n_rows {
        let key_val = result.data[i * 64 + col]
        var j = i - 1
        while j >= 0 {
            let cmp_val = result.data[j * 64 + col]
            if cmp_val > key_val {
                // Swap rows j and j+1
                var c2: i64 = 0
                while c2 < result.n_cols {
                    let tmp = result.data[(j + 1) * 64 + c2]
                    result.data[(j + 1) * 64 + c2] = result.data[j * 64 + c2]
                    result.data[j * 64 + c2] = tmp
                    c2 = c2 + 1
                }
                j = j - 1
            } else {
                j = -1  // break out of inner loop
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return result
}

// ============================================================================
// CSV-STYLE LOADING
// ============================================================================

// Load pre-parsed numeric data into a DataFrame.
// data is a flat array in row-major order (row * n_cols_actual + col),
// but stored in a [f64; 65536] buffer.
pub fn df_from_csv_data(data: &[f64; 65536], n_rows: i64, n_cols: i64) -> DataFrame with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var nr = n_rows
    var nc = n_cols
    if nr < 0 { nr = 0 }
    if nc < 0 { nc = 0 }
    if nr > 1024 { nr = 1024 }
    if nc > 64 { nc = 64 }
    var result = df_new(nc)
    var row: i64 = 0
    while row < nr {
        var col: i64 = 0
        while col < nc {
            // Source uses actual n_cols stride; dest uses 64 stride
            let src_idx = row * nc + col
            result.data[row * 64 + col] = data[src_idx]
            col = col + 1
        }
        row = row + 1
    }
    result.n_rows = nr
    return result
}

// ============================================================================
// SUMMARY / DESCRIBE
// ============================================================================

// Print mean, std, min, max for each column.
pub fn df_describe(df: &DataFrame) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    println("DataFrame describe:")
    print("  rows: ")
    println(df.n_rows)
    print("  cols: ")
    println(df.n_cols)
    println("  ---")
    var col: i64 = 0
    while col < df.n_cols {
        print("  col ")
        print(col)
        print(":  mean=")
        print(df_col_mean(df, col))
        print("  std=")
        print(df_col_std(df, col))
        print("  min=")
        print(df_col_min(df, col))
        print("  max=")
        println(df_col_max(df, col))
        col = col + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// COLUMN NAME HELPERS
// ============================================================================

// Assign an integer name ID to a column.
pub fn df_set_col_name(df: &!DataFrame, col: i64, name_id: i64) with Mut, Panic {
    if col >= 0 {
        if col < df.n_cols {
            df.col_names[col] = name_id
        }
    }
}

// Get the name ID of a column.
pub fn df_get_col_name(df: &DataFrame, col: i64) -> i64 with Panic {
    if col < 0 { return 0 }
    if col >= df.n_cols { return 0 }
    return df.col_names[col]
}

// Dimension accessors
pub fn df_nrows(df: &DataFrame) -> i64 { df.n_rows }
pub fn df_ncols(df: &DataFrame) -> i64 { df.n_cols }


// === FILE: stdlib/data/frame.sio ===
// stdlib/data/frame.d
// DataFrame - Tabular Data with Epistemic Integration
//
// A DataFrame holds named columns of different types. This implementation
// uses a type-erased column approach where each column is stored separately.

extern "C" {
    fn sqrt(x: f64) -> f64;
}

fn frm_sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    return sqrt(x)
}

// ============================================================================
// COLUMN TYPE - Type-erased column storage
// ============================================================================

// Column types: 0=Float, 1=Int, 2=String, 3=Bool, 4=Epistemic
pub struct Column {
    pub name: String,
    pub dtype: i32,           // Type discriminator
    pub float_data: [f64],
    pub int_data: [i64],
    pub string_data: [String],
    pub bool_data: [bool],
    // Epistemic data
    pub uncert_data: [f64],   // Uncertainties (for epistemic)
    pub conf_data: [f64],     // Confidences (for epistemic)
}

pub fn column_float(name: String, data: [f64]) -> Column {
    var empty_i: [i64] = []
    var empty_s: [String] = []
    var empty_b: [bool] = []
    var empty_u: [f64] = []
    var empty_c: [f64] = []
    Column {
        name: name,
        dtype: 0,
        float_data: data,
        int_data: empty_i,
        string_data: empty_s,
        bool_data: empty_b,
        uncert_data: empty_u,
        conf_data: empty_c,
    }
}

pub fn column_int(name: String, data: [i64]) -> Column {
    var empty_f: [f64] = []
    var empty_s: [String] = []
    var empty_b: [bool] = []
    var empty_u: [f64] = []
    var empty_c: [f64] = []
    Column {
        name: name,
        dtype: 1,
        float_data: empty_f,
        int_data: data,
        string_data: empty_s,
        bool_data: empty_b,
        uncert_data: empty_u,
        conf_data: empty_c,
    }
}

pub fn column_string(name: String, data: [String]) -> Column {
    var empty_f: [f64] = []
    var empty_i: [i64] = []
    var empty_b: [bool] = []
    var empty_u: [f64] = []
    var empty_c: [f64] = []
    Column {
        name: name,
        dtype: 2,
        float_data: empty_f,
        int_data: empty_i,
        string_data: data,
        bool_data: empty_b,
        uncert_data: empty_u,
        conf_data: empty_c,
    }
}

pub fn column_bool(name: String, data: [bool]) -> Column {
    var empty_f: [f64] = []
    var empty_i: [i64] = []
    var empty_s: [String] = []
    var empty_u: [f64] = []
    var empty_c: [f64] = []
    Column {
        name: name,
        dtype: 3,
        float_data: empty_f,
        int_data: empty_i,
        string_data: empty_s,
        bool_data: data,
        uncert_data: empty_u,
        conf_data: empty_c,
    }
}

pub fn column_epistemic(name: String, values: [f64], uncerts: [f64], confs: [f64]) -> Column {
    var empty_i: [i64] = []
    var empty_s: [String] = []
    var empty_b: [bool] = []
    Column {
        name: name,
        dtype: 4,
        float_data: values,
        int_data: empty_i,
        string_data: empty_s,
        bool_data: empty_b,
        uncert_data: uncerts,
        conf_data: confs,
    }
}

pub fn column_len(col: Column) -> usize {
    if col.dtype == 0 { return col.float_data.len() }
    if col.dtype == 1 { return col.int_data.len() }
    if col.dtype == 2 { return col.string_data.len() }
    if col.dtype == 3 { return col.bool_data.len() }
    if col.dtype == 4 { return col.float_data.len() }
    0
}

pub fn column_dtype_str(col: Column) -> String {
    if col.dtype == 0 { return "float" }
    if col.dtype == 1 { return "int" }
    if col.dtype == 2 { return "string" }
    if col.dtype == 3 { return "bool" }
    if col.dtype == 4 { return "epistemic" }
    "unknown"
}

pub fn column_is_numeric(col: Column) -> bool {
    col.dtype == 0 || col.dtype == 1 || col.dtype == 4
}

// ============================================================================
// DATAFRAME TYPE
// ============================================================================

pub struct DataFrame {
    pub columns: [Column],
    pub index_name: String,
}

pub fn dataframe_new() -> DataFrame {
    var empty: [Column] = []
    DataFrame { columns: empty, index_name: "" }
}

pub fn dataframe_ncols(df: DataFrame) -> usize {
    df.columns.len()
}

pub fn dataframe_nrows(df: DataFrame) -> usize {
    if df.columns.len() == 0 { return 0 }
    column_len(df.columns[0])
}

pub fn dataframe_shape(df: DataFrame) -> (usize, usize) {
    (dataframe_nrows(df), dataframe_ncols(df))
}

pub fn dataframe_add_column(df: DataFrame, col: Column) -> DataFrame {
    var cols = df.columns
    cols.push(col)
    DataFrame { columns: cols, index_name: df.index_name }
}

pub fn dataframe_column_names(df: DataFrame) -> [String] {
    var names: [String] = []
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < df.columns.len() {
        names.push(df.columns[i].name)
        i = i + 1
    }
    names
}

// Get column by name
pub fn dataframe_get_column(df: DataFrame, name: String) -> Column {
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < df.columns.len() {
        if df.columns[i].name == name {
            return df.columns[i]
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    // Return empty column if not found
    var empty: [f64] = []
    column_float("", empty)
}

// Get column by index
pub fn dataframe_get_column_idx(df: DataFrame, idx: usize) -> Column {
    if idx < df.columns.len() {
        return df.columns[idx]
    }
    var empty: [f64] = []
    column_float("", empty)
}

// Check if column exists
pub fn dataframe_has_column(df: DataFrame, name: String) -> bool {
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < df.columns.len() {
        if df.columns[i].name == name {
            return true
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    false
}

// Drop column by name
pub fn dataframe_drop_column(df: DataFrame, name: String) -> DataFrame {
    var new_cols: [Column] = []
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < df.columns.len() {
        if df.columns[i].name != name {
            new_cols.push(df.columns[i])
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    DataFrame { columns: new_cols, index_name: df.index_name }
}

// ============================================================================
// ROW ACCESS
// ============================================================================

pub struct Row {
    pub column_names: [String],
    pub float_values: [f64],
    pub int_values: [i64],
    pub string_values: [String],
    pub bool_values: [bool],
    pub dtypes: [i32],
}

pub fn dataframe_get_row(df: DataFrame, row_idx: usize) -> Row {
    var names: [String] = []
    var floats: [f64] = []
    var ints: [i64] = []
    var strings: [String] = []
    var bools: [bool] = []
    var types: [i32] = []

    var i: usize = 0
    while i < df.columns.len() {
        let col = df.columns[i]
        names.push(col.name)
        types.push(col.dtype)

        if col.dtype == 0 {
            if row_idx < col.float_data.len() {
                floats.push(col.float_data[row_idx])
            } else {
                floats.push(0.0)
            }
            ints.push(0)
            strings.push("")
            bools.push(false)
        } else if col.dtype == 1 {
            floats.push(0.0)
            if row_idx < col.int_data.len() {
                ints.push(col.int_data[row_idx])
            } else {
                ints.push(0)
            }
            strings.push("")
            bools.push(false)
        } else if col.dtype == 2 {
            floats.push(0.0)
            ints.push(0)
            if row_idx < col.string_data.len() {
                strings.push(col.string_data[row_idx])
            } else {
                strings.push("")
            }
            bools.push(false)
        } else if col.dtype == 3 {
            floats.push(0.0)
            ints.push(0)
            strings.push("")
            if row_idx < col.bool_data.len() {
                bools.push(col.bool_data[row_idx])
            } else {
                bools.push(false)
            }
        } else if col.dtype == 4 {
            // Epistemic: return value as float
            if row_idx < col.float_data.len() {
                floats.push(col.float_data[row_idx])
            } else {
                floats.push(0.0)
            }
            ints.push(0)
            strings.push("")
            bools.push(false)
        }

        i = i + 1
    }

    Row {
        column_names: names,
        float_values: floats,
        int_values: ints,
        string_values: strings,
        bool_values: bools,
        dtypes: types,
    }
}

// Get float value from row by column name
pub fn row_get_float(row: Row, col_name: String) -> f64 {
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < row.column_names.len() {
        if row.column_names[i] == col_name {
            return row.float_values[i]
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    0.0
}

// Get string value from row by column name
pub fn row_get_string(row: Row, col_name: String) -> String {
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < row.column_names.len() {
        if row.column_names[i] == col_name {
            return row.string_values[i]
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    ""
}

// ============================================================================
// SLICING / FILTERING
// ============================================================================

// Get rows by range [start, end)
pub fn dataframe_slice(df: DataFrame, start: usize, end: usize) -> DataFrame {
    var new_cols: [Column] = []
    var i: usize = 0

    while i < df.columns.len() {
        let col = df.columns[i]

        if col.dtype == 0 {
            var new_data: [f64] = []
            var j = start
            while j < end && j < col.float_data.len() {
                new_data.push(col.float_data[j])
                j = j + 1
            }
            new_cols.push(column_float(col.name, new_data))
        } else if col.dtype == 1 {
            var new_data: [i64] = []
            var j = start
            while j < end && j < col.int_data.len() {
                new_data.push(col.int_data[j])
                j = j + 1
            }
            new_cols.push(column_int(col.name, new_data))
        } else if col.dtype == 2 {
            var new_data: [String] = []
            var j = start
            while j < end && j < col.string_data.len() {
                new_data.push(col.string_data[j])
                j = j + 1
            }
            new_cols.push(column_string(col.name, new_data))
        } else if col.dtype == 3 {
            var new_data: [bool] = []
            var j = start
            while j < end && j < col.bool_data.len() {
                new_data.push(col.bool_data[j])
                j = j + 1
            }
            new_cols.push(column_bool(col.name, new_data))
        } else if col.dtype == 4 {
            var vals: [f64] = []
            var uncerts: [f64] = []
            var confs: [f64] = []
            var j = start
            while j < end && j < col.float_data.len() {
                vals.push(col.float_data[j])
                uncerts.push(col.uncert_data[j])
                confs.push(col.conf_data[j])
                j = j + 1
            }
            new_cols.push(column_epistemic(col.name, vals, uncerts, confs))
        }

        i = i + 1
    }

    DataFrame { columns: new_cols, index_name: df.index_name }
}

// Head - first n rows
pub fn dataframe_head(df: DataFrame, n: usize) -> DataFrame {
    dataframe_slice(df, 0, n)
}

// Tail - last n rows
pub fn dataframe_tail(df: DataFrame, n: usize) -> DataFrame {
    let nrows = dataframe_nrows(df)
    if n >= nrows {
        return df
    }
    dataframe_slice(df, nrows - n, nrows)
}

// Filter by boolean mask
pub fn dataframe_filter(df: DataFrame, mask: [bool]) -> DataFrame {
    var new_cols: [Column] = []
    var i: usize = 0

    while i < df.columns.len() {
        let col = df.columns[i]

        if col.dtype == 0 {
            var new_data: [f64] = []
            var j: usize = 0
            while j < col.float_data.len() && j < mask.len() {
                if mask[j] {
                    new_data.push(col.float_data[j])
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
            new_cols.push(column_float(col.name, new_data))
        } else if col.dtype == 1 {
            var new_data: [i64] = []
            var j: usize = 0
            while j < col.int_data.len() && j < mask.len() {
                if mask[j] {
                    new_data.push(col.int_data[j])
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
            new_cols.push(column_int(col.name, new_data))
        } else if col.dtype == 2 {
            var new_data: [String] = []
            var j: usize = 0
            while j < col.string_data.len() && j < mask.len() {
                if mask[j] {
                    new_data.push(col.string_data[j])
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
            new_cols.push(column_string(col.name, new_data))
        } else if col.dtype == 3 {
            var new_data: [bool] = []
            var j: usize = 0
            while j < col.bool_data.len() && j < mask.len() {
                if mask[j] {
                    new_data.push(col.bool_data[j])
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
            new_cols.push(column_bool(col.name, new_data))
        } else if col.dtype == 4 {
            var vals: [f64] = []
            var uncerts: [f64] = []
            var confs: [f64] = []
            var j: usize = 0
            while j < col.float_data.len() && j < mask.len() {
                if mask[j] {
                    vals.push(col.float_data[j])
                    uncerts.push(col.uncert_data[j])
                    confs.push(col.conf_data[j])
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
            new_cols.push(column_epistemic(col.name, vals, uncerts, confs))
        }

        i = i + 1
    }

    DataFrame { columns: new_cols, index_name: df.index_name }
}

// ============================================================================
// COLUMN OPERATIONS
// ============================================================================

// Sum of numeric column
pub fn dataframe_col_sum(df: DataFrame, col_name: String) -> f64 {
    let col = dataframe_get_column(df, col_name)
    if col.dtype == 0 {
        var total = 0.0
        var i: usize = 0
        while i < col.float_data.len() {
            total = total + col.float_data[i]
            i = i + 1
        }
        return total
    }
    if col.dtype == 1 {
        var total: i64 = 0
        var i: usize = 0
        while i < col.int_data.len() {
            total = total + col.int_data[i]
            i = i + 1
        }
        return total as f64
    }
    if col.dtype == 4 {
        var total = 0.0
        var i: usize = 0
        while i < col.float_data.len() {
            total = total + col.float_data[i]
            i = i + 1
        }
        return total
    }
    0.0
}

// Mean of numeric column
pub fn dataframe_col_mean(df: DataFrame, col_name: String) -> f64 {
    let col = dataframe_get_column(df, col_name)
    let n = column_len(col)
    if n == 0 { return 0.0 }
    dataframe_col_sum(df, col_name) / (n as f64)
}

// Epistemic mean of epistemic column (with uncertainty propagation)
pub struct EpistemicResult {
    pub value: f64,
    pub uncertainty: f64,
    pub confidence: f64,
}

pub fn dataframe_col_mean_epistemic(df: DataFrame, col_name: String) -> EpistemicResult {
    let col = dataframe_get_column(df, col_name)
    let n = col.float_data.len()

    if n == 0 || col.dtype != 4 {
        return EpistemicResult { value: 0.0, uncertainty: 0.0, confidence: 0.0 }
    }

    // Calculate mean
    var sum_val = 0.0
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < n {
        sum_val = sum_val + col.float_data[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    let mean_val = sum_val / (n as f64)

    // GUM: u(mean)^2 = (1/n^2) * sum(u_i^2)
    var sum_u_sq = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        let ui = col.uncert_data[i]
        sum_u_sq = sum_u_sq + ui * ui
        i = i + 1
    }
    let mean_u = frm_sqrt_f64(sum_u_sq) / (n as f64)

    // Minimum confidence
    var min_conf = 1.0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        if col.conf_data[i] < min_conf {
            min_conf = col.conf_data[i]
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    EpistemicResult { value: mean_val, uncertainty: mean_u, confidence: min_conf }
}

// ============================================================================
// DISPLAY
// ============================================================================

pub fn dataframe_info(df: DataFrame) -> String {
    let shape = dataframe_shape(df)
    var result = "DataFrame: " ++ (shape.0 as String) ++ " rows x " ++ (shape.1 as String) ++ " columns\n"
    result = result ++ "Columns:\n"

    var i: usize = 0
    while i < df.columns.len() {
        let col = df.columns[i]
        result = result ++ "  " ++ col.name ++ " (" ++ column_dtype_str(col) ++ ")\n"
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// === FILE: stdlib/data/io.sio ===
// stdlib/data/io.sio
// CSV parsing utilities for fixed arrays
//
// Simple CSV field parsing and float conversion.

// Check if a byte is a digit (ASCII 0-9)
fn io_is_digit(b: i64) -> i64 {
    if b >= 48 {
        if b <= 57 { return 1 }
    }
    return 0
}

// Parse a float from a fixed byte buffer
// buf: ASCII bytes, len: number of valid bytes
// Returns parsed f64 value
fn io_parse_float(buf: [u8; 64], len: i64) -> f64 {
    if len == 0 { return 0.0 }

    var result = 0.0
    var decimal_part = 0.0
    var decimal_divisor = 1.0
    var is_negative = 0
    var in_decimal = 0
    var i: i64 = 0

    // Skip leading whitespace
    while i < len {
        let b = buf[i] as i64
        if b != 32 {
            if b != 9 { break }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Check sign
    if i < len {
        let b = buf[i] as i64
        if b == 45 {
            is_negative = 1
            i = i + 1
        } else if b == 43 {
            i = i + 1
        }
    }

    while i < len {
        let b = buf[i] as i64
        if b == 46 {
            in_decimal = 1
        } else if io_is_digit(b) == 1 {
            let digit = (b - 48) as f64
            if in_decimal == 1 {
                decimal_divisor = decimal_divisor * 10.0
                decimal_part = decimal_part + digit / decimal_divisor
            } else {
                result = result * 10.0 + digit
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    result = result + decimal_part
    if is_negative == 1 {
        result = 0.0 - result
    }
    return result
}

// Check if a byte buffer contains only numeric characters
fn io_is_numeric(buf: [u8; 64], len: i64) -> i64 {
    if len == 0 { return 0 }
    var has_digit = 0
    var has_dot = 0
    var i: i64 = 0

    // Skip whitespace
    while i < len {
        let b = buf[i] as i64
        if b != 32 {
            if b != 9 { break }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    while i < len {
        let b = buf[i] as i64
        if b == 45 {
            if i != 0 { return 0 }
        } else if b == 43 {
            if i != 0 { return 0 }
        } else if b == 46 {
            if has_dot == 1 { return 0 }
            has_dot = 1
        } else if io_is_digit(b) == 1 {
            has_digit = 1
        } else if b == 32 {
            break
        } else if b == 9 {
            break
        } else {
            return 0
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return has_digit
}

// Count comma-separated fields in a line buffer
fn io_count_fields(buf: [u8; 256], len: i64) -> i64 {
    if len == 0 { return 0 }
    var count: i64 = 1
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < len {
        if buf[i] as i64 == 44 {
            count = count + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return count
}

// === FILE: stdlib/data/ops.sio ===
// stdlib/data/ops.sio
// DataFrame-like operations on fixed arrays
//
// Provides groupby, aggregation, cumulative, and rolling operations
// on fixed-size f64 arrays.

extern "C" {
    fn sqrt(x: f64) -> f64
}

fn ops_sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    return sqrt(x)
}

fn ops_abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn ops_min_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a < b { a } else { b }
}

fn ops_max_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { a } else { b }
}

// Sum elements of a float array up to length n
fn ops_sum(data: [f64; 256], n: i64) -> f64 {
    var sum = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        sum = sum + data[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    return sum
}

// Mean of elements
fn ops_mean(data: [f64; 256], n: i64) -> f64 {
    if n == 0 { return 0.0 }
    return ops_sum(data, n) / (n as f64)
}

// Cumulative sum: result[i] = sum(data[0..=i])
fn ops_cumsum(data: [f64; 256], n: i64, result: &![f64; 256]) {
    var running = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        running = running + data[i]
        result[i] = running
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Cumulative max
fn ops_cummax(data: [f64; 256], n: i64, result: &![f64; 256]) {
    if n == 0 { return }
    var running = data[0]
    result[0] = running
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < n {
        if data[i] > running {
            running = data[i]
        }
        result[i] = running
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Rolling mean with window size
fn ops_rolling_mean(data: [f64; 256], n: i64, window: i64, result: &![f64; 256]) {
    if window == 0 { return }
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        let start = if i + 1 >= window { i + 1 - window } else { 0 }
        var sum = 0.0
        var j = start
        while j <= i {
            sum = sum + data[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        let count = i - start + 1
        result[i] = sum / (count as f64)
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// GUM uncertainty for mean: u(mean)^2 = (1/n^2) * sum(u_i^2)
fn ops_gum_mean_uncertainty(uncerts: [f64; 256], n: i64) -> f64 {
    if n == 0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum_u_sq = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        sum_u_sq = sum_u_sq + uncerts[i] * uncerts[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    return ops_sqrt_f64(sum_u_sq) / (n as f64)
}


// === FILE: stdlib/data/series.sio ===
// stdlib/data/series.d
// Typed Series (Columns) with Full Epistemic Support
//
// Series are the building blocks of DataFrames - typed arrays
// with optional epistemic metadata (uncertainty + confidence).

extern "C" {
    fn sqrt(x: f64) -> f64;
}

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    return sqrt(x)
}

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn min_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a < b { a } else { b }
}

fn max_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { a } else { b }
}

// ============================================================================
// UNCERTAINTY TYPE (inline for self-contained module)
// ============================================================================

pub struct Uncertainty {
    pub tag: i32,          // 0=Exact, 1=StdDev, 2=Interval
    pub std_u: f64,
    pub std_k: f64,
    pub interval_lo: f64,
    pub interval_hi: f64,
}

pub fn uncertainty_exact() -> Uncertainty {
    Uncertainty { tag: 0, std_u: 0.0, std_k: 1.0, interval_lo: 0.0, interval_hi: 0.0 }
}

pub fn uncertainty_std(u: f64) -> Uncertainty {
    Uncertainty { tag: 1, std_u: if u < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { u }, std_k: 1.0, interval_lo: 0.0, interval_hi: 0.0 }
}

pub fn uncertainty_interval(lo: f64, hi: f64) -> Uncertainty {
    let l = if lo < hi { lo } else { hi }
    let h = if lo < hi { hi } else { lo }
    Uncertainty { tag: 2, std_u: 0.0, std_k: 1.0, interval_lo: l, interval_hi: h }
}

pub fn uncert_to_std(u: Uncertainty) -> f64 {
    if u.tag == 0 { return 0.0 }
    if u.tag == 1 { return u.std_u }
    return (u.interval_hi - u.interval_lo) / 4.0
}

// ============================================================================
// EPISTEMIC VALUE TYPE
// ============================================================================

pub struct EpistemicValue {
    pub value: f64,
    pub uncert: Uncertainty,
    pub conf: f64,
    pub provenance_id: i64,
}

pub fn epistemic_std(value: f64, uncertainty: f64, confidence: f64) -> EpistemicValue {
    var c = confidence
    if c < 0.0 { c = 0.0 }
    if c > 1.0 { c = 1.0 }
    EpistemicValue {
        value: value,
        uncert: uncertainty_std(uncertainty),
        conf: c,
        provenance_id: 0,
    }
}

pub fn epistemic_exact(value: f64, confidence: f64) -> EpistemicValue {
    var c = confidence
    if c < 0.0 { c = 0.0 }
    if c > 1.0 { c = 1.0 }
    EpistemicValue {
        value: value,
        uncert: uncertainty_exact(),
        conf: c,
        provenance_id: 0,
    }
}

pub fn get_value(e: EpistemicValue) -> f64 { e.value }
pub fn get_conf(e: EpistemicValue) -> f64 { e.conf }
pub fn get_std_u(e: EpistemicValue) -> f64 { uncert_to_std(e.uncert) }

// ============================================================================
// FLOAT SERIES - Basic numeric column
// ============================================================================

pub struct FloatSeries {
    pub name: String,
    pub data: [f64],
}

pub fn float_series_new(name: String) -> FloatSeries {
    var empty: [f64] = []
    FloatSeries { name: name, data: empty }
}

pub fn float_series_from(name: String, data: [f64]) -> FloatSeries {
    FloatSeries { name: name, data: data }
}

pub fn float_series_len(s: FloatSeries) -> usize {
    s.data.len()
}

pub fn float_series_get(s: FloatSeries, idx: usize) -> f64 {
    if idx < s.data.len() { s.data[idx] } else { 0.0 }
}

pub fn float_series_push(s: FloatSeries, val: f64) -> FloatSeries {
    var d = s.data
    d.push(val)
    FloatSeries { name: s.name, data: d }
}

pub fn float_series_sum(s: FloatSeries) -> f64 {
    var total = 0.0
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < s.data.len() {
        total = total + s.data[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    total
}

pub fn float_series_mean(s: FloatSeries) -> f64 {
    let n = s.data.len()
    if n == 0 { return 0.0 }
    float_series_sum(s) / (n as f64)
}

pub fn float_series_min(s: FloatSeries) -> f64 {
    if s.data.len() == 0 { return 0.0 }
    var m = s.data[0]
    var i: usize = 1
    while i < s.data.len() {
        if s.data[i] < m { m = s.data[i] }
        i = i + 1
    }
    m
}

pub fn float_series_max(s: FloatSeries) -> f64 {
    if s.data.len() == 0 { return 0.0 }
    var m = s.data[0]
    var i: usize = 1
    while i < s.data.len() {
        if s.data[i] > m { m = s.data[i] }
        i = i + 1
    }
    m
}

pub fn float_series_variance(s: FloatSeries) -> f64 {
    let n = s.data.len()
    if n < 2 { return 0.0 }
    let mean_val = float_series_mean(s)
    var sum_sq = 0.0
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < n {
        let diff = s.data[i] - mean_val
        sum_sq = sum_sq + diff * diff
        i = i + 1
    }
    sum_sq / ((n - 1) as f64)
}

pub fn float_series_std(s: FloatSeries) -> f64 {
    sqrt_f64(float_series_variance(s))
}

    var count: usize = 0
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < s.data.len() {

        i = i + 1
    }
    count
}

// ============================================================================
// EPISTEMIC SERIES - Numeric column with uncertainty tracking
// ============================================================================

pub struct EpistemicSeries {
    pub name: String,
    pub values: [f64],
    pub uncertainties: [f64],    // Standard uncertainty for each value
    pub confidences: [f64],      // Confidence for each value
}

pub fn epistemic_series_new(name: String) -> EpistemicSeries {
    var empty_v: [f64] = []
    var empty_u: [f64] = []
    var empty_c: [f64] = []
    EpistemicSeries {
        name: name,
        values: empty_v,
        uncertainties: empty_u,
        confidences: empty_c,
    }
}

pub fn epistemic_series_len(s: EpistemicSeries) -> usize {
    s.values.len()
}

pub fn epistemic_series_get(s: EpistemicSeries, idx: usize) -> EpistemicValue {
    if idx >= s.values.len() {
        return epistemic_exact(0.0, 0.0)
    }
    EpistemicValue {
        value: s.values[idx],
        uncert: uncertainty_std(s.uncertainties[idx]),
        conf: s.confidences[idx],
        provenance_id: 0,
    }
}

pub fn epistemic_series_push(s: EpistemicSeries, ev: EpistemicValue) -> EpistemicSeries {
    var vs = s.values
    var us = s.uncertainties
    var cs = s.confidences
    vs.push(ev.value)
    us.push(uncert_to_std(ev.uncert))
    cs.push(ev.conf)
    EpistemicSeries {
        name: s.name,
        values: vs,
        uncertainties: us,
        confidences: cs,
    }
}

pub fn epistemic_series_push_with_u(s: EpistemicSeries, val: f64, uncert: f64, conf: f64) -> EpistemicSeries {
    var vs = s.values
    var us = s.uncertainties
    var cs = s.confidences
    vs.push(val)
    us.push(uncert)
    cs.push(conf)
    EpistemicSeries {
        name: s.name,
        values: vs,
        uncertainties: us,
        confidences: cs,
    }
}

// Epistemic mean with proper uncertainty propagation
pub fn epistemic_series_mean(s: EpistemicSeries) -> EpistemicValue {
    let n = s.values.len()
    if n == 0 {
        return epistemic_exact(0.0, 0.0)
    }

    // Calculate mean value
    var sum_val = 0.0
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < n {
        sum_val = sum_val + s.values[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    let mean_val = sum_val / (n as f64)

    // GUM: Combined uncertainty for mean of independent measurements
    // u(mean)^2 = (1/n^2) * sum(u_i^2)
    var sum_u_sq = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        let ui = s.uncertainties[i]
        sum_u_sq = sum_u_sq + ui * ui
        i = i + 1
    }
    let mean_u = sqrt_f64(sum_u_sq) / (n as f64)

    // Confidence: minimum of all confidences
    var min_conf = 1.0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        if s.confidences[i] < min_conf {
            min_conf = s.confidences[i]
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    epistemic_std(mean_val, mean_u, min_conf)
}

// Epistemic sum with proper uncertainty propagation
pub fn epistemic_series_sum(s: EpistemicSeries) -> EpistemicValue {
    let n = s.values.len()
    if n == 0 {
        return epistemic_exact(0.0, 0.0)
    }

    var sum_val = 0.0
    var sum_u_sq = 0.0
    var min_conf = 1.0
    var i: usize = 0

    while i < n {
        sum_val = sum_val + s.values[i]
        let ui = s.uncertainties[i]
        sum_u_sq = sum_u_sq + ui * ui
        if s.confidences[i] < min_conf {
            min_conf = s.confidences[i]
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    let combined_u = sqrt_f64(sum_u_sq)
    epistemic_std(sum_val, combined_u, min_conf)
}

// Epistemic standard deviation
pub fn epistemic_series_std(s: EpistemicSeries) -> EpistemicValue {
    let n = s.values.len()
    if n < 2 {
        return epistemic_exact(0.0, 0.0)
    }

    // Calculate sample mean
    var sum_val = 0.0
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < n {
        sum_val = sum_val + s.values[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    let mean_val = sum_val / (n as f64)

    // Calculate sample variance
    var sum_sq = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        let diff = s.values[i] - mean_val
        sum_sq = sum_sq + diff * diff
        i = i + 1
    }
    let variance = sum_sq / ((n - 1) as f64)
    let std_val = sqrt_f64(variance)

    // Uncertainty in std: approximate using bootstrap-like approach
    // u(s) ~ s / sqrt(2*(n-1))
    let std_u = std_val / sqrt_f64(2.0 * ((n - 1) as f64))

    // Minimum confidence
    var min_conf = 1.0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        if s.confidences[i] < min_conf {
            min_conf = s.confidences[i]
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    epistemic_std(std_val, std_u, min_conf)
}

// Epistemic min (value with minimum)
pub fn epistemic_series_min(s: EpistemicSeries) -> EpistemicValue {
    let n = s.values.len()
    if n == 0 {
        return epistemic_exact(0.0, 0.0)
    }

    var min_idx: usize = 0
    var min_val = s.values[0]
    var i: usize = 1
    while i < n {
        if s.values[i] < min_val {
            min_val = s.values[i]
            min_idx = i
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    epistemic_std(min_val, s.uncertainties[min_idx], s.confidences[min_idx])
}

// Epistemic max (value with maximum)
pub fn epistemic_series_max(s: EpistemicSeries) -> EpistemicValue {
    let n = s.values.len()
    if n == 0 {
        return epistemic_exact(0.0, 0.0)
    }

    var max_idx: usize = 0
    var max_val = s.values[0]
    var i: usize = 1
    while i < n {
        if s.values[i] > max_val {
            max_val = s.values[i]
            max_idx = i
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    epistemic_std(max_val, s.uncertainties[max_idx], s.confidences[max_idx])
}

// Convert FloatSeries to EpistemicSeries with uniform uncertainty
pub fn float_to_epistemic(s: FloatSeries, default_u: f64, default_conf: f64) -> EpistemicSeries {
    var es = epistemic_series_new(s.name)
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < s.data.len() {
        es = epistemic_series_push_with_u(es, s.data[i], default_u, default_conf)
        i = i + 1
    }
    es
}

// Extract just values from EpistemicSeries
pub fn epistemic_to_float(s: EpistemicSeries) -> FloatSeries {
    FloatSeries { name: s.name, data: s.values }
}

// ============================================================================
// SERIES OPERATIONS
// ============================================================================

// Element-wise addition of float series
pub fn float_series_add(a: FloatSeries, b: FloatSeries) -> FloatSeries {
    let n = if a.data.len() < b.data.len() { a.data.len() } else { b.data.len() }
    var result: [f64] = []
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < n {
        result.push(a.data[i] + b.data[i])
        i = i + 1
    }
    FloatSeries { name: a.name ++ "_plus_" ++ b.name, data: result }
}

// Element-wise multiplication of float series
pub fn float_series_mul(a: FloatSeries, b: FloatSeries) -> FloatSeries {
    let n = if a.data.len() < b.data.len() { a.data.len() } else { b.data.len() }
    var result: [f64] = []
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < n {
        result.push(a.data[i] * b.data[i])
        i = i + 1
    }
    FloatSeries { name: a.name ++ "_times_" ++ b.name, data: result }
}

// Scalar multiplication
pub fn float_series_scale(s: FloatSeries, scalar: f64) -> FloatSeries {
    var result: [f64] = []
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < s.data.len() {
        result.push(s.data[i] * scalar)
        i = i + 1
    }
    FloatSeries { name: s.name, data: result }
}

// Filter float series by boolean mask
pub fn float_series_filter(s: FloatSeries, mask: BoolSeries) -> FloatSeries {
    let n = if s.data.len() < mask.data.len() { s.data.len() } else { mask.data.len() }
    var result: [f64] = []
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < n {
        if mask.data[i] {
            result.push(s.data[i])
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    FloatSeries { name: s.name, data: result }
}

// Compare float series element-wise (greater than)
pub fn float_series_gt(s: FloatSeries, threshold: f64) -> BoolSeries {
    var result: [bool] = []
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < s.data.len() {
        result.push(s.data[i] > threshold)
        i = i + 1
    }
    BoolSeries { name: s.name ++ "_gt", data: result }
}

// Compare float series element-wise (less than)
pub fn float_series_lt(s: FloatSeries, threshold: f64) -> BoolSeries {
    var result: [bool] = []
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < s.data.len() {
        result.push(s.data[i] < threshold)
        i = i + 1
    }
    BoolSeries { name: s.name ++ "_lt", data: result }
}

// === FILE: stdlib/database/ffi/fallback.sio ===
// stdlib/database/ffi/fallback.sio — Fallback When FFI Unavailable
//
// When FFI bindings are not available (e.g., no compiled libsqlite3/libpq),
// this module provides graceful fallback to the pure Sounio in-memory engine.
// All public API functions have fallbacks here.

pub fn sqlite_available() -> bool { false }
pub fn postgres_available() -> bool { false }

pub fn use_fallback_engine() -> bool { true }

pub fn fallback_execute(sql: String) -> Result<ResultSet, String> {
    Err("FFI not available. Use pure Sounio in-memory engine.".to_string())
}

pub fn engine_list_tables(db: &InMemoryDB) -> Vec<string> {
    var names = Vec::new()
    var i = 0
    while i < db.table_count {
        names.push(db.table_names[i as usize])
        i = i + 1
    }
    names
}

pub fn engine_table_row_count(db: &InMemoryDB, name: string) -> i32 with Mut {
    db_table_row_count(db, name)
}

pub fn engine_create_table(db: &! InMemoryDB, name: string) -> i32 with Mut {
    db_create_table(db, name)
}

pub fn engine_drop_table(db: &! InMemoryDB, name: string) -> i32 with Mut {
    db_drop_table(db, name)
}

pub fn engine_insert_row(db: &! InMemoryDB, name: string, v0: i64, v1: i64) -> i32 with Mut {
    db_insert_row(db, name, v0, v1)
}

pub fn engine_get_cell(db: &InMemoryDB, name: string, row: i32, col: i32) -> i64 with Mut {
    db_get_cell(db, name, row, col)
}

// === FILE: stdlib/database/pure/types.sio ===
// stdlib/database/pure/types.sio — Database Types
//
// Uses fixed-capacity flat-array storage to avoid Vec issues.
// Max 4 tables, 16 rows/table, 4 i64 columns/row.

pub struct InMemoryDB {
    pub table_count: i32,
    pub table_names: [string; 4],
    pub row_counts: [i32; 4],
    pub data: [i64; 256],  // 4 tables × 16 rows × 4 cols = 256
}

pub fn in_memory_db_new() -> InMemoryDB {
    InMemoryDB {
        table_count: 0,
        table_names: [""; 4],
        row_counts: [0; 4],
        data: [0; 256],
    }
}

pub fn cell_idx(t: i32, r: i32, c: i32) -> i32 {
    t * 64 + r * 4 + c
}

pub fn db_find_table(db: &InMemoryDB, name: string) -> i32 with Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < db.table_count {
        if db.table_names[i as usize] == name { return i }
        i = i + 1
    }
    -1
}

pub fn db_create_table(db: &! InMemoryDB, name: string) -> i32 with Mut {
    if db.table_count >= 4 { return -1 }
    if db_find_table(db, name) >= 0 { return 0 }
    let idx = db.table_count as usize
    db.table_names[idx] = name
    db.row_counts[idx] = 0
    db.table_count = db.table_count + 1
    1
}

pub fn db_drop_table(db: &! InMemoryDB, name: string) -> i32 with Mut {
    let idx = db_find_table(db, name)
    if idx < 0 { return -1 }
    var i = idx
    while i < db.table_count - 1 {
        let j = i as usize
        db.table_names[j] = db.table_names[j + 1]
        db.row_counts[j] = db.row_counts[j + 1]
        var d = 0
        while d < 64 {
            db.data[j * 64 + d] = db.data[(j + 1) * 64 + d]
            d = d + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    db.table_count = db.table_count - 1
    1
}

pub fn db_table_row_count(db: &InMemoryDB, name: string) -> i32 with Mut {
    let idx = db_find_table(db, name)
    if idx < 0 { return -1 }
    db.row_counts[idx as usize]
}

pub fn db_insert_row(db: &! InMemoryDB, name: string, v0: i64, v1: i64) -> i32 with Mut {
    let idx = db_find_table(db, name)
    if idx < 0 { return -1 }
    let row = db.row_counts[idx as usize]
    if row >= 16 { return -1 }
    let ci = cell_idx(idx, row, 0)
    db.data[ci as usize] = v0
    db.data[(ci + 1) as usize] = v1
    db.row_counts[idx as usize] = row + 1
    1
}

pub fn db_get_cell(db: &InMemoryDB, name: string, row: i32, col: i32) -> i64 with Mut {
    let idx = db_find_table(db, name)
    if idx < 0 { return -1 }
    let ci = cell_idx(idx, row, col)
    db.data[ci as usize]
}

// === FILE: stdlib/dataframe/pure/core.sio ===
// stdlib/dataframe/pure/core.sio — DataFrame core operations.
//
// Flat fixed-array layout: max 4 columns, max 64 rows.
//   data[col * 64 + row]  (64 rows per column)
//
// All functions are promoted directly from tests/stdlib_dataframe/test_dataframe_e2e.sio,
// which validates them at 11/11 PASS. No new algorithms.

pub struct DataFrame {
    pub n_cols: i32,
    pub n_rows: i32,
    pub col_names: [string; 4],
    pub data: [f64; 256],
}

pub fn df_new() -> DataFrame {
    DataFrame { n_cols: 0, n_rows: 0, col_names: [""; 4], data: [0.0; 256] }
}

pub fn df_cell_idx(col: i32, row: i32) -> usize {
    (col * 64 + row) as usize
}

pub fn df_get(df: &DataFrame, col: i32, row: i32) -> f64 {
    df.data[df_cell_idx(col, row)]
}

pub fn df_set(df: &! DataFrame, col: i32, row: i32, v: f64) with Mut {
    df.data[df_cell_idx(col, row)] = v
}

pub fn df_col_idx(df: &DataFrame, name: string) -> i32 with Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < df.n_cols {
        if df.col_names[i as usize] == name { return i }
        i = i + 1
    }
    -1
}

pub fn df_head(df: &DataFrame, n: i32) -> DataFrame with Mut {
    var out = df_new()
    out.n_cols = df.n_cols
    out.n_rows = if n < df.n_rows { n } else { df.n_rows }
    var c = 0
    while c < df.n_cols {
        out.col_names[c as usize] = df.col_names[c as usize]
        var r = 0
        while r < out.n_rows {
            out.data[df_cell_idx(c, r)] = df.data[df_cell_idx(c, r)]
            r = r + 1
        }
        c = c + 1
    }
    out
}

pub fn df_tail(df: &DataFrame, n: i32) -> DataFrame with Mut {
    var out = df_new()
    out.n_cols = df.n_cols
    let take = if n < df.n_rows { n } else { df.n_rows }
    let start = df.n_rows - take
    out.n_rows = take
    var c = 0
    while c < df.n_cols {
        out.col_names[c as usize] = df.col_names[c as usize]
        var r = 0
        while r < take {
            out.data[df_cell_idx(c, r)] = df.data[df_cell_idx(c, start + r)]
            r = r + 1
        }
        c = c + 1
    }
    out
}

pub fn df_unique_count(df: &DataFrame, col_name: string) -> i32 with Mut {
    let ci = df_col_idx(df, col_name)
    if ci < 0 { return -1 }
    var seen: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var n_seen = 0
    var r = 0
    while r < df.n_rows {
        let v = df_get(df, ci, r)
        var found = 0
        var s = 0
        while s < n_seen {
            if seen[s as usize] == v { found = 1 }
            s = s + 1
        }
        if found == 0 && n_seen < 16 {
            seen[n_seen as usize] = v
            n_seen = n_seen + 1
        }
        r = r + 1
    }
    n_seen
}

pub fn col_mean(data: &[f64; 64], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        sum = sum + data[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    sum / (n as f64)
}

// Population variance (÷ n). Use col_covariance for sample variance (÷ n-1).
pub fn col_variance(data: &[f64; 64], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    let m = col_mean(data, n)
    var v = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let d = data[i as usize] - m
        v = v + d * d
        i = i + 1
    }
    v / (n as f64)
}

pub fn f64_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var g = x / 2.0
    var i = 0
    while i < 40 {
        g = (g + x / g) / 2.0
        i = i + 1
    }
    g
}

pub fn f64_abs(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

pub fn col_std(data: &[f64; 64], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    f64_sqrt(col_variance(data, n))
}

pub fn col_correlation(xa: &[f64; 64], xb: &[f64; 64], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    let ma = col_mean(xa, n)
    let mb = col_mean(xb, n)
    var num = 0.0
    var da = 0.0
    var db = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let a = xa[i as usize] - ma
        let b = xb[i as usize] - mb
        num = num + a * b
        da = da + a * a
        db = db + b * b
        i = i + 1
    }
    let denom = f64_sqrt(da) * f64_sqrt(db)
    if denom == 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    num / denom
}

// Sample covariance (÷ n-1).
pub fn col_covariance(xa: &[f64; 64], xb: &[f64; 64], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    let ma = col_mean(xa, n)
    let mb = col_mean(xb, n)
    var cov = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        cov = cov + (xa[i as usize] - ma) * (xb[i as usize] - mb)
        i = i + 1
    }
    cov / ((n - 1) as f64)
}

// Median via insertion sort. O(n²) — suitable for n ≤ 64.
pub fn col_quantile_50(data: &[f64; 64], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    var sorted: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        sorted[i as usize] = data[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    var j = 1
    while j < n {
        let key = sorted[j as usize]
        var k = j - 1
        while k >= 0 && sorted[k as usize] > key {
            sorted[(k + 1) as usize] = sorted[k as usize]
            k = k - 1
        }
        sorted[(k + 1) as usize] = key
        j = j + 1
    }
    if n % 2 == 0 {
        (sorted[(n / 2 - 1) as usize] + sorted[(n / 2) as usize]) / 2.0
    } else {
        sorted[(n / 2) as usize]
    }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/dataframe/pure/epistemic.sio ===
// stdlib/dataframe/pure/epistemic.sio — Epistemic DataFrame Operations
//
// Epistemic variants of dataframe operations with GUM variance propagation.

pub struct EColumn {
    pub name: string,
    pub n_vals: i32,
    pub values: [Epistemic; 256],
}

pub fn ecolumn_new(name: string) -> EColumn {
    EColumn { name: name, n_vals: 0, values: [Epistemic::certain(0.0); 256] }
}

pub fn ecolumn_push(c: &! EColumn, v: Epistemic) with Mut {
    if c.n_vals < 256 {
        c.values[c.n_vals as usize] = v
        c.n_vals = c.n_vals + 1
    }
}

pub fn ecolumn_mean(c: &EColumn) -> Epistemic with Mut, Div {
    if c.n_vals == 0 { return Epistemic::certain(0.0) }
    var sum = Epistemic::certain(0.0)
    var i = 0
    while i < c.n_vals {
        sum = sum.add(&c.values[i as usize])
        i = i + 1
    }
    let n = Epistemic::certain(c.n_vals as f64)
    sum.div(&n)
}

pub fn ecolumn_std(c: &EColumn) -> Epistemic with Mut, Div {
    if c.n_vals == 0 { return Epistemic::certain(0.0) }
    let mean = ecolumn_mean(c)
    var var_sum = Epistemic::certain(0.0)
    var i = 0
    while i < c.n_vals {
        let diff = c.values[i as usize].sub(&mean)
        var_sum = var_sum.add(&diff.square())
        i = i + 1
    }
    let n = Epistemic::certain(c.n_vals as f64)
    let variance = var_sum.div(&n)
    variance.sqrt()
}

pub fn ecolumn_sum(c: &EColumn) -> Epistemic with Mut, Div {
    var sum = Epistemic::certain(0.0)
    var i = 0
    while i < c.n_vals {
        sum = sum.add(&c.values[i as usize])
        i = i + 1
    }
    sum
}

pub fn ecolumn_correlation(c1: &EColumn, c2: &EColumn) -> Epistemic with Mut, Div {
    if c1.n_vals == 0 || c2.n_vals == 0 {
        return Epistemic::certain(0.0)
    }
    let mean1 = ecolumn_mean(c1)
    let mean2 = ecolumn_mean(c2)
    var cov_sum = Epistemic::certain(0.0)
    var var1_sum = Epistemic::certain(0.0)
    var var2_sum = Epistemic::certain(0.0)
    var i = 0
    while i < c1.n_vals && i < c2.n_vals {
        let d1 = c1.values[i as usize].sub(&mean1)
        let d2 = c2.values[i as usize].sub(&mean2)
        cov_sum = cov_sum.add(&d1.mul(&d2))
        var1_sum = var1_sum.add(&d1.square())
        var2_sum = var2_sum.add(&d2.square())
        i = i + 1
    }
    let n = Epistemic::certain(c1.n_vals as f64)
    let cov = cov_sum.div(&n)
    let var1 = var1_sum.div(&n)
    let var2 = var2_sum.div(&n)
    cov.div(&var1.sqrt()).div(&var2.sqrt())
}

    (col * 64 + row) as usize
}


// === FILE: stdlib/dialogue/embed.sio ===
// stdlib/dialogue/embed.sio
//
// `embed: i64 (utterance hash) -> Octonion` — the unitary embedding the
// homology functor F: C_dial -> C_O uses to map dialogue utterances into 𝕆.
//
// Plan reference: project_octonion_homology_functor.md, M2b (wk 5–6).
// Preprint reference: ocssm_preprint_skeleton.md §4 (R1–R7), §6.1 (F1
// Moufang/alternativity test).
//
// CONTRACT (the load-bearing properties for F1):
//
//   1. Determinism:                     embed(h) = embed(h) bit-exact.
//   2. Unit norm:                       ||embed(h)||_2 = 1.0 (within ε).
//   3. R7 / G₂-uniformity by construction:
//                                       The mapping from h to S^7 factors
//                                       through Halton-on-cube → Box-Muller
//                                       → unit-normalisation. Halton is a
//                                       low-discrepancy sequence; Box-Muller
//                                       is the Marsaglia method that
//                                       produces an isotropic Gaussian on
//                                       R^8; isotropic-on-R^8 + radial
//                                       projection = uniform on S^7. Any
//                                       O(8) action — and in particular the
//                                       discrete G₂ subgroup PSL(2,7) of
//                                       order 168 — preserves uniformity.
//                                       The Lean obligation in M4 reduces
//                                       to a finite check on 14 generators
//                                       × 1024 rows.
//
// IMPLEMENTATION NOTES:
//
//   - Algebra is computed inside Sounio. No Python. Per the plan and
//     `feedback_sounio_first.md`.
//   - Halton bases for 8 dimensions: [2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19].
//   - The 1024-row table is computed on demand from `embed_row(i)`. We do
//     NOT pre-cache into a global because the native compiler's BSS-zero
//     initialisation prevents non-zero static data; the compute is cheap
//     enough (~50 ops/embed) that a per-call recomputation is fine for the
//     F1/F2 corpus loop.

use stdlib::math::pure::*

// ============================================================================
// CONSTANTS
// ============================================================================

fn embed_table_rows() -> i64 { return 1024 }

fn embed_two_pi() -> f64 { return 6.283185307179586 }

// ============================================================================
// HALTON VAN-DER-CORPUT
// ============================================================================
//
// Returns the i-th term of the Halton sequence for the given prime base.
// halton(0, b) = 0; halton(i, b) ∈ [0, 1) for all i ≥ 0.
//
// Integer-only loop on i; float accumulator on the radix-fraction side.

pub fn halton(i: i64, base: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if base < 2 { return 0.0 }
    if i < 0 { return 0.0 }
    let bf: f64 = base as f64
    var f: f64 = 1.0
    var r: f64 = 0.0
    var n: i64 = i
    while n > 0 {
        f = f / bf
        let digit: i64 = n - (n / base) * base
        r = r + f * (digit as f64)
        n = n / base
    }
    return r
}

// Eight Halton bases.
fn halton_b0() -> i64 { return  2 }
fn halton_b1() -> i64 { return  3 }
fn halton_b2() -> i64 { return  5 }
fn halton_b3() -> i64 { return  7 }
fn halton_b4() -> i64 { return 11 }
fn halton_b5() -> i64 { return 13 }
fn halton_b6() -> i64 { return 17 }
fn halton_b7() -> i64 { return 19 }

// ============================================================================
// BOX–MULLER  (uniforms → standard-normal pair)
// ============================================================================
//
// Marsaglia/Bray–Box–Muller direct form:
//   z1 = sqrt(-2 ln u1) * cos(2π u2)
//   z2 = sqrt(-2 ln u1) * sin(2π u2)
//
// Halton is right-open at 0 for index 0; we clamp u1 away from zero so
// ln(u1) stays finite. The clamp is bit-deterministic and does not break
// determinism (point 1) of the contract.

fn bm_clamp(u: f64) -> f64 {
    if u < 0.000000001 { return 0.000000001 }
    return u
}

// ============================================================================
// EMBED
// ============================================================================
//
// `embed_row_into(i, out)` writes the i-th octonion of the Halton-Box-Muller
// table into `out: &mut [f64; 8]`. Writes via a mutable reference avoid the
// SRET-large-struct codegen quirk for 8-cell f64 arrays.

pub fn embed_row_into(i: i64, out: &[f64; 8]) with Mut, Div, Panic, NaturalityG2 {
    let u0: f64 = bm_clamp(halton(i, halton_b0()))
    let u1: f64 = halton(i, halton_b1())
    let u2: f64 = bm_clamp(halton(i, halton_b2()))
    let u3: f64 = halton(i, halton_b3())
    let u4: f64 = bm_clamp(halton(i, halton_b4()))
    let u5: f64 = halton(i, halton_b5())
    let u6: f64 = bm_clamp(halton(i, halton_b6()))
    let u7: f64 = halton(i, halton_b7())

    let r0: f64 = sqrt(0.0 - 2.0 * ln(u0))
    let a0: f64 = embed_two_pi() * u1
    let z0: f64 = r0 * cos(a0)
    let z1: f64 = r0 * sin(a0)

    let r1: f64 = sqrt(0.0 - 2.0 * ln(u2))
    let a1: f64 = embed_two_pi() * u3
    let z2: f64 = r1 * cos(a1)
    let z3: f64 = r1 * sin(a1)

    let r2: f64 = sqrt(0.0 - 2.0 * ln(u4))
    let a2: f64 = embed_two_pi() * u5
    let z4: f64 = r2 * cos(a2)
    let z5: f64 = r2 * sin(a2)

    let r3: f64 = sqrt(0.0 - 2.0 * ln(u6))
    let a3: f64 = embed_two_pi() * u7
    let z6: f64 = r3 * cos(a3)
    let z7: f64 = r3 * sin(a3)

    let norm_sq: f64 = z0*z0 + z1*z1 + z2*z2 + z3*z3 + z4*z4 + z5*z5 + z6*z6 + z7*z7
    let norm: f64 = sqrt(norm_sq)
    let inv: f64 = 1.0 / norm

    out[0] = z0 * inv
    out[1] = z1 * inv
    out[2] = z2 * inv
    out[3] = z3 * inv
    out[4] = z4 * inv
    out[5] = z5 * inv
    out[6] = z6 * inv
    out[7] = z7 * inv
}

// `embed_into(hash, out)` picks row = hash mod table_rows, writes the
// embedded octonion. Negative hashes are reflected to non-negative.

pub fn embed_into(hash: i64, out: &[f64; 8]) with Mut, Div, Panic, NaturalityG2 {
    var h: i64 = hash
    if h < 0 { h = 0 - h }
    let row: i64 = h - (h / embed_table_rows()) * embed_table_rows()
    embed_row_into(row, out)
}


// === FILE: stdlib/dialogue/mod.sio ===
// stdlib/dialogue/mod.sio — Public exports for the dialogue module
//
// Per stdlib/CONVENTIONS.md §2, mod.sio declares only the public surface
// (pub use re-exports). Implementations live in the sibling files
// (embed.sio, trajectory.sio).

pub use dialogue::embed::{
    halton, embed_row_into, embed_into,
}

pub use dialogue::trajectory::{
    Trajectory,
    traj_empty, traj_push, traj_set_payload,
    traj_speaker, traj_hash, traj_affect, traj_rupture, traj_dim,
    traj_payload_at, traj_len,
    traj_count_speaker, traj_count_rupture,
}


// === FILE: stdlib/dialogue/trajectory.sio ===
// stdlib/dialogue/trajectory.sio
//
// `Trajectory` — finite ordered sequence of `Utterance` values, the dyadic
// dialogue object that the homology functor `F: C_dial → C_𝕆` operates on.
//
// Plan reference: project_octonion_homology_functor.md, M2a (wk 5 of the
// "savage" five-month push). The mathematical role is described in the
// O-CSSM preprint draft §4: a Trajectory is a finite path in the dialogue
// category C_dial; F maps it to a single octonion via fold.
//
// SHAPE NOTE — flat-array layout (not array-of-struct).
// The plan originally specified `utts: [Utterance; 256]`. The native
// compiler indexing path collapses dynamic indexing into nested arrays-of-
// structs to a single slot (verified empirically 2026-04-30 on
// `claude/approx-effect`; lean_single.sio struct-array stride is broken).
// Per `feedback_native_compiler_limits.md` the documented workaround is to
// flatten: parallel arrays per field, dimension-major. This loses no
// semantics — the i-th utterance is reconstructed by reading column i of
// each parallel array.
//
// Cap T ≤ 256 utterances/trajectory matches the BSS-safe bound documented
// in `ocssm_functoriality_check_toy.md`. Payload width 16 matches the
// preprint §4.1 embedding pre-projection dimension.

// ============================================================================
// CONSTANTS
// ============================================================================

fn traj_max_len() -> i64 { return 256 }
fn traj_payload_dim() -> i64 { return 16 }

// ============================================================================
// STRUCT
// ============================================================================
//
// Speaker:  i64, ≥ 0; convention 0 = A, 1 = B for dyadic dialogue
// Hash:     deterministic content hash of the utterance surface form
// Affect:   integer code 0..N for affect class (annotation-defined)
// Rupture:  0 = no rupture, 1 = repair marker, 2 = topic break
// Dim:      effective dimension of `payload[i, *]` (≤ 16)
// Payload:  pre-embedding feature vector; 256 × 16 = 4096 f64 cells

pub struct Trajectory {
    len: i64,
    speakers: [i64; 256],
    hashes:   [i64; 256],
    affects:  [i64; 256],
    ruptures: [i64; 256],
    dims:     [i64; 256],
    payload:  [f64; 4096],
}

// ============================================================================
// CONSTRUCTORS
// ============================================================================

// Returns an empty trajectory. `len = 0` means no utterances; all parallel
// arrays are zero-initialised.
pub fn traj_empty() -> Trajectory {
    let zi: [i64; 256] = [0; 256]
    let zf: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    return Trajectory {
        len: 0,
        speakers: zi,
        hashes:   zi,
        affects:  zi,
        ruptures: zi,
        dims:     zi,
        payload:  zf,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// MUTATION (in-place push)
// ============================================================================
//
// Returns the new length. If the trajectory is at capacity, returns the
// existing length unchanged (silent drop — caller must check len == max).
//
// The payload row is left zero. Use `traj_set_payload(&t, i, j, v)` to
// populate after push.

pub fn traj_push(t: &Trajectory, speaker: i64, hash: i64,
