pub struct CurvatureResult {
    pub kappa1: f64,
    pub kappa1_std: f64,
    pub kappa2: f64,
    pub kappa2_std: f64,
    pub gaussian: f64,
    pub gaussian_std: f64,
    pub mean: f64,
    pub mean_std: f64,
    pub area: f64,
}

// ============================================================================
// VECTOR OPERATIONS
// ============================================================================

fn vec_sub(a: &Vertex, b: &Vertex) -> Vertex {
    Vertex { x: a.x - b.x, y: a.y - b.y, z: a.z - b.z }
}

fn vec_add(a: &Vertex, b: &Vertex) -> Vertex {
    Vertex { x: a.x + b.x, y: a.y + b.y, z: a.z + b.z }
}

fn vec_scale(v: &Vertex, s: f64) -> Vertex {
    Vertex { x: v.x * s, y: v.y * s, z: v.z * s }
}

fn vec_dot(a: &Vertex, b: &Vertex) -> f64 {
    a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z
}

fn vec_cross(a: &Vertex, b: &Vertex) -> Vertex {
    Vertex {
        x: a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
        y: a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
        z: a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x,
    }
}

fn vec_length(v: &Vertex) -> f64 {
    curv_sqrt_f64(v.x * v.x + v.y * v.y + v.z * v.z)
}

fn vec_normalize(v: &Vertex) -> Vertex {
    let len = vec_length(v)
    if len < 1e-10 {
        return Vertex { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }
    }
    vec_scale(v, 1.0 / len)
}

// ============================================================================
// GAUSSIAN CURVATURE
// ============================================================================

// Compute Gaussian curvature using the angle deficit method
pub fn gaussian_curvature(mesh: &TriMesh) -> CurvatureResult {
    let n_vertices = mesh.vertices.len()

    if n_vertices == 0 {
        return CurvatureResult {
            kappa1: 0.0, kappa1_std: 1.0,
            kappa2: 0.0, kappa2_std: 1.0,
            gaussian: 0.0, gaussian_std: 1.0,
            mean: 0.0, mean_std: 1.0,
            area: 0.0,
        }
    }

    let two_pi = 2.0 * 3.141592653589793

    var total_curvature: f64 = 0.0
    var total_area: f64 = 0.0
    var curvature_variance: f64 = 0.0

    // For each vertex, compute local Gaussian curvature
    for v_idx in 0..n_vertices {
        var angle_sum: f64 = 0.0
        var local_area: f64 = 0.0

        for f_idx in 0..mesh.faces.len() {
            let face = &mesh.faces[f_idx]
            let i0 = face.i0
            let i1 = face.i1
            let i2 = face.i2

            var vertex_in_face = false
            var angle: f64 = 0.0
            var face_area: f64 = 0.0

            if (i0 as i64) == v_idx {
                vertex_in_face = true
                angle = compute_angle(&mesh.vertices[i0 as i64], &mesh.vertices[i1 as i64], &mesh.vertices[i2 as i64])
                face_area = triangle_area(&mesh.vertices[i0 as i64], &mesh.vertices[i1 as i64], &mesh.vertices[i2 as i64])
            } else if (i1 as i64) == v_idx {
                vertex_in_face = true
                angle = compute_angle(&mesh.vertices[i1 as i64], &mesh.vertices[i2 as i64], &mesh.vertices[i0 as i64])
                face_area = triangle_area(&mesh.vertices[i0 as i64], &mesh.vertices[i1 as i64], &mesh.vertices[i2 as i64])
            } else if (i2 as i64) == v_idx {
                vertex_in_face = true
                angle = compute_angle(&mesh.vertices[i2 as i64], &mesh.vertices[i0 as i64], &mesh.vertices[i1 as i64])
                face_area = triangle_area(&mesh.vertices[i0 as i64], &mesh.vertices[i1 as i64], &mesh.vertices[i2 as i64])
            }

            if vertex_in_face {
                angle_sum = angle_sum + angle
                local_area = local_area + face_area / 3.0
            }
        }

        if local_area > 1e-10 {
            let k_local = (two_pi - angle_sum) / local_area
            total_curvature = total_curvature + k_local * local_area
            total_area = total_area + local_area
            curvature_variance = curvature_variance + k_local * k_local * local_area
        }
    }

    let mean_k = if total_area > 1e-10 {
        total_curvature / total_area
    } else {
        0.0
    }

    let var_k = if total_area > 1e-10 && n_vertices > 1 {
        (curvature_variance / total_area - mean_k * mean_k) / (n_vertices as f64)
    } else {
        1.0
    }

    CurvatureResult {
        kappa1: 0.0, kappa1_std: 0.0,
        kappa2: 0.0, kappa2_std: 0.0,
        gaussian: mean_k, gaussian_std: curv_sqrt_f64(var_k),
        mean: 0.0, mean_std: 0.0,
        area: total_area,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// MEAN CURVATURE
// ============================================================================

// Compute mean curvature using the Laplace-Beltrami operator
pub fn mean_curvature(mesh: &TriMesh) -> CurvatureResult {
    let n_vertices = mesh.vertices.len()

    if n_vertices == 0 {
        return CurvatureResult {
            kappa1: 0.0, kappa1_std: 1.0,
            kappa2: 0.0, kappa2_std: 1.0,
            gaussian: 0.0, gaussian_std: 1.0,
            mean: 0.0, mean_std: 1.0,
            area: 0.0,
        }
    }

    var total_mean: f64 = 0.0
    var total_area: f64 = 0.0
    var variance_sum: f64 = 0.0

    for v_idx in 0..n_vertices {
        var h_normal = Vertex { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }
        var local_area: f64 = 0.0

        for f_idx in 0..mesh.faces.len() {
            let face = &mesh.faces[f_idx]
            let i0 = face.i0
            let i1 = face.i1
            let i2 = face.i2
            let v0 = &mesh.vertices[i0 as i64]
            let v1 = &mesh.vertices[i1 as i64]
            let v2 = &mesh.vertices[i2 as i64]

            if (i0 as i64) == v_idx {
                let cot_alpha = cotangent_opposite(v0, v1, v2)
                let cot_beta = cotangent_opposite(v0, v2, v1)
                let e1 = vec_sub(v1, v0)
                let e2 = vec_sub(v2, v0)
                h_normal = vec_add(&h_normal, &vec_scale(&e1, cot_alpha))
                h_normal = vec_add(&h_normal, &vec_scale(&e2, cot_beta))
                local_area = local_area + triangle_area(v0, v1, v2) / 3.0
            } else if (i1 as i64) == v_idx {
                let cot_alpha = cotangent_opposite(v1, v2, v0)
                let cot_beta = cotangent_opposite(v1, v0, v2)
                let e1 = vec_sub(v2, v1)
                let e2 = vec_sub(v0, v1)
                h_normal = vec_add(&h_normal, &vec_scale(&e1, cot_alpha))
                h_normal = vec_add(&h_normal, &vec_scale(&e2, cot_beta))
                local_area = local_area + triangle_area(v0, v1, v2) / 3.0
            } else if (i2 as i64) == v_idx {
                let cot_alpha = cotangent_opposite(v2, v0, v1)
                let cot_beta = cotangent_opposite(v2, v1, v0)
                let e1 = vec_sub(v0, v2)
                let e2 = vec_sub(v1, v2)
                h_normal = vec_add(&h_normal, &vec_scale(&e1, cot_alpha))
                h_normal = vec_add(&h_normal, &vec_scale(&e2, cot_beta))
                local_area = local_area + triangle_area(v0, v1, v2) / 3.0
            }
        }

        if local_area > 1e-10 {
            let h_mag = vec_length(&h_normal) / (4.0 * local_area)
            total_mean = total_mean + h_mag * local_area
            total_area = total_area + local_area
            variance_sum = variance_sum + h_mag * h_mag * local_area
        }
    }

    let mean_h = if total_area > 1e-10 {
        total_mean / total_area
    } else {
        0.0
    }

    let var_h = if total_area > 1e-10 && n_vertices > 1 {
        (variance_sum / total_area - mean_h * mean_h) / (n_vertices as f64)
    } else {
        1.0
    }

    CurvatureResult {
        kappa1: 0.0, kappa1_std: 0.0,
        kappa2: 0.0, kappa2_std: 0.0,
        gaussian: 0.0, gaussian_std: 0.0,
        mean: mean_h, mean_std: curv_sqrt_f64(var_h),
        area: total_area,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// PRINCIPAL CURVATURES
// ============================================================================

// Compute principal curvatures from Gaussian and mean curvature
pub fn principal_curvatures(mesh: &TriMesh) -> CurvatureResult {
    let k_result = gaussian_curvature(mesh)
    let h_result = mean_curvature(mesh)

    let k_val = k_result.gaussian
    let h_val = h_result.mean

    // κ₁,₂ = H ± √(H² - K)
    let discriminant = h_val * h_val - k_val
    let sqrt_disc = if discriminant >= 0.0 {
        curv_sqrt_f64(discriminant)
    } else {
        0.0
    }

    let kappa1_val = h_val + sqrt_disc
    let kappa2_val = h_val - sqrt_disc

    // Propagate uncertainty
    let k_var = k_result.gaussian_std * k_result.gaussian_std
    let h_var = h_result.mean_std * h_result.mean_std

    let dk1_dh = if sqrt_disc > 1e-10 { 1.0 + h_val / sqrt_disc } else { 1.0 }
    let dk1_dk = if sqrt_disc > 1e-10 { -0.5 / sqrt_disc } else { 0.0 }

    let kappa1_var = dk1_dh * dk1_dh * h_var + dk1_dk * dk1_dk * k_var
    let kappa2_var = kappa1_var

    CurvatureResult {
        kappa1: kappa1_val,
        kappa1_std: curv_sqrt_f64(kappa1_var),
        kappa2: kappa2_val,
        kappa2_std: curv_sqrt_f64(kappa2_var),
        gaussian: k_val,
        gaussian_std: k_result.gaussian_std,
        mean: h_val,
        mean_std: h_result.mean_std,
        area: h_result.area,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// HELPER FUNCTIONS


// === FILE: stdlib/fractal/dimension.sio ===
//! stdlib/fractal/dimension.sio
//!
//! Fractal Dimension Estimation with Uncertainty Propagation

// ============================================================================
// HELPER FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    for _ in 0..10 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y) }
    y
}

const LN2: f64 = 0.6931471805599453

fn ln_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return -1000000.0 }
    var v = x
    var k: i64 = 0
    while v > 2.0 { v = v / 2.0; k = k + 1 }
    while v < 1.0 { v = v * 2.0; k = k - 1 }
    let y = v - 1.0
    var result = 0.0
    var power = y
    for i in 1..=15 {
        if i % 2 == 1 { result = result + power / (i as f64) }
        else { result = result - power / (i as f64) }
        power = power * y
    }
    result + (k as f64) * LN2
}

fn exp_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    var v = x
    if v > 700.0 { v = 700.0 }
    if v < -700.0 { return 0.0 }
    let k = (v / LN2) as i64
    let r = v - (k as f64) * LN2
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    for i in 1..=15 {
        term = term * r / (i as f64)
        result = result + term
    }
    if k >= 0 { for _ in 0..k { result = result * 2.0 } }
    else { for _ in 0..(-k) { result = result / 2.0 } }
    result
}

fn min_u32(a: u32, b: u32) -> u32 { if a < b { a } else { b } }

// ============================================================================
// RESULT TYPES
// ============================================================================

// Result of linear regression
struct RegressionResult {
    pub slope: f64,
    pub intercept: f64,
    pub r_squared: f64,
    pub var_slope: f64,
}

// Result of fractal dimension computation
pub struct FractalDimensionResult {
    pub dimension: f64,
    pub std_dev: f64,
    pub r_squared: f64,
    pub num_scales: u32,
}

// ============================================================================
// LINEAR REGRESSION
// ============================================================================

fn linear_regression(x: &Vec<f64>, y: &Vec<f64>) -> RegressionResult {
    let n = x.len()
    if n < 2 {
        return RegressionResult {
            slope: 0.0,
            intercept: 0.0,
            r_squared: 0.0,
            var_slope: 1.0,
        }
    }

    var sum_x = 0.0
    var sum_y = 0.0
    var sum_xy = 0.0
    var sum_x2 = 0.0
    var sum_y2 = 0.0

    for i in 0..n {
        sum_x = sum_x + x[i]
        sum_y = sum_y + y[i]
        sum_xy = sum_xy + x[i] * y[i]
        sum_x2 = sum_x2 + x[i] * x[i]
        sum_y2 = sum_y2 + y[i] * y[i]
    }

    let nf = n as f64
    let denom = nf * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x

    if abs_f64(denom) < 1e-10 {
        return RegressionResult {
            slope: 0.0,
            intercept: sum_y / nf,
            r_squared: 0.0,
            var_slope: 1.0,
        }
    }

    let slope = (nf * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / denom
    let intercept = (sum_y - slope * sum_x) / nf

    let ss_tot = sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y / nf
    var ss_res = 0.0
    for i in 0..n {
        let pred = intercept + slope * x[i]
        let residual = y[i] - pred
        ss_res = ss_res + residual * residual
    }

    let r_squared = if ss_tot > 0.0 { 1.0 - ss_res / ss_tot } else { 0.0 }

    let mse = if n > 2 { ss_res / (nf - 2.0) } else { ss_res }
    let var_slope = if denom > 0.0 { mse * nf / denom } else { 1.0 }

    RegressionResult {
        slope: slope,
        intercept: intercept,
        r_squared: r_squared,
        var_slope: var_slope,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// BOX COUNTING DIMENSION
// ============================================================================

// Compute box-counting dimension from 3D voxel data
pub fn box_counting_dimension(
    voxels: &Vec<bool>,
    nx: u32,
    ny: u32,
    nz: u32,
    min_scale: u32,
    max_scale: u32,
) -> FractalDimensionResult {
    var scales: Vec<u32> = vec![]
    var r = min_scale
    let max_dim = min_u32(min_u32(nx, ny), nz)
    while r <= max_scale && r <= max_dim {
        scales.push(r)
        r = r * 2
    }

    if scales.len() < 2 {
        scales.push(1)
        scales.push(2)
    }

    var log_inv_scales: Vec<f64> = vec![]
    var log_counts: Vec<f64> = vec![]

    for i in 0..scales.len() {
        let scale = scales[i]
        let count = count_boxes(voxels, nx, ny, nz, scale)

        if count > 0 {
            log_inv_scales.push(ln_f64(1.0 / (scale as f64)))
            log_counts.push(ln_f64(count as f64))
        }
    }

    let reg = linear_regression(&log_inv_scales, &log_counts)

    FractalDimensionResult {
        dimension: reg.slope,
        std_dev: sqrt_f64(reg.var_slope),
        r_squared: reg.r_squared,
        num_scales: scales.len() as u32,
    }
}

fn count_boxes(voxels: &Vec<bool>, nx: u32, ny: u32, nz: u32, scale: u32) -> u64 {
    var count: u64 = 0

    let bx_max = (nx + scale - 1) / scale
    let by_max = (ny + scale - 1) / scale
    let bz_max = (nz + scale - 1) / scale

    for bx in 0..bx_max {
        for by in 0..by_max {
            for bz in 0..bz_max {
                var found = false

                for dx in 0..scale {
                    if found { break }
                    for dy in 0..scale {
                        if found { break }
                        for dz in 0..scale {
                            let x = bx * scale + dx
                            let y = by * scale + dy
                            let z = bz * scale + dz

                            if x < nx && y < ny && z < nz {
                                let idx = ((z as usize) * (ny as usize) + (y as usize)) * (nx as usize) + (x as usize)
                                if idx < voxels.len() && voxels[idx] {
                                    found = true
                                    break
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                if found { count = count + 1 }
            }
        }
    }

    count
}

// ============================================================================
// HIGUCHI DIMENSION
// ============================================================================

// Compute Higuchi fractal dimension for 1D time series
pub fn higuchi_dimension(series: &Vec<f64>, k_max: u32) -> FractalDimensionResult {
    let n = series.len()

    if n < (2 * k_max) as usize {
        return FractalDimensionResult {
            dimension: 0.0,
            std_dev: 1.0,
            r_squared: 0.0,
            num_scales: 0,
        }
    }

    var log_inv_k: Vec<f64> = vec![]
    var log_lengths: Vec<f64> = vec![]

    for k in 1..=k_max {
        var l_k = 0.0

        for m in 1..=k {
            var l_m = 0.0
            let limit = ((n - (m as usize)) as f64 / (k as f64)) as usize

            for i in 1..limit {
                let idx1 = (m as usize) + i * (k as usize)
                let idx2 = (m as usize) + (i - 1) * (k as usize)
                if idx1 < n && idx2 < n {
                    l_m = l_m + abs_f64(series[idx1] - series[idx2])
                }
            }

            let norm = ((n - 1) as f64) / ((limit as f64) * (k as f64) * (k as f64))
            l_m = l_m * norm
            l_k = l_k + l_m
        }

        l_k = l_k / (k as f64)

        if l_k > 0.0 {
            log_inv_k.push(ln_f64(1.0 / (k as f64)))
            log_lengths.push(ln_f64(l_k))
        }
    }

    let reg = linear_regression(&log_inv_k, &log_lengths)

    FractalDimensionResult {
        dimension: reg.slope,
        std_dev: sqrt_f64(reg.var_slope),
        r_squared: reg.r_squared,
        num_scales: k_max,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN


// === FILE: stdlib/fractal/entropy.sio ===
//! stdlib/fractal/entropy.sio
//!
//! Entropy Measures with Uncertainty Propagation
//!
//! Provides Shannon, Rényi, sample, approximate, and permutation entropy.

// ============================================================================
// HELPER FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

fn ent_abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn ent_sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    for _ in 0..10 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y) }
    y
}

fn ent_ln_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return -1000000.0 }
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var v = x
    var k: i64 = 0
    while v > 2.0 { v = v / 2.0; k = k + 1 }
    while v < 1.0 { v = v * 2.0; k = k - 1 }
    let y = v - 1.0
    var result = 0.0
    var power = y
    for i in 1..=15 {
        if i % 2 == 1 { result = result + power / (i as f64) }
        else { result = result - power / (i as f64) }
        power = power * y
    }
    result + (k as f64) * ln2
}

fn ent_pow_f64(x: f64, y: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    ent_exp_f64(y * ent_ln_f64(x))
}

fn ent_exp_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var v = x
    if v > 700.0 { v = 700.0 }
    if v < -700.0 { return 0.0 }
    let k = (v / ln2) as i64
    let r = v - (k as f64) * ln2
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    for i in 1..=15 {
        term = term * r / (i as f64)
        result = result + term
    }
    if k >= 0 { for _ in 0..k { result = result * 2.0 } }
    else { for _ in 0..(-k) { result = result / 2.0 } }
    result
}

fn min_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }
fn max_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }

// ============================================================================
// RESULT TYPES
// ============================================================================

// Result of entropy computation with uncertainty
pub struct EntropyResult {
    pub value: f64,
    pub std_dev: f64,
    pub sample_size: usize,
}

// Result of histogram computation
struct HistogramResult {
    pub counts: Vec<u64>,
    pub min_val: f64,
    pub max_val: f64,
}

// ============================================================================
// HISTOGRAM COMPUTATION
// ============================================================================

fn compute_histogram(data: &Vec<f64>, bins: u32) -> HistogramResult {
    if data.len() == 0 {
        return HistogramResult {
            counts: vec![],
            min_val: 0.0,
            max_val: 0.0,
        }
    }

    // Find data range
    var min_val = data[0]
    var max_val = data[0]
    for i in 1..data.len() {
        min_val = min_f64(min_val, data[i])
        max_val = max_f64(max_val, data[i])
    }

    // Handle degenerate case
    if max_val == min_val {
        var counts: Vec<u64> = vec![]
        counts.push(data.len() as u64)
        return HistogramResult {
            counts: counts,
            min_val: min_val,
            max_val: max_val,
        }
    }

    // Initialize bins
    var counts: Vec<u64> = vec![]
    for _ in 0..bins {
        counts.push(0)
    }

    // Fill histogram
    let bin_width = (max_val - min_val) / (bins as f64)
    for i in 0..data.len() {
        var bin = ((data[i] - min_val) / bin_width) as usize
        if bin >= bins as usize {
            bin = (bins - 1) as usize
        }
        counts[bin] = counts[bin] + 1
    }

    HistogramResult {
        counts: counts,
        min_val: min_val,
        max_val: max_val,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// SHANNON ENTROPY
// ============================================================================

// Compute Shannon entropy with Miller-Madow bias correction
//
// H = -Σ pᵢ log(pᵢ)
pub fn shannon_entropy(data: &Vec<f64>, bins: u32) -> EntropyResult {
    let n = data.len()

    if n == 0 {
        return EntropyResult {
            value: 0.0,
            std_dev: 0.0,
            sample_size: 0,
        }
    }

    // Compute histogram
    let hist = compute_histogram(data, bins)
    let counts = hist.counts

    // Compute probabilities and entropy
    var entropy = 0.0
    var non_zero_bins = 0

    for i in 0..counts.len() {
        if counts[i] > 0 {
            let p = (counts[i] as f64) / (n as f64)
            entropy = entropy - p * ent_ln_f64(p)
            non_zero_bins = non_zero_bins + 1
        }
    }

    // Miller-Madow bias correction
    let bias_correction = ((non_zero_bins - 1) as f64) / (2.0 * (n as f64))
    let corrected_entropy = entropy + bias_correction

    // Uncertainty estimation
    var sum_p_log2 = 0.0
    for i in 0..counts.len() {
        if counts[i] > 0 {
            let p = (counts[i] as f64) / (n as f64)
            let log_p = ent_ln_f64(p)
            sum_p_log2 = sum_p_log2 + p * log_p * log_p
        }
    }

    let var_term = sum_p_log2 - entropy * entropy
    let sample_var = if var_term > 0.0 { var_term / (n as f64) } else { 0.0 }
    let bin_var = 1.0 / ((bins * bins) as f64)
    let total_var = sample_var + bin_var

    EntropyResult {
        value: corrected_entropy,
        std_dev: ent_sqrt_f64(total_var),
        sample_size: n,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// RÉNYI ENTROPY
// ============================================================================

// Compute Rényi entropy of order q
//
// H_q = (1/(1-q)) log(Σ pᵢ^q)
pub fn renyi_entropy(data: &Vec<f64>, q: f64, bins: u32) -> EntropyResult {
    let n = data.len()

    if n == 0 {
        return EntropyResult {
            value: 0.0,
            std_dev: 0.0,
            sample_size: 0,
        }
    }

    // Handle q = 1 case (Shannon entropy limit)
    if ent_abs_f64(q - 1.0) < 0.001 {
        return shannon_entropy(data, bins)
    }

    // Compute histogram
    let hist = compute_histogram(data, bins)
    let counts = hist.counts

    // Compute Σ pᵢ^q
    var sum_p_q = 0.0

    for i in 0..counts.len() {
        if counts[i] > 0 {
            let p = (counts[i] as f64) / (n as f64)
            sum_p_q = sum_p_q + ent_pow_f64(p, q)
        }
    }

    // Handle edge cases
    if sum_p_q <= 0.0 {
        return EntropyResult {
            value: 0.0,
            std_dev: 1.0,
            sample_size: n,
        }
    }

    // Rényi entropy
    let entropy = ent_ln_f64(sum_p_q) / (1.0 - q)

    // Uncertainty estimation (approximate)
    let sample_var = 1.0 / (n as f64)
    let q_factor = if q > 1.0 { q } else { 1.0 / (2.0 - q) }
    let total_var = sample_var * q_factor

    EntropyResult {
        value: entropy,
        std_dev: ent_sqrt_f64(total_var),
        sample_size: n,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// SAMPLE ENTROPY
// ============================================================================

// Compute Sample Entropy (SampEn) for time series
//
// Measures regularity/predictability of a time series.
pub fn sample_entropy(series: &Vec<f64>, m: u32, r: f64) -> EntropyResult {
    let n = series.len()

    if n < ((m + 2) as usize) {
        return EntropyResult {
            value: 0.0,
            std_dev: 1.0,
            sample_size: n,
        }
    }

    // Count matches for templates of length m and m+1
    var count_m: u64 = 0
    var count_m1: u64 = 0

    let n_templates = n - (m as usize)

    // For each pair of templates
    for i in 0..n_templates {
        for j in (i + 1)..n_templates {
            // Check if templates of length m match within tolerance r
            var match_m = true
            for k in 0..(m as usize) {
                if ent_abs_f64(series[i + k] - series[j + k]) > r {
                    match_m = false
                }
            }

            if match_m {
                count_m = count_m + 1

                // Check if templates of length m+1 also match
                if i + (m as usize) < n && j + (m as usize) < n {
                    if ent_abs_f64(series[i + (m as usize)] - series[j + (m as usize)]) <= r {
                        count_m1 = count_m1 + 1
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Compute sample entropy
    let sampen = if count_m > 0 && count_m1 > 0 {
        0.0 - ent_ln_f64((count_m1 as f64) / (count_m as f64))
    } else if count_m > 0 {
        ent_ln_f64(count_m as f64)
    } else {
        0.0
    }

    // Uncertainty estimation
    let var_term = if count_m > 0 {
        1.0 / (count_m as f64) + 1.0 / ((count_m1 + 1) as f64)
    } else {
        1.0
    }

    EntropyResult {
        value: sampen,
        std_dev: ent_sqrt_f64(var_term),
        sample_size: n,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// APPROXIMATE ENTROPY
// ============================================================================

// Compute approximate entropy (ApEn)
pub fn approximate_entropy(series: &Vec<f64>, m: u32, r: f64) -> EntropyResult {
    let n = series.len()

    if n < ((m + 1) as usize) {
        return EntropyResult {
            value: 0.0,
            std_dev: 1.0,
            sample_size: n,
        }
    }

    // Compute φ(m) and φ(m+1)
    let phi_m = compute_phi(series, m, r)
    let phi_m1 = compute_phi(series, m + 1, r)

    let apen = phi_m - phi_m1

    let sample_var = 1.0 / (n as f64)

    EntropyResult {
        value: apen,
        std_dev: ent_sqrt_f64(sample_var),
        sample_size: n,
    }
}

// Helper: compute φ for ApEn
fn compute_phi(x: &Vec<f64>, m: u32, r: f64) -> f64 {
    let n = x.len()
    if n < (m as usize) { return 0.0 }

    let n_templates = n - (m as usize) + 1
    var sum_log_c = 0.0

    for i in 0..n_templates {
        var count = 0

        for j in 0..n_templates {
            var match_flag = true
            for k in 0..(m as usize) {
                if ent_abs_f64(x[i + k] - x[j + k]) > r {
                    match_flag = false
                }
            }
            if match_flag {
                count = count + 1
            }
        }

        let c_i = (count as f64) / (n_templates as f64)
        if c_i > 0.0 {
            sum_log_c = sum_log_c + ent_ln_f64(c_i)
        }
    }

    sum_log_c / (n_templates as f64)
}

// ============================================================================
// PERMUTATION ENTROPY
// ============================================================================

// Compute permutation entropy
pub fn permutation_entropy(series: &Vec<f64>, order: u32, delay: u32) -> EntropyResult {
    let n = series.len()

    let pattern_len = order as usize
    let delay_val = delay as usize

    if n < pattern_len * delay_val {
        return EntropyResult {
            value: 0.0,
            std_dev: 1.0,
            sample_size: n,
        }
    }

    let n_patterns = n - (pattern_len - 1) * delay_val
    var pattern_counts: Vec<u64> = vec![]

    // Initialize for up to 24 permutations (order ≤ 4)
    let max_perms = 24
    for _ in 0..max_perms {
        pattern_counts.push(0)
    }

    for i in 0..n_patterns {
        // Extract pattern
        var pattern: Vec<f64> = vec![]
        for j in 0..pattern_len {
            pattern.push(series[i + j * delay_val])
        }

        // Compute ordinal pattern index
        let idx = ordinal_pattern_index(&pattern, order) % max_perms
        pattern_counts[idx] = pattern_counts[idx] + 1
    }

    // Compute entropy
    var entropy = 0.0
    for i in 0..max_perms {
        if pattern_counts[i] > 0 {
            let p = (pattern_counts[i] as f64) / (n_patterns as f64)
            entropy = entropy - p * ent_ln_f64(p)
        }
    }

    // Normalize by log(order!)
    let factorial = factorial_u32(order)
    let max_entropy = ent_ln_f64(factorial as f64)
    let normalized = if max_entropy > 0.0 { entropy / max_entropy } else { 0.0 }

    let sample_var = 1.0 / (n_patterns as f64)

    EntropyResult {
        value: normalized,
        std_dev: ent_sqrt_f64(sample_var),
        sample_size: n,
    }
}

// Helper: compute ordinal pattern index
fn ordinal_pattern_index(pattern: &Vec<f64>, order: u32) -> usize {
    var idx: usize = 0
    for i in 0..pattern.len() {
        for j in (i + 1)..pattern.len() {
            if pattern[i] > pattern[j] {
                idx = idx + 1
            }
        }
        idx = idx * (order as usize)
    }
    idx
}

// Helper: factorial
fn factorial_u32(n: u32) -> u32 {
    if n <= 1 { return 1 }
    var result: u32 = 1
    for i in 2..=n {
        result = result * i
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN


// === FILE: stdlib/fractal/fsnn.sio ===
//! stdlib/fractal/fsnn.sio - Fractal Sedenionic Neural Network Layer
//!
//! Takes a sedenionic embedding c in S, runs the Mandelbrot orbit,
//! and extracts a 16-dimensional feature vector phi(c) for downstream classification.
//!
//! Feature vector components:
//!   [0]  escape_ratio       n_esc / N_max
//!   [1]  terminal_norm      |z_N|
//!   [2]  jacobian_op_norm   sigma_1(J_N)
//!   [3]  jacobian_frob_norm ||J_N||_F
//!   [4]  jacobian_condition sigma_1 / sigma_16
//!   [5]  hessian_frob_norm  ||H_N||_F
//!   [6]  curvature_ratio    ||H||_F / ||J||_op^2
//!   [7]  distance_estimator |z_N| ln|z_N| / ||J||_op
//!   [8]  lyapunov_max       (1/n) sum_k ln sigma_1(J_k)
//!   [9]  lyapunov_min       (1/n) ln sigma_16
//!   [10] lyapunov_dim       # expanding singular values (sigma > 1)
//!   [11] zero_div_proximity Moreno analytic distance to Z
//!   [12] orbit_mean         mean(|z_n|)
//!   [13] orbit_std          std(|z_n|)
//!   [14] orbit_skewness     skewness(|z_n|)
//!   [15] orbit_kurtosis     excess kurtosis(|z_n|)

use math::sedenion64::*
use linalg::mat16::*
use linalg::tensor16::*
use fractal::mandelbrot::{OrbitConfig, OrbitResult, compute_orbit, orbit_config_default}
use fractal::zero_divisor::{zd_moreno_proximity}

// ============================================================================
// FSNN FEATURES TYPE
// ============================================================================

pub struct FSNNFeatures {
    escape_ratio: f64,
    terminal_norm: f64,
    jacobian_op_norm: f64,
    jacobian_frob_norm: f64,
    jacobian_condition: f64,
    hessian_frob_norm: f64,
    curvature_ratio: f64,
    distance_estimator: f64,
    lyapunov_max: f64,
    lyapunov_min: f64,
    lyapunov_dim: f64,
    zero_div_proximity: f64,
    orbit_mean: f64,
    orbit_std: f64,
    orbit_skewness: f64,
    orbit_kurtosis: f64,
}

// ============================================================================
// MATH HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn fsnn_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    // Scale into [0.25, 4) before Babylonian iteration.
    // y=x starting point diverges for tiny x (first step gives y≈0.5).
    var xn = x
    var scale = 1.0
    while xn < 0.25 {
        xn = xn * 4.0
        scale = scale * 0.5
    }
    while xn >= 4.0 {
        xn = xn * 0.25
        scale = scale * 2.0
    }
    var y = 1.0
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    return y * scale
}

fn fsnn_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn fsnn_ln(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = 0.0
    var t = x
    if t > 1.0 {
        while t > 2.718281828 {
            t = t / 2.718281828
            y = y + 1.0
        }
        y = y + (t - 1.0) / t
    } else {
        while t < 0.367879441 {
            t = t * 2.718281828
            y = y - 1.0
        }
        y = y + (t - 1.0) / t
    }
    // Newton refinement
    var i = 0
    while i < 8 {
        let ey = fsnn_exp_approx(y)
        y = y + (x - ey) / ey
        i = i + 1
    }
    return y
}

fn fsnn_exp_approx(x: f64) -> f64 {
    var k = 0
    var r = x
    while r > 1.0 {
        r = r * 0.5
        k = k + 1
    }
    while r < -1.0 {
        r = r * 0.5
        k = k + 1
    }
    let r2 = r * r
    let r3 = r2 * r
    let r4 = r3 * r
    let r5 = r4 * r
    let r6 = r5 * r
    var result = 1.0 + r + r2 * 0.5 + r3 / 6.0 + r4 / 24.0 + r5 / 120.0 + r6 / 720.0
    var j = 0
    while j < k {
        result = result * result
        j = j + 1
    }
    return result
}

fn fsnn_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { a } else { b }
}

// ============================================================================
// STATISTICS HELPERS
// ============================================================================

pub fn fsnn_stat_mean(arr: [f64; 256], n: i32) -> f64 {
    if n <= 0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        sum = sum + arr[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    sum / (n as f64)
}

pub fn fsnn_stat_std(arr: [f64; 256], n: i32) -> f64 {
    if n <= 1 { return 0.0 }
    let mean = fsnn_stat_mean(arr, n)
    var sum_sq = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let d = arr[i] - mean
        sum_sq = sum_sq + d * d
        i = i + 1
    }
    fsnn_sqrt(sum_sq / ((n - 1) as f64))
}

pub fn fsnn_stat_skewness(arr: [f64; 256], n: i32) -> f64 {
    if n <= 2 { return 0.0 }
    let mean = fsnn_stat_mean(arr, n)
    let std = fsnn_stat_std(arr, n)
    if std < 1e-30 { return 0.0 }
    var sum_cube = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let d = (arr[i] - mean) / std
        sum_cube = sum_cube + d * d * d
        i = i + 1
    }
    sum_cube / (n as f64)
}

pub fn fsnn_stat_kurtosis(arr: [f64; 256], n: i32) -> f64 {
    if n <= 3 { return 0.0 }
    let mean = fsnn_stat_mean(arr, n)
    let std = fsnn_stat_std(arr, n)
    if std < 1e-30 { return 0.0 }
    var sum_quad = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let d = (arr[i] - mean) / std
        sum_quad = sum_quad + d * d * d * d
        i = i + 1
    }
    sum_quad / (n as f64) - 3.0    // excess kurtosis
}

// ============================================================================
// FEATURE EXTRACTION
// ============================================================================

pub fn fsnn_extract_features(orbit: OrbitResult, config: OrbitConfig) -> FSNNFeatures {
    let eps = 1e-10
    let n = orbit.n_escape as f64
    let z_norm = sed64_norm(orbit.z_final)

    // Singular values of Jacobian
    let sv = mat16_singular_values(orbit.jacobian)
    let J_op = fsnn_max(sv[0], eps)
    let J_frob = mat16_frobenius_norm(orbit.jacobian)
    let H_frob = tensor16_frobenius_norm(orbit.hessian)

    // Count expanding directions (sigma > 1)
    var lyap_dim = 0.0
    var si = 0
    while si < 16 {
        if sv[si] > 1.0 {
            lyap_dim = lyap_dim + 1.0
        }
        si = si + 1
    }

    // Analytic Moreno proximity (O(1), replaces Monte Carlo)
    let zd_prox = zd_moreno_proximity(orbit.z_final)

    // Distance estimator: |z| ln|z| / ||J||_op
    var dist_est = 0.0
    if z_norm > eps {
        dist_est = z_norm * fsnn_ln(z_norm) / (J_op + eps)
    }

    // Oseledec (1968) Lyapunov exponent: (1/N) sum_n ln sigma_1(J_n)
    // Uses per-iteration sigma_1 approximations stored in jacobian_op_norms.
    var lya_sum = 0.0
    var lk = 0
    while lk < orbit.history_len {
        let jk = orbit.jacobian_op_norms[lk]
        if jk > eps { lya_sum = lya_sum + fsnn_ln(jk) }
        lk = lk + 1
    }
    let n_hist = fsnn_max(orbit.history_len as f64, 1.0)

    FSNNFeatures {
        escape_ratio:       n / (config.max_iter as f64),
        terminal_norm:      z_norm,
        jacobian_op_norm:   J_op,
        jacobian_frob_norm: J_frob,
        jacobian_condition: sv[0] / fsnn_max(sv[15], eps),
        hessian_frob_norm:  H_frob,
        curvature_ratio:    H_frob / (J_op * J_op + eps),
        distance_estimator: dist_est,
        lyapunov_max:       lya_sum / n_hist,
        lyapunov_min:       fsnn_ln(fsnn_max(sv[15], eps)) / fsnn_max(n, 1.0),
        lyapunov_dim:       lyap_dim,
        zero_div_proximity: zd_prox,
        orbit_mean:         fsnn_stat_mean(orbit.orbit_norms, orbit.history_len),
        orbit_std:          fsnn_stat_std(orbit.orbit_norms, orbit.history_len),
        orbit_skewness:     fsnn_stat_skewness(orbit.orbit_norms, orbit.history_len),
        orbit_kurtosis:     fsnn_stat_kurtosis(orbit.orbit_norms, orbit.history_len),
    }
}

// Full FSNN forward pass: embedding -> orbit -> features
pub fn fsnn_forward(c: Sedenion64, config: OrbitConfig) -> FSNNFeatures {
    let orbit = compute_orbit(c, config)
    fsnn_extract_features(orbit, config)
}

// Convert features to flat array for downstream ML
pub fn fsnn_features_to_array(f: FSNNFeatures) -> [f64; 16] {
    var arr = [0.0; 16]
    arr[0] = f.escape_ratio
    arr[1] = f.terminal_norm
    arr[2] = f.jacobian_op_norm
    arr[3] = f.jacobian_frob_norm
    arr[4] = f.jacobian_condition
    arr[5] = f.hessian_frob_norm
    arr[6] = f.curvature_ratio
    arr[7] = f.distance_estimator
    arr[8] = f.lyapunov_max
    arr[9] = f.lyapunov_min
    arr[10] = f.lyapunov_dim
    arr[11] = f.zero_div_proximity
    arr[12] = f.orbit_mean
    arr[13] = f.orbit_std
    arr[14] = f.orbit_skewness
    arr[15] = f.orbit_kurtosis
    return arr
}

pub fn fsnn_features_from_array(arr: [f64; 16]) -> FSNNFeatures {
    FSNNFeatures {
        escape_ratio:       arr[0],
        terminal_norm:      arr[1],
        jacobian_op_norm:   arr[2],
        jacobian_frob_norm: arr[3],
        jacobian_condition: arr[4],
        hessian_frob_norm:  arr[5],
        curvature_ratio:    arr[6],
        distance_estimator: arr[7],
        lyapunov_max:       arr[8],
        lyapunov_min:       arr[9],
        lyapunov_dim:       arr[10],
        zero_div_proximity: arr[11],
        orbit_mean:         arr[12],
        orbit_std:          arr[13],
        orbit_skewness:     arr[14],
        orbit_kurtosis:     arr[15],
    }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/fractal/gpu/box_counting.sio ===
//! stdlib/fractal/gpu/box_counting.sio
//!
//! GPU-Accelerated Box-Counting Dimension
//!
//! This module provides a parallel GPU implementation of the box-counting
//! algorithm for fractal dimension estimation.

// ============================================================================
// HELPER FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

fn gbc_abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn gbc_sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    for _ in 0..10 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y) }
    y
}

fn gbc_ln_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return -1000000.0 }
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var v = x
    var k: i64 = 0
    while v > 2.0 { v = v / 2.0; k = k + 1 }
    while v < 1.0 { v = v * 2.0; k = k - 1 }
    let y = v - 1.0
    var result = 0.0
    var power = y
    for i in 1..=15 {
        if i % 2 == 1 { result = result + power / (i as f64) }
        else { result = result - power / (i as f64) }
        power = power * y
    }
    result + (k as f64) * ln2
}

fn gbc_exp_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var v = x
    if v > 700.0 { v = 700.0 }
    if v < -700.0 { return 0.0 }
    let k = (v / ln2) as i64
    let r = v - (k as f64) * ln2
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    for i in 1..=15 {
        term = term * r / (i as f64)
        result = result + term
    }
    if k >= 0 { for _ in 0..k { result = result * 2.0 } }
    else { for _ in 0..(-k) { result = result / 2.0 } }
    result
}

fn gbc_min_u32(a: u32, b: u32) -> u32 { if a < b { a } else { b } }

// ============================================================================
// TYPES
// ============================================================================

// Result of fractal dimension analysis
pub struct GbcFractalDimensionResult {
    pub dimension: f64,
    pub dimension_std: f64,
    pub r_squared: f64,
    pub scales: Vec<u32>,
    pub counts: Vec<u64>,
    pub valid: bool,
}

// Simple voxel grid
pub struct VoxelGrid3D {
    pub data: Vec<bool>,
    pub size_x: u32,
    pub size_y: u32,
    pub size_z: u32,
}

// Regression result
struct GbcRegressionResult {
    pub slope: f64,
    pub r_squared: f64,
    pub var_slope: f64,
}

// ============================================================================
// INTERNAL FUNCTIONS (must precede callers)
// ============================================================================

// Check GPU availability
fn gbc_is_gpu_available() -> bool {
    false
}

// Count occupied boxes at a specific scale
fn count_boxes_at_scale(data: &VoxelGrid3D, scale: u32) -> u64 {
    let nx = data.size_x
    let ny = data.size_y
    let nz = data.size_z

    var count: u64 = 0

    let boxes_x = (nx + scale - 1) / scale
    let boxes_y = (ny + scale - 1) / scale
    let boxes_z = (nz + scale - 1) / scale

    for bz in 0..boxes_z {
        for by in 0..boxes_y {
            for bx in 0..boxes_x {
                var found = false

                for dz in 0..scale {
                    if found { break }
                    for dy in 0..scale {
                        if found { break }
                        for dx in 0..scale {
                            let x = bx * scale + dx
                            let y = by * scale + dy
                            let z = bz * scale + dz

                            if x < nx && y < ny && z < nz {
                                let idx = ((z as usize) * (ny as usize) + (y as usize)) * (nx as usize) + (x as usize)
                                if idx < data.data.len() && data.data[idx] {
                                    found = true
                                    break
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                if found {
                    count = count + 1
                }
            }
        }
    }

    count
}

// CPU box counting fallback
fn cpu_count_boxes(data: &VoxelGrid3D, scales: &Vec<u32>) -> Vec<u64> {
    var counts: Vec<u64> = vec![]

    for i in 0..scales.len() {
        let scale = scales[i]
        let count = count_boxes_at_scale(data, scale)
        counts.push(count)
    }

    counts
}

// GPU box counting (stub - falls back to CPU)
fn gpu_count_boxes(data: &VoxelGrid3D, scales: &Vec<u32>) -> Vec<u64> {
    cpu_count_boxes(data, scales)
}

// Weighted linear regression
fn weighted_linear_regression(
    x: &Vec<f64>,
    y: &Vec<f64>,
    w: &Vec<f64>,
) -> GbcRegressionResult {
    let n = x.len()
    if n < 2 {
        return GbcRegressionResult { slope: 0.0, r_squared: 0.0, var_slope: 1.0 }
    }

    var sum_w = 0.0
    var sum_wx = 0.0
    var sum_wy = 0.0
    var sum_wxy = 0.0
    var sum_wx2 = 0.0
    var sum_wy2 = 0.0

    for i in 0..n {
        sum_w = sum_w + w[i]
        sum_wx = sum_wx + w[i] * x[i]
        sum_wy = sum_wy + w[i] * y[i]
        sum_wxy = sum_wxy + w[i] * x[i] * y[i]
        sum_wx2 = sum_wx2 + w[i] * x[i] * x[i]
        sum_wy2 = sum_wy2 + w[i] * y[i] * y[i]
    }

    let denom = sum_w * sum_wx2 - sum_wx * sum_wx

    if gbc_abs_f64(denom) < 1e-10 {
        return GbcRegressionResult { slope: 0.0, r_squared: 0.0, var_slope: 1.0 }
    }

    let slope = (sum_w * sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy) / denom
    let intercept = (sum_wy - slope * sum_wx) / sum_w

    // Weighted R²
    let y_mean = sum_wy / sum_w
    var ss_tot = 0.0
    var ss_res = 0.0

    for i in 0..n {
        let pred = intercept + slope * x[i]
        ss_tot = ss_tot + w[i] * (y[i] - y_mean) * (y[i] - y_mean)
        ss_res = ss_res + w[i] * (y[i] - pred) * (y[i] - pred)
    }

    let r_sq = if ss_tot > 0.0 { 1.0 - ss_res / ss_tot } else { 0.0 }

    // Variance of slope
    let mse = if n > 2 { ss_res / (sum_w * (1.0 - 2.0 / (n as f64))) } else { ss_res / sum_w }
    let var_slope = if denom > 0.0 { mse * sum_w / denom } else { 1.0 }

    GbcRegressionResult {
        slope: slope,
        r_squared: r_sq,
        var_slope: var_slope,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// GPU BOX COUNTING DIMENSION (public entry point)
// ============================================================================

// Compute box-counting dimension with GPU acceleration (or CPU fallback)
pub fn gpu_box_counting_dimension(
    data: &VoxelGrid3D,
    min_scale: u32,
    max_scale: u32,
    num_scales: u32,
) -> GbcFractalDimensionResult {
    // Validate inputs
    if min_scale >= max_scale {
        return GbcFractalDimensionResult {
            dimension: 0.0, dimension_std: 1.0, r_squared: 0.0,
            scales: vec![], counts: vec![], valid: false,
        }
    }

    let nx = data.size_x
    let ny = data.size_y
    let nz = data.size_z
    let min_dim = gbc_min_u32(gbc_min_u32(nx, ny), nz)

    // Generate logarithmically spaced scales
    var scales: Vec<u32> = vec![]
    let log_min = gbc_ln_f64(min_scale as f64)
    let log_max = gbc_ln_f64(gbc_min_u32(max_scale, min_dim) as f64)
    let log_step = (log_max - log_min) / ((num_scales - 1) as f64)

    for i in 0..num_scales {
        let log_scale = log_min + (i as f64) * log_step
        let scale = gbc_exp_f64(log_scale) as u32
        if scale >= 1 {
            var is_duplicate = false
            if scales.len() > 0 && scale == scales[scales.len() - 1] {
                is_duplicate = true
            }
            if !is_duplicate {
                scales.push(scale)
            }
        }
    }

    if scales.len() < 2 {
        return GbcFractalDimensionResult {
            dimension: 0.0, dimension_std: 1.0, r_squared: 0.0,
            scales: scales, counts: vec![], valid: false,
        }
    }

    // Check GPU availability and dispatch
    let use_gpu = gbc_is_gpu_available() && data.data.len() > 100000

    var counts: Vec<u64> = vec![]

    if use_gpu {
        counts = gpu_count_boxes(data, &scales)
    } else {
        counts = cpu_count_boxes(data, &scales)
    }

    // Prepare for log-log regression
    var log_inv_scales: Vec<f64> = vec![]
    var log_counts: Vec<f64> = vec![]
    var weights: Vec<f64> = vec![]

    for i in 0..scales.len() {
        if i < counts.len() && counts[i] > 0 {
            log_inv_scales.push(gbc_ln_f64(1.0 / (scales[i] as f64)))
            log_counts.push(gbc_ln_f64(counts[i] as f64))
            let rel_err = gbc_sqrt_f64(counts[i] as f64) / (counts[i] as f64)
            weights.push(1.0 / (rel_err * rel_err + 0.01))
        }
    }

    if log_inv_scales.len() < 2 {
        return GbcFractalDimensionResult {
            dimension: 0.0, dimension_std: 1.0, r_squared: 0.0,
            scales: scales, counts: counts, valid: false,
        }
    }

    // Weighted linear regression
    let reg = weighted_linear_regression(&log_inv_scales, &log_counts, &weights)

    GbcFractalDimensionResult {
        dimension: reg.slope,
        dimension_std: gbc_sqrt_f64(reg.var_slope),
        r_squared: reg.r_squared,
        scales: scales,
        counts: counts,
        valid: reg.r_squared >= 0.90,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// GPU BUFFER TYPES
// ============================================================================

// GPU memory buffer for voxel data
pub struct GpuVoxelBuffer {
    pub data: Vec<u8>,
    pub dim_x: u32,
    pub dim_y: u32,
    pub dim_z: u32,
    pub on_device: bool,
}

// Create GPU buffer from voxels
pub fn gpu_buffer_from_voxels(voxels: &Vec<bool>, nx: u32, ny: u32, nz: u32) -> GpuVoxelBuffer {
    var data: Vec<u8> = vec![]
    for i in 0..voxels.len() {
        if voxels[i] {
            data.push(1)
        } else {
            data.push(0)
        }
    }

    GpuVoxelBuffer {
        data: data,
        dim_x: nx,
        dim_y: ny,
        dim_z: nz,
        on_device: false,
    }
}

// Transfer buffer to device
pub fn gpu_buffer_to_device(buffer: &GpuVoxelBuffer) -> GpuVoxelBuffer {
    var data: Vec<u8> = vec![]
    for i in 0..buffer.data.len() {
        data.push(buffer.data[i])
    }

    GpuVoxelBuffer {
        data: data,
        dim_x: buffer.dim_x,
        dim_y: buffer.dim_y,
        dim_z: buffer.dim_z,
        on_device: is_gpu_available(),
    }
}

// Transfer buffer back to host as bool vec
pub fn gpu_buffer_to_host(buffer: &GpuVoxelBuffer) -> Vec<bool> {
    var result: Vec<bool> = vec![]
    for i in 0..buffer.data.len() {
        result.push(buffer.data[i] > 0)
    }
    result
}

// GPU buffer for scalar results
pub struct GpuScalarBuffer {
    pub data: Vec<u64>,
    pub on_device: bool,
}

// Create zeros scalar buffer
pub fn gpu_scalar_buffer_zeros(size: usize) -> GpuScalarBuffer {
    var data: Vec<u64> = vec![]
    for _ in 0..size {
        data.push(0)
    }
    GpuScalarBuffer { data: data, on_device: false }
}

// === FILE: stdlib/fractal/hessian_curvature.sio ===
//! stdlib/fractal/hessian_curvature.sio - Curvature Feature Extraction from Sedenion Mandelbrot Hessian
//!
//! Given an OrbitResult containing the 16x16x16 Hessian tensor H[i][d][j],
//! extract the curvature spectrum: eigenvalues of the contracted Hessian
//! M[i][j] = sum_d H[i][d][j] (trace over fibre index = mean curvature matrix).
//!
//! The null space of M is structurally determined by the 336 zero-divisor
//! pairs (= 2 * |PSL(2,7)|) of the sedenion algebra.
//!
//! Features extracted:
//!   - curvature_eigenvalues[16]: sorted eigenvalue spectrum of M
//!   - null_dim: number of eigenvalues with |lambda| < threshold
//!   - trace: sum of eigenvalues = scalar curvature
//!   - anisotropy: lambda_max / lambda_min (nonzero)
//!   - zd_alignment: alignment of null space with known zero-divisor directions
//!   - frob_norm: Frobenius norm of M (total curvature magnitude)
//!
//! Reference: Chiuratto Agourakis, "Generalised Wirtinger Calculus on Sedenions" (2026)

// ============================================================================
// HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn hc_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn hc_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 12 {
        y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
        i = i + 1
    }
    return y
}

// ============================================================================
// CURVATURE FEATURES TYPE
// ============================================================================

pub struct CurvatureFeatures {
    // Eigenvalue spectrum (sorted descending by magnitude)
    eigenvalues: [f64; 16],

    // Null space dimension: count of |lambda_i| < null_threshold
    null_dim: i32,

    // Scalar curvature: trace(M) = sum of eigenvalues
    trace: f64,

    // Anisotropy: |lambda_max| / |lambda_min_nonzero|
    anisotropy: f64,

    // Frobenius norm of the contracted Hessian
    frob_norm: f64,

    // Zero-divisor alignment score: fraction of null eigenvectors
    // that align with known zero-divisor directions
    zd_alignment: f64,

    // Curvature concentration: fraction of total |eigenvalue| in top 4
    concentration_top4: f64,

    // Sign distribution: count of positive eigenvalues
    n_positive: i32,

    // Sign distribution: count of negative eigenvalues
    n_negative: i32,

    // Spectral gap: |lambda_1| - |lambda_2|
    spectral_gap: f64,

    // Effective rank: exp(Shannon entropy of normalized |eigenvalues|)
    effective_rank: f64,
}

// ============================================================================
// CONTRACT HESSIAN TENSOR TO 16x16 MATRIX
// ============================================================================

// Contract the 16x16x16 Hessian tensor H[i][d][j] over the fibre index d
// to produce the 16x16 mean curvature matrix M[i][j] = sum_d H[i][d][j].
//
// This is the sedenion analogue of the Ricci tensor: contracting the full
// Riemann curvature over one index pair.
pub fn contract_hessian(h_data: [f64; 4096]) -> [f64; 256] {
    var M = [0.0; 256]
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        var j = 0
        while j < 16 {
            var sum = 0.0
            var d = 0
            while d < 16 {
                // H is stored as H[i][d][j] = h_data[i*256 + d*16 + j]
                sum = sum + h_data[i * 256 + d * 16 + j]
                d = d + 1
            }
            M[i * 16 + j] = sum
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return M
}

// ============================================================================
// SYMMETRIC POWER ITERATION FOR ALL 16 EIGENVALUES
// ============================================================================

// Compute all 16 eigenvalues of a symmetric 16x16 matrix via deflated
// power iteration. Returns eigenvalues sorted by descending |magnitude|.
//
// For each eigenvalue: run power iteration on M, find dominant eigenvalue,
// then deflate M by subtracting lambda * v * v^T.
fn eigenvalues_symmetric_16(M_in: [f64; 256]) -> [f64; 16] {
    var eigenvalues = [0.0; 16]
    var M = [0.0; 256]
    var idx = 0
    while idx < 256 {
        M[idx] = M_in[idx]
        idx = idx + 1
    }

    var ev_idx = 0
    while ev_idx < 16 {
        // Power iteration for dominant eigenvalue
        var v = [0.0; 16]
        // Initialize with a vector that varies per iteration to avoid degeneracy
        var init = 0
        while init < 16 {
            v[init] = 1.0 + 0.1 * (init as f64) + 0.01 * (ev_idx as f64)
            init = init + 1
        }
        // Normalize
        var norm_sq = 0.0
        var ni = 0
        while ni < 16 {
            norm_sq = norm_sq + v[ni] * v[ni]
            ni = ni + 1
        }
        let inv_norm = 1.0 / hc_sqrt(norm_sq)
        ni = 0
        while ni < 16 {
            v[ni] = v[ni] * inv_norm
            ni = ni + 1
        }

        var lambda = 0.0
        var iter = 0
        while iter < 50 {
            // w = M * v
            var w = [0.0; 16]
            var i = 0
            while i < 16 {
                var sum = 0.0
                var j = 0
                while j < 16 {
                    sum = sum + M[i * 16 + j] * v[j]
                    j = j + 1
                }
                w[i] = sum
                i = i + 1
            }

            // Rayleigh quotient: lambda = v^T * w
            lambda = 0.0
            i = 0
            while i < 16 {
                lambda = lambda + v[i] * w[i]
                i = i + 1
            }

            // Normalize w -> v
            norm_sq = 0.0
            i = 0
            while i < 16 {
                norm_sq = norm_sq + w[i] * w[i]
                i = i + 1
            }
            if norm_sq < 1.0e-30 {
                // Deflated to zero — remaining eigenvalues are zero
                iter = 50
            } else {
                let inv = 1.0 / hc_sqrt(norm_sq)
                i = 0
                while i < 16 {
                    v[i] = w[i] * inv
                    i = i + 1
                }
            }
            iter = iter + 1
        }

        eigenvalues[ev_idx] = lambda

        // Deflate: M = M - lambda * v * v^T
        var i = 0
        while i < 16 {
            var j = 0
            while j < 16 {
                M[i * 16 + j] = M[i * 16 + j] - lambda * v[i] * v[j]
                j = j + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }

        ev_idx = ev_idx + 1
    }

    return eigenvalues
}

// ============================================================================
// ZERO-DIVISOR ALIGNMENT
// ============================================================================

// Check alignment of a null eigenvector with the 4 canonical zero-divisor
// directions from Moreno's Proposition 2.5:
//   (e1 + e10)(e4 - e15) = 0
// The zero-divisor variety lives in the subspace spanned by
// {e1, e4, e10, e15} (indices 1, 4, 10, 15 in 0-based sedenion components).
//
// Alignment score = fraction of null-eigenvector energy in the ZD subspace.
fn zd_subspace_alignment(v: [f64; 16]) -> f64 {
    // Energy in the 4 zero-divisor-relevant components
    let zd_energy = v[1]*v[1] + v[4]*v[4] + v[10]*v[10] + v[15]*v[15]
    // Total energy
    var total = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        total = total + v[i] * v[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    if total < 1.0e-30 { return 0.0 }
    return zd_energy / total
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN FEATURE EXTRACTION
// ============================================================================

// Extract curvature features from a Hessian tensor stored as [f64; 4096].
// The null_threshold determines what eigenvalue magnitude counts as "zero".
pub fn extract_curvature_features(h_data: [f64; 4096], null_threshold: f64) -> CurvatureFeatures {
    // Step 1: Contract H[i][d][j] -> M[i][j]
    let M = contract_hessian(h_data)

    // Step 2: Compute Frobenius norm of M
    var frob_sq = 0.0
    var fi = 0
    while fi < 256 {
        frob_sq = frob_sq + M[fi] * M[fi]
        fi = fi + 1
    }
    let frob = hc_sqrt(frob_sq)

    // Step 3: Eigendecompose M
    let eigs = eigenvalues_symmetric_16(M)

    // Step 4: Compute trace
    var trace = 0.0
    var ti = 0
    while ti < 16 {
        trace = trace + eigs[ti]
        ti = ti + 1
    }

    // Step 5: Count null, positive, negative
    var null_dim = 0
    var n_pos = 0
    var n_neg = 0
    var max_abs = 0.0
    var min_abs_nonzero = 1.0e30
    ti = 0
    while ti < 16 {
        let a = hc_abs(eigs[ti])
        if a < null_threshold {
            null_dim = null_dim + 1
        } else {
            if eigs[ti] > 0.0 { n_pos = n_pos + 1 }
            if eigs[ti] < 0.0 { n_neg = n_neg + 1 }
            if a > max_abs { max_abs = a }
            if a < min_abs_nonzero { min_abs_nonzero = a }
        }
        ti = ti + 1
    }

    // Step 6: Anisotropy
    let aniso = if min_abs_nonzero > 1.0e-30 { max_abs / min_abs_nonzero } else { 0.0 }

    // Step 7: Concentration in top 4
    var total_abs = 0.0
    var top4_abs = 0.0
    ti = 0
    while ti < 16 {
        total_abs = total_abs + hc_abs(eigs[ti])
        if ti < 4 {
            top4_abs = top4_abs + hc_abs(eigs[ti])
        }
        ti = ti + 1
    }
    let conc = if total_abs > 1.0e-30 { top4_abs / total_abs } else { 0.0 }

    // Step 8: Spectral gap
    let gap = if hc_abs(eigs[0]) > hc_abs(eigs[1]) {
        hc_abs(eigs[0]) - hc_abs(eigs[1])
    } else {
        hc_abs(eigs[1]) - hc_abs(eigs[0])
    }

    // Step 9: Effective rank via Shannon entropy of |eigenvalues|
    // eff_rank = exp(-sum p_i ln p_i) where p_i = |lambda_i| / sum|lambda|
    var eff_rank = 1.0
    if total_abs > 1.0e-30 {
        var entropy = 0.0
        ti = 0
        while ti < 16 {
            let p = hc_abs(eigs[ti]) / total_abs
            if p > 1.0e-15 {
                // ln(p) via ln(x) = 2 * sum t^(2k+1)/(2k+1) where t=(x-1)/(x+1)
                let t = (p - 1.0) / (p + 1.0)
                let t2 = t * t
                let ln_p = 2.0 * t * (1.0 + t2 * (1.0/3.0 + t2 * (1.0/5.0 + t2 * (1.0/7.0 + t2 * (1.0/9.0)))))
                entropy = entropy - p * ln_p
            }
            ti = ti + 1
        }
        // exp(entropy) via Taylor: e^x = 1 + x + x^2/2 + x^3/6 + x^4/24 + x^5/120
        let x = entropy
        eff_rank = 1.0 + x * (1.0 + x * (0.5 + x * (1.0/6.0 + x * (1.0/24.0 + x * (1.0/120.0)))))
    }

    // Step 10: Zero-divisor alignment (simplified: check if null eigenvalues
    // correspond to directions in the ZD subspace)
    // For now, use the fraction of near-zero eigenvalues that are in ZD-relevant positions
    // (indices 1, 4, 10, 15 in the eigenvalue ordering correspond to ZD directions
    //  only if the eigenvectors align — this is an approximation)
    var zd_null_count = 0
    // Check if eigenvalues at positions corresponding to ZD indices are near-zero
    // This is a heuristic; full alignment requires eigenvector computation
    if hc_abs(eigs[1]) < null_threshold { zd_null_count = zd_null_count + 1 }
    if hc_abs(eigs[4]) < null_threshold { zd_null_count = zd_null_count + 1 }
    if hc_abs(eigs[10]) < null_threshold { zd_null_count = zd_null_count + 1 }
    if hc_abs(eigs[15]) < null_threshold { zd_null_count = zd_null_count + 1 }
    let zd_align = (zd_null_count as f64) / 4.0

    CurvatureFeatures {
        eigenvalues: eigs,
        null_dim: null_dim,
        trace: trace,
        anisotropy: aniso,
        frob_norm: frob,
        zd_alignment: zd_align,
        concentration_top4: conc,
        n_positive: n_pos,
        n_negative: n_neg,
        spectral_gap: gap,
        effective_rank: eff_rank,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// PRINTING
// ============================================================================

pub fn print_curvature_features(cf: CurvatureFeatures) -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    println("=== Sedenion Mandelbrot Hessian Curvature ===")

    print("  Eigenvalue spectrum: [")
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        if i > 0 { print(", ") }
        print_f64(cf.eigenvalues[i], 6)
        i = i + 1
    }
    println("]")

    print("  Null dimension:     "); print_i32(cf.null_dim); println("")
    print("  Scalar curvature:   "); print_f64(cf.trace, 6); println("")
    print("  Anisotropy:         "); print_f64(cf.anisotropy, 4); println("")
    print("  Frobenius norm:     "); print_f64(cf.frob_norm, 6); println("")
    print("  ZD alignment:       "); print_f64(cf.zd_alignment, 4); println("")
    print("  Top-4 concentration:"); print_f64(cf.concentration_top4, 4); println("")
    print("  Positive eigenvalues: "); print_i32(cf.n_positive); println("")
    print("  Negative eigenvalues: "); print_i32(cf.n_negative); println("")
    print("  Spectral gap:       "); print_f64(cf.spectral_gap, 6); println("")
    print("  Effective rank:     "); print_f64(cf.effective_rank, 4); println("")

    return 0
}

// ============================================================================
// PRINT HELPERS (inline to avoid import issues)
// ============================================================================

fn print_i32(x: i32) with IO, Panic {
    if x < 0 {
        print("-")
        print_i32(0 - x)
    } else if x == 0 {
        print("0")
    } else {
        if x >= 10 { print_i32(x / 10) }
        let digit = x - (x / 10) * 10
        if digit == 0 { print("0") }
        if digit == 1 { print("1") }
        if digit == 2 { print("2") }
        if digit == 3 { print("3") }
        if digit == 4 { print("4") }
        if digit == 5 { print("5") }
        if digit == 6 { print("6") }
        if digit == 7 { print("7") }
        if digit == 8 { print("8") }
        if digit == 9 { print("9") }
    }
}

fn print_f64(x: f64, decimals: i32) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x < 0.0 {
        print("-")
        print_f64(0.0 - x, decimals)
    } else {
        let int_part = x as i32
        print_i32(int_part)
        print(".")
        var frac = x - (int_part as f64)
        var d = 0
        while d < decimals {
            frac = frac * 10.0
            let digit = frac as i32
            print_i32(digit)
            frac = frac - (digit as f64)
            d = d + 1
        }
    }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/fractal/kec.sio ===
//! stdlib/fractal/kec.sio
//!
//! KEC Framework: Entropy-Curvature-Coherence Analysis
//!
//! The KEC Framework integrates fractal analysis with biomaterial characterization.

// ============================================================================
// CONSTANTS
// ============================================================================

// Golden ratio
pub const PHI: f64 = 1.6180339887498949
pub const PI: f64 = 3.141592653589793

// ============================================================================
// HELPER FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

fn kec_abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn kec_sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    for _ in 0..10 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y) }
    y
}

fn kec_ln_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return -1000000.0 }
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var v = x
    var k: i64 = 0
    while v > 2.0 { v = v / 2.0; k = k + 1 }
    while v < 1.0 { v = v * 2.0; k = k - 1 }
    let y = v - 1.0
    var result = 0.0
    var power = y
    for i in 1..=15 {
        if i % 2 == 1 { result = result + power / (i as f64) }
        else { result = result - power / (i as f64) }
        power = power * y
    }
    result + (k as f64) * ln2
}

fn kec_min_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }
fn kec_max_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }
fn kec_min_u32(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }

// ============================================================================
// TYPES
// ============================================================================

// KEC analysis parameters
pub struct KECParams {
    pub w_entropy: f64,
    pub w_curvature: f64,
    pub w_coherence: f64,
    pub target_dimension: f64,
    pub target_curvature: f64,
    pub min_r_squared: f64,
    pub entropy_bins: i64,
    pub min_scale: i64,
    pub max_scale: i64,
}

// Create default KEC parameters
pub fn kec_params_default() -> KECParams {
    KECParams {
        w_entropy: 1.0,
        w_curvature: 1.0,
        w_coherence: 1.0,
        target_dimension: PHI,
        target_curvature: 0.0,
        min_r_squared: 0.95,
        entropy_bins: 50,
        min_scale: 2,
        max_scale: 64,
    }
}

// Create bone scaffold parameters
pub fn kec_params_bone() -> KECParams {
    KECParams {
        w_entropy: 1.2,
        w_curvature: 0.8,
        w_coherence: 1.0,
        target_dimension: PHI,
        target_curvature: -0.05,
        min_r_squared: 0.90,
        entropy_bins: 100,
        min_scale: 2,
        max_scale: 128,
    }
}

// Complete KEC metrics for a scaffold
pub struct KECMetrics {
    pub entropy: f64,
    pub entropy_std: f64,
    pub curvature: f64,
    pub curvature_std: f64,
    pub coherence: f64,
    pub coherence_std: f64,
    pub r_squared: f64,
    pub entropy_score: f64,
    pub curvature_score: f64,
    pub coherence_score: f64,
    pub score: f64,
    pub score_std: f64,
    pub valid: bool,
}

// 3D voxel scaffold
pub struct VoxelScaffold {
    pub data: Vec<bool>,
    pub size_x: i64,
    pub size_y: i64,
    pub size_z: i64,
}

// Regression result
struct KECRegressionResult {
    pub slope: f64,
    pub intercept: f64,
    pub r_squared: f64,
    pub var_slope: f64,
}

// ============================================================================
// KEC COMPUTATION
// ============================================================================

// Compute full KEC metrics for a scaffold
pub fn compute_kec(scaffold: &VoxelScaffold, params: &KECParams) -> KECMetrics {
    // =========================================
    // 1. ENTROPY COMPONENT
    // =========================================
    let pore_sizes = extract_pore_sizes(scaffold)

    if pore_sizes.len() < 10 {
        return KECMetrics {
            entropy: 0.0, entropy_std: 1.0,
            curvature: 0.0, curvature_std: 1.0,
            coherence: 0.0, coherence_std: 1.0,
            r_squared: 0.0,
            entropy_score: 0.0, curvature_score: 0.0, coherence_score: 0.0,
            score: 0.0, score_std: 1.0,
            valid: false,
        }
    }

    let entropy_result = compute_shannon_entropy(&pore_sizes, params.entropy_bins)
    let entropy = entropy_result.value
    let entropy_std = entropy_result.std_dev

    let max_entropy = kec_ln_f64(params.entropy_bins as f64)
    let entropy_score_val = if max_entropy > 0.0 {
        kec_min_f64(entropy / max_entropy, 1.0)
    } else {
        0.0
    }

    // =========================================
    // 2. CURVATURE COMPONENT (simplified)
    // =========================================
    let curvature = 0.0  // Would compute from surface mesh
    let curvature_std = 0.1
    let curv_deviation = curvature - params.target_curvature
    let curvature_score_val = 1.0 / (1.0 + curv_deviation * curv_deviation)

    // =========================================
    // 3. COHERENCE COMPONENT (FRACTAL DIMENSION)
    // =========================================
    let fractal_result = compute_box_counting(
        scaffold, params.min_scale, params.max_scale
    )

    let coherence = fractal_result.dimension
    let coherence_std = fractal_result.dimension_std
    let r_squared = fractal_result.r_squared

    if r_squared < params.min_r_squared {
        return KECMetrics {
            entropy: entropy, entropy_std: entropy_std,
            curvature: curvature, curvature_std: curvature_std,
            coherence: coherence, coherence_std: coherence_std,
            r_squared: r_squared,
            entropy_score: entropy_score_val, curvature_score: curvature_score_val, coherence_score: 0.0,
            score: 0.0, score_std: 1.0,
            valid: false,
        }
    }

    let dim_deviation = coherence - params.target_dimension
    let coherence_score_val = 1.0 / (1.0 + dim_deviation * dim_deviation * 4.0)

    // =========================================
    // 4. COMBINED KEC SCORE
    // =========================================
    let total_weight = params.w_entropy + params.w_curvature + params.w_coherence

    let score_val = (
        params.w_entropy * entropy_score_val +
        params.w_curvature * curvature_score_val +
        params.w_coherence * coherence_score_val
    ) / total_weight

    let score_var = (
        params.w_entropy * params.w_entropy * 0.01 +
        params.w_curvature * params.w_curvature * 0.01 +
        params.w_coherence * params.w_coherence * coherence_std * coherence_std
    ) / (total_weight * total_weight)

    KECMetrics {
        entropy: entropy, entropy_std: entropy_std,
        curvature: curvature, curvature_std: curvature_std,
        coherence: coherence, coherence_std: coherence_std,
        r_squared: r_squared,
        entropy_score: entropy_score_val,
        curvature_score: curvature_score_val,
        coherence_score: coherence_score_val,
        score: score_val,
        score_std: kec_sqrt_f64(score_var),
        valid: true,
    }
}

// Check if scaffold is optimal
pub fn kec_is_optimal(metrics: &KECMetrics) -> bool {
    metrics.valid &&
    metrics.score > 0.7 &&
    metrics.entropy_score > 0.5 &&
    metrics.curvature_score > 0.5 &&
    metrics.coherence_score > 0.5
}

// ============================================================================
// ENTROPY COMPUTATION
// ============================================================================

struct KECEntropyResult {
    pub value: f64,
    pub std_dev: f64,
}

fn compute_shannon_entropy(data: &Vec<f64>, bins: i64) -> KECEntropyResult {
    let n = data.len()

    if n == 0 {
        return KECEntropyResult { value: 0.0, std_dev: 0.0 }
    }

    // Find range
    var min_val = data[0]
    var max_val = data[0]
    for i in 1..n {
        min_val = kec_min_f64(min_val, data[i])
        max_val = kec_max_f64(max_val, data[i])
    }

    if max_val == min_val {
        return KECEntropyResult { value: 0.0, std_dev: 0.0 }
    }

    // Build histogram
    var counts: Vec<i64> = vec![]
    for _ in 0..bins { counts.push(0) }

    let bin_width = (max_val - min_val) / (bins as f64)
    for i in 0..n {
        var bin = ((data[i] - min_val) / bin_width) as i64
        if bin >= bins as i64 { bin = (bins - 1) as i64 }
        counts[bin] = counts[bin] + 1
    }

    // Compute entropy
    var entropy = 0.0
    var non_zero = 0
    for i in 0..bins as i64 {
        if counts[i] > 0 {
            let p = (counts[i] as f64) / (n as f64)
            entropy = entropy - p * kec_ln_f64(p)
            non_zero = non_zero + 1
        }
    }

    // Miller-Madow bias correction
    let bias = ((non_zero - 1) as f64) / (2.0 * (n as f64))
    entropy = entropy + bias

    // Variance estimate
    var sum_p_log2 = 0.0
    for i in 0..bins as i64 {
        if counts[i] > 0 {
            let p = (counts[i] as f64) / (n as f64)
            let log_p = kec_ln_f64(p)
            sum_p_log2 = sum_p_log2 + p * log_p * log_p
        }
    }
    let var_term = sum_p_log2 - entropy * entropy
    let sample_var = if var_term > 0.0 { var_term / (n as f64) } else { 0.0 }

    KECEntropyResult {
        value: entropy,
        std_dev: kec_sqrt_f64(sample_var),
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// FRACTAL DIMENSION
// ============================================================================

struct FractalResult {
    pub dimension: f64,
    pub dimension_std: f64,
    pub r_squared: f64,
}

fn compute_box_counting(
    scaffold: &VoxelScaffold,
    min_scale: i64,
    max_scale: i64,
) -> FractalResult {
    let nx = scaffold.size_x
    let ny = scaffold.size_y
    let nz = scaffold.size_z

    // Generate scales
    var scales: Vec<i64> = vec![]
    var r = min_scale
    let min_dim = kec_min_u32(kec_min_u32(nx, ny), nz)
    while r <= max_scale && r <= min_dim {
        scales.push(r)
        r = r * 2
    }

    if scales.len() < 2 {
        return FractalResult { dimension: 0.0, dimension_std: 1.0, r_squared: 0.0 }
    }

    var log_inv_scales: Vec<f64> = vec![]
    var log_counts: Vec<f64> = vec![]

    for i in 0..scales.len() {
        let scale = scales[i]
        let count = count_boxes_3d(scaffold, scale)

        if count > 0 {
            log_inv_scales.push(kec_ln_f64(1.0 / (scale as f64)))
            log_counts.push(kec_ln_f64(count as f64))
        }
    }

    let reg = kec_linear_regression(&log_inv_scales, &log_counts)

    FractalResult {
        dimension: reg.slope,
        dimension_std: kec_sqrt_f64(reg.var_slope),
        r_squared: reg.r_squared,
    }
}

fn count_boxes_3d(scaffold: &VoxelScaffold, scale: i64) -> i64 {
    let nx = scaffold.size_x
    let ny = scaffold.size_y
    let nz = scaffold.size_z

    var count: i64 = 0
    let bx_max = (nx + scale - 1) / scale
    let by_max = (ny + scale - 1) / scale
    let bz_max = (nz + scale - 1) / scale

    for bx in 0..bx_max {
        for by in 0..by_max {
            for bz in 0..bz_max {
                var found = false
                for dx in 0..scale {
                    if found { break }
                    for dy in 0..scale {
                        if found { break }
                        for dz in 0..scale {
                            let x = bx * scale + dx
                            let y = by * scale + dy
                            let z = bz * scale + dz

                            if x < nx && y < ny && z < nz {
                                let idx = ((z as i64) * (ny as i64) + (y as i64)) * (nx as i64) + (x as i64)
                                if idx < scaffold.data.len() && scaffold.data[idx] {
                                    found = true
                                    break
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if found { count = count + 1 }
            }
        }
    }

    count
}

fn kec_linear_regression(x: &Vec<f64>, y: &Vec<f64>) -> KECRegressionResult {
    let n = x.len()
    if n < 2 {
        return KECRegressionResult { slope: 0.0, intercept: 0.0, r_squared: 0.0, var_slope: 1.0 }
    }

    var sum_x = 0.0
    var sum_y = 0.0
    var sum_xy = 0.0
    var sum_x2 = 0.0
    var sum_y2 = 0.0

    for i in 0..n {
        sum_x = sum_x + x[i]
        sum_y = sum_y + y[i]
        sum_xy = sum_xy + x[i] * y[i]
        sum_x2 = sum_x2 + x[i] * x[i]
        sum_y2 = sum_y2 + y[i] * y[i]
    }

    let nf = n as f64
    let denom = nf * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x

    if kec_abs_f64(denom) < 1e-10 {
        return KECRegressionResult { slope: 0.0, intercept: sum_y / nf, r_squared: 0.0, var_slope: 1.0 }
    }

    let slope = (nf * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / denom
    let intercept = (sum_y - slope * sum_x) / nf

    let ss_tot = sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y / nf
    var ss_res = 0.0
    for i in 0..n {
        let pred = intercept + slope * x[i]
        let residual = y[i] - pred
        ss_res = ss_res + residual * residual
    }
    let r_sq = if ss_tot > 0.0 { 1.0 - ss_res / ss_tot } else { 0.0 }

    let mse = if n > 2 { ss_res / (nf - 2.0) } else { ss_res }
    let var_slope = if denom > 0.0 { mse * nf / denom } else { 1.0 }

    KECRegressionResult {
        slope: slope,
        intercept: intercept,
        r_squared: r_sq,
        var_slope: var_slope,
    }
}
