// Helper: map f64 data to pixel coordinates (same convention as plot::plot_line_raster).
fn map_data_to_pixel_x(x: f64, xmin: f64, x_range: f64, margin: i64, plot_w: i64) -> i64 {
    let xf = if x_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (x - xmin) / x_range }
    margin + (xf * (plot_w as f64)) as i64
}

fn map_data_to_pixel_y(y: f64, ymin: f64, y_range: f64, height: i64, margin: i64, plot_h: i64) -> i64 {
    let yf = if y_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (y - ymin) / y_range }
    height - margin - 1 - (yf * (plot_h as f64)) as i64
}

pub fn plot_errorbar_vertical_png(
    xs: &[f64; 256], ys: &[f64; 256], errs: &[f64; 256], n: i64,
    width: i64, height: i64, filename: string
) -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    if n <= 0 { return false }
    var s = surface_new(width, height)
    s = surface_clear(s, color_white())

    var xmin = xs[0]
    var xmax = xs[0]
    var ymin = ys[0]
    var ymax = ys[0]
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < n {
        if xs[i] < xmin { xmin = xs[i] }
        if xs[i] > xmax { xmax = xs[i] }
        if ys[i] < ymin { ymin = ys[i] }
        if ys[i] > ymax { ymax = ys[i] }
        i = i + 1
    }

    let x_range = xmax - xmin
    let y_range = ymax - ymin
    let margin = 20
    let plot_w = width - margin * 2
    let plot_h = height - margin * 2

    let config = errorbar_config_default()
    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < n && j < 256 {
        let px = map_data_to_pixel_x(xs[j], xmin, x_range, margin, plot_w)
        let py = map_data_to_pixel_y(ys[j], ymin, y_range, height, margin, plot_h)
        var err_px: i64 = 0
        if y_range != 0.0 {
            err_px = ((errs[j] * (plot_h as f64)) / y_range) as i64
        }
        if err_px < 0 { err_px = 0 - err_px }
        s = draw_errorbar_vertical_raster(s, px, py, err_px, config)
        j = j + 1
    }
    png_encode_surface(&s, filename)
}

// === FILE: stdlib/graphics/filter.sio ===
// Graphics Filter — Image processing kernels (blur, sharpen, edge detection)
//
// Convolution-based filters for Surface and TiledSurface.
// All filters use direct array writes for performance.

use graphics::drawing::{Color}
use graphics::surface::{Surface, surface_new}
use graphics::tile::{TiledSurface, tiled_surface_new, tiled_clear}

// ============================================================================
// BOX BLUR
// ============================================================================

// 3×3 box blur kernel (all ones, divide by 9).
pub fn blur_box_raster(s: Surface, radius: i64) -> Surface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var out = s
    if radius <= 0 { return out }
    let w = out.width
    let h = out.height
    if w <= 0 || h <= 0 { return out }

    // Temporary output surface
    var tmp = surface_new(w, h)

    var y: i64 = 0
    while y < h {
        var x: i64 = 0
        while x < w {
            var sum_r: i64 = 0
            var sum_g: i64 = 0
            var sum_b: i64 = 0
            var count: i64 = 0

            var dy = 0 - radius
            while dy <= radius {
                var dx = 0 - radius
                while dx <= radius {
                    let sx = x + dx
                    let sy = y + dy
                    if sx >= 0 && sx < w && sy >= 0 && sy < h {
                        let idx = sy * w + sx
                        sum_r = sum_r + out.r[idx]
                        sum_g = sum_g + out.g[idx]
                        sum_b = sum_b + out.b[idx]
                        count = count + 1
                    }
                    dx = dx + 1
                }
                dy = dy + 1
            }

            let idx = y * w + x
            if count > 0 {
                tmp.r[idx] = sum_r / count
                tmp.g[idx] = sum_g / count
                tmp.b[idx] = sum_b / count
            } else {
                tmp.r[idx] = out.r[idx]
                tmp.g[idx] = out.g[idx]
                tmp.b[idx] = out.b[idx]
            }
            tmp.a[idx] = out.a[idx]
            x = x + 1
        }
        y = y + 1
    }

    // Copy tmp back to out
    var cy: i64 = 0
    while cy < h {
        var cx: i64 = 0
        while cx < w {
            let idx = cy * w + cx
            out.r[idx] = tmp.r[idx]
            out.g[idx] = tmp.g[idx]
            out.b[idx] = tmp.b[idx]
            out.a[idx] = tmp.a[idx]
            cx = cx + 1
        }
        cy = cy + 1
    }
    out
}

// ============================================================================
// GAUSSIAN BLUR (3×3)
// ============================================================================

// 3×3 Gaussian kernel: [1,2,1; 2,4,2; 1,2,1] / 16
pub fn blur_gaussian3_raster(s: Surface) -> Surface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var out = s
    let w = out.width
    let h = out.height
    if w <= 0 || h <= 0 { return out }

    var tmp = surface_new(w, h)

    var y: i64 = 1
    while y < h - 1 {
        var x: i64 = 1
        while x < w - 1 {
            var sum_r: i64 = 0
            var sum_g: i64 = 0
            var sum_b: i64 = 0

            // Row -1
            let idx1 = (y - 1) * w + (x - 1)
            let idx2 = (y - 1) * w + x
            let idx3 = (y - 1) * w + (x + 1)
            sum_r = sum_r + out.r[idx1] + 2 * out.r[idx2] + out.r[idx3]
            sum_g = sum_g + out.g[idx1] + 2 * out.g[idx2] + out.g[idx3]
            sum_b = sum_b + out.b[idx1] + 2 * out.b[idx2] + out.b[idx3]

            // Row 0
            let idx4 = y * w + (x - 1)
            let idx5 = y * w + x
            let idx6 = y * w + (x + 1)
            sum_r = sum_r + 2 * out.r[idx4] + 4 * out.r[idx5] + 2 * out.r[idx6]
            sum_g = sum_g + 2 * out.g[idx4] + 4 * out.g[idx5] + 2 * out.g[idx6]
            sum_b = sum_b + 2 * out.b[idx4] + 4 * out.b[idx5] + 2 * out.b[idx6]

            // Row +1
            let idx7 = (y + 1) * w + (x - 1)
            let idx8 = (y + 1) * w + x
            let idx9 = (y + 1) * w + (x + 1)
            sum_r = sum_r + out.r[idx7] + 2 * out.r[idx8] + out.r[idx9]
            sum_g = sum_g + out.g[idx7] + 2 * out.g[idx8] + out.g[idx9]
            sum_b = sum_b + out.b[idx7] + 2 * out.b[idx8] + out.b[idx9]

            let idx = y * w + x
            tmp.r[idx] = sum_r / 16
            tmp.g[idx] = sum_g / 16
            tmp.b[idx] = sum_b / 16
            tmp.a[idx] = out.a[idx]
            x = x + 1
        }
        y = y + 1
    }

    // Copy tmp back
    var cy: i64 = 0
    while cy < h {
        var cx: i64 = 0
        while cx < w {
            let idx = cy * w + cx
            out.r[idx] = tmp.r[idx]
            out.g[idx] = tmp.g[idx]
            out.b[idx] = tmp.b[idx]
            out.a[idx] = tmp.a[idx]
            cx = cx + 1
        }
        cy = cy + 1
    }
    out
}

// ============================================================================
// SHARPEN
// ============================================================================

// 3×3 sharpen kernel: [0,-1,0; -1,5,-1; 0,-1,0]
pub fn sharpen_raster(s: Surface) -> Surface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var out = s
    let w = out.width
    let h = out.height
    if w <= 0 || h <= 0 { return out }

    var tmp = surface_new(w, h)

    var y: i64 = 1
    while y < h - 1 {
        var x: i64 = 1
        while x < w - 1 {
            let idx = y * w + x
            let idx_n = (y - 1) * w + x
            let idx_s = (y + 1) * w + x
            let idx_w = y * w + (x - 1)
            let idx_e = y * w + (x + 1)

            var r = 5 * out.r[idx] - out.r[idx_n] - out.r[idx_s] - out.r[idx_w] - out.r[idx_e]
            var g = 5 * out.g[idx] - out.g[idx_n] - out.g[idx_s] - out.g[idx_w] - out.g[idx_e]
            var b = 5 * out.b[idx] - out.b[idx_n] - out.b[idx_s] - out.b[idx_w] - out.b[idx_e]

            if r < 0 { r = 0 } else if r > 255 { r = 255 }
            if g < 0 { g = 0 } else if g > 255 { g = 255 }
            if b < 0 { b = 0 } else if b > 255 { b = 255 }

            tmp.r[idx] = r
            tmp.g[idx] = g
            tmp.b[idx] = b
            tmp.a[idx] = out.a[idx]
            x = x + 1
        }
        y = y + 1
    }

    // Copy tmp back
    var cy: i64 = 0
    while cy < h {
        var cx: i64 = 0
        while cx < w {
            let idx = cy * w + cx
            out.r[idx] = tmp.r[idx]
            out.g[idx] = tmp.g[idx]
            out.b[idx] = tmp.b[idx]
            out.a[idx] = tmp.a[idx]
            cx = cx + 1
        }
        cy = cy + 1
    }
    out
}

// ============================================================================
// SOBEL EDGE DETECTION
// ============================================================================

// Sobel X kernel: [-1,0,1; -2,0,2; -1,0,1]
// Sobel Y kernel: [-1,-2,-1; 0,0,0; 1,2,1]
// Output: grayscale magnitude clamped to 0..255
pub fn edge_sobel_raster(s: Surface) -> Surface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var out = s
    let w = out.width
    let h = out.height
    if w <= 0 || h <= 0 { return out }

    var tmp = surface_new(w, h)

    var y: i64 = 1
    while y < h - 1 {
        var x: i64 = 1
        while x < w - 1 {
            // Sobel X
            let idx_nw = (y - 1) * w + (x - 1)
            let idx_n = (y - 1) * w + x
            let idx_ne = (y - 1) * w + (x + 1)
            let idx_w = y * w + (x - 1)
            let idx_e = y * w + (x + 1)
            let idx_sw = (y + 1) * w + (x - 1)
            let idx_s = (y + 1) * w + x
            let idx_se = (y + 1) * w + (x + 1)

            // Compute grayscale values for neighbors
            let nw = out.r[idx_nw] + out.g[idx_nw] + out.b[idx_nw]
            let n = out.r[idx_n] + out.g[idx_n] + out.b[idx_n]
            let ne = out.r[idx_ne] + out.g[idx_ne] + out.b[idx_ne]
            let ww = out.r[idx_w] + out.g[idx_w] + out.b[idx_w]
            let ee = out.r[idx_e] + out.g[idx_e] + out.b[idx_e]
            let sw = out.r[idx_sw] + out.g[idx_sw] + out.b[idx_sw]
            let s = out.r[idx_s] + out.g[idx_s] + out.b[idx_s]
            let se = out.r[idx_se] + out.g[idx_se] + out.b[idx_se]

            let gx = (ne + 2 * ee + se) - (nw + 2 * ww + sw)
            let gy = (sw + 2 * s + se) - (nw + 2 * n + ne)

            var mag = gx
            if gx < 0 { mag = 0 - gx }
            var magy = gy
            if gy < 0 { magy = 0 - gy }
            mag = mag + magy
            mag = mag / 3  // scale down since we summed 3 channels
            if mag > 255 { mag = 255 }

            let idx = y * w + x
            tmp.r[idx] = mag
            tmp.g[idx] = mag
            tmp.b[idx] = mag
            tmp.a[idx] = 255
            x = x + 1
        }
        y = y + 1
    }

    // Copy tmp back
    var cy: i64 = 0
    while cy < h {
        var cx: i64 = 0
        while cx < w {
            let idx = cy * w + cx
            out.r[idx] = tmp.r[idx]
            out.g[idx] = tmp.g[idx]
            out.b[idx] = tmp.b[idx]
            out.a[idx] = tmp.a[idx]
            cx = cx + 1
        }
        cy = cy + 1
    }
    out
}

// Apply a filter to each tile independently.
// For box blur, radius is clamped to tile dimensions.
pub fn tiled_blur_box_raster(ts: TiledSurface, radius: i64) -> TiledSurface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var out = ts
    if radius <= 0 { return out }

    let n = out.tiles_wide * out.tiles_high
    if n > 0 { out.tile0 = blur_box_raster(out.tile0, radius) }
    if n > 1 { out.tile1 = blur_box_raster(out.tile1, radius) }
    if n > 2 { out.tile2 = blur_box_raster(out.tile2, radius) }
    if n > 3 { out.tile3 = blur_box_raster(out.tile3, radius) }
    if n > 4 { out.tile4 = blur_box_raster(out.tile4, radius) }
    if n > 5 { out.tile5 = blur_box_raster(out.tile5, radius) }
    if n > 6 { out.tile6 = blur_box_raster(out.tile6, radius) }
    if n > 7 { out.tile7 = blur_box_raster(out.tile7, radius) }
    if n > 8 { out.tile8 = blur_box_raster(out.tile8, radius) }
    out
}

pub fn tiled_blur_gaussian3_raster(ts: TiledSurface) -> TiledSurface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var out = ts

    if n > 3 { out.tile3 = blur_gaussian3_raster(out.tile3) }
    if n > 4 { out.tile4 = blur_gaussian3_raster(out.tile4) }

pub fn tiled_sharpen_raster(ts: TiledSurface) -> TiledSurface with Mut, Panic, Div {

// === FILE: stdlib/graphics/grid.sio ===
// Graphics Grid — Evenly spaced horizontal/vertical grid lines behind plot data.

use graphics::drawing::{Color}
use graphics::surface::{Surface}
use graphics::tile::{TiledSurface, tiled_draw_line}

pub struct GridConfig {
    pub margin: i64,
    pub grid_color: Color,
    pub n_x_ticks: i64,
    pub n_y_ticks: i64,
}

pub fn grid_config_default() -> GridConfig {
    GridConfig {
        margin: 20,
        grid_color: Color { r: 200, g: 200, b: 200, a: 255 },
        n_x_ticks: 5,
        n_y_ticks: 5,
    }
}

// Helper: draw a vertical line with direct pixel writes (no by-value copies per pixel).
fn draw_vline_direct(s: Surface, x: i64, y0: i64, y1: i64, c: Color) -> Surface with Mut, Panic {
    var out = s
    if x < 0 || x >= out.width { return out }
    var y = y0
    var y_end = y1
    if y0 > y1 { y = y1; y_end = y0 }
    if y < 0 { y = 0 }
    if y_end >= out.height { y_end = out.height - 1 }
    while y <= y_end {
        let idx = y * out.width + x
        out.r[idx] = c.r
        out.g[idx] = c.g
        out.b[idx] = c.b
        out.a[idx] = c.a
        y = y + 1
    }
    out
}

// Helper: draw a horizontal line with direct pixel writes (no by-value copies per pixel).
fn draw_hline_direct(s: Surface, x0: i64, x1: i64, y: i64, c: Color) -> Surface with Mut, Panic {
    var out = s
    if y < 0 || y >= out.height { return out }
    var x = x0
    var x_end = x1
    if x0 > x1 { x = x1; x_end = x0 }
    if x < 0 { x = 0 }
    if x_end >= out.width { x_end = out.width - 1 }
    while x <= x_end {
        let idx = y * out.width + x
        out.r[idx] = c.r
        out.g[idx] = c.g
        out.b[idx] = c.b
        out.a[idx] = c.a
        x = x + 1
    }
    out
}

// Draw evenly spaced grid lines on a Surface.
pub fn draw_grid_raster(s: Surface, config: GridConfig) -> Surface with Mut, Panic {
    var out = s
    let inner_w = out.width - 2 * config.margin
    let inner_h = out.height - 2 * config.margin

    if config.n_x_ticks > 1 && inner_w > 0 {
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < config.n_x_ticks {
            let x = config.margin + (i * inner_w) / (config.n_x_ticks - 1)
            out = draw_vline_direct(out, x, config.margin, out.height - config.margin, config.grid_color)
            i = i + 1
        }
    }

    if config.n_y_ticks > 1 && inner_h > 0 {
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < config.n_y_ticks {
            let y = config.margin + (i * inner_h) / (config.n_y_ticks - 1)
            out = draw_hline_direct(out, config.margin, out.width - config.margin, y, config.grid_color)
            i = i + 1
        }
    }

    out
}

// Draw evenly spaced grid lines on a TiledSurface.
pub fn tiled_draw_grid(ts: TiledSurface, config: GridConfig) -> TiledSurface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var out = ts
    let inner_w = out.width - 2 * config.margin
    let inner_h = out.height - 2 * config.margin

    if config.n_x_ticks > 1 && inner_w > 0 {
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < config.n_x_ticks {
            let x = config.margin + (i * inner_w) / (config.n_x_ticks - 1)
            out = tiled_draw_line(out, x, config.margin, x, out.height - config.margin, config.grid_color)
            i = i + 1
        }
    }

    if config.n_y_ticks > 1 && inner_h > 0 {
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < config.n_y_ticks {
            let y = config.margin + (i * inner_h) / (config.n_y_ticks - 1)
            out = tiled_draw_line(out, config.margin, y, out.width - config.margin, y, config.grid_color)
            i = i + 1
        }
    }

    out
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO { 0 }


// === FILE: stdlib/graphics/heatmap.sio ===
// Graphics Heatmap — Raster heatmaps
//
// Pixel-based heatmap rendering onto a Surface.
// Counterpart to plot::heatmap (terminal-based).

use graphics::drawing::{Color}
use graphics::surface::{Surface, surface_draw_rect}

pub struct HeatmapConfig {
    pub width: i64,
    pub height: i64,
    pub margin: i64,
    pub bg_color: Color,
    pub axis_color: Color,
}

pub fn heatmap_config_default() -> HeatmapConfig {
    HeatmapConfig {
        width: 256,
        height: 256,
        margin: 20,
        bg_color: Color { r: 255, g: 255, b: 255, a: 255 },
        axis_color: Color { r: 0, g: 0, b: 0, a: 255 },
    }
}

// Draw a heatmap from a row-major data array.
// data: up to 4096 values (64×64 max for the cell grid)
// rows, cols: dimensions of the data grid
// Returns the updated surface.
pub fn plot_heatmap_raster(
    s: Surface,
    data: &[f64; 4096],
    rows: i64,
    cols: i64,
    config: HeatmapConfig
) -> Surface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if rows <= 0 || cols <= 0 { return s }

    var out = s

    // Find data range
    var min_val = data[0]
    var max_val = data[0]
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < rows * cols {
        if data[i] < min_val { min_val = data[i] }
        if data[i] > max_val { max_val = data[i] }
        i = i + 1
    }
    let range = max_val - min_val

    let plot_w = out.width - config.margin * 2
    let plot_h = out.height - config.margin * 2
    let cell_w = plot_w / cols
    let cell_h = plot_h / rows
    if cell_w <= 0 { return s }
    if cell_h <= 0 { return s }

    // Clear background
    out = surface_draw_rect(out, 0, 0, out.width, out.height, config.bg_color)

    // Draw axes
    out = surface_draw_rect(out, config.margin, config.margin, 1, plot_h, config.axis_color)
    out = surface_draw_rect(out, config.margin, out.height - config.margin - 1, plot_w, 1, config.axis_color)

    // Draw cells
    var r: i64 = 0
    while r < rows {
        var c: i64 = 0
        while c < cols {
            let idx = r * cols + c
            let normalized = if range == 0.0 { 0.5 } else { (data[idx] - min_val) / range }
            let cell_color = heatmap_color(normalized)
            let px = config.margin + c * cell_w
            let py = out.height - config.margin - 1 - (r + 1) * cell_h
            out = surface_draw_rect(out, px, py, cell_w, cell_h, cell_color)
            c = c + 1
        }
        r = r + 1
    }
    out
}

// Map normalized value [0.0, 1.0] to a color (blue -> cyan -> yellow -> red)
pub fn heatmap_color(t: f64) -> Color {
    let nt = if t < 0.0 { 0.0 } else if t > 1.0 { 1.0 } else { t }
    if nt < 0.25 {
        // blue -> cyan
        let local = nt / 0.25
        Color { r: 0, g: (local * 255.0) as i64, b: 255, a: 255 }
    } else if nt < 0.5 {
        // cyan -> green
        let local = (nt - 0.25) / 0.25
        Color { r: 0, g: 255, b: 255 - (local * 255.0) as i64, a: 255 }
    } else if nt < 0.75 {
        // green -> yellow
        let local = (nt - 0.5) / 0.25
        Color { r: (local * 255.0) as i64, g: 255, b: 0, a: 255 }
    } else {
        // yellow -> red
        let local = (nt - 0.75) / 0.25
        Color { r: 255, g: 255 - (local * 255.0) as i64, b: 0, a: 255 }
    }
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO { 0 }


// === FILE: stdlib/graphics/histogram.sio ===
// Graphics Histogram — Raster histogram rendering
//
// Histograms for Surface and TiledSurface with PNG export.

use graphics::drawing::{Color, color_white}
use graphics::surface::{Surface, surface_new, surface_clear, surface_draw_rect}
use graphics::tile::{TiledSurface, tiled_surface_new, tiled_clear, tiled_draw_rect, tiled_export_png}
use graphics::png::{png_encode_surface}

pub struct HistogramConfig {
    pub margin: i64,
    pub bar_color: Color,
    pub bg_color: Color,
    pub axis_color: Color,
    pub bins: i64,
}

pub fn histogram_config_default() -> HistogramConfig {
    HistogramConfig {
        margin: 20,
        bar_color: Color { r: 0, g: 150, b: 100, a: 255 },
        bg_color: Color { r: 255, g: 255, b: 255, a: 255 },
        axis_color: Color { r: 0, g: 0, b: 0, a: 255 },
        bins: 10,
    }
}

pub fn plot_histogram_raster(s: Surface, values: &[f64; 256], n: i64, config: HistogramConfig) -> Surface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if n <= 0 || config.bins <= 0 { return s }

    var out = s

    var vmin = values[0]
    var vmax = values[0]
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < n {
        if values[i] < vmin { vmin = values[i] }
        if values[i] > vmax { vmax = values[i] }
        i = i + 1
    }

    let plot_w = out.width - config.margin * 2
    let plot_h = out.height - config.margin * 2

    out = surface_clear(out, config.bg_color)

    out = surface_draw_rect(out, config.margin, config.margin, 1, plot_h, config.axis_color)
    out = surface_draw_rect(out, config.margin, out.height - config.margin - 1, plot_w, 1, config.axis_color)

    var bins = config.bins
    if bins > 32 { bins = 32 }

    var counts: [i64; 32] = [0; 32]
    let vrange = vmax - vmin

    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < n {
        let v = values[j]
        var idx: i64 = 0
        if vrange == 0.0 {
            idx = 0
        } else {
            idx = ((v - vmin) / vrange * (bins as f64)) as i64
            if idx < 0 { idx = 0 }
            if idx >= bins { idx = bins - 1 }
        }
        counts[idx] = counts[idx] + 1
        j = j + 1
    }

    var max_count: i64 = 0
    var k: i64 = 0
    while k < bins {
        if counts[k] > max_count { max_count = counts[k] }
        k = k + 1
    }

    let bar_width = plot_w / bins
    if bar_width <= 0 { return out }

    var b: i64 = 0
    while b < bins {
        let count = counts[b]
        let bar_h = if max_count == 0 { 0 } else { (count * plot_h) / max_count }
        let x = config.margin + b * bar_width
        let y = out.height - config.margin - 1 - bar_h
        out = surface_draw_rect(out, x, y, bar_width, bar_h, config.bar_color)
        b = b + 1
    }

    out
}

pub fn tiled_plot_histogram_raster(ts: TiledSurface, values: &[f64; 256], n: i64, config: HistogramConfig) -> TiledSurface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if n <= 0 || config.bins <= 0 { return ts }

    var out = ts

    var vmin = values[0]
    var vmax = values[0]
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < n {
        if values[i] < vmin { vmin = values[i] }
        if values[i] > vmax { vmax = values[i] }
        i = i + 1
    }

    let plot_w = out.width - config.margin * 2
    let plot_h = out.height - config.margin * 2

    out = tiled_clear(out, config.bg_color)

    out = tiled_draw_rect(out, config.margin, config.margin, 1, plot_h, config.axis_color)
    out = tiled_draw_rect(out, config.margin, out.height - config.margin - 1, plot_w, 1, config.axis_color)

    var bins = config.bins
    if bins > 32 { bins = 32 }

    var counts: [i64; 32] = [0; 32]
    let vrange = vmax - vmin

    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < n {
        let v = values[j]
        var idx: i64 = 0
        if vrange == 0.0 {
            idx = 0
        } else {
            idx = ((v - vmin) / vrange * (bins as f64)) as i64
            if idx < 0 { idx = 0 }
            if idx >= bins { idx = bins - 1 }
        }
        counts[idx] = counts[idx] + 1
        j = j + 1
    }

    var max_count: i64 = 0
    var k: i64 = 0
    while k < bins {
        if counts[k] > max_count { max_count = counts[k] }
        k = k + 1
    }

    let bar_width = plot_w / bins
    if bar_width <= 0 { return out }

    var b: i64 = 0
    while b < bins {
        let count = counts[b]
        let bar_h = if max_count == 0 { 0 } else { (count * plot_h) / max_count }
        let x = config.margin + b * bar_width
        let y = out.height - config.margin - 1 - bar_h
        out = tiled_draw_rect(out, x, y, bar_width, bar_h, config.bar_color)
        b = b + 1
    }

    out
}

pub fn plot_histogram_png(values: &[f64; 256], n: i64, width: i64, height: i64, filename: string) -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var s = surface_new(width, height)
    s = surface_clear(s, color_white())
    let config = histogram_config_default()
    s = plot_histogram_raster(s, values, n, config)
    png_encode_surface(&s, filename)
}

pub fn tiled_plot_histogram_png(values: &[f64; 256], n: i64, width: i64, height: i64, filename: string) -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var ts = tiled_surface_new(width, height, 256, 256)
    ts = tiled_clear(ts, color_white())
    let config = histogram_config_default()
    ts = tiled_plot_histogram_raster(ts, values, n, config)
    tiled_export_png(&ts, filename)
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO { 0 }


// === FILE: stdlib/graphics/lib.sio ===
/// graphics — Native Graphics Library for Sounio
///
/// Pixel-based drawing and scientific plotting without external dependencies.
///
/// ## Modules
///
/// - `drawing` — Core primitives: Point2D, Color, Rect
/// - `surface` — RGBA pixel surface with line and rect drawing
/// - `export` — PPM output (pure Sounio), PNG stub (pending FFI)
/// - `plot` — Raster line plots with auto-scaling
/// - `scatter` — Raster scatter plots with cross markers
/// - `heatmap` — Raster heatmaps with color interpolation
/// - `quality` — Publication-oriented scientific raster plots: antialiased line/heatmap/contour, uncertainty bands, markers, error bars, histogram, ECDF, boxplot, violin density
/// - `epistemic` — Confidence bands, decay curves, and advanced epistemic visualization primitives (pure Sounio)
/// - `svg` — Vector export bridge (SVG markup to stdout)
/// - `tile` — TiledSurface for resolutions beyond 256×256
/// - `view` — Terminal image viewer (`show`, `render_surface`, `show_tiled`) using Unicode half-blocks + truecolor. Perfect for rapid iteration on epistemic figures.
///
/// ## Known Limitation
///
/// Due to a compiler bug with mutable references to structs containing large
/// arrays, write operations on `Surface` take and return the surface by value
/// rather than using `&!Surface`. This is a pragmatic workaround documented in
/// the implementation; it will be reverted once the codegen fix lands.
///
/// ## Design
///
/// This is the Phase 1 scaffold per `docs/design/native_graphics_library.md`.
/// The current implementation is stitched across the design/scaffold/quality lanes:
/// Grok owns the architecture brief, the scaffold lane materialized the base
/// graphics modules, and the quality lane adds SOTA scientific plot primitives.
/// All 5 moves for "best everything" epistemic visualization completed in parallel:
/// 1. Full glyph variety (shapes + uncertainty rings)
/// 2. ProvenanceLegend (SVG + helpers)
/// 3. Placement helpers
/// 4. TiledSurface integration (via view + primitives)
/// 5. EpistemicCurveFigure builder skeleton
/// Plus real terminal image viewer (graphics::view) so you can actually see the graphs inside Sounio.
///
/// ## Quick Start
///
/// ```sio
/// use graphics::surface::{Surface, surface_new, surface_clear, surface_draw_line}
/// use graphics::drawing::{color_black, color_white, color_red}
/// use graphics::export::export_ppm
///

// === FILE: stdlib/graphics/multi_series.sio ===
// Graphics Multi-Series — Multiple data series with auto-legend

use graphics::drawing::{Color, color_white, color_black}
use graphics::surface::{Surface, surface_new, surface_draw_line, surface_draw_rect}
use graphics::tile::{TiledSurface, tiled_surface_new, tiled_clear, tiled_draw_line, tiled_draw_rect}
use graphics::text::{draw_text_raster, tiled_draw_text}
use graphics::png::{png_encode_surface}

pub struct SeriesConfig {
    pub label: string,
    pub color: Color,
    pub marker_size: i64,
    pub line_width: i64,
    pub show_line: bool,
    pub show_scatter: bool,
}

pub struct MultiSeriesConfig {
    pub width: i64,
    pub height: i64,
    pub margin: i64,
    pub bg_color: Color,
    pub axis_color: Color,
    pub legend_bg: Color,
    pub legend_border: Color,
    pub show_legend: bool,
    pub legend_x: i64,
    pub legend_y: i64,
}

pub fn multi_series_config_default() -> MultiSeriesConfig {
    MultiSeriesConfig {
        width: 400,
        height: 300,
        margin: 40,
        bg_color: color_white(),
        axis_color: color_black(),
        legend_bg: Color { r: 240, g: 240, b: 240, a: 255 },
        legend_border: Color { r: 150, g: 150, b: 150, a: 255 },
        show_legend: true,
        legend_x: 0 - 1,
        legend_y: 10,
    }
}

pub fn series_config_default(label: string, color: Color) -> SeriesConfig {
    SeriesConfig {
        label: label,
        color: color,
        marker_size: 3,
        line_width: 1,
        show_line: true,
        show_scatter: false,
    }
}

// Convert string to [i64; 64] for draw_text_raster.
fn string_to_text_array(s: string) -> [i64; 64] with Mut {
    var arr: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 64 {
        let ch = str_char_at(s, i)
        if ch < 0 { return arr }
        arr[i] = ch
        i = i + 1
    }
    arr
}

pub struct Bounds {
    pub xmin: f64,
    pub xmax: f64,
    pub ymin: f64,
    pub ymax: f64,
}

// Compute global bounds across all series.
fn compute_global_bounds(xs: &[f64; 256], yss: &[f64; 2048], ns: &[i64; 8], series_count: i64) -> Bounds with Mut {
    var b = Bounds { xmin: xs[0], xmax: xs[0], ymin: yss[0], ymax: yss[0] }

    var si: i64 = 0
    while si < series_count && si < 8 {
        let n = ns[si]
        let base = si * 256
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < n && i < 256 {
            if xs[i] < b.xmin { b.xmin = xs[i] }
            if xs[i] > b.xmax { b.xmax = xs[i] }
            let y = yss[base + i]
            if y < b.ymin { b.ymin = y }
            if y > b.ymax { b.ymax = y }
            i = i + 1
        }
        si = si + 1
    }
    b
}

// Draw legend box on surface.
fn draw_legend(s: Surface, series_configs: &[SeriesConfig; 8], series_count: i64, config: MultiSeriesConfig) -> Surface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var out = s
    if !config.show_legend || series_count <= 0 { return out }

    let entry_h = 12
    let legend_w = 100
    let legend_h = 8 + series_count * entry_h
    var lx = config.legend_x
    var ly = config.legend_y
    if lx < 0 {
        lx = out.width - legend_w - 10
    }
    if ly < 0 { ly = 10 }
    if lx + legend_w > out.width { lx = out.width - legend_w - 1 }
    if ly + legend_h > out.height { ly = out.height - legend_h - 1 }

    // Background
    out = surface_draw_rect(out, lx, ly, legend_w, legend_h, config.legend_bg)
    // Border
    var bx: i64 = lx
    while bx < lx + legend_w {
        if bx >= 0 && bx < out.width {
            if ly >= 0 && ly < out.height {
                let idx = ly * out.width + bx
                out.r[idx] = config.legend_border.r
                out.g[idx] = config.legend_border.g
                out.b[idx] = config.legend_border.b
                out.a[idx] = config.legend_border.a
            }
            if ly + legend_h - 1 >= 0 && ly + legend_h - 1 < out.height {
                let idx = (ly + legend_h - 1) * out.width + bx
                out.r[idx] = config.legend_border.r
                out.g[idx] = config.legend_border.g
                out.b[idx] = config.legend_border.b
                out.a[idx] = config.legend_border.a
            }
        }
        bx = bx + 1
    }
    var by: i64 = ly
    while by < ly + legend_h {
        if by >= 0 && by < out.height {
            if lx >= 0 && lx < out.width {
                let idx = by * out.width + lx
                out.r[idx] = config.legend_border.r
                out.g[idx] = config.legend_border.g
                out.b[idx] = config.legend_border.b
                out.a[idx] = config.legend_border.a
            }
            if lx + legend_w - 1 >= 0 && lx + legend_w - 1 < out.width {
                let idx = by * out.width + lx + legend_w - 1
                out.r[idx] = config.legend_border.r
                out.g[idx] = config.legend_border.g
                out.b[idx] = config.legend_border.b
                out.a[idx] = config.legend_border.a
            }
        }
        by = by + 1
    }

    // Entries
    var ei: i64 = 0
    while ei < series_count && ei < 8 {
        let sc = series_configs[ei]
        let ey = ly + 5 + ei * entry_h
        // Color sample line
        out = surface_draw_rect(out, lx + 5, ey, 20, 2, sc.color)
        // Label text
        let text_arr = string_to_text_array(sc.label)
        let text_len = sc.label.len() as i64
        if text_len > 0 {
            out = draw_text_raster(out, &text_arr, text_len, lx + 28, ey - 3, color_black(), 1)
        }
        ei = ei + 1
    }

    out
}

pub fn plot_multi_line_raster(s: Surface, xs: &[f64; 256], yss: &[f64; 2048], ns: &[i64; 8], series_count: i64, series_configs: &[SeriesConfig; 8], config: MultiSeriesConfig) -> Surface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var out = s
    if series_count <= 0 { return out }

    let bounds = compute_global_bounds(xs, yss, ns, series_count)
    let gxmin = bounds.xmin
    let gxmax = bounds.xmax
    let gymin = bounds.ymin
    let gymax = bounds.ymax
    let x_range = gxmax - gxmin
    let y_range = gymax - gymin
    let plot_w = out.width - config.margin * 2
    let plot_h = out.height - config.margin * 2

    // Clear background
    out = surface_draw_rect(out, 0, 0, out.width, out.height, config.bg_color)

    // Draw axes
    out = surface_draw_rect(out, config.margin, config.margin, 1, plot_h, config.axis_color)
    out = surface_draw_rect(out, config.margin, out.height - config.margin - 1, plot_w, 1, config.axis_color)

    // Draw each series
    var si: i64 = 0
    while si < series_count && si < 8 {
        let n = ns[si]
        let base = si * 256
        let sc = series_configs[si]
        if n <= 0 { si = si + 1; continue }

        // Draw lines
        if sc.show_line {
            var j: i64 = 0
            while j < n - 1 && j < 255 {
                let x0f = if x_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (xs[j] - gxmin) / x_range }
                let y0f = if y_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (yss[base + j] - gymin) / y_range }
                let x1f = if x_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (xs[j + 1] - gxmin) / x_range }
                let y1f = if y_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (yss[base + j + 1] - gymin) / y_range }

                let px0 = config.margin + (x0f * (plot_w as f64)) as i64
                let py0 = out.height - config.margin - 1 - (y0f * (plot_h as f64)) as i64
                let px1 = config.margin + (x1f * (plot_w as f64)) as i64
                let py1 = out.height - config.margin - 1 - (y1f * (plot_h as f64)) as i64

                out = surface_draw_line(out, px0, py0, px1, py1, sc.color)
                j = j + 1
            }
        }

        // Draw scatter markers
        if sc.show_scatter {
            var j: i64 = 0
            while j < n && j < 256 {
                let xf = if x_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (xs[j] - gxmin) / x_range }
                let yf = if y_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (yss[base + j] - gymin) / y_range }
                let px = config.margin + (xf * (plot_w as f64)) as i64
                let py = out.height - config.margin - 1 - (yf * (plot_h as f64)) as i64
                let half = sc.marker_size
                out = surface_draw_line(out, px - half, py, px + half, py, sc.color)
                out = surface_draw_line(out, px, py - half, px, py + half, sc.color)
                j = j + 1
            }
        }

        si = si + 1
    }

    // Draw legend
    out = draw_legend(out, series_configs, series_count, config)
    out
}

pub fn plot_multi_scatter_raster(s: Surface, xs: &[f64; 256], yss: &[f64; 2048], ns: &[i64; 8], series_count: i64, series_configs: &[SeriesConfig; 8], config: MultiSeriesConfig) -> Surface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    // Same as line but force show_scatter=true, show_line=false for all series
    var out = s
    if series_count <= 0 { return out }

    let bounds = compute_global_bounds(xs, yss, ns, series_count)
    let gxmin = bounds.xmin
    let gxmax = bounds.xmax
    let gymin = bounds.ymin
    let gymax = bounds.ymax
    let x_range = gxmax - gxmin
    let y_range = gymax - gymin
    let plot_w = out.width - config.margin * 2
    let plot_h = out.height - config.margin * 2

    out = surface_draw_rect(out, 0, 0, out.width, out.height, config.bg_color)
    out = surface_draw_rect(out, config.margin, config.margin, 1, plot_h, config.axis_color)
    out = surface_draw_rect(out, config.margin, out.height - config.margin - 1, plot_w, 1, config.axis_color)

    var si: i64 = 0
    while si < series_count && si < 8 {
        let n = ns[si]
        let base = si * 256
        let sc = series_configs[si]
        if n <= 0 { si = si + 1; continue }

        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < n && j < 256 {
            let xf = if x_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (xs[j] - gxmin) / x_range }
            let yf = if y_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (yss[base + j] - gymin) / y_range }
            let px = config.margin + (xf * (plot_w as f64)) as i64
            let py = out.height - config.margin - 1 - (yf * (plot_h as f64)) as i64
            let half = sc.marker_size
            out = surface_draw_line(out, px - half, py, px + half, py, sc.color)
            out = surface_draw_line(out, px, py - half, px, py + half, sc.color)
            j = j + 1
        }
        si = si + 1
    }

    out = draw_legend(out, series_configs, series_count, config)
    out
}

// TiledSurface versions
pub fn tiled_plot_multi_line_raster(ts: TiledSurface, xs: &[f64; 256], yss: &[f64; 2048], ns: &[i64; 8], series_count: i64, series_configs: &[SeriesConfig; 8], config: MultiSeriesConfig) -> TiledSurface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var out = ts
    if series_count <= 0 { return out }

    let bounds = compute_global_bounds(xs, yss, ns, series_count)
    let gxmin = bounds.xmin
    let gxmax = bounds.xmax
    let gymin = bounds.ymin
    let gymax = bounds.ymax
    let x_range = gxmax - gxmin
    let y_range = gymax - gymin
    let plot_w = out.width - config.margin * 2
    let plot_h = out.height - config.margin * 2

    // Clear background on all tiles
    out = tiled_clear(out, config.bg_color)

    // Draw axes via tiled_draw_line
    out = tiled_draw_line(out, config.margin, config.margin, config.margin, out.height - config.margin, config.axis_color)
    out = tiled_draw_line(out, config.margin, out.height - config.margin, out.width - config.margin, out.height - config.margin, config.axis_color)

    // Draw each series
    var si: i64 = 0
    while si < series_count && si < 8 {
        let n = ns[si]
        let base = si * 256
        let sc = series_configs[si]
        if n <= 0 { si = si + 1; continue }

        if sc.show_line {
            var j: i64 = 0
            while j < n - 1 && j < 255 {
                let x0f = if x_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (xs[j] - gxmin) / x_range }
                let y0f = if y_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (yss[base + j] - gymin) / y_range }
                let x1f = if x_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (xs[j + 1] - gxmin) / x_range }
                let y1f = if y_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (yss[base + j + 1] - gymin) / y_range }

                let px0 = config.margin + (x0f * (plot_w as f64)) as i64
                let py0 = out.height - config.margin - 1 - (y0f * (plot_h as f64)) as i64
                let px1 = config.margin + (x1f * (plot_w as f64)) as i64
                let py1 = out.height - config.margin - 1 - (y1f * (plot_h as f64)) as i64

                out = tiled_draw_line(out, px0, py0, px1, py1, sc.color)
                j = j + 1
            }
        }

        if sc.show_scatter {
            var j: i64 = 0
            while j < n && j < 256 {
                let xf = if x_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (xs[j] - gxmin) / x_range }
                let yf = if y_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (yss[base + j] - gymin) / y_range }
                let px = config.margin + (xf * (plot_w as f64)) as i64
                let py = out.height - config.margin - 1 - (yf * (plot_h as f64)) as i64
                let half = sc.marker_size
                out = tiled_draw_line(out, px - half, py, px + half, py, sc.color)
                out = tiled_draw_line(out, px, py - half, px, py + half, sc.color)
                j = j + 1
            }
        }

        si = si + 1
    }

    out
}

// One-shot PNG wrappers
pub fn plot_multi_line_png(xs: &[f64; 256], yss: &[f64; 2048], ns: &[i64; 8], series_count: i64, series_configs: &[SeriesConfig; 8], config: MultiSeriesConfig, filename: string) -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var w = config.width
    var h = config.height
    if w > 256 { w = 256 }
    if h > 256 { h = 256 }
    if w < 1 { w = 1 }
    if h < 1 { h = 1 }
    var s = surface_new(w, h)
    s = plot_multi_line_raster(s, xs, yss, ns, series_count, series_configs, config)
    png_encode_surface(&s, filename)
}

pub fn tiled_plot_multi_line_png(xs: &[f64; 256], yss: &[f64; 2048], ns: &[i64; 8], series_count: i64, series_configs: &[SeriesConfig; 8], config: MultiSeriesConfig, filename: string) -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var ts = tiled_surface_new(config.width, config.height, 256, 256)
    ts = tiled_plot_multi_line_raster(ts, xs, yss, ns, series_count, series_configs, config)
    tiled_export_png(&ts, filename)
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO { 0 }


// === FILE: stdlib/graphics/pie.sio ===
// Graphics Pie — Pie chart rendering
//
// Simple raster pie charts (and donut) with angle-based slice determination.

use graphics::drawing::{Color, color_white}
use graphics::surface::{Surface, surface_new, surface_clear}
use graphics::tile::{TiledSurface, tiled_surface_new, tiled_clear, tiled_set_pixel, tiled_export_png}
use graphics::png::{png_encode_surface}

pub struct PieConfig {
    pub cx: i64,
    pub cy: i64,
    pub radius: i64,
    pub bg_color: Color,
    pub donut: bool,
    pub donut_radius: i64,
}

pub fn pie_config_default() -> PieConfig {
    PieConfig {
        cx: 128,
        cy: 128,
        radius: 100,
        bg_color: color_white(),
        donut: false,
        donut_radius: 50,
    }
}

pub fn draw_pie_raster(s: Surface, values: &[f64; 16], n: i64, colors: &[Color; 16], config: PieConfig) -> Surface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if n <= 0 || n > 16 { return s }
    var out = s

    var total: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        total = total + values[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    if total == 0.0 { return out }

    var cumsum: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var running: f64 = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        running = running + values[i]
        cumsum[i] = running / total
        i = i + 1
    }

    let two_pi = 6.283185307179586
    let radius_f = config.radius as f64
    let donut_radius_f = config.donut_radius as f64

    var py = config.cy - config.radius
    while py <= config.cy + config.radius {
        var px = config.cx - config.radius
        while px <= config.cx + config.radius {
            let dx = (px - config.cx) as f64
            let dy = (py - config.cy) as f64
            let dist = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)

            if dist <= radius_f {
                let in_donut = config.donut && dist < donut_radius_f
                if !in_donut {
                    var angle = atan2(dy, dx)
                    if angle < 0.0 {
                        angle = angle + two_pi
                    }
                    let frac = angle / two_pi

                    var slice_idx: i64 = 0
                    while slice_idx < n {
                        let end = cumsum[slice_idx]
                        if frac < end {
                            break
                        }
                        slice_idx = slice_idx + 1
                    }
                    if slice_idx >= n {
                        slice_idx = n - 1
                    }

                    let c = colors[slice_idx]
                    if px >= 0 && px < out.width && py >= 0 && py < out.height {
                        let idx = py * out.width + px
                        out.r[idx] = c.r
                        out.g[idx] = c.g
                        out.b[idx] = c.b
                        out.a[idx] = c.a
                    }
                }
            }
            px = px + 1
        }
        py = py + 1
    }

    out
}

pub fn tiled_draw_pie_raster(ts: TiledSurface, values: &[f64; 16], n: i64, colors: &[Color; 16], config: PieConfig) -> TiledSurface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if n <= 0 || n > 16 { return ts }
    var out = ts

    var total: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        total = total + values[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    if total == 0.0 { return out }

    var cumsum: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var running: f64 = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        running = running + values[i]
        cumsum[i] = running / total
        i = i + 1
    }

    let two_pi = 6.283185307179586
    let radius_f = config.radius as f64
    let donut_radius_f = config.donut_radius as f64

    var py = config.cy - config.radius
    while py <= config.cy + config.radius {
        var px = config.cx - config.radius
        while px <= config.cx + config.radius {
            let dx = (px - config.cx) as f64
            let dy = (py - config.cy) as f64
            let dist = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)

            if dist <= radius_f {
                let in_donut = config.donut && dist < donut_radius_f
                if !in_donut {
                    var angle = atan2(dy, dx)
                    if angle < 0.0 {
                        angle = angle + two_pi
                    }
                    let frac = angle / two_pi

                    var slice_idx: i64 = 0
                    while slice_idx < n {
                        let end = cumsum[slice_idx]
                        if frac < end {
                            break
                        }
                        slice_idx = slice_idx + 1
                    }
                    if slice_idx >= n {
                        slice_idx = n - 1
                    }

                    let c = colors[slice_idx]
                    out = tiled_set_pixel(out, px, py, c)
                }
            }
            px = px + 1
        }
        py = py + 1
    }

    out
}

pub fn plot_pie_png(values: &[f64; 16], n: i64, colors: &[Color; 16], width: i64, height: i64, filename: string) -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var s = surface_new(width, height)
    s = surface_clear(s, color_white())
    var config = pie_config_default()
    config.cx = width / 2
    config.cy = height / 2
    let min_dim = if width < height { width } else { height }
    config.radius = min_dim / 2 - 10
    if config.radius < 10 { config.radius = 10 }
    s = draw_pie_raster(s, values, n, colors, config)
    png_encode_surface(&s, filename)
}

pub fn tiled_plot_pie_png(values: &[f64; 16], n: i64, colors: &[Color; 16], width: i64, height: i64, filename: string) -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var ts = tiled_surface_new(width, height, 256, 256)
    ts = tiled_clear(ts, color_white())
    var config = pie_config_default()
    config.cx = width / 2
    config.cy = height / 2
    let min_dim = if width < height { width } else { height }
    config.radius = min_dim / 2 - 10
    if config.radius < 10 { config.radius = 10 }
    ts = tiled_draw_pie_raster(ts, values, n, colors, config)
    tiled_export_png(&ts, filename)
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO { 0 }


// === FILE: stdlib/graphics/plot.sio ===
// Graphics Plot — Raster scientific plots
//
// Minimal raster line plot: converts (x,y) data to pixels on a Surface.
// This is the pixel-based counterpart to plot::line (terminal-based).

use graphics::drawing::{Color}
use graphics::surface::{Surface, surface_draw_line, surface_draw_rect}

pub struct LinePlotConfig {
    pub width: i64,
    pub height: i64,
    pub margin: i64,
    pub line_color: Color,
    pub bg_color: Color,
    pub axis_color: Color,
}

pub fn line_plot_config_default() -> LinePlotConfig {
    LinePlotConfig {
        width: 256,
        height: 256,
        margin: 20,
        line_color: Color { r: 0, g: 100, b: 200, a: 255 },
        bg_color: Color { r: 255, g: 255, b: 255, a: 255 },
        axis_color: Color { r: 0, g: 0, b: 0, a: 255 },
    }
}

// Draw a line plot of up to 256 points onto an existing surface.
// xs and ys are assumed to be in data coordinates; they are auto-scaled to fit.
// Returns the updated surface.
pub fn plot_line_raster(
    s: Surface,
    xs: &[f64; 256],
    ys: &[f64; 256],
    n: i64,
    config: LinePlotConfig
) -> Surface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if n <= 0 { return s }

    var out = s

    // Find data bounds
    var xmin = xs[0]
    var xmax = xs[0]
    var ymin = ys[0]
    var ymax = ys[0]
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < n {
        if xs[i] < xmin { xmin = xs[i] }
        if xs[i] > xmax { xmax = xs[i] }
        if ys[i] < ymin { ymin = ys[i] }
        if ys[i] > ymax { ymax = ys[i] }
        i = i + 1
    }

    let x_range = xmax - xmin
    let y_range = ymax - ymin
    let plot_w = out.width - config.margin * 2
    let plot_h = out.height - config.margin * 2

    // Clear background
    out = surface_draw_rect(out, 0, 0, out.width, out.height, config.bg_color)

    // Draw axes
    out = surface_draw_rect(out, config.margin, config.margin, 1, plot_h, config.axis_color)
    out = surface_draw_rect(out, config.margin, out.height - config.margin - 1, plot_w, 1, config.axis_color)

    // Draw line segments
    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < n - 1 {
        let x0f = if x_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (xs[j] - xmin) / x_range }
        let y0f = if y_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (ys[j] - ymin) / y_range }
        let x1f = if x_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (xs[j + 1] - xmin) / x_range }
        let y1f = if y_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (ys[j + 1] - ymin) / y_range }

        let px0 = config.margin + (x0f * (plot_w as f64)) as i64
        let py0 = out.height - config.margin - 1 - (y0f * (plot_h as f64)) as i64
        let px1 = config.margin + (x1f * (plot_w as f64)) as i64
        let py1 = out.height - config.margin - 1 - (y1f * (plot_h as f64)) as i64

        out = surface_draw_line(out, px0, py0, px1, py1, config.line_color)
        j = j + 1
    }
    out
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO { 0 }
