// === FILE: stdlib/graphics/png.sio ===
// stdlib/graphics/png.sio — Pure-Sounio PNG encoder (stored DEFLATE)
//
// Writes valid PNG files using zlib stored blocks (no compression).
// Output goes directly to a file via write_file / append_file builtins.
//
// Supported color types:
//   - 2 = 8-bit RGB
//   - 6 = 8-bit RGBA
//
// Format:
//   - PNG signature (8 bytes)
//   - IHDR chunk (13 bytes data)
//   - One or more IDAT chunks (zlib stream with stored deflate blocks)
//   - IEND chunk (empty)
//
// Each stored deflate block has a 5-byte header + up to 32,768 bytes payload.
// Images larger than 32,768 raw bytes use multiple IDAT chunks.

use graphics::surface::{Surface}
use compress::huffman::{huffman_fixed_encode, HuffmanResult}

// ============================================================================
// CONSTANTS
// ============================================================================

pub const BLOCK_MAX: i64 = 32768
pub const PNG_COLOR_RGB: i8 = 2 as i8
pub const PNG_COLOR_RGBA: i8 = 6 as i8

// ============================================================================
// CRC32 TABLE
// ============================================================================

var crc_table: [i64; 256] = [0; 256]
var crc_table_ready: bool = false

fn crc32_ensure_init() with Mut {
    if crc_table_ready { return }
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 256 {
        var c = i
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < 8 {
            if (c & 1) != 0 {
                c = 0xEDB88320 ^ (c >> 1)
            } else {
                c = c >> 1
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        crc_table[i] = c
        i = i + 1
    }
    crc_table_ready = true
}

// Convert signed i8 to unsigned value 0..255
fn byte_to_u64(b: i8) -> i64 {
    let v = b as i64
    if v < 0 { v + 256 } else { v }
}

// Convert pixel value 0..255 to i8 (wraps values > 127)
pub fn pixel_to_i8(v: i64) -> i8 {
    if v > 127 { (v - 256) as i8 } else { v as i8 }
}

// Update CRC over len bytes of data
fn crc32_update(crc: i64, data: &[i8; 32800], len: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    var c = crc
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < len {
        let byte = byte_to_u64(data[i])
        let idx = (c ^ byte) & 0xFF
        c = crc_table[idx] ^ (c >> 8)
        i = i + 1
    }
    c
}

// CRC over chunk type + data
fn crc32_of_chunk(type_bytes: &[i8; 4], data: &[i8; 32800], data_len: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    var crc: i64 = 0xFFFFFFFF
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 4 {
        let byte = byte_to_u64(type_bytes[i])
        let idx = (crc ^ byte) & 0xFF
        crc = crc_table[idx] ^ (crc >> 8)
        i = i + 1
    }
    crc = crc32_update(crc, data, data_len)
    crc ^ 0xFFFFFFFF
}

// ============================================================================
// LOW-LEVEL CHUNK WRITING (public for use by tile.sio)
// ============================================================================

pub fn png_write_chunk(filename: string, type_bytes: [i8; 4], data: &[i8; 32800], data_len: i64) -> bool with IO, Mut {
    let crc = crc32_of_chunk(type_bytes, data, data_len)
    let chunk_total = 4 + 4 + data_len + 4
    var chunk: [i8; 32800] = [0; 32800]

    // Length (big-endian)
    chunk[0] = ((data_len >> 24) & 0xFF) as i8
    chunk[1] = ((data_len >> 16) & 0xFF) as i8
    chunk[2] = ((data_len >> 8) & 0xFF) as i8
    chunk[3] = (data_len & 0xFF) as i8

    // Type
    chunk[4] = type_bytes[0]
    chunk[5] = type_bytes[1]
    chunk[6] = type_bytes[2]
    chunk[7] = type_bytes[3]

    // Data
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < data_len {
        chunk[8 + i] = data[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    // CRC (big-endian)
    chunk[8 + data_len] = ((crc >> 24) & 0xFF) as i8
    chunk[9 + data_len] = ((crc >> 16) & 0xFF) as i8
    chunk[10 + data_len] = ((crc >> 8) & 0xFF) as i8
    chunk[11 + data_len] = (crc & 0xFF) as i8

    append_file(filename, chunk, chunk_total) >= 0
}

pub fn png_write_sig(filename: string) -> bool with IO, Mut {
    var sig: [i8; 8] = [0; 8]
    sig[0] = 137 as i8
    sig[1] = 80 as i8
    sig[2] = 78 as i8
    sig[3] = 71 as i8
    sig[4] = 13 as i8
    sig[5] = 10 as i8
    sig[6] = 26 as i8
    sig[7] = 10 as i8
    write_file(filename, sig, 8) >= 0
}

pub fn png_write_ihdr(filename: string, width: i64, height: i64, color_type: i8) -> bool with IO, Mut {
    var data: [i8; 32800] = [0; 32800]
    data[0] = ((width >> 24) & 0xFF) as i8
    data[1] = ((width >> 16) & 0xFF) as i8
    data[2] = ((width >> 8) & 0xFF) as i8
    data[3] = (width & 0xFF) as i8
    data[4] = ((height >> 24) & 0xFF) as i8
    data[5] = ((height >> 16) & 0xFF) as i8
    data[6] = ((height >> 8) & 0xFF) as i8
    data[7] = (height & 0xFF) as i8
    data[8] = 8 as i8
    data[9] = color_type
    data[10] = 0 as i8
    data[11] = 0 as i8
    data[12] = 0 as i8
    var type_bytes: [i8; 4] = [0; 4]
    type_bytes[0] = 73 as i8
    type_bytes[1] = 72 as i8
    type_bytes[2] = 68 as i8
    type_bytes[3] = 82 as i8
    png_write_chunk(filename, type_bytes, &data, 13)
}

pub fn png_write_iend(filename: string) -> bool with IO, Mut {
    var data: [i8; 32800] = [0; 32800]
    var type_bytes: [i8; 4] = [0; 4]
    type_bytes[0] = 73 as i8
    type_bytes[1] = 69 as i8
    type_bytes[2] = 78 as i8
    type_bytes[3] = 68 as i8
    png_write_chunk(filename, type_bytes, &data, 0)
}

// ============================================================================
// ADLER32
// ============================================================================

pub fn compute_adler32_rgb(s: &Surface) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var a: i64 = 1
    var b: i64 = 0
    var y: i64 = 0
    while y < s.height {
        a = (a + 0) % 65521
        b = (b + a) % 65521
        var x: i64 = 0
        while x < s.width {
            let idx = y * s.width + x
            a = (a + s.r[idx]) % 65521
            b = (b + a) % 65521
            a = (a + s.g[idx]) % 65521
            b = (b + a) % 65521
            a = (a + s.b[idx]) % 65521
            b = (b + a) % 65521
            x = x + 1
        }
        y = y + 1
    }
    (b << 16) | a
}

pub fn compute_adler32_rgba(s: &Surface) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var a: i64 = 1
    var b: i64 = 0
    var y: i64 = 0
    while y < s.height {
        a = (a + 0) % 65521
        b = (b + a) % 65521
        var x: i64 = 0
        while x < s.width {
            let idx = y * s.width + x
            a = (a + s.r[idx]) % 65521
            b = (b + a) % 65521
            a = (a + s.g[idx]) % 65521
            b = (b + a) % 65521
            a = (a + s.b[idx]) % 65521
            b = (b + a) % 65521
            a = (a + s.a[idx]) % 65521
            b = (b + a) % 65521
            x = x + 1
        }
        y = y + 1
    }
    (b << 16) | a
}

// ============================================================================
// DEFLATE BLOCK WRITING (public for streaming use)
// ============================================================================

pub fn png_write_deflate_block(filename: string, block_num: i64, is_final: bool,
                               payload_len: i64, payload: [i8; 32800], adler: i64) -> bool with IO, Mut {
    let bfinal: i8 = if is_final { 1 as i8 } else { 0 as i8 }
    let nlen = 65535 - payload_len
    var type_bytes: [i8; 4] = [0; 4]
    type_bytes[0] = 73 as i8
    type_bytes[1] = 68 as i8
    type_bytes[2] = 65 as i8
    type_bytes[3] = 84 as i8

    if block_num == 0 {
        // First chunk: zlib header (2) + deflate header (5) + payload
        var data: [i8; 32800] = [0; 32800]
        data[0] = 120 as i8
        data[1] = 1 as i8
        data[2] = bfinal
        data[3] = (payload_len & 0xFF) as i8
        data[4] = ((payload_len >> 8) & 0xFF) as i8
        data[5] = (nlen & 0xFF) as i8
        data[6] = ((nlen >> 8) & 0xFF) as i8
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < payload_len {
            data[7 + i] = payload[i]
            i = i + 1
        }
        png_write_chunk(filename, type_bytes, &data, 7 + payload_len)
    } else if !is_final {
        // Middle chunk: deflate header (5) + payload
        var data: [i8; 32800] = [0; 32800]
        data[0] = bfinal
        data[1] = (payload_len & 0xFF) as i8
        data[2] = ((payload_len >> 8) & 0xFF) as i8
        data[3] = (nlen & 0xFF) as i8
        data[4] = ((nlen >> 8) & 0xFF) as i8
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < payload_len {
            data[5 + i] = payload[i]
            i = i + 1
        }
        png_write_chunk(filename, type_bytes, &data, 5 + payload_len)
    } else {
        // Last chunk: deflate header (5) + payload + adler32 (4)
        var data: [i8; 32800] = [0; 32800]
        data[0] = bfinal
        data[1] = (payload_len & 0xFF) as i8
        data[2] = ((payload_len >> 8) & 0xFF) as i8
        data[3] = (nlen & 0xFF) as i8
        data[4] = ((nlen >> 8) & 0xFF) as i8
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < payload_len {
            data[5 + i] = payload[i]
            i = i + 1
        }
        data[5 + payload_len] = ((adler >> 24) & 0xFF) as i8
        data[6 + payload_len] = ((adler >> 16) & 0xFF) as i8
        data[7 + payload_len] = ((adler >> 8) & 0xFF) as i8
        data[8 + payload_len] = (adler & 0xFF) as i8
        png_write_chunk(filename, type_bytes, &data, 9 + payload_len)
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// COMPRESSED IDAT (fixed Huffman, single block)
// ============================================================================

fn write_idat_compressed(filename: string, raw: &[i8; 32800], raw_len: i64, adler: i64) -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic {
    if raw_len < 0 || raw_len > 32768 { return false }

    // Convert i8 payload to i64 for the Huffman encoder
    var src: [i64; 32768] = [0; 32768]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < raw_len {
        let v = raw[i] as i64
        src[i] = if v < 0 { v + 256 } else { v }
        i = i + 1
    }

    var dst: [i64; 65536] = [0; 65536]
    let res = huffman_fixed_encode(&src, raw_len, &!dst, 65536)
    if !res.ok { return false }

    let compressed_len = res.written
    let total_len = 2 + compressed_len + 4
    if total_len > 32768 { return false }

    var data: [i8; 32800] = [0; 32800]
    // zlib header: CMF=0x78, FLG=0x9c
    data[0] = 120 as i8
    data[1] = 156 as i8

    i = 0
    while i < compressed_len {
        let v = dst[i]
        data[2 + i] = if v > 127 { (v - 256) as i8 } else { v as i8 }
        i = i + 1
    }

    data[2 + compressed_len] = ((adler >> 24) & 0xFF) as i8
    data[3 + compressed_len] = ((adler >> 16) & 0xFF) as i8
    data[4 + compressed_len] = ((adler >> 8) & 0xFF) as i8
    data[5 + compressed_len] = (adler & 0xFF) as i8

    var type_bytes: [i8; 4] = [0; 4]
    type_bytes[0] = 73 as i8
    type_bytes[1] = 68 as i8
    type_bytes[2] = 65 as i8
    type_bytes[3] = 84 as i8
    png_write_chunk(filename, type_bytes, &data, total_len)
}

// ============================================================================
// IDAT — zlib stream for a Surface
// ============================================================================

fn write_idat_rgb(filename: string, s: &Surface) -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let scanline_size = 1 + s.width * 3
    let total_size = s.height * scanline_size
    let adler = compute_adler32_rgb(s)

    // For small images, try fixed Huffman compression in a single block
    if total_size <= BLOCK_MAX {
        var buf: [i8; 32800] = [0; 32800]
        var pos: i64 = 0
        var y: i64 = 0
        while y < s.height {
            buf[pos] = 0 as i8
            pos = pos + 1
            var x: i64 = 0
            while x < s.width {
                let idx = y * s.width + x
                buf[pos] = pixel_to_i8(s.r[idx])
                pos = pos + 1
                buf[pos] = pixel_to_i8(s.g[idx])
                pos = pos + 1
                buf[pos] = pixel_to_i8(s.b[idx])
                pos = pos + 1
                x = x + 1
            }
            y = y + 1
        }
        if write_idat_compressed(filename, &buf, pos, adler) {
            return true
        }
        // Compression failed or expanded: fall through to stored blocks
    }

    // Stored blocks for large images or when compression expands
    var block_buf: [i8; 32800] = [0; 32800]
    var block_pos: i64 = 0
    var block_num: i64 = 0
    var y: i64 = 0

    while y < s.height {
        if block_pos > 0 && block_pos + scanline_size > BLOCK_MAX {
            if !png_write_deflate_block(filename, block_num, false, block_pos, block_buf, adler) {
                return false
            }
            block_pos = 0
            block_num = block_num + 1
        }

        block_buf[block_pos] = 0 as i8
        block_pos = block_pos + 1
        var x: i64 = 0
        while x < s.width {
            let idx = y * s.width + x
            block_buf[block_pos] = pixel_to_i8(s.r[idx])
            block_pos = block_pos + 1
            block_buf[block_pos] = pixel_to_i8(s.g[idx])
            block_pos = block_pos + 1
            block_buf[block_pos] = pixel_to_i8(s.b[idx])
            block_pos = block_pos + 1
            x = x + 1
        }
        y = y + 1
    }

    if block_pos > 0 {
        if !png_write_deflate_block(filename, block_num, true, block_pos, block_buf, adler) {
            return false
        }
    }

    true
}

fn write_idat_rgba(filename: string, s: &Surface) -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let scanline_size = 1 + s.width * 4
    let total_size = s.height * scanline_size
    let adler = compute_adler32_rgba(s)

    // For small images, try fixed Huffman compression in a single block
    if total_size <= BLOCK_MAX {
        var buf: [i8; 32800] = [0; 32800]
        var pos: i64 = 0
        var y: i64 = 0
        while y < s.height {
            buf[pos] = 0 as i8
            pos = pos + 1
            var x: i64 = 0
            while x < s.width {
                let idx = y * s.width + x
                buf[pos] = pixel_to_i8(s.r[idx])
                pos = pos + 1
                buf[pos] = pixel_to_i8(s.g[idx])
                pos = pos + 1
                buf[pos] = pixel_to_i8(s.b[idx])
                pos = pos + 1
                buf[pos] = pixel_to_i8(s.a[idx])
                pos = pos + 1
                x = x + 1
            }
            y = y + 1
        }
        if write_idat_compressed(filename, &buf, pos, adler) {
            return true
        }
        // Compression failed or expanded: fall through to stored blocks
    }

    // Stored blocks for large images or when compression expands
    var block_buf: [i8; 32800] = [0; 32800]
    var block_pos: i64 = 0
    var block_num: i64 = 0
    var y: i64 = 0

    while y < s.height {
        if block_pos > 0 && block_pos + scanline_size > BLOCK_MAX {
            if !png_write_deflate_block(filename, block_num, false, block_pos, block_buf, adler) {
                return false
            }
            block_pos = 0
            block_num = block_num + 1
        }

        block_buf[block_pos] = 0 as i8
        block_pos = block_pos + 1
        var x: i64 = 0
        while x < s.width {
            let idx = y * s.width + x
            block_buf[block_pos] = pixel_to_i8(s.r[idx])
            block_pos = block_pos + 1
            block_buf[block_pos] = pixel_to_i8(s.g[idx])
            block_pos = block_pos + 1
            block_buf[block_pos] = pixel_to_i8(s.b[idx])
            block_pos = block_pos + 1
            block_buf[block_pos] = pixel_to_i8(s.a[idx])
            block_pos = block_pos + 1
            x = x + 1
        }
        y = y + 1
    }

    if block_pos > 0 {
        if !png_write_deflate_block(filename, block_num, true, block_pos, block_buf, adler) {
            return false
        }
    }

    true
}

// ============================================================================
// PUBLIC API
// ============================================================================

pub fn png_encode_surface(s: &Surface, filename: string) -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    if s.width <= 0 || s.height <= 0 { return false }
    crc32_ensure_init()
    if !png_write_sig(filename) { return false }
    if !png_write_ihdr(filename, s.width, s.height, PNG_COLOR_RGB) { return false }
    if !write_idat_rgb(filename, s) { return false }
    if !png_write_iend(filename) { return false }
    true
}

pub fn png_encode_surface_rgba(s: &Surface, filename: string) -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    if s.width <= 0 || s.height <= 0 { return false }
    crc32_ensure_init()
    if !png_write_sig(filename) { return false }
    if !png_write_ihdr(filename, s.width, s.height, PNG_COLOR_RGBA) { return false }
    if !write_idat_rgba(filename, s) { return false }
    if !png_write_iend(filename) { return false }
    true
}

// Backward-compatible alias
pub fn png_export(s: &Surface, filename: string) -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    png_encode_surface(s, filename)
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO { 0 }


// === FILE: stdlib/graphics/png_decode.sio ===
// stdlib/graphics/png_decode.sio — Pure-Sounio PNG decoder
//
// Decodes PNG files produced by stdlib/graphics/png.sio (and compatible files).
// Supports:
//   - Color types 2 (RGB) and 6 (RGBA)
//   - 8-bit depth only
//   - Stored DEFLATE blocks (BTYPE=00)
//   - Fixed Huffman DEFLATE blocks (BTYPE=01) — literal-only, no LZ77
//   - All PNG filter types (None, Sub, Up, Average, Paeth)
//
// Limitations:
//   - Max image size: 256×256 (matches Surface capacity)
//   - No interlacing (interlace must be 0)
//   - No 16-bit, indexed, or grayscale color types
//   - No dynamic Huffman (BTYPE=10) blocks

use graphics::surface::{Surface, surface_new}

// ============================================================================
// CONSTANTS
// ============================================================================

const MAX_RAW_SIZE: i64 = 300000
const MAX_SCANLINE: i64 = 1280
const MAX_WIDTH: i64 = 256
const MAX_HEIGHT: i64 = 256

// ============================================================================
// BYTE READERS
// ============================================================================

fn read_u8(data: string, offset: i64, data_len: i64) -> i64 {
    if offset < 0 || offset >= data_len { return 0 }
    let v = str_char_at(data, offset)
    if v < 0 { v + 256 } else { v }
}

fn read_u32_be(data: string, offset: i64, data_len: i64) -> i64 {
    (read_u8(data, offset, data_len) << 24) |
    (read_u8(data, offset + 1, data_len) << 16) |
    (read_u8(data, offset + 2, data_len) << 8) |
    read_u8(data, offset + 3, data_len)
}

fn check_png_sig(data: string, data_len: i64) -> bool {
    data_len >= 8 &&
    read_u8(data, 0, data_len) == 137 &&
    read_u8(data, 1, data_len) == 80 &&
    read_u8(data, 2, data_len) == 78 &&
    read_u8(data, 3, data_len) == 71 &&
    read_u8(data, 4, data_len) == 13 &&
    read_u8(data, 5, data_len) == 10 &&
    read_u8(data, 6, data_len) == 26 &&
    read_u8(data, 7, data_len) == 10
}

fn chunk_type_eq(data: string, offset: i64, data_len: i64,
                 a: i64, b: i64, c: i64, d: i64) -> bool {
    offset + 4 <= data_len &&
    read_u8(data, offset, data_len) == a &&
    read_u8(data, offset + 1, data_len) == b &&
    read_u8(data, offset + 2, data_len) == c &&
    read_u8(data, offset + 3, data_len) == d
}

// ============================================================================
// BIT READER (for fixed Huffman decode)
// ============================================================================

struct BitReader {
    pos: i64,
    end: i64,
    bits: i64,
    nbits: i64,
}

fn br_new(pos: i64, end: i64) -> BitReader {
    BitReader { pos: pos, end: end, bits: 0, nbits: 0 }
}

fn br_read_bits(data: &[i64; 300000], bra: BitReader, n: i64) -> (BitReader, i64) with Mut {
    var b = bra
    while b.nbits < n && b.pos < b.end {
        let byte = data[b.pos]
        b.bits = b.bits | (byte << b.nbits)
        b.nbits = b.nbits + 8
        b.pos = b.pos + 1
    }
    let mask = (1 << n) - 1
    let result = b.bits & mask
    b.bits = b.bits >> n
    b.nbits = b.nbits - n
    (b, result)
}

fn br_read_byte(data: &[i64; 300000], bra: BitReader) -> (BitReader, i64) with Mut {
    var b = bra
    if b.nbits >= 8 {
        let result = b.bits & 0xFF
        b.bits = b.bits >> 8
        b.nbits = b.nbits - 8
        return (b, result)
    }
    if b.pos < b.end {
        let result = data[b.pos]
        b.pos = b.pos + 1
        return (b, result)
    }
    (b, 0)
}

fn br_skip_to_byte(bra: BitReader) -> BitReader with Mut {
    var b = bra
    b.bits = 0
    b.nbits = 0
    b
}

// ============================================================================
// FIXED HUFFMAN DECODE
// ============================================================================

fn reverse_bits(v: i64, n: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    var r: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 0
    var x: i64 = v
    while i < n {
        r = (r << 1) | (x & 1)
        x = x >> 1
        i = i + 1
    }
    r
}

fn decode_fixed_symbol(data: &[i64; 300000], bra: BitReader) -> (BitReader, i64) with Mut, Panic {
    var b = bra
    let v7 = br_read_bits(data, b, 7)
    b = v7.0
    let orig7 = reverse_bits(v7.1, 7)
    if orig7 <= 23 {
        return (b, 256 + orig7)
    }
    // Not a 7-bit code; read 1 more bit to make 8
    let extra1 = br_read_bits(data, b, 1)
    b = extra1.0
    let v8 = v7.1 | (extra1.1 << 7)
    let orig8 = reverse_bits(v8, 8)
    if orig8 >= 48 && orig8 <= 191 {
        return (b, orig8 - 48)
    }
    if orig8 >= 192 && orig8 <= 199 {
        return (b, orig8 + 88)
    }
    // Not an 8-bit code; read 1 more bit to make 9
    let extra2 = br_read_bits(data, b, 1)
    b = extra2.0
    let v9 = v8 | (extra2.1 << 8)
    let orig9 = reverse_bits(v9, 9)
    if orig9 >= 400 && orig9 <= 511 {
        return (b, orig9 - 256)
    }
    (b, -1)
}

// ============================================================================
// ADLER32
// ============================================================================

fn compute_adler32(data: &[i64; 300000], len: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var a: i64 = 1
    var b: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < len {
        a = (a + data[i]) % 65521
        b = (b + a) % 65521
        i = i + 1
    }
    (b << 16) | a
}

// ============================================================================
// DEFLATE DECOMPRESSION
// ============================================================================

fn decompress_idat(idat: &[i64; 300000], idat_len: i64,
                   raw: &![i64; 300000]) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if idat_len < 6 { return 0 }

    let zlib_cmf = idat[0]
    let zlib_flg = idat[1]

    if (zlib_cmf & 0x0F) != 8 { return 0 }

    let adler_offset = idat_len - 4
    if adler_offset < 2 { return 0 }

    let deflate_start = 2
    let deflate_end = adler_offset

    var br = br_new(deflate_start, deflate_end)
    var raw_pos: i64 = 0
    var done = false

    while !done && raw_pos < MAX_RAW_SIZE {
        let bfinal_res = br_read_bits(idat, br, 1)
        br = bfinal_res.0
        let bfinal = bfinal_res.1

        let btype_res = br_read_bits(idat, br, 2)
        br = btype_res.0
        let btype = btype_res.1

        if btype == 0 {
            br = br_skip_to_byte(br)
            let len_lo = br_read_byte(idat, br)
            br = len_lo.0
            let len_hi = br_read_byte(idat, br)
            br = len_hi.0
            let nlen_lo = br_read_byte(idat, br)
            br = nlen_lo.0
            let nlen_hi = br_read_byte(idat, br)
            br = nlen_hi.0

            let len = len_lo.1 | (len_hi.1 << 8)
            let nlen = nlen_lo.1 | (nlen_hi.1 << 8)
            if (len ^ nlen) != 0xFFFF { return 0 }

            var i: i64 = 0
            while i < len && raw_pos < MAX_RAW_SIZE {
                let byte_res = br_read_byte(idat, br)
                br = byte_res.0
                (*raw)[raw_pos] = byte_res.1
                raw_pos = raw_pos + 1
                i = i + 1
            }
        } else if btype == 1 {
            var sym = 0
            while sym != 256 && raw_pos < MAX_RAW_SIZE {
                let sym_res = decode_fixed_symbol(idat, br)
                br = sym_res.0
                sym = sym_res.1
                if sym < 0 { return 0 }
                if sym < 256 {
                    (*raw)[raw_pos] = sym
                    raw_pos = raw_pos + 1
                }
            }
        } else {
            return 0
        }

        done = bfinal == 1
    }

    raw_pos
}

// ============================================================================
// FILTER RECONSTRUCTION
// ============================================================================

fn paeth_predictor(a: i64, b_val: i64, c: i64) -> i64 {
    let p = a + b_val - c
    let pa = if p >= a { p - a } else { a - p }
    let pb = if p >= b_val { p - b_val } else { b_val - p }
    let pc = if p >= c { p - c } else { c - p }
    if pa <= pb && pa <= pc { a }
    else if pb <= pc { b_val }
    else { c }
}

fn reconstruct_scanlines(raw: &[i64; 300000], raw_len: i64,
                         width: i64, height: i64, bpp: i64) -> Surface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let scanline_size = 1 + width * bpp
    let expected = height * scanline_size
    if raw_len < expected {
        return surface_new(1, 1)
    }

    var s = surface_new(width, height)
    var prev: [i64; 1280] = [0; 1280]
    var curr: [i64; 1280] = [0; 1280]

    var y: i64 = 0
    while y < height {
        let filter = raw[y * scanline_size]
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < width * bpp {
            let raw_val = raw[y * scanline_size + 1 + i]
            let a = if i >= bpp { curr[i - bpp] } else { 0 }
            let b_val = prev[i]
            let c = if i >= bpp { prev[i - bpp] } else { 0 }

            let recon = if filter == 0 {
                raw_val
            } else if filter == 1 {
                (raw_val + a) & 0xFF
            } else if filter == 2 {
                (raw_val + b_val) & 0xFF
            } else if filter == 3 {
                (raw_val + ((a + b_val) >> 1)) & 0xFF
            } else if filter == 4 {
                (raw_val + paeth_predictor(a, b_val, c)) & 0xFF
            } else {
                raw_val
            }

            curr[i] = recon
            i = i + 1
        }

        var x: i64 = 0
        while x < width {
            let sidx = y * width + x
            let bi = x * bpp
            s.r[sidx] = curr[bi]
            s.g[sidx] = curr[bi + 1]
            s.b[sidx] = curr[bi + 2]
            if bpp == 4 {
                s.a[sidx] = curr[bi + 3]
            } else {
                s.a[sidx] = 255
            }
            x = x + 1
        }

        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < width * bpp {
            prev[j] = curr[j]
            j = j + 1
        }

        y = y + 1
    }

    s
}

// ============================================================================
// PUBLIC API
// ============================================================================

pub fn png_decode_surface(filename: string) -> Surface with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let data = read_file(filename)
    let data_len = file_size(filename)

    if data_len < 33 || !check_png_sig(data, data_len) {
        return surface_new(1, 1)
    }

    var width: i64 = 0
    var height: i64 = 0
    var color_type: i64 = 0
    var bit_depth: i64 = 0
    var compression: i64 = 0
    var filter_method: i64 = 0
    var interlace: i64 = 0

    var idat_buf: [i64; 300000] = [0; 300000]
    var idat_pos: i64 = 0

    var pos: i64 = 8
    while pos + 12 <= data_len {
        let chunk_len = read_u32_be(data, pos, data_len)
        if chunk_len < 0 || pos + 12 + chunk_len > data_len { break }

        if chunk_type_eq(data, pos + 4, data_len, 73, 72, 68, 82) {
            if chunk_len != 13 { break }
            width = read_u32_be(data, pos + 8, data_len)
            height = read_u32_be(data, pos + 12, data_len)
            bit_depth = read_u8(data, pos + 16, data_len)
            color_type = read_u8(data, pos + 17, data_len)
            compression = read_u8(data, pos + 18, data_len)
            filter_method = read_u8(data, pos + 19, data_len)
            interlace = read_u8(data, pos + 20, data_len)
        } else if chunk_type_eq(data, pos + 4, data_len, 73, 68, 65, 84) {
            var i: i64 = 0
            while i < chunk_len && idat_pos < MAX_RAW_SIZE {
                idat_buf[idat_pos] = read_u8(data, pos + 8 + i, data_len)
                idat_pos = idat_pos + 1
                i = i + 1
            }
        } else if chunk_type_eq(data, pos + 4, data_len, 73, 69, 78, 68) {
            break
        }

        pos = pos + 12 + chunk_len
    }

    if width <= 0 || width > MAX_WIDTH || height <= 0 || height > MAX_HEIGHT {
        return surface_new(1, 1)
    }
    if bit_depth != 8 {
        return surface_new(1, 1)
    }
    if color_type != 2 && color_type != 6 {
        return surface_new(1, 1)
    }
    if compression != 0 || filter_method != 0 || interlace != 0 {
        return surface_new(1, 1)
    }
    if idat_pos < 6 {
        return surface_new(1, 1)
    }

    let bpp = if color_type == 6 { 4 } else { 3 }

    var raw_buf: [i64; 300000] = [0; 300000]
    let raw_len = decompress_idat(&idat_buf, idat_pos, &!raw_buf)
    if raw_len <= 0 {
        return surface_new(1, 1)
    }

    let expected_adler = (idat_buf[idat_pos - 4] << 24) |
                         (idat_buf[idat_pos - 3] << 16) |
                         (idat_buf[idat_pos - 2] << 8) |
                         idat_buf[idat_pos - 1]
    let computed_adler = compute_adler32(&raw_buf, raw_len)
    if expected_adler != computed_adler {
        return surface_new(1, 1)
    }

    reconstruct_scanlines(&raw_buf, raw_len, width, height, bpp)
}


// === FILE: stdlib/graphics/png_decode_test.sio ===
// Test for stdlib/graphics/png_decode.sio
//
// Encode a small test image, decode it, and verify pixel values.

use graphics::surface::{Surface, surface_new, surface_set_pixel}
use graphics::drawing::{Color, color_with_alpha}
use graphics::png::{png_encode_surface, png_encode_surface_rgba}
use graphics::png_decode::{png_decode_surface}

fn test_decode_rgb() -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    // Create a 4×4 RGB image with a diagonal pattern
    var s = surface_new(4, 4)
    let red = Color { r: 255, g: 0, b: 0, a: 255 }
    let green = Color { r: 0, g: 255, b: 0, a: 255 }
    let blue = Color { r: 0, g: 0, b: 255, a: 255 }
    let white = Color { r: 255, g: 255, b: 255, a: 255 }

    s = surface_set_pixel(s, 0, 0, red)
    s = surface_set_pixel(s, 1, 1, green)
    s = surface_set_pixel(s, 2, 2, blue)
    s = surface_set_pixel(s, 3, 3, white)

    let enc = png_encode_surface(&s, "/tmp/test_decode_rgb.png")
    if !enc {
        print("FAIL: encode RGB\n")
        return false
    }

    let d = png_decode_surface("/tmp/test_decode_rgb.png")
    if d.width != 4 || d.height != 4 {
        print("FAIL: decode RGB size mismatch\n")
        return false
    }

    // Check corner pixels
    if d.r[0] != 255 || d.g[0] != 0 || d.b[0] != 0 || d.a[0] != 255 {
        print("FAIL: decode RGB pixel (0,0)\n")
        return false
    }
    let idx11 = 1 * 4 + 1
    if d.r[idx11] != 0 || d.g[idx11] != 255 || d.b[idx11] != 0 || d.a[idx11] != 255 {
        print("FAIL: decode RGB pixel (1,1)\n")
        return false
    }
    let idx22 = 2 * 4 + 2
    if d.r[idx22] != 0 || d.g[idx22] != 0 || d.b[idx22] != 255 || d.a[idx22] != 255 {
        print("FAIL: decode RGB pixel (2,2)\n")
        return false
    }
    let idx33 = 3 * 4 + 3
    if d.r[idx33] != 255 || d.g[idx33] != 255 || d.b[idx33] != 255 || d.a[idx33] != 255 {
        print("FAIL: decode RGB pixel (3,3)\n")
        return false
    }

    print("PASS: decode RGB\n")
    true
}

fn test_decode_rgba() -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    // Create a 4×4 RGBA image with transparency
    var s = surface_new(4, 4)
    let semi_red = Color { r: 255, g: 0, b: 0, a: 128 }
    let semi_green = Color { r: 0, g: 255, b: 0, a: 64 }

    s = surface_set_pixel(s, 0, 0, semi_red)
    s = surface_set_pixel(s, 2, 2, semi_green)

    let enc = png_encode_surface_rgba(&s, "/tmp/test_decode_rgba.png")
    if !enc {
        print("FAIL: encode RGBA\n")
        return false
    }

    let d = png_decode_surface("/tmp/test_decode_rgba.png")
    if d.width != 4 || d.height != 4 {
        print("FAIL: decode RGBA size mismatch\n")
        return false
    }

    if d.r[0] != 255 || d.g[0] != 0 || d.b[0] != 0 || d.a[0] != 128 {
        print("FAIL: decode RGBA pixel (0,0)\n")
        return false
    }
    let idx22 = 2 * 4 + 2
    if d.r[idx22] != 0 || d.g[idx22] != 255 || d.b[idx22] != 0 || d.a[idx22] != 64 {
        print("FAIL: decode RGBA pixel (2,2)\n")
        return false
    }

    print("PASS: decode RGBA\n")
    true
}

fn test_decode_gradient() -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    // Create a 16×16 gradient to trigger stored blocks
    var s = surface_new(16, 16)
    var y: i64 = 0
    while y < 16 {
        var x: i64 = 0
        while x < 16 {
            let c = Color { r: x * 16, g: y * 16, b: 128, a: 255 }
            s = surface_set_pixel(s, x, y, c)
            x = x + 1
        }
        y = y + 1
    }

    let enc = png_encode_surface(&s, "/tmp/test_decode_grad.png")
    if !enc {
        print("FAIL: encode gradient\n")
        return false
    }

    let d = png_decode_surface("/tmp/test_decode_grad.png")
    if d.width != 16 || d.height != 16 {
        print("FAIL: decode gradient size mismatch\n")
        return false
    }

    // Spot-check a few pixels
    let idx55 = 5 * 16 + 5
    if d.r[idx55] != 80 || d.g[idx55] != 80 || d.b[idx55] != 128 || d.a[idx55] != 255 {
        print("FAIL: decode gradient pixel (5,5)\n")
        return false
    }
    let idx1515 = 15 * 16 + 15
    if d.r[idx1515] != 240 || d.g[idx1515] != 240 || d.b[idx1515] != 128 || d.a[idx1515] != 255 {
        print("FAIL: decode gradient pixel (15,15)\n")
        return false
    }

    print("PASS: decode gradient\n")
    true
}

pub fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var failures: i64 = 0
    if !test_decode_rgb() { failures = failures + 1 }
    if !test_decode_rgba() { failures = failures + 1 }
    if !test_decode_gradient() { failures = failures + 1 }

    if failures == 0 {
        print("ALL PASS\n")
        0
    } else {
        print("SOME FAILURES\n")
        1
    }
}

pub fn plot_line_raster_smooth(
    s: Surface,
    xs: &[f64; 256],
    ys: &[f64; 256],
    n: i64,
    config: QualityLinePlotConfig
) -> Surface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if n <= 0 { return s }

    var out = s
    let margin = sanitize_margin(config.margin, out.width, out.height)
    let plot_w = out.width - margin * 2
    let plot_h = out.height - margin * 2
    if plot_w <= 0 || plot_h <= 0 { return out }

    var xmin = xs[0]
    var xmax = xs[0]
    var ymin = ys[0]
    var ymax = ys[0]
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < n {
        if xs[i] < xmin { xmin = xs[i] }
        if xs[i] > xmax { xmax = xs[i] }
        if ys[i] < ymin { ymin = ys[i] }
        if ys[i] > ymax { ymax = ys[i] }
        i = i + 1
    }

    let x_range_raw = xmax - xmin
    let y_range_raw = ymax - ymin
    let x_range = if x_range_raw == 0.0 { 1.0 } else { x_range_raw }
    let y_range = if y_range_raw == 0.0 { 1.0 } else { y_range_raw }
    if x_range_raw == 0.0 {
        xmin = xmin - 0.5
        xmax = xmax + 0.5
    }
    if y_range_raw == 0.0 {
        ymin = ymin - 0.5
        ymax = ymax + 0.5
    }

    out = surface_draw_rect(out, 0, 0, out.width, out.height, config.bg_color)
    out = draw_quality_grid(out, margin, plot_w, plot_h, config)

    out = surface_draw_rect(out, margin, margin, 1, plot_h, config.axis_color)
    out = surface_draw_rect(out, margin, out.height - margin - 1, plot_w, 1, config.axis_color)

    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < n - 1 {
        let px0 = map_x(xs[j], xmin, x_range, margin, plot_w)
        let py0 = map_y(ys[j], ymin, y_range, out.height, margin, plot_h)
        let px1 = map_x(xs[j + 1], xmin, x_range, margin, plot_w)
        let py1 = map_y(ys[j + 1], ymin, y_range, out.height, margin, plot_h)
        out = surface_draw_line_smooth(out, px0, py0, px1, py1, config.line_color)
        j = j + 1
    }

    out
}

pub fn plot_heatmap_raster_smooth(
    s: Surface,
    data: &[f64; 4096],
    rows: i64,
    cols: i64,
    config: QualityHeatmapConfig
) -> Surface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if rows <= 0 || cols <= 0 { return s }

    var out = s
    let margin = sanitize_margin(config.margin, out.width, out.height)
    let plot_w = out.width - margin * 2
    let plot_h = out.height - margin * 2
    if plot_w <= 0 || plot_h <= 0 { return out }

    var min_val = data[0]
    var max_val = data[0]
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < rows * cols {
        if data[i] < min_val { min_val = data[i] }
        if data[i] > max_val { max_val = data[i] }
        i = i + 1
    }
    let range_raw = max_val - min_val
    let range = if range_raw == 0.0 { 1.0 } else { range_raw }

    out = surface_draw_rect(out, 0, 0, out.width, out.height, config.bg_color)

    var py_rel: i64 = 0
    while py_rel < plot_h {
        var px_rel: i64 = 0
        while px_rel < plot_w {
            let v = if config.smooth {
                sample_bilinear(data, rows, cols, px_rel, py_rel, plot_w, plot_h)
            } else {
                sample_nearest(data, rows, cols, px_rel, py_rel, plot_w, plot_h)
            }
            let t = (v - min_val) / range
            let c = quality_colormap_viridis(t)
            out = surface_blend_pixel(out, margin + px_rel, margin + py_rel, c, 255)
            px_rel = px_rel + 1
        }
        py_rel = py_rel + 1
    }

    out = surface_draw_rect(out, margin, margin, 1, plot_h, config.axis_color)
    out = surface_draw_rect(out, margin, out.height - margin - 1, plot_w, 1, config.axis_color)
    out
}

pub fn plot_contour_raster(
    s: Surface,
    data: &[f64; 4096],
    rows: i64,
    cols: i64,
    level: f64,
    config: QualityContourConfig
) -> Surface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if rows <= 1 || cols <= 1 { return s }

    var out = s
    let margin = sanitize_margin(config.margin, out.width, out.height)
    let plot_w = out.width - margin * 2
    let plot_h = out.height - margin * 2
    if plot_w <= 0 || plot_h <= 0 { return out }

    var r: i64 = 0
    while r < rows - 1 {
        var c: i64 = 0
        while c < cols - 1 {
            let v00 = data[r * cols + c]
            let v10 = data[r * cols + c + 1]
            let v01 = data[(r + 1) * cols + c]
            let v11 = data[(r + 1) * cols + c + 1]

            let x0 = margin + (c * plot_w) / (cols - 1)
            let x1 = margin + ((c + 1) * plot_w) / (cols - 1)
            let y0 = out.height - margin - 1 - (r * plot_h) / (rows - 1)
            let y1 = out.height - margin - 1 - ((r + 1) * plot_h) / (rows - 1)

            var xs: [i64; 4] = [0; 4]
            var ys: [i64; 4] = [0; 4]
            var count: i64 = 0

            if edge_crosses(v00, v10, level) {
                xs[count] = interp_i64(x0, x1, v00, v10, level)
                ys[count] = y0
                count = count + 1
            }
            if edge_crosses(v10, v11, level) {
                xs[count] = x1
                ys[count] = interp_i64(y0, y1, v10, v11, level)
                count = count + 1
            }
            if edge_crosses(v01, v11, level) {
                xs[count] = interp_i64(x0, x1, v01, v11, level)
                ys[count] = y1
                count = count + 1
            }
            if edge_crosses(v00, v01, level) {
                xs[count] = x0
                ys[count] = interp_i64(y0, y1, v00, v01, level)
                count = count + 1
            }

            if count >= 2 {
                out = surface_draw_line_smooth(out, xs[0], ys[0], xs[1], ys[1], config.line_color)
            }
            if count >= 4 {
                out = surface_draw_line_smooth(out, xs[2], ys[2], xs[3], ys[3], config.line_color)
            }

            c = c + 1
        }
        r = r + 1
    }

    out
}

pub fn plot_band_raster_smooth(
    s: Surface,
    xs: &[f64; 256],
    y_low: &[f64; 256],
    y_high: &[f64; 256],
    n: i64,
    config: QualityBandPlotConfig
) -> Surface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if n <= 0 { return s }

    var out = s
    let margin = sanitize_margin(config.margin, out.width, out.height)
    let plot_w = out.width - margin * 2
    let plot_h = out.height - margin * 2
    if plot_w <= 0 || plot_h <= 0 { return out }

    var xmin = xs[0]
    var xmax = xs[0]
    var ymin = y_low[0]
    var ymax = y_high[0]
    if y_high[0] < ymin { ymin = y_high[0] }
    if y_low[0] > ymax { ymax = y_low[0] }

    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < n {
        if xs[i] < xmin { xmin = xs[i] }
        if xs[i] > xmax { xmax = xs[i] }
        if y_low[i] < ymin { ymin = y_low[i] }
        if y_high[i] < ymin { ymin = y_high[i] }
        if y_low[i] > ymax { ymax = y_low[i] }
        if y_high[i] > ymax { ymax = y_high[i] }
        i = i + 1
    }

    let x_range_raw = xmax - xmin
    let y_range_raw = ymax - ymin
    let x_range = if x_range_raw == 0.0 { 1.0 } else { x_range_raw }
    let y_range = if y_range_raw == 0.0 { 1.0 } else { y_range_raw }
    if x_range_raw == 0.0 {
        xmin = xmin - 0.5
        xmax = xmax + 0.5
    }
    if y_range_raw == 0.0 {
        ymin = ymin - 0.5
        ymax = ymax + 0.5
    }

    out = surface_draw_rect(out, 0, 0, out.width, out.height, config.bg_color)

    let band_alpha = clamp_byte(config.band_alpha)
    let band = Color {
        r: blend_direct_channel(config.bg_color.r, config.band_color.r, band_alpha),
        g: blend_direct_channel(config.bg_color.g, config.band_color.g, band_alpha),
        b: blend_direct_channel(config.bg_color.b, config.band_color.b, band_alpha),
        a: 255,
    }

    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < n - 1 {
        let px0 = map_x(xs[j], xmin, x_range, margin, plot_w)
        let px1 = map_x(xs[j + 1], xmin, x_range, margin, plot_w)
        let low0 = map_y(y_low[j], ymin, y_range, out.height, margin, plot_h)
        let low1 = map_y(y_low[j + 1], ymin, y_range, out.height, margin, plot_h)
        let high0 = map_y(y_high[j], ymin, y_range, out.height, margin, plot_h)
        let high1 = map_y(y_high[j + 1], ymin, y_range, out.height, margin, plot_h)

        var xa = px0
        var xb = px1
        var l0 = low0
        var l1 = low1
        var h0 = high0
        var h1 = high1
        if xa > xb {
            xa = px1
            xb = px0
            l0 = low1
            l1 = low0
            h0 = high1
            h1 = high0
        }
        if xa < 0 { xa = 0 }
        if xb >= out.width { xb = out.width - 1 }

        let span = xb - xa
        var x = xa
        while x <= xb {
            let t = if span <= 0 { 0.0 } else { ((x - xa) as f64) / (span as f64) }
            let y_a = ((l0 as f64) * (1.0 - t) + (l1 as f64) * t) as i64
            let y_b = ((h0 as f64) * (1.0 - t) + (h1 as f64) * t) as i64
            var fy0 = y_a
            var fy1 = y_b
            if fy0 > fy1 {
                fy0 = y_b
                fy1 = y_a
            }
            if fy0 < 0 { fy0 = 0 }
            if fy1 >= out.height { fy1 = out.height - 1 }
            var fy = fy0
            var fy_guard: i64 = 0
            while fy <= fy1 && fy_guard < out.height {
                let idx = fy * out.width + x
                out.r[idx] = band.r
                out.g[idx] = band.g
                out.b[idx] = band.b
                out.a[idx] = band.a
                fy = fy + 1
                fy_guard = fy_guard + 1
            }
            x = x + 1
        }
        j = j + 1
    }

    out = surface_draw_rect(out, margin, margin, 1, plot_h, config.axis_color)
    out = surface_draw_rect(out, margin, out.height - margin - 1, plot_w, 1, config.axis_color)

    j = 0
    while j < n - 1 {
        let x0 = map_x(xs[j], xmin, x_range, margin, plot_w)
        let x1 = map_x(xs[j + 1], xmin, x_range, margin, plot_w)
        out = surface_draw_line_smooth(
            out,
            x0,
            map_y(y_low[j], ymin, y_range, out.height, margin, plot_h),
            x1,
            map_y(y_low[j + 1], ymin, y_range, out.height, margin, plot_h),
            config.line_color
        )
        out = surface_draw_line_smooth(
            out,
            x0,
            map_y(y_high[j], ymin, y_range, out.height, margin, plot_h),
            x1,
            map_y(y_high[j + 1], ymin, y_range, out.height, margin, plot_h),
            config.line_color
        )
        j = j + 1
    }

    out
}
