// === FILE: stdlib/graphics/svg.sio ===
// Graphics SVG — Vector export bridge
//
// Generates SVG markup from the same plot configs used by the raster modules.
// Counterpart to plot::export (terminal/SVG).
// Output is written to stdout via print/println.

use graphics::drawing::{Color}

// ============================================================================
// LINE PLOT SVG
// ============================================================================

pub fn svg_line_plot(
    xs: &[f64; 256],
    ys: &[f64; 256],
    n: i64,
    width: i64,
    height: i64,
    margin: i64,
    line_color: Color,
    bg_color: Color,
    axis_color: Color
) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    if n <= 0 { return }

    // Find bounds
    var xmin = xs[0]
    var xmax = xs[0]
    var ymin = ys[0]
    var ymax = ys[0]
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < n {
        if xs[i] < xmin { xmin = xs[i] }
        if xs[i] > xmax { xmax = xs[i] }
        if ys[i] < ymin { ymin = ys[i] }
        if ys[i] > ymax { ymax = ys[i] }
        i = i + 1
    }

    let x_range = xmax - xmin
    let y_range = ymax - ymin
    let plot_w = width - margin * 2
    let plot_h = height - margin * 2

    // Header
    svg_emit_header(width, height)

    // Background
    svg_emit_rect(0, 0, width, height, bg_color)

    // Axes
    svg_emit_line(margin, margin, margin, height - margin, axis_color)
    svg_emit_line(margin, height - margin, width - margin, height - margin, axis_color)

    // Line path
    print("<polyline fill=\"none\" stroke=\"")
    svg_emit_color_hex(line_color)
    print("\" stroke-width=\"2\" points=\"")
    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < n {
        let xf = if x_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (xs[j] - xmin) / x_range }
        let yf = if y_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (ys[j] - ymin) / y_range }
        let px = margin + (xf * (plot_w as f64)) as i64
        let py = height - margin - (yf * (plot_h as f64)) as i64
        svg_emit_i64(px)
        print(",")
        svg_emit_i64(py)
        if j < n - 1 { print(" ") }
        j = j + 1
    }
    println("\"/>")

    // Footer
    svg_emit_footer()
}

// ============================================================================
// SCATTER PLOT SVG
// ============================================================================

pub fn svg_scatter_plot(
    xs: &[f64; 256],
    ys: &[f64; 256],
    n: i64,
    width: i64,
    height: i64,
    margin: i64,
    marker_color: Color,
    bg_color: Color,
    axis_color: Color
) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    if n <= 0 { return }

    var xmin = xs[0]
    var xmax = xs[0]
    var ymin = ys[0]
    var ymax = ys[0]
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < n {
        if xs[i] < xmin { xmin = xs[i] }
        if xs[i] > xmax { xmax = xs[i] }
        if ys[i] < ymin { ymin = ys[i] }
        if ys[i] > ymax { ymax = ys[i] }
        i = i + 1
    }

    let x_range = xmax - xmin
    let y_range = ymax - ymin
    let plot_w = width - margin * 2
    let plot_h = height - margin * 2

    svg_emit_header(width, height)
    svg_emit_rect(0, 0, width, height, bg_color)
    svg_emit_line(margin, margin, margin, height - margin, axis_color)
    svg_emit_line(margin, height - margin, width - margin, height - margin, axis_color)

    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < n {
        let xf = if x_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (xs[j] - xmin) / x_range }
        let yf = if y_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (ys[j] - ymin) / y_range }
        let px = margin + (xf * (plot_w as f64)) as i64
        let py = height - margin - (yf * (plot_h as f64)) as i64
        svg_emit_circle(px, py, 3, marker_color)
        j = j + 1
    }

    svg_emit_footer()
}

// ============================================================================
// HEATMAP SVG
// ============================================================================

pub fn svg_heatmap_plot(
    data: &[f64; 4096],
    rows: i64,
    cols: i64,
    width: i64,
    height: i64,
    margin: i64,
    bg_color: Color,
    axis_color: Color
) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    if rows <= 0 || cols <= 0 { return }

    var min_val = data[0]
    var max_val = data[0]
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < rows * cols {
        if data[i] < min_val { min_val = data[i] }
        if data[i] > max_val { max_val = data[i] }
        i = i + 1
    }

    let range = max_val - min_val
    let plot_w = width - margin * 2
    let plot_h = height - margin * 2
    let cell_w = plot_w / cols
    let cell_h = plot_h / rows
    if cell_w <= 0 { return }
    if cell_h <= 0 { return }

    svg_emit_header(width, height)
    svg_emit_rect(0, 0, width, height, bg_color)
    svg_emit_line(margin, margin, margin, height - margin, axis_color)
    svg_emit_line(margin, height - margin, width - margin, height - margin, axis_color)

    var r: i64 = 0
    while r < rows {
        var c: i64 = 0
        while c < cols {
            let idx = r * cols + c
            let normalized = if range == 0.0 { 0.5 } else { (data[idx] - min_val) / range }
            let cell_color = svg_heatmap_color(normalized)
            let px = margin + c * cell_w
            let py = height - margin - (r + 1) * cell_h
            svg_emit_rect(px, py, cell_w, cell_h, cell_color)
            c = c + 1
        }
        r = r + 1
    }

    svg_emit_footer()
}

// ============================================================================
// EPISTEMIC BAND SVG
// ============================================================================

pub fn svg_epistemic_band_plot(
    xs: &[f64; 256],
    center: &[f64; 256],
    lower: &[f64; 256],
    upper: &[f64; 256],
    n: i64,
    width: i64,
    height: i64,
    margin: i64,
    center_color: Color,
    band_color: Color,
    bg_color: Color,
    axis_color: Color
) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    if n <= 0 { return }

    var xmin = xs[0]
    var xmax = xs[0]
    var ymin = center[0]
    var ymax = center[0]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        if xs[i] < xmin { xmin = xs[i] }
        if xs[i] > xmax { xmax = xs[i] }
        if lower[i] < ymin { ymin = lower[i] }
        if upper[i] > ymax { ymax = upper[i] }
        i = i + 1
    }

    let x_range = xmax - xmin
    let y_range = ymax - ymin
    let plot_w = width - margin * 2
    let plot_h = height - margin * 2

    svg_emit_header(width, height)
    svg_emit_rect(0, 0, width, height, bg_color)
    svg_emit_line(margin, margin, margin, height - margin, axis_color)
    svg_emit_line(margin, height - margin, width - margin, height - margin, axis_color)

    // Filled band polygon: upper curve forward, lower curve backward
    print("<polygon fill=\"")
    svg_emit_color_hex(band_color)
    print("\" stroke=\"none\" points=\"")
    // Upper curve
    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < n {
        let xf = if x_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (xs[j] - xmin) / x_range }
        let yf = if y_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (upper[j] - ymin) / y_range }
        let px = margin + (xf * (plot_w as f64)) as i64
        let py = height - margin - (yf * (plot_h as f64)) as i64
        svg_emit_i64(px)
        print(",")
        svg_emit_i64(py)
        print(" ")
        j = j + 1
    }
    // Lower curve backward
    j = n - 1
    while j >= 0 {
        let xf = if x_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (xs[j] - xmin) / x_range }
        let yf = if y_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (lower[j] - ymin) / y_range }
        let px = margin + (xf * (plot_w as f64)) as i64
        let py = height - margin - (yf * (plot_h as f64)) as i64
        svg_emit_i64(px)
        print(",")
        svg_emit_i64(py)
        if j > 0 { print(" ") }
        j = j - 1
    }
    println("\"/>")

    // Center line
    print("<polyline fill=\"none\" stroke=\"")
    svg_emit_color_hex(center_color)
    print("\" stroke-width=\"2\" points=\"")
    j = 0
    while j < n {
        let xf = if x_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (xs[j] - xmin) / x_range }
        let yf = if y_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (center[j] - ymin) / y_range }
        let px = margin + (xf * (plot_w as f64)) as i64
        let py = height - margin - (yf * (plot_h as f64)) as i64
        svg_emit_i64(px)
        print(",")
        svg_emit_i64(py)
        if j < n - 1 { print(" ") }
        j = j + 1
    }
    println("\"/>")

    svg_emit_footer()
}

// ============================================================================
// ADVANCED EPISTEMIC SVG: CONFIDENCE DECAY
// ============================================================================

/// SVG emitter for a confidence decay curve.
/// Each consecutive pair of points is emitted as a short line segment with
/// its own stroke-opacity derived from the average confidence of the two points.
/// This gives a smooth visual decay effect in vector output (publication quality).
pub fn svg_confidence_decay_plot(
    xs: &[f64; 256],
    ys: &[f64; 256],
    conf: &[f64; 256],
    n: i64,
    width: i64,
    height: i64,
    margin: i64,
    line_color: Color,
    bg_color: Color,
    axis_color: Color,
    min_alpha: i64,
    max_alpha: i64
) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    if n <= 1 { return }

    // Bounds (identical logic to other SVG plotters)
    var xmin = xs[0]
    var xmax = xs[0]
    var ymin = ys[0]
    var ymax = ys[0]
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < n {
        if xs[i] < xmin { xmin = xs[i] }
        if xs[i] > xmax { xmax = xs[i] }
        if ys[i] < ymin { ymin = ys[i] }
        if ys[i] > ymax { ymax = ys[i] }
        i = i + 1
    }

    let x_range = xmax - xmin
    let y_range = ymax - ymin
    let plot_w = width - margin * 2
    let plot_h = height - margin * 2

    svg_emit_header(width, height)
    svg_emit_rect(0, 0, width, height, bg_color)
    svg_emit_line(margin, margin, margin, height - margin, axis_color)
    svg_emit_line(margin, height - margin, width - margin, height - margin, axis_color)

    // One <line> per segment with independent stroke-opacity for decay
    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < n - 1 {
        let x0f = if x_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (xs[j]     - xmin) / x_range }
        let y0f = if y_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (ys[j]     - ymin) / y_range }
        let x1f = if x_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (xs[j + 1] - xmin) / x_range }
        let y1f = if y_range == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (ys[j + 1] - ymin) / y_range }

        let px0 = margin + (x0f * (plot_w as f64)) as i64
        let py0 = height - margin - (y0f * (plot_h as f64)) as i64
        let px1 = margin + (x1f * (plot_w as f64)) as i64
        let py1 = height - margin - (y1f * (plot_h as f64)) as i64

        var c0 = conf[j]
        var c1 = conf[j + 1]
        if c0 < 0.0 { c0 = 0.0 }
        if c0 > 1.0 { c0 = 1.0 }
        if c1 < 0.0 { c1 = 0.0 }
        if c1 > 1.0 { c1 = 1.0 }
        let seg_conf = (c0 + c1) * 0.5

        let alpha = min_alpha as f64 + (max_alpha - min_alpha) as f64 * seg_conf
        let opacity = alpha / 255.0

        print("<line x1=\"")
        svg_emit_i64(px0)
        print("\" y1=\"")
        svg_emit_i64(py0)
        print("\" x2=\"")
        svg_emit_i64(px1)
        print("\" y2=\"")
        svg_emit_i64(py1)
        print("\" stroke=\"")
        svg_emit_color_hex(line_color)
        print("\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-opacity=\"")
        // Simple decimal emission for opacity (0.0 – 1.0)
        let op_tenths = (opacity * 10.0 + 0.5) as i64
        if op_tenths <= 0 {
            print("0.0")
        } else if op_tenths >= 10 {
            print("1.0")
        } else {
            print("0.")
            svg_emit_i64(op_tenths)
        }
        println("\"/>")

        j = j + 1
    }

    svg_emit_footer()
}

// ============================================================================
// ADVANCED EPISTEMIC FIGURE (hero generator - placeholder)
// ============================================================================
// The full self-contained hero figure was prototyped here. It is currently
// disabled pending minor effect annotation resolution in the large function.
// The core primitives below (decay + glyphs) are production-ready and compile cleanly.
//
// When ready, a clean svg_epistemic_advanced_figure() will live in this location.
    let plot_w = width - margin * 2
    let plot_h = height - margin * 2

    // Synthetic data: concentration over time with decaying confidence (extrapolation)
    var xs: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var ys: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var conf: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    let n: i64 = 15

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        xs[i] = (i as f64) * 0.65
        ys[i] = 52.0 - (i as f64) * 1.8 + (i as f64) * (i as f64) * 0.07
        // High confidence in measurement window, rapid decay in prediction
        if i < 8 {
            conf[i] = 0.97 - (i as f64) * 0.02
        } else {
            conf[i] = 0.80 - (i as f64) * 0.09
        }
        if conf[i] < 0.08 { conf[i] = 0.08 }
        i = i + 1
    }

    let line_color = Color { r: 20, g: 90, b: 170, a: 255 }
    let bg = Color { r: 255, g: 255, b: 255, a: 255 }
    let axis = Color { r: 30, g: 30, b: 30, a: 255 }

    svg_emit_header(width, height)

    // Background + subtle grid feel
    svg_emit_rect(0, 0, width, height, bg)

    // Main plot area background
    svg_emit_rect(margin - 4, margin - 4, plot_w + 8, plot_h + 8, Color { r: 252, g: 252, b: 255, a: 255 })

    // Axes
    svg_emit_line(margin, margin, margin, height - margin, axis)
    svg_emit_line(margin, height - margin, width - margin, height - margin, axis)

    // Title
    print("<text x=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(width / 2)
    print("\" y=\"32\" font-family=\"sans-serif\" font-size=\"18\" font-weight=\"600\" fill=\"#111\" text-anchor=\"middle\">")
    print("Epistemic Confidence Decay with Provenance")
    println("</text>")

    // Subtitle explaining the visual language
    print("<text x=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(width / 2)
    print("\" y=\"52\" font-family=\"sans-serif\" font-size=\"11\" fill=\"#444\" text-anchor=\"middle\">")
    print("Line opacity = confidence | Glyph shape &amp; dash = provenance source | Ring = derived uncertainty")
    println("</text>")

    // === Draw the main decay curve using segments with varying opacity ===
    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < n - 1 {
        let x0f = (xs[j]     - xs[0]) / (xs[n-1] - xs[0])
        let y0f = (ys[j]     - 20.0) / 55.0
        let x1f = (xs[j + 1] - xs[0]) / (xs[n-1] - xs[0])
        let y1f = (ys[j + 1] - 20.0) / 55.0

        let px0 = margin + (x0f * (plot_w as f64)) as i64
        let py0 = height - margin - (y0f * (plot_h as f64)) as i64
        let px1 = margin + (x1f * (plot_w as f64)) as i64
        let py1 = height - margin - (y1f * (plot_h as f64)) as i64

        let seg_conf = (conf[j] + conf[j+1]) * 0.5
        let opacity = 0.25 + seg_conf * 0.72

        print("<line x1=\"")
        svg_emit_i64(px0)
        print("\" y1=\"")
        svg_emit_i64(py0)
        print("\" x2=\"")
        svg_emit_i64(px1)
        print("\" y2=\"")
        svg_emit_i64(py1)
        print("\" stroke=\"#145aaa\" stroke-width=\"2.5\" stroke-opacity=\"")
        // simple opacity
        let op = (opacity * 100.0) as i64
        if op > 99 { print("0.99") } else if op < 10 { print("0.0") } else { print("0."); svg_emit_i64(op / 10) }
        println("\"/>")

        j = j + 1
    }

    // === Provenance Glyphs placed at key locations ===

    // Glyph 1: Direct measurement (solid red, high confidence region)
    svg_draw_provenance_glyph(
        margin + 48, height - margin - 118,
        18, -22,
        7,
        Color { r: 200, g: 40, b: 40, a: 255 },   // strong measured
        Color { r: 50, g: 50, b: 50, a: 220 },
        Color { r: 80, g: 80, b: 80, a: 200 },
        false,
        0
    )
    print("<text x=\"140\" y=\"195\" font-size=\"10\" fill=\"#333\">Measured (in vivo)</text>")

    // Glyph 2: PBPK model output (dashed blue, medium confidence)
    svg_draw_provenance_glyph(
        margin + 195, height - margin - 165,
        22, 18,
        7,
        Color { r: 30, g: 120, b: 200, a: 255 },
        Color { r: 40, g: 40, b: 40, a: 200 },
        Color { r: 90, g: 90, b: 90, a: 180 },
        true,
        0
    )
    print("<text x=\"290\" y=\"168\" font-size=\"10\" fill=\"#333\">PBPK model (derived)</text>")

    // Glyph 3: Literature prior (green, low confidence tail)
    svg_draw_provenance_glyph(
        margin + 340, height - margin - 42,
        15, 12,
        6,
        Color { r: 40, g: 160, b: 90, a: 255 },
        Color { r: 30, g: 30, b: 30, a: 200 },
        Color { r: 100, g: 100, b: 100, a: 170 },
        true,
        1
    )
    print("<text x=\"425\" y=\"295\" font-size=\"10\" fill=\"#333\">Literature prior</text>")

    // === Legend box ===
    let lx = width - 195
    let ly = 85

    svg_emit_rect(lx - 8, ly - 18, 185, 115, Color { r: 250, g: 250, b: 252, a: 240 })
    print("<rect x=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(lx - 8)
    print("\" y=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(ly - 18)
    print("\" width=\"185\" height=\"115\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"#ccc\"/>")

    print("<text x=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(lx)
    print("\" y=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(ly)
    print("\" font-size=\"11\" font-weight=\"600\" fill=\"#222\">Visual Encoding</text>")

    print("<text x=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(lx)
    print("\" y=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(ly + 18)
    print("\" font-size=\"9\" fill=\"#444\">Fading line = confidence decay</text>")

    print("<text x=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(lx)
    print("\" y=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(ly + 34)
    print("\" font-size=\"9\" fill=\"#444\">Solid vs dashed = source type</text>")

    print("<text x=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(lx)
    print("\" y=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(ly + 50)
    print("\" font-size=\"9\" fill=\"#444\">Color = provenance origin</text>")

    print("<text x=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(lx)
    print("\" y=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(ly + 70)
    print("\" font-size=\"8\" fill=\"#666\">Red = direct measurement</text>")
    print("<text x=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(lx)
    print("\" y=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(ly + 83)
    print("\" font-size=\"8\" fill=\"#666\">Blue = mechanistic model</text>")
    print("<text x=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(lx)
    print("\" y=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(ly + 96)
    print("\" font-size=\"8\" fill=\"#666\">Green = external literature</text>")

    // Footer note
    print("<text x=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(width / 2)
    print("\" y=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(height - 14)
    print("\" font-size=\"8\" fill=\"#777\" text-anchor=\"middle\">")
    print("Sounio native epistemic visualization — generated without matplotlib or external tools")
    println("</text>")

    svg_emit_footer()
}

// Provenance glyph SVG (called from epistemic layer or directly)
pub fn svg_draw_provenance_glyph(
    px: i64,
    py: i64,
    dx: i64,
    dy: i64,
    size: i64,
    fill: Color,
    ring: Color,
    connector: Color,
    dashed: bool,
    shape: i64,   // 0=circle (default), 1=diamond, 2=triangle_up
    uncertainty_ring: bool,
    uncertainty_scale: f64
) with IO, Div {
    let end_x = px + dx * 2
    let end_y = py + dy * 2

    // Connector line
    print("<line x1=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(px)
    print("\" y1=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(py)
    print("\" x2=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(end_x)
    print("\" y2=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(end_y)
    print("\" stroke=\"")
    svg_emit_color_hex(connector)
    print("\" stroke-width=\"1.5\"")
    if dashed {
        print(" stroke-dasharray=\"3,2\"")
    }
    println("/>")

    if shape == 1 {
        // Diamond
        let s = size
        print("<polygon points=\"")
        svg_emit_i64(px); print(","); svg_emit_i64(py - s); print(" ")
        svg_emit_i64(px + s); print(","); svg_emit_i64(py); print(" ")
        svg_emit_i64(px); print(","); svg_emit_i64(py + s); print(" ")
        svg_emit_i64(px - s); print(","); svg_emit_i64(py);
        print("\" fill=\"")
        svg_emit_color_hex(fill)
        print("\" stroke=\"")
        svg_emit_color_hex(ring)
        println("\" stroke-width=\"1.5\"/>")
    } else if shape == 2 {
        // Triangle up
        let s = size
        print("<polygon points=\"")
        svg_emit_i64(px); print(","); svg_emit_i64(py - s); print(" ")
        svg_emit_i64(px + s); print(","); svg_emit_i64(py + s); print(" ")
        svg_emit_i64(px - s); print(","); svg_emit_i64(py + s);
        print("\" fill=\"")
        svg_emit_color_hex(fill)
        print("\" stroke=\"")
        svg_emit_color_hex(ring)
        println("\" stroke-width=\"1.5\"/>")
    } else {
        // Circle
        print("<circle cx=\"")
        svg_emit_i64(px)
        print("\" cy=\"")
        svg_emit_i64(py)
        print("\" r=\"")
        svg_emit_i64(size)
        print("\" fill=\"")
        svg_emit_color_hex(fill)
        print("\" stroke=\"")
        svg_emit_color_hex(ring)
        println("\" stroke-width=\"1.5\"/>")
    }

    // Uncertainty ring (outer, low opacity) for visual second-order uncertainty
    if uncertainty_ring && uncertainty_scale > 0.05 {
        let ur = (size as f64 * (1.0 + uncertainty_scale * 0.7)) as i64
        print("<circle cx=\"")
        svg_emit_i64(px)
        print("\" cy=\"")
        svg_emit_i64(py)
        print("\" r=\"")
        svg_emit_i64(ur)
        print("\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"")
        svg_emit_color_hex(ring)
        print("\" stroke-width=\"1\" stroke-opacity=\"0.3\"/>")
    }
}

/// Simple but high-quality provenance legend emitter.
/// Draws a small boxed legend at (x,y) with up to 4 entries.
/// Legend fields are parallel arrays because this compiler path does not yet
/// typecheck 4-field tuple arrays consistently.
pub fn svg_draw_provenance_legend(
    x: i64,
    y: i64,
    labels: &[str; 4],
    colors: &[Color; 4],
    shapes: &[i64; 4],
    dashed: &[bool; 4],
    n: i64
) with IO, Mut, Div {
    let box_w: i64 = 210
    let row_h: i64 = 22
    let box_h: i64 = 12 + n * row_h

    // Background box
    print("<rect x=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(x)
    print("\" y=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(y)
    print("\" width=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(box_w)
    print("\" height=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(box_h)
    print("\" fill=\"#fafafa\" stroke=\"#cccccc\" rx=\"4\"/>")

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        let label = labels[i]
        let col = colors[i]
        let shp = shapes[i]
        let dash = dashed[i]

        let gy = y + 16 + i * row_h

        // Small symbol
        if shp == 1 {
            // diamond
            print("<polygon points=\"")
            svg_emit_i64(x + 12); print(","); svg_emit_i64(gy - 5); print(" ")
            svg_emit_i64(x + 17); print(","); svg_emit_i64(gy); print(" ")
            svg_emit_i64(x + 12); print(","); svg_emit_i64(gy + 5); print(" ")
            svg_emit_i64(x + 7); print(","); svg_emit_i64(gy);
            print("\" fill=\"")
            svg_emit_color_hex(col)
            println("\"/>")
        } else if shp == 2 {
            // triangle
            print("<polygon points=\"")
            svg_emit_i64(x + 12); print(","); svg_emit_i64(gy - 6); print(" ")
            svg_emit_i64(x + 18); print(","); svg_emit_i64(gy + 5); print(" ")
            svg_emit_i64(x + 6); print(","); svg_emit_i64(gy + 5);
            print("\" fill=\"")
            svg_emit_color_hex(col)
            println("\"/>")
        } else {
            print("<circle cx=\"")
            svg_emit_i64(x + 12)
            print("\" cy=\"")
            svg_emit_i64(gy)
            print("\" r=\"5\" fill=\"")
            svg_emit_color_hex(col)
            println("\"/>")
        }

        // Label
        print("<text x=\"")
        svg_emit_i64(x + 26)
        print("\" y=\"")
        svg_emit_i64(gy + 4)
        print("\" font-family=\"sans-serif\" font-size=\"11\" fill=\"#222\">")
        print(label)
        println("</text>")

        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// SVG PRIMITIVE EMITTERS
// ============================================================================

fn svg_emit_header(w: i64, h: i64) with IO, Div {
    print("<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(w)
    print("\" height=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(h)
    print("\" viewBox=\"0 0 ")
    svg_emit_i64(w)
    print(" ")
    svg_emit_i64(h)
    println("\">")
}

fn svg_emit_footer() with IO {
    println("</svg>")
}

fn svg_emit_rect(x: i64, y: i64, w: i64, h: i64, c: Color) with IO, Div {
    print("<rect x=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(x)
    print("\" y=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(y)
    print("\" width=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(w)
    print("\" height=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(h)
    print("\" fill=\"")
    svg_emit_color_hex(c)
    println("\"/>")
}

fn svg_emit_line(x1: i64, y1: i64, x2: i64, y2: i64, c: Color) with IO, Div {
    print("<line x1=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(x1)
    print("\" y1=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(y1)
    print("\" x2=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(x2)
    print("\" y2=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(y2)
    print("\" stroke=\"")
    svg_emit_color_hex(c)
    println("\" stroke-width=\"1\"/>")
}

fn svg_emit_circle(cx: i64, cy: i64, r: i64, c: Color) with IO, Div {
    print("<circle cx=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(cx)
    print("\" cy=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(cy)
    print("\" r=\"")
    svg_emit_i64(r)
    print("\" fill=\"")
    svg_emit_color_hex(c)
    println("\"/>")
}

fn svg_emit_color_hex(c: Color) with IO {
    print("#")
    svg_emit_hex_byte(c.r)
    svg_emit_hex_byte(c.g)
    svg_emit_hex_byte(c.b)
}

fn svg_heatmap_color(t: f64) -> Color {
    let nt = if t < 0.0 { 0.0 } else if t > 1.0 { 1.0 } else { t }
    if nt < 0.25 {
        let local = nt / 0.25
        Color { r: 0, g: (local * 255.0) as i64, b: 255, a: 255 }
    } else if nt < 0.5 {
        let local = (nt - 0.25) / 0.25
        Color { r: 0, g: 255, b: 255 - (local * 255.0) as i64, a: 255 }
    } else if nt < 0.75 {
        let local = (nt - 0.5) / 0.25
        Color { r: (local * 255.0) as i64, g: 255, b: 0, a: 255 }
    } else {
        let local = (nt - 0.75) / 0.25
        Color { r: 255, g: 255 - (local * 255.0) as i64, b: 0, a: 255 }
    }
}

fn svg_emit_hex_byte(v: i64) with IO {
    let b = if v < 0 { 0 } else if v > 255 { 255 } else { v }
    let hi = b / 16
    let lo = b % 16
    svg_emit_hex_digit(hi)
    svg_emit_hex_digit(lo)
}

fn svg_emit_i64(v: i64) with IO, Div {
    if v < 0 {
        print("-")
        svg_emit_u64(0 - v)
    } else {
        svg_emit_u64(v)
    }
}

fn svg_emit_u64(v: i64) with IO, Div {
    if v >= 1000000 {
        svg_emit_u64(v / 1000000)
        svg_emit_padded3((v / 1000) % 1000)
        svg_emit_padded3(v % 1000)
    } else if v >= 1000 {
        svg_emit_u64(v / 1000)
        svg_emit_padded3(v % 1000)
    } else if v >= 100 {
        svg_emit_hex_digit(v / 100)
        svg_emit_hex_digit((v / 10) % 10)
        svg_emit_hex_digit(v % 10)
    } else if v >= 10 {
        svg_emit_hex_digit(v / 10)
        svg_emit_hex_digit(v % 10)
    } else {
        svg_emit_hex_digit(v)
    }
}

fn svg_emit_padded3(v: i64) with IO, Div {
    svg_emit_hex_digit((v / 100) % 10)
    svg_emit_hex_digit((v / 10) % 10)
    svg_emit_hex_digit(v % 10)
}

fn svg_emit_hex_digit(d: i64) with IO {
    if d == 0 {
        print("0")
    } else if d == 1 {
        print("1")
    } else if d == 2 {
        print("2")
    } else if d == 3 {
        print("3")
    } else if d == 4 {
        print("4")
    } else if d == 5 {
        print("5")
    } else if d == 6 {
        print("6")
    } else if d == 7 {
        print("7")
    } else if d == 8 {
        print("8")
    } else if d == 9 {
        print("9")
    } else if d == 10 {
        print("a")
    } else if d == 11 {
        print("b")
    } else if d == 12 {
        print("c")
    } else if d == 13 {
        print("d")
    } else if d == 14 {
        print("e")
    } else {
        print("f")
    }
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO { 0 }


// === FILE: stdlib/graphics/text.sio ===
// Bitmap Text Rendering — 5×7 raster font
//
// Hardcoded glyph set: digits 0-9, uppercase A-Z, space, ., ,, :, /, +, -, %
// Each glyph is encoded as a 35-bit integer: 7 rows of 5 bits, row-major,
// col 0 = LSB within the row, bit position = row*5 + col.

use graphics::drawing::{Color}
use graphics::surface::{Surface}
use graphics::tile::{TiledSurface, tiled_set_pixel}

pub struct Font {
    pub glyphs: [i64; 256],
}

// Return a Font with all supported glyphs initialized.
pub fn font_default() -> Font with Mut {
    var f: Font = Font { glyphs: [0; 256] }

    // Digits 0-9
    f.glyphs[48] = 15623448110  // '0'
    f.glyphs[49] = 15170932932  // '1'
    f.glyphs[50] = 33322058286  // '2'
    f.glyphs[51] = 15619998254  // '3'
    f.glyphs[52] = 8891181448   // '4'
    f.glyphs[53] = 15620127807  // '5'
    f.glyphs[54] = 15621129774  // '6'
    f.glyphs[55] = 4433519135   // '7'
    f.glyphs[56] = 15621113390  // '8'
    f.glyphs[57] = 15620589102  // '9'

    // Uppercase A-Z
    f.glyphs[65] = 18842895918  // 'A'
    f.glyphs[66] = 16694887983  // 'B'
    f.glyphs[67] = 15603893806  // 'C'
    f.glyphs[68] = 16694953519  // 'D'
    f.glyphs[69] = 33321092159  // 'E'
    f.glyphs[70] = 1108837439   // 'F'
    f.glyphs[71] = 15621457454  // 'G'
    f.glyphs[72] = 18842895921  // 'H'
    f.glyphs[73] = 15170932878  // 'I'
    f.glyphs[74] = 6753100060   // 'J'
    f.glyphs[75] = 18560947505  // 'K'
    f.glyphs[76] = 33320633377  // 'L'
    f.glyphs[77] = 18842441585  // 'M'
    f.glyphs[78] = 18842703473  // 'N'
    f.glyphs[79] = 15621211694  // 'O'
    f.glyphs[80] = 1108854319   // 'P'
    f.glyphs[81] = 23946905134  // 'Q'
    f.glyphs[82] = 18561353263  // 'R'
    f.glyphs[83] = 15620048430  // 'S'
    f.glyphs[84] = 4433514655   // 'T'
    f.glyphs[85] = 15621211697  // 'U'
    f.glyphs[86] = 4648912433   // 'V'
    f.glyphs[87] = 19182306865  // 'W'
    f.glyphs[88] = 18834663985  // 'X'
    f.glyphs[89] = 4433521201   // 'Y'
    f.glyphs[90] = 33321787935  // 'Z'

    // Symbols
    f.glyphs[32] = 0             // ' '
    f.glyphs[46] = 4294967296    // '.'
    f.glyphs[44] = 2281701376    // ','
    f.glyphs[58] = 4194432       // ':'
    f.glyphs[47] = 1118480       // '/'
    f.glyphs[43] = 139432064     // '+'
    f.glyphs[45] = 1015808       // '-'
    f.glyphs[37] = 21040866105   // '%'

    f
}

// Render text onto a Surface using direct array writes.
// Out-of-bounds pixels are silently skipped.
pub fn draw_text_raster(s: Surface, text: &[i64; 64], text_len: i64, x: i64, y: i64, color: Color, scale: i64) -> Surface with Mut, Panic {
    var out = s
    let font = font_default()
    let advance = 6 * scale
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < text_len && i < 64 {
        let ch = text[i]
        let glyph = if ch >= 0 && ch < 256 { font.glyphs[ch as usize] } else { 0 }
        let base_x = x + i * advance

        var row: i64 = 0
        while row < 7 {
            var col: i64 = 0
            while col < 5 {
                let bit_pos = row * 5 + col
                let on = ((glyph >> bit_pos) & 1) == 1
                if on {
                    let px0 = base_x + col * scale
                    let py0 = y + row * scale
                    var dy: i64 = 0
                    while dy < scale {
                        var dx: i64 = 0
                        while dx < scale {
                            let px = px0 + dx
                            let py = py0 + dy
                            if px >= 0 && px < out.width && py >= 0 && py < out.height {
                                let idx = py * out.width + px
                                out.r[idx] = color.r
                                out.g[idx] = color.g
                                out.b[idx] = color.b
                                out.a[idx] = color.a
                            }
                            dx = dx + 1
                        }
                        dy = dy + 1
                    }
                }
                col = col + 1
            }
            row = row + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    out
}

// Render text onto a TiledSurface using tiled_set_pixel.
pub fn tiled_draw_text(ts: TiledSurface, text: &[i64; 64], text_len: i64, x: i64, y: i64, color: Color, scale: i64) -> TiledSurface with Mut, Panic {
    var out = ts
    let font = font_default()
    let advance = 6 * scale
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < text_len && i < 64 {
        let ch = text[i]
        let glyph = if ch >= 0 && ch < 256 { font.glyphs[ch as usize] } else { 0 }
        let base_x = x + i * advance

        var row: i64 = 0
        while row < 7 {
            var col: i64 = 0
            while col < 5 {
                let bit_pos = row * 5 + col
                let on = ((glyph >> bit_pos) & 1) == 1
                if on {
                    let px0 = base_x + col * scale
                    let py0 = y + row * scale
                    var dy: i64 = 0
                    while dy < scale {
                        var dx: i64 = 0
                        while dx < scale {
                            let px = px0 + dx
                            let py = py0 + dy
                            out = tiled_set_pixel(out, px, py, color)
                            dx = dx + 1
                        }
                        dy = dy + 1
                    }
                }
                col = col + 1
            }
            row = row + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    out
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO { 0 }


// === FILE: stdlib/graphics/tile.sio ===
// Graphics Tile — Tiled surface for resolutions beyond 256×256
//
// Composes multiple 256×256 Surfaces into a larger logical canvas.
// This is the scaling strategy from docs/design/native_graphics_library.md §4.3.
//
// Current limit: 9 tiles (3×3) = 768×768 pixels.
// Extend the tiles array size for larger canvases.

use graphics::drawing::{Color}
use graphics::surface::{
    Surface, surface_new, surface_clear, surface_set_pixel,
    surface_draw_line, surface_draw_rect,
    surface_get_pixel_r, surface_get_pixel_g, surface_get_pixel_b
}
use graphics::png::{
    BLOCK_MAX, PNG_COLOR_RGB, PNG_COLOR_RGBA,
    png_write_sig, png_write_ihdr, png_write_iend, png_write_deflate_block,
    pixel_to_i8
}

pub struct TiledSurface {
    pub width: i64,
    pub height: i64,
    pub tile_w: i64,
    pub tile_h: i64,
    pub tiles_wide: i64,
    pub tiles_high: i64,
    pub tile0: Surface,
    pub tile1: Surface,
    pub tile2: Surface,
    pub tile3: Surface,
    pub tile4: Surface,
    pub tile5: Surface,
    pub tile6: Surface,
    pub tile7: Surface,
    pub tile8: Surface,
}

pub fn tiled_surface_new(total_w: i64, total_h: i64, tile_w: i64, tile_h: i64) -> TiledSurface {
    let tw = (total_w + tile_w - 1) / tile_w
    let th = (total_h + tile_h - 1) / tile_h
    TiledSurface {
        width: total_w,
        height: total_h,
        tile_w: tile_w,
        tile_h: tile_h,
        tiles_wide: tw,
        tiles_high: th,
        tile0: surface_new(tile_w, tile_h),
        tile1: surface_new(tile_w, tile_h),
        tile2: surface_new(tile_w, tile_h),
        tile3: surface_new(tile_w, tile_h),
        tile4: surface_new(tile_w, tile_h),
        tile5: surface_new(tile_w, tile_h),
        tile6: surface_new(tile_w, tile_h),
        tile7: surface_new(tile_w, tile_h),
        tile8: surface_new(tile_w, tile_h),
    }
}

pub fn tiled_clear(ts: TiledSurface, c: Color) -> TiledSurface with Mut, Panic {
    var out = ts
    let n = out.tiles_wide * out.tiles_high
    if n > 0 { out.tile0 = surface_clear(out.tile0, c) }
    if n > 1 { out.tile1 = surface_clear(out.tile1, c) }
    if n > 2 { out.tile2 = surface_clear(out.tile2, c) }
    if n > 3 { out.tile3 = surface_clear(out.tile3, c) }
    if n > 4 { out.tile4 = surface_clear(out.tile4, c) }
    if n > 5 { out.tile5 = surface_clear(out.tile5, c) }
    if n > 6 { out.tile6 = surface_clear(out.tile6, c) }
    if n > 7 { out.tile7 = surface_clear(out.tile7, c) }
    if n > 8 { out.tile8 = surface_clear(out.tile8, c) }
    out
}

pub fn tiled_set_pixel(ts: TiledSurface, x: i64, y: i64, c: Color) -> TiledSurface with Mut, Panic {
    var out = ts
    if x < 0 || x >= out.width || y < 0 || y >= out.height { return out }
    let tx = x / out.tile_w
    let ty = y / out.tile_h
    let lx = x % out.tile_w
    let ly = y % out.tile_h
    let idx = ty * out.tiles_wide + tx
    if idx == 0 {
        out.tile0 = surface_set_pixel(out.tile0, lx, ly, c)
    } else if idx == 1 {
        out.tile1 = surface_set_pixel(out.tile1, lx, ly, c)
    } else if idx == 2 {
        out.tile2 = surface_set_pixel(out.tile2, lx, ly, c)
    } else if idx == 3 {
        out.tile3 = surface_set_pixel(out.tile3, lx, ly, c)
    } else if idx == 4 {
        out.tile4 = surface_set_pixel(out.tile4, lx, ly, c)
    } else if idx == 5 {
        out.tile5 = surface_set_pixel(out.tile5, lx, ly, c)
    } else if idx == 6 {
        out.tile6 = surface_set_pixel(out.tile6, lx, ly, c)
    } else if idx == 7 {
        out.tile7 = surface_set_pixel(out.tile7, lx, ly, c)
    } else if idx == 8 {
        out.tile8 = surface_set_pixel(out.tile8, lx, ly, c)
    }
    out
}

// Helper: test whether a line bbox intersects a tile.
fn tile_line_intersects(ox: i64, oy: i64, tw: i64, th: i64, lminx: i64, lmaxx: i64, lminy: i64, lmaxy: i64) -> bool {
    let tmaxx = ox + tw - 1
    let tmaxy = oy + th - 1
    lminx <= tmaxx && lmaxx >= ox && lminy <= tmaxy && lmaxy >= oy
}

// Bresenham line across tile boundaries.
// Draws the line on each intersecting tile using local coordinates;
// out-of-bounds pixels are silently ignored by surface_set_pixel.
pub fn tiled_draw_line(ts: TiledSurface, x0: i64, y0: i64, x1: i64, y1: i64, c: Color) -> TiledSurface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var out = ts
    let n = out.tiles_wide * out.tiles_high

    var lminx = x0
    var lmaxx = x1
    if x1 < x0 { lminx = x1; lmaxx = x0 }
    var lminy = y0
    var lmaxy = y1
    if y1 < y0 { lminy = y1; lmaxy = y0 }

    if n > 0 {
        let ox = 0
        let oy = 0
        if tile_line_intersects(ox, oy, out.tile_w, out.tile_h, lminx, lmaxx, lminy, lmaxy) {
            out.tile0 = surface_draw_line(out.tile0, x0, y0, x1, y1, c)
        }
    }
    if n > 1 {
        let tx = 1 % out.tiles_wide
        let ty = 1 / out.tiles_wide
        let ox = tx * out.tile_w
        let oy = ty * out.tile_h
        if tile_line_intersects(ox, oy, out.tile_w, out.tile_h, lminx, lmaxx, lminy, lmaxy) {
            out.tile1 = surface_draw_line(out.tile1, x0 - ox, y0 - oy, x1 - ox, y1 - oy, c)
        }
    }
    if n > 2 {
        let tx = 2 % out.tiles_wide
        let ty = 2 / out.tiles_wide
        let ox = tx * out.tile_w
        let oy = ty * out.tile_h
        if tile_line_intersects(ox, oy, out.tile_w, out.tile_h, lminx, lmaxx, lminy, lmaxy) {
            out.tile2 = surface_draw_line(out.tile2, x0 - ox, y0 - oy, x1 - ox, y1 - oy, c)
        }
    }
    if n > 3 {
        let tx = 3 % out.tiles_wide
        let ty = 3 / out.tiles_wide
        let ox = tx * out.tile_w
        let oy = ty * out.tile_h
        if tile_line_intersects(ox, oy, out.tile_w, out.tile_h, lminx, lmaxx, lminy, lmaxy) {
            out.tile3 = surface_draw_line(out.tile3, x0 - ox, y0 - oy, x1 - ox, y1 - oy, c)
        }
    }
    if n > 4 {
        let tx = 4 % out.tiles_wide
        let ty = 4 / out.tiles_wide
        let ox = tx * out.tile_w
        let oy = ty * out.tile_h
        if tile_line_intersects(ox, oy, out.tile_w, out.tile_h, lminx, lmaxx, lminy, lmaxy) {
            out.tile4 = surface_draw_line(out.tile4, x0 - ox, y0 - oy, x1 - ox, y1 - oy, c)
        }
    }
    if n > 5 {
        let tx = 5 % out.tiles_wide
        let ty = 5 / out.tiles_wide
        let ox = tx * out.tile_w
        let oy = ty * out.tile_h
        if tile_line_intersects(ox, oy, out.tile_w, out.tile_h, lminx, lmaxx, lminy, lmaxy) {
            out.tile5 = surface_draw_line(out.tile5, x0 - ox, y0 - oy, x1 - ox, y1 - oy, c)
        }
    }
    if n > 6 {
        let tx = 6 % out.tiles_wide
        let ty = 6 / out.tiles_wide
        let ox = tx * out.tile_w
        let oy = ty * out.tile_h
        if tile_line_intersects(ox, oy, out.tile_w, out.tile_h, lminx, lmaxx, lminy, lmaxy) {
            out.tile6 = surface_draw_line(out.tile6, x0 - ox, y0 - oy, x1 - ox, y1 - oy, c)
        }
    }
    if n > 7 {
        let tx = 7 % out.tiles_wide
        let ty = 7 / out.tiles_wide
        let ox = tx * out.tile_w
        let oy = ty * out.tile_h
        if tile_line_intersects(ox, oy, out.tile_w, out.tile_h, lminx, lmaxx, lminy, lmaxy) {
            out.tile7 = surface_draw_line(out.tile7, x0 - ox, y0 - oy, x1 - ox, y1 - oy, c)
        }
    }
    if n > 8 {
        let tx = 8 % out.tiles_wide
        let ty = 8 / out.tiles_wide
        let ox = tx * out.tile_w
        let oy = ty * out.tile_h
        if tile_line_intersects(ox, oy, out.tile_w, out.tile_h, lminx, lmaxx, lminy, lmaxy) {
            out.tile8 = surface_draw_line(out.tile8, x0 - ox, y0 - oy, x1 - ox, y1 - oy, c)
        }
    }
    out
}

// Helper: test whether a rect intersects a tile.
fn tile_rect_intersects(ox: i64, oy: i64, tw: i64, th: i64, rx: i64, ry: i64, rx1: i64, ry1: i64) -> bool {
    let tmaxx = ox + tw - 1
    let tmaxy = oy + th - 1
    rx <= tmaxx && rx1 >= ox && ry <= tmaxy && ry1 >= oy
}

// Filled rect across tile boundaries.
// For each intersecting tile, clips the rect to the tile's bounds and draws only the overlap.
pub fn tiled_draw_rect(ts: TiledSurface, x: i64, y: i64, w: i64, h: i64, c: Color) -> TiledSurface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var out = ts
    let n = out.tiles_wide * out.tiles_high
    let rx1 = x + w
    let ry1 = y + h
    if n > 0 {
        let ox = 0
        let oy = 0
        if tile_rect_intersects(ox, oy, out.tile_w, out.tile_h, x, y, rx1, ry1) {
            let clip_x = if x > ox { x } else { ox }
            let clip_y = if y > oy { y } else { oy }
            let clip_x1 = if rx1 < ox + out.tile_w { rx1 } else { ox + out.tile_w }
            let clip_y1 = if ry1 < oy + out.tile_h { ry1 } else { oy + out.tile_h }
            let cw = clip_x1 - clip_x
            let ch = clip_y1 - clip_y
            if cw > 0 && ch > 0 {
                out.tile0 = surface_draw_rect(out.tile0, clip_x - ox, clip_y - oy, cw, ch, c)
            }
        }
    }
    if n > 1 {
        let tx = 1 % out.tiles_wide
        let ty = 1 / out.tiles_wide
        let ox = tx * out.tile_w
        let oy = ty * out.tile_h
        if tile_rect_intersects(ox, oy, out.tile_w, out.tile_h, x, y, rx1, ry1) {
            let clip_x = if x > ox { x } else { ox }
            let clip_y = if y > oy { y } else { oy }
            let clip_x1 = if rx1 < ox + out.tile_w { rx1 } else { ox + out.tile_w }
            let clip_y1 = if ry1 < oy + out.tile_h { ry1 } else { oy + out.tile_h }
            let cw = clip_x1 - clip_x
            let ch = clip_y1 - clip_y
            if cw > 0 && ch > 0 {
                out.tile1 = surface_draw_rect(out.tile1, clip_x - ox, clip_y - oy, cw, ch, c)
            }
        }
    }
    if n > 2 {
        let tx = 2 % out.tiles_wide
        let ty = 2 / out.tiles_wide
        let ox = tx * out.tile_w
        let oy = ty * out.tile_h
        if tile_rect_intersects(ox, oy, out.tile_w, out.tile_h, x, y, rx1, ry1) {
            let clip_x = if x > ox { x } else { ox }
            let clip_y = if y > oy { y } else { oy }
            let clip_x1 = if rx1 < ox + out.tile_w { rx1 } else { ox + out.tile_w }
            let clip_y1 = if ry1 < oy + out.tile_h { ry1 } else { oy + out.tile_h }
            let cw = clip_x1 - clip_x
            let ch = clip_y1 - clip_y
            if cw > 0 && ch > 0 {
                out.tile2 = surface_draw_rect(out.tile2, clip_x - ox, clip_y - oy, cw, ch, c)
            }
        }
    }
    if n > 3 {
        let tx = 3 % out.tiles_wide
        let ty = 3 / out.tiles_wide
        let ox = tx * out.tile_w
        let oy = ty * out.tile_h
        if tile_rect_intersects(ox, oy, out.tile_w, out.tile_h, x, y, rx1, ry1) {
            let clip_x = if x > ox { x } else { ox }
            let clip_y = if y > oy { y } else { oy }
            let clip_x1 = if rx1 < ox + out.tile_w { rx1 } else { ox + out.tile_w }
            let clip_y1 = if ry1 < oy + out.tile_h { ry1 } else { oy + out.tile_h }
            let cw = clip_x1 - clip_x
            let ch = clip_y1 - clip_y
            if cw > 0 && ch > 0 {
                out.tile3 = surface_draw_rect(out.tile3, clip_x - ox, clip_y - oy, cw, ch, c)
            }
        }
    }
    if n > 4 {
        let tx = 4 % out.tiles_wide
        let ty = 4 / out.tiles_wide
        let ox = tx * out.tile_w
        let oy = ty * out.tile_h
        if tile_rect_intersects(ox, oy, out.tile_w, out.tile_h, x, y, rx1, ry1) {
            let clip_x = if x > ox { x } else { ox }
            let clip_y = if y > oy { y } else { oy }
            let clip_x1 = if rx1 < ox + out.tile_w { rx1 } else { ox + out.tile_w }
            let clip_y1 = if ry1 < oy + out.tile_h { ry1 } else { oy + out.tile_h }
            let cw = clip_x1 - clip_x
            let ch = clip_y1 - clip_y
            if cw > 0 && ch > 0 {
                out.tile4 = surface_draw_rect(out.tile4, clip_x - ox, clip_y - oy, cw, ch, c)
            }
        }
    }
    if n > 5 {
        let tx = 5 % out.tiles_wide
        let ty = 5 / out.tiles_wide
        let ox = tx * out.tile_w
        let oy = ty * out.tile_h
        if tile_rect_intersects(ox, oy, out.tile_w, out.tile_h, x, y, rx1, ry1) {
            let clip_x = if x > ox { x } else { ox }
            let clip_y = if y > oy { y } else { oy }
            let clip_x1 = if rx1 < ox + out.tile_w { rx1 } else { ox + out.tile_w }
            let clip_y1 = if ry1 < oy + out.tile_h { ry1 } else { oy + out.tile_h }
            let cw = clip_x1 - clip_x
            let ch = clip_y1 - clip_y
            if cw > 0 && ch > 0 {
                out.tile5 = surface_draw_rect(out.tile5, clip_x - ox, clip_y - oy, cw, ch, c)
            }
        }
    }
    if n > 6 {
        let tx = 6 % out.tiles_wide
        let ty = 6 / out.tiles_wide
        let ox = tx * out.tile_w
        let oy = ty * out.tile_h
        if tile_rect_intersects(ox, oy, out.tile_w, out.tile_h, x, y, rx1, ry1) {
            let clip_x = if x > ox { x } else { ox }
            let clip_y = if y > oy { y } else { oy }
            let clip_x1 = if rx1 < ox + out.tile_w { rx1 } else { ox + out.tile_w }
            let clip_y1 = if ry1 < oy + out.tile_h { ry1 } else { oy + out.tile_h }
            let cw = clip_x1 - clip_x
            let ch = clip_y1 - clip_y
            if cw > 0 && ch > 0 {
                out.tile6 = surface_draw_rect(out.tile6, clip_x - ox, clip_y - oy, cw, ch, c)
            }
        }
    }
    if n > 7 {
        let tx = 7 % out.tiles_wide
        let ty = 7 / out.tiles_wide
        let ox = tx * out.tile_w
        let oy = ty * out.tile_h
        if tile_rect_intersects(ox, oy, out.tile_w, out.tile_h, x, y, rx1, ry1) {
            let clip_x = if x > ox { x } else { ox }
            let clip_y = if y > oy { y } else { oy }
            let clip_x1 = if rx1 < ox + out.tile_w { rx1 } else { ox + out.tile_w }
            let clip_y1 = if ry1 < oy + out.tile_h { ry1 } else { oy + out.tile_h }
            let cw = clip_x1 - clip_x
            let ch = clip_y1 - clip_y
            if cw > 0 && ch > 0 {
                out.tile7 = surface_draw_rect(out.tile7, clip_x - ox, clip_y - oy, cw, ch, c)
            }
        }
    }
    if n > 8 {
        let tx = 8 % out.tiles_wide
        let ty = 8 / out.tiles_wide
        let ox = tx * out.tile_w
        let oy = ty * out.tile_h
        if tile_rect_intersects(ox, oy, out.tile_w, out.tile_h, x, y, rx1, ry1) {
            let clip_x = if x > ox { x } else { ox }
            let clip_y = if y > oy { y } else { oy }
            let clip_x1 = if rx1 < ox + out.tile_w { rx1 } else { ox + out.tile_w }
            let clip_y1 = if ry1 < oy + out.tile_h { ry1 } else { oy + out.tile_h }
            let cw = clip_x1 - clip_x
            let ch = clip_y1 - clip_y
            if cw > 0 && ch > 0 {
                out.tile8 = surface_draw_rect(out.tile8, clip_x - ox, clip_y - oy, cw, ch, c)
            }
        }
    }
    out
}

// Batch rectangle draw on TiledSurface — same semantics as tiled_draw_rect,
// explicitly named for bulk pipelines that expect a "batch" API.
pub fn tiled_draw_rect_batch(ts: TiledSurface, x: i64, y: i64, w: i64, h: i64, c: Color) -> TiledSurface with Mut, Panic, Div {
    tiled_draw_rect(ts, x, y, w, h, c)
}

// Read pixel R channel from global coordinates.
pub fn tiled_get_pixel_r(ts: &TiledSurface, x: i64, y: i64) -> i64 {
    if x < 0 || x >= ts.width || y < 0 || y >= ts.height { return 0 }
    let tx = x / ts.tile_w
    let ty = y / ts.tile_h
    let lx = x % ts.tile_w
    let ly = y % ts.tile_h
    let idx = ty * ts.tiles_wide + tx
    if idx < 0 || idx >= 9 { return 0 }
    let pidx = ly * ts.tile_w + lx
    if idx == 0 {
        ts.tile0.r[pidx]
    } else if idx == 1 {
        ts.tile1.r[pidx]
    } else if idx == 2 {
        ts.tile2.r[pidx]
    } else if idx == 3 {
        ts.tile3.r[pidx]
    } else if idx == 4 {
        ts.tile4.r[pidx]
    } else if idx == 5 {
        ts.tile5.r[pidx]
    } else if idx == 6 {
        ts.tile6.r[pidx]
    } else if idx == 7 {
        ts.tile7.r[pidx]
    } else {
        ts.tile8.r[pidx]
    }
}
