struct Matrix8 {
    data: [f64; 64],
    rows: i32,
    cols: i32
}

struct QRResult {
    q: Matrix8,
    r: Matrix8,
    rows: i32,
    cols: i32
}

struct EigenResult {
    eigenvalues_real: [f64; 8],
    eigenvalues_imag: [f64; 8],
    eigenvectors: Matrix8,
    n: i32
}

struct SVDResult {
    u: Matrix8,
    sigma: [f64; 8],
    vt: Matrix8,
    rows: i32,
    cols: i32
}

// ============================================================================
// MATRIX8 BASIC OPERATIONS
// ============================================================================

fn mat8_get(m: Matrix8, r: i32, c: i32) -> f64 with Panic {
    let idx = r * m.cols + c
    return m.data[idx]
}

fn mat8_set(m: Matrix8, r: i32, c: i32, val: f64) -> Matrix8 with Mut, Panic {
    var result = m
    let idx = r * m.cols + c
    result.data[idx] = val
    return result
}

fn mat8_zeros(rows: i32, cols: i32) -> Matrix8 {
    let data: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    return Matrix8 { data: data, rows: rows, cols: cols }
}

fn mat8_identity(n: i32) -> Matrix8 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var m = mat8_zeros(n, n)
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        m = mat8_set(m, i, i, 1.0)
        i = i + 1
    }
    return m
}

fn mat8_copy(src: Matrix8) -> Matrix8 {
    return Matrix8 { data: src.data, rows: src.rows, cols: src.cols }
}

fn mat8_multiply(a: Matrix8, b: Matrix8) -> Matrix8 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var c = mat8_zeros(a.rows, b.cols)
    var i = 0
    while i < a.rows {
        var j = 0
        while j < b.cols {
            var sum = 0.0
            var k = 0
            while k < a.cols {
                sum = sum + mat8_get(a, i, k) * mat8_get(b, k, j)
                k = k + 1
            }
            c = mat8_set(c, i, j, sum)
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return c
}

fn mat8_transpose(m: Matrix8) -> Matrix8 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var t = mat8_zeros(m.cols, m.rows)
    var i = 0
    while i < m.rows {
        var j = 0
        while j < m.cols {
            t = mat8_set(t, j, i, mat8_get(m, i, j))
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return t
}

fn mat8_subtract(a: Matrix8, b: Matrix8) -> Matrix8 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var c = mat8_zeros(a.rows, a.cols)
    var i = 0
    while i < a.rows {
        var j = 0
        while j < a.cols {
            c = mat8_set(c, i, j, mat8_get(a, i, j) - mat8_get(b, i, j))
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return c
}

fn mat8_frobenius_norm(m: Matrix8) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < m.rows {
        var j = 0
        while j < m.cols {
            let v = mat8_get(m, i, j)
            sum = sum + v * v
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return sqrt_f64(sum)
}

fn vec8_norm(v: [f64; 8], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        sum = sum + v[i] * v[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    return sqrt_f64(sum)
}

fn vec8_dot(a: [f64; 8], b: [f64; 8], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        sum = sum + a[i] * b[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    return sum
}

// ============================================================================
// QR DECOMPOSITION (Householder reflections)
// ============================================================================
// For A (m x n), compute Q (m x m orthogonal) and R (m x n upper triangular)
// such that A = Q * R.
//
// Householder reflection: for column x, compute v = x + sign(x_0)|x|e_1,
// then H = I - 2*v*v^T / (v^T*v) is a reflection that zeroes out below-diagonal.

fn qr_decompose(a: Matrix8) -> QRResult with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let m = a.rows
    let n = a.cols
    let mn = min_i32(m, n)

    // Work on a copy that becomes R
    var r = mat8_copy(a)
    // Q starts as identity
    var q = mat8_identity(m)

    var k = 0
    while k < mn {
        // Extract the column below the diagonal into a working vector
        var x: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
        let col_len = m - k
        var i = 0
        while i < col_len {
            x[i] = mat8_get(r, k + i, k)
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Compute norm of x
        let x_norm = vec8_norm(x, col_len)

        if x_norm > 1e-15 {
            // Compute Householder vector v = x + sign(x_0)|x|e_1
            var v: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
            i = 0
            while i < col_len {
                v[i] = x[i]
                i = i + 1
            }
            v[0] = v[0] + sign_f64(x[0]) * x_norm

            // Compute v^T * v
            let vtv = vec8_dot(v, v, col_len)

            if vtv > 1e-30 {
                let scale = 2.0 / vtv

                // Apply H to remaining columns of R: R[k:m, j] -= scale * v * (v^T * R[k:m, j])
                var j = k
                while j < n {
                    // Compute v^T * R[k:m, j]
                    var dot = 0.0
                    i = 0
                    while i < col_len {
                        dot = dot + v[i] * mat8_get(r, k + i, j)
                        i = i + 1
                    }
                    // Update R[k:m, j]
                    i = 0
                    while i < col_len {
                        let old = mat8_get(r, k + i, j)
                        r = mat8_set(r, k + i, j, old - scale * v[i] * dot)
                        i = i + 1
                    }
                    j = j + 1
                }

                // Apply H to Q from the right: Q[:, k:m] -= scale * Q[:, k:m] * v * v^T
                // Equivalently Q[i, :] -= scale * (Q[i, k:m] . v) * v^T for each row i
                i = 0
                while i < m {
                    // Compute Q[i, k:m] . v
                    var dot2 = 0.0
                    var p = 0
                    while p < col_len {
                        dot2 = dot2 + mat8_get(q, i, k + p) * v[p]
                        p = p + 1
                    }
                    // Update Q[i, k:m]
                    p = 0
                    while p < col_len {
                        let old2 = mat8_get(q, i, k + p)
                        q = mat8_set(q, i, k + p, old2 - scale * dot2 * v[p])
                        p = p + 1
                    }
                    i = i + 1
                }
            }
        }

        k = k + 1
    }

    // Clean up near-zero entries in R below diagonal
    var ci = 0
    while ci < m {
        var cj = 0
        while cj < min_i32(ci, n) {
            let rv = mat8_get(r, ci, cj)
            if abs_f64(rv) < 1e-14 {
                r = mat8_set(r, ci, cj, 0.0)
            }
            cj = cj + 1
        }
        ci = ci + 1
    }

    return QRResult { q: q, r: r, rows: m, cols: n }
}

// ============================================================================
// EIGENDECOMPOSITION (QR algorithm with Wilkinson shift)
// ============================================================================
// For a square matrix A (n x n), computes eigenvalues and eigenvectors.
// Uses iterated QR decomposition with implicit shifts for convergence.
//
// The QR algorithm: A_{k+1} = R_k * Q_k (where Q_k * R_k = A_k - sigma*I)
// converges to a quasi-upper-triangular (Schur) form.
// Eigenvalues appear on the diagonal (real) or in 2x2 blocks (complex pairs).

fn mat8_is_symmetric(a: Matrix8, tol: f64) -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if a.rows != a.cols { return false }

    var i = 0
    while i < a.rows {
        var j = 0
        while j < i {
            let aij = mat8_get(a, i, j)
            let aji = mat8_get(a, j, i)
            let limit = tol * (1.0 + abs_f64(aij) + abs_f64(aji))
            if abs_f64(aij - aji) > limit {
                return false
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    true
}

fn hypot_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let aa = abs_f64(a)
    let bb = abs_f64(b)
    if aa > bb {
        let r = bb / aa
        return aa * sqrt_f64(1.0 + r * r)
    }
    if bb > 0.0 {
        let r = aa / bb
        return bb * sqrt_f64(1.0 + r * r)
    }
    0.0
}

fn tridiag8_householder(a: Matrix8, diag: &![f64; 8], subdiag: &![f64; 8]) -> Matrix8 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var mat = mat8_copy(a)
    var work: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]

    var k = 0
    while k < a.rows - 2 {
        let alpha = mat8_get(mat, k + 1, k)
        var xnorm_sq = 0.0
        var i = k + 2
        while i < a.rows {
            let v = mat8_get(mat, i, k)
            xnorm_sq = xnorm_sq + v * v
            i = i + 1
        }

        if xnorm_sq <= 1.0e-30 {
            i = k + 2
            while i < a.rows {
                mat = mat8_set(mat, i, k, 0.0)
                mat = mat8_set(mat, k, i, 0.0)
                i = i + 1
            }
        } else {
            let xnorm = sqrt_f64(xnorm_sq)
            let beta = if alpha >= 0.0 { 0.0 - hypot_f64(alpha, xnorm) } else { hypot_f64(alpha, xnorm) }
            let tau = (beta - alpha) / beta
            let inv = 1.0 / (alpha - beta)
            let start = k + 1
            let end = a.rows - 1

            mat = mat8_set(mat, start, k, 1.0)
            i = k + 2
            while i < a.rows {
                mat = mat8_set(mat, i, k, mat8_get(mat, i, k) * inv)
                i = i + 1
            }

            i = start
            while i <= end {
                var ui = 1.0
                if i > start { ui = mat8_get(mat, i, k) }

                var sum = 0.0
                var j = start
                while j <= end {
                    var uj = 1.0
                    if j > start { uj = mat8_get(mat, j, k) }
                    sum = sum + mat8_get(mat, i, j) * uj
                    j = j + 1
                }
                work[i - start] = tau * sum
                i = i + 1
            }

            var dot = work[0]
            i = start + 1
            while i <= end {
                dot = dot + mat8_get(mat, i, k) * work[i - start]
                i = i + 1
            }
            let corr = 0.0 - 0.5 * tau * dot

            i = start
            while i <= end {
                var ui = 1.0
                if i > start { ui = mat8_get(mat, i, k) }
                work[i - start] = work[i - start] + corr * ui
                i = i + 1
            }

            i = start
            while i <= end {
                var ui = 1.0
                if i > start { ui = mat8_get(mat, i, k) }

                var j = i
                while j <= end {
                    var uj = 1.0
                    if j > start { uj = mat8_get(mat, j, k) }
                    let updated = mat8_get(mat, i, j) - ui * work[j - start] - work[i - start] * uj
                    mat = mat8_set(mat, i, j, updated)
                    mat = mat8_set(mat, j, i, updated)
                    j = j + 1
                }
                i = i + 1
            }

            mat = mat8_set(mat, start, k, beta)
            mat = mat8_set(mat, k, start, beta)
            i = k + 2
            while i < a.rows {
                mat = mat8_set(mat, k, i, 0.0)
                i = i + 1
            }
        }

        k = k + 1
    }

    var i = 0
    while i < a.rows {
        diag[i] = mat8_get(mat, i, i)
        if i < a.rows - 1 { subdiag[i] = mat8_get(mat, i + 1, i) }
        else { subdiag[i] = 0.0 }
        i = i + 1
    }

    mat
}

fn tridiag8_accumulate_householder(mat: Matrix8, vecs: &!Matrix8) with Mut, Panic, Div {
    vecs.rows = mat.rows
    vecs.cols = mat.cols
    var i = 0
    while i < mat.rows {
        var j = 0
        while j < mat.cols {
            if i == j { vecs.data[i * mat.cols + j] = 1.0 }
            else { vecs.data[i * mat.cols + j] = 0.0 }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    if mat.rows <= 2 { return }

    var k = 0
    while k < mat.rows - 2 {
        let start = k + 1
        let end = mat.rows - 1
        var tail_sq = 0.0
        i = k + 2
        while i < mat.rows {
            let v = mat8_get(mat, i, k)
            tail_sq = tail_sq + v * v
            i = i + 1
        }

        if tail_sq > 1.0e-30 {
            let tau = 2.0 / (1.0 + tail_sq)
            i = 0
            while i < mat.rows {
                var dot = vecs.data[i * vecs.cols + start]
                var p = start + 1
                while p <= end {
                    dot = dot + vecs.data[i * vecs.cols + p] * mat8_get(mat, p, k)
                    p = p + 1
                }
                dot = tau * dot

                vecs.data[i * vecs.cols + start] = vecs.data[i * vecs.cols + start] - dot
                p = start + 1
                while p <= end {
                    vecs.data[i * vecs.cols + p] = vecs.data[i * vecs.cols + p] - dot * mat8_get(mat, p, k)
                    p = p + 1
                }
                i = i + 1
            }
        }

        k = k + 1
    }
}

fn tridiag8_sort_pairs(values: &![f64; 8], vecs: &!Matrix8, n: i32) with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i = 1
    while i < n {
        let key = values[i]
        var col: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
        var r = 0
        while r < n {
            col[r] = vecs.data[r * vecs.cols + i]
            r = r + 1
        }

        var j = i - 1
        while j >= 0 && values[j] > key {
            values[j + 1] = values[j]
            r = 0
            while r < n {
                vecs.data[r * vecs.cols + (j + 1)] = vecs.data[r * vecs.cols + j]
                r = r + 1
            }
            j = j - 1
        }

        values[j + 1] = key
        r = 0
        while r < n {
            vecs.data[r * vecs.cols + (j + 1)] = col[r]
            r = r + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn tridiag8_iter(diag: &![f64; 8], subdiag: &![f64; 8], n: i32, vecs: &!Matrix8) -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let tol = 1.0e-12
    var total_iter = 0
    var l = 0
    var f = 0.0
    var tst1 = 0.0

    while l < n {
        let row_mag = abs_f64(diag[l]) + abs_f64(subdiag[l])
        if row_mag > tst1 { tst1 = row_mag }

        var m = l
        while m < n - 1 {
            if abs_f64(subdiag[m]) <= tol * (tst1 + 1.0) { break }
            m = m + 1
        }

        if m > l {
            var keep_iterating = true
            while keep_iterating {
                if total_iter >= 128 * n { return false }
                total_iter = total_iter + 1

                let g0 = diag[l]
                var p = (diag[l + 1] - g0) / (2.0 * subdiag[l])
                var r = hypot_f64(p, 1.0)
                if p < 0.0 { r = 0.0 - r }

                diag[l] = subdiag[l] / (p + r)
                diag[l + 1] = subdiag[l] * (p + r)

                let dl1 = diag[l + 1]
                let h = g0 - diag[l]
                var i = l + 2
                while i < n {
                    diag[i] = diag[i] - h
                    i = i + 1
                }
                f = f + h

                p = diag[m]
                var c = 1.0
                var c2 = 1.0
                var c3 = 1.0
                let el1 = if l + 1 < n { subdiag[l + 1] } else { 0.0 }
                var s = 0.0
                var s2 = 0.0
                i = m - 1
                while i >= l {
                    c3 = c2
                    c2 = c
                    s2 = s

                    let g1 = c * subdiag[i]
                    let h2 = c * p
                    r = hypot_f64(p, subdiag[i])

                    if r <= 1.0e-30 {
                        subdiag[i + 1] = 0.0
                        s = 0.0
                        c = 1.0
                    } else {
                        subdiag[i + 1] = s * r
                        s = subdiag[i] / r
                        c = p / r
                    }

                    p = c * diag[i] - s * g1
                    diag[i + 1] = h2 + s * (c * g1 + s * diag[i])

                    var k = 0
                    while k < n {
                        let vk1 = vecs.data[k * vecs.cols + (i + 1)]
                        let vki = vecs.data[k * vecs.cols + i]
                        vecs.data[k * vecs.cols + (i + 1)] = s * vki + c * vk1
                        vecs.data[k * vecs.cols + i] = c * vki - s * vk1
                        k = k + 1
                    }

                    if i == l { break }
                    i = i - 1
                }

                var p_shift = 0.0
                if abs_f64(dl1) > 1.0e-30 {
                    p_shift = 0.0 - s * s2 * c3 * el1 * subdiag[l] / dl1
                }
                subdiag[l] = s * p_shift
                diag[l] = c * p_shift

                if abs_f64(subdiag[l]) <= tol * (tst1 + 1.0) {
                    keep_iterating = false
                }
            }
        }

        diag[l] = diag[l] + f
        subdiag[l] = 0.0
        l = l + 1
    }

    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        subdiag[i] = 0.0
        i = i + 1
    }

    tridiag8_sort_pairs(diag, vecs, n)
    true
}

fn eigen_decompose_symmetric_mat8(a: Matrix8) -> EigenResult with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let n = a.rows
    var eigenvalues_real: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    var eigenvalues_imag: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]

    // Reduce to tridiagonal form via Householder reflections
    var diag: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    var subdiag: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    let hmat = tridiag8_householder(a, &!diag, &!subdiag)

    // Accumulate Householder transforms into eigenvector matrix
    var eigenvectors = mat8_zeros(n, n)
    tridiag8_accumulate_householder(hmat, &!eigenvectors)

    // QR iteration on tridiagonal form
    tridiag8_iter(&!diag, &!subdiag, n, &!eigenvectors)

    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        eigenvalues_real[i] = diag[i]
        eigenvalues_imag[i] = 0.0
        i = i + 1
    }

    return EigenResult {
        eigenvalues_real: eigenvalues_real,
        eigenvalues_imag: eigenvalues_imag,
        eigenvectors: eigenvectors,
        n: n
    }
}

fn eigen_decompose_general_qr(a: Matrix8) -> EigenResult with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let n = a.rows
    var eigenvalues_real: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    var eigenvalues_imag: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]

    // Work matrix that converges to quasi-upper-triangular form
    var work = mat8_copy(a)
    // Accumulate eigenvector transformations
    var vecs = mat8_identity(n)

    let max_iter = 200
    let tol = 1e-10

    // Deflation: process from bottom-right
    var p = n - 1
    var total_iter = 0

    while p > 0 {
        if total_iter > max_iter {
            // Did not converge, take what we have
            p = 0
        } else {
            // Check convergence of subdiagonal element work[p, p-1]
            let subdiag = abs_f64(mat8_get(work, p, p - 1))
            let diag_sum = abs_f64(mat8_get(work, p, p)) + abs_f64(mat8_get(work, p - 1, p - 1))
            let threshold = tol * diag_sum
            let use_threshold = tol
            // Use absolute threshold if diag_sum is tiny
            let effective_tol = tol
            if diag_sum > 1.0 {
                // Use relative threshold
                if subdiag < tol * diag_sum {
                    work = mat8_set(work, p, p - 1, 0.0)
                    p = p - 1
                } else {
                    // Perform one QR step with Wilkinson shift on active submatrix [0..p+1, 0..p+1]
                    // Wilkinson shift: eigenvalue of trailing 2x2 block closest to work[p,p]
                    let app = mat8_get(work, p, p)
                    let apm = mat8_get(work, p - 1, p - 1)
                    let apmp = mat8_get(work, p - 1, p)
                    let appm = mat8_get(work, p, p - 1)

                    let dd = (apm - app) / 2.0
                    let det_2x2 = appm * apmp
                    let disc = dd * dd + det_2x2
                    var sigma = app

                    if disc >= 0.0 {
                        let sq = sqrt_f64(disc)
                        let s1 = app - dd + sq
                        let s2 = app - dd - sq
                        // Pick the one closer to app
                        if abs_f64(s1 - app) < abs_f64(s2 - app) {
                            sigma = s1
                        } else {
                            sigma = s2
                        }
                    }

                    // Shift: work = work - sigma * I
                    var si = 0
                    while si <= p {
                        let old_d = mat8_get(work, si, si)
                        work = mat8_set(work, si, si, old_d - sigma)
                        si = si + 1
                    }

                    // Build a temporary submatrix for QR
                    var sub = mat8_zeros(p + 1, p + 1)
                    si = 0
                    while si <= p {
                        var sj = 0
                        while sj <= p {
                            sub = mat8_set(sub, si, sj, mat8_get(work, si, sj))
                            sj = sj + 1
                        }
                        si = si + 1
                    }

                    let qr = qr_decompose(sub)

                    // work = R * Q + sigma * I
                    let rq = mat8_multiply(qr.r, qr.q)
                    si = 0
                    while si <= p {
                        var sj = 0
                        while sj <= p {
                            var val = mat8_get(rq, si, sj)
                            if si == sj {
                                val = val + sigma
                            }
                            work = mat8_set(work, si, sj, val)
                            sj = sj + 1
                        }
                        si = si + 1
                    }

                    // Accumulate eigenvectors: vecs = vecs * Q
                    var new_vecs = mat8_zeros(n, n)
                    si = 0
                    while si < n {
                        var sj = 0
                        while sj <= p {
                            var sum = 0.0
                            var sk = 0
                            while sk <= p {
                                sum = sum + mat8_get(vecs, si, sk) * mat8_get(qr.q, sk, sj)
                                sk = sk + 1
                            }
                            new_vecs = mat8_set(new_vecs, si, sj, sum)
                            sj = sj + 1
                        }
                        // Copy unchanged columns
                        sj = p + 1
                        while sj < n {
                            new_vecs = mat8_set(new_vecs, si, sj, mat8_get(vecs, si, sj))
                            sj = sj + 1
                        }
                        si = si + 1
                    }
                    vecs = new_vecs

                    total_iter = total_iter + 1
                }
            } else {
                // Small diagonal sum, use absolute tolerance
                if subdiag < tol {
                    work = mat8_set(work, p, p - 1, 0.0)
                    p = p - 1
                } else {
                    // Same QR step as above
                    let app2 = mat8_get(work, p, p)
                    let apm2 = mat8_get(work, p - 1, p - 1)
                    let apmp2 = mat8_get(work, p - 1, p)
                    let appm2 = mat8_get(work, p, p - 1)

                    let dd2 = (apm2 - app2) / 2.0
                    let det2 = appm2 * apmp2
                    let disc2 = dd2 * dd2 + det2
                    var sigma2 = app2
                    if disc2 >= 0.0 {
                        let sq2 = sqrt_f64(disc2)
                        let s12 = app2 - dd2 + sq2
                        let s22 = app2 - dd2 - sq2
                        if abs_f64(s12 - app2) < abs_f64(s22 - app2) {
                            sigma2 = s12
                        } else {
                            sigma2 = s22
                        }
                    }

                    var si2 = 0
                    while si2 <= p {
                        let old_d2 = mat8_get(work, si2, si2)
                        work = mat8_set(work, si2, si2, old_d2 - sigma2)
                        si2 = si2 + 1
                    }

                    var sub2 = mat8_zeros(p + 1, p + 1)
                    si2 = 0
                    while si2 <= p {
                        var sj2 = 0
                        while sj2 <= p {
                            sub2 = mat8_set(sub2, si2, sj2, mat8_get(work, si2, sj2))
                            sj2 = sj2 + 1
                        }
                        si2 = si2 + 1
                    }

                    let qr2 = qr_decompose(sub2)
                    let rq2 = mat8_multiply(qr2.r, qr2.q)

                    si2 = 0
                    while si2 <= p {
                        var sj2 = 0
                        while sj2 <= p {
                            var val2 = mat8_get(rq2, si2, sj2)
                            if si2 == sj2 {
                                val2 = val2 + sigma2
                            }
                            work = mat8_set(work, si2, sj2, val2)
                            sj2 = sj2 + 1
                        }
                        si2 = si2 + 1
                    }

                    var new_v2 = mat8_zeros(n, n)
                    si2 = 0
                    while si2 < n {
                        var sj2 = 0
                        while sj2 <= p {
                            var sum2 = 0.0
                            var sk2 = 0
                            while sk2 <= p {
                                sum2 = sum2 + mat8_get(vecs, si2, sk2) * mat8_get(qr2.q, sk2, sj2)
                                sk2 = sk2 + 1
                            }
                            new_v2 = mat8_set(new_v2, si2, sj2, sum2)
                            sj2 = sj2 + 1
                        }
                        sj2 = p + 1
                        while sj2 < n {
                            new_v2 = mat8_set(new_v2, si2, sj2, mat8_get(vecs, si2, sj2))
                            sj2 = sj2 + 1
                        }
                        si2 = si2 + 1
                    }
                    vecs = new_v2

                    total_iter = total_iter + 1
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Extract eigenvalues from the quasi-upper-triangular work matrix
    var ei = 0
    while ei < n {
        if ei < n - 1 {
            let sub_el = abs_f64(mat8_get(work, ei + 1, ei))
            if sub_el > tol {
                // 2x2 block: complex eigenvalue pair
                let a11 = mat8_get(work, ei, ei)
                let a12 = mat8_get(work, ei, ei + 1)
                let a21 = mat8_get(work, ei + 1, ei)
                let a22 = mat8_get(work, ei + 1, ei + 1)
                let tr = a11 + a22
                let det = a11 * a22 - a12 * a21
                let disc_e = tr * tr - 4.0 * det
                if disc_e < 0.0 {
                    eigenvalues_real[ei] = tr / 2.0
                    eigenvalues_imag[ei] = sqrt_f64(0.0 - disc_e) / 2.0
                    eigenvalues_real[ei + 1] = tr / 2.0
                    eigenvalues_imag[ei + 1] = 0.0 - sqrt_f64(0.0 - disc_e) / 2.0
                } else {
                    let sq_e = sqrt_f64(disc_e)
                    eigenvalues_real[ei] = (tr + sq_e) / 2.0
                    eigenvalues_imag[ei] = 0.0
                    eigenvalues_real[ei + 1] = (tr - sq_e) / 2.0
                    eigenvalues_imag[ei + 1] = 0.0
                }
                ei = ei + 2
            } else {
                eigenvalues_real[ei] = mat8_get(work, ei, ei)
                eigenvalues_imag[ei] = 0.0
                ei = ei + 1
            }
        } else {
            eigenvalues_real[ei] = mat8_get(work, ei, ei)
            eigenvalues_imag[ei] = 0.0
            ei = ei + 1
        }
    }

    return EigenResult {
        eigenvalues_real: eigenvalues_real,
        eigenvalues_imag: eigenvalues_imag,
        eigenvectors: vecs,
        n: n
    }
}

fn eigen_decompose(a: Matrix8) -> EigenResult with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if a.rows == a.cols {
        if mat8_is_symmetric(a, 1.0e-12) {
            return eigen_decompose_symmetric_mat8(a)
        }
    }
    return eigen_decompose_general_qr(a)
}

// ============================================================================
// SVD DECOMPOSITION (via eigendecomposition of A^T A)
// ============================================================================
// For A (m x n), compute U (m x m), sigma (min(m,n)), V^T (n x n)
// such that A = U * diag(sigma) * V^T.
//
// Method: eigendecompose A^T * A to get V and sigma^2,
//         then U columns = A * v_i / sigma_i.

fn svd_decompose(a: Matrix8) -> SVDResult with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let m = a.rows
    let n = a.cols
    let mn = min_i32(m, n)

    // Compute A^T * A (n x n, symmetric positive semi-definite)
    let at = mat8_transpose(a)
    let ata = mat8_multiply(at, a)

    // Eigendecompose A^T A
    let eig = eigen_decompose_symmetric_mat8(ata)

    // Singular values = sqrt(eigenvalues of A^T A)
    // Eigenvalues should be non-negative for A^T A
    var sigma: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    var order: [i32; 8] = [0; 8]
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let ev = eig.eigenvalues_real[i]
        if ev > 0.0 {
            sigma[i] = sqrt_f64(ev)
        } else {
            sigma[i] = 0.0
        }
        order[i] = i
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Sort singular values in descending order (bubble sort for small n)
    i = 0
    while i < n - 1 {
        var j = 0
        while j < n - 1 - i {
            if sigma[j] < sigma[j + 1] {
                // Swap sigma
                let tmp_s = sigma[j]
                sigma[j] = sigma[j + 1]
                sigma[j + 1] = tmp_s
                // Swap order
                let tmp_o = order[j]
                order[j] = order[j + 1]
                order[j + 1] = tmp_o
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Build V^T from eigenvectors in sorted order
    // V columns are eigenvectors of A^T A
    var vt = mat8_zeros(n, n)
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        let col_idx = order[i]
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            // V^T row i = eigenvector col_idx (transposed)
            vt = mat8_set(vt, i, j, mat8_get(eig.eigenvectors, j, col_idx))
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Build U: u_i = A * v_i / sigma_i
    var u = mat8_zeros(m, m)
    i = 0
    while i < mn {
        if sigma[i] > 1e-14 {
            // v_i is row i of V^T (transposed back to column)
            var vi: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
            var j = 0
            while j < n {
                vi[j] = mat8_get(vt, i, j)
                j = j + 1
            }

            // Compute A * v_i
            j = 0
            while j < m {
                var dot = 0.0
                var k = 0
                while k < n {
                    dot = dot + mat8_get(a, j, k) * vi[k]
                    k = k + 1
                }
                u = mat8_set(u, j, i, dot / sigma[i])
                j = j + 1
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // For remaining columns of U (if m > n), fill with orthogonal complement
    // Use Gram-Schmidt on standard basis vectors
    if m > mn {
        var col = mn
        while col < m {
            // Start with e_{col}
            var candidate: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
            candidate[col] = 1.0

            // Orthogonalize against existing U columns
            var oi = 0
            while oi < col {
                var dot_o = 0.0
                var oj = 0
                while oj < m {
                    dot_o = dot_o + candidate[oj] * mat8_get(u, oj, oi)
                    oj = oj + 1
                }
                oj = 0
                while oj < m {
                    candidate[oj] = candidate[oj] - dot_o * mat8_get(u, oj, oi)
                    oj = oj + 1
                }
                oi = oi + 1
            }

            // Normalize
            let cn = vec8_norm(candidate, m)
            if cn > 1e-14 {
                var ci = 0
                while ci < m {
                    u = mat8_set(u, ci, col, candidate[ci] / cn)
                    ci = ci + 1
                }
            }
            col = col + 1
        }
    }

    return SVDResult {
        u: u,
        sigma: sigma,
        vt: vt,
        rows: m,
        cols: n
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// VALIDATION UTILITIES
// ============================================================================

// Check Q*R = A (within tolerance)
fn qr_reconstruction_error(a: Matrix8, result: QRResult) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let qr_prod = mat8_multiply(result.q, result.r)
    let diff = mat8_subtract(qr_prod, a)
    return mat8_frobenius_norm(diff)
}

// Check Q^T * Q = I (orthogonality)
fn qr_orthogonality_error(result: QRResult) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let qt = mat8_transpose(result.q)
    let qtq = mat8_multiply(qt, result.q)
    let eye = mat8_identity(result.rows)
    let diff = mat8_subtract(qtq, eye)
    return mat8_frobenius_norm(diff)
}

// Check R is upper triangular: max |R[i][j]| for i > j
fn qr_upper_triangular_error(result: QRResult) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var max_err = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < result.rows {
        var j = 0
        while j < min_i32(i, result.cols) {
            let v = abs_f64(mat8_get(result.r, i, j))
            if v > max_err {
                max_err = v
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return max_err
}

// Check Av = lambda*v for each eigenpair (max relative residual)
fn eigen_residual(a: Matrix8, result: EigenResult) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var max_err = 0.0
    let n = result.n

    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        // Only check real eigenvalues
        if abs_f64(result.eigenvalues_imag[i]) < 1e-10 {
            let lambda = result.eigenvalues_real[i]

            // Compute Av
            var av: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
            var j = 0
            while j < n {
                var sum = 0.0
                var k = 0
                while k < n {
                    sum = sum + mat8_get(a, j, k) * mat8_get(result.eigenvectors, k, i)
                    k = k + 1
                }
                av[j] = sum
                j = j + 1
            }

            // Compute Av - lambda*v
            var err_sq = 0.0
            var v_sq = 0.0
            j = 0
            while j < n {
                let vi = mat8_get(result.eigenvectors, j, i)
                let diff = av[j] - lambda * vi
                err_sq = err_sq + diff * diff
                v_sq = v_sq + vi * vi
                j = j + 1
            }

            if v_sq > 1e-20 {
                let rel = sqrt_f64(err_sq) / sqrt_f64(v_sq)
                if rel > max_err {
                    max_err = rel
                }
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return max_err
}

// Check U*Sigma*V^T = A (reconstruction error)
fn svd_reconstruction_error(a: Matrix8, result: SVDResult) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let m = result.rows
    let n = result.cols
    let mn = min_i32(m, n)

    // Build U * diag(sigma) * V^T
    // First: diag(sigma) * V^T  (mn x n)
    var sv = mat8_zeros(m, n)
    var i = 0
    while i < mn {
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            sv = mat8_set(sv, i, j, result.sigma[i] * mat8_get(result.vt, i, j))
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // U * (diag(sigma) * V^T)
    let usv = mat8_multiply(result.u, sv)
    let diff = mat8_subtract(usv, a)
    return mat8_frobenius_norm(diff)
}

// ============================================================================
// TESTS

var CNT: [i64; 2] = [0; 2]

fn chk(label: i64, ok: i64) with IO, Mut {
    if ok == 1 {
        print("  PASS ["); print(label); print("]\n")
        CNT[0] = CNT[0] + 1
    } else {
        print("  FAIL ["); print(label); print("]\n")
        CNT[1] = CNT[1] + 1
    }
}

fn near(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> i64 {
    let d = a - b
    let d2 = if d < 0.0 { 0.0 - d } else { d }
    if d2 <= tol { 1 } else { 0 }
}

fn test_qr_3x3() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    // A = [[1,2,3],[4,5,6],[7,8,10]] (det != 0)
    var a = mat8_zeros(3, 3)
    a = mat8_set(a, 0, 0, 1.0); a = mat8_set(a, 0, 1, 2.0); a = mat8_set(a, 0, 2, 3.0)
    a = mat8_set(a, 1, 0, 4.0); a = mat8_set(a, 1, 1, 5.0); a = mat8_set(a, 1, 2, 6.0)
    a = mat8_set(a, 2, 0, 7.0); a = mat8_set(a, 2, 1, 8.0); a = mat8_set(a, 2, 2, 10.0)

    let result = qr_decompose(a)

    let recon_err = qr_reconstruction_error(a, result)
    chk(1, near(recon_err, 0.0, 1e-10))

    let orth_err = qr_orthogonality_error(result)
    chk(2, near(orth_err, 0.0, 1e-10))

    let tri_err = qr_upper_triangular_error(result)
    chk(3, near(tri_err, 0.0, 1e-12))
}

fn test_qr_identity() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let a = mat8_identity(4)
    let result = qr_decompose(a)
    let recon_err = qr_reconstruction_error(a, result)
    chk(4, near(recon_err, 0.0, 1e-12))
    let orth_err = qr_orthogonality_error(result)
    chk(5, near(orth_err, 0.0, 1e-12))
}

fn test_mat8_basic() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Multiply identity by a matrix → same matrix
    let a = mat8_identity(3)
    var b = mat8_zeros(3, 3)
    b = mat8_set(b, 0, 0, 2.0); b = mat8_set(b, 1, 1, 3.0); b = mat8_set(b, 2, 2, 4.0)
    let c = mat8_multiply(a, b)
    chk(6, near(mat8_get(c, 0, 0), 2.0, 1e-12))
    chk(7, near(mat8_get(c, 1, 1), 3.0, 1e-12))
    chk(8, near(mat8_get(c, 2, 2), 4.0, 1e-12))

    // Frobenius norm of identity(3) = sqrt(3)
    let fn3 = mat8_frobenius_norm(a)
    chk(9, near(fn3, 1.7320508075688772, 1e-9))

    // Transpose
    var m = mat8_zeros(2, 2)
    m = mat8_set(m, 0, 1, 5.0)
    let mt = mat8_transpose(m)
    chk(10, near(mat8_get(mt, 1, 0), 5.0, 1e-12))
}

fn test_eigen_diagonal() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Diagonal matrix: eigenvalues are the diagonal entries
    var a = mat8_zeros(3, 3)
    a = mat8_set(a, 0, 0, 3.0)
    a = mat8_set(a, 1, 1, 1.0)
    a = mat8_set(a, 2, 2, 2.0)

    let eig = eigen_decompose_symmetric_mat8(a)
    // After sorting, eigenvalues should be [1, 2, 3]
    chk(11, near(eig.eigenvalues_real[0], 1.0, 1e-8))
    chk(12, near(eig.eigenvalues_real[1], 2.0, 1e-8))
    chk(13, near(eig.eigenvalues_real[2], 3.0, 1e-8))
}

pub fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    CNT[0] = 0; CNT[1] = 0
    print("─── stdlib/linalg/decomp tests ───\n")
    test_mat8_basic()
    test_qr_identity()
    test_qr_3x3()
    test_eigen_diagonal()
    print("─── "); print(CNT[0]); print("/"); print(CNT[0]+CNT[1]); print(" PASS ───\n")
    if CNT[1] == 0 { print("ALL PASS\n"); 0 } else { 1 }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/linalg/eigen.sio ===
// eigen.sio - Dense symmetric eigendecomposition for matrices up to 256x256
//
// Algorithm:
//   1. Householder tridiagonalization of a real symmetric matrix
//   2. Implicit shifted iteration on the symmetric tridiagonal
//   3. Accumulation of orthogonal transforms for eigenvectors

fn eg_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    x
}

fn eg_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 24 {
        y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
        i = i + 1
    }
    y
}

fn eg_hypot(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let aa = eg_abs(a)
    let bb = eg_abs(b)
    if aa > bb {
        let r = bb / aa
        return aa * eg_sqrt(1.0 + r * r)
    }
    if bb > 0.0 {
        let r = aa / bb
        return bb * eg_sqrt(1.0 + r * r)
    }
    0.0
}

fn eg_identity(mat: &![f64; 65536], n: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            if i == j { mat[i * n + j] = 1.0 }
            else { mat[i * n + j] = 0.0 }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn eg_copy_matrix(dst: &![f64; 65536], src: &![f64; 65536], n: i32) with Mut, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            dst[i * n + j] = src[i * n + j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn eg_sort_values(values: &![f64; 256], n: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 1
    while i < n {
        let key = values[i]
        var j = i - 1
        while j >= 0 && values[j] > key {
            values[j + 1] = values[j]
            j = j - 1
        }
        values[j + 1] = key
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn eg_sort_pairs(values: &![f64; 256], vecs: &![f64; 65536], n: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 1
    while i < n {
        let key = values[i]
        var col: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
        var r = 0
        while r < n {
            col[r] = vecs[r * n + i]
            r = r + 1
        }

        var j = i - 1
        while j >= 0 && values[j] > key {
            values[j + 1] = values[j]
            r = 0
            while r < n {
                vecs[r * n + (j + 1)] = vecs[r * n + j]
                r = r + 1
            }
            j = j - 1
        }

        values[j + 1] = key
        r = 0
        while r < n {
            vecs[r * n + (j + 1)] = col[r]
            r = r + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

var EIG_WORK_MAT: [f64; 65536] = [0.0; 65536]
var EIG_WORK_VECS: [f64; 65536] = [0.0; 65536]
var EIG_WORK_DIAG: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
var EIG_WORK_SUBDIAG: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
var EIG_WORK_N: i32 = 0
var EIG_WORK_CONVERGED: i32 = 0

fn eg_shift_subdiag_left(subdiag: &![f64; 256], n: i32) with Mut, Panic {
    if n <= 0 { return }
    var i = 1
    while i < n {
        subdiag[i - 1] = subdiag[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    subdiag[n - 1] = 0.0
}

fn eg_tred2_inplace(mat: &![f64; 65536], n: i32, diag: &![f64; 256], subdiag: &![f64; 256]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if n <= 0 { return }

    var j = 0
    while j < n {
        diag[j] = mat[(n - 1) * n + j]
        j = j + 1
    }

    var i = n - 1
    while i >= 1 {
        var scale = 0.0
        var h = 0.0
        var k = 0
        while k < i {
            scale = scale + eg_abs(diag[k])
            k = k + 1
        }

        if scale <= 1.0e-30 {
            subdiag[i] = diag[i - 1]
            j = 0
            while j < i {
                diag[j] = mat[(i - 1) * n + j]
                mat[i * n + j] = 0.0
                mat[j * n + i] = 0.0
                j = j + 1
            }
        } else {
            k = 0
            while k < i {
                diag[k] = diag[k] / scale
                h = h + diag[k] * diag[k]
                k = k + 1
            }

            let f0 = diag[i - 1]
            var g = eg_sqrt(h)
            if f0 > 0.0 { g = 0.0 - g }
            subdiag[i] = scale * g
            h = h - f0 * g
            diag[i - 1] = f0 - g

            j = 0
            while j < i {
                subdiag[j] = 0.0
                j = j + 1
            }

            j = 0
            while j < i {
                let f = diag[j]
                mat[j * n + i] = f
                g = subdiag[j] + mat[j * n + j] * f

                k = j + 1
                while k <= i - 1 {
                    g = g + mat[k * n + j] * diag[k]
                    subdiag[k] = subdiag[k] + mat[k * n + j] * f
                    k = k + 1
                }
                subdiag[j] = g
                j = j + 1
            }

            var f = 0.0
            j = 0
            while j < i {
                subdiag[j] = subdiag[j] / h
                f = f + subdiag[j] * diag[j]
                j = j + 1
            }
            let hh = f / (h + h)

            j = 0
            while j < i {
                subdiag[j] = subdiag[j] - hh * diag[j]
                j = j + 1
            }

            j = 0
            while j < i {
                let f = diag[j]
                g = subdiag[j]
                k = j
                while k <= i - 1 {
                    mat[k * n + j] = mat[k * n + j] - (f * subdiag[k] + g * diag[k])
                    k = k + 1
                }
                diag[j] = mat[(i - 1) * n + j]
                mat[i * n + j] = 0.0
                j = j + 1
            }
        }

        diag[i] = h
        if i == 1 { break }
        i = i - 1
    }

    i = 0
    while i < n - 1 {
        mat[(n - 1) * n + i] = mat[i * n + i]
        mat[i * n + i] = 1.0

        let h2 = diag[i + 1]
        if eg_abs(h2) > 1.0e-30 {
            var k2 = 0
            while k2 <= i {
                diag[k2] = mat[k2 * n + (i + 1)] / h2
                k2 = k2 + 1
            }

            j = 0
            while j <= i {
                var g2 = 0.0
                k2 = 0
                while k2 <= i {
                    g2 = g2 + mat[k2 * n + (i + 1)] * mat[k2 * n + j]
                    k2 = k2 + 1
                }

                k2 = 0
                while k2 <= i {
                    mat[k2 * n + j] = mat[k2 * n + j] - g2 * diag[k2]
                    k2 = k2 + 1
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
        }

        var k3 = 0
        while k3 <= i {
            mat[k3 * n + (i + 1)] = 0.0
            k3 = k3 + 1
        }

        i = i + 1
    }

    j = 0
    while j < n {
        diag[j] = mat[(n - 1) * n + j]
        mat[(n - 1) * n + j] = 0.0
        j = j + 1
    }
    mat[(n - 1) * n + (n - 1)] = 1.0
    subdiag[0] = 0.0
}

fn eg_tridiag_iter_no_vecs(diag: &![f64; 256], subdiag: &![f64; 256], n: i32, max_iter: i32) -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let tol = 1.0e-12
    var total_iter = 0
    var l = 0

    while l < n {
        var keep_iterating = true
        while keep_iterating {
            var m = l
            while m < n - 1 {
                let dd = eg_abs(diag[m]) + eg_abs(diag[m + 1])
                if eg_abs(subdiag[m]) <= tol * (dd + 1.0) { break }
                m = m + 1
            }

            if m == l {
                keep_iterating = false
            } else {
                if total_iter >= max_iter { return false }
                total_iter = total_iter + 1

                var g = (diag[l + 1] - diag[l]) / (2.0 * subdiag[l])
                let gr = eg_hypot(g, 1.0)
                if g < 0.0 {
                    g = diag[m] - diag[l] + subdiag[l] / (g - gr)
                } else {
                    g = diag[m] - diag[l] + subdiag[l] / (g + gr)
                }

                var s = 1.0
                var c = 1.0
                var p = 0.0
                var restart = false
                var i = m - 1
                while i >= l {
                    let f = s * subdiag[i]
                    let b = c * subdiag[i]
                    let r = eg_hypot(f, g)
                    subdiag[i + 1] = r

                    if r <= 1.0e-30 {
                        diag[i + 1] = diag[i + 1] - p
                        subdiag[m] = 0.0
                        restart = true
                        break
                    }

                    s = f / r
                    c = g / r
                    g = diag[i + 1] - p
                    let t = (diag[i] - g) * s + 2.0 * c * b
                    p = s * t
                    diag[i + 1] = g + p
                    g = c * t - b

                    if i == l { break }
                    i = i - 1
                }

                if restart { continue }

                diag[l] = diag[l] - p
                subdiag[l] = g
                subdiag[m] = 0.0
            }
        }

        l = l + 1
    }

    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        subdiag[i] = 0.0
        i = i + 1
    }
    eg_sort_values(diag, n)
    true
}

fn eg_tridiag_iter_with_vecs(
    diag: &![f64; 256],
    subdiag: &![f64; 256],
    n: i32,
    max_iter: i32,
    vecs: &![f64; 65536]
) -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let tol = 1.0e-12
    var total_iter = 0
    var l = 0

    while l < n {
        var keep_iterating = true
        while keep_iterating {
            var m = l
            while m < n - 1 {
                let dd = eg_abs(diag[m]) + eg_abs(diag[m + 1])
                if eg_abs(subdiag[m]) <= tol * (dd + 1.0) { break }
                m = m + 1
            }

            if m == l {
                keep_iterating = false
            } else {
                if total_iter >= max_iter { return false }
                total_iter = total_iter + 1

                var g = (diag[l + 1] - diag[l]) / (2.0 * subdiag[l])
                let gr = eg_hypot(g, 1.0)
                if g < 0.0 {
                    g = diag[m] - diag[l] + subdiag[l] / (g - gr)
                } else {
                    g = diag[m] - diag[l] + subdiag[l] / (g + gr)
                }

                var s = 1.0
                var c = 1.0
                var p = 0.0
                var restart = false
                var i = m - 1
                while i >= l {
                    let f = s * subdiag[i]
                    let b = c * subdiag[i]
                    let r = eg_hypot(f, g)
                    subdiag[i + 1] = r

                    if r <= 1.0e-30 {
                        diag[i + 1] = diag[i + 1] - p
                        subdiag[m] = 0.0
                        restart = true
                        break
                    }

                    s = f / r
                    c = g / r
                    g = diag[i + 1] - p
                    let t = (diag[i] - g) * s + 2.0 * c * b
                    p = s * t
                    diag[i + 1] = g + p
                    g = c * t - b

                    var k = 0
                    while k < n {
                        let vk1 = vecs[k * n + (i + 1)]
                        let vki = vecs[k * n + i]
                        vecs[k * n + (i + 1)] = s * vki + c * vk1
                        vecs[k * n + i] = c * vki - s * vk1
                        k = k + 1
                    }

                    if i == l { break }
                    i = i - 1
                }

                if restart { continue }

                diag[l] = diag[l] - p
                subdiag[l] = g
                subdiag[m] = 0.0
            }
        }

        l = l + 1
    }

    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        subdiag[i] = 0.0
        i = i + 1
    }
    eg_sort_pairs(diag, vecs, n)
    true
}

fn householder_tridiag_raw(mat: &![f64; 65536], n: i32, diag: &![f64; 256], subdiag: &![f64; 256]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if n <= 0 { return }
    if n == 1 {
        diag[0] = mat[0]
        subdiag[0] = 0.0
        return
    }
    eg_tred2_inplace(mat, n, diag, subdiag)
    eg_shift_subdiag_left(subdiag, n)
}

fn qr_tridiag_raw(
    diag: &![f64; 256],
    subdiag: &![f64; 256],
    n: i32,
    max_iter: i32,
    vecs: &![f64; 65536]
) -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    eg_identity(vecs, n)
    eg_tridiag_iter_with_vecs(diag, subdiag, n, max_iter, vecs)
}

fn eigen_symmetric_raw(
    mat: &![f64; 65536],
    n: i32,
    diag: &![f64; 256],
    subdiag: &![f64; 256],
    vecs: &![f64; 65536]
) -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if n <= 0 { return false }
    if n == 1 {
        diag[0] = mat[0]
        subdiag[0] = 0.0
        eg_identity(vecs, 1)
        return true
    }

    eg_copy_matrix(vecs, mat, n)
    eg_tred2_inplace(vecs, n, diag, subdiag)
    eg_shift_subdiag_left(subdiag, n)

    let max_steps = 128 * n
    eg_tridiag_iter_with_vecs(diag, subdiag, n, max_steps, vecs)
}

pub fn eigen_workspace_reset(n: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var size = n
    if size < 0 { size = 0 }
    if size > 256 { size = 256 }
    EIG_WORK_N = size
    EIG_WORK_CONVERGED = 0

    var i = 0
    while i < size {
        EIG_WORK_DIAG[i] = 0.0
        EIG_WORK_SUBDIAG[i] = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < size {
            EIG_WORK_MAT[i * size + j] = 0.0
            EIG_WORK_VECS[i * size + j] = 0.0
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

pub fn eigen_workspace_n() -> i32 {
    EIG_WORK_N
}

pub fn eigen_workspace_set(row: i32, col: i32, value: f64) with Mut, Panic {
    if row < 0 { return }
    if col < 0 { return }
    if row >= EIG_WORK_N { return }
    if col >= EIG_WORK_N { return }
    EIG_WORK_MAT[row * EIG_WORK_N + col] = value
}

pub fn eigen_workspace_get(row: i32, col: i32) -> f64 with Panic {
    if row < 0 { return 0.0 }
    if col < 0 { return 0.0 }
    if row >= EIG_WORK_N { return 0.0 }
    if col >= EIG_WORK_N { return 0.0 }
    EIG_WORK_MAT[row * EIG_WORK_N + col]
}

pub fn householder_tridiag(
    mat: &![f64; 65536],
    n: i32,
    diag: &![f64; 256],
    subdiag: &![f64; 256]
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    householder_tridiag_raw(mat, n, diag, subdiag)
}

pub fn qr_tridiag(
    diag: &![f64; 256],
    subdiag: &![f64; 256],
    n: i32,
    max_iter: i32
) -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    qr_tridiag_raw(diag, subdiag, n, max_iter, &!EIG_WORK_VECS)
}

pub fn eigen_symmetric(
    mat: &![f64; 65536],
    n: i32,
    eigenvalues: &![f64; 256],
    eigenvectors: &![f64; 65536]
) -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var subdiag: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    let ok = eigen_symmetric_raw(mat, n, eigenvalues, &!subdiag, eigenvectors)
    ok
}

pub fn eigen_workspace_householder_tridiag(n: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    EIG_WORK_N = n
    householder_tridiag(&!EIG_WORK_MAT, n, &!EIG_WORK_DIAG, &!EIG_WORK_SUBDIAG)
    EIG_WORK_CONVERGED = 1
}

pub fn eigen_workspace_qr_tridiag(n: i32, max_iter: i32) -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    EIG_WORK_N = n
    let ok = qr_tridiag(&!EIG_WORK_DIAG, &!EIG_WORK_SUBDIAG, n, max_iter)
    if ok { EIG_WORK_CONVERGED = 1 } else { EIG_WORK_CONVERGED = 0 }
    ok
}

pub fn eigen_workspace_symmetric(n: i32) -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    EIG_WORK_N = n
    let ok = eigen_symmetric(&!EIG_WORK_MAT, n, &!EIG_WORK_DIAG, &!EIG_WORK_VECS)
    if ok { EIG_WORK_CONVERGED = 1 } else { EIG_WORK_CONVERGED = 0 }
    ok
}

pub fn eigen_converged() -> bool {
    EIG_WORK_CONVERGED == 1
}

pub fn tridiag_diag_get(idx: i32) -> f64 with Panic {
    if idx < 0 { return 0.0 }
    if idx >= EIG_WORK_N { return 0.0 }
    EIG_WORK_DIAG[idx]
}

pub fn tridiag_subdiag_get(idx: i32) -> f64 with Panic {
    if idx < 0 { return 0.0 }
    if idx >= EIG_WORK_N { return 0.0 }
    EIG_WORK_SUBDIAG[idx]
}

pub fn eigenvalue_get(idx: i32) -> f64 with Panic {
    if idx < 0 { return 0.0 }
    if idx >= EIG_WORK_N { return 0.0 }
    EIG_WORK_DIAG[idx]
}

pub fn eigenvector_get(row: i32, col: i32) -> f64 with Panic {
    if row < 0 { return 0.0 }
    if col < 0 { return 0.0 }
    if row >= EIG_WORK_N { return 0.0 }
    if col >= EIG_WORK_N { return 0.0 }
    EIG_WORK_VECS[row * EIG_WORK_N + col]
}


// === FILE: stdlib/linalg/epistemic_matrix.sio ===
// stdlib/linalg/epistemic_matrix.sio — Epistemic Matrices
//
// Matrix where every element carries uncertainty and confidence.
// GUM-compliant uncertainty propagation through all matrix operations.
//
// When you multiply two epistemic matrices, the uncertainty PROPAGATES
// according to the law of propagation of uncertainty (GUM Section 5.1):
//   u(c_ij)^2 = sum_k( u(a_ik)^2 * b_kj^2 + a_ik^2 * u(b_kj)^2 )
// And confidence DEGRADES monotonically:
//   conf(c_ij) = min over all contributing elements
//
// This is the matrix algebra that scientific computing SHOULD have:
// every result knows how uncertain it is.
//
// # BLAS Acceleration
//
// When both input matrices are deterministic (all uncertainties = 0),
// matmul dispatches to optimized BLAS (OpenBLAS/MKL) via FFI for
// 5-50x speedup on large matrices. For epistemic matrices, pure-Sounio
// fallback is used to correctly propagate uncertainty.
//
// SOTA: GUM (2008): "Guide to Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement"
//       GUM Supplement 1 (2008): Monte Carlo propagation
//
// References:
//   JCGM 100:2008: "Evaluation of measurement data"
//   Sounio GUM compliance tests: tests/run-pass/gum_compliance.sio

module linalg::epistemic_matrix

// =============================================================================
// Math helpers
// =============================================================================

fn sqrt_em(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

fn abs_em(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn min_em(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a < b { a } else { b }
}

// =============================================================================
// Core Type
// =============================================================================

// Maximum size: 16x16 = 256 elements
///
/// # EpistemicMatrix
///
/// Matrix where every element carries uncertainty and confidence.
/// GUM-compliant uncertainty propagation through all matrix operations.
///
/// # Builder Pattern
///
/// ```sio
/// let m = EpistemicMatrix::zeros(3, 3)
///     .uncertainty(0.1)
///     .confidence(0.95)
///     .set(0, 0, 1.0)
/// ```
///
/// # Method Chaining
///
/// ```sio
/// let a = EpistemicMatrix::identity(2)
///     .uncertainty(0.05)
///     .confidence(0.99);
///
/// let b = EpistemicMatrix::zeros(2, 2)
///     .set(0, 0, 2.0)
///     .set(1, 1, 2.0);
///
/// let c = a.matmul(&b);
/// ```
pub struct EpistemicMatrix {
    pub values: [f64; 256],         // matrix elements
    pub uncertainties: [f64; 256],  // standard uncertainty per element
    pub confidences: [f64; 256],    // confidence level per element [0, 1]
    pub rows: i32,
    pub cols: i32,
    // Builder state for default uncertainty/confidence
    pub default_uncertainty: f64,
    pub default_confidence: f64,
}

// =============================================================================
// Constructors (Builder Pattern + Standalone for backward compatibility)
// =============================================================================

/// Create a zero matrix with builder pattern.
///
/// # Parameters
/// - `rows`: Number of rows
/// - `cols`: Number of columns
///
/// # Return
/// EpistemicMatrix with all zeros, zero uncertainty, confidence 1.0
///
/// # Complexity
/// O(rows * cols)
///
/// # Example
/// ```sio
/// let m = EpistemicMatrix::zeros(3, 3)
///     .uncertainty(0.1)
///     .confidence(0.95)
///     .set(0, 0, 1.0);
/// ```
impl EpistemicMatrix {
    /// Create a zero matrix ready for builder pattern.
    pub fn zeros(rows: i32, cols: i32) -> EpistemicMatrix {
        EpistemicMatrix {
            values: [0.0; 256],
            uncertainties: [0.0; 256],
            confidences: [1.0; 256],
            rows: rows,
            cols: cols,
            default_uncertainty: 0.0,
            default_confidence: 1.0,
        }
    }

    /// Create an identity matrix with builder pattern.
    ///
    /// # Parameters
    /// - `n`: Size of the square identity matrix
    ///
    /// # Return
    /// EpistemicMatrix with 1s on diagonal, 0s elsewhere
    pub fn identity(n: i32) -> EpistemicMatrix with Mut, Div, Panic {
        var m = EpistemicMatrix::zeros(n, n)
        var i = 0
        while i < n {
            m.values[i * n + i] = 1.0
            m.uncertainties[i * n + i] = 0.0
            m.confidences[i * n + i] = 1.0
            i = i + 1
        }
        m
    }

    /// Set default uncertainty for subsequent .set() calls.
    ///
    /// # Parameters
    /// - `u`: Default standard uncertainty
    ///
    /// # Return
    /// Self for method chaining
    pub fn uncertainty(self, u: f64) -> EpistemicMatrix {
        var result = self
        result.default_uncertainty = u
        result
    }

    /// Set default confidence for subsequent .set() calls.
    ///
    /// # Parameters
    /// - `c`: Default confidence level [0, 1]
    ///
    /// # Return
    /// Self for method chaining
    pub fn confidence(self, c: f64) -> EpistemicMatrix {
        var result = self
        result.default_confidence = c
        result
    }

    /// Set element value using default uncertainty and confidence.
    ///
    /// # Parameters
    /// - `row`: Row index
    /// - `col`: Column index
    /// - `val`: Element value
    ///
    /// # Return
    /// Self for method chaining
    pub fn set(self, row: i32, col: i32, val: f64) -> EpistemicMatrix with Mut, Panic {
        var result = self
        let idx = row * result.cols + col
        result.values[idx] = val
        result.uncertainties[idx] = result.default_uncertainty
        result.confidences[idx] = result.default_confidence
        result
    }

    /// Set element with explicit uncertainty and confidence.
    ///
    /// # Parameters
    /// - `row`: Row index
    /// - `col`: Column index
    /// - `val`: Element value
    /// - `unc`: Standard uncertainty
    /// - `conf`: Confidence level [0, 1]
    ///
    /// # Return
    /// Self for method chaining
    pub fn set_full(self, row: i32, col: i32, val: f64, unc: f64, conf: f64) -> EpistemicMatrix with Mut, Panic {
        var result = self
        let idx = row * result.cols + col
        result.values[idx] = val
        result.uncertainties[idx] = unc
        result.confidences[idx] = conf
        result
    }

    /// Matrix multiplication with GUM uncertainty propagation.
    ///
    /// # Parameters
    /// - `other`: Right-hand matrix
    ///
    /// # Return
    /// New EpistemicMatrix with propagated uncertainty
    ///
    /// # Complexity
    /// O(self.rows * self.cols * other.cols)
    ///
    /// # BLAS Dispatch
    /// When both matrices are deterministic (all uncertainties = 0, all confidences = 1),
    /// this method dispatches to optimized BLAS (OpenBLAS/MKL) for 5-50x speedup.
    /// For epistemic matrices, pure-Sounio GUM propagation is used.
    ///
    /// # GUM Formula
    /// c_ij = sum_l a_il * b_lj
    /// u(c_ij)^2 = sum_l( u(a_il)^2 * b_lj^2 + a_il^2 * u(b_lj)^2 )
    /// conf(c_ij) = min over all contributing elements
    /// Matrix multiplication with GUM uncertainty propagation.
    /// Pure-Sounio implementation — correct for all epistemic matrices.
    pub fn matmul(&self, other: &EpistemicMatrix) -> EpistemicMatrix with Mut, Div, Panic {
        var c = EpistemicMatrix::zeros(self.rows, other.cols)
        let k = self.cols  // inner dimension

        var i = 0
        while i < self.rows {
            var j = 0
            while j < other.cols {
                var sum_val: f64 = 0.0
                var sum_unc_sq: f64 = 0.0
                var min_conf: f64 = 1.0

                var l = 0
                while l < k {
                    let a_il = self.values[i * k + l]
                    let b_lj = other.values[l * other.cols + j]
                    let ua_il = self.uncertainties[i * k + l]
                    let ub_lj = other.uncertainties[l * other.cols + j]

                    sum_val = sum_val + a_il * b_lj

                    // GUM quadrature: u^2 = sum(partial_a^2 * u_a^2 + partial_b^2 * u_b^2)
                    sum_unc_sq = sum_unc_sq + ua_il * ua_il * b_lj * b_lj + a_il * a_il * ub_lj * ub_lj

                    // Confidence degrades through the chain
                    let conf_a = self.confidences[i * k + l]
                    let conf_b = other.confidences[l * other.cols + j]
                    let local_min = min_em(conf_a, conf_b)
                    min_conf = min_em(min_conf, local_min)

                    l = l + 1
                }

                let idx = i * other.cols + j
                c.values[idx] = sum_val
                c.uncertainties[idx] = sqrt_em(sum_unc_sq)
                c.confidences[idx] = min_conf

                j = j + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        c
    }

    /// Matrix addition with GUM uncertainty propagation.
    ///
    /// # Parameters
    /// - `other`: Right-hand matrix
    ///
    /// # Return
    /// New EpistemicMatrix with propagated uncertainty
    pub fn add(&self, other: &EpistemicMatrix) -> EpistemicMatrix with Mut, Div, Panic {
        var c = EpistemicMatrix::zeros(self.rows, self.cols)
        var i = 0
        while i < self.rows {
            var j = 0
            while j < self.cols {
                let idx = i * self.cols + j
                c.values[idx] = self.values[idx] + other.values[idx]
                // GUM: u(c) = sqrt(u(a)^2 + u(b)^2)
                let ua = self.uncertainties[idx]
                let ub = other.uncertainties[idx]
                c.uncertainties[idx] = sqrt_em(ua * ua + ub * ub)
                // Confidence: monotone non-increasing
                c.confidences[idx] = min_em(self.confidences[idx], other.confidences[idx])
                j = j + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        c
    }

    /// Matrix subtraction with GUM uncertainty propagation.
    pub fn sub(&self, other: &EpistemicMatrix) -> EpistemicMatrix with Mut, Div, Panic {
        var c = EpistemicMatrix::zeros(self.rows, self.cols)
        var i = 0
        while i < self.rows {
            var j = 0
            while j < self.cols {
                let idx = i * self.cols + j
                c.values[idx] = self.values[idx] - other.values[idx]
                let ua = self.uncertainties[idx]
                let ub = other.uncertainties[idx]
                c.uncertainties[idx] = sqrt_em(ua * ua + ub * ub)
                c.confidences[idx] = min_em(self.confidences[idx], other.confidences[idx])
                j = j + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        c
    }

    /// Scalar multiplication with uncertainty scaling.
    pub fn scale(&self, scalar: f64) -> EpistemicMatrix with Mut, Div, Panic {
        var result = EpistemicMatrix::zeros(self.rows, self.cols)
        let as_val = abs_em(scalar)
        var i = 0
        while i < self.rows * self.cols {
            result.values[i] = scalar * self.values[i]
            result.uncertainties[i] = as_val * self.uncertainties[i]
            result.confidences[i] = self.confidences[i]
            i = i + 1
        }
        result
    }

    /// Matrix transpose.
    pub fn transpose(&self) -> EpistemicMatrix with Mut, Div, Panic {
        var result = EpistemicMatrix::zeros(self.cols, self.rows)
        var i = 0
        while i < self.rows {
            var j = 0
            while j < self.cols {
                let src = i * self.cols + j
                let dst = j * self.rows + i
                result.values[dst] = self.values[src]
                result.uncertainties[dst] = self.uncertainties[src]
                result.confidences[dst] = self.confidences[src]
                j = j + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        result
    }

    /// Get element value.
    pub fn get_val(&self, row: i32, col: i32) -> f64 with Panic {
        self.values[row * self.cols + col]
    }

    /// Get element uncertainty.
    pub fn get_unc(&self, row: i32, col: i32) -> f64 with Panic {
        self.uncertainties[row * self.cols + col]
    }

    /// Get element confidence.
    pub fn get_conf(&self, row: i32, col: i32) -> f64 with Panic {
        self.confidences[row * self.cols + col]
    }

    /// Frobenius norm with uncertainty.
    pub fn frobenius(&self) -> EpistemicScalar with Mut, Div, Panic {
        ematrix_frobenius(self)
    }

    /// Trace with uncertainty.
    pub fn trace(&self) -> EpistemicScalar with Mut, Div, Panic {
        ematrix_trace(self)
    }

    /// Confidence summary.
    pub fn confidence_summary(&self) -> MatrixConfidenceSummary with Mut, Div, Panic {
        ematrix_confidence_summary(self)
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Standalone Constructors (Backward Compatibility)
// =============================================================================

/// Create a zero matrix.
///
/// # Backward Compatibility
/// Prefer `EpistemicMatrix::zeros(rows, cols)` for new code.
pub fn ematrix_zeros(rows: i32, cols: i32) -> EpistemicMatrix {
    EpistemicMatrix {
        values: [0.0; 256],
        uncertainties: [0.0; 256],
        confidences: [1.0; 256],
        rows: rows,
        cols: cols,
        default_uncertainty: 0.0,
        default_confidence: 1.0,
    }
}

/// Create an identity matrix.
pub fn ematrix_identity(n: i32) -> EpistemicMatrix with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var m = ematrix_zeros(n, n)
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        m.values[i * n + i] = 1.0
        m.uncertainties[i * n + i] = 0.0
        m.confidences[i * n + i] = 1.0
        i = i + 1
    }
    m
}

/// Set element with uncertainty.
///
/// # Backward Compatibility
/// Prefer builder pattern: `m.uncertainty(u).confidence(c).set(row, col, val)` for new code.
pub fn ematrix_set(
    m: &!EpistemicMatrix,
    row: i32, col: i32,
    val: f64, unc: f64, conf: f64,
) with Mut, Panic {
    let idx = row * m.cols + col
    m.values[idx] = val
    m.uncertainties[idx] = unc
    m.confidences[idx] = conf
}

/// Get element value.
///
/// # Backward Compatibility
/// Prefer `m.get_val(row, col)` for new code.
pub fn ematrix_get_val(m: &EpistemicMatrix, row: i32, col: i32) -> f64 with Panic {
    m.get_val(row, col)
}

/// Get element uncertainty.
///
/// # Backward Compatibility
/// Prefer `m.get_unc(row, col)` for new code.
pub fn ematrix_get_unc(m: &EpistemicMatrix, row: i32, col: i32) -> f64 with Panic {
    m.get_unc(row, col)
}

/// Get element confidence.
///
/// # Backward Compatibility
/// Prefer `m.get_conf(row, col)` for new code.
pub fn ematrix_get_conf(m: &EpistemicMatrix, row: i32, col: i32) -> f64 with Panic {
    m.get_conf(row, col)
}

// =============================================================================
// Matrix Norms (with uncertainty)
// =============================================================================

/// Scalar with epistemic information.
pub struct EpistemicScalar {
    pub value: f64,
    pub uncertainty: f64,
    pub confidence: f64,
}

// Frobenius norm: ||A||_F = sqrt(sum(a_ij^2))
pub fn ematrix_frobenius(m: &EpistemicMatrix) -> EpistemicScalar with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum_sq: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_unc_sq: f64 = 0.0
    var min_conf: f64 = 1.0

    var i = 0
    while i < m.rows * m.cols {
        let v = m.values[i]
        let u = m.uncertainties[i]
        sum_sq = sum_sq + v * v
        // d(||A||_F^2)/d(a_ij) = 2*a_ij, so u(sum)^2 += (2*a_ij)^2 * u_ij^2
        sum_unc_sq = sum_unc_sq + 4.0 * v * v * u * u
        min_conf = min_em(min_conf, m.confidences[i])
        i = i + 1
    }

    let norm = sqrt_em(sum_sq)
    // u(sqrt(x)) = u(x) / (2*sqrt(x))
    let norm_unc = if norm > 1.0e-30 { sqrt_em(sum_unc_sq) / (2.0 * norm) } else { 0.0 }

    EpistemicScalar {
        value: norm,
        uncertainty: norm_unc,
        confidence: min_conf,
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Trace (with uncertainty)
// =============================================================================

pub fn ematrix_trace(m: &EpistemicMatrix) -> EpistemicScalar with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_unc_sq: f64 = 0.0
    var min_conf: f64 = 1.0

    let n = if m.rows < m.cols { m.rows } else { m.cols }
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let idx = i * m.cols + i
        sum = sum + m.values[idx]
        let u = m.uncertainties[idx]
        sum_unc_sq = sum_unc_sq + u * u
        min_conf = min_em(min_conf, m.confidences[idx])
        i = i + 1
    }

    EpistemicScalar {
        value: sum,
        uncertainty: sqrt_em(sum_unc_sq),
        confidence: min_conf,
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Confidence Summary
// =============================================================================

pub struct MatrixConfidenceSummary {
    pub min_confidence: f64,
    pub max_confidence: f64,
    pub mean_confidence: f64,
    pub max_relative_uncertainty: f64,  // max(u/|v|) across all elements
}

fn ematrix_confidence_summary(m: &EpistemicMatrix) -> MatrixConfidenceSummary with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var min_c: f64 = 1.0
    var max_c: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_c: f64 = 0.0
    var max_rel: f64 = 0.0
    let n = m.rows * m.cols

    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let c = m.confidences[i]
        if c < min_c { min_c = c }
        if c > max_c { max_c = c }
        sum_c = sum_c + c

        let v = abs_em(m.values[i])
        if v > 1.0e-30 {
            let rel = m.uncertainties[i] / v
            if rel > max_rel { max_rel = rel }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    MatrixConfidenceSummary {
        min_confidence: min_c,
        max_confidence: max_c,
        mean_confidence: sum_c / (n as f64),
        max_relative_uncertainty: max_rel,
    }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/linalg/epistemic_tensor.sio ===
// stdlib/linalg/epistemic_tensor.sio — Epistemic Tensors (Rank-3)
//
// Generalizes EpistemicMatrix to batched tensors (batch x rows x cols).
// Max size: batch*rows*cols <= 256 elements.
// GUM-compliant uncertainty propagation through all tensor operations.
//
// When you multiply two epistemic tensors, the uncertainty PROPAGATES
// according to the law of propagation of uncertainty (GUM Section 5.1).
// Confidence DEGRADES monotonically through compositions.
//
// This is the tensor algebra that scientific ML SHOULD have:
// every result knows how uncertain it is.
//
// References:
//   JCGM 100:2008: "Evaluation of measurement data" (GUM)
//   Golub & Van Loan (2013) "Matrix Computations" 4th ed.
//
// # Exemplo
// ```sio
// let a = etensor_constant(1, 2, 2, 1.0);  // 1x2x2 tensor of 1.0
// let b = etensor_measured(1, 2, 2, data, unc, conf);
// let c = etensor_matmul(&a, &b);
// let summary = etensor_confidence_summary(&c);
// assert(summary.min_confidence <= 1.0);
// ```

// =============================================================================
// Math helpers
// =============================================================================

fn sqrt_et(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

fn abs_et(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn min_et(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a < b { a } else { b }
}

fn max_et(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { a } else { b }
}

// =============================================================================
// Core Type
// =============================================================================

/// EpistemicTensor - Rank-3 tensor with per-element uncertainty and confidence.
///
/// Each element carries:
/// - value: the point estimate
/// - uncertainty: standard uncertainty (u)
/// - confidence: confidence level [0, 1]
///
/// Storage: flat array of size batch * rows * cols <= 256
/// Index: element (b, i, j) at index b * rows * cols + i * cols + j
pub struct EpistemicTensor {
    values: [f64; 256],
    uncertainties: [f64; 256],
    confidences: [f64; 256],
    batch: i64,
    rows: i64,
    cols: i64,
}

// =============================================================================
// Epistemic Scalar (for reductions)
// =============================================================================

pub struct EpistemicScalar {
    value: f64,
    uncertainty: f64,
    confidence: f64,
}

// =============================================================================
// Constructors
// =============================================================================

/// Create zero tensor with given shape.
pub fn etensor_zeros(batch: i64, rows: i64, cols: i64) -> EpistemicTensor with Panic {
    let total = batch * rows * cols
    if total > 256 { panic("EpistemicTensor: size exceeds 256 elements") }
    EpistemicTensor {
        values: [0.0; 256],
        uncertainties: [0.0; 256],
        confidences: [1.0; 256],
        batch: batch,
        rows: rows,
        cols: cols,
    }
}

/// Create batched identity matrices.
pub fn etensor_identity(batch: i64, n: i64) -> EpistemicTensor with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var m = etensor_zeros(batch, n, n)
    var b = 0
    while b < batch {
        var i = 0
        while i < n {
            let idx = b * n * n + i * n + i
            m.values[idx] = 1.0
            m.uncertainties[idx] = 0.0
            m.confidences[idx] = 1.0
            i = i + 1
        }
        b = b + 1
    }
    m
}

/// Create tensor filled with constant value.
pub fn etensor_constant(batch: i64, rows: i64, cols: i64, val: f64) -> EpistemicTensor with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var m = etensor_zeros(batch, rows, cols)
    let total = batch * rows * cols
    var i = 0
    while i < total {
        m.values[i] = val
        m.uncertainties[i] = 0.0
        m.confidences[i] = 1.0
        i = i + 1
    }
    m
}

// =============================================================================
// Element Access
// =============================================================================

/// Compute flat index from (batch, row, col).
fn etensor_idx(t: &EpistemicTensor, b: i64, r: i64, c: i64) -> i64 {
    b * t.rows * t.cols + r * t.cols + c
}

/// Get value at (b, r, c).
pub fn etensor_get_val(t: &EpistemicTensor, b: i64, r: i64, c: i64) -> f64 with Panic {
    let idx = etensor_idx(t, b, r, c)
    t.values[idx]
}

/// Get uncertainty at (b, r, c).
pub fn etensor_get_unc(t: &EpistemicTensor, b: i64, r: i64, c: i64) -> f64 with Panic {
    let idx = etensor_idx(t, b, r, c)
    t.uncertainties[idx]
}

/// Get confidence at (b, r, c).
pub fn etensor_get_conf(t: &EpistemicTensor, b: i64, r: i64, c: i64) -> f64 with Panic {
    let idx = etensor_idx(t, b, r, c)
    t.confidences[idx]
}

/// Set element with full epistemic metadata.
pub fn etensor_set(
    m: &!EpistemicTensor,
    b: i64, r: i64, c: i64,
    val: f64, unc: f64, conf: f64,
) with Mut, Panic {
    let idx = etensor_idx(m, b, r, c)
    m.values[idx] = val
    m.uncertainties[idx] = unc
    m.confidences[idx] = conf
}

// =============================================================================
// Elementwise Addition — GUM propagation
// =============================================================================

pub fn etensor_add(a: &EpistemicTensor, b: &EpistemicTensor) -> EpistemicTensor with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if a.batch != b.batch || a.rows != b.rows || a.cols != b.cols {
        panic("etensor_add: shape mismatch")
    }
    var c = etensor_zeros(a.batch, a.rows, a.cols)
    var bb = 0
    while bb < a.batch {
        var i = 0
        while i < a.rows {
            var j = 0
            while j < a.cols {
                let idx = etensor_idx(&c, bb, i, j)
                let va = etensor_get_val(a, bb, i, j)
                let vb = etensor_get_val(b, bb, i, j)
                let ua = etensor_get_unc(a, bb, i, j)
                let ub = etensor_get_unc(b, bb, i, j)
                let ca = etensor_get_conf(a, bb, i, j)
                let cb = etensor_get_conf(b, bb, i, j)

                c.values[idx] = va + vb
                c.uncertainties[idx] = sqrt_et(ua * ua + ub * ub)
                c.confidences[idx] = min_et(ca, cb)
                j = j + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        bb = bb + 1
    }
    c
}

// =============================================================================
// Elementwise Subtraction
// =============================================================================

pub fn etensor_sub(a: &EpistemicTensor, b: &EpistemicTensor) -> EpistemicTensor with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if a.batch != b.batch || a.rows != b.rows || a.cols != b.cols {
        panic("etensor_sub: shape mismatch")
    }
    var c = etensor_zeros(a.batch, a.rows, a.cols)
    var bb = 0
    while bb < a.batch {
        var i = 0
        while i < a.rows {
            var j = 0
            while j < a.cols {
                let idx = etensor_idx(&c, bb, i, j)
                let va = etensor_get_val(a, bb, i, j)
                let vb = etensor_get_val(b, bb, i, j)
                let ua = etensor_get_unc(a, bb, i, j)
                let ub = etensor_get_unc(b, bb, i, j)
