                } else {
                    gb[gi] = 0.0
                }
                gi = gi + 1
            }
            let gnorm = co_norminf(&gb, n)
            if gnorm < config.tol_opt {
                inner = 80
            } else {
                co_copy(&x, &!xprev, n)
                co_copy(&gb, &!gb_prev, n)
                if inner == 0 {
                    var di = 0
                    while di < n { db[di] = 0.0 - gb[di]; di = di + 1 }
                } else {
                    lbfgs_direction(&istate, &gb, &!db)
                }
                let ab = barrier_line_search(f, c_ineq, n_ineq,
                                             &x, &db, &gb, n, t)
                var ui = 0
                while ui < n { x[ui] = x[ui] + ab * db[ui]; ui = ui + 1 }

                // Recompute gradient for L-BFGS
                gi = 0
                while gi < n {
                    var j = 0
                    while j < n { xpp[j] = x[j]; xmm[j] = x[j]; j = j + 1 }
                    let h = cbrt_eps * co_max(co_abs(x[gi]), 1.0)
                    xpp[gi] = x[gi] + h
                    xmm[gi] = x[gi] - h
                    let fp2 = barrier_eval_obj(f, c_ineq, n_ineq, &xpp, n, t)
                    let fm2 = barrier_eval_obj(f, c_ineq, n_ineq, &xmm, n, t)
                    let diff2 = fp2 - fm2
                    if co_abs(diff2) < 1.0e300 {
                        gb[gi] = diff2 / (2.0 * h)
                    } else {
                        gb[gi] = 0.0
                    }
                    gi = gi + 1
                }
                var si = 0
                while si < n {
                    sb[si] = x[si] - xprev[si]
                    yb[si] = gb[si] - gb_prev[si]
                    si = si + 1
                }
                let syb = co_dot(&sb, &yb, n)
                if syb > 1.0e-16 { lbfgs_update(&!istate, &sb, &yb) }
                inner = inner + 1
            }
        }

        // Check duality gap: m/t
        let gap = (n_ineq as f64) / t
        if gap < config.tol_opt {
            c_ineq(&x, n, &!cv, n_ineq)
            var mv = 0.0
            i = 0
            while i < n_ineq {
                if cv[i] > 0.0 { if cv[i] > mv { mv = cv[i] } }
                i = i + 1
            }
            co_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
            result.obj_val = f(&x, n)
            result.constraint_viol = mv
            result.iterations = outer
            result.converged = true
            result.n_dim = n
            return
        }
        t = t * config.rho
        outer = outer + 1
    }

    c_ineq(&x, n, &!cv, n_ineq)
    var mv = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n_ineq {
        if cv[i] > 0.0 { if cv[i] > mv { mv = cv[i] } }
        i = i + 1
    }
    co_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
    result.obj_val = f(&x, n)
    result.constraint_viol = mv
    result.iterations = outer
    result.converged = false
    result.n_dim = n
}

// =============================================================================
// KKT violation analysis
// =============================================================================

// Compute max KKT violation for a constrained optimization solution.
// Checks: stationarity, primal feasibility (eq+ineq), dual feasibility, complementarity.
// jac_eq: n_eq x n row-major, jac_ineq: n_ineq x n row-major.
fn kkt_violation(grad_f_x: &[f64; 64],
                 jac_eq: &[f64; 4096], n_eq: i32,
                 jac_ineq: &[f64; 4096], n_ineq: i32,
                 lambda_eq: &[f64; 64], lambda_ineq: &[f64; 64],
                 c_eq_x: &[f64; 64], c_ineq_x: &[f64; 64],
                 n: i32) -> f64 with Panic, Mut, Div {
    // Stationarity: ||grad_f + J_eq^T*lam_eq + J_ineq^T*lam_ineq||_inf
    var stat: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var i = 0
    while i < n { stat[i] = grad_f_x[i]; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < n_eq {
        var j = 0
        while j < n { stat[j] = stat[j] + jac_eq[i * n + j] * lambda_eq[i]; j = j + 1 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    i = 0
    while i < n_ineq {
        var j = 0
        while j < n { stat[j] = stat[j] + jac_ineq[i * n + j] * lambda_ineq[i]; j = j + 1 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    var sv = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n { let v = co_abs(stat[i]); if v > sv { sv = v }; i = i + 1 }

    // Primal feasibility (equality): ||c_eq||_inf
    var ev = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n_eq { let v = co_abs(c_eq_x[i]); if v > ev { ev = v }; i = i + 1 }

    // Primal feasibility (inequality): max(0, c_ineq_j)
    var iv = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n_ineq {
        if c_ineq_x[i] > 0.0 { if c_ineq_x[i] > iv { iv = c_ineq_x[i] } }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Dual feasibility: lambda_ineq >= 0
    var dv = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n_ineq {
        if lambda_ineq[i] < 0.0 { let v = co_abs(lambda_ineq[i]); if v > dv { dv = v } }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Complementarity: |lambda_ineq_j * c_ineq_j|
    var cv = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n_ineq {
        let v = co_abs(lambda_ineq[i] * c_ineq_x[i])
        if v > cv { cv = v }
        i = i + 1
    }

    var mx = sv
    if ev > mx { mx = ev }
    if iv > mx { mx = iv }
    if dv > mx { mx = dv }
    if cv > mx { mx = cv }
    mx
}

// =============================================================================
// Default configuration and initialization
// =============================================================================

// Default: max_iter=100, tol_opt=1e-8, tol_feas=1e-8, mu_init=1.0, mu_max=1e8, rho=10.0
fn constrained_default_config(cfg: &!ConstrainedConfig) with Div, Panic, Mut {
    cfg.max_iter = 100
    cfg.tol_opt = 1.0e-8
    cfg.tol_feas = 1.0e-8
    cfg.mu_init = 1.0
    cfg.mu_max = 1.0e8
    cfg.rho = 10.0
}

fn constrained_init_result(res: &!ConstrainedResult) with Div, Panic, Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 { res.x[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    res.obj_val = 0.0
    res.constraint_viol = 0.0
    res.iterations = 0
    res.converged = false
    res.n_dim = 0
}


// === FILE: stdlib/math/convex.sio ===
// stdlib/math/convex.sio — Convex optimization and proximal methods
//
// Pure Sounio implementations:
//   Proximal operators (L1 soft-threshold, L2-ball, nonneg, box, simplex)
//   Forward-backward splitting (proximal gradient)
//   FISTA (Nesterov-accelerated O(1/k^2) convergence)
//   ADMM (consensus splitting)
//   LASSO (L1-regularized least squares)
//   Moreau envelope, adaptive backtracking
//
// References:
//   Boyd et al. (2011): "Distributed Optimization via ADMM"
//   Beck & Teboulle (2009): "A Fast Iterative Shrinkage-Thresholding Algorithm"
//   Parikh & Boyd (2014): "Proximal Algorithms"

// =============================================================================
// Scalar helpers (cv_ prefix, self-contained)
// =============================================================================

fn cv_abs(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

fn cv_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }

fn cv_min(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }

fn cv_sign(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x > 0.0 { 1.0 }
    else if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - 1.0 }
    else { 0.0 }
}

fn cv_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 30 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

// =============================================================================
// Vector helpers (fixed-size [f64; 128])
// =============================================================================

// Dot product: sum a[i]*b[i] for i in 0..n
fn cv_dot(a: &[f64; 128], b: &[f64; 128], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var s = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n { s = s + a[i] * b[i]; i = i + 1 }
    s
}

// Euclidean norm: ||a||_2
fn cv_norm2(a: &[f64; 128], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var s = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n { s = s + a[i] * a[i]; i = i + 1 }
    cv_sqrt(s)
}

// AXPY: y[i] = y[i] + alpha * x[i]
fn cv_axpy(alpha: f64, x: &[f64; 128], y: &![f64; 128], n: i32) with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < n { y[i] = y[i] + alpha * x[i]; i = i + 1 }
}

// Copy: dst[i] = src[i]
fn cv_copy(src: &[f64; 128], dst: &![f64; 128], n: i32) with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < n { dst[i] = src[i]; i = i + 1 }
}

// Scale: x[i] = alpha * x[i]
fn cv_scale(alpha: f64, x: &![f64; 128], n: i32) with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < n { x[i] = alpha * x[i]; i = i + 1 }
}

// Zero: dst[i] = 0
fn cv_zero(dst: &![f64; 128], n: i32) with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < n { dst[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
}

// Infinity norm: max |a[i]|
fn cv_norminf(a: &[f64; 128], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var mx = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let v = cv_abs(a[i])
        if v > mx { mx = v }
        i = i + 1
    }
    mx
}

// =============================================================================
// Matrix-vector helpers (row-major flat arrays [f64; 16384])
// =============================================================================

// Matrix-vector product: y = A * x, where A is m-by-n row-major
// A stored as A[i*n + j], x is n-vector, y is m-vector
fn cv_matvec(A: &[f64; 16384], x: &[f64; 128], y: &![f64; 128],
             m: i32, n: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < m {
        var s = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            s = s + A[i * n + j] * x[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        y[i] = s
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Transpose matrix-vector product: y = A^T * x, where A is m-by-n row-major
// A^T is n-by-m, so y is n-vector, x is m-vector
fn cv_mat_t_vec(A: &[f64; 16384], x: &[f64; 128], y: &![f64; 128],
                m: i32, n: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var j = 0
    while j < n { y[j] = 0.0; j = j + 1 }
    var i = 0
    while i < m {
        j = 0
        while j < n {
            y[j] = y[j] + A[i * n + j] * x[i]
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Structs
// =============================================================================

struct ProxResult {
    x: [f64; 128],
    obj_val: f64,
    iterations: i32,
    converged: bool
}

struct ADMMResult {
    x: [f64; 128],
    z: [f64; 128],
    obj_val: f64,
    iterations: i32,
    converged: bool
}

struct LassoResult {
    x: [f64; 128],
    obj_val: f64,
    n_nonzero: i32,
    iterations: i32,
    converged: bool
}

// =============================================================================
// Initialization helpers
// =============================================================================

fn cv_init_prox_result(res: &!ProxResult) with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < 128 { res.x[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    res.obj_val = 0.0
    res.iterations = 0
    res.converged = false
}

fn cv_init_admm_result(res: &!ADMMResult) with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < 128 { res.x[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 128 { res.z[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    res.obj_val = 0.0
    res.iterations = 0
    res.converged = false
}

fn cv_init_lasso_result(res: &!LassoResult) with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < 128 { res.x[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    res.obj_val = 0.0
    res.n_nonzero = 0
    res.iterations = 0
    res.converged = false
}

// =============================================================================
// Proximal operators
// =============================================================================

// Proximal operator for L1 norm: prox_{lambda * ||.||_1}(x)
// Soft thresholding: out[i] = sign(x[i]) * max(|x[i]| - lambda, 0)
//
// This is the fundamental building block for sparse optimization.
// Reference: Parikh & Boyd (2014), Section 6.5.2
fn prox_l1(x: &[f64; 128], lambda: f64, n: i32,
           out: &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let ax = cv_abs(x[i])
        let shrunk = ax - lambda
        if shrunk > 0.0 {
            out[i] = cv_sign(x[i]) * shrunk
        } else {
            out[i] = 0.0
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Proximal operator for L2 ball constraint: projection onto {z: ||z||_2 <= radius}
// If ||x||_2 <= radius, out = x; otherwise out = x * (radius / ||x||_2)
//
// Reference: Parikh & Boyd (2014), Section 6.3.1
fn prox_l2_ball(x: &[f64; 128], radius: f64, n: i32,
                out: &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let nrm = cv_norm2(x, n)
    if nrm <= radius {
        // Already inside the ball
        var i = 0
        while i < n { out[i] = x[i]; i = i + 1 }
    } else {
        // Project onto the ball boundary
        let scale = radius / nrm
        var i = 0
        while i < n { out[i] = x[i] * scale; i = i + 1 }
    }
}

// Proximal operator for nonnegative orthant: projection onto R+^n
// out[i] = max(x[i], 0)
//
// Reference: Parikh & Boyd (2014), Section 6.3
fn prox_nonneg(x: &[f64; 128], n: i32,
               out: &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        if x[i] > 0.0 {
            out[i] = x[i]
        } else {
            out[i] = 0.0
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Proximal operator for box constraints: projection onto [lower, upper]^n
// out[i] = clamp(x[i], lower[i], upper[i])
//
// Reference: Parikh & Boyd (2014), Section 6.3
fn prox_box(x: &[f64; 128], lower: &[f64; 128], upper: &[f64; 128],
            n: i32, out: &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        var v = x[i]
        if v < lower[i] { v = lower[i] }
        if v > upper[i] { v = upper[i] }
        out[i] = v
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Proximal operator for probability simplex: projection onto Delta_n
// {z: z >= 0, sum(z) = 1}
//
// Algorithm: Duchi et al. (2008) / Condat (2016) sort-based projection.
// Uses insertion sort since Sounio has no built-in sort.
//
// Steps:
//   1. Sort x in descending order into mu
//   2. Find rho = max{j : mu[j] - (1/j)(sum_{i=1}^j mu[i] - 1) > 0}
//   3. theta = (1/rho)(sum_{i=1}^rho mu[i] - 1)
//   4. out[i] = max(x[i] - theta, 0)
//
// Reference: Duchi et al. (2008): "Efficient Projections onto the l1-Ball"
fn prox_simplex(x: &[f64; 128], n: i32,
                out: &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Copy into working array for sorting
    var mu: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var i = 0
    while i < n { mu[i] = x[i]; i = i + 1 }

    // Insertion sort descending
    var k = 1
    while k < n {
        let key = mu[k]
        var j = k - 1
        while j >= 0 {
            if mu[j] < key {
                mu[j + 1] = mu[j]
                j = j - 1
            } else {
                j = 0 - 1  // break
            }
        }
        mu[j + 1] = key
        k = k + 1
    }

    // Find rho and compute theta
    var cumsum = 0.0
    var rho = 0
    var theta = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        cumsum = cumsum + mu[i]
        let t_cand = (cumsum - 1.0) / ((i + 1) as f64)
        if mu[i] - t_cand > 0.0 {
            rho = i + 1
            theta = t_cand
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Project
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        let v = x[i] - theta
        if v > 0.0 {
            out[i] = v
        } else {
            out[i] = 0.0
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Proximal gradient method (forward-backward splitting)
// =============================================================================

// Proximal gradient descent: minimize f(x) + g(x)
//
// where f is smooth (we have grad_f) and g is non-smooth (we have prox_g).
//
// Iteration:
//   x_{k+1} = prox_{step * g}(x_k - step * grad_f(x_k))
//
// Convergence: O(1/k) for convex f + g.
//
// Parameters:
//   grad_f  — gradient of smooth part f
//   f_val   — evaluate f(x)
//   prox_g  — proximal operator of step*g (takes x, step, n, out)
//   g_val   — evaluate g(x)
//   x0      — initial point
//   n       — dimension
//   step_size — step size (should be <= 1/L where L = Lipschitz constant of grad_f)
//   max_iter — maximum iterations
//   tol     — convergence tolerance on ||x_{k+1} - x_k||_inf
//   result  — output
//
// Reference: Parikh & Boyd (2014), Section 4.2
fn proximal_gradient(
    grad_f: fn(&[f64; 128], i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    f_val: fn(&[f64; 128], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    prox_g: fn(&[f64; 128], f64, i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    g_val: fn(&[f64; 128], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    x0: &[f64; 128], n: i32,
    step_size: f64, max_iter: i32, tol: f64,
    result: &!ProxResult
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var x: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    cv_copy(x0, &!x, n)

    var grad: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var x_new: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var grad_step: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]

    var iter = 0
    while iter < max_iter {
        // Gradient step: grad_step = x - step * grad_f(x)
        grad_f(&x, n, &!grad)
        var i = 0
        while i < n {
            grad_step[i] = x[i] - step_size * grad[i]
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Proximal step: x_new = prox_{step*g}(grad_step)
        prox_g(&grad_step, step_size, n, &!x_new)

        // Check convergence: ||x_new - x||_inf < tol
        var diff_norm = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            let d = cv_abs(x_new[i] - x[i])
            if d > diff_norm { diff_norm = d }
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Update x
        cv_copy(&x_new, &!x, n)

        if diff_norm < tol {
            cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
            result.obj_val = f_val(&x, n) + g_val(&x, n)
            result.iterations = iter + 1
            result.converged = true
            return
        }

        iter = iter + 1
    }

    // Did not converge
    cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
    result.obj_val = f_val(&x, n) + g_val(&x, n)
    result.iterations = max_iter
    result.converged = false
}

// =============================================================================
// FISTA (Fast Iterative Shrinkage-Thresholding Algorithm)
// =============================================================================

// FISTA: accelerated proximal gradient with Nesterov momentum.
//
// Achieves O(1/k^2) convergence rate vs O(1/k) for vanilla proximal gradient.
//
// Iteration:
//   y_k = x_k + ((t_{k-1} - 1) / t_k) * (x_k - x_{k-1})
//   x_{k+1} = prox_{step * g}(y_k - step * grad_f(y_k))
//   t_{k+1} = (1 + sqrt(1 + 4*t_k^2)) / 2
//
// Reference: Beck & Teboulle (2009), "A Fast Iterative Shrinkage-Thresholding
//   Algorithm for Linear Inverse Problems"
fn fista(
    grad_f: fn(&[f64; 128], i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    f_val: fn(&[f64; 128], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    prox_g: fn(&[f64; 128], f64, i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    g_val: fn(&[f64; 128], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    x0: &[f64; 128], n: i32,
    step_size: f64, max_iter: i32, tol: f64,
    result: &!ProxResult
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var x: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var x_prev: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var y: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var grad: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var x_new: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var grad_step: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]

    cv_copy(x0, &!x, n)
    cv_copy(x0, &!x_prev, n)
    cv_copy(x0, &!y, n)

    var t = 1.0
    var iter = 0

    while iter < max_iter {
        // Gradient at y
        grad_f(&y, n, &!grad)

        // Gradient step: grad_step = y - step * grad_f(y)
        var i = 0
        while i < n {
            grad_step[i] = y[i] - step_size * grad[i]
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Proximal step: x_new = prox_{step*g}(grad_step)
        prox_g(&grad_step, step_size, n, &!x_new)

        // Check convergence: ||x_new - x||_inf < tol
        var diff_norm = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            let d = cv_abs(x_new[i] - x[i])
            if d > diff_norm { diff_norm = d }
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Save x_prev = x, x = x_new
        cv_copy(&x, &!x_prev, n)
        cv_copy(&x_new, &!x, n)

        if diff_norm < tol {
            cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
            result.obj_val = f_val(&x, n) + g_val(&x, n)
            result.iterations = iter + 1
            result.converged = true
            return
        }

        // Nesterov momentum update
        let t_new = (1.0 + cv_sqrt(1.0 + 4.0 * t * t)) / 2.0
        let momentum = (t - 1.0) / t_new

        // y = x + momentum * (x - x_prev)
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            y[i] = x[i] + momentum * (x[i] - x_prev[i])
            i = i + 1
        }

        t = t_new
        iter = iter + 1
    }

    // Did not converge
    cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
    result.obj_val = f_val(&x, n) + g_val(&x, n)
    result.iterations = max_iter
    result.converged = false
}

// =============================================================================
// ADMM (Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers)
// =============================================================================

// ADMM for consensus splitting: minimize f(x) + g(z) subject to x = z
//
// Scaled form iterations:
//   x_{k+1} = prox_f(z_k - u_k)
//   z_{k+1} = prox_g(x_{k+1} + u_k)
//   u_{k+1} = u_k + x_{k+1} - z_{k+1}
//
// Convergence checked via primal and dual residuals:
//   r_k = ||x_{k+1} - z_{k+1}||_2  (primal)
//   s_k = rho * ||z_{k+1} - z_k||_2  (dual)
//
// Reference: Boyd et al. (2011), Section 3.1
fn admm(
    prox_f: fn(&[f64; 128], f64, i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    prox_g: fn(&[f64; 128], f64, i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    x0: &[f64; 128], n: i32,
    rho: f64, max_iter: i32, tol: f64,
    result: &!ADMMResult
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var x: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var z: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var z_prev: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var u: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var x_hat: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var z_hat: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]

    cv_copy(x0, &!x, n)
    cv_copy(x0, &!z, n)
    cv_zero(&!u, n)

    let inv_rho = 1.0 / rho

    var iter = 0
    while iter < max_iter {
        cv_copy(&z, &!z_prev, n)

        // x-update: x = prox_{(1/rho)*f}(z - u)
        var i = 0
        while i < n {
            x_hat[i] = z[i] - u[i]
            i = i + 1
        }
        prox_f(&x_hat, inv_rho, n, &!x)

        // z-update: z = prox_{(1/rho)*g}(x + u)
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            z_hat[i] = x[i] + u[i]
            i = i + 1
        }
        prox_g(&z_hat, inv_rho, n, &!z)

        // u-update (dual variable): u = u + x - z
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            u[i] = u[i] + x[i] - z[i]
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Convergence check: primal and dual residuals
        // Primal residual: ||x - z||_2
        var primal_resid = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            let d = x[i] - z[i]
            primal_resid = primal_resid + d * d
            i = i + 1
        }
        primal_resid = cv_sqrt(primal_resid)

        // Dual residual: rho * ||z - z_prev||_2
        var dual_resid = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            let d = z[i] - z_prev[i]
            dual_resid = dual_resid + d * d
            i = i + 1
        }
        dual_resid = rho * cv_sqrt(dual_resid)

        if primal_resid < tol {
            if dual_resid < tol {
                cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
                cv_copy(&z, &!result.z, n)
                result.obj_val = 0.0
                result.iterations = iter + 1
                result.converged = true
                return
            }
        }

        iter = iter + 1
    }

    // Did not converge
    cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
    cv_copy(&z, &!result.z, n)
    result.obj_val = 0.0
    result.iterations = max_iter
    result.converged = false
}

// =============================================================================
// LASSO helper: gradient of (1/2)||Ax - b||_2^2
// =============================================================================

// Compute gradient of the smooth part of LASSO: grad = A^T(Ax - b)
// Uses auxiliary workspace. A is m-by-n row-major in [f64; 16384].
fn cv_lasso_grad(A: &[f64; 16384], b: &[f64; 128],
                 x: &[f64; 128], m: i32, n: i32,
                 grad: &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // residual = Ax - b
    var residual: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    cv_matvec(A, x, &!residual, m, n)
    var i = 0
    while i < m {
        residual[i] = residual[i] - b[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    // grad = A^T * residual
    cv_mat_t_vec(A, &residual, grad, m, n)
}

// =============================================================================
// LASSO objective helpers
// =============================================================================

// Compute LASSO objective: (1/2)||Ax - b||_2^2 + lambda * ||x||_1
fn cv_objective_lasso(A: &[f64; 16384], b: &[f64; 128],
                      x: &[f64; 128], lambda: f64,
                      m: i32, n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // (1/2)||Ax - b||_2^2
    var residual: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    cv_matvec(A, x, &!residual, m, n)
    var sq_err = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < m {
        let r = residual[i] - b[i]
        sq_err = sq_err + r * r
        i = i + 1
    }

    // lambda * ||x||_1
    var l1 = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        l1 = l1 + cv_abs(x[i])
        i = i + 1
    }

    0.5 * sq_err + lambda * l1
}

// Count nonzero entries: |{i : |x[i]| > tol}|
fn cv_count_nonzero(x: &[f64; 128], n: i32, tol: f64) -> i32 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var count = 0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        if cv_abs(x[i]) > tol { count = count + 1 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    count
}

// =============================================================================
// Lipschitz constant estimation via power iteration
// =============================================================================

// Estimate the largest eigenvalue of A^T A via power iteration.
// This gives the Lipschitz constant L of grad f(x) = A^T(Ax - b).
// step_size = 1/L guarantees convergence of proximal gradient methods.
//
// Algorithm: start with random-ish vector v, iterate v <- A^T A v / ||A^T A v||
// and estimate lambda = v^T (A^T A v).
//
// Reference: Golub & Van Loan (2013), "Matrix Computations" Section 7.3
fn cv_lipschitz_estimate(A: &[f64; 16384], m: i32, n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Initialize v with a deterministic non-degenerate vector
    var v: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        // Use a simple sequence to avoid degeneracy
        v[i] = 1.0 / ((i + 1) as f64)
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Normalize v
    var nrm0 = 0.0
    {
        var ii = 0
        while ii < n { nrm0 = nrm0 + v[ii] * v[ii]; ii = ii + 1 }
    }
    // sqrt via Newton
    if nrm0 > 0.0 {
        var sq = nrm0
        var it = 0
        while it < 30 { sq = 0.5 * (sq + nrm0 / sq); it = it + 1 }
        nrm0 = sq
        cv_scale(1.0 / nrm0, &!v, n)
    }

    var Av: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var AtAv: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var lambda = 1.0

    // Power iteration: 50 iterations is more than enough for convergence
    var iter = 0
    while iter < 50 {
        // Av = A * v
        cv_matvec(A, &v, &!Av, m, n)

        // AtAv = A^T * Av
        cv_mat_t_vec(A, &Av, &!AtAv, m, n)

        // Estimate eigenvalue: lambda = v^T * (A^T A v)
        lambda = cv_dot(&v, &AtAv, n)

        // Normalize: v = AtAv / ||AtAv||
        let nrm = cv_norm2(&AtAv, n)
        if nrm < 1.0e-30 { return lambda }
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            v[i] = AtAv[i] / nrm
            i = i + 1
        }

        iter = iter + 1
    }

    lambda
}

// =============================================================================
// LASSO solver via FISTA
// =============================================================================

// LASSO: minimize (1/2)||Ax - b||_2^2 + lambda * ||x||_1
//
// Solved via FISTA (accelerated proximal gradient):
//   - Smooth part: f(x) = (1/2)||Ax - b||_2^2, grad_f(x) = A^T(Ax - b)
//   - Non-smooth part: g(x) = lambda * ||x||_1, prox = soft thresholding
//   - Step size: 1/L where L = ||A^T A|| (Lipschitz constant)
//
// Parameters:
//   A       — m-by-n design matrix (row-major, flat [f64; 16384])
//   b       — m-vector of observations
//   lambda  — regularization parameter (>0)
//   m, n    — matrix dimensions (m observations, n features)
//   max_iter — maximum FISTA iterations
//   tol     — convergence tolerance on ||x_{k+1} - x_k||_inf
//   result  — output (solution, objective, sparsity, iteration count)
//
// Reference: Beck & Teboulle (2009)
fn lasso(
    A: &[f64; 16384], b: &[f64; 128],
    lambda: f64, m: i32, n: i32,
    max_iter: i32, tol: f64,
    result: &!LassoResult
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Estimate Lipschitz constant for step size selection
    let L = cv_lipschitz_estimate(A, m, n)
    var step = 1.0 / L
    if step > 1.0 { step = 1.0 }
    if step < 1.0e-16 { step = 1.0e-4 }

    // Initialize iterates
    var x: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var x_prev: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var y: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var grad: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var grad_step: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var x_new: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]

    var t = 1.0
    var iter = 0

    while iter < max_iter {
        // Gradient at y: grad = A^T(Ay - b)
        cv_lasso_grad(A, b, &y, m, n, &!grad)

        // Gradient step: grad_step = y - step * grad
        var i = 0
        while i < n {
            grad_step[i] = y[i] - step * grad[i]
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Proximal step: soft thresholding at step * lambda
        let threshold = step * lambda
        prox_l1(&grad_step, threshold, n, &!x_new)

        // Check convergence
        var diff_norm = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            let d = cv_abs(x_new[i] - x[i])
            if d > diff_norm { diff_norm = d }
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Save x_prev = x, x = x_new
        cv_copy(&x, &!x_prev, n)
        cv_copy(&x_new, &!x, n)

        if diff_norm < tol {
            cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
            result.obj_val = cv_objective_lasso(A, b, &x, lambda, m, n)
            result.n_nonzero = cv_count_nonzero(&x, n, 1.0e-10)
            result.iterations = iter + 1
            result.converged = true
            return
        }

        // Nesterov momentum update
        let t_new = (1.0 + cv_sqrt(1.0 + 4.0 * t * t)) / 2.0
        let momentum = (t - 1.0) / t_new

        // y = x + momentum * (x - x_prev)
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            y[i] = x[i] + momentum * (x[i] - x_prev[i])
            i = i + 1
        }

        t = t_new
        iter = iter + 1
    }

    // Did not converge
    cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
    result.obj_val = cv_objective_lasso(A, b, &x, lambda, m, n)
    result.n_nonzero = cv_count_nonzero(&x, n, 1.0e-10)
    result.iterations = max_iter
    result.converged = false
}

// =============================================================================
// Moreau envelope
// =============================================================================

// Moreau envelope of f at x with parameter gamma:
//   M_gamma(f)(x) = min_y { f(y) + (1/(2*gamma)) * ||y - x||_2^2 }
//
// Computed as: M_gamma(f)(x) = f(prox_{gamma*f}(x)) + (1/(2*gamma)) * ||prox_{gamma*f}(x) - x||_2^2
//
// The Moreau envelope is a smooth approximation of f (even when f is non-smooth).
// It has the same minimizers as f, and its gradient is (1/gamma)(x - prox_{gamma*f}(x)).
//
// Reference: Parikh & Boyd (2014), Section 2.2
fn moreau_envelope(
    prox_f: fn(&[f64; 128], f64, i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    f_val: fn(&[f64; 128], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    x: &[f64; 128], gamma: f64, n: i32
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Compute proximal point
    var p: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    prox_f(x, gamma, n, &!p)

    // f(prox(x))
    let fval = f_val(&p, n)

    // (1/(2*gamma)) * ||prox(x) - x||_2^2
    var dist_sq = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let d = p[i] - x[i]
        dist_sq = dist_sq + d * d
        i = i + 1
    }

    fval + dist_sq / (2.0 * gamma)
}

// =============================================================================
// Backtracking line search for proximal gradient
// =============================================================================

// Adaptive backtracking for proximal gradient step size selection.
//
// Finds the largest step s in {step * beta^k : k=0,1,...} such that
//   f(prox_step) <= f(x) + grad^T(prox_step - x) + (1/(2*s))||prox_step - x||^2
//
// This is the sufficient decrease condition for proximal gradient methods.
//
// Reference: Beck & Teboulle (2009), Algorithm with backtracking (FISTA-BT)
fn cv_backtrack_proxgrad(
    grad_f: fn(&[f64; 128], i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    f_val: fn(&[f64; 128], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    prox_g: fn(&[f64; 128], f64, i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    x: &[f64; 128], n: i32,
    step_init: f64, beta: f64
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var grad: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    grad_f(x, n, &!grad)
    let fx = f_val(x, n)

    var step = step_init
    var grad_step: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var p: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]

    var k = 0
    while k < 40 {
        // grad_step = x - step * grad
        var i = 0
        while i < n {
            grad_step[i] = x[i] - step * grad[i]
            i = i + 1
        }

        // p = prox_{step*g}(grad_step)
        prox_g(&grad_step, step, n, &!p)

        // Check sufficient decrease
        let fp = f_val(&p, n)

        // Q_step(p, x) = f(x) + grad^T(p - x) + (1/(2*step))||p - x||^2
        var grad_inner = 0.0
        var dist_sq = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            let d = p[i] - x[i]
            grad_inner = grad_inner + grad[i] * d
            dist_sq = dist_sq + d * d
            i = i + 1
        }
        let quad_upper = fx + grad_inner + dist_sq / (2.0 * step)

        if fp <= quad_upper + 1.0e-14 {
            return step
        }

        step = step * beta
        if step < 1.0e-20 { return 1.0e-20 }

        k = k + 1
    }

    step
}

// =============================================================================
// FISTA with backtracking (FISTA-BT)
// =============================================================================

// FISTA with adaptive backtracking line search.
//
// Same as fista() but automatically selects the step size at each iteration
// using the sufficient decrease condition. No need to know the Lipschitz
// constant in advance.
//
// Reference: Beck & Teboulle (2009), Algorithm 2 (FISTA with backtracking)
fn fista_backtrack(
    grad_f: fn(&[f64; 128], i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    f_val: fn(&[f64; 128], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    prox_g: fn(&[f64; 128], f64, i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    g_val: fn(&[f64; 128], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    x0: &[f64; 128], n: i32,
    step_init: f64, beta: f64,
    max_iter: i32, tol: f64,
    result: &!ProxResult
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var x: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var x_prev: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var y: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var grad: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var grad_step: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var x_new: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]

    cv_copy(x0, &!x, n)
    cv_copy(x0, &!x_prev, n)
    cv_copy(x0, &!y, n)

    var t = 1.0
    var step = step_init

    var iter = 0
    while iter < max_iter {
        // Backtracking: find step size at y
        step = cv_backtrack_proxgrad(grad_f, f_val, prox_g, &y, n, step, beta)

        // Gradient at y
        grad_f(&y, n, &!grad)

        // Gradient step
        var i = 0
        while i < n {
            grad_step[i] = y[i] - step * grad[i]
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Proximal step
        prox_g(&grad_step, step, n, &!x_new)

        // Check convergence
        var diff_norm = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            let d = cv_abs(x_new[i] - x[i])
            if d > diff_norm { diff_norm = d }
            i = i + 1
        }

        cv_copy(&x, &!x_prev, n)
        cv_copy(&x_new, &!x, n)

        if diff_norm < tol {
            cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
            result.obj_val = f_val(&x, n) + g_val(&x, n)
            result.iterations = iter + 1
            result.converged = true
            return
        }

        // Nesterov momentum
        let t_new = (1.0 + cv_sqrt(1.0 + 4.0 * t * t)) / 2.0
        let momentum = (t - 1.0) / t_new

        i = 0
        while i < n {
            y[i] = x[i] + momentum * (x[i] - x_prev[i])
            i = i + 1
        }

        t = t_new
        // Allow step to grow slightly for next iteration
        step = step / beta
        iter = iter + 1
    }

    cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
    result.obj_val = f_val(&x, n) + g_val(&x, n)
    result.iterations = max_iter
    result.converged = false
}

// =============================================================================
// Proximal gradient with adaptive restart
// =============================================================================

// FISTA with gradient-based restart (O'Donoghue & Candes, 2015).
//
// Restarts the Nesterov sequence when the gradient-momentum angle criterion
// detects that momentum is not helping:
//   restart when grad_f(x_k)^T (x_k - x_{k-1}) > 0
//
// This prevents oscillation and can dramatically speed up convergence near
// the optimum.
//
// Reference: O'Donoghue & Candes (2015): "Adaptive Restart for Accelerated
//   Gradient Schemes"
fn fista_restart(
    grad_f: fn(&[f64; 128], i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    f_val: fn(&[f64; 128], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    prox_g: fn(&[f64; 128], f64, i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    g_val: fn(&[f64; 128], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    x0: &[f64; 128], n: i32,
    step_size: f64, max_iter: i32, tol: f64,
    result: &!ProxResult
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var x: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var x_prev: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var y: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var grad: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var grad_step: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var x_new: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var diff_vec: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]

    cv_copy(x0, &!x, n)
    cv_copy(x0, &!x_prev, n)
    cv_copy(x0, &!y, n)

    var t = 1.0
    var iter = 0

    while iter < max_iter {
        // Gradient at y
        grad_f(&y, n, &!grad)

        // Gradient step
        var i = 0
        while i < n {
            grad_step[i] = y[i] - step_size * grad[i]
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Proximal step
        prox_g(&grad_step, step_size, n, &!x_new)

        // Check convergence
        var diff_norm = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            let d = cv_abs(x_new[i] - x[i])
            if d > diff_norm { diff_norm = d }
            i = i + 1
        }

        cv_copy(&x, &!x_prev, n)
        cv_copy(&x_new, &!x, n)

        if diff_norm < tol {
            cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
            result.obj_val = f_val(&x, n) + g_val(&x, n)
            result.iterations = iter + 1
            result.converged = true
            return
        }

        // Restart criterion: grad_f(x)^T (x - x_prev) > 0
        grad_f(&x, n, &!grad)
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            diff_vec[i] = x[i] - x_prev[i]
            i = i + 1
        }
        let restart_crit = cv_dot(&grad, &diff_vec, n)

        if restart_crit > 0.0 {
            // Restart: reset momentum
            t = 1.0
            cv_copy(&x, &!y, n)
        } else {
            // Nesterov momentum
            let t_new = (1.0 + cv_sqrt(1.0 + 4.0 * t * t)) / 2.0
            let momentum = (t - 1.0) / t_new
            i = 0
            while i < n {
                y[i] = x[i] + momentum * (x[i] - x_prev[i])
                i = i + 1
            }
            t = t_new
        }

        iter = iter + 1
    }

    cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
    result.obj_val = f_val(&x, n) + g_val(&x, n)
    result.iterations = max_iter
    result.converged = false
}

// =============================================================================
// Douglas-Rachford splitting
// =============================================================================

// Douglas-Rachford splitting: find x in fix(R_g R_f) where R_f = 2*prox_f - I
//
// Iteration:
//   x_hat = prox_f(z_k)
//   z_{k+1} = z_k + prox_g(2*x_hat - z_k) - x_hat
//
// Converges for any two closed proper convex functions f, g.
// The fixed point z* gives x* = prox_f(z*).
//
// Reference: Eckstein & Bertsekas (1992); Parikh & Boyd (2014) Section 4.3
fn douglas_rachford(
    prox_f: fn(&[f64; 128], f64, i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    prox_g: fn(&[f64; 128], f64, i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    z0: &[f64; 128], n: i32,
    gamma: f64, max_iter: i32, tol: f64,
    result: &!ProxResult
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var z: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var x_hat: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var reflect: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var g_prox: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]

    cv_copy(z0, &!z, n)

    var iter = 0
    while iter < max_iter {
        // x_hat = prox_{gamma*f}(z)
        prox_f(&z, gamma, n, &!x_hat)

        // reflect = 2*x_hat - z
        var i = 0
        while i < n {
            reflect[i] = 2.0 * x_hat[i] - z[i]
            i = i + 1
        }

        // g_prox = prox_{gamma*g}(reflect)
        prox_g(&reflect, gamma, n, &!g_prox)

        // z_new = z + g_prox - x_hat
        var diff_norm = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            let z_new = z[i] + g_prox[i] - x_hat[i]
            let d = cv_abs(z_new - z[i])
            if d > diff_norm { diff_norm = d }
            z[i] = z_new
            i = i + 1
        }

        if diff_norm < tol {
            // Return x_hat = prox_f(z) as the solution
            prox_f(&z, gamma, n, &!result.x)
            result.obj_val = 0.0
            result.iterations = iter + 1
            result.converged = true
            return
        }

        iter = iter + 1
    }

    // Return best x = prox_f(z)
    prox_f(&z, gamma, n, &!result.x)
    result.obj_val = 0.0
    result.iterations = max_iter
    result.converged = false
}

// =============================================================================
// Elastic net (L1 + L2 regularization)
// =============================================================================

// Elastic net proximal operator: prox_{lambda1 * ||.||_1 + lambda2 * ||.||_2^2}(x)
// = soft_threshold(x, lambda1) / (1 + 2*lambda2)
//
// Combines L1 sparsity with L2 grouping effect.
// Reference: Zou & Hastie (2005): "Regularization and Variable Selection via
//   the Elastic Net"
fn prox_elastic_net(x: &[f64; 128], lambda1: f64, lambda2: f64,
                    n: i32, out: &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let denom = 1.0 + 2.0 * lambda2
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let ax = cv_abs(x[i])
        let shrunk = ax - lambda1
        if shrunk > 0.0 {
            out[i] = cv_sign(x[i]) * shrunk / denom
        } else {
            out[i] = 0.0
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Proximal operator for group LASSO (L1/L2 norm)
// =============================================================================

// Group LASSO proximal: prox_{lambda * ||.||_2}(x)
// Block soft-thresholding: if ||x|| > lambda, out = (1 - lambda/||x||) * x, else 0
//
// Reference: Yuan & Lin (2006): "Model selection and estimation in regression
//   with grouped variables"
fn prox_group_l1l2(x: &[f64; 128], lambda: f64, n: i32,
                   out: &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let nrm = cv_norm2(x, n)
    if nrm <= lambda {
        var i = 0
        while i < n { out[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    } else {
        let scale = 1.0 - lambda / nrm
        var i = 0
        while i < n { out[i] = scale * x[i]; i = i + 1 }
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Duality gap computation for LASSO
// =============================================================================

// Compute the duality gap for LASSO: gap = primal_obj - dual_obj.
//
// Primal: (1/2)||Ax-b||^2 + lambda*||x||_1
// Dual:   -(1/2)||b||^2 + (1/2)||b - nu||^2  where nu = b - Ax, scaled
//
// The duality gap provides a certificate of epsilon-optimality.
// Reference: Boyd et al. (2011), Section 3.3.1
fn cv_lasso_duality_gap(A: &[f64; 16384], b: &[f64; 128],
                        x: &[f64; 128], lambda: f64,
                        m: i32, n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Compute residual: r = Ax - b
    var r: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    cv_matvec(A, x, &!r, m, n)
    var i = 0
    while i < m {
        r[i] = r[i] - b[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Primal objective
    var r_sq = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < m { r_sq = r_sq + r[i] * r[i]; i = i + 1 }
    var l1_norm = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n { l1_norm = l1_norm + cv_abs(x[i]); i = i + 1 }
    let primal = 0.5 * r_sq + lambda * l1_norm

    // Dual feasible point: nu = -r / max(lambda, ||A^T r||_inf)
    var Atr: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    cv_mat_t_vec(A, &r, &!Atr, m, n)
    var Atr_inf = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        let v = cv_abs(Atr[i])
        if v > Atr_inf { Atr_inf = v }
        i = i + 1
    }

    var scale_factor = 1.0
    if Atr_inf > lambda {
        scale_factor = lambda / Atr_inf
    }

    // Dual objective: -(1/2)||scale*r||^2 + scale*r^T b
    var dual = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < m {
        let sr = scale_factor * r[i]
        dual = dual - 0.5 * sr * sr + sr * b[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Correct dual: dual = (1/2)||b||^2 - (1/2)||b + scale*r||^2
    // Simplified: gap = primal - dual
    let gap = primal - dual
    if gap < 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    gap
}

// =============================================================================
// Proximal operator for indicator of affine set
// =============================================================================

// Proximal (projection) onto affine set {x : Cx = d} where C is p-by-n.
// Computed via: prox(v) = v - C^T (C C^T)^{-1} (Cv - d)
//
// For small p, we form and solve the p-by-p system C*C^T * lambda = Cv - d
// using Cholesky-like direct solve (Gauss elimination with partial pivoting).
//
// C stored row-major in [f64; 16384], d in [f64; 128], p = number of constraints.
fn prox_affine(x: &[f64; 128], C: &[f64; 16384], d: &[f64; 128],
               p: i32, n: i32,
               out: &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Compute residual: Cx - d
    var resid: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var i = 0
    while i < p {
        var s = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            s = s + C[i * n + j] * x[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        resid[i] = s - d[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Form G = C * C^T (p-by-p)
    var G: [f64; 16384] = [0.0; 16384]
    i = 0
    while i < p {
        var j = 0
        while j < p {
            var s = 0.0
            var k = 0
            while k < n {
                s = s + C[i * n + k] * C[j * n + k]
                k = k + 1
            }
            G[i * p + j] = s
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Solve G * lambda = resid via Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting
    var lam: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    i = 0
    while i < p { lam[i] = resid[i]; i = i + 1 }

    // Forward elimination
    var col = 0
    while col < p {
        // Partial pivoting
        var max_val = cv_abs(G[col * p + col])
        var max_row = col
        var row = col + 1
        while row < p {
            let v = cv_abs(G[row * p + col])
            if v > max_val { max_val = v; max_row = row }
            row = row + 1
        }
        // Swap rows
        if max_row != col {
            var k = 0
            while k < p {
                let tmp = G[col * p + k]
                G[col * p + k] = G[max_row * p + k]
                G[max_row * p + k] = tmp
                k = k + 1
            }
            let tmp_lam = lam[col]
            lam[col] = lam[max_row]
            lam[max_row] = tmp_lam
        }

        let pivot = G[col * p + col]
        if cv_abs(pivot) < 1.0e-30 {
            col = col + 1
        } else {
            row = col + 1
            while row < p {
                let factor = G[row * p + col] / pivot
                var k = col
                while k < p {
                    G[row * p + k] = G[row * p + k] - factor * G[col * p + k]
                    k = k + 1
                }
                lam[row] = lam[row] - factor * lam[col]
                row = row + 1
            }
            col = col + 1
        }
    }

    // Back substitution
    var r = p - 1
    while r >= 0 {
        var s = lam[r]
        var k = r + 1
        while k < p {
            s = s - G[r * p + k] * lam[k]
            k = k + 1
        }
        let piv = G[r * p + r]
        if cv_abs(piv) > 1.0e-30 {
            lam[r] = s / piv
        } else {
            lam[r] = 0.0
        }
        r = r - 1
    }

    // out = x - C^T * lambda
    i = 0
    while i < n { out[i] = x[i]; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < p {
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            out[j] = out[j] - C[i * n + j] * lam[i]
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/math/diffgeo.sio ===
// stdlib/math/diffgeo.sio — Differential geometry
//
// Pure Sounio implementations:
//   Metric tensor operations (inverse, determinant)
//   Christoffel symbols via numerical differentiation
//   Riemann curvature tensor
//   Ricci tensor and scalar curvature
//   Geodesic integration via RK4
//   Parallel transport along geodesics
//   Lie derivative of vector fields
//   Standard metrics (Euclidean, sphere, Schwarzschild)
//   Gaussian curvature for 2D surfaces
//
// References:
//   do Carmo (1992): "Riemannian Geometry"
//   Misner, Thorne & Wheeler (1973): "Gravitation"
//   Lee (2018): "Introduction to Riemannian Manifolds"

// =============================================================================
// Helpers (prefixed dg_ to avoid collisions)
// =============================================================================

fn dg_abs(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }
fn dg_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }

fn dg_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 24 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

fn dg_sin(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var a = x
    let tp = 6.28318530717958647692
    while a >= tp { a = a - tp }
    while a < 0.0 { a = a + tp }
    if a > 3.14159265358979323846 { a = a - tp }
    let a2 = a * a
    var sum = a
    var term = a
    var n = 1
    while n < 20 { term = 0.0 - term * a2 / ((2 * n) * (2 * n + 1)) as f64; sum = sum + term; n = n + 1 }
    sum
}

fn dg_cos(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    dg_sin(x + 1.57079632679489661923)
}

fn dg_exp(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 500.0 { return 1.0e200 }
    if x < -500.0 { return 0.0 }
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var kf = x / ln2
    var k: i32 = 0
    if kf >= 0.0 { k = kf as i32 } else { k = (kf as i32) - 1 }
    let r = x - (k as f64) * ln2
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var n = 1
    while n < 25 { term = term * r / (n as f64); sum = sum + term; n = n + 1 }
    var result = sum
    if k >= 0 { var i = 0; while i < k { result = result * 2.0; i = i + 1 } }
    else { var i = 0; while i < (0 - k) { result = result / 2.0; i = i + 1 } }
    result
}

fn dg_ln(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 - 1.0e30 }
    if x == 1.0 { return 0.0 }
    var m = x
    var e = 0
    while m >= 2.0 { m = m / 2.0; e = e + 1 }
    while m < 0.5 { m = m * 2.0; e = e - 1 }
    let t = (m - 1.0) / (m + 1.0)
    let t2 = t * t
    var sum = t
    var term = t
    var k = 1
    while k < 30 { term = term * t2; sum = sum + term / ((2 * k + 1) as f64); k = k + 1 }
    2.0 * sum + (e as f64) * 0.6931471805599453
}

fn dg_pi() -> f64 { 3.14159265358979323846 }

// =============================================================================
// Structs
// =============================================================================

struct Metric4 { g: [f64; 16], dim: i32 }

struct Christoffel4 { gamma: [f64; 64], dim: i32 }

struct RiemannTensor { R: [f64; 256], dim: i32 }

struct RicciTensor { Ric: [f64; 16], scalar: f64, dim: i32 }

struct GeodesicState { x: [f64; 4], v: [f64; 4], dim: i32, tau: f64 }

struct GeodesicPath { x: [f64; 4096], v: [f64; 4096], tau: [f64; 1024], n_steps: i32, dim: i32 }

// =============================================================================
// Metric operations
// =============================================================================

// Inverse of a dim x dim metric (up to 4D) via Gauss-Jordan elimination.
// g is stored row-major in [f64; 16], g_inv receives the result.
fn metric_inverse(g: &[f64; 16], dim: i32, g_inv: &![f64; 16]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Augmented matrix [g | I] stored in work[row * 2*dim + col]
    var work: [f64; 32] = [0.0; 32]  // max 4x8 = 32

    // Fill augmented matrix
    var i = 0
    while i < dim {
        var j = 0
        while j < dim {
            work[i * 2 * dim + j] = g[i * dim + j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        // Identity on the right half
        work[i * 2 * dim + dim + i] = 1.0
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Forward elimination with partial pivoting
    var col = 0
    while col < dim {
        // Find pivot
        var max_val = dg_abs(work[col * 2 * dim + col])
        var max_row = col
        var row = col + 1
        while row < dim {
            let v = dg_abs(work[row * 2 * dim + col])
            if v > max_val { max_val = v; max_row = row }
            row = row + 1
        }

        // Swap rows if needed
        if max_row != col {
            var j = 0
            while j < 2 * dim {
                let tmp = work[col * 2 * dim + j]
                work[col * 2 * dim + j] = work[max_row * 2 * dim + j]
                work[max_row * 2 * dim + j] = tmp
                j = j + 1
            }
        }

        let pivot = work[col * 2 * dim + col]
        if dg_abs(pivot) < 1.0e-30 {
            // Singular: set identity as fallback
            i = 0
            while i < 16 { g_inv[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
            i = 0
            while i < dim { g_inv[i * dim + i] = 1.0; i = i + 1 }
            return
        }

        // Scale pivot row
        let inv_pivot = 1.0 / pivot
        var j = 0
        while j < 2 * dim {
            work[col * 2 * dim + j] = work[col * 2 * dim + j] * inv_pivot
            j = j + 1
        }

        // Eliminate column in all other rows
        row = 0
        while row < dim {
            if row != col {
                let factor = work[row * 2 * dim + col]
                j = 0
                while j < 2 * dim {
                    work[row * 2 * dim + j] = work[row * 2 * dim + j] - factor * work[col * 2 * dim + j]
                    j = j + 1
                }
            }
            row = row + 1
        }
        col = col + 1
    }

    // Extract inverse from right half
    i = 0
    while i < 16 { g_inv[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < dim {
        var j = 0
        while j < dim {
            g_inv[i * dim + j] = work[i * 2 * dim + dim + j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Determinant of a dim x dim metric (row-major in [f64; 16]).
// dim=2: ad-bc. dim=3: cofactor expansion. dim=4: LU decomposition.
fn metric_det(g: &[f64; 16], dim: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if dim == 1 { return g[0] }

    if dim == 2 {
        return g[0] * g[3] - g[1] * g[2]
    }

    if dim == 3 {
        // Cofactor expansion along first row
        let a = g[0]; let b = g[1]; let c = g[2]
        let d = g[3]; let e = g[4]; let f = g[5]
        let h = g[6]; let i = g[7]; let j = g[8]
        return a * (e * j - f * i) - b * (d * j - f * h) + c * (d * i - e * h)
    }

    // dim == 4: LU decomposition for determinant
    var A: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var k = 0
    while k < 16 { A[k] = g[k]; k = k + 1 }

    var det = 1.0
    var col = 0
    while col < dim {
        // Partial pivoting
        var max_val = dg_abs(A[col * dim + col])
        var max_row = col
        var row = col + 1
        while row < dim {
            let v = dg_abs(A[row * dim + col])
            if v > max_val { max_val = v; max_row = row }
            row = row + 1
        }
        if max_row != col {
            var j = 0
            while j < dim {
                let tmp = A[col * dim + j]
                A[col * dim + j] = A[max_row * dim + j]
                A[max_row * dim + j] = tmp
                j = j + 1
            }
            det = 0.0 - det
        }

        let pivot = A[col * dim + col]
        if dg_abs(pivot) < 1.0e-30 { return 0.0 }
        det = det * pivot

        // Eliminate below
        row = col + 1
        while row < dim {
            let factor = A[row * dim + col] / pivot
            var j = col + 1
            while j < dim {
                A[row * dim + j] = A[row * dim + j] - factor * A[col * dim + j]
                j = j + 1
            }
            row = row + 1
        }
        col = col + 1
    }
    det
}

// Raise an index: v^i = g^{ij} v_j
fn metric_raise_index(g_inv: &[f64; 16], v_lower: &[f64; 4], dim: i32, v_upper: &![f64; 4]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < dim {
        var s = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < dim {
            s = s + g_inv[i * dim + j] * v_lower[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        v_upper[i] = s
        i = i + 1
    }
    // Zero out unused components
    while i < 4 { v_upper[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
}

// Lower an index: v_i = g_{ij} v^j
fn metric_lower_index(g: &[f64; 16], v_upper: &[f64; 4], dim: i32, v_lower: &![f64; 4]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < dim {
        var s = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < dim {
            s = s + g[i * dim + j] * v_upper[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        v_lower[i] = s
        i = i + 1
    }
    while i < 4 { v_lower[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
}

// =============================================================================
// Christoffel symbols
// =============================================================================

// Compute Christoffel symbols Gamma^k_{ij} from a metric callback.
// metric_fn(x, dim, g_out) fills g_out with the metric at point x.
// Uses central differences with step h = 1e-6 to approximate partial derivatives.
//
// Gamma^k_{ij} = 0.5 * g^{kl} * (dg_{li}/dx^j + dg_{lj}/dx^i - dg_{ij}/dx^l)
//
// Indexing: gamma.gamma[k * dim*dim + i * dim + j]
fn christoffel_from_metric(metric_fn: fn(&[f64; 4], i32, &![f64; 16]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                           x: &[f64; 4], dim: i32,
                           gamma: &!Christoffel4) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let h = 1.0e-6
    gamma.dim = dim

    // Zero out gamma
    var idx = 0
    while idx < 64 { gamma.gamma[idx] = 0.0; idx = idx + 1 }

    // Compute metric at x
    var g0: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    metric_fn(x, dim, &!g0)

    // Compute metric inverse
    var g_inv: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    metric_inverse(&g0, dim, &!g_inv)

    // Compute partial derivatives of the metric: dg[m][i][j] = dg_{ij}/dx^m
    // Stored as dg[m * dim*dim + i * dim + j]
    var dg: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]  // max 4 * 16 = 64, but 256 for safety

    var m = 0
    while m < dim {
        var xp: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
        var xm: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
        var c = 0
        while c < 4 { xp[c] = x[c]; xm[c] = x[c]; c = c + 1 }
        xp[m] = x[m] + h
        xm[m] = x[m] - h

        var gp: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
        var gm: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
        metric_fn(&xp, dim, &!gp)
        metric_fn(&xm, dim, &!gm)

        var i = 0
        while i < dim {
            var j = 0
            while j < dim {
                dg[m * dim * dim + i * dim + j] = (gp[i * dim + j] - gm[i * dim + j]) / (2.0 * h)
                j = j + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        m = m + 1
    }

    // Assemble Christoffel symbols
    // Gamma^k_{ij} = 0.5 * g^{kl} * (dg_{li}/dx^j + dg_{lj}/dx^i - dg_{ij}/dx^l)
    var k = 0
    while k < dim {
        var i = 0
        while i < dim {
            var j = 0
            while j < dim {
                var s = 0.0
                var l = 0
                while l < dim {
                    let term1 = dg[j * dim * dim + l * dim + i]   // dg_{li}/dx^j
                    let term2 = dg[i * dim * dim + l * dim + j]   // dg_{lj}/dx^i
                    let term3 = dg[l * dim * dim + i * dim + j]   // dg_{ij}/dx^l
                    s = s + g_inv[k * dim + l] * (term1 + term2 - term3)
                    l = l + 1
                }
                gamma.gamma[k * dim * dim + i * dim + j] = 0.5 * s
                j = j + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        k = k + 1
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Riemann curvature tensor
// =============================================================================

// Compute Riemann tensor R^k_{lij} from a metric callback.
// Uses central differences on Christoffel symbols plus quadratic Christoffel terms.
//
// R^k_{lij} = d_i Gamma^k_{jl} - d_j Gamma^k_{il}
//           + Gamma^k_{im} Gamma^m_{jl} - Gamma^k_{jm} Gamma^m_{il}
//
// Indexing: R.R[k * dim^3 + l * dim^2 + i * dim + j]
fn riemann_tensor(metric_fn: fn(&[f64; 4], i32, &![f64; 16]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                  x: &[f64; 4], dim: i32,
                  R: &!RiemannTensor) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let h = 1.0e-5  // slightly larger step for second-level numerical differentiation
    R.dim = dim

    // Zero out
    var idx = 0
    while idx < 256 { R.R[idx] = 0.0; idx = idx + 1 }

    // Compute Christoffel symbols at x
    var gamma0: Christoffel4 = Christoffel4 { gamma: [0.0; 64], dim: dim }
    christoffel_from_metric(metric_fn, x, dim, &!gamma0)

    // Compute partial derivatives of Christoffel symbols via central differences
    // d_gamma[m][k][a][b] = d(Gamma^k_{ab})/dx^m
    // Stored flat: d_gamma[m * dim^3 + k * dim^2 + a * dim + b]
    var d_gamma: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]  // 4 * 64 = 256

    var m = 0
    while m < dim {
        var xp: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
        var xm: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
        var c = 0
        while c < 4 { xp[c] = x[c]; xm[c] = x[c]; c = c + 1 }
        xp[m] = x[m] + h
        xm[m] = x[m] - h

        var gp: Christoffel4 = Christoffel4 { gamma: [0.0; 64], dim: dim }
        var gm: Christoffel4 = Christoffel4 { gamma: [0.0; 64], dim: dim }
        christoffel_from_metric(metric_fn, &xp, dim, &!gp)
        christoffel_from_metric(metric_fn, &xm, dim, &!gm)

        var k = 0
        while k < dim {
            var a = 0
            while a < dim {
                var b = 0
                while b < dim {
                    let gp_val = gp.gamma[k * dim * dim + a * dim + b]
                    let gm_val = gm.gamma[k * dim * dim + a * dim + b]
                    d_gamma[m * dim * dim * dim + k * dim * dim + a * dim + b] = (gp_val - gm_val) / (2.0 * h)
                    b = b + 1
                }
                a = a + 1
            }
            k = k + 1
        }
        m = m + 1
    }

    // Assemble Riemann tensor
    // R^k_{lij} = d_i Gamma^k_{jl} - d_j Gamma^k_{il}
    //           + Gamma^k_{im} Gamma^m_{jl} - Gamma^k_{jm} Gamma^m_{il}
    var k = 0
    while k < dim {
        var l = 0
        while l < dim {
            var i = 0
            while i < dim {
                var j = 0
                while j < dim {
                    // Derivative terms
                    let di_Gkjl = d_gamma[i * dim * dim * dim + k * dim * dim + j * dim + l]
                    let dj_Gkil = d_gamma[j * dim * dim * dim + k * dim * dim + i * dim + l]

                    // Quadratic Christoffel terms
                    var quad1 = 0.0
                    var quad2 = 0.0
                    var mm = 0
                    while mm < dim {
                        quad1 = quad1 + gamma0.gamma[k * dim * dim + i * dim + mm] * gamma0.gamma[mm * dim * dim + j * dim + l]
                        quad2 = quad2 + gamma0.gamma[k * dim * dim + j * dim + mm] * gamma0.gamma[mm * dim * dim + i * dim + l]
                        mm = mm + 1
                    }

                    R.R[k * dim * dim * dim + l * dim * dim + i * dim + j] = di_Gkjl - dj_Gkil + quad1 - quad2
                    j = j + 1
                }
                i = i + 1
            }
            l = l + 1
        }
        k = k + 1
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Ricci tensor and scalar curvature
// =============================================================================

// Contract the Riemann tensor to get the Ricci tensor: R_{ij} = R^k_{ikj}
// Note: this only fills Ric and dim; scalar is set to 0.0 (needs metric inverse).
fn ricci_tensor(R_in: &RiemannTensor, result: &!RicciTensor) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let dim = R_in.dim
    result.dim = dim
    result.scalar = 0.0

    var i = 0
    while i < 16 { result.Ric[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }

    i = 0
    while i < dim {
        var j = 0
        while j < dim {
            var s = 0.0
            var k = 0
            while k < dim {
                // R^k_{ikj}
                s = s + R_in.R[k * dim * dim * dim + i * dim * dim + k * dim + j]
                k = k + 1
            }
            result.Ric[i * dim + j] = s
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Compute full Ricci tensor and scalar curvature in one call.
// R = g^{ij} R_{ij}
fn ricci_with_scalar(metric_fn: fn(&[f64; 4], i32, &![f64; 16]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                     x: &[f64; 4], dim: i32,
                     result: &!RicciTensor) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Compute Riemann tensor
    var Riem: RiemannTensor = RiemannTensor { R: [0.0; 256], dim: dim }
    riemann_tensor(metric_fn, x, dim, &!Riem)

    // Contract to Ricci
    ricci_tensor(&Riem, result)

    // Compute metric and its inverse for scalar curvature
    var g0: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    metric_fn(x, dim, &!g0)
    var g_inv: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    metric_inverse(&g0, dim, &!g_inv)

    // Scalar curvature: R = g^{ij} R_{ij}
    var scalar = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < dim {
        var j = 0
        while j < dim {
            scalar = scalar + g_inv[i * dim + j] * result.Ric[i * dim + j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    result.scalar = scalar
}

// Compute only the scalar curvature R = g^{ij} R_{ij}
fn scalar_curvature(metric_fn: fn(&[f64; 4], i32, &![f64; 16]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                    x: &[f64; 4], dim: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var ric: RicciTensor = RicciTensor { Ric: [0.0; 16], scalar: 0.0, dim: dim }
    ricci_with_scalar(metric_fn, x, dim, &!ric)
    ric.scalar
}

// =============================================================================
// Geodesic equations
// =============================================================================

// Compute the geodesic RHS:
//   dx^i/dtau = v^i
//   dv^k/dtau = -Gamma^k_{ij} v^i v^j
fn geodesic_rhs(metric_fn: fn(&[f64; 4], i32, &![f64; 16]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                st: &GeodesicState,
                dx: &![f64; 4], dv: &![f64; 4]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let dim = st.dim

    // dx/dtau = v
    var i = 0
    while i < 4 { dx[i] = 0.0; dv[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < dim { dx[i] = st.v[i]; i = i + 1 }

    // Compute Christoffel symbols at current position
    var gamma: Christoffel4 = Christoffel4 { gamma: [0.0; 64], dim: dim }
    christoffel_from_metric(metric_fn, &st.x, dim, &!gamma)

    // dv^k/dtau = -Gamma^k_{ij} v^i v^j
    var k = 0
    while k < dim {
        var s = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < dim {
            var j = 0
            while j < dim {
                s = s + gamma.gamma[k * dim * dim + i * dim + j] * st.v[i] * st.v[j]
                j = j + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        dv[k] = 0.0 - s
        k = k + 1
    }
}

// Single RK4 step on the geodesic equation.
fn geodesic_step(metric_fn: fn(&[f64; 4], i32, &![f64; 16]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                 st: &!GeodesicState, dtau: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let dim = st.dim

    // k1
    var dx1: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
    var dv1: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
    geodesic_rhs(metric_fn, st, &!dx1, &!dv1)

    // Stage 2: st at tau + dtau/2 using k1
    var s2: GeodesicState = GeodesicState { x: [0.0; 4], v: [0.0; 4], dim: dim, tau: st.tau + dtau / 2.0 }
    var c = 0
    while c < dim {
        s2.x[c] = st.x[c] + 0.5 * dtau * dx1[c]
        s2.v[c] = st.v[c] + 0.5 * dtau * dv1[c]
        c = c + 1
    }

    var dx2: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
    var dv2: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
    geodesic_rhs(metric_fn, &s2, &!dx2, &!dv2)

    // Stage 3: st at tau + dtau/2 using k2
    var s3: GeodesicState = GeodesicState { x: [0.0; 4], v: [0.0; 4], dim: dim, tau: st.tau + dtau / 2.0 }
    c = 0
    while c < dim {
        s3.x[c] = st.x[c] + 0.5 * dtau * dx2[c]
        s3.v[c] = st.v[c] + 0.5 * dtau * dv2[c]
        c = c + 1
    }

    var dx3: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
    var dv3: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
    geodesic_rhs(metric_fn, &s3, &!dx3, &!dv3)

    // Stage 4: st at tau + dtau using k3
    var s4: GeodesicState = GeodesicState { x: [0.0; 4], v: [0.0; 4], dim: dim, tau: st.tau + dtau }
    c = 0
    while c < dim {
        s4.x[c] = st.x[c] + dtau * dx3[c]
        s4.v[c] = st.v[c] + dtau * dv3[c]
        c = c + 1
    }

    var dx4: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
    var dv4: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
    geodesic_rhs(metric_fn, &s4, &!dx4, &!dv4)

    // Combine: st += dtau/6 * (k1 + 2*k2 + 2*k3 + k4)
    c = 0
    while c < dim {
        st.x[c] = st.x[c] + dtau / 6.0 * (dx1[c] + 2.0 * dx2[c] + 2.0 * dx3[c] + dx4[c])
        st.v[c] = st.v[c] + dtau / 6.0 * (dv1[c] + 2.0 * dv2[c] + 2.0 * dv3[c] + dv4[c])
        c = c + 1
    }
    st.tau = st.tau + dtau
}

// Integrate geodesic from initial conditions over n_steps of equal size.
// Stores positions, velocities, and proper time at each step in path.
fn geodesic_integrate(metric_fn: fn(&[f64; 4], i32, &![f64; 16]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                      x0: &[f64; 4], v0: &[f64; 4], dim: i32,
                      tau_end: f64, n_steps: i32,
                      path: &!GeodesicPath) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    path.dim = dim
    path.n_steps = n_steps

    // Zero out path arrays
    var z = 0
    while z < 4096 { path.x[z] = 0.0; path.v[z] = 0.0; z = z + 1 }
    z = 0
    while z < 1024 { path.tau[z] = 0.0; z = z + 1 }

    let dtau = tau_end / (n_steps as f64)

    // Initialize state
    var state: GeodesicState = GeodesicState { x: [0.0; 4], v: [0.0; 4], dim: dim, tau: 0.0 }
    var c = 0
    while c < dim { state.x[c] = x0[c]; state.v[c] = v0[c]; c = c + 1 }

    // Store initial conditions (step 0)
    c = 0
    while c < dim {
        path.x[0 * dim + c] = state.x[c]
        path.v[0 * dim + c] = state.v[c]
        c = c + 1
    }
    path.tau[0] = 0.0

    // Integrate
    var step = 1
    while step <= n_steps {
        geodesic_step(metric_fn, &!state, dtau)

        // Clamp step index for storage (max 1024 steps in tau, 4096/dim in x,v)
        if step < 1024 {
            path.tau[step] = state.tau
            c = 0
            while c < dim {
                path.x[step * dim + c] = state.x[c]
                path.v[step * dim + c] = state.v[c]
                c = c + 1
            }
        }
        step = step + 1
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Parallel transport
// =============================================================================

// Single RK4 step for parallel transport of vector w along a geodesic with
// tangent vector v at point x.
// Transport equation: dw^k/dtau = -Gamma^k_{ij} v^i w^j
fn parallel_transport_step(metric_fn: fn(&[f64; 4], i32, &![f64; 16]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                           x: &[f64; 4], v: &[f64; 4],
                           w: &![f64; 4], dim: i32, dtau: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Compute Christoffel symbols at x
    var gamma: Christoffel4 = Christoffel4 { gamma: [0.0; 64], dim: dim }
    christoffel_from_metric(metric_fn, x, dim, &!gamma)

    // k1: dw^k = -Gamma^k_{ij} v^i w^j
    var k1: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
    var k = 0
    while k < dim {
        var s = 0.0
        var i = 0
        while i < dim {
            var j = 0
            while j < dim {
                s = s + gamma.gamma[k * dim * dim + i * dim + j] * v[i] * w[j]
                j = j + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        k1[k] = 0.0 - s
        k = k + 1
    }

    // k2: at w + dtau/2 * k1
    var w2: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
    var c = 0
    while c < dim { w2[c] = w[c] + 0.5 * dtau * k1[c]; c = c + 1 }
    var k2: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
    k = 0
    while k < dim {
        var s = 0.0
        var i = 0
        while i < dim {
            var j = 0
            while j < dim {
                s = s + gamma.gamma[k * dim * dim + i * dim + j] * v[i] * w2[j]
                j = j + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        k2[k] = 0.0 - s
        k = k + 1
    }

    // k3: at w + dtau/2 * k2
    var w3: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
    c = 0
    while c < dim { w3[c] = w[c] + 0.5 * dtau * k2[c]; c = c + 1 }
    var k3: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
    k = 0
    while k < dim {
        var s = 0.0
        var i = 0
        while i < dim {
            var j = 0
            while j < dim {
                s = s + gamma.gamma[k * dim * dim + i * dim + j] * v[i] * w3[j]
                j = j + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        k3[k] = 0.0 - s
        k = k + 1
    }

    // k4: at w + dtau * k3
    var w4: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
    c = 0
    while c < dim { w4[c] = w[c] + dtau * k3[c]; c = c + 1 }
    var k4: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
    k = 0
    while k < dim {
        var s = 0.0
        var i = 0
        while i < dim {
            var j = 0
            while j < dim {
                s = s + gamma.gamma[k * dim * dim + i * dim + j] * v[i] * w4[j]
                j = j + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        k4[k] = 0.0 - s
        k = k + 1
    }

    // Combine: w += dtau/6 * (k1 + 2*k2 + 2*k3 + k4)
    c = 0
    while c < dim {
        w[c] = w[c] + dtau / 6.0 * (k1[c] + 2.0 * k2[c] + 2.0 * k3[c] + k4[c])
        c = c + 1
    }
}

// Transport a vector w0 along a precomputed geodesic path.
// The result is stored in w_final.
fn parallel_transport_along(metric_fn: fn(&[f64; 4], i32, &![f64; 16]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                            path: &GeodesicPath,
                            w0: &[f64; 4],
                            w_final: &![f64; 4]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let dim = path.dim
    let n = path.n_steps

    // Initialize w_final with w0
    var c = 0
    while c < 4 { w_final[c] = 0.0; c = c + 1 }
    c = 0
    while c < dim { w_final[c] = w0[c]; c = c + 1 }

    // Step through the path
    var step = 0
    while step < n {
        // Extract position and velocity at this step
        var x_cur: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
        var v_cur: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
        c = 0
        while c < dim {
            x_cur[c] = path.x[step * dim + c]
            v_cur[c] = path.v[step * dim + c]
            c = c + 1
        }

        // Compute dtau for this segment
        var dtau = 0.0
        if step + 1 < 1024 {
            dtau = path.tau[step + 1] - path.tau[step]
        }

        if dg_abs(dtau) > 1.0e-30 {
            parallel_transport_step(metric_fn, &x_cur, &v_cur, w_final, dim, dtau)
        }
        step = step + 1
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Lie derivative of vector fields
// =============================================================================

// Lie derivative of W along V: (L_V W)^i = V^j dW^i/dx^j - W^j dV^i/dx^j
// V and W are vector field callbacks: V(x, dim, out), W(x, dim, out).
// Derivatives computed via central differences with h = 1e-6.
fn lie_derivative_vec(V: fn(&[f64; 4], i32, &![f64; 4]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                      W: fn(&[f64; 4], i32, &![f64; 4]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                      x: &[f64; 4], dim: i32,
                      result: &![f64; 4]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let h = 1.0e-6

    // Evaluate V and W at x
    var V0: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
    var W0: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
    V(x, dim, &!V0)
    W(x, dim, &!W0)

    // Compute Jacobians dV^i/dx^j and dW^i/dx^j via central differences
    // dV[i * dim + j] = dV^i/dx^j
    var dV: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var dW: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]

    var j = 0
    while j < dim {
        var xp: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
        var xm: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
        var c = 0
        while c < 4 { xp[c] = x[c]; xm[c] = x[c]; c = c + 1 }
        xp[j] = x[j] + h
        xm[j] = x[j] - h

        var Vp: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
        var Vm: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
        V(&xp, dim, &!Vp)
        V(&xm, dim, &!Vm)

        var Wp: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
        var Wm: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
        W(&xp, dim, &!Wp)
        W(&xm, dim, &!Wm)

        var i = 0
        while i < dim {
            dV[i * dim + j] = (Vp[i] - Vm[i]) / (2.0 * h)
            dW[i * dim + j] = (Wp[i] - Wm[i]) / (2.0 * h)
            i = i + 1
        }
        j = j + 1
    }

    // Assemble Lie derivative: (L_V W)^i = V^j dW^i/dx^j - W^j dV^i/dx^j
    var i = 0
    while i < 4 { result[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < dim {
        var s = 0.0
        j = 0
        while j < dim {
            s = s + V0[j] * dW[i * dim + j] - W0[j] * dV[i * dim + j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        result[i] = s
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Standard metrics (callback-compatible)
// =============================================================================

// Euclidean metric in 3D: g = diag(1, 1, 1)
fn metric_euclidean_3d(x: &[f64; 4], dim: i32, g: &![f64; 16]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 { g[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    g[0] = 1.0
    g[4] = 1.0
    g[8] = 1.0
}

// Unit sphere in 2D: coordinates (theta, phi).
// g = diag(1, sin^2(theta))
// x[0] = theta, x[1] = phi
fn metric_sphere_2d(x: &[f64; 4], dim: i32, g: &![f64; 16]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 { g[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    let theta = x[0]
    let sth = dg_sin(theta)
    g[0] = 1.0            // g_{theta theta}
    g[3] = sth * sth       // g_{phi phi}
}

// Sphere of radius R in 2D: g = R^2 * diag(1, sin^2(theta))
// x[0] = theta, x[1] = phi
// Note: R passed as separate argument since Sounio lacks partial application.
fn metric_sphere_2d_r(x: &[f64; 4], dim: i32, g: &![f64; 16], R: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 { g[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    let theta = x[0]
    let sth = dg_sin(theta)
    g[0] = R * R                    // g_{theta theta}
    g[3] = R * R * sth * sth        // g_{phi phi}
}

// Schwarzschild metric in Boyer-Lindquist coordinates (t, r, theta, phi).
// M = 1 (geometric units, r_s = 2M = 2).
// x[0] = t, x[1] = r, x[2] = theta, x[3] = phi
// g_tt = -(1 - 2/r), g_rr = 1/(1 - 2/r), g_{theta theta} = r^2, g_{phi phi} = r^2 sin^2(theta)
fn metric_schwarzschild(x: &[f64; 4], dim: i32, g: &![f64; 16]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 { g[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }

    let r = x[1]
    let theta = x[2]
    let sth = dg_sin(theta)
