// Property classes: 0=nonpolar, 1=polar, 2=positive, 3=negative, 4=stop
pub fn aa_class(aa: i32) -> i32 {
    // nonpolar: Ala(0), Gly(7), Ile(9), Leu(10), Met(12), Phe(13), Pro(14), Val(19), Trp(17)
    // polar: Asn(2), Cys(4), Gln(5), Ser(15), Thr(16), Tyr(18)
    // positive: Arg(1), His(8), Lys(11)
    // negative: Asp(3), Glu(6)
    // stop: Stop(20)
    if aa == 0 { return 0 }  // Ala
    if aa == 1 { return 2 }  // Arg+
    if aa == 2 { return 1 }  // Asn polar
    if aa == 3 { return 3 }  // Asp-
    if aa == 4 { return 1 }  // Cys polar
    if aa == 5 { return 1 }  // Gln polar
    if aa == 6 { return 3 }  // Glu-
    if aa == 7 { return 0 }  // Gly
    if aa == 8 { return 2 }  // His+
    if aa == 9 { return 0 }  // Ile
    if aa == 10 { return 0 } // Leu
    if aa == 11 { return 2 } // Lys+
    if aa == 12 { return 0 } // Met
    if aa == 13 { return 0 } // Phe
    if aa == 14 { return 0 } // Pro
    if aa == 15 { return 1 } // Ser
    if aa == 16 { return 1 } // Thr
    if aa == 17 { return 0 } // Trp
    if aa == 18 { return 1 } // Tyr
    if aa == 19 { return 0 } // Val
    if aa == 20 { return 4 } // Stop
    -1
}

/// Build the genetic code lookup table: codon_index → amino acid code
/// The index is the Z_2^6 integer representation of the codon.
pub fn build_codon_table() -> [i32; 64] with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var t: [i32; 64] = [0; 64]
    // We need to map each 6-bit index to its amino acid.
    // Index encoding: base1=(bit0,bit1), base2=(bit2,bit3), base3=(bit4,bit5)
    // where bit0=purine(0)/pyrimidine(1), bit1=weak(0)/strong(1)
    // A=(0,0)=0, G=(0,1)=1, U=(1,0)=2, C=(1,1)=3
    //
    // Standard genetic code (base1, base2, base3 → AA):
    // We iterate over all 64 codons systematically.
    // Base decoding: 0=A, 1=G, 2=U, 3=C

    var b1: i32 = 0
    while b1 < 4 {
        var b2: i32 = 0
        while b2 < 4 {
            var b3: i32 = 0
            while b3 < 4 {
                let idx = b1 + b2 * 4 + b3 * 16
                // Decode: b1,b2,b3 in {A=0, G=1, U=2, C=3}
                // Map to standard genetic code
                let aa = codon_to_aa(b1, b2, b3)
                t[idx as usize] = aa
                b3 = b3 + 1
            }
            b2 = b2 + 1
        }
        b1 = b1 + 1
    }
    t
}

/// Standard genetic code: (base1, base2, base3) → amino acid code
/// Bases: A=0, G=1, U=2, C=3
fn codon_to_aa(b1: i32, b2: i32, b3: i32) -> i32 {
    // UUU=Phe(13), UUC=Phe, UUA=Leu(10), UUG=Leu
    // UCU=Ser(15), UCC=Ser, UCA=Ser, UCG=Ser
    // UAU=Tyr(18), UAC=Tyr, UAA=Stop(20), UAG=Stop
    // UGU=Cys(4), UGC=Cys, UGA=Stop, UGG=Trp(17)
    //
    // CUU=Leu, CUC=Leu, CUA=Leu, CUG=Leu
    // CCU=Pro(14), CCC=Pro, CCA=Pro, CCG=Pro
    // CAU=His(8), CAC=His, CAA=Gln(5), CAG=Gln
    // CGU=Arg(1), CGC=Arg, CGA=Arg, CGG=Arg
    //
    // AUU=Ile(9), AUC=Ile, AUA=Ile, AUG=Met(12)
    // ACU=Thr(16), ACC=Thr, ACA=Thr, ACG=Thr
    // AAU=Asn(2), AAC=Asn, AAA=Lys(11), AAG=Lys
    // AGU=Ser, AGC=Ser, AGA=Arg, AGG=Arg
    //
    // GUU=Val(19), GUC=Val, GUA=Val, GUG=Val
    // GCU=Ala(0), GCC=Ala, GCA=Ala, GCG=Ala
    // GAU=Asp(3), GAC=Asp, GAA=Glu(6), GAG=Glu
    // GGU=Gly(7), GGC=Gly, GGA=Gly, GGG=Gly

    if b1 == 2 {  // U
        if b2 == 2 { if b3 == 0 || b3 == 1 { return 10 } else { return 13 } } // UU: A/G=Leu, U/C=Phe
        if b2 == 3 { return 15 }  // UC: all Ser
        if b2 == 0 { if b3 == 2 || b3 == 3 { return 18 } else { return 20 } } // UA: U/C=Tyr, A/G=Stop
        if b2 == 1 { // UG
            if b3 == 2 || b3 == 3 { return 4 }  // UGU/UGC = Cys
            if b3 == 0 { return 20 }              // UGA = Stop
            return 17                               // UGG = Trp
        }
    }
    if b1 == 3 {  // C
        if b2 == 2 { return 10 }  // CU: all Leu
        if b2 == 3 { return 14 }  // CC: all Pro
        if b2 == 0 { if b3 == 2 || b3 == 3 { return 8 } else { return 5 } } // CA: U/C=His, A/G=Gln
        if b2 == 1 { return 1 }   // CG: all Arg
    }
    if b1 == 0 {  // A
        if b2 == 2 { if b3 == 1 { return 12 } else { return 9 } } // AU: G=Met, else Ile
        if b2 == 3 { return 16 }  // AC: all Thr
        if b2 == 0 { if b3 == 2 || b3 == 3 { return 2 } else { return 11 } } // AA: U/C=Asn, A/G=Lys
        if b2 == 1 { if b3 == 2 || b3 == 3 { return 15 } else { return 1 } } // AG: U/C=Ser, A/G=Arg
    }
    if b1 == 1 {  // G
        if b2 == 2 { return 19 }  // GU: all Val
        if b2 == 3 { return 0 }   // GC: all Ala
        if b2 == 0 { if b3 == 2 || b3 == 3 { return 3 } else { return 6 } } // GA: U/C=Asp, A/G=Glu
        if b2 == 1 { return 7 }   // GG: all Gly
    }
    -1  // should not reach
}

/// Hamming distance in Z_2^6 between two codon indices
pub fn hamming_z26(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 {
    let x = a ^ b  // XOR = differing bits
    var count: i32 = 0
    var v = x
    var bit: i32 = 0
    while bit < 6 {
        if (v & 1) == 1 { count = count + 1 }
        v = v >> 1
        bit = bit + 1
    }
    count
}

/// Check if three codon indices form a line in PG(5,2)
/// A line consists of {a, b, a XOR b} for distinct nonzero a, b
pub fn is_on_pg_line(a: i32, b: i32, c: i32) -> bool {
    if a == 0 || b == 0 || c == 0 { return false }  // zero vector excluded
    if a == b || b == c || a == c { return false }
    // {a, b, c} is a line iff one is the XOR of the other two
    if (a ^ b) == c { return true }
    if (a ^ c) == b { return true }
    if (b ^ c) == a { return true }
    false
}


// === FILE: stdlib/medical/hyperspectral.sio ===

// === FILE: stdlib/medical/kg_reason.sio ===
// stdlib/medical/kg_reason.sio — Medical Knowledge Graph Reasoning
//
// Drug-disease-gene triplet reasoning over a biomedical knowledge graph.
// Supports TransE, DistMult, and RotatE scoring functions with
// GUM-compliant uncertainty propagation on every prediction.
//
// SOTA references:
//   MedKGent (2025): 156K biomedical entities, multi-hop reasoning
//   GALAX (2025): Graph-Aligned LLM for KG completion
//   LLaDR (2025): LLM-driven drug repurposing via KG traversal
//   RotatE (Sun+ 2019): arXiv:1902.10197, rotation-based KG embedding
//   TransE (Bordes+ 2013): Translating Embeddings for Modeling Relations
//   DistMult (Yang+ 2015): arXiv:1412.6575, bilinear diagonal scoring
//
// Theory:
//   TransE:   score(h,r,t) = -||h + r - t||_2
//   DistMult: score(h,r,t) = sum_i(h_i * r_i * t_i)
//   RotatE:   score(h,r,t) = -||h . r - t||_2  (complex rotation)
//
//   Uncertainty propagation (GUM first-order):
//     u_score^2 = sum_i (df/dx_i)^2 * u_{x_i}^2

// =============================================================================
// Math Helpers
// =============================================================================

fn kg_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn kg_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 25 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

fn kg_min(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a < b { a } else { b }
}

fn kg_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { a } else { b }
}

fn kg_clamp(x: f64, lo: f64, hi: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x }
}

// Approximate sin for RotatE complex rotation
fn kg_sin(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Reduce x to [-pi, pi]
    var t = x
    let two_pi = 6.283185307179586
    while t > 3.14159265 { t = t - two_pi }
    while t < 0.0 - 3.14159265 { t = t + two_pi }
    // Taylor: sin(t) = t - t^3/6 + t^5/120 - t^7/5040 + ...
    let t2 = t * t
    let t3 = t2 * t
    let t5 = t3 * t2
    let t7 = t5 * t2
    let t9 = t7 * t2
    t - t3 / 6.0 + t5 / 120.0 - t7 / 5040.0 + t9 / 362880.0
}

// Approximate cos for RotatE complex rotation
fn kg_cos(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // cos(x) = sin(x + pi/2)
    kg_sin(x + 1.5707963267948966)
}

// =============================================================================
// Core Types
// =============================================================================

// Entity types: 0=drug, 1=disease, 2=gene, 3=protein, 4=pathway, 5=symptom
struct MedEntity {
    embedding: [f64; 16],
    u_embedding: [f64; 16],
    entity_type: i32,
}

// Relation types: 0=treats, 1=causes, 2=targets, 3=interacts,
//                 4=associated_with, 5=inhibits
struct MedRelation {
    embedding: [f64; 16],
    rel_type: i32,
}

struct MedTriple {
    head: i32,
    relation: i32,
    tail: i32,
    confidence: f64,
}

struct MedKG {
    entities: [MedEntity; 4096],
    relations: [MedRelation; 64],
    triples: [MedTriple; 16384],
    n_entities: i32,
    n_relations: i32,
    n_triples: i32,
}

struct PathResult {
    path_entities: [i32; 16],
    path_relations: [i32; 16],
    path_len: i32,
    path_score: f64,
    u_score: f64,
}

struct RepurposeCandidate {
    drug_id: i32,
    disease_id: i32,
    score: f64,
    u_score: f64,
    confidence: f64,
}

// =============================================================================
// Constructors
// =============================================================================

fn med_entity_zero() -> MedEntity {
    MedEntity {
        embedding: [0.0; 16],
        u_embedding: [1.0; 16],
        entity_type: 0,
    }
}

fn med_relation_zero() -> MedRelation {
    MedRelation {
        embedding: [0.0; 16],
        rel_type: 0,
    }
}

fn med_triple_zero() -> MedTriple {
    MedTriple {
        head: 0,
        relation: 0,
        tail: 0,
        confidence: 0.0,
    }
}

fn med_kg_new() -> MedKG with Mut, Panic {
    var kg = MedKG {
        entities: [MedEntity {
            embedding: [0.0; 16],
            u_embedding: [1.0; 16],
            entity_type: 0,
        }; 4096],
        relations: [MedRelation {
            embedding: [0.0; 16],
            rel_type: 0,
        }; 64],
        triples: [MedTriple {
            head: 0,
            relation: 0,
            tail: 0,
            confidence: 0.0,
        }; 16384],
        n_entities: 0,
        n_relations: 0,
        n_triples: 0,
    }
    kg
}

// =============================================================================
// Graph Construction
// =============================================================================

fn med_kg_add_entity(
    kg: &!MedKG,
    emb: &[f64; 16],
    u_emb: &[f64; 16],
    etype: i32,
) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let idx = kg.n_entities
    if idx >= 4096 { return 0 - 1 }
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        kg.entities[idx].embedding[i] = emb[i]
        kg.entities[idx].u_embedding[i] = u_emb[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    kg.entities[idx].entity_type = etype
    kg.n_entities = kg.n_entities + 1
    idx
}

fn med_kg_add_relation(
    kg: &!MedKG,
    emb: &[f64; 16],
    rtype: i32,
) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let idx = kg.n_relations
    if idx >= 64 { return 0 - 1 }
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        kg.relations[idx].embedding[i] = emb[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    kg.relations[idx].rel_type = rtype
    kg.n_relations = kg.n_relations + 1
    idx
}

fn med_kg_add_triple(
    kg: &!MedKG,
    h: i32,
    r: i32,
    t: i32,
    conf: f64,
) with Mut, Panic {
    let idx = kg.n_triples
    if idx >= 16384 { return }
    kg.triples[idx].head = h
    kg.triples[idx].relation = r
    kg.triples[idx].tail = t
    kg.triples[idx].confidence = conf
    kg.n_triples = kg.n_triples + 1
}

// =============================================================================
// TransE Scoring: score = -||h + r - t||_2
// =============================================================================

fn med_score_transe(
    kg: &MedKG,
    h: i32,
    r: i32,
    t: i32,
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var dist_sq = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        let diff = kg.entities[h].embedding[i]
                 + kg.relations[r].embedding[i]
                 - kg.entities[t].embedding[i]
        dist_sq = dist_sq + diff * diff
        i = i + 1
    }
    0.0 - kg_sqrt(dist_sq)
}

// =============================================================================
// DistMult Scoring: score = sum_i(h_i * r_i * t_i)
// =============================================================================

fn med_score_distmult(
    kg: &MedKG,
    h: i32,
    r: i32,
    t: i32,
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var score = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        score = score + kg.entities[h].embedding[i]
                      * kg.relations[r].embedding[i]
                      * kg.entities[t].embedding[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    score
}

// =============================================================================
// RotatE Scoring: complex rotation in paired dimensions
// =============================================================================
// Treat embedding as 8 complex numbers: (dim 2k, dim 2k+1) = (re, im)
// Relation acts as rotation: r = (cos(theta), sin(theta))
// score = -||h . r - t||_2 where . is element-wise complex product

fn med_score_rotate(
    kg: &MedKG,
    h: i32,
    r: i32,
    t: i32,
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var dist_sq = 0.0
    var k = 0
    while k < 8 {
        let re_idx = (k * 2) as i32
        let im_idx = (k * 2 + 1) as i32

        let h_re = kg.entities[h].embedding[re_idx]
        let h_im = kg.entities[h].embedding[im_idx]

        // Relation angle: interpret relation embedding as rotation phase
        let theta = kg.relations[r].embedding[re_idx]
        let r_re = kg_cos(theta)
        let r_im = kg_sin(theta)

        let t_re = kg.entities[t].embedding[re_idx]
        let t_im = kg.entities[t].embedding[im_idx]

        // Complex multiplication: (h_re + i*h_im) * (r_re + i*r_im)
        let hr_re = h_re * r_re - h_im * r_im
        let hr_im = h_re * r_im + h_im * r_re

        let diff_re = hr_re - t_re
        let diff_im = hr_im - t_im
        dist_sq = dist_sq + diff_re * diff_re + diff_im * diff_im

        k = k + 1
    }
    0.0 - kg_sqrt(dist_sq)
}

// =============================================================================
// Uncertainty Scoring (GUM first-order propagation)
// =============================================================================
// u_score^2 = sum_i (u_h_i^2 + u_t_i^2)  (TransE sensitivity = 1 per dim)

fn med_score_uncertainty(
    kg: &MedKG,
    h: i32,
    t: i32,
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var u_sq = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        let uh = kg.entities[h].u_embedding[i]
        let ut = kg.entities[t].u_embedding[i]
        u_sq = u_sq + uh * uh + ut * ut
        i = i + 1
    }
    kg_sqrt(u_sq)
}

// =============================================================================
// BFS Path Finding with Confidence
// =============================================================================
// Find a path from src to dst of length <= max_len.
// Uses breadth-first search over the triple adjacency.

fn med_path_bfs(
    kg: &MedKG,
    src: i32,
    dst: i32,
    max_len: i32,
    result: &!PathResult,
) -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // BFS state: queue of (entity_id, depth) pairs
    // visited[i] = 1 if entity i has been visited
    // parent[i] = entity that led to i
    // parent_rel[i] = relation used to reach i

    var visited: [i32; 4096] = [0; 4096]
    var parent: [i32; 4096] = [0 - 1; 4096]
    var parent_rel: [i32; 4096] = [0 - 1; 4096]
    var queue_ent: [i32; 4096] = [0; 4096]
    var queue_depth: [i32; 4096] = [0; 4096]
    var q_head = 0
    var q_tail = 0

    // Enqueue source
    queue_ent[q_tail] = src
    queue_depth[q_tail] = 0
    q_tail = q_tail + 1
    visited[src] = 1

    var found = false

    while q_head < q_tail {
        if found { q_head = q_tail } else {
            let cur = queue_ent[q_head]
            let depth = queue_depth[q_head]
            q_head = q_head + 1

            if cur == dst {
                found = true
            } else {
                if depth < max_len {
                    // Scan all triples for edges from cur
                    var ti = 0
                    while ti < kg.n_triples {
                        if found == false {
                            if kg.triples[ti].head == cur {
                                let nbr = kg.triples[ti].tail
                                if visited[nbr] == 0 {
                                    visited[nbr] = 1
                                    parent[nbr] = cur
                                    parent_rel[nbr] = kg.triples[ti].relation
                                    if q_tail < 4096 {
                                        queue_ent[q_tail] = nbr
                                        queue_depth[q_tail] = depth + 1
                                        q_tail = q_tail + 1
                                    }
                                    if nbr == dst { found = true }
                                }
                            }
                            // Also check reverse direction (undirected traversal)
                            if kg.triples[ti].tail == cur {
                                let nbr = kg.triples[ti].head
                                if visited[nbr] == 0 {
                                    visited[nbr] = 1
                                    parent[nbr] = cur
                                    parent_rel[nbr] = kg.triples[ti].relation
                                    if q_tail < 4096 {
                                        queue_ent[q_tail] = nbr
                                        queue_depth[q_tail] = depth + 1
                                        q_tail = q_tail + 1
                                    }
                                    if nbr == dst { found = true }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        ti = ti + 1
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if found == false { return false }

    // Reconstruct path from dst back to src
    var path_buf: [i32; 16] = [0; 16]
    var rel_buf: [i32; 16] = [0; 16]
    var path_len = 0
    var cur = dst

    while cur != src {
        if path_len >= 16 { return false }  // path too long for buffer
        path_buf[path_len] = cur
        rel_buf[path_len] = parent_rel[cur]
        path_len = path_len + 1
        cur = parent[cur]
        if cur < 0 { return false }  // broken chain
    }
    path_buf[path_len] = src
    path_len = path_len + 1

    // Reverse into result (src -> ... -> dst)
    result.path_len = path_len
    var ri = 0
    while ri < path_len {
        result.path_entities[ri] = path_buf[path_len - 1 - ri]
        if ri < path_len - 1 {
            result.path_relations[ri] = rel_buf[path_len - 2 - ri]
        }
        ri = ri + 1
    }

    // Compute path score: product of edge confidences along path
    var score = 1.0
    var u_sq = 0.0
    var pi = 0
    while pi < path_len - 1 {
        let ent_a = result.path_entities[pi]
        let ent_b = result.path_entities[pi + 1]
        let rel = result.path_relations[pi]

        // Find matching triple to get confidence
        var conf = 0.5  // default if not found
        var tj = 0
        while tj < kg.n_triples {
            if kg.triples[tj].head == ent_a {
                if kg.triples[tj].tail == ent_b {
                    if kg.triples[tj].relation == rel {
                        conf = kg.triples[tj].confidence
                        tj = kg.n_triples  // break
                    }
                }
            }
            if kg.triples[tj].tail == ent_a {
                if kg.triples[tj].head == ent_b {
                    if kg.triples[tj].relation == rel {
                        conf = kg.triples[tj].confidence
                        tj = kg.n_triples  // break
                    }
                }
            }
            tj = tj + 1
        }
        score = score * conf

        // Uncertainty: propagate from entity embeddings
        let u_edge = med_score_uncertainty(kg, ent_a, ent_b)
        u_sq = u_sq + u_edge * u_edge

        pi = pi + 1
    }

    result.path_score = score
    result.u_score = kg_sqrt(u_sq)
    true
}

// =============================================================================
// Drug Repurposing
// =============================================================================
// Score all diseases for a given drug using TransE + DistMult ensemble.
// Returns the number of candidates written into the results buffer.

fn med_drug_repurpose(
    kg: &MedKG,
    drug_id: i32,
    top_k: i32,
    results: &![RepurposeCandidate; 64],
) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Score every disease entity (type=1) against the drug
    // Use the "treats" relation (type=0)

    // Find the "treats" relation index
    var treats_rel = 0 - 1
    var ri = 0
    while ri < kg.n_relations {
        if kg.relations[ri].rel_type == 0 {
            treats_rel = ri
            ri = kg.n_relations  // break
        }
        ri = ri + 1
    }
    if treats_rel < 0 { return 0 }

    // Temporary buffer for all disease scores
    var disease_ids: [i32; 4096] = [0; 4096]
    var disease_scores: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var disease_u: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var n_diseases = 0

    var ei = 0
    while ei < kg.n_entities {
        if kg.entities[ei].entity_type == 1 {
            // Ensemble: average of TransE and DistMult scores
            let s_transe = med_score_transe(kg, drug_id, treats_rel, ei)
            let s_distmult = med_score_distmult(kg, drug_id, treats_rel, ei)
            let s_rotate = med_score_rotate(kg, drug_id, treats_rel, ei)

            let ensemble_score = (s_transe + s_distmult + s_rotate) / 3.0
            let u = med_score_uncertainty(kg, drug_id, ei)

            disease_ids[n_diseases] = ei
            disease_scores[n_diseases] = ensemble_score
            disease_u[n_diseases] = u
            n_diseases = n_diseases + 1
        }
        ei = ei + 1
    }

    // Sort by score (descending) — insertion sort
    var si = 1
    while si < n_diseases {
        let key_id = disease_ids[si]
        let key_score = disease_scores[si]
        let key_u = disease_u[si]
        var sj = si - 1
        while sj >= 0 {
            if disease_scores[sj] < key_score {
                disease_ids[sj + 1] = disease_ids[sj]
                disease_scores[sj + 1] = disease_scores[sj]
                disease_u[sj + 1] = disease_u[sj]
                sj = sj - 1
            } else {
                sj = 0 - 1  // break
            }
        }
        disease_ids[sj + 1] = key_id
        disease_scores[sj + 1] = key_score
        disease_u[sj + 1] = key_u
        si = si + 1
    }

    // Write top_k into results
    let n_out = if top_k < n_diseases { top_k } else { n_diseases }
    let n_capped = if n_out > 64 { 64 } else { n_out }

    var wi = 0
    while wi < n_capped {
        let sc = disease_scores[wi]
        let u = disease_u[wi]

        // Confidence: higher score and lower uncertainty = more confident
        // Sigmoid-like mapping: conf = 1 / (1 + exp(-score)) * (1 - u_norm)
        let score_factor = 1.0 / (1.0 + kg_sqrt(kg_abs(0.0 - sc) + 1.0))
        let u_norm = kg_clamp(u / 10.0, 0.0, 1.0)
        let conf = (1.0 - score_factor) * (1.0 - u_norm)

        results[wi] = RepurposeCandidate {
            drug_id: drug_id,
            disease_id: disease_ids[wi],
            score: sc,
            u_score: u,
            confidence: kg_clamp(conf, 0.0, 1.0),
        }
        wi = wi + 1
    }

    n_capped
}

// =============================================================================
// TransE Training Step
// =============================================================================
// Gradient descent on one triple:
//   loss = max(0, ||h + r - t||_2 - ||h' + r - t'||_2 + margin)
//   grad_h = 2*(h + r - t) / ||h + r - t||  (normalised direction)
//   Update: h -= lr * grad_h, r -= lr * grad_r, t += lr * grad_t
//   Also update uncertainty: u decreases as gradient signal is received.

fn med_train_step_transe(
    kg: &!MedKG,
    triple_idx: i32,
    lr: f64,
    margin: f64,
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if triple_idx < 0 { return }
    if triple_idx >= kg.n_triples { return }

    let h_id = kg.triples[triple_idx].head
    let r_id = kg.triples[triple_idx].relation
    let t_id = kg.triples[triple_idx].tail

    // Compute h + r - t
    var diff: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var dist_sq = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        diff[i] = kg.entities[h_id].embedding[i]
                + kg.relations[r_id].embedding[i]
                - kg.entities[t_id].embedding[i]
        dist_sq = dist_sq + diff[i] * diff[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    let dist = kg_sqrt(dist_sq)

    // Only update if distance is greater than margin threshold
    // (In full training, would compare positive vs negative triple)
    if dist < margin { return }

    // Normalise gradient direction
    var grad: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    if dist > 1.0e-10 {
        var gi = 0
        while gi < 16 {
            grad[gi] = diff[gi] / dist
            gi = gi + 1
        }
    }

    // Apply gradient updates
    var ui = 0
    while ui < 16 {
        // h moves toward t-r direction
        kg.entities[h_id].embedding[ui] = kg.entities[h_id].embedding[ui] - lr * grad[ui]
        // r moves toward t-h direction
        kg.relations[r_id].embedding[ui] = kg.relations[r_id].embedding[ui] - lr * grad[ui]
        // t moves toward h+r direction
        kg.entities[t_id].embedding[ui] = kg.entities[t_id].embedding[ui] + lr * grad[ui]

        // Reduce uncertainty (more training signal = less uncertainty)
        let decay = 0.99
        kg.entities[h_id].u_embedding[ui] = kg.entities[h_id].u_embedding[ui] * decay
        kg.entities[t_id].u_embedding[ui] = kg.entities[t_id].u_embedding[ui] * decay
        ui = ui + 1
    }

    // Update triple confidence based on new distance
    var new_dist_sq = 0.0
    var ni = 0
    while ni < 16 {
        let d = kg.entities[h_id].embedding[ni]
              + kg.relations[r_id].embedding[ni]
              - kg.entities[t_id].embedding[ni]
        new_dist_sq = new_dist_sq + d * d
        ni = ni + 1
    }
    let new_dist = kg_sqrt(new_dist_sq)
    // Confidence increases as distance decreases
    let conf = 1.0 / (1.0 + new_dist)
    kg.triples[triple_idx].confidence = conf
}

// =============================================================================
// Multi-hop Reasoning Score
// =============================================================================
// Given a path (sequence of entities and relations), compute a composite
// score as the product of individual edge scores (TransE-based).

fn med_path_score_transe(
    kg: &MedKG,
    path: &PathResult,
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if path.path_len < 2 { return 0.0 }

    var product = 1.0
    var i = 0
    while i < path.path_len - 1 {
        let h = path.path_entities[i]
        let r = path.path_relations[i]
        let t = path.path_entities[i + 1]
        let s = med_score_transe(kg, h, r, t)
        // Convert score to probability-like: sigmoid(-score)
        // TransE score is negative distance, so higher = better
        let prob = 1.0 / (1.0 + kg_sqrt(kg_abs(0.0 - s) + 1.0))
        product = product * prob
        i = i + 1
    }
    product
}

// =============================================================================
// Entity Similarity Search
// =============================================================================
// Find the k most similar entities to a query entity by L2 distance
// in embedding space.

fn med_find_similar(
    kg: &MedKG,
    query_id: i32,
    etype_filter: i32,
    top_k: i32,
    out_ids: &![i32; 64],
    out_scores: &![f64; 64],
) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Compute distances to all entities of the given type
    var ids: [i32; 4096] = [0; 4096]
    var dists: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var n = 0

    var ei = 0
    while ei < kg.n_entities {
        if ei != query_id {
            let type_match = if etype_filter < 0 { true }
                             else { kg.entities[ei].entity_type == etype_filter }
            if type_match {
                var d_sq = 0.0
                var di = 0
                while di < 16 {
                    let diff = kg.entities[query_id].embedding[di]
                             - kg.entities[ei].embedding[di]
                    d_sq = d_sq + diff * diff
                    di = di + 1
                }
                ids[n] = ei
                dists[n] = kg_sqrt(d_sq)
                n = n + 1
            }
        }
        ei = ei + 1
    }

    // Insertion sort by distance (ascending)
    var si = 1
    while si < n {
        let key_id = ids[si]
        let key_d = dists[si]
        var sj = si - 1
        while sj >= 0 {
            if dists[sj] > key_d {
                ids[sj + 1] = ids[sj]
                dists[sj + 1] = dists[sj]
                sj = sj - 1
            } else {
                sj = 0 - 1  // break
            }
        }
        ids[sj + 1] = key_id
        dists[sj + 1] = key_d
        si = si + 1
    }

    let n_out = if top_k < n { top_k } else { n }
    let n_capped = if n_out > 64 { 64 } else { n_out }

    var wi = 0
    while wi < n_capped {
        out_ids[wi] = ids[wi]
        // Convert distance to similarity score: 1/(1+d)
        out_scores[wi] = 1.0 / (1.0 + dists[wi])
        wi = wi + 1
    }
    n_capped
}


// === FILE: stdlib/medical/mod.sio ===
//! stdlib/medical - Medical Applications with Sedenions
//!
//! Provides sedenion-based (16D hypercomplex) medical computing.

module medical

pub fn medical_module_ready() -> i32 { 1 }


// === FILE: stdlib/medical/multiomics.sio ===
// stdlib/medical/multiomics.sio — Multi-Omics Staged Integration
//
// Staged multi-omics fusion with modality sufficiency detection.
// Every fused estimate carries GUM-compliant uncertainty — the first
// multi-omics framework with compile-time epistemic tracking.
//
// Clinical problem: A $10K proteomic panel is routinely ordered alongside
// $500 genomic assays, but in ~46% of cases the cheaper modality alone
// provides sufficient predictive confidence (Chen+ 2024, SGUQ). This
// module detects when a single modality suffices, avoiding unnecessary
// expense and patient burden.
//
// SOTA references:
//   SGUQ (Chen+ 2024): Staged uncertainty quantification for multi-modal
//       learning; 46% of samples reliably predicted from single modality
//   hist2RNA (Dinh+ 2023): Histology-to-transcriptomics translation,
//       showing cross-modal redundancy in tissue profiling
//   TAIS (Swanson+ 2024): Multi-agent discovery for multi-omics,
//       staged reasoning over heterogeneous biological data
//
// Mathematical framework:
//   GUM inverse-variance weighting (JCGM 100:2008):
//     w_i = 1 / u_i^2     (weight = inverse squared uncertainty)
//     x_fused = sum(w_i * x_i) / sum(w_i)
//     u_fused = 1 / sqrt(sum(w_i))
//
//   Sufficiency criterion:
//     A single modality k is sufficient when:
//       conf_k > target_confidence  AND
//       marginal_gain(k+1) < threshold
//     where marginal_gain measures the reduction in fused uncertainty
//     from adding the next most informative modality.
//
//   Modality codes:
//     0 = genomic (SNP/WGS, ~$500)
//     1 = transcriptomic (RNA-seq, ~$2K)
//     2 = proteomic (mass-spec, ~$10K)
//     3 = clinical (EHR vitals, ~$0)
//     4 = imaging (histopathology, ~$300)

// =============================================================================
// Math Helpers (must precede all callers)
// =============================================================================

fn mo_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn mo_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { a } else { b }
}

fn mo_min(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a < b { a } else { b }
}

fn mo_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 30 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

fn mo_ln(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 - 1.0e30 }
    var m = x
    var e = 0
    while m >= 2.0 { m = m / 2.0; e = e + 1 }
    while m < 0.5 { m = m * 2.0; e = e - 1 }
    let t = (m - 1.0) / (m + 1.0)
    let t2 = t * t
    var sum = t
    var term = t
    var k = 1
    while k < 30 {
        term = term * t2
        sum = sum + term / (2 * k + 1) as f64
        k = k + 1
    }
    2.0 * sum + (e as f64) * 0.6931471805599453
}

fn mo_exp(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 500.0 { return 1.0e200 }
    if x < -500.0 { return 0.0 }
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var k_f = x / ln2
    var k: i32 = 0
    if k_f >= 0.0 { k = k_f as i32 } else { k = (k_f as i32) - 1 }
    let r = x - (k as f64) * ln2
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var n = 1
    while n < 25 { term = term * r / (n as f64); sum = sum + term; n = n + 1 }
    var result = sum
    if k >= 0 {
        var i = 0
        while i < k { result = result * 2.0; i = i + 1 }
    } else {
        var i = 0
        while i < (0 - k) { result = result / 2.0; i = i + 1 }
    }
    result
}

// =============================================================================
// Core Types
// =============================================================================

// A single omics modality layer with per-feature uncertainty and confidence.
// features[i] is the measured value, u_features[i] is its standard uncertainty,
// confidence[i] in [0,1] is the reliability of that measurement.
struct OmicsLayer {
    features: [f64; 256],
    u_features: [f64; 256],
    confidence: [f64; 256],
    n_features: i32,
    modality: i32,          // 0=genomic, 1=transcriptomic, 2=proteomic, 3=clinical, 4=imaging
}

// Staged fusion container: accumulates layers and stores the fused result.
// sufficiency[k] holds the sufficiency score for layer k (1.0 = fully sufficient).
struct StagedFusion {
    layers: [OmicsLayer; 8],
    n_layers: i32,
    fused: [f64; 256],
    u_fused: [f64; 256],
    conf_fused: [f64; 256],
    n_fused: i32,
    sufficiency: [f64; 8],
}

// Result of sufficiency analysis for a single modality.
struct SufficiencyResult {
    is_sufficient: bool,
    modality_idx: i32,
    confidence: f64,
    marginal_gain: f64,
    features_reliable: i32,
}

// Risk prediction with propagated uncertainty.
struct PredictionResult {
    risk_score: f64,
    u_risk: f64,
    confidence: f64,
    modalities_used: i32,
    explanation: [f64; 256],
}

// Per-feature importance with gradient-based attribution.
struct FeatureImportance {
    importances: [f64; 256],
    n_features: i32,
    top_feature: i32,
    top_importance: f64,
}

// =============================================================================
// Layer Construction
// =============================================================================

// Create a new omics layer with zeroed features.
fn omics_layer_new(modality: i32, n_features: i32) -> OmicsLayer with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var layer = OmicsLayer {
        features: [0.0; 256],
        u_features: [0.0; 256],
        confidence: [0.0; 256],
        n_features: n_features,
        modality: modality,
    }
    // Initialize uncertainties to a high default (uninformative prior)
    var i = 0
    while i < 256 {
        layer.u_features[i] = 1.0e6
        i = i + 1
    }
    layer
}

// Set a single feature value with its uncertainty and confidence.
fn omics_set_feature(layer: &!OmicsLayer, idx: i32, val: f64, unc: f64, conf: f64) with Mut, Panic {
    if idx < 0 { return }
    if idx >= 256 { return }
    layer.features[idx] = val
    // Clamp uncertainty to a positive floor to avoid division by zero
    layer.u_features[idx] = mo_max(unc, 1.0e-12)
    layer.confidence[idx] = mo_min(mo_max(conf, 0.0), 1.0)
}

// =============================================================================
// Staged Fusion Construction
// =============================================================================

// Create an empty staged fusion container.
fn staged_fusion_new() -> StagedFusion with Mut, Panic {
    var empty_layer = OmicsLayer {
        features: [0.0; 256],
        u_features: [0.0; 256],
        confidence: [0.0; 256],
        n_features: 0,
        modality: 0,
    }
    // We need 8 default layers; build them inline
    var layers: [OmicsLayer; 8] = [
        empty_layer, empty_layer, empty_layer, empty_layer,
        empty_layer, empty_layer, empty_layer, empty_layer
    ]

    StagedFusion {
        layers: layers,
        n_layers: 0,
        fused: [0.0; 256],
        u_fused: [0.0; 256],
        conf_fused: [0.0; 256],
        n_fused: 0,
        sufficiency: [0.0; 8],
    }
}

// Add a layer to the staged fusion. Copies layer data into the next slot.
fn staged_add_layer(fusion: &!StagedFusion, layer: &OmicsLayer) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let idx = fusion.n_layers
    if idx >= 8 { return }

    // Copy feature data into fusion slot
    var j = 0
    while j < 256 {
        fusion.layers[idx].features[j] = layer.features[j]
        fusion.layers[idx].u_features[j] = layer.u_features[j]
        fusion.layers[idx].confidence[j] = layer.confidence[j]
        j = j + 1
    }
    fusion.layers[idx].n_features = layer.n_features
    fusion.layers[idx].modality = layer.modality

    // Track the maximum feature count across all layers
    if layer.n_features > fusion.n_fused {
        fusion.n_fused = layer.n_features
    }

    fusion.n_layers = idx + 1
}

// =============================================================================
// GUM Inverse-Variance Fusion
// =============================================================================
// For each feature index j:
//   w_i = conf_i * (1 / u_i^2)     weight = confidence-scaled inverse variance
//   fused_j = sum_i(w_i * x_i) / sum_i(w_i)
//   u_fused_j = 1 / sqrt(sum_i(w_i))
//
// Only layers with confidence > 0 for feature j contribute.

fn inverse_variance_fuse(fusion: &!StagedFusion) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var j = 0
    while j < fusion.n_fused {
        var w_sum = 0.0
        var wx_sum = 0.0
        var max_conf = 0.0

        var i = 0
        while i < fusion.n_layers {
            let u = fusion.layers[i].u_features[j]
            let c = fusion.layers[i].confidence[j]
            let x = fusion.layers[i].features[j]

            // Only fuse if this layer has valid data for feature j
            if c > 1.0e-10 {
                if u > 1.0e-12 {
                    let w = c / (u * u)
                    w_sum = w_sum + w
                    wx_sum = wx_sum + w * x
                }
                if c > max_conf { max_conf = c }
            }

            i = i + 1
        }

        if w_sum > 1.0e-30 {
            fusion.fused[j] = wx_sum / w_sum
            fusion.u_fused[j] = 1.0 / mo_sqrt(w_sum)
            // Fused confidence: weighted harmonic mean bounded by max contributor
            fusion.conf_fused[j] = mo_min(max_conf, 1.0 - fusion.u_fused[j])
            fusion.conf_fused[j] = mo_max(fusion.conf_fused[j], 0.0)
        } else {
            fusion.fused[j] = 0.0
            fusion.u_fused[j] = 1.0e6
            fusion.conf_fused[j] = 0.0
        }

        j = j + 1
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Sufficiency Detection
// =============================================================================
// Can a single modality (layer_idx) predict reliably without the others?
//
// Criterion: count features where layer confidence exceeds target, then
// check whether fusing the remaining layers would materially reduce
// the uncertainty (marginal gain < threshold).

fn staged_check_sufficiency(
    fusion: &StagedFusion,
    target_confidence: f64,
    layer_idx: i32,
) -> SufficiencyResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if layer_idx < 0 { return SufficiencyResult {
        is_sufficient: false, modality_idx: layer_idx,
        confidence: 0.0, marginal_gain: 1.0, features_reliable: 0,
    }}
    if layer_idx >= fusion.n_layers { return SufficiencyResult {
        is_sufficient: false, modality_idx: layer_idx,
        confidence: 0.0, marginal_gain: 1.0, features_reliable: 0,
    }}

    // Count reliable features in this single layer
    var reliable = 0
    var conf_sum = 0.0
    var j = 0
    while j < fusion.n_fused {
        let c = fusion.layers[layer_idx].confidence[j]
        if c >= target_confidence {
            reliable = reliable + 1
        }
        conf_sum = conf_sum + c
        j = j + 1
    }

    let mean_conf = if fusion.n_fused > 0 {
        conf_sum / (fusion.n_fused as f64)
    } else { 0.0 }

    // Compute single-layer uncertainty (average across features)
    var single_u_sum = 0.0
    j = 0
    while j < fusion.n_fused {
        single_u_sum = single_u_sum + fusion.layers[layer_idx].u_features[j]
        j = j + 1
    }
    let single_u_mean = if fusion.n_fused > 0 {
        single_u_sum / (fusion.n_fused as f64)
    } else { 1.0e6 }

    // Compute fused uncertainty (average across features)
    var fused_u_sum = 0.0
    j = 0
    while j < fusion.n_fused {
        fused_u_sum = fused_u_sum + fusion.u_fused[j]
        j = j + 1
    }
    let fused_u_mean = if fusion.n_fused > 0 {
        fused_u_sum / (fusion.n_fused as f64)
    } else { 1.0e6 }

    // Marginal gain: fractional reduction in uncertainty from fusing all layers
    // vs using this single layer alone
    let marginal = if single_u_mean > 1.0e-12 {
        (single_u_mean - fused_u_mean) / single_u_mean
    } else { 0.0 }

    // Sufficient if: mean confidence exceeds target AND marginal gain is small
    // The 0.05 threshold follows SGUQ: <5% improvement means single modality suffices
    let sufficient = mean_conf >= target_confidence
    let marginal_small = marginal < 0.05

    SufficiencyResult {
        is_sufficient: sufficient,
        modality_idx: layer_idx,
        confidence: mean_conf,
        marginal_gain: marginal,
        features_reliable: reliable,
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Marginal Information Gain
// =============================================================================
// Compute the reduction in average fused uncertainty if new_layer were added.
// Returns a value in [0,1]: 0 = no gain, 1 = halves all uncertainty.

fn staged_marginal_gain(
    fusion: &StagedFusion,
    new_layer: &OmicsLayer,
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Current average fused uncertainty
    var current_u_sum = 0.0
    var j = 0
    while j < fusion.n_fused {
        current_u_sum = current_u_sum + fusion.u_fused[j]
        j = j + 1
    }
    let current_u_mean = if fusion.n_fused > 0 {
        current_u_sum / (fusion.n_fused as f64)
    } else { 1.0e6 }

    // Hypothetical fused uncertainty after adding new_layer
    var new_u_sum = 0.0
    j = 0
    while j < fusion.n_fused {
        // Current inverse-variance weight sum for feature j
        var w_sum = 0.0
        var i = 0
        while i < fusion.n_layers {
            let u = fusion.layers[i].u_features[j]
            let c = fusion.layers[i].confidence[j]
            if c > 1.0e-10 {
                if u > 1.0e-12 {
                    w_sum = w_sum + c / (u * u)
                }
            }
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Add the new layer's contribution
        let u_new = new_layer.u_features[j]
        let c_new = new_layer.confidence[j]
        if c_new > 1.0e-10 {
            if u_new > 1.0e-12 {
                w_sum = w_sum + c_new / (u_new * u_new)
            }
        }

        let hypothetical_u = if w_sum > 1.0e-30 {
            1.0 / mo_sqrt(w_sum)
        } else { 1.0e6 }

        new_u_sum = new_u_sum + hypothetical_u
        j = j + 1
    }
    let new_u_mean = if fusion.n_fused > 0 {
        new_u_sum / (fusion.n_fused as f64)
    } else { 1.0e6 }

    // Fractional reduction
    if current_u_mean > 1.0e-12 {
        (current_u_mean - new_u_mean) / current_u_mean
    } else {
        0.0
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Risk Prediction with Uncertainty Propagation
// =============================================================================
// Linear risk model: risk = sum(w_j * fused_j)
// Uncertainty via quadrature: u_risk = sqrt(sum((w_j * u_fused_j)^2))
// Confidence: weighted average of feature confidences

fn staged_predict_risk(
    fusion: &StagedFusion,
    weights: &[f64; 256],
) -> PredictionResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var risk = 0.0
    var u_risk_sq = 0.0
    var conf_sum = 0.0
    var conf_count = 0.0
    var explanation: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]

    var j = 0
    while j < fusion.n_fused {
        let w = weights[j]
        let f = fusion.fused[j]
        let u = fusion.u_fused[j]
        let c = fusion.conf_fused[j]

        let contribution = w * f
        risk = risk + contribution
        u_risk_sq = u_risk_sq + (w * u) * (w * u)

        // Explanation: how much each feature contributes to risk
        explanation[j] = contribution

        if c > 0.0 {
            conf_sum = conf_sum + c
            conf_count = conf_count + 1.0
        }

        j = j + 1
    }

    let u_risk = mo_sqrt(u_risk_sq)
    let mean_conf = if conf_count > 0.0 {
        conf_sum / conf_count
    } else { 0.0 }

    // Clamp risk to [0,1] for probability interpretation
    let clamped_risk = mo_min(mo_max(risk, 0.0), 1.0)

    PredictionResult {
        risk_score: clamped_risk,
        u_risk: u_risk,
        confidence: mean_conf,
        modalities_used: fusion.n_layers,
        explanation: explanation,
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Feature Importance (gradient-based attribution)
// =============================================================================
// Importance of feature j = |w_j * fused_j| / sum(|w_k * fused_k|)
// Weighted by confidence: features with low confidence get discounted.

fn compute_feature_importance(
    fusion: &StagedFusion,
    result: &PredictionResult,
    weights: &[f64; 256],
) -> FeatureImportance with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var imps: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var total_imp = 0.0
    var top_idx = 0
    var top_val = 0.0

    // Raw importance: |weight * fused_value| * confidence
    var j = 0
    while j < fusion.n_fused {
        let raw = mo_abs(weights[j] * fusion.fused[j])
        let discounted = raw * fusion.conf_fused[j]
        imps[j] = discounted
        total_imp = total_imp + discounted
        j = j + 1
    }

    // Normalize to sum to 1.0 and find top feature
    j = 0
    while j < fusion.n_fused {
        if total_imp > 1.0e-30 {
            imps[j] = imps[j] / total_imp
        }
        if imps[j] > top_val {
            top_val = imps[j]
            top_idx = j
        }
        j = j + 1
    }

    FeatureImportance {
        importances: imps,
        n_features: fusion.n_fused,
        top_feature: top_idx,
        top_importance: top_val,
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Modality Recommendation
// =============================================================================
// Given current fused state and a target confidence, recommend which
// modality type to acquire next. Returns the modality code (0-4) that
// would yield the greatest marginal gain.
//
// Strategy: for each candidate modality not yet in the fusion, estimate
// the expected information gain based on typical uncertainty profiles.
// This uses prior knowledge about modality quality:
//   genomic:        u ~ 0.1 (low noise, high throughput)
//   transcriptomic: u ~ 0.2 (batch effects)
//   proteomic:      u ~ 0.05 (high precision mass-spec)
//   clinical:       u ~ 0.3 (subjective, noisy)
//   imaging:        u ~ 0.15 (depends on resolution)

fn staged_recommend_modality(
    fusion: &StagedFusion,
    target_confidence: f64,
) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Typical uncertainty profiles per modality
    var typical_u: [f64; 5] = [0.0; 5]
    typical_u[0] = 0.10   // genomic
    typical_u[1] = 0.20   // transcriptomic
    typical_u[2] = 0.05   // proteomic
    typical_u[3] = 0.30   // clinical
    typical_u[4] = 0.15   // imaging

    // Typical confidence per modality
    var typical_c: [f64; 5] = [0.0; 5]
    typical_c[0] = 0.85
    typical_c[1] = 0.75
    typical_c[2] = 0.90
    typical_c[3] = 0.60
    typical_c[4] = 0.80

    // Check which modalities are already present
    var present: [bool; 5] = [false; 5]
    var i = 0
    while i < fusion.n_layers {
        let m = fusion.layers[i].modality
        if m >= 0 {
            if m < 5 {
                present[m] = true
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // For each absent modality, build a hypothetical layer and score it
    var best_modality = 0
    var best_gain = 0.0 - 1.0
    var found_any = false

    var m = 0
    while m < 5 {
        if present[m] == false {
            // Construct hypothetical layer with typical profile
            var hypo = omics_layer_new(m, fusion.n_fused)
            var j = 0
            while j < fusion.n_fused {
                hypo.features[j] = fusion.fused[j]  // assume similar values
                hypo.u_features[j] = typical_u[m]
                hypo.confidence[j] = typical_c[m]
                j = j + 1
            }

            // Score = marginal gain from adding this modality
            let gain = staged_marginal_gain(fusion, &hypo)

            if found_any == false {
                best_gain = gain
                best_modality = m
                found_any = true
            } else {
                if gain > best_gain {
                    best_gain = gain
                    best_modality = m
                }
            }
        }
        m = m + 1
    }

    // If all modalities present or no gain possible, return -1
    if found_any == false { return 0 - 1 }

    // Check if current fusion already meets target
    var mean_conf = 0.0
    var j = 0
    while j < fusion.n_fused {
        mean_conf = mean_conf + fusion.conf_fused[j]
        j = j + 1
    }
    mean_conf = if fusion.n_fused > 0 {
        mean_conf / (fusion.n_fused as f64)
    } else { 0.0 }

    if mean_conf >= target_confidence { return 0 - 1 }

    best_modality
}


// === FILE: stdlib/medical/sedenion_eeg.sio ===
//! stdlib/medical/sedenion_eeg.sio — EEG-to-Sedenion Encoding Pipeline
//!
//! Maps 16-channel EEG data into the sedenion (S = R^16) via CDElement.
//! Each sedenion component encodes a neurophysiological feature:
//!
//!   e0-e4:   band power (delta, theta, alpha, beta, gamma)
//!   e5-e9:   band coherence (mean pairwise per band)
//!   e10-e15: inter-band coupling (6 clinically relevant pairs:
//!            theta-alpha, alpha-beta, beta-gamma, theta-gamma,
//!            delta-theta, alpha-gamma)
//!
//! Band-specific encoding uses the 10-20 system's 16-channel subset.
//! Coherence matrices (16x16) are summarised per band, then fused
//! into a single sedenion whose algebraic products capture cross-band
//! interactions (non-associativity = order-dependent coupling).
//!
//! Uses CDElement (bits=4, dim=16) from cayley_dickson.sio for mutation
//! via array indexing (workaround for Sedenion64 named-field limitation).
//!
//! References:
//!   Nunez & Srinivasan (2006): EEG coherence theory
//!   Boller et al. (2023): Ricci curvature in aging brain FC
//!   Prerau et al. (2017): Sleep neurophysiology

use algebra::cayley_dickson::{CDElement, cd_zero, cd_mul, cd_add,
                               cd_sub, cd_scale, cd_norm_sq, cd_norm}

// ============================================================================
// CONSTANTS
// ============================================================================

// Frequency band indices
fn BAND_DELTA() -> i32 { 0 }   // 1-4 Hz
fn BAND_THETA() -> i32 { 1 }   // 4-8 Hz
fn BAND_ALPHA() -> i32 { 2 }   // 8-13 Hz
fn BAND_BETA() -> i32 { 3 }    // 13-30 Hz
fn BAND_GAMMA() -> i32 { 4 }   // 30-100 Hz
fn NUM_BANDS() -> i32 { 5 }
fn NUM_CHANNELS() -> i32 { 16 }
fn EEG_SED_BITS() -> i32 { 4 }     // 2^4 = 16 components

// ============================================================================
// EEG DATA STRUCTURES
// ============================================================================

/// Single-band EEG data for 16 channels.
/// Coherence matrix is 16x16 = 256 entries (row-major, symmetric).
/// Band power is per-channel (16 entries).
pub struct EegBandData {
    coherence: [f64; 256],
    band_power: [f64; 16],
    n_channels: i32,
    band_idx: i32,
}

/// Multi-band EEG: 5 frequency bands plus inter-band coupling.
pub struct EegMultiBandData {
    // Per-band coherence and power
    delta: EegBandData,
    theta: EegBandData,
    alpha: EegBandData,
    beta: EegBandData,
    gamma: EegBandData,
    // Inter-band coupling strengths (10 unique pairs from C(5,2))
    interband: [f64; 10],
    n_channels: i32,
}

/// Result of sedenion encoding with diagnostic metadata.
pub struct EegSedenionResult {
    sed: CDElement,
    norm: f64,
    dominant_band: i32,
    mean_coherence: f64,
}

// ============================================================================
// CONSTRUCTORS
// ============================================================================

/// Create empty single-band data.
pub fn eeg_band_data_new(n_ch: i32, band: i32) -> EegBandData {
    EegBandData {
        coherence: [0.0; 256],
        band_power: [0.0; 16],
        n_channels: n_ch,
        band_idx: band,
    }
}

/// Create empty multi-band data.
pub fn eeg_multiband_new(n_ch: i32) -> EegMultiBandData {
    EegMultiBandData {
        delta: eeg_band_data_new(n_ch, 0),
        theta: eeg_band_data_new(n_ch, 1),
        alpha: eeg_band_data_new(n_ch, 2),
        beta: eeg_band_data_new(n_ch, 3),
        gamma: eeg_band_data_new(n_ch, 4),
        interband: [0.0; 10],
        n_channels: n_ch,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn eeg_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var r = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 { r = 0.5 * (r + x / r); i = i + 1 }
    r
}

fn eeg_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

// ============================================================================
// BAND DATA SETTERS
// ============================================================================

/// Set coherence between channels i and j (symmetric).
pub fn eeg_band_set_coherence(bd: EegBandData, i: i32, j: i32, val: f64) -> EegBandData with Mut, Panic {
    var b = bd
    if i >= 0 && i < b.n_channels && j >= 0 && j < b.n_channels {
        b.coherence[(i * 16 + j) as usize] = val
        b.coherence[(j * 16 + i) as usize] = val
    }
    b
}

/// Set band power for a single channel.
pub fn eeg_band_set_power(bd: EegBandData, ch: i32, power: f64) -> EegBandData with Mut, Panic {
    var b = bd
    if ch >= 0 && ch < b.n_channels {
        b.band_power[ch as usize] = power
    }
    b
}

// ============================================================================
// MEAN COHERENCE PER BAND
// ============================================================================

/// Compute mean upper-triangular coherence for a band.
fn band_mean_coherence(bd: EegBandData) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum: f64 = 0.0
    var count: i32 = 0
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < bd.n_channels {
        var j: i32 = i + 1
        while j < bd.n_channels {
            sum = sum + bd.coherence[(i * 16 + j) as usize]
            count = count + 1
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if count > 0 { sum / (count as f64) } else { 0.0 }
}

/// Compute mean band power across channels.
fn band_mean_power(bd: EegBandData) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < bd.n_channels {
        sum = sum + bd.band_power[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    if bd.n_channels > 0 { sum / (bd.n_channels as f64) } else { 0.0 }
}

// ============================================================================
// CORE ENCODING: 16 EEG CHANNELS -> SEDENION
// ============================================================================

/// Encode 16-channel band power directly as sedenion components.
/// Each channel maps to one sedenion component (e0..e15).
/// This is the simplest encoding: channel i -> component i.
pub fn eeg_channels_to_sedenion(powers: [f64; 16]) -> CDElement with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var s = cd_zero(EEG_SED_BITS())
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 16 {
        s.c[i as usize] = powers[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    s
}

/// Normalise a CDElement to unit norm.
pub fn eeg_sed_normalize(s: CDElement) -> CDElement with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let nsq = cd_norm_sq(s)
    if nsq < 1e-30 { return s }
    let n = eeg_sqrt(nsq)
    cd_scale(s, 1.0 / n)
}

// ============================================================================
// BAND-SPECIFIC ENCODING: DELTA, THETA, ALPHA, BETA, GAMMA
// ============================================================================

/// Encode a single frequency band as a sedenion.
/// Components 0..15 = coherence-weighted channel power.
/// Weighting: power_i * mean_coherence_of_channel_i.
pub fn eeg_band_to_sedenion(bd: EegBandData) -> CDElement with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var s = cd_zero(EEG_SED_BITS())
    var ch: i32 = 0
    while ch < bd.n_channels {
        // Mean coherence of this channel with all others
        var ch_coh: f64 = 0.0
        var count: i32 = 0
        var j: i32 = 0
        while j < bd.n_channels {
            if j != ch {
                ch_coh = ch_coh + bd.coherence[(ch * 16 + j) as usize]
                count = count + 1
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        let mean_ch_coh = if count > 0 { ch_coh / (count as f64) } else { 0.0 }
        // Weighted: power * coherence
        s.c[ch as usize] = bd.band_power[ch as usize] * (1.0 + mean_ch_coh)
        ch = ch + 1
    }
    s
}

// ============================================================================
// MULTI-BAND ENCODING: EEG -> SEDENION
// ============================================================================

/// Encode full multi-band EEG as a single sedenion (CDElement, bits=4).
///
///   e0-e4:   mean band power (delta, theta, alpha, beta, gamma)
///   e5-e9:   mean band coherence (same 5 bands)
///   e10-e15: inter-band coupling (6 clinically relevant pairs:
///            0=theta-alpha, 1=alpha-beta, 2=beta-gamma,
///            3=theta-gamma, 4=delta-theta, 5=alpha-gamma)
///
/// The sedenion is normalised to unit norm.
pub fn eeg_multiband_to_sedenion(mb: EegMultiBandData) -> CDElement with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var s = cd_zero(EEG_SED_BITS())

    // e0-e4: mean band power
    s.c[0] = band_mean_power(mb.delta)
    s.c[1] = band_mean_power(mb.theta)
    s.c[2] = band_mean_power(mb.alpha)
    s.c[3] = band_mean_power(mb.beta)
    s.c[4] = band_mean_power(mb.gamma)

    // e5-e9: mean band coherence
    s.c[5] = band_mean_coherence(mb.delta)
    s.c[6] = band_mean_coherence(mb.theta)
    s.c[7] = band_mean_coherence(mb.alpha)
    s.c[8] = band_mean_coherence(mb.beta)
    s.c[9] = band_mean_coherence(mb.gamma)

    // e10-e15: inter-band coupling (first 6 of 10 pairs)
    // Pair ordering: theta-alpha, alpha-beta, beta-gamma,
    //                theta-gamma, delta-theta, alpha-gamma
    var ib: i32 = 0
    while ib < 6 {
        s.c[(ib + 10) as usize] = mb.interband[ib as usize]
        ib = ib + 1
    }

    // Normalise to unit sedenion
    eeg_sed_normalize(s)
}

/// Encode multi-band EEG with full diagnostic metadata.
pub fn eeg_multiband_encode(mb: EegMultiBandData) -> EegSedenionResult with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let s = eeg_multiband_to_sedenion(mb)
    let n = eeg_sqrt(cd_norm_sq(s))

    // Find dominant band (highest mean power)
    var powers: [f64; 5] = [0.0; 5]
    powers[0] = band_mean_power(mb.delta)
    powers[1] = band_mean_power(mb.theta)
    powers[2] = band_mean_power(mb.alpha)
    powers[3] = band_mean_power(mb.beta)
    powers[4] = band_mean_power(mb.gamma)

    var dom: i32 = 0
    var max_p: f64 = powers[0]
    var b: i32 = 1
    while b < 5 {
        if powers[b as usize] > max_p {
            max_p = powers[b as usize]
            dom = b
        }
        b = b + 1
    }

    // Overall mean coherence (average across bands)
    let mc = (band_mean_coherence(mb.delta) + band_mean_coherence(mb.theta)
            + band_mean_coherence(mb.alpha) + band_mean_coherence(mb.beta)
            + band_mean_coherence(mb.gamma)) / 5.0

    EegSedenionResult {
        sed: s,
        norm: n,
        dominant_band: dom,
        mean_coherence: mc,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// COHERENCE MATRIX -> SEDENION REPRESENTATION
// ============================================================================

/// Encode a 16x16 coherence matrix directly as a sedenion.
/// Uses eigenvalue-like summary: each component i = sum of row i (minus diagonal).
/// This preserves the graph-theoretic degree structure.
pub fn eeg_coherence_to_sedenion(coh: [f64; 256], n: i32) -> CDElement with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var s = cd_zero(EEG_SED_BITS())
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < n && i < 16 {
        var row_sum: f64 = 0.0
        var j: i32 = 0
        while j < n && j < 16 {
            if i != j {
                row_sum = row_sum + coh[(i * 16 + j) as usize]
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        s.c[i as usize] = row_sum
        i = i + 1
    }
    // Normalise
    eeg_sed_normalize(s)
}

/// Compute the sedenion difference between two coherence states.
/// Useful for tracking EEG evolution (e.g., pre- vs post-treatment).
pub fn eeg_sedenion_diff(a: CDElement, b: CDElement) -> CDElement with Mut, Panic, Div {
    cd_sub(a, b)
}

/// Compute the sedenion product of two EEG encodings.
/// Non-commutativity of the sedenion product captures order-dependent
/// cross-modal interactions. Non-associativity means (A*B)*C != A*(B*C),
/// reflecting the irreducibility of multi-band neural coupling order.
pub fn eeg_sedenion_product(a: CDElement, b: CDElement) -> CDElement with Mut, Panic, Div {
    cd_mul(a, b)
}

// ============================================================================
// BAND-PAIR COUPLING (inter-band)
// ============================================================================

/// Compute inter-band coupling from two band coherence matrices.
/// Coupling = correlation of upper-triangular coherence vectors.
pub fn eeg_interband_coupling(a: EegBandData, b: EegBandData) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let n = a.n_channels
    var sum_ab: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_a: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_b: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_aa: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_bb: f64 = 0.0
    var count: i32 = 0
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < n {
        var j: i32 = i + 1
        while j < n {
            let va = a.coherence[(i * 16 + j) as usize]
            let vb = b.coherence[(i * 16 + j) as usize]
            sum_ab = sum_ab + va * vb
            sum_a = sum_a + va
            sum_b = sum_b + vb
            sum_aa = sum_aa + va * va
            sum_bb = sum_bb + vb * vb
            count = count + 1
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if count == 0 { return 0.0 }
    let cf = count as f64
    let num = sum_ab - (sum_a * sum_b) / cf
    let den_a = sum_aa - (sum_a * sum_a) / cf
    let den_b = sum_bb - (sum_b * sum_b) / cf
    let den = eeg_sqrt(eeg_abs(den_a) * eeg_abs(den_b))
    if den < 1e-15 { 0.0 } else { num / den }
}

// ============================================================================
// EEG GRAPH METRICS
// ============================================================================

/// Compute eta = <k>^2 / N for a coherence matrix (threshold > thresh).
pub fn eeg_eta(coh: [f64; 256], n: i32, thresh: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var edges: i32 = 0
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < n {
        var j: i32 = i + 1
        while j < n {
            if coh[(i * 16 + j) as usize] > thresh { edges = edges + 1 }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    let mean_k = (2.0 * (edges as f64)) / (n as f64)
    mean_k * mean_k / (n as f64)
}

// ============================================================================
// DEMO / SELF-TEST
// ============================================================================

fn eeg_main() with Mut, Panic, Div {
    // Create synthetic 16-channel EEG data
    var mb = eeg_multiband_new(16)

    // Populate delta band with synthetic power and coherence
    var ch: i32 = 0
    while ch < 16 {
        mb.delta.band_power[ch as usize] = 0.3 + 0.02 * (ch as f64)
        mb.theta.band_power[ch as usize] = 0.15 + 0.01 * (ch as f64)
        mb.alpha.band_power[ch as usize] = 0.25 + 0.015 * (ch as f64)
        mb.beta.band_power[ch as usize] = 0.2 + 0.01 * (ch as f64)
        mb.gamma.band_power[ch as usize] = 0.1 + 0.005 * (ch as f64)
        ch = ch + 1
    }

    // Populate coherence (nearby channels more coherent)
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 16 {
        var j: i32 = i + 1
        while j < 16 {
            let dist = j - i
            let base_coh = if dist <= 2 { 0.7 }
                           else if dist <= 4 { 0.4 }
                           else { 0.2 }
            mb.delta.coherence[(i * 16 + j) as usize] = base_coh
            mb.delta.coherence[(j * 16 + i) as usize] = base_coh
            mb.alpha.coherence[(i * 16 + j) as usize] = base_coh * 0.9
            mb.alpha.coherence[(j * 16 + i) as usize] = base_coh * 0.9
            mb.theta.coherence[(i * 16 + j) as usize] = base_coh * 0.6
            mb.theta.coherence[(j * 16 + i) as usize] = base_coh * 0.6
            mb.beta.coherence[(i * 16 + j) as usize] = base_coh * 0.5
            mb.beta.coherence[(j * 16 + i) as usize] = base_coh * 0.5
            mb.gamma.coherence[(i * 16 + j) as usize] = base_coh * 0.3
            mb.gamma.coherence[(j * 16 + i) as usize] = base_coh * 0.3
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Set inter-band coupling
    mb.interband[0] = 0.6    // theta-alpha
    mb.interband[1] = 0.5    // alpha-beta
    mb.interband[2] = 0.4    // beta-gamma
    mb.interband[3] = 0.3    // theta-gamma
    mb.interband[4] = 0.7    // delta-theta
    mb.interband[5] = 0.2    // alpha-gamma

    // Encode
    let result = eeg_multiband_encode(mb)
    println("EEG sedenion norm: ", result.norm)
    println("Dominant band: ", result.dominant_band)
    println("Mean coherence: ", result.mean_coherence)

    // Coherence matrix encoding
    let coh_sed = eeg_coherence_to_sedenion(mb.delta.coherence, 16)
    let coh_norm = eeg_sqrt(cd_norm_sq(coh_sed))
    println("Delta coherence sedenion norm: ", coh_norm)

    // Channel-direct encoding
    let ch_sed = eeg_channels_to_sedenion(mb.alpha.band_power)
    let ch_norm = eeg_sqrt(cd_norm_sq(ch_sed))
    println("Alpha channel sedenion norm: ", ch_norm)

    // Eta for delta band coherence graph
    let eta = eeg_eta(mb.delta.coherence, 16, 0.3)
    println("Delta eta (thresh=0.3): ", eta)
}


// === FILE: stdlib/medical/sedenion_imaging.sio ===
//! stdlib/medical/sedenion_imaging.sio — Multi-Modal Neuroimaging Sedenion Encoding
//!
//! Encodes fMRI BOLD and CT Hounsfield signals into sedenion (S = R^16)
//! representations, then fuses them via sedenion algebra.
//!
//! fMRI BOLD encoding (16 ROIs -> 16 sedenion components):
//!   Each ROI's BOLD activation maps to one sedenion component.
//!   Temporal correlation structure is captured via connectivity-weighted
//!   encoding.
//!
//! CT Hounsfield encoding (16 tissue regions -> 16 components):
//!   Hounsfield units normalised to [-1, 1] range map to sedenion
//!   components. Tissue density variations become algebraic structure.
//!
//! Multi-modal fusion via sedenion product:
//!   fMRI_sed * CT_sed captures cross-modal interactions.
//!   Non-commutativity: fMRI*CT != CT*fMRI (temporal vs structural primacy).
//!   Non-associativity: (fMRI*CT)*PET != fMRI*(CT*PET) (order matters).
//!
//! Uses CDElement (bits=4, dim=16) for mutable component access.
//!
//! References:
//!   Logothetis (2008): fMRI BOLD signal basis
//!   Hounsfield (1973): CT attenuation coefficients
//!   Calhoun & Sui (2016): multimodal data fusion review

use algebra::cayley_dickson::{CDElement, cd_zero, cd_mul, cd_add,
                               cd_sub, cd_scale, cd_norm_sq, cd_norm}

// ============================================================================
// CONSTANTS
// ============================================================================

fn SED_BITS() -> i32 { 4 }      // 2^4 = 16 components
fn NUM_ROIS() -> i32 { 16 }     // standard ROI count

// Hounsfield unit reference values (HU)
fn HU_AIR() -> f64 { -1000.0 }
fn HU_WATER() -> f64 { 0.0 }
fn HU_BONE() -> f64 { 1000.0 }
fn HU_BRAIN_GM() -> f64 { 37.0 }   // grey matter
fn HU_BRAIN_WM() -> f64 { 30.0 }   // white matter
fn HU_CSF() -> f64 { 15.0 }        // cerebrospinal fluid
fn HU_BLOOD() -> f64 { 55.0 }

// ============================================================================
// HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn img_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var r = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 { r = 0.5 * (r + x / r); i = i + 1 }
    r
}

fn img_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn img_clamp(x: f64, lo: f64, hi: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < lo { lo }
    else if x > hi { hi }
    else { x }
}

// ============================================================================
// fMRI BOLD STRUCTURES
// ============================================================================

/// fMRI BOLD activation for 16 ROIs.
/// activation[i] = mean BOLD signal in ROI i (arbitrary units, typically 0-10).
/// correlation[i*16+j] = temporal correlation between ROI i and ROI j.
pub struct FmriBoldData {
    activation: [f64; 16],
    correlation: [f64; 256],
    n_rois: i32,
    tr: f64,            // repetition time in seconds
    n_volumes: i32,     // number of time points
}

/// Create empty fMRI data.
pub fn fmri_new(n_rois: i32, tr: f64, n_vols: i32) -> FmriBoldData {
    FmriBoldData {
        activation: [0.0; 16],
        correlation: [0.0; 256],
        n_rois: n_rois,
        tr: tr,
        n_volumes: n_vols,
    }
}

/// Set activation for a single ROI.
pub fn fmri_set_activation(data: FmriBoldData, roi: i32, val: f64) -> FmriBoldData with Mut, Panic {
    var d = data
    if roi >= 0 && roi < d.n_rois {
        d.activation[roi as usize] = val
    }
    d
}

/// Set temporal correlation between two ROIs (symmetric).
pub fn fmri_set_correlation(data: FmriBoldData, i: i32, j: i32, val: f64) -> FmriBoldData with Mut, Panic {
    var d = data
    if i >= 0 && i < d.n_rois && j >= 0 && j < d.n_rois {
        d.correlation[(i * 16 + j) as usize] = val
        d.correlation[(j * 16 + i) as usize] = val
    }
    d
}

// ============================================================================
// CT HOUNSFIELD STRUCTURES
// ============================================================================

/// CT scan data: Hounsfield units for 16 tissue regions.
/// Each region represents an anatomical ROI whose mean HU is recorded.
pub struct CtHounsfieldData {
    hu_values: [f64; 16],
    n_regions: i32,
    // Tissue classification: 0=air, 1=CSF, 2=GM, 3=WM, 4=bone, 5=blood
    tissue_type: [i32; 16],
}

/// Create empty CT data.
pub fn ct_new(n_regions: i32) -> CtHounsfieldData {
    CtHounsfieldData {
        hu_values: [0.0; 16],
        n_regions: n_regions,
        tissue_type: [0; 16],
    }
}

/// Set HU value for a region.
pub fn ct_set_hu(data: CtHounsfieldData, region: i32, hu: f64, ttype: i32) -> CtHounsfieldData with Mut, Panic {
    var d = data
    if region >= 0 && region < d.n_regions {
        d.hu_values[region as usize] = hu
        d.tissue_type[region as usize] = ttype
    }
    d
}

// ============================================================================
// fMRI BOLD -> SEDENION ENCODING
// ============================================================================

/// Encode fMRI BOLD signal as a sedenion.
/// Each ROI activation is weighted by its mean functional connectivity.
/// Components: e_i = activation_i * (1 + mean_correlation_i)
pub fn fmri_to_sedenion(data: FmriBoldData) -> CDElement with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var s = cd_zero(SED_BITS())
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < data.n_rois && i < 16 {
        // Mean correlation of this ROI with all others
        var mean_corr: f64 = 0.0
        var count: i32 = 0
        var j: i32 = 0
        while j < data.n_rois {
            if j != i {
                mean_corr = mean_corr + img_abs(data.correlation[(i * 16 + j) as usize])
                count = count + 1
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        if count > 0 { mean_corr = mean_corr / (count as f64) }
        // Connectivity-weighted activation
        s.c[i as usize] = data.activation[i as usize] * (1.0 + mean_corr)
        i = i + 1
    }
    s
}

/// Encode and normalise fMRI to unit sedenion.
pub fn fmri_to_sedenion_normalized(data: FmriBoldData) -> CDElement with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let s = fmri_to_sedenion(data)
    img_sed_normalize(s)
}

// ============================================================================
// CT HOUNSFIELD -> SEDENION ENCODING
// ============================================================================

/// Normalise Hounsfield units to [-1, 1] range.
/// Uses brain-relevant window: [-100, 200] HU for soft tissue.
fn hu_normalize(hu: f64) -> f64 {
    let lo = -100.0
    let hi = 200.0
    let clamped = img_clamp(hu, lo, hi)
    // Map [lo, hi] -> [-1, 1]
    2.0 * (clamped - lo) / (hi - lo) - 1.0
}

/// Encode CT Hounsfield data as a sedenion.
/// Each region's normalised HU maps to one component.
/// Tissue type weighting emphasises diagnostically relevant regions.
pub fn ct_to_sedenion(data: CtHounsfieldData) -> CDElement with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var s = cd_zero(SED_BITS())
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < data.n_regions && i < 16 {
        let norm_hu = hu_normalize(data.hu_values[i as usize])
        // Weight by tissue diagnostic relevance
        let weight = if data.tissue_type[i as usize] == 2 { 1.5 }   // GM: high relevance
                     else if data.tissue_type[i as usize] == 3 { 1.3 } // WM
                     else if data.tissue_type[i as usize] == 5 { 1.4 } // blood (hemorrhage)
                     else if data.tissue_type[i as usize] == 1 { 1.2 } // CSF
                     else { 1.0 }
        s.c[i as usize] = norm_hu * weight
        i = i + 1
    }
    s
}

/// Encode and normalise CT to unit sedenion.
pub fn ct_to_sedenion_normalized(data: CtHounsfieldData) -> CDElement with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let s = ct_to_sedenion(data)
    img_sed_normalize(s)
}

// ============================================================================
// MULTI-MODAL FUSION
// ============================================================================

/// Result of multi-modal sedenion fusion.
pub struct FusionResult {
    fmri_sed: CDElement,
    ct_sed: CDElement,
    fused: CDElement,
    fmri_norm: f64,
    ct_norm: f64,
    fused_norm: f64,
    // Commutator norm: measures non-commutativity of the modalities
    commutator_norm: f64,
}

/// Fuse fMRI and CT via sedenion product.
/// The product fMRI * CT encodes cross-modal interactions.
/// Non-commutativity: fMRI*CT != CT*fMRI.
pub fn fuse_fmri_ct(fmri: FmriBoldData, ct: CtHounsfieldData) -> FusionResult with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let f_sed = fmri_to_sedenion_normalized(fmri)
    let c_sed = ct_to_sedenion_normalized(ct)

    // Forward product: fMRI * CT
    let fwd = cd_mul(f_sed, c_sed)
    // Reverse product: CT * fMRI
    let rev = cd_mul(c_sed, f_sed)
    // Commutator: fwd - rev (measures asymmetry)
    let comm = cd_sub(fwd, rev)
    let comm_nsq = cd_norm_sq(comm)
    let comm_norm = img_sqrt(comm_nsq)

    FusionResult {
        fmri_sed: f_sed,
        ct_sed: c_sed,
        fused: fwd,
        fmri_norm: img_sqrt(cd_norm_sq(f_sed)),
        ct_norm: img_sqrt(cd_norm_sq(c_sed)),
        fused_norm: img_sqrt(cd_norm_sq(fwd)),
        commutator_norm: comm_norm,
    }
}

/// Fuse two arbitrary modality sedenions.
/// Symmetric fusion: (a*b + b*a) / 2 (Jordan product, always commutative).
pub fn fuse_symmetric(a: CDElement, b: CDElement) -> CDElement with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let ab = cd_mul(a, b)
    let ba = cd_mul(b, a)
    let sum = cd_add(ab, ba)
    cd_scale(sum, 0.5)
}

/// Asymmetric fusion: a*b (preserves modality ordering).
pub fn fuse_asymmetric(a: CDElement, b: CDElement) -> CDElement with Mut, Panic, Div {
    cd_mul(a, b)
}

/// Three-modality fusion with associator diagnostic.
/// Returns (fused, associator_norm).
/// associator_norm > 0 means the fusion is order-dependent beyond pairwise.
pub fn fuse_three_modal(a: CDElement, b: CDElement, c: CDElement) -> CDElement with Mut, Panic, Div {
    // (a * b) * c
    cd_mul(cd_mul(a, b), c)
}

/// Compute associator norm for three modalities: ||(a*b)*c - a*(b*c)||
pub fn three_modal_associator_norm(a: CDElement, b: CDElement, c: CDElement) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let left = cd_mul(cd_mul(a, b), c)
    let right = cd_mul(a, cd_mul(b, c))
    let assoc = cd_sub(left, right)
    img_sqrt(cd_norm_sq(assoc))
}

// ============================================================================
// NORMALISATION
// ============================================================================

/// Normalise a CDElement to unit norm.
fn img_sed_normalize(s: CDElement) -> CDElement with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let nsq = cd_norm_sq(s)
    if nsq < 1e-30 { return s }
    let n = img_sqrt(nsq)
    cd_scale(s, 1.0 / n)
}

// ============================================================================
// DEMO / SELF-TEST
// ============================================================================

fn imaging_main() with Mut, Panic, Div {
    // --- fMRI data ---
    var fmri = fmri_new(16, 2.0, 200)
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 16 {
        // Synthetic BOLD activation: regions 3,4,5 (default mode) higher
        let act = if i >= 3 && i <= 5 { 5.0 + 0.5 * (i as f64) }
                  else { 2.0 + 0.3 * (i as f64) }
        fmri.activation[i as usize] = act
        // Correlations: nearby ROIs more correlated
        var j: i32 = i + 1
        while j < 16 {
            let dist = j - i
            let corr = if dist <= 2 { 0.8 }
                       else if dist <= 4 { 0.5 }
                       else { 0.2 }
            fmri.correlation[(i * 16 + j) as usize] = corr
            fmri.correlation[(j * 16 + i) as usize] = corr
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // --- CT data ---
    var ct = ct_new(16)
    i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        // Alternate between GM and WM with some variation
        let hu = if i < 8 { HU_BRAIN_GM() + 2.0 * (i as f64) }
                 else { HU_BRAIN_WM() + 1.5 * ((i - 8) as f64) }
        ct.hu_values[i as usize] = hu
        ct.tissue_type[i as usize] = if i < 8 { 2 } else { 3 }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // --- Encode each modality ---
    let f_sed = fmri_to_sedenion_normalized(fmri)
    let c_sed = ct_to_sedenion_normalized(ct)
    println("fMRI sedenion norm: ", img_sqrt(cd_norm_sq(f_sed)))
    println("CT sedenion norm: ", img_sqrt(cd_norm_sq(c_sed)))

    // --- Fuse ---
    let result = fuse_fmri_ct(fmri, ct)
