// === FILE: stdlib/medlang/pk/multi_compartment.sio ===
// stdlib/medlang/pk/multi_compartment.sio
//
// Generic n-compartment PK model with RK4 solver — Sounio
//
// Solves dC/dt = K*C where K is the rate matrix.
// Max 8 compartments. Uses fixed arrays throughout.

// ============================================================================
// Helpers
// ============================================================================

fn mc_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn mc_exp(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var xc = x
    if xc > 20.0 { xc = 20.0 }
    if xc < -20.0 { xc = -20.0 }
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 30 {
        term = term * xc / i as f64
        result = result + term
        i = i + 1
    }
    if result < 1.0e-15 { result = 1.0e-15 }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Multi-compartment model
// rates[i*8+j] = rate constant from compartment j to compartment i
// For elimination: rates[i*8+i] is negative (outflow = sum of all k_ij for j!=i + k_i0)
// volumes[i] = volume of compartment i
// ============================================================================

struct MultiCompModel {
    rates: [f64; 64],       // 8x8 rate matrix (row-major)
    volumes: [f64; 8],      // volumes per compartment
    n_comp: i32,            // number of compartments (max 8)
    dose: f64,              // dose amount
    dose_comp: i32,         // compartment receiving dose (0-indexed)
}

fn multi_comp_model_new(n_comp: i32) -> MultiCompModel {
    MultiCompModel {
        rates: [0.0; 64],
        volumes: [1.0; 8],
        n_comp: n_comp,
        dose: 0.0,
        dose_comp: 0,
    }
}

// Set transfer rate from compartment `from` to compartment `to`
fn multi_comp_set_rate(m: &!MultiCompModel, from: i32, to: i32, rate: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if from >= 0 && from < 8 && to >= 0 && to < 8 {
        m.rates[to * 8 + from] = rate
    }
}

// Set elimination rate from compartment `comp` (k_i0)
fn multi_comp_set_elim(m: &!MultiCompModel, comp: i32, rate: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if comp >= 0 && comp < 8 {
        // Store elimination on the diagonal as negative
        // The diagonal will be: -(sum of outgoing rates)
        // We accumulate it during derivative computation
        m.rates[comp * 8 + comp] = 0.0 - rate
    }
}

fn multi_comp_set_volume(m: &!MultiCompModel, comp: i32, vol: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if comp >= 0 && comp < 8 {
        m.volumes[comp] = vol
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Compute derivatives: dA/dt for each compartment amount
// state[i] = amount in compartment i
// deriv[i] = dA_i/dt = sum_j(k_ij * A_j) + k_ii_diag * A_i
// ============================================================================

fn mc_compute_deriv(model: &MultiCompModel, state: &[f64; 8], deriv: &![f64; 8]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < model.n_comp {
        var d = 0.0
        // Off-diagonal: inflow from other compartments
        var j = 0
        while j < model.n_comp {
            if j != i {
                let rate = model.rates[i * 8 + j]
                d = d + rate * state[j]
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        // Diagonal: total outflow (negative)
        // Sum of all rates leaving compartment i
        var out_rate = 0.0
        var k = 0
        while k < model.n_comp {
            if k != i {
                out_rate = out_rate + model.rates[k * 8 + i]
            }
            k = k + 1
        }
        // Add elimination (stored as negative on diagonal)
        let elim = model.rates[i * 8 + i]
        d = d - (out_rate) * state[i] + elim * state[i]
        deriv[i] = d
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// RK4 step
// ============================================================================

fn mc_rk4_step(model: &MultiCompModel, state: &![f64; 8], dt: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var k1: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    var k2: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    var k3: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    var k4: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    var tmp: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]

    // k1 = f(state)
    mc_compute_deriv(model, state, &!k1)

    // tmp = state + 0.5*dt*k1
    var i = 0
    while i < model.n_comp {
        tmp[i] = state[i] + 0.5 * dt * k1[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    mc_compute_deriv(model, &tmp, &!k2)

    // tmp = state + 0.5*dt*k2
    i = 0
    while i < model.n_comp {
        tmp[i] = state[i] + 0.5 * dt * k2[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    mc_compute_deriv(model, &tmp, &!k3)

    // tmp = state + dt*k3
    i = 0
    while i < model.n_comp {
        tmp[i] = state[i] + dt * k3[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    mc_compute_deriv(model, &tmp, &!k4)

    // state += (dt/6) * (k1 + 2*k2 + 2*k3 + k4)
    i = 0
    while i < model.n_comp {
        state[i] = state[i] + (dt / 6.0) * (k1[i] + 2.0 * k2[i] + 2.0 * k3[i] + k4[i])
        if state[i] < 0.0 { state[i] = 0.0 }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Simulate: run RK4 from t=0 to t_end, store concentrations (amount/volume)
// at each dt step in conc_out. Returns number of time steps stored.
// conc_out stores concentrations for compartment 0 (central).
// ============================================================================

fn multi_comp_simulate(model: MultiCompModel, t_end: f64, dt: f64, conc_out: &![f64; 256]) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var state: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    // Initial dose in dose_comp
    if model.dose_comp >= 0 && model.dose_comp < 8 {
        state[model.dose_comp] = model.dose
    }

    var t = 0.0
    var step = 0
    while t <= t_end && step < 256 {
        // Store concentration (amount / volume) for central compartment (0)
        if model.volumes[0] > 1.0e-15 {
            conc_out[step] = state[0] / model.volumes[0]
        } else {
            conc_out[step] = 0.0
        }
        mc_rk4_step(&model, &!state, dt)
        t = t + dt
        step = step + 1
    }
    step
}

// ============================================================================
// Simulate all compartments: store amount in each compartment
// out[step * 8 + comp] = amount at that step
// ============================================================================

fn multi_comp_simulate_all(model: MultiCompModel, t_end: f64, dt: f64, out: &![f64; 2048]) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var state: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    if model.dose_comp >= 0 && model.dose_comp < 8 {
        state[model.dose_comp] = model.dose
    }

    var t = 0.0
    var step = 0
    var max_steps = 256
    while t <= t_end && step < max_steps {
        var c = 0
        while c < model.n_comp && c < 8 {
            let idx = step * 8 + c
            if idx < 2048 {
                out[idx] = state[c]
            }
            c = c + 1
        }
        mc_rk4_step(&model, &!state, dt)
        t = t + dt
        step = step + 1
    }
    step
}

// ============================================================================
// Tests
// ============================================================================

fn test_multi_comp_one_comp() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Set up a one-compartment model via the generic framework
    // k10 = 0.1, V1 = 10, dose = 100
    var model = multi_comp_model_new(1)
    model.dose = 100.0
    model.dose_comp = 0
    model.volumes[0] = 10.0
    // Elimination: k10 = 0.1 (stored as negative on diagonal)
    model.rates[0] = -0.1

    var conc: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    let steps = multi_comp_simulate(model, 10.0, 0.1, &!conc)

    // C(0) = 100/10 = 10
    let c0 = conc[0]
    // Should decay
    let c_last = conc[steps - 1]
    mc_abs(c0 - 10.0) < 0.1 && c_last < c0 && steps > 0
}

fn test_multi_comp_two_comp() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Two-compartment: k10=0.5, k12=0.3, k21=0.2
    var model = multi_comp_model_new(2)
    model.dose = 100.0
    model.dose_comp = 0
    model.volumes[0] = 10.0
    model.volumes[1] = 20.0
    // Diagonal (elimination from comp 0)
    model.rates[0] = -0.5
    // Off-diagonal transfers
    model.rates[1 * 8 + 0] = 0.3   // comp 0 -> comp 1
    model.rates[0 * 8 + 1] = 0.2   // comp 1 -> comp 0

    var conc: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    let steps = multi_comp_simulate(model, 20.0, 0.1, &!conc)

    // Initial concentration > 0, decays
    conc[0] > 0.0 && conc[steps - 1] < conc[0] && steps > 0
}

fn test_multi_comp_mass_conservation_closed() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Closed system (no elimination): total mass should be conserved
    var model = multi_comp_model_new(2)
    model.dose = 100.0
    model.dose_comp = 0
    model.volumes[0] = 1.0
    model.volumes[1] = 1.0
    // No elimination (diagonal = 0)
    model.rates[1 * 8 + 0] = 0.3   // comp 0 -> comp 1
    model.rates[0 * 8 + 1] = 0.2   // comp 1 -> comp 0

    var out: [f64; 2048] = [0.0; 2048]
    let steps = multi_comp_simulate_all(model, 10.0, 0.1, &!out)

    // Check mass at last step
    let last = steps - 1
    let total = out[last * 8 + 0] + out[last * 8 + 1]
    mc_abs(total - 100.0) < 1.0
}


// === FILE: stdlib/medlang/pk/one_compartment.sio ===
// stdlib/medlang/pk/one_compartment.sio
//
// One-compartment pharmacokinetic models — Sounio
//
// IV bolus: C(t) = (dose/Vd) * exp(-ke*t)
// Oral (Bateman): C(t) = (F*dose*ka)/(Vd*(ka-ke)) * [exp(-ke*t) - exp(-ka*t)]
// AUC: F*dose / (Vd*ke)
// Half-life: 0.693 / ke

// ============================================================================
// Helpers
// ============================================================================

fn pk1_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn pk1_exp(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // exp(x) via Taylor series, clamped to [-20, 20]
    var xc = x
    if xc > 20.0 { xc = 20.0 }
    if xc < -20.0 { xc = -20.0 }
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 30 {
        term = term * xc / i as f64
        result = result + term
        i = i + 1
    }
    if result < 1.0e-15 { result = 1.0e-15 }
    result
}

fn pk1_ln(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // ln(x) via series expansion around 1
    if x <= 0.0 { return -50.0 }
    // Reduce to [0.5, 2) range
    var v = x
    var adjust = 0.0
    while v > 2.0 {
        v = v / 2.0
        adjust = adjust + 0.6931471805599453
    }
    while v < 0.5 {
        v = v * 2.0
        adjust = adjust - 0.6931471805599453
    }
    // Series: ln(v) = 2 * sum( ((v-1)/(v+1))^(2k+1) / (2k+1) )
    let u = (v - 1.0) / (v + 1.0)
    let u2 = u * u
    var term = u
    var sum = u
    var k = 1
    while k <= 20 {
        term = term * u2
        sum = sum + term / (2 * k + 1) as f64
        k = k + 1
    }
    2.0 * sum + adjust
}

// ============================================================================
// One-compartment parameter struct
// ============================================================================

struct OneCompParams {
    ka: f64,      // absorption rate constant (1/h)
    ke: f64,      // elimination rate constant (1/h)
    vd: f64,      // volume of distribution (L)
    dose: f64,    // dose amount (mg)
    f_bio: f64,   // bioavailability fraction (0-1)
}

fn one_comp_params_new(ka: f64, ke: f64, vd: f64, dose: f64, f_bio: f64) -> OneCompParams {
    OneCompParams {
        ka: ka,
        ke: ke,
        vd: vd,
        dose: dose,
        f_bio: f_bio,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// IV bolus: C(t) = (dose / Vd) * exp(-ke * t)
// ============================================================================

fn one_comp_iv_conc(p: OneCompParams, t: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if p.vd < 1.0e-15 { return 0.0 }
    let c0 = p.dose / p.vd
    c0 * pk1_exp(0.0 - p.ke * t)
}

// ============================================================================
// Oral absorption (Bateman equation):
// C(t) = (F * dose * ka) / (Vd * (ka - ke)) * [exp(-ke*t) - exp(-ka*t)]
// ============================================================================

fn one_comp_oral_conc(p: OneCompParams, t: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if p.vd < 1.0e-15 { return 0.0 }
    let diff = p.ka - p.ke
    if pk1_abs(diff) < 1.0e-12 {
        // ka ≈ ke: degenerate case, L'Hopital limit
        // C(t) = (F * dose * ka / Vd) * t * exp(-ke*t)
        return (p.f_bio * p.dose * p.ka / p.vd) * t * pk1_exp(0.0 - p.ke * t)
    }
    let coeff = (p.f_bio * p.dose * p.ka) / (p.vd * diff)
    let exp_ke = pk1_exp(0.0 - p.ke * t)
    let exp_ka = pk1_exp(0.0 - p.ka * t)
    coeff * (exp_ke - exp_ka)
}

// ============================================================================
// AUC (area under curve, 0 to infinity): F * dose / (Vd * ke)
// ============================================================================

fn one_comp_auc(p: OneCompParams) -> f64 with Div, Panic {
    if p.vd < 1.0e-15 { return 0.0 }
    if p.ke < 1.0e-15 { return 0.0 }
    (p.f_bio * p.dose) / (p.vd * p.ke)
}

// ============================================================================
// Half-life: t1/2 = ln(2) / ke = 0.693147 / ke
// ============================================================================

fn one_comp_half_life(p: OneCompParams) -> f64 with Div, Panic {
    if p.ke < 1.0e-15 { return 0.0 }
    0.6931471805599453 / p.ke
}

// ============================================================================
// Time of maximum concentration (oral):
// tmax = ln(ka/ke) / (ka - ke)
// ============================================================================

fn one_comp_tmax(p: OneCompParams) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let diff = p.ka - p.ke
    if pk1_abs(diff) < 1.0e-12 { return 0.0 }
    if p.ke < 1.0e-15 { return 0.0 }
    if p.ka < 1.0e-15 { return 0.0 }
    pk1_ln(p.ka / p.ke) / diff
}

// ============================================================================
// Maximum concentration (oral): Cmax = C(tmax)
// ============================================================================

fn one_comp_cmax(p: OneCompParams) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let tmax = one_comp_tmax(p)
    one_comp_oral_conc(p, tmax)
}

// ============================================================================
// Clearance: CL = ke * Vd
// ============================================================================

fn one_comp_clearance(p: OneCompParams) -> f64 {
    p.ke * p.vd
}

// ============================================================================
// Multiple dosing steady-state trough (IV):
// Css_trough = (dose/Vd) * exp(-ke*tau) / (1 - exp(-ke*tau))
// ============================================================================

fn one_comp_ss_trough(p: OneCompParams, tau: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if p.vd < 1.0e-15 { return 0.0 }
    let exp_ke_tau = pk1_exp(0.0 - p.ke * tau)
    let denom = 1.0 - exp_ke_tau
    if pk1_abs(denom) < 1.0e-15 { return 0.0 }
    (p.dose / p.vd) * exp_ke_tau / denom
}

// ============================================================================
// Concentration time-course into output array (IV)
// ============================================================================

fn one_comp_iv_profile(p: OneCompParams, dt: f64, n: i32, out: &![f64; 256]) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    var count = n
    if count > 256 { count = 256 }
    while i < count {
        let t = i as f64 * dt
        out[i] = one_comp_iv_conc(p, t)
        i = i + 1
    }
    count
}

// ============================================================================
// Concentration time-course into output array (oral)
// ============================================================================

fn one_comp_oral_profile(p: OneCompParams, dt: f64, n: i32, out: &![f64; 256]) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    var count = n
    if count > 256 { count = 256 }
    while i < count {
        let t = i as f64 * dt
        out[i] = one_comp_oral_conc(p, t)
        i = i + 1
    }
    count
}

// ============================================================================
// Tests
// ============================================================================

fn test_one_comp_iv() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // 100 mg IV, Vd = 10 L, ke = 0.1/h
    let p = one_comp_params_new(0.0, 0.1, 10.0, 100.0, 1.0)
    // C(0) = 100/10 = 10 mg/L
    let c0 = one_comp_iv_conc(p, 0.0)
    // C(6.93) ≈ 5 mg/L (one half-life)
    let c_half = one_comp_iv_conc(p, 6.931)
    pk1_abs(c0 - 10.0) < 0.01 && pk1_abs(c_half - 5.0) < 0.1
}

fn test_one_comp_oral_bateman() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // ka=1.0, ke=0.1, Vd=10L, dose=100mg, F=1.0
    let p = one_comp_params_new(1.0, 0.1, 10.0, 100.0, 1.0)
    // At t=0, C=0 (no absorption yet)
    let c0 = one_comp_oral_conc(p, 0.0)
    // At some time t, C > 0
    let c5 = one_comp_oral_conc(p, 5.0)
    pk1_abs(c0) < 0.01 && c5 > 0.0
}

fn test_one_comp_auc() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // AUC = F*dose/(Vd*ke) = 1*100/(10*0.1) = 100
    let p = one_comp_params_new(1.0, 0.1, 10.0, 100.0, 1.0)
    let auc = one_comp_auc(p)
    pk1_abs(auc - 100.0) < 0.01
}

fn test_one_comp_half_life() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // t1/2 = 0.693/0.1 = 6.93 h
    let p = one_comp_params_new(1.0, 0.1, 10.0, 100.0, 1.0)
    let t12 = one_comp_half_life(p)
    pk1_abs(t12 - 6.931) < 0.01
}

fn test_one_comp_clearance() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // CL = ke * Vd = 0.1 * 10 = 1.0 L/h
    let p = one_comp_params_new(1.0, 0.1, 10.0, 100.0, 1.0)
    let cl = one_comp_clearance(p)
    pk1_abs(cl - 1.0) < 0.01
}


// === FILE: stdlib/medlang/pk/three_compartment.sio ===
// stdlib/medlang/pk/three_compartment.sio
//
// Three-compartment pharmacokinetic model — Sounio
//
// Tri-exponential: C(t) = A*exp(-alpha*t) + B*exp(-beta*t) + G*exp(-gamma*t)
// Eigenvalues from cubic characteristic equation of micro-constant matrix

// ============================================================================
// Helpers
// ============================================================================

fn pk3_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn pk3_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 15 {
        y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
        i = i + 1
    }
    y
}

fn pk3_exp(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var xc = x
    if xc > 20.0 { xc = 20.0 }
    if xc < -20.0 { xc = -20.0 }
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 30 {
        term = term * xc / i as f64
        result = result + term
        i = i + 1
    }
    if result < 1.0e-15 { result = 1.0e-15 }
    result
}

fn pk3_cos(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // cos via Taylor series
    var xc = x
    // Reduce to [-pi, pi]
    while xc > 3.14159265358979 { xc = xc - 6.28318530717959 }
    while xc < -3.14159265358979 { xc = xc + 6.28318530717959 }
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 15 {
        term = 0.0 - term * xc * xc / ((2 * i - 1) as f64 * (2 * i) as f64)
        result = result + term
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

fn pk3_cbrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Cube root via Newton's method: y^3 = x => y = y - (y^3 - x)/(3*y^2)
    if pk3_abs(x) < 1.0e-30 { return 0.0 }
    var sign = 1.0
    var v = x
    if v < 0.0 {
        sign = -1.0
        v = 0.0 - v
    }
    var y = v
    if y > 1.0 { y = y / 3.0 }
    var i = 0
    while i < 30 {
        let y2 = y * y
        if y2 < 1.0e-30 { return 0.0 }
        y = y - (y * y2 - v) / (3.0 * y2)
        if y < 1.0e-30 { y = 1.0e-30 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    sign * y
}

fn pk3_acos(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // acos approximation
    var xc = x
    if xc > 1.0 { xc = 1.0 }
    if xc < -1.0 { xc = -1.0 }
    // acos(x) ≈ pi/2 - asin(x), asin via series
    let x2 = xc * xc
    var term = xc
    var sum = xc
    var n = 1
    while n <= 15 {
        term = term * x2 * (2 * n - 1) as f64 * (2 * n - 1) as f64 / ((2 * n) as f64 * (2 * n + 1) as f64)
        sum = sum + term
        n = n + 1
    }
    1.5707963267948966 - sum
}

// ============================================================================
// Three-compartment parameters
// ============================================================================

struct ThreeCompParams {
    k10: f64,   // elimination from central
    k12: f64,   // central -> shallow peripheral
    k21: f64,   // shallow peripheral -> central
    k13: f64,   // central -> deep peripheral
    k31: f64,   // deep peripheral -> central
    v1: f64,    // volume of central compartment
    dose: f64,  // IV bolus dose
}

fn three_comp_params_new(k10: f64, k12: f64, k21: f64, k13: f64, k31: f64, v1: f64, dose: f64) -> ThreeCompParams {
    ThreeCompParams {
        k10: k10,
        k12: k12,
        k21: k21,
        k13: k13,
        k31: k31,
        v1: v1,
        dose: dose,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Eigenvalues via Cardano's formula for the cubic
// Characteristic equation: lambda^3 - a1*lambda^2 + a2*lambda - a3 = 0
// a1 = k10 + k12 + k21 + k13 + k31
// a2 = k10*k21 + k10*k31 + k12*k31 + k13*k21 + k21*k31
// a3 = k10*k21*k31
// ============================================================================

struct TripleEigen {
    alpha: f64,
    beta: f64,
    gamma: f64,
}

fn three_comp_eigenvalues(p: ThreeCompParams) -> TripleEigen with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let a1 = p.k10 + p.k12 + p.k21 + p.k13 + p.k31
    let a2 = p.k10 * p.k21 + p.k10 * p.k31 + p.k12 * p.k31 + p.k13 * p.k21 + p.k21 * p.k31
    let a3 = p.k10 * p.k21 * p.k31

    // Depressed cubic via substitution lambda = t + a1/3
    let q = (3.0 * a2 - a1 * a1) / 9.0
    let r = (9.0 * a1 * a2 - 27.0 * a3 - 2.0 * a1 * a1 * a1) / 54.0

    let q3 = q * q * q
    let disc = q3 + r * r

    var l1 = 0.0
    var l2 = 0.0
    var l3 = 0.0

    if disc < 0.0 {
        // Three real roots (trigonometric solution)
        let rho = pk3_sqrt(0.0 - q3)
        if rho < 1.0e-30 {
            l1 = a1 / 3.0
            l2 = a1 / 3.0
            l3 = a1 / 3.0
        } else {
            // Use cbrt for rho^(1/3)
            let rho_third = pk3_cbrt(rho)
            let cos_arg = r / rho
            let theta = pk3_acos(cos_arg) / 3.0
            let shift = a1 / 3.0
            let two_rho = 2.0 * rho_third
            l1 = two_rho * pk3_cos(theta) + shift
            l2 = two_rho * pk3_cos(theta - 2.0943951023931953) + shift
            l3 = two_rho * pk3_cos(theta + 2.0943951023931953) + shift
        }
    } else {
        // One or two real roots (use Cardano directly)
        let sq_disc = pk3_sqrt(disc)
        let s = pk3_cbrt(r + sq_disc)
        let tt = pk3_cbrt(r - sq_disc)
        l1 = s + tt + a1 / 3.0
        l2 = 0.0 - 0.5 * (s + tt) + a1 / 3.0
        l3 = l2
    }

    // Sort: alpha > beta > gamma
    var ea = l1
    var eb = l2
    var eg = l3
    if eb > ea { let tmp = ea; ea = eb; eb = tmp }
    if eg > ea { let tmp = ea; ea = eg; eg = tmp }
    if eg > eb { let tmp = eb; eb = eg; eg = tmp }

    TripleEigen {
        alpha: ea,
        beta: eb,
        gamma: eg,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Tri-exponential coefficients
// A = (dose/V1) * (alpha-k21)*(alpha-k31) / ((alpha-beta)*(alpha-gamma))
// B = (dose/V1) * (beta-k21)*(beta-k31)  / ((beta-alpha)*(beta-gamma))
// G = (dose/V1) * (gamma-k21)*(gamma-k31) / ((gamma-alpha)*(gamma-beta))
// ============================================================================

struct TriExpCoeff {
    a_coeff: f64,
    b_coeff: f64,
    g_coeff: f64,
    alpha: f64,
    beta: f64,
    gamma: f64,
}

fn three_comp_coefficients(p: ThreeCompParams) -> TriExpCoeff with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let e = three_comp_eigenvalues(p)
    var a_c = 0.0
    var b_c = 0.0
    var g_c = 0.0

    if p.v1 > 1.0e-15 {
        let c0 = p.dose / p.v1
        let ab = e.alpha - e.beta
        let ag = e.alpha - e.gamma
        let bg = e.beta - e.gamma

        if pk3_abs(ab) > 1.0e-15 && pk3_abs(ag) > 1.0e-15 {
            a_c = c0 * (e.alpha - p.k21) * (e.alpha - p.k31) / (ab * ag)
        }
        if pk3_abs(ab) > 1.0e-15 && pk3_abs(bg) > 1.0e-15 {
            b_c = c0 * (e.beta - p.k21) * (e.beta - p.k31) / ((0.0 - ab) * bg)
        }
        if pk3_abs(ag) > 1.0e-15 && pk3_abs(bg) > 1.0e-15 {
            g_c = c0 * (e.gamma - p.k21) * (e.gamma - p.k31) / ((0.0 - ag) * (0.0 - bg))
        }
    }

    TriExpCoeff {
        a_coeff: a_c,
        b_coeff: b_c,
        g_coeff: g_c,
        alpha: e.alpha,
        beta: e.beta,
        gamma: e.gamma,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Concentration: C(t) = A*exp(-alpha*t) + B*exp(-beta*t) + G*exp(-gamma*t)
// ============================================================================

fn three_comp_conc(p: ThreeCompParams, t: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let c = three_comp_coefficients(p)
    c.a_coeff * pk3_exp(0.0 - c.alpha * t) +
        c.b_coeff * pk3_exp(0.0 - c.beta * t) +
        c.g_coeff * pk3_exp(0.0 - c.gamma * t)
}

// ============================================================================
// AUC (0->inf) = A/alpha + B/beta + G/gamma
// ============================================================================

fn three_comp_auc(p: ThreeCompParams) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let c = three_comp_coefficients(p)
    var auc = 0.0
    if c.alpha > 1.0e-15 { auc = auc + c.a_coeff / c.alpha }
    if c.beta > 1.0e-15 { auc = auc + c.b_coeff / c.beta }
    if c.gamma > 1.0e-15 { auc = auc + c.g_coeff / c.gamma }
    auc
}

// ============================================================================
// Concentration profile
// ============================================================================

fn three_comp_profile(p: ThreeCompParams, dt: f64, n: i32, out: &![f64; 256]) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    var count = n
    if count > 256 { count = 256 }
    while i < count {
        let t = i as f64 * dt
        out[i] = three_comp_conc(p, t)
        i = i + 1
    }
    count
}

// ============================================================================
// Tests
// ============================================================================

fn test_three_comp_at_zero() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // At t=0, C = dose/V1 = 100/10 = 10
    let p = three_comp_params_new(0.3, 0.2, 0.1, 0.15, 0.05, 10.0, 100.0)
    let c0 = three_comp_conc(p, 0.0)
    pk3_abs(c0 - 10.0) < 0.5
}

fn test_three_comp_decay() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let p = three_comp_params_new(0.3, 0.2, 0.1, 0.15, 0.05, 10.0, 100.0)
    let c0 = three_comp_conc(p, 0.0)
    let c10 = three_comp_conc(p, 10.0)
    let c50 = three_comp_conc(p, 50.0)
    c0 > c10 && c10 > c50
}

fn test_three_comp_eigenvalues_positive() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let p = three_comp_params_new(0.3, 0.2, 0.1, 0.15, 0.05, 10.0, 100.0)
    let e = three_comp_eigenvalues(p)
    e.alpha > 0.0 && e.beta > 0.0 && e.gamma > 0.0
}

fn test_three_comp_auc_positive() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let p = three_comp_params_new(0.3, 0.2, 0.1, 0.15, 0.05, 10.0, 100.0)
    let auc = three_comp_auc(p)
    auc > 0.0
}


// === FILE: stdlib/medlang/pk/two_compartment.sio ===
// stdlib/medlang/pk/two_compartment.sio
//
// Two-compartment pharmacokinetic model — Sounio
//
// Bi-exponential: C(t) = A*exp(-alpha*t) + B*exp(-beta*t)
// where alpha, beta are eigenvalues of the micro-constant matrix

// ============================================================================
// Helpers
// ============================================================================

fn pk2_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn pk2_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 15 {
        y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
        i = i + 1
    }
    y
}

fn pk2_exp(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var xc = x
    if xc > 20.0 { xc = 20.0 }
    if xc < -20.0 { xc = -20.0 }
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 30 {
        term = term * xc / i as f64
        result = result + term
        i = i + 1
    }
    if result < 1.0e-15 { result = 1.0e-15 }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Two-compartment parameters
// ============================================================================

struct TwoCompParams {
    k10: f64,   // elimination rate from central (1/h)
    k12: f64,   // transfer rate central -> peripheral (1/h)
    k21: f64,   // transfer rate peripheral -> central (1/h)
    v1: f64,    // volume of central compartment (L)
    dose: f64,  // IV bolus dose (mg)
}

fn two_comp_params_new(k10: f64, k12: f64, k21: f64, v1: f64, dose: f64) -> TwoCompParams {
    TwoCompParams {
        k10: k10,
        k12: k12,
        k21: k21,
        v1: v1,
        dose: dose,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Eigenvalues: alpha/beta from micro-constants
// alpha + beta = k10 + k12 + k21
// alpha * beta = k10 * k21
// alpha = 0.5 * (sum + sqrt(sum^2 - 4*prod))
// beta  = 0.5 * (sum - sqrt(sum^2 - 4*prod))
// ============================================================================

struct AlphaBeta {
    alpha: f64,
    beta: f64,
}

fn two_comp_alpha_beta(p: TwoCompParams) -> AlphaBeta with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let sum = p.k10 + p.k12 + p.k21
    let prod = p.k10 * p.k21
    let disc = sum * sum - 4.0 * prod
    let sq = pk2_sqrt(disc)
    AlphaBeta {
        alpha: 0.5 * (sum + sq),
        beta: 0.5 * (sum - sq),
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Bi-exponential coefficients A, B
// A = (dose / V1) * (alpha - k21) / (alpha - beta)
// B = (dose / V1) * (k21 - beta) / (alpha - beta)
// ============================================================================

struct BiExpCoeff {
    a_coeff: f64,
    b_coeff: f64,
    alpha: f64,
    beta: f64,
}

fn two_comp_coefficients(p: TwoCompParams) -> BiExpCoeff with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ab = two_comp_alpha_beta(p)
    let diff = ab.alpha - ab.beta
    if pk2_abs(diff) < 1.0e-15 {
        return BiExpCoeff {
            a_coeff: 0.0,
            b_coeff: 0.0,
            alpha: ab.alpha,
            beta: ab.beta,
        }
    }
    if p.v1 < 1.0e-15 {
        return BiExpCoeff {
            a_coeff: 0.0,
            b_coeff: 0.0,
            alpha: ab.alpha,
            beta: ab.beta,
        }
    }
    let c0 = p.dose / p.v1
    BiExpCoeff {
        a_coeff: c0 * (ab.alpha - p.k21) / diff,
        b_coeff: c0 * (p.k21 - ab.beta) / diff,
        alpha: ab.alpha,
        beta: ab.beta,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Concentration: C(t) = A*exp(-alpha*t) + B*exp(-beta*t)
// ============================================================================

fn two_comp_conc(p: TwoCompParams, t: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let c = two_comp_coefficients(p)
    c.a_coeff * pk2_exp(0.0 - c.alpha * t) + c.b_coeff * pk2_exp(0.0 - c.beta * t)
}

// ============================================================================
// AUC (0 to inf) = A/alpha + B/beta
// ============================================================================

fn two_comp_auc(p: TwoCompParams) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let c = two_comp_coefficients(p)
    if c.alpha < 1.0e-15 { return 0.0 }
    if c.beta < 1.0e-15 { return 0.0 }
    c.a_coeff / c.alpha + c.b_coeff / c.beta
}

// ============================================================================
// Terminal half-life: ln(2)/beta
// ============================================================================

fn two_comp_terminal_half_life(p: TwoCompParams) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ab = two_comp_alpha_beta(p)
    if ab.beta < 1.0e-15 { return 0.0 }
    0.6931471805599453 / ab.beta
}

// ============================================================================
// Concentration time-course
// ============================================================================

fn two_comp_profile(p: TwoCompParams, dt: f64, n: i32, out: &![f64; 256]) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    var count = n
    if count > 256 { count = 256 }
    while i < count {
        let t = i as f64 * dt
        out[i] = two_comp_conc(p, t)
        i = i + 1
    }
    count
}

// ============================================================================
// Tests
// ============================================================================

fn test_two_comp_alpha_beta() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // k10=0.5, k12=0.3, k21=0.2, V1=10, dose=100
    let p = two_comp_params_new(0.5, 0.3, 0.2, 10.0, 100.0)
    let ab = two_comp_alpha_beta(p)
    // sum = 1.0, prod = 0.1
    // alpha = 0.5*(1 + sqrt(1 - 0.4)) = 0.5*(1 + 0.7746) = 0.8873
    // beta  = 0.5*(1 - 0.7746) = 0.1127
    pk2_abs(ab.alpha - 0.8873) < 0.01 && pk2_abs(ab.beta - 0.1127) < 0.01
}

fn test_two_comp_conc_at_zero() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let p = two_comp_params_new(0.5, 0.3, 0.2, 10.0, 100.0)
    // C(0) = A + B = dose/V1 = 10
    let c0 = two_comp_conc(p, 0.0)
    pk2_abs(c0 - 10.0) < 0.1
}

fn test_two_comp_decay() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let p = two_comp_params_new(0.5, 0.3, 0.2, 10.0, 100.0)
    let c0 = two_comp_conc(p, 0.0)
    let c10 = two_comp_conc(p, 10.0)
    let c50 = two_comp_conc(p, 50.0)
    // Concentration should decrease monotonically
    c0 > c10 && c10 > c50 && c50 > 0.0
}

fn test_two_comp_auc_positive() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let p = two_comp_params_new(0.5, 0.3, 0.2, 10.0, 100.0)
    let auc = two_comp_auc(p)
    auc > 0.0
}


// === FILE: stdlib/medlang/policy/policy.sio ===
// medlang/policy/mod.sio — Therapeutic Drug Monitoring & Dosing Policy
//
// Dose adjustment based on observed drug concentrations.
// Implements simple proportional TDM (Therapeutic Drug Monitoring).
//
// References:
// - Kang & Lee (2009): "Overview of TDM of aminoglycosides"
// - Winter (2010): "Basic Clinical Pharmacokinetics", 5th ed.

fn pol_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

// ============================================================================
// DOSING POLICY
// ============================================================================

pub struct DosingPolicy {
    target_min: f64,     // Minimum therapeutic concentration (mg/L)
    target_max: f64,     // Maximum therapeutic concentration (mg/L)
    adjust_factor: f64,  // Proportional adjustment factor (e.g. 0.5 for cautious)
}

pub fn dosing_policy_new(target_min: f64, target_max: f64, adjust_factor: f64) -> DosingPolicy {
    DosingPolicy {
        target_min: target_min,
        target_max: target_max,
        adjust_factor: adjust_factor,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// DOSE ADJUSTMENT
// ============================================================================
// Adjusts dose based on current concentration relative to target range.
//
// - If current_conc < target_min: increase dose proportionally
// - If current_conc > target_max: decrease dose proportionally
// - If within range: no change
//
// The adjust_factor controls how aggressively the dose is changed.
// factor=1.0 means full linear correction; 0.5 means half-step.

pub fn policy_adjust_dose(policy: DosingPolicy, current_conc: f64, current_dose: f64) -> f64 {
    if current_dose <= 0.0 {
        return 0.0
    }

    let target_mid = (policy.target_min + policy.target_max) * 0.5

    // Within therapeutic window: no adjustment
    if current_conc >= policy.target_min && current_conc <= policy.target_max {
        return current_dose
    }

    // Below target: increase dose
    if current_conc < policy.target_min {
        if current_conc <= 0.0 {
            // No measurable level: double the dose
            return current_dose * 2.0
        }
        let ratio = target_mid / current_conc
        let adjustment = 1.0 + (ratio - 1.0) * policy.adjust_factor
        return current_dose * adjustment
    }

    // Above target: decrease dose
    let ratio = target_mid / current_conc
    let adjustment = 1.0 + (ratio - 1.0) * policy.adjust_factor
    // Never reduce below 10% of current dose
    var new_dose = current_dose * adjustment
    let floor = current_dose * 0.1
    if new_dose < floor {
        new_dose = floor
    }
    new_dose
}

// Check if concentration is within therapeutic window
pub fn policy_in_range(policy: DosingPolicy, conc: f64) -> bool {
    conc >= policy.target_min && conc <= policy.target_max
}

// Check if concentration is critically high (>2x target_max)
pub fn policy_is_toxic(policy: DosingPolicy, conc: f64) -> bool {
    conc > policy.target_max * 2.0
}

// ============================================================================
// INLINE TESTS
// ============================================================================

//@ run-pass
fn test_policy_in_range_no_change() -> i32 {
    let p = dosing_policy_new(10.0, 20.0, 0.5)
    let dose = policy_adjust_dose(p, 15.0, 100.0)
    // Within range: dose should stay at 100
    if pol_abs(dose - 100.0) > 0.001 { return 1 }
    0
}

//@ run-pass
fn test_policy_below_range_increase() -> i32 {
    let p = dosing_policy_new(10.0, 20.0, 1.0)
    let dose = policy_adjust_dose(p, 5.0, 100.0)
    // Below target_min: dose should increase
    if dose <= 100.0 { return 1 }
    0
}

//@ run-pass
fn test_policy_above_range_decrease() -> i32 {
    let p = dosing_policy_new(10.0, 20.0, 1.0)
    let dose = policy_adjust_dose(p, 30.0, 100.0)
    // Above target_max: dose should decrease
    if dose >= 100.0 { return 1 }
    0
}

//@ run-pass
fn test_policy_in_range_check() -> i32 {
    let p = dosing_policy_new(10.0, 20.0, 0.5)
    if !policy_in_range(p, 15.0) { return 1 }
    if policy_in_range(p, 5.0) { return 2 }
    if policy_in_range(p, 25.0) { return 3 }
    0
}

//@ run-pass
fn test_policy_toxic() -> i32 {
    let p = dosing_policy_new(10.0, 20.0, 0.5)
    if policy_is_toxic(p, 30.0) { return 1 }  // 30 < 40 (2x20)
    if !policy_is_toxic(p, 50.0) { return 2 }  // 50 > 40
    0
}


// === FILE: stdlib/medlang/population/estimation.sio ===
// stdlib/medlang/population/estimation.sio
//
// Population parameter estimation — Sounio
//
// Naive pooled estimation: compute mean and variance of observations
// to estimate population-level PK parameters.

// ============================================================================
// Helpers
// ============================================================================

fn pe_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn pe_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 15 {
        y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
        i = i + 1
    }
    y
}

// ============================================================================
// Population estimate structure
// theta: fixed-effect parameters (means)
// omega: between-subject variability (variances)
// sigma: residual variability
// ============================================================================

struct PopEstimate {
    theta: [f64; 16],    // fixed effects
    omega: [f64; 16],    // random effect variances
    sigma: f64,          // residual error variance
    n_params: i32,       // number of parameters estimated
}

fn pop_estimate_new() -> PopEstimate {
    PopEstimate {
        theta: [0.0; 16],
        omega: [0.0; 16],
        sigma: 0.0,
        n_params: 0,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Naive pooled estimation
// Treats all observations as from a single "average" subject.
// Computes mean and variance of observation blocks.
//
// observations: flat array of observations
// n_obs: total number of observations
// n_params: number of parameters to extract (divides observations into blocks)
// ============================================================================

fn pop_naive_pooled(observations: &[f64; 256], n_obs: i32, n_params: i32) -> PopEstimate with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var est = pop_estimate_new()
    if n_params <= 0 { return est }
    if n_obs <= 0 { return est }

    var np = n_params
    if np > 16 { np = 16 }
    est.n_params = np

    // Block size: how many observations per parameter
    let block_size = n_obs / np

    if block_size < 1 {
        // Fewer observations than parameters: just copy what we have
        var i = 0
        while i < n_obs && i < np {
            est.theta[i] = observations[i]
            i = i + 1
        }
        return est
    }

    // For each parameter block, compute mean (theta) and variance (omega)
    var p = 0
    while p < np {
        let start = p * block_size
        var end_idx = start + block_size
        if end_idx > n_obs { end_idx = n_obs }

        // Mean
        var sum = 0.0
        var count = 0
        var i = start
        while i < end_idx {
            sum = sum + observations[i]
            count = count + 1
            i = i + 1
        }
        let mean = if count > 0 { sum / count as f64 } else { 0.0 }
        est.theta[p] = mean

        // Variance (unbiased: divide by n-1)
        var var_sum = 0.0
        i = start
        while i < end_idx {
            let diff = observations[i] - mean
            var_sum = var_sum + diff * diff
            i = i + 1
        }
        if count > 1 {
            est.omega[p] = var_sum / (count - 1) as f64
        } else {
            est.omega[p] = 0.0
        }

        p = p + 1
    }

    // Residual sigma: overall variance of residuals from block means
    var resid_sum = 0.0
    var total_count = 0
    p = 0
    while p < np {
        let start = p * block_size
        var end_idx = start + block_size
        if end_idx > n_obs { end_idx = n_obs }
        var i = start
        while i < end_idx {
            let diff = observations[i] - est.theta[p]
            resid_sum = resid_sum + diff * diff
            total_count = total_count + 1
            i = i + 1
        }
        p = p + 1
    }
    if total_count > np {
        est.sigma = resid_sum / (total_count - np) as f64
    }

    est
}

// ============================================================================
// Coefficient of variation (CV%) for each parameter
// CV = sqrt(omega) / |theta| * 100
// ============================================================================

fn pop_cv_percent(est: &PopEstimate, cv_out: &![f64; 16]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < est.n_params {
        if pe_abs(est.theta[i]) > 1.0e-15 {
            cv_out[i] = pe_sqrt(est.omega[i]) / pe_abs(est.theta[i]) * 100.0
        } else {
            cv_out[i] = 0.0
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Standard error of mean for each parameter
// SE = sqrt(omega / n_subjects)
// ============================================================================

fn pop_standard_error(est: &PopEstimate, n_subjects: i32, se_out: &![f64; 16]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if n_subjects <= 0 { return }
    var i = 0
    while i < est.n_params {
        se_out[i] = pe_sqrt(est.omega[i] / n_subjects as f64)
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Tests
// ============================================================================

fn test_pooled_constant() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // All observations = 5.0, one parameter
    var obs: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var i = 0
    while i < 10 {
        obs[i] = 5.0
        i = i + 1
    }
    let est = pop_naive_pooled(&obs, 10, 1)
    pe_abs(est.theta[0] - 5.0) < 0.01 && est.omega[0] < 0.01
}

fn test_pooled_two_params() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // First 5 obs around 10.0, next 5 around 20.0
    var obs: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    obs[0] = 9.0
    obs[1] = 10.0
    obs[2] = 11.0
    obs[3] = 10.0
    obs[4] = 10.0
    obs[5] = 19.0
    obs[6] = 20.0
    obs[7] = 21.0
    obs[8] = 20.0
    obs[9] = 20.0
    let est = pop_naive_pooled(&obs, 10, 2)
    pe_abs(est.theta[0] - 10.0) < 0.5 && pe_abs(est.theta[1] - 20.0) < 0.5
}

fn test_pooled_variance() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Known variance dataset
    var obs: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    obs[0] = 1.0
    obs[1] = 2.0
    obs[2] = 3.0
    obs[3] = 4.0
    obs[4] = 5.0
    let est = pop_naive_pooled(&obs, 5, 1)
    // Mean = 3.0, var = 2.5 (unbiased)
    pe_abs(est.theta[0] - 3.0) < 0.01 && pe_abs(est.omega[0] - 2.5) < 0.01
}


// === FILE: stdlib/medlang/population/model.sio ===
//! stdlib/medlang/population/model.sio
//!
//! Population Model Definitions
//!
//! Core structures for defining population pharmacokinetic models including
//! fixed effects, random effects, covariates, and prior distributions.

// ============================================================================
// HELPER FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    for _ in 0..10 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y) }
    y
}

fn ln_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 - 1000000.0 }
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var v = x
    var k: i64 = 0
    while v > 2.0 { v = v / 2.0; k = k + 1 }
    while v < 1.0 { v = v * 2.0; k = k - 1 }
    let y = v - 1.0
    var result = 0.0
    var power = y
    for i in 1..=15 {
        if i % 2 == 1 { result = result + power / (i as f64) }
        else { result = result - power / (i as f64) }
        power = power * y
    }
    result + (k as f64) * ln2
}

fn exp_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var v = x
    if v > 700.0 { v = 700.0 }
    if v < 0.0 - 700.0 { return 0.0 }
    let k = (v / ln2) as i64
    let r = v - (k as f64) * ln2
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    for i in 1..=15 {
        term = term * r / (i as f64)
        result = result + term
    }
    if k >= 0 { for _ in 0..k { result = result * 2.0 } }
    else { for _ in 0..(-k) { result = result / 2.0 } }
    result
}

fn pi() -> f64 { 3.14159265358979323846 }

// ============================================================================
// PARAMETER TYPES
// ============================================================================

// Fixed effect parameter (typical value in population)
pub struct FixedEffect {
    pub name_id: i64,
    pub value: f64,
    pub lower_bound: f64,
    pub upper_bound: f64,
    pub fixed: bool,
    pub transform: i64,
}

pub fn fixed_effect_new(name_id: i64, value: f64) -> FixedEffect {
    FixedEffect {
        name_id: name_id,
        value: value,
        lower_bound: 0.0 - 1e100,
        upper_bound: 1e100,
        fixed: false,
        transform: 0,
    }
}

pub fn fixed_effect_log(name_id: i64, value: f64) -> FixedEffect {
    FixedEffect {
        name_id: name_id,
        value: value,
        lower_bound: 1e-10,
        upper_bound: 1e100,
        fixed: false,
        transform: 1,
    }
}

pub fn fixed_effect_logit(name_id: i64, value: f64, lower: f64, upper: f64) -> FixedEffect {
    FixedEffect {
        name_id: name_id,
        value: value,
        lower_bound: lower,
        upper_bound: upper,
        fixed: false,
        transform: 2,
    }
}

// Apply transform to unconstrained parameter
pub fn fixed_effect_from_unconstrained(fe: &FixedEffect, x: f64) -> f64 {
    if fe.transform == 1 {
        return exp_f64(x)
    }
    if fe.transform == 2 {
        let sigmoid = 1.0 / (1.0 + exp_f64(0.0 - x))
        return fe.lower_bound + (fe.upper_bound - fe.lower_bound) * sigmoid
    }
    x
}

// Apply inverse transform to get unconstrained parameter
pub fn fixed_effect_to_unconstrained(fe: &FixedEffect, x: f64) -> f64 {
    if fe.transform == 1 {
        if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 - 100.0 }
        return ln_f64(x)
    }
    if fe.transform == 2 {
        let range = fe.upper_bound - fe.lower_bound
        if range <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
        let p = (x - fe.lower_bound) / range
        var p_clamped = p
        if p_clamped < 0.001 { p_clamped = 0.001 }
        if p_clamped > 0.999 { p_clamped = 0.999 }
        return ln_f64(p_clamped / (1.0 - p_clamped))
    }
    x
}

// ============================================================================
// PRIOR DISTRIBUTIONS
// ============================================================================

// Prior distribution specification
pub struct Prior {
    pub dist_type: i64,
    pub param1: f64,
    pub param2: f64,
}

pub fn prior_normal(mean: f64, std: f64) -> Prior {
    Prior { dist_type: 0, param1: mean, param2: std }
}

pub fn prior_lognormal(log_mean: f64, log_std: f64) -> Prior {
    Prior { dist_type: 1, param1: log_mean, param2: log_std }
}

pub fn prior_uniform(lower: f64, upper: f64) -> Prior {
    Prior { dist_type: 2, param1: lower, param2: upper }
}

pub fn prior_half_normal(scale: f64) -> Prior {
    Prior { dist_type: 3, param1: 0.0, param2: scale }
}

pub fn prior_inverse_wishart(df: f64) -> Prior {
    Prior { dist_type: 4, param1: df, param2: 0.0 }
}

// Evaluate log-probability of prior at value x
pub fn prior_log_prob(prior: &Prior, x: f64) -> f64 {
    let neg_inf = 0.0 - 1e100
    if prior.dist_type == 0 {
        if prior.param2 <= 0.0 { return neg_inf }
        let z = (x - prior.param1) / prior.param2
        return 0.0 - 0.5 * ln_f64(2.0 * pi()) - ln_f64(prior.param2) - 0.5 * z * z
    }
    if prior.dist_type == 1 {
        if x <= 0.0 || prior.param2 <= 0.0 { return neg_inf }
        let log_x = ln_f64(x)
        let z = (log_x - prior.param1) / prior.param2
        return 0.0 - 0.5 * ln_f64(2.0 * pi()) - ln_f64(prior.param2) - log_x - 0.5 * z * z
    }
    if prior.dist_type == 2 {
        if x < prior.param1 || x > prior.param2 { return neg_inf }
        return 0.0 - ln_f64(prior.param2 - prior.param1)
    }
    if prior.dist_type == 3 {
        if x < 0.0 || prior.param2 <= 0.0 { return neg_inf }
        let z = x / prior.param2
        return ln_f64(2.0) - 0.5 * ln_f64(2.0 * pi()) - ln_f64(prior.param2) - 0.5 * z * z
    }
    neg_inf
}

// ============================================================================
// COVARIATE MODEL
// ============================================================================

// Covariate effect specification
pub struct CovariateEffect {
    pub param_id: i64,
    pub covariate_id: i64,
    pub effect_type: i64,
    pub coefficient: f64,
    pub reference: f64,
}

pub fn covariate_power(param_id: i64, cov_id: i64, coef: f64, ref_val: f64) -> CovariateEffect {
    CovariateEffect {
        param_id: param_id,
        covariate_id: cov_id,
        effect_type: 0,
        coefficient: coef,
        reference: ref_val,
    }
}

pub fn covariate_linear(param_id: i64, cov_id: i64, coef: f64, ref_val: f64) -> CovariateEffect {
    CovariateEffect {
        param_id: param_id,
        covariate_id: cov_id,
        effect_type: 1,
        coefficient: coef,
        reference: ref_val,
    }
}

pub fn covariate_exponential(param_id: i64, cov_id: i64, coef: f64) -> CovariateEffect {
    CovariateEffect {
        param_id: param_id,
        covariate_id: cov_id,
        effect_type: 2,
        coefficient: coef,
        reference: 0.0,
    }
}

// Apply covariate effect to parameter
pub fn apply_covariate_effect(effect: &CovariateEffect, base_value: f64, cov_value: f64) -> f64 {
    if effect.effect_type == 0 {
        if cov_value <= 0.0 || effect.reference <= 0.0 { return base_value }
        let ratio = cov_value / effect.reference
        var power_result = 1.0
        let coef = effect.coefficient
        if ratio > 0.0 {
            power_result = exp_f64(coef * ln_f64(ratio))
        }
        return base_value * power_result
    }
    if effect.effect_type == 1 {
        return base_value * (1.0 + effect.coefficient * (cov_value - effect.reference))
    }
    if effect.effect_type == 2 {
        return base_value * exp_f64(effect.coefficient * cov_value)
    }
    base_value
}

// Individual parameter vector
pub struct IndividualParameters {
    pub values: Vec<f64>,
    pub etas: Vec<f64>,
    pub subject_id: i64,
    pub valid: bool,
}

pub fn individual_parameters_new(n_params: usize) -> IndividualParameters {
    var values: Vec<f64> = vec![]
    var etas: Vec<f64> = vec![]
    for _ in 0..n_params {
        values.push(0.0)
        etas.push(0.0)
    }
    IndividualParameters {
        values: values,
        etas: etas,
        subject_id: 0,
        valid: true,
    }
}

// Compute individual parameters from population parameters and random effects
pub fn compute_individual_parameters(
    thetas: &Vec<f64>,
    etas: &Vec<f64>,
    transforms: &Vec<i64>,
) -> Vec<f64> {
    var result: Vec<f64> = vec![]
    let n = thetas.len()

    for i in 0..n {
        var eta = 0.0
        if i < etas.len() {
            eta = etas[i]
        }

        var transform: i64 = 1
        if i < transforms.len() {
            transform = transforms[i]
        }

        if transform == 0 {
            result.push(thetas[i] + eta)
        } else if transform == 1 {
            result.push(thetas[i] * exp_f64(eta))
        } else if transform == 2 {
            let f = thetas[i]
            if f > 0.0 && f < 1.0 {
                let p = f / (f + (1.0 - f) * exp_f64(0.0 - eta))
                result.push(p)
            } else {
                result.push(f)
            }
        } else {
            result.push(thetas[i])
        }
    }

    result
}

// === FILE: stdlib/medlang/population/simulation.sio ===
// stdlib/medlang/population/simulation.sio
//
// Population PK simulation — Sounio
//
// Monte Carlo simulation with between-subject parameter variability.
// Uses a simple linear congruential PRNG for reproducibility.

// ============================================================================
// Helpers
// ============================================================================

fn ps_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn ps_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 15 {
        y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
        i = i + 1
    }
    y
}

fn ps_exp(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var xc = x
    if xc > 20.0 { xc = 20.0 }
    if xc < -20.0 { xc = -20.0 }
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 30 {
        term = term * xc / i as f64
        result = result + term
        i = i + 1
    }
    if result < 1.0e-15 { result = 1.0e-15 }
    result
}

fn ps_ln(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return -50.0 }
    var v = x
    var adjust = 0.0
    while v > 2.0 {
        v = v / 2.0
        adjust = adjust + 0.6931471805599453
    }
    while v < 0.5 {
        v = v * 2.0
        adjust = adjust - 0.6931471805599453
    }
    let u = (v - 1.0) / (v + 1.0)
    let u2 = u * u
    var term = u
    var sum = u
    var k = 1
    while k <= 20 {
        term = term * u2
        sum = sum + term / (2 * k + 1) as f64
        k = k + 1
    }
    2.0 * sum + adjust
}

// ============================================================================
// Simple LCG PRNG (linear congruential generator)
// Returns value in [0, 1)
// ============================================================================

struct PsRng {
    state: i64,
}

fn ps_rng_new(seed: i64) -> PsRng {
    PsRng { state: seed }
}

fn ps_rng_next(rng: &!PsRng) -> f64 with Mut, Panic {
    // LCG parameters (Numerical Recipes)
    rng.state = rng.state * 1103515245 + 12345
    // Mask to positive
    var v = rng.state
    if v < 0 { v = 0 - v }
    let bits = v % 1000000
    bits as f64 / 1000000.0
}

// ============================================================================
// Box-Muller transform: generate normal(0,1) from two uniforms
// ============================================================================

fn ps_normal(rng: &!PsRng) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var u1 = ps_rng_next(rng)
    if u1 < 1.0e-10 { u1 = 1.0e-10 }
    let u2 = ps_rng_next(rng)
    // z = sqrt(-2*ln(u1)) * cos(2*pi*u2)
    let r = ps_sqrt(0.0 - 2.0 * ps_ln(u1))
    // cos approximation via Taylor
    let angle = 6.28318530717959 * u2
    var cos_val = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 12 {
        term = 0.0 - term * angle * angle / ((2 * i - 1) as f64 * (2 * i) as f64)
        cos_val = cos_val + term
        i = i + 1
    }
    r * cos_val
}

// ============================================================================
// Population simulation
//
// params: population mean parameters (theta)
// omega: between-subject variability (variance of log-normal distribution)
// n_subjects: number of virtual subjects to simulate
// out: output array, out[subj * n_params + p] = individual parameter value
// Returns: n_subjects * n_params stored
//
// Log-normal variability: individual_p = theta_p * exp(eta_p)
//   where eta_p ~ N(0, omega_p)
// ============================================================================

fn pop_simulate(params: &[f64; 16], omega: &[f64; 16], n_subjects: i32, n_params: i32, out: &![f64; 256]) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if n_subjects <= 0 { return 0 }
    if n_params <= 0 { return 0 }

    var np = n_params
    if np > 16 { np = 16 }
    var ns = n_subjects
    if ns * np > 256 { ns = 256 / np }

    var rng = ps_rng_new(42)
    var subj = 0
    while subj < ns {
        var p = 0
        while p < np {
            let eta = ps_normal(&!rng) * ps_sqrt(omega[p])
            // Log-normal: individual = theta * exp(eta)
            let individual = params[p] * ps_exp(eta)
            let idx = subj * np + p
            if idx < 256 {
                out[idx] = individual
            }
            p = p + 1
        }
        subj = subj + 1
    }
    ns * np
}

// ============================================================================
// Summary statistics: compute mean and SD across subjects for each parameter
// ============================================================================

struct PopSimSummary {
    means: [f64; 16],
    sds: [f64; 16],
    n_params: i32,
    n_subjects: i32,
}

fn pop_sim_summary(sim_out: &[f64; 256], n_subjects: i32, n_params: i32) -> PopSimSummary with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var summary = PopSimSummary {
        means: [0.0; 16],
        sds: [0.0; 16],
        n_params: n_params,
        n_subjects: n_subjects,
    }

    var np = n_params
    if np > 16 { np = 16 }

    var p = 0
    while p < np {
        // Mean
        var sum = 0.0
        var subj = 0
        while subj < n_subjects {
            let idx = subj * np + p
            if idx < 256 {
                sum = sum + sim_out[idx]
            }
            subj = subj + 1
        }
        let mean = if n_subjects > 0 { sum / n_subjects as f64 } else { 0.0 }
        summary.means[p] = mean

        // SD
        var var_sum = 0.0
        subj = 0
        while subj < n_subjects {
            let idx = subj * np + p
            if idx < 256 {
                let diff = sim_out[idx] - mean
                var_sum = var_sum + diff * diff
            }
            subj = subj + 1
        }
        if n_subjects > 1 {
            summary.sds[p] = ps_sqrt(var_sum / (n_subjects - 1) as f64)
        }

        p = p + 1
    }
    summary
}

// ============================================================================
// Tests
// ============================================================================

fn test_pop_simulate_count() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var params: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    params[0] = 10.0
    params[1] = 50.0
    var omega: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    omega[0] = 0.04   // ~20% CV
    omega[1] = 0.09   // ~30% CV

    var out: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    let n = pop_simulate(&params, &omega, 10, 2, &!out)
    n == 20
}

fn test_pop_simulate_positive() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Log-normal should produce positive values
    var params: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    params[0] = 10.0
    var omega: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    omega[0] = 0.04

    var out: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    let n = pop_simulate(&params, &omega, 20, 1, &!out)

    var all_positive = true
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 {
        if out[i] <= 0.0 { all_positive = false }
        i = i + 1
    }
    all_positive
}

fn test_pop_summary() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var params: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    params[0] = 100.0
    var omega: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    omega[0] = 0.01   // small variability

    var sim_out: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    let n = pop_simulate(&params, &omega, 20, 1, &!sim_out)

    // Copy to a separate read-only buffer for summary
    var read_buf: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var ci = 0
    while ci < 256 {
        read_buf[ci] = sim_out[ci]
        ci = ci + 1
    }
    let summary = pop_sim_summary(&read_buf, 20, 1)

    // Mean should be near 100 (log-normal has E = theta * exp(omega/2))
    ps_abs(summary.means[0] - 100.0) < 20.0
}


// === FILE: stdlib/medlang/population/variability.sio ===
//! stdlib/medlang/population/variability.sio
//!
//! Inter-Individual Variability and Residual Error Models
//!
//! Provides structures for random effects (omega matrices) and
//! residual unexplained variability (RUV) models.

// ============================================================================
// HELPER FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    for _ in 0..10 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y) }
    y
}

fn ln_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return -1000000.0 }
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var v = x
    var k: i64 = 0
    while v > 2.0 { v = v / 2.0; k = k + 1 }
    while v < 1.0 { v = v * 2.0; k = k - 1 }
    let y = v - 1.0
    var result = 0.0
    var power = y
    for i in 1..=15 {
        if i % 2 == 1 { result = result + power / (i as f64) }
        else { result = result - power / (i as f64) }
        power = power * y
    }
    result + (k as f64) * ln2
}

fn exp_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var v = x
    if v > 700.0 { v = 700.0 }
    if v < -700.0 { return 0.0 }
    let k = (v / ln2) as i64
    let r = v - (k as f64) * ln2
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    for i in 1..=15 {
        term = term * r / (i as f64)
        result = result + term
    }
    if k >= 0 { for _ in 0..k { result = result * 2.0 } }
    else { for _ in 0..(-k) { result = result / 2.0 } }
    result
}

fn pi() -> f64 { 3.14159265358979323846 }

// ============================================================================
// OMEGA MATRIX (VARIANCE-COVARIANCE OF RANDOM EFFECTS)
// ============================================================================

// Omega matrix storage (symmetric, stored as lower triangular)
pub struct OmegaMatrix {
    pub elements: Vec<f64>,
    pub dimension: i64,
    pub block_structure: i64,
}

pub fn omega_matrix_new(dim: i64) -> OmegaMatrix {
    let n_elements = (dim * (dim + 1) / 2) as usize
    var elements: Vec<f64> = vec![]
    for _ in 0..n_elements {
        elements.push(0.0)
    }
    OmegaMatrix {
        elements: elements,
        dimension: dim,
        block_structure: 0,
    }
}

pub fn omega_matrix_diagonal(variances: &Vec<f64>) -> OmegaMatrix {
    let dim = variances.len() as i64
    var elements: Vec<f64> = vec![]

    for i in 0..dim {
        for j in 0..=i {
            if i == j {
                elements.push(variances[i as usize])
            } else {
                elements.push(0.0)
            }
        }
    }

    OmegaMatrix {
        elements: elements,
        dimension: dim,
        block_structure: 1,
    }
}

// Get element (i, j) from lower triangular storage
pub fn omega_get(omega: &OmegaMatrix, i: i64, j: i64) -> f64 {
    var row = i
    var col = j
    if col > row {
        let temp = row
        row = col
        col = temp
    }
    let idx = row * (row + 1) / 2 + col
    if idx < 0 || (idx as usize) >= omega.elements.len() {
        return 0.0
    }
    omega.elements[idx as usize]
}

// Set element (i, j) in lower triangular storage
pub fn omega_set(omega: &OmegaMatrix, i: i64, j: i64, value: f64) {
    var row = i
    var col = j
    if col > row {
        let temp = row
        row = col
        col = temp
    }
    let idx = row * (row + 1) / 2 + col
    if idx >= 0 && (idx as usize) < omega.elements.len() {
        omega.elements[idx as usize] = value
    }
}

// Compute variance from diagonal
pub fn omega_variance(omega: &OmegaMatrix, i: i64) -> f64 {
    omega_get(omega, i, i)
}

// Compute standard deviation
pub fn omega_std(omega: &OmegaMatrix, i: i64) -> f64 {
    sqrt_f64(omega_get(omega, i, i))
}

// Compute correlation between parameters i and j
pub fn omega_correlation(omega: &OmegaMatrix, i: i64, j: i64) -> f64 {
    let var_i = omega_get(omega, i, i)
    let var_j = omega_get(omega, j, j)
    if var_i <= 0.0 || var_j <= 0.0 {
        return 0.0
    }
    let cov_ij = omega_get(omega, i, j)
    cov_ij / sqrt_f64(var_i * var_j)
}

// Compute coefficient of variation (CV%) from omega
pub fn omega_cv_percent(omega: &OmegaMatrix, i: i64) -> f64 {
    let variance = omega_get(omega, i, i)
    if variance < 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    sqrt_f64(exp_f64(variance) - 1.0) * 100.0
}

// ============================================================================
// INTER-INDIVIDUAL VARIABILITY (IIV)
// ============================================================================

// Inter-individual variability specification
pub struct InterIndividualVariability {
    pub omega: OmegaMatrix,
    pub param_names: Vec<i64>,
    pub distribution: i64,
    pub shrinkage: Vec<f64>,
}

pub fn iiv_new(n_params: i64) -> InterIndividualVariability {
    var param_names: Vec<i64> = vec![]
    var shrinkage: Vec<f64> = vec![]
    for i in 0..n_params {
        param_names.push(i)
        shrinkage.push(0.0)
    }

    InterIndividualVariability {
        omega: omega_matrix_new(n_params),
        param_names: param_names,
        distribution: 1,
        shrinkage: shrinkage,
    }
}

pub fn iiv_from_variances(variances: &Vec<f64>) -> InterIndividualVariability {
    let n = variances.len()
    var param_names: Vec<i64> = vec![]
    var shrinkage: Vec<f64> = vec![]
    for i in 0..n {
        param_names.push(i as i64)
        shrinkage.push(0.0)
    }

    InterIndividualVariability {
        omega: omega_matrix_diagonal(variances),
        param_names: param_names,
        distribution: 1,
        shrinkage: shrinkage,
    }
}

// Compute eta shrinkage: 1 - SD(EBE_eta) / omega
pub fn compute_shrinkage(iiv: &InterIndividualVariability, ebe_etas: &Vec<Vec<f64>>) -> Vec<f64> {
    let n_subjects = ebe_etas.len()
    let n_params = iiv.omega.dimension as usize

    var shrinkage: Vec<f64> = vec![]

    for p in 0..n_params {
        var sum = 0.0
        var sum_sq = 0.0
        var count = 0.0

        for s in 0..n_subjects {
            if p < ebe_etas[s].len() {
                sum = sum + ebe_etas[s][p]
                sum_sq = sum_sq + ebe_etas[s][p] * ebe_etas[s][p]
                count = count + 1.0
            }
        }

        if count > 1.0 {
            let mean = sum / count
            let var_ebe = (sum_sq - count * mean * mean) / (count - 1.0)
            let sd_ebe = sqrt_f64(var_ebe)
            let omega_sd = sqrt_f64(omega_get(&iiv.omega, p as i64, p as i64))

            if omega_sd > 0.0 {
                shrinkage.push(1.0 - sd_ebe / omega_sd)
            } else {
                shrinkage.push(0.0)
            }
        } else {
            shrinkage.push(0.0)
        }
    }

    shrinkage
}

// ============================================================================
// RESIDUAL ERROR MODELS
// ============================================================================

// Residual error model type
pub struct ResidualError {
    pub model_type: i64,
    pub sigma_add: f64,
    pub sigma_prop: f64,
    pub power: f64,
}

pub fn residual_additive(sigma: f64) -> ResidualError {
    ResidualError {
        model_type: 0,
        sigma_add: sigma,
        sigma_prop: 0.0,
        power: 0.0,
    }
}

pub fn residual_proportional(sigma: f64) -> ResidualError {
    ResidualError {
        model_type: 1,
        sigma_add: 0.0,
        sigma_prop: sigma,
        power: 0.0,
    }
}

pub fn residual_combined(sigma_add: f64, sigma_prop: f64) -> ResidualError {
    ResidualError {
        model_type: 2,
        sigma_add: sigma_add,
        sigma_prop: sigma_prop,
        power: 0.0,
    }
}

pub fn residual_power(sigma: f64, power: f64) -> ResidualError {
    ResidualError {
        model_type: 3,
        sigma_add: sigma,
        sigma_prop: 0.0,
        power: power,
    }
}

// Compute standard deviation of residual error given predicted value
pub fn residual_std(error: &ResidualError, prediction: f64) -> f64 {
    if error.model_type == 0 {
        return error.sigma_add
    }
    if error.model_type == 1 {
        return error.sigma_prop * abs_f64(prediction)
    }
    if error.model_type == 2 {
        let add_sq = error.sigma_add * error.sigma_add
        let prop_sq = error.sigma_prop * error.sigma_prop * prediction * prediction
        return sqrt_f64(add_sq + prop_sq)
    }
    if error.model_type == 3 {
        if abs_f64(prediction) < 1e-10 { return error.sigma_add }
        return error.sigma_add * exp_f64(error.power * ln_f64(abs_f64(prediction)))
    }
    error.sigma_add
}

// Compute log-likelihood contribution for a single observation
pub fn residual_log_likelihood(error: &ResidualError, observed: f64, predicted: f64) -> f64 {
    let sd = residual_std(error, predicted)
    if sd <= 0.0 {
        return -1e100
    }

    let z = (observed - predicted) / sd
    0.0 - 0.5 * ln_f64(2.0 * pi()) - ln_f64(sd) - 0.5 * z * z
}

// Compute weighted residual (WRES)
pub fn weighted_residual(error: &ResidualError, observed: f64, predicted: f64) -> f64 {
    let sd = residual_std(error, predicted)
    if sd <= 0.0 {
        return 0.0
    }
    (observed - predicted) / sd
}

// Compute conditional weighted residual (CWRES)
pub fn conditional_weighted_residual(
    error: &ResidualError,
    observed: f64,
    ipred: f64,
    pred: f64,
    h: f64,
    omega: f64,
) -> f64 {
    let g = residual_std(error, ipred) / residual_std(error, pred)
    let f_derivative = h

    let var_approx = g * g + f_derivative * f_derivative * omega
    let sd_approx = sqrt_f64(var_approx)

    if sd_approx <= 0.0 {
        return 0.0
    }

    (observed - ipred) / (residual_std(error, ipred) * sd_approx)
}

// ============================================================================
// BETWEEN-OCCASION VARIABILITY (BOV)
// ============================================================================

// Between-occasion variability specification
pub struct BetweenOccasionVariability {
    pub gamma: OmegaMatrix,
    pub param_names: Vec<i64>,
    pub n_occasions: i64,
}

pub fn bov_new(n_params: i64, n_occasions: i64) -> BetweenOccasionVariability {
    var param_names: Vec<i64> = vec![]
    for i in 0..n_params {
        param_names.push(i)
    }

    BetweenOccasionVariability {
        gamma: omega_matrix_new(n_params),
        param_names: param_names,
        n_occasions: n_occasions,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// CHOLESKY DECOMPOSITION FOR CORRELATION
// ============================================================================

// Cholesky decomposition of omega matrix for correlated sampling
pub fn cholesky_decompose(omega: &OmegaMatrix) -> OmegaMatrix {
    let n = omega.dimension
    var L = omega_matrix_new(n)

    for i in 0..n {
        for j in 0..=i {
            var sum = 0.0

            if j == i {
                for k in 0..j {
                    let l_jk = omega_get(&L, j, k)
                    sum = sum + l_jk * l_jk
                }
                let diag = omega_get(omega, i, i) - sum
                if diag > 0.0 {
                    omega_set(&L, i, j, sqrt_f64(diag))
                }
            } else {
                for k in 0..j {
                    let l_ik = omega_get(&L, i, k)
                    let l_jk = omega_get(&L, j, k)
                    sum = sum + l_ik * l_jk
                }
                let l_jj = omega_get(&L, j, j)
                if l_jj > 0.0 {
                    omega_set(&L, i, j, (omega_get(omega, i, j) - sum) / l_jj)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    L
}

// Sample correlated random effects using Cholesky factor
pub fn sample_correlated_etas(L: &OmegaMatrix, z: &Vec<f64>) -> Vec<f64> {
    let n = L.dimension as usize
    var eta: Vec<f64> = vec![]

    for i in 0..n {
        var sum = 0.0
        for j in 0..=i {
            if j < z.len() {
                sum = sum + omega_get(L, i as i64, j as i64) * z[j]
            }
        }
        eta.push(sum)
    }

    eta
}
