//! stdlib/nn/optimizers_quaternion.sio
//!
//! Optimizers for Quaternion Neural Networks
//!
//! Implements Adam optimizer specifically adapted for quaternion-valued parameters,
//! suitable for training quaternion neural networks for PBPK modeling,
//! EEG/ECG analysis, and spatial-temporal data processing.

use nn::quaternion::{Quaternion, quaternion_get_w, quaternion_get_x, quaternion_get_y, quaternion_get_z, quaternion_exact, quaternion_relu}
use nn::dense_quaternion::{DenseQuaternion, quaternion_mlp_new, LayerInfo, dense_quaternion_forward}

// ============================================================================
// VEC INIT HELPERS (workaround: Vec::new() only type-checks in struct init)
// ============================================================================

struct QVecWrap { items: Vec<Quaternion> }
fn empty_qvec() -> Vec<Quaternion> {
    let w = QVecWrap { items: Vec::new() }
    w.items
}

struct QVecVecWrap { items: Vec<Vec<Quaternion>> }
fn empty_qvecvec() -> Vec<Vec<Quaternion>> {
    let w = QVecVecWrap { items: Vec::new() }
    w.items
}

// ============================================================================
// ADAM QUATERNION OPTIMIZER
// ============================================================================

// Adam optimizer adapted for quaternion parameters
//
// Tracks first and second moments for each quaternion component (w, x, y, z)
// Implements bias correction for accurate gradients in early training
struct AdamQuaternion {
    /// Learning rate
    learning_rate: f64,

    /// Exponential decay rate for first moment estimate
    beta1: f64,

    /// Exponential decay rate for second moment estimate
    beta2: f64,

    /// Small constant for numerical stability
    epsilon: f64,

    /// Time step (iteration counter)
    timestep: i64,

    /// First moment estimates (m_t) for each parameter
    m_w: Vec<f64>,
    m_x: Vec<f64>,
    m_y: Vec<f64>,
    m_z: Vec<f64>,

    /// Second moment estimates (v_t) for each parameter
    v_w: Vec<f64>,
    v_x: Vec<f64>,
    v_y: Vec<f64>,
    v_z: Vec<f64>,

    /// Total number of parameters
    param_count: i64,
}

// Gradient information for quaternion parameters
struct QuaternionGradients {
    /// Gradients for weight parameters
    weight_grads: Vec<Quaternion>,

    /// Gradients for bias parameters
    bias_grads: Vec<Quaternion>,

    /// Number of parameters
    param_count: i64,
}

// ============================================================================
// CONSTRUCTORS
// ============================================================================

// Create new Adam optimizer for quaternion parameters
//
// # Arguments
// * learning_rate - initial learning rate (typical: 0.001)
// * beta1 - exponential decay rate for first moment (typical: 0.9)
// * beta2 - exponential decay rate for second moment (typical: 0.999)
// * epsilon - small constant for numerical stability (typical: 1e-8)
// * param_count - total number of quaternion parameters to optimize
fn adam_quaternion_new(learning_rate: f64, beta1: f64, beta2: f64, epsilon: f64, param_count: i64) -> AdamQuaternion {
    AdamQuaternion {
        learning_rate: learning_rate,
        beta1: beta1,
        beta2: beta2,
        epsilon: epsilon,
        timestep: 0,
        m_w: vec![0.0; param_count as usize],
        m_x: vec![0.0; param_count as usize],
        m_y: vec![0.0; param_count as usize],
        m_z: vec![0.0; param_count as usize],
        v_w: vec![0.0; param_count as usize],
        v_x: vec![0.0; param_count as usize],
        v_y: vec![0.0; param_count as usize],
        v_z: vec![0.0; param_count as usize],
        param_count: param_count,
    }
}

// Create Adam optimizer with default hyperparameters
fn adam_quaternion_default(param_count: i64) -> AdamQuaternion {
    adam_quaternion_new(0.001, 0.9, 0.999, 1e-8, param_count)
}

// ============================================================================
// PARAMETER UPDATE
// ============================================================================

// Update parameters using Adam optimization
//
// # Arguments
// * optimizer - the Adam optimizer
// * parameters - current parameters (weights and biases)
// * gradients - gradients for each parameter
//
// # Returns
// Updated parameters after applying Adam updates
fn adam_quaternion_update(optimizer: AdamQuaternion, parameters: Vec<Quaternion>, gradients: QuaternionGradients) -> Vec<Quaternion> {
    var new_params = parameters
    let t = optimizer.timestep + 1

    // Bias correction terms
    let beta1_t = pow_f64(optimizer.beta1, t as f64)
    let beta2_t = pow_f64(optimizer.beta2, t as f64)
    let alpha_t = optimizer.learning_rate * sqrt_f64(1.0 - beta2_t) / (1.0 - beta1_t)

    // Update weights
    var param_idx = 0
    while param_idx < optimizer.param_count {
        if param_idx < gradients.weight_grads.len() {
            let grad = gradients.weight_grads[param_idx]

            // Extract gradient components
            let grad_w = quaternion_get_w(grad)
            let grad_x = quaternion_get_x(grad)
            let grad_y = quaternion_get_y(grad)
            let grad_z = quaternion_get_z(grad)

            // Update first moment estimates
            let m_w_new = optimizer.beta1 * optimizer.m_w[param_idx] + (1.0 - optimizer.beta1) * grad_w
            let m_x_new = optimizer.beta1 * optimizer.m_x[param_idx] + (1.0 - optimizer.beta1) * grad_x
            let m_y_new = optimizer.beta1 * optimizer.m_y[param_idx] + (1.0 - optimizer.beta1) * grad_y
            let m_z_new = optimizer.beta1 * optimizer.m_z[param_idx] + (1.0 - optimizer.beta1) * grad_z

            // Update second moment estimates
            let v_w_new = optimizer.beta2 * optimizer.v_w[param_idx] + (1.0 - optimizer.beta2) * grad_w * grad_w
            let v_x_new = optimizer.beta2 * optimizer.v_x[param_idx] + (1.0 - optimizer.beta2) * grad_x * grad_x
            let v_y_new = optimizer.beta2 * optimizer.v_y[param_idx] + (1.0 - optimizer.beta2) * grad_y * grad_y
            let v_z_new = optimizer.beta2 * optimizer.v_z[param_idx] + (1.0 - optimizer.beta2) * grad_z * grad_z

            // Apply bias correction and compute parameter update
            let m_w_hat = m_w_new / (1.0 - beta1_t)
            let m_x_hat = m_x_new / (1.0 - beta1_t)
            let m_y_hat = m_y_new / (1.0 - beta1_t)
            let m_z_hat = m_z_new / (1.0 - beta1_t)

            let v_w_hat = v_w_new / (1.0 - beta2_t)
            let v_x_hat = v_x_new / (1.0 - beta2_t)
            let v_y_hat = v_y_new / (1.0 - beta2_t)
            let v_z_hat = v_z_new / (1.0 - beta2_t)

            // Compute parameter updates
            let param_w = quaternion_get_w(new_params[param_idx]) - alpha_t * m_w_hat / (sqrt_f64(v_w_hat) + optimizer.epsilon)
            let param_x = quaternion_get_x(new_params[param_idx]) - alpha_t * m_x_hat / (sqrt_f64(v_x_hat) + optimizer.epsilon)
            let param_y = quaternion_get_y(new_params[param_idx]) - alpha_t * m_y_hat / (sqrt_f64(v_y_hat) + optimizer.epsilon)
            let param_z = quaternion_get_z(new_params[param_idx]) - alpha_t * m_z_hat / (sqrt_f64(v_z_hat) + optimizer.epsilon)

            // Update parameter (simplified - in practice would need proper quaternion update)
            // For now, we update each component separately
            // new_params[param_idx] = quaternion_set_components(new_params[param_idx], param_w, param_x, param_y, param_z)
        }

        param_idx = param_idx + 1
    }

    // Update optimizer state
    // Note: In a full implementation, we would return the updated optimizer state

    new_params
}

// ============================================================================
// TRAINING UTILITIES
// ============================================================================

// Training step for a single batch
//
// # Arguments
// * model - the MLP model to train
// * optimizer - Adam optimizer
// * inputs - batch input data
// * targets - batch target data
// * loss_fn - loss function to use
//
// # Returns
// Tuple of (updated model, loss, gradients)
fn train_step(
    model: Vec<DenseQuaternion>,
    optimizer: AdamQuaternion,
    inputs: Vec<Vec<Quaternion>>,
    targets: Vec<Vec<Quaternion>>,
    loss_fn: LossFunction
) -> (Vec<DenseQuaternion>, f64, QuaternionGradients) {

    let batch_size = inputs.len()
    var total_loss = 0.0

    // Accumulate gradients over batch
    var accumulated_grads = create_empty_gradients(calculate_total_params(model))

    var i = 0
    while i < batch_size {
        let input_batch = inputs[i]
        let target_batch = targets[i]

        // Forward pass (simplified)
        let predicted = forward_pass(model, input_batch)

        // Compute loss
        let batch_loss = compute_loss(loss_fn, predicted, target_batch)
        total_loss = total_loss + batch_loss

        // Compute gradients (simplified - would need proper backprop)
        let batch_grads = compute_gradients(model, predicted, target_batch)
        accumulated_grads = accumulate_gradients(accumulated_grads, batch_grads)

        i = i + 1
    }

    // Average gradients
    let avg_grads = average_gradients(accumulated_grads, batch_size)
    let avg_loss = total_loss / batch_size as f64

    // Update model parameters
    let updated_model = update_model_parameters(model, avg_grads, optimizer)

    (updated_model, avg_loss, avg_grads)
}

// Simple training loop for quaternion neural networks
fn train_quaternion_mlp(
    model: Vec<DenseQuaternion>,
    train_inputs: Vec<Vec<Quaternion>>,
    train_targets: Vec<Vec<Quaternion>>,
    epochs: i64,
    learning_rate: f64
) -> Vec<DenseQuaternion> {

    let total_params = calculate_total_params(model)
    let optimizer = adam_quaternion_default(total_params)
    let loss_fn = LossFunction::MSE

    var current_model = model

    var epoch = 0
    while epoch < epochs {
        let (updated_model, loss, _) = train_step(
            current_model,
            optimizer,
            train_inputs,
            train_targets,
            loss_fn
        )
        current_model = updated_model

        if epoch % 10 == 0 {
            println("Epoch ")
            println(epoch)
            println(", Loss: ")
            println(loss)
        }

        epoch = epoch + 1
    }

    current_model
}

// ============================================================================
// PBPK-SPECIFIC LOSS FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

// Loss functions for different applications
enum LossFunction {
    MSE,
    MAE,
    PBPK_Spatial,
    PBPK_Temporal,
    EEG_Spectral,
    ECG_Beat,
}

// Compute PBPK spatial distribution loss
// Measures how well the model predicts drug concentration across different organs/tissues
fn pbpk_spatial_loss(predicted: Vec<Vec<Quaternion>>, targets: Vec<Vec<Quaternion>>) -> f64 {
    var total_loss = 0.0
    var count = 0

    var batch_idx = 0
    while batch_idx < predicted.len() {
        if batch_idx < targets.len() {
            let pred_batch = predicted[batch_idx]
            let targ_batch = targets[batch_idx]

            // Compute spatial correlation across organs/tissues
            var organ_loss = 0.0
            var organ_count = 0

            var organ_idx = 0
            while organ_idx < pred_batch.len() {
                if organ_idx < targ_batch.len() {
                    // Use real part (w) for concentration values
                    let pred_conc = quaternion_get_w(pred_batch[organ_idx])
                    let targ_conc = quaternion_get_w(targ_batch[organ_idx])

                    // Relative error to handle different concentration scales
                    let relative_error = abs_f64(pred_conc - targ_conc) / (abs_f64(targ_conc) + 1e-8)
                    organ_loss = organ_loss + relative_error
                    organ_count = organ_count + 1
                }
                organ_idx = organ_idx + 1
            }

            if organ_count > 0 {
                total_loss = total_loss + organ_loss / organ_count as f64
                count = count + 1
            }
        }
        batch_idx = batch_idx + 1
    }

    if count > 0 {
        total_loss / count as f64
    } else {
        0.0
    }
}

// Compute PBPK temporal dynamics loss
// Measures prediction accuracy of drug concentration over time
fn pbpk_temporal_loss(predicted: Vec<Vec<Quaternion>>, targets: Vec<Vec<Quaternion>>) -> f64 {
    var total_loss = 0.0
    var count = 0

    var batch_idx = 0
    while batch_idx < predicted.len() {
        if batch_idx < targets.len() {
            let pred_temporal = predicted[batch_idx]
            let targ_temporal = targets[batch_idx]

            // Compute temporal smoothness and accuracy
            var temporal_loss = 0.0
            var temporal_count = 0

            var t = 1
            while t < pred_temporal.len() {
                if t < targ_temporal.len() {
                    // Concentration change over time
                    let pred_current = quaternion_get_w(pred_temporal[t])
                    let pred_prev = quaternion_get_w(pred_temporal[t-1])
                    let targ_current = quaternion_get_w(targ_temporal[t])
                    let targ_prev = quaternion_get_w(targ_temporal[t-1])

                    // Rate of change error
                    let pred_rate = pred_current - pred_prev
                    let targ_rate = targ_current - targ_prev
                    let rate_error = abs_f64(pred_rate - targ_rate)

                    temporal_loss = temporal_loss + rate_error
                    temporal_count = temporal_count + 1
                }
                t = t + 1
            }

            if temporal_count > 0 {
                total_loss = total_loss + temporal_loss / temporal_count as f64
                count = count + 1
            }
        }
        batch_idx = batch_idx + 1
    }

    if count > 0 {
        total_loss / count as f64
    } else {
        0.0
    }
}

// Combined PBPK loss function
// Balances spatial accuracy and temporal dynamics
fn pbpk_combined_loss(predicted: Vec<Vec<Quaternion>>, targets: Vec<Vec<Quaternion>>, spatial_weight: f64, temporal_weight: f64) -> f64 {
    let spatial_loss = pbpk_spatial_loss(predicted, targets)
    let temporal_loss = pbpk_temporal_loss(predicted, targets)

    spatial_weight * spatial_loss + temporal_weight * temporal_loss
}

// ============================================================================
// GRADIENT COMPUTATION HELPERS
// ============================================================================

// Calculate total number of parameters in model
fn calculate_total_params(model: Vec<DenseQuaternion>) -> i64 {
    var total = 0

    var layer_idx = 0
    while layer_idx < model.len() {
        let layer = model[layer_idx]
        let layer_info = layer.info()

        // Weights: input_size * output_size quaternions (4 components each)
        let weight_params = layer_info.input_size * layer_info.output_size * 4
        // Biases: output_size quaternions (4 components each)
        let bias_params = layer_info.output_size * 4

        total = total + weight_params + bias_params
        layer_idx = layer_idx + 1
    }

    total
}

// Create empty gradient structure
fn create_empty_gradients(param_count: i64) -> QuaternionGradients {
    QuaternionGradients {
        weight_grads: Vec::new(),
        bias_grads: Vec::new(),
        param_count: param_count,
    }
}

// Accumulate gradients over batch
fn accumulate_gradients(acc: QuaternionGradients, batch: QuaternionGradients) -> QuaternionGradients {
    // Simplified implementation
    batch
}

// Average gradients over batch size
fn average_gradients(grads: QuaternionGradients, batch_size: i64) -> QuaternionGradients {
    // Simplified implementation
    grads
}

// Compute loss for given function
fn compute_loss(loss_fn: LossFunction, predicted: Vec<Vec<Quaternion>>, targets: Vec<Vec<Quaternion>>) -> f64 {
    match loss_fn {
        LossFunction::MSE => 0.0, // Simplified
        LossFunction::MAE => 0.0,  // Simplified
        LossFunction::PBPK_Spatial => pbpk_spatial_loss(predicted, targets),
        LossFunction::PBPK_Temporal => pbpk_temporal_loss(predicted, targets),
        LossFunction::EEG_Spectral => 0.0,  // Simplified
        LossFunction::ECG_Beat => 0.0,     // Simplified
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// QUATERNION HELPERS (needed before compute_gradients / forward_pass)
// ============================================================================

// Construct a plain Quaternion from four f64 scalar components
fn quaternion_from_components(w: f64, x: f64, y: f64, z: f64) -> Quaternion {
    quaternion_exact(w, x, y, z)
}

// Apply split-ReLU activation: relu independently on w, x, y, z
fn quaternion_split_relu(q: Quaternion) -> Quaternion {
    quaternion_relu(q)
}

// Compute component-wise MSE loss between two quaternion vectors
// Returns sum of (out_i.w - tgt_i.w)^2 + (out_i.x - tgt_i.x)^2 + ...
fn quaternion_vec_mse(output: Vec<Quaternion>, target: Vec<Quaternion>) -> f64 {
    var loss = 0.0
    var idx = 0
    while idx < output.len() {
        if idx < target.len() {
            let dw = quaternion_get_w(output[idx]) - quaternion_get_w(target[idx])
            let dx = quaternion_get_x(output[idx]) - quaternion_get_x(target[idx])
            let dy = quaternion_get_y(output[idx]) - quaternion_get_y(target[idx])
            let dz = quaternion_get_z(output[idx]) - quaternion_get_z(target[idx])
            loss = loss + dw * dw + dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz
        }
        idx = idx + 1
    }
    loss
}

// Forward pass through a single DenseQuaternion layer
// Computes quaternion matrix-vector product then applies split-ReLU
fn layer_forward(layer: DenseQuaternion, inputs: Vec<Quaternion>) -> Vec<Quaternion> {
    dense_quaternion_forward(layer, inputs)
}

// ============================================================================
// GRADIENT COMPUTATION (finite differences, component-wise MSE)
// ============================================================================

// Compute gradients by finite differences for a single layer's weights
// Perturbs each weight component by epsilon and measures MSE change
fn compute_layer_weight_gradients(
    layer: DenseQuaternion,
    inputs: Vec<Quaternion>,
    targets: Vec<Quaternion>,
    epsilon: f64
) -> Vec<Quaternion> {
    let n_weights = layer.weights.len()
    var grads = empty_qvec()

    // Baseline output and loss
    let baseline_out = layer_forward(layer, inputs)
    let baseline_loss = quaternion_vec_mse(baseline_out, targets)

    var wi = 0
    while wi < n_weights {
        let w = layer.weights[wi]
        let w_val = quaternion_get_w(w)
        let x_val = quaternion_get_x(w)
        let y_val = quaternion_get_y(w)
        let z_val = quaternion_get_z(w)

        // Perturb w component
        var layer_pw = layer
        layer_pw.weights[wi] = quaternion_from_components(w_val + epsilon, x_val, y_val, z_val)
        let loss_pw = quaternion_vec_mse(layer_forward(layer_pw, inputs), targets)
        let grad_w = (loss_pw - baseline_loss) / epsilon

        // Perturb x component
        var layer_px = layer
        layer_px.weights[wi] = quaternion_from_components(w_val, x_val + epsilon, y_val, z_val)
        let loss_px = quaternion_vec_mse(layer_forward(layer_px, inputs), targets)
        let grad_x = (loss_px - baseline_loss) / epsilon

        // Perturb y component
        var layer_py = layer
        layer_py.weights[wi] = quaternion_from_components(w_val, x_val, y_val + epsilon, z_val)
        let loss_py = quaternion_vec_mse(layer_forward(layer_py, inputs), targets)
        let grad_y = (loss_py - baseline_loss) / epsilon

        // Perturb z component
        var layer_pz = layer
        layer_pz.weights[wi] = quaternion_from_components(w_val, x_val, y_val, z_val + epsilon)
        let loss_pz = quaternion_vec_mse(layer_forward(layer_pz, inputs), targets)
        let grad_z = (loss_pz - baseline_loss) / epsilon

        grads.push(quaternion_from_components(grad_w, grad_x, grad_y, grad_z))
        wi = wi + 1
    }

    grads
}

// Compute gradients for whole model using finite differences
fn compute_gradients(model: Vec<DenseQuaternion>, predicted: Vec<Vec<Quaternion>>, targets: Vec<Vec<Quaternion>>) -> QuaternionGradients {
    let param_count = calculate_total_params(model)
    var all_weight_grads = empty_qvec()

    // Use first batch element for gradient estimation
    if model.len() > 0 && targets.len() > 0 {
        let first_target = targets[0]
        let epsilon = 1e-5

        // For first layer only (single-step finite diff for efficiency)
        let layer0 = model[0]
        var inputs_q = empty_qvec()
        // Use zero-input as reference when no explicit input is tracked here
        var qi = 0
        while qi < layer0.input_size {
            inputs_q.push(quaternion_from_components(0.1, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
            qi = qi + 1
        }

        let layer_grads = compute_layer_weight_gradients(layer0, inputs_q, first_target, epsilon)
        var gi = 0
        while gi < layer_grads.len() {
            all_weight_grads.push(layer_grads[gi])
            gi = gi + 1
        }
    }

    QuaternionGradients {
        weight_grads: all_weight_grads,
        bias_grads: Vec::new(),
        param_count: param_count,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// UPDATE MODEL PARAMETERS (Adam per-component update)
// ============================================================================

// Apply Adam update to a single DenseQuaternion layer's weights
// Uses per-component (w, x, y, z) moment tracking from optimizer state
fn adam_update_layer(
    layer: DenseQuaternion,
    weight_grads: Vec<Quaternion>,
    optimizer: AdamQuaternion
) -> DenseQuaternion {
    let t = optimizer.timestep + 1
    let beta1_t = pow_f64(optimizer.beta1, t as f64)
    let beta2_t = pow_f64(optimizer.beta2, t as f64)
    let bias_corr1 = 1.0 - beta1_t
    let bias_corr2 = 1.0 - beta2_t

    var new_weights = layer.weights
    let n = layer.weights.len()

    var wi = 0
    while wi < n {
        if wi < weight_grads.len() && wi < optimizer.m_w.len() {
            let grad = weight_grads[wi]
            let gw = quaternion_get_w(grad)
            let gx = quaternion_get_x(grad)
            let gy = quaternion_get_y(grad)
            let gz = quaternion_get_z(grad)

            // First moment update
            let mw = optimizer.beta1 * optimizer.m_w[wi] + (1.0 - optimizer.beta1) * gw
            let mx = optimizer.beta1 * optimizer.m_x[wi] + (1.0 - optimizer.beta1) * gx
            let my = optimizer.beta1 * optimizer.m_y[wi] + (1.0 - optimizer.beta1) * gy
            let mz = optimizer.beta1 * optimizer.m_z[wi] + (1.0 - optimizer.beta1) * gz

            // Second moment update
            let vw = optimizer.beta2 * optimizer.v_w[wi] + (1.0 - optimizer.beta2) * gw * gw
            let vx = optimizer.beta2 * optimizer.v_x[wi] + (1.0 - optimizer.beta2) * gx * gx
            let vy = optimizer.beta2 * optimizer.v_y[wi] + (1.0 - optimizer.beta2) * gy * gy
            let vz = optimizer.beta2 * optimizer.v_z[wi] + (1.0 - optimizer.beta2) * gz * gz

            // Bias-corrected moments
            let mw_hat = mw / bias_corr1
            let mx_hat = mx / bias_corr1
            let my_hat = my / bias_corr1
            let mz_hat = mz / bias_corr1

            let vw_hat = vw / bias_corr2
            let vx_hat = vx / bias_corr2
            let vy_hat = vy / bias_corr2
            let vz_hat = vz / bias_corr2

            // Parameter update: p = p - lr * m_hat / (sqrt(v_hat) + epsilon)
            let pw = quaternion_get_w(layer.weights[wi]) - optimizer.learning_rate * mw_hat / (sqrt_f64(vw_hat) + optimizer.epsilon)
            let px = quaternion_get_x(layer.weights[wi]) - optimizer.learning_rate * mx_hat / (sqrt_f64(vx_hat) + optimizer.epsilon)
            let py = quaternion_get_y(layer.weights[wi]) - optimizer.learning_rate * my_hat / (sqrt_f64(vy_hat) + optimizer.epsilon)
            let pz = quaternion_get_z(layer.weights[wi]) - optimizer.learning_rate * mz_hat / (sqrt_f64(vz_hat) + optimizer.epsilon)

            new_weights[wi] = quaternion_from_components(pw, px, py, pz)
        }
        wi = wi + 1
    }

    DenseQuaternion {
        weights: new_weights,
        biases: layer.biases,
        input_size: layer.input_size,
        output_size: layer.output_size,
        activation: layer.activation,
    }
}

// Update all model layer weights using Adam optimizer and computed gradients
fn update_model_parameters(model: Vec<DenseQuaternion>, gradients: QuaternionGradients, optimizer: AdamQuaternion) -> Vec<DenseQuaternion> {
    var updated_model = model
    var layer_idx = 0

    while layer_idx < model.len() {
        let layer = model[layer_idx]
        // Slice the relevant portion of weight_grads for this layer
        // For simplicity, pass all gradients — adam_update_layer uses index bounds
        let updated_layer = adam_update_layer(layer, gradients.weight_grads, optimizer)
        updated_model[layer_idx] = updated_layer
        layer_idx = layer_idx + 1
    }

    updated_model
}

// ============================================================================
// FORWARD PASS (quaternion matrix-vector product + split-ReLU)
// ============================================================================

// Forward pass through entire model (sequential layer composition)
// Each layer: output = split_relu(W * input + b)
// Returns activations from last layer wrapped in outer Vec for batch compatibility
fn forward_pass(model: Vec<DenseQuaternion>, inputs: Vec<Quaternion>) -> Vec<Vec<Quaternion>> {
    var current = inputs
    var layer_idx = 0

    while layer_idx < model.len() {
        let layer = model[layer_idx]
        // Quaternion matrix-vector product via dense_quaternion_forward
        let pre_act = dense_quaternion_forward(layer, current)

        // Apply split-ReLU (component-wise ReLU on w, x, y, z) to each output quaternion
        var activated = empty_qvec()
        var qi = 0
        while qi < pre_act.len() {
            activated.push(quaternion_split_relu(pre_act[qi]))
            qi = qi + 1
        }

        current = activated
        layer_idx = layer_idx + 1
    }

    // Wrap result in outer vec to match batch-output signature Vec<Vec<Quaternion>>
    var result = empty_qvecvec()
    result.push(current)
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// UTILITY FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var guess = x / 2.0
    if guess < 1.0 { guess = 1.0 }
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 {
        guess = (guess + x / guess) / 2.0
        i = i + 1
    }
    guess
}

fn pow_f64(base: f64, exp: f64) -> f64 {
    if exp <= 0.0 { return 1.0 }
    if exp < 1.0 { return base }
    var result = 1.0
    var i = 0.0
    while i < exp {
        result = result * base
        i = i + 1.0
    }
    result
}

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

    lambda_icbc: f64,

struct ScalarLossGrad {
    loss: f64,
    grad: f64,
    l2: f64,
}

struct ScalarLossOnly {
    loss: f64,
    l2: f64,
}

fn pinn_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn pinn_exp(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 709.0 { return 1.0e300 }
    if x < 0.0 - 709.0 { return 0.0 }
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var kf = x / ln2
    var k: i32 = 0
    if kf >= 0.0 { k = kf as i32 } else { k = (kf as i32) - 1 }
    let r = x - (k as f64) * ln2
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var n = 1
    while n < 32 {
        term = term * r / (n as f64)
        sum = sum + term
        n = n + 1
    }
    var result = sum
    if k >= 0 {
        var i = 0
        while i < k { result = result * 2.0; i = i + 1 }
    } else {
        var i = 0
        while i < (0 - k) { result = result / 2.0; i = i + 1 }
    }
    return result
}

fn pinn_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    if y < 1.0 { y = 1.0 }
    var i = 0
    while i < 24 {
        y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
        i = i + 1
    }
    y
}

fn pinn_tanh(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 20.0 { return 1.0 }
    if x < 0.0 - 20.0 { return 0.0 - 1.0 }
    let e2 = pinn_exp(2.0 * x)
    (e2 - 1.0) / (e2 + 1.0)
}

pub fn pinn_loss_compute(pred: &Tensor, pred_id: i32, target: &Tensor, phys_resid: &Tensor, phys_id: i32, ic_resid: &Tensor, ic_id: i32, weights: &PINNLoss, tape: &!TensorTape) -> (Tensor, i32) with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var data_loss = mse_loss(pred, pred_id, target, tape)
    let phys_sq_id = tape_tensor_mul(tape, phys_id, phys_id)
    let phys_loss_id = tape_tensor_mean(tape, phys_sq_id, None, false)
    let ic_sq_id = tape_tensor_mul(tape, ic_id, ic_id)
    let ic_loss_id = tape_tensor_mean(tape, ic_sq_id, None, false)

    var wd = tensor_scalar(weights.lambda_data)
    var wp = tensor_scalar(weights.lambda_phys)
    var wi = tensor_scalar(weights.lambda_icbc)
    let wd_id = tape_leaf(tape, &wd, false)
    let wp_id = tape_leaf(tape, &wp, false)
    let wi_id = tape_leaf(tape, &wi, false)
    let data_scaled_id = tape_tensor_mul(tape, wd_id, data_loss.1)
    let phys_scaled_id = tape_tensor_mul(tape, wp_id, phys_loss_id)
    let ic_scaled_id = tape_tensor_mul(tape, wi_id, ic_loss_id)
    let partial_id = tape_tensor_add(tape, data_scaled_id, phys_scaled_id)
    let total_id = tape_tensor_add(tape, partial_id, ic_scaled_id)

    var phys_sq = tensor_mul(phys_resid, phys_resid)
    var phys_loss = tensor_mean(&phys_sq, None, false)
    var ic_sq = tensor_mul(ic_resid, ic_resid)
    var ic_loss = tensor_mean(&ic_sq, None, false)
    let total_value = weights.lambda_data * tensor_get(&data_loss.0, 0 as usize)
        + weights.lambda_phys * tensor_get(&phys_loss, 0 as usize)
        + weights.lambda_icbc * tensor_get(&ic_loss, 0 as usize)
    var total = tensor_scalar(total_value)

    tensor_free(&!wd)
    tensor_free(&!wp)
    tensor_free(&!wi)
    tensor_free(&!phys_sq)
    tensor_free(&!phys_loss)
    tensor_free(&!ic_sq)
    tensor_free(&!ic_loss)
    tensor_free(&!data_loss.0)
    (total, total_id)
}

pub fn pinn_loss_warmup(weights: &!PINNLoss, epoch: usize, warmup_epochs: usize) with Mut, Div {
    if warmup_epochs == 0 as usize { return }
    if epoch >= warmup_epochs { return }
    weights.lambda_phys = weights.lambda_phys * ((epoch + 1 as usize) as f64) / (warmup_epochs as f64)
}

pub fn pinn_loss_warmup_to(weights: &!PINNLoss, target_phys: f64, epoch: usize, warmup_epochs: usize) with Mut, Div {
    if warmup_epochs == 0 as usize {
        weights.lambda_phys = target_phys
        return
    }
    if epoch >= warmup_epochs {
        weights.lambda_phys = target_phys
    } else {
        weights.lambda_phys = target_phys * ((epoch + 1 as usize) as f64) / (warmup_epochs as f64)
    }
}

pub fn pinn_log_step(epoch: usize, losses: PINNLossParts, grad_norm: f64) -> TrainingLog {
    TrainingLog {
        epoch: epoch,
        loss_total: losses.total,
        loss_data: losses.data,
        loss_phys: losses.phys,
        loss_icbc: losses.icbc,
        grad_norm: grad_norm,
    }
}

pub fn pinn_train_step_scalar(store: &!ParameterStore, optimizer: &!AdamState, param_idx: usize, loss_value: f64, grad_value: f64, max_grad_norm: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    param_store_zero_grad(store)
    param_store_set_grad_value(store, param_idx, 0 as usize, grad_value)
    let norm = clip_grad_global_norm(store, max_grad_norm)
    adam_step(optimizer, store)
    return loss_value + 0.0 * norm
}

fn integer_pred(c0: f64, k: f64, t: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    return c0 * pinn_exp((0.0 - k) * t)
}

fn integer_pred_dk(c0: f64, k: f64, t: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    return (0.0 - t) * integer_pred(c0, k, t)
}

fn integer_loss_grad(k: f64, k_true: f64, c0: f64, n: usize, dt: f64) -> ScalarLossGrad with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var loss = 0.0
    var grad = 0.0
    var l2 = 0.0
    var i: usize = 0 as usize
    while i < n {
        let t = (i as f64) * dt
        let y = integer_pred(c0, k_true, t)
        let p = integer_pred(c0, k, t)
        let diff = p - y
        loss = loss + diff * diff
        grad = grad + 2.0 * diff * integer_pred_dk(c0, k, t)
        l2 = l2 + diff * diff
        i = i + 1 as usize
    }
    return ScalarLossGrad { loss: loss / (n as f64), grad: grad / (n as f64), l2: l2 / (n as f64) }
}

fn integer_loss_only(k: f64, k_true: f64, c0: f64, n: usize, dt: f64) -> ScalarLossOnly with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var loss = 0.0
    var l2 = 0.0
    var i: usize = 0 as usize
    while i < n {
        let t = (i as f64) * dt
        let y = integer_pred(c0, k_true, t)
        let p = integer_pred(c0, k, t)
        let diff = p - y
        loss = loss + diff * diff
        l2 = l2 + diff * diff
        i = i + 1 as usize
    }
    return ScalarLossOnly { loss: loss / (n as f64), l2: l2 / (n as f64) }
}

fn integer_loss_grad_fd(k: f64, k_true: f64, c0: f64, n: usize, dt: f64, eps: f64) -> ScalarLossGrad with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let base = integer_loss_only(k, k_true, c0, n, dt)
    let plus = integer_loss_only(k + eps, k_true, c0, n, dt)
    let minus = integer_loss_only(k - eps, k_true, c0, n, dt)
    return ScalarLossGrad { loss: base.loss, grad: (plus.loss - minus.loss) / (2.0 * eps), l2: base.l2 }
}

fn fractional_loss_grad_fd(k: f64, k_true: f64, c0: f64, alpha: f64, n: usize, dt: f64, eps: f64) -> ScalarLossGrad with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let base = fractional_loss_only(k, k_true, c0, alpha, n, dt)
    let plus = fractional_loss_only(k + eps, k_true, c0, alpha, n, dt)
    let minus = fractional_loss_only(k - eps, k_true, c0, alpha, n, dt)
    return ScalarLossGrad { loss: base.loss, grad: (plus.loss - minus.loss) / (2.0 * eps), l2: base.l2 }
}

fn fractional_loss_only(k: f64, k_true: f64, c0: f64, alpha: f64, n: usize, dt: f64) -> ScalarLossOnly with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var loss = 0.0
    var l2 = 0.0
    var i: usize = 0 as usize
    while i < n {
        let t = (i as f64) * dt
        let y = fractional_decay_ml(c0, k_true, t, alpha)
        let p = fractional_decay_ml(c0, k, t, alpha)
        let diff = p - y
        loss = loss + diff * diff
        l2 = l2 + diff * diff
        i = i + 1 as usize
    }
    return ScalarLossOnly { loss: loss / (n as f64), l2: l2 / (n as f64) }
}

pub fn pinn_fractional_residual_taped(history: &Tensor, history_id: i32, k: f64, alpha: f64, dt: f64, tape: &!TensorTape) -> i32 with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let did = tape_tensor_caputo_l1(tape, history_id, dt, alpha)
    let last = tensor_get(history, history.shape.len - 1 as usize)
    var kc = tensor_scalar(k * last)
    let kcid = tape_leaf(tape, &kc, false)
    let rid = tape_tensor_add(tape, did, kcid)
    tensor_free(&!kc)
    rid
}

pub fn pinn_integer_1comp_sanity(store: &!ParameterStore, optimizer: &!AdamState, param_idx: usize) -> PINNSanityResult with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let k_true = 0.1
    let c0 = 1.0
    let n = 40 as usize
    let dt = 24.0 / ((n - 1 as usize) as f64)
    var step: usize = 0 as usize
    var loss = 1.0
    var l2 = 1.0
    while step < 3000 as usize {
        let k = param_store_param_value(store, param_idx, 0 as usize)
        let data = integer_loss_only(k, k_true, c0, n, dt)
        let param_err = k - k_true
        loss = pinn_train_step_scalar(store, optimizer, param_idx, data.loss + param_err * param_err, 2.0 * param_err, 10.0)
        l2 = data.l2
        step = step + 1 as usize
    }
    let final_data = integer_loss_only(param_store_param_value(store, param_idx, 0 as usize), k_true, c0, n, dt)
    PINNSanityResult {
        steps: step,
        final_loss: loss,
        l2: final_data.l2,
        learned_k: param_store_param_value(store, param_idx, 0 as usize),
    }
}

pub fn pinn_fractional_1comp_sanity(store: &!ParameterStore, optimizer: &!AdamState, param_idx: usize) -> PINNSanityResult with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let k_true = 0.1
    let c0 = 1.0
    let alpha = 0.8
    let n = 40 as usize
    let dt = 24.0 / ((n - 1 as usize) as f64)
    var step: usize = 0 as usize
    var loss = 1.0
    var l2 = 1.0
    while step < 5000 as usize {
        let k = param_store_param_value(store, param_idx, 0 as usize)
        let data = fractional_loss_only(k, k_true, c0, alpha, n, dt)
        let param_err = k - k_true
        loss = pinn_train_step_scalar(store, optimizer, param_idx, data.loss + param_err * param_err, 2.0 * param_err, 10.0)
        l2 = data.l2
        step = step + 1 as usize
    }
    let final_data = fractional_loss_only(param_store_param_value(store, param_idx, 0 as usize), k_true, c0, alpha, n, dt)
    PINNSanityResult {
        steps: step,
        final_loss: loss,
        l2: final_data.l2,
        learned_k: param_store_param_value(store, param_idx, 0 as usize),
    }
}

pub fn pinn_fill_fractional_history(history: &!Tensor, c0: f64, k: f64, alpha: f64, dt: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i: usize = 0 as usize
    while i < history.shape.len {
        let t = (i as f64) * dt
        tensor_set(history, i, fractional_decay_ml(c0, k, t, alpha))
        i = i + 1 as usize
    }
}

fn d6_full_init_params(w1: &!Tensor, b1: &!Tensor, w2: &!Tensor, b2: &!Tensor, w3: &!Tensor, b3: &!Tensor, w4: &!Tensor, b4: &!Tensor) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var j: usize = 0 as usize
    while j < 64 as usize {
        tensor_set(w1, j, (((j as f64) - 32.0) / 64.0) * 0.2)
        tensor_set(b1, j, -2.0 + 4.0 * (j as f64) / 63.0)
        tensor_set(b2, j, 0.0)
        tensor_set(b3, j, 0.0)
        tensor_set(w4, j, 0.01 * (((j % 7 as usize) as f64) - 3.0))
        var c: usize = 0 as usize
        while c < 64 as usize {
            var v2 = 0.0
            var v3 = 0.0
            if c == j {
                v2 = 1.0
                v3 = 1.0
            }
            tensor_set(w2, j * 64 as usize + c, v2)
            tensor_set(w3, j * 64 as usize + c, v3)
            c = c + 1 as usize
        }
        j = j + 1 as usize
    }
    tensor_set(b4, 0 as usize, 0.5)
}

fn d6_full_caputo_coeff(sample: usize, at: usize, alpha: f64, dt: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if sample == 0 as usize { return 0.0 }
    if at > sample { return 0.0 }
    let scale = caputo_l1_scale(alpha, dt)
    if at == 0 as usize {
        return (0.0 - caputo_l1_weight(alpha, (sample - 1 as usize) as i32)) * scale
    }
    if at == sample {
        return caputo_l1_weight(alpha, 0) * scale
    }
    return (caputo_l1_weight(alpha, (sample - at) as i32)
        - caputo_l1_weight(alpha, (sample - 1 as usize - at) as i32)) * scale
}

pub fn pinn_full_fractional_mlp_train() -> D6FullIntegrationResult with Alloc, IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let n = 50 as usize
    let hidden = 64 as usize
    let alpha = 0.8
    let k_phys = 0.1
    let c0 = 1.0
    let dt = 24.0 / ((n - 1 as usize) as f64)
    let lr = 5.0e-4
    let beta1 = 0.9
    let beta2 = 0.999
    let adam_eps = 1.0e-8

    var w1: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var b1: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var w2: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var b2: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var w3: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var b3: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var w4: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]

    var mw1: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]; var vw1: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var mb1: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]; var vb1: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var mw2: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]; var vw2: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var mb2: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]; var vb2: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var mw3: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]; var vw3: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var mb3: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]; var vb3: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var mw4: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]; var vw4: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]

    var target: [f64; 50] = [0.0; 50]
    var y: [f64; 50] = [0.0; 50]
    var gy: [f64; 50] = [0.0; 50]
    var gw1: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]; var gb1: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var gw2: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]; var gb2: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var gw3: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]; var gb3: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var gw4: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var b4 = 0.5
    var mb4 = 0.0
    var vb4 = 0.0

    var j: usize = 0 as usize
    while j < hidden {
        w1[j] = (((j as f64) - 32.0) / 64.0) * 0.2
        b1[j] = -2.0 + 4.0 * (j as f64) / 63.0
        w2[j] = 1.0
        b2[j] = 0.0
        w3[j] = 1.0
        b3[j] = 0.0
        w4[j] = 0.01 * (((j % 7 as usize) as f64) - 3.0)
        j = j + 1 as usize
    }

    var i: usize = 0 as usize
    while i < n {
        target[i] = fractional_decay_ml(c0, k_phys, (i as f64) * dt, alpha)
        i = i + 1 as usize
    }

    var loss0 = 0.0
    var loss500 = 0.0
    var loss1000 = 0.0
    var loss2000 = 0.0
    var loss3000 = 0.0
    var loss4000 = 0.0
    var loss5000 = 0.0
    var final_data = 0.0
    var final_phys = 0.0
    var final_ic = 0.0
    var max_g1 = 0.0
    var max_g2 = 0.0
    var max_g3 = 0.0
    var beta1_pow = 1.0
    var beta2_pow = 1.0

    var epoch: usize = 1 as usize
    while epoch <= 5000 as usize {
        i = 0 as usize
        while i < n {
            let t = (i as f64) * dt
            var out = b4
            j = 0 as usize
            while j < hidden {
                let a1 = pinn_tanh(w1[j] * t + b1[j])
                let a2 = pinn_tanh(w2[j] * a1 + b2[j])
                let a3 = pinn_tanh(w3[j] * a2 + b3[j])
                out = out + w4[j] * a3
                j = j + 1 as usize
            }
            y[i] = out
            i = i + 1 as usize
        }

        var data_loss = 0.0
        i = 0 as usize
        while i < n {
            let diff = y[i] - target[i]
            data_loss = data_loss + diff * diff
            gy[i] = 2.0 * diff / (n as f64)
            i = i + 1 as usize
        }
        data_loss = data_loss / (n as f64)

        let lambda_phys = if epoch < 500 as usize { (epoch as f64) / 500.0 } else { 1.0 }
        var phys_loss = 0.0
        i = 1 as usize
        while i < n {
            var deriv = 0.0
            var m: usize = 0 as usize
            while m <= i {
                deriv = deriv + d6_full_caputo_coeff(i, m, alpha, dt) * y[m]
                m = m + 1 as usize
            }
            let resid = deriv + k_phys * y[i]
            phys_loss = phys_loss + resid * resid
            m = 0 as usize
            while m <= i {
                let coeff = d6_full_caputo_coeff(i, m, alpha, dt)
                gy[m] = gy[m] + lambda_phys * 2.0 * resid * coeff / ((n - 1 as usize) as f64)
                m = m + 1 as usize
            }
            gy[i] = gy[i] + lambda_phys * 2.0 * resid * k_phys / ((n - 1 as usize) as f64)
            i = i + 1 as usize
        }
        phys_loss = phys_loss / ((n - 1 as usize) as f64)
        let ic_loss = (y[0] - c0) * (y[0] - c0)
        gy[0] = gy[0] + 2.0 * (y[0] - c0)
        let total_loss = data_loss + lambda_phys * phys_loss + ic_loss

        if epoch == 1 as usize { loss0 = total_loss }
        if epoch == 500 as usize { loss500 = total_loss }
        if epoch == 1000 as usize { loss1000 = total_loss }
        if epoch == 2000 as usize { loss2000 = total_loss }
        if epoch == 3000 as usize { loss3000 = total_loss }
        if epoch == 4000 as usize { loss4000 = total_loss }
        if epoch == 5000 as usize {
            loss5000 = total_loss
            final_data = data_loss
            final_phys = phys_loss
            final_ic = ic_loss
        }

        j = 0 as usize
        while j < hidden {
            gw1[j] = 0.0; gb1[j] = 0.0
            gw2[j] = 0.0; gb2[j] = 0.0
            gw3[j] = 0.0; gb3[j] = 0.0
            gw4[j] = 0.0
            j = j + 1 as usize
        }
        var gb4_acc = 0.0
        i = 0 as usize
        while i < n {
            let t = (i as f64) * dt
            let go = gy[i]
            gb4_acc = gb4_acc + go
            j = 0 as usize
            while j < hidden {
                let a1 = pinn_tanh(w1[j] * t + b1[j])
                let a2 = pinn_tanh(w2[j] * a1 + b2[j])
                let a3 = pinn_tanh(w3[j] * a2 + b3[j])
                gw4[j] = gw4[j] + go * a3
                let gz3 = go * w4[j] * (1.0 - a3 * a3)
                gw3[j] = gw3[j] + gz3 * a2
                gb3[j] = gb3[j] + gz3
                let gz2 = gz3 * w3[j] * (1.0 - a2 * a2)
                gw2[j] = gw2[j] + gz2 * a1
                gb2[j] = gb2[j] + gz2
                let gz1 = gz2 * w2[j] * (1.0 - a1 * a1)
                gw1[j] = gw1[j] + gz1 * t
                gb1[j] = gb1[j] + gz1
                j = j + 1 as usize
            }
            i = i + 1 as usize
        }

        var norm2 = gb4_acc * gb4_acc
        j = 0 as usize
        while j < hidden {
            norm2 = norm2 + gw1[j]*gw1[j] + gb1[j]*gb1[j] + gw2[j]*gw2[j] + gb2[j]*gb2[j] + gw3[j]*gw3[j] + gb3[j]*gb3[j] + gw4[j]*gw4[j]
            if pinn_abs(gw1[j]) > max_g1 { max_g1 = pinn_abs(gw1[j]) }
            if pinn_abs(gw2[j]) > max_g2 { max_g2 = pinn_abs(gw2[j]) }
            if pinn_abs(gw3[j]) > max_g3 { max_g3 = pinn_abs(gw3[j]) }
            j = j + 1 as usize
        }
        let grad_norm = pinn_sqrt(norm2)
        var grad_scale = 1.0
        if grad_norm > 1.0 { grad_scale = 1.0 / grad_norm }

        beta1_pow = beta1_pow * beta1
        beta2_pow = beta2_pow * beta2
        let corr1 = 1.0 - beta1_pow
        let corr2 = 1.0 - beta2_pow

        j = 0 as usize
        while j < hidden {
            let g1 = gw1[j] * grad_scale
            mw1[j] = beta1 * mw1[j] + (1.0 - beta1) * g1
            vw1[j] = beta2 * vw1[j] + (1.0 - beta2) * g1 * g1
            w1[j] = w1[j] - lr * (mw1[j] / corr1) / (pinn_sqrt(vw1[j] / corr2) + adam_eps)

            let gb1v = gb1[j] * grad_scale
            mb1[j] = beta1 * mb1[j] + (1.0 - beta1) * gb1v
            vb1[j] = beta2 * vb1[j] + (1.0 - beta2) * gb1v * gb1v
            b1[j] = b1[j] - lr * (mb1[j] / corr1) / (pinn_sqrt(vb1[j] / corr2) + adam_eps)

            let g2 = gw2[j] * grad_scale
            mw2[j] = beta1 * mw2[j] + (1.0 - beta1) * g2
            vw2[j] = beta2 * vw2[j] + (1.0 - beta2) * g2 * g2
            w2[j] = w2[j] - lr * (mw2[j] / corr1) / (pinn_sqrt(vw2[j] / corr2) + adam_eps)

            let gb2v = gb2[j] * grad_scale
            mb2[j] = beta1 * mb2[j] + (1.0 - beta1) * gb2v
            vb2[j] = beta2 * vb2[j] + (1.0 - beta2) * gb2v * gb2v
            b2[j] = b2[j] - lr * (mb2[j] / corr1) / (pinn_sqrt(vb2[j] / corr2) + adam_eps)

            let g3 = gw3[j] * grad_scale
            mw3[j] = beta1 * mw3[j] + (1.0 - beta1) * g3
            vw3[j] = beta2 * vw3[j] + (1.0 - beta2) * g3 * g3
            w3[j] = w3[j] - lr * (mw3[j] / corr1) / (pinn_sqrt(vw3[j] / corr2) + adam_eps)

            let gb3v = gb3[j] * grad_scale
            mb3[j] = beta1 * mb3[j] + (1.0 - beta1) * gb3v
            vb3[j] = beta2 * vb3[j] + (1.0 - beta2) * gb3v * gb3v
            b3[j] = b3[j] - lr * (mb3[j] / corr1) / (pinn_sqrt(vb3[j] / corr2) + adam_eps)

            let g4 = gw4[j] * grad_scale
            mw4[j] = beta1 * mw4[j] + (1.0 - beta1) * g4
            vw4[j] = beta2 * vw4[j] + (1.0 - beta2) * g4 * g4
            w4[j] = w4[j] - lr * (mw4[j] / corr1) / (pinn_sqrt(vw4[j] / corr2) + adam_eps)
            j = j + 1 as usize
        }
        let gb4v = gb4_acc * grad_scale
        mb4 = beta1 * mb4 + (1.0 - beta1) * gb4v
        vb4 = beta2 * vb4 + (1.0 - beta2) * gb4v * gb4v
        b4 = b4 - lr * (mb4 / corr1) / (pinn_sqrt(vb4 / corr2) + adam_eps)
        epoch = epoch + 1 as usize
    }

    var heldout = 0.0
    i = 0 as usize
    while i < 100 as usize {
        let t = 24.0 * (i as f64) / 99.0
        var out = b4
        j = 0 as usize
        while j < hidden {
            let a1 = pinn_tanh(w1[j] * t + b1[j])
            let a2 = pinn_tanh(w2[j] * a1 + b2[j])
            let a3 = pinn_tanh(w3[j] * a2 + b3[j])
            out = out + w4[j] * a3
            j = j + 1 as usize
        }
        let truth = fractional_decay_ml(c0, k_phys, t, alpha)
        let diff = out - truth
        heldout = heldout + diff * diff
        i = i + 1 as usize
    }

    D6FullIntegrationResult {
        epochs: 5000 as usize,
        loss_0: loss0,
        loss_500: loss500,
        loss_1000: loss1000,
        loss_2000: loss2000,
        loss_3000: loss3000,
        loss_4000: loss4000,
        loss_5000: loss5000,
        final_data: final_data,
        final_phys: final_phys,
        final_ic: final_ic,
        heldout_l2: pinn_sqrt(heldout / 100.0),
        phys_residual_mean: final_phys,
        ic_residual: pinn_sqrt(final_ic),
        layer1_grad_max: max_g1,
        layer2_grad_max: max_g2,
        layer3_grad_max: max_g3,
    }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/nn/quaternion.sio ===
//! stdlib/nn/quaternion.sio
//!
//! Quaternion Neural Networks - Epistemically Aware Quaternion Types
//!
//! This module implements quaternion arithmetic with full epistemic uncertainty
//! propagation, enabling neuro-symbolic computing with spatial-temporal data
//! for PBPK modeling, EEG/ECG analysis, and genomic/proteomic applications.
//!
//! # Philosophy
//!
//! Traditional quaternion: q = w + xi + yj + zk
//! Epistemic quaternion: q = (w ± σw) + (x ± σx)i + (y ± σy)j + (z ± σz)k
//!                       with confidence c ∈ [0,1] and provenance tracking
//!
//! Every quaternion operation propagates uncertainty using the delta method
//! and maintains confidence through transformation chains.

use epistemic::lib::{EpistemicValue, uncertainty_std, epistemic_std, add_epistemic, sub_epistemic, mul_epistemic, div_epistemic, uncert_to_std}

// ============================================================================
// LOCAL CONFIDENCE TYPE (simplified Beta-posterior confidence)
// ============================================================================

// Lightweight confidence representation for quaternion operations
// Mirrors BetaConfidence semantics: alpha/(alpha+beta) = mean confidence
struct QuatConfidence {
    alpha: f64,
    beta_param: f64,
}

fn qconf_strong(center: f64, strength: f64) -> QuatConfidence {
    let a = center * strength + 1.0
    let b = (1.0 - center) * strength + 1.0
    QuatConfidence { alpha: a, beta_param: b }
}

fn qconf_from_rate(rate: f64, n: f64) -> QuatConfidence {
    let a = rate * n + 1.0
    let b = (1.0 - rate) * n + 1.0
    QuatConfidence { alpha: a, beta_param: b }
}

fn qconf_mean(c: QuatConfidence) -> f64 {
    c.alpha / (c.alpha + c.beta_param)
}

fn qconf_combine(a: QuatConfidence, b: QuatConfidence) -> QuatConfidence {
    var al = a.alpha + b.alpha - 1.0
    var be = a.beta_param + b.beta_param - 1.0
    if al < 0.0001 { al = 0.0001 }
    if be < 0.0001 { be = 0.0001 }
    QuatConfidence { alpha: al, beta_param: be }
}

fn qconf_decay(c: QuatConfidence, factor: f64) -> QuatConfidence {
    let m = qconf_mean(c)
    let n = (c.alpha + c.beta_param) * factor
    qconf_from_rate(m, n)
}

// ============================================================================
// QUATERNION CORE TYPE
// ============================================================================

// Quaternion with epistemic uncertainty and confidence
//
// Represents: q = w + xi + yj + zk
// Where each component w, x, y, z is an EpistemicValue
pub struct Quaternion {
    /// Real part w
    w: EpistemicValue,

    /// Imaginary part x (coefficient of i)
    x: EpistemicValue,

    /// Imaginary part y (coefficient of j)
    y: EpistemicValue,

    /// Imaginary part z (coefficient of k)
    z: EpistemicValue,

    /// Confidence in the quaternion as a whole
    confidence: QuatConfidence,

    /// Provenance tracking
    provenance_id: i64,
}

// ============================================================================
// CONSTRUCTORS
// ============================================================================

// Create quaternion from exact components (maximum confidence)
fn quaternion_exact(w: f64, x: f64, y: f64, z: f64) -> Quaternion {
    let comp_confidence = 0.99
    Quaternion {
        w: epistemic_std(w, 0.0, comp_confidence),
        x: epistemic_std(x, 0.0, comp_confidence),
        y: epistemic_std(y, 0.0, comp_confidence),
        z: epistemic_std(z, 0.0, comp_confidence),
        confidence: qconf_strong(0.99, 1000.0),
        provenance_id: 0,
    }
}

// Create quaternion with uncertainty in each component
fn quaternion_uncertain(
    w: f64, w_unc: f64, w_conf: f64,
    x: f64, x_unc: f64, x_conf: f64,
    y: f64, y_unc: f64, y_conf: f64,
    z: f64, z_unc: f64, z_conf: f64
) -> Quaternion {
    let min_conf = min_f64(min_f64(min_f64(w_conf, x_conf), y_conf), z_conf)
    Quaternion {
        w: epistemic_std(w, w_unc, w_conf),
        x: epistemic_std(x, x_unc, x_conf),
        y: epistemic_std(y, y_unc, y_conf),
        z: epistemic_std(z, z_unc, z_conf),
        confidence: qconf_from_rate(min_conf, 100.0),
        provenance_id: 0,
    }
}

// Create quaternion representing pure rotation around axis
// angle: rotation angle in radians
// axis_x, axis_y, axis_z: rotation axis (automatically normalized)
fn quaternion_from_axis_angle(angle: f64, axis_x: f64, axis_y: f64, axis_z: f64) -> Quaternion {
    let half_angle = angle / 2.0
    let sin_half = sin_f64(half_angle)
    let cos_half = cos_f64(half_angle)

    // Normalize axis
    let norm = sqrt_f64(axis_x * axis_x + axis_y * axis_y + axis_z * axis_z)
    let nx = if norm > 1.0e-10 { axis_x / norm } else { 0.0 }
    let ny = if norm > 1.0e-10 { axis_y / norm } else { 0.0 }
    let nz = if norm > 1.0e-10 { axis_z / norm } else { 0.0 }

    quaternion_exact(
        cos_half,
        sin_half * nx,
        sin_half * ny,
        sin_half * nz
    )
}

// Create identity quaternion (no rotation)
fn quaternion_identity() -> Quaternion {
    quaternion_exact(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
}

// Create zero quaternion
fn quaternion_zero() -> Quaternion {
    quaternion_exact(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
}

// ============================================================================
// ACCESSORS
// ============================================================================

fn quaternion_get_w(q: Quaternion) -> f64 {
    q.w.value
}

fn quaternion_get_x(q: Quaternion) -> f64 {
    q.x.value
}

fn quaternion_get_y(q: Quaternion) -> f64 {
    q.y.value
}

fn quaternion_get_z(q: Quaternion) -> f64 {
    q.z.value
}

fn quaternion_get_confidence(q: Quaternion) -> f64 {
    qconf_mean(q.confidence)
}

fn quaternion_get_std_w(q: Quaternion) -> f64 {
    uncert_to_std(q.w.uncert)
}

fn quaternion_get_std_x(q: Quaternion) -> f64 {
    uncert_to_std(q.x.uncert)
}

fn quaternion_get_std_y(q: Quaternion) -> f64 {
    uncert_to_std(q.y.uncert)
}

fn quaternion_get_std_z(q: Quaternion) -> f64 {
    uncert_to_std(q.z.uncert)
}

// ============================================================================
// BASIC QUATERNION OPERATIONS
// ============================================================================

// Quaternion conjugate: q* = w - xi - yj - zk
fn quaternion_conjugate(q: Quaternion) -> Quaternion {
    Quaternion {
        w: q.w,
        x: sub_epistemic(q.x, q.x), // x - x = 0, preserves uncertainty
        y: sub_epistemic(q.y, q.y), // y - y = 0, preserves uncertainty
        z: sub_epistemic(q.z, q.z), // z - z = 0, preserves uncertainty
        confidence: qconf_decay(q.confidence, 0.98),
        provenance_id: q.provenance_id + 1,
    }
}

// Quaternion norm: ||q|| = sqrt(w² + x² + y² + z²)
fn quaternion_norm(q: Quaternion) -> EpistemicValue {
    let w2 = mul_epistemic(q.w, q.w)
    let x2 = mul_epistemic(q.x, q.x)
    let y2 = mul_epistemic(q.y, q.y)
    let z2 = mul_epistemic(q.z, q.z)

    let sum = add_epistemic(add_epistemic(w2, x2), add_epistemic(y2, z2))

    // sqrt using series expansion for uncertainty propagation
    let norm_value = sqrt_f64(sum.value)
    let sum_std = uncert_to_std(sum.uncert)
    let std_combined = if norm_value > 1.0e-10 { sum_std / (2.0 * norm_value) } else { sum_std }

    epistemic_std(norm_value, std_combined, qconf_mean(q.confidence))
}

// Quaternion inverse: q⁻¹ = q*/||q||²
fn quaternion_inverse(q: Quaternion) -> Quaternion {
    let norm_sq = quaternion_norm_squared(q)
    let one = epistemic_std(1.0, 0.0, 1.0)

    let inv_norm_sq = div_epistemic(one, norm_sq)
    let conj = quaternion_conjugate(q)

    quaternion_mul_scalar(conj, inv_norm_sq)
}

// Quaternion norm squared: ||q||² = w² + x² + y² + z²
fn quaternion_norm_squared(q: Quaternion) -> EpistemicValue {
    let w2 = mul_epistemic(q.w, q.w)
    let x2 = mul_epistemic(q.x, q.x)
    let y2 = mul_epistemic(q.y, q.y)
    let z2 = mul_epistemic(q.z, q.z)

    add_epistemic(add_epistemic(w2, x2), add_epistemic(y2, z2))
}

// ============================================================================
// QUATERNION ARITHMETIC
// ============================================================================

// Quaternion multiplication: (a_w + a_x i + a_y j + a_z k) * (b_w + b_x i + b_y j + b_z k)
//
// Result:
// w = a_w*b_w - a_x*b_x - a_y*b_y - a_z*b_z
// x = a_w*b_x + a_x*b_w + a_y*b_z - a_z*b_y
// y = a_w*b_y - a_x*b_z + a_y*b_w + a_z*b_x
// z = a_w*b_z + a_x*b_y - a_y*b_x + a_z*b_w
fn quaternion_mul(a: Quaternion, b: Quaternion) -> Quaternion {
    let w = sub_epistemic(
        sub_epistemic(sub_epistemic(
            mul_epistemic(a.w, b.w),
            mul_epistemic(a.x, b.x)
        ), mul_epistemic(a.y, b.y)),
        mul_epistemic(a.z, b.z)
    )

    let x_fixed = add_epistemic(
        add_epistemic(mul_epistemic(a.w, b.x), mul_epistemic(a.x, b.w)),
        sub_epistemic(mul_epistemic(a.y, b.z), mul_epistemic(a.z, b.y))
    )

    let y = sub_epistemic(
        add_epistemic(
            add_epistemic(mul_epistemic(a.w, b.y), mul_epistemic(a.x, b.z)),
            mul_epistemic(a.y, b.w)
        ),
        mul_epistemic(a.z, b.x)
    )

    let z = add_epistemic(
        add_epistemic(
            sub_epistemic(mul_epistemic(a.w, b.z), mul_epistemic(a.x, b.y)),
            mul_epistemic(a.y, b.x)
        ),
        mul_epistemic(a.z, b.w)
    )

    let min_conf = min_f64(min_f64(min_f64(qconf_mean(a.confidence), qconf_mean(b.confidence)),
                                  min_f64(a.w.conf, b.w.conf)),
                          min_f64(min_f64(a.x.conf, b.x.conf),
                                 min_f64(a.y.conf, b.y.conf)))

    Quaternion {
        w: w,
        x: x_fixed,
        y: y,
        z: z,
        confidence: qconf_from_rate(min_conf, 50.0),
        provenance_id: max_i64(a.provenance_id, b.provenance_id) + 1,
    }
}

// Quaternion addition: (a_w + b_w) + (a_x + b_x)i + (a_y + b_y)j + (a_z + b_z)k
fn quaternion_add(a: Quaternion, b: Quaternion) -> Quaternion {
    Quaternion {
        w: add_epistemic(a.w, b.w),
        x: add_epistemic(a.x, b.x),
        y: add_epistemic(a.y, b.y),
        z: add_epistemic(a.z, b.z),
        confidence: qconf_decay(qconf_combine(a.confidence, b.confidence), 0.99),
        provenance_id: max_i64(a.provenance_id, b.provenance_id) + 1,
    }
}

// Quaternion subtraction: (a_w - b_w) + (a_x - b_x)i + (a_y - b_y)j + (a_z - b_z)k
fn quaternion_sub(a: Quaternion, b: Quaternion) -> Quaternion {
    Quaternion {
        w: sub_epistemic(a.w, b.w),
        x: sub_epistemic(a.x, b.x),
        y: sub_epistemic(a.y, b.y),
        z: sub_epistemic(a.z, b.z),
        confidence: qconf_decay(qconf_combine(a.confidence, b.confidence), 0.99),
        provenance_id: max_i64(a.provenance_id, b.provenance_id) + 1,
    }
}

// Scalar multiplication: s * (w + xi + yj + zk)
fn quaternion_mul_scalar(q: Quaternion, s: EpistemicValue) -> Quaternion {
    Quaternion {
        w: mul_epistemic(q.w, s),
        x: mul_epistemic(q.x, s),
        y: mul_epistemic(q.y, s),
        z: mul_epistemic(q.z, s),
        confidence: qconf_decay(q.confidence, 0.98),
        provenance_id: q.provenance_id + 1,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// QUATERNION ROTATIONS
// ============================================================================

// Rotate vector (x, y, z) by quaternion q
// Result: q * v * q⁻¹ where v = (0, x, y, z)
fn quaternion_rotate_vector(q: Quaternion, v_x: f64, v_y: f64, v_z: f64) -> (EpistemicValue, EpistemicValue, EpistemicValue) {
    let v = quaternion_exact(0.0, v_x, v_y, v_z)
    let q_inv = quaternion_inverse(q)
    let rotated = quaternion_mul(quaternion_mul(q, v), q_inv)

    (rotated.x, rotated.y, rotated.z)
}

// Spherical linear interpolation between quaternions
fn quaternion_slerp(q1: Quaternion, q2: Quaternion, t: f64) -> Quaternion {
    let dot_product = quaternion_dot(q1, q2)

    // Clamp dot product to [-1, 1] for numerical stability
    let dot_clamped = max_f64(min_f64(dot_product, 1.0), -1.0)
    let theta = acos_f64(dot_clamped)

    if abs_f64(theta) < 1.0e-5 {
        // Quaternions are very similar - use linear interpolation
        return quaternion_add(quaternion_mul_scalar(q1, epistemic_std(1.0 - t, 0.0, 1.0)),
                           quaternion_mul_scalar(q2, epistemic_std(t, 0.0, 1.0)))
    }

    let sin_theta = sin_f64(theta)
    let w1 = sin_f64((1.0 - t) * theta) / sin_theta
    let w2 = sin_f64(t * theta) / sin_theta

    let w1_ep = epistemic_std(w1, 0.0, 1.0)
    let w2_ep = epistemic_std(w2, 0.0, 1.0)

    quaternion_add(quaternion_mul_scalar(q1, w1_ep), quaternion_mul_scalar(q2, w2_ep))
}

// Dot product between quaternions (component-wise)
fn quaternion_dot(a: Quaternion, b: Quaternion) -> f64 {
    a.w.value * b.w.value + a.x.value * b.x.value + a.y.value * b.y.value + a.z.value * b.z.value
}

// ============================================================================
// NEURAL NETWORK SPECIFIC OPERATIONS
// ============================================================================

// Quaternion ReLU activation component-wise
fn quaternion_relu(q: Quaternion) -> Quaternion {
    Quaternion {
        w: if q.w.value > 0.0 { q.w } else { epistemic_std(0.0, uncert_to_std(q.w.uncert), q.w.conf) },
        x: if q.x.value > 0.0 { q.x } else { epistemic_std(0.0, uncert_to_std(q.x.uncert), q.x.conf) },
        y: if q.y.value > 0.0 { q.y } else { epistemic_std(0.0, uncert_to_std(q.y.uncert), q.y.conf) },
        z: if q.z.value > 0.0 { q.z } else { epistemic_std(0.0, uncert_to_std(q.z.uncert), q.z.conf) },
        confidence: qconf_decay(q.confidence, 0.95),
        provenance_id: q.provenance_id + 1,
    }
}

// Quaternion Sigmoid activation component-wise
fn quaternion_sigmoid(q: Quaternion) -> Quaternion {
    let sigmoid_w = sigmoid_f64(q.w.value)
    let sigmoid_x = sigmoid_f64(q.x.value)
    let sigmoid_y = sigmoid_f64(q.y.value)
    let sigmoid_z = sigmoid_f64(q.z.value)

    // Propagate uncertainty through sigmoid using delta method
    let dsigmoid_w = sigmoid_w * (1.0 - sigmoid_w)
    let dsigmoid_x = sigmoid_x * (1.0 - sigmoid_x)
    let dsigmoid_y = sigmoid_y * (1.0 - sigmoid_y)
    let dsigmoid_z = sigmoid_z * (1.0 - sigmoid_z)

    Quaternion {
        w: epistemic_std(sigmoid_w, uncert_to_std(q.w.uncert) * abs_f64(dsigmoid_w), q.w.conf),
        x: epistemic_std(sigmoid_x, uncert_to_std(q.x.uncert) * abs_f64(dsigmoid_x), q.x.conf),
        y: epistemic_std(sigmoid_y, uncert_to_std(q.y.uncert) * abs_f64(dsigmoid_y), q.y.conf),
        z: epistemic_std(sigmoid_z, uncert_to_std(q.z.uncert) * abs_f64(dsigmoid_z), q.z.conf),
        confidence: qconf_decay(q.confidence, 0.95),
        provenance_id: q.provenance_id + 1,
    }
}

// Quaternion Tanh activation component-wise
fn quaternion_tanh(q: Quaternion) -> Quaternion {
    let tanh_w = tanh_f64(q.w.value)
    let tanh_x = tanh_f64(q.x.value)
    let tanh_y = tanh_f64(q.y.value)
    let tanh_z = tanh_f64(q.z.value)

    // Propagate uncertainty through tanh using delta method
    let dtanh_w = 1.0 - tanh_w * tanh_w
    let dtanh_x = 1.0 - tanh_x * tanh_x
    let dtanh_y = 1.0 - tanh_y * tanh_y
    let dtanh_z = 1.0 - tanh_z * tanh_z

    Quaternion {
        w: epistemic_std(tanh_w, uncert_to_std(q.w.uncert) * abs_f64(dtanh_w), q.w.conf),
        x: epistemic_std(tanh_x, uncert_to_std(q.x.uncert) * abs_f64(dtanh_x), q.x.conf),
        y: epistemic_std(tanh_y, uncert_to_std(q.y.uncert) * abs_f64(dtanh_y), q.y.conf),
        z: epistemic_std(tanh_z, uncert_to_std(q.z.uncert) * abs_f64(dtanh_z), q.z.conf),
        confidence: qconf_decay(q.confidence, 0.95),
        provenance_id: q.provenance_id + 1,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// UTILITY FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

fn min_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a < b { a } else { b }
}

fn max_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { a } else { b }
}

fn max_i64(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 {
    if a > b { a } else { b }
}

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var guess = x / 2.0
    if guess < 1.0 { guess = 1.0 }
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 {
        guess = (guess + x / guess) / 2.0
        i = i + 1
    }
    guess
}

fn sin_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    let pi = 3.141592653589793
    var y = x
    while y > pi { y = y - 2.0 * pi }
    while y < 0.0 - pi { y = y + 2.0 * pi }
    let y2 = y * y
    var sum = y
    var term = y
    term = term * (0.0 - y2) / 6.0
    sum = sum + term
    term = term * (0.0 - y2) / 20.0
    sum = sum + term
    term = term * (0.0 - y2) / 42.0
    sum = sum + term
    sum
}

fn cos_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    let pi = 3.141592653589793
    var y = x
    while y > pi { y = y - 2.0 * pi }
    while y < 0.0 - pi { y = y + 2.0 * pi }
    let y2 = y * y
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    term = term * (0.0 - y2) / 2.0
    sum = sum + term
    term = term * (0.0 - y2) / 12.0
    sum = sum + term
    term = term * (0.0 - y2) / 30.0
    sum = sum + term
    term = term * (0.0 - y2) / 56.0
    sum = sum + term
    term = term * (0.0 - y2) / 90.0
    sum = sum + term
    sum
}

fn tanh_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    let exp_pos = exp_f64(x)
    let exp_neg = exp_f64(0.0 - x)
    (exp_pos - exp_neg) / (exp_pos + exp_neg)
}

fn sigmoid_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    1.0 / (1.0 + exp_f64(0.0 - x))
}

fn exp_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x > 20.0 { return exp_f64(x / 2.0) * exp_f64(x / 2.0) }
    if x < 0.0 - 20.0 { return 1.0 / exp_f64(0.0 - x) }
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 20 {
        term = term * x / i
        sum = sum + term
        i = i + 1
    }
    sum
}

fn acos_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    // Approximation for arccos
    let pi = 3.141592653589793
    if x >= 1.0 { return 0.0 }
    if x <= -1.0 { return pi }
    pi / 2.0 - asin_f64(x)
}

fn asin_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    // Approximation for arcsin
    if abs_f64(x) >= 1.0 { return if x > 0.0 { 1.5707963267948966 } else { -1.5707963267948966 } }
    let x2 = x * x
    var sum = x
    var term = x
    term = term * x2 / 6.0
    sum = sum + term
    term = term * x2 * 3.0 / 40.0
    sum = sum + term
    term = term * x2 * 5.0 / 112.0
    sum = sum + term
    sum
}

// === FILE: stdlib/nn/tensor.sio ===
// tensor.d - Basic tensor/vector types for neural networks
//
// Provides simple fixed-size vector operations needed for ML:
// - Tensor8: 8-element vector (common for small feature vectors)
// - Tensor16: 16-element vector (common for hidden layers)
// - Tensor32: 32-element vector (for larger layers)
//
// Operations: add, scale, dot product, hadamard product, norm
//
// These are stack-allocated for performance, no dynamic allocation.

// ============================================================================
// MATH HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn max_val(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { a } else { b }
}

fn min_val(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a < b { a } else { b }
}

fn sqrt_val(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var result = x
    result = 0.5 * (result + x / result)
    result = 0.5 * (result + x / result)
    result = 0.5 * (result + x / result)
    result = 0.5 * (result + x / result)
    result = 0.5 * (result + x / result)
    result = 0.5 * (result + x / result)
    result = 0.5 * (result + x / result)
    result = 0.5 * (result + x / result)
    result = 0.5 * (result + x / result)
    result = 0.5 * (result + x / result)
    return result
}


// ============================================================================
// TENSOR8 - 8-ELEMENT VECTOR
// ============================================================================

struct Tensor8 {
    e0: f64, e1: f64, e2: f64, e3: f64,
    e4: f64, e5: f64, e6: f64, e7: f64
}

fn tensor8_new(v0: f64, v1: f64, v2: f64, v3: f64, v4: f64, v5: f64, v6: f64, v7: f64) -> Tensor8 {
    return Tensor8 { e0: v0, e1: v1, e2: v2, e3: v3, e4: v4, e5: v5, e6: v6, e7: v7 }
}

fn tensor8_zero() -> Tensor8 {
    return Tensor8 { e0: 0.0, e1: 0.0, e2: 0.0, e3: 0.0, e4: 0.0, e5: 0.0, e6: 0.0, e7: 0.0 }
}

fn tensor8_ones() -> Tensor8 {
    return Tensor8 { e0: 1.0, e1: 1.0, e2: 1.0, e3: 1.0, e4: 1.0, e5: 1.0, e6: 1.0, e7: 1.0 }
}

fn tensor8_fill(val: f64) -> Tensor8 {
    return Tensor8 { e0: val, e1: val, e2: val, e3: val, e4: val, e5: val, e6: val, e7: val }
}

fn tensor8_add(a: Tensor8, b: Tensor8) -> Tensor8 {
    return Tensor8 {
        e0: a.e0 + b.e0, e1: a.e1 + b.e1, e2: a.e2 + b.e2, e3: a.e3 + b.e3,
        e4: a.e4 + b.e4, e5: a.e5 + b.e5, e6: a.e6 + b.e6, e7: a.e7 + b.e7
    }
}

fn tensor8_sub(a: Tensor8, b: Tensor8) -> Tensor8 {
    return Tensor8 {
        e0: a.e0 - b.e0, e1: a.e1 - b.e1, e2: a.e2 - b.e2, e3: a.e3 - b.e3,
        e4: a.e4 - b.e4, e5: a.e5 - b.e5, e6: a.e6 - b.e6, e7: a.e7 - b.e7
    }
}

fn tensor8_scale(vec: Tensor8, scalar: f64) -> Tensor8 {
    return Tensor8 {
        e0: vec.e0 * scalar, e1: vec.e1 * scalar, e2: vec.e2 * scalar, e3: vec.e3 * scalar,
        e4: vec.e4 * scalar, e5: vec.e5 * scalar, e6: vec.e6 * scalar, e7: vec.e7 * scalar
    }
}

fn tensor8_neg(vec: Tensor8) -> Tensor8 {
    return Tensor8 {
        e0: 0.0 - vec.e0, e1: 0.0 - vec.e1, e2: 0.0 - vec.e2, e3: 0.0 - vec.e3,
        e4: 0.0 - vec.e4, e5: 0.0 - vec.e5, e6: 0.0 - vec.e6, e7: 0.0 - vec.e7
    }
}

fn tensor8_dot(a: Tensor8, b: Tensor8) -> f64 {
    return a.e0 * b.e0 + a.e1 * b.e1 + a.e2 * b.e2 + a.e3 * b.e3
         + a.e4 * b.e4 + a.e5 * b.e5 + a.e6 * b.e6 + a.e7 * b.e7
}

fn tensor8_hadamard(a: Tensor8, b: Tensor8) -> Tensor8 {
    return Tensor8 {
        e0: a.e0 * b.e0, e1: a.e1 * b.e1, e2: a.e2 * b.e2, e3: a.e3 * b.e3,
        e4: a.e4 * b.e4, e5: a.e5 * b.e5, e6: a.e6 * b.e6, e7: a.e7 * b.e7
    }
}

fn tensor8_norm_sq(vec: Tensor8) -> f64 {
    return tensor8_dot(vec, vec)
}

fn tensor8_norm(vec: Tensor8) -> f64 {
    return sqrt_val(tensor8_norm_sq(vec))
}

fn tensor8_sum(vec: Tensor8) -> f64 {
    return vec.e0 + vec.e1 + vec.e2 + vec.e3 + vec.e4 + vec.e5 + vec.e6 + vec.e7
}

fn tensor8_mean(vec: Tensor8) -> f64 {
    return tensor8_sum(vec) / 8.0
}

fn tensor8_max(vec: Tensor8) -> f64 {
    let m01 = max_val(vec.e0, vec.e1)
    let m23 = max_val(vec.e2, vec.e3)
    let m45 = max_val(vec.e4, vec.e5)
    let m67 = max_val(vec.e6, vec.e7)
    let m03 = max_val(m01, m23)
    let m47 = max_val(m45, m67)
    return max_val(m03, m47)
}

fn tensor8_min(vec: Tensor8) -> f64 {
    let m01 = min_val(vec.e0, vec.e1)
    let m23 = min_val(vec.e2, vec.e3)
    let m45 = min_val(vec.e4, vec.e5)
    let m67 = min_val(vec.e6, vec.e7)
    let m03 = min_val(m01, m23)
    let m47 = min_val(m45, m67)
    return min_val(m03, m47)
}

// ============================================================================
// TENSOR16 - 16-ELEMENT VECTOR
// ============================================================================

struct Tensor16 {
    e0: f64, e1: f64, e2: f64, e3: f64, e4: f64, e5: f64, e6: f64, e7: f64,
    e8: f64, e9: f64, e10: f64, e11: f64, e12: f64, e13: f64, e14: f64, e15: f64
}

fn tensor16_zero() -> Tensor16 {
    return Tensor16 {
        e0: 0.0, e1: 0.0, e2: 0.0, e3: 0.0, e4: 0.0, e5: 0.0, e6: 0.0, e7: 0.0,
        e8: 0.0, e9: 0.0, e10: 0.0, e11: 0.0, e12: 0.0, e13: 0.0, e14: 0.0, e15: 0.0
    }
}

fn tensor16_ones() -> Tensor16 {
    return Tensor16 {
        e0: 1.0, e1: 1.0, e2: 1.0, e3: 1.0, e4: 1.0, e5: 1.0, e6: 1.0, e7: 1.0,
        e8: 1.0, e9: 1.0, e10: 1.0, e11: 1.0, e12: 1.0, e13: 1.0, e14: 1.0, e15: 1.0
    }
}

fn tensor16_fill(val: f64) -> Tensor16 {
    return Tensor16 {
        e0: val, e1: val, e2: val, e3: val, e4: val, e5: val, e6: val, e7: val,
        e8: val, e9: val, e10: val, e11: val, e12: val, e13: val, e14: val, e15: val
    }
}

fn tensor16_add(a: Tensor16, b: Tensor16) -> Tensor16 {
    return Tensor16 {
        e0: a.e0 + b.e0, e1: a.e1 + b.e1, e2: a.e2 + b.e2, e3: a.e3 + b.e3,
        e4: a.e4 + b.e4, e5: a.e5 + b.e5, e6: a.e6 + b.e6, e7: a.e7 + b.e7,
        e8: a.e8 + b.e8, e9: a.e9 + b.e9, e10: a.e10 + b.e10, e11: a.e11 + b.e11,
        e12: a.e12 + b.e12, e13: a.e13 + b.e13, e14: a.e14 + b.e14, e15: a.e15 + b.e15
    }
}

fn tensor16_sub(a: Tensor16, b: Tensor16) -> Tensor16 {
    return Tensor16 {
        e0: a.e0 - b.e0, e1: a.e1 - b.e1, e2: a.e2 - b.e2, e3: a.e3 - b.e3,
        e4: a.e4 - b.e4, e5: a.e5 - b.e5, e6: a.e6 - b.e6, e7: a.e7 - b.e7,
        e8: a.e8 - b.e8, e9: a.e9 - b.e9, e10: a.e10 - b.e10, e11: a.e11 - b.e11,
        e12: a.e12 - b.e12, e13: a.e13 - b.e13, e14: a.e14 - b.e14, e15: a.e15 - b.e15
    }
}

fn tensor16_scale(vec: Tensor16, scalar: f64) -> Tensor16 {
    return Tensor16 {
        e0: vec.e0 * scalar, e1: vec.e1 * scalar, e2: vec.e2 * scalar, e3: vec.e3 * scalar,
        e4: vec.e4 * scalar, e5: vec.e5 * scalar, e6: vec.e6 * scalar, e7: vec.e7 * scalar,
        e8: vec.e8 * scalar, e9: vec.e9 * scalar, e10: vec.e10 * scalar, e11: vec.e11 * scalar,
        e12: vec.e12 * scalar, e13: vec.e13 * scalar, e14: vec.e14 * scalar, e15: vec.e15 * scalar
    }
}

fn tensor16_neg(vec: Tensor16) -> Tensor16 {
    return Tensor16 {
        e0: 0.0 - vec.e0, e1: 0.0 - vec.e1, e2: 0.0 - vec.e2, e3: 0.0 - vec.e3,
        e4: 0.0 - vec.e4, e5: 0.0 - vec.e5, e6: 0.0 - vec.e6, e7: 0.0 - vec.e7,
        e8: 0.0 - vec.e8, e9: 0.0 - vec.e9, e10: 0.0 - vec.e10, e11: 0.0 - vec.e11,
        e12: 0.0 - vec.e12, e13: 0.0 - vec.e13, e14: 0.0 - vec.e14, e15: 0.0 - vec.e15
    }
}

fn tensor16_dot(a: Tensor16, b: Tensor16) -> f64 {
    return a.e0 * b.e0 + a.e1 * b.e1 + a.e2 * b.e2 + a.e3 * b.e3
         + a.e4 * b.e4 + a.e5 * b.e5 + a.e6 * b.e6 + a.e7 * b.e7
         + a.e8 * b.e8 + a.e9 * b.e9 + a.e10 * b.e10 + a.e11 * b.e11
         + a.e12 * b.e12 + a.e13 * b.e13 + a.e14 * b.e14 + a.e15 * b.e15
}

fn tensor16_hadamard(a: Tensor16, b: Tensor16) -> Tensor16 {
    return Tensor16 {
        e0: a.e0 * b.e0, e1: a.e1 * b.e1, e2: a.e2 * b.e2, e3: a.e3 * b.e3,
        e4: a.e4 * b.e4, e5: a.e5 * b.e5, e6: a.e6 * b.e6, e7: a.e7 * b.e7,
        e8: a.e8 * b.e8, e9: a.e9 * b.e9, e10: a.e10 * b.e10, e11: a.e11 * b.e11,
        e12: a.e12 * b.e12, e13: a.e13 * b.e13, e14: a.e14 * b.e14, e15: a.e15 * b.e15
    }
}

fn tensor16_norm_sq(vec: Tensor16) -> f64 {
    return tensor16_dot(vec, vec)
}

fn tensor16_norm(vec: Tensor16) -> f64 {
    return sqrt_val(tensor16_norm_sq(vec))
}

fn tensor16_sum(vec: Tensor16) -> f64 {
    return vec.e0 + vec.e1 + vec.e2 + vec.e3 + vec.e4 + vec.e5 + vec.e6 + vec.e7
         + vec.e8 + vec.e9 + vec.e10 + vec.e11 + vec.e12 + vec.e13 + vec.e14 + vec.e15
}

fn tensor16_mean(vec: Tensor16) -> f64 {
    return tensor16_sum(vec) / 16.0
}

fn tensor32_add(a: Tensor32, b: Tensor32) -> Tensor32 {
    return Tensor32 {

        e8: a.e8 + b.e8, e9: a.e9 + b.e9, e10: a.e10 + b.e10, e11: a.e11 + b.e11,

        e20: a.e20 + b.e20, e21: a.e21 + b.e21, e22: a.e22 + b.e22, e23: a.e23 + b.e23,
        e24: a.e24 + b.e24, e25: a.e25 + b.e25, e26: a.e26 + b.e26, e27: a.e27 + b.e27,

fn tensor32_scale(vec: Tensor32, scalar: f64) -> Tensor32 {
    return Tensor32 {
        e0: vec.e0 * scalar, e1: vec.e1 * scalar, e2: vec.e2 * scalar, e3: vec.e3 * scalar,
        e4: vec.e4 * scalar, e5: vec.e5 * scalar, e6: vec.e6 * scalar, e7: vec.e7 * scalar,
        e8: vec.e8 * scalar, e9: vec.e9 * scalar, e10: vec.e10 * scalar, e11: vec.e11 * scalar,
        e12: vec.e12 * scalar, e13: vec.e13 * scalar, e14: vec.e14 * scalar, e15: vec.e15 * scalar,
        e16: vec.e16 * scalar, e17: vec.e17 * scalar, e18: vec.e18 * scalar, e19: vec.e19 * scalar,
        e20: vec.e20 * scalar, e21: vec.e21 * scalar, e22: vec.e22 * scalar, e23: vec.e23 * scalar,
        e24: vec.e24 * scalar, e25: vec.e25 * scalar, e26: vec.e26 * scalar, e27: vec.e27 * scalar,
        e28: vec.e28 * scalar, e29: vec.e29 * scalar, e30: vec.e30 * scalar, e31: vec.e31 * scalar
    }
}

fn tensor32_dot(a: Tensor32, b: Tensor32) -> f64 {
    let sum0 = a.e0 * b.e0 + a.e1 * b.e1 + a.e2 * b.e2 + a.e3 * b.e3
    let sum1 = a.e4 * b.e4 + a.e5 * b.e5 + a.e6 * b.e6 + a.e7 * b.e7
    let sum2 = a.e8 * b.e8 + a.e9 * b.e9 + a.e10 * b.e10 + a.e11 * b.e11
    let sum3 = a.e12 * b.e12 + a.e13 * b.e13 + a.e14 * b.e14 + a.e15 * b.e15
    let sum4 = a.e16 * b.e16 + a.e17 * b.e17 + a.e18 * b.e18 + a.e19 * b.e19
    let sum5 = a.e20 * b.e20 + a.e21 * b.e21 + a.e22 * b.e22 + a.e23 * b.e23
    let sum6 = a.e24 * b.e24 + a.e25 * b.e25 + a.e26 * b.e26 + a.e27 * b.e27
    let sum7 = a.e28 * b.e28 + a.e29 * b.e29 + a.e30 * b.e30 + a.e31 * b.e31
    return sum0 + sum1 + sum2 + sum3 + sum4 + sum5 + sum6 + sum7
}

fn tensor32_norm(vec: Tensor32) -> f64 {
    return sqrt_val(tensor32_dot(vec, vec))
}

fn tensor32_sum(vec: Tensor32) -> f64 {
    let s0 = vec.e0 + vec.e1 + vec.e2 + vec.e3 + vec.e4 + vec.e5 + vec.e6 + vec.e7
    let s1 = vec.e8 + vec.e9 + vec.e10 + vec.e11 + vec.e12 + vec.e13 + vec.e14 + vec.e15
    let s2 = vec.e16 + vec.e17 + vec.e18 + vec.e19 + vec.e20 + vec.e21 + vec.e22 + vec.e23
    let s3 = vec.e24 + vec.e25 + vec.e26 + vec.e27 + vec.e28 + vec.e29 + vec.e30 + vec.e31
    return s0 + s1 + s2 + s3
}

module numerical


// === FILE: stdlib/numerical/linalg.sio ===
// stdlib/numerical/linalg.sio
//
// Fixed 7x7 f64 Cholesky-Banachiewicz factorization for small covariance and
// correlation matrices used by dissertation PBPK uncertainty propagation.

fn num_linalg_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn num_linalg_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var scaled = x
    var scale_back = 1.0
    while scaled < 1.0 {
        scaled = scaled * 4.0
        scale_back = scale_back * 2.0
    }
    while scaled > 4.0 {
        scaled = scaled * 0.25
        scale_back = scale_back * 0.5
    }
    var y = 1.5
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    return y / scale_back
}

pub struct Cholesky7 {
    l: [f64; 49],
    ok: bool,
    min_pivot: f64,
}

pub fn mat7_idx(r: i32, c: i32) -> i32 {
    return r * 7 + c
}

pub fn mat7_zero() -> [f64; 49] {
    return [0.0; 49]
}

pub fn mat7_identity() -> [f64; 49] with Mut, Panic {
    var a = mat7_zero()
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 7 {
        a[mat7_idx(i, i)] = 1.0
        i = i + 1
    }
    return a
}

pub fn mat7_set(a: [f64; 49], r: i32, c: i32, v: f64) -> [f64; 49] with Mut, Panic {
    var out = a
    out[mat7_idx(r, c)] = v
    return out
}
