// === FILE: stdlib/optimize/constrained.sio ===
// optimize::constrained — Box-Constrained and Penalty-Based Optimization
//
// Extends the unconstrained BFGS optimizer with:
//   1. Box constraints (lower/upper bounds on each parameter)
//   2. L-BFGS-B style projected gradient for bound-constrained problems
//   3. Penalty method for general inequality constraints
//   4. Augmented Lagrangian for equality constraints
//
// Scientific use cases:
//   - PBPK parameter estimation with physiological bounds
//     (e.g., clearance > 0, fraction unbound in [0,1])
//   - PK model fitting with regularization
//   - Population parameter estimation under constraints
//
// References:
//   - Byrd et al. (1995): L-BFGS-B algorithm
//   - Nocedal & Wright (2006): "Numerical Optimization" Ch. 17
//   - Conn, Gould, Toint (2000): "Trust Region Methods"

// ============================================================================
// Helpers
// ============================================================================

fn co_abs(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }
fn co_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }
fn co_min(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }
fn co_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 15 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

// ============================================================================
// BOX CONSTRAINTS
// ============================================================================

struct BoxConstraints {
    lower: [f64; 64],     // Lower bounds (-1e30 = unbounded)
    upper: [f64; 64],     // Upper bounds (+1e30 = unbounded)
    n: i64,
}

fn box_unconstrained(n: i64) -> BoxConstraints {
    BoxConstraints {
        lower: [-1.0e30; 64],
        upper: [1.0e30; 64],
        n: n,
    }
}

fn box_set_lower(bc: &!BoxConstraints, idx: i64, val: f64) {
    if idx >= 0 && idx < 64 { bc.lower[idx] = val }
}

fn box_set_upper(bc: &!BoxConstraints, idx: i64, val: f64) {
    if idx >= 0 && idx < 64 { bc.upper[idx] = val }
}

fn box_set_bounds(bc: &!BoxConstraints, idx: i64, lo: f64, hi: f64) {
    if idx >= 0 && idx < 64 { bc.lower[idx] = lo; bc.upper[idx] = hi }
}

// Project x onto feasible region [lower, upper]
// Project x onto feasible region [lower, upper] in-place
fn box_project(x: &![f64; 64], bc: &BoxConstraints) with Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < bc.n {
        if i < 64 {
            if x[i] < bc.lower[i] { x[i] = bc.lower[i] }
            if x[i] > bc.upper[i] { x[i] = bc.upper[i] }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Check if x is feasible
fn box_feasible(x: &[f64; 64], bc: &BoxConstraints) -> bool {
    var i = 0
    while i < bc.n {
        if i < 64 {
            if x[i] < bc.lower[i] - 1.0e-10 { return false }
            if x[i] > bc.upper[i] + 1.0e-10 { return false }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    true
}

// ============================================================================
// PROJECTED GRADIENT DESCENT (for box-constrained problems)
// ============================================================================

struct PGDConfig {
    max_iterations: i64,
    grad_tol: f64,
    step_size: f64,       // Initial step size
    step_decay: f64,      // Step decay factor on rejection (0.5 typical)
    fd_eps: f64,          // Finite difference step
}

fn pgd_config_default() -> PGDConfig {
    PGDConfig {
        max_iterations: 500,
        grad_tol: 1.0e-6,
        step_size: 0.01,
        step_decay: 0.5,
        fd_eps: 1.0e-7,
    }
}

struct OptResult {
    params: [f64; 64],
    n_params: i64,
    value: f64,
    converged: bool,
    iterations: i64,
    func_evals: i64,
}

fn opt_result_new(n: i64) -> OptResult {
    OptResult {
        params: [0.0; 64], n_params: n, value: 1.0e30,
        converged: false, iterations: 0, func_evals: 0,
    }
}

// Finite-difference gradient
fn compute_gradient(
    obj: fn(&[f64; 64], i64) -> f64,
    x: &[f64; 64], n: i64, eps: f64,
    grad: &![f64; 64], n_evals: &!i64
) with Mut {
    var x_pert: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        if i < 64 { x_pert[i] = x[i] }
        i = i + 1
    }

    i = 0
    while i < n {
        if i < 64 {
            let h = co_max(eps * co_abs(x[i]), eps)
            x_pert[i] = x[i] + h
            let f_plus = obj(&x_pert, n)
            x_pert[i] = x[i] - h
            let f_minus = obj(&x_pert, n)
            x_pert[i] = x[i]
            grad[i] = (f_plus - f_minus) / (2.0 * h)
            *n_evals = *n_evals + 2
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Projected gradient descent with Armijo line search
fn minimize_box_pgd(
    obj: fn(&[f64; 64], i64) -> f64,
    x0: [f64; 64],
    n: i64,
    bc: BoxConstraints,
    config: PGDConfig
) -> OptResult with Mut {
    var result = opt_result_new(n)
    var x: [f64; 64] = x0
    box_project(&!x, &bc)

    var f_val = obj(&x, n)
    result.func_evals = result.func_evals + 1
    var n_evals: i64 = 0
    var grad: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]

    var iter = 0
    while iter < config.max_iterations {
        // Compute gradient
        compute_gradient(obj, &x, n, config.fd_eps, &!grad, &!n_evals)
        result.func_evals = result.func_evals + n_evals
        n_evals = 0

        // Check gradient norm (projected)
        var grad_norm = 0.0
        var i = 0
        while i < n {
            if i < 64 {
                // Projected gradient: zero gradient at active bounds
                var gi = grad[i]
                if x[i] <= bc.lower[i] + 1.0e-12 && gi > 0.0 { gi = 0.0 }
                if x[i] >= bc.upper[i] - 1.0e-12 && gi < 0.0 { gi = 0.0 }
                grad_norm = grad_norm + gi * gi
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        grad_norm = co_sqrt(grad_norm)

        if grad_norm < config.grad_tol {
            result.converged = true
            result.iterations = iter
            i = 0
            while i < n { if i < 64 { result.params[i] = x[i] }; i = i + 1 }
            result.value = f_val
            return result
        }

        // Armijo line search with projection
        var alpha = config.step_size
        var found = false
        var ls_iter = 0
        while ls_iter < 30 && !found {
            var x_trial: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
            i = 0
            while i < n {
                if i < 64 { x_trial[i] = x[i] - alpha * grad[i] }
                i = i + 1
            }
            box_project(&!x_trial, &bc)

            let f_trial = obj(&x_trial, n)
            result.func_evals = result.func_evals + 1

            // Armijo condition: f(x_trial) <= f(x) - c1*alpha*||grad||²
            if f_trial <= f_val - 1.0e-4 * alpha * grad_norm * grad_norm {
                i = 0
                while i < n { if i < 64 { x[i] = x_trial[i] }; i = i + 1 }
                f_val = f_trial
                found = true
            } else {
                alpha = alpha * config.step_decay
            }
            ls_iter = ls_iter + 1
        }

        if !found {
            // Line search failed — try with smaller step
            config.step_size = config.step_size * 0.1
            if config.step_size < 1.0e-15 {
                result.iterations = iter
                var j = 0
                while j < n { if j < 64 { result.params[j] = x[j] }; j = j + 1 }
                result.value = f_val
                return result
            }
        }

        iter = iter + 1
    }

    result.iterations = iter
    var j = 0
    while j < n { if j < 64 { result.params[j] = x[j] }; j = j + 1 }
    result.value = f_val
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// PENALTY METHOD (for general inequality constraints g(x) <= 0)
// ============================================================================

// Convert constrained problem to unconstrained:
//   min f(x) + mu * sum(max(0, g_i(x))²)
//
// Increase mu across outer iterations until constraints satisfied.

struct PenaltyConfig {
    mu_init: f64,         // Initial penalty parameter
    mu_growth: f64,       // Growth factor per outer iteration (10 typical)
    mu_max: f64,          // Maximum penalty (1e12 typical)
    outer_iterations: i64, // Number of penalty outer loops
    inner_config: PGDConfig,
    bounds: BoxConstraints,
}

fn penalty_config_default(n: i64) -> PenaltyConfig {
    PenaltyConfig {
        mu_init: 1.0,
        mu_growth: 10.0,
        mu_max: 1.0e12,
        outer_iterations: 10,
        inner_config: pgd_config_default(),
        bounds: box_unconstrained(n),
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// CONVENIENCE: L-BFGS-B style minimize with box constraints
// ============================================================================

// Simple interface: minimize f(x) subject to lower <= x <= upper
fn minimize_bounded(
    obj: fn(&[f64; 64], i64) -> f64,
    x0: [f64; 64],
    n: i64,
    lower: [f64; 64],
    upper: [f64; 64]
) -> OptResult with Mut {
    let bc = BoxConstraints { lower: lower, upper: upper, n: n }
    let config = pgd_config_default()
    minimize_box_pgd(obj, x0, n, bc, config)
}

// Minimize with only lower bounds (e.g., all params > 0)
fn minimize_positive(
    obj: fn(&[f64; 64], i64) -> f64,
    x0: [f64; 64],
    n: i64
) -> OptResult with Mut {
    var bc = box_unconstrained(n)
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        if i < 64 { bc.lower[i] = 0.0 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    let config = pgd_config_default()
    minimize_box_pgd(obj, x0, n, bc, config)
}


// === FILE: stdlib/optimize/differential_evolution.sio ===
// optimize::differential_evolution — Differential Evolution Global Optimizer
//
// A population-based stochastic optimization algorithm for finding global
// optima. Particularly effective for non-convex, multi-modal, and high-
// dimensional problems.
//
// References:
// - Storn & Price (1997): "Differential Evolution - A Simple and Efficient Heuristic"
// - Price, Storn & Lampinen (2005): "Differential Evolution: A Practical Approach"

extern "C" {
    fn sqrt(x: f64) -> f64;
}

// ============================================================================
// CONFIG AND RESULT TYPES
// ============================================================================

struct DEConfig {
    pop_size: i64,
    max_generations: i64,
    F: f64,              // mutation scale factor [0,2]
    CR: f64,             // crossover probability [0,1]
    func_tol: f64,
    strategy: i32,       // 0=rand/1, 1=best/1
}

fn de_config_default() -> DEConfig {
    DEConfig {
        pop_size: 50,
        max_generations: 1000,
        F: 0.8,
        CR: 0.9,
        func_tol: 1e-8,
        strategy: 0,
    }
}

fn DE_TERM_MAX_GEN() -> i32 { 1 }
fn DE_TERM_FUNC_TOL() -> i32 { 2 }

fn de_termination_success(reason: i32) -> bool {
    reason >= 2
}

struct DEResult {
    params: [f64; 20],
    n_params: i64,
    value: f64,
    converged: bool,
    termination: i32,
    generations: i64,
    func_evals: i64,
}

fn de_result_new() -> DEResult {
    DEResult {
        params: [0.0; 20],
        n_params: 0,
        value: 1e308,
        converged: false,
        termination: DE_TERM_MAX_GEN(),
        generations: 0,
        func_evals: 0,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// SIMPLE LINEAR CONGRUENTIAL RNG
// ============================================================================

struct SimpleRng {
    state: i64,
}

fn rng_new(seed: i64) -> SimpleRng {
    SimpleRng { state: seed }
}

fn rng_next(r: SimpleRng) -> (SimpleRng, i64) {
    // LCG parameters (same as glibc)
    let a: i64 = 1103515245
    let c: i64 = 12345
    let m: i64 = 2147483648  // 2^31
    let new_state = (a * r.state + c) % m
    return (SimpleRng { state: new_state }, new_state)
}

fn rng_uniform(r: SimpleRng) -> (SimpleRng, f64) {
    let result = rng_next(r)
    let new_r = result.0
    let val = result.1
    let u = (val as f64) / 2147483648.0
    return (new_r, u)
}

fn rng_int_range(r: SimpleRng, low: i64, high: i64) -> (SimpleRng, i64) {
    let result = rng_uniform(r)
    let new_r = result.0
    let u = result.1
    let range = high - low
    let idx = low + (u * (range as f64)) as i64
    return (new_r, if idx >= high { high - 1 } else { idx })
}

// ============================================================================
// POPULATION STORAGE
// Max 100 individuals, each with 20 params
// ============================================================================

struct Population {
    individuals: [f64; 2000],  // 100 * 20
    fitness: [f64; 100],
    size: i64,
    n_params: i64,
    best_idx: i64,
}

fn pop_new(size: i64, n: i64) -> Population {
    Population {
        individuals: [0.0; 2000],
        fitness: [1e308; 100],
        size: size,
        n_params: n,
        best_idx: 0,
    }
}

fn pop_get(p: Population, idx: i64) -> [f64; 20] {
    var v: [f64; 20] = [0.0; 20]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < p.n_params {
        v[i as usize] = p.individuals[(idx * 20 + i) as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    return v
}

fn pop_set(p: Population, idx: i64, v: [f64; 20], fit: f64) -> Population {
    var pnew = p
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < p.n_params {
        pnew.individuals[(idx * 20 + i) as usize] = v[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    pnew.fitness[idx as usize] = fit

    // Update best if necessary
    if fit < pnew.fitness[pnew.best_idx as usize] {
        pnew.best_idx = idx
    }

    return pnew
}

fn pop_find_best(p: Population) -> i64 {
    var best: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < p.size {
        if p.fitness[i as usize] < p.fitness[best as usize] {
            best = i
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return best
}

fn pop_best_fitness(p: Population) -> f64 {
    let best = pop_find_best(p)
    return p.fitness[best as usize]
}

fn pop_worst_fitness(p: Population) -> f64 {
    var worst = p.fitness[0]
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < p.size {
        if p.fitness[i as usize] > worst {
            worst = p.fitness[i as usize]
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return worst
}

// ============================================================================
// TEST FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

fn rastrigin(params: [f64; 20], n: i64) -> f64 {
    let pi = 3.14159265358979323846
    var sum = 10.0 * (n as f64)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        let x = params[i as usize]
        sum = sum + x * x - 10.0 * cos_approx(2.0 * pi * x)
        i = i + 1
    }
    return sum
}

fn cos_approx(x: f64) -> f64 {
    // Cosine approximation using Taylor series
    // Reduce x to [-pi, pi]
    let pi = 3.14159265358979323846
    let two_pi = 2.0 * pi
    var y = x
    while y > pi {
        y = y - two_pi
    }
    while y < -pi {
        y = y + two_pi
    }
    // Taylor series for cos
    let y2 = y * y
    let y4 = y2 * y2
    let y6 = y4 * y2
    let y8 = y6 * y2
    return 1.0 - y2/2.0 + y4/24.0 - y6/720.0 + y8/40320.0
}

fn sphere(params: [f64; 20], n: i64) -> f64 {
    var sum = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        let x = params[i as usize]
        sum = sum + x * x
        i = i + 1
    }
    return sum
}

// ============================================================================
// DIFFERENTIAL EVOLUTION FOR SPHERE
// ============================================================================

fn de_sphere(lower: [f64; 20], upper: [f64; 20], n_params: i64, config: DEConfig) -> DEResult {
    var result = de_result_new()
    result.n_params = n_params

    let pop_size = if config.pop_size > 100 { 100 } else { config.pop_size }
    var pop = pop_new(pop_size, n_params)
    var rng = rng_new(12345)

    // Initialize population randomly
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < pop_size {
        var v: [f64; 20] = [0.0; 20]
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < n_params {
            let r = rng_uniform(rng)
            rng = r.0
            let u = r.1
            v[j as usize] = lower[j as usize] + u * (upper[j as usize] - lower[j as usize])
            j = j + 1
        }
        let fit = sphere(v, n_params)
        pop = pop_set(pop, i, v, fit)
        result.func_evals = result.func_evals + 1
        i = i + 1
    }

    var termination = DE_TERM_MAX_GEN()

    while result.generations < config.max_generations {
        result.generations = result.generations + 1

        // Check convergence
        let best_fit = pop_best_fitness(pop)
        let worst_fit = pop_worst_fitness(pop)
        if worst_fit - best_fit < config.func_tol {
            termination = DE_TERM_FUNC_TOL()
            break
        }

        // For each individual
        i = 0
        while i < pop_size {
            let target = pop_get(pop, i)

            // Select 3 distinct random individuals
            var r1: i64 = i
            while r1 == i {
                let sel = rng_int_range(rng, 0, pop_size)
                rng = sel.0
                r1 = sel.1
            }

            var r2: i64 = i
            while r2 == i || r2 == r1 {
                let sel = rng_int_range(rng, 0, pop_size)
                rng = sel.0
                r2 = sel.1
            }

            var r3: i64 = i
            while r3 == i || r3 == r1 || r3 == r2 {
                let sel = rng_int_range(rng, 0, pop_size)
                rng = sel.0
                r3 = sel.1
            }

            let x1 = pop_get(pop, r1)
            let x2 = pop_get(pop, r2)
            let x3 = pop_get(pop, r3)

            // Mutation: v = x1 + F * (x2 - x3)
            var mutant: [f64; 20] = [0.0; 20]
            var j: i64 = 0
            while j < n_params {
                mutant[j as usize] = x1[j as usize] + config.F * (x2[j as usize] - x3[j as usize])
                // Bound
                if mutant[j as usize] < lower[j as usize] {
                    mutant[j as usize] = lower[j as usize]
                }
                if mutant[j as usize] > upper[j as usize] {
                    mutant[j as usize] = upper[j as usize]
                }
                j = j + 1
            }

            // Crossover
            var trial: [f64; 20] = [0.0; 20]
            let jrand_sel = rng_int_range(rng, 0, n_params)
            rng = jrand_sel.0
            let jrand = jrand_sel.1

            j = 0
            while j < n_params {
                let r = rng_uniform(rng)
                rng = r.0
                let u = r.1

                if u < config.CR || j == jrand {
                    trial[j as usize] = mutant[j as usize]
                } else {
                    trial[j as usize] = target[j as usize]
                }
                j = j + 1
            }

            // Selection
            let fit_trial = sphere(trial, n_params)
            result.func_evals = result.func_evals + 1

            if fit_trial <= pop.fitness[i as usize] {
                pop = pop_set(pop, i, trial, fit_trial)
            }

            i = i + 1
        }
    }

    // Extract best
    let best_idx = pop_find_best(pop)
    result.params = pop_get(pop, best_idx)
    result.value = pop.fitness[best_idx as usize]
    result.termination = termination
    result.converged = de_termination_success(termination)

    return result
}

// ============================================================================
// DIFFERENTIAL EVOLUTION FOR RASTRIGIN
// ============================================================================

fn de_rastrigin(lower: [f64; 20], upper: [f64; 20], n_params: i64, config: DEConfig) -> DEResult {
    var result = de_result_new()
    result.n_params = n_params

    let pop_size = if config.pop_size > 100 { 100 } else { config.pop_size }
    var pop = pop_new(pop_size, n_params)
    var rng = rng_new(54321)

    // Initialize population
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < pop_size {
        var v: [f64; 20] = [0.0; 20]
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < n_params {
            let r = rng_uniform(rng)
            rng = r.0
            let u = r.1
            v[j as usize] = lower[j as usize] + u * (upper[j as usize] - lower[j as usize])
            j = j + 1
        }
        let fit = rastrigin(v, n_params)
        pop = pop_set(pop, i, v, fit)
        result.func_evals = result.func_evals + 1
        i = i + 1
    }

    var termination = DE_TERM_MAX_GEN()

    while result.generations < config.max_generations {
        result.generations = result.generations + 1

        let best_fit = pop_best_fitness(pop)
        let worst_fit = pop_worst_fitness(pop)
        if worst_fit - best_fit < config.func_tol {
            termination = DE_TERM_FUNC_TOL()
            break
        }

        i = 0
        while i < pop_size {
            let target = pop_get(pop, i)

            var r1: i64 = i
            while r1 == i {
                let sel = rng_int_range(rng, 0, pop_size)
                rng = sel.0
                r1 = sel.1
            }

            var r2: i64 = i
            while r2 == i || r2 == r1 {
                let sel = rng_int_range(rng, 0, pop_size)
                rng = sel.0
                r2 = sel.1
            }

            var r3: i64 = i
            while r3 == i || r3 == r1 || r3 == r2 {
                let sel = rng_int_range(rng, 0, pop_size)
                rng = sel.0
                r3 = sel.1
            }

            let x1 = pop_get(pop, r1)
            let x2 = pop_get(pop, r2)
            let x3 = pop_get(pop, r3)

            var mutant: [f64; 20] = [0.0; 20]
            var j: i64 = 0
            while j < n_params {
                mutant[j as usize] = x1[j as usize] + config.F * (x2[j as usize] - x3[j as usize])
                if mutant[j as usize] < lower[j as usize] {
                    mutant[j as usize] = lower[j as usize]
                }
                if mutant[j as usize] > upper[j as usize] {
                    mutant[j as usize] = upper[j as usize]
                }
                j = j + 1
            }

            var trial: [f64; 20] = [0.0; 20]
            let jrand_sel = rng_int_range(rng, 0, n_params)
            rng = jrand_sel.0
            let jrand = jrand_sel.1

            j = 0
            while j < n_params {
                let r = rng_uniform(rng)
                rng = r.0
                let u = r.1

                if u < config.CR || j == jrand {
                    trial[j as usize] = mutant[j as usize]
                } else {
                    trial[j as usize] = target[j as usize]
                }
                j = j + 1
            }

            let fit_trial = rastrigin(trial, n_params)
            result.func_evals = result.func_evals + 1

            if fit_trial <= pop.fitness[i as usize] {
                pop = pop_set(pop, i, trial, fit_trial)
            }

            i = i + 1
        }
    }

    let best_idx = pop_find_best(pop)
    result.params = pop_get(pop, best_idx)
    result.value = pop.fitness[best_idx as usize]
    result.termination = termination
    result.converged = de_termination_success(termination)

    return result
}

// === FILE: stdlib/optimize/epistemic_bfgs.sio ===
// stdlib/optimize/epistemic_bfgs.sio — Epistemic BFGS Optimizer
//
// BFGS quasi-Newton optimization with uncertainty-aware gradients.
// Gradients computed from epistemic autodiff carry uncertainty.
// Step size adapts based on gradient uncertainty.
//
// References:
//   JCGM 100:2008: "Evaluation of measurement data" (GUM)
//   Nocedal & Wright (2006): "Numerical Optimization"
//
// # Exemplo
// ```sio
// let result = epistemic_bfgs_optimize(initial, config);
// assert(result.converged);
// assert(result.final_uncertainty > 0.0);
// ```

// =============================================================================
// Math helpers
// =============================================================================

fn sqrt_eb(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

fn abs_eb(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn min_eb(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a < b { a } else { b }
}

fn max_eb(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { a } else { b }
}

// =============================================================================
// Epistemic Gradient
// =============================================================================

pub struct EpistemicGradient {
    values: [f64; 20],
    uncertainties: [f64; 20],
    confidences: [f64; 20],
    n: i32,
}

pub fn egrad_zeros(n: i32) -> EpistemicGradient with Panic {
    if n > 20 { panic("EpistemicGradient: n > 20") }
    EpistemicGradient {
        values: [0.0; 20],
        uncertainties: [0.0; 20],
        confidences: [1.0; 20],
        n: n,
    }
}

pub fn egrad_norm(g: &EpistemicGradient) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < g.n {
        sum = sum + g.values[i] * g.values[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    sqrt_eb(sum)
}

pub fn egrad_unc_norm(g: &EpistemicGradient) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < g.n {
        sum = sum + g.uncertainties[i] * g.uncertainties[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    sqrt_eb(sum)
}

pub fn egrad_min_conf(g: &EpistemicGradient) -> f64 {
    var min_c = 1.0
    var i = 0
    while i < g.n {
        if g.confidences[i] < min_c { min_c = g.confidences[i] }
        i = i + 1
    }
    min_c
}

// =============================================================================
// Epistemic Parameters
// =============================================================================

pub struct EpistemicParams {
    values: [f64; 20],
    uncertainties: [f64; 20],
    confidences: [f64; 20],
    n: i32,
}

pub fn eparams_zeros(n: i32) -> EpistemicParams with Panic {
    if n > 20 { panic("EpistemicParams: n > 20") }
    EpistemicParams {
        values: [0.0; 20],
        uncertainties: [0.0; 20],
        confidences: [1.0; 20],
        n: n,
    }
}

pub fn eparams_norm(p: &EpistemicParams) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < p.n {
        sum = sum + p.values[i] * p.values[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    sqrt_eb(sum)
}

// =============================================================================
// Epistemic Hessian Approximation
// =============================================================================

pub struct EpistemicHessian {
    values: [f64; 400],
    uncertainties: [f64; 400],
    confidences: [f64; 400],
    n: i32,
}

pub fn ehess_identity(n: i32) -> EpistemicHessian with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if n > 20 { panic("EpistemicHessian: n > 20") }
    var h = EpistemicHessian {
        values: [0.0; 400],
        uncertainties: [0.0; 400],
        confidences: [1.0; 400],
        n: n,
    }
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        h.values[(i * n + i) as usize] = 1.0
        i = i + 1
    }
    h
}

pub fn ehess_mat_vec(h: &EpistemicHessian, v: &EpistemicGradient) -> EpistemicGradient with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if h.n != v.n { panic("ehess_mat_vec: dimension mismatch") }
    var result = egrad_zeros(h.n)
    var i = 0
    while i < h.n {
        var sum_val = 0.0
        var sum_unc_sq = 0.0
        var min_conf = 1.0
        var j = 0
        while j < h.n {
            let h_val = h.values[(i * h.n + j) as usize]
            let v_val = v.values[j]
            let h_unc = h.uncertainties[(i * h.n + j) as usize]
            let v_unc = v.uncertainties[j]
            let h_conf = h.confidences[(i * h.n + j) as usize]
            let v_conf = v.confidences[j]

            sum_val = sum_val + h_val * v_val
            sum_unc_sq = sum_unc_sq + h_unc * h_unc * v_val * v_val + h_val * h_val * v_unc * v_unc
            min_conf = min_eb(min_conf, min_eb(h_conf, v_conf))
            j = j + 1
        }
        result.values[i] = sum_val
        result.uncertainties[i] = sqrt_eb(sum_unc_sq)
        result.confidences[i] = min_conf
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// =============================================================================
// Config and Result Types
// =============================================================================

pub struct EpistemicBFGSConfig {
    max_iterations: i32,
    grad_tol: f64,
    func_tol: f64,
    param_tol: f64,
    c1: f64,
    alpha_init: f64,
    alpha_min: f64,
    max_linesearch: i32,
    uncertainty_scale: f64,
}

pub fn epistemic_bfgs_config_default() -> EpistemicBFGSConfig {
    EpistemicBFGSConfig {
        max_iterations: 1000,
        grad_tol: 1e-6,
        func_tol: 1e-8,
        param_tol: 1e-8,
        c1: 1e-4,
        alpha_init: 1.0,
        alpha_min: 1e-20,
        max_linesearch: 40,
        uncertainty_scale: 0.5,
    }
}

pub fn EBFGS_TERM_MAX_ITER() -> i32 { 1 }
pub fn EBFGS_TERM_GRAD_TOL() -> i32 { 2 }
pub fn EBFGS_TERM_FUNC_TOL() -> i32 { 3 }
pub fn EBFGS_TERM_PARAM_TOL() -> i32 { 4 }
pub fn EBFGS_TERM_LINESEARCH_FAIL() -> i32 { 5 }

pub fn ebfgs_termination_success(reason: i32) -> bool {
    reason >= 2 && reason <= 4
}

pub struct EpistemicBFGSResult {
    params: EpistemicParams,
    value: f64,
    value_uncertainty: f64,
    converged: bool,
    termination: i32,
    iterations: i32,
    func_evals: i32,
    grad_evals: i32,
    final_grad_norm: f64,
    final_grad_uncertainty: f64,
}

// =============================================================================
// Test Function: Quadratic with Epistemic Gradient
// =============================================================================

fn ebfgs_quadratic(params: &EpistemicParams) -> f64 with Mut, Panic {
    let dx = params.values[0] - 3.0
    let dy = params.values[1] - 2.0
    dx * dx + dy * dy
}

fn ebfgs_quadratic_grad(params: &EpistemicParams) -> EpistemicGradient with Mut, Panic {
    var g = egrad_zeros(params.n)
    let dx = params.values[0] - 3.0
    let dy = params.values[1] - 2.0
    g.values[0] = 2.0 * dx
    g.values[1] = 2.0 * dy
    // Uncertainty from param uncertainty (propagated)
    g.uncertainties[0] = 2.0 * params.uncertainties[0]
    g.uncertainties[1] = 2.0 * params.uncertainties[1]
    g.confidences[0] = params.confidences[0]
    g.confidences[1] = params.confidences[1]
    g
}

// =============================================================================
// BFGS Update with Uncertainty
// =============================================================================

pub fn ebfgs_update(
    h: &EpistemicHessian,
    s: &EpistemicParams,
    y: &EpistemicGradient,
) -> EpistemicHessian with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if h.n != s.n || h.n != y.n { panic("ebfgs_update: dimension mismatch") }

    // Compute y^T * s
    var ys: f64 = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < h.n {
        ys = ys + y.values[i] * s.values[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    if ys <= 1e-10 {
        return EpistemicHessian {
            values: h.values,
            uncertainties: h.uncertainties,
            confidences: h.confidences,
            n: h.n,
        }
    }

    let rho = 1.0 / ys

    // Compute H * y
    var hy: [f64; 20] = [0.0; 20]
    i = 0
    while i < h.n {
        var sum = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < h.n {
            sum = sum + h.values[(i * h.n + j) as usize] * y.values[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        hy[i] = sum
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Compute y^T * H * y
    var yhy: f64 = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < h.n {
        yhy = yhy + y.values[i] * hy[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    let factor = (1.0 + yhy * rho) * rho

    var h_new = EpistemicHessian {
        values: h.values,
        uncertainties: h.uncertainties,
        confidences: h.confidences,
        n: h.n,
    }

    i = 0
    while i < h.n {
        var j = 0
        while j < h.n {
            let idx = (i * h.n + j) as usize
            h_new.values[idx] = h.values[idx]
                - rho * (hy[i] * s.values[j] + s.values[i] * hy[j])
                + factor * s.values[i] * s.values[j]
            // Propagate uncertainty (simplified: scale by factor)
            h_new.uncertainties[idx] = h.uncertainties[idx] * 1.01
            h_new.confidences[idx] = min_eb(h.confidences[idx], 0.99)
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    h_new
}

// =============================================================================
// Uncertainty-Aware Step Size
// =============================================================================

pub fn ebfgs_compute_step_size(
    grad_unc_norm: f64,
    base_alpha: f64,
    config: &EpistemicBFGSConfig,
) -> f64 {
    // Reduce step size when gradient uncertainty is high
    let unc_factor = 1.0 / (1.0 + config.uncertainty_scale * grad_unc_norm)
    base_alpha * unc_factor
}

// =============================================================================
// Main Optimization Loop
// =============================================================================

pub fn epistemic_bfgs_quadratic(
    initial: &EpistemicParams,
    config: &EpistemicBFGSConfig,
) -> EpistemicBFGSResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var x = EpistemicParams {
        values: initial.values,
        uncertainties: initial.uncertainties,
        confidences: initial.confidences,
        n: initial.n,
    }
    var h = ehess_identity(x.n)

    var f_x = ebfgs_quadratic(&x)
    var g = ebfgs_quadratic_grad(&x)

    var iterations: i32 = 0
    var func_evals: i32 = 1
    var grad_evals: i32 = 1
    var termination = EBFGS_TERM_MAX_ITER()

    while iterations < config.max_iterations {
        iterations = iterations + 1

        let grad_norm = egrad_norm(&g)
        let grad_unc = egrad_unc_norm(&g)

        if grad_norm < config.grad_tol {
            termination = EBFGS_TERM_GRAD_TOL()
            break
        }

        // d = -H * g
        var d = ehess_mat_vec(&h, &g)
        var i = 0
        while i < d.n {
            d.values[i] = -d.values[i]
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Compute slope = g^T * d
        var slope: f64 = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < g.n {
            slope = slope + g.values[i] * d.values[i]
            i = i + 1
        }

        if slope >= 0.0 {
            termination = EBFGS_TERM_LINESEARCH_FAIL()
            break
        }

        // Uncertainty-aware step size
        var alpha = ebfgs_compute_step_size(grad_unc, config.alpha_init, config)

        // Line search
        var work = eparams_zeros(x.n)
        var f_new = f_x
        var ls_iter: i32 = 0
        var ls_done = false

        while ls_iter < config.max_linesearch && !ls_done {
            i = 0
            while i < x.n {
                work.values[i] = x.values[i] + alpha * d.values[i]
                work.uncertainties[i] = sqrt_eb(x.uncertainties[i] * x.uncertainties[i] + alpha * alpha * d.uncertainties[i] * d.uncertainties[i])
                work.confidences[i] = min_eb(x.confidences[i], d.confidences[i])
                i = i + 1
            }

            f_new = ebfgs_quadratic(&work)
            func_evals = func_evals + 1

            if f_new <= f_x + config.c1 * alpha * slope {
                ls_done = true
            } else {
                alpha = alpha * 0.5
                if alpha < config.alpha_min {
                    ls_done = true
                }
            }
            ls_iter = ls_iter + 1
        }

        if alpha < config.alpha_min {
            termination = EBFGS_TERM_LINESEARCH_FAIL()
            break
        }

        // Compute step
        var s = eparams_zeros(x.n)
        i = 0
        while i < x.n {
            s.values[i] = alpha * d.values[i]
            s.uncertainties[i] = alpha * d.uncertainties[i]
            s.confidences[i] = d.confidences[i]
            i = i + 1
        }

        let step_norm = eparams_norm(&s)
        let x_norm = eparams_norm(&x)
        if step_norm < config.param_tol * (1.0 + x_norm) {
            termination = EBFGS_TERM_PARAM_TOL()
            i = 0
            while i < x.n {
                x.values[i] = x.values[i] + s.values[i]
                x.uncertainties[i] = sqrt_eb(x.uncertainties[i] * x.uncertainties[i] + s.uncertainties[i] * s.uncertainties[i])
                x.confidences[i] = min_eb(x.confidences[i], s.confidences[i])
                i = i + 1
            }
            f_x = f_new
            break
        }

        let f_change = f_x - f_new
        let abs_f_change = if f_change < 0.0 { -f_change } else { f_change }
        if abs_f_change < config.func_tol * (1.0 + f_x) {
            termination = EBFGS_TERM_FUNC_TOL()
        }

        // Update x
        i = 0
        while i < x.n {
            x.values[i] = x.values[i] + s.values[i]
            x.uncertainties[i] = sqrt_eb(x.uncertainties[i] * x.uncertainties[i] + s.uncertainties[i] * s.uncertainties[i])
            x.confidences[i] = min_eb(x.confidences[i], s.confidences[i])
            i = i + 1
        }

        let g_new = ebfgs_quadratic_grad(&x)
        grad_evals = grad_evals + 1

        // y = g_new - g
        var y = egrad_zeros(x.n)
        i = 0
        while i < x.n {
            y.values[i] = g_new.values[i] - g.values[i]
            y.uncertainties[i] = sqrt_eb(g_new.uncertainties[i] * g_new.uncertainties[i] + g.uncertainties[i] * g.uncertainties[i])
            y.confidences[i] = min_eb(g_new.confidences[i], g.confidences[i])
            i = i + 1
        }

        h = ebfgs_update(&h, &s, &y)
        g = g_new
        f_x = f_new

        if termination != EBFGS_TERM_MAX_ITER() {
            break
        }
    }

    EpistemicBFGSResult {
        params: x,
        value: f_x,
        value_uncertainty: eparams_norm(&x) * 0.01,
        converged: ebfgs_termination_success(termination),
        termination: termination,
        iterations: iterations,
        func_evals: func_evals,
        grad_evals: grad_evals,
        final_grad_norm: egrad_norm(&g),
        final_grad_uncertainty: egrad_unc_norm(&g),
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Tests
// =============================================================================

fn test_epistemic_bfgs_quadratic() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var initial = eparams_zeros(2)
    initial.values[0] = 0.0
    initial.values[1] = 0.0
    initial.uncertainties[0] = 0.01
    initial.uncertainties[1] = 0.01
    initial.confidences[0] = 0.95
    initial.confidences[1] = 0.95

    let config = epistemic_bfgs_config_default()
    let result = epistemic_bfgs_quadratic(&initial, &config)

    // Should converge to (3, 2)
    assert(result.converged)
    assert(result.params.values[0] > 2.99 && result.params.values[0] < 3.01)
    assert(result.params.values[1] > 1.99 && result.params.values[1] < 2.01)

    // Uncertainty should be tracked
    assert(result.params.uncertainties[0] > 0.0)
    assert(result.final_grad_uncertainty >= 0.0)
}

fn test_epistemic_step_size() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let config = epistemic_bfgs_config_default()

    // Low uncertainty -> full step
    let alpha_low = ebfgs_compute_step_size(0.001, 1.0, &config)
    assert(alpha_low > 0.9)

    // High uncertainty -> reduced step
    let alpha_high = ebfgs_compute_step_size(1.0, 1.0, &config)
    assert(alpha_high < alpha_low)
}

pub fn main() {
    test_epistemic_bfgs_quadratic()
    test_epistemic_step_size()
}


// === FILE: stdlib/optimize/levenberg_marquardt.sio ===
// optimize::levenberg_marquardt — Levenberg-Marquardt Algorithm
//
// The workhorse of nonlinear least squares optimization.
// Interpolates between Gauss-Newton and gradient descent.
//
// Algorithm:
// 1. Compute Jacobian J and residuals r
// 2. Solve (J'J + λI) δ = -J'r for step δ
// 3. If f(x + δ) < f(x): accept, decrease λ
//    Else: reject, increase λ
// 4. Repeat until convergence
//
// References:
// - Levenberg (1944): "A Method for the Solution of Certain Problems in Least Squares"
// - Marquardt (1963): "An Algorithm for Least-Squares Estimation of Nonlinear Parameters"
// - Moré (1978): "The Levenberg-Marquardt Algorithm: Implementation and Theory"

extern "C" {
    fn sqrt(x: f64) -> f64;
    fn fabs(x: f64) -> f64;
    fn exp(x: f64) -> f64;
}

// ============================================================================
// LEVENBERG-MARQUARDT CONFIG
// ============================================================================

struct LMConfig {
    initial_lambda: f64,        // Initial damping parameter
    lambda_up: f64,             // Factor to increase λ on reject
    lambda_down: f64,           // Factor to decrease λ on accept
    min_lambda: f64,            // Minimum λ (nearly Gauss-Newton)
    max_lambda: f64,            // Maximum λ (nearly gradient descent)
    max_iterations: i64,
    func_tol: f64,              // Convergence on residual change
    param_tol: f64,             // Convergence on parameter change
    grad_tol: f64,              // Convergence on gradient norm
    finite_diff_step: f64,      // Step size for Jacobian
}

fn lm_config_default() -> LMConfig {
    LMConfig {
        initial_lambda: 1.0,
        lambda_up: 10.0,
        lambda_down: 3.0,
        min_lambda: 1e-12,
        max_lambda: 1e12,
        max_iterations: 200,
        func_tol: 1e-8,
        param_tol: 1e-8,
        grad_tol: 1e-6,
        finite_diff_step: 1.4901161193847656e-8,
    }
}

fn lm_config_tight() -> LMConfig {
    var c = lm_config_default()
    c.max_iterations = 500
    c.func_tol = 1e-12
    c.param_tol = 1e-12
    c.grad_tol = 1e-10
    return c
}

fn lm_config_fast() -> LMConfig {
    var c = lm_config_default()
    c.max_iterations = 100
    c.func_tol = 1e-6
    c.param_tol = 1e-6
    c.grad_tol = 1e-4
    return c
}

// ============================================================================
// TERMINATION REASONS
// ============================================================================

fn LM_TERM_MAX_ITER() -> i32 { 1 }
fn LM_TERM_FUNC_TOL() -> i32 { 2 }
fn LM_TERM_PARAM_TOL() -> i32 { 3 }
fn LM_TERM_GRAD_TOL() -> i32 { 4 }
fn LM_TERM_STALLED() -> i32 { 5 }

fn lm_termination_success(reason: i32) -> bool {
    reason >= 2 && reason <= 4
}

// ============================================================================
// PARAMETER UNCERTAINTY
// ============================================================================

struct ParamUncertainty {
    value: f64,
    std_uncertainty: f64,
    expanded_k2: f64,
    coverage: f64,
    df: i64,
}

fn param_uncertainty_new(value: f64, std_unc: f64, df: i64) -> ParamUncertainty {
    let k = if df < 10 { 2.0 + 2.0 / (df as f64) } else { 2.0 }
    ParamUncertainty {
        value: value,
        std_uncertainty: std_unc,
        expanded_k2: k * std_unc,
        coverage: k,
        df: df,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// OPTIMIZE RESULT
// ============================================================================

struct OptimizeResult {
    params: [f64; 20],
    n_params: i64,
    value: f64,
    converged: bool,
    termination: i32,
    iterations: i64,
    func_evals: i64,
    grad_evals: i64,
    has_uncertainty: bool,
    uncertainty: [ParamUncertainty; 20],
    covariance: [[f64; 20]; 20],
    mse: f64,
    dof: i64,
}

fn optimize_result_new() -> OptimizeResult {
    OptimizeResult {
        params: [0.0; 20],
        n_params: 0,
        value: 1e308,
        converged: false,
        termination: 6,
        iterations: 0,
        func_evals: 0,
        grad_evals: 0,
        has_uncertainty: false,
        uncertainty: [param_uncertainty_new(0.0, 0.0, -1); 20],
        covariance: [[0.0; 20]; 20],
        mse: 0.0,
        dof: 0,
    }
}

fn optimize_result_set_params(result: OptimizeResult, params: [f64; 20], n: i64) -> OptimizeResult {
    var r = result
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n && i < 20 {
        r.params[i as usize] = params[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    r.n_params = n
    return r
}

// ============================================================================
// VECTOR UTILITIES
// ============================================================================

fn vec_sum_sq(v: [f64; 100], n: i64) -> f64 {
    var sum = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        sum = sum + v[i as usize] * v[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    return sum
}

fn vec_norm_20(v: [f64; 20], n: i64) -> f64 {
    var sum = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        sum = sum + v[i as usize] * v[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    return sqrt(sum)
}

// ============================================================================
// MATRIX OPERATIONS
// ============================================================================

// Compute J'J (Gram matrix)
fn compute_jtj(j: [f64; 2000], n_res: i64, n_par: i64, jtj: [f64; 400]) -> [f64; 400] {
    var result = jtj
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n_par {
        var jj: i64 = 0
        while jj < n_par {
            var sum = 0.0
            var k: i64 = 0
            while k < n_res {
                let ji = j[(k * n_par + i) as usize]
                let jk = j[(k * n_par + jj) as usize]
                sum = sum + ji * jk
                k = k + 1
            }
            result[(i * n_par + jj) as usize] = sum
            jj = jj + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return result
}

// Compute J'r
fn compute_jtr(j: [f64; 2000], r: [f64; 100], n_res: i64, n_par: i64) -> [f64; 20] {
    var jtr: [f64; 20] = [0.0; 20]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n_par {
        var sum = 0.0
        var k: i64 = 0
        while k < n_res {
            sum = sum + j[(k * n_par + i) as usize] * r[k as usize]
            k = k + 1
        }
        jtr[i as usize] = sum
        i = i + 1
    }
    return jtr
}

// Solve (A + λI)x = b using Cholesky decomposition
fn solve_damped_system(
    a: [f64; 400],
    b: [f64; 20],
    lambda: f64,
    n: i64
) -> ([f64; 20], bool) {
    var L: [f64; 400] = [0.0; 400]
    var y: [f64; 20] = [0.0; 20]
    var x: [f64; 20] = [0.0; 20]

    // Form A + λI and compute Cholesky: L * L' = A + λI
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j <= i {
            var sum = a[(i * n + j) as usize]
            if i == j {
                sum = sum + lambda
            }

            var k: i64 = 0
            while k < j {
                sum = sum - L[(i * n + k) as usize] * L[(j * n + k) as usize]
                k = k + 1
            }

            if i == j {
                if sum <= 0.0 {
                    return (x, false)
                }
                L[(i * n + j) as usize] = sqrt(sum)
            } else {
                let Ljj = L[(j * n + j) as usize]
                if Ljj == 0.0 {
                    return (x, false)
                }
                L[(i * n + j) as usize] = sum / Ljj
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Forward solve: L * y = b
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        var sum = b[i as usize]
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < i {
            sum = sum - L[(i * n + j) as usize] * y[j as usize]
            j = j + 1
        }
        let Lii = L[(i * n + i) as usize]
        if Lii == 0.0 {
            return (x, false)
        }
        y[i as usize] = sum / Lii
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Backward solve: L' * x = y
    i = n - 1
    while i >= 0 {
        var sum = y[i as usize]
        var j = i + 1
        while j < n {
            sum = sum - L[(j * n + i) as usize] * x[j as usize]
            j = j + 1
        }
        let Lii = L[(i * n + i) as usize]
        if Lii == 0.0 {
            return (x, false)
        }
        x[i as usize] = sum / Lii
        i = i - 1
    }

    return (x, true)
}

// ============================================================================
// FINITE DIFFERENCES
// ============================================================================

fn finite_diff_jacobian_lm(
    params: [f64; 20],
    n_params: i64,
    n_residuals: i64,
    h: f64,
    // Inline residuals computation for exponential model
    x_data: [f64; 5],
    y_data: [f64; 5]
) -> [f64; 2000] {
    var jac: [f64; 2000] = [0.0; 2000]
    var work_params: [f64; 20] = [0.0; 20]
    var r_plus: [f64; 100] = [0.0; 100]
    var r_minus: [f64; 100] = [0.0; 100]

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n_params {
        work_params[i as usize] = params[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }

    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < n_params {
        let pj = params[j as usize]
        let abs_pj = if pj < 0.0 { -pj } else { pj }
        let step = h * (1.0 + abs_pj)

        // Compute r_plus
        work_params[j as usize] = pj + step
        let a_plus = work_params[0]
        let b_plus = work_params[1]
        var k: i64 = 0
        while k < n_residuals {
            let x = x_data[k as usize]
            r_plus[k as usize] = y_data[k as usize] - a_plus * exp(-b_plus * x)
            k = k + 1
        }

        // Compute r_minus
        work_params[j as usize] = pj - step
        let a_minus = work_params[0]
        let b_minus = work_params[1]
        k = 0
        while k < n_residuals {
            let x = x_data[k as usize]
            r_minus[k as usize] = y_data[k as usize] - a_minus * exp(-b_minus * x)
            k = k + 1
        }

        // Compute derivative
        var ii: i64 = 0
        while ii < n_residuals {
            let idx = (ii * n_params + j) as usize
            jac[idx] = (r_plus[ii as usize] - r_minus[ii as usize]) / (2.0 * step)
            ii = ii + 1
        }

        work_params[j as usize] = pj
        j = j + 1
    }

    return jac
}

// ============================================================================
// LEVENBERG-MARQUARDT (SIMPLIFIED)
// ============================================================================

// Simplified LM for exponential fit test
fn lm_fit_exponential(
    initial_params: [f64; 20],
    n_params: i64,
    x_data: [f64; 5],
    y_data: [f64; 5],
    n_residuals: i64,
    config: LMConfig
) -> OptimizeResult {
    var result = optimize_result_new()
    result.n_params = n_params

    var params = initial_params
    var lambda = config.initial_lambda

    // Compute initial residuals and cost
    var residuals: [f64; 100] = [0.0; 100]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n_residuals {
        let x = x_data[i as usize]
        residuals[i as usize] = y_data[i as usize] - params[0] * exp(-params[1] * x)
        i = i + 1
    }
    var cost = 0.5 * vec_sum_sq(residuals, n_residuals)
    result.func_evals = 1

    // Compute initial Jacobian
    var jac = finite_diff_jacobian_lm(params, n_params, n_residuals, config.finite_diff_step, x_data, y_data)
    result.grad_evals = 1

    var termination = LM_TERM_MAX_ITER()
    var iterations: i64 = 0

    while iterations < config.max_iterations {
        iterations = iterations + 1

        // Compute J'J and J'r
        var jtj: [f64; 400] = [0.0; 400]
        jtj = compute_jtj(jac, n_residuals, n_params, jtj)
        let jtr = compute_jtr(jac, residuals, n_residuals, n_params)

        // Check gradient convergence
        let grad_norm = vec_norm_20(jtr, n_params)
        if grad_norm < config.grad_tol {
            termination = LM_TERM_GRAD_TOL()
            break
        }

        // Negate J'r
        var neg_jtr: [f64; 20] = [0.0; 20]
        i = 0
        while i < n_params {
            neg_jtr[i as usize] = -jtr[i as usize]
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Try to find acceptable step
        var step_accepted = false
        var inner_iters = 0
        var delta: [f64; 20] = [0.0; 20]

        while !step_accepted && inner_iters < 20 {
            inner_iters = inner_iters + 1

            // Solve (J'J + λI) δ = -J'r
            let solve_result = solve_damped_system(jtj, neg_jtr, lambda, n_params)
            delta = solve_result.0
            let solved = solve_result.1

            if !solved {
                lambda = lambda * config.lambda_up
                if lambda > config.max_lambda {
                    lambda = config.max_lambda
                }
                continue
            }

            // Compute trial point
            var trial_params: [f64; 20] = [0.0; 20]
            i = 0
            while i < n_params {
                trial_params[i as usize] = params[i as usize] + delta[i as usize]
                i = i + 1
            }

            // Evaluate at trial
            var trial_residuals: [f64; 100] = [0.0; 100]
            i = 0
            while i < n_residuals {
                let x = x_data[i as usize]
                trial_residuals[i as usize] = y_data[i as usize] - trial_params[0] * exp(-trial_params[1] * x)
                i = i + 1
            }
            result.func_evals = result.func_evals + 1

            let trial_cost = 0.5 * vec_sum_sq(trial_residuals, n_residuals)

            if trial_cost < cost {
                step_accepted = true

                // Check param convergence
                let param_change = vec_norm_20(delta, n_params)
                let param_scale = vec_norm_20(params, n_params)
                if param_change < config.param_tol * (1.0 + param_scale) {
                    termination = LM_TERM_PARAM_TOL()
                }

                // Check function convergence
                let cost_change = cost - trial_cost
                if cost_change < config.func_tol * cost {
                    if termination == LM_TERM_MAX_ITER() {
                        termination = LM_TERM_FUNC_TOL()
                    }
                }

                // Update state
                params = trial_params
                residuals = trial_residuals
                cost = trial_cost

                // Decrease lambda
                lambda = lambda / config.lambda_down
                if lambda < config.min_lambda {
                    lambda = config.min_lambda
                }

                // Update Jacobian
                jac = finite_diff_jacobian_lm(params, n_params, n_residuals, config.finite_diff_step, x_data, y_data)
                result.grad_evals = result.grad_evals + 1
            } else {
                lambda = lambda * config.lambda_up
                if lambda > config.max_lambda {
                    termination = LM_TERM_STALLED()
                    step_accepted = true
                }
            }
        }

        if termination != LM_TERM_MAX_ITER() {
            break
        }
    }

    // Build result
    result = optimize_result_set_params(result, params, n_params)
    result.value = 2.0 * cost
    result.converged = lm_termination_success(termination)
    result.termination = termination
    result.iterations = iterations

    // Compute uncertainty
    let dof = n_residuals - n_params
    if dof > 0 {
        let mse = 2.0 * cost / (dof as f64)
        result.mse = mse
        result.dof = dof

        // Compute (J'J)^(-1)
        var jtj: [f64; 400] = [0.0; 400]
        jtj = compute_jtj(jac, n_residuals, n_params, jtj)

        // Invert by solving for identity columns
        var cov_success = true
        i = 0
        while i < n_params && cov_success {
            var identity_col: [f64; 20] = [0.0; 20]
            identity_col[i as usize] = 1.0

            let solve_result = solve_damped_system(jtj, identity_col, 0.0, n_params)
            let cov_col = solve_result.0
            cov_success = solve_result.1

            if cov_success {
                var j: i64 = 0
                while j < n_params {
                    result.covariance[j as usize][i as usize] = mse * cov_col[j as usize]
                    j = j + 1
                }
            }
            i = i + 1
        }

        if cov_success {
            result.has_uncertainty = true
            i = 0
            while i < n_params {
                let variance = result.covariance[i as usize][i as usize]
                let std_unc = if variance > 0.0 { sqrt(variance) } else { 0.0 }
                result.uncertainty[i as usize] = param_uncertainty_new(
                    params[i as usize],
                    std_unc,
                    dof
                )
                i = i + 1
            }
        }
    }

    return result
}
