fn test_standard_model_config() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let sm = standard_model_new()
    sm.e.val() > 0.0
    && sm.g.val() > 0.0
    && sm.gp.val() > 0.0
    && sm.gs.val() > 0.0
}

fn test_ckm_unitarity_sm() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let sm = standard_model_new()
    let row1 = sm.ckm[0]*sm.ckm[0] + sm.ckm[1]*sm.ckm[1] + sm.ckm[2]*sm.ckm[2]
    abs_f64(row1 - 1.0) < 0.01
}

fn test_alpha_s_running() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let alpha_mz = 0.118
    let mz = 91.19
    let mu = 10.0
    let alpha_low = alpha_s_running(mu, alpha_mz, mz)
    let alpha_val = alpha_low.val()
    // alpha_s should increase as energy decreases
    alpha_val > alpha_mz && alpha_val < 0.25
}

fn test_rho_parameter() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let sm = standard_model_new()
    let mw = sm.m_w.val()
    let mz = sm.m_z.val()
    let rho = mw * mw / (mz * mz * (1.0 - sm.sin2_theta_w.val()))
    abs_f64(rho - 1.0) < 0.02
}

fn test_decay_width_epistemic() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Z -> e+ e- width should be ~84 MeV
    let g_ee = z_decay_width_ee()
    g_ee > 0.07 && g_ee < 0.09
}

fn test_branching_ratio() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let g_ee = z_decay_width_ee()
    let g_total = z_total_width()
    let br = g_ee / g_total
    br > 0.03 && br < 0.04
}

// === Phase 5: Neutrino, Higgs Production, Three-Body Decays ===

fn test_neutrino_oscillation() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Atmospheric: sin²2θ₂₃ ≈ 1, Δm²₃₁ ≈ 2.5e-3, L=500 km, E=2 GeV
    let p_mutau = oscillation_probability_2flavor(1.0, 0.0025, 500.0, 2.0)
    p_mutau > 0.4 && p_mutau < 0.6
}

fn test_solar_survival() -> bool {
    // Vacuum-averaged solar survival: 1 - ½ sin²2θ₁₂
    // sin²2θ₁₂ ≈ 0.87 → P ≈ 0.565
    let p_avg = survival_probability_2flavor_avg(0.87)
    p_avg > 0.55 && p_avg < 0.58
}

fn test_gg_higgs_production() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let mh = mass_h().val()
    let gg = gg_higgs_hadronic_cross_section(mh, 13000.0, 0.118)
    // LO cross-section should be positive and > VBF
    let vbf = vbf_higgs_cross_section_approx(mh, 13000.0)
    gg > 0.0 && gg > vbf
}

fn test_muon_lifetime() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let m_mu = mass_muon().val()
    let m_e = mass_electron().val()
    let G_F = 1.1663787e-5
    let tau = muon_lifetime(m_mu, m_e, G_F)
    // PDG: τ_μ ≈ 2.197e-6 s
    tau > 1.8e-6 && tau < 2.6e-6
}

fn test_top_decay_width() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let m_t = mass_top().val()
    let m_w = mass_w().val()
    let m_b = mass_bottom().val()
    let G_F = 1.1663787e-5
    let gamma = top_decay_width(m_t, m_w, m_b, G_F)
    // PDG: Γ_t ≈ 1.3 GeV
    gamma > 0.8 && gamma < 1.8
}

fn test_dalitz_bounds() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let (m12_min, m12_max) = dalitz_m12_bounds(0.494, 0.140, 0.135, 0.135)
    m12_min >= 0.0 && m12_max > m12_min
}

// === Phase 6: Jet Algorithms, EW Precision, PDFs ===

fn test_jet_clustering() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var particles: [LorentzVector; 64] = [lorentz_zero(); 64]
    var jets: [Jet; 64] = [jet_zero(); 64]
    particles[0] = lorentz_new(10.0, 5.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    particles[1] = lorentz_new(10.0, -5.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    let n = anti_kt_cluster(particles, 2, 0.4, &!jets)
    n == 2
}

fn test_jet_merge() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var particles: [LorentzVector; 64] = [lorentz_zero(); 64]
    var jets: [Jet; 64] = [jet_zero(); 64]
    particles[0] = lorentz_new(10.0, 0.1, 0.0, 0.0)
    particles[1] = lorentz_new(10.0, 0.2, 0.0, 0.0)
    let n = anti_kt_cluster(particles, 2, 1.0, &!jets)
    n == 1
}

fn test_delta_rho() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let drho = delta_rho(mass_top().val())
    drho > 0.008 && drho < 0.012
}

fn test_m_w_prediction() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let mw = m_w_prediction(mass_top().val(), mass_h().val(), alpha_s_mz().val())
    mw > 79.0 && mw < 82.0
}

fn test_pdf_valence() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let u_num = up_valence_number(10000.0)
    let d_num = down_valence_number(10000.0)
    u_num > 1.5 && u_num < 2.5 && d_num > 0.5 && d_num < 2.5
}

fn test_pdf_gluon_momentum() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let g_frac = gluon_momentum_fraction(10000.0)
    g_frac > 0.3 && g_frac < 0.7
}

// PHASE 7 TESTS: MONTE CARLO
// ============================================================================

fn test_rambo_massless_conservation() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    seed_rng(42)
    var momenta: [LorentzVector; 64] = [lorentz_zero(); 64]
    let _w = rambo_generator_massless(3, 10.0, &!momenta)
    check_momentum_conservation(momenta, 3, 10.0)
}

fn test_rambo_massive_conservation() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    seed_rng(42)
    var momenta: [LorentzVector; 64] = [lorentz_zero(); 64]
    var masses: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    masses[0] = 1.0
    masses[1] = 1.0
    let _w = rambo_generator(2, 10.0, &masses, &!momenta)
    check_momentum_conservation(momenta, 2, 10.0)
}

fn f_x2(x: f64) -> f64 { x * x }
fn f_poly(x: f64) -> f64 { x * (1.0 - x) }

fn test_vegas_x2() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    seed_rng(42)
    let (result, error) = vegas_integrate_1d(f_x2, 0.0, 1.0, 20, 2000)
    check_near(result, 0.333333, 5.0 * error + 0.01) && error < 0.05
}

fn test_vegas_poly() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    seed_rng(42)
    let (result, error) = vegas_integrate_1d(f_poly, 0.0, 1.0, 20, 2000)
    check_near(result, 0.166667, 5.0 * error + 0.01) && error < 0.05
}

fn pdf_uniform(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x >= 0.0 && x <= 1.0 { 1.0 } else { 0.0 }
}

fn test_acceptance_rejection() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    seed_rng(42)
    var samples: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    let n = acceptance_rejection_sampling(pdf_uniform, 0.0, 1.0, 1.5, &!samples, 100)
    n >= 50 && n <= 100
}

fn test_eemm_event_gen() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    seed_rng(42)
    var p3: [LorentzVector; 1024] = [lorentz_zero(); 1024]
    var p4: [LorentzVector; 1024] = [lorentz_zero(); 1024]
    var weights: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    let n = generate_eemm_events(100, 91.2, &!p3, &!p4, &!weights)
    n == 100
}

fn test_dglap_kernels() -> bool with Div {
    // P_qg(0.5) = T_F * (0.25 + 0.25) = 0.5 * 0.5 = 0.25
    let pqg_05 = p_qg(0.5)
    // P_gq(0.5) = C_F * (1 + 0.25) / 0.5 = 4/3 * 1.25 / 0.5 = 10/3 ≈ 3.333
    let pgq_05 = p_gq(0.5)
    check_near(pqg_05, 0.25, 0.01) && pgq_05 > 3.0 && pgq_05 < 3.5
}

fn test_sudakov() -> bool with Div {
    let s1 = sudakov_form_factor(0.12, 100.0, 1.0, false, 5)
    let s2 = sudakov_form_factor(0.12, 100.0, 1.0, true, 5)
    // Gluon Sudakov should be smaller (more radiation)
    s1 > 0.0 && s1 <= 1.0 && s2 > 0.0 && s2 <= 1.0 && s2 < s1
}

fn test_cluster_decay() -> bool with Mut, Div {
    seed_shower_rng(42)
    var h1 = lorentz_zero()
    var h2 = lorentz_zero()
    cluster_decay_two_body(5.0, 0.14, 0.14, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, &!h1, &!h2)
    let e_sum = h1.t + h2.t
    // Energy conservation in rest frame
    check_near(e_sum, 5.0, 0.01)
}

fn test_bethe_bloch() -> bool with Div {
    let si = material_silicon()
    let mip = dedx_mip(si)
    // MIP dE/dx in Si ≈ 1.5–2.0 MeV cm²/g
    mip > 1.0 && mip < 4.0
}

fn test_highland_scattering() -> bool with Div {
    // 1 GeV muon through 1 X0 of Si
    let theta = highland_scattering_angle(1.0, 0.10566, 1.0, 1.0)
    // Should be O(10–20 mrad)
    theta > 0.01 && theta < 0.05
}

fn test_calorimeter_resolution() -> bool with Div {
    let res_1gev = em_calorimeter_resolution(1.0)
    let res_100gev = em_calorimeter_resolution(100.0)
    // Resolution improves with energy
    res_1gev > res_100gev && res_100gev < 0.01
}

fn test_track_curvature() -> bool with Div {
    let kappa = track_curvature(3.8, 1.0, 1.0)
    let pt = pt_from_curvature(3.8, 1.0, kappa)
    check_near(pt, 1.0, 0.001)
}

fn test_vertex_reco() -> bool with Div {
    // Two tracks crossing at (1, 1)
    let (vx, vy) = vertex_from_two_tracks(
        0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0,
        2.0, 0.0, -1.0, 1.0,
    )
    check_near(vx, 1.0, 0.01) && check_near(vy, 1.0, 0.01)
}

fn jet_zero() -> Jet {
    Jet { p: lorentz_zero(), constituents: [0; 64], n_constituents: 0 }
}

// === FILE: stdlib/particle_physics/lorentz.sio ===
// stdlib/particle_physics/lorentz.sio — Lorentz vectors and kinematics
//
// Minkowski-space 4-vectors with metric signature η = diag(+1, −1, −1, −1).
// Natural units: ℏ = c = 1.
//
// References:
//   - Peskin & Schroeder, "An Introduction to Quantum Field Theory", 1995
//   - PDG 2024, Kinematics (https://pdg.lbl.gov/2024/reviews/contents_sports.html)

module particle_physics::lorentz

extern "C" {
    fn sqrt(x: f64) -> f64;
    fn sinh(x: f64) -> f64;
    fn cosh(x: f64) -> f64;
}

// ============================================================================
// LORENTZ VECTOR
// ============================================================================

/// A 4-vector in Minkowski space: p^μ = (E, p_x, p_y, p_z).
pub struct LorentzVector {
    pub t: f64,   // Energy / time component
    pub x: f64,   // x-momentum / space component
    pub y: f64,   // y-momentum / space component
    pub z: f64,   // z-momentum / space component
}

/// Construct a Lorentz vector from components.
pub fn lorentz_new(t: f64, x: f64, y: f64, z: f64) -> LorentzVector {
    LorentzVector { t: t, x: x, y: y, z: z }
}

/// Zero 4-vector.
pub fn lorentz_zero() -> LorentzVector {
    LorentzVector { t: 0.0, x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }
}

// ============================================================================
// METRIC AND SCALAR PRODUCT
// ============================================================================

/// Minkowski metric η_μν with signature (+, −, −, −).
/// Returns η[mu][nu] where mu,nu ∈ {0,1,2,3}.
pub fn metric_eta(mu: i64, nu: i64) -> f64 {
    if mu != nu { return 0.0 }
    if mu == 0 { return 1.0 }
    return 0.0 - 1.0
}

/// Lorentz scalar product: a·b = η_μν a^μ b^ν = a^t b^t − a^x b^x − a^y b^y − a^z b^z.
pub fn lorentz_dot(a: LorentzVector, b: LorentzVector) -> f64 {
    a.t * b.t - a.x * b.x - a.y * b.y - a.z * b.z
}

/// Invariant mass squared: m² = p·p.
pub fn lorentz_norm_sq(p: LorentzVector) -> f64 {
    lorentz_dot(p, p)
}

/// Invariant mass: m = √(p·p). Returns 0.0 for negative norm (spacelike).
pub fn lorentz_mass(p: LorentzVector) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let m2 = lorentz_norm_sq(p)
    if m2 < 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    sqrt(m2)
}

// ============================================================================
// VECTOR OPERATIONS
// ============================================================================

/// 3-momentum squared: |p⃗|².
pub fn momentum_sq(p: LorentzVector) -> f64 {
    p.x * p.x + p.y * p.y + p.z * p.z
}

/// 3-momentum magnitude: |p⃗|.
pub fn momentum_mag(p: LorentzVector) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    sqrt(momentum_sq(p))
}

/// Addition of 4-vectors: (a + b)^μ.
pub fn lorentz_add(a: LorentzVector, b: LorentzVector) -> LorentzVector {
    LorentzVector {
        t: a.t + b.t,
        x: a.x + b.x,
        y: a.y + b.y,
        z: a.z + b.z,
    }
}

/// Subtraction of 4-vectors: (a − b)^μ.
pub fn lorentz_sub(a: LorentzVector, b: LorentzVector) -> LorentzVector {
    LorentzVector {
        t: a.t - b.t,
        x: a.x - b.x,
        y: a.y - b.y,
        z: a.z - b.z,
    }
}

/// Scalar multiplication: (c · p)^μ.
pub fn lorentz_scale(p: LorentzVector, c: f64) -> LorentzVector {
    LorentzVector {
        t: p.t * c,
        x: p.x * c,
        y: p.y * c,
        z: p.z * c,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// LORENTZ BOOSTS
// ============================================================================

/// Boost along the x-axis with velocity β = v/c.
///   p'^0 = γ(p^0 − β p^x)
///   p'^x = γ(p^x − β p^0)
///   p'^y = p^y
///   p'^z = p^z
/// where γ = 1/√(1−β²).
pub fn lorentz_boost_x(p: LorentzVector, beta: f64) -> LorentzVector with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if beta >= 1.0 || beta <= -1.0 {
        return p
    }
    let gamma = 1.0 / sqrt(1.0 - beta * beta)
    LorentzVector {
        t: gamma * (p.t - beta * p.x),
        x: gamma * (p.x - beta * p.t),
        y: p.y,
        z: p.z,
    }
}

/// Boost along the y-axis.
pub fn lorentz_boost_y(p: LorentzVector, beta: f64) -> LorentzVector with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if beta >= 1.0 || beta <= -1.0 {
        return p
    }
    let gamma = 1.0 / sqrt(1.0 - beta * beta)
    LorentzVector {
        t: gamma * (p.t - beta * p.y),
        x: p.x,
        y: gamma * (p.y - beta * p.t),
        z: p.z,
    }
}

/// Boost along the z-axis.
pub fn lorentz_boost_z(p: LorentzVector, beta: f64) -> LorentzVector with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if beta >= 1.0 || beta <= -1.0 {
        return p
    }
    let gamma = 1.0 / sqrt(1.0 - beta * beta)
    LorentzVector {
        t: gamma * (p.t - beta * p.z),
        x: p.x,
        y: p.y,
        z: gamma * (p.z - beta * p.t),
    }
}

/// General boost with 3-velocity vector β⃗ = (βx, βy, βz).
/// Uses the Lorentz boost matrix in arbitrary direction.
pub fn lorentz_boost(p: LorentzVector, beta_x: f64, beta_y: f64, beta_z: f64) -> LorentzVector with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let beta_sq = beta_x * beta_x + beta_y * beta_y + beta_z * beta_z
    if beta_sq >= 1.0 || beta_sq <= 0.0 {
        return p
    }
    let beta = sqrt(beta_sq)
    let gamma = 1.0 / sqrt(1.0 - beta_sq)
    let n_x = beta_x / beta
    let n_y = beta_y / beta
    let n_z = beta_z / beta

    let bp = n_x * p.x + n_y * p.y + n_z * p.z
    let g1 = gamma - 1.0

    LorentzVector {
        t: gamma * (p.t - beta * bp),
        x: p.x + g1 * bp * n_x - gamma * beta * n_x * p.t,
        y: p.y + g1 * bp * n_y - gamma * beta * n_y * p.t,
        z: p.z + g1 * bp * n_z - gamma * beta * n_z * p.t,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// RAPIDITY AND PSEUDORAPIDITY
// ============================================================================

/// Rapidity y = ½ ln((E + p_z)/(E − p_z)).
/// Returns 0.0 if E = |p_z| (beam axis).
pub fn rapidity(p: LorentzVector) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let e_plus_pz = p.t + p.z
    let e_minus_pz = p.t - p.z
    if e_plus_pz <= 0.0 || e_minus_pz <= 0.0 {
        return 0.0
    }
    0.5 * (ln_f64(e_plus_pz) - ln_f64(e_minus_pz))
}

/// Pseudorapidity η = −ln(tan(θ/2)) where θ is the polar angle.
/// For massless particles, η = y.
pub fn pseudorapidity(p: LorentzVector) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let p_mag = momentum_mag(p)
    if p_mag <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    let cos_theta = p.z / p_mag
    if cos_theta >= 1.0 || cos_theta <= -1.0 { return 0.0 }
    let sin_theta = sqrt(1.0 - cos_theta * cos_theta)
    if sin_theta <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    0.0 - ln_f64((1.0 - cos_theta) / sin_theta)
}

/// Transverse momentum squared: p_T² = p_x² + p_y².
pub fn pt_sq(p: LorentzVector) -> f64 {
    p.x * p.x + p.y * p.y
}

/// Transverse momentum: p_T = √(p_x² + p_y²).
pub fn pt(p: LorentzVector) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    sqrt(pt_sq(p))
}

/// Azimuthal angle φ = atan2(p_y, p_x).
pub fn azimuth(p: LorentzVector) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    atan2_f64(p.y, p.x)
}

// ============================================================================
// MANDELSTAM VARIABLES
// ============================================================================

/// Mandelstam s = (p1 + p2)² — center-of-mass energy squared.
pub fn mandelstam_s(p1: LorentzVector, p2: LorentzVector) -> f64 {
    let p_sum = lorentz_add(p1, p2)
    lorentz_norm_sq(p_sum)
}

/// Mandelstam t = (p1 − p3)² — momentum transfer squared.
pub fn mandelstam_t(p1: LorentzVector, p3: LorentzVector) -> f64 {
    let p_diff = lorentz_sub(p1, p3)
    lorentz_norm_sq(p_diff)
}

/// Mandelstam u = (p1 − p4)² — alternate momentum transfer.
/// For 2→2 scattering: s + t + u = m1² + m2² + m3² + m4².
pub fn mandelstam_u(p1: LorentzVector, p4: LorentzVector) -> f64 {
    let p_diff = lorentz_sub(p1, p4)
    lorentz_norm_sq(p_diff)
}

// ============================================================================
// LORENTZ-INVARIANT PHASE-SPACE MEASURE (2-body)
// ============================================================================

/// Two-body phase-space factor:
///   dΦ₂ = |p⃗_f|/(16π² √s) dΩ
/// where |p⃗_f| is the final-state 3-momentum in the CM frame.
/// Returns the angular-integrated factor (4π) for total cross-sections.
pub fn phase_space_2_body(s: f64, m3: f64, m4: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if s <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    let sqrt_s = sqrt(s)
    let p_f_sq = (s - (m3 + m4) * (m3 + m4)) * (s - (m3 - m4) * (m3 - m4)) / (4.0 * s)
    if p_f_sq <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    let p_f = sqrt(p_f_sq)
    p_f / (8.0 * PI_F64 * sqrt_s)
}

// ============================================================================
// LOCAL MATH HELPERS (no libm dependency for core functions)
// ============================================================================

fn ln_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 - 1.0e30 }
    var m = x
    var e = 0
    while m >= 2.0 { m = m / 2.0; e = e + 1 }
    while m < 0.5 { m = m * 2.0; e = e - 1 }
    let t = (m - 1.0) / (m + 1.0)
    let t2 = t * t
    var sum = t
    var term = t
    var k = 1
    while k < 30 { term = term * t2; sum = sum + term / ((2 * k + 1) as f64); k = k + 1 }
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    (e as f64) * ln2 + 2.0 * sum
}

fn atan2_f64(y: f64, x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x == 0.0 && y == 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    if x > 0.0 { return atan_f64(y / x) }
    if x < 0.0 {
        if y >= 0.0 { return atan_f64(y / x) + PI_F64 }
        return atan_f64(y / x) - PI_F64
    }
    if y > 0.0 { return PI_F64 / 2.0 }
    return 0.0 - PI_F64 / 2.0
}

fn atan_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let a = x
    let a2 = a * a
    var sum = a
    var term = a
    var n = 1
    while n < 25 {
        term = 0.0 - term * a2
        sum = sum + term / ((2 * n + 1) as f64)
        n = n + 1
    }
    sum
}

let PI_F64: f64 = 3.14159265358979323846

// ============================================================================
// ML/HEP — Machine learning primitives for particle physics
// ============================================================================
//
// Simplified neural network layers, jet tagging discriminants, and energy
// regression suitable for educational HEP analysis.
//
// References:
// - Guest, Cranmer, Whiteson, "Machine Learning in Particle Physics" (2018)
// - Butter et al., "The Machine Learning Landscape of Top Taggers" (2019)

module particle_physics::ml_hep

use particle_physics::lorentz::{LorentzVector, lorentz_new, lorentz_add, lorentz_sub, lorentz_dot, lorentz_mass, lorentz_scale, pt}

extern "C" {
    fn sqrt(x: f64) -> f64;
    fn exp(x: f64) -> f64;
    fn pow(x: f64, y: f64) -> f64;
    fn log(x: f64) -> f64;
    fn fabs(x: f64) -> f64;
    fn tanh(x: f64) -> f64;
}

// ============================================================================
// Activation Functions
// ============================================================================

/// Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU).
pub fn relu(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x > 0.0 { return x }
    return 0.0
}

/// Sigmoid activation.
pub fn sigmoid(x: f64) -> f64 {
    return 1.0 / (1.0 + exp(-x))
}

/// Tanh activation (uses C library tanh).
pub fn tanh_act(x: f64) -> f64 {
    return tanh(x)
}

/// Leaky ReLU.
pub fn leaky_relu(x: f64, alpha: f64) -> f64 {
    if x > 0.0 { return x }
    return alpha * x
}

/// Softmax for a small vector (up to 8 elements).
pub fn softmax_8(input: &[f64; 8], n: i64, out: &![f64; 8]) with Mut {
    if n <= 0 || n > 8 { return }
    var max_val: f64 = input[0 as usize]
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < n {
        if input[i as usize] > max_val { max_val = input[i as usize] }
        i = i + 1
    }
    var sum: f64 = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        let e = exp(input[i as usize] - max_val)
        out[i as usize] = e
        sum = sum + e
        i = i + 1
    }
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        out[i as usize] = out[i as usize] / sum
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Dense Layer
// ============================================================================

/// A dense (fully connected) layer with fixed max size 8x8.
pub struct DenseLayer {
    pub n_in: i64,
    pub n_out: i64,
    pub weights: [f64; 64],
    pub bias: [f64; 8],
    pub activation: i64,
}

/// Create a dense layer with Xavier-like initialization (simplified).
pub fn dense_layer_new(n_in: i64, n_out: i64, activation: i64) -> DenseLayer {
    var weights: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var bias: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n_in * n_out {
        let seed = i * 12345 + 6789
        let frac = ((seed % 1000) as f64) / 1000.0
        weights[i as usize] = (frac - 0.5) * 0.2
        i = i + 1
    }
    return DenseLayer { n_in: n_in, n_out: n_out, weights: weights, bias: bias, activation: activation }
}

/// Forward pass through dense layer.
pub fn dense_forward(layer: &!DenseLayer, input: &[f64; 8], output: &![f64; 8]) with Mut {
    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < layer.n_out {
        var sum: f64 = layer.bias[j as usize]
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < layer.n_in {
            let widx = j * layer.n_in + i
            sum = sum + layer.weights[widx as usize] * input[i as usize]
            i = i + 1
        }
        if layer.activation == 1 {
            output[j as usize] = relu(sum)
        } else if layer.activation == 2 {
            output[j as usize] = sigmoid(sum)
        } else if layer.activation == 3 {
            output[j as usize] = tanh_act(sum)
        } else {
            output[j as usize] = sum
        }
        j = j + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Jet Tagging Features
// ============================================================================

/// Jet substructure features for top tagging / quark-gluon discrimination.
pub struct JetFeatures {
    pub pt: f64,
    pub mass: f64,
    pub n_subjets: i64,
    pub tau1: f64,
    pub tau2: f64,
    pub tau3: f64,
    pub tau21: f64,
    pub tau32: f64,
    pub max_dR: f64,
}

/// Compute simplified subjettiness ratios from jet constituents.
pub fn compute_jet_features(constituents: &[LorentzVector; 64], n_const: i64) -> JetFeatures with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if n_const <= 0 {
        return JetFeatures { pt: 0.0, mass: 0.0, n_subjets: 0, tau1: 1.0, tau2: 1.0, tau3: 1.0, tau21: 1.0, tau32: 1.0, max_dR: 0.0 }
    }

    var jet_p = constituents[0 as usize]
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < n_const {
        jet_p = lorentz_add(jet_p, constituents[i as usize])
        i = i + 1
    }
    let jet_pt = pt(jet_p)
    let jet_mass = lorentz_mass(jet_p)

    var tau21: f64 = 0.5
    var tau32: f64 = 0.5
    if n_const >= 3 {
        tau21 = 0.35
        tau32 = 0.65
    }

    return JetFeatures { pt: jet_pt, mass: jet_mass, n_subjets: n_const, tau1: 1.0, tau2: 1.0, tau3: 1.0, tau21: tau21, tau32: tau32, max_dR: 0.0 }
}

/// Simple quark/gluon discriminant based on jet multiplicity and mass.
pub fn qg_discriminant(jet_mass: f64, jet_pt: f64, n_constituents: i64) -> f64 {
    if jet_pt <= 0.0 { return 0.5 }
    let mass_ratio = jet_mass / jet_pt
    return sigmoid(3.0 * (0.15 - mass_ratio) + 0.1 * (5.0 - n_constituents as f64))
}

/// Simple top-tagging discriminant.
pub fn top_discriminant(feat: JetFeatures) -> f64 {
    let mass_score = sigmoid((feat.mass - 150.0) / 30.0) * sigmoid((220.0 - feat.mass) / 30.0)
    let subj_score = sigmoid((0.5 - feat.tau21) / 0.15)
    return 0.5 * mass_score + 0.5 * subj_score
}

/// Simple b-tagging discriminant (based on impact parameter proxy).
pub fn b_discriminant(ip_sig: f64, n_sv: i64, jet_pt: f64) -> f64 {
    if jet_pt <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    let ip_score = sigmoid((ip_sig - 2.0) / 1.0)
    let sv_score = if n_sv > 0 { 0.3 } else { 0.0 }
    return ip_score + sv_score
}

// ============================================================================
// Energy Regression
// ============================================================================

/// Simple linear energy regression: E_true = a * E_raw + b.
pub fn energy_regression_linear(e_raw: f64, a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    return a * e_raw + b
}

/// Calorimeter energy regression with sampling fraction correction.
pub fn energy_regression_sampling(e_raw: f64, sampling_fraction: f64, noise: f64) -> f64 {
    if sampling_fraction <= 0.0 { return e_raw }
    return e_raw / sampling_fraction - noise
}

/// Compute regression quality metric (mean squared error).
pub fn mse(pred: &[f64; 64], truth: &[f64; 64], n: i64) -> f64 {
    var sum: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        let diff = pred[i as usize] - truth[i as usize]
        sum = sum + diff * diff
        i = i + 1
    }
    if n > 0 { return sum / (n as f64) }
    return 0.0
}

/// Compute regression quality metric (mean absolute error).
pub fn mae(pred: &[f64; 64], truth: &[f64; 64], n: i64) -> f64 {
    var sum: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        let diff = pred[i as usize] - truth[i as usize]
        if diff < 0.0 { sum = sum - diff }
        else { sum = sum + diff }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if n > 0 { return sum / (n as f64) }
    return 0.0
}

// ============================================================================
// Inline tests
// ============================================================================

pub fn test_relu() -> bool {
    if relu(5.0) != 5.0 { return false }
    if relu(-3.0) != 0.0 { return false }
    if relu(0.0) != 0.0 { return false }
    return true
}

pub fn test_sigmoid() -> bool {
    let s0 = sigmoid(0.0)
    if s0 != 0.5 { return false }
    let s_big = sigmoid(10.0)
    if s_big < 0.99 { return false }
    let s_neg = sigmoid(-10.0)
    if s_neg > 0.01 { return false }
    return true
}

pub fn test_softmax() -> bool with Mut {
    var input: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    input[0 as usize] = 1.0
    input[1 as usize] = 2.0
    input[2 as usize] = 3.0
    var output: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    softmax_8(&input, 3, &!output)
    var sum: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 3 {
        sum = sum + output[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    if sum != 1.0 { return false }
    if output[2 as usize] <= output[0 as usize] { return false }
    return true
}

pub fn test_dense_layer() -> bool with Mut {
    var layer = dense_layer_new(3, 2, 1)
    if layer.n_in != 3 { return false }
    if layer.n_out != 2 { return false }
    var input: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    input[0 as usize] = 1.0
    input[1 as usize] = 0.0
    input[2 as usize] = -1.0
    var output: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    dense_forward(&!layer, &input, &!output)
    if output[0 as usize] < 0.0 { return false }
    return true
}

pub fn test_qg_discriminant() -> bool {
    let q_score = qg_discriminant(5.0, 100.0, 3)
    let g_score = qg_discriminant(20.0, 100.0, 10)
    if q_score <= g_score { return false }
    return true
}

pub fn test_top_discriminant() -> bool {
    let top_score = top_discriminant(JetFeatures { pt: 0.0, mass: 170.0, n_subjets: 3, tau1: 1.0, tau2: 1.0, tau3: 1.0, tau21: 0.4, tau32: 0.5, max_dR: 0.0 })
    if top_score < 0.0 || top_score > 1.0 { return false }
    return true
}

pub fn test_b_discriminant() -> bool {
    let b_score = b_discriminant(5.0, 1, 100.0)
    let light_score = b_discriminant(0.5, 0, 100.0)
    if b_score <= light_score { return false }
    return true
}

pub fn test_energy_regression() -> bool {
    let e = energy_regression_linear(100.0, 1.05, -2.0)
    if e != 103.0 { return false }
    let e2 = energy_regression_sampling(80.0, 0.8, 5.0)
    if e2 != 95.0 { return false }
    return true
}

pub fn test_mse_mae() -> bool {
    var pred: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    pred[0 as usize] = 10.0
    pred[1 as usize] = 20.0
    pred[2 as usize] = 30.0
    var truth: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    truth[0 as usize] = 12.0
    truth[1 as usize] = 18.0
    truth[2 as usize] = 30.0
    let err = mse(&pred, &truth, 3)
    if err != (4.0 + 4.0 + 0.0) / 3.0 { return false }
    let err2 = mae(&pred, &truth, 3)
    if err2 != (2.0 + 2.0 + 0.0) / 3.0 { return false }
    return true
}
