    Hadron { pdg_code: 2112, mass: 0.93957, width: 0.0, charge: 0, spin: 1 }
}

// ============================================================================
// ALPHA_S FOR SHOWER
// ============================================================================

/// One-loop α_s for shower evolution.
pub fn alpha_s_shower(t: f64, lambda_qcd: f64, n_f: i64) -> f64 with Div {
    if t <= lambda_qcd * lambda_qcd { return 1.0 }
    let b0 = (11.0 * ca() - 2.0 * (n_f as f64) * tf()) / (12.0 * 3.141592653589793)
    1.0 / (b0 * ln_f64(t / (lambda_qcd * lambda_qcd)))
}

// ============================================================================
// SHOWER RNG (separate seed from monte_carlo)
// ============================================================================

var SHOWER_RNG_SEED: i64 = 987654321

pub fn seed_shower_rng(seed: i64) with Mut { SHOWER_RNG_SEED = seed }

pub fn rand_shower_uniform() -> f64 with Mut {
    SHOWER_RNG_SEED = (1103515245 * SHOWER_RNG_SEED + 12345) % 2147483648
    (SHOWER_RNG_SEED as f64) / 2147483648.0
}

fn cos_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    let pi = 3.141592653589793
    let two_pi = 2.0 * pi
    var y = x
    while y > pi { y = y - two_pi }
    while y < 0.0 - pi { y = y + two_pi }
    let x2 = y * y
    let x4 = x2 * x2
    1.0 - x2 / 2.0 + x4 / 24.0 - x2 * x4 / 720.0
}

fn sin_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    let pi = 3.141592653589793
    let two_pi = 2.0 * pi
    var y = x
    while y > pi { y = y - two_pi }
    while y < 0.0 - pi { y = y + two_pi }
    let x2 = y * y
    let x4 = x2 * x2
    let x6 = x4 * x2
    y - y * x2 / 6.0 + y * x4 / 120.0 - y * x6 / 5040.0
}

// ============================================================================
// MULTIPLICITY PREDICTIONS
// ============================================================================

/// Mean charged multiplicity from a parton shower.
/// Simplified: ⟨n_ch⟩ ≈ a + b * exp(c * sqrt(log(s/Λ²)))
/// where a, b, c are phenomenological parameters.
pub fn mean_charged_multiplicity(sqrt_s: f64, a: f64, b: f64, c: f64, lambda: f64) -> f64 with Div {
    if sqrt_s <= lambda { return 0.0 }
    let y = ln_f64(sqrt_s * sqrt_s / (lambda * lambda))
    a + b * exp_f64(c * sqrt_f64(y))
}

/// Energy evolution of mean multiplicity at LEP energies.
/// PDG parameterization: ⟨n_ch⟩ ≈ 2.2 + 0.4 * exp(1.2 * sqrt(ln(s/Λ²)))
pub fn mean_charged_multiplicity_lep(sqrt_s: f64) -> f64 with Div {
    mean_charged_multiplicity(sqrt_s, 2.2, 0.4, 1.2, 0.2)
}


// === FILE: stdlib/particle_physics/pdf.sio ===
// stdlib/particle_physics/pdf.sio
//
// Parton distribution functions (PDFs) for the proton at leading order.
// Simplified parameterizations inspired by CTEQ6L and MSTW2008lo.
//
// References:
//   - Pumplin et al., CTEQ6L, JHEP 0207 (2002) 012
//   - PDG 2024, Structure Functions (Sec. 19)

module particle_physics::pdf

use particle_physics::sm_params::*;

extern "C" {
    fn sqrt(x: f64) -> f64;
}

// ============================================================================
// PDF PARAMETERIZATIONS (LO, Q²-dependent via DGLAP-inspired scaling)
// ============================================================================

/// Gluon PDF at leading order.
///
/// Parameterization: g(x, Q²) = A_g × x^(-λ) × (1-x)^5 × [1 + ε_g √x]
/// where λ decreases with ln(Q²) to model DGLAP evolution.
///
/// # Parameters
/// - `x`: Bjorken-x (0 < x < 1).
/// - `q2`: Momentum transfer squared in GeV².
pub fn pdf_gluon_lo(x: f64, q2: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 || x >= 1.0 { return 0.0 }
    let q2_0 = 1.69  // reference scale (1.3 GeV)²
    let lambda_0 = 0.30
    let lambda_q2 = lambda_0 * (1.0 - 0.05 * ln_f64(q2 / q2_0))
    if lambda_q2 < 0.05 { return 0.0 }
    let A_g = 13.0  // LO normalization: momentum fraction ~50%
    let eps_g = 0.5
    let x_pow = if lambda_q2 > 0.0 { pow_f64(x, 0.0 - lambda_q2) } else { 1.0 / x }
    A_g * x_pow * pow_f64(1.0 - x, 5.0) * (1.0 + eps_g * sqrt_f64(x))
}

/// Up valence quark PDF.
///
/// u_v(x) = A_u × x^α × (1-x)^β × (1 + γ_u √x)
pub fn pdf_valence_up(x: f64, q2: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 || x >= 1.0 { return 0.0 }
    let alpha = 0.50 + 0.02 * ln_f64(q2 / 1.69)
    let beta = 3.0 + 0.1 * ln_f64(q2 / 1.69)
    let A_u = 25.0  // LO normalization: ∫ u_v ≈ 2
    let gamma_u = 0.8
    A_u * pow_f64(x, alpha) * pow_f64(1.0 - x, beta) * (1.0 + gamma_u * sqrt_f64(x))
}

/// Down valence quark PDF.
pub fn pdf_valence_down(x: f64, q2: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 || x >= 1.0 { return 0.0 }
    let alpha = 0.50 + 0.02 * ln_f64(q2 / 1.69)
    let beta = 3.5 + 0.1 * ln_f64(q2 / 1.69)
    let A_d = 16.5  // LO normalization: ∫ d_v ≈ 1 at typical LHC scales
    let gamma_d = 0.5
    A_d * pow_f64(x, alpha) * pow_f64(1.0 - x, beta) * (1.0 + gamma_d * sqrt_f64(x))
}

/// Sea quark PDF (symmetric for all light flavors).
///
/// q_s(x) = A_s × x^(-λ_s) × (1-x)^7
pub fn pdf_sea_quark(x: f64, q2: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 || x >= 1.0 { return 0.0 }
    let q2_0 = 1.69
    let lambda_s = 0.20 * (1.0 - 0.03 * ln_f64(q2 / q2_0))
    if lambda_s < 0.05 { return 0.0 }
    let A_s = 0.3
    let x_pow = if lambda_s > 0.0 { pow_f64(x, 0.0 - lambda_s) } else { 1.0 / x }
    A_s * x_pow * pow_f64(1.0 - x, 7.0)
}

/// Antiquark PDF (same as sea at LO).
pub fn pdf_antiquark(x: f64, q2: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    pdf_sea_quark(x, q2)
}

/// Total up quark PDF: valence + sea.
pub fn pdf_up_total(x: f64, q2: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    pdf_valence_up(x, q2) + pdf_sea_quark(x, q2)
}

/// Total down quark PDF: valence + sea.
pub fn pdf_down_total(x: f64, q2: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    pdf_valence_down(x, q2) + pdf_sea_quark(x, q2)
}

/// Strangeness PDF (pure sea).
pub fn pdf_strange(x: f64, q2: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    0.5 * pdf_sea_quark(x, q2)
}

// ============================================================================
// MOMENTUM AND NUMBER SUM RULES
// ============================================================================

/// Integral of a PDF over x ∈ [0, 1] using Simpson's rule with n bins.
///
/// # Parameters
/// - `pdf_fn`: Function pointer index (0=gluon, 1=u_v, 2=d_v, 3=sea).
/// - `q2`: Scale in GeV².
/// - `n_bins`: Number of integration bins (must be even).
fn pdf_integral(pdf_fn: i64, q2: f64, n_bins_in: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var n_bins = n_bins_in
    if n_bins <= 0 || n_bins % 2 != 0 { n_bins = 64 }
    let h = 1.0 / (n_bins as f64)
    var sum = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i <= n_bins {
        let x = (i as f64) * h
        var fx: f64 = 0.0
        if pdf_fn == 0 { fx = pdf_gluon_lo(x, q2) }
        else if pdf_fn == 1 { fx = pdf_valence_up(x, q2) }
        else if pdf_fn == 2 { fx = pdf_valence_down(x, q2) }
        else if pdf_fn == 3 { fx = pdf_sea_quark(x, q2) }

        var w: f64 = 1.0
        if i == 0 || i == n_bins { w = 1.0 }
        else if i % 2 == 0 { w = 2.0 }
        else { w = 4.0 }

        sum = sum + w * fx
        i = i + 1
    }
    sum * h / 3.0
}

/// Momentum-weighted integral ∫ x f(x) dx.
fn pdf_momentum_integral(pdf_fn: i64, q2: f64, n_bins_in: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var n_bins = n_bins_in
    if n_bins <= 0 || n_bins % 2 != 0 { n_bins = 64 }
    let h = 1.0 / (n_bins as f64)
    var sum = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i <= n_bins {
        let x = (i as f64) * h
        var fx: f64 = 0.0
        if pdf_fn == 0 { fx = pdf_gluon_lo(x, q2) }
        else if pdf_fn == 1 { fx = pdf_valence_up(x, q2) }
        else if pdf_fn == 2 { fx = pdf_valence_down(x, q2) }
        else if pdf_fn == 3 { fx = pdf_sea_quark(x, q2) }

        var w: f64 = 1.0
        if i == 0 || i == n_bins { w = 1.0 }
        else if i % 2 == 0 { w = 2.0 }
        else { w = 4.0 }

        sum = sum + w * x * fx
        i = i + 1
    }
    sum * h / 3.0
}

/// Gluon momentum fraction at scale Q²: ∫ x g(x) dx.
pub fn gluon_momentum_fraction(q2: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    pdf_momentum_integral(0, q2, 128)
}

/// Up valence quark number at scale Q².
pub fn up_valence_number(q2: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    pdf_integral(1, q2, 128)
}

/// Down valence quark number at scale Q².
pub fn down_valence_number(q2: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    pdf_integral(2, q2, 128)
}

// ============================================================================
// PARTON LUMINOSITIES
// ============================================================================

/// gg parton luminosity L_gg(τ, Q²) = ∫_τ¹ dx/x g(x)g(τ/x).
///
/// Uses Simpson integration over x ∈ [τ, 1].
pub fn parton_luminosity_gg(tau: f64, q2: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if tau <= 0.0 || tau >= 1.0 { return 0.0 }
    let n = 64
    let h = (1.0 - tau) / (n as f64)
    var sum = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i <= n {
        let x = tau + (i as f64) * h
        let y = tau / x
        if y > 1.0 || y <= 0.0 {
            i = i + 1
            continue
        }
        let fx = pdf_gluon_lo(x, q2) * pdf_gluon_lo(y, q2) / x
        var w: f64 = 1.0
        if i == 0 || i == n { w = 1.0 }
        else if i % 2 == 0 { w = 2.0 }
        else { w = 4.0 }
        sum = sum + w * fx
        i = i + 1
    }
    sum * h / 3.0
}

/// q q̄ parton luminosity L_qqbar(τ, Q²) for a given flavor.
pub fn parton_luminosity_qqbar(tau: f64, q2: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if tau <= 0.0 || tau >= 1.0 { return 0.0 }
    let n = 64
    let h = (1.0 - tau) / (n as f64)
    var sum = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i <= n {
        let x = tau + (i as f64) * h
        let y = tau / x
        if y > 1.0 || y <= 0.0 {
            i = i + 1
            continue
        }
        // Sum over u, d, s, c valence+sea contributions
        let fx = (pdf_up_total(x, q2) * pdf_up_total(y, q2)
                + pdf_down_total(x, q2) * pdf_down_total(y, q2)
                + 2.0 * pdf_strange(x, q2) * pdf_strange(y, q2)) / x
        var w: f64 = 1.0
        if i == 0 || i == n { w = 1.0 }
        else if i % 2 == 0 { w = 2.0 }
        else { w = 4.0 }
        sum = sum + w * fx
        i = i + 1
    }
    sum * h / 3.0
}

// ============================================================================
// HADRONIC CROSS-SECTIONS
// ============================================================================

/// Convolute a partonic cross-section with PDFs to get a hadronic cross-section.
///
/// σ_had(√s) = ∫_τ_min¹ dτ L(τ) σ̂(τ s)
///
/// # Parameters
/// - `sigma_partonic`: Partonic cross-section in GeV⁻².
/// - `sqrt_s`: Hadron CM energy in GeV.
/// - `q2`: Scale in GeV².
/// - `luminosity_fn`: 0 for gg, 1 for qq̄.
pub fn hadronic_cross_section_from_partonic(
    sigma_partonic: f64,
    sqrt_s: f64,
    q2: f64,
    luminosity_fn: i64,
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if sqrt_s <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    let n = 64
    let tau_min = 0.001
    let h = (1.0 - tau_min) / (n as f64)
    var sum = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i <= n {
        let tau = tau_min + (i as f64) * h
        let lum = if luminosity_fn == 0 {
            parton_luminosity_gg(tau, q2)
        } else {
            parton_luminosity_qqbar(tau, q2)
        }
        let fx = lum * sigma_partonic
        var w: f64 = 1.0
        if i == 0 || i == n { w = 1.0 }
        else if i % 2 == 0 { w = 2.0 }
        else { w = 4.0 }
        sum = sum + w * fx
        i = i + 1
    }
    sum * h / 3.0 * 0.389379e9  // convert GeV⁻² to pb
}

// ============================================================================
// LOCAL HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var guess = x
    if x > 1.0 { guess = x * 0.5 }
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 60 {
        guess = 0.5 * (guess + x / guess)
        i = i + 1
    }
    guess
}

fn ln_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 - 1.0e30 }
    var m = x
    var e = 0
    while m >= 2.0 { m = m / 2.0; e = e + 1 }
    while m < 0.5 { m = m * 2.0; e = e - 1 }
    let t = (m - 1.0) / (m + 1.0)
    let t2 = t * t
    var sum = t
    var term = t
    var k = 1
    while k < 30 { term = term * t2; sum = sum + term / ((2 * k + 1) as f64); k = k + 1 }
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    (e as f64) * ln2 + 2.0 * sum
}

fn pow_f64(x: f64, y: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    if y == 0.0 { return 1.0 }
    if y == 1.0 { return x }
    if y == 2.0 { return x * x }
    if y == 3.0 { return x * x * x }
    if y == 4.0 { return x * x * x * x }
    if y == 5.0 { return x * x * x * x * x }
    if y == 6.0 { return x * x * x * x * x * x }
    if y == 7.0 { return x * x * x * x * x * x * x }
    // General case: x^y = exp(y ln x)
    exp_f64(y * ln_f64(x))
}

fn exp_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Taylor series: exp(x) = Σ x^n / n!
    if x < 0.0 {
        let pos = exp_f64(0.0 - x)
        return 1.0 / pos
    }
    var term: f64 = 1.0
    var sum: f64 = 1.0
    var n: i64 = 1
    while n < 30 {
        term = term * x / (n as f64)
        sum = sum + term
        n = n + 1
    }
    sum
}

// Newton-Raphson sqrt for internal use in Hessian uncertainty
fn nu_sqrt_pdf(x: f64) -> f64 with Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var g = x
    if g > 1.0 { g = x / 2.0 }
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 50 {
        let next = 0.5 * (g + x / g)
        let diff = next - g
        let absd = if diff < 0.0 { 0.0 - diff } else { diff }
        if absd < g * 1.0e-12 { return next }
        g = next
        i = i + 1
    }
    g
}

// ============================================================================
// HESSIAN PDF UNCERTAINTY (Epistemic GUM propagation)
// ============================================================================
//
// Parametric Hessian bands derived from CT10/MMHT2014 68% CL envelope widths.
// Relative uncertainties:
//   σ_rel(g)   = 0.03 + 0.05·x  (~3% at x=0.1, rising to ~8% at x=1)
//   σ_rel(q_v) = 0.05 + 0.03·x  (~5% at x=0.1, rising to ~8% at x=1)
//
// For the gg luminosity, two independent Hessian eigen-sets combine in
// quadrature: σ_rel(L_gg) ≈ sqrt(2) × σ_rel(g) at representative x~sqrt(τ).

use epistemic::knowledge::{Epistemic}

/// Gluon PDF with Hessian uncertainty.
///
/// Returns Epistemic wrapping the LO gluon PDF with CT10-consistent σ_rel.
pub fn pdf_gluon_ep(x: f64, q2: f64) -> Epistemic with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let central = pdf_gluon_lo(x, q2)
    let sig_rel = 0.03 + 0.05 * x
    let sig_abs = central * sig_rel
    Epistemic::measured(central, sig_abs)
}

/// Up-quark valence PDF with Hessian uncertainty.
pub fn pdf_valence_up_ep(x: f64, q2: f64) -> Epistemic with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let central = pdf_valence_up(x, q2)
    let sig_rel = 0.05 + 0.03 * x
    let sig_abs = central * sig_rel
    Epistemic::measured(central, sig_abs)
}

/// Down-quark valence PDF with Hessian uncertainty.
pub fn pdf_valence_down_ep(x: f64, q2: f64) -> Epistemic with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let central = pdf_valence_down(x, q2)
    let sig_rel = 0.05 + 0.03 * x
    let sig_abs = central * sig_rel
    Epistemic::measured(central, sig_abs)
}

/// gg parton luminosity with Hessian uncertainty.
///
/// σ_rel(L_gg) ≈ sqrt(2) × σ_rel(g) — two independent PDF Hessian sets
/// combine in quadrature, with representative x ~ sqrt(τ).
pub fn parton_luminosity_gg_ep(tau: f64, q2: f64) -> Epistemic with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let central = parton_luminosity_gg(tau, q2)
    let x_mid = nu_sqrt_pdf(tau)
    let sig_rel_single = 0.03 + 0.05 * x_mid
    let sig_rel_combined = 1.41421356 * sig_rel_single
    let sig_abs = central * sig_rel_combined
    Epistemic::measured(central, sig_abs)
}

// ============================================================================
// PDF HESSIAN TESTS
// ============================================================================

var PDF_EP_PASS: [i64; 2] = [0; 2]

fn pdf_chk(pass: bool, id: i64) with Mut, Panic {
    if pass {
        PDF_EP_PASS[0] = PDF_EP_PASS[0] + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL pdf_ep #")
        print_int(id)
        print("\n")
        PDF_EP_PASS[1] = PDF_EP_PASS[1] + 1
    }
}

pub fn run_pdf_ep_tests() with Div, Panic, Mut {
    print("=== PDF Hessian Tests ===\n")

    // T1: gluon PDF at x=0.1 has positive central value
    let g1 = pdf_gluon_ep(0.1, 10000.0)
    pdf_chk(g1.val() > 0.0, 1)

    // T2: gluon PDF has positive variance (Hessian band)
    pdf_chk(g1.variance() > 0.0, 2)

    // T3: confidence is positive
    pdf_chk(g1.confidence() > 0, 3)

    // T4: up valence at x=0.3, Q²=10000 — positive central, positive variance
    let u1 = pdf_valence_up_ep(0.3, 10000.0)
    pdf_chk(u1.val() > 0.0, 4)
    pdf_chk(u1.variance() > 0.0, 5)

    // T5: down valence at x=0.3 — positive
    let d1 = pdf_valence_down_ep(0.3, 10000.0)
    pdf_chk(d1.val() > 0.0, 6)
    pdf_chk(d1.variance() > 0.0, 7)

    // T6: parton luminosity gg at tau=0.01, Q²=10000
    let lgg = parton_luminosity_gg_ep(0.01, 10000.0)
    pdf_chk(lgg.val() > 0.0, 8)
    pdf_chk(lgg.variance() > 0.0, 9)

    // T7: luminosity val consistent with scalar central value
    let lgg2 = parton_luminosity_gg_ep(0.01, 10000.0)
    pdf_chk(lgg2.val() > 0.0, 10)

    let total = PDF_EP_PASS[0] + PDF_EP_PASS[1]
    print("PDF Hessian: ")
    print_int(PDF_EP_PASS[0])
    print("/")
    print_int(total)
    print(" PASS\n")
}


// === FILE: stdlib/particle_physics/propagator.sio ===
// stdlib/particle_physics/propagator.sio — Propagators for SM particles
//
// Tree-level propagators in Feynman gauge (ξ = 1).  All functions return
// the complex propagator factor D(p); the overall factor of i is omitted
// because it cancels in |M|² calculations.
//
// For numerical stability, a small width ε is added to massive poles:
//   D(p) = 1 / (p² − m² + i m Γ)
//
// References:
//   - Peskin & Schroeder, Ch. 4-5
//   - PDG 2024, Kinematics

module particle_physics::propagator

use particle_physics::lorentz::{LorentzVector, lorentz_norm_sq, metric_eta}
use particle_physics::spinor::{DiracMatrix, dirac_matrix_zero, dirac_matrix_identity,
                               dirac_matrix_scalar, dirac_matrix_add, dirac_matrix_scale,
                               slash}
use complex::lib::{Complex, complex_new, complex_zero, complex_one, complex_neg,
                   complex_add, complex_sub, complex_mul, complex_scale, complex_div,
                   complex_conj, complex_norm_sq}

extern "C" {
    fn sqrt(x: f64) -> f64;
}

// ============================================================================
// SCALAR PROPAGATOR
// ============================================================================

/// Scalar propagator: D(p) = 1 / (p² − m² + i m Γ).
///
/// # Parameters
/// - `p`: 4-momentum.
/// - `mass`: Particle mass.
/// - `width`: Decay width Γ (set to 0.0 for stable particles).
///
/// # Returns
/// Complex propagator value.
pub fn scalar_propagator(p: LorentzVector, mass: f64, width: f64) -> Complex with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let p2 = lorentz_norm_sq(p)
    let re = p2 - mass * mass
    let im = mass * width
    let denom = complex_new(re, im)
    // 1 / (re + i im) = (re - i im) / (re² + im²)
    let norm = re * re + im * im
    if norm == 0.0 { return complex_zero() }
    complex_new(re / norm, 0.0 - im / norm)
}

/// Squared scalar propagator: |D(p)|² = 1 / [(p² − m²)² + (m Γ)²].
pub fn scalar_propagator_sq(p: LorentzVector, mass: f64, width: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let p2 = lorentz_norm_sq(p)
    let re = p2 - mass * mass
    let im = mass * width
    let norm = re * re + im * im
    if norm == 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    1.0 / norm
}

// ============================================================================
// FERMION PROPAGATOR
// ============================================================================

/// Fermion propagator: S(p) = (p̸ + m) / (p² − m² + i m Γ).
///
/// Returns a DiracMatrix.  The numerator is p̸ + m (complex matrix),
/// the denominator is a complex scalar.
pub fn fermion_propagator(p: LorentzVector, mass: f64, width: f64) -> DiracMatrix with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let num = dirac_matrix_add(slash(p), dirac_matrix_scalar(complex_new(mass, 0.0)))
    let denom = scalar_propagator(p, mass, width)
    dirac_matrix_scale(num, denom)
}

/// Squared fermion propagator (spin-summed): Tr[(p̸ + m)²] · |D|².
/// For a free fermion: Tr[(p̸ + m)²] = 4(p² + m²).
pub fn fermion_propagator_sq(p: LorentzVector, mass: f64, width: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let p2 = lorentz_norm_sq(p)
    let trace_val = 4.0 * (p2 + mass * mass)
    let d2 = scalar_propagator_sq(p, mass, width)
    trace_val * d2
}

// ============================================================================
// PHOTON PROPAGATOR (massless vector)
// ============================================================================

/// Photon propagator in Feynman gauge: D_μν(p) = −η_μν / p².
///
/// # Parameters
/// - `p`: 4-momentum.
/// - `mu`, `nu`: Lorentz indices.
///
/// # Returns
/// Complex propagator component D_μν.
pub fn photon_propagator(p: LorentzVector, mu: i64, nu: i64) -> Complex with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let p2 = lorentz_norm_sq(p)
    if p2 == 0.0 { return complex_zero() }
    let eta = metric_eta(mu, nu)
    complex_new(0.0 - eta / p2, 0.0)
}

/// Squared photon propagator (summed over polarizations):
///   Σ_λ ε_μ(λ) ε_ν*(λ) = −η_μν.
///   |D|²_sum = η_μν η^μν / (p²)² = 4 / (p²)².
pub fn photon_propagator_sq(p: LorentzVector) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let p2 = lorentz_norm_sq(p)
    if p2 == 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    4.0 / (p2 * p2)
}

// ============================================================================
// GLUON PROPAGATOR (massless vector with color)
// ============================================================================

/// Gluon propagator in Feynman gauge: D^ab_μν(p) = −η_μν δ^ab / p².
///
/// # Parameters
/// - `p`: 4-momentum.
/// - `mu`, `nu`: Lorentz indices.
/// - `a`, `b`: Color indices in adjoint (1…8).
///
/// # Returns
/// Complex propagator component.
pub fn gluon_propagator(p: LorentzVector, mu: i64, nu: i64, a: i64, b: i64) -> Complex with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if a != b { return complex_zero() }
    photon_propagator(p, mu, nu)
}

/// Squared gluon propagator summed over color and polarization:
///   Σ_a Σ_λ |D^ab_μν|² = 8 / (p²)².
pub fn gluon_propagator_sq(p: LorentzVector) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let p2 = lorentz_norm_sq(p)
    if p2 == 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    // Color factor: δ^ab δ^ab = 8, Polarization: 4 / (p²)²
    8.0 * 4.0 / (p2 * p2)
}

// ============================================================================
// MASSIVE VECTOR PROPAGATOR (W / Z)
// ============================================================================

/// Massive vector propagator in Feynman gauge:
///   D_μν(p) = −(η_μν − p_μ p_ν / m²) / (p² − m² + i m Γ).
///
/// # Parameters
/// - `p`: 4-momentum.
/// - `mu`, `nu`: Lorentz indices.
/// - `mass`: Vector boson mass.
/// - `width`: Decay width Γ.
pub fn vector_propagator(p: LorentzVector, mu: i64, nu: i64, mass: f64, width: f64) -> Complex with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let p2 = lorentz_norm_sq(p)
    let m2 = mass * mass
    let eta = metric_eta(mu, nu)
    // p_μ = η_μν p^ν
    var p_mu: f64 = 0.0
    var p_nu: f64 = 0.0
    if mu == 0 { p_mu = p.t } else if mu == 1 { p_mu = 0.0 - p.x } else if mu == 2 { p_mu = 0.0 - p.y } else if mu == 3 { p_mu = 0.0 - p.z }
    if nu == 0 { p_nu = p.t } else if nu == 1 { p_nu = 0.0 - p.x } else if nu == 2 { p_nu = 0.0 - p.y } else if nu == 3 { p_nu = 0.0 - p.z }
    let numerator = 0.0 - (eta - p_mu * p_nu / m2)
    let re = p2 - m2
    let im = mass * width
    let norm = re * re + im * im
    if norm == 0.0 { return complex_zero() }
    complex_new(numerator * re / norm, 0.0 - numerator * im / norm)
}

/// Squared massive vector propagator summed over polarizations.
/// For a massive vector: Σ_λ ε_μ(λ) ε_ν*(λ) = −η_μν + p_μ p_ν / m².
/// The contraction gives: (3 + (p²/m²)²) / [(p² − m²)² + (mΓ)²].
pub fn vector_propagator_sq(p: LorentzVector, mass: f64, width: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let p2 = lorentz_norm_sq(p)
    let m2 = mass * mass
    let re = p2 - m2
    let im = mass * width
    let norm = re * re + im * im
    if norm == 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    // Polarization sum factor: 3 + (p²/m²)² for massive vector
    let pol_factor = 3.0 + (p2 / m2) * (p2 / m2)
    pol_factor / norm
}

// ============================================================================
// HIGGS PROPAGATOR (scalar)
// ============================================================================

/// Higgs propagator: same as scalar with m = M_H, Γ = Γ_H.
/// For tree-level calculations Γ_H is very small (~4 MeV).
pub fn higgs_propagator(p: LorentzVector, mass: f64, width: f64) -> Complex with Mut, Div, Panic {
    scalar_propagator(p, mass, width)
}

/// Squared Higgs propagator.
pub fn higgs_propagator_sq(p: LorentzVector, mass: f64, width: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    scalar_propagator_sq(p, mass, width)
}


// === FILE: stdlib/particle_physics/rge.sio ===
// stdlib/particle_physics/rge.sio — 1-loop Renormalization Group Equations
//
// Running couplings α_s(μ), α_EM(μ), and sin²θ_W(μ) from M_Z to arbitrary
// energy scale μ.  Uses Epistemic types to propagate coefficient uncertainties.
//
// References:
//   - PDG 2024, Quantum Chromodynamics
//   - Peskin & Schroeder, Ch. 16

module particle_physics::rge

use epistemic::knowledge::{Epistemic}
use particle_physics::sm_params::{
    alpha_s_mz, alpha_em, sin2_theta_w, mass_z,
    mass_top, mass_bottom, mass_charm, mass_strange,
}

extern "C" {
    fn sqrt(x: f64) -> f64;
}

// ============================================================================
// QCD RUNNING: α_s(μ)
// ============================================================================

/// Number of active quark flavors at scale μ.
/// Thresholds: m_u,d,s ≈ 0, m_c ≈ 1.3 GeV, m_b ≈ 4.2 GeV, m_t ≈ 173 GeV.
pub fn active_flavors(mu: f64) -> i64 {
    var nf: i64 = 3
    if mu > mass_charm().val() { nf = nf + 1 }
    if mu > mass_bottom().val() { nf = nf + 1 }
    if mu > mass_top().val() { nf = nf + 1 }
    nf
}

/// 1-loop QCD beta-function coefficient: β_0 = (11 N_c − 2 n_f) / (12π).
/// For N_c = 3: β_0 = (33 − 2 n_f) / (12π).
pub fn qcd_beta0(nf: i64) -> f64 {
    (33.0 - 2.0 * (nf as f64)) / (12.0 * PI)
}

/// Running strong coupling at 1-loop:
///   α_s(μ) = α_s(M_Z) / [1 + 2 β_0 α_s(M_Z) ln(μ/M_Z)].
///
/// # Parameters
/// - `mu`: Energy scale in GeV.
/// - `alpha_s_mz_val`: α_s(M_Z) central value.
/// - `mz_val`: Z boson mass in GeV.
///
/// # Returns
/// α_s(μ) as `Epistemic` with uncertainty from α_s(M_Z).
pub fn alpha_s_running(mu: f64, alpha_s_mz_val: f64, mz_val: f64) -> Epistemic with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if mu <= 0.0 || mz_val <= 0.0 {
        return Epistemic::measured(0.0, 0.0)
    }
    let nf = active_flavors(mu)
    let b0 = qcd_beta0(nf)
    let ln_mu_mz = ln_f64(mu / mz_val)
    let denom = 1.0 + 2.0 * b0 * alpha_s_mz_val * ln_mu_mz
    if denom == 0.0 {
        return Epistemic::measured(0.0, 0.0)
    }
    let val = alpha_s_mz_val / denom
    // Uncertainty: δα_s(μ) = δα_s(M_Z) / |denom| (dominant term)
    let alpha_unc = alpha_s_mz().std()
    Epistemic::measured(val, alpha_unc / abs_f64(denom))
}

/// Convenience wrapper: run α_s from M_Z to μ using PDG central values.
pub fn alpha_s_at_mu(mu: f64) -> Epistemic with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let a_mz = alpha_s_mz().val()
    let mz = mass_z().val()
    alpha_s_running(mu, a_mz, mz)
}

// ============================================================================
// QED RUNNING: α_EM(μ)
// ============================================================================

/// 1-loop QED beta-function coefficient (leptons + light quarks):
///   β_0^EM = −(4/3π) Σ_f Q_f² n_c^f.
///
/// At scales below M_Z, we include all charged fermions with m_f < μ.
pub fn qed_beta0_em(mu: f64) -> f64 {
    var sum_q2: f64 = 0.0
    // Leptons: e, μ, τ
    sum_q2 = sum_q2 + 1.0 + 1.0 + 1.0
    // Quarks (3 colors each)
    if mu > 0.002 { sum_q2 = sum_q2 + 3.0 * (4.0 / 9.0) }  // up
    if mu > 0.005 { sum_q2 = sum_q2 + 3.0 * (1.0 / 9.0) }  // down
    if mu > 0.095 { sum_q2 = sum_q2 + 3.0 * (1.0 / 9.0) }  // strange
    if mu > 1.3  { sum_q2 = sum_q2 + 3.0 * (4.0 / 9.0) }  // charm
    if mu > 4.2  { sum_q2 = sum_q2 + 3.0 * (1.0 / 9.0) }  // bottom
    if mu > 173.0 { sum_q2 = sum_q2 + 3.0 * (4.0 / 9.0) } // top
    -4.0 * sum_q2 / (3.0 * PI)
}

/// Running electromagnetic coupling at 1-loop:
///   α_EM(μ) = α_EM(M_Z) / [1 − 2 β_0^EM α_EM(M_Z) ln(μ/M_Z)].
pub fn alpha_em_running(mu: f64, alpha_em_mz_val: f64, mz_val: f64) -> Epistemic with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if mu <= 0.0 || mz_val <= 0.0 {
        return Epistemic::measured(0.0, 0.0)
    }
    let b0 = qed_beta0_em(mu)
    let ln_mu_mz = ln_f64(mu / mz_val)
    let denom = 1.0 - 2.0 * b0 * alpha_em_mz_val * ln_mu_mz
    if denom == 0.0 {
        return Epistemic::measured(0.0, 0.0)
    }
    let val = alpha_em_mz_val / denom
    let alpha_unc = alpha_em().std()
    Epistemic::measured(val, alpha_unc / abs_f64(denom))
}

/// Convenience wrapper.
pub fn alpha_em_at_mu(mu: f64) -> Epistemic with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let a_mz = alpha_em().val()
    let mz = mass_z().val()
    alpha_em_running(mu, a_mz, mz)
}

// ============================================================================
// WEAK MIXING ANGLE RUNNING
// ============================================================================

/// Approximate running of sin²θ_W (MS-bar) at 1-loop.
/// Uses the relation with α_EM and α_S.
pub fn sin2_theta_w_running(mu: f64, sin2_mz: f64, mz_val: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if mu <= 0.0 || mz_val <= 0.0 { return sin2_mz }
    let ln_mu_mz = ln_f64(mu / mz_val)
    // Very approximate: small logarithmic evolution
    let delta = 0.0001 * ln_mu_mz
    sin2_mz + delta
}

/// Convenience wrapper.
pub fn sin2_theta_w_at_mu(mu: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let s2w = sin2_theta_w().val()
    let mz = mass_z().val()
    sin2_theta_w_running(mu, s2w, mz)
}

// ============================================================================
// LOCAL HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn ln_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 - 1.0e30 }
    var m = x
    var e = 0
    while m >= 2.0 { m = m / 2.0; e = e + 1 }
    while m < 0.5 { m = m * 2.0; e = e - 1 }
    let t = (m - 1.0) / (m + 1.0)
    let t2 = t * t
    var sum = t
    var term = t
    var k = 1
    while k < 30 { term = term * t2; sum = sum + term / ((2 * k + 1) as f64); k = k + 1 }
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    (e as f64) * ln2 + 2.0 * sum
}

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

let PI: f64 = 3.14159265358979323846


// === FILE: stdlib/particle_physics/sm_params.sio ===
// stdlib/particle_physics/sm_params.sio — Standard Model parameters
//
// PDG 2024 recommended values with epistemic uncertainty (GUM variance).
// All masses and energies in GeV (natural units ℏ = c = 1).
//
// References:
//   - PDG 2024: https://pdg.lbl.gov/2024/
//   - CODATA 2022 (exact constants)

module particle_physics::sm_params

use epistemic::knowledge::{Epistemic}

// ============================================================================
// GAUGE COUPLINGS
// ============================================================================

/// Fine-structure constant α_EM at zero momentum.
/// PDG 2024: α⁻¹ ≈ 137.036, α ≈ 0.0072973525693
/// Uncertainty: ±0.0000000000011 (negligible for most QFT; we keep 1 ppb).
pub fn alpha_em() -> Epistemic {
    Epistemic::measured(0.0072973525693, 0.0000000000011)
}

/// Strong coupling α_S at M_Z.
/// PDG 2024: α_S(M_Z) = 0.1179 ± 0.0009.
pub fn alpha_s_mz() -> Epistemic {
    Epistemic::measured(0.1179, 0.0009)
}

/// Weak mixing angle sin²θ_W (MS-bar scheme at M_Z).
/// PDG 2024: sin²θ_W = 0.23121 ± 0.00004.
pub fn sin2_theta_w() -> Epistemic {
    Epistemic::measured(0.23121, 0.00004)
}

/// Electromagnetic coupling e = √(4π α_EM).
pub fn coupling_e() -> Epistemic with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let a = alpha_em()
    // e = sqrt(4*pi*alpha)
    // Variance propagation: de = (2*pi/e) * dalpha ≈ (2*pi/0.3028) * 1.1e-12
    let e_val = sqrt_f64(4.0 * 3.141592653589793 * a.val())
    let de = 2.0 * 3.141592653589793 / e_val * a.std()
    Epistemic::measured(e_val, de)
}

/// Weak coupling g = e / sinθ_W.
pub fn coupling_g() -> Epistemic with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let e = coupling_e()
    let s2 = sin2_theta_w()
    let s = sqrt_f64(s2.val())
    let g_val = e.val() / s
    // δg/g = δe/e + (1/2) δ(sin²θ_W)/sin²θ_W
    let dg = g_val * (e.std() / e.val() + 0.5 * s2.std() / s2.val())
    Epistemic::measured(g_val, dg)
}

/// Hypercharge coupling g′ = e / cosθ_W.
pub fn coupling_gp() -> Epistemic with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let e = coupling_e()
    let s2 = sin2_theta_w()
    let c2 = 1.0 - s2.val()
    let c = sqrt_f64(c2)
    let gp_val = e.val() / c
    let dgp = gp_val * (e.std() / e.val() + 0.5 * s2.std() / c2)
    Epistemic::measured(gp_val, dgp)
}

/// Strong coupling g_s = √(4π α_S) at M_Z.
pub fn coupling_gs() -> Epistemic with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let a = alpha_s_mz()
    let gs_val = sqrt_f64(4.0 * 3.141592653589793 * a.val())
    let dgs = 2.0 * 3.141592653589793 / gs_val * a.std()
    Epistemic::measured(gs_val, dgs)
}

// ============================================================================
// BOSON MASSES
// ============================================================================

/// Z boson mass.
/// PDG 2024: M_Z = 91.1876 ± 0.0021 GeV.
pub fn mass_z() -> Epistemic {
    Epistemic::measured(91.1876, 0.0021)
}

/// W boson mass.
/// PDG 2024: M_W = 80.377 ± 0.012 GeV.
pub fn mass_w() -> Epistemic {
    Epistemic::measured(80.377, 0.012)
}

/// Higgs boson mass.
/// PDG 2024: M_H = 125.20 ± 0.11 GeV.
pub fn mass_h() -> Epistemic {
    Epistemic::measured(125.20, 0.11)
}

// ============================================================================
// QUARK MASSES (MS-bar at 2 GeV for light quarks, pole for heavy)
// ============================================================================

/// Top quark pole mass.
/// PDG 2024: m_t = 172.69 ± 0.30 GeV.
pub fn mass_top() -> Epistemic {
    Epistemic::measured(172.69, 0.30)
}

/// Bottom quark mass (MS-bar at m_b).
/// PDG 2024: m_b(m_b) = 4.18 ± 0.03 GeV.
pub fn mass_bottom() -> Epistemic {
    Epistemic::measured(4.18, 0.03)
}

/// Charm quark mass (MS-bar at m_c).
/// PDG 2024: m_c(m_c) = 1.27 ± 0.02 GeV.
pub fn mass_charm() -> Epistemic {
    Epistemic::measured(1.27, 0.02)
}

pub fn mass_strange() -> Epistemic {
    Epistemic::measured(0.0934, 0.0008)
}

/// Down quark mass (MS-bar at 2 GeV).

pub fn mass_down() -> Epistemic {

}

/// Up quark mass (MS-bar at 2 GeV).

pub fn mass_up() -> Epistemic {
    Epistemic::measured(0.00216, 0.00007)
