// === FILE: stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_dose_response.sio ===
// stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_dose_response.sio — Sprint 24: Dose-Response Certification
//
// Novel dissertation contribution: certifies dose-proportionality of the GUM
// model and maps the full therapeutic/unsafe dose range for every clinical stratum.
//
// ── GUM Dose-Proportionality Theorem ──────────────────────────────────────────
//
//   For a linear N-compartment Euler ODE with initial loading A_gut = D:
//     C_trough(D)  = α · D          (linearly proportional to dose)
//     V₁_amount(D) = β · D²         (quadratic, since sensitivity ∝ D)
//     σ_conc(D)    = √β/Vc · D      (linear in D)
//     rel_std(D)   = σ_conc / C = √β/(α·Vc)  ← DOSE-INVARIANT
//
//   Corollary: the GUM confidence score is dose-independent.
//   Only N (doses to date), patient PK parameters (ke, F, ka), and assay quality
//   determine confidence. Adjusting dose changes the point estimate (C) but
//   not the uncertainty band (rel_std).
//
//   Verified numerically (Sprint 24 probe): C(10mg)/C(5mg) = 2.000000 (exact),
//   V(10mg)/V(5mg) = 4.000000 (exact), rel_std identical to 6 decimal places.
//
// ── Key dose-response findings (all certified by Sprint 24 gate) ──────────────
//
//   Standard genotype SS (ke=0.01118, F=0.141, N=14):
//     D=2mg:  C=3.917 ng/mL  → UNCERTAIN (CI straddles floor)
//     D=3mg:  C=5.876 ng/mL  → THERAPEUTIC
//     D=5mg:  C=9.793 ng/mL  → THERAPEUTIC
//     D=10mg: C=19.586 ng/mL → THERAPEUTIC (just below 20 ng/mL ceiling)
//     D=11mg: C=21.545 ng/mL → TOXIC
//     Therapeutic dose window: [3mg, 10mg]
//
//   Slow genotype SS (ke=0.00838, F=0.188, N=14):
//     D=2mg:  C=5.794 ng/mL  → THERAPEUTIC (lower dose sufficient)
//     D=5mg:  C=14.485 ng/mL → THERAPEUTIC
//     D=10mg: C=28.971 ng/mL → TOXIC
//     Therapeutic dose window: [~1.5mg, ~6.9mg]
//
//   Fast genotype SS (ke=0.01677, F=0.094, N=14):
//     C(5mg) = 5.374 ng/mL   → THERAPEUTIC (narrow range; needs close monitoring)
//     C(10mg) = 10.749 ng/mL → THERAPEUTIC
//     C(15mg) = 16.123 ng/mL → THERAPEUTIC
//
//   Strong CYP3A4 inhibitor SS (ke=0.002236, F=0.282, N=14):
//     D=1.5mg: C=8.334 ng/mL → THERAPEUTIC (Sprint 21 reduced dose)
//     D=5mg:   C=27.780 ng/mL → TOXIC  ← EPISTEMIC SAFETY FINDING
//     Standard dosing on an inhibitor patient is a compile-time-detectable safety error.
//
//   Strong CYP3A4 inducer N=26 (ke=0.05590, F=0.047):
//     D=10mg: C=2.353 ng/mL → SUB (CI fully below floor)
//     D=15mg: C=3.530 ng/mL → UNCERTAIN (CI straddles floor)
//     D=20mg: C=4.707 ng/mL → THERAPEUTIC (Sprint 21 N_min=26 dose)
//     D=40mg: C=9.413 ng/mL → THERAPEUTIC
//
// ── Effect annotations ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//   dr_sqrt, dr_classify, dr_proportional_*: with Mut, Div, Panic
//   All boolean gate fns:                    with Mut, Div, Panic

module pbpk::rapamycin_dose_response

use pbpk::rapamycin_clinical::{
    conf_from_rel, trough_floor_mg_l, trough_ceil_mg_l, conf_clinical_min,
    decision_sub, decision_therapeutic, decision_toxic, decision_uncertain
}
use pbpk::rapamycin_assay::{as_trough_mg_l, as_v_pred_conc, as_conf_pred}
use pbpk::rapamycin_oral_budget::{
    ob_v1_total,
    ob_ka_var_std, ob_f_var_std, ob_ke_var_std, ob_k12_var_std, ob_k21_var_std,
    ob_ke_var_inh, ob_ke_var_ind
}

fn dr_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { 0.0001 } else {
        var r = x
        var i = 0
        while i < 50 { r = (r + x / r) / 2.0; i = i + 1 }
        r
    }
}

// ── Core classification function ──────────────────────────────────────────────

// Clinical TDM decision without Epistemic effect.
// Replicates assess_trough logic using GUM-certified C and σ, without Epistemic.
// Returns: 0=SUB, 1=THERAPEUTIC, 2=TOXIC, 3=UNCERTAIN
pub fn dr_classify(d_oral: f64, n_doses: i64, ke_val: f64, f_val: f64,
                   ka_var: f64, f_var: f64, ke_var: f64,
                   k12_var: f64, k21_var: f64) -> i64
    with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let vc    = 75.0
    let c     = as_trough_mg_l(d_oral, n_doses, ke_val, f_val)
    let v     = as_v_pred_conc(d_oral, n_doses, ke_val, f_val,
                               ka_var, f_var, ke_var, k12_var, k21_var)
    let std   = dr_sqrt(v)
    let conf  = conf_from_rel(c, std)
    let hi    = c + 1.96 * std
    let floor = trough_floor_mg_l()
    let ceil  = trough_ceil_mg_l()
    if c > ceil { decision_toxic() }
    else if c < floor {
        if hi > floor { decision_uncertain() }
        else          { decision_sub() }
    }
    else if conf >= conf_clinical_min() { decision_therapeutic() }
    else { decision_uncertain() }
}

// ── Dose-proportionality theorem ──────────────────────────────────────────────

// True iff C(D2)/C(D1) is within 2% of D2/D1 (cross-multiply: exact for linear ODE).
// In practice, for the Euler ODE the ratio is exact to floating-point precision.
pub fn dr_proportional(d1: f64, d2: f64, n: i64, ke: f64, f: f64) -> bool
    with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let c1 = as_trough_mg_l(d1, n, ke, f)
    let c2 = as_trough_mg_l(d2, n, ke, f)
    // cross-multiply: c2 * d1 ≈ c1 * d2 → check within 2%
    // c2 * d1 > c1 * d2 * 0.98 AND c2 * d1 < c1 * d2 * 1.02
    // Using integers: 100 * c2 * d1 > 98 * c1 * d2 AND 100 * c2 * d1 < 102 * c1 * d2
    let lhs = c2 * d1
    let lo  = c1 * d2 * 0.98
    let hi  = c1 * d2 * 1.02
    lhs > lo && lhs < hi
}

// True iff conf(D1, ...) == conf(D2, ...) — dose-invariance of confidence.
pub fn dr_conf_dose_invariant(d1: f64, d2: f64, n: i64, ke: f64, f: f64,
                               ka_var: f64, f_var: f64, ke_var: f64,
                               k12_var: f64, k21_var: f64) -> bool
    with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let cp1 = as_conf_pred(d1, n, ke, f, ka_var, f_var, ke_var, k12_var, k21_var)
    let cp2 = as_conf_pred(d2, n, ke, f, ka_var, f_var, ke_var, k12_var, k21_var)
    cp1 == cp2
}

    let ke = ob_ke_var_std(); let k12 = ob_k12_var_std(); let k21 = ob_k21_var_std()

// === FILE: stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_expanded_u.sio ===
// stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_expanded_u.sio — Sprint 25: ISO GUM Expanded Uncertainty
//
// Novel dissertation contribution: certifies 95% coverage intervals for every
// clinical stratum; distinguishes THERAPEUTIC classification (point estimate)
// from FULL CI CERTIFICATION (both bounds within [floor, ceil]).
//
// ── ISO GUM §E.5 Expanded Uncertainty ────────────────────────────────────────
//
//   u_c(C) = sqrt(V_pred_conc)          (combined standard uncertainty)
//   U_95   = k * u_c,  k = 2            (coverage factor, ~95% normal)
//   CI_95  = [C - U_95, C + U_95]
//
//   A stratum is FULLY CERTIFIED iff:
//     C - 2*u_c > floor  AND  C + 2*u_c < ceil
//
// ── Key Sprint 25 findings (all certified by gate) ────────────────────────────
//
//   Standard SS (N=14, D=5mg):
//     u_c = 0.000901 mg/L, U_95 = 1.80 ng/mL
//     CI = [7.99, 11.59] ng/mL → FULLY CERTIFIED
//
//   Standard onset (N=3):
//     u_c = 0.000836, CI = [2.56, 5.90] ng/mL → straddles floor
//
//   Standard N=7 (critical N):
//     u_c = 0.000855, CI = [4.70, 8.12] ng/mL → FULLY CERTIFIED (margin=0.70 ng/mL)
//
//   Slow genotype SS (N=14, D=5mg):
//     u_c = 0.001038, U_95 = 2.08 ng/mL, CI = [12.41, 16.56] ng/mL → FULLY CERTIFIED
//
//   Fast genotype SS (N=14, D=5mg) — KEY FINDING:
//     u_c = 0.000745, CI = [3.88, 6.87] ng/mL → straddles floor
//     Point estimate (5.37 ng/mL) says THERAPEUTIC; expanded-U says NOT CERTIFIED.
//     Compile-time-detectable gap between classification and certification.
//
//   Strong CYP3A4 inhibitor SS (N=14, D=1.5mg) — NARROWEST CI:
//     u_c = 0.000440, U_95 = 0.88 ng/mL, CI = [7.45, 9.21] ng/mL → FULLY CERTIFIED
//     Paradox: CYP inhibition slows ke → high SS concentration, low variability.
//
//   Strong CYP3A4 inducer (N=26, D=20mg) — INHERENTLY WIDE:
//     u_c = 0.001168, U_95 = 2.34 ng/mL, CI = [2.37, 7.04] ng/mL → straddles floor
//     N_min=26 certifies THERAPEUTIC point estimate; cannot certify full CI.
//
//   Width ordering (U_95, narrowest to widest):
//     inh (0.88) < fast (1.49) < std (1.80) < slow (2.08) < ind (2.34) ng/mL
//
// ── Effect annotations ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//   All pub fns: with Mut, Div, Panic

module pbpk::rapamycin_expanded_u

use pbpk::rapamycin_clinical::{trough_floor_mg_l, trough_ceil_mg_l}
use pbpk::rapamycin_assay::{as_trough_mg_l, as_v_pred_conc}
use pbpk::rapamycin_oral_budget::{
    ob_ka_var_std, ob_f_var_std, ob_ke_var_std,
    ob_k12_var_std, ob_k21_var_std, ob_ke_var_inh, ob_ke_var_ind
}

fn eu_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { 0.0001 } else {
        var r = x
        var i = 0
        while i < 50 { r = (r + x / r) / 2.0; i = i + 1 }
        r
    }
}

// Combined standard uncertainty u_c = sqrt(V_pred_conc)  [ISO GUM §5.1.2]
pub fn eu_u_c(d_oral: f64, n_doses: i64, ke_val: f64, f_val: f64,
              ka_var: f64, f_var: f64, ke_var: f64, k12_var: f64, k21_var: f64) -> f64
    with Mut, Div, Panic {
    eu_sqrt(as_v_pred_conc(d_oral, n_doses, ke_val, f_val, ka_var, f_var, ke_var, k12_var, k21_var))
}

// Expanded uncertainty U_95 = 2 * u_c  (coverage factor k=2, ~95%)
pub fn eu_U95(d_oral: f64, n_doses: i64, ke_val: f64, f_val: f64,
              ka_var: f64, f_var: f64, ke_var: f64, k12_var: f64, k21_var: f64) -> f64
    with Mut, Div, Panic {
    2.0 * eu_u_c(d_oral, n_doses, ke_val, f_val, ka_var, f_var, ke_var, k12_var, k21_var)
}

// Lower bound of 95% coverage interval: C - 2*u_c
pub fn eu_lo(d_oral: f64, n_doses: i64, ke_val: f64, f_val: f64,
             ka_var: f64, f_var: f64, ke_var: f64, k12_var: f64, k21_var: f64) -> f64
    with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let c  = as_trough_mg_l(d_oral, n_doses, ke_val, f_val)
    let uc = eu_u_c(d_oral, n_doses, ke_val, f_val, ka_var, f_var, ke_var, k12_var, k21_var)
    c - 2.0 * uc
}

// Upper bound of 95% coverage interval: C + 2*u_c
pub fn eu_hi(d_oral: f64, n_doses: i64, ke_val: f64, f_val: f64,
             ka_var: f64, f_var: f64, ke_var: f64, k12_var: f64, k21_var: f64) -> f64
    with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let c  = as_trough_mg_l(d_oral, n_doses, ke_val, f_val)
    let uc = eu_u_c(d_oral, n_doses, ke_val, f_val, ka_var, f_var, ke_var, k12_var, k21_var)
    c + 2.0 * uc
}

// True iff 95% CI lies fully within [floor, ceil]  — the CI certification gate
pub fn eu_fully_in_range(d_oral: f64, n_doses: i64, ke_val: f64, f_val: f64,
                         ka_var: f64, f_var: f64, ke_var: f64, k12_var: f64, k21_var: f64) -> bool
    with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let lo = eu_lo(d_oral, n_doses, ke_val, f_val, ka_var, f_var, ke_var, k12_var, k21_var)
    let hi = eu_hi(d_oral, n_doses, ke_val, f_val, ka_var, f_var, ke_var, k12_var, k21_var)
    lo > trough_floor_mg_l() && hi < trough_ceil_mg_l()
}

// True iff CI lower bound is below floor (CI straddles floor)
pub fn eu_lo_below_floor(d_oral: f64, n_doses: i64, ke_val: f64, f_val: f64,
                          ka_var: f64, f_var: f64, ke_var: f64, k12_var: f64, k21_var: f64) -> bool
    with Mut, Div, Panic {
    eu_lo(d_oral, n_doses, ke_val, f_val, ka_var, f_var, ke_var, k12_var, k21_var) < trough_floor_mg_l()
}

// True iff CI upper bound exceeds ceiling (CI straddles ceiling)
pub fn eu_hi_above_ceil(d_oral: f64, n_doses: i64, ke_val: f64, f_val: f64,
                         ka_var: f64, f_var: f64, ke_var: f64, k12_var: f64, k21_var: f64) -> bool
    with Mut, Div, Panic {
    eu_hi(d_oral, n_doses, ke_val, f_val, ka_var, f_var, ke_var, k12_var, k21_var) > trough_ceil_mg_l()
}

// === FILE: stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_f_threshold.sio ===
// stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_f_threshold.sio — Bioavailability epistemic threshold theorem
//
// Sprint 20 dissertation finding: there exist four bioavailability thresholds
// that govern the epistemic regime of oral rapamycin TDM. These thresholds
// unify the CYP3A5 genotype findings (Sprint 18) and DDI findings (Sprint 19)
// under a single structural principle.
//
// ── Four bioavailability thresholds (D=5mg, N=14, ke=0.01118, standard ka_var) ──
//
//   F < F_low ≈ 0.048:          conf = 700 (Regime I — epistemic impossibility)
//   F_low ≤ F < F* ≈ 0.128:    conf = 820 (Regime II — structural ceiling)
//   F* ≤ F < F_low_ka16 ≈ ...: conf = 900 (Regime III — standard accessible)
//   F ≥ F** ≈ 0.150 (ka÷16):   conf = 950 (Regime IV — global optimum accessible)
//   F ≥ F*** ≈ 0.365 (std ka):  conf = 950 (Regime IV via bioavailability alone)
//
//   F_low = 0.047 → 0.048 (exact crossover 700→820)
//   F*    = 0.127 → 0.128 (exact crossover 820→900 at standard ka_var)
//   F**   = 0.149 → 0.150 (exact crossover 900→950 at ka÷16)
//   F***  = 0.360 → 0.370 (exact crossover 900→950 at standard ka_var)
//
// ── Clinical scenario classification ─────────────────────────────────────────────
//
//   Regime I  (F < F_low ≈ 0.048): conf=700
//     → inducer (F=0.047), *1/*1+inducer (F=0.031), inducer N=14 impossibility
//   Regime II (F_low ≤ F < F* ≈ 0.128): conf=820 ceiling
//     → *1/*1 genotype (F=0.094), any DDI producing F < 0.128
//   Regime III (F* ≤ F < F*** ≈ 0.365): conf=900 at standard; 950 needs ka÷16 if F < F**
//     → *1/*3 standard (F=0.141), *3/*3 (F=0.188), strong inhibitor (F=0.282)
//   Regime IV (F ≥ F*** ≈ 0.365): conf=950 at standard ka_var
//     → *3/*3 + strong inhibitor (F=0.376)
//
// ── The F* ceiling is a concentration problem, NOT a variance problem ─────────────
//
//   At F < F*, trough concentration is LOW relative to the ka-variance-driven
//   uncertainty. The conf=820 ceiling cannot be crossed by:
//   - Dose escalation (D-independent: F=0.094 at D=5,10,20,50mg → all conf=820)
//   - f_var reduction (f_var÷256 at F=0.094 → still conf=820)
//
//   The ceiling CAN be crossed by:
//   - Raising F (formulation improvement, P-gp modulation)
//   - Reducing ka_var (ka measurement improvement)
//   - Route switch to IV (eliminates gut compartment entirely)
//
//   The ka_var-dependent F* shift: at ka÷4, F*' shifts from 0.128 to ≈0.073.
//   This explains Sprint 18's *1/*1 result: F=0.094 < F* at std ka → conf=820;
//   but F=0.094 > F*' at ka÷4 → conf=900.
//
// ── Absorbed dose (D×F) is not the epistemic driver ──────────────────────────────
//
//   F=0.141 at D=3.33mg: D×F=0.470mg, conf=900
//   F=0.094 at D=5.0mg:  D×F=0.470mg, conf=820
//
//   Same absorbed dose, different regimes. Conf is determined by F (mean
//   bioavailability), not by D×F (absorbed amount). Increasing dose to
//   compensate for low F inflates both signal and noise proportionally.
//
// ── Budget channel indices (same as rapamycin_ss_oral) ────────────────────────────
//   0 = F (bioavailability)   1 = ka   2 = ke   3 = k12   4 = k21

module pbpk::rapamycin_f_threshold

use epistemic::knowledge::{Epistemic}
use pbpk::rapamycin_clinical::{
    conf_from_rel, assess_trough, decision_therapeutic, decision_uncertain
}

fn ft_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { 0.0001 } else {
        var r = x; var i = 0
        while i < 50 { r = (r + x / r) / 2.0; i = i + 1 }
        r
    }
}

// ── Threshold boundary constants ──────────────────────────────────────────────

pub fn f_low_below()         -> f64 { 0.047 }   // conf=700 (Regime I lower bound)
pub fn f_low_above()         -> f64 { 0.048 }   // conf=820 (F_low upper bound)
pub fn f_star_below()        -> f64 { 0.127 }   // conf=820 (F* lower bound)
pub fn f_star_above()        -> f64 { 0.128 }   // conf=900 (F* upper bound)
pub fn f_starstar_below()    -> f64 { 0.149 }   // ka÷16 → conf=900 (F** lower)
pub fn f_starstar_above()    -> f64 { 0.150 }   // ka÷16 → conf=950 (F** upper)
pub fn f_starstar_star_below() -> f64 { 0.360 } // std ka → conf=900 (F*** lower)
pub fn f_starstar_star_above() -> f64 { 0.370 } // std ka → conf=950 (F*** upper)

// ka_var shift of F*: at ka÷4
pub fn f_star_ka4_below()    -> f64 { 0.070 }   // ka÷4: conf=820 (F*' lower bound)
pub fn f_star_ka4_above()    -> f64 { 0.075 }   // ka÷4: conf=900 (F*' upper bound)

// Standard variance constants
pub fn ft_ka_var_std()  -> f64 { 0.0225 }
pub fn ft_f_var_std()   -> f64 { 0.001521 }
pub fn ft_ke_var_std()  -> f64 { 0.00000841 }
pub fn ft_k12_var_std() -> f64 { 0.000156 }
pub fn ft_k21_var_std() -> f64 { 0.0000016 }

// ── conf_at_f_ka ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Core function: compute conf at given f_val (bioavailability) and ka_var.
// Fixed: D=5mg, N=14, ke=0.01118, standard ke/k12/k21/f variances.

pub fn conf_at_f_ka(f_val: f64, ka_var: f64) -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ke_val = 0.01118;   let k12_val = 0.05;   let k21_val = 0.005
    let vc_val = 75.0;      let ka_val  = 0.62
    let ke_var  = ft_ke_var_std()
    let k12_var = ft_k12_var_std()
    let k21_var = ft_k21_var_std()
    let f_var   = ft_f_var_std()
    let d_oral  = 5.0;      let n_doses = 14

    let j11 = 0.0 - (ke_val + k12_val);  let j12 = k21_val
    let j21 = k12_val;                    let j22 = 0.0 - k21_val
    let g11 = 1.0 + 0.5 * j11;           let g12 = 0.5 * j12
    let g21 = 0.5 * j21;                 let g22 = 1.0 + 0.5 * j22
    let g_gut    = 1.0 - 0.5 * ka_val
    let g11sq    = g11 * g11
    let g_gut_sq = g_gut * g_gut

    var a_gut    = d_oral
    var a1       = 0.0;   var a2      = 0.0
    var v_gut_f  = d_oral * d_oral * f_var
    var v_gut_ka = 0.0
    var v1       = 0.0;   var v2      = 0.0

    var dose = 0
    while dose < n_doses {
        if dose > 0 {
            a_gut   = a_gut + d_oral
            v_gut_f = v_gut_f + d_oral * d_oral * f_var
        }
        var step = 0
        while step < 48 {
            let flux     = f_val * ka_val * a_gut
            let new_ag   = a_gut + 0.5 * (0.0 - ka_val * a_gut)
            let new_a1   = a1 + 0.5 * (j11 * a1 + j12 * a2 + flux)
            let new_a2   = a2 + 0.5 * (j21 * a1 + j22 * a2)
            let ckg      = 0.25 * ka_var * a_gut * a_gut
            let new_vgf  = g_gut_sq * v_gut_f
            let new_vgka = g_gut_sq * v_gut_ka + ckg
            let v_gut    = v_gut_f + v_gut_ka
            let v1s      = g11sq * v1 + g12 * g12 * v2
            let cke      = 0.25 * ke_var  * a1 * a1
            let ck12     = 0.25 * k12_var * a1 * a1
            let ck21     = 0.25 * k21_var * a2 * a2
            let gv1      = 0.25 * ka_val * ka_val * v_gut
            let new_v1   = v1s + cke + ck12 + ck21 + gv1
            let new_v2   = g21*g21*v1 + g22*g22*v2 + 0.25*(k12_var*a1*a1 + k21_var*a2*a2)
            a_gut = new_ag; a1 = new_a1; a2 = new_a2
            v_gut_f = new_vgf; v_gut_ka = new_vgka
            v1 = new_v1; v2 = new_v2
            step = step + 1
        }
        dose = dose + 1
    }
    conf_from_rel(a1 / vc_val, ft_sqrt(v1) / vc_val)
}

// ── conf_at_f_d: arbitrary dose (for D-independence proof) ────────────────────

pub fn conf_at_f_d(f_val: f64, ka_var: f64, d_oral: f64) -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ke_val = 0.01118;   let k12_val = 0.05;   let k21_val = 0.005
    let vc_val = 75.0;      let ka_val  = 0.62
    let ke_var  = ft_ke_var_std()
    let k12_var = ft_k12_var_std()
    let k21_var = ft_k21_var_std()
    let f_var   = ft_f_var_std()
    let n_doses = 14

    let j11 = 0.0 - (ke_val + k12_val);  let j12 = k21_val
    let j21 = k12_val;                    let j22 = 0.0 - k21_val
    let g11 = 1.0 + 0.5 * j11;           let g12 = 0.5 * j12
    let g21 = 0.5 * j21;                 let g22 = 1.0 + 0.5 * j22
    let g_gut    = 1.0 - 0.5 * ka_val
    let g11sq    = g11 * g11
    let g_gut_sq = g_gut * g_gut

    var a_gut    = d_oral
    var a1       = 0.0;   var a2      = 0.0
    var v_gut_f  = d_oral * d_oral * f_var
    var v_gut_ka = 0.0
    var v1       = 0.0;   var v2      = 0.0

    var dose = 0
    while dose < n_doses {
        if dose > 0 {
            a_gut   = a_gut + d_oral
            v_gut_f = v_gut_f + d_oral * d_oral * f_var
        }
        var step = 0
        while step < 48 {
            let flux     = f_val * ka_val * a_gut
            let new_ag   = a_gut + 0.5 * (0.0 - ka_val * a_gut)
            let new_a1   = a1 + 0.5 * (j11 * a1 + j12 * a2 + flux)
            let new_a2   = a2 + 0.5 * (j21 * a1 + j22 * a2)
            let ckg      = 0.25 * ka_var * a_gut * a_gut
            let new_vgf  = g_gut_sq * v_gut_f
            let new_vgka = g_gut_sq * v_gut_ka + ckg
            let v_gut    = v_gut_f + v_gut_ka
            let v1s      = g11sq * v1 + g12 * g12 * v2
            let cke      = 0.25 * ke_var  * a1 * a1
            let ck12     = 0.25 * k12_var * a1 * a1
            let ck21     = 0.25 * k21_var * a2 * a2
            let gv1      = 0.25 * ka_val * ka_val * v_gut
            let new_v1   = v1s + cke + ck12 + ck21 + gv1
            let new_v2   = g21*g21*v1 + g22*g22*v2 + 0.25*(k12_var*a1*a1 + k21_var*a2*a2)
            a_gut = new_ag; a1 = new_a1; a2 = new_a2
            v_gut_f = new_vgf; v_gut_ka = new_vgka
            v1 = new_v1; v2 = new_v2
            step = step + 1
        }
        dose = dose + 1
    }
    conf_from_rel(a1 / vc_val, ft_sqrt(v1) / vc_val)
}

// ── conf_at_f_fvar: variable f_var (for f_var reduction proof) ────────────────

pub fn conf_at_f_fvar(f_val: f64, ka_var: f64, f_var: f64) -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ke_val = 0.01118;   let k12_val = 0.05;   let k21_val = 0.005
    let vc_val = 75.0;      let ka_val  = 0.62
    let ke_var  = ft_ke_var_std()
    let k12_var = ft_k12_var_std()
    let k21_var = ft_k21_var_std()
    let d_oral  = 5.0;      let n_doses = 14

    let j11 = 0.0 - (ke_val + k12_val);  let j12 = k21_val
    let j21 = k12_val;                    let j22 = 0.0 - k21_val
    let g11 = 1.0 + 0.5 * j11;           let g12 = 0.5 * j12
    let g21 = 0.5 * j21;                 let g22 = 1.0 + 0.5 * j22
    let g_gut    = 1.0 - 0.5 * ka_val
    let g11sq    = g11 * g11
    let g_gut_sq = g_gut * g_gut

    var a_gut    = d_oral
    var a1       = 0.0;   var a2      = 0.0
    var v_gut_f  = d_oral * d_oral * f_var
    var v_gut_ka = 0.0
    var v1       = 0.0;   var v2      = 0.0

    var dose = 0
    while dose < n_doses {
        if dose > 0 {
            a_gut   = a_gut + d_oral
            v_gut_f = v_gut_f + d_oral * d_oral * f_var
        }
        var step = 0
        while step < 48 {
            let flux     = f_val * ka_val * a_gut
            let new_ag   = a_gut + 0.5 * (0.0 - ka_val * a_gut)
            let new_a1   = a1 + 0.5 * (j11 * a1 + j12 * a2 + flux)
            let new_a2   = a2 + 0.5 * (j21 * a1 + j22 * a2)
            let ckg      = 0.25 * ka_var * a_gut * a_gut
            let new_vgf  = g_gut_sq * v_gut_f
            let new_vgka = g_gut_sq * v_gut_ka + ckg
            let v_gut    = v_gut_f + v_gut_ka
            let v1s      = g11sq * v1 + g12 * g12 * v2
            let cke      = 0.25 * ke_var  * a1 * a1
            let ck12     = 0.25 * k12_var * a1 * a1
            let ck21     = 0.25 * k21_var * a2 * a2
            let gv1      = 0.25 * ka_val * ka_val * v_gut
            let new_v1   = v1s + cke + ck12 + ck21 + gv1
            let new_v2   = g21*g21*v1 + g22*g22*v2 + 0.25*(k12_var*a1*a1 + k21_var*a2*a2)
            a_gut = new_ag; a1 = new_a1; a2 = new_a2
            v_gut_f = new_vgf; v_gut_ka = new_vgka
            v1 = new_v1; v2 = new_v2
            step = step + 1
        }
        dose = dose + 1
    }
    conf_from_rel(a1 / vc_val, ft_sqrt(v1) / vc_val)
}

// ── Gate summary functions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Regime I lower bound: F=0.047 → conf=700 (below F_low)
pub fn ft_regime_i_below() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    conf_at_f_ka(f_low_below(), ft_ka_var_std()) == 700
}

// Regime II lower bound: F=0.048 → conf=820 (at/above F_low)
pub fn ft_regime_ii_below_flow() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    conf_at_f_ka(f_low_above(), ft_ka_var_std()) == 820
}

// F* lower bound: F=0.127 → conf=820 (below F*)
pub fn ft_f_star_lower() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    conf_at_f_ka(f_star_below(), ft_ka_var_std()) == 820
}

// F* upper bound: F=0.128 → conf=900 (at/above F*)
pub fn ft_f_star_upper() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    conf_at_f_ka(f_star_above(), ft_ka_var_std()) == 900
}

// *1/*1 F=0.094 < F*: conf=820 at standard ka_var — Sprint 18 explained
pub fn ft_cyp11_regime_ii() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    conf_at_f_ka(0.094, ft_ka_var_std()) == 820
}

// F** lower bound: F=0.149, ka÷16 → conf=900
pub fn ft_f_starstar_lower() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    conf_at_f_ka(f_starstar_below(), ft_ka_var_std() / 16.0) == 900
}

// F** upper bound: F=0.150, ka÷16 → conf=950
pub fn ft_f_starstar_upper() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    conf_at_f_ka(f_starstar_above(), ft_ka_var_std() / 16.0) == 950
}

// D-independence: F=0.094 at D=5,10,20,50 → all conf=820
pub fn ft_dose_independent() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    conf_at_f_d(0.094, ft_ka_var_std(), 5.0)  == 820 &&
    conf_at_f_d(0.094, ft_ka_var_std(), 10.0) == 820 &&
    conf_at_f_d(0.094, ft_ka_var_std(), 20.0) == 820 &&
    conf_at_f_d(0.094, ft_ka_var_std(), 50.0) == 820
}

// Absorbed dose (D×F) not the driver: same D×F but different F → different conf
pub fn ft_absorbed_dose_insufficient() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let c_low = conf_at_f_d(0.094, ft_ka_var_std(), 5.0)    // D×F = 0.47 at F=0.094
    let c_std = conf_at_f_d(0.141, ft_ka_var_std(), 3.33)   // D×F ≈ 0.47 at F=0.141
    c_std == 900 && c_low == 820    // same absorbed dose, different regime
}

// f_var reduction cannot cross F*: f_var÷256 at F=0.094 → still conf=820
pub fn ft_fvar_reduction_irrelevant() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let fv = ft_f_var_std()
    conf_at_f_fvar(0.094, ft_ka_var_std(), fv)        == 820 &&
    conf_at_f_fvar(0.094, ft_ka_var_std(), fv/4.0)    == 820 &&
    conf_at_f_fvar(0.094, ft_ka_var_std(), fv/64.0)   == 820 &&
    conf_at_f_fvar(0.094, ft_ka_var_std(), fv/256.0)  == 820
}

// ka_var shift of F*: at ka÷4, F=0.094 crosses into Regime III (conf=900)
pub fn ft_ka4_shifts_f_star() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let conf_std = conf_at_f_ka(0.094, ft_ka_var_std())           // 820 at std ka
    let conf_ka4 = conf_at_f_ka(0.094, ft_ka_var_std() / 4.0)    // 900 at ka÷4
    conf_std == 820 && conf_ka4 == 900
}

// F*' at ka÷4 is between 0.070 and 0.075
pub fn ft_f_star_ka4_bounds() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    conf_at_f_ka(f_star_ka4_below(), ft_ka_var_std() / 4.0) == 820 &&
    conf_at_f_ka(f_star_ka4_above(), ft_ka_var_std() / 4.0) == 900
}

// F*** lower bound: F=0.360, std ka → conf=900
pub fn ft_f_starstar_star_lower() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    conf_at_f_ka(f_starstar_star_below(), ft_ka_var_std()) == 900
}

// F*** upper bound: F=0.370, std ka → conf=950
pub fn ft_f_starstar_star_upper() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    conf_at_f_ka(f_starstar_star_above(), ft_ka_var_std()) == 950
}


// === FILE: stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_iv_bolus.sio ===
// stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_iv_bolus.sio — IV bolus rapamycin 2-compartment GUM
//
// Novel contribution: GUM variance propagation for IV bolus rapamycin in a
// 2-compartment model (central → peripheral), with a 3-channel uncertainty
// budget (ke, k12, k21). Completes the four-route delivery atlas.
//
// Sprint 16 dissertation finding: for IV administration, k12 (central→peripheral
// distribution rate) dominates the 24h trough uncertainty — NOT ke (elimination),
// despite ke being the parameter most often targeted by clinicians.
//
// ── Mechanistic unity of the route atlas ─────────────────────────────────────
//
//   Each delivery route has a characteristic primary flux; the dominant
//   uncertainty source always governs that flux:
//
//   Stent (S12):    peripheral depot → central       → k21 dominant
//   IV bolus (S16): central bolus  → peripheral      → k12 dominant
//   Oral (S13–15):  gut bolus → central (absorption) → ka dominant
//
//   The IV bolus creates a large A1(0) = D_iv. Per-step budget injections scale
//   as dt² × Var(param) × A². With k12_var = 1.56e-4 and ke_var = 8.41e-6,
//   the distribution rate contributes 18.5× more variance per step than
//   elimination, regardless of A1's magnitude.
//
// ── Why ke is irrelevant for IV ───────────────────────────────────────────────
//
//   Both ke and k12 terms scale as Var × A1². Their ratio is fixed:
//   k12_var / ke_var ≈ 18.5. No amount of ke improvement changes conf or dom
//   as long as k12_var remains at its standard value.
//
//   Even ke÷64 leaves conf=900 and dom=k12 — ke is structurally irrelevant
//   for IV TDM under current PK population variance estimates.
//
// ── Second bottleneck after extreme k12 tightening ───────────────────────────
//
//   When k12_var is tightened below ke_var (at k12÷20 ≈ 7.8e-6 < ke_var 8.41e-6),
//   dom shifts to ke. The crossover: k12÷16 (dom=k12) → k12÷25 (dom=ke).
//
// ── Standard IV scenario ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//
//   D_iv=1.5mg bolus, ke=0.01118 h⁻¹, k12=0.05, k21=0.005, Vc=75L
//   dt=1h, n_steps=24 (24h trough)
//   Results: dec=1 (THERAPEUTIC), conf=900, dom=1 (k12)
//
//   D=1.0mg → UNCERTAIN (trough at therapeutic window lower boundary; conf=900
//   insufficient because concentration CI straddles 0.004 mg/L floor)
//
// ── Improvement hierarchy ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//
//   ke÷4   → unchanged (900/k12)   — ke irrelevant for IV
//   ke÷64  → unchanged (900/k12)   — even extreme ke tightening is wasted
//   k12÷4  → conf=950 (k12 still)  — distribution rate improvement crosses gate
//   k12÷16 → conf=950, dom=k12 (barely: k12_var/16 ≈ 9.75e-6 > ke_var 8.41e-6)
//   k12÷25 → conf=950, dom=ke      — ke surfaces as second bottleneck
//
// ── Clinical implication ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//
//   For IV rapamycin TDM, dense PK sampling around the distribution phase
//   (Tmax for peripheral: ≈2–6h post-dose) to characterise k12 is the only
//   intervention that improves epistemic certainty. Measuring elimination rate
//   more accurately is a wasted diagnostic resource for IV dosing.
//
// ── Budget channel indices ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//   0 = ke (elimination)         ← second bottleneck when k12 tightened ÷25
//   1 = k12 (distribution rate)  ← dominant
//   2 = k21 (return rate)        ← minor
//
// Effect annotations:
//   classify_iv_trough:        with Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic
//   conf_iv_trough:            with Mut, Div, Panic
//   dom_iv_trough:             with Mut, Div, Panic
//   classify_standard_iv:      with Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic
//   conf_standard_iv:          with Mut, Div, Panic
//   dom_standard_iv:           with Mut, Div, Panic
//   iv_k12_dominant:           with Mut, Div, Panic
//   iv_ke_irrelevant:          with Mut, Div, Panic
//   iv_k12_tighten_fires:      with Mut, Div, Panic
//   iv_ke_second_bottleneck:   with Mut, Div, Panic

module pbpk::rapamycin_iv_bolus

use epistemic::knowledge::{Epistemic}
use pbpk::rapamycin_clinical::{
    assess_trough, conf_from_rel,
    decision_therapeutic, decision_uncertain
}

fn iv_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { 0.0001 } else {
        var r = x; var i = 0
        while i < 50 { r = (r + x / r) / 2.0; i = i + 1 }
        r
    }
}

fn iv_argmax3(b0: f64, b1: f64, b2: f64) -> i64 {
    var idx = 0; var dv = b0
    if b1 > dv { idx = 1; dv = b1 }
    if b2 > dv { idx = 2 }
    idx
}

// ── classify_iv_trough ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// IV bolus: A1(0)=d_iv, A2(0)=0, dt=1h (hardcoded), n_steps steps.
// Returns trough classification at t_end = n_steps hours.

pub fn classify_iv_trough(
    ke_val: f64, ke_var: f64,
    k12_val: f64, k12_var: f64,
    k21_val: f64, k21_var: f64,
    d_iv: f64, vc: f64, n_steps: i64
) -> i64 with Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let j11 = 0.0 - (ke_val + k12_val);  let j12 = k21_val
    let j21 = k12_val;                    let j22 = 0.0 - k21_val
    let g11 = 1.0 + j11;  let g12 = j12
    let g21 = j21;         let g22 = 1.0 + j22

    var a1 = d_iv;  var a2 = 0.0
    var v1 = 0.0;   var v2 = 0.0

    var step = 0
    while step < n_steps {
        let new_a1 = a1 + (j11 * a1 + j12 * a2)
        let new_a2 = a2 + (j21 * a1 + j22 * a2)
        let cke  = ke_var  * a1 * a1
        let ck12 = k12_var * a1 * a1
        let ck21 = k21_var * a2 * a2
        let new_v1 = g11*g11*v1 + g12*g12*v2 + cke + ck12 + ck21
        let new_v2 = g21*g21*v1 + g22*g22*v2 + k12_var*a1*a1 + k21_var*a2*a2
        a1 = new_a1; a2 = new_a2; v1 = new_v1; v2 = new_v2
        step = step + 1
    }
    let c_t   = a1 / vc
    let std_t = iv_sqrt(v1) / vc
    let conf  = conf_from_rel(c_t, std_t)
    let c_ep  = Epistemic::new(c_t, v1 / (vc * vc), conf)
    assess_trough(&c_ep)
}

// ── conf_iv_trough ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

pub fn conf_iv_trough(
    ke_val: f64, ke_var: f64,
    k12_val: f64, k12_var: f64,
    k21_val: f64, k21_var: f64,
    d_iv: f64, vc: f64, n_steps: i64
) -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let j11 = 0.0 - (ke_val + k12_val);  let j12 = k21_val
    let j21 = k12_val;                    let j22 = 0.0 - k21_val
    let g11 = 1.0 + j11;  let g12 = j12
    let g21 = j21;         let g22 = 1.0 + j22

    var a1 = d_iv;  var a2 = 0.0
    var v1 = 0.0;   var v2 = 0.0

    var step = 0
    while step < n_steps {
        let new_a1 = a1 + (j11 * a1 + j12 * a2)
        let new_a2 = a2 + (j21 * a1 + j22 * a2)
        let cke  = ke_var  * a1 * a1
        let ck12 = k12_var * a1 * a1
        let ck21 = k21_var * a2 * a2
        let new_v1 = g11*g11*v1 + g12*g12*v2 + cke + ck12 + ck21
        let new_v2 = g21*g21*v1 + g22*g22*v2 + k12_var*a1*a1 + k21_var*a2*a2
        a1 = new_a1; a2 = new_a2; v1 = new_v1; v2 = new_v2
        step = step + 1
    }
    let c_t   = a1 / vc
    let std_t = iv_sqrt(v1) / vc
    conf_from_rel(c_t, std_t)
}

// ── dom_iv_trough ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

pub fn dom_iv_trough(
    ke_val: f64, ke_var: f64,
    k12_val: f64, k12_var: f64,
    k21_val: f64, k21_var: f64,
    d_iv: f64, vc: f64, n_steps: i64
) -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let j11 = 0.0 - (ke_val + k12_val);  let j12 = k21_val
    let j21 = k12_val;                    let j22 = 0.0 - k21_val
    let g11 = 1.0 + j11;  let g12 = j12
    let g21 = j21;         let g22 = 1.0 + j22
    let g11sq = g11 * g11

    var a1 = d_iv;  var a2 = 0.0
    var v1 = 0.0;   var v2 = 0.0
    var bud_ke = 0.0;  var bud_k12 = 0.0;  var bud_k21 = 0.0

    var step = 0
    while step < n_steps {
        let new_a1 = a1 + (j11 * a1 + j12 * a2)
        let new_a2 = a2 + (j21 * a1 + j22 * a2)
        let cke  = ke_var  * a1 * a1
        let ck12 = k12_var * a1 * a1
        let ck21 = k21_var * a2 * a2
        let new_v1 = g11*g11*v1 + g12*g12*v2 + cke + ck12 + ck21
        let new_v2 = g21*g21*v1 + g22*g22*v2 + k12_var*a1*a1 + k21_var*a2*a2
        a1 = new_a1; a2 = new_a2; v1 = new_v1; v2 = new_v2
        bud_ke  = g11sq * bud_ke  + cke
        bud_k12 = g11sq * bud_k12 + ck12
        bud_k21 = g11sq * bud_k21 + ck21
        step = step + 1
    }
    iv_argmax3(bud_ke, bud_k12, bud_k21)
}

// ── Standard variance constants ────────────────────────────────────────────────

pub fn iv_ke_var_std()  -> f64 { 0.00000841 }
pub fn iv_k12_var_std() -> f64 { 0.000156 }
pub fn iv_k21_var_std() -> f64 { 0.0000016 }

// ── Standard wrappers: D=1.5mg, standard PK, 24-step trough ───────────────────

pub fn classify_standard_iv(ke_var: f64, k12_var: f64) -> i64
    with Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic {
    classify_iv_trough(0.01118, ke_var, 0.05, k12_var,
                       0.005, iv_k21_var_std(), 1.5, 75.0, 24)
}

pub fn conf_standard_iv(ke_var: f64, k12_var: f64) -> i64
    with Mut, Div, Panic {
    conf_iv_trough(0.01118, ke_var, 0.05, k12_var,
                   0.005, iv_k21_var_std(), 1.5, 75.0, 24)
}

pub fn dom_standard_iv(ke_var: f64, k12_var: f64) -> i64
    with Mut, Div, Panic {
    dom_iv_trough(0.01118, ke_var, 0.05, k12_var,
                  0.005, iv_k21_var_std(), 1.5, 75.0, 24)
}

// ── Gate summary functions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// k12 dominates at standard D=1.5mg, 24h trough
pub fn iv_k12_dominant() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    dom_standard_iv(iv_ke_var_std(), iv_k12_var_std()) == 1
}

// ke÷4 leaves dec/conf/dom unchanged — ke is structurally irrelevant for IV
pub fn iv_ke_irrelevant() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let conf_base = conf_standard_iv(iv_ke_var_std(), iv_k12_var_std())
    let conf_kei  = conf_standard_iv(iv_ke_var_std() / 4.0, iv_k12_var_std())
    let dom_base  = dom_standard_iv(iv_ke_var_std(), iv_k12_var_std())
    let dom_kei   = dom_standard_iv(iv_ke_var_std() / 4.0, iv_k12_var_std())
    conf_base == conf_kei && dom_base == dom_kei
}

// k12÷4 → conf=950 (clinically meaningful improvement over 900 baseline)
pub fn iv_k12_tighten_fires() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    conf_standard_iv(iv_ke_var_std(), iv_k12_var_std() / 4.0) == 950
}

// k12÷25 → dom shifts to ke (second bottleneck, k12_var/25 < ke_var)
pub fn iv_ke_second_bottleneck() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    dom_standard_iv(iv_ke_var_std(), iv_k12_var_std() / 25.0) == 0
}


// === FILE: stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_load_oral.sio ===
// stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_load_oral.sio — Loading-dose oral rapamycin
//
// Novel contribution: GUM variance propagation through a clinical loading-dose
// + maintenance protocol (D_load on day 1, D_maint daily thereafter), modelled
// as N multi-dose cycles with heterogeneous first-dose amplitude.
//
// Sprint 15 dissertation finding: the loading dose RESCUES the THERAPEUTIC gate
// for a 2mg/day maintenance regimen — reducing the required number of doses from
// N=21 (uniform 2mg, Sprint 14) to N=14 (6mg load + 2mg maintenance). This is
// the minimal clinical protocol that crosses the epistemic gate within 2 weeks.
//
// ── Loading dose mechanics ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//
//   Day 0 (loading): A_gut(0) = D_load;  V_gut_f(0) = D_load² × Var(F)
//   Days 1..N-1 (maintenance): A_gut += D_maint; V_gut_f += D_maint² × Var(F)
//
//   The larger initial bolus (D_load > D_maint) achieves higher early central
//   concentrations, pushing the trough into the therapeutic window earlier than
//   uniform D_maint dosing. However, D_load² amplifies the early gut variance
//   contribution (via Var(F)) relative to uniform dosing with the same dose.
//
// ── ka dominance preserved under loading ─────────────────────────────────────
//
//   ka remains the dominant uncertainty source across all tested loading ratios
//   (1:1, 3:1, 4.5:1) and at all N. The large A_gut at day 0 creates a large
//   per-step ka variance injection (0.25 × Var(ka) × A_gut²) that persists
//   through the absorption phase of each dose, preventing any other source from
//   overtaking ka.
//
// ── Second bottleneck after extreme ka tightening ────────────────────────────
//
//   At ka÷16: dom shifts to k12 (index 3, distribution rate) — consistent with
//   Sprint 14. Additionally, at D_load=6mg + ka÷16, conf reaches 950 — the
//   highest epistemic confidence in the entire oral rapamycin trilogy.
//
// ── Standard loading scenario ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
//
//   D_load=6mg, D_maint=2mg, N=14 doses (2 weeks); standard PK + variances.
//   Results: dec=1 (THERAPEUTIC), conf=900, dom=1 (ka)
//
// ── Loading protocol comparison ───────────────────────────────────────────────
//
//   D_maint=2mg uniform × 14 → UNCERTAIN/900 (Sprint 14)
//   D_load=6mg + D_maint=2mg × 13 → THERAPEUTIC/900 (Sprint 15)  ← rescue!
//   D_load=9mg + D_maint=3mg × 13 → THERAPEUTIC/900 at N=7+
//
// ── Budget channel indices ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//   0 = F (bioavailability)    1 = ka (absorption rate — universally dominant)
//   2 = ke (elimination)       3 = k12 (distribution — 2nd bottleneck at ka÷16)
//   4 = k21 (return rate)
//
// Effect annotations:
//   classify_load_trough:      with Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic
//   conf_load_trough:          with Mut, Div, Panic
//   dom_load_trough:           with Mut, Div, Panic
//   classify_standard_load:    with Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic
//   conf_standard_load:        with Mut, Div, Panic
//   dom_standard_load:         with Mut, Div, Panic
//   load_rescues_therapeutic:  with Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic
//   load_ka_dominant:          with Mut, Div, Panic
//   load_ka16_optimal:         with Mut, Div, Panic

module pbpk::rapamycin_load_oral

use epistemic::knowledge::{Epistemic}
use pbpk::rapamycin_clinical::{
    assess_trough, conf_from_rel,
    decision_therapeutic, decision_uncertain
}

fn load_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { 0.0001 } else {
        var r = x; var i = 0
        while i < 50 { r = (r + x / r) / 2.0; i = i + 1 }
        r
    }
}

fn load_argmax5(b0: f64, b1: f64, b2: f64, b3: f64, b4: f64) -> i64 {
    var idx = 0; var dv = b0
    if b1 > dv { idx = 1; dv = b1 }
    if b2 > dv { idx = 2; dv = b2 }
    if b3 > dv { idx = 3; dv = b3 }
    if b4 > dv { idx = 4 }
    idx
}

// ── classify_load_trough ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Loading-dose Euler: day 0 = d_load, days 1..n_doses-1 = d_maint.
// 48 steps of dt=0.5h per day. Returns trough decision at end of day n_doses-1.

pub fn classify_load_trough(
    d_load: f64, d_maint: f64, n_doses: i64,
    ke_val: f64, ke_var: f64,
    k12_val: f64, k12_var: f64,
    k21_val: f64, k21_var: f64,
    ka_val: f64, ka_var: f64,
    f_val: f64, f_var: f64,
    vc: f64
) -> i64 with Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let j11 = 0.0 - (ke_val + k12_val);  let j12 = k21_val
    let j21 = k12_val;                    let j22 = 0.0 - k21_val
    let g11 = 1.0 + 0.5 * j11;           let g12 = 0.5 * j12
    let g21 = 0.5 * j21;                 let g22 = 1.0 + 0.5 * j22
    let g_gut    = 1.0 - 0.5 * ka_val
    let g_gut_sq = g_gut * g_gut

    var a_gut    = d_load
    var a1       = 0.0;     var a2      = 0.0
    var v_gut_f  = d_load * d_load * f_var
    var v_gut_ka = 0.0
    var v1       = 0.0;     var v2      = 0.0

    var dose = 0
    while dose < n_doses {
        if dose > 0 {
            a_gut   = a_gut + d_maint
            v_gut_f = v_gut_f + d_maint * d_maint * f_var
        }
        var step = 0
        while step < 48 {
            let flux   = f_val * ka_val * a_gut
            let new_ag = a_gut + 0.5 * (0.0 - ka_val * a_gut)
            let new_a1 = a1 + 0.5 * (j11 * a1 + j12 * a2 + flux)
            let new_a2 = a2 + 0.5 * (j21 * a1 + j22 * a2)
            let ckg      = 0.25 * ka_var * a_gut * a_gut
            let new_vgf  = g_gut_sq * v_gut_f
            let new_vgka = g_gut_sq * v_gut_ka + ckg
            let v_gut    = v_gut_f + v_gut_ka
            let v1s  = g11*g11*v1 + g12*g12*v2
            let cke  = 0.25 * ke_var  * a1 * a1
            let ck12 = 0.25 * k12_var * a1 * a1
            let ck21 = 0.25 * k21_var * a2 * a2
            let gv1  = 0.25 * ka_val * ka_val * v_gut
            let new_v1 = v1s + cke + ck12 + ck21 + gv1
            let new_v2 = g21*g21*v1 + g22*g22*v2 + 0.25*(k12_var*a1*a1 + k21_var*a2*a2)
            a_gut = new_ag; a1 = new_a1; a2 = new_a2
            v_gut_f = new_vgf; v_gut_ka = new_vgka
            v1 = new_v1; v2 = new_v2
            step = step + 1
        }
        dose = dose + 1
    }
    let c_t   = a1 / vc
    let std_t = load_sqrt(v1) / vc
    let conf  = conf_from_rel(c_t, std_t)
    let c_ep  = Epistemic::new(c_t, v1 / (vc * vc), conf)
    assess_trough(&c_ep)
}

// ── conf_load_trough ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

pub fn conf_load_trough(
    d_load: f64, d_maint: f64, n_doses: i64,
    ke_val: f64, ke_var: f64,
    k12_val: f64, k12_var: f64,
    k21_val: f64, k21_var: f64,
    ka_val: f64, ka_var: f64,
    f_val: f64, f_var: f64,
    vc: f64
) -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let j11 = 0.0 - (ke_val + k12_val);  let j12 = k21_val
    let j21 = k12_val;                    let j22 = 0.0 - k21_val
    let g11 = 1.0 + 0.5 * j11;           let g12 = 0.5 * j12
    let g21 = 0.5 * j21;                 let g22 = 1.0 + 0.5 * j22
    let g_gut    = 1.0 - 0.5 * ka_val
    let g_gut_sq = g_gut * g_gut

    var a_gut    = d_load
    var a1       = 0.0;     var a2      = 0.0
    var v_gut_f  = d_load * d_load * f_var
    var v_gut_ka = 0.0
    var v1       = 0.0;     var v2      = 0.0

    var dose = 0
    while dose < n_doses {
        if dose > 0 {
            a_gut   = a_gut + d_maint
            v_gut_f = v_gut_f + d_maint * d_maint * f_var
        }
        var step = 0
        while step < 48 {
            let flux   = f_val * ka_val * a_gut
            let new_ag = a_gut + 0.5 * (0.0 - ka_val * a_gut)
            let new_a1 = a1 + 0.5 * (j11 * a1 + j12 * a2 + flux)
            let new_a2 = a2 + 0.5 * (j21 * a1 + j22 * a2)
            let ckg      = 0.25 * ka_var * a_gut * a_gut
            let new_vgf  = g_gut_sq * v_gut_f
            let new_vgka = g_gut_sq * v_gut_ka + ckg
            let v_gut    = v_gut_f + v_gut_ka
            let v1s  = g11*g11*v1 + g12*g12*v2
            let cke  = 0.25 * ke_var  * a1 * a1
            let ck12 = 0.25 * k12_var * a1 * a1
            let ck21 = 0.25 * k21_var * a2 * a2
            let gv1  = 0.25 * ka_val * ka_val * v_gut
            let new_v1 = v1s + cke + ck12 + ck21 + gv1
            let new_v2 = g21*g21*v1 + g22*g22*v2 + 0.25*(k12_var*a1*a1 + k21_var*a2*a2)
            a_gut = new_ag; a1 = new_a1; a2 = new_a2
            v_gut_f = new_vgf; v_gut_ka = new_vgka
            v1 = new_v1; v2 = new_v2
            step = step + 1
        }
        dose = dose + 1
    }
    let c_t   = a1 / vc
    let std_t = load_sqrt(v1) / vc
    conf_from_rel(c_t, std_t)
}

// ── dom_load_trough ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

pub fn dom_load_trough(
    d_load: f64, d_maint: f64, n_doses: i64,
    ke_val: f64, ke_var: f64,
    k12_val: f64, k12_var: f64,
    k21_val: f64, k21_var: f64,
    ka_val: f64, ka_var: f64,
    f_val: f64, f_var: f64,
    vc: f64
) -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let j11 = 0.0 - (ke_val + k12_val);  let j12 = k21_val
    let j21 = k12_val;                    let j22 = 0.0 - k21_val
    let g11 = 1.0 + 0.5 * j11;           let g12 = 0.5 * j12
    let g21 = 0.5 * j21;                 let g22 = 1.0 + 0.5 * j22
    let g_gut    = 1.0 - 0.5 * ka_val
    let g11sq    = g11 * g11
    let g_gut_sq = g_gut * g_gut

    var a_gut    = d_load
    var a1       = 0.0;     var a2      = 0.0
    var v_gut_f  = d_load * d_load * f_var
    var v_gut_ka = 0.0
    var v1       = 0.0;     var v2      = 0.0
    var bud_f    = 0.0;     var bud_ka  = 0.0
    var bud_ke   = 0.0;     var bud_k12 = 0.0;  var bud_k21 = 0.0

    var dose = 0
    while dose < n_doses {
        if dose > 0 {
            a_gut   = a_gut + d_maint
            v_gut_f = v_gut_f + d_maint * d_maint * f_var
        }
        var step = 0
        while step < 48 {
            let flux   = f_val * ka_val * a_gut
            let new_ag = a_gut + 0.5 * (0.0 - ka_val * a_gut)
            let new_a1 = a1 + 0.5 * (j11 * a1 + j12 * a2 + flux)
            let new_a2 = a2 + 0.5 * (j21 * a1 + j22 * a2)
            let ckg      = 0.25 * ka_var * a_gut * a_gut
            let new_vgf  = g_gut_sq * v_gut_f
            let new_vgka = g_gut_sq * v_gut_ka + ckg
            let v_gut    = v_gut_f + v_gut_ka
            let v1s  = g11sq * v1 + g12*g12*v2
            let cke  = 0.25 * ke_var  * a1 * a1
            let ck12 = 0.25 * k12_var * a1 * a1
            let ck21 = 0.25 * k21_var * a2 * a2
            let ckac = 0.25 * ka_var * a_gut * a_gut * f_val * f_val
            let gv1  = 0.25 * ka_val * ka_val * v_gut
            let new_v1 = v1s + cke + ck12 + ck21 + gv1
            let new_v2 = g21*g21*v1 + g22*g22*v2 + 0.25*(k12_var*a1*a1 + k21_var*a2*a2)
            let bfc  = 0.25 * ka_val * ka_val * v_gut_f
            let bkac = 0.25 * ka_val * ka_val * v_gut_ka + ckac
            a_gut = new_ag; a1 = new_a1; a2 = new_a2
            v_gut_f = new_vgf; v_gut_ka = new_vgka
            v1 = new_v1; v2 = new_v2
            bud_f   = g11sq * bud_f   + bfc
            bud_ka  = g11sq * bud_ka  + bkac
            bud_ke  = g11sq * bud_ke  + cke
            bud_k12 = g11sq * bud_k12 + ck12
            bud_k21 = g11sq * bud_k21 + ck21
            step = step + 1
        }
        dose = dose + 1
    }
    load_argmax5(bud_f, bud_ka, bud_ke, bud_k12, bud_k21)
}

// ── Standard variance constants ────────────────────────────────────────────────

pub fn load_ka_var_std()  -> f64 { 0.0225 }
pub fn load_f_var_std()   -> f64 { 0.001521 }
pub fn load_ke_var_std()  -> f64 { 0.00000841 }
pub fn load_k12_var_std() -> f64 { 0.000156 }
pub fn load_k21_var_std() -> f64 { 0.0000016 }

// ── Standard wrappers: D_load=6mg, D_maint=2mg, standard PK constants ─────────

pub fn classify_standard_load(n_doses: i64, ka_var: f64) -> i64
    with Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic {
    classify_load_trough(6.0, 2.0, n_doses,
                         0.01118, load_ke_var_std(), 0.05, load_k12_var_std(),
                         0.005, load_k21_var_std(), 0.62, ka_var,
                         0.141, load_f_var_std(), 75.0)
}

pub fn conf_standard_load(n_doses: i64, ka_var: f64) -> i64
    with Mut, Div, Panic {
    conf_load_trough(6.0, 2.0, n_doses,
                     0.01118, load_ke_var_std(), 0.05, load_k12_var_std(),
                     0.005, load_k21_var_std(), 0.62, ka_var,
                     0.141, load_f_var_std(), 75.0)
}

pub fn dom_standard_load(n_doses: i64, ka_var: f64) -> i64
    with Mut, Div, Panic {
    dom_load_trough(6.0, 2.0, n_doses,
                    0.01118, load_ke_var_std(), 0.05, load_k12_var_std(),
                    0.005, load_k21_var_std(), 0.62, ka_var,
                    0.141, load_f_var_std(), 75.0)
}

// ── Uniform 2mg wrappers (for rescue comparison) ───────────────────────────────

pub fn classify_uniform_2mg(n_doses: i64) -> i64
    with Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic {
    classify_load_trough(2.0, 2.0, n_doses,
                         0.01118, load_ke_var_std(), 0.05, load_k12_var_std(),
                         0.005, load_k21_var_std(), 0.62, load_ka_var_std(),
                         0.141, load_f_var_std(), 75.0)
}

pub fn conf_uniform_2mg(n_doses: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    conf_load_trough(2.0, 2.0, n_doses,
                     0.01118, load_ke_var_std(), 0.05, load_k12_var_std(),
                     0.005, load_k21_var_std(), 0.62, load_ka_var_std(),
                     0.141, load_f_var_std(), 75.0)
}

// ── Gate summary functions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Loading dose rescues the 2mg maintenance protocol:
// uniform 2mg × 14 → UNCERTAIN, but 6mg load + 2mg × 13 → THERAPEUTIC
pub fn load_rescues_therapeutic() -> bool with Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let unif_14 = classify_uniform_2mg(14)
    let load_14 = classify_standard_load(14, load_ka_var_std())
    unif_14 == decision_uncertain() && load_14 == decision_therapeutic()
}

// ka remains dominant with the 6mg loading dose
pub fn load_ka_dominant() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    dom_standard_load(14, load_ka_var_std()) == 1
}

// ka/16 at loaded SS: conf=950 (highest in trilogy), k12 surfaces as second bottleneck
pub fn load_ka16_optimal() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let conf16 = conf_standard_load(14, load_ka_var_std() / 16.0)
    let dom16  = dom_standard_load(14, load_ka_var_std() / 16.0)
    conf16 == 950 && dom16 == 3
}


// === FILE: stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_margin.sio ===
// stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_margin.sio — Safety-margin analysis: dose-dependent classification
//
// Dissertation contribution #2 (compile-time confidence gates) provides a
// mechanism the gate uses in two distinct ways:
//
//   Route A — confidence gate: relative std > 25% → conf = 700 < 800 → UNCERTAIN.
//             Firing condition: ke_var too large relative to C(t).
//             Example (Sprint 7): D=2mg, ke_var≥0.0025 at t=24h.
//
//   Route B — boundary proximity: point estimate near/below therapeutic floor,
//             CI straddles the floor → else-branch UNCERTAIN in assess_trough.
//             Firing condition: C(t) < trough_floor but hi > floor (CI overlap).
//             Example (this module): D=0.9mg, ke_var=0.001 at t=24h.
//
// This module demonstrates Route B via a dose-comparison experiment:
//   SAME ke_var=0.001, SAME conf=820, DIFFERENT dose D:
//     D = 2.0 mg → C(24h) ≈ 0.00834 mg/L (inside window) → THERAPEUTIC
//     D = 0.9 mg → C(24h) ≈ 0.00375 mg/L (below floor)   → UNCERTAIN
//
// The epistemic system thus detects that 0.9 mg cannot be confidently classified
// as THERAPEUTIC: the concentration is below the therapeutic floor, but the
// measurement uncertainty means it might actually be in-window.  A point-estimate
// TDM tool would say SUB; the epistemic system correctly says UNCERTAIN —
// "do not reduce the dose without a more precise ke measurement."
//
// ── Safety-margin intuition ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
//
//   margin = C(t) - trough_floor_mg_l()
//   margin > 0: point estimate inside window; classification depends on ke_var
//   margin < 0: point estimate below floor; classification depends on CI coverage
//
//   For Route B UNCERTAIN:
//     margin < 0 AND hi > floor (i.e., |margin| < 1.96·std_c)
//     → CI straddles floor; could be therapeutic or subtherapeutic
//
//   For Route A UNCERTAIN:
//     margin > 0 but relative std > 25% → conf = 700 < 800 → gate fires
//
// Effect annotations:
//   margin_above_floor: none (pure subtraction)
//   classify_high/low_dose: with Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic
//   dose_gate_fires:      with Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic
//   dose_gate_standard:   with Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic

module pbpk::rapamycin_margin

use epistemic::knowledge::{Epistemic}
use pbpk::rapamycin_precision::{classify_iv_trough, conf_iv_trough}
use pbpk::rapamycin_clinical::{
    trough_floor_mg_l, decision_therapeutic, decision_uncertain
}

// ── Pure margin metric ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Returns C - trough_floor_mg_l() (may be negative when below therapeutic floor).
// Positive margin: point estimate safely inside window.
// Negative margin: point estimate below floor (Route B UNCERTAIN territory).
pub fn margin_above_floor(c_val: f64) -> f64 {
    c_val - trough_floor_mg_l()
}

// ── Standard-scenario wrappers ────────────────────────────────────────────────
//
// Standard 24h scenario: ke=0.05 h⁻¹, Vc=70 L, dt=1h, n=25, assess at idx=24.
//   High dose D=2.0 mg: C(24h) ≈ 0.00834 mg/L — positive margin (0.00434)
//   Low  dose D=0.9 mg: C(24h) ≈ 0.00375 mg/L — negative margin (−0.00025)

pub fn classify_high_dose(ke_var: f64) -> i64 with Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic {
    classify_iv_trough(0.05, ke_var, 70.0, 2.0, 24.0, 1.0, 25, 24)
}

pub fn classify_low_dose(ke_var: f64) -> i64 with Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic {
    classify_iv_trough(0.05, ke_var, 70.0, 0.9, 24.0, 1.0, 25, 24)
}

pub fn conf_high_dose(ke_var: f64) -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    conf_iv_trough(0.05, ke_var, 70.0, 2.0, 24.0, 1.0, 25, 24)
}

pub fn conf_low_dose(ke_var: f64) -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    conf_iv_trough(0.05, ke_var, 70.0, 0.9, 24.0, 1.0, 25, 24)
}

// ── Dose-pair gate ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Returns true iff high dose → THERAPEUTIC and low dose → UNCERTAIN.
//
// This captures the full dissertation claim: the same ke measurement quality
// (same ke_var) gives a confident THERAPEUTIC for the higher dose and a
// well-reasoned UNCERTAIN for the lower dose.
//
// Clinically: "do not reduce from 2 mg to 0.9 mg without improving assay
// precision — we cannot confirm the lower dose is therapeutic."
pub fn dose_gate_fires(
    ke_val:  f64,
    ke_var:  f64,
    vc:      f64,
    d_high:  f64,
    d_low:   f64,
    t_end:   f64,
    dt:      f64,
    n:       i64,
    idx:     i64
) -> bool with Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let dec_high = classify_iv_trough(ke_val, ke_var, vc, d_high, t_end, dt, n, idx)
    let dec_low  = classify_iv_trough(ke_val, ke_var, vc, d_low,  t_end, dt, n, idx)
    dec_high == decision_therapeutic() && dec_low == decision_uncertain()
}

// Convenience wrapper for the standard dose pair (D_high=2.0, D_low=0.9).
pub fn dose_gate_standard(ke_var: f64) -> bool with Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic {
    dose_gate_fires(0.05, ke_var, 70.0, 2.0, 0.9, 24.0, 1.0, 25, 24)
}


// === FILE: stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_n_crit.sio ===
// stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_n_crit.sio — Sprint 26: N_crit Certification Curve
//
// Novel dissertation contribution: for each clinical stratum, certifies N_crit
// (minimum doses for 95% CI to lie fully within [floor, ceil]) and, for strata
// whose window closes, the N at which the CI first straddles the toxic ceiling.
//
// ── N_crit findings (all certified by Sprint 26 gate) ─────────────────────────
//
//   Slow genotype (D=5mg):
//     N_crit = 3  — certifies earliest (high F, low ke → rapid accumulation)
//     Window closes at N=19: CI first straddles toxic ceiling [lo=15.6, hi=20.0 ng/mL]
//     Certification window: N ∈ [3, 18]  (16 doses wide)
//
//   Standard genotype (D=5mg):
//     N_crit = 6  — certifies at 6th dose
//     Window closes at N=37: CI first straddles toxic ceiling
//     Certification window: N ∈ [6, 36]  (31 doses wide)
//
//   CYP3A4 inhibitor (D=1.5mg):
//     N_crit = 7  — certifies at 7th dose
//     Window closes at N=38: CI straddles toxic ceiling with long accumulation
//     Certification window: N ∈ [7, 37]  (31 doses wide)
//
//   Fast genotype (D=5mg) — KEY FINDING:
//     N_crit = 15 — standard protocol N_min=14 is INSUFFICIENT by 1 dose
//     At N=14: point estimate THERAPEUTIC (5.37 ng/mL) but CI straddles floor
//     Gap: fast metabolizer needs 9 more doses than standard (N_crit: 15 vs 6)
//
//   CYP3A4 inducer (D=20mg) — STRUCTURAL FINDING:
//     N_crit = 0 (never certifiable within N=1..50)
//     Structural reason: C_SS (4.71 ng/mL) < floor + 2*u_c_SS (6.34 ng/mL)
//     N_min=26 certifies the POINT ESTIMATE; the 95% CI always straddles floor
//
//   N_crit ordering: slow (3) < std (6) < inh (7) < fast (15) << ind (never)
//
// ── Effect annotations ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//   All pub fns: with Mut, Div, Panic

module pbpk::rapamycin_n_crit

use pbpk::rapamycin_expanded_u::{eu_fully_in_range, eu_hi_above_ceil}
use pbpk::rapamycin_oral_budget::{
    ob_ka_var_std, ob_f_var_std, ob_ke_var_std,
    ob_k12_var_std, ob_k21_var_std, ob_ke_var_inh, ob_ke_var_ind
}

// Returns first N in [1, max_n] such that CI lies fully within [floor, ceil].
// Returns 0 if no such N exists (structurally uncertifiable within max_n doses).
pub fn nc_find_crit(d_oral: f64, max_n: i64, ke_val: f64, f_val: f64,
                    ka_var: f64, f_var: f64, ke_var: f64, k12_var: f64, k21_var: f64) -> i64
    with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var n = 1
    var found = 0
    while n <= max_n {
        if found == 0 && eu_fully_in_range(d_oral, n, ke_val, f_val, ka_var, f_var, ke_var, k12_var, k21_var) {
            found = n
        };
        n = n + 1
    }
    found
}

// Returns first N in [start_n, max_n] at which a previously certified CI first
// straddles the toxic ceiling (hi > ceil).  Returns 0 if window still open at max_n.
pub fn nc_find_close(d_oral: f64, start_n: i64, max_n: i64, ke_val: f64, f_val: f64,
                     ka_var: f64, f_var: f64, ke_var: f64, k12_var: f64, k21_var: f64) -> i64
    with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var n = start_n
    var found = 0
    while n <= max_n {
        if found == 0 && eu_hi_above_ceil(d_oral, n, ke_val, f_val, ka_var, f_var, ke_var, k12_var, k21_var) {
            found = n
        };
        n = n + 1
    }
    found
}

// ── Named scenario N_crit functions ──────────────────────────────────────────

pub fn nc_std_crit() -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ka = ob_ka_var_std(); let fv = ob_f_var_std()
    let ke = ob_ke_var_std(); let k12 = ob_k12_var_std(); let k21 = ob_k21_var_std()
    nc_find_crit(5.0, 50, 0.01118, 0.141, ka, fv, ke, k12, k21)
}

pub fn nc_slow_crit() -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {

    let ke = ob_ke_var_std(); let k12 = ob_k12_var_std(); let k21 = ob_k21_var_std()
    nc_find_crit(5.0, 50, 0.00838, 0.188, ka, fv, ke, k12, k21)
}

pub fn nc_fast_crit() -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
