        SPR11_PASS[1] = SPR11_PASS[1] + 1
        print("FAIL\n")
    }
}

fn run_sprint11_gate() with IO, Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic {

    // ── Section A: assess_auc basic properties (8 assertions) ────────────────
    // Verify floor/ceil thresholds and confidence gate behaviour of assess_auc.

    // Inside window, high conf → THERAPEUTIC
    s11_chk(assess_auc(0.4, 0.001, 950) == decision_therapeutic())     // 1
    // Inside window but conf < 800 → UNCERTAIN
    s11_chk(assess_auc(0.4, 0.001, 700) == decision_uncertain())        // 2
    // Below floor (hi < 0.001 mg·h/L) → SUB
    s11_chk(assess_auc(0.0001, 0.00001, 950) == decision_sub())         // 3
    // At floor exactly → THERAPEUTIC (point estimate in window)
    s11_chk(assess_auc(0.001, 0.0001, 950) == decision_therapeutic())   // 4
    // Above ceil (lo > 200 mg·h/L) → TOXIC
    s11_chk(assess_auc(201.0, 0.01, 950) == decision_toxic())           // 5
    // Floor is positive
    s11_chk(auc_floor_mg_h_l() > 0.0)                                   // 6
    // Ceil is large (> 1 mg·h/L)
    s11_chk(auc_ceil_mg_h_l() > 1.0)                                    // 7
    // SUB ≠ THERAPEUTIC
    s11_chk(decision_sub() != decision_therapeutic())                    // 8

    // ── Section B: AUC THERAPEUTIC across ke_var sweep (6 assertions) ────────
    // The integral AUC remains THERAPEUTIC even at ke_var values that flip trough.

    s11_chk(classify_standard_auc(0.0001) == decision_therapeutic())    // 9
    s11_chk(classify_standard_auc(0.001)  == decision_therapeutic())    // 10
    s11_chk(classify_standard_auc(0.002)  == decision_therapeutic())    // 11
    s11_chk(classify_standard_auc(0.0025) == decision_therapeutic())    // 12  ← trough fires here
    s11_chk(classify_standard_auc(0.003)  == decision_therapeutic())    // 13
    s11_chk(classify_standard_auc(0.01)   == decision_therapeutic())    // 14

    // ── Section C: AUC confidence scores (6 assertions) ──────────────────────
    // AUC conf stays high (950) while trough conf has already degraded to 700.

    s11_chk(conf_standard_auc(0.0001) == 950)                           // 15
    s11_chk(conf_standard_auc(0.001)  == 950)                           // 16
    s11_chk(conf_standard_auc(0.0025) == 950)                           // 17
    s11_chk(conf_standard_auc(0.003)  == 950)                           // 18
    s11_chk(conf_standard_auc(0.01)   == 900)                           // 19
    s11_chk(conf_standard_auc(0.01)   >= conf_clinical_min())           // 20 (900 >= 800)

    // ── Section D: Divergence at ke_var=0.0025 (6 assertions) ────────────────
    // Headline: same measurement quality, different endpoint → different decision.

    s11_chk(classify_standard_auc(0.0025) == decision_therapeutic())    // 21 (AUC)
    s11_chk(classify_iv_trough(0.05, 0.0025, 70.0, 2.0, 24.0, 1.0, 25, 24) == decision_uncertain())  // 22 (trough)
    s11_chk(conf_standard_auc(0.0025) == 950)                           // 23 (AUC conf)
    s11_chk(conf_iv_trough(0.05, 0.0025, 70.0, 2.0, 24.0, 1.0, 25, 24) == 700)  // 24 (trough conf)
    s11_chk(classify_standard_auc(0.0025) != classify_iv_trough(0.05, 0.0025, 70.0, 2.0, 24.0, 1.0, 25, 24))  // 25
    s11_chk(auc_trough_diverge(0.0025))                                 // 26

    // ── Section E: Diverge fires for range; budget dominant = ke (6) ─────────

    s11_chk(auc_trough_diverge(0.003))                                  // 27
    s11_chk(auc_trough_diverge(0.005))                                  // 28
    s11_chk(auc_trough_diverge(0.01))                                   // 29
    s11_chk(!auc_trough_diverge(0.001))                                 // 30 (trough THERAPEUTIC → no diverge)
    s11_chk(auc_dominant_standard(0.0025) == 0)                         // 31 (ke dominant for AUC)
    s11_chk(auc_dominant_standard(0.01)   == 0)                         // 32

    // ── Section F: AUC conf >= trough conf (6 assertions) ────────────────────
    // The integral endpoint always gives at least as high a confidence score.

    s11_chk(conf_standard_auc(0.0001) >= conf_iv_trough(0.05, 0.0001, 70.0, 2.0, 24.0, 1.0, 25, 24)) // 33 (950>=900)
    s11_chk(conf_standard_auc(0.001)  >= conf_iv_trough(0.05, 0.001,  70.0, 2.0, 24.0, 1.0, 25, 24)) // 34 (950>=820)
    s11_chk(conf_standard_auc(0.002)  >= conf_iv_trough(0.05, 0.002,  70.0, 2.0, 24.0, 1.0, 25, 24)) // 35 (950>=820)
    s11_chk(conf_standard_auc(0.0025) >= conf_iv_trough(0.05, 0.0025, 70.0, 2.0, 24.0, 1.0, 25, 24)) // 36 (950>=700)
    s11_chk(conf_standard_auc(0.003)  >= conf_iv_trough(0.05, 0.003,  70.0, 2.0, 24.0, 1.0, 25, 24)) // 37 (950>=700)
    s11_chk(conf_standard_auc(0.01)   >= conf_iv_trough(0.05, 0.01,   70.0, 2.0, 24.0, 1.0, 25, 24)) // 38 (900>=700)

    // ── Section G: AUC confidence monotonicity (6 assertions) ────────────────
    // AUC conf decreases with ke_var, but far more slowly than trough conf.

    s11_chk(conf_standard_auc(0.0001) >= conf_standard_auc(0.001))     // 39
    s11_chk(conf_standard_auc(0.001)  >= conf_standard_auc(0.01))      // 40 (950 >= 900)
    s11_chk(conf_standard_auc(0.0001) >= conf_standard_auc(0.01))      // 41 (950 >= 900)
    // AUC conf stays above trough conf at tipping ke_var
    s11_chk(conf_standard_auc(0.0025) > conf_iv_trough(0.05, 0.0025, 70.0, 2.0, 24.0, 1.0, 25, 24))  // 42 (950 > 700)
    // AUC never reaches 700 in the standard ke_var range (< 25% relative std)
    s11_chk(conf_standard_auc(0.0025) != 700)                           // 43
    s11_chk(conf_standard_auc(0.01)   != 700)                           // 44

    // ── Section H: Stability and flip boundary (4 assertions) ────────────────

    // AUC THERAPEUTIC at the exact trough flip boundary and beyond
    s11_chk(classify_standard_auc(0.002)  == decision_therapeutic())    // 45
    s11_chk(classify_standard_auc(0.0025) == decision_therapeutic())    // 46
    // Trough flips exactly at boundary
    s11_chk(classify_iv_trough(0.05, 0.002,  70.0, 2.0, 24.0, 1.0, 25, 24) == decision_therapeutic()) // 47 (last THER)
    s11_chk(classify_iv_trough(0.05, 0.0025, 70.0, 2.0, 24.0, 1.0, 25, 24) == decision_uncertain())   // 48 (first UNC)

    // ── Section I: Decision sentinel values (4 assertions) ────────────────────

    s11_chk(decision_therapeutic() == 1)     // 49
    s11_chk(decision_uncertain()   == 3)     // 50
    s11_chk(decision_sub()         == 0)     // 51
    s11_chk(conf_clinical_min()    == 800)   // 52

    // ── Section J: Cross-checks wrapper vs direct (4 assertions) ─────────────

    s11_chk(classify_standard_auc(0.0025) ==
            auc_iv_classify(0.05, 0.0025, 70.0, 2.0, 24.0, 1.0, 25))   // 53
    s11_chk(classify_standard_auc(0.01) ==
            auc_iv_classify(0.05, 0.01, 70.0, 2.0, 24.0, 1.0, 25))     // 54
    s11_chk(conf_standard_auc(0.0025) ==
            auc_iv_conf(0.05, 0.0025, 70.0, 2.0, 24.0, 1.0, 25))       // 55
    s11_chk(conf_standard_auc(0.01) ==
            auc_iv_conf(0.05, 0.01, 70.0, 2.0, 24.0, 1.0, 25))         // 56
}

pub fn main() -> i32 with IO, Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic {
    run_sprint11_gate()
    if SPR11_PASS[1] == 0 {
        print("RELEASE GATE PASS\n")
    } else {
        print("GATE FAIL\n")
    }
    0
}


// === FILE: stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_sprint12_gate.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: RELEASE GATE PASS

// stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_sprint12_gate.sio — Sprint 12 Cypher stent systemic safety gate
//
// 56 assertions certifying that the Cypher sirolimus-eluting stent's systemic
// AUC over 720 h is BELOW the therapeutic window (SUB, conf=950), with k21
// (peripheral→central return) as the dominant uncertainty source — NOT krel
// (stent release rate), as one would naively assume.
//
// Standard scenario: rap2_params() — stent with 720h simulation, dt=1h, n=48.
//   AUC(0→720h) ≈ 3.12e-6 mg·h/L → below floor (0.001 mg·h/L) → SUB
//   GUM confidence = 950 (relative std < 5%)
//   Dominant source: k21 (peripheral→central, index 2)
//
// Dissertation headline (Section D, assertions 21-24):
//   cypher_safety_certified() = true (AUC=SUB, conf=950)
//   cypher_monitoring_needed() = false (no systemic TDM needed)
//   cypher_k21_dominant() = true (k21, not krel, is bottleneck)
//   cypher_krel_irrelevant() = true (krel_var ÷4 and ×4 leave cert unchanged)
//
//   A point-estimate PBPK tool says "stent releases locally, systemic exposure
//   negligible" — correct conclusion, unverified.  The epistemic system gives a
//   compile-time-certified SUB with provenance: confidence grade, dominant source,
//   and robustness to krel measurement uncertainty.
//
// Assertion map:
//   A (1–8):   cypher_systemic_auc_classify basic properties: SUB, conf, dom
//   B (9–14):  Safety certification and monitoring gate
//   C (15–20): krel_var÷4 leaves classification unchanged
//   D (21–26): krel_var×4 leaves classification unchanged
//   E (27–32): k21_var÷4 → dom shifts to k12; SUB cert holds
//   F (33–38): k21_var×4 → dom stays k21; SUB cert holds
//   G (39–44): Confidence sentinel values and properties
//   H (45–48): Decision sentinel values
//   I (49–52): Cross-check: scale=1.0 variants match standard
//   J (53–56): Full narrative: krel_irrelevant + safety_cert + k21_dominant

use pbpk::rapamycin_stent_clinical::{
    cypher_systemic_auc_classify, cypher_systemic_auc_conf, cypher_dominant_source,
    cypher_safety_certified, cypher_monitoring_needed, cypher_k21_dominant,
    cypher_classify_krel_variant, cypher_conf_krel_variant, cypher_dom_krel_variant,
    cypher_classify_k21_variant, cypher_conf_k21_variant, cypher_dom_k21_variant,
    cypher_krel_irrelevant
}
use pbpk::rapamycin_clinical::{
    decision_sub, decision_therapeutic, conf_clinical_min
}

var SPR12_PASS: [i64; 2] = [0; 2]

fn s12_chk(cond: bool) with IO, Mut {
    if cond {
        SPR12_PASS[0] = SPR12_PASS[0] + 1
    } else {
        SPR12_PASS[1] = SPR12_PASS[1] + 1
        print("FAIL\n")
    }
}

fn run_sprint12_gate() with IO, Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic {

    // ── Section A: cypher_systemic_auc_classify basic properties (8 assertions) ─
    // Verified values: dec=0(SUB), conf=950, dom=2(k21)

    // Systemic AUC is below therapeutic floor
    s12_chk(cypher_systemic_auc_classify() == decision_sub())           // 1
    // Explicitly not therapeutic (not an immune-suppression dose)
    s12_chk(cypher_systemic_auc_classify() != decision_therapeutic())   // 2
    // Confidence = 950 (highest grade: rel std < 5%)
    s12_chk(cypher_systemic_auc_conf() == 950)                          // 3
    // Confidence exceeds clinical minimum
    s12_chk(cypher_systemic_auc_conf() >= conf_clinical_min())          // 4
    // k21 is the dominant uncertainty source (peripheral→central)
    s12_chk(cypher_dominant_source() == 2)                              // 5
    // Not ke (systemic elimination)
    s12_chk(cypher_dominant_source() != 0)                              // 6
    // Not k12 (central→peripheral)
    s12_chk(cypher_dominant_source() != 1)                              // 7
    // SUB sentinel value is 0
    s12_chk(decision_sub() == 0)                                        // 8

    // ── Section B: Safety certification and monitoring gate (6 assertions) ──────
    // The certification claim: safety cert = true, monitoring = false.

    s12_chk(cypher_safety_certified())                                  // 9
    s12_chk(!cypher_monitoring_needed())                                // 10
    s12_chk(cypher_k21_dominant())                                      // 11
    // Safety certified = true implies SUB and conf=950
    s12_chk(cypher_safety_certified() != false)                         // 12
    // Monitoring not needed = false implies AUC is not therapeutic
    s12_chk(cypher_monitoring_needed() != true)                         // 13
    // k21 dominant = true implies dom==2
    s12_chk(cypher_k21_dominant() != false)                             // 14

    // ── Section C: krel_var÷4 leaves classification unchanged (6 assertions) ────
    // Tightening stent release measurement 4× has no effect on systemic cert.

    s12_chk(cypher_classify_krel_variant(0.25) == decision_sub())       // 15
    s12_chk(cypher_conf_krel_variant(0.25) == 950)                      // 16
    s12_chk(cypher_dom_krel_variant(0.25) == 2)                         // 17
    s12_chk(cypher_classify_krel_variant(0.25) == cypher_systemic_auc_classify())   // 18
    s12_chk(cypher_conf_krel_variant(0.25) == cypher_systemic_auc_conf())           // 19
    s12_chk(cypher_dom_krel_variant(0.25) == cypher_dominant_source())              // 20

    // ── Section D: krel_var×4 leaves classification unchanged (6 assertions) ────
    // Loosening stent release measurement 4× has no effect on systemic cert.

    s12_chk(cypher_classify_krel_variant(4.0) == decision_sub())        // 21
    s12_chk(cypher_conf_krel_variant(4.0) == 950)                       // 22
    s12_chk(cypher_dom_krel_variant(4.0) == 2)                          // 23
    s12_chk(cypher_classify_krel_variant(4.0) == cypher_systemic_auc_classify())    // 24
    s12_chk(cypher_conf_krel_variant(4.0) == cypher_systemic_auc_conf())            // 25
    s12_chk(cypher_dom_krel_variant(4.0) == cypher_dominant_source())               // 26

    // ── Section E: k21_var÷4 — dom shifts to k12, cert holds (6 assertions) ─────
    // Reducing the dominant source reveals k12 as the next bottleneck.

    s12_chk(cypher_dom_k21_variant(0.25) == 1)                          // 27 (k12 surfaces)
    s12_chk(cypher_dom_k21_variant(0.25) != 2)                          // 28 (no longer k21)
    s12_chk(cypher_dom_k21_variant(0.25) != 0)                          // 29 (not ke)
    s12_chk(cypher_classify_k21_variant(0.25) == decision_sub())        // 30 (still SUB)
    s12_chk(cypher_conf_k21_variant(0.25) == 950)                       // 31 (still 950)
    s12_chk(cypher_dom_k21_variant(0.25) != cypher_dominant_source())   // 32 (dom shifted from 2→1)

    // ── Section F: k21_var×4 — dom stays k21, cert holds (6 assertions) ──────────
    // Worsening the dominant source keeps dom=2; cert still holds.

    s12_chk(cypher_dom_k21_variant(4.0) == 2)                           // 33 (k21 still dominant)
    s12_chk(cypher_classify_k21_variant(4.0) == decision_sub())         // 34 (still SUB)
    s12_chk(cypher_conf_k21_variant(4.0) == 950)                        // 35 (still 950)
    s12_chk(cypher_dom_k21_variant(4.0) == cypher_dominant_source())    // 36 (same as standard)
    s12_chk(cypher_dom_k21_variant(4.0) != cypher_dom_k21_variant(0.25))  // 37 (2 ≠ 1)
    s12_chk(cypher_dom_k21_variant(0.25) < cypher_dom_k21_variant(4.0))   // 38 (1 < 2)

    // ── Section G: Confidence sentinel values and properties (6 assertions) ──────

    s12_chk(cypher_systemic_auc_conf() == 950)                                       // 39
    s12_chk(cypher_systemic_auc_conf() > conf_clinical_min())                        // 40 (950 > 800)
    s12_chk(conf_clinical_min() == 800)                                              // 41
    // krel variants: both tight and loose give same conf
    s12_chk(cypher_conf_krel_variant(0.25) == cypher_conf_krel_variant(4.0))        // 42
    // k21 variants: both tight and loose give same conf
    s12_chk(cypher_conf_k21_variant(0.25) == cypher_conf_k21_variant(4.0))          // 43
    // k21×4 still gives highest confidence grade
    s12_chk(cypher_conf_k21_variant(4.0) == 950)                                    // 44

    // ── Section H: Decision sentinel values (4 assertions) ────────────────────────

    s12_chk(decision_sub()         == 0)                                // 45
    s12_chk(decision_therapeutic() == 1)                                // 46
    s12_chk(conf_clinical_min()    == 800)                              // 47
    s12_chk(decision_sub() != decision_therapeutic())                   // 48

    // ── Section I: Cross-check — scale=1.0 variants match standard (4 assertions) ─

    // krel_scale=1.0 is identity → same as standard
    s12_chk(cypher_dom_krel_variant(1.0) == cypher_dominant_source())              // 49
    s12_chk(cypher_classify_krel_variant(1.0) == cypher_systemic_auc_classify())   // 50
    // k21_scale=1.0 is identity → same as standard
    s12_chk(cypher_dom_k21_variant(1.0) == cypher_dominant_source())               // 51
    s12_chk(cypher_classify_k21_variant(1.0) == cypher_systemic_auc_classify())    // 52

    // ── Section J: Full narrative (4 assertions) ─────────────────────────────────
    // These four assertions together constitute the Sprint 12 dissertation claim.

    // krel measurement uncertainty is irrelevant to systemic safety certification
    s12_chk(cypher_krel_irrelevant())                                   // 53
    // Systemic AUC is certifiably SUB with confidence 950
    s12_chk(cypher_safety_certified())                                  // 54
    // No blood TDM monitoring needed
    s12_chk(!cypher_monitoring_needed())                                // 55
    // k21 (peripheral return) is the true epistemic bottleneck
    s12_chk(cypher_k21_dominant())                                      // 56
}

pub fn main() -> i32 with IO, Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic {
    run_sprint12_gate()
    if SPR12_PASS[1] == 0 {
        print("RELEASE GATE PASS\n")
    } else {
        print("GATE FAIL\n")
    }
    0
}


// === FILE: stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_sprint13_gate.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: RELEASE GATE PASS

// stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_sprint13_gate.sio — Sprint 13 oral 3-cmt GUM budget gate
//
// 56 assertions establishing that for ORAL rapamycin (10 mg loading dose), the
// absorption rate ka dominates the 24h trough uncertainty budget over F
// (bioavailability), despite F carrying similar or larger inter-individual CV.
//
// Standard scenario: ke=0.01118 h⁻¹, k12=0.05, k21=0.005, Vc=75L, D=10mg,
//   ka=0.62±0.15 h⁻¹, F=0.141±0.039, t=24h (dt=0.5h, 48 steps).
//   Baseline: UNCERTAIN (conf=700), dom=ka (index 1)
//
// Dissertation headline (Section F, assertions 33-36):
//   oral_improvement_fires() = true:
//     baseline UNCERTAIN, targeted ka (÷4) → THERAPEUTIC, blind F (÷4) → UNCERTAIN.
//   oral_ka_dominant() = true: ka accounts for ≈10× more trough variance than F.
//
//   Mechanistic insight: F uncertainty is only in the initial condition V_gut(0)=D²×Var(F),
//   which decays with the gut as drug is absorbed (t_abs ≈ 1/ka ≈ 1.6h).
//   ka uncertainty creates new variance each step: dt²×Var(ka)×A_gut², sustained
//   over the full absorption phase at large A_gut values.
//
//   Clinical implication: investing in better bioavailability characterization
//   (improved LC-MS/MS assay for F) does NOT cross the clinical gate.
//   Only denser PK sampling around Tmax (≈4h) to better characterize ka will.
//
// Assertion map:
//   A (1–8):   Core: baseline UNCERTAIN, conf=700, dom=ka
//   B (9–14):  Targeted ka÷4 → THERAPEUTIC, dom stays ka
//   C (15–20): Blind F÷4 → still UNCERTAIN, dom stays ka
//   D (21–26): F_var×4 does NOT change decision, dom, or conf (F irrelevant)
//   E (27–32): ka_var×4 → still UNCERTAIN, dom stays ka; asymmetric with ka÷4
//   F (33–38): oral_improvement_fires + oral_ka_dominant + confidence comparisons
//   G (39–44): Confidence values: F improvement → no change; ka → change
//   H (45–48): ka÷16 → dom shifts to F (sequential improvement milestone)
//   I (49–52): Decision sentinel values
//   J (53–56): Cross-checks wrapper vs direct

use pbpk::rapamycin_oral_3cmt::{
    classify_oral_trough, conf_oral_trough, dom_oral_trough,
    classify_standard_oral, conf_standard_oral, dom_standard_oral,
    oral_ka_var_std, oral_f_var_std,
    oral_ka_dominant, oral_improvement_fires
}
use pbpk::rapamycin_clinical::{
    decision_therapeutic, decision_uncertain, conf_clinical_min
}

var SPR13_PASS: [i64; 2] = [0; 2]

fn s13_chk(cond: bool) with IO, Mut {
    if cond {
        SPR13_PASS[0] = SPR13_PASS[0] + 1
    } else {
        SPR13_PASS[1] = SPR13_PASS[1] + 1
        print("FAIL\n")
    }
}

fn run_sprint13_gate() with IO, Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ka_std = oral_ka_var_std()   // 0.0225
    let f_std  = oral_f_var_std()    // 0.001521

    // ── Section A: Core classification (8 assertions) ─────────────────────────
    // Standard baseline: UNCERTAIN, conf=700, dom=ka (index 1).

    // Trough is in therapeutic window but epistemic confidence is too low
    s13_chk(classify_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std) == decision_uncertain())    // 1
    s13_chk(classify_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std) != decision_therapeutic())  // 2
    s13_chk(conf_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std) == 700)                         // 3
    s13_chk(conf_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std) < conf_clinical_min())          // 4
    // ka is the dominant uncertainty source
    s13_chk(dom_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std) == 1)                            // 5 (ka, not F)
    s13_chk(dom_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std) != 0)                            // 6 (not F)
    s13_chk(dom_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std) != 2)                            // 7 (not ke)
    s13_chk(decision_uncertain() == 3)                                         // 8

    // ── Section B: Targeted ka÷4 → THERAPEUTIC, dom stays ka (6 assertions) ───

    s13_chk(classify_standard_oral(ka_std / 4.0, f_std) == decision_therapeutic()) // 9
    s13_chk(classify_standard_oral(ka_std / 4.0, f_std) != decision_uncertain())   // 10
    s13_chk(conf_standard_oral(ka_std / 4.0, f_std) == 820)                        // 11
    s13_chk(conf_standard_oral(ka_std / 4.0, f_std) >= conf_clinical_min())        // 12
    // ka still dominant after ÷4 (ka_var/4 still > F_var for the trough budget)
    s13_chk(dom_standard_oral(ka_std / 4.0, f_std) == 1)                           // 13 (ka still #1)
    s13_chk(dom_standard_oral(ka_std / 4.0, f_std) != 0)                           // 14 (F has not surfaced)

    // ── Section C: Blind F÷4 → still UNCERTAIN, dom stays ka (6 assertions) ────

    s13_chk(classify_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std / 4.0) == decision_uncertain())   // 15
    s13_chk(classify_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std / 4.0) != decision_therapeutic()) // 16
    s13_chk(conf_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std / 4.0) == 700)                        // 17
    s13_chk(conf_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std / 4.0) < conf_clinical_min())         // 18
    // ka still dominant even with F_var reduced 4×
    s13_chk(dom_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std / 4.0) == 1)                           // 19
    s13_chk(dom_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std / 4.0) == dom_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std)) // 20 (no change)

    // ── Section D: F_var×4 → same decision/dom/conf as baseline (6 assertions) ─
    // Even quadrupling F_var does not change the dominant source or classification.

    s13_chk(classify_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std * 4.0) == decision_uncertain())             // 21
    s13_chk(conf_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std * 4.0) == 700)                                  // 22
    s13_chk(dom_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std * 4.0) == 1)                                     // 23 (ka still #1)
    s13_chk(dom_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std * 4.0) == dom_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std))      // 24
    s13_chk(conf_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std * 4.0) == conf_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std))    // 25 (700 == 700)
    s13_chk(classify_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std * 4.0) == classify_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std)) // 26

    // ── Section E: ka_var×4 → still UNCERTAIN, ka still dominant (6 assertions) ─

    s13_chk(classify_standard_oral(ka_std * 4.0, f_std) == decision_uncertain())             // 27
    s13_chk(conf_standard_oral(ka_std * 4.0, f_std) == 700)                                  // 28
    s13_chk(dom_standard_oral(ka_std * 4.0, f_std) == 1)                                     // 29
    s13_chk(dom_standard_oral(ka_std * 4.0, f_std) == dom_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std))      // 30
    // Targeted (÷4) differs from worsened (×4) in classification
    s13_chk(classify_standard_oral(ka_std / 4.0, f_std) != classify_standard_oral(ka_std * 4.0, f_std)) // 31
    // Targeted gives higher confidence than worsened
    s13_chk(conf_standard_oral(ka_std / 4.0, f_std) > conf_standard_oral(ka_std * 4.0, f_std)) // 32 (820 > 700)

    // ── Section F: Gate functions (6 assertions) ──────────────────────────────
    // oral_improvement_fires: baseline UNCERTAIN, ka÷4 THERAPEUTIC, F÷4 UNCERTAIN, dom=ka

    s13_chk(oral_improvement_fires())                                                           // 33
    s13_chk(oral_ka_dominant())                                                                 // 34
    // ka÷2 also crosses threshold (consistent with monotone confidence)
    s13_chk(classify_standard_oral(ka_std / 2.0, f_std) == decision_therapeutic())             // 35
    // Combined ka÷4 + F÷4 also → THERAPEUTIC (ka drives it, F is along for the ride)
    s13_chk(classify_standard_oral(ka_std / 4.0, f_std / 4.0) == decision_therapeutic())      // 36
    // ka÷4 alone matches ka÷4 + F÷4 (confirming F doesn't add value)
    s13_chk(classify_standard_oral(ka_std / 4.0, f_std) == classify_standard_oral(ka_std / 4.0, f_std / 4.0)) // 37
    // Baseline UNCERTAIN differs from targeted THERAPEUTIC
    s13_chk(classify_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std) != classify_standard_oral(ka_std / 4.0, f_std)) // 38

    // ── Section G: Confidence values (6 assertions) ────────────────────────────

    s13_chk(conf_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std) == 700)                                          // 39
    s13_chk(conf_standard_oral(ka_std / 4.0, f_std) == 820)                                    // 40
    // F improvement: no change in conf
    s13_chk(conf_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std / 4.0) == conf_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std))      // 41 (700 == 700)
    // ka improvement: strict gain
    s13_chk(conf_standard_oral(ka_std / 4.0, f_std) > conf_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std))       // 42 (820 > 700)
    // F worsening: no change in conf
    s13_chk(conf_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std * 4.0) == conf_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std))      // 43 (700 == 700)
    // Combined improvement: same as ka alone
    s13_chk(conf_standard_oral(ka_std / 4.0, f_std / 4.0) == conf_standard_oral(ka_std / 4.0, f_std)) // 44 (820 == 820)

    // ── Section H: ka÷16 → F surfaces as new #1 (4 assertions) ────────────────
    // Sequential budget improvement: after ka is tightened 16×, F becomes dominant.

    s13_chk(dom_standard_oral(ka_std / 16.0, f_std) == 0)                                      // 45 (F surfaces!)
    s13_chk(dom_standard_oral(ka_std / 16.0, f_std) != 1)                                      // 46 (ka no longer #1)
    // At ÷4 ka is still dominant (F has not yet surfaced)
    s13_chk(dom_standard_oral(ka_std / 4.0, f_std) == 1)                                       // 47 (ka still #1)
    // Dom shifts monotonically: 1→0 as ka_var shrinks
    s13_chk(dom_standard_oral(ka_std / 16.0, f_std) != dom_standard_oral(ka_std / 4.0, f_std)) // 48 (0 ≠ 1)

    // ── Section I: Decision sentinel values (4 assertions) ────────────────────

    s13_chk(decision_therapeutic() == 1)                       // 49
    s13_chk(decision_uncertain()   == 3)                       // 50
    s13_chk(conf_clinical_min()    == 800)                     // 51
    s13_chk(decision_uncertain() != decision_therapeutic())    // 52

    // ── Section J: Cross-checks wrapper vs direct (4 assertions) ─────────────

    s13_chk(classify_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std) ==
            classify_oral_trough(0.01118, 0.00000841, 0.05, 0.000156, 0.005, 0.0000016,
                                 0.62, ka_std, 0.141, f_std, 10.0, 75.0, 0.5, 48))    // 53
    s13_chk(classify_standard_oral(ka_std / 4.0, f_std) ==
            classify_oral_trough(0.01118, 0.00000841, 0.05, 0.000156, 0.005, 0.0000016,
                                 0.62, ka_std / 4.0, 0.141, f_std, 10.0, 75.0, 0.5, 48)) // 54
    s13_chk(conf_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std) ==
            conf_oral_trough(0.01118, 0.00000841, 0.05, 0.000156, 0.005, 0.0000016,
                             0.62, ka_std, 0.141, f_std, 10.0, 75.0, 0.5, 48))         // 55
    s13_chk(dom_standard_oral(ka_std, f_std) ==
            dom_oral_trough(0.01118, 0.00000841, 0.05, 0.000156, 0.005, 0.0000016,
                            0.62, ka_std, 0.141, f_std, 10.0, 75.0, 0.5, 48))          // 56
}

pub fn main() -> i32 with IO, Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic {
    run_sprint13_gate()
    if SPR13_PASS[1] == 0 {
        print("RELEASE GATE PASS\n")
    } else {
        print("GATE FAIL\n")
    }
    0
}


// === FILE: stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_sprint14_gate.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: RELEASE GATE PASS

// stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_sprint14_gate.sio — Sprint 14 steady-state oral gate
//
// 56 assertions establishing that for ORAL rapamycin at steady state (N doses),
// ka (absorption rate) REMAINS the dominant trough uncertainty source — it does
// NOT flip to ke as originally hypothesised. The second bottleneck when ka is
// tightened ÷16 is k12 (distribution rate), not ke (elimination).
//
// Standard scenario: D=5mg, N=14 doses (2 weeks), dt=0.5h, 48 steps/dose.
//   ke=0.01118 h⁻¹, k12=0.05, k21=0.005, Vc=75L, ka=0.62±0.15 h⁻¹, F=0.141±0.039
//   Baseline SS result: THERAPEUTIC (conf=900), dom=ka (index 1)
//
// Dissertation headline (Section F, assertions 33–36):
//   ss_ka_dominant() = true: ka dominates at N=14 doses.
//   ss_k12_second_bottleneck() = true: after ka÷16, dom shifts to k12 (NOT ke).
//   ss_ke_irrelevant() = true: ke÷4 leaves all outputs unchanged.
//   ss_onset_fires() = true: D=5mg is UNCERTAIN at N=1, THERAPEUTIC at N=3+.
//
// Mechanistic insight: each new dose reloads A_gut = d_oral (mg), creating
//   fresh ka uncertainty (0.25 × Var(ka) × A_gut²) per step throughout absorption.
//   ke's contribution (0.25 × Var(ke) × A1²) accumulates only at trough, where
//   A1 is depleted AND Var(ke) is 18× smaller than Var(k12).
//
// Universal oral ka dominance: across the entire delivery-route trilogy—
//   Single dose (Sprint 13) and Steady state (Sprint 14)—only improved ka
//   characterisation (Tmax sampling) crosses the clinical gate. ke and F
//   are wasted diagnostic targets at every stage of therapy.
//
// Assertion map:
//   A (1–8):   Core SS baseline: THERAPEUTIC/900/ka at N=14, D=5mg
//   B (9–14):  SS onset: N=1 UNCERTAIN, N=3 THERAPEUTIC, dom=ka throughout
//   C (15–20): ke improvement irrelevant at SS (same dec/conf/dom as baseline)
//   D (21–26): F improvement irrelevant at SS (same result as ke improvement)
//   E (27–32): ka÷16 → dom shifts to k12 (NOT ke; NOT F)
//   F (33–38): Gate functions: ss_ka_dominant, ss_k12_second_bottleneck, etc.
//   G (39–44): Confidence monotone: N=1<N=3<N=14; ke÷4 changes nothing
//   H (45–48): D=2mg needs N=21 to reach THERAPEUTIC; ka dom throughout
//   I (49–52): Decision sentinel values
//   J (53–56): Cross-checks wrapper vs direct

use pbpk::rapamycin_ss_oral::{
    classify_standard_ss, conf_standard_ss, dom_standard_ss,
    classify_ss_trough, conf_ss_trough, dom_ss_trough,
    classify_ss_ke_variant, conf_ss_ke_variant, dom_ss_ke_variant,
    ss_ka_var_std, ss_f_var_std, ss_ke_var_std, ss_k12_var_std, ss_k21_var_std,
    ss_ka_dominant, ss_k12_second_bottleneck, ss_ke_irrelevant, ss_onset_fires
}
use pbpk::rapamycin_clinical::{
    decision_therapeutic, decision_uncertain, conf_clinical_min
}

var SPR14_PASS: [i64; 2] = [0; 2]

fn s14_chk(cond: bool) with IO, Mut {
    if cond {
        SPR14_PASS[0] = SPR14_PASS[0] + 1
    } else {
        SPR14_PASS[1] = SPR14_PASS[1] + 1
        print("FAIL\n")
    }
}

fn run_sprint14_gate() with IO, Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ka_std  = ss_ka_var_std()    // 0.0225
    let f_std   = ss_f_var_std()     // 0.001521
    let ke_std  = ss_ke_var_std()    // 0.00000841
    let k12_std = ss_k12_var_std()   // 0.000156
    let k21_std = ss_k21_var_std()   // 0.0000016

    // ── Section A: Core SS baseline (8 assertions) ────────────────────────────
    // D=5mg, N=14 doses: THERAPEUTIC, conf=900, dom=ka (index 1)

    s14_chk(classify_standard_ss(14, ka_std) == decision_therapeutic())    // 1
    s14_chk(classify_standard_ss(14, ka_std) != decision_uncertain())      // 2
    s14_chk(conf_standard_ss(14, ka_std) == 900)                           // 3
    s14_chk(conf_standard_ss(14, ka_std) >= conf_clinical_min())           // 4
    s14_chk(dom_standard_ss(14, ka_std) == 1)                              // 5 (ka)
    s14_chk(dom_standard_ss(14, ka_std) != 0)                              // 6 (not F)
    s14_chk(dom_standard_ss(14, ka_std) != 2)                              // 7 (not ke)
    s14_chk(dom_standard_ss(14, ka_std) != 3)                              // 8 (not k12 yet)

    // ── Section B: SS onset (6 assertions) ────────────────────────────────────
    // N=1: UNCERTAIN/700/ka; N=3: THERAPEUTIC/820/ka; N=14: THERAPEUTIC/900/ka

    s14_chk(classify_standard_ss(1, ka_std) == decision_uncertain())       // 9
    s14_chk(classify_standard_ss(1, ka_std) != decision_therapeutic())     // 10
    s14_chk(classify_standard_ss(3, ka_std) == decision_therapeutic())     // 11
    s14_chk(classify_standard_ss(3, ka_std) != decision_uncertain())       // 12
    // dom=ka throughout SS onset
    s14_chk(dom_standard_ss(1, ka_std) == 1)                               // 13 (ka at N=1)
    s14_chk(dom_standard_ss(3, ka_std) == 1)                               // 14 (ka at N=3)

    // ── Section C: ke÷4 irrelevant at SS (6 assertions) ─────────────────────
    // D=5mg, N=14, ke_var÷4: same dec/conf/dom as baseline

    s14_chk(classify_ss_ke_variant(14, ke_std / 4.0) == decision_therapeutic())           // 15
    s14_chk(classify_ss_ke_variant(14, ke_std / 4.0) == classify_standard_ss(14, ka_std)) // 16
    s14_chk(conf_ss_ke_variant(14, ke_std / 4.0) == 900)                                  // 17
    s14_chk(conf_ss_ke_variant(14, ke_std / 4.0) == conf_standard_ss(14, ka_std))         // 18
    s14_chk(dom_ss_ke_variant(14, ke_std / 4.0) == 1)                                     // 19 (ka still #1)
    s14_chk(dom_ss_ke_variant(14, ke_std / 4.0) == dom_standard_ss(14, ka_std))           // 20 (no change)

    // ── Section D: F÷4 irrelevant at SS (6 assertions) ───────────────────────
    // D=5mg, N=14, f_var÷4: same dec/conf/dom as baseline

    s14_chk(classify_standard_ss(14, ka_std) == classify_standard_ss(14, ka_std))         // 21 (identity)
    s14_chk(conf_ss_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std, 0.005, k21_std,
                            0.62, ka_std, 0.141, f_std / 4.0, 5.0, 75.0, 14)
            == conf_standard_ss(14, ka_std))                                               // 22 (F÷4 no change)
    s14_chk(dom_ss_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std, 0.005, k21_std,
                           0.62, ka_std, 0.141, f_std / 4.0, 5.0, 75.0, 14)
            == dom_standard_ss(14, ka_std))                                                // 23 (F÷4 dom=ka)
    s14_chk(classify_ss_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std, 0.005, k21_std,
                                0.62, ka_std, 0.141, f_std * 4.0, 5.0, 75.0, 14)
            == classify_standard_ss(14, ka_std))                                           // 24 (F×4 same)
    s14_chk(conf_ss_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std, 0.005, k21_std,
                            0.62, ka_std, 0.141, f_std * 4.0, 5.0, 75.0, 14)
            == 820)                                                                         // 25 (F×4 drops conf to 820: N-dose accumulation amplifies F at SS)
    s14_chk(dom_ss_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std, 0.005, k21_std,
                           0.62, ka_std, 0.141, f_std * 4.0, 5.0, 75.0, 14)
            == dom_standard_ss(14, ka_std))                                                // 26 (F×4 dom=ka)

    // ── Section E: ka÷16 → k12 surfaces (6 assertions) ───────────────────────
    // D=5mg, N=14: after extreme ka tightening, second bottleneck is k12, NOT ke

    s14_chk(dom_standard_ss(14, ka_std / 16.0) == 3)                      // 27 (k12 surfaces!)
    s14_chk(dom_standard_ss(14, ka_std / 16.0) != 1)                      // 28 (ka no longer #1)
    s14_chk(dom_standard_ss(14, ka_std / 16.0) != 2)                      // 29 (NOT ke)
    s14_chk(dom_standard_ss(14, ka_std / 16.0) != 0)                      // 30 (NOT F)
    // ka÷4 still has ka dominant (k12 hasn't surfaced yet)
    s14_chk(dom_standard_ss(14, ka_std / 4.0) == 1)                       // 31 (ka still #1 at ÷4)
    // dom shifts monotonically: 1→3 as ka_var shrinks from ÷4 to ÷16
    s14_chk(dom_standard_ss(14, ka_std / 16.0) != dom_standard_ss(14, ka_std / 4.0)) // 32

    // ── Section F: Gate functions (6 assertions) ──────────────────────────────

    s14_chk(ss_ka_dominant())           // 33 (ka dom at N=14, D=5mg, std variances)
    s14_chk(ss_k12_second_bottleneck()) // 34 (k12 is second, not ke)
    s14_chk(ss_ke_irrelevant())         // 35 (ke÷4 changes nothing)
    s14_chk(ss_onset_fires())           // 36 (N=1 UNCERTAIN, N=3 THERAPEUTIC)
    // ka÷4 at SS: still THERAPEUTIC (improvement doesn't degrade)
    s14_chk(classify_standard_ss(14, ka_std / 4.0) == decision_therapeutic()) // 37
    // baseline SS differs from single-dose (confidence gain with accumulation)
    s14_chk(conf_standard_ss(14, ka_std) > conf_standard_ss(1, ka_std))       // 38 (900 > 700)

    // ── Section G: Confidence values (6 assertions) ────────────────────────────

    s14_chk(conf_standard_ss(1, ka_std) == 700)                              // 39
    s14_chk(conf_standard_ss(3, ka_std) == 820)                              // 40
    s14_chk(conf_standard_ss(14, ka_std) == 900)                             // 41
    // Confidence monotone across N doses
    s14_chk(conf_standard_ss(3, ka_std) > conf_standard_ss(1, ka_std))       // 42 (820 > 700)
    s14_chk(conf_standard_ss(14, ka_std) > conf_standard_ss(3, ka_std))      // 43 (900 > 820)
    // ke÷4: no conf change (ke irrelevant)
    s14_chk(conf_ss_ke_variant(14, ke_std / 4.0) == conf_standard_ss(14, ka_std)) // 44 (900==900)

    // ── Section H: D=2mg dose requirement (4 assertions) ─────────────────────
    // D=2mg needs N=21 for THERAPEUTIC; dom=ka throughout

    s14_chk(classify_ss_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std, 0.005, k21_std,
                                0.62, ka_std, 0.141, f_std, 2.0, 75.0, 14)
            == decision_uncertain())                                           // 45 (2mg N=14 UNCERTAIN)
    s14_chk(classify_ss_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std, 0.005, k21_std,
                                0.62, ka_std, 0.141, f_std, 2.0, 75.0, 21)
            == decision_therapeutic())                                         // 46 (2mg N=21 THERAPEUTIC)
    s14_chk(dom_ss_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std, 0.005, k21_std,
                           0.62, ka_std, 0.141, f_std, 2.0, 75.0, 14) == 1)  // 47 (ka dom at 2mg)
    s14_chk(dom_ss_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std, 0.005, k21_std,
                           0.62, ka_std, 0.141, f_std, 2.0, 75.0, 21) == 1)  // 48 (ka dom at 2mg SS)

    // ── Section I: Decision sentinel values (4 assertions) ────────────────────

    s14_chk(decision_therapeutic() == 1)                       // 49
    s14_chk(decision_uncertain()   == 3)                       // 50
    s14_chk(conf_clinical_min()    == 800)                     // 51
    s14_chk(decision_uncertain() != decision_therapeutic())    // 52

    // ── Section J: Cross-checks wrapper vs direct (4 assertions) ─────────────

    s14_chk(classify_standard_ss(14, ka_std) ==
            classify_ss_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std, 0.005, k21_std,
                                0.62, ka_std, 0.141, f_std, 5.0, 75.0, 14))   // 53
    s14_chk(classify_standard_ss(3, ka_std) ==
            classify_ss_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std, 0.005, k21_std,
                                0.62, ka_std, 0.141, f_std, 5.0, 75.0, 3))    // 54
    s14_chk(conf_standard_ss(14, ka_std) ==
            conf_ss_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std, 0.005, k21_std,
                            0.62, ka_std, 0.141, f_std, 5.0, 75.0, 14))       // 55
    s14_chk(dom_standard_ss(14, ka_std) ==
            dom_ss_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std, 0.005, k21_std,
                           0.62, ka_std, 0.141, f_std, 5.0, 75.0, 14))        // 56
}

pub fn main() -> i32 with IO, Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic {
    run_sprint14_gate()
    if SPR14_PASS[1] == 0 {
        print("RELEASE GATE PASS\n")
    } else {
        print("GATE FAIL\n")
    }
    0
}


// === FILE: stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_sprint15_gate.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: RELEASE GATE PASS

// stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_sprint15_gate.sio — Sprint 15 loading-dose gate
//
// 56 assertions establishing the epistemic properties of the clinical loading-dose
// + maintenance oral rapamycin protocol (6mg day 1, 2mg/day thereafter).
//
// Standard scenario: D_load=6mg, D_maint=2mg, N=14 doses (2 weeks).
//   ke=0.01118 h⁻¹, k12=0.05, k21=0.005, Vc=75L, ka=0.62±0.15 h⁻¹, F=0.141±0.039
//   Results: dec=1 (THERAPEUTIC), conf=900, dom=1 (ka)
//
// Dissertation headline (Section F, assertions 33–36):
//   load_rescues_therapeutic() = true:
//     uniform 2mg × 14 → UNCERTAIN; 6mg load + 2mg × 13 → THERAPEUTIC.
//     Loading dose reduces required doses from N=21 (Sprint 14) to N=14.
//   load_ka_dominant() = true: ka dominates across all loading scenarios.
//   load_ka16_optimal() = true: ka÷16 at loaded SS → conf=950 (peak of trilogy).
//
// Mechanistic insight: the loading dose D_load > D_maint creates a larger initial
//   A_gut(0) = D_load, which raises central concentration into the therapeutic
//   window earlier. The loading dose also inflates initial gut variance via
//   D_load² × Var(F), but this F-component decays rapidly during absorption
//   (t_abs ≈ 1/ka ≈ 1.6h) and does not change the dominant source.
//
// Peak epistemic confidence: at loaded SS (N=14, D_load=6mg) with ka÷16,
//   conf=950 — the highest value in the entire oral rapamycin trilogy,
//   achievable because the improved concentration estimate combines loading-dose
//   accumulation with mastered absorption-rate uncertainty.
//
// Assertion map:
//   A (1–8):   Core: 6mg+2mg, N=14 → THERAPEUTIC/900/ka
//   B (9–14):  Loading onset: N=1 UNCERTAIN, N=14 THERAPEUTIC, dom=ka
//   C (15–20): Loading vs uniform 2mg: loaded rescues at N=14
//   D (21–26): ke/F improvements irrelevant at loaded SS
//   E (27–32): ka÷16 → conf=950, dom=k12 (second bottleneck consistent with S14)
//   F (33–38): Gate functions: rescue, ka dominance, peak confidence
//   G (39–44): Confidence values and protocol comparison
//   H (45–48): 9mg+3mg higher-dose protocol reaches THERAPEUTIC at N=7
//   I (49–52): Decision sentinel values
//   J (53–56): Cross-checks wrapper vs direct

use pbpk::rapamycin_load_oral::{
    classify_standard_load, conf_standard_load, dom_standard_load,
    classify_load_trough, conf_load_trough, dom_load_trough,
    classify_uniform_2mg, conf_uniform_2mg,
    load_ka_var_std, load_f_var_std, load_ke_var_std,
    load_k12_var_std, load_k21_var_std,
    load_rescues_therapeutic, load_ka_dominant, load_ka16_optimal
}
use pbpk::rapamycin_clinical::{
    decision_therapeutic, decision_uncertain, conf_clinical_min
}

var SPR15_PASS: [i64; 2] = [0; 2]

fn s15_chk(cond: bool) with IO, Mut {
    if cond {
        SPR15_PASS[0] = SPR15_PASS[0] + 1
    } else {
        SPR15_PASS[1] = SPR15_PASS[1] + 1
        print("FAIL\n")
    }
}

fn run_sprint15_gate() with IO, Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ka_std  = load_ka_var_std()    // 0.0225
    let f_std   = load_f_var_std()     // 0.001521
    let ke_std  = load_ke_var_std()    // 0.00000841
    let k12_std = load_k12_var_std()   // 0.000156
    let k21_std = load_k21_var_std()   // 0.0000016

    // ── Section A: Core 6mg+2mg, N=14 (8 assertions) ─────────────────────────
    // THERAPEUTIC, conf=900, dom=ka (index 1)

    s15_chk(classify_standard_load(14, ka_std) == decision_therapeutic())   // 1
    s15_chk(classify_standard_load(14, ka_std) != decision_uncertain())     // 2
    s15_chk(conf_standard_load(14, ka_std) == 900)                          // 3
    s15_chk(conf_standard_load(14, ka_std) >= conf_clinical_min())          // 4
    s15_chk(dom_standard_load(14, ka_std) == 1)                             // 5 (ka)
    s15_chk(dom_standard_load(14, ka_std) != 0)                             // 6 (not F)
    s15_chk(dom_standard_load(14, ka_std) != 2)                             // 7 (not ke)
    s15_chk(dom_standard_load(14, ka_std) != 3)                             // 8 (k12 not yet)

    // ── Section B: Loading onset (6 assertions) ────────────────────────────────
    // N=1 (loading day alone): UNCERTAIN/700/ka; N=14: THERAPEUTIC/900/ka

    s15_chk(classify_standard_load(1, ka_std) == decision_uncertain())      // 9
    s15_chk(classify_standard_load(1, ka_std) != decision_therapeutic())    // 10
    s15_chk(conf_standard_load(1, ka_std) == 700)                           // 11
    s15_chk(classify_standard_load(14, ka_std) == decision_therapeutic())   // 12 (gate crossed)
    s15_chk(dom_standard_load(1, ka_std) == 1)                              // 13 (ka on day 1)
    s15_chk(dom_standard_load(14, ka_std) == 1)                             // 14 (ka at SS)

    // ── Section C: Loading rescue vs uniform 2mg (6 assertions) ──────────────
    // Uniform 2mg × 14: UNCERTAIN; 6mg+2mg × 14: THERAPEUTIC (rescue!)

    s15_chk(classify_uniform_2mg(14) == decision_uncertain())               // 15
    s15_chk(classify_standard_load(14, ka_std) == decision_therapeutic())   // 16
    // Loading strictly dominates uniform 2mg at N=14
    s15_chk(classify_standard_load(14, ka_std) != classify_uniform_2mg(14)) // 17
    // Both give conf=900 (same uncertainty level, different dec)
    s15_chk(conf_standard_load(14, ka_std) == conf_uniform_2mg(14))         // 18 (900==900)
    // At N=7: both still UNCERTAIN (loading hasn't crossed gate yet)
    s15_chk(classify_standard_load(7, ka_std) == decision_uncertain())      // 19
    s15_chk(classify_uniform_2mg(7) == decision_uncertain())                // 20

    // ── Section D: ke/F irrelevant at loaded SS (6 assertions) ───────────────
    // D_load=6, D_maint=2, N=14: ke÷4 and F÷4 unchanged

    s15_chk(classify_load_trough(6.0, 2.0, 14,
                                  0.01118, ke_std / 4.0, 0.05, k12_std,
                                  0.005, k21_std, 0.62, ka_std,
                                  0.141, f_std, 75.0)
            == classify_standard_load(14, ka_std))                           // 21 (ke÷4 same dec)
    s15_chk(conf_load_trough(6.0, 2.0, 14,
                              0.01118, ke_std / 4.0, 0.05, k12_std,
                              0.005, k21_std, 0.62, ka_std,
                              0.141, f_std, 75.0)
            == conf_standard_load(14, ka_std))                               // 22 (ke÷4 same conf)
    s15_chk(dom_load_trough(6.0, 2.0, 14,
                             0.01118, ke_std / 4.0, 0.05, k12_std,
                             0.005, k21_std, 0.62, ka_std,
                             0.141, f_std, 75.0)
            == dom_standard_load(14, ka_std))                                // 23 (ke÷4 dom=ka)
    s15_chk(conf_load_trough(6.0, 2.0, 14,
                              0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std,
                              0.005, k21_std, 0.62, ka_std,
                              0.141, f_std / 4.0, 75.0)
            == conf_standard_load(14, ka_std))                               // 24 (F÷4 same conf)
    s15_chk(classify_load_trough(6.0, 2.0, 14,
                                  0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std,
                                  0.005, k21_std, 0.62, ka_std,
                                  0.141, f_std / 4.0, 75.0)
            == decision_therapeutic())                                        // 25 (F÷4 still THERAPEUTIC)
    s15_chk(dom_load_trough(6.0, 2.0, 14,
                             0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std,
                             0.005, k21_std, 0.62, ka_std,
                             0.141, f_std / 4.0, 75.0)
            == 1)                                                             // 26 (F÷4 dom=ka)

    // ── Section E: ka÷16 → conf=950, dom=k12 (6 assertions) ─────────────────
    // Peak epistemic confidence in the oral rapamycin trilogy.

    s15_chk(conf_standard_load(14, ka_std / 16.0) == 950)                   // 27 (peak conf!)
    s15_chk(dom_standard_load(14, ka_std / 16.0) == 3)                      // 28 (k12 surfaces)
    s15_chk(dom_standard_load(14, ka_std / 16.0) != 1)                      // 29 (ka no longer #1)
    s15_chk(dom_standard_load(14, ka_std / 16.0) != 2)                      // 30 (NOT ke)
    // ka÷4 still has ka dominant (k12 hasn't surfaced yet)
    s15_chk(dom_standard_load(14, ka_std / 4.0) == 1)                       // 31 (ka still #1 at ÷4)
    // 950 is strictly higher than the previous best (900)
    s15_chk(conf_standard_load(14, ka_std / 16.0) > conf_standard_load(14, ka_std)) // 32

    // ── Section F: Gate functions (6 assertions) ──────────────────────────────

    s15_chk(load_rescues_therapeutic())  // 33 (loading makes N=14 THERAPEUTIC)
    s15_chk(load_ka_dominant())          // 34 (ka dom at N=14, std variances)
    s15_chk(load_ka16_optimal())         // 35 (ka÷16: conf=950, dom=k12)
    // ka÷4 at loaded SS: still THERAPEUTIC
    s15_chk(classify_standard_load(14, ka_std / 4.0) == decision_therapeutic()) // 36
    // ka÷2 at loaded SS: check THERAPEUTIC
    s15_chk(classify_standard_load(14, ka_std / 2.0) == decision_therapeutic()) // 37
    // Loading strictly better than uniform 2mg at N=14 (THERAPEUTIC vs UNCERTAIN)
    s15_chk(classify_standard_load(14, ka_std) != classify_uniform_2mg(14)) // 38

    // ── Section G: Confidence values (6 assertions) ────────────────────────────

    s15_chk(conf_standard_load(1, ka_std) == 700)                           // 39
    s15_chk(conf_standard_load(14, ka_std) == 900)                          // 40
    s15_chk(conf_standard_load(14, ka_std / 16.0) == 950)                   // 41
    // Confidence monotone: N=1 < N=14; ka÷16 > baseline
    s15_chk(conf_standard_load(14, ka_std) > conf_standard_load(1, ka_std)) // 42 (900 > 700)
    s15_chk(conf_standard_load(14, ka_std / 16.0) > conf_standard_load(14, ka_std)) // 43 (950 > 900)
    // ke÷4 no conf change
    s15_chk(conf_load_trough(6.0, 2.0, 14,
                              0.01118, ke_std / 4.0, 0.05, k12_std,
                              0.005, k21_std, 0.62, ka_std,
                              0.141, f_std, 75.0)
            == conf_standard_load(14, ka_std))                               // 44 (900==900)

    // ── Section H: 9mg+3mg higher-dose protocol (4 assertions) ───────────────
    // Reaches THERAPEUTIC at N=7 (faster onset than 6mg+2mg); dom=ka throughout

    s15_chk(classify_load_trough(9.0, 3.0, 7,
                                  0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std,
                                  0.005, k21_std, 0.62, ka_std,
                                  0.141, f_std, 75.0)
            == decision_therapeutic())                                        // 45 (9+3 N=7 THERAPEUTIC)
    s15_chk(classify_load_trough(9.0, 3.0, 14,
                                  0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std,
                                  0.005, k21_std, 0.62, ka_std,
                                  0.141, f_std, 75.0)
            == decision_therapeutic())                                        // 46 (9+3 N=14 THERAPEUTIC)
    s15_chk(dom_load_trough(9.0, 3.0, 14,
                             0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std,
                             0.005, k21_std, 0.62, ka_std,
                             0.141, f_std, 75.0)
            == 1)                                                             // 47 (9+3: ka dom)
    s15_chk(dom_load_trough(9.0, 3.0, 7,
                             0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std,
                             0.005, k21_std, 0.62, ka_std,
                             0.141, f_std, 75.0)
            == 1)                                                             // 48 (9+3 N=7: ka dom)

    // ── Section I: Decision sentinel values (4 assertions) ────────────────────

    s15_chk(decision_therapeutic() == 1)                       // 49
    s15_chk(decision_uncertain()   == 3)                       // 50
    s15_chk(conf_clinical_min()    == 800)                     // 51
    s15_chk(decision_uncertain() != decision_therapeutic())    // 52

    // ── Section J: Cross-checks wrapper vs direct (4 assertions) ─────────────

    s15_chk(classify_standard_load(14, ka_std) ==
            classify_load_trough(6.0, 2.0, 14,
                                  0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std,
                                  0.005, k21_std, 0.62, ka_std,
                                  0.141, f_std, 75.0))                       // 53
    s15_chk(classify_standard_load(1, ka_std) ==
            classify_load_trough(6.0, 2.0, 1,
                                  0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std,
                                  0.005, k21_std, 0.62, ka_std,
                                  0.141, f_std, 75.0))                       // 54
    s15_chk(conf_standard_load(14, ka_std) ==
            conf_load_trough(6.0, 2.0, 14,
                              0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std,
                              0.005, k21_std, 0.62, ka_std,
                              0.141, f_std, 75.0))                           // 55
    s15_chk(dom_standard_load(14, ka_std) ==
            dom_load_trough(6.0, 2.0, 14,
                             0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std,
                             0.005, k21_std, 0.62, ka_std,
                             0.141, f_std, 75.0))                            // 56
}

    run_sprint15_gate()
    if SPR15_PASS[1] == 0 {
        print("RELEASE GATE PASS\n")
    } else {
        print("GATE FAIL\n")
    }
    0
}

//@ run-pass

// stdlib/pbpk/rapamycin_sprint16_gate.sio — Sprint 16 IV bolus gate
//
// 56 assertions establishing that for IV bolus rapamycin (2-compartment model,
// no gut compartment), k12 (central→peripheral distribution rate) dominates the
// 24h trough uncertainty budget — NOT ke (elimination), which is the parameter
// most often targeted by clinicians.
//
// Standard scenario: D_iv=1.5mg bolus, dt=1h, n=24 steps (24h trough).
//   ke=0.01118 h⁻¹, k12=0.05, k21=0.005, Vc=75L
//   Variances: ke_var=8.41e-6, k12_var=1.56e-4, k21_var=1.6e-6
//   Results: dec=1 (THERAPEUTIC), conf=900, dom=1 (k12)
//
// Dissertation headline (Section F, assertions 33–36):
//   iv_k12_dominant() = true: k12 dominates at standard D=1.5mg.
//   iv_ke_irrelevant() = true: ke÷4 leaves all outputs unchanged.
//   iv_k12_tighten_fires() = true: k12÷4 → conf=950.
//   iv_ke_second_bottleneck() = true: k12÷25 → dom shifts to ke.
//
// Mechanistic unity of the delivery route atlas:
//   Stent (k21 dom): drug flows from peripheral depot to central — k21 governs.
//   IV bolus (k12 dom): drug deposited in central, distributes to peripheral.
//   Oral (ka dom): drug must first be absorbed through gut wall into central.
//   In every case, the dominant uncertainty source governs the primary flux.
//
// Why ke is irrelevant for IV: both ke and k12 terms scale as Var × A1².
//   k12_var / ke_var ≈ 18.5; this ratio is fixed and independent of dose.
//   ke÷64 still leaves conf=900 and dom=k12.
//
// Boundary UNCERTAIN at D=1.0mg: even with k12÷4 (conf=950), trough remains
//   UNCERTAIN because the CI straddles the 0.004 mg/L therapeutic floor.
//   This is a concentration problem, not a measurement problem — dose must
//   be raised, not measurement precision increased.
//
// Assertion map:
//   A (1–8):   Core: D=1.5mg, 24h → THERAPEUTIC/900/k12
//   B (9–14):  Dose matters: D=1.0mg UNCERTAIN, D=1.5mg+ THERAPEUTIC, dom=k12
//   C (15–20): ke irrelevant: ke÷4, ke÷64 → same dec/conf/dom as baseline
//   D (21–26): k12÷4 → conf=950; k12÷4 still therapeutic; dom stays k12
//   E (27–32): k12÷16 dom=k12; k12÷25 dom=ke (second bottleneck crossover)
//   F (33–38): Gate functions: k12 dominant, ke irrelevant, k12 fires, ke #2
//   G (39–44): Confidence values; ke extremes irrelevant; k12 improvement saturates
//   H (45–48): D=1.0mg boundary: k12÷4 → conf=950 but still UNCERTAIN
//   I (49–52): Decision sentinel values
//   J (53–56): Cross-checks wrapper vs direct

use pbpk::rapamycin_iv_bolus::{
    classify_standard_iv, conf_standard_iv, dom_standard_iv,
    classify_iv_trough, conf_iv_trough, dom_iv_trough,
    iv_ke_var_std, iv_k12_var_std, iv_k21_var_std,
    iv_k12_dominant, iv_ke_irrelevant, iv_k12_tighten_fires, iv_ke_second_bottleneck
}
use pbpk::rapamycin_clinical::{
    decision_therapeutic, decision_uncertain, conf_clinical_min

var SPR16_PASS: [i64; 2] = [0; 2]

fn s16_chk(cond: bool) with IO, Mut {
    if cond {
        SPR16_PASS[0] = SPR16_PASS[0] + 1
    } else {
        SPR16_PASS[1] = SPR16_PASS[1] + 1
        print("FAIL\n")
    }
}

fn run_sprint16_gate() with IO, Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ke_std  = iv_ke_var_std()    // 0.00000841
    let k12_std = iv_k12_var_std()   // 0.000156
    let k21_std = iv_k21_var_std()   // 0.0000016

    // ── Section A: Core D=1.5mg, 24h (8 assertions) ───────────────────────────
    // THERAPEUTIC, conf=900, dom=k12 (index 1 in {ke, k12, k21})

    s16_chk(classify_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std) == decision_therapeutic())  // 1
    s16_chk(classify_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std) != decision_uncertain())    // 2
    s16_chk(conf_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std) == 900)                         // 3
    s16_chk(conf_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std) >= conf_clinical_min())         // 4
    s16_chk(dom_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std) == 1)                            // 5 (k12)
    s16_chk(dom_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std) != 0)                            // 6 (not ke)
    s16_chk(dom_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std) != 2)                            // 7 (not k21)
    s16_chk(dom_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std) == 1)                            // 8 (k12 confirmed)

    // ── Section B: Dose matters (6 assertions) ─────────────────────────────────
    // D=1.0mg → UNCERTAIN (boundary); D=1.5mg → THERAPEUTIC; dom=k12 throughout

    s16_chk(classify_iv_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std,
                                0.005, k21_std, 1.0, 75.0, 24)
            == decision_uncertain())                                            // 9 (1.0mg UNCERTAIN)
    s16_chk(classify_iv_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std,
                                0.005, k21_std, 1.5, 75.0, 24)
            == decision_therapeutic())                                          // 10 (1.5mg THERAPEUTIC)
    s16_chk(classify_iv_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std,
                                0.005, k21_std, 2.0, 75.0, 24)
            == decision_therapeutic())                                          // 11 (2.0mg THERAPEUTIC)
    // dom=k12 at all tested doses
    s16_chk(dom_iv_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std,
                           0.005, k21_std, 1.0, 75.0, 24) == 1)               // 12 (k12 at 1.0mg)
    s16_chk(dom_iv_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std,
                           0.005, k21_std, 2.0, 75.0, 24) == 1)               // 13 (k12 at 2.0mg)
    s16_chk(dom_iv_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std,
                           0.005, k21_std, 5.0, 75.0, 24) == 1)               // 14 (k12 at 5.0mg)

    // ── Section C: ke irrelevant (6 assertions) ────────────────────────────────
    // ke÷4 and ke÷64 leave dec, conf, dom unchanged

    s16_chk(classify_standard_iv(ke_std / 4.0, k12_std) ==
            classify_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std))                             // 15 (ke÷4 same dec)
    s16_chk(conf_standard_iv(ke_std / 4.0, k12_std) ==
            conf_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std))                                 // 16 (ke÷4 same conf)
    s16_chk(dom_standard_iv(ke_std / 4.0, k12_std) ==
            dom_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std))                                  // 17 (ke÷4 dom=k12)
    // Even extreme ke÷64: still irrelevant
    s16_chk(conf_standard_iv(ke_std / 64.0, k12_std) ==
            conf_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std))                                 // 18 (ke÷64 same conf)
    s16_chk(dom_standard_iv(ke_std / 64.0, k12_std) ==
            dom_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std))                                  // 19 (ke÷64 dom=k12)
    s16_chk(classify_standard_iv(ke_std / 64.0, k12_std) ==
            classify_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std))                             // 20 (ke÷64 same dec)

    // ── Section D: k12÷4 → conf=950 (6 assertions) ────────────────────────────
    // Distributional rate improvement crosses the confidence ceiling.

    s16_chk(conf_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std / 4.0) == 950)                   // 21 (conf jumps)
    s16_chk(conf_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std / 4.0) >
            conf_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std))                                 // 22 (950 > 900)
    s16_chk(classify_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std / 4.0) == decision_therapeutic()) // 23 (still THERAPEUTIC)
    s16_chk(dom_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std / 4.0) == 1)                      // 24 (k12 still dom at ÷4)
    // k12÷4 better than ke÷4 (ke÷4 gives 900, k12÷4 gives 950)
    s16_chk(conf_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std / 4.0) >
            conf_standard_iv(ke_std / 4.0, k12_std))                          // 25 (950 > 900)
    // k12÷16 also gives conf=950 (saturates at ÷4)
    s16_chk(conf_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std / 16.0) == 950)                  // 26

    // ── Section E: k12÷16 dom=k12, k12÷25 dom=ke (6 assertions) ─────────────
    // The crossover: k12_var/25 ≈ 6.24e-6 < ke_var ≈ 8.41e-6.

    s16_chk(dom_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std / 16.0) == 1)                     // 27 (k12÷16: k12 still dom)
    s16_chk(dom_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std / 16.0) != 0)                     // 28 (not ke yet)
    s16_chk(dom_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std / 25.0) == 0)                     // 29 (k12÷25: ke surfaces!)
    s16_chk(dom_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std / 25.0) != 1)                     // 30 (k12 no longer #1)
    // Dom shifts monotonically: 1→0 as k12_var shrinks
    s16_chk(dom_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std / 25.0) !=
            dom_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std / 16.0))                          // 31 (0 ≠ 1)
    // At ÷4 k12 still dominant (crossover not yet reached)
    s16_chk(dom_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std / 4.0) == 1)                      // 32 (k12÷4: k12 still dom)

    // ── Section F: Gate functions (6 assertions) ──────────────────────────────

    s16_chk(iv_k12_dominant())          // 33 (k12 dom at std D=1.5mg)
    s16_chk(iv_ke_irrelevant())         // 34 (ke÷4 changes nothing)
    s16_chk(iv_k12_tighten_fires())     // 35 (k12÷4 → conf=950)
    s16_chk(iv_ke_second_bottleneck())  // 36 (k12÷25 → ke surfaces)
    // Baseline THERAPEUTIC, not UNCERTAIN
    s16_chk(classify_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std) == decision_therapeutic())  // 37
    // k12 dominance confirmed at ÷4 (dom unchanged by improvement)
    s16_chk(dom_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std / 4.0) == dom_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std)) // 38

    // ── Section G: Confidence values (6 assertions) ────────────────────────────

    s16_chk(conf_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std) == 900)                         // 39
    s16_chk(conf_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std / 4.0) == 950)                   // 40
    // ke÷4: no conf change
    s16_chk(conf_standard_iv(ke_std / 4.0, k12_std) ==
            conf_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std))                                 // 41 (900==900)
    // k12÷4 strictly better than baseline
    s16_chk(conf_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std / 4.0) >
            conf_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std))                                 // 42 (950 > 900)
    // k12÷4 and k12÷16 give same conf (saturates at 950)
    s16_chk(conf_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std / 4.0) ==
            conf_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std / 16.0))                         // 43 (950==950)
    // ke improvement adds nothing even on top of k12 improvement
    s16_chk(conf_standard_iv(ke_std / 4.0, k12_std / 4.0) ==
            conf_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std / 4.0))                          // 44 (950==950)

    // ── Section H: D=1.0mg boundary (4 assertions) ────────────────────────────
    // Trough straddles 0.004 mg/L; even conf=950 cannot save UNCERTAIN classification.

    s16_chk(classify_iv_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std,
                                0.005, k21_std, 1.0, 75.0, 24)
            == decision_uncertain())                                            // 45 (1.0mg UNCERTAIN)
    s16_chk(conf_iv_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std / 4.0,
                            0.005, k21_std, 1.0, 75.0, 24) == 950)            // 46 (k12÷4 gives conf=950)
    s16_chk(classify_iv_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std / 4.0,
                                0.005, k21_std, 1.0, 75.0, 24)
            == decision_uncertain())                                            // 47 (still UNCERTAIN at conf=950!)
    s16_chk(dom_iv_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std,
                           0.005, k21_std, 1.0, 75.0, 24) == 1)               // 48 (k12 dom at 1.0mg)

    // ── Section I: Decision sentinel values (4 assertions) ────────────────────

    s16_chk(decision_therapeutic() == 1)                       // 49
    s16_chk(decision_uncertain()   == 3)                       // 50
    s16_chk(conf_clinical_min()    == 800)                     // 51
    s16_chk(decision_uncertain() != decision_therapeutic())    // 52

    // ── Section J: Cross-checks wrapper vs direct (4 assertions) ─────────────

    s16_chk(classify_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std) ==
            classify_iv_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std,
                                0.005, k21_std, 1.5, 75.0, 24))               // 53
    s16_chk(classify_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std / 4.0) ==
            classify_iv_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std / 4.0,
                                0.005, k21_std, 1.5, 75.0, 24))               // 54
    s16_chk(conf_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std) ==
            conf_iv_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std,
                            0.005, k21_std, 1.5, 75.0, 24))                   // 55
    s16_chk(dom_standard_iv(ke_std, k12_std) ==
            dom_iv_trough(0.01118, ke_std, 0.05, k12_std,
                           0.005, k21_std, 1.5, 75.0, 24))                    // 56
}

    run_sprint16_gate()
    if SPR16_PASS[1] == 0 {
        print("RELEASE GATE PASS\n")
    } else {
        print("GATE FAIL\n")
    }
    0
}
