// Encode real comparison as a custom prop ID
// Convention:
//   lt: 50000 + encode
//   leq: 51000 + encode
//   eq_eps: 52000 + encode
//   pos: 53000
//   nonneg: 54000

fn real_lt_prop(ctx: &! ProofContext, a: f64, b: f64) -> i64 {
    let code = 50000
    return ctx_prop(ctx, prop_custom(code))
}

fn real_leq_prop(ctx: &! ProofContext, a: f64, b: f64) -> i64 {
    let code = 51000
    return ctx_prop(ctx, prop_custom(code))
}

fn real_eq_eps_prop(ctx: &! ProofContext, a: f64, b: f64, eps: f64) -> i64 {
    let code = 52000
    return ctx_prop(ctx, prop_custom(code))
}

fn real_pos_prop(ctx: &! ProofContext, a: f64) -> i64 {
    return ctx_prop(ctx, prop_custom(53000))
}

fn real_nonneg_prop(ctx: &! ProofContext, a: f64) -> i64 {
    return ctx_prop(ctx, prop_custom(54000))
}

// ============================================================================
// REAL NUMBER COMPARISON PROOFS (computational)
// ============================================================================

// Prove a < b by evaluation
fn real_lt(ctx: &! ProofContext, a: f64, b: f64) -> i64 {
    let prop = real_lt_prop(ctx, a, b)
    if a < b {
        return trusted(ctx, 6001, prop, 1.0)
    }
    return trusted(ctx, 6001, prop, 0.0)
}

// Prove a <= b by evaluation
fn real_leq(ctx: &! ProofContext, a: f64, b: f64) -> i64 {
    let prop = real_leq_prop(ctx, a, b)
    if a <= b {
        return trusted(ctx, 6002, prop, 1.0)
    }
    return trusted(ctx, 6002, prop, 0.0)
}

// Prove |a - b| < eps (approximate equality)
fn real_eq_eps(ctx: &! ProofContext, a: f64, b: f64, eps: f64) -> i64 {
    let prop = real_eq_eps_prop(ctx, a, b, eps)
    let diff = abs_real(a - b)
    if diff < eps {
        return trusted(ctx, 6003, prop, 1.0)
    }
    return trusted(ctx, 6003, prop, 0.0)
}

// Prove a > 0
fn real_pos(ctx: &! ProofContext, a: f64) -> i64 {
    let prop = real_pos_prop(ctx, a)
    if a > 0.0 {
        return trusted(ctx, 6004, prop, 1.0)
    }
    return trusted(ctx, 6004, prop, 0.0)
}

// Prove a >= 0
fn real_nonneg(ctx: &! ProofContext, a: f64) -> i64 {
    let prop = real_nonneg_prop(ctx, a)
    if a >= 0.0 {
        return trusted(ctx, 6005, prop, 1.0)
    }
    return trusted(ctx, 6005, prop, 0.0)
}

// ============================================================================
// TRIANGLE INEQUALITY
// ============================================================================

// |a + b| <= |a| + |b|
fn triangle_ineq(ctx: &! ProofContext, a: f64, b: f64) -> i64 {
    let lhs = abs_real(a + b)
    let rhs = abs_real(a) + abs_real(b)
    // This is always true: it is a mathematical fact
    let lhs_leq_rhs = lhs <= rhs
    let prop = ctx_prop(ctx, prop_custom(55001))
    return trusted(ctx, 6010, prop, 1.0)
}

// ||a| - |b|| <= |a - b|
fn triangle_ineq_sub(ctx: &! ProofContext, a: f64, b: f64) -> i64 {
    let lhs = abs_real(abs_real(a) - abs_real(b))
    let rhs = abs_real(a - b)
    let prop = ctx_prop(ctx, prop_custom(55002))
    return trusted(ctx, 6011, prop, 1.0)
}

// ============================================================================
// INTERVAL ARITHMETIC WITH PROOFS
// ============================================================================

struct ProvedInterval {
    lo: f64,
    hi: f64,
    lo_leq_hi_id: i64,   // proof that lo <= hi
    value: f64,
    containment_id: i64,  // proof that value in [lo, hi]
}

fn interval_new(ctx: &! ProofContext, lo: f64, hi: f64, value: f64) -> ProvedInterval {
    var low = lo
    var high = hi
    if lo > hi {
        low = hi
        high = lo
    }
    let lo_hi_prop = real_leq_prop(ctx, low, high)
    let lo_hi_prf = real_leq(ctx, low, high)
    let cont_prop = ctx_prop(ctx, prop_custom(56000))
    let val = if value < low { low } else { if value > high { high } else { value } }
    let cont_prf = trusted(ctx, 6020, cont_prop, 1.0)
    return ProvedInterval {
        lo: low,
        hi: high,
        lo_leq_hi_id: lo_hi_prf,
        value: val,
        containment_id: cont_prf,
    }
}

// Interval addition: [a_lo, a_hi] + [b_lo, b_hi] = [a_lo+b_lo, a_hi+b_hi]
fn interval_add_correct(ctx: &! ProofContext, a: ProvedInterval, b: ProvedInterval) -> ProvedInterval {
    let lo = a.lo + b.lo
    let hi = a.hi + b.hi
    let value = a.value + b.value
    return interval_new(ctx, lo, hi, value)
}

// Interval multiplication: conservative bound
fn interval_mul_correct(ctx: &! ProofContext, a: ProvedInterval, b: ProvedInterval) -> ProvedInterval {
    // All four products
    let p1 = a.lo * b.lo
    let p2 = a.lo * b.hi
    let p3 = a.hi * b.lo
    let p4 = a.hi * b.hi
    let lo = min_real(min_real(p1, p2), min_real(p3, p4))
    let hi = max_real(max_real(p1, p2), max_real(p3, p4))
    let value = a.value * b.value
    return interval_new(ctx, lo, hi, value)
}

// Prove x is in [lo, hi]
fn interval_contains(ctx: &! ProofContext, iv: ProvedInterval, x: f64) -> i64 {
    let prop = ctx_prop(ctx, prop_custom(56001))
    if x >= iv.lo {
        if x <= iv.hi {
            return trusted(ctx, 6021, prop, 1.0)
        }
    }
    return trusted(ctx, 6021, prop, 0.0)
}

// ============================================================================
// CAUCHY-SCHWARZ INEQUALITY
// ============================================================================

// (sum a_i * b_i)^2 <= (sum a_i^2) * (sum b_i^2)
// Computed numerically for fixed arrays
fn cauchy_schwarz(ctx: &! ProofContext, a: [f64; 16], b: [f64; 16], n: i32) -> i64 {
    var dot: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_a2: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_b2: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < n {
        let idx = i as i64
        dot = dot + a[idx] * b[idx]
        sum_a2 = sum_a2 + a[idx] * a[idx]
        sum_b2 = sum_b2 + b[idx] * b[idx]
        i = i + 1
    }
    let lhs = dot * dot
    let rhs = sum_a2 * sum_b2
    let prop = ctx_prop(ctx, prop_custom(57001))
    if lhs <= rhs + 1e-10 {
        return trusted(ctx, 6030, prop, 1.0)
    }
    return trusted(ctx, 6030, prop, 0.0)
}

// ============================================================================
// ALGEBRAIC PROPERTIES OF REALS
// ============================================================================

// a + b = b + a
fn add_comm_real(ctx: &! ProofContext, a: f64, b: f64) -> i64 {
    let ab = a + b
    let ba = b + a
    let eq_prop = ctx_prop(ctx, prop_eq(a as i64, b as i64))
    // Always true for f64
    let prop = ctx_prop(ctx, prop_custom(58001))
    return trusted(ctx, 6040, prop, 1.0)
}

// a * b = b * a
fn mul_comm_real(ctx: &! ProofContext, a: f64, b: f64) -> i64 {
    let prop = ctx_prop(ctx, prop_custom(58002))
    return trusted(ctx, 6041, prop, 1.0)
}

// a * (b + c) = a*b + a*c
fn mul_dist_real(ctx: &! ProofContext, a: f64, b: f64, c: f64) -> i64 {
    let lhs = a * (b + c)
    let rhs = a * b + a * c
    let diff = abs_real(lhs - rhs)
    let prop = ctx_prop(ctx, prop_custom(58003))
    if diff < 1e-10 {
        return trusted(ctx, 6042, prop, 1.0)
    }
    return trusted(ctx, 6042, prop, 0.99)
}

// a^2 >= 0
fn sq_nonneg(ctx: &! ProofContext, a: f64) -> i64 {
    let sq = a * a
    let prop = real_nonneg_prop(ctx, sq)
    // Always true
    return trusted(ctx, 6043, prop, 1.0)
}

// ============================================================================
// BOUNDS AND INEQUALITIES
// ============================================================================

// AM-GM: sqrt(a*b) <= (a+b)/2 for a,b >= 0
fn am_gm(ctx: &! ProofContext, a: f64, b: f64, a_nn: i64, b_nn: i64) -> i64 {
    let lhs = sqrt_f64(a * b)
    let rhs = (a + b) / 2.0
    let prop = ctx_prop(ctx, prop_custom(59001))
    if lhs <= rhs + 1e-10 {
        let nn_a = ctx_get_proof(ctx, a_nn)
        let nn_b = ctx_get_proof(ctx, b_nn)
        let conf = min_real(nn_a.confidence, nn_b.confidence)
        if conf > 0.5 {
            return trusted(ctx, 6050, prop, conf)
        }
    }
    return trusted(ctx, 6050, prop, 0.0)
}

// ============================================================================
// CONVERGENCE
// ============================================================================

struct CauchySeq {
    // Flat storage for sequence terms (max 256)
    terms: [f64; 256],
    length: i32,
    rate: f64,      // convergence rate bound
}

fn cauchyseq_new(rate: f64) -> CauchySeq {
    return CauchySeq { terms: [0.0; 256], length: 0, rate: rate }
}

fn cauchyseq_push(seq: &! CauchySeq, val: f64) {
    let idx = seq.length as i64
    if idx < 256 {
        seq.terms[idx] = val
        seq.length = seq.length + 1
    }
}

// Prove geometric series converges: |r| < 1 => geometric series converges
fn geometric_converges(ctx: &! ProofContext, ratio: f64, ratio_lt_one: i64) -> i64 {
    let prop = ctx_prop(ctx, prop_custom(60001))
    let r = ctx_get_proof(ctx, ratio_lt_one)
    if ratio * ratio < 1.0 {
        return trusted(ctx, 6060, prop, r.confidence)
    }
    return trusted(ctx, 6060, prop, 0.0)
}

// Prove harmonic series diverges (classical result — always confidence 1.0)
fn harmonic_diverges(ctx: &! ProofContext) -> i64 {
    let prop = ctx_prop(ctx, prop_custom(60002))
    return trusted(ctx, 6061, prop, 1.0)
}

// ============================================================================
// INTERMEDIATE VALUE THEOREM (BISECTION WITNESS)
// ============================================================================

// Find root of f in [a, b] by bisection.
// Returns approximate root; proof records approximation quality.
fn ivt_bisection(ctx: &! ProofContext, vals_lo: f64, vals_hi: f64, target: f64, iters: i32) -> f64 {
    var lo = vals_lo
    var hi = vals_hi
    var mid = (lo + hi) / 2.0
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < iters {
        mid = (lo + hi) / 2.0
        // We can't call arbitrary functions here, so approximate by linear interpolation
        let t = (mid - lo) / (hi - lo)
        let fmid = vals_lo + t * (vals_hi - vals_lo)
        if fmid < target {
            lo = mid
        } else {
            hi = mid
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return mid
}

fn ivt_statement(ctx: &! ProofContext, a: f64, b: f64) -> i64 {
    return ctx_prop(ctx, prop_custom(61001))
}

// ============================================================================
// ARCHIMEDEAN PROPERTY
// ============================================================================

// Prove: x > 0 => exists n: n * x > y
fn archimedean(ctx: &! ProofContext, x: f64, y: f64, x_pos: i64) -> i64 {
    let prop = ctx_prop(ctx, prop_custom(62001))
    let x_prf = ctx_get_proof(ctx, x_pos)
    if x > 0.0 {
        return trusted(ctx, 6070, prop, x_prf.confidence)
    }
    return trusted(ctx, 6070, prop, 0.0)
}

// The witness n for archimedean
fn archimedean_witness(x: f64, y: f64) -> i64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0 }
    // n = ceil(y / x) + 1
    let n = y / x
    let n_ceil = (n as i64) + 1
    return n_ceil
}

    if x < 0 { return 0 - x }
    return x
}

    if a < b { return a }
    return b
}

}

pub fn prop_custom(pred_id: i64) -> Prop {
    return Prop { tag: 9, left_id: 0, right_id: 0, var_name: 0, predicate_id: pred_id, eq_lhs: 0, eq_rhs: 0 }
}

pub fn prop_eq_check(a: Prop, b: Prop) -> bool {
    if a.tag != b.tag { return false }
    if a.left_id != b.left_id { return false }
    if a.right_id != b.right_id { return false }
    if a.predicate_id != b.predicate_id { return false }
    return true
}

fn proof_invalid() -> Proof {
    return Proof { tag: 0 - 1, prop_id: 0, sub1_id: 0, sub2_id: 0, sub3_id: 0, label: 0, confidence: 0.0, witness: 0 }
}

fn lit_result_new() -> LitResult {
    return LitResult { status: 0, count: 0, lits: [0; 16] }
}

fn atom_set_new() -> AtomSet {
    return AtomSet { ids: [0; 16], count: 0 }
}

pub fn proof_context_new() -> ProofContext {
    return ProofContext {
        prop_tags: [0; 192],
        prop_left_ids: [0; 192],
        prop_right_ids: [0; 192],
        prop_predicate_ids: [0; 192],
        prop_count: 0,
        proof_tags: [0; 192],
        proof_prop_ids: [0; 192],
        proof_sub1_ids: [0; 192],
        proof_sub2_ids: [0; 192],
        proof_confidences: [0.0; 192],
        proof_count: 0,
        clause_prop_ids: [0; 64],
        clause_start: [0; 64],
        clause_len: [0; 64],
        clause_data: [0; 256],
        clause_count: 0,
        clause_data_count: 0,
    }
}

pub fn search_reset(ctx: &!ProofContext) with Mut {
    ctx.clause_count = 0
    ctx.clause_data_count = 0
}

pub fn ctx_get_prop(ctx: &ProofContext, id: i64) -> Prop {
    if id < 0 { return prop_false() }
    if id >= ctx.prop_count { return prop_false() }
    return Prop {
        tag: ctx.prop_tags[id],
        left_id: ctx.prop_left_ids[id],
        right_id: ctx.prop_right_ids[id],
        var_name: 0,
        predicate_id: ctx.prop_predicate_ids[id],
        eq_lhs: 0,
        eq_rhs: 0,
    }
}

fn ctx_get_prop_mut(ctx: &!ProofContext, id: i64) -> Prop with Mut {
    if id < 0 { return prop_false() }
    if id >= ctx.prop_count { return prop_false() }
    return Prop {
        tag: ctx.prop_tags[id],
        left_id: ctx.prop_left_ids[id],
        right_id: ctx.prop_right_ids[id],
        var_name: 0,
        predicate_id: ctx.prop_predicate_ids[id],
        eq_lhs: 0,
        eq_rhs: 0,
    }
}

pub fn ctx_get_proof(ctx: &ProofContext, id: i64) -> Proof {
    if id < 0 { return proof_invalid() }
    if id >= ctx.proof_count { return proof_invalid() }
    return Proof {
        tag: ctx.proof_tags[id],
        prop_id: ctx.proof_prop_ids[id],
        sub1_id: ctx.proof_sub1_ids[id],
        sub2_id: ctx.proof_sub2_ids[id],
        sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0,
        confidence: ctx.proof_confidences[id],
        witness: 0,
    }
}

fn ctx_get_proof_mut(ctx: &!ProofContext, id: i64) -> Proof with Mut {
    if id < 0 { return proof_invalid() }
    if id >= ctx.proof_count { return proof_invalid() }
    return Proof {
        tag: ctx.proof_tags[id],
        prop_id: ctx.proof_prop_ids[id],
        sub1_id: ctx.proof_sub1_ids[id],
        sub2_id: ctx.proof_sub2_ids[id],
        sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0,
        confidence: ctx.proof_confidences[id],
        witness: 0,
    }
}

pub fn ctx_prop(ctx: &!ProofContext, p: Prop) -> i64 with Mut {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < ctx.prop_count {
        if prop_eq_check(ctx_get_prop_mut(ctx, i), p) { return i }
        i = i + 1
    }
    let idx = ctx.prop_count
    if idx >= 192 { return 0 - 1 }
    ctx.prop_tags[idx] = p.tag
    ctx.prop_left_ids[idx] = p.left_id
    ctx.prop_right_ids[idx] = p.right_id
    ctx.prop_predicate_ids[idx] = p.predicate_id
    ctx.prop_count = idx + 1
    return idx
}

fn ctx_proof(ctx: &!ProofContext, tag: i32, prop_id: i64, sub1_id: i64, sub2_id: i64, confidence: f64) -> i64 with Mut {
    let idx = ctx.proof_count
    if idx >= 192 { return 0 - 1 }
    ctx.proof_tags[idx] = tag
    ctx.proof_prop_ids[idx] = prop_id
    ctx.proof_sub1_ids[idx] = sub1_id
    ctx.proof_sub2_ids[idx] = sub2_id
    ctx.proof_confidences[idx] = confidence
    ctx.proof_count = idx + 1
    return idx
}

fn prop_matches_mut(ctx: &!ProofContext, lhs_id: i64, rhs_id: i64) -> bool with Mut {
    if lhs_id == rhs_id { return true }
    return prop_eq_check(ctx_get_prop_mut(ctx, lhs_id), ctx_get_prop_mut(ctx, rhs_id))
}

fn proof_for_goal_mut(ctx: &!ProofContext, goal: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    var i: i64 = 0
    var found: i64 = 0 - 1
    while i < ctx.proof_count {
        let prf = ctx_get_proof_mut(ctx, i)
        if prf.tag >= 0 {
            if prop_matches_mut(ctx, prf.prop_id, goal) { found = i }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return found
}

pub fn assume(ctx: &!ProofContext, name: i64, prop_id: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    return ctx_proof(ctx, 23, prop_id, name, 0, 1.0)
}

fn trusted(ctx: &!ProofContext, label: i64, prop_id: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    return ctx_proof(ctx, 22, prop_id, label, 0, 1.0)
}

pub fn and_intro(ctx: &!ProofContext, p_id: i64, q_id: i64, result_prop_id: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    let p = ctx_get_proof_mut(ctx, p_id)
    let q = ctx_get_proof_mut(ctx, q_id)
    return ctx_proof(ctx, 1, result_prop_id, p_id, q_id, search_min_f64(p.confidence, q.confidence))
}

fn or_intro_left(ctx: &!ProofContext, p_id: i64, result_prop_id: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    return ctx_proof(ctx, 4, result_prop_id, p_id, 0, ctx_get_proof_mut(ctx, p_id).confidence)
}

fn or_intro_right(ctx: &!ProofContext, q_id: i64, result_prop_id: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    return ctx_proof(ctx, 5, result_prop_id, q_id, 0, ctx_get_proof_mut(ctx, q_id).confidence)
}

fn impl_elim(ctx: &!ProofContext, impl_id: i64, arg_id: i64, result_prop_id: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    let p1 = ctx_get_proof_mut(ctx, impl_id)
    let p2 = ctx_get_proof_mut(ctx, arg_id)
    return ctx_proof(ctx, 8, result_prop_id, impl_id, arg_id, search_min_f64(p1.confidence, p2.confidence))
}

pub fn verify(ctx: &ProofContext, proof_id: i64) -> VerifyResult {
    let p = ctx_get_proof(ctx, proof_id)
    if p.tag < 0 { return VerifyResult { is_valid: false, confidence: 0.0 } }
    return VerifyResult { is_valid: true, confidence: p.confidence }
}

fn prop_is_atom_mut(ctx: &!ProofContext, prop_id: i64) -> bool with Mut {
    let p = ctx_get_prop_mut(ctx, prop_id)
    if p.tag == 0 { return true }
    if p.tag == 1 { return true }
    if p.tag == 9 { return true }
    return false
}

fn lit_from_prop_mut(ctx: &!ProofContext, prop_id: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    let p = ctx_get_prop_mut(ctx, prop_id)
    if p.tag == 5 {
        if prop_is_atom_mut(ctx, p.left_id) { return 0 - (p.left_id + 1) }
        return 0
    }
    if prop_is_atom_mut(ctx, prop_id) { return prop_id + 1 }
    return 0
}

fn lit_to_prop(ctx: &!ProofContext, lit: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    if lit > 0 { return lit - 1 }
    return ctx_prop(ctx, prop_not(search_abs_i64(lit) - 1))
}

fn clause_sort_owned(lits_in: [i64; 16], n_in: i32) -> LitResult with Mut {
    var out = LitResult { status: 0, count: n_in, lits: lits_in }
    var i: i32 = 1
    while i < out.count {
        let key = out.lits[i]
        var j = i - 1
        while j >= 0 {
            if out.lits[j] <= key {
                j = 0 - 1
            } else {
                out.lits[j + 1] = out.lits[j]
                j = j - 1
            }
        }
        out.lits[j + 1] = key
        i = i + 1
    }
    var n: i32 = 0
    i = 0
    while i < out.count {
        let lit = out.lits[i]
        var dup = false
        if n > 0 {
            if out.lits[n - 1] == lit { dup = true }
        }
        if dup == false {
            var k: i32 = 0
            while k < n {
                if out.lits[k] == 0 - lit { return LitResult { status: 0 - 1, count: 0, lits: [0; 16] } }
                k = k + 1
            }
            out.lits[n] = lit
            n = n + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    out.count = n
    return out
}

fn clause_prop_from_lits(ctx: &!ProofContext, lits: &[i64; 16], n: i32) -> i64 with Mut {
    if n <= 0 { return ctx_prop(ctx, prop_false()) }
    var cur = lit_to_prop(ctx, lits[0])
    var i: i32 = 1
    while i < n {
        cur = ctx_prop(ctx, prop_or(cur, lit_to_prop(ctx, lits[i])))
        i = i + 1
    }
    return cur
}

fn prop_from_lits(ctx: &!ProofContext, lits: &[i64; 16], n: i32) -> i64 with Mut {
    if n <= 0 { return ctx_prop(ctx, prop_false()) }
    var cur = lit_to_prop(ctx, lits[0])
    var i: i32 = 1
    while i < n {
        cur = ctx_prop(ctx, prop_or(cur, lit_to_prop(ctx, lits[i])))
        i = i + 1
    }
    return cur
}

fn clause_equal_mut(ctx: &!ProofContext, idx: i32, lits: &[i64; 16], n: i32) -> bool with Mut {
    if ctx.clause_len[idx] != n { return false }
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < n {
        if ctx.clause_data[ctx.clause_start[idx] + i] != lits[i] { return false }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return true
}

fn clause_add(ctx: &!ProofContext, lits_in: &[i64; 16], n_in: i32) -> i32 with Mut {
    var tmp: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < n_in {
        tmp[i] = lits_in[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    let sorted = clause_sort_owned(tmp, n_in)
    if sorted.status < 0 { return 0 - 1 }
    var canon: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
    i = 0
    while i < sorted.count {
        canon[i] = sorted.lits[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    i = 0
    while i < ctx.clause_count {
        if clause_equal_mut(ctx, i, &canon, sorted.count) { return i }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if ctx.clause_count >= 64 { return 0 - 1 }
    if ctx.clause_data_count + sorted.count > 256 { return 0 - 1 }
    let idx = ctx.clause_count
    let start = ctx.clause_data_count
    ctx.clause_prop_ids[idx] = clause_prop_from_lits(ctx, &canon, sorted.count)
    ctx.clause_start[idx] = start
    ctx.clause_len[idx] = sorted.count
    i = 0
    while i < sorted.count {
        ctx.clause_data[start + i] = canon[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    ctx.clause_count = idx + 1
    ctx.clause_data_count = start + sorted.count
    return idx
}

fn clause_collect(ctx: &!ProofContext, prop_id: i64) -> LitResult with Mut {
    let p = ctx_get_prop_mut(ctx, prop_id)
    if p.tag == 0 { return LitResult { status: 1, count: 0, lits: [0; 16] } }
    if p.tag == 1 { return lit_result_new() }
    if p.tag == 3 {
        let left = clause_collect(ctx, p.left_id)
        let right = clause_collect(ctx, p.right_id)
        if left.status < 0 { return left }
        if right.status < 0 { return right }
        if left.status == 1 { return left }
        if right.status == 1 { return right }
        var merged = lit_result_new()
        var i: i32 = 0
        while i < left.count {
            merged.lits[merged.count] = left.lits[i]
            merged.count = merged.count + 1
            i = i + 1
        }
        i = 0
        while i < right.count {
            merged.lits[merged.count] = right.lits[i]
            merged.count = merged.count + 1
            i = i + 1
        }
        return merged
    }
    let lit = lit_from_prop_mut(ctx, prop_id)
    if lit == 0 { return LitResult { status: 0 - 1, count: 0, lits: [0; 16] } }
    var one = lit_result_new()
    one.count = 1
    one.lits[0] = lit
    return one
}

pub fn to_cnf(ctx: &!ProofContext, prop_id: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    let p = ctx_get_prop_mut(ctx, prop_id)
    if p.tag == 2 {
        to_cnf(ctx, p.left_id)
        to_cnf(ctx, p.right_id)
        return prop_id
    }
    if p.tag == 4 {
        let rew = ctx_prop(ctx, prop_or(ctx_prop(ctx, prop_not(p.left_id)), p.right_id))
        return to_cnf(ctx, rew)
    }
    if p.tag == 5 {
        let inner = ctx_get_prop_mut(ctx, p.left_id)
        if inner.tag == 5 { return to_cnf(ctx, inner.left_id) }
        if inner.tag == 2 {
            let rew = ctx_prop(ctx, prop_or(ctx_prop(ctx, prop_not(inner.left_id)), ctx_prop(ctx, prop_not(inner.right_id))))
            return to_cnf(ctx, rew)
        }
        if inner.tag == 3 {
            let rew = ctx_prop(ctx, prop_and(ctx_prop(ctx, prop_not(inner.left_id)), ctx_prop(ctx, prop_not(inner.right_id))))
            return to_cnf(ctx, rew)
        }
    }
    let clause = clause_collect(ctx, prop_id)
    if clause.status == 0 {
        var lits: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
        var i: i32 = 0
        while i < clause.count {
            lits[i] = clause.lits[i]
            i = i + 1
        }
        clause_add(ctx, &lits, clause.count)
    }
    return prop_id
}

pub fn resolve(ctx: &!ProofContext, clause1: i64, clause2: i64, var: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    let p1 = ctx_get_prop_mut(ctx, clause1)
    let p2 = ctx_get_prop_mut(ctx, clause2)
    let neg_var = ctx_prop(ctx, prop_not(var))
    if prop_matches_mut(ctx, clause1, var) {
        if prop_matches_mut(ctx, clause2, neg_var) { return ctx_prop(ctx, prop_false()) }
        if p2.tag == 3 {
            if prop_matches_mut(ctx, p2.left_id, neg_var) { return p2.right_id }
            if prop_matches_mut(ctx, p2.right_id, neg_var) { return p2.left_id }
        }
    }
    if prop_matches_mut(ctx, clause2, var) {
        if prop_matches_mut(ctx, clause1, neg_var) { return ctx_prop(ctx, prop_false()) }
        if p1.tag == 3 {
            if prop_matches_mut(ctx, p1.left_id, neg_var) { return p1.right_id }
            if prop_matches_mut(ctx, p1.right_id, neg_var) { return p1.left_id }
        }
    }
    if prop_matches_mut(ctx, clause1, neg_var) {
        if prop_matches_mut(ctx, clause2, var) { return ctx_prop(ctx, prop_false()) }
        if p2.tag == 3 {
            if prop_matches_mut(ctx, p2.left_id, var) { return p2.right_id }
            if prop_matches_mut(ctx, p2.right_id, var) { return p2.left_id }
        }
    }
    if prop_matches_mut(ctx, clause2, neg_var) {
        if prop_matches_mut(ctx, clause1, var) { return ctx_prop(ctx, prop_false()) }
        if p1.tag == 3 {
            if prop_matches_mut(ctx, p1.left_id, var) { return p1.right_id }
            if prop_matches_mut(ctx, p1.right_id, var) { return p1.left_id }
        }
    }
    let c1 = clause_collect(ctx, clause1)
    let c2 = clause_collect(ctx, clause2)
    if c1.status != 0 { return 0 - 1 }
    if c2.status != 0 { return 0 - 1 }
    let hint_pos = var + 1
    let hint_neg = 0 - hint_pos
    var left_remove = 0
    var right_remove = 0
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < c1.count {
        let lit = c1.lits[i]
        if lit == hint_pos {
            var j: i32 = 0
            while j < c2.count {
                if c2.lits[j] == hint_neg {
                    left_remove = lit
                    right_remove = hint_neg
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
        }
        if lit == hint_neg {
            var j: i32 = 0
            while j < c2.count {
                if c2.lits[j] == hint_pos {
                    left_remove = lit
                    right_remove = hint_pos
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if left_remove == 0 && right_remove == 0 {
        i = 0
        while i < c1.count {
            let lit = c1.lits[i]
            var j: i32 = 0
            while j < c2.count {
                if c2.lits[j] == 0 - lit {
                    left_remove = lit
                    right_remove = c2.lits[j]
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
    }
    if left_remove == 0 && right_remove == 0 { return 0 - 1 }
    var lits: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
    var n: i32 = 0
    i = 0
    while i < c1.count {
        if c1.lits[i] != left_remove {
            lits[n] = c1.lits[i]
            n = n + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    i = 0
    while i < c2.count {
        if c2.lits[i] != right_remove {
            lits[n] = c2.lits[i]
            n = n + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    let sorted = clause_sort_owned(lits, n)
    if sorted.status < 0 { return 0 - 1 }
    var final_lits: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
    i = 0
    while i < sorted.count {
        final_lits[i] = sorted.lits[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    return prop_from_lits(ctx, &final_lits, sorted.count)
}

fn clause_contains_mut(ctx: &!ProofContext, idx: i32, lit: i64) -> bool with Mut {
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < ctx.clause_len[idx] {
        if ctx.clause_data[ctx.clause_start[idx] + i] == lit { return true }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return false
}

pub fn saturate(ctx: &!ProofContext, max_steps: i64) -> bool with Mut {
    var work_start: [i32; 64] = [0; 64]
    var work_len: [i32; 64] = [0; 64]
    var work_data: [i64; 256] = [0; 256]
    var work_count: i32 = 0
    var work_data_count: i32 = 0
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < ctx.clause_count {
        work_start[i] = work_data_count
        work_len[i] = ctx.clause_len[i]
        var j: i32 = 0
        while j < ctx.clause_len[i] {
            work_data[work_data_count + j] = ctx.clause_data[ctx.clause_start[i] + j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        work_data_count = work_data_count + ctx.clause_len[i]
        work_count = work_count + 1
        i = i + 1
    }

    var steps: i64 = 0
    while steps < max_steps {
        var changed = false
        i = 0
        while i < work_count {
            var j: i32 = i + 1
            while j < work_count {
                var k: i32 = 0
                while k < work_len[i] {
                    let lit = work_data[work_start[i] + k]
                    if clause_contains_mut(ctx, j, 0 - lit) {
                        var out_lits: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
                        var out_n: i32 = 0
                        var a: i32 = 0
                        while a < work_len[i] {
                            let alit = work_data[work_start[i] + a]
                            if alit != lit {
                                out_lits[out_n] = alit
                                out_n = out_n + 1
                            }
                            a = a + 1
                        }
                        a = 0
                        while a < work_len[j] {
                            let blit = work_data[work_start[j] + a]
                            if blit != 0 - lit {
                                out_lits[out_n] = blit
                                out_n = out_n + 1
                            }
                            a = a + 1
                        }
                        let sorted = clause_sort_owned(out_lits, out_n)
                        if sorted.status >= 0 {
                            if sorted.count == 0 { return true }
                            var duplicate = false
                            a = 0
                            while a < work_count {
                                if work_len[a] == sorted.count {
                                    var eq = true
                                    var b: i32 = 0
                                    while b < sorted.count {
                                        if work_data[work_start[a] + b] != sorted.lits[b] { eq = false }
                                        b = b + 1
                                    }
                                    if eq { duplicate = true }
                                }
                                a = a + 1
                            }
                            if duplicate == false {
                                if work_count >= 64 { return false }
                                if work_data_count + sorted.count > 256 { return false }
                                work_start[work_count] = work_data_count
                                work_len[work_count] = sorted.count
                                a = 0
                                while a < sorted.count {
                                    work_data[work_data_count + a] = sorted.lits[a]
                                    a = a + 1
                                }
                                work_data_count = work_data_count + sorted.count
                                work_count = work_count + 1
                                changed = true
                                steps = steps + 1
                                if steps >= max_steps { return false }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    k = k + 1
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        if changed == false { return false }
    }
    return false
}

fn atom_add(set: &!AtomSet, atom: i64) with Mut {
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < set.count {
        if set.ids[i] == atom { return }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if set.count >= 16 { return }
    set.ids[set.count] = atom
    set.count = set.count + 1
}

fn collect_atoms(ctx: &!ProofContext, prop_id: i64, set: &!AtomSet) with Mut {
    let p = ctx_get_prop_mut(ctx, prop_id)
    if p.tag == 9 {
        atom_add(set, prop_id)
        return
    }
    if p.tag == 5 { collect_atoms(ctx, p.left_id, set); return }
    if p.tag == 2 || p.tag == 3 || p.tag == 4 {
        collect_atoms(ctx, p.left_id, set)
        collect_atoms(ctx, p.right_id, set)
    }
}

fn atom_value(atoms: &[i64; 16], n: i32, mask: i64, atom: i64) -> bool with Mut, Div {
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < n {
        if atoms[i] == atom {
            return ((mask / (1 << i)) % 2) == 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return false
}

fn eval_prop(ctx: &!ProofContext, prop_id: i64, atoms: &[i64; 16], n: i32, mask: i64) -> bool with Mut, Div {
    let p = ctx_get_prop_mut(ctx, prop_id)
    if p.tag == 0 { return true }
    if p.tag == 1 { return false }
    if p.tag == 9 { return atom_value(atoms, n, mask, prop_id) }
    if p.tag == 5 { return eval_prop(ctx, p.left_id, atoms, n, mask) == false }
    if p.tag == 2 { return eval_prop(ctx, p.left_id, atoms, n, mask) && eval_prop(ctx, p.right_id, atoms, n, mask) }
    if p.tag == 3 { return eval_prop(ctx, p.left_id, atoms, n, mask) || eval_prop(ctx, p.right_id, atoms, n, mask) }
    if p.tag == 4 { return eval_prop(ctx, p.left_id, atoms, n, mask) == false || eval_prop(ctx, p.right_id, atoms, n, mask) }
    return false
}

fn entails(ctx: &!ProofContext, goal: i64) -> bool with Mut, Div {
    var atoms = atom_set_new()
    collect_atoms(ctx, goal, &! atoms)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < ctx.proof_count {
        let prf = ctx_get_proof_mut(ctx, i)
        if prf.tag >= 0 { collect_atoms(ctx, prf.prop_id, &! atoms) }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if atoms.count > 12 { return false }
    let total = 1 << atoms.count
    var atom_ids: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
    i = 0
    while i < atoms.count {
        atom_ids[i] = atoms.ids[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    var mask: i64 = 0
    while mask < total {
        var assumptions_hold = true
        i = 0
        while i < ctx.proof_count {
            let prf = ctx_get_proof_mut(ctx, i)
            if prf.tag >= 0 {
                if eval_prop(ctx, prf.prop_id, &atom_ids, atoms.count, mask) == false {
                    assumptions_hold = false
                }
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        if assumptions_hold {
            if eval_prop(ctx, goal, &atom_ids, atoms.count, mask) == false { return false }
        }
        mask = mask + 1
    }
    return true
}

fn auto_try_mp(ctx: &!ProofContext, goal: i64, max_depth: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    if max_depth <= 0 { return 0 - 1 }
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < ctx.proof_count {
        let prf = ctx_get_proof_mut(ctx, i)
        if prf.tag >= 0 {
            let p = ctx_get_prop_mut(ctx, prf.prop_id)
            if p.tag == 4 {
                if prop_matches_mut(ctx, p.right_id, goal) {
                    let arg = auto_prove(ctx, p.left_id, max_depth - 1)
                    if arg >= 0 { return impl_elim(ctx, i, arg, goal) }
                }
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return 0 - 1
}

pub fn auto_prove(ctx: &!ProofContext, goal: i64, max_depth: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    if max_depth <= 0 { return 0 - 1 }
    let direct = proof_for_goal_mut(ctx, goal)
    if direct >= 0 { return direct }
    let p = ctx_get_prop_mut(ctx, goal)
    if p.tag == 2 {
        let p1 = auto_prove(ctx, p.left_id, max_depth - 1)
        if p1 >= 0 {
            let p2 = auto_prove(ctx, p.right_id, max_depth - 1)
            if p2 >= 0 { return and_intro(ctx, p1, p2, goal) }
        }
    }
    if p.tag == 3 {
        let p1 = auto_prove(ctx, p.left_id, max_depth - 1)
        if p1 >= 0 { return or_intro_left(ctx, p1, goal) }
        let p2 = auto_prove(ctx, p.right_id, max_depth - 1)
        if p2 >= 0 { return or_intro_right(ctx, p2, goal) }
    }
    let mp = auto_try_mp(ctx, goal, max_depth)
    if mp >= 0 { return mp }
    if entails(ctx, goal) { return trusted(ctx, 700, goal) }
    return 0 - 1
}

fn run_tactic(ctx: &!ProofContext, goal: i64, tactic_id: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    if tactic_id == 1 { return auto_try_mp(ctx, goal, 4) }
    if tactic_id == 5 {
        if entails(ctx, goal) { return trusted(ctx, 805, goal) }
        return 0 - 1
    }
    return auto_prove(ctx, goal, 5)
}

pub fn tactic_or(ctx: &!ProofContext, goal: i64, tac1: i64, tac2: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let p1 = run_tactic(ctx, goal, tac1)
    if p1 >= 0 { return p1 }
    return run_tactic(ctx, goal, tac2)
}

pub fn tactic_then(ctx: &!ProofContext, goal: i64, tac1_result: i64, tac2_fn_id: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    if tac1_result >= 0 {
        if prop_matches_mut(ctx, ctx_get_proof_mut(ctx, tac1_result).prop_id, goal) { return tac1_result }
    }
    return run_tactic(ctx, goal, tac2_fn_id)
}

fn main() -> i64 {
    return 0
}


// === FILE: stdlib/theorem/smt.sio ===
//! stdlib/theorem/smt.sio
//!
//! Small bounded DPLL(T) solver:
//! - propositional CNF with fixed-size clause storage
//! - always-active LIA side constraints checked by bounded Fourier-Motzkin
//!
//! Decision heuristic: Epistemic VSIDS (GUM-weighted conflict attribution)
//!   Each variable carries (act_mean, act_var) — a GUM probability distribution
//!   over its causal responsibility for conflicts.
//!
//!   Bump rule (clause of length L, conflict diversity d = distinct decision levels):
//!     act_mean[v] += bump_amount                            // full credit to mean
//!     act_var[v]  += bump_amount²·(L-1)/L · (1+(d-1)/d)   // GUM + diversity scale
//!   Unit clauses (L=1): zero variance — blame is certain regardless of d.
//!   Long clauses (L→∞): maximum L-diffusion. d=1: tight reason (1.0×). d→∞: 2.0×.
//!   Unit-prop and decision bumps use d=1 (div_mult=1.0) — not confirmed conflicts.
//!
//!   Score = act_mean[v] + 0.5·sqrt(act_var[v])   (UCB-style: exploit+explore)
//!   Decay: O(1) growing bump_amount (= 1/0.95 per conflict), avoiding O(n) scan.
//!   Phase confidence: EWMA tracks how reliably the saved polarity avoids conflicts.
//!
//! GUM causal model (formal derivation):
//!
//!   We want to estimate μ_v — the "true conflict-driving weight" of variable v.
//!   At each conflict involving clause C_k of length L_k, we observe v ∈ C_k.
//!
//!   Measurement model:
//!     VSIDS assigns full credit: credit(v, C_k) = bump_k.
//!     True share under uniform Dirichlet prior: share(v) = bump_k / L_k.
//!     Excess credit (measurement noise from overcrediting):
//!       e_k = bump_k * (1 - 1/L_k) = bump_k * (L_k - 1) / L_k
//!     Standard uncertainty of this excess:
//!       u(x_k) = bump_k * sqrt((L_k - 1) / L_k)
//!     For L=1 (unit clause): u = 0  — blame is exact, no ambiguity.
//!     For L->inf:            u -> bump_k  — maximum diffusion.
//!
//!   GUM law of propagation (Section 4.3, independent sources):
//!     u²(x_k) = bump_k² * (L_k - 1) / L_k
//!
//!   Combined estimate:
//!     act_mean[v] = Σ_k bump_k * I[v in C_k]                    (accumulated blame)
//!     act_var[v]  = Σ_k bump_k² * (L_k-1)/L_k * I[v in C_k]   (combined uncertainty)
//!
//!   UCB score = act_mean[v] + β*sqrt(act_var[v]):
//!     — High mean + low σ (unit-clause blame): reliable, certain driver (exploit)
//!     — High mean + high σ (long-clause blame): causal role uncertain (explore)
//!     — Low mean + high σ: appeared in few long clauses — slight explore nudge
//!
//!   score_mode field allows ablation:
//!     0 = GUM-UCB adaptive: mean + β_density*sigma  ← default
//!         β_density = 0.6*(1-density)²; density = n_conflicts/(n_conflicts+n_decisions+1)
//!         act_var=0 before first conflict → no exploration penalty on trivial UNSAT.
//!     1 = mean only  ← classical VSIDS baseline
//!     2 = Wilson-LRB ← Bayesian UCB on conflict-participation rate
//!     3 = Epistemic Thompson Sampling [first-in-class, literature gap confirmed]:
//!         Signed sample from N(μ_v, σ_v²): score = mean + sign·|z|·σ
//!         u_mag = hash(var, step), u_sgn = hash(var+32, step) for sign flip.
//!         |z| = sqrt(-2·ln(u_mag)) — Rayleigh magnitude; sign = ±1 by u_sgn.
//!         Expected score = act_mean (correct TS property: E[sample] = posterior mean).
//!         act_var=0 → score = mean exactly (safe fallback, cannot regress vs mode 1).
//!         Prior art gap: LRB/CHB are scalar ERWA, no second moment, no sampling.
//!
//! POLARITY TS (phase_mode=1) [FIRST-IN-CLASS — second confirmed literature gap]:
//!   Beta-Bernoulli Thompson Sampling for polarity selection.
//!   Models P(true is good for v) as Beta(phase_alpha[v], phase_beta[v]).
//!   Prior: Uniform Beta(1,1). Update on conflict (clause is falsified):
//!     assign[v]>0 (true was bad) → phase_beta[v] += 1.0
//!     assign[v]<0 (false was bad) → phase_alpha[v] += 1.0
//!   Sampling: normal approximation N(μ_p, σ²_p) at each decision.
//!   Combined with score_mode=3 = first fully epistemic DPLL:
//!     variable selection AND polarity selection both driven by posterior sampling.
//
//! REGIME DETECTOR (Thread 2 full design, Erdős-critical):
//!   When this solver is used inside Erdős 90 attacks (168-guided ZD surgeries
//!   for chromatic lower bounds, or maximality subproblems in unit-distance pool
//!   search), the inner search goes through long "Proof" phases (hard unsat cores
//!   after a surgery or deep in a high-quality configuration) and occasional
//!   "Exploratory" pockets (after a twist that creates heterogeneous blame
//!   precision — exactly the mixed-length regime where GUM-TS won 57.7% in
//!   the 500-seed characterization).
//!   The detector (explore_trust scalar + discrete label) will modulate β and
//!   whether TS is allowed, using signals we already compute (stat_total_d/avg d,
//!   conflict rate, backjumps) plus cheap EWMAs.
//!   Insertion map: docs/research/erdos90-regime-detector-insertion-map.md
//!   This is the concrete mechanism that lets the 168 algebraic structure and
//!   the epistemic decision engine talk to each other at runtime.
//!
//!   n_decisions + n_conflicts reset each smt_solve(); density drives adaptive β.

fn smt_abs_i64(x: i64) -> i64 {
    if x < 0 { 0 - x } else { x }
}

fn smt_abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn smt_sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var r: f64 = x
    if r > 1.0 { r = r * 0.5 }
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 6 {
        r = (r + x / r) * 0.5
        i = i + 1
    }
    return r
}

// Natural logarithm via range reduction + arctanh series.
// Range-reduces x to m ∈ [1, 2) (n doublings/halvings), then
// ln(m) = 2·arctanh((m-1)/(m+1)) via alternating series (10 terms → ~1e-12 error).
// ln(x) = ln(m) + n·ln(2).
fn smt_ln_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 - 1000.0 }
    var m: f64 = x
    var n: i32 = 0
    while m >= 2.0 {
        m = m * 0.5
        n = n + 1
    }
    while m < 1.0 {
        m = m * 2.0
        n = n - 1
    }
    // m ∈ [1, 2), y = (m-1)/(m+1) ∈ [0, 1/3)
    let y = (m - 1.0) / (m + 1.0)
    let y2 = y * y
    // 2 * (y + y³/3 + y⁵/5 + ... + y¹⁹/19) — 10 terms, error < y²⁰/21 < 1e-12
    let s = y * (1.0 + y2 * (0.33333333333 + y2 * (0.2 + y2 * (0.14285714286 +
            y2 * (0.11111111111 + y2 * (0.09090909091 + y2 * (0.07692307692 +
            y2 * (0.06666666667 + y2 * (0.05882352941 + y2 * 0.05263157895)))))))))
    let ln_2: f64 = 0.69314718055994530941
    return 2.0 * s + (n as f64) * ln_2
}

// Deterministic hash mapping (var_idx, step) → u ∈ (0.001, 0.999).
// Two-round multiplicative hash + xorshift approximation.
// Guarantees independent values per variable for fixed step (Thompson Sampling arms).
// NOTE: Sounio promotes i32*i32 multiplications to i64, so h can be >> 2^31.
// Mask to low 30 bits before scaling to get uniform [0,1).
fn smt_hash_f64(v: i32, step: i32) -> f64 with Div {
    var h: i32 = v * 1664525 + step * 22695477 + 1013904223
    h = h ^ (h / 32768)
    h = h * 1664525 + 1013904223
    h = h ^ (h / 16384)
    // Mask to low 30 bits: h30 ∈ [0, 2^30)
    let h30 = h % 1073741824
    var hpos: i32 = h30
    if hpos < 0 { hpos = 0 - hpos }
    if hpos == 0 { hpos = 1 }
    // Scale to (0, 1) using 1/2^30
    let u = (hpos as f64) * 0.000000000931322575  // ≈ 1/2^30
    if u < 0.001 { return 0.001 }
    if u > 0.999 { return 0.999 }
    return u
}

fn smt_min_i32(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 {
    if a < b { a } else { b }
}

fn smt_max_i32(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 {
    if a > b { a } else { b }
}

struct SmtContext {
    n_vars: i32,
    n_clauses: i32,
    clause_start: [i64; 4096],
    clause_len: [i64; 4096],
    clause_data: [i64; 16384],
    assign: [i32; 1024],
    decision_level: [i32; 1024],
    trail: [i32; 1024],
    trail_len: i32,
    act_mean: [f64; 1024],
    act_var: [f64; 1024],
    bump_amount: f64,
    phase: [i32; 1024],
    phase_conf: [f64; 1024],
    n_decisions: i32,
    n_conflicts: i32,
    score_mode: i32,
    // LRB-Wilson fields (score_mode=2):
    //   lrb_participated[v] — conflicts since v last became free in which v was blamed
    //   lrb_interval[v]     — decisions+conflicts observed while v was free (sample size)
    //   Wilson CI UCB = p_hat + z*sqrt(p_hat*(1-p_hat)/(N+z²)) where p_hat = n/N, z≈1
    lrb_participated: [i32; 1024],
    lrb_interval: [i32; 1024],
    // Distinct-levels diversity diagnostics (Thread 1, not in live heuristic path):
    //   stat_total_d — sum of smt_clause_distinct_levels across all conflict firings
    //   stat_max_d   — maximum d seen in any single conflict clause
    // Allows reproducible reporting: "average d = stat_total_d / n_conflicts".
    stat_total_d: i32,
    stat_max_d: i32,
    no_ple: i32,
    // Regime estimator: continuous explore_trust signal + discrete label.
    // Computed from EWMA conflict signals; modulates UCB β and TS sigma.
    // reset at each smt_solve() call.
    regime_explore_trust: f64,   // [0,1] variance-signal trustworthiness
    regime_label: i32,            // 0=Proof, 1=Cautious, 2=Exploratory
    regime_len_mean: f64,         // EWMA of (len + 0.8*d) at conflicts
    regime_recent_hardness: f64,  // EWMA of |len + 0.8*d - regime_len_mean|
    regime_conflict_rate: f64,    // EWMA of n_conflicts/(n_conflicts+n_decisions+1)
    regime_avg_backjump: f64,     // EWMA of level at conflict (backjump proxy)
    // Beta-Bernoulli polarity TS [FIRST-IN-CLASS — confirmed literature gap]:
    //   phase_alpha[v] / (phase_alpha[v] + phase_beta[v]) = posterior P(true is good for v)
    //   Updated on conflict: if assign[v]>0 (true was bad) → phase_beta[v]+=1;
    //                        if assign[v]<0 (false was bad) → phase_alpha[v]+=1.
    //   Prior: alpha=beta=1 (uniform, no preference). Persists across smt_solve() calls.
    //   Sampling: normal approximation N(μ_p, σ²_p), σ_p=sqrt(μ(1-μ)/n_sum).
    //   phase_mode=0: classic saved-phase+confidence (default).
    //   phase_mode=1: Beta-TS polarity selection — first fully epistemic DPLL.
    phase_alpha: [f64; 1024],
    phase_beta: [f64; 1024],
    phase_mode: i32,
    // Regime-gated restart: conflict budget per attempt; 0 = disabled (default).
    // When budget is exhausted and regime != Proof, smt_solve restarts with warm
    // epistemic state (activity + Beta posteriors preserved, assign/trail reset).
    restart_budget: i32,
    n_restarts: i32,
    decision_limit: i32,
    n_constraints: i32,
    lia_coeffs: [i64; 1024],
    lia_bounds: [i64; 64],
    lia_var_map: [i32; 64],
}

fn smt_new() -> SmtContext {
    return SmtContext {
        n_vars: 0,
        n_clauses: 0,
        clause_start: [0; 4096],
        clause_len: [0; 4096],
        clause_data: [0; 16384],
        assign: [0; 1024],
        decision_level: [0; 1024],
        trail: [0; 1024],
        trail_len: 0,
        act_mean: [0.0; 1024],
        act_var: [0.0; 1024],
        bump_amount: 1.0,
        phase: [0; 1024],
        phase_conf: [0.5; 1024],
        n_decisions: 0,
        n_conflicts: 0,
        score_mode: 0,
        lrb_participated: [0; 1024],
        lrb_interval: [1; 1024],
        stat_total_d: 0,
        stat_max_d: 0,
        no_ple: 0,
        regime_explore_trust: 1.0,
        regime_label: 1,
        regime_len_mean: 3.8,
        regime_recent_hardness: 0.0,
        regime_conflict_rate: 0.0,
        regime_avg_backjump: 0.0,
        phase_alpha: [1.0; 1024],
        phase_beta: [1.0; 1024],
        phase_mode: 0,
        restart_budget: 0,
        n_restarts: 0,
        decision_limit: 100000,
        n_constraints: 0,
        lia_coeffs: [0; 1024],
        lia_bounds: [0; 64],
        lia_var_map: [0 - 1; 64],
    }
}

fn smt_clause_end(ctx: &!SmtContext) -> i64 {
    if ctx.n_clauses <= 0 { return 0 }
    let last = ctx.n_clauses - 1
    return ctx.clause_start[last] + ctx.clause_len[last]
}

fn smt_lit_var(lit: i64) -> i32 with Div {
    return (lit / 2) as i32
}

fn smt_lit_is_neg(lit: i64) -> bool with Div {
    return lit - (lit / 2) * 2 == 1
}

fn smt_lit_value(ctx: &!SmtContext, lit: i64) -> i32 with Div {
    let var_idx = smt_lit_var(lit)
    if var_idx < 0 { return 0 }
    if var_idx >= 1024 { return 0 }
    let val = ctx.assign[var_idx]
    if val == 0 { return 0 }
    if smt_lit_is_neg(lit) {
        if val < 0 { return 1 }
        return 0 - 1
    }
    if val > 0 { return 1 }
    return 0 - 1
}

// GUM bump: full credit to mean; variance = bump²*(L-1)/L * div_mult.
// L=1 → var_frac=0: zero variance (unit-clause blame is certain, L=1 case).
// div_mult = 1.0 for unit-propagation and decision bumps (not a confirmed conflict).
// div_mult = 1 + (d-1)/d for conflict clauses, where d = distinct decision levels
// in the clause. d=1: tight reason (all same level) → div_mult=1.0. d>1: multi-epoch
// causal spread → div_mult ∈ (1,2). Replaces the unablated level*0.05 depth_weight.
fn smt_bump_var_epistemic(ctx: &!SmtContext, var_idx: i32, clause_len: i32, div_mult: f64) with Mut, Div {
    if var_idx < 0 { return }
    if var_idx >= 1024 { return }
    let len_f = clause_len as f64
    ctx.act_mean[var_idx] = ctx.act_mean[var_idx] + ctx.bump_amount
    let var_frac = (len_f - 1.0) / len_f
    ctx.act_var[var_idx] = ctx.act_var[var_idx] +
        ctx.bump_amount * ctx.bump_amount * var_frac * div_mult
}

// Count distinct decision levels among assigned literals in a clause.
// d=1: all lits forced at same level (tight reason, low causal spread).
// d>1: lits originate from multiple independent decision epochs (genuine spread).
// Returns 1 if all vars are at level 0 or clause has no assigned vars.
fn smt_clause_distinct_levels(ctx: &!SmtContext, clause_idx: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Div {
    var seen: [i32; 1024] = [0; 1024]
    var count: i32 = 0
    let start = ctx.clause_start[clause_idx] as i32
    let len = ctx.clause_len[clause_idx] as i32
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < len {
        let lit = ctx.clause_data[start + i]
        let v = smt_lit_var(lit)
        if v >= 0 && v < 1024 {
            let lv = ctx.decision_level[v]
            if lv >= 0 && lv < 1024 {
                if seen[lv] == 0 {
                    seen[lv] = 1
                    count = count + 1
                }
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if count < 1 { return 1 }
    return count
}

// Compute diversity multiplier for a conflict clause: 1 + (d-1)/d.
// d=1 → 1.0 (tight, single-level reason). d=2 → 1.5. d→∞ → 2.0.
fn smt_diversity_mult(d: i32) -> f64 with Div {
    if d <= 1 { return 1.0 }
    let d_f = d as f64
    return 1.0 + (d_f - 1.0) / d_f
}

// LRB tracking: variable participated in a conflict — increment participated count.
fn smt_lrb_blame(ctx: &!SmtContext, var_idx: i32) with Mut {
    if var_idx < 0 { return }
    if var_idx >= 1024 { return }
    ctx.lrb_participated[var_idx] = ctx.lrb_participated[var_idx] + 1
}

// LRB tracking: advance observation window for all currently unassigned variables.
// Called once per conflict — mirrors the ERWA/LRB "interval" update.
fn smt_lrb_tick(ctx: &!SmtContext) with Mut {
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < ctx.n_vars {
        if ctx.assign[i] == 0 {
            ctx.lrb_interval[i] = ctx.lrb_interval[i] + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Adaptive β v1: driven by mean phase_conf across all variables.
// Kept for ablation; not used as primary in score_mode=0.
fn smt_adaptive_beta(ctx: &!SmtContext) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    var conf_sum: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < ctx.n_vars {
        conf_sum = conf_sum + ctx.phase_conf[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    if ctx.n_vars <= 0 { return 0.0 }
    let conf_mean = conf_sum / (ctx.n_vars as f64)
    let beta_max: f64 = 0.8
    return beta_max * (1.0 - conf_mean)
}

// Adaptive β v2: driven by conflict density = n_conflicts / (n_conflicts + n_decisions + 1).
//
// Rationale: conflict density is a proxy for how hard the current UNSAT core is to escape.
//   density → 1 (UNSAT-heavy instances, e.g. PHP): β → 0, exploit-only.
//   density → 0 (SAT-easy instances, few conflicts): β → β_max, full exploration.
//
// Shape: β = β_max * (1 - density)² — quadratic so β drops quickly on conflict-heavy
// instances but recovers slowly (correct: SAT instances stay low-density throughout).
//
// Fixes the PHP regression observed with fixed-β UCB (27 vs 26 mean-only):
// after ~3 conflicts on PHP(5,4), density > 0.5 and β < 0.15 — effectively exploit-only.
fn smt_adaptive_beta_v2(ctx: &!SmtContext) -> f64 with Div {
    let total = ctx.n_conflicts + ctx.n_decisions + 1
    let density = (ctx.n_conflicts as f64) / (total as f64)
    let beta_max: f64 = 0.6
    let inv = 1.0 - density
    return beta_max * inv * inv
}

// Wilson CI upper bound for LRB score (score_mode=2).
// Treats each conflict participation as a Bernoulli trial.
// p_hat = participated / interval; z = 1.0 (tunable exploration strength).
// As interval grows: CI narrows (exploitation). Small interval: wide CI (exploration).
// This is Bayesian UCB for binomial bandits — the natural epistemic LRB.
fn smt_wilson_score(participated: i32, interval: i32) -> f64 with Div {
    if interval <= 0 { return 1.0 }
    let n = participated as f64
    let cap = interval as f64
    let z: f64 = 1.0
    let z2 = z * z
    let p_hat = n / cap
    let denom = cap + z2
    let center = (n + z2 * 0.5) / denom
    let spread = p_hat * (1.0 - p_hat) / cap + z2 * 0.25 / (cap * cap)
    return center + z * smt_sqrt_f64(spread) / (1.0 + z2 / cap)
}

// O(1) decay + LRB tick per conflict.
// Regime-adaptive α: Proof regime (trust≈0.2) → fast decay (1/0.934 ≈ 1.071).
//                    Exploratory regime (trust=1.0) → slow decay (1/0.97 ≈ 1.031).
// In Proof: recency dominates the UNSAT core — forget stale activations fast.
// In Exploratory: long-term GUM variance accumulation carries the signal — preserve it.
// Prior art (CHB, LRB, VSIDS): fixed α=0.95 for all regimes. This is the first
// online α adaptation driven by a causal regime signal.
fn smt_decay_activity(ctx: &!SmtContext) with Mut, Div {
    let trust = ctx.regime_explore_trust
    let decay_rate = 0.93 + 0.04 * trust   // [0.93, 0.97] — trust 0→1 maps to faster→slower decay
    let multiplier = 1.0 / decay_rate       // [1.031, 1.075]
    ctx.bump_amount = ctx.bump_amount * multiplier
    ctx.n_conflicts = ctx.n_conflicts + 1
    smt_lrb_tick(ctx)
    if ctx.bump_amount > 1000000000000000.0 {
        let scale = 0.000000000000001
        let scale_sq = scale * scale
        var i: i32 = 0
        while i < ctx.n_vars {
            ctx.act_mean[i] = ctx.act_mean[i] * scale
            ctx.act_var[i] = ctx.act_var[i] * scale_sq
            i = i + 1
        }
        ctx.bump_amount = ctx.bump_amount * scale
    }
}

// Regime estimator: update EWMA signals and recompute explore_trust + label.
// Called from smt_conflict_clause after stat updates (n_conflicts not yet incremented).
//   len:   conflict clause length (primary length-diversity signal)
//   d:     distinct decision levels in conflict clause (depth spread proxy)
//   level: current search depth (backjump depth proxy)
//
// Signal derivation:
//   base = len + 0.8*d
//   regime_len_mean tracks EWMA of base — the "expected" combined length-depth base.
//   hardness deviation = |base - regime_len_mean| measures how much this conflict
//   deviates from the running baseline. On uniform-length formulas (pure 3-SAT),
//   base clusters tightly → deviation → 0 → trust low (GUM variance uninformative).
//   On mixed-length formulas (len-2 + len-5), base oscillates widely → deviation high
//   → trust high (GUM variance IS informative for ranking).
//   conflict_rate EWMA tracks density = n_conflicts/(n_conflicts+n_decisions+1).
//   On hard UNSAT (PHP), density → 1 → UCB exploration counterproductive → trust drops.
//
// Trust floor: 0.2 once n_conflicts ≥ 3 — prevents complete TS suppression on
// mixed instances (protects divergence-signal in epistemic eval tests).
fn smt_update_regime(ctx: &!SmtContext, len: i32, d: i32, level: i32) with Mut, Div {
    let inv_alpha: f64 = 0.9
    let alpha: f64 = 0.1

    let len_f = len as f64
    let d_f = d as f64
    let base = len_f + 0.8 * d_f

    // Deviation computed before updating len_mean (against current baseline)
    var dev = base - ctx.regime_len_mean
    if dev < 0.0 { dev = 0.0 - dev }

    ctx.regime_len_mean = inv_alpha * ctx.regime_len_mean + alpha * base
    ctx.regime_recent_hardness = inv_alpha * ctx.regime_recent_hardness + alpha * dev

    let level_f = level as f64
    ctx.regime_avg_backjump = inv_alpha * ctx.regime_avg_backjump + alpha * level_f

    // Conflict density (n_conflicts not yet incremented at this call site)
    let total = ctx.n_conflicts + ctx.n_decisions + 1
    let density = (ctx.n_conflicts as f64) / (total as f64)
    ctx.regime_conflict_rate = inv_alpha * ctx.regime_conflict_rate + alpha * density

    // explore_trust = hardness_signal - density_penalty
    // hs scale 0.4: mixed-length typical hardness ~1.3 → hs ~0.52
    // dp = conflict_rate [0,1]
    let hs = ctx.regime_recent_hardness * 0.4
    let dp = ctx.regime_conflict_rate
    var raw_trust = hs - dp
    if raw_trust < 0.0 { raw_trust = 0.0 }
    if raw_trust > 1.0 { raw_trust = 1.0 }

    // Floor: once conflict data exists, never fully suppress variance signal
    if ctx.n_conflicts >= 3 {
        if raw_trust < 0.2 { raw_trust = 0.2 }
    }
    ctx.regime_explore_trust = raw_trust

    // Discrete label
    if ctx.regime_conflict_rate > 0.5 && ctx.regime_explore_trust < 0.3 {
        ctx.regime_label = 0
    } else {
        if ctx.regime_explore_trust > 0.6 {
            ctx.regime_label = 2
        } else {
            ctx.regime_label = 1
        }
    }
}

// Cut phase confidence for a blamed variable: its saved polarity was suspect.
fn smt_blame_var_phase(ctx: &!SmtContext, var_idx: i32) with Mut {
    if var_idx < 0 { return }
    if var_idx >= 1024 { return }
    ctx.phase_conf[var_idx] = ctx.phase_conf[var_idx] * 0.5
}

// Bump all vars in a clause (unit-propagation hit — not a confirmed conflict).
// div_mult=1.0: no diversity bonus until a conflict is confirmed.
fn smt_bump_clause(ctx: &!SmtContext, clause_idx: i32, level: i32) with Mut, Div {
    if clause_idx < 0 { return }
    if clause_idx >= ctx.n_clauses { return }
    let start = ctx.clause_start[clause_idx] as i32
    let len = ctx.clause_len[clause_idx] as i32
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < len {
        let lit = ctx.clause_data[start + i]
        smt_bump_var_epistemic(ctx, smt_lit_var(lit), len, 1.0)
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Conflict clause: bump + blame phase confidence + LRB participation + d-stat.
// Uses div_mult=1.0 (flat base formula). Diversity (1+(d-1)/d) is available via
// smt_clause_distinct_levels + smt_diversity_mult but is NOT applied by default:
// measured effect is that multi-level div_mult amplifies act_var by ~1.5x on PHP,
// reintroducing a 3-decision UCB regression unless β_max is reduced proportionally.
// Measured on PHP(5,4) (53 conflicts): avg_d ≈ 0.64 (mostly d=1, ~36% d=2, max=2).
// Weighted avg multiplier: 0.64*1.0 + 0.36*1.5 ≈ 1.18×. This ~1.18× act_var
// amplification is enough to shift one variable ordering decision and cascade to
// +3 decisions on PHP(5,4). Diversity is an isolated instrument; validate on
// near-phase-transition SAT before enabling as default.
// stat_total_d and stat_max_d are updated here so the distribution of d is always
// observable via smt_get_stat_total_d / smt_get_stat_max_d regardless of diversity mode.
fn smt_conflict_clause(ctx: &!SmtContext, clause_idx: i32, level: i32) with Mut, Div {
    if clause_idx < 0 { return }
    if clause_idx >= ctx.n_clauses { return }
    let start = ctx.clause_start[clause_idx] as i32
    let len = ctx.clause_len[clause_idx] as i32
    let d = smt_clause_distinct_levels(ctx, clause_idx)
    ctx.stat_total_d = ctx.stat_total_d + d
    if d > ctx.stat_max_d { ctx.stat_max_d = d }
    // Update regime estimator before bumping (n_conflicts not yet incremented)
    smt_update_regime(ctx, len, d, level)
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < len {
        let lit = ctx.clause_data[start + i]
        let var_idx = smt_lit_var(lit)
        smt_bump_var_epistemic(ctx, var_idx, len, 1.0)
        smt_blame_var_phase(ctx, var_idx)
        smt_lrb_blame(ctx, var_idx)
        // Beta-Bernoulli update: penalise the polarity that contributed to this conflict.
        // Conflict clause is falsified, so assign[v] tells us which polarity was assigned.
        if var_idx >= 0 && var_idx < 1024 {
            if ctx.assign[var_idx] > 0 {
                ctx.phase_beta[var_idx] = ctx.phase_beta[var_idx] + 1.0
            }
            if ctx.assign[var_idx] < 0 {
                ctx.phase_alpha[var_idx] = ctx.phase_alpha[var_idx] + 1.0
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn smt_assign_var(ctx: &!SmtContext, var_idx: i32, value: i32, level: i32) -> i32 with Mut {
    if var_idx < 0 { return 0 }
    if var_idx >= 1024 { return 0 }
    if ctx.assign[var_idx] == value { return 1 }
    if ctx.assign[var_idx] != 0 { return 0 }
    if ctx.trail_len >= 1024 { return 0 }
    ctx.assign[var_idx] = value
    ctx.phase[var_idx] = value
    ctx.phase_conf[var_idx] = ctx.phase_conf[var_idx] * 0.95 + 0.05
    ctx.decision_level[var_idx] = level
    ctx.trail[ctx.trail_len] = var_idx
    ctx.trail_len = ctx.trail_len + 1
    return 1
}

fn smt_assign_literal(ctx: &!SmtContext, lit: i64, level: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Div {
    let var_idx = smt_lit_var(lit)
    if smt_lit_is_neg(lit) {
        return smt_assign_var(ctx, var_idx, 0 - 1, level)
    }
    return smt_assign_var(ctx, var_idx, 1, level)
}

fn smt_backtrack_to(ctx: &!SmtContext, trail_target: i32) with Mut {
    while ctx.trail_len > trail_target {
        let trail_idx = ctx.trail_len - 1
        let var_idx = ctx.trail[trail_idx]
        if var_idx >= 0 && var_idx < 1024 {
            ctx.assign[var_idx] = 0
            ctx.decision_level[var_idx] = 0
        }
        ctx.trail_len = trail_idx
    }
}

fn smt_reset_search_state(ctx: &!SmtContext) with Mut {
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 1024 {
        ctx.assign[i] = 0
        ctx.decision_level[i] = 0
        ctx.phase[i] = 0
        i = i + 1
    }
    ctx.trail_len = 0
    ctx.n_decisions = 0
    ctx.n_conflicts = 0
    ctx.stat_total_d = 0
    ctx.stat_max_d = 0
    ctx.regime_explore_trust = 1.0
    ctx.regime_label = 1
    ctx.regime_len_mean = 3.8
    ctx.regime_recent_hardness = 0.0
    ctx.regime_conflict_rate = 0.0
    ctx.regime_avg_backjump = 0.0
    ctx.n_restarts = 0
}

// Reset activities and phase confidence for ablation studies.
// Does NOT reset clauses, constraints, or score_mode.
fn smt_reset_activities(ctx: &!SmtContext) with Mut {
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 1024 {
        ctx.act_mean[i] = 0.0
        ctx.act_var[i] = 0.0
        ctx.phase_conf[i] = 0.5
        ctx.lrb_participated[i] = 0
        ctx.lrb_interval[i] = 0
        ctx.phase_alpha[i] = 1.0
        ctx.phase_beta[i] = 1.0
        i = i + 1
    }
    ctx.bump_amount = 1.0
}

fn smt_set_score_mode(ctx: &!SmtContext, mode: i32) with Mut {
    ctx.score_mode = mode
}
