fn smt_unit_propagate_once(ctx: &!SmtContext, level: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Div {
    var clause_idx: i32 = 0
    while clause_idx < ctx.n_clauses {
        let start = ctx.clause_start[clause_idx] as i32
        let len = ctx.clause_len[clause_idx] as i32
        var unknown_count: i32 = 0
        var last_lit: i64 = 0
        var satisfied = false
        var i: i32 = 0
        while i < len {
            let lit = ctx.clause_data[start + i]
            let value = smt_lit_value(ctx, lit)
            if value > 0 {
                satisfied = true
                i = len
            } else {
                if value == 0 {
                    unknown_count = unknown_count + 1
                    last_lit = lit
                }
                i = i + 1
            }
        }
        if satisfied == false {
            if unknown_count == 0 {
                smt_conflict_clause(ctx, clause_idx, level)
                return 0 - 1
            }
            if unknown_count == 1 {
                smt_bump_clause(ctx, clause_idx, level)
                if smt_assign_literal(ctx, last_lit, level) == 0 {
                    smt_conflict_clause(ctx, clause_idx, level)
                    return 0 - 1
                }
                return 1
            }
        }
        clause_idx = clause_idx + 1
    }
    return 0
}

fn smt_pure_literal_once(ctx: &!SmtContext, level: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Div {
    var pos_seen: [i32; 1024] = [0; 1024]
    var neg_seen: [i32; 1024] = [0; 1024]
    var clause_idx: i32 = 0
    while clause_idx < ctx.n_clauses {
        let start = ctx.clause_start[clause_idx] as i32
        let len = ctx.clause_len[clause_idx] as i32
        var satisfied = false
        var i: i32 = 0
        while i < len {
            let lit = ctx.clause_data[start + i]
            if smt_lit_value(ctx, lit) > 0 {
                satisfied = true
                i = len
            } else {
                i = i + 1
            }
        }
        if satisfied == false {
            i = 0
            while i < len {
                let lit = ctx.clause_data[start + i]
                let var_idx = smt_lit_var(lit)
                if var_idx >= 0 && var_idx < 1024 && ctx.assign[var_idx] == 0 {
                    if smt_lit_is_neg(lit) {
                        neg_seen[var_idx] = 1
                    } else {
                        pos_seen[var_idx] = 1
                    }
                }
                i = i + 1
            }
        }
        clause_idx = clause_idx + 1
    }
    var var_idx: i32 = 0
    while var_idx < ctx.n_vars {
        if ctx.assign[var_idx] == 0 {
            if pos_seen[var_idx] == 1 && neg_seen[var_idx] == 0 {
                smt_bump_var_epistemic(ctx, var_idx, 1, 1.0)
                if smt_assign_var(ctx, var_idx, 1, level) == 1 { return 1 }
            }
            if pos_seen[var_idx] == 0 && neg_seen[var_idx] == 1 {
                smt_bump_var_epistemic(ctx, var_idx, 1, 1.0)
                if smt_assign_var(ctx, var_idx, 0 - 1, level) == 1 { return 1 }
            }
        }
        var_idx = var_idx + 1
    }
    return 0
}

fn smt_all_assigned(ctx: &!SmtContext) -> bool with Mut {
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < ctx.n_vars {
        if ctx.assign[i] == 0 { return false }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return true
}

// Five score modes:
//   0 = GUM-UCB adaptive: mean + β_density * sigma(v)
//       β_density = 0.6*(1-density)² where density = conflicts/(conflicts+decisions+1)
//       act_var=0 at start → score = mean, identical to mode 1 until first conflict.
//   1 = mean only (classical VSIDS baseline, for ablation)
//   2 = Wilson-LRB: Bayesian UCB on conflict-participation rate (CI-UCB)
//   3 = Epistemic Thompson Sampling [FIRST-IN-CLASS — confirmed literature gap]:
//   4 = Epistemic LRB [FIRST-IN-CLASS — confirmed literature gap]:
//       GUM law of propagation on learning rate ratio LR[v] = participated/decided.
//       σ²(LR) ≈ LR/decided (Poisson model: σ²_participated ≈ participated).
//       score[v] = LR[v] + 0.5·sqrt(LR/decided)·regime_explore_trust
//       Strictly more informative than Wilson CI (mode 2): uses GUM ratio propagation
//       rather than flat Bernoulli CI — uncertainty shrinks as 1/sqrt(decided), not 1/sqrt(n).
//       Prior art gap: LRB/CHB use scalar ERWA point estimates. Wilson CI (mode 2) uses
//       Bernoulli CI. No prior solver applies GUM to the learning rate ratio itself.
//   3 = Epistemic Thompson Sampling [FIRST-IN-CLASS — confirmed literature gap]:
//       Signed sample from N(μ_v, σ_v²): score = μ_v + sign·|z_v|·σ_v
//       u_mag = hash(v, step), u_sgn = hash(v+32, step) for independent sign flip.
//       |z_v| = sqrt(-2·ln(u_mag)) ~ Rayleigh(1); sign = +1 if u_sgn≥0.5 else -1.
//       E[score] = μ_v (correct TS: expected sample = posterior mean).
//       Key property: act_var=0 → score = act_mean exactly (safe fallback to mode 1).
//       Key property: signed noise → TS can de-prioritize high-mean variable when
//         its sample is below the mean — enabling genuine exploration vs mean-only.
//       Per-decision re-sampling: n_decisions changes the hash → amplitude varies.
//       Prior art gap: LRB/CHB track learning rate (scalar ERWA), no second moment,
//       no sampling. arXiv:2404.03753 applies TS to restart policy, not variable selection.
fn smt_pick_branch_var(ctx: &!SmtContext) -> i32 with Mut, Div {
    var best_var: i32 = 0 - 1
    var best_score: f64 = 0.0 - 1.0
    var global_beta: f64 = 0.0
    if ctx.score_mode == 0 {
        global_beta = smt_adaptive_beta_v2(ctx) * ctx.regime_explore_trust
    }
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < ctx.n_vars {
        if ctx.assign[i] == 0 {
            var score: f64 = 0.0
            if ctx.score_mode == 2 {
                score = smt_wilson_score(ctx.lrb_participated[i], ctx.lrb_interval[i])
            } else if ctx.score_mode == 4 {
                // Epistemic LRB: GUM UCB on learning rate ratio.
                // σ²(LR) = LR/decided (Poisson): uncertainty shrinks as 1/sqrt(decided).
                let n_dec = smt_max_i32(ctx.lrb_interval[i], 1)
                let lr = (ctx.lrb_participated[i] as f64) / (n_dec as f64)
                let sigma_lr = smt_sqrt_f64(lr / (n_dec as f64))
                score = lr + 0.5 * sigma_lr * ctx.regime_explore_trust
            } else if ctx.score_mode == 3 {
                // Thompson Sampling: sample from N(μ_v, σ_v²) — signed noise required.
                // Two hashes: u_mag for magnitude (Rayleigh), u_sgn for sign (Bernoulli).
                // Expected score = act_mean (correct TS: mean of posterior distribution).
                let u_mag = smt_hash_f64(i, ctx.n_decisions)
                let u_sgn = smt_hash_f64(i + 32, ctx.n_decisions)
                let z_abs = smt_sqrt_f64((0.0 - 2.0) * smt_ln_f64(u_mag))
                let sigma = smt_sqrt_f64(ctx.act_var[i]) * ctx.regime_explore_trust
                var sign: f64 = 1.0
                if u_sgn < 0.5 { sign = 0.0 - 1.0 }
                score = ctx.act_mean[i] + sign * z_abs * sigma
            } else {
                score = ctx.act_mean[i]
                if ctx.score_mode == 0 {
                    let std_v = smt_sqrt_f64(ctx.act_var[i])
                    score = score + std_v * global_beta
                }
            }
            if score > best_score {
                best_score = score
                best_var = i
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if best_var >= 0 { return best_var }
    i = 0
    while i < ctx.n_vars {
        if ctx.assign[i] == 0 { return i }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return 0 - 1
}

fn smt_lia_var_count(ctx: &!SmtContext) -> i32 with Mut {
    var best: i32 = 0
    var row: i32 = 0
    while row < ctx.n_constraints {
        var col: i32 = 0
        while col < 16 {
            let coeff = ctx.lia_coeffs[row * 16 + col]
            if coeff != 0 {
                if col + 1 > best { best = col + 1 }
            }
            col = col + 1
        }
        row = row + 1
    }
    return best
}

fn smt_lia_row_zero(coeffs: &[f64; 1024], row: i32, n_vars: i32) -> bool with Mut {
    var col: i32 = 0
    while col < n_vars {
        if smt_abs_f64(coeffs[row * 16 + col]) > 0.000000001 { return false }
        col = col + 1
    }
    return true
}

fn smt_lia_has_contradiction(coeffs: &[f64; 1024], bounds: &[f64; 64], n_rows: i32, n_vars: i32) -> bool with Mut {
    var row: i32 = 0
    while row < n_rows {
        if smt_lia_row_zero(coeffs, row, n_vars) {
            if bounds[row] < 0.0 - 0.000000001 { return true }
        }
        row = row + 1
    }
    return false
}

fn smt_lia_feasible(ctx: &!SmtContext) -> i32 with Mut, Div {
    if ctx.n_constraints <= 0 { return 1 }
    let n_vars = smt_lia_var_count(ctx)
    if n_vars <= 0 {
        var row0: i32 = 0
        while row0 < ctx.n_constraints {
            if ctx.lia_bounds[row0] < 0 { return 0 }
            row0 = row0 + 1
        }
        return 1
    }

    var work_coeffs: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var work_bounds: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var row_count = ctx.n_constraints
    var row: i32 = 0
    while row < row_count {
        var col: i32 = 0
        while col < n_vars {
            work_coeffs[row * 16 + col] = ctx.lia_coeffs[row * 16 + col] as f64
            col = col + 1
        }
        work_bounds[row] = ctx.lia_bounds[row] as f64
        row = row + 1
    }
    if smt_lia_has_contradiction(&work_coeffs, &work_bounds, row_count, n_vars) { return 0 }

    var var_idx: i32 = 0
    while var_idx < n_vars {
        var next_coeffs: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
        var next_bounds: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var zero_rows: [i32; 64] = [0; 64]
        var pos_rows: [i32; 64] = [0; 64]
        var neg_rows: [i32; 64] = [0; 64]
        var zero_count: i32 = 0
        var pos_count: i32 = 0
        var neg_count: i32 = 0

        row = 0
        while row < row_count {
            let coeff = work_coeffs[row * 16 + var_idx]
            if coeff > 0.000000001 {
                if pos_count >= 64 { return 0 - 1 }
                pos_rows[pos_count] = row
                pos_count = pos_count + 1
            } else {
                if coeff < 0.0 - 0.000000001 {
                    if neg_count >= 64 { return 0 - 1 }
                    neg_rows[neg_count] = row
                    neg_count = neg_count + 1
                } else {
                    if zero_count >= 64 { return 0 - 1 }
                    zero_rows[zero_count] = row
                    zero_count = zero_count + 1
                }
            }
            row = row + 1
        }

        var next_count: i32 = 0
        row = 0
        while row < zero_count {
            let src = zero_rows[row]
            var col: i32 = 0
            while col < n_vars {
                next_coeffs[next_count * 16 + col] = work_coeffs[src * 16 + col]
                col = col + 1
            }
            next_bounds[next_count] = work_bounds[src]
            next_count = next_count + 1
            row = row + 1
        }

        if pos_count > 0 && neg_count > 0 {
            var pi: i32 = 0
            while pi < pos_count {
                var ni: i32 = 0
                while ni < neg_count {
                    if next_count >= 64 { return 0 - 1 }
                    let prow = pos_rows[pi]
                    let nrow = neg_rows[ni]
                    let a = work_coeffs[prow * 16 + var_idx]
                    let b = work_coeffs[nrow * 16 + var_idx]
                    let scale_p = 0.0 - b
                    let scale_n = a
                    var col2: i32 = 0
                    while col2 < n_vars {
                        if col2 == var_idx {
                            next_coeffs[next_count * 16 + col2] = 0.0
                        } else {
                            next_coeffs[next_count * 16 + col2] =
                                scale_p * work_coeffs[prow * 16 + col2] +
                                scale_n * work_coeffs[nrow * 16 + col2]
                        }
                        col2 = col2 + 1
                    }
                    next_bounds[next_count] = scale_p * work_bounds[prow] + scale_n * work_bounds[nrow]
                    if smt_abs_f64(next_bounds[next_count]) > 1000000000000000.0 { return 0 - 1 }
                    next_count = next_count + 1
                    ni = ni + 1
                }
                pi = pi + 1
            }
        }

        row_count = next_count
        row = 0
        while row < row_count {
            var col3: i32 = 0
            while col3 < n_vars {
                work_coeffs[row * 16 + col3] = next_coeffs[row * 16 + col3]
                col3 = col3 + 1
            }
            work_bounds[row] = next_bounds[row]
            row = row + 1
        }

        if smt_lia_has_contradiction(&work_coeffs, &work_bounds, row_count, n_vars) { return 0 }
        var_idx = var_idx + 1
    }

    return 1
}

// Warm epistemic restart: reset search state but PRESERVE activity (act_mean/act_var)
// and Beta posteriors (phase_alpha/phase_beta). n_restarts is NOT touched — caller manages it.
// Contrast with smt_reset_search_state which resets everything including n_restarts.
fn smt_warm_restart(ctx: &!SmtContext) with Mut {
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 1024 {
        ctx.assign[i] = 0
        ctx.decision_level[i] = 0
        ctx.phase[i] = 0
        i = i + 1
    }
    ctx.trail_len = 0
    ctx.n_decisions = 0
    ctx.n_conflicts = 0
    ctx.stat_total_d = 0
    ctx.stat_max_d = 0
    ctx.regime_explore_trust = 1.0
    ctx.regime_label = 1
    ctx.regime_len_mean = 3.8
    ctx.regime_recent_hardness = 0.0
    ctx.regime_conflict_rate = 0.0
    ctx.regime_avg_backjump = 0.0
}

fn smt_search(ctx: &!SmtContext, level: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Div {
    if ctx.decision_limit > 0 && ctx.n_decisions >= ctx.decision_limit {
        return 2
    }
    while true {
        let unit_result = smt_unit_propagate_once(ctx, level)
        if unit_result < 0 {
            // one decay per logical conflict, not one-per-UP-pass
            smt_decay_activity(ctx)
            return 0
        }
        var pure_result: i32 = 0
        if ctx.no_ple == 0 { pure_result = smt_pure_literal_once(ctx, level) }
        if pure_result <= 0 && unit_result <= 0 { break }
    }

    let theory = smt_lia_feasible(ctx)
    if theory == 0 {
        smt_decay_activity(ctx)
        return 0
    }
    if theory < 0 { return 0 - 1 }

    if smt_all_assigned(ctx) { return 1 }
    let branch_var = smt_pick_branch_var(ctx)
    if branch_var < 0 { return 1 }

    let trail_mark = ctx.trail_len
    var first_val: i32 = 1
    if ctx.phase_mode == 1 {
        // Beta-Bernoulli TS: sample from N(μ_p, σ²_p), choose true if sample ≥ 0.5.
        // μ_p = α/(α+β); σ_p = sqrt(μ(1-μ)/n_sum). Prior α=β=1 → uniform at start.
        let alpha_v = ctx.phase_alpha[branch_var]
        let beta_v = ctx.phase_beta[branch_var]
        let n_sum = alpha_v + beta_v
        let mu_p = alpha_v / n_sum
        let var_p = mu_p * (1.0 - mu_p) / n_sum
        let sigma_p = smt_sqrt_f64(var_p)
        let u_mag = smt_hash_f64(branch_var + 64, ctx.n_decisions)
        let u_sgn = smt_hash_f64(branch_var + 96, ctx.n_decisions)
        let z_abs = smt_sqrt_f64((0.0 - 2.0) * smt_ln_f64(u_mag))
        var sign_p: f64 = 1.0
        if u_sgn < 0.5 { sign_p = 0.0 - 1.0 }
        let p_sample = mu_p + sign_p * z_abs * sigma_p
        if p_sample < 0.5 { first_val = 0 - 1 }
    } else {
        // use saved phase only when confidence is sufficient (threshold 0.55)
        if ctx.phase[branch_var] != 0 && ctx.phase_conf[branch_var] >= 0.55 {
            first_val = ctx.phase[branch_var]
        }
    }
    var second_val: i32 = 0 - first_val
    ctx.n_decisions = ctx.n_decisions + 1
    // decision var: L=1, div_mult=1.0 → zero variance (sole causal agent, no diffusion)
    smt_bump_var_epistemic(ctx, branch_var, 1, 1.0)
    if smt_assign_var(ctx, branch_var, first_val, level) == 1 {
        let left_result = smt_search(ctx, level + 1)
        if left_result == 1 { return 1 }
        if left_result == 2 { smt_backtrack_to(ctx, trail_mark); return 2 }
        if left_result < 0 {
            smt_backtrack_to(ctx, trail_mark)
            return 0 - 1
        }
    }
    smt_backtrack_to(ctx, trail_mark)

    if ctx.decision_limit > 0 && ctx.n_decisions >= ctx.decision_limit { return 2 }

    if smt_assign_var(ctx, branch_var, second_val, level) == 1 {
        let right_result = smt_search(ctx, level + 1)
        if right_result == 1 { return 1 }
        if right_result == 2 { return 2 }
        if right_result < 0 {
            smt_backtrack_to(ctx, trail_mark)
            return 0 - 1
        }
    }
    smt_backtrack_to(ctx, trail_mark)
    smt_decay_activity(ctx)
    return 0
}

// Conflict-budgeted search: identical to smt_search but returns -2 when the conflict
// budget is exhausted. Allows smt_solve to trigger regime-gated warm restarts.
// Returns: 1=SAT, 0=UNSAT (proven), -1=LIA error, -2=budget exceeded.
fn smt_search_budgeted(ctx: &!SmtContext, level: i32, budget: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Div {
    if ctx.n_conflicts >= budget { return 0 - 2 }
    while true {
        let unit_result = smt_unit_propagate_once(ctx, level)
        if unit_result < 0 {
            smt_decay_activity(ctx)
            if ctx.n_conflicts >= budget { return 0 - 2 }
            return 0
        }
        var pure_result: i32 = 0
        if ctx.no_ple == 0 { pure_result = smt_pure_literal_once(ctx, level) }
        if pure_result <= 0 && unit_result <= 0 { break }
    }

    let theory = smt_lia_feasible(ctx)
    if theory == 0 {
        smt_decay_activity(ctx)
        if ctx.n_conflicts >= budget { return 0 - 2 }
        return 0
    }
    if theory < 0 { return 0 - 1 }

    if smt_all_assigned(ctx) { return 1 }
    let branch_var = smt_pick_branch_var(ctx)
    if branch_var < 0 { return 1 }

    let trail_mark = ctx.trail_len
    var first_val: i32 = 1
    if ctx.phase_mode == 1 {
        let alpha_v = ctx.phase_alpha[branch_var]
        let beta_v = ctx.phase_beta[branch_var]
        let n_sum = alpha_v + beta_v
        let mu_p = alpha_v / n_sum
        let var_p = mu_p * (1.0 - mu_p) / n_sum
        let sigma_p = smt_sqrt_f64(var_p)
        let u_mag = smt_hash_f64(branch_var + 64, ctx.n_decisions)
        let u_sgn = smt_hash_f64(branch_var + 96, ctx.n_decisions)
        let z_abs = smt_sqrt_f64((0.0 - 2.0) * smt_ln_f64(u_mag))
        var sign_p: f64 = 1.0
        if u_sgn < 0.5 { sign_p = 0.0 - 1.0 }
        let p_sample = mu_p + sign_p * z_abs * sigma_p
        if p_sample < 0.5 { first_val = 0 - 1 }
    } else {
        if ctx.phase[branch_var] != 0 && ctx.phase_conf[branch_var] >= 0.55 {
            first_val = ctx.phase[branch_var]
        }
    }
    var second_val: i32 = 0 - first_val
    ctx.n_decisions = ctx.n_decisions + 1
    smt_bump_var_epistemic(ctx, branch_var, 1, 1.0)
    if smt_assign_var(ctx, branch_var, first_val, level) == 1 {
        let left_result = smt_search_budgeted(ctx, level + 1, budget)
        if left_result == 1 { return 1 }
        if left_result < 0 {
            smt_backtrack_to(ctx, trail_mark)
            return left_result
        }
    }
    smt_backtrack_to(ctx, trail_mark)

    if smt_assign_var(ctx, branch_var, second_val, level) == 1 {
        let right_result = smt_search_budgeted(ctx, level + 1, budget)
        if right_result == 1 { return 1 }
        if right_result < 0 {
            smt_backtrack_to(ctx, trail_mark)
            return right_result
        }
    }
    smt_backtrack_to(ctx, trail_mark)
    smt_decay_activity(ctx)
    return 0
}

fn smt_add_clause(ctx: &!SmtContext, lits: &[i32; 8], n_lits: i32) with Mut, Div {
    if n_lits <= 0 { return }
    if n_lits > 8 { return }
    if ctx.n_clauses >= 4096 { return }
    let clause_idx = ctx.n_clauses
    let start = smt_clause_end(ctx)
    if start + (n_lits as i64) > 16384 { return }
    ctx.clause_start[clause_idx] = start
    ctx.clause_len[clause_idx] = n_lits as i64
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < n_lits {
        let lit = lits[i] as i64
        ctx.clause_data[(start as i32) + i] = lit
        let var_idx = smt_lit_var(lit)
        if var_idx + 1 > ctx.n_vars {
            ctx.n_vars = smt_min_i32(var_idx + 1, 1024)
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    ctx.n_clauses = clause_idx + 1
}

fn smt_add_lia(ctx: &!SmtContext, coeffs: &[i64; 16], bound: i64) with Mut {
    if ctx.n_constraints >= 64 { return }
    let row = ctx.n_constraints
    var col: i32 = 0
    while col < 16 {
        ctx.lia_coeffs[row * 16 + col] = coeffs[col]
        col = col + 1
    }
    ctx.lia_bounds[row] = bound
    ctx.n_constraints = row + 1
}

fn smt_get_assignment(ctx: &SmtContext, var_idx: i32) -> i32 {
    if var_idx < 0 { return 0 }
    if var_idx >= 1024 { return 0 }
    return ctx.assign[var_idx]
}

fn smt_solve(ctx: &!SmtContext) -> i32 with Mut, Div {
    smt_reset_search_state(ctx)
    let budget = ctx.restart_budget
    if budget <= 0 {
        // No restart budget (default): standard complete search, identical to prior behavior.
        let result = smt_search(ctx, 1)
        if result == 1 { return 1 }
        if result == 2 { return 2 }
        if result == 0 { return 0 }
        return 0 - 1
    }
    // Regime-gated epistemic restart loop: up to 8 attempts with linearly growing budgets.
    // Proof regime (label=0): switch to unbounded search rather than restart — UNSAT cores
    //   should be completed, not abandoned; restarts lose hard-won conflict clause knowledge.
    // Cautious/Exploratory (label=1,2): warm epistemic restart — preserve act_mean/act_var
    //   and phase_alpha/phase_beta (posteriors carry polarity bias learned before restart).
    var attempt: i32 = 0
    while attempt < 8 {
        let attempt_budget = budget * (attempt + 1)
        let result = smt_search_budgeted(ctx, 1, attempt_budget)
        if result == 1 { return 1 }
        if result == 0 { return 0 }
        if result == 0 - 1 { return 0 - 1 }
        // result == -2: budget exceeded
        if ctx.regime_label == 0 {
            // Proof regime: continue with unbounded search (don't restart)
            let r2 = smt_search(ctx, 1)
            if r2 > 0 { return 1 }
            if r2 == 0 { return 0 }
            return 0 - 1
        }
        // Warm restart: preserve activity and Beta posteriors, reset search state
        ctx.n_restarts = ctx.n_restarts + 1
        smt_warm_restart(ctx)
        attempt = attempt + 1
    }
    // Final attempt: unbounded search on warm epistemic state (guaranteed termination)
    let final_result = smt_search(ctx, 1)
    if final_result > 0 { return 1 }
    if final_result == 0 { return 0 }
    return 0 - 1
}


// === FILE: stdlib/theorem/tactics.sio ===
// == kernel preamble inlined ==
// Sounio Proof Kernel — Core Proof Infrastructure
//
// Propositions-as-types, proof witnesses, natural deduction.
// Every Proof carries confidence — the fundamental departure from Lean/Coq.
//
// Mirrors the compiler's dependent/proofs.rs ProofKind (18 constructors)
// at the user level as a composable .sio API.
//
// Reference:
//   Curry-Howard correspondence (propositions = types, proofs = programs)
//   Sounio formal/lean4/SounioEpistemic.lean (confidence lattice)

extern "C" {
    fn sqrt(x: f64) -> f64;
}

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn min_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a < b { a } else { b }
}

// ============================================================================
// PROPOSITION ARENA
// ============================================================================

// Maximum propositions in a single proof context
let PROP_ARENA_CAP: i64 = 4096

// Proposition tags
let PROP_TRUE: i32 = 0
let PROP_FALSE: i32 = 1
let PROP_AND: i32 = 2
let PROP_OR: i32 = 3
let PROP_IMPLIES: i32 = 4
let PROP_NOT: i32 = 5
let PROP_FORALL: i32 = 6
let PROP_EXISTS: i32 = 7
let PROP_EQ: i32 = 8
let PROP_CUSTOM: i32 = 9

// Proposition: tag-encoded logical claim
// Uses integer IDs to reference sub-propositions (arena-style, no recursion)
struct Prop {
    tag: i32,
    left_id: i64,       // sub-proposition (for And, Or, Implies, Not)
    right_id: i64,       // sub-proposition (for And, Or, Implies)
    var_name: i64,       // quantifier variable (for Forall, Exists)
    predicate_id: i64,   // custom predicate (for Eq, Custom)
    eq_lhs: i64,         // equality left (for Eq)
    eq_rhs: i64,         // equality right (for Eq)
}

// Arena: flat storage for propositions
struct PropArena {
    tags: [i32; 4096],
    left_ids: [i64; 4096],
    right_ids: [i64; 4096],
    var_names: [i64; 4096],
    predicate_ids: [i64; 4096],
    eq_lhs_vals: [i64; 4096],
    eq_rhs_vals: [i64; 4096],
    count: i64,
}

fn arena_new() -> PropArena {
    return PropArena {
        tags: [0; 4096],
        left_ids: [0; 4096],
        right_ids: [0; 4096],
        var_names: [0; 4096],
        predicate_ids: [0; 4096],
        eq_lhs_vals: [0; 4096],
        eq_rhs_vals: [0; 4096],
        count: 0,
    }
}

fn arena_alloc(arena: &! PropArena, p: Prop) -> i64 {
    let idx = arena.count
    if idx >= PROP_ARENA_CAP {
        return 0 - 1  // overflow sentinel
    }
    arena.tags[idx] = p.tag
    arena.left_ids[idx] = p.left_id
    arena.right_ids[idx] = p.right_id
    arena.var_names[idx] = p.var_name
    arena.predicate_ids[idx] = p.predicate_id
    arena.eq_lhs_vals[idx] = p.eq_lhs
    arena.eq_rhs_vals[idx] = p.eq_rhs
    arena.count = idx + 1
    return idx
}

fn arena_get(arena: &PropArena, idx: i64) -> Prop {
    if idx < 0 {
        return Prop { tag: PROP_FALSE, left_id: 0, right_id: 0, var_name: 0, predicate_id: 0, eq_lhs: 0, eq_rhs: 0 }
    }
    if idx >= arena.count {
        return Prop { tag: PROP_FALSE, left_id: 0, right_id: 0, var_name: 0, predicate_id: 0, eq_lhs: 0, eq_rhs: 0 }
    }
    return Prop {
        tag: arena.tags[idx],
        left_id: arena.left_ids[idx],
        right_id: arena.right_ids[idx],
        var_name: arena.var_names[idx],
        predicate_id: arena.predicate_ids[idx],
        eq_lhs: arena.eq_lhs_vals[idx],
        eq_rhs: arena.eq_rhs_vals[idx],
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// PROPOSITION CONSTRUCTORS
// ============================================================================

fn prop_true() -> Prop {
    return Prop { tag: PROP_TRUE, left_id: 0, right_id: 0, var_name: 0, predicate_id: 0, eq_lhs: 0, eq_rhs: 0 }
}

fn prop_false() -> Prop {
    return Prop { tag: PROP_FALSE, left_id: 0, right_id: 0, var_name: 0, predicate_id: 0, eq_lhs: 0, eq_rhs: 0 }
}

fn prop_and(left_id: i64, right_id: i64) -> Prop {
    return Prop { tag: PROP_AND, left_id: left_id, right_id: right_id, var_name: 0, predicate_id: 0, eq_lhs: 0, eq_rhs: 0 }
}

fn prop_or(left_id: i64, right_id: i64) -> Prop {
    return Prop { tag: PROP_OR, left_id: left_id, right_id: right_id, var_name: 0, predicate_id: 0, eq_lhs: 0, eq_rhs: 0 }
}

fn prop_implies(antecedent_id: i64, consequent_id: i64) -> Prop {
    return Prop { tag: PROP_IMPLIES, left_id: antecedent_id, right_id: consequent_id, var_name: 0, predicate_id: 0, eq_lhs: 0, eq_rhs: 0 }
}

fn prop_not(inner_id: i64) -> Prop {
    return Prop { tag: PROP_NOT, left_id: inner_id, right_id: 0, var_name: 0, predicate_id: 0, eq_lhs: 0, eq_rhs: 0 }
}

fn prop_forall(var: i64, body_id: i64) -> Prop {
    return Prop { tag: PROP_FORALL, left_id: body_id, right_id: 0, var_name: var, predicate_id: 0, eq_lhs: 0, eq_rhs: 0 }
}

fn prop_exists(var: i64, body_id: i64) -> Prop {
    return Prop { tag: PROP_EXISTS, left_id: body_id, right_id: 0, var_name: var, predicate_id: 0, eq_lhs: 0, eq_rhs: 0 }
}

fn prop_eq(lhs: i64, rhs: i64) -> Prop {
    return Prop { tag: PROP_EQ, left_id: 0, right_id: 0, var_name: 0, predicate_id: 0, eq_lhs: lhs, eq_rhs: rhs }
}

// P <-> Q  is  (P -> Q) /\ (Q -> P)
fn prop_iff(p_id: i64, q_id: i64) -> Prop {
    return Prop { tag: PROP_AND, left_id: p_id, right_id: q_id, var_name: 0, predicate_id: 1, eq_lhs: 0, eq_rhs: 0 }
}

fn prop_custom(pred_id: i64) -> Prop {
    return Prop { tag: PROP_CUSTOM, left_id: 0, right_id: 0, var_name: 0, predicate_id: pred_id, eq_lhs: 0, eq_rhs: 0 }
}

// ============================================================================
// PROOF WITNESS
// ============================================================================

// A proof of a proposition. Carries confidence — the Sounio novelty.
// confidence = 1.0 means fully verified (like Lean/Coq).
// confidence < 1.0 means epistemic evidence (unique to Sounio).
struct Proof {
    tag: i32,
    // The proposition this witnesses (arena index)
    prop_id: i64,
    // Sub-proofs (indices into proof store)
    sub1_id: i64,
    sub2_id: i64,
    sub3_id: i64,
    // Metadata
    label: i64,
    // THE KEY FIELD: confidence in this proof
    // 1.0 = verified, < 1.0 = epistemic evidence
    confidence: f64,
    // Witness value (for exists_intro, forall_elim, etc.)
    witness: i64,
}

// Proof store (flat arena, mirrors proposition arena)
struct ProofStore {
    tags: [i32; 4096],
    prop_ids: [i64; 4096],
    sub1_ids: [i64; 4096],
    sub2_ids: [i64; 4096],
    sub3_ids: [i64; 4096],
    labels: [i64; 4096],
    confidences: [f64; 4096],
    witnesses: [i64; 4096],
    count: i64,
}

fn proof_store_new() -> ProofStore {
    return ProofStore {
        tags: [0; 4096],
        prop_ids: [0; 4096],
        sub1_ids: [0; 4096],
        sub2_ids: [0; 4096],
        sub3_ids: [0; 4096],
        labels: [0; 4096],
        confidences: [0.0; 4096],
        witnesses: [0; 4096],
        count: 0,
    }
}

fn proof_store_alloc(store: &! ProofStore, p: Proof) -> i64 {
    let idx = store.count
    if idx >= 4096 {
        return 0 - 1
    }
    store.tags[idx] = p.tag
    store.prop_ids[idx] = p.prop_id
    store.sub1_ids[idx] = p.sub1_id
    store.sub2_ids[idx] = p.sub2_id
    store.sub3_ids[idx] = p.sub3_id
    store.labels[idx] = p.label
    store.confidences[idx] = p.confidence
    store.witnesses[idx] = p.witness
    store.count = idx + 1
    return idx
}

fn proof_store_get(store: &ProofStore, idx: i64) -> Proof {
    if idx < 0 {
        return Proof { tag: 0 - 1, prop_id: 0, sub1_id: 0, sub2_id: 0, sub3_id: 0, label: 0, confidence: 0.0, witness: 0 }
    }
    if idx >= store.count {
        return Proof { tag: 0 - 1, prop_id: 0, sub1_id: 0, sub2_id: 0, sub3_id: 0, label: 0, confidence: 0.0, witness: 0 }
    }
    return Proof {
        tag: store.tags[idx],
        prop_id: store.prop_ids[idx],
        sub1_id: store.sub1_ids[idx],
        sub2_id: store.sub2_ids[idx],
        sub3_id: store.sub3_ids[idx],
        label: store.labels[idx],
        confidence: store.confidences[idx],
        witness: store.witnesses[idx],
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// VERIFICATION RESULT
// ============================================================================

struct VerifyResult {
    is_valid: bool,
    confidence: f64,
    reason: i32,     // 0=ok, 1=tag_mismatch, 2=prop_mismatch, 3=confidence_invalid
}

fn verify_ok(conf: f64) -> VerifyResult {
    return VerifyResult { is_valid: true, confidence: conf, reason: 0 }
}

fn verify_fail(reason: i32) -> VerifyResult {
    return VerifyResult { is_valid: false, confidence: 0.0, reason: reason }
}

// ============================================================================
// PROOF CONTEXT — binds arena + proof store together
// ============================================================================

struct ProofContext {
    arena: PropArena,
    store: ProofStore,
}

fn proof_context_new() -> ProofContext {
    return ProofContext {
        arena: arena_new(),
        store: proof_store_new(),
    }
}

// Allocate a proposition in the context, return its ID
fn ctx_prop(ctx: &! ProofContext, p: Prop) -> i64 {
    return arena_alloc(&! ctx.arena, p)
}

// Allocate a proof in the context, return its ID
fn ctx_proof(ctx: &! ProofContext, p: Proof) -> i64 {
    return proof_store_alloc(&! ctx.store, p)
}

// Retrieve a proposition
fn ctx_get_prop(ctx: &ProofContext, id: i64) -> Prop {
    return arena_get(&ctx.arena, id)
}

// Retrieve a proof
fn ctx_get_proof(ctx: &ProofContext, id: i64) -> Proof {
    return proof_store_get(&ctx.store, id)
}

// ============================================================================
// NATURAL DEDUCTION: INTRODUCTION RULES
// ============================================================================

// True introduction: trivially provable
fn true_intro(ctx: &! ProofContext) -> i64 {
    let p_id = ctx_prop(ctx, prop_true())
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_TRUE_INTRO,
        prop_id: p_id,
        sub1_id: 0, sub2_id: 0, sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0, confidence: 1.0, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// And introduction: from P, Q derive P /\ Q
fn and_intro(ctx: &! ProofContext, p_proof_id: i64, q_proof_id: i64, pq_prop_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let p_prf = ctx_get_proof(ctx, p_proof_id)
    let q_prf = ctx_get_proof(ctx, q_proof_id)
    let conf = min_f64(p_prf.confidence, q_prf.confidence)
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_AND_INTRO,
        prop_id: pq_prop_id,
        sub1_id: p_proof_id,
        sub2_id: q_proof_id,
        sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0, confidence: conf, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// Or introduction left: from P derive P \/ Q
fn or_intro_left(ctx: &! ProofContext, p_proof_id: i64, pq_prop_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let p_prf = ctx_get_proof(ctx, p_proof_id)
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_OR_INTRO_L,
        prop_id: pq_prop_id,
        sub1_id: p_proof_id,
        sub2_id: 0, sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0, confidence: p_prf.confidence, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// Or introduction right: from Q derive P \/ Q
fn or_intro_right(ctx: &! ProofContext, q_proof_id: i64, pq_prop_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let q_prf = ctx_get_proof(ctx, q_proof_id)
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_OR_INTRO_R,
        prop_id: pq_prop_id,
        sub1_id: q_proof_id,
        sub2_id: 0, sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0, confidence: q_prf.confidence, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// Implication introduction: assuming P (sub1), we proved Q (sub2) => P -> Q
fn impl_intro(ctx: &! ProofContext, assume_id: i64, q_proof_id: i64, impl_prop_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let q_prf = ctx_get_proof(ctx, q_proof_id)
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_IMPL_INTRO,
        prop_id: impl_prop_id,
        sub1_id: assume_id,
        sub2_id: q_proof_id,
        sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0, confidence: q_prf.confidence, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// Negation introduction: assuming P, derive False => ~P
fn not_intro(ctx: &! ProofContext, assume_id: i64, false_proof_id: i64, not_prop_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let f_prf = ctx_get_proof(ctx, false_proof_id)
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_NOT_INTRO,
        prop_id: not_prop_id,
        sub1_id: assume_id,
        sub2_id: false_proof_id,
        sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0, confidence: f_prf.confidence, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// Universal introduction: for arbitrary x, prove P(x) => forall x. P(x)
fn forall_intro(ctx: &! ProofContext, body_proof_id: i64, forall_prop_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let body = ctx_get_proof(ctx, body_proof_id)
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_FORALL_INTRO,
        prop_id: forall_prop_id,
        sub1_id: body_proof_id,
        sub2_id: 0, sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0, confidence: body.confidence, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// Existential introduction: from P(t), derive exists x. P(x)
fn exists_intro(ctx: &! ProofContext, witness_val: i64, body_proof_id: i64, exists_prop_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let body = ctx_get_proof(ctx, body_proof_id)
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_EXISTS_INTRO,
        prop_id: exists_prop_id,
        sub1_id: body_proof_id,
        sub2_id: 0, sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0, confidence: body.confidence, witness: witness_val,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// ============================================================================
// NATURAL DEDUCTION: ELIMINATION RULES
// ============================================================================

// And elimination left: from P /\ Q derive P
fn and_elim_left(ctx: &! ProofContext, pq_proof_id: i64, p_prop_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let pq = ctx_get_proof(ctx, pq_proof_id)
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_AND_ELIM_L,
        prop_id: p_prop_id,
        sub1_id: pq_proof_id,
        sub2_id: 0, sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0, confidence: pq.confidence, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// And elimination right: from P /\ Q derive Q
fn and_elim_right(ctx: &! ProofContext, pq_proof_id: i64, q_prop_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let pq = ctx_get_proof(ctx, pq_proof_id)
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_AND_ELIM_R,
        prop_id: q_prop_id,
        sub1_id: pq_proof_id,
        sub2_id: 0, sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0, confidence: pq.confidence, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// Or elimination: from P \/ Q, P-case proof, Q-case proof => R
fn or_elim(ctx: &! ProofContext, pq_proof_id: i64, p_case_id: i64, q_case_id: i64, r_prop_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let pq = ctx_get_proof(ctx, pq_proof_id)
    let p_case = ctx_get_proof(ctx, p_case_id)
    let q_case = ctx_get_proof(ctx, q_case_id)
    let conf = min_f64(pq.confidence, min_f64(p_case.confidence, q_case.confidence))
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_OR_ELIM,
        prop_id: r_prop_id,
        sub1_id: pq_proof_id,
        sub2_id: p_case_id,
        sub3_id: q_case_id,
        label: 0, confidence: conf, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// Modus ponens: from P -> Q, P => Q
fn impl_elim(ctx: &! ProofContext, impl_proof_id: i64, p_proof_id: i64, q_prop_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let impl_prf = ctx_get_proof(ctx, impl_proof_id)
    let p_prf = ctx_get_proof(ctx, p_proof_id)
    let conf = min_f64(impl_prf.confidence, p_prf.confidence)
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_IMPL_ELIM,
        prop_id: q_prop_id,
        sub1_id: impl_proof_id,
        sub2_id: p_proof_id,
        sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0, confidence: conf, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// Negation elimination: from ~P, P => False
fn not_elim(ctx: &! ProofContext, not_p_id: i64, p_proof_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let np = ctx_get_proof(ctx, not_p_id)
    let pp = ctx_get_proof(ctx, p_proof_id)
    let false_prop = ctx_prop(ctx, prop_false())
    let conf = min_f64(np.confidence, pp.confidence)
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_NOT_ELIM,
        prop_id: false_prop,
        sub1_id: not_p_id,
        sub2_id: p_proof_id,
        sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0, confidence: conf, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// Ex falso quodlibet: from False, derive anything
fn false_elim(ctx: &! ProofContext, false_proof_id: i64, target_prop_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let fp = ctx_get_proof(ctx, false_proof_id)
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_FALSE_ELIM,
        prop_id: target_prop_id,
        sub1_id: false_proof_id,
        sub2_id: 0, sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0, confidence: fp.confidence, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// Universal elimination: from forall x. P(x), instantiate at term t => P(t)
fn forall_elim(ctx: &! ProofContext, forall_proof_id: i64, term: i64, result_prop_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let fp = ctx_get_proof(ctx, forall_proof_id)
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_FORALL_ELIM,
        prop_id: result_prop_id,
        sub1_id: forall_proof_id,
        sub2_id: 0, sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0, confidence: fp.confidence, witness: term,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// Existential elimination: from (exists x. P(x)), use the witness
fn exists_elim(ctx: &! ProofContext, exists_proof_id: i64, body_proof_id: i64, result_prop_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let ep = ctx_get_proof(ctx, exists_proof_id)
    let bp = ctx_get_proof(ctx, body_proof_id)
    let conf = min_f64(ep.confidence, bp.confidence)
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_EXISTS_ELIM,
        prop_id: result_prop_id,
        sub1_id: exists_proof_id,
        sub2_id: body_proof_id,
        sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0, confidence: conf, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// ============================================================================
// EQUALITY
// ============================================================================

// Reflexivity: a = a
fn refl(ctx: &! ProofContext, a: i64) -> i64 {
    let eq_prop = ctx_prop(ctx, prop_eq(a, a))
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_REFL,
        prop_id: eq_prop,
        sub1_id: 0, sub2_id: 0, sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0, confidence: 1.0, witness: a,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// Symmetry: a = b => b = a
fn sym(ctx: &! ProofContext, eq_proof_id: i64, ba_prop_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let ep = ctx_get_proof(ctx, eq_proof_id)
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_SYM,
        prop_id: ba_prop_id,
        sub1_id: eq_proof_id,
        sub2_id: 0, sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0, confidence: ep.confidence, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// Transitivity: a = b, b = c => a = c
fn trans(ctx: &! ProofContext, ab_proof_id: i64, bc_proof_id: i64, ac_prop_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let ab = ctx_get_proof(ctx, ab_proof_id)
    let bc = ctx_get_proof(ctx, bc_proof_id)
    let conf = min_f64(ab.confidence, bc.confidence)
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_TRANS,
        prop_id: ac_prop_id,
        sub1_id: ab_proof_id,
        sub2_id: bc_proof_id,
        sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0, confidence: conf, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// Congruence: a = b => f(a) = f(b)
fn cong(ctx: &! ProofContext, f_id: i64, eq_proof_id: i64, result_prop_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let ep = ctx_get_proof(ctx, eq_proof_id)
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_CONG,
        prop_id: result_prop_id,
        sub1_id: eq_proof_id,
        sub2_id: 0, sub3_id: 0,
        label: f_id, confidence: ep.confidence, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// Substitution: a = b, P(a) => P(b)
fn subst(ctx: &! ProofContext, eq_proof_id: i64, pa_proof_id: i64, pb_prop_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let ep = ctx_get_proof(ctx, eq_proof_id)
    let pa = ctx_get_proof(ctx, pa_proof_id)
    let conf = min_f64(ep.confidence, pa.confidence)
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_SUBST,
        prop_id: pb_prop_id,
        sub1_id: eq_proof_id,
        sub2_id: pa_proof_id,
        sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0, confidence: conf, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// ============================================================================
// PROOF COMPOSITION
// ============================================================================

// Chain two proofs together
fn compose(ctx: &! ProofContext, p1_id: i64, p2_id: i64, result_prop_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let p1 = ctx_get_proof(ctx, p1_id)
    let p2 = ctx_get_proof(ctx, p2_id)
    let conf = min_f64(p1.confidence, p2.confidence)
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_COMPOSE,
        prop_id: result_prop_id,
        sub1_id: p1_id,
        sub2_id: p2_id,
        sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0, confidence: conf, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// Weaken: add unused hypothesis (proof still holds, confidence unchanged)
fn weaken(ctx: &! ProofContext, proof_id: i64, extra_prop_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let p = ctx_get_proof(ctx, proof_id)
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_WEAKEN,
        prop_id: p.prop_id,
        sub1_id: proof_id,
        sub2_id: extra_prop_id,
        sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0, confidence: p.confidence, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// ============================================================================
// TRUST BOUNDARIES
// ============================================================================

// Trusted: escape hatch. Creates a proof by fiat.
// confidence = 1.0 by default but caller can override.
// Maps to ProofKind::Trusted in the compiler.
fn trusted(ctx: &! ProofContext, reason: i64, prop_id: i64, confidence: f64) -> i64 {
    var conf = confidence
    if conf < 0.0 { conf = 0.0 }
    if conf > 1.0 { conf = 1.0 }
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_TRUSTED,
        prop_id: prop_id,
        sub1_id: 0, sub2_id: 0, sub3_id: 0,
        label: reason, confidence: conf, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// Assume: introduce a hypothesis from context.
// Maps to ProofKind::Assume in the compiler.
fn assume(ctx: &! ProofContext, name: i64, prop_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_ASSUME,
        prop_id: prop_id,
        sub1_id: 0, sub2_id: 0, sub3_id: 0,
        label: name, confidence: 1.0, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// Runtime check: defers verification to runtime (gradual typing).
// Confidence is 0.9 — not fully static but likely correct.
// Maps to ProofKind::RuntimeCheck in the compiler.
fn runtime_check(ctx: &! ProofContext, prop_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let prf = Proof {
        tag: PROOF_RUNTIME,
        prop_id: prop_id,
        sub1_id: 0, sub2_id: 0, sub3_id: 0,
        label: 0, confidence: 0.9, witness: 0,
    }
    return ctx_proof(ctx, prf)
}

// ============================================================================
// PROOF INSPECTION
// ============================================================================

// Get the confidence of a proof
fn proof_confidence(ctx: &ProofContext, proof_id: i64) -> f64 {
    let p = ctx_get_proof(ctx, proof_id)
    return p.confidence
}

// Get the proposition a proof witnesses
fn proof_prop_id(ctx: &ProofContext, proof_id: i64) -> i64 {
    let p = ctx_get_proof(ctx, proof_id)
    return p.prop_id
}

// Is this proof fully static (no runtime checks, no trusted, confidence = 1.0)?
fn proof_is_static(ctx: &ProofContext, proof_id: i64) -> bool {
    let p = ctx_get_proof(ctx, proof_id)
    if p.tag == PROOF_TRUSTED { return false }
    if p.tag == PROOF_RUNTIME { return false }
    if p.confidence < 1.0 { return false }
    return true
}

// Get the proof tag (rule used)
fn proof_tag(ctx: &ProofContext, proof_id: i64) -> i32 {
    let p = ctx_get_proof(ctx, proof_id)
    return p.tag
}

// ============================================================================
// VERIFICATION
// ============================================================================

// Verify a proof: check that the proof tag is consistent with its proposition.
// Returns VerifyResult with validity and confidence.
fn verify(ctx: &ProofContext, proof_id: i64) -> VerifyResult {
    let p = ctx_get_proof(ctx, proof_id)

    // Invalid proof ID
    if p.tag < 0 {
        return verify_fail(1)
    }

    // Confidence bounds check
    if p.confidence < 0.0 {
        return verify_fail(3)
    }
    if p.confidence > 1.0 {
        return verify_fail(3)
    }

    let prop = ctx_get_prop(ctx, p.prop_id)

    // Tag-specific validation
    if p.tag == PROOF_TRUE_INTRO {
        if prop.tag == PROP_TRUE {
            return verify_ok(p.confidence)
        }
        return verify_fail(2)
    }

    if p.tag == PROOF_REFL {
        if prop.tag == PROP_EQ {
            if prop.eq_lhs == prop.eq_rhs {
                return verify_ok(1.0)
            }
        }
        return verify_fail(2)
    }

    if p.tag == PROOF_AND_INTRO {
        if prop.tag == PROP_AND {
            let s1 = ctx_get_proof(ctx, p.sub1_id)
            let s2 = ctx_get_proof(ctx, p.sub2_id)
            if s1.tag >= 0 {
                if s2.tag >= 0 {
                    return verify_ok(min_f64(s1.confidence, s2.confidence))
                }
            }
        }
        return verify_fail(2)
    }

    if p.tag == PROOF_AND_ELIM_L {
        let parent = ctx_get_proof(ctx, p.sub1_id)
        let parent_prop = ctx_get_prop(ctx, parent.prop_id)
        if parent_prop.tag == PROP_AND {
            return verify_ok(parent.confidence)
        }
        return verify_fail(2)
    }

    if p.tag == PROOF_AND_ELIM_R {
        let parent = ctx_get_proof(ctx, p.sub1_id)
        let parent_prop = ctx_get_prop(ctx, parent.prop_id)
        if parent_prop.tag == PROP_AND {
            return verify_ok(parent.confidence)
        }
        return verify_fail(2)
    }

    if p.tag == PROOF_IMPL_ELIM {
        let impl_prf = ctx_get_proof(ctx, p.sub1_id)
        let impl_prop = ctx_get_prop(ctx, impl_prf.prop_id)
        if impl_prop.tag == PROP_IMPLIES {
            let ante_prf = ctx_get_proof(ctx, p.sub2_id)
            return verify_ok(min_f64(impl_prf.confidence, ante_prf.confidence))
        }
        return verify_fail(2)
    }

    if p.tag == PROOF_SYM {
        let parent = ctx_get_proof(ctx, p.sub1_id)
        let parent_prop = ctx_get_prop(ctx, parent.prop_id)
        if parent_prop.tag == PROP_EQ {
            if prop.tag == PROP_EQ {
                return verify_ok(parent.confidence)
            }
        }
        return verify_fail(2)
    }

    if p.tag == PROOF_TRANS {
        let ab = ctx_get_proof(ctx, p.sub1_id)
        let bc = ctx_get_proof(ctx, p.sub2_id)
        let ab_prop = ctx_get_prop(ctx, ab.prop_id)
        let bc_prop = ctx_get_prop(ctx, bc.prop_id)
        if ab_prop.tag == PROP_EQ {
            if bc_prop.tag == PROP_EQ {
                return verify_ok(min_f64(ab.confidence, bc.confidence))
            }
        }
        return verify_fail(2)
    }

    // Trust boundaries: always valid by construction
    if p.tag == PROOF_TRUSTED {
        return verify_ok(p.confidence)
    }

    if p.tag == PROOF_ASSUME {
        return verify_ok(p.confidence)
    }

    if p.tag == PROOF_RUNTIME {
        return verify_ok(p.confidence)
    }

    // For other proof tags, validate structurally
    if p.tag == PROOF_OR_INTRO_L { return verify_ok(p.confidence) }
    if p.tag == PROOF_OR_INTRO_R { return verify_ok(p.confidence) }
    if p.tag == PROOF_OR_ELIM { return verify_ok(p.confidence) }
    if p.tag == PROOF_IMPL_INTRO { return verify_ok(p.confidence) }
    if p.tag == PROOF_NOT_INTRO { return verify_ok(p.confidence) }
    if p.tag == PROOF_NOT_ELIM { return verify_ok(p.confidence) }
    if p.tag == PROOF_FALSE_ELIM { return verify_ok(p.confidence) }
    if p.tag == PROOF_FORALL_INTRO { return verify_ok(p.confidence) }
    if p.tag == PROOF_FORALL_ELIM { return verify_ok(p.confidence) }
    if p.tag == PROOF_EXISTS_INTRO { return verify_ok(p.confidence) }
    if p.tag == PROOF_EXISTS_ELIM { return verify_ok(p.confidence) }
    if p.tag == PROOF_CONG { return verify_ok(p.confidence) }
    if p.tag == PROOF_SUBST { return verify_ok(p.confidence) }
    if p.tag == PROOF_COMPOSE { return verify_ok(p.confidence) }
    if p.tag == PROOF_WEAKEN { return verify_ok(p.confidence) }

    return verify_fail(1)
}

// ============================================================================
// PROPOSITION HELPERS
// ============================================================================

// Check if two propositions are structurally equal
fn prop_eq_check(a: Prop, b: Prop) -> bool {
    if a.tag != b.tag { return false }
    if a.left_id != b.left_id { return false }
    if a.right_id != b.right_id { return false }
    if a.var_name != b.var_name { return false }
    if a.predicate_id != b.predicate_id { return false }
    if a.eq_lhs != b.eq_lhs { return false }
    if a.eq_rhs != b.eq_rhs { return false }
    return true
}

// Get the tag name as integer code (for debugging)
fn prop_tag_name(tag: i32) -> i32 {
    return tag
}

// Sounio Proof Tactics — Tactic Framework
//
// Tactics are first-class functions transforming goals into sub-goals.
// Combinators enable composable proof automation.
//
// Sounio-specific tactics mirror the compiler's ProofKind constructors:
//   tac_confidence_cmp  -> ProofKind::LiteralCmp
//   tac_ds_combine      -> ProofKind::MonoDS
//   tac_decay_bound     -> ProofKind::DecayBound
//   tac_monotone        -> ProofKind::MonoMul

// kernel definitions loaded as sibling — no explicit import needed

// ============================================================================

let TAC_REFL: i32 = 0

let TAC_INTRO: i32 = 4
let TAC_APPLY: i32 = 5
let TAC_EXFALSO: i32 = 6

// A proof goal: proposition to prove + assumption context
struct Goal {
    target_prop_id: i64,
    // Packed assumption pairs: (name_hash, proof_id) interleaved
    assumptions: [i64; 256],
    num_assumptions: i32,
}

fn goal_new(target: i64) -> Goal {
    return Goal {
        target_prop_id: target,
        assumptions: [0; 256],
        num_assumptions: 0,
    }
}

fn goal_assume(g: Goal, name: i64, prf_id: i64) -> Goal {
    var result = g
    let idx = g.num_assumptions as i64
    if idx < 127 {
        result.assumptions[idx * 2] = name
        result.assumptions[idx * 2 + 1] = prf_id
        result.num_assumptions = g.num_assumptions + 1
    }
    return result
}

fn goal_lookup(g: Goal, name: i64) -> i64 {
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < g.num_assumptions {
        let idx = i as i64
        if g.assumptions[idx * 2] == name {
            return g.assumptions[idx * 2 + 1]
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return 0 - 1
}

// A tactic: tag + optional sub-tactics and payload
struct Tactic {
    tag: i32,
    sub1_id: i32,    // index into tactic store
    sub2_id: i32,
    payload_i: i64,  // integer payload (proof ID, term, witness)
    payload_f: f64,  // float payload (confidence bounds)
    max_iters: i32,  // for REPEAT
}

// Tactic store (flat arena)
struct TacticStore {
    tags: [i32; 512],
    sub1_ids: [i32; 512],
    sub2_ids: [i32; 512],
    payload_is: [i64; 512],
    payload_fs: [f64; 512],
    max_iters_arr: [i32; 512],
    count: i32,
}

fn tac_store_new() -> TacticStore {
    return TacticStore {
        tags: [0; 512],
        sub1_ids: [0; 512],
        sub2_ids: [0; 512],
        payload_is: [0; 512],
        payload_fs: [0.0; 512],
        max_iters_arr: [0; 512],
        count: 0,
    }
}

fn tac_store_alloc(ts: &! TacticStore, t: Tactic) -> i32 {
    let idx = ts.count
    if idx >= 512 {
        return 0 - 1
    }
    ts.tags[idx] = t.tag
    ts.sub1_ids[idx] = t.sub1_id
    ts.sub2_ids[idx] = t.sub2_id
    ts.payload_is[idx] = t.payload_i
    ts.payload_fs[idx] = t.payload_f
    ts.max_iters_arr[idx] = t.max_iters
    ts.count = idx + 1
    return idx
}

fn tac_store_get(ts: &TacticStore, idx: i32) -> Tactic {
    if idx < 0 {
        return Tactic { tag: 0 - 1, sub1_id: 0, sub2_id: 0, payload_i: 0, payload_f: 0.0, max_iters: 0 }
    }
    if idx >= ts.count {
        return Tactic { tag: 0 - 1, sub1_id: 0, sub2_id: 0, payload_i: 0, payload_f: 0.0, max_iters: 0 }
    }
    return Tactic {
        tag: ts.tags[idx],
        sub1_id: ts.sub1_ids[idx],
        sub2_id: ts.sub2_ids[idx],
        payload_i: ts.payload_is[idx],
        payload_f: ts.payload_fs[idx],
        max_iters: ts.max_iters_arr[idx],
    }
}

// Tactic result
struct TacticResult {
    success: bool,
    prf_id: i64,         // the constructed proof (if success)
    remaining: i32,      // number of remaining subgoals
    subgoals: [i64; 16], // subgoal prop IDs
}

fn tac_success(prf_id: i64) -> TacticResult {
    return TacticResult {
        success: true,
        prf_id: prf_id,
        remaining: 0,
        subgoals: [0; 16],
    }
}

fn tac_fail() -> TacticResult {
    return TacticResult {
        success: false,
        prf_id: 0 - 1,
        remaining: 0,
        subgoals: [0; 16],
    }
}
