pub fn viz_scene_set_time(scene: &!VizScene, t: f64) with Mut {
    scene.time = t
}

fn viz_node_is_focusable_kind(node: VizNode) -> bool {
    if node.kind != VIZ_NODE_CONTROL { return false }
    if node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_BUTTON { return true }
    if node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_SLIDER { return true }
    if node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_TOGGLE { return true }
    if node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_TABS { return true }
    if node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_VIEWPORT { return true }
    return false
}

fn viz_scene_is_focusable_node(scene: &VizScene, node_idx: i64) -> bool {
    if node_idx < 0 || node_idx >= scene.node_count { return false }
    return viz_node_is_focusable_kind(scene.nodes[node_idx as usize])
}

fn viz_scene_focus_set(scene: &!VizScene, node_idx: i64) with Mut {
    if node_idx < 0 || node_idx >= scene.node_count {
        scene.focused_node = 0 - 1
        return
    }
    scene.focused_node = node_idx
}

pub fn viz_scene_focus_next(scene: &!VizScene) -> i64 with Mut {
    if scene.node_count <= 0 {
        scene.focused_node = 0 - 1
        return 0 - 1
    }
    var start = scene.focused_node + 1
    if start < 0 || start >= scene.node_count { start = 0 }
    var step: i64 = 0
    while step < scene.node_count {
        let idx = (start + step) % scene.node_count
        if viz_scene_is_focusable_node(scene, idx) {
            viz_scene_focus_set(scene, idx)
            return idx
        }
        step = step + 1
    }
    scene.focused_node = 0 - 1
    return 0 - 1
}

pub fn viz_scene_focus_prev(scene: &!VizScene) -> i64 with Mut {
    if scene.node_count <= 0 {
        scene.focused_node = 0 - 1
        return 0 - 1
    }
    var start = scene.focused_node - 1
    if start < 0 || start >= scene.node_count { start = scene.node_count - 1 }
    var step: i64 = 0
    while step < scene.node_count {
        var idx = start - step
        while idx < 0 { idx = idx + scene.node_count }
        if viz_scene_is_focusable_node(scene, idx) {
            viz_scene_focus_set(scene, idx)
            return idx
        }
        step = step + 1
    }
    scene.focused_node = 0 - 1
    return 0 - 1
}

pub fn viz_scene_activate_focused(scene: &!VizScene) -> bool with Mut, Div {
    let idx = scene.focused_node
    if idx < 0 || idx >= scene.node_count { return false }
    let node = scene.nodes[idx as usize]
    if !viz_node_is_focusable_kind(node) { return false }
    scene.selected_node = idx
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < scene.node_count {
        scene.nodes[i as usize].selected = i == idx
        i = i + 1
    }
    if node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_TOGGLE {
        viz_scene_toggle(scene, idx)
    } else if node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_TABS {
        viz_scene_step_tab_key(scene, idx, 1)
    }
    return true
}

fn viz_print_i64(n: i64) with IO, Mut, Div {
    if n == 0 { print("0"); return }
    var v = n
    if v < 0 { print("-"); v = 0 - v }
    var digits: [i64; 20] = [0; 20]
    var len: i64 = 0
    while v > 0 {
        digits[len as usize] = v - (v / 10) * 10
        v = v / 10
        len = len + 1
    }
    var i = len - 1
    while i >= 0 {
        let d = digits[i as usize]
        if d == 0 { print("0") }
        if d == 1 { print("1") }
        if d == 2 { print("2") }
        if d == 3 { print("3") }
        if d == 4 { print("4") }
        if d == 5 { print("5") }
        if d == 6 { print("6") }
        if d == 7 { print("7") }
        if d == 8 { print("8") }
        if d == 9 { print("9") }
        i = i - 1
    }
}

fn viz_dump_node(scene: &VizScene, idx: i64) with IO, Mut, Div {
    let n = scene.nodes[idx as usize]
    print("node idx="); viz_print_i64(idx)
    print(" id="); viz_print_i64(n.id)
    print(" parent_id="); viz_print_i64(n.parent_id)
    print(" tag="); viz_print_i64(n.tag)
    print(" kind="); viz_print_i64(n.kind)
    print(" slot="); viz_print_i64(n.data_slot)
    print(" rect="); viz_print_i64(n.layout.x); print(","); viz_print_i64(n.layout.y)
    print(","); viz_print_i64(n.layout.w); print(","); viz_print_i64(n.layout.h)
    println("")
}

pub fn viz_scene_dump(scene: &VizScene) with IO, Mut, Div {
    print("VizScene nodes="); viz_print_i64(scene.node_count)
    print(" selected="); viz_print_i64(scene.selected_node)
    print(" hovered="); viz_print_i64(scene.hovered_node)
    print(" focused="); viz_print_i64(scene.focused_node)
    print(" series="); viz_print_i64(scene.series_count)
    print(" heatmaps="); viz_print_i64(scene.heatmap_count)
    print(" molecules="); viz_print_i64(scene.molecule_count)
    print(" fields="); viz_print_i64(scene.field_count)
    print(" vectors="); viz_print_i64(scene.vector_field_count)
    print(" trajectories="); viz_print_i64(scene.trajectory_count)
    print(" spectra="); viz_print_i64(scene.spectrum_count)
    print(" meshes="); viz_print_i64(scene.mesh_count)
    println("")
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < scene.node_count {
        viz_dump_node(scene, i)
        i = i + 1
    }
}

pub fn viz_scene_apply_layout_range(scene: &!VizScene, first_idx: i64, count: i64, layout: VizLayout) with Mut {
    if count <= 0 { return }
    if first_idx < 0 || first_idx >= scene.node_count { return }
    var n = count
    if first_idx + n > scene.node_count {
        n = scene.node_count - first_idx
    }
    if n <= 0 { return }

    if layout.layout_kind == VIZ_LAYOUT_ROW {
        let total_gap = layout.gap * (n - 1)
        let cell_w = viz_layout_nonneg(layout.w - total_gap) / n
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < n {
            let idx = first_idx + i
            var node = scene.nodes[idx as usize]
            node.layout = viz_layout_rect(layout.x + i * (cell_w + layout.gap), layout.y, cell_w, layout.h)
            scene.nodes[idx as usize] = node
            i = i + 1
        }
    } else if layout.layout_kind == VIZ_LAYOUT_COLUMN {
        let total_gap = layout.gap * (n - 1)
        let cell_h = viz_layout_nonneg(layout.h - total_gap) / n
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < n {
            let idx = first_idx + i
            var node = scene.nodes[idx as usize]
            node.layout = viz_layout_rect(layout.x, layout.y + i * (cell_h + layout.gap), layout.w, cell_h)
            scene.nodes[idx as usize] = node
            i = i + 1
        }
    }
}

pub fn viz_scene_set_slider(scene: &!VizScene, node_idx: i64, value: f64) with Mut {
    if node_idx < 0 || node_idx >= scene.node_count { return }
    var node = scene.nodes[node_idx as usize]
    var v = value
    if v < node.min_value { v = node.min_value }
    if v > node.max_value { v = node.max_value }
    node.value = v
    scene.nodes[node_idx as usize] = node
}

pub fn viz_scene_set_time_from_slider(scene: &!VizScene, node_idx: i64, value: f64) with Mut {
    viz_scene_set_slider(scene, node_idx, value)
    if node_idx < 0 || node_idx >= scene.node_count { return }
    let node = scene.nodes[node_idx as usize]
    if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_CONTROL && node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_SLIDER {
        scene.time = node.value
    }
}

pub fn viz_scene_set_toggle(scene: &!VizScene, node_idx: i64, enabled: bool) with Mut {
    if node_idx < 0 || node_idx >= scene.node_count { return }
    var node = scene.nodes[node_idx as usize]
    if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_CONTROL && node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_TOGGLE {
        node.value = if enabled { 1.0 } else { 0.0 }
        node.selected = enabled
        scene.nodes[node_idx as usize] = node
    }
}

pub fn viz_scene_toggle(scene: &!VizScene, node_idx: i64) with Mut {
    if node_idx < 0 || node_idx >= scene.node_count { return }
    let node = scene.nodes[node_idx as usize]
    if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_CONTROL && node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_TOGGLE {
        viz_scene_set_toggle(scene, node_idx, node.value <= 0.0)
    }
}

pub fn viz_scene_set_tab(scene: &!VizScene, node_idx: i64, tab_idx: i64) with Mut {
    if node_idx < 0 || node_idx >= scene.node_count { return }
    var node = scene.nodes[node_idx as usize]
    if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_CONTROL && node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_TABS {
        var idx = tab_idx
        let min_i = node.min_value as i64
        let max_i = node.max_value as i64
        if idx < min_i { idx = min_i }
        if idx > max_i { idx = max_i }
        node.value = idx as f64
        scene.active_tab = idx
        scene.nodes[node_idx as usize] = node
    }
}

fn viz_scene_tab_from_pointer(node: &VizNode, px: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let min_i = node.min_value as i64
    let max_i = node.max_value as i64
    var count = max_i - min_i + 1
    if count <= 0 { count = 1 }
    let denom = if node.layout.w <= 0 { 1 } else { node.layout.w }
    var rel = px - node.layout.x
    if rel < 0 { rel = 0 }
    if rel >= denom { rel = denom - 1 }
    let tab_w = if denom / count <= 0 { 1 } else { denom / count }
    var idx = min_i + rel / tab_w
    if idx > max_i { idx = max_i }
    idx
}

pub fn viz_scene_activate_control(scene: &!VizScene, node_idx: i64, px: i64, py: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    if node_idx < 0 || node_idx >= scene.node_count { return node_idx }
    let node = scene.nodes[node_idx as usize]
    if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_CONTROL && node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_TOGGLE {
        viz_scene_toggle(scene, node_idx)
    } else if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_CONTROL && node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_TABS {
        let tab = viz_scene_tab_from_pointer(&node, px)
        viz_scene_set_tab(scene, node_idx, tab)
    }
    node_idx
}

pub fn viz_scene_hit_test(scene: &VizScene, px: i64, py: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    var found: i64 = 0 - 1
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < scene.node_count {
        let n = scene.nodes[i as usize]
        if px >= n.layout.x && px < n.layout.x + n.layout.w && py >= n.layout.y && py < n.layout.y + n.layout.h {
            found = i
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    found
}

pub fn viz_scene_pointer_down(scene: &!VizScene, px: i64, py: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let idx = viz_scene_hit_test(scene, px, py)
    scene.selected_node = idx
    if idx >= 0 && idx < scene.node_count && viz_scene_is_focusable_node(scene, idx) {
        scene.focused_node = idx
    }
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < scene.node_count {
        scene.nodes[i as usize].selected = i == idx
        i = i + 1
    }
    viz_scene_activate_control(scene, idx, px, py)
    idx
}

pub fn viz_scene_pointer_move(scene: &!VizScene, px: i64, py: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    let idx = viz_scene_hit_test(scene, px, py)
    scene.hovered_node = idx
    idx
}

pub fn viz_scene_pointer_up(scene: &!VizScene, px: i64, py: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    let idx = viz_scene_hit_test(scene, px, py)
    scene.hovered_node = idx
    scene.selected_node = 0 - 1
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < scene.node_count {
        scene.nodes[i as usize].selected = false
        i = i + 1
    }
    idx
}

pub fn viz_scene_pointer_update(scene: &!VizScene, px: i64, py: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    var idx = scene.selected_node
    if idx < 0 || idx >= scene.node_count {
        idx = viz_scene_hit_test(scene, px, py)
        scene.selected_node = idx
    }
    if idx < 0 || idx >= scene.node_count { return idx }
    var node = scene.nodes[idx as usize]
    if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_CONTROL && node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_SLIDER {
        let denom = if node.layout.w <= 0 { 1 } else { node.layout.w }
        var rel = px - node.layout.x
        if rel < 0 { rel = 0 }
        if rel > denom { rel = denom }
        let frac = (rel as f64) / (denom as f64)
        let value = node.min_value + frac * (node.max_value - node.min_value)
        viz_scene_set_time_from_slider(scene, idx, value)
        node = scene.nodes[idx as usize]
    } else if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_CONTROL && node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_TABS {
        let tab = viz_scene_tab_from_pointer(&node, px)
        viz_scene_set_tab(scene, idx, tab)
        node = scene.nodes[idx as usize]
    }
    scene.nodes[idx as usize] = node
    idx
}

fn viz_scene_step_slider_key(scene: &!VizScene, node_idx: i64, direction: i64) with Mut {
    if node_idx < 0 || node_idx >= scene.node_count { return }
    let node = scene.nodes[node_idx as usize]
    let step = (node.max_value - node.min_value) / 10.0
    viz_scene_set_time_from_slider(scene, node_idx, node.value + step * (direction as f64))
}

fn viz_scene_step_tab_key(scene: &!VizScene, node_idx: i64, direction: i64) with Mut {
    if node_idx < 0 || node_idx >= scene.node_count { return }
    let node = scene.nodes[node_idx as usize]
    let tab = (node.value as i64) + direction
    viz_scene_set_tab(scene, node_idx, tab)
}

pub fn viz_scene_key_press(scene: &!VizScene, key: i64) -> bool with Mut {
    if key == KEY_TAB {
        return viz_scene_focus_next(scene) >= 0
    }
    var idx = scene.selected_node
    if idx < 0 || idx >= scene.node_count {
        idx = scene.hovered_node
    }
    if idx < 0 || idx >= scene.node_count {
        idx = scene.focused_node
    }
    if idx < 0 || idx >= scene.node_count {
        return false
    }
    let node = scene.nodes[idx as usize]
    if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_CONTROL && node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_SLIDER {
        if key == KEY_LEFT {
            viz_scene_step_slider_key(scene, idx, 0 - 1)
            return true
        }
        if key == KEY_RIGHT {
            viz_scene_step_slider_key(scene, idx, 1)
            return true
        }
    } else if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_CONTROL && node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_TABS {
        if key == KEY_LEFT {
            viz_scene_step_tab_key(scene, idx, 0 - 1)
            return true
        }
        if key == KEY_RIGHT {
            viz_scene_step_tab_key(scene, idx, 1)
            return true
        }
    } else if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_CONTROL && node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_TOGGLE {
        if key == KEY_SPACE || key == KEY_RETURN {
            viz_scene_toggle(scene, idx)
            return true
        }
    }
    false
}

pub fn viz_scene_handle_event(scene: &!VizScene, ev: Event) -> bool with Mut, Div {
    if ev.kind == EV_MOUSE_PRESS && ev.key == MOUSE_LEFT {
        viz_scene_pointer_down(scene, ev.x, ev.y)
        return true
    }
    if ev.kind == EV_MOTION {
        if scene.selected_node >= 0 {
            viz_scene_pointer_update(scene, ev.x, ev.y)
        } else {
            viz_scene_pointer_move(scene, ev.x, ev.y)
        }
        return true
    }
    if ev.kind == EV_MOUSE_RELEASE && ev.key == MOUSE_LEFT {
        viz_scene_pointer_up(scene, ev.x, ev.y)
        return true
    }
    if ev.kind == EV_KEY_PRESS {
        return viz_scene_key_press(scene, ev.key)
    }
    false
}

pub fn viz_version() -> i64 { 15 }


// === FILE: stdlib/viz/mol3d.sio ===
// stdlib/viz/mol3d.sio — Screen-space molecular 3D renderer
//
// Renders MoleculeViz atoms as depth-sorted filled circles and bonds as
// antialiased lines directly into a display::Canvas.
// Coordinates are in Ångströms. Camera uses Camera3D from renderer3d.sio.
//
// Usage:
//   let mol = molecule_h2o()
//   let cam = Camera3D { pos_x: 0.0, pos_y: 0.0, pos_z: -15.0, focal: 400.0 }
//   mol3d_render(&mol, &cam, angle_y, angle_x, &!canvas)

use display::canvas::{Canvas}
use display::canvas_ext::{canvas_draw_line_aa, canvas_blend_pixel, canvas_sphere_shaded,
                           canvas_sphere_shaded_fog, canvas_sphere_sss, canvas_bond_cylinder}
use render::renderer3d::{Camera3D, Vec3f}
use viz::physchem::{MoleculeViz}

// ============================================================
// Precomputed ambient occlusion
// ============================================================
//
// Tarini et al. 2006 (VMV): AO per-atom = solid-angle sum of overlapping
// neighbours.  Call once per molecule; pass ao[] to mol3d_render_ao.
// ao[i] ∈ [0.0, 1.0]; 0 = fully lit, 1 = fully occluded.

// ============================================================
// Per-atom analytic soft shadows (Quilez 2010)
// ============================================================
//
// Trace a ray toward the directional light from each atom center.
// For each other atom along the ray, measure how much it occludes the light
// via its angular radius (Quilez 2010 soft penumbra formula).
// shadow[i] ∈ [0,1]: 0=full shadow, 1=fully lit.
// Light direction matches canvas_sphere_shaded: (0.447, -0.632, 0.632).

fn m3_sqrt_f(x: f64) -> f64 with Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var g = x * 0.5 + 0.5
    g = 0.5 * (g + x / g)
    g = 0.5 * (g + x / g)
    g = 0.5 * (g + x / g)
    g = 0.5 * (g + x / g)
    g
}

pub fn mol3d_precompute_shadow(mol: &MoleculeViz, shadow: &![f64; 64]) with Mut, Div {
    let lx: f64 = 0.447
    let ly: f64 = 0.0 - 0.632
    let lz: f64 = 0.632
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < mol.atom_count {
        var sf: f64 = 1.0
        let ax = mol.atoms[i as usize].x
        let ay = mol.atoms[i as usize].y
        let az = mol.atoms[i as usize].z
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < mol.atom_count {
            if j != i {
                let dx = mol.atoms[j as usize].x - ax
                let dy = mol.atoms[j as usize].y - ay
                let dz = mol.atoms[j as usize].z - az
                let br = mol.atoms[j as usize].radius
                // Project onto light ray direction
                let t = dx * lx + dy * ly + dz * lz
                if t > 0.0 {
                    let qx = dx - t * lx
                    let qy = dy - t * ly
                    let qz = dz - t * lz
                    let perp = m3_sqrt_f(qx*qx + qy*qy + qz*qz)
                    let pen = if br > 0.0001 { perp / br } else { 1.0 }
                    let pcl = if pen < 0.0 { 0.0 } else if pen > 1.0 { 1.0 } else { pen }
                    if pcl < sf { sf = pcl }
                }
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        shadow[i as usize] = sf
        i = i + 1
    }
}

pub fn mol3d_precompute_ao(mol: &MoleculeViz, ao: &![f64; 64]) with Mut, Div {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < mol.atom_count {
        ao[i as usize] = 0.0
        i = i + 1
    }
    var ai: i64 = 0
    while ai < mol.atom_count {
        let ax = mol.atoms[ai as usize].x
        let ay = mol.atoms[ai as usize].y
        let az = mol.atoms[ai as usize].z
        var sum: f64 = 0.0
        var bi: i64 = 0
        while bi < mol.atom_count {
            if bi == ai { bi = bi + 1; continue }
            let bx = mol.atoms[bi as usize].x
            let by = mol.atoms[bi as usize].y
            let bz = mol.atoms[bi as usize].z
            let br = mol.atoms[bi as usize].radius
            let dx = bx - ax
            let dy = by - ay
            let dz = bz - az
            let dist2 = dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz
            if dist2 < 0.0001 { bi = bi + 1; continue }
            // Solid angle occlusion: r²/dist²
            let sa = (br * br) / dist2
            sum = sum + sa
            bi = bi + 1
        }
        let clamped = if sum > 1.0 { 1.0 } else { sum }
        ao[ai as usize] = clamped
        ai = ai + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================
// Internal math
// ============================================================

// HSV to RGB — H ∈ [0, 360], S=1, V=1. Returns r/g/b each in [0, 255].
// Used for chromatic depth cueing (near=red, far=blue).
fn m3_hsv_r(h: f64) -> i64 with Div {
    let sector = (h / 60.0) as i64
    let frac = h / 60.0 - (sector as f64)
    if sector == 0 { 255 }
    else if sector == 1 { (255.0 * (1.0 - frac)) as i64 }
    else if sector == 2 { 0 }
    else if sector == 3 { 0 }
    else if sector == 4 { (255.0 * frac) as i64 }
    else { 255 }
}

fn m3_hsv_g(h: f64) -> i64 with Div {
    let sector = (h / 60.0) as i64
    let frac = h / 60.0 - (sector as f64)
    if sector == 0 { (255.0 * frac) as i64 }
    else if sector == 1 { 255 }
    else if sector == 2 { 255 }
    else if sector == 3 { (255.0 * (1.0 - frac)) as i64 }
    else { 0 }
}

fn m3_hsv_b(h: f64) -> i64 with Div {
    let sector = (h / 60.0) as i64
    let frac = h / 60.0 - (sector as f64)
    if sector == 0 { 0 }
    else if sector == 1 { 0 }
    else if sector == 2 { (255.0 * frac) as i64 }
    else if sector == 3 { 255 }
    else if sector == 4 { 255 }
    else { (255.0 * (1.0 - frac)) as i64 }
}

fn m3_sin(t: f64) -> f64 with Div {
    let t2 = t * t
    t * (1.0 - t2 * (1.0 / 6.0 - t2 * (1.0 / 120.0 - t2 / 5040.0)))
}

fn m3_cos(t: f64) -> f64 with Div {
    let t2 = t * t
    1.0 - t2 * (0.5 - t2 * (1.0 / 24.0 - t2 / 720.0))
}

// Project world point → screen. z component of returned Vec3f = depth (> 0 if visible).
fn m3_project(x: f64, y: f64, z: f64, cam: &Camera3D, w: i64, h: i64) -> Vec3f with Div {
    let rz = z - cam.pos_z
    if rz >= 0.0 {
        return Vec3f { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }
    }
    let depth = 0.0 - rz
    let scale = cam.focal / depth
    let sx = (x - cam.pos_x) * scale + (w as f64) * 0.5
    let sy = (0.0 - (y - cam.pos_y)) * scale + (h as f64) * 0.5
    Vec3f { x: sx, y: sy, z: depth }
}

// Insertion sort: order[0..n] = indices into depth[], descending (furthest first).
fn m3_sort_desc(depth: &[f64; 64], n: i64, order: &![i64; 64]) with Mut {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        (*order)[i as usize] = i
        i = i + 1
    }
    var j: i64 = 1
    while j < n {
        let ki = (*order)[j as usize]
        let kd = depth[ki as usize]
        var k = j - 1
        while k >= 0 && depth[(*order)[k as usize] as usize] < kd {
            (*order)[(k + 1) as usize] = (*order)[k as usize]
            k = k - 1
        }
        (*order)[(k + 1) as usize] = ki
        j = j + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================
// Public API
// ============================================================

// Render a MoleculeViz into a Canvas with perspective projection.
//   angle_y   — rotation around vertical (Y) axis in radians
//   angle_x   — rotation around horizontal (X) axis in radians
//   cam       — Camera3D; set pos_z negative (e.g. -15.0) and focal ~400 for typical molecules
//   outline   — silhouette outline radius in extra screen pixels (0=off, 1-3 recommended)
//   chromatic — chromatic depth cueing strength [0=off .. 255=full]
pub fn mol3d_render(
    mol: &MoleculeViz,
    cam: &Camera3D,
    angle_y: f64,
    angle_x: f64,
    c: &!Canvas,
) with Mut, Div {
    let cy = m3_cos(angle_y)
    let sy = m3_sin(angle_y)
    let cx = m3_cos(angle_x)
    let sx = m3_sin(angle_x)

    // Per-atom projected data
    var px:  [i64; 64] = [0; 64]      // screen x
    var py:  [i64; 64] = [0; 64]      // screen y
    var pd:  [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]    // depth (0 = behind camera)
    var prad:[i64; 64] = [0; 64]      // screen radius
    var pvis:[i64; 64] = [0; 64]      // 1 = visible
    // World-space rotated positions (needed for cylinder bonds)
    var wx: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var wy: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var wz: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < mol.atom_count {
        let a = mol.atoms[i as usize]

        // Rotate Y then X
        let x1 = a.x * cy + a.z * sy
        let y1 = a.y
        let z1 = 0.0 - a.x * sy + a.z * cy
        let y2 = y1 * cx - z1 * sx
        let z2 = y1 * sx + z1 * cx

        wx[i as usize] = x1
        wy[i as usize] = y2
        wz[i as usize] = z2

        let p = m3_project(x1, y2, z2, cam, c.width, c.height)
        if p.z > 0.0 {
            px[i as usize]   = p.x as i64
            py[i as usize]   = p.y as i64
            pd[i as usize]   = p.z
            let rs = (a.radius * cam.focal / p.z) as i64
            prad[i as usize] = if rs < 3 { 3 } else if rs > 100 { 100 } else { rs }
            pvis[i as usize] = 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Precompute per-atom ambient occlusion (model-space, view-independent).
    // Approximation: sum of solid angle contributions from all neighbouring atoms.
    var ao: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var ai: i64 = 0
    while ai < mol.atom_count {
        let aa = mol.atoms[ai as usize]
        var acc: f64 = 0.0
        var bj: i64 = 0
        while bj < mol.atom_count {
            if bj != ai {
                let ab = mol.atoms[bj as usize]
                let ddx = ab.x - aa.x
                let ddy = ab.y - aa.y
                let ddz = ab.z - aa.z
                let dist2 = ddx*ddx + ddy*ddy + ddz*ddz
                if dist2 > 0.0 {
                    acc = acc + (ab.radius * ab.radius) / dist2
                }
            }
            bj = bj + 1
        }
        let raw = acc * 0.30
        ao[ai as usize] = if raw > 1.0 { 1.0 } else { raw }
        ai = ai + 1
    }

    // Draw bonds (behind atoms — paint first).
    // Use cylinder impostor when the average projected radius ≥ 4px; AA lines otherwise.
    let bond_r_w: f64 = 0.20   // cylinder radius in Ångströms (typical covalent bond)
    var bi: i64 = 0
    while bi < mol.bond_count {
        let bond = mol.bonds[bi as usize]
        let ia = bond.atom_a
        let ib = bond.atom_b
        if pvis[ia as usize] == 1 && pvis[ib as usize] == 1 {
            let avg_rad = (prad[ia as usize] + prad[ib as usize]) / 2
            if avg_rad >= 3 {
                // Full cylinder impostor
                canvas_bond_cylinder(c,
                    wx[ia as usize], wy[ia as usize], wz[ia as usize],
                    wx[ib as usize], wy[ib as usize], wz[ib as usize],
                    cam.pos_x, cam.pos_y, cam.pos_z, cam.focal,
                    130, 150, 175, bond_r_w)
            } else {
                // Fast AA line for small/distant bonds
                canvas_draw_line_aa(c,
                    px[ia as usize], py[ia as usize],
                    px[ib as usize], py[ib as usize],
                    140, 155, 175)
                canvas_draw_line_aa(c,
                    px[ia as usize] + 1, py[ia as usize],
                    px[ib as usize] + 1, py[ib as usize],
                    120, 135, 155)
            }
        }
        bi = bi + 1
    }

    // Depth-sort back-to-front and draw atoms as filled circles
    var order: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    m3_sort_desc(&pd, mol.atom_count, &!order)

    // Fog / depth parameters.
    // mol_viewer camera at pos_z=-15 → depth = -(z - pos_z) ≈ 10..20 for typical molecules.
    let fog_near: f64 = 12.0
    let fog_far:  f64 = 30.0

    // Pass 1: silhouette outlines — render each atom at radius+2 in dark colour first.
    var oi: i64 = 0
    while oi < mol.atom_count {
        let idx = order[oi as usize]
        if pvis[idx as usize] == 1 {
            let outline_r = prad[idx as usize] + 2
            canvas_sphere_shaded(c, px[idx as usize], py[idx as usize], outline_r, 30, 30, 42)
        }
        oi = oi + 1
    }

    // Pass 2: lit + AO + chromatic-depth atoms (back-to-front).
    var oi2: i64 = 0
    while oi2 < mol.atom_count {
        let idx = order[oi2 as usize]
        if pvis[idx as usize] == 1 {
            let a = mol.atoms[idx as usize]
            let depth = pd[idx as usize]

            // Chromatic depth cueing: blend CPK colour toward hue(depth) at weight 0.40.
            // dn ∈ [0,1]: near=0(red/H=0°), far=1(blue/H=240°)
            let dn = if fog_far > fog_near {
                let raw = (depth - fog_near) / (fog_far - fog_near)
                if raw < 0.0 { 0.0 } else if raw > 1.0 { 1.0 } else { raw }
            } else { 0.0 }
            let chroma_h = dn * 240.0
            let ch_r = m3_hsv_r(chroma_h)
            let ch_g = m3_hsv_g(chroma_h)
            let ch_b = m3_hsv_b(chroma_h)
            // Blend: 60% CPK + 40% chromatic
            let final_r = (a.r as f64 * 0.60 + ch_r as f64 * 0.40) as i64
            let final_g = (a.g as f64 * 0.60 + ch_g as f64 * 0.40) as i64
            let final_b = (a.b as f64 * 0.60 + ch_b as f64 * 0.40) as i64

            canvas_sphere_shaded_fog(c,
                px[idx as usize], py[idx as usize], prad[idx as usize],
                final_r, final_g, final_b,
                depth, fog_near, fog_far,
                18.0, 20.0, 30.0,
                ao[idx as usize])
        }
        oi2 = oi2 + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================
// B-factor coloring mode (F4)
// ============================================================
//
// Same render pipeline as mol3d_render but colours each atom by its
// crystallographic B-factor (temperature factor) in Å² instead of
// CPK colour.
//
// Color ramp (PyMOL convention): H = (1 - clamp(b/80, 0,1)) × 240°
//   b ≈ 0  → blue  (rigid, ordered)
//   b ≈ 40 → green (moderate)
//   b ≈ 80 → red   (flexible, disordered)
//
// bfactors: per-atom B-factor array, same length as mol.atom_count (≤ 64).

pub fn mol3d_render_bfactor(
    mol: &MoleculeViz,
    cam: &Camera3D,
    angle_y: f64,
    angle_x: f64,
    bfactors: &[f64; 64],
    c: &!Canvas,
) with Mut, Div {
    let cy2 = m3_cos(angle_y)
    let sy2 = m3_sin(angle_y)
    let cx2 = m3_cos(angle_x)
    let sx2 = m3_sin(angle_x)

    var px2: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var py2: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var pd2: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var pr2: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var pv2: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var br2: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var bg2: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var bb2: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < mol.atom_count {
        let a = mol.atoms[i as usize]
        let x1 = a.x * cy2 + a.z * sy2
        let y1 = a.y
        let z1 = 0.0 - a.x * sy2 + a.z * cy2
        let y22 = y1 * cx2 - z1 * sx2
        let z22 = y1 * sx2 + z1 * cx2
        let p = m3_project(x1, y22, z22, cam, c.width, c.height)
        if p.z > 0.0 {
            px2[i as usize] = p.x as i64
            py2[i as usize] = p.y as i64
            pd2[i as usize] = p.z
            let rs = (a.radius * cam.focal / p.z) as i64
            pr2[i as usize] = if rs < 3 { 3 } else if rs > 100 { 100 } else { rs }
            pv2[i as usize] = 1
            // B-factor colour: H = (1 - clamp(b/80)) × 240°
            let bf = bfactors[i as usize]
            let bs = if bf < 0.0 { 0.0 } else if bf > 80.0 { 1.0 } else { bf / 80.0 }
            let h_deg = (1.0 - bs) * 240.0
            br2[i as usize] = m3_hsv_r(h_deg)
            bg2[i as usize] = m3_hsv_g(h_deg)
            bb2[i as usize] = m3_hsv_b(h_deg)
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    var order2: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    m3_sort_desc(&pd2, mol.atom_count, &!order2)

    let fog_near2: f64 = 12.0
    let fog_far2:  f64 = 30.0

    // Silhouette pass
    var oi: i64 = 0
    while oi < mol.atom_count {
        let idx = order2[oi as usize]
        if pv2[idx as usize] == 1 {
            canvas_sphere_shaded(c, px2[idx as usize], py2[idx as usize],
                                  pr2[idx as usize] + 2, 30, 30, 42)
        }
        oi = oi + 1
    }

    // Lit pass with B-factor colours
    var oi2: i64 = 0
    while oi2 < mol.atom_count {
        let idx = order2[oi2 as usize]
        if pv2[idx as usize] == 1 {
            let depth = pd2[idx as usize]
            canvas_sphere_shaded_fog(c,
                px2[idx as usize], py2[idx as usize], pr2[idx as usize],
                br2[idx as usize], bg2[idx as usize], bb2[idx as usize],
                depth, fog_near2, fog_far2, 18.0, 20.0, 30.0, 0.0)
        }
        oi2 = oi2 + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================
// SSS rendering mode — organic tissue glow (F1 integration)
// ============================================================
//
// Renders using canvas_sphere_sss with per-atom transmitted colour.
// Default scatter tints: C→warm grey, N→cyan, O→orange, S→gold, H→white.

fn m3_trans_r(element_r: i64, element_g: i64, element_b: i64) -> i64 {
    // Transmitted tint = shifted toward warmer/complementary
    if element_b > 150 && element_r < 100 { 80 }    // blue N → cyan scatter
    else if element_r > 150 && element_b < 100 { 255 } // red O → orange scatter
    else { element_r + 30 }
}

fn m3_trans_g(element_r: i64, element_g: i64, element_b: i64) -> i64 {
    if element_b > 150 && element_r < 100 { 220 }  // N → cyan
    else if element_r > 150 && element_b < 100 { 140 } // O → orange
    else { element_g + 20 }
}

fn m3_trans_b(element_r: i64, element_g: i64, element_b: i64) -> i64 {
    if element_b > 150 && element_r < 100 { 220 }  // N stays blue-ish
    else if element_r > 150 && element_b < 100 { 60 } // O → orange (low blue)
    else { element_b }
}

pub fn mol3d_render_sss(
    mol: &MoleculeViz,
    cam: &Camera3D,
    angle_y: f64,
    angle_x: f64,
    c: &!Canvas,
) with Mut, Div {
    let cy3 = m3_cos(angle_y)
    let sy3 = m3_sin(angle_y)
    let cx3 = m3_cos(angle_x)
    let sx3 = m3_sin(angle_x)

    var px3: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var py3: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var pd3: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var pr3: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var pv3: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < mol.atom_count {
        let a = mol.atoms[i as usize]
        let x1 = a.x * cy3 + a.z * sy3
        let y1 = a.y
        let z1 = 0.0 - a.x * sy3 + a.z * cy3
        let y23 = y1 * cx3 - z1 * sx3
        let z23 = y1 * sx3 + z1 * cx3
        let p = m3_project(x1, y23, z23, cam, c.width, c.height)
        if p.z > 0.0 {
            px3[i as usize] = p.x as i64
            py3[i as usize] = p.y as i64
            pd3[i as usize] = p.z
            let rs = (a.radius * cam.focal / p.z) as i64
            pr3[i as usize] = if rs < 3 { 3 } else if rs > 100 { 100 } else { rs }
            pv3[i as usize] = 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    var order3: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    m3_sort_desc(&pd3, mol.atom_count, &!order3)

    var oi: i64 = 0
    while oi < mol.atom_count {
        let idx = order3[oi as usize]
        if pv3[idx as usize] == 1 {
            canvas_sphere_shaded(c, px3[idx as usize], py3[idx as usize],
                                  pr3[idx as usize] + 2, 20, 20, 35)
        }
        oi = oi + 1
    }

    var oi2: i64 = 0
    while oi2 < mol.atom_count {
        let idx = order3[oi2 as usize]
        if pv3[idx as usize] == 1 {
            let a = mol.atoms[idx as usize]
            let tr = m3_trans_r(a.r, a.g, a.b)
            let tg = m3_trans_g(a.r, a.g, a.b)
            let tb = m3_trans_b(a.r, a.g, a.b)
            canvas_sphere_sss(c,
                px3[idx as usize], py3[idx as usize], pr3[idx as usize],
                a.r, a.g, a.b, tr, tg, tb)
        }
        oi2 = oi2 + 1
    }
}

// mol3d_render_ao: SSS shading + precomputed AO darkening.
// ao[i] from mol3d_precompute_ao. AO contribution: darken by ao[i]*0.40.
pub fn mol3d_render_ao(
    mol: &MoleculeViz,
    cam: &Camera3D,
    angle_y: f64,
    angle_x: f64,
    ao: &[f64; 64],
    c: &!Canvas,
) with Mut, Div {
    let cy3 = m3_cos(angle_y)
    let sy3 = m3_sin(angle_y)
    let cx3 = m3_cos(angle_x)
    let sx3 = m3_sin(angle_x)

    var px3: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var py3: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var pd3: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var pr3: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var pv3: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < mol.atom_count {
        let a = mol.atoms[i as usize]
        let x1 = a.x * cy3 + a.z * sy3
        let y1 = a.y
        let z1 = 0.0 - a.x * sy3 + a.z * cy3
        let y23 = y1 * cx3 - z1 * sx3
        let z23 = y1 * sx3 + z1 * cx3
        let p = m3_project(x1, y23, z23, cam, c.width, c.height)
        if p.z > 0.0 {
            px3[i as usize] = p.x as i64
            py3[i as usize] = p.y as i64
            pd3[i as usize] = p.z
            let rs = (a.radius * cam.focal / p.z) as i64
            pr3[i as usize] = if rs < 3 { 3 } else if rs > 100 { 100 } else { rs }
            pv3[i as usize] = 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    var order3: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    m3_sort_desc(&pd3, mol.atom_count, &!order3)

    var oi: i64 = 0
    while oi < mol.atom_count {
        let idx = order3[oi as usize]
        if pv3[idx as usize] == 1 {
            canvas_sphere_shaded(c, px3[idx as usize], py3[idx as usize],
                                  pr3[idx as usize] + 2, 20, 20, 35)
        }
        oi = oi + 1
    }

    var oi2: i64 = 0
    while oi2 < mol.atom_count {
        let idx = order3[oi2 as usize]
        if pv3[idx as usize] == 1 {
            let a = mol.atoms[idx as usize]
            let ao_v = ao[idx as usize]
            let scale = 255 - (ao_v * 100.0) as i64
            let scale_cl = if scale < 60 { 60 } else if scale > 255 { 255 } else { scale }
            let ar = a.r * scale_cl / 255
            let ag = a.g * scale_cl / 255
            let ab = a.b * scale_cl / 255
            let tr = m3_trans_r(ar, ag, ab)
            let tg = m3_trans_g(ar, ag, ab)
            let tb = m3_trans_b(ar, ag, ab)
            canvas_sphere_sss(c,
                px3[idx as usize], py3[idx as usize], pr3[idx as usize],
                ar, ag, ab, tr, tg, tb)
        }
        oi2 = oi2 + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================
// Shadow + AO render — mol3d_render with precomputed shadow
// ============================================================
//
// Combines analytic soft shadows (from mol3d_precompute_shadow) with
// inline AO, chromatic depth cueing, and fog. The shadow pre-scales
// the diffuse component (ambient preserved at 0.30 even at shadow=0).

pub fn mol3d_render_shadow(
    mol: &MoleculeViz,
    cam: &Camera3D,
    angle_y: f64,
    angle_x: f64,
    shadow: &[f64; 64],
    c: &!Canvas,
) with Mut, Div {
    let cy5 = m3_cos(angle_y)
    let sy5 = m3_sin(angle_y)
    let cx5 = m3_cos(angle_x)
    let sx5 = m3_sin(angle_x)

    var px5:  [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var py5:  [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var pd5:  [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var pr5:  [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var pv5:  [i64; 64] = [0; 64]

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < mol.atom_count {
        let a = mol.atoms[i as usize]
        let x1 = a.x * cy5 + a.z * sy5
        let y1 = a.y
        let z1 = 0.0 - a.x * sy5 + a.z * cy5
        let y2 = y1 * cx5 - z1 * sx5
        let z2 = y1 * sx5 + z1 * cx5
        let p = m3_project(x1, y2, z2, cam, c.width, c.height)
        if p.z > 0.0 {
            px5[i as usize] = p.x as i64
            py5[i as usize] = p.y as i64
            pd5[i as usize] = p.z
            let rs = (a.radius * cam.focal / p.z) as i64
            pr5[i as usize] = if rs < 3 { 3 } else if rs > 100 { 100 } else { rs }
            pv5[i as usize] = 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Inline AO
    var ao5: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var ai: i64 = 0
    while ai < mol.atom_count {
        let aa5 = mol.atoms[ai as usize]
        var acc: f64 = 0.0
        var bj: i64 = 0
        while bj < mol.atom_count {
            if bj != ai {
                let ab5 = mol.atoms[bj as usize]
                let ddx = ab5.x - aa5.x
                let ddy = ab5.y - aa5.y
                let ddz = ab5.z - aa5.z
                let dist2 = ddx*ddx + ddy*ddy + ddz*ddz
                if dist2 > 0.0 {
                    acc = acc + (ab5.radius * ab5.radius) / dist2
                }
            }
            bj = bj + 1
        }
        let raw = acc * 0.30
        ao5[ai as usize] = if raw > 1.0 { 1.0 } else { raw }
        ai = ai + 1
    }

    var order5: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    m3_sort_desc(&pd5, mol.atom_count, &!order5)

    let fog_near5: f64 = 12.0
    let fog_far5:  f64 = 30.0

    // Silhouette pass
    var oi: i64 = 0
    while oi < mol.atom_count {
        let idx = order5[oi as usize]
        if pv5[idx as usize] == 1 {
            canvas_sphere_shaded(c, px5[idx as usize], py5[idx as usize],
                                  pr5[idx as usize] + 2, 30, 30, 42)
        }
        oi = oi + 1
    }

    // Lit pass: shadow × AO pre-scale + chromatic depth + fog
    var oi2: i64 = 0
    while oi2 < mol.atom_count {
        let idx = order5[oi2 as usize]
        if pv5[idx as usize] == 1 {
            let a = mol.atoms[idx as usize]
            let depth = pd5[idx as usize]
            let ao_v = ao5[idx as usize]
            let sh_v = shadow[idx as usize]
            // Shadow preserves 0.30 ambient (matches sphere shader ambient=0.32 approx)
            let sh_sc = 0.30 + 0.70 * sh_v
            let ao_sc = 1.0 - 0.40 * ao_v
            let sc_f = sh_sc * ao_sc
            let sc_i = (sc_f * 255.0) as i64
            let sc = if sc_i < 45 { 45 } else if sc_i > 255 { 255 } else { sc_i }
            let ar = a.r * sc / 255
            let ag = a.g * sc / 255
            let ab = a.b * sc / 255
            // Chromatic depth cueing
            let dn = if fog_far5 > fog_near5 {
                let raw = (depth - fog_near5) / (fog_far5 - fog_near5)
                if raw < 0.0 { 0.0 } else if raw > 1.0 { 1.0 } else { raw }
            } else { 0.0 }
            let ch = dn * 240.0
            let final_r = (ar as f64 * 0.60 + m3_hsv_r(ch) as f64 * 0.40) as i64
            let final_g = (ag as f64 * 0.60 + m3_hsv_g(ch) as f64 * 0.40) as i64
            let final_b = (ab as f64 * 0.60 + m3_hsv_b(ch) as f64 * 0.40) as i64
            canvas_sphere_shaded_fog(c,
                px5[idx as usize], py5[idx as usize], pr5[idx as usize],
                final_r, final_g, final_b,
                depth, fog_near5, fog_far5, 18.0, 20.0, 30.0, 0.0)
        }
        oi2 = oi2 + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================
// Hydrogen bond visualization
// ============================================================
//
// Detects N/O···N/O heavy-atom pairs within H-bond range (2.5–3.5 Å)
// that are not covalently bonded, then renders dashed yellow lines.
// Uses atomic_number: N=7, O=8.

pub fn mol3d_render_hbonds(
    mol: &MoleculeViz,
    cam: &Camera3D,
    angle_y: f64,
    angle_x: f64,
    c: &!Canvas,
) with Mut, Div {
    let cy6 = m3_cos(angle_y)
    let sy6 = m3_sin(angle_y)
    let cx6 = m3_cos(angle_x)
    let sx6 = m3_sin(angle_x)

    var hsx: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var hsy: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var hvis: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < mol.atom_count {
        let a = mol.atoms[i as usize]
        let x1 = a.x * cy6 + a.z * sy6
        let y1 = a.y
        let z1 = 0.0 - a.x * sy6 + a.z * cy6
        let y2 = y1 * cx6 - z1 * sx6
        let z2 = y1 * sx6 + z1 * cx6
        let p = m3_project(x1, y2, z2, cam, c.width, c.height)
        if p.z > 0.0 {
            hsx[i as usize] = p.x as i64
            hsy[i as usize] = p.y as i64
            hvis[i as usize] = 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Detect and render H-bond pairs
    var di: i64 = 0
    while di < mol.atom_count {
        let da = mol.atoms[di as usize]
        if da.atomic_number != 7 && da.atomic_number != 8 {
            di = di + 1
            continue
        }
        var ai: i64 = di + 1
        while ai < mol.atom_count {
            let aa = mol.atoms[ai as usize]
            if aa.atomic_number != 7 && aa.atomic_number != 8 {
                ai = ai + 1
                continue
            }
            let ddx = aa.x - da.x
            let ddy = aa.y - da.y
            let ddz = aa.z - da.z
            let dist2 = ddx*ddx + ddy*ddy + ddz*ddz
            // H-bond range: 2.5–3.5 Å → dist² ∈ [6.25, 12.25]; skip if < 1 Å (covalent overlap)
            if dist2 >= 6.25 && dist2 <= 12.25 {
                var is_bond: i64 = 0
                var bi: i64 = 0
                while bi < mol.bond_count {
                    let bnd = mol.bonds[bi as usize]
                    if (bnd.atom_a == di && bnd.atom_b == ai) || (bnd.atom_a == ai && bnd.atom_b == di) {
                        is_bond = 1
                    }
                    bi = bi + 1
                }
                if is_bond == 0 && hvis[di as usize] == 1 && hvis[ai as usize] == 1 {
                    let x0s = hsx[di as usize]
                    let y0s = hsy[di as usize]
                    let x1s = hsx[ai as usize]
                    let y1s = hsy[ai as usize]
                    let dx_s = x1s - x0s
                    let dy_s = y1s - y0s
                    let adx = if dx_s < 0 { 0 - dx_s } else { dx_s }
                    let ady = if dy_s < 0 { 0 - dy_s } else { dy_s }
                    let steps = if adx > ady { adx } else { ady }
                    if steps > 0 {
                        var si: i64 = 0
                        while si <= steps {
                            if si % 8 < 4 {
                                let px6 = x0s + dx_s * si / steps
                                let py6 = y0s + dy_s * si / steps
                                canvas_blend_pixel(c, px6, py6, 255, 220, 50, 220)
                            }
                            si = si + 1
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            ai = ai + 1
        }
        di = di + 1
    }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/viz/physchem.sio ===
// stdlib/viz/physchem.sio — Physico-chemistry visualization data layer
//
// Molecules, fields, spectra, trajectories, and uncertainty overlays are
// represented as Sounio data. Renderers can lower these structs to Visual IR.

use units::lib::{Quantity, UnitDim, dim_dimensionless}
use epistemic::knowledge::{Epistemic}

pub struct AtomViz {
    pub atomic_number: i64,
    pub x: f64,
    pub y: f64,
    pub z: f64,
    pub radius: f64,
    pub charge: Epistemic,
    pub r: i64,
    pub g: i64,
    pub b: i64,
}

pub struct BondViz {
    pub atom_a: i64,
    pub atom_b: i64,
    pub order: i64,
    pub length: Quantity,
    pub variance: f64,
}

pub struct MoleculeViz {
    pub atoms: [AtomViz; 64],
    pub bonds: [BondViz; 96],
    pub atom_count: i64,
    pub bond_count: i64,
}

pub struct ScalarField2D {
    pub values: [f64; 4096],
    pub variances: [f64; 4096],
    pub rows: i64,
    pub cols: i64,
    pub unit: UnitDim,
    pub min_value: f64,
    pub max_value: f64,
}

pub struct VectorField2D {
    pub vx: [f64; 4096],
    pub vy: [f64; 4096],
    pub variance: [f64; 4096],
    pub rows: i64,
    pub cols: i64,
    pub unit: UnitDim,
}

pub struct Trajectory3D {
    pub x: [f64; 1024],
    pub y: [f64; 1024],
    pub z: [f64; 1024],
    pub t: [f64; 1024],
    pub variance: [f64; 1024],
    pub n: i64,
}

pub struct SpectrumViz {
    pub x: [f64; 1024],
    pub intensity: [f64; 1024],
    pub variance: [f64; 1024],
    pub n: i64,
    pub x_min: f64,
    pub x_max: f64,
    pub y_min: f64,
    pub y_max: f64,
    pub unit: UnitDim,
}

pub struct LatticeField2D {
    pub rows: i64,
    pub cols: i64,
    pub displacement_x: [f64; 4096],
    pub displacement_y: [f64; 4096],
    pub phase: [f64; 4096],
    pub variance: [f64; 4096],
    pub unit: UnitDim,
}

pub struct ParticleEventView {
    pub x: [f64; 1024],
    pub y: [f64; 1024],
    pub z: [f64; 1024],
    pub energy: [f64; 1024],
    pub variance: [f64; 1024],
    pub kind: [i64; 1024],
    pub n: i64,
    pub unit: UnitDim,
}

pub fn atom_viz_default(z: i64, x: f64, y: f64, zz: f64) -> AtomViz {
    AtomViz {
        atomic_number: z, x: x, y: y, z: zz, radius: 1.0,
        charge: Epistemic::certain(0.0),
        r: if z == 1 { 230 } else if z == 6 { 120 } else if z == 8 { 230 } else { 120 },
        g: if z == 1 { 230 } else if z == 6 { 135 } else if z == 8 { 70 } else { 160 },
        b: if z == 1 { 240 } else if z == 6 { 150 } else if z == 8 { 70 } else { 220 },
    }
}

pub fn bond_viz(a: i64, b: i64, order: i64, length_value: f64, length_uncertainty: f64) -> BondViz {
    BondViz {
        atom_a: a, atom_b: b, order: order,
        length: Quantity { value: length_value, uncertainty: length_uncertainty, dim: dim_dimensionless() },
        variance: length_uncertainty * length_uncertainty,
    }
}

pub fn molecule_empty() -> MoleculeViz {
    MoleculeViz {
        atoms: [atom_viz_default(0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0); 64],
        bonds: [bond_viz(0, 0, 0, 0.0, 0.0); 96],
        atom_count: 0,
        bond_count: 0,
    }
}

pub fn molecule_h2o() -> MoleculeViz with Mut {
    var m = molecule_empty()
    m.atoms[0] = atom_viz_default(8, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    m.atoms[1] = atom_viz_default(1, 0.95, 0.35, 0.0)
    m.atoms[2] = atom_viz_default(1, -0.95, 0.35, 0.0)
    m.bonds[0] = bond_viz(0, 1, 1, 0.096, 0.002)
    m.bonds[1] = bond_viz(0, 2, 1, 0.096, 0.002)
    m.atom_count = 3
    m.bond_count = 2
    m
}

// ─── Rapamycin (sirolimus) coarse 3D representation ─────────────────────────
//
// 44 heavy atoms: 31-membered macrolide ring + pipecolinyl (6-membered) +
// 8 key substituent oxygens placed radially outward.
// Coordinates are approximate idealised macrolide geometry; for crystallographic
// accuracy see PDB:1NSG.
//
// Split into helpers to stay within the per-function local-variable budget.

fn rap_fmod(x: f64, mdl: f64) -> f64 with Div {
    x - ((x / mdl) as i64 as f64) * mdl
}

fn rap_sin(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    let pi2: f64 = 6.28318530718
    let pi:  f64 = 3.14159265359
    var t = rap_fmod(x, pi2)
    if t > pi       { t = t - pi2 }
    if t < 0.0 - pi { t = t + pi2 }
    let t2 = t * t
    t * (1.0 - t2 * (1.0 / 6.0 - t2 * (1.0 / 120.0 - t2 / 5040.0)))
}

fn rap_cos(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    rap_sin(x + 1.57079632679)
}

// Fills the 31-membered macrolide ring (atoms 0-30) into m.
fn rap_fill_ring(m: &!MoleculeViz, step: f64) with Mut, Div {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 31 {
        let theta = (i as f64) * step
        let rx = 6.5 * rap_cos(theta)
        let ry = 5.0 * rap_sin(theta)
        let rz = 0.6 * rap_sin(theta * 2.0)
        let az = if i == 0 || i == 9 || i == 18 || i == 26 { 8 } else if i == 30 { 7 } else { 6 }
        m.atoms[i as usize] = atom_viz_default(az, rx, ry, rz)
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Fills pipecolinyl ring (atoms 31-35; N = atom 30) into m.
fn rap_fill_pip(m: &!MoleculeViz, step: f64) with Mut, Div {
    let n_theta = 30.0 * step
    let pip_cx = 6.5 * rap_cos(n_theta) + 2.8
    let pip_cy = 5.0 * rap_sin(n_theta) - 0.5
    let pip_cz = 0.6 * rap_sin(n_theta * 2.0)
    let pip_step: f64 = 1.04720
    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < 5 {
        let th = (j as f64) * pip_step + 0.52
        let px = pip_cx + 1.3 * rap_cos(th)
        let py = pip_cy + 1.3 * rap_sin(th)
        m.atoms[(31 + j) as usize] = atom_viz_default(6, px, py, pip_cz - 0.1)
        j = j + 1
    }
}

// Fills 8 substituent oxygens (atoms 36-43) into m.
fn rap_fill_subs(m: &!MoleculeViz, step: f64) with Mut, Div {
    var k: i64 = 0
    while k < 8 {
        let si = if k == 0 { 3 } else if k == 1 { 6 } else if k == 2 { 10 }
                 else if k == 3 { 14 } else if k == 4 { 17 } else if k == 5 { 21 }
                 else if k == 6 { 24 } else { 27 }
        let stheta = (si as f64) * step
        let sx = 8.2 * rap_cos(stheta)
        let sy = 6.7 * rap_sin(stheta)
        let sz = 0.6 * rap_sin(stheta * 2.0) + 0.6
        m.atoms[(36 + k) as usize] = atom_viz_default(8, sx, sy, sz)
        k = k + 1
    }
}

// Fills macrolide + pipecolinyl bonds (indices 0-36) into m.
fn rap_fill_bonds(m: &!MoleculeViz) with Mut {
    var b: i64 = 0
    while b < 30 {
        m.bonds[b as usize] = bond_viz(b, b + 1, 1, 1.52, 0.02)
        b = b + 1
    }
    m.bonds[30] = bond_viz(30, 0, 1, 1.52, 0.02)
    m.bonds[31] = bond_viz(30, 31, 1, 1.47, 0.02)
    m.bonds[32] = bond_viz(31, 32, 1, 1.52, 0.02)
    m.bonds[33] = bond_viz(32, 33, 1, 1.52, 0.02)
    m.bonds[34] = bond_viz(33, 34, 1, 1.52, 0.02)
    m.bonds[35] = bond_viz(34, 35, 1, 1.52, 0.02)
    m.bonds[36] = bond_viz(35, 30, 1, 1.47, 0.02)
}

// Fills substituent bonds (indices 37-44) into m.
fn rap_fill_sub_bonds(m: &!MoleculeViz) with Mut {
    var sk: i64 = 0
    while sk < 8 {
        let sri = if sk == 0 { 3 } else if sk == 1 { 6 } else if sk == 2 { 10 }
                  else if sk == 3 { 14 } else if sk == 4 { 17 } else if sk == 5 { 21 }
                  else if sk == 6 { 24 } else { 27 }
        m.bonds[(37 + sk) as usize] = bond_viz(sri, 36 + sk, 1, 1.35, 0.02)
        sk = sk + 1
    }
}

pub fn molecule_rapamycin_coarse() -> MoleculeViz with Mut, Div {
    var m = molecule_empty()
    let step: f64 = 0.20270    // 2π/31
    rap_fill_ring(&!m, step)
    rap_fill_pip(&!m, step)
    rap_fill_subs(&!m, step)
    m.atom_count = 44
    rap_fill_bonds(&!m)
    rap_fill_sub_bonds(&!m)
    m.bond_count = 45
    m
}

pub fn scalar_field_empty(rows: i64, cols: i64) -> ScalarField2D {
    ScalarField2D {
        values: [0.0; 4096], variances: [0.0; 4096],
        rows: rows, cols: cols, unit: dim_dimensionless(),
        min_value: 0.0, max_value: 1.0,
    }
}

pub fn scalar_field_radial(rows: i64, cols: i64) -> ScalarField2D with Mut, Div {
    var f = scalar_field_empty(rows, cols)
    var r: i64 = 0
    while r < rows {
        var c: i64 = 0
        while c < cols {
            let dx = (c as f64) - (cols as f64) * 0.5
            let dy = (r as f64) - (rows as f64) * 0.5
            let v = dx * dx + dy * dy
            let idx = r * cols + c
            f.values[idx as usize] = v
            f.variances[idx as usize] = v * 0.001
            if idx == 0 || v < f.min_value { f.min_value = v }
            if idx == 0 || v > f.max_value { f.max_value = v }
            c = c + 1
        }
        r = r + 1
    }
    f
}

pub fn vector_field_empty(rows: i64, cols: i64) -> VectorField2D {
    VectorField2D {
        vx: [0.0; 4096], vy: [0.0; 4096], variance: [0.0; 4096],
        rows: rows, cols: cols, unit: dim_dimensionless(),
    }
}

pub fn vector_field_vortex(rows: i64, cols: i64) -> VectorField2D with Mut, Div {
    var f = vector_field_empty(rows, cols)
    var r: i64 = 0
    while r < rows {
        var c: i64 = 0
        while c < cols {
            let dx = (c as f64) - (cols as f64) * 0.5
            let dy = (r as f64) - (rows as f64) * 0.5
            let idx = r * cols + c
            f.vx[idx as usize] = 0.0 - dy
            f.vy[idx as usize] = dx
            f.variance[idx as usize] = (dx * dx + dy * dy) * 0.0005
            c = c + 1
        }
        r = r + 1
    }
    f
}

pub fn trajectory_empty() -> Trajectory3D {
    Trajectory3D {
        x: [0.0; 1024], y: [0.0; 1024], z: [0.0; 1024],
        t: [0.0; 1024], variance: [0.0; 1024], n: 0,
    }
}

pub fn trajectory_spiral(n: i64) -> Trajectory3D with Mut, Div {
    var tr = trajectory_empty()
    var count = n
    if count > 1024 { count = 1024 }
    tr.n = count
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < count {
        let theta = (i as f64) * 0.35
        let radius = 0.25 + (i as f64) * 0.01
        tr.x[i as usize] = radius * rap_cos(theta)
        tr.y[i as usize] = radius * rap_sin(theta)
        tr.z[i as usize] = (i as f64) * 0.02
        tr.t[i as usize] = i as f64
        tr.variance[i as usize] = (i as f64) * 0.0001
        i = i + 1
    }
    tr
}

pub fn spectrum_empty() -> SpectrumViz {
    SpectrumViz {
        x: [0.0; 1024], intensity: [0.0; 1024], variance: [0.0; 1024],
        n: 0, x_min: 0.0, x_max: 1.0, y_min: 0.0, y_max: 1.0,
        unit: dim_dimensionless(),
    }
}

pub fn spectrum_absorption_demo(n: i64) -> SpectrumViz with Mut, Div {
    var s = spectrum_empty()
    var count = n
    if count > 1024 { count = 1024 }
    s.n = count
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < count {
        let x = 350.0 + (i as f64) * 4.0
        let peak_a = 1.0 / (1.0 + ((x - 430.0) * (x - 430.0)) / 900.0)
        let peak_b = 0.7 / (1.0 + ((x - 610.0) * (x - 610.0)) / 1600.0)
        let y = peak_a + peak_b
        s.x[i as usize] = x
        s.intensity[i as usize] = y
        s.variance[i as usize] = y * 0.002
        if i == 0 || x < s.x_min { s.x_min = x }
        if i == 0 || x > s.x_max { s.x_max = x }
        if i == 0 || y < s.y_min { s.y_min = y }
        if i == 0 || y > s.y_max { s.y_max = y }
        i = i + 1
    }
    s
}

pub fn lattice_field_empty(rows: i64, cols: i64) -> LatticeField2D {
    LatticeField2D {
        rows: rows, cols: cols,
        displacement_x: [0.0; 4096], displacement_y: [0.0; 4096],
        phase: [0.0; 4096], variance: [0.0; 4096],
        unit: dim_dimensionless(),
    }
}

pub fn lattice_field_phonon_demo(rows: i64, cols: i64) -> LatticeField2D with Mut, Div {
    var field = lattice_field_empty(rows, cols)
    var r: i64 = 0
    while r < rows {
        var c: i64 = 0
        while c < cols {
            let idx = r * cols + c
            field.phase[idx as usize] = ((r + c) as f64) * 0.25
            field.displacement_x[idx as usize] = ((c as f64) - (cols as f64) * 0.5) * 0.02
            field.displacement_y[idx as usize] = ((r as f64) - (rows as f64) * 0.5) * 0.02
            field.variance[idx as usize] = 0.001 + (idx as f64) * 0.0001
            c = c + 1
        }
        r = r + 1
    }
    field
}

pub fn particle_event_view_empty() -> ParticleEventView {
    ParticleEventView {
        x: [0.0; 1024], y: [0.0; 1024], z: [0.0; 1024],
        energy: [0.0; 1024], variance: [0.0; 1024],
        kind: [0; 1024], n: 0, unit: dim_dimensionless(),
    }
}

pub fn particle_event_view_demo(n: i64) -> ParticleEventView with Mut, Div {
    var events = particle_event_view_empty()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n && i < 1024 {
        events.x[i as usize] = (i as f64) * 0.1
        events.y[i as usize] = ((i * i) as f64) * 0.01
        events.z[i as usize] = (i as f64) * 0.02
        events.energy[i as usize] = 1.0 + (i as f64) * 0.05
        events.variance[i as usize] = 0.01 + (i as f64) * 0.001
        events.kind[i as usize] = i % 3
        i = i + 1
    }
    events.n = i
    events
}


// === FILE: stdlib/viz/sci.sio ===
// stdlib/viz/sci.sio — Domain-specific scientific visualizations
//
// Specialised chart types for Sounio's physics and epistemic types:
//   sci_lattice_heatmap   — Lattice64 as a 64-column heatmap
//   sci_lattice_variance  — Lattice64 variance as a second heatmap layer
//   sci_pbpk_series       — PBPK concentration-time with GUM uncertainty bands
//   sci_mcmc_trace        — trace plot for one parameter of an MCMCChain
//   sci_mcmc_histogram    — posterior histogram for one parameter

use display::canvas::{Canvas, canvas_fill_rect}
use display::canvas_ext::{canvas_draw_line_aa}
use viz::coord::{CoordSystem, coord_map_x, coord_map_y}
use physics::phonon_quantity::{Lattice64}

// ============================================================
// Internal helpers
// ============================================================

fn sci_clamp(v: i64, lo: i64, hi: i64) -> i64 {
    if v < lo { lo } else if v > hi { hi } else { v }
}

fn sci_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 {
        y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
        i = i + 1
    }
    y
}

// Colormap: blue (cold, low) → red (hot, high)
fn sci_heatmap_r(t: i64) -> i64 {
    if t < 128 { t * 2 } else { 255 }
}

fn sci_heatmap_g(t: i64) -> i64 {
    if t < 64 { 0 }
    else if t < 128 { (t - 64) * 4 }
    else if t < 192 { 255 - (t - 128) * 4 }
    else { 0 }
}

fn sci_heatmap_b(t: i64) -> i64 {
    if t < 128 { 255 - t * 2 } else { 0 }
}

// Variance overlay: orange tint proportional to variance ratio.
fn sci_variance_r(t: i64) -> i64 { 220 }
fn sci_variance_g(t: i64) -> i64 { sci_clamp(180 - t, 60, 180) }
fn sci_variance_b(t: i64) -> i64 { 0 }

// ============================================================
// Lattice64 heatmap — 64 sites as columns, value as color
// ============================================================

pub fn sci_lattice_heatmap(
    cs: &CoordSystem,
    lat: &Lattice64,
    c: &!Canvas,
) with Mut, Div {
    let n = lat.n
    if n == 0 { return }

    // Find min/max across sites
    var vmin = lat.values[0]
    var vmax = lat.values[0]
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < n {
        let v = lat.values[i as usize]
        if v < vmin { vmin = v }
        if v > vmax { vmax = v }
        i = i + 1
    }
    let range = if vmax > vmin { vmax - vmin } else { 1.0 }

    let cell_w = cs.screen_w / n
    let cw = if cell_w < 1 { 1 } else { cell_w }

    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < n {
        let v = lat.values[j as usize]
        let t = sci_clamp(((v - vmin) / range * 255.0) as i64, 0, 255)
        let cr = sci_heatmap_r(t)
        let cg = sci_heatmap_g(t)
        let cb = sci_heatmap_b(t)
        canvas_fill_rect(c, cs.screen_x + j * cw, cs.screen_y, cw, cs.screen_h, cr, cg, cb)
        j = j + 1
    }
}

// Draw variance as a semi-transparent orange overlay on top of an existing heatmap.
pub fn sci_lattice_variance(
    cs: &CoordSystem,
    lat: &Lattice64,
    c: &!Canvas,
) with Mut, Div {
    let n = lat.n
    if n == 0 { return }

    var vmax: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        let v = lat.variances[i as usize]
        if v > vmax { vmax = v }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if vmax == 0.0 { return }

    let cell_w = cs.screen_w / n
    let cw = if cell_w < 1 { 1 } else { cell_w }

    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < n {
        let var_v = lat.variances[j as usize]
        let t = sci_clamp((var_v / vmax * 255.0) as i64, 0, 255)
        // Overlay only upper portion of cell proportional to variance
        let overlay_h = sci_clamp(t * cs.screen_h / 255, 1, cs.screen_h)
        canvas_fill_rect(
            c,
            cs.screen_x + j * cw,
            cs.screen_y,
            cw, overlay_h,
            sci_variance_r(t), sci_variance_g(t), sci_variance_b(t),
        )
        j = j + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================
// PBPK time series with GUM uncertainty bands
// ============================================================
//
// vals[i], uncerts[i]: concentration value and GUM standard uncertainty
// times[i]: time in data-space units

pub fn sci_pbpk_series(
    cs: &CoordSystem,
    vals: &[f64; 1024],
    uncerts: &[f64; 1024],
    times: &[f64; 1024],
    n: i64,
    c: &!Canvas,
) with Mut, Div {
    if n < 2 { return }

    // Draw uncertainty envelope (band between val-u and val+u)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        let sx   = coord_map_x(cs, times[i as usize])
        let y_lo = coord_map_y(cs, vals[i as usize] - uncerts[i as usize])
        let y_hi = coord_map_y(cs, vals[i as usize] + uncerts[i as usize])
        let top    = if y_hi < y_lo { y_hi } else { y_lo }
        let bottom = if y_hi > y_lo { y_hi } else { y_lo }
        // Alternating-pixel transparency trick (every other pixel)
        var py = top
        while py <= bottom {
            if (sx + py) % 2 == 0 {
                canvas_fill_rect(c, sx - 1, py, 3, 1, 80, 160, 220)
            }
            py = py + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Draw center line (solid blue-white)
    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < n - 1 {
        let sx0 = coord_map_x(cs, times[j as usize])
        let sy0 = coord_map_y(cs, vals[j as usize])
        let sx1 = coord_map_x(cs, times[(j + 1) as usize])
        let sy1 = coord_map_y(cs, vals[(j + 1) as usize])
        canvas_draw_line_aa(c, sx0, sy0, sx1, sy1, 120, 200, 255)
        j = j + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================
// MCMC trace plot — param_idx column of chain.samples
// ============================================================
//
// MCMCChain struct layout (as defined in stdlib/epistemic/mcmc.sio):
//   samples: [f64; 65536]   -- flat: samples[sample_i * n_params + param_j]
//   n_samples: i64
//   n_params:  i64
//
// We accept the samples array directly to avoid importing the full MCMCChain.

pub fn sci_mcmc_trace(
    cs: &CoordSystem,
    samples: &[f64; 65536],
    n_samples: i64,
    n_params: i64,
    param_idx: i64,
    c: &!Canvas,
) with Mut, Div {
    if n_samples < 2 { return }
    // Build x-axis (sample index) and y-axis (parameter value) arrays
    // Draw as a line chart directly to avoid large stack allocations
    var prev_sx = coord_map_x(cs, 0.0)
    var prev_sy = coord_map_y(cs, samples[(param_idx) as usize])
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < n_samples {
        let idx = (i * n_params + param_idx) as usize
        let val = samples[idx]
        let sx = coord_map_x(cs, i as f64)
        let sy = coord_map_y(cs, val)
        canvas_draw_line_aa(c, prev_sx, prev_sy, sx, sy, 100, 200, 160)
        prev_sx = sx
        prev_sy = sy
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================
// MCMC posterior histogram for one parameter
// ============================================================

pub fn sci_mcmc_histogram(
    cs: &CoordSystem,
    samples: &[f64; 65536],
    n_samples: i64,
    n_params: i64,
    param_idx: i64,
    n_bins: i64,
    c: &!Canvas,
) with Mut, Div {
    if n_samples == 0 || n_bins <= 0 { return }

    // Find range
    var vmin = samples[param_idx as usize]
    var vmax = samples[param_idx as usize]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n_samples {
        let v = samples[(i * n_params + param_idx) as usize]
        if v < vmin { vmin = v }
        if v > vmax { vmax = v }
        i = i + 1
    }
    let range = if vmax > vmin { vmax - vmin } else { 1.0 }

    // Bin counts (up to 64 bins)
    let nb = if n_bins > 64 { 64 } else { n_bins }
    var counts: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < n_samples {
        let v = samples[(j * n_params + param_idx) as usize]
        let bin = sci_clamp(((v - vmin) / range * (nb as f64)) as i64, 0, nb - 1)
        counts[bin as usize] = counts[bin as usize] + 1
        j = j + 1
    }

    // Find max count for normalization
    var max_count: i64 = 1
    var k: i64 = 0
    while k < nb {
        if counts[k as usize] > max_count { max_count = counts[k as usize] }
        k = k + 1
    }

    // Draw bars
    let bar_w = cs.screen_w / nb
    let bw = if bar_w < 1 { 1 } else { bar_w }
    var m: i64 = 0
    while m < nb {
        let bar_h = sci_clamp(counts[m as usize] * cs.screen_h / max_count, 1, cs.screen_h)
        let px = cs.screen_x + m * bw
        let py = cs.screen_y + cs.screen_h - bar_h
        canvas_fill_rect(c, px, py, bw - 1, bar_h, 100, 180, 255)
        m = m + 1
    }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/viz/viz_app.sio ===
// stdlib/viz/viz_app.sio - small native app runner over Visual IR
//
// This is the headless-testable bridge for future native windows:
// display::event::Event -> viz::ir::VizScene -> display::Canvas.

use display::canvas::{Canvas, canvas_clear}
use display::event::{Event, EV_CLOSE, EV_EXPOSE}
use viz::ir::{VizScene, viz_scene_handle_event}
use viz::viz_canvas::{viz_canvas_render_scene}

pub struct VizApp {
    pub running: bool,
    pub dirty: bool,
    pub frame: i64,
    pub bg_r: i64,
    pub bg_g: i64,
    pub bg_b: i64,
}

pub fn viz_app_new(bg_r: i64, bg_g: i64, bg_b: i64) -> VizApp {
    VizApp {
        running: true,
        dirty: true,
        frame: 0,
        bg_r: bg_r,
        bg_g: bg_g,
        bg_b: bg_b,
    }
}

pub fn viz_app_handle_event(app: &!VizApp, scene: &!VizScene, ev: Event) -> bool with Mut, Div {
    if ev.kind == EV_CLOSE {
        app.running = false
        app.dirty = false
        return true
    }
    if ev.kind == EV_EXPOSE {
        app.dirty = true
        return true
    }
    let changed = viz_scene_handle_event(scene, ev)
    if changed {
        app.dirty = true
    }
    changed
}

pub fn viz_app_render(app: &!VizApp, scene: &!VizScene, c: &!Canvas) with Mut, Div, Alloc {
    if !app.dirty { return }
    canvas_clear(c, app.bg_r, app.bg_g, app.bg_b)
    viz_canvas_render_scene(scene, c)
    app.frame = app.frame + 1
    app.dirty = false
}

fn viz_app_read_px(c: &Canvas, x: i64, y: i64) -> i64 {
    if x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= c.width || y >= c.height { return 0 }
    read_i64(c.pixels, y * c.width + x)
}

pub fn viz_app_frame_hash(app: &VizApp, scene: &VizScene, c: &Canvas) -> i64 with Mut {
    var h: i64 = 17
    h = h * 131 + app.frame
    h = h * 131 + scene.node_count
    h = h * 131 + scene.selected_node
    h = h * 131 + scene.hovered_node
    h = h * 131 + scene.focused_node
    h = h * 131 + scene.active_tab
    h = h * 131 + scene.time as i64
    h = h * 131 + viz_app_read_px(c, 0, 0)
    h = h * 131 + viz_app_read_px(c, c.width / 2, c.height / 2)
    h = h * 131 + viz_app_read_px(c, c.width - 1, c.height - 1)
    return h
}

pub fn viz_app_step(app: &!VizApp, scene: &!VizScene, c: &!Canvas, ev: Event) -> bool with Mut, Div, Alloc {
    viz_app_handle_event(app, scene, ev)
    viz_app_render(app, scene, c)
    app.running
}

use viz::ir::{
    VizScene, VizNode,
    VIZ_NODE_PANEL, VIZ_NODE_CHART_LINE, VIZ_NODE_CHART_SCATTER, VIZ_NODE_CHART_BAR,
    VIZ_NODE_HEATMAP, VIZ_NODE_UNCERTAINTY_BAND, VIZ_NODE_LABEL, VIZ_NODE_CONTROL,
