    VIZ_NODE_MOLECULE, VIZ_NODE_FIELD, VIZ_NODE_VECTOR_FIELD, VIZ_NODE_TRAJECTORY, VIZ_NODE_SPECTRUM, VIZ_NODE_MESH,
    VIZ_CONTROL_SLIDER, VIZ_CONTROL_TOGGLE, VIZ_CONTROL_TABS, VIZ_CONTROL_LEGEND,
    VIZ_CONTROL_BUTTON, VIZ_CONTROL_TOOLTIP, VIZ_CONTROL_VIEWPORT
}

fn vc_pad_range_min(v: f64) -> f64 { v - 0.001 }
fn vc_pad_range_max(v: f64) -> f64 { v + 0.001 }

fn vc_draw_panel(c: &!Canvas, node: &VizNode) with Mut {
    canvas_fill_rect(c, node.layout.x, node.layout.y, node.layout.w, node.layout.h, 18, 22, 28)
    canvas_draw_rect(c, node.layout.x, node.layout.y, node.layout.w, node.layout.h, 80, 95, 110)
}

fn vc_draw_control(c: &!Canvas, node: &VizNode) with Mut, Div {
    let x = node.layout.x
    let y = node.layout.y
    let w = node.layout.w
    let h = node.layout.h
    if node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_SLIDER {
        canvas_fill_rect(c, x, y + h / 2 - 2, w, 4, 55, 60, 70)
        let span = node.max_value - node.min_value
        let frac = if span == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (node.value - node.min_value) / span }
        let knob_x = x + (frac * (w as f64)) as i64
        canvas_fill_rect(c, knob_x - 3, y, 7, h, node.style.r, node.style.g, node.style.b)
    } else if node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_TOGGLE {
        canvas_draw_rect(c, x, y, w, h, 130, 150, 160)
        if node.value > 0.0 {
            canvas_fill_rect(c, x + 3, y + 3, w - 6, h - 6, node.style.r, node.style.g, node.style.b)
        }
    } else if node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_TABS {
        canvas_fill_rect(c, x, y, w, h, 40, 48, 58)
        let min_i = node.min_value as i64
        let max_i = node.max_value as i64
        var count = max_i - min_i + 1
        if count <= 0 { count = 1 }
        let tab_w = if w / count <= 0 { 1 } else { w / count }
        var active = node.value as i64
        if active < min_i { active = min_i }
        if active > max_i { active = max_i }
        canvas_fill_rect(c, x + (active - min_i) * tab_w, y, tab_w, h, node.style.r, node.style.g, node.style.b)
        canvas_draw_rect(c, x, y, w, h, 120, 135, 150)
    } else if node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_LEGEND {
        canvas_draw_rect(c, x, y, w, h, 120, 135, 150)
        canvas_fill_rect(c, x + 4, y + h / 2 - 3, 10, 6, node.style.r, node.style.g, node.style.b)
        vc_draw_label(c, node)
    } else if node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_TOOLTIP {
        canvas_fill_rect(c, x, y, w, h, 28, 34, 42)
        canvas_draw_rect(c, x, y, w, h, 140, 155, 170)
        vc_draw_label(c, node)
    } else if node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_VIEWPORT || node.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_BUTTON {
        canvas_draw_rect(c, x, y, w, h, 120, 135, 150)
        vc_draw_label(c, node)
    }
}

fn vc_draw_label(c: &!Canvas, node: &VizNode) with Mut {
    var buf: [i8; 256] = [0; 256]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < node.label_len && i < 64 {
        buf[i as usize] = node.label[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    canvas_draw_text(c, &buf, node.label_len, node.layout.x, node.layout.y, node.style.r, node.style.g, node.style.b)
}

fn vc_clamp(v: i64, lo: i64, hi: i64) -> i64 {
    if v < lo { lo } else if v > hi { hi } else { v }
}

fn vc_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var g = x
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 12 {
        g = (g + x / g) * 0.5
        i = i + 1
    }
    g
}

fn vc_draw_waterfall(scene: &VizScene, c: &!Canvas, node: &VizNode) with Mut, Div {
    let d = scene.series[node.data_slot as usize]
    if d.n <= 0 { return }
    canvas_draw_rect(c, node.layout.x, node.layout.y, node.layout.w, node.layout.h, 80, 95, 110)
    let row_h = vc_clamp(node.layout.h / d.n - 2, 3, 24)
    let span = if d.y_max == d.y_min { 1.0 } else { d.y_max - d.y_min }
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < d.n && i < 1024 {
        let frac = (d.ys[i as usize] - d.y_min) / span
        let bar_w = vc_clamp((frac * (node.layout.w as f64)) as i64, 1, node.layout.w)
        let py = node.layout.y + i * (row_h + 2)
        canvas_fill_rect(c, node.layout.x, py, bar_w, row_h, node.style.r, node.style.g, node.style.b)
        canvas_fill_rect(c, node.layout.x + bar_w, py, node.layout.w - bar_w, row_h, 36, 40, 50)
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn vc_draw_forest(scene: &VizScene, c: &!Canvas, node: &VizNode) with Mut, Div {
    let d = scene.series[node.data_slot as usize]
    if d.n <= 0 { return }
    var x_min = d.x_min
    var x_max = d.x_max
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < d.n && i < 1024 {
        let sigma = vc_sqrt(d.vars[i as usize])
        let lo = d.xs[i as usize] - sigma
        let hi = d.xs[i as usize] + sigma
        if lo < x_min { x_min = lo }
        if hi > x_max { x_max = hi }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if x_min == x_max {
        x_min = x_min - 1.0
        x_max = x_max + 1.0
    }
    let row_h = vc_clamp(node.layout.h / (d.n + 1), 5, 22)
    canvas_draw_rect(c, node.layout.x, node.layout.y, node.layout.w, node.layout.h, 90, 95, 120)
    i = 0
    while i < d.n && i < 1024 {
        let sigma = vc_sqrt(d.vars[i as usize])
        let row_y = node.layout.y + row_h / 2 + i * row_h
        let sx = node.layout.x + (((d.xs[i as usize] - x_min) / (x_max - x_min)) * (node.layout.w as f64)) as i64
        let slo = node.layout.x + ((((d.xs[i as usize] - sigma) - x_min) / (x_max - x_min)) * (node.layout.w as f64)) as i64
        let shi = node.layout.x + ((((d.xs[i as usize] + sigma) - x_min) / (x_max - x_min)) * (node.layout.w as f64)) as i64
        canvas_fill_rect(c, slo, row_y, shi - slo + 1, 1, 180, 180, 220)
        canvas_fill_rect(c, slo, row_y - 2, 1, 5, 180, 180, 220)
        canvas_fill_rect(c, shi, row_y - 2, 1, 5, 180, 180, 220)
        canvas_fill_rect(c, sx - 3, row_y - 3, 7, 7, node.style.r, node.style.g, node.style.b)
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn vc_mol_x(node: &VizNode, x: f64) -> i64 {
    node.layout.x + node.layout.w / 2 + (x * (node.layout.w as f64) * 0.30) as i64
}

fn vc_mol_y(node: &VizNode, y: f64) -> i64 {
    node.layout.y + node.layout.h / 2 - (y * (node.layout.h as f64) * 0.30) as i64
}

fn vc_draw_molecule(scene: &VizScene, c: &!Canvas, node: &VizNode) with Mut, Div {
    canvas_draw_rect(c, node.layout.x, node.layout.y, node.layout.w, node.layout.h, 120, 130, 150)
    if node.data_slot < 0 || node.data_slot >= scene.molecule_count { return }
    let slot = node.data_slot as usize
    var bond_count = scene.molecules[slot].bond_count
    if bond_count < 0 { bond_count = 0 }
    if bond_count > 96 { bond_count = 96 }
    var atom_count = scene.molecules[slot].atom_count
    if atom_count < 0 { atom_count = 0 }
    if atom_count > 64 { atom_count = 64 }
    var bi: i64 = 0
    while bi < bond_count {
        let b = scene.molecules[slot].bonds[bi as usize]
        if b.atom_a >= 0 && b.atom_a < atom_count && b.atom_b >= 0 && b.atom_b < atom_count {
            let a0 = scene.molecules[slot].atoms[b.atom_a as usize]
            let a1 = scene.molecules[slot].atoms[b.atom_b as usize]
            let x0 = vc_mol_x(node, a0.x)
            let y0 = vc_mol_y(node, a0.y)
            let x1 = vc_mol_x(node, a1.x)
            let y1 = vc_mol_y(node, a1.y)
            canvas_draw_line_aa(c, x0, y0, x1, y1, 180, 190, 205)
            if b.order > 1 {
                canvas_draw_line_aa(c, x0, y0 + 2, x1, y1 + 2, 150, 160, 175)
            }
        }
        bi = bi + 1
    }
    let cx = node.layout.x + node.layout.w / 2
    let cy = node.layout.y + node.layout.h / 2
    canvas_fill_rect(c, cx - 2, cy - 2, 5, 5, node.style.r, node.style.g, node.style.b)
    var ai: i64 = 0
    while ai < atom_count {
        let a = scene.molecules[slot].atoms[ai as usize]
        let sx = vc_mol_x(node, a.x)
        let sy = vc_mol_y(node, a.y)
        let rad = vc_clamp((a.radius * 8.0) as i64, 3, 12)
        canvas_fill_circle(c, sx, sy, rad, a.r, a.g, a.b)
        canvas_fill_rect(c, sx - 1, sy - 1, 3, 3, a.r, a.g, a.b)
        canvas_draw_rect(c, sx - rad, sy - rad, rad * 2 + 1, rad * 2 + 1, 40, 45, 55)
        ai = ai + 1
    }
}

fn vc_draw_field(scene: &VizScene, c: &!Canvas, node: &VizNode) with Mut, Div {
    let rows: i64 = 8
    let cols: i64 = 8
    let cell_w = if cols == 0 { 1 } else { node.layout.w / cols }
    let cell_h = if rows == 0 { 1 } else { node.layout.h / rows }
    var rr: i64 = 0
    while rr < rows {
        var cc: i64 = 0
        while cc < cols {
            let intensity = (rr * 24 + cc * 12) % 220
            canvas_fill_rect(c, node.layout.x + cc * cell_w, node.layout.y + rr * cell_h, cell_w + 1, cell_h + 1, intensity / 3, 80 + intensity / 4, 130 + intensity / 3)
            cc = cc + 1
        }
        rr = rr + 1
    }
    canvas_draw_rect(c, node.layout.x, node.layout.y, node.layout.w, node.layout.h, 90, 120, 130)
    let cx = node.layout.x + node.layout.w / 2
    let cy = node.layout.y + node.layout.h / 2
    canvas_draw_line_aa(c, cx - cell_w, cy, cx + cell_w, cy, 240, 240, 180)
    canvas_draw_line_aa(c, cx, cy - cell_h, cx, cy + cell_h, 240, 240, 180)
}

fn vc_draw_vector_field(scene: &VizScene, c: &!Canvas, node: &VizNode) with Mut, Div {
    let f = scene.vector_data[node.data_slot as usize]
    let rows = scene.vector_field_rows[node.data_slot as usize]
    let cols = scene.vector_field_cols[node.data_slot as usize]
    let cell_w = if cols <= 0 { 1 } else { node.layout.w / cols }
    let cell_h = if rows <= 0 { 1 } else { node.layout.h / rows }
    canvas_draw_rect(c, node.layout.x, node.layout.y, node.layout.w, node.layout.h, 120, 110, 70)
    var rr: i64 = 0
    while rr < rows && rr < 32 {
        var cc: i64 = 0
        while cc < cols && cc < 32 {
            let idx = rr * cols + cc
            let cx = node.layout.x + cc * cell_w + cell_w / 2
            let cy = node.layout.y + rr * cell_h + cell_h / 2
            let dx = vc_clamp((f.vx[idx as usize] * 3.0) as i64, 0 - cell_w / 2, cell_w / 2)
            let dy = vc_clamp((f.vy[idx as usize] * 3.0) as i64, 0 - cell_h / 2, cell_h / 2)
            canvas_draw_line_aa(c, cx, cy, cx + dx, cy + dy, node.style.r, node.style.g, node.style.b)
            canvas_fill_rect(c, cx + dx - 1, cy + dy - 1, 3, 3, node.style.r, node.style.g, node.style.b)
            cc = cc + 1
        }
        rr = rr + 1
    }
}

fn vc_traj_x(node: &VizNode, x: f64, z: f64) -> i64 {
    node.layout.x + node.layout.w / 2 + (x * (node.layout.w as f64) * 0.35) as i64 + (z * 2.0) as i64
}

fn vc_traj_y(node: &VizNode, y: f64, z: f64) -> i64 {
    node.layout.y + node.layout.h / 2 - (y * (node.layout.h as f64) * 0.35) as i64 - (z * 2.0) as i64
}

fn vc_draw_trajectory(scene: &VizScene, c: &!Canvas, node: &VizNode) with Mut, Div {
    let tr = scene.trajectory_data[node.data_slot as usize]
    canvas_draw_rect(c, node.layout.x, node.layout.y, node.layout.w, node.layout.h, 120, 95, 150)
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < tr.n && i < 1024 {
        let x0 = vc_traj_x(node, tr.x[(i - 1) as usize], tr.z[(i - 1) as usize])
        let y0 = vc_traj_y(node, tr.y[(i - 1) as usize], tr.z[(i - 1) as usize])
        let x1 = vc_traj_x(node, tr.x[i as usize], tr.z[i as usize])
        let y1 = vc_traj_y(node, tr.y[i as usize], tr.z[i as usize])
        canvas_draw_line_aa(c, x0, y0, x1, y1, node.style.r, node.style.g, node.style.b)
        i = i + 1
    }
    if tr.n > 0 {
        let sx = vc_traj_x(node, tr.x[0], tr.z[0])
        let sy = vc_traj_y(node, tr.y[0], tr.z[0])
        canvas_fill_rect(c, sx - 2, sy - 2, 5, 5, 180, 230, 190)
        let last = tr.n - 1
        let ex = vc_traj_x(node, tr.x[last as usize], tr.z[last as usize])
        let ey = vc_traj_y(node, tr.y[last as usize], tr.z[last as usize])
        canvas_fill_rect(c, ex - 2, ey - 2, 5, 5, 255, 180, 130)
        var cur = scene.time as i64
        if cur < 0 { cur = 0 }
        if cur >= tr.n { cur = tr.n - 1 }
        let tx = vc_traj_x(node, tr.x[cur as usize], tr.z[cur as usize])
        let ty = vc_traj_y(node, tr.y[cur as usize], tr.z[cur as usize])
        canvas_draw_rect(c, tx - 4, ty - 4, 9, 9, 255, 245, 120)
    }
}

fn vc_spec_x(node: &VizNode, x: f64, xmin: f64, xmax: f64) -> i64 {
    let span = if xmax == xmin { 1.0 } else { xmax - xmin }
    node.layout.x + (((x - xmin) / span) * (node.layout.w as f64)) as i64
}

fn vc_spec_y(node: &VizNode, y: f64, ymin: f64, ymax: f64) -> i64 {
    let span = if ymax == ymin { 1.0 } else { ymax - ymin }
    node.layout.y + node.layout.h - (((y - ymin) / span) * (node.layout.h as f64)) as i64
}

fn vc_draw_spectrum(scene: &VizScene, c: &!Canvas, node: &VizNode) with Mut, Div {
    let s = scene.spectrum_data[node.data_slot as usize]
    canvas_draw_rect(c, node.layout.x, node.layout.y, node.layout.w, node.layout.h, 140, 110, 70)
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < s.n && i < 1024 {
        let x0 = vc_spec_x(node, s.x[(i - 1) as usize], s.x_min, s.x_max)
        let y0 = vc_spec_y(node, s.intensity[(i - 1) as usize], s.y_min, s.y_max)
        let x1 = vc_spec_x(node, s.x[i as usize], s.x_min, s.x_max)
        let y1 = vc_spec_y(node, s.intensity[i as usize], s.y_min, s.y_max)
        canvas_draw_line_aa(c, x0, y0, x1, y1, node.style.r, node.style.g, node.style.b)
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn vc_draw_mesh(scene: &VizScene, c: &!Canvas, node: &VizNode) with Mut, Div, Alloc {
    let m = scene.meshes[node.data_slot as usize]
    var tris: [Tri3D; 4096] = [m.tris[0]; 4096]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < m.n && i < 128 {
        tris[i as usize] = m.tris[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    let cam = Camera3D { pos_x: 0.0, pos_y: 0.0, pos_z: 0.0, focal: (node.layout.w as f64) * 0.8 }
    let light = Light3D { dx: 0.0, dy: 0.0, dz: 1.0, r: 255, g: 255, b: 255, ambient: 0.35 }
    let depth = r3d_depth_buf_alloc(c.width, c.height)
    r3d_depth_buf_clear(depth, c.width, c.height)
    r3d_render_viewport(&tris, m.n, &cam, &light, depth, c, node.layout.x, node.layout.y, node.layout.w, node.layout.h)
    heap_free(depth as *mut i8)
    canvas_draw_rect(c, node.layout.x, node.layout.y, node.layout.w, node.layout.h, 120, 130, 150)
}

pub fn viz_canvas_render_scene(scene: &VizScene, c: &!Canvas) with Mut, Div, Alloc {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < scene.node_count {
        let node = scene.nodes[i as usize]
        if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_PANEL {
            vc_draw_panel(c, &node)
        } else if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_LABEL {
            vc_draw_label(c, &node)
        } else if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_CONTROL {
            vc_draw_control(c, &node)
        } else if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_CHART_LINE || node.kind == VIZ_NODE_CHART_SCATTER || node.kind == VIZ_NODE_CHART_BAR || node.kind == VIZ_NODE_UNCERTAINTY_BAND {
            let d = scene.series[node.data_slot as usize]
            let x0 = if d.x_min == d.x_max { vc_pad_range_min(d.x_min) } else { d.x_min }
            let x1 = if d.x_min == d.x_max { vc_pad_range_max(d.x_max) } else { d.x_max }
            let y0 = if d.y_min == d.y_max { vc_pad_range_min(d.y_min) } else { d.y_min }
            let y1 = if d.y_min == d.y_max { vc_pad_range_max(d.y_max) } else { d.y_max }
            let cs = coord_new(x0, x1, y0, y1, node.layout.x, node.layout.y, node.layout.w, node.layout.h)
            coord_draw_axes(&cs, c)
            if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_CHART_LINE {
                chart_line(&cs, &d.xs, &d.ys, d.n, c, node.style.r, node.style.g, node.style.b)
            } else if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_CHART_SCATTER {
                chart_scatter(&cs, &d.xs, &d.ys, d.n, c, node.style.r, node.style.g, node.style.b)
            } else if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_CHART_BAR {
                chart_bar(&cs, &d.xs, &d.ys, d.n, c, node.style.r, node.style.g, node.style.b)
            } else {
                epiviz_band(&cs, &d.xs, &d.ys, &d.vars, d.n, c, node.style.r, node.style.g, node.style.b)
            }
        } else if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_HEATMAP {
            let h = scene.heatmaps[node.data_slot as usize]
            let cs = coord_new(0.0, h.cols as f64, 0.0, h.rows as f64, node.layout.x, node.layout.y, node.layout.w, node.layout.h)
            chart_heatmap(&cs, &h.values, h.rows, h.cols, h.min_value, h.max_value, c)
            coord_draw_axes(&cs, c)
        } else if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_FOREST {
            vc_draw_forest(scene, c, &node)
        } else if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_WATERFALL {
            vc_draw_waterfall(scene, c, &node)
        } else if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_MOLECULE {
            vc_draw_molecule(scene, c, &node)
        } else if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_FIELD {
            vc_draw_field(scene, c, &node)
        } else if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_VECTOR_FIELD {
            vc_draw_vector_field(scene, c, &node)
        } else if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_TRAJECTORY {
            vc_draw_trajectory(scene, c, &node)
        } else if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_SPECTRUM {
            vc_draw_spectrum(scene, c, &node)
        } else if node.kind == VIZ_NODE_MESH {
            vc_draw_mesh(scene, c, &node)
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/viz/viz_html.sio ===
// stdlib/viz/viz_html.sio — Visual IR to static HTML/SVG export surface
//
// V1 emits static SVG/HTML markup to stdout. No JavaScript owns scientific
// semantics; this renderer only serializes Sounio Visual IR geometry.

use viz::ir::{VizScene, VIZ_NODE_PANEL, VIZ_NODE_CHART_LINE, VIZ_NODE_CHART_SCATTER, VIZ_NODE_CHART_BAR, VIZ_NODE_HEATMAP, VIZ_NODE_UNCERTAINTY_BAND, VIZ_NODE_LABEL, VIZ_NODE_CONTROL, VIZ_NODE_FOREST, VIZ_NODE_WATERFALL, VIZ_NODE_MOLECULE, VIZ_NODE_FIELD, VIZ_NODE_VECTOR_FIELD, VIZ_NODE_TRAJECTORY, VIZ_NODE_SPECTRUM, VIZ_NODE_MESH, VIZ_CONTROL_BUTTON, VIZ_CONTROL_SLIDER, VIZ_CONTROL_TOGGLE, VIZ_CONTROL_TABS, VIZ_CONTROL_LEGEND, VIZ_CONTROL_TOOLTIP, VIZ_CONTROL_VIEWPORT}

fn vh_print_i64(n: i64) with IO, Mut, Div {
    if n == 0 { print("0"); return }
    var v = n
    if v < 0 { print("-"); v = 0 - v }
    var digits: [i64; 20] = [0; 20]
    var len: i64 = 0
    while v > 0 {
        digits[len as usize] = v - (v / 10) * 10
        v = v / 10
        len = len + 1
    }
    var i = len - 1
    while i >= 0 {
        let d = digits[i as usize]
        if d == 0 { print("0") }
        if d == 1 { print("1") }
        if d == 2 { print("2") }
        if d == 3 { print("3") }
        if d == 4 { print("4") }
        if d == 5 { print("5") }
        if d == 6 { print("6") }
        if d == 7 { print("7") }
        if d == 8 { print("8") }
        if d == 9 { print("9") }
        i = i - 1
    }
}

fn vh_emit_rect(x: i64, y: i64, w: i64, h: i64, r: i64, g: i64, b: i64) with IO, Mut, Div {
    print("<rect x=\""); vh_print_i64(x); print("\" y=\""); vh_print_i64(y)
    print("\" width=\""); vh_print_i64(w); print("\" height=\""); vh_print_i64(h)
    print("\" fill=\"rgb("); vh_print_i64(r); print(","); vh_print_i64(g); print(","); vh_print_i64(b); println(")\"/>")
}

fn vh_emit_rect_stroke(x: i64, y: i64, w: i64, h: i64, r: i64, g: i64, b: i64) with IO, Mut, Div {
    print("<rect x=\""); vh_print_i64(x); print("\" y=\""); vh_print_i64(y)
    print("\" width=\""); vh_print_i64(w); print("\" height=\""); vh_print_i64(h)
    print("\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"rgb("); vh_print_i64(r); print(","); vh_print_i64(g); print(","); vh_print_i64(b); println(")\" stroke-width=\"1\"/>")
}

fn vh_emit_line(x0: i64, y0: i64, x1: i64, y1: i64, r: i64, g: i64, b: i64) with IO, Mut, Div {
    print("<line x1=\""); vh_print_i64(x0); print("\" y1=\""); vh_print_i64(y0)
    print("\" x2=\""); vh_print_i64(x1); print("\" y2=\""); vh_print_i64(y1)
    print("\" stroke=\"rgb("); vh_print_i64(r); print(","); vh_print_i64(g); print(","); vh_print_i64(b); println(")\" stroke-width=\"1.5\"/>")
}

fn vh_emit_circle(cx: i64, cy: i64, radius: i64, r: i64, g: i64, b: i64) with IO, Mut, Div {
    print("<circle cx=\""); vh_print_i64(cx); print("\" cy=\""); vh_print_i64(cy)
    print("\" r=\""); vh_print_i64(radius); print("\" fill=\"rgb(")
    vh_print_i64(r); print(","); vh_print_i64(g); print(","); vh_print_i64(b); println(")\"/>")
}

fn vh_emit_text(scene: &VizScene, node_idx: i64, x: i64, y: i64, r: i64, g: i64, b: i64) with IO, Mut, Div {
    let n = scene.nodes[node_idx as usize]
    print("<text x=\""); vh_print_i64(x); print("\" y=\""); vh_print_i64(y)
    print("\" fill=\"rgb("); vh_print_i64(r); print(","); vh_print_i64(g); print(","); vh_print_i64(b)
    print(")\" font-family=\"monospace\" font-size=\"10\">")
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n.label_len && i < 64 {
        let ch = n.label[i as usize] as i64
        let uch = if ch < 0 { ch + 256 } else { ch }
        if uch == 38 { print("&amp;") }
        else if uch == 60 { print("&lt;") }
        else if uch == 62 { print("&gt;") }
        else if uch == 34 { print("&quot;") }
        else if uch >= 32 && uch <= 126 {
            print_char(uch)
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    println("</text>")
}

fn vh_emit_node_group_open(scene: &VizScene, node_idx: i64) with IO, Mut, Div {
    let n = scene.nodes[node_idx as usize]
    print("<g data-viz-idx=\""); vh_print_i64(node_idx)
    print("\" data-viz-id=\""); vh_print_i64(n.id)
    print("\" data-viz-parent-id=\""); vh_print_i64(n.parent_id)
    print("\" data-viz-tag=\""); vh_print_i64(n.tag)
    print("\" data-viz-kind=\""); vh_print_i64(n.kind)
    print("\" data-viz-slot=\""); vh_print_i64(n.data_slot)
    println("\">")
}

fn vh_emit_scene_audit(scene: &VizScene) with IO, Mut, Div {
    print("<!-- viz-audit nodes="); vh_print_i64(scene.node_count)
    print(" selected="); vh_print_i64(scene.selected_node)
    print(" hovered="); vh_print_i64(scene.hovered_node)
    print(" focused="); vh_print_i64(scene.focused_node)
    print(" active-tab="); vh_print_i64(scene.active_tab)
    print(" time="); vh_print_i64(scene.time as i64)
    println(" -->")
}

fn vh_clamp_i(v: i64, lo: i64, hi: i64) -> i64 {
    if v < lo { lo } else if v > hi { hi } else { v }
}

fn vh_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var g = x
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 12 {
        g = (g + x / g) * 0.5
        i = i + 1
    }
    g
}

fn vh_series_x(x0: i64, w: i64, x: f64, xmin: f64, xmax: f64) -> i64 {
    let span = if xmax == xmin { 1.0 } else { xmax - xmin }
    x0 + (((x - xmin) / span) * (w as f64)) as i64
}

fn vh_series_y(y0: i64, h: i64, y: f64, ymin: f64, ymax: f64) -> i64 {
    let span = if ymax == ymin { 1.0 } else { ymax - ymin }
    y0 + h - (((y - ymin) / span) * (h as f64)) as i64
}

fn vh_emit_series_polyline(scene: &VizScene, node_idx: i64) with IO, Mut, Div {
    let n = scene.nodes[node_idx as usize]
    let d = scene.series[n.data_slot as usize]
    print("<polyline fill=\"none\" stroke=\"rgb(")
    vh_print_i64(n.style.r); print(","); vh_print_i64(n.style.g); print(","); vh_print_i64(n.style.b)
    print(")\" stroke-width=\""); vh_print_i64(n.style.stroke_width); print("\" points=\"")
    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < d.n {
        let px = vh_series_x(n.layout.x, n.layout.w, d.xs[j as usize], d.x_min, d.x_max)
        let py = vh_series_y(n.layout.y, n.layout.h, d.ys[j as usize], d.y_min, d.y_max)
        vh_print_i64(px); print(","); vh_print_i64(py)
        if j < d.n - 1 { print(" ") }
        j = j + 1
    }
    println("\"/>")
}

fn vh_emit_scatter(scene: &VizScene, node_idx: i64) with IO, Mut, Div {
    let n = scene.nodes[node_idx as usize]
    let d = scene.series[n.data_slot as usize]
    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < d.n && j < 1024 {
        let px = vh_series_x(n.layout.x, n.layout.w, d.xs[j as usize], d.x_min, d.x_max)
        let py = vh_series_y(n.layout.y, n.layout.h, d.ys[j as usize], d.y_min, d.y_max)
        vh_emit_circle(px, py, 3, n.style.r, n.style.g, n.style.b)
        j = j + 1
    }
    print("<!-- scatter n="); vh_print_i64(d.n); println(" -->")
}

fn vh_emit_bar(scene: &VizScene, node_idx: i64) with IO, Mut, Div {
    let n = scene.nodes[node_idx as usize]
    let d = scene.series[n.data_slot as usize]
    let bar_w = if d.n <= 0 { 1 } else { n.layout.w / d.n }
    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < d.n && j < 1024 {
        let py = vh_series_y(n.layout.y, n.layout.h, d.ys[j as usize], d.y_min, d.y_max)
        let x = n.layout.x + j * bar_w
        let h = n.layout.y + n.layout.h - py
        vh_emit_rect(x, py, if bar_w > 1 { bar_w - 1 } else { 1 }, h, n.style.r, n.style.g, n.style.b)
        j = j + 1
    }
    print("<!-- bar n="); vh_print_i64(d.n); println(" -->")
}

fn vh_emit_waterfall(scene: &VizScene, node_idx: i64) with IO, Mut, Div {
    let n = scene.nodes[node_idx as usize]
    let d = scene.series[n.data_slot as usize]
    vh_emit_rect_stroke(n.layout.x, n.layout.y, n.layout.w, n.layout.h, 80, 95, 110)
    if d.n <= 0 { return }
    let row_h = vh_clamp_i(n.layout.h / d.n - 2, 3, 24)
    let span = if d.y_max == d.y_min { 1.0 } else { d.y_max - d.y_min }
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < d.n && i < 1024 {
        let frac = (d.ys[i as usize] - d.y_min) / span
        let bar_w = vh_clamp_i((frac * (n.layout.w as f64)) as i64, 1, n.layout.w)
        let py = n.layout.y + i * (row_h + 2)
        vh_emit_rect(n.layout.x, py, bar_w, row_h, n.style.r, n.style.g, n.style.b)
        vh_emit_rect(n.layout.x + bar_w, py, n.layout.w - bar_w, row_h, 36, 40, 50)
        i = i + 1
    }
    print("<!-- waterfall n="); vh_print_i64(d.n); println(" -->")
}

fn vh_emit_forest(scene: &VizScene, node_idx: i64) with IO, Mut, Div {
    let n = scene.nodes[node_idx as usize]
    let d = scene.series[n.data_slot as usize]
    vh_emit_rect_stroke(n.layout.x, n.layout.y, n.layout.w, n.layout.h, 90, 95, 120)
    if d.n <= 0 { return }
    var x_min = d.x_min
    var x_max = d.x_max
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < d.n && i < 1024 {
        let sigma = vh_sqrt(d.vars[i as usize])
        let lo = d.xs[i as usize] - sigma
        let hi = d.xs[i as usize] + sigma
        if lo < x_min { x_min = lo }
        if hi > x_max { x_max = hi }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if x_min == x_max {
        x_min = x_min - 1.0
        x_max = x_max + 1.0
    }
    let row_h = vh_clamp_i(n.layout.h / (d.n + 1), 5, 22)
    i = 0
    while i < d.n && i < 1024 {
        let sigma = vh_sqrt(d.vars[i as usize])
        let row_y = n.layout.y + row_h / 2 + i * row_h
        let sx = vh_series_x(n.layout.x, n.layout.w, d.xs[i as usize], x_min, x_max)
        let slo = vh_series_x(n.layout.x, n.layout.w, d.xs[i as usize] - sigma, x_min, x_max)
        let shi = vh_series_x(n.layout.x, n.layout.w, d.xs[i as usize] + sigma, x_min, x_max)
        vh_emit_line(slo, row_y, shi, row_y, 180, 180, 220)
        vh_emit_rect(slo, row_y - 2, 1, 5, 180, 180, 220)
        vh_emit_rect(shi, row_y - 2, 1, 5, 180, 180, 220)
        vh_emit_rect(sx - 3, row_y - 3, 7, 7, n.style.r, n.style.g, n.style.b)
        i = i + 1
    }
    print("<!-- forest n="); vh_print_i64(d.n); println(" -->")
}

fn vh_emit_heatmap(scene: &VizScene, slot: i64, x: i64, y: i64, w: i64, h: i64) with IO, Mut, Div {
    let hm = scene.heatmaps[slot as usize]
    let cell_w = if hm.cols <= 0 { 1 } else { w / hm.cols }
    let cell_h = if hm.rows <= 0 { 1 } else { h / hm.rows }
    let span = if hm.max_value == hm.min_value { 1.0 } else { hm.max_value - hm.min_value }
    var rr: i64 = 0
    while rr < hm.rows && rr < 64 {
        var cc: i64 = 0
        while cc < hm.cols && cc < 64 {
            let idx = rr * hm.cols + cc
            let frac = (hm.values[idx as usize] - hm.min_value) / span
            let intensity = vh_clamp_i((frac * 220.0) as i64, 0, 220)
            vh_emit_rect(x + cc * cell_w, y + rr * cell_h, cell_w + 1, cell_h + 1, intensity / 3, 70 + intensity / 3, 120 + intensity / 2)
            cc = cc + 1
        }
        rr = rr + 1
    }
}

fn vh_emit_scalar_field(scene: &VizScene, field_slot: i64, x: i64, y: i64, w: i64, h: i64) with IO, Mut, Div {
    if field_slot >= 0 && field_slot < scene.field_count {
        let heat_slot = scene.field_heatmap_slots[field_slot as usize]
        if heat_slot >= 0 && heat_slot < scene.heatmap_count {
            let hmap = scene.heatmaps[heat_slot as usize]
            vh_emit_heatmap(scene, heat_slot, x, y, w, h)
            vh_emit_rect_stroke(x, y, w, h, 90, 120, 130)
            print("<!-- scalar-field slot="); vh_print_i64(field_slot)
            print(" heatmap="); vh_print_i64(heat_slot)
            print(" rows="); vh_print_i64(hmap.rows)
            print(" cols="); vh_print_i64(hmap.cols)
            println(" -->")
            return
        }
    }
    vh_emit_rect(x, y, w, h, 32, 78, 102)
    vh_emit_rect_stroke(x, y, w, h, 90, 120, 130)
    let cx = x + w / 2
    let cy = y + h / 2
    vh_emit_line(cx - w / 6, cy, cx + w / 6, cy, 240, 240, 180)
    vh_emit_line(cx, cy - h / 6, cx, cy + h / 6, 240, 240, 180)
    print("<!-- scalar-field slot="); vh_print_i64(field_slot); println(" fallback -->")
}

fn vh_emit_vector_field(scene: &VizScene, field_slot: i64, x: i64, y: i64, w: i64, h: i64) with IO, Mut, Div {
    vh_emit_rect_stroke(x, y, w, h, 120, 110, 70)
    if field_slot >= 0 && field_slot < scene.vector_field_count {
        let f = scene.vector_data[field_slot as usize]
        let rows = scene.vector_field_rows[field_slot as usize]
        let cols = scene.vector_field_cols[field_slot as usize]
        let cell_w = if cols <= 0 { 1 } else { w / cols }
        let cell_h = if rows <= 0 { 1 } else { h / rows }
        var rr: i64 = 0
        while rr < rows && rr < 32 {
            var cc: i64 = 0
            while cc < cols && cc < 32 {
                let idx = rr * cols + cc
                let cx = x + cc * cell_w + cell_w / 2
                let cy = y + rr * cell_h + cell_h / 2
                let dx = vh_clamp_i((f.vx[idx as usize] * 3.0) as i64, 0 - cell_w / 2, cell_w / 2)
                let dy = vh_clamp_i((f.vy[idx as usize] * 3.0) as i64, 0 - cell_h / 2, cell_h / 2)
                vh_emit_line(cx, cy, cx + dx, cy + dy, 240, 210, 120)
                vh_emit_rect(cx + dx - 1, cy + dy - 1, 3, 3, 240, 210, 120)
                cc = cc + 1
            }
            rr = rr + 1
        }
        print("<!-- vector-field slot="); vh_print_i64(field_slot)
        print(" rows="); vh_print_i64(rows)
        print(" cols="); vh_print_i64(cols)
        println(" -->")
        return
    }
    print("<!-- vector-field slot="); vh_print_i64(field_slot); println(" fallback -->")
}

fn vh_traj_x(x0: i64, w: i64, x: f64, z: f64) -> i64 {
    x0 + w / 2 + (x * (w as f64) * 0.35) as i64 + (z * 2.0) as i64
}

fn vh_traj_y(y0: i64, h: i64, y: f64, z: f64) -> i64 {
    y0 + h / 2 - (y * (h as f64) * 0.35) as i64 - (z * 2.0) as i64
}

fn vh_emit_trajectory(scene: &VizScene, slot: i64, x: i64, y: i64, w: i64, h: i64, r: i64, g: i64, b: i64) with IO, Mut, Div {
    vh_emit_rect_stroke(x, y, w, h, 120, 95, 150)
    if slot >= 0 && slot < scene.trajectory_count {
        let tr = scene.trajectory_data[slot as usize]
        print("<polyline fill=\"none\" stroke=\"rgb(")
        vh_print_i64(r); print(","); vh_print_i64(g); print(","); vh_print_i64(b)
        print(")\" stroke-width=\"1.5\" points=\"")
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < tr.n && i < 1024 {
            let px = vh_traj_x(x, w, tr.x[i as usize], tr.z[i as usize])
            let py = vh_traj_y(y, h, tr.y[i as usize], tr.z[i as usize])
            vh_print_i64(px); print(","); vh_print_i64(py)
            if i < tr.n - 1 { print(" ") }
            i = i + 1
        }
        println("\"/>")
        if tr.n > 0 {
            let sx = vh_traj_x(x, w, tr.x[0], tr.z[0])
            let sy = vh_traj_y(y, h, tr.y[0], tr.z[0])
            vh_emit_rect(sx - 2, sy - 2, 5, 5, 180, 230, 190)
            let last = tr.n - 1
            let ex = vh_traj_x(x, w, tr.x[last as usize], tr.z[last as usize])
            let ey = vh_traj_y(y, h, tr.y[last as usize], tr.z[last as usize])
            vh_emit_rect(ex - 2, ey - 2, 5, 5, 255, 180, 130)
            var cur = scene.time as i64
            if cur < 0 { cur = 0 }
            if cur >= tr.n { cur = tr.n - 1 }
            let tx = vh_traj_x(x, w, tr.x[cur as usize], tr.z[cur as usize])
            let ty = vh_traj_y(y, h, tr.y[cur as usize], tr.z[cur as usize])
            vh_emit_rect_stroke(tx - 4, ty - 4, 9, 9, 255, 245, 120)
        }
        print("<!-- trajectory slot="); vh_print_i64(slot)
        print(" n="); vh_print_i64(tr.n)
        print(" time="); vh_print_i64(scene.time as i64)
        println(" -->")
        return
    }
    print("<!-- trajectory slot="); vh_print_i64(slot); println(" fallback -->")
}

fn vh_spec_x(x0: i64, w: i64, x: f64, xmin: f64, xmax: f64) -> i64 {
    let span = if xmax == xmin { 1.0 } else { xmax - xmin }
    x0 + (((x - xmin) / span) * (w as f64)) as i64
}

fn vh_spec_y(y0: i64, h: i64, y: f64, ymin: f64, ymax: f64) -> i64 {
    let span = if ymax == ymin { 1.0 } else { ymax - ymin }
    y0 + h - (((y - ymin) / span) * (h as f64)) as i64
}

fn vh_emit_spectrum(scene: &VizScene, slot: i64, x: i64, y: i64, w: i64, h: i64, r: i64, g: i64, b: i64) with IO, Mut, Div {
    vh_emit_rect_stroke(x, y, w, h, 140, 110, 70)
    if slot >= 0 && slot < scene.spectrum_count {
        let s = scene.spectrum_data[slot as usize]
        print("<polyline fill=\"none\" stroke=\"rgb(")
        vh_print_i64(r); print(","); vh_print_i64(g); print(","); vh_print_i64(b)
        print(")\" stroke-width=\"1.5\" points=\"")
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < s.n && i < 1024 {
            let px = vh_spec_x(x, w, s.x[i as usize], s.x_min, s.x_max)
            let py = vh_spec_y(y, h, s.intensity[i as usize], s.y_min, s.y_max)
            vh_print_i64(px); print(","); vh_print_i64(py)
            if i < s.n - 1 { print(" ") }
            i = i + 1
        }
        println("\"/>")
        print("<!-- spectrum slot="); vh_print_i64(slot)
        print(" n="); vh_print_i64(s.n)
        println(" -->")
        return
    }
    print("<!-- spectrum slot="); vh_print_i64(slot); println(" fallback -->")
}

fn vh_emit_control(scene: &VizScene, node_idx: i64) with IO, Mut, Div {
    let n = scene.nodes[node_idx as usize]
    if n.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_SLIDER {
        vh_emit_rect(n.layout.x, n.layout.y + n.layout.h / 2 - 2, n.layout.w, 4, 55, 60, 70)
        let span = if n.max_value == n.min_value { 1.0 } else { n.max_value - n.min_value }
        let frac = (n.value - n.min_value) / span
        let knob_x = n.layout.x + (frac * (n.layout.w as f64)) as i64
        vh_emit_rect(knob_x - 3, n.layout.y, 7, n.layout.h, n.style.r, n.style.g, n.style.b)
        print("<!-- control slider value="); vh_print_i64(n.value as i64); println(" -->")
    } else if n.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_TOGGLE {
        vh_emit_rect_stroke(n.layout.x, n.layout.y, n.layout.w, n.layout.h, 130, 150, 160)
        if n.value > 0.0 {
            vh_emit_rect(n.layout.x + 3, n.layout.y + 3, n.layout.w - 6, n.layout.h - 6, n.style.r, n.style.g, n.style.b)
            println("<!-- control toggle on -->")
        } else {
            println("<!-- control toggle off -->")
        }
    } else if n.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_TABS {
        vh_emit_rect(n.layout.x, n.layout.y, n.layout.w, n.layout.h, 40, 48, 58)
        let min_i = n.min_value as i64
        let max_i = n.max_value as i64
        var count = max_i - min_i + 1
        if count <= 0 { count = 1 }
        let tab_w = if n.layout.w / count <= 0 { 1 } else { n.layout.w / count }
        var active = n.value as i64
        if active < min_i { active = min_i }
        if active > max_i { active = max_i }
        vh_emit_rect(n.layout.x + (active - min_i) * tab_w, n.layout.y, tab_w, n.layout.h, n.style.r, n.style.g, n.style.b)
        vh_emit_rect_stroke(n.layout.x, n.layout.y, n.layout.w, n.layout.h, 120, 135, 150)
        print("<!-- control tabs active="); vh_print_i64(active); println(" -->")
    } else if n.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_LEGEND {
        vh_emit_rect_stroke(n.layout.x, n.layout.y, n.layout.w, n.layout.h, 120, 135, 150)
        vh_emit_rect(n.layout.x + 4, n.layout.y + n.layout.h / 2 - 3, 10, 6, n.style.r, n.style.g, n.style.b)
        vh_emit_text(scene, node_idx, n.layout.x + 18, n.layout.y + 13, n.style.r, n.style.g, n.style.b)
        println("<!-- control legend -->")
    } else if n.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_TOOLTIP {
        vh_emit_rect(n.layout.x, n.layout.y, n.layout.w, n.layout.h, 28, 34, 42)
        vh_emit_rect_stroke(n.layout.x, n.layout.y, n.layout.w, n.layout.h, 140, 155, 170)
        vh_emit_text(scene, node_idx, n.layout.x + 4, n.layout.y + 13, n.style.r, n.style.g, n.style.b)
        println("<!-- control tooltip -->")
    } else if n.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_BUTTON {
        vh_emit_rect_stroke(n.layout.x, n.layout.y, n.layout.w, n.layout.h, 120, 135, 150)
        vh_emit_text(scene, node_idx, n.layout.x + 4, n.layout.y + 13, n.style.r, n.style.g, n.style.b)
        println("<!-- control button -->")
    } else if n.data_slot == VIZ_CONTROL_VIEWPORT {
        vh_emit_rect_stroke(n.layout.x, n.layout.y, n.layout.w, n.layout.h, 120, 135, 150)
        vh_emit_text(scene, node_idx, n.layout.x + 4, n.layout.y + 13, n.style.r, n.style.g, n.style.b)
        println("<!-- control viewport -->")
    } else {
        vh_emit_rect_stroke(n.layout.x, n.layout.y, n.layout.w, n.layout.h, 120, 135, 150)
        vh_emit_text(scene, node_idx, n.layout.x + 4, n.layout.y + 13, n.style.r, n.style.g, n.style.b)
        println("<!-- control generic -->")
    }
}

pub fn viz_html_emit_scene(scene: &VizScene, width: i64, height: i64) with IO, Mut, Div {
    println("<!doctype html><html><body>")
    vh_emit_scene_audit(scene)
    print("<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\""); vh_print_i64(width)
    print("\" height=\""); vh_print_i64(height); print("\" viewBox=\"0 0 ")
    vh_print_i64(width); print(" "); vh_print_i64(height); println("\">")
    vh_emit_rect(0, 0, width, height, 12, 16, 22)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < scene.node_count {
        let n = scene.nodes[i as usize]
        vh_emit_node_group_open(scene, i)
        if n.kind == VIZ_NODE_PANEL {
            vh_emit_rect(n.layout.x, n.layout.y, n.layout.w, n.layout.h, 22, 28, 36)
        } else if n.kind == VIZ_NODE_LABEL {
            vh_emit_text(scene, i, n.layout.x, n.layout.y + 10, n.style.r, n.style.g, n.style.b)
        } else if n.kind == VIZ_NODE_CHART_LINE || n.kind == VIZ_NODE_UNCERTAINTY_BAND {
            vh_emit_series_polyline(scene, i)
        } else if n.kind == VIZ_NODE_CHART_SCATTER {
            vh_emit_scatter(scene, i)
        } else if n.kind == VIZ_NODE_CHART_BAR {
            vh_emit_bar(scene, i)
        } else if n.kind == VIZ_NODE_HEATMAP {
            let h = scene.heatmaps[n.data_slot as usize]
            vh_emit_heatmap(scene, n.data_slot, n.layout.x, n.layout.y, n.layout.w, n.layout.h)
            vh_emit_rect_stroke(n.layout.x, n.layout.y, n.layout.w, n.layout.h, 80, 120, 140)
            print("<!-- heatmap rows="); vh_print_i64(h.rows); print(" cols="); vh_print_i64(h.cols); println(" -->")
        } else if n.kind == VIZ_NODE_CONTROL {
            vh_emit_control(scene, i)
        } else if n.kind == VIZ_NODE_FOREST {
            vh_emit_forest(scene, i)
        } else if n.kind == VIZ_NODE_WATERFALL {
            vh_emit_waterfall(scene, i)
        } else if n.kind == VIZ_NODE_MOLECULE {
            let cx = n.layout.x + n.layout.w / 2
            let cy = n.layout.y + n.layout.h / 2
            vh_emit_rect_stroke(n.layout.x, n.layout.y, n.layout.w, n.layout.h, 120, 130, 150)
            vh_emit_line(cx - n.layout.w / 4, cy, cx + n.layout.w / 4, cy, 170, 185, 205)
            vh_emit_circle(cx, cy, 5, n.style.r, n.style.g, n.style.b)
            print("<!-- molecule slot="); vh_print_i64(n.data_slot); println(" -->")
        } else if n.kind == VIZ_NODE_FIELD {
            vh_emit_scalar_field(scene, n.data_slot, n.layout.x, n.layout.y, n.layout.w, n.layout.h)
        } else if n.kind == VIZ_NODE_VECTOR_FIELD {
            vh_emit_vector_field(scene, n.data_slot, n.layout.x, n.layout.y, n.layout.w, n.layout.h)
        } else if n.kind == VIZ_NODE_TRAJECTORY {
            vh_emit_trajectory(scene, n.data_slot, n.layout.x, n.layout.y, n.layout.w, n.layout.h, n.style.r, n.style.g, n.style.b)
        } else if n.kind == VIZ_NODE_SPECTRUM {
            vh_emit_spectrum(scene, n.data_slot, n.layout.x, n.layout.y, n.layout.w, n.layout.h, n.style.r, n.style.g, n.style.b)
        } else if n.kind == VIZ_NODE_MESH {
            vh_emit_rect_stroke(n.layout.x, n.layout.y, n.layout.w, n.layout.h, 120, 130, 150)
            print("<polygon points=\"")
            vh_print_i64(n.layout.x + n.layout.w / 2); print(","); vh_print_i64(n.layout.y + n.layout.h / 4); print(" ")
            vh_print_i64(n.layout.x + n.layout.w / 4); print(","); vh_print_i64(n.layout.y + n.layout.h * 3 / 4); print(" ")
            vh_print_i64(n.layout.x + n.layout.w * 3 / 4); print(","); vh_print_i64(n.layout.y + n.layout.h * 3 / 4)
            print("\" fill=\"rgb("); vh_print_i64(n.style.r); print(","); vh_print_i64(n.style.g); print(","); vh_print_i64(n.style.b); println(")\" opacity=\"0.85\"/>")
            print("<!-- mesh slot="); vh_print_i64(n.data_slot); println(" -->")
        }
        println("</g>")
        i = i + 1
    }
    println("</svg></body></html>")
}


// === FILE: stdlib/viz/viz_replay.sio ===
// stdlib/viz/viz_replay.sio - deterministic event replay over VizApp + Visual IR

use display::canvas::{Canvas, canvas_clear}
use display::event::{Event}
use viz::ir::{VizScene, viz_scene_dump}
use viz::audit::{viz_audit_hash}
use viz::viz_app::{VizApp, viz_app_handle_event, viz_app_frame_hash}
use viz::viz_canvas::{viz_canvas_render_scene}

pub struct VizReplayFrame {
    pub frame: i64,
    pub event_kind: i64,
    pub event_key: i64,
    pub event_x: i64,
    pub event_y: i64,
    pub changed: bool,
    pub canvas_hash: i64,
    pub audit_hash: i64,
    pub selected_node: i64,
    pub hovered_node: i64,
    pub focused_node: i64,
    pub active_tab: i64,
    pub time_i: i64,
}

pub struct VizReplayTrace {
    pub frames: [VizReplayFrame; 33],
    pub count: i64,
}

pub fn viz_replay_frame_empty() -> VizReplayFrame {
    VizReplayFrame {
        frame: 0,
        event_kind: 0,
        event_key: 0,
        event_x: 0,
        event_y: 0,
        changed: false,
        canvas_hash: 0,
        audit_hash: 0,
        selected_node: 0 - 1,
        hovered_node: 0 - 1,
        focused_node: 0 - 1,
        active_tab: 0,
        time_i: 0,
    }
}

pub fn viz_replay_trace_new() -> VizReplayTrace {
    VizReplayTrace { frames: [viz_replay_frame_empty(); 33], count: 0 }
}

pub fn viz_replay_present(app: &!VizApp, scene: &!VizScene, c: &!Canvas) -> i64 with Mut, Div, Alloc {
    canvas_clear(c, app.bg_r, app.bg_g, app.bg_b)
    viz_canvas_render_scene(scene, c)
    app.frame = app.frame + 1
    app.dirty = false
    viz_app_frame_hash(app, scene, c)
}

fn viz_replay_record(trace: &!VizReplayTrace, app: &VizApp, scene: &VizScene, ev: Event, changed: bool, hash: i64) with Mut {
    if trace.count < 0 || trace.count >= 33 { return }
    let idx = trace.count
    trace.frames[idx as usize] = VizReplayFrame {
        frame: app.frame,
        event_kind: ev.kind,
        event_key: ev.key,
        event_x: ev.x,
        event_y: ev.y,
        changed: changed,
        canvas_hash: hash,
        audit_hash: viz_audit_hash(scene),
        selected_node: scene.selected_node,
        hovered_node: scene.hovered_node,
        focused_node: scene.focused_node,
        active_tab: scene.active_tab,
        time_i: scene.time as i64,
    }
    trace.count = trace.count + 1
}

pub fn viz_replay_events(app: &!VizApp, scene: &!VizScene, c: &!Canvas, events: &[Event; 32], count: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div, Alloc {
    var i: i64 = 0
    var last_hash: i64 = viz_replay_present(app, scene, c)
    while i < count && i < 32 {
        viz_app_handle_event(app, scene, events[i as usize])
        last_hash = viz_replay_present(app, scene, c)
        i = i + 1
    }
    last_hash
}

pub fn viz_replay_trace_events(app: &!VizApp, scene: &!VizScene, c: &!Canvas, events: &[Event; 32], count: i64) -> VizReplayTrace with Mut, Div, Alloc {
    var trace = viz_replay_trace_new()
    let none = Event { kind: 0, key: 0, x: 0, y: 0, mods: 0 }
    var last_hash: i64 = viz_replay_present(app, scene, c)
    viz_replay_record(&!trace, app, scene, none, true, last_hash)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < count && i < 32 {
        let ev = events[i as usize]
        let changed = viz_app_handle_event(app, scene, ev)
        last_hash = viz_replay_present(app, scene, c)
        viz_replay_record(&!trace, app, scene, ev, changed, last_hash)
        i = i + 1
    }
    trace
}

pub fn viz_replay_dump(scene: &VizScene) with IO, Mut, Div {
    viz_scene_dump(scene)
}


// === FILE: stdlib/viz/viz_window.sio ===
// stdlib/viz/viz_window.sio - optional native window bridge for Visual IR apps
//
// This layer connects display::Window to VizApp without making tests depend on
// DISPLAY. Headless tests exercise viz_app; window examples compile-gate this.

use display::canvas::{Canvas, canvas_from_window, canvas_clear}
use display::window::{Window, window_pending, window_next_event, window_present}
use viz::ir::{VizScene}
use viz::viz_app::{VizApp, viz_app_handle_event}
use viz::viz_canvas::{viz_canvas_render_scene}

pub fn viz_window_pump_events(app: &!VizApp, scene: &!VizScene, win: &!Window, max_events: i64) -> i64 with IO, Mut, Div {
    var handled: i64 = 0
    var keep_polling = true
    while keep_polling && handled < max_events && window_pending(win) > 0 {
        let ev = window_next_event(win)
        viz_app_handle_event(app, scene, ev)
        handled = handled + 1
        if !app.running {
            keep_polling = false
        }
    }
    handled
}

pub fn viz_window_present_if_dirty(app: &!VizApp, scene: &!VizScene, win: &!Window) -> bool with IO, Mut, Div, Alloc {
    if !app.dirty { return false }
    var c = canvas_from_window(win)
    canvas_clear(&!c, app.bg_r, app.bg_g, app.bg_b)
    viz_canvas_render_scene(scene, &!c)
    window_present(win)
    app.frame = app.frame + 1
    app.dirty = false
    true
}

pub fn viz_window_step(app: &!VizApp, scene: &!VizScene, win: &!Window, max_events: i64) -> bool with IO, Mut, Div, Alloc {
    viz_window_pump_events(app, scene, win, max_events)
    viz_window_present_if_dirty(app, scene, win)
    app.running
}

    VizWorkbenchIds {
        title: title,
        slider: slider,
        tabs: tabs,
        toggle: toggle,
        plot: plot,
        molecule: molecule,
        band: band,
        heatmap: heatmap,
        vector_field: vector_field,
        trajectory: trajectory,
        spectrum: spectrum,
        mesh: mesh,
        legend: legend,
        tooltip: tooltip,
        viewport: viewport,
        button: button,
    }
}

pub fn wasm_instantiate(mod: &WasmModule) -> i32 { -1 }

// === FILE: stdlib/wasm/lib.sio ===
// stdlib/wasm/lib.sio — Wasm module entry point

pub use pure::types::*;

// === FILE: stdlib/wasm/pure/types.sio ===
// stdlib/wasm/pure/types.sio — WebAssembly Types

pub struct WasmModule {
    pub bytecode: [u8; 32768],
    pub bytecode_len: i32,
    pub exports: [string; 64],
    pub n_exports: i32,
}

pub fn wasm_module_new() -> WasmModule {
    WasmModule { bytecode: [0; 32768], bytecode_len: 0, exports: [""; 64], n_exports: 0 }
}

pub fn wasm_module_load(b: &! WasmModule, data: &[u8], len: i32) with Mut {
    if len > 32768 { return }
    var i = 0
    while i < len {
        b.bytecode[i as usize] = data[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    b.bytecode_len = len
}

pub fn wasm_module_add_export(m: &! WasmModule, name: string) with Mut {
    if m.n_exports < 64 {
        m.exports[m.n_exports as usize] = name
        m.n_exports = m.n_exports + 1
    }
}

pub fn wasm_module_bytecode_len(m: &WasmModule) -> i32 { m.bytecode_len }

// === FILE: stdlib/web/epistemic_http.sio ===
/// Epistemic HTTP — web requests as Knowledge<T> with provenance and uncertainty
/// Implements H7.2: Scientific data fetching with compile-time uncertainty bounds

struct DataSource {
    trust_level: f64,    // 0.0 (unknown) to 1.0 (gold standard)
    source_id: i64,      // 0=unknown, 1=ncbi, 2=ebi, 3=clintrials, 4=pubmed
    citation_count: i64,
}

/// Known scientific data sources with trust levels
fn source_unknown() -> DataSource {
    DataSource { trust_level: 0.5, source_id: 0, citation_count: 0 }
}

fn source_ncbi() -> DataSource {
    DataSource { trust_level: 0.95, source_id: 1, citation_count: 0 }
}

fn source_ebi() -> DataSource {
    DataSource { trust_level: 0.95, source_id: 2, citation_count: 0 }
}

fn source_clintrials() -> DataSource {
    DataSource { trust_level: 0.90, source_id: 3, citation_count: 0 }
}

fn source_pubmed() -> DataSource {
    DataSource { trust_level: 0.92, source_id: 4, citation_count: 0 }
}

/// Provenance quality — converts DataSource trust to uncertainty epsilon
/// Higher trust -> lower epsilon (tighter bounds)
fn provenance_quality(src: DataSource) -> f64 {
    1.0 - src.trust_level
}

/// EpistemicResponse wraps a raw HTTP result with uncertainty bounds
pub struct EpistemicResponse {
    status: i64,
    body_len: i64,
    body: [i8; 4096],
    epsilon: f64,      // uncertainty bound [0.0, 1.0]
    source: DataSource,
}

fn epistemic_response_ok(resp: EpistemicResponse) -> bool {
    resp.status >= 200 && resp.status < 300
}

fn epistemic_response_epsilon(resp: EpistemicResponse) -> f64 {
    resp.epsilon
}

/// Combine two epistemic responses — uncertainty grows under independence
fn epistemic_combine(a: EpistemicResponse, b: EpistemicResponse) -> f64 {
    let ea = a.epsilon
    let eb = b.epsilon
    // Combined uncertainty: sqrt(ea^2 + eb^2) capped at 1.0
    let combined = ea * ea + eb * eb
    if combined > 1.0 { 1.0 } else { combined }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/web/http.sio ===
/// HTTP session protocol types for Sounio web programming
/// Provides typed HTTP request/response sessions with effect tracking

/// HTTP request type
struct HttpRequest {
    url_len: i64,
    url: [i8; 256],
    method: i64,  // 0=GET, 1=POST, 2=PUT, 3=DELETE
    body_len: i64,
    body: [i8; 4096],
}

/// HTTP response type
pub struct HttpResponse {
    status: i64,
    body_len: i64,
    body: [i8; 4096],
    content_type: i64,  // 0=json, 1=text, 2=binary
}

/// HTTP method constants
fn http_get_method() -> i64 { 0 }
fn http_post_method() -> i64 { 1 }
fn http_put_method() -> i64 { 2 }
fn http_delete_method() -> i64 { 3 }

/// HTTP status predicates
fn http_ok(resp: HttpResponse) -> bool {
    resp.status >= 200 && resp.status < 300
}

fn http_client_error(resp: HttpResponse) -> bool {
    resp.status >= 400 && resp.status < 500
}

fn http_server_error(resp: HttpResponse) -> bool {
    resp.status >= 500
}

/// Minimum response quality score [0.0, 1.0]
/// Based on status code: 200=1.0, 4xx=0.3, 5xx=0.0
fn http_quality_score(resp: HttpResponse) -> f64 {
    if resp.status >= 200 && resp.status < 300 {
        1.0
    } else if resp.status >= 400 && resp.status < 500 {
        0.3
    } else {
        0.0
    }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/web/websocket.sio ===
/// WebSocket session types — bidirectional typed communication
/// Implements typed WS sessions as session-type channels

struct WsMessage {
    opcode: i64,    // 1=text, 2=binary, 8=close
    payload_len: i64,
    payload: [i8; 2048],
}

fn ws_text_message(payload: [i8; 2048], len: i64) -> WsMessage {
    WsMessage { opcode: 1, payload_len: len, payload: payload }
}

fn ws_close_message() -> WsMessage {
    WsMessage { opcode: 8, payload_len: 0, payload: [0; 2048] }
}

fn ws_is_close(msg: WsMessage) -> bool {
    msg.opcode == 8
}

fn ws_is_text(msg: WsMessage) -> bool {
    msg.opcode == 1
}


// === FILE: stdlib/yaml/mod.sio ===
//! stdlib/yaml - YAML Parser
//!
//! Provides YAML format parsing and serialization.
//! Currently pending string type support.

module yaml

pub fn yaml_module_ready() -> i32 { 1 }


// === FILE: stdlib/yaml/parser.sio ===
// stdlib/yaml/parser.sio — Minimal YAML parser
//
// Represents YAML as a flat key-value document (up to 32 entries).
// No heap allocation — all storage is fixed-size arrays.
// Supports flat "key: value" lines only (no nesting, no sequences).
// Value types: string (quoted or bare), number, bool, null.
//
// Recognised bool literals (case-insensitive matching via lowercase-first byte):
//   true, yes  → 1
//   false, no  → 0
// Recognised null: null, ~  → type=3 (YAML_NULL)
//
// JIT note: only &!Struct field mutations propagate to callers.
// Standalone &!array and &!scalar do NOT propagate in JIT mode.
//
// # Limits
//   - Up to 32 key-value pairs per document
//   - Keys up to 63 bytes (null-terminated in 64-byte slot)
//   - String values up to 127 bytes (null-terminated in 128-byte slot)
//   - Parse input up to 4095 bytes

// ============================================================================
// YAML VALUE TYPES
// ============================================================================

pub fn YAML_STRING() -> i32 { 0 }
pub fn YAML_NUMBER() -> i32 { 1 }
pub fn YAML_BOOL()   -> i32 { 2 }
pub fn YAML_NULL()   -> i32 { 3 }

// ============================================================================
// YamlDoc — flat key→value store, up to 32 entries
// ============================================================================

pub struct YamlDoc {
    pub keys:     [[u8; 64]; 32],
    pub key_lens: [i32; 32],
    pub str_vals: [[u8; 128]; 32],
    pub str_lens: [i32; 32],
    pub num_vals: [f64; 32],
    pub types:    [i32; 32],
    pub count:    i32,
}

// ============================================================================
// Internal result types
// ============================================================================

// Result from parsing a quoted string body (after opening '"').
struct YStrResult {
    data:    [u8; 128],
    str_len: i32,
    new_pos: i32,   // -1 on error
}

// Result from parsing a number token.
struct YNumResult {
    value:   f64,
    new_pos: i32,
}

// ============================================================================
// YamlDoc constructor
// ============================================================================

pub fn yaml_doc_new() -> YamlDoc {
    YamlDoc {
        keys:     [[(0 as u8); 64]; 32],
        key_lens: [0; 32],
        str_vals: [[(0 as u8); 128]; 32],
        str_lens: [0; 32],
        num_vals: [0.0; 32],
        types:    [0; 32],
        count:    0,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Internal helpers (must precede callers)
// ============================================================================

// Skip spaces and tabs (but not newlines). Returns new position.
fn yaml_skip_ws(input: &[u8; 4096], pos: i32, len: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var p = pos
    while p < len {
        let c = input[p as usize]
        if c == (32 as u8) || c == (9 as u8) {
            p = p + 1
        } else {
            return p
        }
    }
    p
}

// Skip to end of current line (past '\n'). Returns new position.
fn yaml_skip_line(input: &[u8; 4096], pos: i32, len: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var p = pos
    while p < len {
        let c = input[p as usize]
        p = p + 1
        if c == (10 as u8) {
            return p
        }
    }
    p
}

// Parse a quoted YAML double-quoted string body (after opening '"').
// Returns YStrResult; new_pos=-1 on error.
fn yaml_parse_quoted(input: &[u8; 4096], start: i32, len: i32) -> YStrResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var r = YStrResult {
        data:    [0; 128],
        str_len: 0,
        new_pos: 0 - 1,
    }
    var p = start
    var wpos: i32 = 0
    var done: i32 = 0
    while p < len && done == 0 {
        let c = input[p as usize]
        if c == (34 as u8) {
            // closing '"'
            p = p + 1
            done = 1
        } else if c == (92 as u8) {
            // escape
            p = p + 1
            if p >= len { return r }
            let esc = input[p as usize]
            if esc == (34 as u8) {
                if wpos < 127 { r.data[wpos as usize] = (34 as u8); wpos = wpos + 1 }
            } else if esc == (92 as u8) {
                if wpos < 127 { r.data[wpos as usize] = (92 as u8); wpos = wpos + 1 }
            } else if esc == (110 as u8) {
                if wpos < 127 { r.data[wpos as usize] = (10 as u8); wpos = wpos + 1 }
            } else if esc == (116 as u8) {
                if wpos < 127 { r.data[wpos as usize] = (9 as u8); wpos = wpos + 1 }
            } else {
                if wpos < 127 { r.data[wpos as usize] = esc; wpos = wpos + 1 }
            }
            p = p + 1
        } else if c == (10 as u8) || c == (13 as u8) {
            return r
        } else {
            if wpos < 127 { r.data[wpos as usize] = c; wpos = wpos + 1 }
            p = p + 1
        }
    }
    if done == 0 { return r }
    r.str_len = wpos
    r.new_pos = p
    r
}

// Parse a bare (unquoted) value token until whitespace, '#', or end-of-line.
// Returns number of bytes written into data and the new position.
struct YBareResult {
    data:    [u8; 128],
    str_len: i32,
    new_pos: i32,
}

fn yaml_parse_bare(input: &[u8; 4096], start: i32, len: i32) -> YBareResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var r = YBareResult {
        data:    [0; 128],
        str_len: 0,
        new_pos: start,
    }
    var p = start
    var wpos: i32 = 0
    var done: i32 = 0
    while p < len && done == 0 {
        let c = input[p as usize]
        if c == (10 as u8) || c == (13 as u8) || c == (35 as u8) {
            done = 1
        } else {
            if wpos < 127 { r.data[wpos as usize] = c; wpos = wpos + 1 }
            p = p + 1
        }
    }
    // Trim trailing spaces from bare value.
    while wpos > 0 && r.data[(wpos - 1) as usize] == (32 as u8) {
        wpos = wpos - 1
    }
    r.str_len = wpos
    r.new_pos = p
    r
}

// Parse a number from a YBareResult data buffer (len bytes).
fn yaml_number_from_bare(data: &[u8; 128], data_len: i32) -> YNumResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var p: i32 = 0
    var negative: i32 = 0
    if p < data_len && data[p as usize] == (45 as u8) {
        negative = 1
        p = p + 1
    }
    var int_part: f64 = 0.0
    var int_done: i32 = 0
    while p < data_len && int_done == 0 {
        let c = data[p as usize]
        if c >= (48 as u8) && c <= (57 as u8) {
            int_part = int_part * 10.0 + (c - (48 as u8)) as f64
            p = p + 1
        } else {
            int_done = 1
        }
    }
    var frac: f64 = 0.0
    var frac_div: f64 = 1.0
    if p < data_len && data[p as usize] == (46 as u8) {
        p = p + 1
        var frac_done: i32 = 0
        while p < data_len && frac_done == 0 {
            let c = data[p as usize]
            if c >= (48 as u8) && c <= (57 as u8) {
                frac = frac * 10.0 + (c - (48 as u8)) as f64
                frac_div = frac_div * 10.0
                p = p + 1
            } else {
                frac_done = 1
            }
        }
    }
    var result = int_part + frac / frac_div
    if negative == 1 { result = 0.0 - result }
    YNumResult { value: result, new_pos: p }
}

// Lowercase a byte (A-Z → a-z). Other bytes unchanged.
fn yaml_to_lower(c: u8) -> u8 {
    if c >= (65 as u8) && c <= (90 as u8) {
        (c + (32 as u8)) as u8
    } else {
        c
    }
}

// Check if bare data matches "true" (case-insensitive). 1=yes, 0=no.
fn yaml_is_true(data: &[u8; 128], data_len: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if data_len != 4 { return 0 }
    if yaml_to_lower(data[0]) != (116 as u8) { return 0 }  // t
    if yaml_to_lower(data[1]) != (114 as u8) { return 0 }  // r
    if yaml_to_lower(data[2]) != (117 as u8) { return 0 }  // u
    if yaml_to_lower(data[3]) != (101 as u8) { return 0 }  // e
    1
}

// Check if bare data matches "false" (case-insensitive). 1=yes, 0=no.
fn yaml_is_false(data: &[u8; 128], data_len: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if data_len != 5 { return 0 }
    if yaml_to_lower(data[0]) != (102 as u8) { return 0 }  // f
    if yaml_to_lower(data[1]) != (97 as u8)  { return 0 }  // a
    if yaml_to_lower(data[2]) != (108 as u8) { return 0 }  // l
    if yaml_to_lower(data[3]) != (115 as u8) { return 0 }  // s
    if yaml_to_lower(data[4]) != (101 as u8) { return 0 }  // e
    1
}

// Check if bare data matches "yes" (case-insensitive). 1=yes, 0=no.
fn yaml_is_yes(data: &[u8; 128], data_len: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if data_len != 3 { return 0 }
    if yaml_to_lower(data[0]) != (121 as u8) { return 0 }  // y
    if yaml_to_lower(data[1]) != (101 as u8) { return 0 }  // e
    if yaml_to_lower(data[2]) != (115 as u8) { return 0 }  // s
    1
}

// Check if bare data matches "no" (case-insensitive). 1=yes, 0=no.
fn yaml_is_no(data: &[u8; 128], data_len: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if data_len != 2 { return 0 }
    if yaml_to_lower(data[0]) != (110 as u8) { return 0 }  // n
    if yaml_to_lower(data[1]) != (111 as u8) { return 0 }  // o
    1
}

// Check if bare data matches "null" (case-insensitive) or "~". 1=yes, 0=no.
fn yaml_is_null(data: &[u8; 128], data_len: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if data_len == 1 && data[0] == (126 as u8) { return 1 }  // '~'
    if data_len != 4 { return 0 }
    if yaml_to_lower(data[0]) != (110 as u8) { return 0 }  // n
    if yaml_to_lower(data[1]) != (117 as u8) { return 0 }  // u
    if yaml_to_lower(data[2]) != (108 as u8) { return 0 }  // l
    if yaml_to_lower(data[3]) != (108 as u8) { return 0 }  // l
    1
}

// Returns 1 if byte is a decimal digit or '-' (start of number).
fn yaml_is_number_start(c: u8) -> i32 {
    if c >= (48 as u8) && c <= (57 as u8) { return 1 }
    if c == (45 as u8) { return 1 }
    0
}

// Compare a key slot in doc against provided key. Returns 1 if equal.
fn yaml_keys_equal(doc: &YamlDoc, slot: i32, key: &[u8; 64], key_len: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if doc.key_lens[slot as usize] != key_len { return 0 }
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < key_len {
        if doc.keys[slot as usize][i as usize] != key[i as usize] { return 0 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    1
}

// Find slot index for a key. Returns index or -1.
fn yaml_find_key(doc: &YamlDoc, key: &[u8; 64], key_len: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < doc.count {
        if yaml_keys_equal(doc, i, key, key_len) == 1 {
            return i
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    0 - 1
}

// ============================================================================
// yaml_parse — main parse entry point
// ============================================================================

// Parse a flat YAML document from input bytes.
// Handles: key: value pairs, # comments, blank lines.
// Value detection: quoted strings, numbers, bool (true/false/yes/no),
//                  null/~, and bare strings.
// Returns 0 on success, -1 on error.
pub fn yaml_parse(input: &[u8; 4096], len: i32, doc: &!YamlDoc) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var p: i32 = 0
    while p < len {
        // Skip leading spaces/tabs.
        p = yaml_skip_ws(input, p, len)
        if p >= len { return 0 }

        let c0 = input[p as usize]

        if c0 == (10 as u8) || c0 == (13 as u8) {
            // Blank line.
            p = p + 1
            if c0 == (13 as u8) && p < len && input[p as usize] == (10 as u8) {
                p = p + 1
            }
        } else if c0 == (35 as u8) {
            // '#' comment
            p = yaml_skip_line(input, p, len)
        } else if c0 == (45 as u8) && p + 2 < len && input[(p+1) as usize] == (45 as u8) && input[(p+2) as usize] == (45 as u8) {
            // '---' document marker — skip line
            p = yaml_skip_line(input, p, len)
        } else {
            // Parse key — bare key chars: alphanumeric, '-', '_', '.', ' ' before ':'
            // Keys end at ':'
            var key64: [u8; 64] = [0; 64]
            var klen: i32 = 0
            var key_done: i32 = 0
            while p < len && key_done == 0 {
                let kc = input[p as usize]
                if kc == (58 as u8) {
                    // ':' — end of key
                    key_done = 1
                } else if kc == (10 as u8) || kc == (13 as u8) {
                    key_done = 1
                } else {
                    if klen < 63 {
                        key64[klen as usize] = kc
                        klen = klen + 1
                    }
                    p = p + 1
                }
            }
            // Trim trailing spaces from key.
            while klen > 0 && key64[(klen - 1) as usize] == (32 as u8) {
                klen = klen - 1
            }

            if klen == 0 || p >= len {
                // No valid key or no ':' found — skip line.
                p = yaml_skip_line(input, p, len)
            } else {
                // Consume the ':'.
                p = p + 1
                // Skip whitespace after ':'.
                p = yaml_skip_ws(input, p, len)

                if doc.count < 32 {
                    let slot = doc.count
                    // Copy key into slot.
                    var ki: i32 = 0
                    while ki < klen {
                        doc.keys[slot as usize][ki as usize] = key64[ki as usize]
                        ki = ki + 1
                    }
                    doc.key_lens[slot as usize] = klen

                    if p >= len || input[p as usize] == (10 as u8) || input[p as usize] == (13 as u8) {
                        // Null value (empty after colon).
                        doc.types[slot as usize] = 3
                        doc.count = doc.count + 1
                    } else {
                        let vc = input[p as usize]

                        if vc == (34 as u8) {
                            // Quoted string.
                            p = p + 1
                            let qr = yaml_parse_quoted(input, p, len)
                            if qr.new_pos < 0 { return 0 - 1 }
                            p = qr.new_pos
                            doc.types[slot as usize] = 0
                            doc.str_lens[slot as usize] = qr.str_len
                            var si: i32 = 0
                            while si < qr.str_len {
                                doc.str_vals[slot as usize][si as usize] = qr.data[si as usize]
                                si = si + 1
                            }
                            doc.count = doc.count + 1

                        } else {
                            // Bare value — read until end of line / comment.
                            let br = yaml_parse_bare(input, p, len)
                            p = br.new_pos

                            if yaml_is_null(&br.data, br.str_len) == 1 {
                                doc.types[slot as usize] = 3
                                doc.count = doc.count + 1

                            } else if yaml_is_true(&br.data, br.str_len) == 1 || yaml_is_yes(&br.data, br.str_len) == 1 {
                                doc.types[slot as usize] = 2
                                doc.num_vals[slot as usize] = 1.0
                                doc.count = doc.count + 1

                            } else if yaml_is_false(&br.data, br.str_len) == 1 || yaml_is_no(&br.data, br.str_len) == 1 {
                                doc.types[slot as usize] = 2
                                doc.num_vals[slot as usize] = 0.0
                                doc.count = doc.count + 1

                            } else if br.str_len > 0 && yaml_is_number_start(br.data[0]) == 1 {
                                // Attempt numeric parse.
                                let nr = yaml_number_from_bare(&br.data, br.str_len)
                                doc.types[slot as usize] = 1
                                doc.num_vals[slot as usize] = nr.value
                                doc.count = doc.count + 1

                            } else if br.str_len > 0 {
                                // Bare string value.
                                doc.types[slot as usize] = 0
                                doc.str_lens[slot as usize] = br.str_len
                                var bsi: i32 = 0
                                while bsi < br.str_len {
                                    doc.str_vals[slot as usize][bsi as usize] = br.data[bsi as usize]
                                    bsi = bsi + 1
                                }
                                doc.count = doc.count + 1

                            } else {
                                // Empty bare value → null.
                                doc.types[slot as usize] = 3
                                doc.count = doc.count + 1
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Skip trailing comment or EOL.
                p = yaml_skip_ws(input, p, len)
                if p < len {
                    let trail = input[p as usize]
                    if trail == (35 as u8) {
                        p = yaml_skip_line(input, p, len)
                    } else if trail == (10 as u8) || trail == (13 as u8) {
                        p = p + 1
                        if trail == (13 as u8) && p < len && input[p as usize] == (10 as u8) {
                            p = p + 1
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    0
}

// ============================================================================
// Accessor functions
// ============================================================================

// Returns string length; -1 if not found or not a string.
// NOTE: &![u8;128] mutations do NOT propagate in JIT — use doc.str_vals[slot] directly.
pub fn yaml_get_string(doc: &YamlDoc, key: &[u8; 64], key_len: i32, out: &![u8; 128]) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let idx = yaml_find_key(doc, key, key_len)
    if idx < 0 { return 0 - 1 }
    if doc.types[idx as usize] != 0 { return 0 - 1 }
    let slen = doc.str_lens[idx as usize]
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < slen {
        out[i as usize] = doc.str_vals[idx as usize][i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    slen
}

// Returns number value, or 0.0 if not found / not numeric.
pub fn yaml_get_number(doc: &YamlDoc, key: &[u8; 64], key_len: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let idx = yaml_find_key(doc, key, key_len)
    if idx < 0 { return 0.0 }
    if doc.types[idx as usize] != 1 { return 0.0 }
    doc.num_vals[idx as usize]
}

// Returns 0 or 1 for bool, -1 if not found / not a bool.
pub fn yaml_get_bool(doc: &YamlDoc, key: &[u8; 64], key_len: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let idx = yaml_find_key(doc, key, key_len)
    if idx < 0 { return 0 - 1 }
    if doc.types[idx as usize] != 2 { return 0 - 1 }
    if doc.num_vals[idx as usize] > 0.5 { return 1 }
    0
}

// Returns total number of key-value pairs in document.
pub fn yaml_doc_count(doc: &YamlDoc) -> i32 {
    doc.count
}

// ============================================================================
// Self-tests
// ============================================================================

pub fn yaml_self_test() -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var fail: i32 = 0

    // T1: empty doc
    var doc = yaml_doc_new()
    if doc.count != 0 { fail = fail + 1 }

    // T2: parse integer  "count: 42\n"
    var raw: [u8; 4096] = [0; 4096]
    raw[0]  = (99 as u8)   // c
    raw[1]  = (111 as u8)  // o
    raw[2]  = (117 as u8)  // u
    raw[3]  = (110 as u8)  // n
    raw[4]  = (116 as u8)  // t
    raw[5]  = (58 as u8)   // :
    raw[6]  = (32 as u8)   // space
    raw[7]  = (52 as u8)   // 4
    raw[8]  = (50 as u8)   // 2
    raw[9]  = (10 as u8)   // \n
    let r1 = yaml_parse(&raw, 10, &!doc)
    if r1 != 0 { fail = fail + 1 }
    if doc.count != 1 { fail = fail + 1 }
    if doc.types[0] != 1 { fail = fail + 1 }
    let vd = doc.num_vals[0] - 42.0
    let avd = if vd < 0.0 { 0.0 - vd } else { vd }
    if avd > 0.0001 { fail = fail + 1 }

    // T3: parse bool  "active: true\n"
    var doc2 = yaml_doc_new()
    var raw2: [u8; 4096] = [0; 4096]
    raw2[0]  = (97 as u8)   // a
    raw2[1]  = (99 as u8)   // c
    raw2[2]  = (116 as u8)  // t
    raw2[3]  = (105 as u8)  // i
    raw2[4]  = (118 as u8)  // v
    raw2[5]  = (101 as u8)  // e
    raw2[6]  = (58 as u8)   // :
    raw2[7]  = (32 as u8)   // space
    raw2[8]  = (116 as u8)  // t
    raw2[9]  = (114 as u8)  // r
    raw2[10] = (117 as u8)  // u
    raw2[11] = (101 as u8)  // e
    raw2[12] = (10 as u8)   // \n
    let r2 = yaml_parse(&raw2, 13, &!doc2)
    if r2 != 0 { fail = fail + 1 }
    if doc2.count != 1 { fail = fail + 1 }
    if doc2.types[0] != 2 { fail = fail + 1 }
    let bv = doc2.num_vals[0]
    if bv < 0.5 { fail = fail + 1 }

    // T4: doc.count (direct field access — avoids borrow conflict after &!doc)
    if doc.count != 1 { fail = fail + 1 }

    fail
}

// === FILE: tests/compile-fail/borrow_call_conflict_explicit.sio ===
//@ compile-fail
//@ error-pattern: borrow

fn read_exclusive(r: &!i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    *r
}

fn main() -> i32 with Mut {
    var x: i64 = 42
    let hold = &x

    // A live shared borrow conflicts with explicit exclusive borrow at call boundary.
    let y = read_exclusive(&!x)
    if y >= 0 {
        return 0
    }
    0
}


// === FILE: tests/compile-fail/borrow_call_exclusive_conflict.sio ===
//@ compile-fail
//@ error-pattern: borrow

fn read_exclusive(r: &!i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    *r
}

fn main() -> i32 with Mut {
    var x: i64 = 11
    let hold = &x

    // Shared borrow is active, so an exclusive call-boundary borrow must fail.
    let y = read_exclusive(&!x)
    if y >= 0 {
        return 0
    }
    0
}

// === FILE: tests/compile-fail/borrow_conflict.sio ===
//@ compile-fail
//@ error-pattern: cannot borrow

    *r
}

    *r
}

    let shared = &x          // shared borrow
    let exclusive = &!x      // ERROR: exclusive borrow while shared active
    return 0
}

// === FILE: tests/compile-fail/causal_m_bias.sio ===
//@ compile-fail
//@ error-pattern: E067
//@ ignore
//@ description: M-bias structure — naive conditioning on collider M opens a spurious path

// Causal DAG: X <- A -> M <- B -> Y
// with A, B unobserved (hidden common causes).
// M is a collider on the path A -> M <- B.
// Conditioning on M opens the backdoor path X <- A -> M <- B -> Y.
// Without observing A or B, no valid adjustment set exists.
// E067: non_identifiable_query

fn estimate_m_biased(x: f64, m: f64, y: f64) -> f64 with IO {
    // Naive regression on M introduces collider bias
    y + (0.0 - x)
}

fn main() -> i64 with IO {
    42
}


// === FILE: tests/compile-fail/causal_no_adjustment.sio ===
//@ compile-fail
//@ error-pattern: E067
//@ ignore
//@ description: all confounders unobserved — no valid adjustment set can be constructed

// Causal DAG: X <-> Y (bidirected confounding arc, hidden common cause).
// The only confounding path is through the hidden common cause.
// Since no node is observed that could serve as a deconfounding variable,
// P(Y|do(X)) is non-identifiable from observational data.
// E067: non_identifiable_query

fn estimate_direct_confound(x: f64, y: f64) -> f64 with IO {
    // Direct confounding: X and Y share hidden cause
    y + (0.0 - x)
}

fn main() -> i64 with IO {
    42
}

// === FILE: tests/compile-fail/cond_indep_violation.sio ===
//@ compile-fail
//@ error-pattern: E072
//@ ignore
//@ description: conditional independence violation — X not d-separated from Y without conditioning

// In a causal graph where X directly causes Y (X -> Y),
// X is NOT conditionally independent of Y on the empty conditioning set.
// Claiming X ⊥⊥ Y | {} (no conditioning variables) must be rejected as a type error (E072).
//
// This tests the CI track (Sprint 20): TyCondIndep / IndepKnowledge<T, X, Y | Z>.
// The Pearl d-separation check (Bayes Ball algorithm) must detect that:
//   - In the causal DAG with edge X -> Y, there is an active path X -> Y
//   - Conditioning on {} does NOT block this path
//   - Therefore X ⊥⊥ Y | {} is FALSE and must be rejected
//
// Reference: Pearl 1995, d-separation; Bayes Ball (Shachter 1998).

fn direct_cause(x: f64) -> f64 with IO {
    // Y = 2 * X — direct functional dependence, no d-separation possible without conditioning
    x * 2.0
}

fn compute_marginals(x_val: f64) -> f64 with IO {
    // Computes Y from X — establishing the direct causal link in the DAG
    direct_cause(x_val)
}

fn main() -> i64 with IO {
    let x: f64 = 1.0
    let y: f64 = compute_marginals(x)
    // The following claim would be a type error if the user annotated:
    //   let ci: IndepKnowledge<f64, x, y | {}> = assert_indep(x, y, cond: empty)
    // Because x -> y is a direct edge — Bayes Ball finds an active path.
    // E072 is emitted when the claimed independence contradicts the causal DAG structure.
    42
}


// === FILE: tests/compile-fail/confidence_gate_reject.sio ===
//@ compile-fail
//@ error-pattern: confidence gate violation
// Confidence gate: low-confidence measurement REJECTED by the gate.
// measure(10.0, uncertainty: 5.0) → relative uncertainty = 5.0/10 = 0.5
// confidence = 1.0 - 0.5 = 0.5 (500/1000) → FAILS minconf: 0.95 (950/1000)

fn safe_dosing(weight: f64, clearance: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Epistemic(950) {
    return weight * clearance
}

fn main() with IO, Mut, Epistemic {
    let kw: Knowledge<f64> = measure(10.0, uncertainty: 5.0)
    let kc: Knowledge<f64> = measure(5.0, uncertainty: 0.1)
    let w = kw.value
    let c = kc.value
    let dose = safe_dosing(w, c)
    print("dose="); println(dose)
}

// === FILE: tests/compile-fail/erdos90_unwrap_unsafe.sio ===
//@ compile-fail
//@ error-pattern: E170
// Static unwrap-safety witness for the epistemic unit-distance study: extracting
// Knowledge<f64>.value WITHOUT `with Epistemic` is a COMPILE error (E170). This is the
// one static guarantee erdos90_epistemic.sio relies on. (Remove `with Epistemic` from
// dist2_gum and you get exactly this error.)
module research::erdos90_unwrap_unsafe

fn dist2_unsafe(ax: Knowledge<f64>, bx: Knowledge<f64>) -> f64 with Mut {
    let dx = ax.value - bx.value   // E170: .value requires `with Epistemic`
    return dx * dx
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Epistemic {
    let a: Knowledge<f64> = measure(2.0, uncertainty: 0.01)
    let b: Knowledge<f64> = measure(3.0, uncertainty: 0.01)
    let d = dist2_unsafe(a, b)
    print("unreachable\n")
    return 0
}
