// === FILE: tests/run-pass/d4_optimizer_integration.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//! D.4 tensor-level optimizer integration.

use tensor::types::{shape1, tensor_get, tensor_set}
use tensor::ops::{tensor_scalar, tensor_zeros, tensor_free}
use nn::optimizer::{
    param_store_new, param_store_register, param_store_zero_grad,
    param_store_set_grad_value, param_store_grad_value,
    adam_new, adam_new_full, adam_step, adamw_step,
    sgd_new_with_momentum, sgd_step,
    clip_grad_global_norm, clip_grad_value,
    param_store_free, d4_optimizer_abs, d4_optimizer_sqrt,
}

fn check_near(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> bool {
    d4_optimizer_abs(a - b) <= tol
}

fn test_parameter_store_zero_grad() with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var w = tensor_scalar(1.0)
    var store = param_store_new()
    let pid = param_store_register(&!store, &!w, 17)
    param_store_set_grad_value(&!store, pid, 0 as usize, 9.0)
    assert(check_near(param_store_grad_value(&store, pid, 0 as usize), 9.0, 1.0e-12))
    param_store_zero_grad(&!store)
    assert(check_near(param_store_grad_value(&store, pid, 0 as usize), 0.0, 1.0e-12))
    param_store_free(&!store)
    tensor_free(&!w)
}

fn test_adam_quadratic() with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var w = tensor_scalar(0.0)
    var store = param_store_new()
    let pid = param_store_register(&!store, &!w, 1)
    var opt = adam_new(0.01)
    var step: usize = 0 as usize
    while step < 1000 as usize {
        let v = tensor_get(&w, 0 as usize)
        param_store_zero_grad(&!store)
        param_store_set_grad_value(&!store, pid, 0 as usize, 2.0 * (v - 3.0))
        adam_step(&!opt, &!store)
        step = step + 1 as usize
    }
    let final_w = tensor_get(&w, 0 as usize)
    assert(d4_optimizer_abs(final_w - 3.0) < 0.01)
    param_store_free(&!store)
    tensor_free(&!w)
}

fn test_adamw_quadratic_stable() with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var w = tensor_scalar(0.0)
    var store = param_store_new()
    let pid = param_store_register(&!store, &!w, 2)
    var opt = adam_new_full(0.01, 0.9, 0.999, 1.0e-8)
    var step: usize = 0 as usize
    while step < 1200 as usize {
        let v = tensor_get(&w, 0 as usize)
        param_store_zero_grad(&!store)
        param_store_set_grad_value(&!store, pid, 0 as usize, 2.0 * (v - 3.0))
        adamw_step(&!opt, &!store, 0.001)
        step = step + 1 as usize
    }
    let final_w = tensor_get(&w, 0 as usize)
    assert(final_w > 2.8)
    assert(final_w < 3.1)
    param_store_free(&!store)
    tensor_free(&!w)
}

fn lin_x(i: usize) -> f64 {
    ((i as f64) - 25.0) / 10.0
}

fn lin_y(i: usize) -> f64 {
    2.0 * lin_x(i) - 1.0
}

fn test_linear_regression_adam_and_sgd() with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var wb = tensor_zeros(shape1(2 as usize))
    tensor_set(&!wb, 0 as usize, 0.0)
    tensor_set(&!wb, 1 as usize, 0.0)
    var store = param_store_new()
    let pid = param_store_register(&!store, &!wb, 3)
    var opt = adam_new(0.01)
    var step: usize = 0 as usize
    while step < 2000 as usize {
        var gw = 0.0
        var gb = 0.0
        var i: usize = 0 as usize
        while i < 50 as usize {
            let x = lin_x(i)
            let pred = tensor_get(&wb, 0 as usize) * x + tensor_get(&wb, 1 as usize)
            let err = pred - lin_y(i)
            gw = gw + 2.0 * err * x / 50.0
            gb = gb + 2.0 * err / 50.0
            i = i + 1 as usize
        }
        param_store_zero_grad(&!store)
        param_store_set_grad_value(&!store, pid, 0 as usize, gw)
        param_store_set_grad_value(&!store, pid, 1 as usize, gb)
        adam_step(&!opt, &!store)
        step = step + 1 as usize
    }
    assert(d4_optimizer_abs(tensor_get(&wb, 0 as usize) - 2.0) < 0.1)
    assert(d4_optimizer_abs(tensor_get(&wb, 1 as usize) + 1.0) < 0.1)
    param_store_free(&!store)
    tensor_free(&!wb)

    var wb2 = tensor_zeros(shape1(2 as usize))
    var store2 = param_store_new()
    let pid2 = param_store_register(&!store2, &!wb2, 4)
    var sgd = sgd_new_with_momentum(0.01, 0.9)
    step = 0 as usize
    while step < 2500 as usize {
        var gw2 = 0.0
        var gb2 = 0.0
        var j: usize = 0 as usize
        while j < 50 as usize {
            let x2 = lin_x(j)
            let pred2 = tensor_get(&wb2, 0 as usize) * x2 + tensor_get(&wb2, 1 as usize)
            let err2 = pred2 - lin_y(j)
            gw2 = gw2 + 2.0 * err2 * x2 / 50.0
            gb2 = gb2 + 2.0 * err2 / 50.0
            j = j + 1 as usize
        }
        param_store_zero_grad(&!store2)
        param_store_set_grad_value(&!store2, pid2, 0 as usize, gw2)
        param_store_set_grad_value(&!store2, pid2, 1 as usize, gb2)
        sgd_step(&!sgd, &!store2)
        step = step + 1 as usize
    }
    assert(d4_optimizer_abs(tensor_get(&wb2, 0 as usize) - 2.0) < 0.1)
    assert(d4_optimizer_abs(tensor_get(&wb2, 1 as usize) + 1.0) < 0.1)
    param_store_free(&!store2)
    tensor_free(&!wb2)
}

fn test_gradient_clipping() with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var w = tensor_zeros(shape1(2 as usize))
    var store = param_store_new()
    let pid = param_store_register(&!store, &!w, 5)
    param_store_set_grad_value(&!store, pid, 0 as usize, 30.0)
    param_store_set_grad_value(&!store, pid, 1 as usize, 40.0)
    let pre = clip_grad_global_norm(&!store, 1.0)
    let post = d4_optimizer_sqrt(
        param_store_grad_value(&store, pid, 0 as usize) * param_store_grad_value(&store, pid, 0 as usize)
        + param_store_grad_value(&store, pid, 1 as usize) * param_store_grad_value(&store, pid, 1 as usize)
    )
    assert(check_near(pre, 50.0, 1.0e-9))
    assert(post <= 1.000001)
    param_store_set_grad_value(&!store, pid, 0 as usize, 5.0)
    param_store_set_grad_value(&!store, pid, 1 as usize, 0.0 - 5.0)
    clip_grad_value(&!store, 0.25)
    assert(check_near(param_store_grad_value(&store, pid, 0 as usize), 0.25, 1.0e-12))
    assert(check_near(param_store_grad_value(&store, pid, 1 as usize), 0.0 - 0.25, 1.0e-12))
    param_store_free(&!store)
    tensor_free(&!w)
}

fn run_adam_100() -> f64 with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var w = tensor_scalar(0.0)
    var store = param_store_new()
    let pid = param_store_register(&!store, &!w, 6)
    var opt = adam_new(0.01)
    var step: usize = 0 as usize
    while step < 100 as usize {
        let v = tensor_get(&w, 0 as usize)
        param_store_zero_grad(&!store)
        param_store_set_grad_value(&!store, pid, 0 as usize, 2.0 * (v - 3.0))
        adam_step(&!opt, &!store)
        step = step + 1 as usize
    }
    let out = tensor_get(&w, 0 as usize)
    param_store_free(&!store)
    tensor_free(&!w)
    out
}

fn test_determinism() with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let a = run_adam_100()
    let b = run_adam_100()
    assert(a == b)
}

pub fn main() with IO, Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    println("d4 parameter store")
    test_parameter_store_zero_grad()
    println("d4 adam quadratic")
    test_adam_quadratic()
    println("d4 adamw")
    test_adamw_quadratic_stable()
    println("d4 linear")
    test_linear_regression_adam_and_sgd()
    println("d4 clipping")
    test_gradient_clipping()
    println("d4 determinism")
    test_determinism()
    println("D4_OPTIMIZER_INTEGRATION_PASS")
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/darwin_compartments_coronary_smc_smoke.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout-contains: CORONARY_SMC_SMOKE_PASS
//@ timeout: 30

// Smoke test for stdlib/darwin_pbpk/compartments/coronary_smc.sio (Stage G-ε-17).
//
// Exercises the 5%-of-heart sub-compartment carve-out under three regimes
// (f_local = 0.30 cypher default, 0.00 systemic-only, 1.00 local-only) and
// asserts two distinct invariants:
//
//   (a) Mass-balance across the routing fork (load-bearing): the deposited
//       mass into coronary_smc plus the systemic mass routed through blood
//       equals the rate-based release integral exactly — the splitter must
//       not leak. Checked at 1e-9 relative tolerance against the same
//       rectangle-rule integral both sides consume.
//   (b) Split ratio matches f_local exactly: deposited / total_via_rate
//       within 1e-9 of f_local. Confirms routing semantics.
//
// The analytical Higuchi cumulative K_H · √t is a third reference point;
// the rectangle-rule integral drifts ~0.5 % below it because the rate
// formula caps the t→0 singularity. Smoke asserts the two integrals agree
// to within 1 % (an integration-method drift, not a routing issue).
//
// The dissertation §4.5.3 footnote points at this test as the routing-
// integrity gate for the 5%-mass carve-out and the Cypher f_local = 0.30
// claim.

use darwin_pbpk::compartments::coronary_smc::*
use darwin_pbpk::release::biomaterial_release::*

fn fmt_6(x: f64) -> i64 { return (x * 1000000.0) as i64 }
fn fabs(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x } else { return x } }

struct ScenarioResult {
    deposited:       f64,
    systemic:        f64,
    total_via_rate:  f64,
    total_via_cum:   f64,
    c_blood_end:     f64,
}

fn run_scenario(f_local: f64) -> ScenarioResult with Mut, Div, IO, Panic {
    let pd = coronary_smc_default_params()
    let p = coronary_smc_params(pd.v_csmc, pd.q_csmc, pd.kp_csmc, f_local)
    let rel = release_higuchi(0.14, 0.00417)   // Cypher sirolimus DES, Reza 2003

    var s = coronary_smc_state_zero()
    var c_blood = 0.0
    var systemic_mass = 0.0
    var rate_integral = 0.0
    let v_blood = 5.0
    let cl_hep  = 12.4

    let dt = 0.01
    var t = 0.0
    let t_end = 24.0
    while t < t_end {
        let rr = release_rate(rel, t)
        rate_integral = rate_integral + dt * rr
        s = coronary_smc_step(s, p, c_blood, rr, dt)
        let sys_flux = coronary_smc_systemic_flux(p, rr)
        let dcb = sys_flux / v_blood - cl_hep * c_blood / v_blood
        c_blood = c_blood + dt * dcb
        if c_blood < 0.0 { c_blood = 0.0 }
        systemic_mass = systemic_mass + dt * sys_flux
        t = t + dt
    }

    let cum = release_cumulative(rel, t_end)
    ScenarioResult {
        deposited:      s.deposited_mass,
        systemic:       systemic_mass,
        total_via_rate: rate_integral,
        total_via_cum:  cum,
        c_blood_end:    c_blood,
    }
}

fn check_scenario(r: ScenarioResult, f_local: f64) -> bool with Mut, Div, IO {
    print(" f_local*1e6=")
    print(fmt_6(f_local))
    print(" deposited*1e6=")
    print(fmt_6(r.deposited))
    print(" systemic*1e6=")
    print(fmt_6(r.systemic))
    print(" total_rate*1e6=")
    print(fmt_6(r.total_via_rate))
    print(" total_cum*1e6=")
    println(fmt_6(r.total_via_cum))

    // (a) routing mass-balance — exact under f64
    let bal = (r.deposited + r.systemic) - r.total_via_rate
    let bal_rel = fabs(bal) / r.total_via_rate
    if bal_rel > 1.0e-9 {
        print("FAIL: routing mass-balance drift ")
        print(fmt_6(bal_rel * 1.0e9))
        println(" parts-per-billion")
        return false
    }

    // (b) split ratio matches f_local within 1e-9
    let split = r.deposited / r.total_via_rate
    let split_diff = fabs(split - f_local)
    if split_diff > 1.0e-9 {
        print("FAIL: split ratio diff*1e9=")
        println(fmt_6(split_diff * 1.0e9))
        return false
    }

    // (c) rectangle-rule integral within 1 % of analytical Higuchi cumulative
    let int_diff = fabs(r.total_via_rate - r.total_via_cum) / r.total_via_cum
    if int_diff > 0.01 {
        print("FAIL: rate-integral vs cumulative drift ")
        print(fmt_6(int_diff * 100.0))
        println(" %")
        return false
    }

    return true
}

fn main() with Mut, Div, IO, Panic {
    println("coronary_smc smoke — 24 h Higuchi DES, 3 f_local regimes")

    print("scenario=cypher_default ")
    let r1 = run_scenario(0.30)
    if !check_scenario(r1, 0.30) { return }

    print("scenario=zero_local     ")
    let r2 = run_scenario(0.0)
    if !check_scenario(r2, 0.0)  { return }

    print("scenario=all_local      ")
    let r3 = run_scenario(1.0)
    if !check_scenario(r3, 1.0)  { return }

    // Sanity: zero-local must produce some systemic blood concentration;
    // all-local must produce zero blood concentration (no systemic input).
    if r2.c_blood_end < 1.0e-9 {
        println("FAIL: zero-local scenario produced no blood concentration")
        return
    }
    if r3.c_blood_end > 1.0e-9 {
        println("FAIL: all-local scenario produced nonzero blood concentration")
        return
    }

    println("CORONARY_SMC_SMOKE_PASS")
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/darwin_pbpk28_smoke.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout-contains: PBPK28_CORE_SMOKE_PASS

// Smoke test for stdlib/darwin_pbpk/tsit5_pbpk28.sio + core/pbpk28_params.sio
// (Stage G-ε-15).
//
// Runs the fully-coupled CN step on the rapamycin profile from a 0.05 mg
// IV bolus (= 0.01 mg/L blood C_v at t=0) for 30 h with dt = 0.1 h
// (300 steps, rel_mid = 0). Confirms:
//
//   1. Step is stable — no NaN / inf / negative concentrations.
//   2. Total mass strictly decays (the central CL drains the system,
//      no source).
//   3. Liver organ-average concentration tracks blood concentration with the
//      expected Kp=5.4 accumulation (peak C_liver,avg > 3× C_blood).
//   4. Brain organ-average stays low (Kp=0.10 + small PS → BBB barrier
//      keeps C_brain,avg < 0.2× C_blood).
//
// Math parity with the parity ref is enforced by case 1 of
// `dissertation_pbpk28_parity_gate.sh` once the parity ref is rewired to
// import this module (G-ζ-1).

use darwin_pbpk::core::pbpk28_params::*
use darwin_pbpk::tsit5_pbpk28::*

fn fmt_6(x: f64) -> i64 { return (x * 1000000.0) as i64 }

fn main() with Mut, Div, IO {
    let p = pbpk28_params_rapamycin()
    var s = pbpk28_state_zero()
    s.cv[0] = 0.01      // 0.05 mg / 5 L = 0.01 mg/L blood C_v at t=0

    let dt = 0.001     // matches parity ref's dt
    let n_steps = 30000   // 30 h

    let m_initial = pbpk28_total_mass(s, p)
    print("initial total mass (mg)*1e6=")
    println(fmt_6(m_initial))

    var step = 0
    var m_prev = m_initial
    var liver_peak = 0.0
    var brain_peak = 0.0
    while step < n_steps {
        s = pbpk28_full_cn_step(s, p, 0.0, dt)
        let m_now = pbpk28_total_mass(s, p)

        // Invariant 1: no NaN / inf / negative.
        let inv_ok = (s.cv[0] >= 0.0) && (s.cv[0] < 1.0e3)
        if !inv_ok {
            println("FAIL: blood C_v out of physical range")
            return
        }

        // Invariant 2: total mass decays.
        if m_now > m_prev * 1.0001 {
            print("FAIL: total mass grew at step="); print(step + 1)
            print(" m_prev*1e6="); print(fmt_6(m_prev))
            print(" m_now*1e6="); println(fmt_6(m_now))
            return
        }
        m_prev = m_now

        // Track peaks for liver / brain organ-averages.
        let cavg_liver = pbpk28_organ_average(s, p, 1)
        let cavg_brain = pbpk28_organ_average(s, p, 3)
        if cavg_liver > liver_peak { liver_peak = cavg_liver }
        if cavg_brain > brain_peak { brain_peak = cavg_brain }

        let report = (step + 1) == 100 || (step + 1) == 6000 || (step + 1) == 30000
        if report {
            print("step="); print(step + 1)
            print(" cb*1e6=");         print(fmt_6(s.cv[0]))
            print(" cliver_avg*1e6="); print(fmt_6(cavg_liver))
            print(" cbrain_avg*1e6="); println(fmt_6(cavg_brain))
        }
        step = step + 1
    }

    let m_final = pbpk28_total_mass(s, p)
    print("final total mass (mg)*1e6=")
    println(fmt_6(m_final))

    // Mass decayed monotonically and is essentially gone: with CL_hep=12.4
    // L/h on V_eff = V_b + Σ V_i·Kp_i ≈ 49 L, exp(-12.4·30/49) ≈ 5e-4 so
    // we expect m_final/m_initial ≈ 5e-4. Allow [1e-5, 0.1].
    let decay_ratio = m_final / m_initial
    let decay_ok = (decay_ratio > 1.0e-5) && (decay_ratio < 0.1)
    if !decay_ok {
        print("FAIL: mass decay outside band [1e-5, 0.1]: ratio*1e6=")
        println(fmt_6(decay_ratio))
        return
    }

    // Liver peak (Kp=5.4 + early high blood) > 3× initial blood. C_blood at
    // t=0 is 0.01 mg/L; liver organ-average reaches at least 0.005 mg/L.
    let liver_ok = liver_peak > 5.0e-3
    if !liver_ok {
        print("FAIL: liver peak too low: ")
        println(fmt_6(liver_peak))
        return
    }

    // Brain (Kp=0.10, PS=88) stays below 0.2× initial blood = 2e-3 mg/L.
    let brain_ok = brain_peak < 2.0e-3
    if !brain_ok {
        print("FAIL: brain peak too high (BBB leak?): ")
        println(fmt_6(brain_peak))
        return
    }

    println("PBPK28_CORE_SMOKE_PASS")
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/darwin_pd_bergman_smoke.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout-contains: PD_BERGMAN_SMOKE_PASS

// Smoke test for stdlib/darwin_pbpk/pd/bergman_glucose_insulin.sio (Stage G-ε-14).
//
// Drives the linearised Bergman PD step under three pancreas-occupancy
// regimes:
//
//   1. occ = 0.0   — no drug, baseline (ΔG = ΔI = 0 forever).
//   2. occ = 0.5   — moderate GLP-1R occupancy: ΔI rises, ΔG drops.
//   3. occ = 0.9   — strong occupancy: ΔI rises more, ΔG drops further.
//
// Confirms the qualitative dissertation message: semaglutide drives
// pancreatic GLP-1R occupancy → insulin secretion rises → plasma glucose
// falls.

use darwin_pbpk::pd::bergman_glucose_insulin::*

fn fmt_4(x: f64) -> i64 { return (x * 10000.0) as i64 }

fn run_bergman(occ: f64, n_steps: i64) -> BergmanState with Mut, Div, IO {
    let p = bergman_default_params()
    var s = bergman_state_init()
    let dt = 1.0    // 1 h per step
    var k = 0
    while k < n_steps {
        s = pd_step_glucose_insulin(s, occ, p, dt)
        k = k + 1
    }
    print("occ*1e4="); print(fmt_4(occ))
    print(" dG*1e4="); print(fmt_4(s.dg))
    print(" dI*1e4="); println(fmt_4(s.di))
    return s
}

fn main() with Mut, Div, IO {
    println("Bergman PD smoke — 24 h per scenario")

    // Scenario 1: no drug — both deviations stay at 0.
    print("scenario=baseline   ")
    let s1 = run_bergman(0.0, 24)
    let s1_ok = (s1.dg > -0.01) && (s1.dg < 0.01) && (s1.di > -0.01) && (s1.di < 0.01)
    if !s1_ok {
        println("FAIL: scenario 1 deviations not pinned to 0")
        return
    }

    // Scenario 2: moderate occupancy occ=0.5.
    // Equilibrium: k_I·ΔI = k_base·α·occ → ΔI = ΔI_b·α·occ = 10·1·0.5 = 5 mU/L
    // λ_G·ΔG = -S_I·G_b·ΔI → ΔG = -(S_I·G_b·ΔI)/λ_G
    //                       = -(0.02·100·5)/(1.5+0.02·10)
    //                       = -10/1.7 ≈ -5.88 mg/dL
    // Insulin half-life ~3.3 min so 24 h is fully at equilibrium.
    print("scenario=moderate   ")
    let s2 = run_bergman(0.5, 24)
    let s2_di_ok = (s2.di > 4.5) && (s2.di < 5.5)
    let s2_dg_ok = (s2.dg < -5.0) && (s2.dg > -7.0)
    if !s2_di_ok {
        println("FAIL: scenario 2 ΔI not near 5.0 mU/L")
        return
    }
    if !s2_dg_ok {
        println("FAIL: scenario 2 ΔG not in [-7, -5] mg/dL")
        return
    }

    // Scenario 3: strong occupancy occ=0.9.
    // Equilibrium ΔI = 9.0 mU/L, ΔG ≈ -0.02·100·9/1.7 ≈ -10.6 mg/dL.
    print("scenario=strong     ")
    let s3 = run_bergman(0.9, 24)
    let s3_di_ok = (s3.di > 8.5) && (s3.di < 9.5)
    let s3_dg_ok = (s3.dg < -9.5) && (s3.dg > -12.0)
    if !s3_di_ok {
        println("FAIL: scenario 3 ΔI not near 9.0 mU/L")
        return
    }
    if !s3_dg_ok {
        println("FAIL: scenario 3 ΔG not in [-12, -9.5] mg/dL")
        return
    }

    // Absolute plasma values should always be positive and physiologically sane.
    let p = bergman_default_params()
    let g = bergman_plasma_glucose(s3, p)
    let i = bergman_plasma_insulin(s3, p)
    let g_ok = (g > 80.0) && (g < 110.0)
    let i_ok = (i > 15.0) && (i < 25.0)
    if !g_ok {
        println("FAIL: plasma glucose outside [80, 110]")
        return
    }
    if !i_ok {
        println("FAIL: plasma insulin outside [15, 25]")
        return
    }

    println("PD_BERGMAN_SMOKE_PASS")
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/darwin_pd_coronary_smc_smoke.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout-contains: PD_CORONARY_SMC_SMOKE_PASS

// Smoke test for stdlib/darwin_pbpk/pd/coronary_smc_prolif.sio (Stage G-ε-13).
//
// Drives the rapamycin PD pair-of-scalars step under three target_a regimes:
//
//   1. target_a = 1.0  (no drug, full mTORC1) → A stays at 1, N grows
//      under k_prolif (~5e-4 /h).
//   2. target_a = 0.1  (90% receptor inhibition) → A decays toward 0.1,
//      apoptosis term k_apo·(1-A) dominates, N held near 0.
//   3. target_a = 0.0  (full inhibition) → A → 0, N → 0 (apoptosis wins).
//
// Confirms the qualitative dissertation message: rapamycin elution at the
// stent suppresses neointimal growth by driving A below 1, which switches
// the N ODE from net-prolif to net-apoptosis.

use darwin_pbpk::pd::coronary_smc_prolif::*

fn fmt_6(x: f64) -> i64 { return (x * 1000000.0) as i64 }

fn run_scenario(target_a: f64, n_steps: i64) -> PdState with Mut, Div, IO {
    let p = coronary_pd_params()
    var s = pd_state_init()
    let dt = 1.0    // hours per step
    var k = 0
    while k < n_steps {
        s = pd_step_rapamycin(s, target_a, p, dt)
        k = k + 1
    }
    print("target_a*1e6=")
    print(fmt_6(target_a))
    print(" A*1e6=")
    print(fmt_6(s.a))
    print(" N*1e6=")
    println(fmt_6(s.n))
    return s
}

fn main() with Mut, Div, IO {
    println("PD rapamycin smoke — 168 h per scenario (1 week)")

    // Scenario 1: no drug — A stays at 1, N grows linearly at k_prolif
    print("scenario=no_drug  ")
    let s1 = run_scenario(1.0, 168)
    // A should remain at exactly 1.0
    let s1_a_ok = (s1.a > 0.99) && (s1.a < 1.01)
    // N at 168 h = k_prolif · 168 = 5e-4 · 168 = 0.084 (linear approx)
    let s1_n_ok = (s1.n > 0.05) && (s1.n < 0.10)
    if !s1_a_ok {
        println("FAIL: scenario 1 A not pinned at 1.0")
        return
    }
    if !s1_n_ok {
        println("FAIL: scenario 1 N out of [0.05, 0.10]")
        return
    }

    // Scenario 2: heavy inhibition — A → 0.1, N stays low
    print("scenario=partial  ")
    let s2 = run_scenario(0.1, 168)
    let s2_a_ok = (s2.a > 0.09) && (s2.a < 0.11)
    let s2_n_ok = (s2.n < 0.05)
    if !s2_a_ok {
        println("FAIL: scenario 2 A not near 0.1")
        return
    }
    if !s2_n_ok {
        println("FAIL: scenario 2 N too high")
        return
    }

    // Scenario 3: full inhibition — A → 0, N → 0
    print("scenario=full_inh ")
    let s3 = run_scenario(0.0, 168)
    let s3_a_ok = (s3.a < 0.05)
    let s3_n_ok = (s3.n < 0.01)
    if !s3_a_ok {
        println("FAIL: scenario 3 A not near 0")
        return
    }
    if !s3_n_ok {
        println("FAIL: scenario 3 N too high under full inhibition")
        return
    }

    // Late-lumen-loss stub: at α = 1.0 mm/unit-N, scenario 1's no-drug N
    // converts to ~0.084 mm LLL — same order of magnitude as RAVEL's ~0.74
    // bare-stent LLL at 6 months. Sanity check on the stub.
    let lll = pd_late_lumen_loss_mm(s1.n)
    let lll_ok = (lll > 0.05) && (lll < 0.10)
    if !lll_ok {
        println("FAIL: LLL stub gave unphysical value")
        return
    }

    println("PD_CORONARY_SMC_SMOKE_PASS")
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/darwin_sema_sc_depot_smoke.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout-contains: SEMA_SC_DEPOT_SMOKE_PASS

// Smoke test for stdlib/darwin_pbpk/scenarios/semaglutide_sc_depot.sio
// (Stage G-ε-16).
//
// Composes PBPK28 + GLP-1R TMDD + Bergman PD + SC depot release into a
// runnable end-to-end semaglutide scenario. Runs one weekly dosing cycle
// (168 h) at dt = 0.5 h (336 steps) and verifies:
//
//   1. SC release goes to ~half of cumulative bioavailable dose by 60 h
//      (k_a = ln 2 / 60 → t_half = 60 h by construction).
//   2. Blood C_b stays positive, peaks somewhere mid-week, and is still
//      detectable at end-of-week (t_half_elim ≫ 60 h).
//   3. Pancreas GLP-1R occupancy is non-trivial at end of week (drug
//      accumulates with kinetics slower than receptor binding).
//   4. ΔG is negative (glucose suppression — the dissertation's clinical
//      endpoint).

use darwin_pbpk::core::pbpk28_params::*
use darwin_pbpk::tsit5_pbpk28::*
use darwin_pbpk::tmdd::fkbp12_mtorc1::*
use darwin_pbpk::pd::bergman_glucose_insulin::*
use darwin_pbpk::scenarios::semaglutide_sc_depot::*

fn fmt_6(x: f64) -> i64 { return (x * 1000000.0) as i64 }
fn fmt_3(x: f64) -> i64 { return (x * 1000.0) as i64 }

fn main() with Mut, Div, IO {
    let p = pbpk28_params_semaglutide()
    let bp = bergman_default_params()
    var scen = sema_scenario_init()

    let dt = 0.5     // 30-min step
    let n_steps = 336    // 168 h = 7 days

    println("Semaglutide SC depot — 168 h cycle, 1 mg dose, dt=0.5h")
    println("step       t(h)  cb*1e6  c_panc*1e6  occ_panc*1e6  dG*1e3  dI*1e3")

    var step = 0
    var t = 0.0
    while step < n_steps {
        scen = sema_strang_step(scen, p, bp, t, dt)
        t = t + dt
        let report = (step + 1) == 12  || (step + 1) == 48  ||
                     (step + 1) == 120 || (step + 1) == 336
        if report {
            let cb = scen.pbpk.cv[0]
            let cavg_panc = pbpk28_organ_average(scen.pbpk, p, 12)
            let occ_panc = tmdd_occupancy(scen.tmdd_panc)
            print("step="); print(step + 1)
            print(" cb*1e6=");        print(fmt_6(cb))
            print(" cpanc*1e6=");     print(fmt_6(cavg_panc))
            print(" occ_panc*1e6="); print(fmt_6(occ_panc))
            print(" dG*1e3=");        print(fmt_3(scen.pd.dg))
            print(" dI*1e3=");        println(fmt_3(scen.pd.di))
        }
        step = step + 1
    }

    // Final-state invariants.
    let cb_final = scen.pbpk.cv[0]
    let occ_panc_final = tmdd_occupancy(scen.tmdd_panc)
    let dg_final = scen.pd.dg
    let di_final = scen.pd.di

    // (1) Blood concentration positive and non-trivial at end of week.
    // Expected scale: 0.89 mg bioavailable into V_eff ≈ 19 L → ~47 ng/mL
    // if all in central; partitioning across tissues reduces C_b to
    // ~20 ng/mL ≈ 2e-2 mg/L (this run observes 0.021 mg/L, consistent
    // with Overgaard 2019 peak ~25 ng/mL). Allow [1e-5, 1e-1].
    let cb_ok = (cb_final > 1.0e-5) && (cb_final < 1.0e-1)
    if !cb_ok {
        print("FAIL: cb_final out of expected band [1e-7, 1e-3]: ")
        println(fmt_6(cb_final))
        return
    }

    // (2) Pancreas occupancy > 1% (drug bound to GLP-1R).
    let occ_ok = occ_panc_final > 0.01
    if !occ_ok {
        print("FAIL: pancreas occupancy < 1% at end of week: ")
        println(fmt_6(occ_panc_final))
        return
    }

    // (3) ΔG is negative (glucose suppression).
    let dg_ok = dg_final < 0.0
    if !dg_ok {
        print("FAIL: ΔG not negative: ")
        println(fmt_3(dg_final))
        return
    }

    // (4) ΔI is positive (insulin elevation).
    let di_ok = di_final > 0.0
    if !di_ok {
        print("FAIL: ΔI not positive: ")
        println(fmt_3(di_final))
        return
    }

    println("SEMA_SC_DEPOT_SMOKE_PASS")
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/darwin_tmdd_fkbp12_smoke.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout-contains: TMDD_FKBP12_SMOKE_PASS

// Smoke test for stdlib/darwin_pbpk/tmdd/fkbp12_mtorc1.sio (Stage G-ε-11).
//
// Drives the stdlib's pure-functional tmdd_step on the rapamycin/liver
// configuration (i=1, R_total_0 = 50 nM, K_d = 0.10 nM, k_on = 0.10
// L/(nmol·h)) at a fixed C_t_mass = 1.0e-3 mg/L plasma — the same
// concentration the parity ref reaches in the liver around t ≈ 6 h on the
// canonical Cypher elution. Confirms:
//
//   1. Receptor occupancy climbs monotonically from 0 toward saturation
//      under sustained drug exposure (kinetic plausibility).
//   2. R_free + DR ≈ R_total (mass conservation modulo synthesis &
//      internalisation; we don't expect bit-exact conservation because of
//      ksyn / kint, but the budget should be sane).
//   3. tmdd_occupancy() agrees with manually computed DR / (R_free + DR).
//
// Pure-Sounio, no external golden file: this guards the module's API surface
// against accidental drift. Numerical parity with the parity ref is enforced
// transitively by scripts/ci/dissertation_pbpk28_parity_gate.sh case 5 once
// the parity ref switches its inline tmdd_step_organ to import this module
// (planned G-ε-15 after the PBPK28 core lands).

use darwin_pbpk::tmdd::fkbp12_mtorc1::*

fn fmt_4(x: f64) -> i64 { return (x * 10000.0) as i64 }

fn main() with Mut, Div, IO {
    let p = fkbp12_params_at(1)        // liver
    var s = TmddState { ct_mass: 1.0e-3, rfree: fkbp12_rtotal0_at(1), dr: 0.0 }
    let dt = 0.5                       // hours per step
    let n_steps = 24                   // → 12 h total

    print("TMDD smoke — liver (i=1), R_total_0 = ")
    print(fkbp12_rtotal0_at(1) as i64)
    println(" nM, C_t fixed at 1e-3 mg/L")
    println("step  R_free(nM)   DR(nM)       occupancy")

    var step = 0
    while step < n_steps {
        s = tmdd_step(s, p, dt)
        // Re-pin C_t (this smoke isolates TMDD; PBPK transport would do this
        // job in the coupled simulation).
        s.ct_mass = 1.0e-3
        let occ = tmdd_occupancy(s)
        let total = s.rfree + s.dr
        let report = (step + 1) == 1 || (step + 1) == 6 || (step + 1) == 12 || (step + 1) == 24
        if report {
            print("step="); print(step + 1)
            print(" rfree*1e4="); print(fmt_4(s.rfree))
            print(" dr*1e4="); print(fmt_4(s.dr))
            print(" occ*1e4="); println(fmt_4(occ))
        }
        // Invariant checks at every step:
        let mut_ok = (s.rfree >= 0.0) && (s.dr >= 0.0)
        if !mut_ok {
            println("FAIL: negative state component")
            return
        }
        // Total receptor budget shouldn't explode — bound by 2× initial
        // (synthesis can grow the pool over many hours but not 2× in 12 h
        // at k_syn = 2.5 nM/h).
        if total > 100.0 {
            println("FAIL: receptor budget blew up")
            return
        }
        step = step + 1
    }

    // Final-state invariants.
    let occ_final = tmdd_occupancy(s)
    // Occupancy at C_t = 1.1 nM (≈ 1e-3 mg/L ÷ 914 Da/nmol), K_d = 0.1 nM →
    // saturation fraction at *equilibrium* ≈ 11/12 ≈ 0.92. At t=12 h with
    // k_on·C_t ≈ 0.11/h the binding timescale is τ ≈ 9 h, so 12 h reaches
    // only ~73% of the way — predicted occ ≈ 0.37-0.45. Allow [0.30, 0.70].
    let occ_ok = (occ_final > 0.30) && (occ_final < 0.70)
    if !occ_ok {
        print("FAIL: occupancy out of expected band [0.30, 0.70]: ")
        println(fmt_4(occ_final))
        return
    }

    println("TMDD_FKBP12_SMOKE_PASS")
}

// Smoke test for stdlib/darwin_pbpk/tmdd/glp1r.sio (Stage G-ε-12).
//
// Drives the shared tmdd_step kernel (imported via fkbp12_mtorc1.sio) on the
// semaglutide / pancreas configuration (i=12, R_total_0 = 5 nM, K_d = 0.4 nM,
// k_on = 0.50 L/(nmol·h)) at a fixed C_t_mass = 5.0e-3 mg/L plasma — the same
// concentration the parity ref reaches around steady-state on weekly
// semaglutide dosing. Confirms:
//
//   1. Receptor occupancy climbs monotonically from 0 toward saturation
//      under sustained drug exposure.
//   2. R_free + DR stays in a sane budget (k_syn = 0.25 nM/h on a 5 nM pool).
//   3. Pancreas occupancy at 12 h is *higher* than rapamycin/liver occupancy
//      at 12 h under matched dosing — semaglutide-GLP-1R kinetics are
//      5× faster, so the binding timescale τ = 1 / (k_on·C_t) ≈ 3.3 h
//      (vs ~9 h for rapa/FKBP12).
//
// Pure-Sounio, no external golden file. Transitive parity with the JS engine
// is enforced by case 8 of `scripts/ci/dissertation_pbpk28_parity_gate.sh`
// once the parity ref switches its inline tmdd_step_organ to import this
// module (planned G-ζ-1 after ε-15).

use darwin_pbpk::tmdd::fkbp12_mtorc1::*
use darwin_pbpk::tmdd::glp1r::*

fn fmt_4(x: f64) -> i64 { return (x * 10000.0) as i64 }

fn main() with Mut, Div, IO {
    let p = glp1r_params_at(12)        // pancreas
    var s = TmddState { ct_mass: 5.0e-3, rfree: glp1r_rtotal0_at(12), dr: 0.0 }
    let dt = 0.5                       // hours per step
    let n_steps = 24                   // → 12 h total

    print("TMDD smoke — pancreas (i=12), R_total_0 = ")
    print(glp1r_rtotal0_at(12) as i64)
    println(" nM, C_t fixed at 5e-5 mg/L")
    println("step  R_free(nM)   DR(nM)       occupancy")

    var step = 0
    while step < n_steps {
        s = tmdd_step(s, p, dt)
        // Re-pin C_t (smoke isolates TMDD).
        s.ct_mass = 5.0e-3
        let occ = tmdd_occupancy(s)
        let total = s.rfree + s.dr
        let report = (step + 1) == 1 || (step + 1) == 6 || (step + 1) == 12 || (step + 1) == 24
        if report {
            print("step="); print(step + 1)
            print(" rfree*1e4="); print(fmt_4(s.rfree))
            print(" dr*1e4="); print(fmt_4(s.dr))
            print(" occ*1e4="); println(fmt_4(occ))
        }
        let inv_ok = (s.rfree >= 0.0) && (s.dr >= 0.0)
        if !inv_ok {
            println("FAIL: negative state component")
            return
        }
        if total > 10.0 {
            println("FAIL: receptor budget blew up")
            return
        }
        step = step + 1
    }

    // At C_t = 5e-3 mg/L on a 4114 Da peptide → 5e-3 · 1e6 / 4114 ≈ 1.22 nM
    // drug; K_d = 0.4 nM → eq saturation ≈ 1.22/1.62 ≈ 0.75. Binding
    // timescale 1 / (k_on·C_t) = 1 / (0.50·1.22) ≈ 1.6 h → reaches equilibrium
    // in ~5 h, well before 12 h. Expect occ_final ≈ 0.65-0.80.
    let occ_final = tmdd_occupancy(s)
    let occ_ok = (occ_final > 0.55) && (occ_final < 0.85)
    if !occ_ok {
        print("FAIL: occupancy out of expected band [0.55, 0.85]: ")
        println(fmt_4(occ_final))
        return
    }

    println("TMDD_GLP1R_SMOKE_PASS")
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/dataframe_test.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// DataFrame dense storage — run-pass test
//
// T1: Create DF, set/get values
// T2: Column mean/std
// T3: Filter keeps only matching rows
// T4: Sort orders correctly
//
// All helpers inlined — tests cannot import stdlib.

extern "C" {
    fn sqrt(x: f64) -> f64
}

fn t_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    return sqrt(x)
}

fn t_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

// ============================================================================
// INLINE DATAFRAME (mirrors stdlib/data/dataframe.sio)
// ============================================================================

struct DataFrame {
    data: [f64; 65536],
    col_names: [i64; 64],
    n_rows: i64,
    n_cols: i64,
}

fn df_new(n_cols: i64) -> DataFrame with Mut {
    var nc = n_cols
    if nc < 0 { nc = 0 }
    if nc > 64 { nc = 64 }
    DataFrame {
        data: [0.0; 65536],
        col_names: [0; 64],
        n_rows: 0,
        n_cols: nc,
    }
}

fn df_set(df: &!DataFrame, row: i64, col: i64, val: f64) with Mut, Panic {
    if row < 0 { return }
    if col < 0 { return }
    if row >= df.n_rows { return }
    if col >= df.n_cols { return }
    let idx = row * 64 + col
    df.data[idx] = val
}

fn df_get(df: &DataFrame, row: i64, col: i64) -> f64 with Panic {
    if row < 0 { return 0.0 }
    if col < 0 { return 0.0 }
    if row >= df.n_rows { return 0.0 }
    if col >= df.n_cols { return 0.0 }
    let idx = row * 64 + col
    return df.data[idx]
}

fn df_add_row(df: &!DataFrame, values: &[f64; 64]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if df.n_rows >= 1024 { return }
    let row = df.n_rows
    var col: i64 = 0
    while col < df.n_cols {
        let idx = row * 64 + col
        df.data[idx] = values[col]
        col = col + 1
    }
    df.n_rows = df.n_rows + 1
}

fn df_col_mean(df: &DataFrame, col: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if col < 0 { return 0.0 }
    if col >= df.n_cols { return 0.0 }
    if df.n_rows == 0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 0.0
    var row: i64 = 0
    while row < df.n_rows {
        sum = sum + df.data[row * 64 + col]
        row = row + 1
    }
    return sum / (df.n_rows as f64)
}

fn df_col_std(df: &DataFrame, col: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if col < 0 { return 0.0 }
    if col >= df.n_cols { return 0.0 }
    if df.n_rows < 2 { return 0.0 }
    let mean = df_col_mean(df, col)
    var sum_sq = 0.0
    var row: i64 = 0
    while row < df.n_rows {
        let diff = df.data[row * 64 + col] - mean
        sum_sq = sum_sq + diff * diff
        row = row + 1
    }
    let variance = sum_sq / ((df.n_rows - 1) as f64)
    return t_sqrt(variance)
}

fn df_col_min(df: &DataFrame, col: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if col < 0 { return 0.0 }
    if col >= df.n_cols { return 0.0 }
    if df.n_rows == 0 { return 0.0 }
    var m = df.data[0 * 64 + col]
    var row: i64 = 1
    while row < df.n_rows {
        let v = df.data[row * 64 + col]
        if v < m { m = v }
        row = row + 1
    }
    return m
}

fn df_col_max(df: &DataFrame, col: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if col < 0 { return 0.0 }
    if col >= df.n_cols { return 0.0 }
    if df.n_rows == 0 { return 0.0 }
    var m = df.data[0 * 64 + col]
    var row: i64 = 1
    while row < df.n_rows {
        let v = df.data[row * 64 + col]
        if v > m { m = v }
        row = row + 1
    }
    return m
}

fn df_filter_gt(df: &DataFrame, col: i64, threshold: f64) -> DataFrame with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var result = df_new(df.n_cols)
    if col < 0 { return result }
    if col >= df.n_cols { return result }
    var row: i64 = 0
    while row < df.n_rows {
        let v = df.data[row * 64 + col]
        if v > threshold {
            if result.n_rows < 1024 {
                let dst_row = result.n_rows
                var c: i64 = 0
                while c < df.n_cols {
                    result.data[dst_row * 64 + c] = df.data[row * 64 + c]
                    c = c + 1
                }
                result.n_rows = result.n_rows + 1
            }
        }
        row = row + 1
    }
    return result
}

fn df_sort_by(df: &DataFrame, col: i64) -> DataFrame with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var result = df_new(df.n_cols)
    if col < 0 { return result }
    if col >= df.n_cols { return result }
    var row: i64 = 0
    while row < df.n_rows {
        var c: i64 = 0
        while c < df.n_cols {
            result.data[row * 64 + c] = df.data[row * 64 + c]
            c = c + 1
        }
        row = row + 1
    }
    result.n_rows = df.n_rows
    // Insertion sort ascending
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < result.n_rows {
        let key_val = result.data[i * 64 + col]
        var j = i - 1
        while j >= 0 {
            let cmp_val = result.data[j * 64 + col]
            if cmp_val > key_val {
                var c2: i64 = 0
                while c2 < result.n_cols {
                    let tmp = result.data[(j + 1) * 64 + c2]
                    result.data[(j + 1) * 64 + c2] = result.data[j * 64 + c2]
                    result.data[j * 64 + c2] = tmp
                    c2 = c2 + 1
                }
                j = j - 1
            } else {
                j = -1
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return result
}

// ============================================================================
// TESTS
// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var passed: i64 = 0
    var failed: i64 = 0

    // ==================================================================
    // T1: Create DF, set values, get values back
    // ==================================================================
    var df1 = df_new(3)
    // Manually insert 2 rows
    df1.n_rows = 2
    df_set(&!df1, 0, 0, 1.0)
    df_set(&!df1, 0, 1, 2.0)
    df_set(&!df1, 0, 2, 3.0)
    df_set(&!df1, 1, 0, 4.0)
    df_set(&!df1, 1, 1, 5.0)
    df_set(&!df1, 1, 2, 6.0)

    let v00 = df_get(&df1, 0, 0)
    let v01 = df_get(&df1, 0, 1)
    let v02 = df_get(&df1, 0, 2)
    let v10 = df_get(&df1, 1, 0)
    let v11 = df_get(&df1, 1, 1)
    let v12 = df_get(&df1, 1, 2)

    if t_abs(v00 - 1.0) < 0.001 {
        if t_abs(v01 - 2.0) < 0.001 {
            if t_abs(v02 - 3.0) < 0.001 {
                if t_abs(v10 - 4.0) < 0.001 {
                    if t_abs(v11 - 5.0) < 0.001 {
                        if t_abs(v12 - 6.0) < 0.001 {
                            passed = passed + 1
                            println("T1 PASS: set/get values")
                        } else { failed = failed + 1; println("T1 FAIL") }
                    } else { failed = failed + 1; println("T1 FAIL") }
                } else { failed = failed + 1; println("T1 FAIL") }
            } else { failed = failed + 1; println("T1 FAIL") }
        } else { failed = failed + 1; println("T1 FAIL") }
    } else { failed = failed + 1; println("T1 FAIL") }

    // Also test add_row
    var df1b = df_new(2)
    var row_vals: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    row_vals[0] = 10.0
    row_vals[1] = 20.0
    df_add_row(&!df1b, &row_vals)
    row_vals[0] = 30.0
    row_vals[1] = 40.0
    df_add_row(&!df1b, &row_vals)
    let ar0 = df_get(&df1b, 0, 0)
    let ar1 = df_get(&df1b, 1, 1)
    if t_abs(ar0 - 10.0) < 0.001 {
        if t_abs(ar1 - 40.0) < 0.001 {
            passed = passed + 1
            println("T1b PASS: add_row")
        } else { failed = failed + 1; println("T1b FAIL") }
    } else { failed = failed + 1; println("T1b FAIL") }

    // ==================================================================
    // T2: Column mean/std correct
    // ==================================================================
    // col 0: [1, 4] => mean = 2.5, std = sqrt((1.5^2 + 1.5^2) / 1) = sqrt(4.5) ~ 2.1213
    // col 1: [2, 5] => mean = 3.5
    let mean0 = df_col_mean(&df1, 0)
    let mean1 = df_col_mean(&df1, 1)
    let std0 = df_col_std(&df1, 0)

    // mean of [1,4] = 2.5; std of [1,4] = sqrt(((1-2.5)^2+(4-2.5)^2)/1) = sqrt(4.5) = 2.1213
    let mean0_ok = t_abs(mean0 - 2.5) < 0.001
    let mean1_ok = t_abs(mean1 - 3.5) < 0.001
    let std0_ok = t_abs(std0 - 2.12132) < 0.01

    if mean0_ok {
        if mean1_ok {
            if std0_ok {
                passed = passed + 1
                println("T2 PASS: col mean/std")
            } else { failed = failed + 1; print("T2 FAIL: std0="); println(std0) }
        } else { failed = failed + 1; print("T2 FAIL: mean1="); println(mean1) }
    } else { failed = failed + 1; print("T2 FAIL: mean0="); println(mean0) }

    // Also check min/max
    let min0 = df_col_min(&df1, 0)
    let max0 = df_col_max(&df1, 0)
    if t_abs(min0 - 1.0) < 0.001 {
        if t_abs(max0 - 4.0) < 0.001 {
            passed = passed + 1
            println("T2b PASS: col min/max")
        } else { failed = failed + 1; println("T2b FAIL") }
    } else { failed = failed + 1; println("T2b FAIL") }

    // ==================================================================
    // T3: Filter keeps only matching rows
    // ==================================================================
    // Build a 3-col, 5-row DF:
    //   row 0: [1, 10, 100]
    //   row 1: [5, 50, 500]
    //   row 2: [3, 30, 300]
    //   row 3: [7, 70, 700]
    //   row 4: [2, 20, 200]
    var df3 = df_new(3)
    df3.n_rows = 5
    df_set(&!df3, 0, 0, 1.0);  df_set(&!df3, 0, 1, 10.0);  df_set(&!df3, 0, 2, 100.0)
    df_set(&!df3, 1, 0, 5.0);  df_set(&!df3, 1, 1, 50.0);  df_set(&!df3, 1, 2, 500.0)
    df_set(&!df3, 2, 0, 3.0);  df_set(&!df3, 2, 1, 30.0);  df_set(&!df3, 2, 2, 300.0)
    df_set(&!df3, 3, 0, 7.0);  df_set(&!df3, 3, 1, 70.0);  df_set(&!df3, 3, 2, 700.0)
    df_set(&!df3, 4, 0, 2.0);  df_set(&!df3, 4, 1, 20.0);  df_set(&!df3, 4, 2, 200.0)

    // Filter col 0 > 3.0 => should keep rows 1 (5), 3 (7)
    let filtered = df_filter_gt(&df3, 0, 3.0)
    if filtered.n_rows == 2 {
        let fr0c0 = df_get(&filtered, 0, 0)
        let fr1c0 = df_get(&filtered, 1, 0)
        if t_abs(fr0c0 - 5.0) < 0.001 {
            if t_abs(fr1c0 - 7.0) < 0.001 {
                // Check that associated columns came along
                let fr0c2 = df_get(&filtered, 0, 2)
                if t_abs(fr0c2 - 500.0) < 0.001 {
                    passed = passed + 1
                    println("T3 PASS: filter_gt")
                } else { failed = failed + 1; println("T3 FAIL: associated col") }
            } else { failed = failed + 1; println("T3 FAIL: row1 val") }
        } else { failed = failed + 1; println("T3 FAIL: row0 val") }
    } else {
        failed = failed + 1
        print("T3 FAIL: expected 2 rows, got ")
        println(filtered.n_rows)
    }

    // ==================================================================
    // T4: Sort orders correctly
    // ==================================================================
    // Sort df3 by col 0 => should be [1, 2, 3, 5, 7]
    let sorted = df_sort_by(&df3, 0)
    if sorted.n_rows == 5 {
        let s0 = df_get(&sorted, 0, 0)
        let s1 = df_get(&sorted, 1, 0)
        let s2 = df_get(&sorted, 2, 0)
        let s3 = df_get(&sorted, 3, 0)
        let s4 = df_get(&sorted, 4, 0)
        let sort_ok = t_abs(s0 - 1.0) < 0.001
        if sort_ok {
            if t_abs(s1 - 2.0) < 0.001 {
                if t_abs(s2 - 3.0) < 0.001 {
                    if t_abs(s3 - 5.0) < 0.001 {
                        if t_abs(s4 - 7.0) < 0.001 {
                            // Verify associated column also sorted
                            let sc2 = df_get(&sorted, 4, 2)
                            if t_abs(sc2 - 700.0) < 0.001 {
                                passed = passed + 1
                                println("T4 PASS: sort_by")
                            } else { failed = failed + 1; println("T4 FAIL: assoc col") }
                        } else { failed = failed + 1; println("T4 FAIL: s4") }
                    } else { failed = failed + 1; println("T4 FAIL: s3") }
                } else { failed = failed + 1; println("T4 FAIL: s2") }
            } else { failed = failed + 1; println("T4 FAIL: s1") }
        } else { failed = failed + 1; print("T4 FAIL: s0="); println(s0) }
    } else {
        failed = failed + 1
        print("T4 FAIL: expected 5 rows, got ")
        println(sorted.n_rows)
    }

    // ==================================================================
    // Summary
    // ==================================================================
    println("---")
    print(passed)
    print(" passed, ")
    print(failed)
    println(" failed")

    if failed > 0 { return 1 }
    return 0
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/display_headless.sio ===
// tests/run-pass/display_headless.sio — Headless canvas smoke test
//
// Exercises stdlib/display/canvas + stdlib/display/font without opening
// a window, writing pixels to a heap buffer and verifying values.
//
// Expected output:
//   DISPLAY_HEADLESS_PASS
//   exit 0

use display::canvas::{Canvas, canvas_clear, canvas_set_pixel, canvas_fill_rect,
                       canvas_draw_line, canvas_draw_circle, canvas_fill_circle,
                       canvas_draw_char, canvas_draw_text}
use display::font::{font_glyph, font_draw_char}

fn make_headless_canvas(w: i64, h: i64) -> Canvas with Alloc {
    let pix = heap_alloc(w * h * 8) as *mut i64
    Canvas { pixels: pix, width: w, height: h }
}

fn read_pixel(c: &Canvas, x: i64, y: i64) -> i64 {
    read_i64(c.pixels, y * c.width + x)
}

fn main() with IO, Alloc, Mut, Div {
    let w: i64 = 128
    let h: i64 = 128
    var c = make_headless_canvas(w, h)

    // 1. canvas_clear
    canvas_clear(&!c, 10, 20, 30)
    let p0 = read_pixel(&c, 0, 0)
    let expected_clear = 30 | (20 << 8) | (10 << 16)
    assert(p0 == expected_clear)

    // 2. canvas_set_pixel
    canvas_set_pixel(&!c, 64, 64, 255, 0, 0)
    let p1 = read_pixel(&c, 64, 64)
    let expected_red = 0 | (0 << 8) | (255 << 16)
    assert(p1 == expected_red)

    // 3. canvas_fill_rect — paint a 10×10 blue square at (5,5)
    canvas_fill_rect(&!c, 5, 5, 10, 10, 0, 0, 255)
    let corner = read_pixel(&c, 5, 5)
    let expected_blue = 255 | (0 << 8) | (0 << 16)
    assert(corner == expected_blue)
    // Pixel just outside rect should still be clear background
    let outside = read_pixel(&c, 15, 15)
    assert(outside == expected_clear)

    // 4. canvas_draw_line — draws at least one pixel along y=0 row
    canvas_clear(&!c, 0, 0, 0)
    canvas_draw_line(&!c, 0, 50, 127, 50, 200, 150, 100)
    let line_px = read_pixel(&c, 64, 50)
    let expected_line = 100 | (150 << 8) | (200 << 16)
    assert(line_px == expected_line)

    // 5. canvas_draw_circle — centre pixel won't be filled; check a nearby spoke
    canvas_clear(&!c, 0, 0, 0)
    canvas_draw_circle(&!c, 64, 64, 20, 0, 255, 0)
    // The top-most point of the circle should be colored
    let top = read_pixel(&c, 64, 44)
    let expected_green = 0 | (255 << 8) | (0 << 16)
    assert(top == expected_green)

    // 6. canvas_fill_circle — centre pixel and nearby are filled
    canvas_clear(&!c, 0, 0, 0)
    canvas_fill_circle(&!c, 64, 64, 10, 255, 128, 0)
    // Centre pixel must be filled
    let circ_center = read_pixel(&c, 64, 64)
    let expected_orange = 0 | (128 << 8) | (255 << 16)
    assert(circ_center == expected_orange)
    // Pixel well outside the radius must be unfilled
    let circ_outside = read_pixel(&c, 0, 0)
    assert(circ_outside == 0)

    // 7. font_glyph non-zero for printable char
    let g_a = font_glyph(65)  // 'A'
    assert(g_a != 0)
    let g_space = font_glyph(32)  // ' '
    assert(g_space == 0)

    // 8. font_draw_char writes some pixels
    canvas_clear(&!c, 0, 0, 0)
    font_draw_char(c.pixels, w, h, 65, 0, 0, 255, 255, 255)  // 'A'
    // At least the top row of 'A' glyph (bits 7-0 = row 0) should have pixels
    // Row 0 of 'A' glyph = 0x1C (from packed i64); check pixel at (2,0) which is bit 5
    let glyph_a = font_glyph(65)
    let row0 = glyph_a & 0xFF
    // Rather than hard-code bit positions, just check that at least one pixel in
    // the 8×8 box is white:
    var found_white = false
    var gy: i64 = 0
    while gy < 8 {
        var gx: i64 = 0
        while gx < 8 {
            let px = read_pixel(&c, gx, gy)
            if px != 0 {
                found_white = true
            }
            gx = gx + 1
        }
        gy = gy + 1
    }
    assert(found_white)

    heap_free(c.pixels as *mut i8)
    println("DISPLAY_HEADLESS_PASS")
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/dissertation_frontend_parity_ref.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ timeout: 60
// ============================================================================
// DISSERTATION FRONTEND PARITY REFERENCE
//
// Companion to website/src/lib/pbpk14_core.mjs and the parity gate at
// scripts/ci/dissertation_frontend_parity_gate.sh. Emits per-organ
// concentrations at 12 log-spaced sample times for a fixed IV-bolus
// initial condition. The Node-side runner consumes the same constants and
// must agree within 1% RMSE per compartment.
//
// Compartment indexing (matches website/src/components/dissertation/
// compartments.ts — *not* the same as dissertation_pbpk14_gum.sio):
//   0 blood    1 liver    2 kidney   3 brain     4 heart
//   5 lung     6 muscle   7 adipose  8 gut       9 skin
//  10 bone    11 spleen  12 pancreas 13 other
//
// Model: flow-limited, well-stirred
//   V_i dC_i/dt = Q_i (C_blood - C_i / Kp_i)              for i >= 1
//   V_0 dC_0/dt = sum_i Q_i (C_i/Kp_i - C_blood) - CL_hep C_blood
//
// Integrator: RK4 dt=0.01 h (fixed step).
// Initial condition: bolus 0.05 mg into blood (C_blood(0) = 0.01 mg/L).
// CL_hep = 12.4 L/h. No stent source (stent_active=false).
// ============================================================================

struct PbpkState { v: [f64; 14] }

fn pbpk_zero() -> PbpkState { PbpkState { v: [0.0; 14] } }

// V_ref, L, ICRP standard man 70 kg.
fn vref_at(i: i64) -> f64 {
    if i ==  0 { return 5.0 }
    if i ==  1 { return 1.8 }
    if i ==  2 { return 0.31 }
    if i ==  3 { return 1.45 }
    if i ==  4 { return 0.33 }
    if i ==  5 { return 1.1 }
    if i ==  6 { return 28.0 }
    if i ==  7 { return 20.0 }
    if i ==  8 { return 1.2 }
    if i ==  9 { return 3.6 }
    if i == 10 { return 6.6 }
    if i == 11 { return 0.18 }
    if i == 12 { return 0.09 }
    return 3.7
}

// Kp (rapamycin partition coefficients).
fn kp_at(i: i64) -> f64 {
    if i ==  0 { return 1.00 }
    if i ==  1 { return 5.40 }
    if i ==  2 { return 4.20 }
    if i ==  3 { return 0.10 }
    if i ==  4 { return 2.30 }
    if i ==  5 { return 3.10 }
    if i ==  6 { return 0.50 }
    if i ==  7 { return 0.30 }
    if i ==  8 { return 2.60 }
    if i ==  9 { return 0.80 }
    if i == 10 { return 0.20 }
    if i == 11 { return 2.10 }
    if i == 12 { return 1.80 }
    return 0.40
}

// Q (organ blood flow, L/h, 70 kg adult).
fn q_at(i: i64) -> f64 {
    if i ==  0 { return 350.0 }
    if i ==  1 { return 90.0 }
    if i ==  2 { return 74.0 }
    if i ==  3 { return 44.0 }
    if i ==  4 { return 16.0 }
    if i ==  5 { return 350.0 }
    if i ==  6 { return 42.0 }
    if i ==  7 { return 10.0 }
    if i ==  8 { return 55.0 }
    if i ==  9 { return 21.0 }
    if i == 10 { return 17.0 }
    if i == 11 { return 10.0 }
    if i == 12 { return 8.0 }
    return 13.0
}

fn cl_hep() -> f64 { return 12.4 }

// Arrow-matrix Crank-Nicolson on the 14-state well-stirred PBPK14.
// REPLACES the prior explicit-RK4 step which violated mass conservation
// (172× growth over 30 h) — brain eigenvalue Q/(V·Kp) = 303 h⁻¹ exceeded
// RK4's stability boundary at dt = 0.01. CN is A-stable, 2nd-order, and
// dM/dt = -cl_hep·C_b is preserved exactly by the algorithm.
//
//   h     = dt/2
//   S     = h·(Σ Q + cl_hep)/V_b
//   α_i   = h·Q_i / V_i
//   α'_i  = h·Q_i / (V_i · Kp_i)
//   β_i   = h·Q_i / (V_b · Kp_i)
//   γ_i   = β_i / (1 + α'_i)
//   b[0]  = (1-S)·C_b_old + Σ β_i·C_i_old   (no release in parity ref)
//   b[i]  = α_i·C_b_old + (1-α'_i)·C_i_old
//   C_b_new = (b[0] + Σ γ_i·b[i]) / ((1+S) - Σ γ_i·α_i)
//   C_i_new = (b[i] + α_i·C_b_new) / (1 + α'_i)
fn rk4_step(C: &PbpkState, dt: f64) -> PbpkState with Mut, Div {
    let h = 0.5 * dt
    let vb = vref_at(0)

    var sum_q = 0.0
    var i = 1
    while i < 14 {
        sum_q = sum_q + q_at(i)
        i = i + 1
    }
    let big_s = h * (sum_q + cl_hep()) / vb

    let cb_old = C.v[0]
    var rhs0 = (1.0 - big_s) * cb_old
    i = 1
    while i < 14 {
        let beta = h * q_at(i) / (vb * kp_at(i))
        rhs0 = rhs0 + beta * C.v[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    var alpha: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var alphap: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var bi: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var denom_acc = 0.0
    var num_acc = 0.0
    i = 1
    while i < 14 {
        let vi = vref_at(i)
        let a = h * q_at(i) / vi
        let ap = a / kp_at(i)
        alpha[i] = a
        alphap[i] = ap
        bi[i] = a * cb_old + (1.0 - ap) * C.v[i]
        let beta = h * q_at(i) / (vb * kp_at(i))
        let gamma = beta / (1.0 + ap)
        denom_acc = denom_acc + gamma * a
        num_acc = num_acc + gamma * bi[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    let cb_new = (rhs0 + num_acc) / ((1.0 + big_s) - denom_acc)
    var next = pbpk_zero()
    next.v[0] = if cb_new < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { cb_new }
    i = 1
    while i < 14 {
        let ci = (bi[i] + alpha[i] * cb_new) / (1.0 + alphap[i])
        next.v[i] = if ci < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { ci }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return next
}

fn emit_at(C: &PbpkState, t: f64) with IO, Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < 14 {
        // Sounio: println(i64) and println(&str) emit a trailing newline,
        // println(f64) does NOT. The empty-string println after each f64
        // closes the line so the parity-gate parser can read one record per
        // 3-line block (t, i, c).
        print("PARITY|t=")
        println(t)
        println("")
        print("PARITY|i=")
        println(i)
        print("PARITY|c=")
        println(C.v[i])
        println("")
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Run to a target time using fixed dt=0.01 h. Returns final state.
fn integrate_to(state: PbpkState, t_start: f64, t_end: f64, dt: f64) -> PbpkState with Mut, Div {
    var C = state
    var t = t_start
    while t + dt * 0.5 < t_end {
        C = rk4_step(&C, dt)
        t = t + dt
    }
    return C
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    println("DISSERTATION_PARITY_REF v1")
    println("compartments=14")
    println("dt=0.01")
    println("bolus_mg=0.05")
    println("cl_hep_L_per_h=12.4")
    println("samples=12")

    // Initial condition: 0.05 mg into 5.0 L blood = 0.01 mg/L.
    var C = pbpk_zero()
    C.v[0] = 0.05 / vref_at(0)

    // Twelve log-spaced sample times (hours).
    var t = 0.0
    var dt = 0.01

    // t = 0.1
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 0.1, dt); t = 0.1; emit_at(&C, t)
    // t = 0.5
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 0.5, dt); t = 0.5; emit_at(&C, t)
    // t = 1.0
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 1.0, dt); t = 1.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    // t = 2.0
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 2.0, dt); t = 2.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    // t = 4.0
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 4.0, dt); t = 4.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    // t = 6.0
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 6.0, dt); t = 6.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    // t = 8.0
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 8.0, dt); t = 8.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    // t = 12.0
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 12.0, dt); t = 12.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    // t = 16.0
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 16.0, dt); t = 16.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    // t = 20.0
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 20.0, dt); t = 20.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    // t = 24.0
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 24.0, dt); t = 24.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    // t = 30.0
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 30.0, dt); t = 30.0; emit_at(&C, t)

    println("DISSERTATION_PARITY_DONE")
    return 0
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/dissertation_pbpk14_gum.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ timeout: 120
use epistemic::gum::{GUMUncertainty, gum_simple, welch_satterthwaite_3, coverage_factor_95}
// ============================================================================
// DISSERTATION: GUM-Through-ODE, Confidence Gates, ISO Uncertainty Budgets
// ============================================================================
// Rapamycin (sirolimus) 14-compartment PBPK — IV bolus, 48h simulation
//
// Three novel contributions demonstrated end-to-end:
//
//  1. GUM-THROUGH-ODE (JCGM 100:2008 §5.1.2):
//     Propagate parameter measurement uncertainty through each RK4 step
//     via perturbation-based linearisation. Output: Var(AUC), Var(BPR).
//
//  2. CONFIDENCE GATES (ISO/IEC Guide 98-3:2008 §3.3):
//     Evidence-quality thresholds that block clinical use of simulation
//     outputs when epistemic confidence is insufficient.
//
//  3. ISO UNCERTAINTY BUDGET (JCGM 100:2008 §8):
//     Per-parameter variance decomposition: sensitivity coefficient,
//     standard uncertainty contribution, fractional contribution.
//
// Model: 14-compartment perfusion-limited PBPK (Brown 1997, ICRP 89)
// Drug: rapamycin (sirolimus) — P-gp substrate, CYP3A4 metabolism
// Epistemic inputs (3 uncertain parameters):
//   CL_hepatic: 12.4 L/h, SD=7.4, conf=0.65 (Ferron 1997, n=24, CYP3A4 CV=60%)
//   kp_brain:   0.08,     SD=0.025, conf=0.55 (Lampen 1998, P-gp efflux)
//   fu_plasma:  0.08,     SD=0.020, conf=0.72 (Schreiber 1991, 92% protein-bound)
//
// GUM step: h = max(1e-6*|mean|, 1e-2*SD)   [optimised for finite-diff accuracy]
// RK4 step: dt = 0.001 h — stable for stiffest compartment (lung, lam~1276/h)
// 8 tests — all must pass for dissertation submission
// ============================================================================

// ============================================================================
// MATH HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn dp_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 15 {
        y = (y + x / y) * 0.5
        i = i + 1
    }
    return y
}

fn dp_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn dp_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { return a }
    return b
}

fn dp_finite(x: f64) -> bool {
    if x != x { return false }
    return dp_abs(x) < 1.0e18
}

// ============================================================================
// 14-COMPARTMENT STATE
//
// Compartment indices (perfusion-limited, well-stirred organs):
//   0 = plasma (venous pool)
//   1 = liver
//   2 = gut tissue
//   3 = kidney
//   4 = lung
//   5 = heart
//   6 = brain   ← kp_brain = 0.08 (P-gp efflux at BBB, Lampen 1998)
//   7 = muscle
//   8 = skin
//   9 = fat (adipose)
//  10 = spleen
//  11 = bone
//  12 = rest of body
//  13 = gut lumen (oral dosing; = 0 for IV bolus)
//
// Units: mg/L (concentration) for compartments 0–12
//        mg   (amount)        for compartment  13
// ============================================================================

struct Dp14State {
    v: [f64; 14],
}

fn dp14_zero() -> Dp14State {
    Dp14State { v: [0.0; 14] }
}

// result.v[i] = base.v[i] + scale * deriv.v[i]
// Takes borrows — neither base nor deriv are consumed (wave 8b safe)
fn dp14_axpy(base: &Dp14State, scale: f64, deriv: &Dp14State) -> Dp14State with Mut {
    var r = dp14_zero()
    var i = 0
    while i < 14 {
        r.v[i] = base.v[i] + scale * deriv.v[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    r
}

// ============================================================================
// 14-COMPARTMENT PARAMETERS (44 fields, all f64)
//
// All flows in L/h, volumes in L, Kp dimensionless, CL in L/h.
// ============================================================================

struct Dp14Params {
    q_cardiac: f64,
    v_plasma: f64,
    q_liver: f64,
    q_gut: f64,
    q_kidney: f64,
    q_lung: f64,
    q_heart: f64,
    q_brain: f64,
    q_muscle: f64,
    q_skin: f64,
    q_fat: f64,
    q_spleen: f64,
    q_bone: f64,
    q_rest: f64,
    v_liver: f64,
    v_gut: f64,
    v_kidney: f64,
    v_lung: f64,
    v_heart: f64,
    v_brain: f64,
    v_muscle: f64,
    v_skin: f64,
    v_fat: f64,
    v_spleen: f64,
    v_bone: f64,
    v_rest: f64,
    kp_liver: f64,
    kp_gut: f64,
    kp_kidney: f64,
    kp_lung: f64,
    kp_heart: f64,
    kp_brain: f64,
    kp_muscle: f64,
    kp_skin: f64,
    kp_fat: f64,
    kp_spleen: f64,
    kp_bone: f64,
    kp_rest: f64,
    cl_hep: f64,
    cl_renal: f64,
    ka: f64,
    f_oral: f64,
    fu: f64,
    bp: f64,
}

// Rapamycin mean PK parameters — 70 kg human, IV bolus
// Sources: Brown 1997, ICRP 89, Ferron 1997, Lampen 1998, Schreiber 1991
fn dp14_rapamycin_params() -> Dp14Params with Mut {
    Dp14Params {
        // Cardiac output (L/h) and plasma volume (L)
        q_cardiac: 348.0,      // 5.8 L/min (ICRP 89, 70 kg adult)
        v_plasma: 3.0,         // Venous plasma pool (L)

        // Organ blood flows (L/h) — ICRP 89 / Brown 1997
        // q_liver includes hepatic artery + portal vein (gut + spleen drain here)
        q_liver: 80.5,
        q_gut: 62.6,           // Mesenteric — drains to portal → liver
        q_kidney: 69.6,
        q_lung: 348.0,         // = q_cardiac (full pulmonary circulation)
        q_heart: 17.4,
        q_brain: 46.6,         // Cerebral blood flow (perfusion-limited model)
        q_muscle: 52.2,
        q_skin: 17.4,
        q_fat: 18.3,
        q_spleen: 10.4,        // Splenic — drains to portal → liver
        q_bone: 17.4,
        q_rest: 17.4,

        // Tissue volumes (L) — ICRP 89
        v_liver: 1.50,
        v_gut: 1.20,
        v_kidney: 0.31,
        v_lung: 0.50,
        v_heart: 0.33,
        v_brain: 1.40,
        v_muscle: 29.0,
        v_skin: 3.30,
        v_fat: 14.5,
        v_spleen: 0.15,
        v_bone: 4.00,
        v_rest: 5.30,

        // Rapamycin Kp (tissue:plasma) — Rodgers-Rowland (logP=4.3, lipophilic)
        kp_liver: 5.00,        // High hepatic uptake (CYP3A4 metabolic site)
        kp_gut: 3.00,
        kp_kidney: 3.50,
        kp_lung: 1.20,
        kp_heart: 2.00,
        kp_brain: 0.08,        // *** P-gp efflux at BBB (Lampen 1998) ***
        kp_muscle: 1.80,
        kp_skin: 2.50,
        kp_fat: 12.0,          // Highly lipophilic (logP~4.3); deep tissue sink
        kp_spleen: 2.00,
        kp_bone: 1.50,
        kp_rest: 2.00,

        // Clearance parameters
        cl_hep: 12.4,          // CYP3A4-dominated (Ferron 1997, CV=60%)
        cl_renal: 0.30,        // Minimal renal elimination
        ka: 0.0,               // IV bolus: no oral absorption
        f_oral: 0.0,           // IV: not used
        fu: 0.08,              // Fraction unbound (Schreiber 1991, 92% protein-bound)
        bp: 1.36,              // Blood:plasma ratio (modest RBC binding)
    }
}

// Borrow-based copy — avoids moving prm_ref in simulate_epistemic_dp14.
// Wave 8b enforces affine struct semantics: `var copy = owned` moves the
// original. Using `&Dp14Params` here keeps the original alive.
fn dp14_copy(p: &Dp14Params) -> Dp14Params {
    Dp14Params {
        q_cardiac: p.q_cardiac, v_plasma: p.v_plasma,
        q_liver: p.q_liver, q_gut: p.q_gut, q_kidney: p.q_kidney,
        q_lung: p.q_lung, q_heart: p.q_heart, q_brain: p.q_brain,
        q_muscle: p.q_muscle, q_skin: p.q_skin, q_fat: p.q_fat,
        q_spleen: p.q_spleen, q_bone: p.q_bone, q_rest: p.q_rest,
        v_liver: p.v_liver, v_gut: p.v_gut, v_kidney: p.v_kidney,
        v_lung: p.v_lung, v_heart: p.v_heart, v_brain: p.v_brain,
        v_muscle: p.v_muscle, v_skin: p.v_skin, v_fat: p.v_fat,
        v_spleen: p.v_spleen, v_bone: p.v_bone, v_rest: p.v_rest,
        kp_liver: p.kp_liver, kp_gut: p.kp_gut, kp_kidney: p.kp_kidney,
        kp_lung: p.kp_lung, kp_heart: p.kp_heart, kp_brain: p.kp_brain,
        kp_muscle: p.kp_muscle, kp_skin: p.kp_skin, kp_fat: p.kp_fat,
        kp_spleen: p.kp_spleen, kp_bone: p.kp_bone, kp_rest: p.kp_rest,
        cl_hep: p.cl_hep, cl_renal: p.cl_renal,
        ka: p.ka, f_oral: p.f_oral, fu: p.fu, bp: p.bp,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 14-COMPARTMENT PBPK ODE
//
// Perfusion-limited (well-stirred) model:
//   dC_i/dt = (Q_i/V_i) * (C_art - C_i/Kp_i)   for peripheral organs
// Liver has hepatic clearance (well-stirred liver model):
//   dC_liver/dt = (Q_ha*C_art + Q_gut*C_gut/Kp_gut + Q_spl*C_spl/Kp_spl
//                  - Q_liver*C_liver/Kp_liver - CL_int*fu*C_liver/Kp_liver) / V_liver
// Portal vein: gut + spleen drain to liver (NOT to systemic venous pool directly)
//
// Returns derivatives as Dp14State (same struct reused for dv/dt)
// Takes &Dp14State borrow — st is not consumed (wave 8b safe)
// ============================================================================

fn dp14_ode(st: &Dp14State, prm: &Dp14Params) -> Dp14State with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let c_plasma = st.v[0]
    let c_liver  = st.v[1]
    let c_gut    = st.v[2]
    let c_kidney = st.v[3]
    let c_lung   = st.v[4]
    let c_heart  = st.v[5]
    let c_brain  = st.v[6]
    let c_muscle = st.v[7]
    let c_skin   = st.v[8]
    let c_fat    = st.v[9]
    let c_spleen = st.v[10]
    let c_bone   = st.v[11]
    let c_rest   = st.v[12]
    let a_lumen  = st.v[13]

    // Venous concentration leaving each tissue: cv_i = C_tissue / Kp_i
    let cv_liver  = c_liver  / prm.kp_liver
    let cv_gut    = c_gut    / prm.kp_gut
    let cv_kidney = c_kidney / prm.kp_kidney
    let cv_lung   = c_lung   / prm.kp_lung
    let cv_heart  = c_heart  / prm.kp_heart
    let cv_brain  = c_brain  / prm.kp_brain
    let cv_muscle = c_muscle / prm.kp_muscle
    let cv_skin   = c_skin   / prm.kp_skin
    let cv_fat    = c_fat    / prm.kp_fat
    let cv_spleen = c_spleen / prm.kp_spleen
    let cv_bone   = c_bone   / prm.kp_bone
    let cv_rest   = c_rest   / prm.kp_rest

    // Arterial concentration = blood leaving lung (well-oxygenated)
    let c_art = cv_lung

    // Mixed venous blood concentration (flow-weighted average of systemic returns)
    // Gut + spleen drain to portal → liver; excluded from systemic venous sum
    let c_venous = (prm.q_liver * cv_liver
                  + prm.q_kidney * cv_kidney
                  + prm.q_heart * cv_heart
                  + prm.q_brain * cv_brain
                  + prm.q_muscle * cv_muscle
                  + prm.q_skin * cv_skin
                  + prm.q_fat * cv_fat
                  + prm.q_bone * cv_bone
                  + prm.q_rest * cv_rest) / prm.q_cardiac

    // Effective hepatic clearance (unbound drug)
    let cl_eff = prm.cl_hep * prm.fu

    // Portal vein inflow: gut + spleen
    let q_portal = prm.q_gut + prm.q_spleen
    let q_ha = prm.q_liver - q_portal     // Hepatic artery

    var dv = dp14_zero()

    // Gut lumen (oral dosing; = 0 for IV)
    dv.v[13] = (0.0 - prm.ka) * a_lumen

    // Gut tissue: arterial inflow + lumen absorption
    dv.v[2] = (prm.q_gut * (c_art - cv_gut)
             + prm.ka * prm.f_oral * a_lumen) / prm.v_gut

    // Liver: hepatic artery + portal vein (gut + spleen) + CL_hepatic
    dv.v[1] = (q_ha * c_art
             + prm.q_gut * cv_gut
             + prm.q_spleen * cv_spleen
             - prm.q_liver * cv_liver
             - cl_eff * cv_liver) / prm.v_liver

    // Kidney: arterial inflow + renal clearance
    dv.v[3] = (prm.q_kidney * (c_art - cv_kidney)
             - prm.cl_renal * prm.fu * cv_kidney) / prm.v_kidney

    // Lung: receives from venous pool (c_plasma/bp = blood conc), produces arterial outflow
    // CRITICAL: must use c_plasma (venous pool), NOT c_venous (organ returns).
    // At t=0 the IV bolus is in c_plasma; c_venous = 0 (all tissues empty).
    // Using c_venous here would break drug conservation: plasma drains but lung
    // stays empty → drug disappears. c_plasma/bp converts plasma → blood conc.
    dv.v[4] = (prm.q_lung * (c_plasma / prm.bp - cv_lung)) / prm.v_lung

    // Heart
    dv.v[5] = (prm.q_heart * (c_art - cv_heart)) / prm.v_heart

    // Brain — perfusion-limited; Kp=0.08 reflects P-gp efflux equilibrium
    dv.v[6] = (prm.q_brain * (c_art - cv_brain)) / prm.v_brain

    // Muscle
    dv.v[7] = (prm.q_muscle * (c_art - cv_muscle)) / prm.v_muscle

    // Skin
    dv.v[8] = (prm.q_skin * (c_art - cv_skin)) / prm.v_skin

    // Fat (adipose) — high Kp=12.0 → deep tissue sink for lipophilic drug
    dv.v[9] = (prm.q_fat * (c_art - cv_fat)) / prm.v_fat

    // Spleen (receives arterial; drains to portal → covered by liver eq.)
    dv.v[10] = (prm.q_spleen * (c_art - cv_spleen)) / prm.v_spleen

    // Bone
    dv.v[11] = (prm.q_bone * (c_art - cv_bone)) / prm.v_bone

    // Rest of body
    dv.v[12] = (prm.q_rest * (c_art - cv_rest)) / prm.v_rest

    // Plasma (venous pool): driven toward blood equilibrium
    // c_plasma / bp converts plasma → blood concentration
    dv.v[0] = (prm.q_cardiac * (c_venous - c_plasma / prm.bp)) / prm.v_plasma

    dv
}

// ============================================================================
// RK4 INTEGRATOR (4th-order, fixed step)
//
// Stability analysis for dt = 0.001 h:
//   Stiffest compartment: lung (Q_lung/V_lung * (1 + 1/Kp_lung) ≈ 1276 /h)
//   RK4 stability: |R(z)| < 1 where z = lam*dt = 1276*0.001 = 1.276
//   R(-1.276) = 1 - 1.276 + 0.814 - 0.347 + 0.110 = 0.301 < 1  ✓
// ============================================================================

// Takes &Dp14State borrow — st not consumed, can be used in final combination.
// Intermediate states (s2,s3,s4) are owned and borrowed when passed.
fn dp14_rk4(st: &Dp14State, prm: &Dp14Params, dt: f64) -> Dp14State with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let k1 = dp14_ode(st, prm)
    let s2 = dp14_axpy(st, dt * 0.5, &k1)
    let k2 = dp14_ode(&s2, prm)
    let s3 = dp14_axpy(st, dt * 0.5, &k2)
    let k3 = dp14_ode(&s3, prm)
    let s4 = dp14_axpy(st, dt, &k3)
    let k4 = dp14_ode(&s4, prm)

    var r = dp14_zero()
    let dt6 = dt / 6.0
    var i = 0
    while i < 14 {
        r.v[i] = st.v[i] + dt6 * (k1.v[i] + 2.0 * k2.v[i] + 2.0 * k3.v[i] + k4.v[i])
        i = i + 1
    }
    r
}

// ============================================================================
// SIMULATION METRICS
// ============================================================================

struct Dp14Metrics {
    auc: f64,           // AUC(0-48h) trapezoidal, plasma (mg·h/L)
    cmax: f64,          // Peak plasma concentration (mg/L) — = C0 for IV
    brain_final: f64,   // C_brain at t_end (mg/L)
    blood_final: f64,   // C_plasma at t_end (mg/L)
    success: bool,
}

// Run 14-compartment PBPK simulation
// dose_mg: IV bolus dose (mg), placed into plasma compartment
// t_end:   simulation end time (h)
// dt:      fixed RK4 step (h) — use 0.001 for stability
fn run_dp14(prm: &Dp14Params, dose_mg: f64, t_end: f64) -> Dp14Metrics with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var st = dp14_zero()
    // IV bolus: all drug deposited into plasma compartment at t=0
    st.v[0] = dose_mg / prm.v_plasma

    let dt = 0.001          // h = 3.6 s — stable for lung eigenvalue ~1276/h
    let n_steps: i64 = 48000  // 48.0 / 0.001 (exact for t_end = 48h)

    var cmax = st.v[0]
    var auc = 0.0
    var c_prev = st.v[0]
    var step: i64 = 0

    while step < n_steps {
        st = dp14_rk4(&st, prm, dt)
        let c_now = st.v[0]
        if c_now > cmax { cmax = c_now }
        auc = auc + (c_prev + c_now) * 0.5 * dt
        c_prev = c_now
        step = step + 1
    }

    // Extract fields before struct construction — avoids partial-move of st.v
    let brain_f = st.v[6]
    let blood_f = st.v[0]
    let ok = dp_finite(auc) && dp_finite(cmax) && auc > 0.0
    Dp14Metrics {
        auc: auc,
        cmax: cmax,
        brain_final: brain_f,
        blood_final: blood_f,
        success: ok,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// EPISTEMIC PRIORS (Novel Contribution #1 — GUM-Through-ODE)
//
// Evidence-quality confidence [0,1] is NOT a Beta posterior.
// For unbounded parameters (CL, Ka) Beta is inappropriate.
// Confidence is a normalized evidence score based on:
//   number of independent studies, in vivo vs in vitro, population size.
//
// NOTE: GUM parameter characterisation (mean + std_u) is expressed via
// stdlib epistemic::gum::gum_simple inside simulate_epistemic_dp14.
// Dp14Priors carries only the evidence-quality confidence scores.
// ============================================================================

struct Dp14Priors {
    cl_conf: f64,          // Evidence quality [0,1]
    kp_brain_conf: f64,
    fu_conf: f64,
}

fn dp14_rapamycin_priors() -> Dp14Priors {
    Dp14Priors {
        cl_conf: 0.65,          // Ferron 1997, n=24, CYP3A4 popPK
        kp_brain_conf: 0.55,    // Lampen 1998, indirect P-gp efflux assay
        fu_conf: 0.72,          // Schreiber 1991, replicated in vitro
    }
}

// Finite difference step size — GUM-robust (avoids cancellation and truncation)
// h = max(1e-6 * |mean|, 1e-2 * SD)
fn dp14_fdiff_h(mean: f64, std_u: f64) -> f64 {
    let h_rel = 1.0e-6 * dp_abs(mean)
    let h_abs = 0.01 * std_u
    dp_max(h_rel, h_abs)
}

// ============================================================================
// EPISTEMIC RESULT
// ============================================================================

struct Dp14EpResult {
    // AUC(0-48h) epistemic characterisation
    auc_mean: f64,
    auc_var: f64,
    auc_conf: f64,     // Sensitivity-weighted confidence (GUM propagation)

    // Brain/plasma ratio at t=48h (quasi-steady-state)
    bpr_mean: f64,
    bpr_var: f64,
    bpr_conf: f64,

    // Sensitivity fractions (fractional variance contributions, sum~1)
    s_cl: f64,         // CL_hepatic fraction of AUC variance
    s_kp: f64,         // kp_brain fraction of AUC variance
    s_fu: f64,         // fu_plasma fraction of AUC variance

    // Welch-Satterthwaite effective DOF (from stdlib welch_satterthwaite_3)
    v_eff_auc: f64,

    success: bool,
}

fn dp14_ep_empty() -> Dp14EpResult {
    Dp14EpResult {
        auc_mean: 0.0, auc_var: 0.0, auc_conf: 0.0,
        bpr_mean: 0.0, bpr_var: 0.0, bpr_conf: 0.0,
        s_cl: 0.0, s_kp: 0.0, s_fu: 0.0,
        v_eff_auc: 1.0e9,
        success: false,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// SIMULATE EPISTEMIC PBPK (GUM-Through-ODE)
//
// Strategy: perturbation-based delta method (linearisation)
//   1. Run reference simulation at mean parameter values
//   2. For each uncertain parameter θ_i, perturb by h_i and re-run
//   3. Finite difference: ∂Y/∂θ_i ≈ (Y(θ+h) - Y(θ)) / h
//   4. GUM: Var(Y) = Σ (∂Y/∂θ_i)^2 * Var(θ_i)
//
// Total: 4 simulations (reference + 3 perturbations)
//        4 × 48000 RK4 steps × 4 ODE calls = 768K function evaluations
// ============================================================================

fn simulate_epistemic_dp14(
    priors: Dp14Priors,
    dose_mg: f64,
    t_end: f64,
) -> Dp14EpResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let prm_ref = dp14_rapamycin_params()

    // ---- Reference simulation ----
    let m_ref = run_dp14(&prm_ref, dose_mg, t_end)
    if m_ref.success == false {
        return dp14_ep_empty()
    }

    let auc_ref = m_ref.auc
    let bpr_ref = if m_ref.blood_final > 1.0e-12 {
        m_ref.brain_final / m_ref.blood_final
    } else {
        0.0
    }

    // ---- GUM parameter characterisation (stdlib epistemic::gum) ----
    // Each uncertain parameter expressed as a GUMResult via gum_simple (Type B, DOF=∞).
    // std_u = population SD from literature — characterises epistemic uncertainty
    // in the parameter value used to predict individual patient PK.
    let cl_gum  = gum_simple(12.4, 7.4)    // Ferron 1997, CYP3A4 popPK, CV=60%
    let kp_gum  = gum_simple(0.08, 0.025)  // Lampen 1998, P-gp efflux (indirect)
    let fu_gum  = gum_simple(0.08, 0.020)  // Schreiber 1991, protein binding in vitro

    // ---- Perturbation 1: CL_hepatic ----
    // dp14_copy borrows prm_ref (no move), returns owned copy for mutation
    let h_cl = dp14_fdiff_h(cl_gum.value, cl_gum.std_u)
    var prm_cl = dp14_copy(&prm_ref)
    prm_cl.cl_hep = prm_cl.cl_hep + h_cl
    let m_cl = run_dp14(&prm_cl, dose_mg, t_end)
    let dauc_dcl = (m_cl.auc - auc_ref) / h_cl
    let bpr_cl_p = if m_cl.blood_final > 1.0e-12 {
        m_cl.brain_final / m_cl.blood_final } else { 0.0 }
    let dbpr_dcl = (bpr_cl_p - bpr_ref) / h_cl

    // ---- Perturbation 2: kp_brain ----
    let h_kp = dp14_fdiff_h(kp_gum.value, kp_gum.std_u)
    var prm_kp = dp14_copy(&prm_ref)
    prm_kp.kp_brain = prm_kp.kp_brain + h_kp
    let m_kp = run_dp14(&prm_kp, dose_mg, t_end)
    let dauc_dkp = (m_kp.auc - auc_ref) / h_kp
    let bpr_kp_p = if m_kp.blood_final > 1.0e-12 {
        m_kp.brain_final / m_kp.blood_final } else { 0.0 }
    let dbpr_dkp = (bpr_kp_p - bpr_ref) / h_kp

    // ---- Perturbation 3: fu_plasma ----
    let h_fu = dp14_fdiff_h(fu_gum.value, fu_gum.std_u)
    var prm_fu = dp14_copy(&prm_ref)
    prm_fu.fu = prm_fu.fu + h_fu
    let m_fu = run_dp14(&prm_fu, dose_mg, t_end)
    let dauc_dfu = (m_fu.auc - auc_ref) / h_fu
    let bpr_fu_p = if m_fu.blood_final > 1.0e-12 {
        m_fu.brain_final / m_fu.blood_final } else { 0.0 }
    let dbpr_dfu = (bpr_fu_p - bpr_ref) / h_fu

    // ---- GUM propagation via stdlib epistemic::gum (JCGM 100:2008 §5.1.2) ----
    // Build sensitivity-weighted GUMUncertainty components.
    // sensitivity = |∂AUC/∂θ_i|; std_u and DOF come from gum_simple GUMResult.
    let u_cl_auc = GUMUncertainty { std_uncertainty: cl_gum.std_u, degrees_of_freedom: cl_gum.dof, sensitivity: dp_abs(dauc_dcl) }
    let u_kp_auc = GUMUncertainty { std_uncertainty: kp_gum.std_u, degrees_of_freedom: kp_gum.dof, sensitivity: dp_abs(dauc_dkp) }
    let u_fu_auc = GUMUncertainty { std_uncertainty: fu_gum.std_u, degrees_of_freedom: fu_gum.dof, sensitivity: dp_abs(dauc_dfu) }

    // Welch-Satterthwaite effective DOF — all Type B (DOF=∞) → ν_eff = ∞ → k = 1.96
    let v_eff_auc = welch_satterthwaite_3(u_cl_auc, u_kp_auc, u_fu_auc)

    // Combined variance (GUM law of propagation of uncertainty)
    let var_auc = dauc_dcl * dauc_dcl * cl_gum.std_u * cl_gum.std_u
                + dauc_dkp * dauc_dkp * kp_gum.std_u * kp_gum.std_u
                + dauc_dfu * dauc_dfu * fu_gum.std_u * fu_gum.std_u
