    let var_bpr = dbpr_dcl * dbpr_dcl * cl_gum.std_u * cl_gum.std_u
                + dbpr_dkp * dbpr_dkp * kp_gum.std_u * kp_gum.std_u
                + dbpr_dfu * dbpr_dfu * fu_gum.std_u * fu_gum.std_u

    // ---- Sensitivity fractions for AUC ----
    let s_cl = if var_auc > 1.0e-30 {
        dauc_dcl * dauc_dcl * cl_gum.std_u * cl_gum.std_u / var_auc } else { 0.0 }
    let s_kp = if var_auc > 1.0e-30 {
        dauc_dkp * dauc_dkp * kp_gum.std_u * kp_gum.std_u / var_auc } else { 0.0 }
    let s_fu = if var_auc > 1.0e-30 {
        dauc_dfu * dauc_dfu * fu_gum.std_u * fu_gum.std_u / var_auc } else { 0.0 }

    // ---- Evidence-weighted confidence (Novel Contribution #2 prerequisite) ----
    // Confidence of AUC = Σ s_i * conf_i  (sensitivity-weighted average)
    let conf_auc = priors.cl_conf * s_cl
                 + priors.kp_brain_conf * s_kp
                 + priors.fu_conf * s_fu

    // BPR confidence: kp_brain dominates directly (C_brain ≈ kp_brain * C_blood)
    let s_kp_bpr = if var_bpr > 1.0e-30 {
        dbpr_dkp * dbpr_dkp * kp_gum.std_u * kp_gum.std_u / var_bpr } else { 0.0 }
    let s_cl_bpr = if var_bpr > 1.0e-30 {
        dbpr_dcl * dbpr_dcl * cl_gum.std_u * cl_gum.std_u / var_bpr } else { 0.0 }
    let s_fu_bpr = if var_bpr > 1.0e-30 {
        dbpr_dfu * dbpr_dfu * fu_gum.std_u * fu_gum.std_u / var_bpr } else { 0.0 }
    let conf_bpr = priors.kp_brain_conf * s_kp_bpr
                 + priors.cl_conf * s_cl_bpr
                 + priors.fu_conf * s_fu_bpr

    Dp14EpResult {
        auc_mean: auc_ref,
        auc_var: var_auc,
        auc_conf: conf_auc,
        bpr_mean: bpr_ref,
        bpr_var: var_bpr,
        bpr_conf: conf_bpr,
        s_cl: s_cl,
        s_kp: s_kp,
        s_fu: s_fu,
        v_eff_auc: v_eff_auc,
        success: true,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// CONFIDENCE GATES (Novel Contribution #2)
//
// A ConfidenceGate asserts that evidence quality >= threshold.
// If a gate fails, the output MUST NOT be used for clinical decision-making.
// This is the operationalization of GUM §3.3 "target uncertainty" for
// pharmacokinetic simulation outputs.
//
// Gate thresholds chosen conservatively:
//   AUC gate:  conf >= 0.50 (minimum for any clinical use)
//   BPR gate:  conf >= 0.45 (lower: kp_brain based on indirect evidence)
// ============================================================================

struct Dp14ConfGate {
    actual: f64,
    threshold: f64,
    passed: bool,
}

fn dp14_gate(actual: f64, threshold: f64) -> Dp14ConfGate {
    Dp14ConfGate {
        actual: actual,
        threshold: threshold,
        passed: actual >= threshold,
    }
}

struct Dp14GateSet {
    auc_gate: Dp14ConfGate,
    bpr_gate: Dp14ConfGate,
    all_passed: bool,
}

fn dp14_run_gates(ep: &Dp14EpResult) -> Dp14GateSet {
    let ag = dp14_gate(ep.auc_conf, 0.50)
    let bg = dp14_gate(ep.bpr_conf, 0.45)
    Dp14GateSet {
        auc_gate: ag,
        bpr_gate: bg,
        all_passed: ag.passed && bg.passed,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// ISO UNCERTAINTY BUDGET (Novel Contribution #3)
//
// JCGM 100:2008 §8 — Reporting uncertainty
// For each input quantity x_i:
//   u(x_i)   = standard uncertainty (SD)
//   c_i      = sensitivity coefficient (∂AUC/∂x_i)
//   u_i      = |c_i| * u(x_i)    (contribution to combined uncertainty)
//   s_i      = u_i^2 / u_c^2     (fractional contribution)
//
// Combined:   u_c(AUC) = sqrt(Σ u_i^2)
// Expanded:   U_95 = k * u_c    where k=2.0 (normal approx, large DOF)
// ============================================================================

struct Dp14IsoBudget {
    // Standard uncertainty contributions (mg·h/L)
    u_cl: f64,         // |dAUC/dCL| * SD_CL
    u_kp: f64,         // |dAUC/dkp| * SD_kp
    u_fu: f64,         // |dAUC/dfu| * SD_fu
    u_c: f64,          // Combined standard uncertainty = sqrt(u_cl^2 + u_kp^2 + u_fu^2)
    U_95: f64,         // Expanded uncertainty, k=2 (approx 95% coverage)
    k: f64,            // Coverage factor
}

fn dp14_iso_budget(ep: &Dp14EpResult) -> Dp14IsoBudget with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let u_c = dp_sqrt(ep.auc_var)
    // u_i = sqrt(s_i) * u_c  (since s_i = u_i^2 / u_c^2)
    let u_cl = dp_sqrt(ep.s_cl) * u_c
    let u_kp = dp_sqrt(ep.s_kp) * u_c
    let u_fu = dp_sqrt(ep.s_fu) * u_c
    // Coverage factor from Welch-Satterthwaite effective DOF (stdlib coverage_factor_95)
    // All inputs Type B (DOF=∞) → ν_eff = ∞ → k = 1.96 (normal approx per GUM §G.4)
    let k = coverage_factor_95(ep.v_eff_auc)
    Dp14IsoBudget {
        u_cl: u_cl,
        u_kp: u_kp,
        u_fu: u_fu,
        u_c: u_c,
        U_95: k * u_c,
        k: k,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN TEST SUITE — 8 dissertation tests
// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    println("======================================================================")
    println("  DISSERTATION: Epistemic PBPK — 14-Compartment Rapamycin (IV Bolus)")
    println("  GUM-Through-ODE | Confidence Gates | ISO Uncertainty Budget")
    println("  JCGM 100:2008 | Brown 1997 | ICRP 89 | Ferron 1997 | Lampen 1998")
    println("======================================================================")
    println("")

    let priors = dp14_rapamycin_priors()
    let dose_mg = 5.0    // 5 mg IV bolus (standard rapamycin IV dose)
    let t_end = 48.0     // 48h simulation (covers ~2.3 x t1/2 ~ 21h)

    let ep = simulate_epistemic_dp14(priors, dose_mg, t_end)

    var passed: i64 = 0
    var failed: i64 = 0

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // TEST 1: Simulation completes successfully
    // All 4 runs (reference + 3 perturbations) must succeed
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    println("TEST 1: All 4 simulations complete (reference + 3 perturbations)")
    if ep.success {
        println("  [PASS] 14-compartment RK4 PBPK: 4 × 48000 steps completed")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  [FAIL] Simulation returned success=false — check parameters")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // TEST 2: Brain/plasma ratio < 0.15 (P-gp efflux at BBB)
    //
    // Pharmacological basis: rapamycin is a P-glycoprotein substrate.
    // At pseudo-steady state (τ_brain = V_brain/Q_brain = 1.4/46.6 = 0.03h = 1.8min):
    //   C_brain ≈ Kp_brain * C_art ≈ 0.08 * C_plasma
    //   BPR = C_brain/C_plasma ≈ 0.08  (well below 0.15)
    // Literature range: 0.07-0.12 (Lampen 1998 rodent data)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    println("TEST 2: Brain/plasma ratio < 0.15 at t=48h (P-gp BBB efflux)")
    println("  BPR at t=48h:")
    println(ep.bpr_mean)
    if ep.bpr_mean > 0.0 && ep.bpr_mean < 0.15 {
        println("  [PASS] kp_brain=0.08 correctly limits CNS exposure (P-gp efflux)")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  [FAIL] Expected 0 < BPR < 0.15 (P-gp efflux); got:")
        println(ep.bpr_mean)
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // TEST 3: CV(AUC_0_48) > 0 — GUM-through-ODE propagates CL variability
    //
    // For a highly lipophilic drug (kp_fat=12, 14.5L adipose), <10% of
    // the rapamycin dose is eliminated in 48h. AUC(0-48h) is dominated
    // by distribution, not elimination — so GUM sensitivity to CL is
    // small but demonstrably non-zero. The correct test is that the
    // GUM propagation WORKS (var_auc > 0, cv > 0) and that CL dominates
    // (test 6). CV(0-inf) ≈ CV(CL) = 60%, but CV(0-48h) < 10% due to
    // deep tissue distribution sink (physiologically accurate).
    // Threshold: CV > 1% (verifies non-degenerate propagation).
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    println("TEST 3: CV(AUC_0-48h) > 1% (GUM uncertainty non-degenerate)")
    let auc_sd = dp_sqrt(ep.auc_var)
    let cv_auc = if ep.auc_mean > 1.0e-12 { auc_sd / ep.auc_mean } else { 0.0 }
    println("  AUC mean (mg.h/L):")
    println(ep.auc_mean)
    println("  AUC SD:")
    println(auc_sd)
    println("  CV(AUC):")
    println(cv_auc)
    if cv_auc > 0.01 {
        println("  [PASS] GUM propagated CYP3A4 variability (CV>1%, deep distribution limits CV<10%)")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  [FAIL] CV(AUC) should be > 1% — GUM propagation degenerate")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // TEST 4: All GUM-propagated variances > 0
    //
    // Zero variance would indicate a degenerate Jacobian (parameter has
    // no effect on output) or a numerical error in finite differences.
    // Both var_auc > 0 (CL and fu both affect AUC) and var_bpr > 0
    // (kp_brain directly sets brain/blood ratio) must hold.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    println("TEST 4: All GUM variances > 0 (propagation not degenerate)")
    println("  var_auc:")
    println(ep.auc_var)
    println("  var_bpr:")
    println(ep.bpr_var)
    if ep.auc_var > 0.0 && ep.bpr_var > 0.0 {
        println("  [PASS] GUM uncertainty propagated to all outputs")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  [FAIL] Some variance is zero — check finite difference step h")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // TEST 5: AUC(CL/2) > AUC(CL_ref) — causal monotonicity check
    //
    // PK causality: halving CL doubles t1/2 and increases AUC.
    // For linear PK: AUC = Dose / CL (exactly, for complete elimination).
    // This validates model causality independent of specific AUC value.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    println("TEST 5: AUC(CL/2) > AUC(CL_ref) — causal monotonicity")
    var prm_lc = dp14_rapamycin_params()
    prm_lc.cl_hep = prm_lc.cl_hep * 0.5
    let m_low = run_dp14(&prm_lc, dose_mg, t_end)
    println("  AUC at CL_ref=12.4 L/h:")
    println(ep.auc_mean)
    println("  AUC at CL/2=6.2 L/h:")
    println(m_low.auc)
    if m_low.auc > ep.auc_mean {
        println("  [PASS] Halving CL increases AUC (causal PK relationship verified)")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  [FAIL] AUC should increase when CL decreases")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // TEST 6: CL dominates AUC uncertainty — s_cl > 0.5
    //
    // Sensitivity analysis: CL_hepatic should be the dominant source of
    // AUC variance because:
    //   - CL has largest absolute variance: Var_CL = 54.76 (SD=7.4, CV=60%)
    //   - AUC ≈ Dose/CL (first-order, linear elimination)
    //   → ∂AUC/∂CL ≈ -AUC/CL (large sensitivity)
    //
    // kp_brain has almost no effect on systemic AUC (brain is tiny: 1.4L)
    // fu affects AUC through cl_eff = CL*fu, but Var_fu << Var_CL
    //
    // Analytical estimate: s_cl ≈ 0.85 (see 3-compartment validation)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    println("TEST 6: CL dominates AUC variance (s_cl > 0.5)")
    println("  Sensitivity fractions (s_i = c_i^2*Var_i / Var_AUC):")
    println("    s_cl (CL_hepatic):")
    println(ep.s_cl)
    println("    s_kp (kp_brain):")
    println(ep.s_kp)
    println("    s_fu (fu_plasma):")
    println(ep.s_fu)
    println("    sum:")
    println(ep.s_cl + ep.s_kp + ep.s_fu)
    if ep.s_cl > 0.5 {
        println("  [PASS] CL correctly identified as dominant AUC uncertainty source")
        println("  Clinical implication: TDM monitoring of CL is pharmacokinetically justified")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  [FAIL] CL should dominate AUC variance (expected s_cl > 0.5)")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // TEST 7: Confidence gates pass (Novel Contribution #2)
    //
    // Evidence-quality gates enforce minimum standards before clinical use:
    //   AUC gate:  conf_auc >= 0.50 (minimum for any clinical recommendation)
    //   BPR gate:  conf_bpr >= 0.45 (relaxed: kp_brain from indirect evidence)
    //
    // Confidence is propagated from parameters to outputs via
    // sensitivity-weighted averaging: conf_Y = Σ s_i * conf_i
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    println("TEST 7: Confidence gates pass (Novel Contribution #2)")
    let gates = dp14_run_gates(&ep)
    println("  AUC confidence gate (threshold >= 0.50):")
    println("    actual:")
    println(gates.auc_gate.actual)
    if gates.auc_gate.passed {
        println("    [PASS]")
    } else {
        println("    [FAIL]")
    }
    println("  BPR confidence gate (threshold >= 0.45):")
    println("    actual:")
    println(gates.bpr_gate.actual)
    if gates.bpr_gate.passed {
        println("    [PASS]")
    } else {
        println("    [FAIL]")
    }
    if gates.all_passed {
        println("  [PASS] All confidence gates passed — outputs cleared for clinical use")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  [FAIL] Confidence gate(s) failed — outputs NOT cleared for clinical use")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // TEST 8: ISO budget fractions sum to 1.0 ± 0.01 (Novel Contribution #3)
    //
    // JCGM 100:2008 §8 requires that fractional variance contributions
    // sum to exactly 1.0 (up to floating point rounding).
    // This validates the GUM variance decomposition is internally consistent.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    println("TEST 8: ISO GUM uncertainty budget — fractions sum to 1 (Novel Contribution #3)")
    let budget = dp14_iso_budget(&ep)
    let frac_sum = ep.s_cl + ep.s_kp + ep.s_fu
    let frac_err = dp_abs(frac_sum - 1.0)
    println("")
    println("  === ISO GUM Uncertainty Budget (JCGM 100:2008 sec 8) ===")
    println("  Output: AUC(0-48h) rapamycin 14-comp PBPK [mg.h/L]")
    println("  --------------------------------------------------------")
    println("  Parameter   | u(xi)   | u_i     | s_i")
    println("  CL_hepatic  |   7.400 | u_cl:")
    println(budget.u_cl)
    println("              | s_cl:")
    println(ep.s_cl)
    println("  kp_brain    |   0.025 | u_kp:")
    println(budget.u_kp)
    println("              | s_kp:")
    println(ep.s_kp)
    println("  fu_plasma   |   0.020 | u_fu:")
    println(budget.u_fu)
    println("              | s_fu:")
    println(ep.s_fu)
    println("  --------------------------------------------------------")
    println("  Combined uc(AUC):")
    println(budget.u_c)
    println("  Expanded U95 (k from W-S DOF via coverage_factor_95):")
    println(budget.U_95)
    println("  Fraction sum (must be 1.0):")
    println(frac_sum)
    println("  --------------------------------------------------------")
    if frac_err < 0.01 {
        println("  [PASS] Fractions sum to 1.0 — ISO GUM budget is internally consistent")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  [FAIL] Fractions do not sum to 1.0 — GUM decomposition error")
        println("  Error:")
        println(frac_err)
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // SUMMARY
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    println("======================================================================")
    println("  DISSERTATION TEST SUMMARY — Rapamycin 14-Comp Epistemic PBPK")
    println("======================================================================")
    println("  Passed:")
    println(passed)
    println("  Failed:")
    println(failed)
    println("")
    if failed == 0 {
        println("  ALL 8 TESTS PASSED")
        println("")
        println("  Three novel contributions verified:")
        println("  1. GUM-through-ODE: uncertainty propagated through 48000 RK4 steps")
        println("     CV(AUC) > 1% confirmed (deep tissue distribution limits 48h sensitivity)")
        println("  2. Confidence gates: AUC and BPR cleared for clinical use")
        println("     Evidence-quality thresholds met for all output quantities")
        println("  3. ISO uncertainty budget: JCGM 100:2008 sec 8 compliant")
        println("     CL_hepatic dominates AUC variance (TDM clinically justified)")
    } else {
        println("  SOME TESTS FAILED — investigate above diagnostics")
    }
    println("======================================================================")

    return failed as i32
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/dissertation_pbpk14_hessian.sio ===
// tests/run-pass/dissertation_pbpk14_hessian.sio
//
// End-to-end demonstration of the second-order GUM Hessian propagator.
// Two halves:
//
//   (1) Synthetic-output residual proof.  For a controlled non-linear
//       endpoint y = a · x², the analytic variance is closed-form.  We
//       compute it three ways: ground truth, GUM 1st order (Jacobian),
//       GUM 2nd order (Jacobian + Hessian correction).  The acceptance
//       check is |GUM_2nd − truth| < |GUM_1st − truth| — the dissertation
//       claim that the 2nd-order term moves the GUM estimate toward the
//       true variance for non-linear outputs.
//
//   (2) Rapamycin AUC Hessian budget.  Runs the propagator on a
//       2-parameter rapamycin sub-case (CL_hep × fu_plasma) and emits a
//       CSV-format budget.  The companion gate redirects this section
//       to benchmarks/pbpk/hessian_budget.csv.
//
// Final stdout line: "PASS hessian_correction_reduces_residual"

use math::pure::*
use darwin_pbpk::tsit5_pbpk14::*
use darwin_pbpk::epistemic_pbpk14::{EpPrior14, ep14_rapamycin_params}
use darwin_pbpk::epistemic_pbpk14_hessian::*

fn approx_eq(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var d = a - b
    if d < 0.0 { d = 0.0 - d }
    d < tol
}

fn abs_diff(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var d = a - b
    if d < 0.0 { d = 0.0 - d }
    d
}

fn fail(tag: string) with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    print("FAIL hessian_correction_reduces_residual: ")
    println(tag)
}

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------
// (1) Synthetic non-linear endpoint y = a · x²
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------
//
// For x ~ N(μ, σ²):
//   E[y]      = a (μ² + σ²)
//   Var(y)    = a² · ( 4 μ² σ² + 2 σ⁴ )         (exact)
//
// GUM 1st order:
//   c = ∂y/∂x = 2 a μ
//   Var₁ = c² σ² = 4 a² μ² σ²                    (misses 2 a² σ⁴)
//
// GUM 2nd order:
//   H = ∂²y/∂x² = 2 a
//   correction = ½ · H² · σ⁴ = 2 a² σ⁴
//   Var₂ = Var₁ + correction = 4 a² μ² σ² + 2 a² σ⁴   (exact)
//
// So |Var₁ − truth| = 2 a² σ⁴, |Var₂ − truth| = 0.

fn synthetic_residual_test() -> bool with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let a:    f64 = 0.7
    let mu:   f64 = 1.5
    let sig2: f64 = 0.04            // σ² = 0.04, σ = 0.2

    // Ground truth.
    let var_truth = a * a * (4.0 * mu * mu * sig2 + 2.0 * sig2 * sig2)

    // GUM 1st order (analytic c).
    let c1 = 2.0 * a * mu
    let var_1 = c1 * c1 * sig2

    // GUM 2nd order via 4-point central FD on the synthetic output.
    let h: f64 = 0.01 * sqrt(sig2)
    let f0  = a * mu * mu
    let fp  = a * (mu + h) * (mu + h)
    let fn1 = a * (mu - h) * (mu - h)
    let c_fd = (fp - fn1) / (2.0 * h)
    let h_fd = (fp - 2.0 * f0 + fn1) / (h * h)
    let var_2 = c_fd * c_fd * sig2 + 0.5 * h_fd * h_fd * sig2 * sig2

    let r1 = abs_diff(var_1, var_truth)
    let r2 = abs_diff(var_2, var_truth)

    print("synthetic var_truth="); print_f64(var_truth)
    print(" var_o1=");             print_f64(var_1)
    print(" var_o2=");              print_f64(var_2)
    print(" r1=");                  print_f64(r1)
    print(" r2=");                  print_f64(r2)
    println("")

    r2 < r1
}

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------
// (2) Rapamycin AUC Hessian budget — emit CSV-format rows.
//
// Use a 2-parameter sub-case (CL_hep, fu_plasma) to limit the
// simulation count.  ~9 PBPK simulations total (1 ref + 4 Jacobian +
// 4 off-diagonal corner + 0 extra diagonal — 3-point diagonal reuses
// the Jacobian's perturbed AUC values).
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------

fn rapamycin_priors_2param() -> EpPrior14 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var p = EpPrior14 {
        mean:       [0.0; 8],
        variance:   [0.0; 8],
        confidence: [0.0; 8],
        n: 0,
    }
    p.n = 2
    // 0: cl_hepatic (CYP3A4, CV~60%)
    p.mean[0]       = 12.4
    p.variance[0]   = 6.0       // smaller σ to keep sims well-conditioned
    p.confidence[0] = 0.65
    // 1: fu_plasma (Schreiber 1991)
    p.mean[1]       = 0.08
    p.variance[1]   = 0.0001
    p.confidence[1] = 0.55
    p
}

fn emit_rapamycin_budget() with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let prm    = ep14_rapamycin_params()
    let priors = rapamycin_priors_2param()
    let dose   = 6.0
    let t_end  = 1.0       // 1 h window — short enough that Euler is stable

    let bud = hessian_pbpk14_auc(prm, priors, dose, t_end)

    println("# rapamycin_hessian_budget_v1")
    hessian_emit_csv_header()
    hessian_emit_budget_csv(bud)
}

fn main() with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    // (1) synthetic non-linear residual proof
    let ok = synthetic_residual_test()
    if !ok {
        fail("synthetic_test_did_not_reduce_residual")
        return
    }

    // (2) rapamycin Hessian CSV emission (smoke — checked by the gate
    // for the bytestable header line, not for numerical match)
    emit_rapamycin_budget()

    println("PASS hessian_correction_reduces_residual")
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/dissertation_pbpk28_confidence_gate.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ description: PBPK28 rapamycin priors carried as Knowledge<f64> with literature ε.
//@ A dosing summary declared at the HONEST evidence ceiling (with Epistemic(400),
//@ the weakest prior) compiles and runs. The over-claim counterpart
//@ (with Epistemic(950)) is rejected — see compile-fail/dissertation_pbpk28_overclaim.sio.
//@ METHOD demonstration of compile-time confidence gates (dissertation Contribution 2);
//@ NOT a clinical dosing engine — ε is literature evidence-quality, not a probability.
//
// These are the real rapamycin priors from stdlib/darwin_pbpk/epistemic_pbpk28.sio
// (ep28_rapamycin_priors), where confidence was a plain f64 the type system could
// not see. Carried as Knowledge<f64, ε> they become first-class: the ε flows into
// the EpistemicComplete gate, so a function cannot claim more confidence than its
// weakest input supports.
//
//   cl_hepatic ε=0.65 (Jiao/Zhang 2009 pop-PK, CV≈38%)
//   fu_plasma  ε=0.72 (Schreiber 1991, CV≈25%)
//   kp_liver   ε=0.60 (Valoteau 1996, CV≈25%)
//   kp_adipose ε=0.40 (capped model, CV≈40%)   ← the weakest evidence
//
// Gate semantics (per-token, NOT combined): `with Epistemic(N)` requires EVERY
// input expression to individually carry confidence ≥ N. It does NOT certify the
// propagated/combined confidence of the result (that compounds far lower). So the
// maximum satisfiable N is the WEAKEST single prior, kp_adipose ε=0.40 → 400:
// verified that Epistemic(400) compiles but Epistemic(401) already rejects (and
// Epistemic(650) flags both kp_adipose and kp_liver). This is the type system
// refusing to let any under-evidenced input enter a high-confidence claim.

fn rapa_dosing_summary() -> f64 with Epistemic(400), Mut, Div, Panic {
    let cl_hepatic: Knowledge[f64] = Knowledge(12.4, ε=0.65, prov="Jiao2009_popPK_CV38");
    let fu_plasma:  Knowledge[f64] = Knowledge(0.08, ε=0.72, prov="Schreiber1991_CV25");
    let kp_liver:   Knowledge[f64] = Knowledge(5.40, ε=0.60, prov="Valoteau1996_CV25");
    let kp_adipose: Knowledge[f64] = Knowledge(0.30, ε=0.40, prov="capped_model_CV40");
    cl_hepatic.value + fu_plasma.value + kp_liver.value + kp_adipose.value
}

fn main() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic, Epistemic {
    // Σ of the four prior central values (12.4 + 0.08 + 5.40 + 0.30 = 18.18),
    // proving the gated body actually compiled and executed.
    println(rapa_dosing_summary());
    println("PBPK28_CONFIDENCE_GATE_PASS");
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/dissertation_pbpk28_degenerate_parity_ref.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ timeout: 90
// ============================================================================
// DISSERTATION PBPK28 PARITY REFERENCE — DEGENERATE (V_v→0, PS→∞)
//
// Companion to website/src/lib/pbpk28_core.mjs and the parity gate at
// scripts/ci/dissertation_pbpk28_parity_gate.sh (Case 2: asymptotic reduction
// of PBPK28 → PBPK14 well-stirred).
//
// Degenerate configuration:
//   vasc_frac_at(i) = 1e-3 ∀ organs (vs 0.019–0.282 in the literature ref)
//   ps_at(i)        = lit_PS_i × 1e4   (drives PS-coupling instantaneous)
// At these parameters CN's A-stability is essential — explicit RK4 in the
// slow operator would require dt ~ 1e-7 h for kidney/lung; CN integrates
// stably at dt = 0.001 h.
//
// CORRECTED asymptotic claim (G-α-β math correction):
//   PBPK28 at (V_v → 0, PS → ∞) does NOT reduce to PBPK14 well-stirred. It
//   reduces to a *1-state quasi-steady-state (QSS) model*:
//     V_eff · dC_b/dt = -cl_hep · C_b + release,
//     V_eff = V_b + Σ V_i · Kp_i
//     C_v_i = C_b instantly; C_t_i = Kp_i · C_b instantly.
//
//   PBPK14 well-stirred sits BETWEEN PBPK28-lit (finite PS, finite V_v) and
//   PBPK28-degenerate (V_v→0, PS→∞). The three models form a hierarchy in
//   model-form complexity; PBPK14 is the *intermediate* approximation where
//   tissue redistributes instantly *within* an organ but blood-to-tissue
//   transport remains rate-limited by Q. PBPK28-degenerate additionally
//   assumes blood-to-tissue transport is also instantaneous.
//
// This file remains useful as: (a) the target trajectory for the
// fully-coupled CN A-stability proof at extreme stiffness, and (b) the
// numerical demonstration that PBPK28-degenerate matches the 1-state QSS
// limit (asymptotic verification of the model-reduction theorem).
// Quantitative match against the 1-state QSS limit at literature
// parameters provides the Type B model-form uncertainty contribution per
// JCGM 100:2008 §4.3 (the G-α-γ follow-up will emit benchmarks/pbpk/
// model_form_uc.csv from these comparisons).
//
// Model: permeability-limited PBPK, 14 organs × {vascular, interstitial}.
//   V_v,i · dC_v,i/dt = Q_i·(C_blood - C_v,i) - PS_i·(C_v,i - C_t,i/Kp_i)
//   V_t,i · dC_t,i/dt = PS_i·(C_v,i - C_t,i/Kp_i)
//   V_b   · dC_b/dt   = sum_i Q_i·(C_v,i - C_b) - cl_hep·C_b
//
// Integrator: fully-coupled Crank-Nicolson on the 27-state PBPK28 system —
// no operator splitting. PS coupling and Q transport integrated implicitly in
// one CN step via per-organ Schur-complement elimination + scalar reduction
// for C_blood. A-stable, 2nd-order, no splitting-induced bias.
//
// Compartment indexing matches website/src/components/dissertation/compartments.ts:
//   0=blood 1=liver 2=kidney 3=brain 4=heart 5=lung 6=muscle 7=adipose
//   8=gut   9=skin  10=bone   11=spleen 12=pancreas 13=other
//
// Bolus 0.05 mg into blood (C_blood(0) = 0.01 mg/L). cl_hep = 12.4 L/h. Stent off.
// Twelve log-spaced sample times. Emits PARITY|t / PARITY|i / PARITY|cv / PARITY|ct
// / PARITY|cavg records — the gate joins on (t, i) and compares against the
// Node runner's identical output.
// ============================================================================

struct Pbpk28 { cv: [f64; 14], ct: [f64; 14] }

fn pbpk28_zero() -> Pbpk28 { Pbpk28 { cv: [0.0; 14], ct: [0.0; 14] } }

// V_i, L, ICRP standard man 70 kg (matches pbpk14_core.mjs V_REF).
fn vref_at(i: i64) -> f64 {
    if i ==  0 { return 5.0 }
    if i ==  1 { return 1.8 }
    if i ==  2 { return 0.31 }
    if i ==  3 { return 1.45 }
    if i ==  4 { return 0.33 }
    if i ==  5 { return 1.1 }
    if i ==  6 { return 28.0 }
    if i ==  7 { return 20.0 }
    if i ==  8 { return 1.2 }
    if i ==  9 { return 3.6 }
    if i == 10 { return 6.6 }
    if i == 11 { return 0.18 }
    if i == 12 { return 0.09 }
    return 3.7
}

// DEGENERATE vasc_frac: 1e-3 for all organs (was 0.019–0.282).
// Drives the V_v→0 limit; CN A-stability handles the resulting Q/V_v
// eigenvalue blow-up (~O(7e4) for kidney) unconditionally.
fn vasc_frac_at(i: i64) -> f64 {
    if i == 0 { return 1.000 }
    return 0.001
}

// Kp (rapamycin partition coefficient, tissue:vascular at equilibrium).
fn kp_at(i: i64) -> f64 {
    if i ==  0 { return 1.00 }
    if i ==  1 { return 5.40 }
    if i ==  2 { return 4.20 }
    if i ==  3 { return 0.10 }
    if i ==  4 { return 2.30 }
    if i ==  5 { return 3.10 }
    if i ==  6 { return 0.50 }
    if i ==  7 { return 0.30 }
    if i ==  8 { return 2.60 }
    if i ==  9 { return 0.80 }
    if i == 10 { return 0.20 }
    if i == 11 { return 2.10 }
    if i == 12 { return 1.80 }
    return 0.40
}

// Q (organ blood flow, L/h, 70 kg adult).
fn q_at(i: i64) -> f64 {
    if i ==  0 { return 350.0 }
    if i ==  1 { return 90.0 }
    if i ==  2 { return 74.0 }
    if i ==  3 { return 44.0 }
    if i ==  4 { return 16.0 }
    if i ==  5 { return 350.0 }
    if i ==  6 { return 42.0 }
    if i ==  7 { return 10.0 }
    if i ==  8 { return 55.0 }
    if i ==  9 { return 21.0 }
    if i == 10 { return 17.0 }
    if i == 11 { return 10.0 }
    if i == 12 { return 8.0 }
    return 13.0
}

// DEGENERATE PS_i: literature × 1e4. Drives PS→∞ (PS-coupling equilibrates
// instantly within each Strang half-step; CN's exp_neg yields decay→0).
fn ps_at(i: i64) -> f64 {
    if i ==  0 { return 0.0 }
    if i ==  1 { return 1.8e7 }
    if i ==  2 { return 1.11e7 }
    if i ==  3 { return 8.8e5 }
    if i ==  4 { return 1.6e6 }
    if i ==  5 { return 1.05e8 }
    if i ==  6 { return 3.36e6 }
    if i ==  7 { return 4.0e5 }
    if i ==  8 { return 6.6e6 }
    if i ==  9 { return 1.26e6 }
    if i == 10 { return 5.1e5 }
    if i == 11 { return 1.5e6 }
    if i == 12 { return 9.6e5 }
    return 7.8e5
}

fn cl_hep() -> f64 { return 12.4 }

// Taylor-series exp for the PS-relaxation analytical step. The argument is
// always non-positive (-λ·dt/2 with λ > 0, dt > 0); we range-reduce x → x/2^k
// until |x| ≤ 0.5, evaluate the truncated series to order 8, then square back
// k times. This gives ~14 digits of accuracy for the negative-x range we use.
fn exp_neg(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    if x == 0.0 { return 1.0 }
    var s = x
    var k = 0
    while s < (0.0 - 0.5) {
        s = s * 0.5
        k = k + 1
    }
    let s2 = s * s
    let s3 = s2 * s
    let s4 = s2 * s2
    let s5 = s4 * s
    let s6 = s3 * s3
    let s7 = s6 * s
    let s8 = s4 * s4
    var r = 1.0 + s + s2 / 2.0 + s3 / 6.0 + s4 / 24.0 + s5 / 120.0
              + s6 / 720.0 + s7 / 5040.0 + s8 / 40320.0
    var j = 0
    while j < k {
        r = r * r
        j = j + 1
    }
    return r
}

// Half-step exact PS-relaxation per organ. Equilibrium: Ct_eq = Kp · Cv_eq;
// mass conservation: V_v · Cv + V_t · Ct = M ⇒ Cv_eq = M / (V_v + V_t·Kp).
// Decay: z(τ) = z(0) · exp(-λ·τ) where z = Cv - Ct/Kp,
// λ = PS · (1/V_v + 1/(V_t·Kp)).
fn ps_relax(state: Pbpk28, dt: f64) -> Pbpk28 with Mut, Div {
    var r = state
    var i = 1
    while i < 14 {
        let vi = vref_at(i)
        let vf = vasc_frac_at(i)
        let vv = vi * vf
        let vt = vi * (1.0 - vf)
        let kp = kp_at(i)
        let ps = ps_at(i)
        if vv > 0.0 && vt > 0.0 && kp > 0.0 && ps > 0.0 {
            let mass = vv * r.cv[i] + vt * r.ct[i]
            let denom = vv + vt * kp
            let cv_eq = mass / denom
            let ct_eq = kp * cv_eq
            let lambda = ps * (1.0 / vv + 1.0 / (vt * kp))
            let decay = exp_neg(0.0 - lambda * dt)
            r.cv[i] = cv_eq + (r.cv[i] - cv_eq) * decay
            r.ct[i] = ct_eq + (r.ct[i] - ct_eq) * decay
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return r
}

// Fully-coupled Crank-Nicolson on the 27-state PBPK28 system.
// Identical algorithm to the literature parity ref — see the corresponding
// `full_cn_step` block in tests/run-pass/dissertation_pbpk28_parity_ref_rapamycin.sio
// for the full Schur-complement derivation. PS + Q + clearance integrated
// implicitly together; A-stable; handles arbitrary (V_v→0, PS→∞) regime.
fn full_cn_step(state: Pbpk28, dt: f64) -> Pbpk28 with Mut, Div {
    let h = 0.5 * dt
    let vb = vref_at(0)

    var sum_q = 0.0
    var i = 1
    while i < 14 {
        sum_q = sum_q + q_at(i)
        i = i + 1
    }
    let big_s = h * (sum_q + cl_hep()) / vb

    let cb_old = state.cv[0]
    var rhs0 = (1.0 - big_s) * cb_old

    var a_v: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var b_v: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var a_t: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var b_t: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var sum_beta_a = 0.0
    var sum_beta_b = 0.0

    i = 1
    while i < 14 {
        let vi = vref_at(i)
        let vf = vasc_frac_at(i)
        let vv_raw = vi * vf
        let vt_raw = vi * (1.0 - vf)
        let vv = if vv_raw < 1.0e-30 { 1.0e-30 } else { vv_raw }
        let vt = if vt_raw < 1.0e-30 { 1.0e-30 } else { vt_raw }
        let kp = kp_at(i)
        let ps = ps_at(i)
        let qi = q_at(i)

        let beta = h * qi / vb
        let gamma = h * qi / vv
        let p = 1.0 + h * (qi + ps) / vv
        let q = h * ps / (vv * kp)
        let r = h * ps / vt
        let sb = 1.0 + h * ps / (vt * kp)
        let det = p * sb - q * r

        rhs0 = rhs0 + beta * state.cv[i]

        let rhs_v = gamma * cb_old + (1.0 - h * (qi + ps) / vv) * state.cv[i] + q * state.ct[i]
        let rhs_t = r * state.cv[i] + (1.0 - h * ps / (vt * kp)) * state.ct[i]

        let av = (sb * rhs_v + q * rhs_t) / det
        let bv = (sb * gamma) / det
        let at = (r * rhs_v + p * rhs_t) / det
        let bt = (r * gamma) / det

        a_v[i] = av
        b_v[i] = bv
        a_t[i] = at
        b_t[i] = bt

        sum_beta_a = sum_beta_a + beta * av
        sum_beta_b = sum_beta_b + beta * bv
        i = i + 1
    }

    let cb_new = (rhs0 + sum_beta_a) / ((1.0 + big_s) - sum_beta_b)
    var out = pbpk28_zero()
    out.cv[0] = if cb_new < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { cb_new }
    i = 1
    while i < 14 {
        let cv = a_v[i] + b_v[i] * cb_new
        let ct = a_t[i] + b_t[i] * cb_new
        out.cv[i] = if cv < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { cv }
        out.ct[i] = if ct < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { ct }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return out
}

// One fully-coupled implicit CN step.
fn strang_step(state: Pbpk28, dt: f64) -> Pbpk28 with Mut, Div {
    return full_cn_step(state, dt)
}

fn integrate_to(state: Pbpk28, t_start: f64, t_end: f64, dt: f64) -> Pbpk28 with Mut, Div {
    var C = state
    var t = t_start
    while t + dt * 0.5 < t_end {
        C = strang_step(C, dt)
        t = t + dt
    }
    return C
}

// Organ-average concentration C_avg = vasc_frac · Cv + (1 - vasc_frac) · Ct.
// (For blood at i=0, Cv[0] is the central concentration and Ct[0] is unused.)
fn c_avg_at(state: &Pbpk28, i: i64) -> f64 {
    if i == 0 { return state.cv[0] }
    let vf = vasc_frac_at(i)
    return vf * state.cv[i] + (1.0 - vf) * state.ct[i]
}

fn emit_at(state: &Pbpk28, t: f64) with IO, Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < 14 {
        // PARITY|t / PARITY|i / PARITY|cv / PARITY|ct / PARITY|cavg per organ.
        // Five lines per organ per sample time → 14 × 12 × 5 = 840 records.
        print("PARITY|t=")
        println(t)
        println("")
        print("PARITY|i=")
        println(i)
        print("PARITY|cv=")
        println(state.cv[i])
        println("")
        print("PARITY|ct=")
        println(state.ct[i])
        println("")
        print("PARITY|cavg=")
        let avg = if i == 0 { state.cv[0] } else { vasc_frac_at(i) * state.cv[i] + (1.0 - vasc_frac_at(i)) * state.ct[i] }
        println(avg)
        println("")
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    println("DISSERTATION_PBPK28_DEGENERATE_PARITY_REF v1")
    println("compartments=14")
    println("states=28")
    println("dt=0.001")
    println("bolus_mg=0.05")
    println("cl_hep_L_per_h=12.4")
    println("integrator=fully_coupled_CN_27state")
    println("drug=rapamycin")
    println("case=degenerate")
    println("vasc_frac_all=0.001")
    println("ps_scale=10000")
    println("samples=12")

    var C = pbpk28_zero()
    C.cv[0] = 0.05 / vref_at(0)  // 0.01 mg/L initial blood concentration

    let dt = 0.001
    var t = 0.0

    C = integrate_to(C, t,  0.1, dt); t =  0.1; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t,  0.5, dt); t =  0.5; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t,  1.0, dt); t =  1.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t,  2.0, dt); t =  2.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t,  4.0, dt); t =  4.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t,  6.0, dt); t =  6.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t,  8.0, dt); t =  8.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 12.0, dt); t = 12.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 16.0, dt); t = 16.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 20.0, dt); t = 20.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 24.0, dt); t = 24.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 30.0, dt); t = 30.0; emit_at(&C, t)

    println("DISSERTATION_PBPK28_DEGENERATE_PARITY_DONE")
    return 0
}

// ============================================================================
// DISSERTATION PBPK28 PARITY REFERENCE — RAPAMYCIN at literature PS
//
// Companion to website/src/lib/pbpk28_core.mjs and the parity gate at
// scripts/ci/dissertation_pbpk28_parity_gate.sh (Case 1: Node ↔ Sounio at
// literature parameters).
//
// Model: permeability-limited PBPK, 14 organs × {vascular, interstitial}.
//   V_v,i · dC_v,i/dt = Q_i·(C_blood - C_v,i) - PS_i·(C_v,i - C_t,i/Kp_i)
//   V_t,i · dC_t,i/dt = PS_i·(C_v,i - C_t,i/Kp_i)
//   V_b   · dC_b/dt   = sum_i Q_i·(C_v,i - C_b) - cl_hep·C_b
//
// Integrator: **fully-coupled Crank-Nicolson** on the 27-state system. No
// operator splitting — PS coupling and Q transport integrated implicitly in
// one CN step via per-organ Schur-complement elimination (organ 2×2 blocks
// inverted analytically) + scalar reduction for C_blood. A-stable, 2nd-order,
// O(N) per step. Eliminates the operator-splitting bias of the prior
// Strang(PS, CN-slow) scheme — required for the deep-degenerate (V_v→0, PS→∞)
// asymptotic regime and Stage G-δ semaglutide PS values.
//
// Compartment indexing matches website/src/components/dissertation/compartments.ts:
//   0=blood 1=liver 2=kidney 3=brain 4=heart 5=lung 6=muscle 7=adipose
//   8=gut   9=skin  10=bone   11=spleen 12=pancreas 13=other
//
// Bolus 0.05 mg into blood (C_blood(0) = 0.01 mg/L). cl_hep = 12.4 L/h. Stent off.
// Twelve log-spaced sample times. Emits PARITY|t / PARITY|i / PARITY|cv / PARITY|ct
// / PARITY|cavg records — the gate joins on (t, i) and compares against the
// Node runner's identical output.
// ============================================================================

// State: 14 organs × {Cv [mg/L], Ct [mg/L], Rfree [nmol/L], DR [nmol/L],
//                     A [0..1 mTORC1 activity], N [0..1 neointimal index]}.
// Rfree/DR populated at TMDD organs (1=liver, 4=heart, 8=gut).
// A/N populated at PD organs (4=heart, coronary_smc proxy).
struct Pbpk28 {
    cv: [f64; 14],
    ct: [f64; 14],
    rfree: [f64; 14],
    dr: [f64; 14],
    a: [f64; 14],
    n: [f64; 14]
}

fn pbpk28_zero() -> Pbpk28 {
    Pbpk28 {
        cv: [0.0; 14],
        ct: [0.0; 14],
        rfree: [0.0; 14],
        dr: [0.0; 14],
        a: [0.0; 14],
        n: [0.0; 14]
    }
}

// always non-positive (-λ·dt/2 with λ > 0, dt > 0); we range-reduce x → x/2^k
// until |x| ≤ 0.5, evaluate the truncated series to order 8, then square back
// k times. This gives ~14 digits of accuracy for the negative-x range we use.
fn exp_neg(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {

    var s = x
    var k = 0
    while s < (0.0 - 0.5) {
        s = s * 0.5
        k = k + 1
    }
    let s2 = s * s
    let s3 = s2 * s
    let s4 = s2 * s2
    let s5 = s4 * s
    let s6 = s3 * s3
    let s7 = s6 * s
    let s8 = s4 * s4

              + s6 / 720.0 + s7 / 5040.0 + s8 / 40320.0
    var j = 0
    while j < k {
        r = r * r
        j = j + 1
    }
    return r
}

// Half-step exact PS-relaxation per organ. Equilibrium: Ct_eq = Kp · Cv_eq;
// mass conservation: V_v · Cv + V_t · Ct = M ⇒ Cv_eq = M / (V_v + V_t·Kp).
// Decay: z(τ) = z(0) · exp(-λ·τ) where z = Cv - Ct/Kp,
// λ = PS · (1/V_v + 1/(V_t·Kp)).
fn ps_relax(state: Pbpk28, dt: f64) -> Pbpk28 with Mut, Div {
    var r = state
    var i = 1
    while i < 14 {
        let vi = vref_at(i)
        let vf = vasc_frac_at(i)
        let vv = vi * vf
        let vt = vi * (1.0 - vf)
        let kp = kp_at(i)
        let ps = ps_at(i)
        if vv > 0.0 && vt > 0.0 && kp > 0.0 && ps > 0.0 {
            let mass = vv * r.cv[i] + vt * r.ct[i]
            let denom = vv + vt * kp
            let cv_eq = mass / denom
            let ct_eq = kp * cv_eq
            let lambda = ps * (1.0 / vv + 1.0 / (vt * kp))
            let decay = exp_neg(0.0 - lambda * dt)
            r.cv[i] = cv_eq + (r.cv[i] - cv_eq) * decay
            r.ct[i] = ct_eq + (r.ct[i] - ct_eq) * decay
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return r
}

// Fully-coupled Crank-Nicolson step on the **27-state** PBPK28 system.
// Replaces the prior Strang(PS, CN-slow) splitting — no operator splitting at
// all. PS-coupling and Q-transport are integrated implicitly in one CN step.
//
// State x = [C_blood, Cv_1, Ct_1, ..., Cv_13, Ct_13]; M is block-arrow.
// (I - dt·M/2)·x_new = (I + dt·M/2)·x_old + dt·f_mid
// Per-organ Schur elimination + scalar reduction for C_blood — O(N).
//
//   h = dt/2
//   p_i = 1 + h·(Q_i + PS_i)/V_v_i        (Cv self)
//   q_i = h·PS_i/(V_v_i·Kp_i)             (Cv ← Ct)
//   r_i = h·PS_i/V_t_i                    (Ct ← Cv)
//   s_i = 1 + h·PS_i/(V_t_i·Kp_i)         (Ct self)
//   D_i = p_i·s_i - q_i·r_i               (organ-block det)
//   γ_i = h·Q_i/V_v_i                     (Cv ← Cb)
//   β_i = h·Q_i/V_b                       (Cb ← Cv)
//   S   = h·(Σ Q_i + cl_hep)/V_b          (Cb self)
//
//   rhs0   = (1-S)·Cb_old + Σ β_i·Cv_i_old
//   rhsv_i = γ_i·Cb_old + (1 - h(Q+PS)/V_v)·Cv_i_old + q_i·Ct_i_old
//   rhst_i = r_i·Cv_i_old + (1 - h·PS/(V_t·Kp))·Ct_i_old
//
//   aV_i = (s_i·rhsv_i + q_i·rhst_i)/D_i
//   bV_i = s_i·γ_i / D_i
//   aT_i = (r_i·rhsv_i + p_i·rhst_i)/D_i
//   bT_i = r_i·γ_i / D_i
//   Cb_new = (rhs0 + Σ β_i·aV_i) / ((1+S) - Σ β_i·bV_i)
//   Cv_i_new = aV_i + bV_i·Cb_new
//   Ct_i_new = aT_i + bT_i·Cb_new
//
// A-stable, 2nd-order, no operator-splitting bias.
fn full_cn_step(state: Pbpk28, dt: f64) -> Pbpk28 with Mut, Div {
    let h = 0.5 * dt
    let vb = vref_at(0)

    var sum_q = 0.0
    var i = 1
    while i < 14 {
        sum_q = sum_q + q_at(i)
        i = i + 1
    }
    let big_s = h * (sum_q + cl_hep()) / vb

    let cb_old = state.cv[0]
    var rhs0 = (1.0 - big_s) * cb_old

    var a_v: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var b_v: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var a_t: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var b_t: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var sum_beta_a = 0.0
    var sum_beta_b = 0.0

    i = 1
    while i < 14 {
        let vi = vref_at(i)
        let vf = vasc_frac_at(i)
        let vv_raw = vi * vf
        let vt_raw = vi * (1.0 - vf)
        let vv = if vv_raw < 1.0e-30 { 1.0e-30 } else { vv_raw }
        let vt = if vt_raw < 1.0e-30 { 1.0e-30 } else { vt_raw }
        let kp = kp_at(i)
        let ps = ps_at(i)
        let qi = q_at(i)

        let beta = h * qi / vb
        let gamma = h * qi / vv
        let p = 1.0 + h * (qi + ps) / vv
        let q = h * ps / (vv * kp)
        let r = h * ps / vt
        let sb = 1.0 + h * ps / (vt * kp)
        let det = p * sb - q * r

        rhs0 = rhs0 + beta * state.cv[i]

        let rhs_v = gamma * cb_old + (1.0 - h * (qi + ps) / vv) * state.cv[i] + q * state.ct[i]
        let rhs_t = r * state.cv[i] + (1.0 - h * ps / (vt * kp)) * state.ct[i]

        let av = (sb * rhs_v + q * rhs_t) / det
        let bv = (sb * gamma) / det
        let at = (r * rhs_v + p * rhs_t) / det
        let bt = (r * gamma) / det

        a_v[i] = av
        b_v[i] = bv
        a_t[i] = at
        b_t[i] = bt

        sum_beta_a = sum_beta_a + beta * av
        sum_beta_b = sum_beta_b + beta * bv
        i = i + 1
    }

    let cb_new = (rhs0 + sum_beta_a) / ((1.0 + big_s) - sum_beta_b)
    var out = state                                          // inherits rfree/dr
    out.cv[0] = if cb_new < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { cb_new }
    i = 1
    while i < 14 {
        let cv = a_v[i] + b_v[i] * cb_new
        let ct = a_t[i] + b_t[i] * cb_new
        out.cv[i] = if cv < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { cv }
        out.ct[i] = if ct < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { ct }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return out
}

// ─── TMDD layer with back-reaction (G-β-2) ─────────────────────────────────
// Per-TMDD-organ 3-state implicit step on (C_t_nM, R_free, DR). All states in
// nmol/L; C_t converted from mass at start and back at end. Bilinear term
// k_on·C_t_nM·R_free Newton-linearized at start-of-step values for a single-
// iteration implicit CN solve (3×3 invert per organ).
//
//   dC_t_nM/dt = -k_on·C_t·R_free + k_off·DR
//   dR_free/dt =  k_syn - k_deg·R_free - k_on·C_t·R_free + k_off·DR
//   dDR/dt    =  k_on·C_t·R_free - (k_off + k_int)·DR
//
// Newton at (C_t_old, R_free_old):
//   k_on·C_t·R_free ≈ k_on·(C_t_old·R_free + R_free_old·C_t - C_t_old·R_free_old)
fn tmdd_step_organ(state: Pbpk28, i: i64, dt: f64) -> Pbpk28 with Mut, Div {
    if !fkbp12_is_tmdd_organ(i) { return state }
    var r = state
    let h = 0.5 * dt
    let mass_to_nm = 1.0e6 / fkbp12_mw_rapamycin_da()
    let nm_to_mass = fkbp12_mw_rapamycin_da() * 1.0e-6
    let ct_old_mass = r.ct[i]
    let ct_old_nm = if ct_old_mass < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { ct_old_mass * mass_to_nm }
    let rf_old = r.rfree[i]
    let dr_old = r.dr[i]

    let k_on = fkbp12_kon()
    let k_off = fkbp12_koff()
    let k_int = fkbp12_kint()
    let k_syn = fkbp12_ksyn_at(i)
    let k_deg = fkbp12_kdeg()

    let kon_rf  = k_on * rf_old
    let kon_ct  = k_on * ct_old_nm
    let bil_old = k_on * ct_old_nm * rf_old

    // M (3×3) Newton-linearized at (ct_old_nm, rf_old):
    let m00 = 0.0 - kon_rf
    let m01 = 0.0 - kon_ct
    let m02 = k_off
    let m10 = 0.0 - kon_rf
    let m11 = (0.0 - k_deg) - kon_ct
    let m12 = k_off
    let m20 = kon_rf
    let m21 = kon_ct
    let m22 = 0.0 - (k_off + k_int)

    let f0 = bil_old
    let f1 = k_syn + bil_old
    let f2 = 0.0 - bil_old

    // RHS = (I + h·M)·x_old + dt·f
    let rhs0 = (1.0 + h*m00) * ct_old_nm + (h*m01) * rf_old + (h*m02) * dr_old + dt * f0
    let rhs1 = (h*m10) * ct_old_nm + (1.0 + h*m11) * rf_old + (h*m12) * dr_old + dt * f1
    let rhs2 = (h*m20) * ct_old_nm + (h*m21) * rf_old + (1.0 + h*m22) * dr_old + dt * f2

    // A = I - h·M
    let a00 = 1.0 - h*m00
    let a01 = 0.0 - h*m01
    let a02 = 0.0 - h*m02
    let a10 = 0.0 - h*m10
    let a11 = 1.0 - h*m11
    let a12 = 0.0 - h*m12
    let a20 = 0.0 - h*m20
    let a21 = 0.0 - h*m21
    let a22 = 1.0 - h*m22

    // 3×3 invert via cofactor expansion
    let c00 = a11*a22 - a12*a21
    let c01 = a12*a20 - a10*a22
    let c02 = a10*a21 - a11*a20
    let det = a00*c00 + a01*c01 + a02*c02

    let c10 = a02*a21 - a01*a22
    let c11 = a00*a22 - a02*a20
    let c12 = a01*a20 - a00*a21
    let c20 = a01*a12 - a02*a11
    let c21 = a02*a10 - a00*a12
    let c22 = a00*a11 - a01*a10

    let ct_new_nm = (c00*rhs0 + c10*rhs1 + c20*rhs2) / det
    let rf_new    = (c01*rhs0 + c11*rhs1 + c21*rhs2) / det
    let dr_new    = (c02*rhs0 + c12*rhs1 + c22*rhs2) / det

    let ct_new_clamped = if ct_new_nm < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { ct_new_nm }
    r.ct[i] = ct_new_clamped * nm_to_mass
    r.rfree[i] = if rf_new < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { rf_new }
    r.dr[i] = if dr_new < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { dr_new }
    return r
}

// ─── PD step (G-γ): 1-state implicit CN on A, then on N at fixed A_new ────
fn pd_step_organ(state: Pbpk28, i: i64, dt: f64) -> Pbpk28 with Mut, Div {
    if !pd_is_organ(i) { return state }
    var r = state
    let h = 0.5 * dt
    let target_a = r.rfree[i] / fkbp12_rtotal0_at(i)
    let k_a = coronary_pd_ka()
    // CN on dA/dt = k_a · (target - A):  (1 + h·k_a)·A_new = (1 - h·k_a)·A_old + dt·k_a·target
    let a_new = ((1.0 - h * k_a) * r.a[i] + dt * k_a * target_a) / (1.0 + h * k_a)
    let a_clamped = if a_new < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { if a_new > 1.0 { 1.0 } else { a_new } }
    r.a[i] = a_clamped

    // CN on dN/dt = k_prolif · A - k_apo · (1-A) · N at fixed A_new:
    let one_minus_a = 1.0 - a_clamped
    let gamma_n = coronary_pd_kapo() * one_minus_a
    let n_new = ((1.0 - h * gamma_n) * r.n[i] + dt * coronary_pd_kprolif() * a_clamped) / (1.0 + h * gamma_n)
    r.n[i] = if n_new < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { n_new }
    return r
}

// One fully-coupled implicit PBPK step + per-TMDD-organ binding step
// + per-PD-organ (A, N) step. Lie split: PBPK → TMDD → PD.
fn strang_step(state: Pbpk28, dt: f64) -> Pbpk28 with Mut, Div {
    var s = full_cn_step(state, dt)
    s = tmdd_step_organ(s, 1, dt)
    s = tmdd_step_organ(s, 4, dt)
    s = tmdd_step_organ(s, 8, dt)
    s = pd_step_organ(s, 4, dt)
    return s
}

fn integrate_to(state: Pbpk28, t_start: f64, t_end: f64, dt: f64) -> Pbpk28 with Mut, Div {
    var C = state
    var t = t_start
    while t + dt * 0.5 < t_end {
        C = strang_step(C, dt)
        t = t + dt
    }
    return C
}

// Organ-average concentration C_avg = vasc_frac · Cv + (1 - vasc_frac) · Ct.
// (For blood at i=0, Cv[0] is the central concentration and Ct[0] is unused.)
fn c_avg_at(state: &Pbpk28, i: i64) -> f64 {
    if i == 0 { return state.cv[0] }
    let vf = vasc_frac_at(i)
    return vf * state.cv[i] + (1.0 - vf) * state.ct[i]
}

fn emit_at(state: &Pbpk28, t: f64) with IO, Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < 14 {
        // PARITY|t / PARITY|i / PARITY|cv / PARITY|ct / PARITY|cavg per organ;
        // PARITY|rfree / PARITY|dr additionally for TMDD organs (1=liver,
        // 4=heart, 8=gut). Gate joins on (t, i).
        print("PARITY|t=")
        println(t)
        println("")
        print("PARITY|i=")
        println(i)
        print("PARITY|cv=")
        println(state.cv[i])
        println("")
        print("PARITY|ct=")
        println(state.ct[i])
        println("")
        print("PARITY|cavg=")
        let avg = if i == 0 { state.cv[0] } else { vasc_frac_at(i) * state.cv[i] + (1.0 - vasc_frac_at(i)) * state.ct[i] }
        println(avg)
        println("")
        if fkbp12_is_tmdd_organ(i) {
            print("PARITY|rfree=")
            println(state.rfree[i])
            println("")
            print("PARITY|dr=")
            println(state.dr[i])
            println("")
        }
        if pd_is_organ(i) {
            print("PARITY|pd_a=")
            println(state.a[i])
            println("")
            print("PARITY|pd_n=")
            println(state.n[i])
            println("")
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    println("DISSERTATION_PBPK28_PARITY_REF v1")
    println("compartments=14")
    println("states=28")
    println("dt=0.001")
    println("bolus_mg=0.05")
    println("cl_hep_L_per_h=12.4")
    println("integrator=fully_coupled_CN_27state")
    println("drug=rapamycin")
    println("samples=12")

    var C = pbpk28_zero()
    C.cv[0] = 0.05 / vref_at(0)  // 0.01 mg/L initial blood concentration
    // TMDD organs: initialize R_free at baseline steady-state R_total_0,
    // DR at 0 (no drug bound at t=0).
    C.rfree[1] = fkbp12_rtotal0_at(1)
    C.rfree[4] = fkbp12_rtotal0_at(4)
    C.rfree[8] = fkbp12_rtotal0_at(8)
    // PD organs (heart only for G-γ-1): A = 1.0 (full mTORC1 activity at
    // baseline, no drug), N = 0 (no neointima at stent implant).
    C.a[4] = 1.0

    let dt = 0.001
    var t = 0.0

    C = integrate_to(C, t,  0.1, dt); t =  0.1; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t,  0.5, dt); t =  0.5; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t,  1.0, dt); t =  1.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t,  2.0, dt); t =  2.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t,  4.0, dt); t =  4.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t,  6.0, dt); t =  6.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t,  8.0, dt); t =  8.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 12.0, dt); t = 12.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 16.0, dt); t = 16.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 20.0, dt); t = 20.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 24.0, dt); t = 24.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 30.0, dt); t = 30.0; emit_at(&C, t)

    println("DISSERTATION_PBPK28_PARITY_DONE")
    return 0
}

// ─── TMDD layer — sourced from stdlib/darwin_pbpk/tmdd/glp1r.sio ───────────
// `use darwin_pbpk::tmdd::glp1r::*` (top of file) pulls in:
//   glp1r_mw_semaglutide_da, glp1r_{kdeg,kon,kd,kint,koff,ksyn_at,rtotal0_at,is_tmdd_organ}
// Brain=3, gut=8, pancreas=12. Knudsen 2019 / Lau 2015 (K_d = 0.4 nM).

// Newton-linearized 3×3 implicit step on (C_t_nM, R_free, DR) — identical
// algorithm to the rapamycin TMDD step; only parameters differ.
fn tmdd_step_organ(state: Pbpk28, i: i64, dt: f64) -> Pbpk28 with Mut, Div {
    if !glp1r_is_tmdd_organ(i) { return state }
    var r = state
    let h = 0.5 * dt
    let mass_to_nm = 1.0e6 / glp1r_mw_semaglutide_da()
    let nm_to_mass = glp1r_mw_semaglutide_da() * 1.0e-6
    let ct_old_mass = r.ct[i]
    let ct_old_nm = if ct_old_mass < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { ct_old_mass * mass_to_nm }
    let rf_old = r.rfree[i]
    let dr_old = r.dr[i]

    let k_on = glp1r_kon()
    let k_off = glp1r_koff()
    let k_int = glp1r_kint()
    let k_syn = glp1r_ksyn_at(i)
    let k_deg = glp1r_kdeg()

    let kon_rf  = k_on * rf_old
    let kon_ct  = k_on * ct_old_nm
    let bil_old = k_on * ct_old_nm * rf_old

    let m00 = 0.0 - kon_rf
    let m01 = 0.0 - kon_ct
    let m02 = k_off
    let m10 = 0.0 - kon_rf
    let m11 = (0.0 - k_deg) - kon_ct
    let m12 = k_off
    let m20 = kon_rf
    let m21 = kon_ct
    let m22 = 0.0 - (k_off + k_int)

    let f0 = bil_old
    let f1 = k_syn + bil_old
    let f2 = 0.0 - bil_old

    let rhs0 = (1.0 + h*m00) * ct_old_nm + (h*m01) * rf_old + (h*m02) * dr_old + dt * f0
    let rhs1 = (h*m10) * ct_old_nm + (1.0 + h*m11) * rf_old + (h*m12) * dr_old + dt * f1
    let rhs2 = (h*m20) * ct_old_nm + (h*m21) * rf_old + (1.0 + h*m22) * dr_old + dt * f2

    let a00 = 1.0 - h*m00
    let a01 = 0.0 - h*m01
    let a02 = 0.0 - h*m02
    let a10 = 0.0 - h*m10
    let a11 = 1.0 - h*m11
    let a12 = 0.0 - h*m12
    let a20 = 0.0 - h*m20
    let a21 = 0.0 - h*m21
    let a22 = 1.0 - h*m22

    let c00 = a11*a22 - a12*a21
    let c01 = a12*a20 - a10*a22
    let c02 = a10*a21 - a11*a20
    let det = a00*c00 + a01*c01 + a02*c02

    let c10 = a02*a21 - a01*a22
    let c11 = a00*a22 - a02*a20
    let c12 = a01*a20 - a00*a21
    let c20 = a01*a12 - a02*a11
    let c21 = a02*a10 - a00*a12
    let c22 = a00*a11 - a01*a10

    let ct_new_nm = (c00*rhs0 + c10*rhs1 + c20*rhs2) / det
    let rf_new    = (c01*rhs0 + c11*rhs1 + c21*rhs2) / det
    let dr_new    = (c02*rhs0 + c12*rhs1 + c22*rhs2) / det

    let ct_new_clamped = if ct_new_nm < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { ct_new_nm }
    r.ct[i] = ct_new_clamped * nm_to_mass
    r.rfree[i] = if rf_new < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { rf_new }
    r.dr[i] = if dr_new < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { dr_new }
    return r
}

// Taylor exp_neg for release rate (argument always non-positive: -k_a·t).
fn exp_neg(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    if x == 0.0 { return 1.0 }
    var s = x
    var k = 0
    while s < (0.0 - 0.5) {
        s = s * 0.5
        k = k + 1
    }
    let s2 = s * s
    let s3 = s2 * s
    let s4 = s2 * s2
    let s5 = s4 * s
    let s6 = s3 * s3
    let s7 = s6 * s
    let s8 = s4 * s4
    var r = 1.0 + s + s2 / 2.0 + s3 / 6.0 + s4 / 24.0 + s5 / 120.0
              + s6 / 720.0 + s7 / 5040.0 + s8 / 40320.0
    var j = 0
    while j < k {
        r = r * r
        j = j + 1
    }
    return r
}

// SC depot release rate at time t (mg/h):
//   rate(t) = F · Dose · k_a · exp(-k_a · t)
fn release_rate_at(t: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    let ka = sema_ka()
    let t_clamped = if t < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { t }
    return sema_f() * sema_dose_mg() * ka * exp_neg(0.0 - ka * t_clamped)
}

// Fully-coupled CN step at midpoint release rate `rel_mid` (mg/h).
fn full_cn_step(state: Pbpk28, dt: f64, rel_mid: f64) -> Pbpk28 with Mut, Div {
    let h = 0.5 * dt
    let vb = vref_at(0)

    var sum_q = 0.0
    var i = 1
    while i < 14 {
        sum_q = sum_q + q_at(i)
        i = i + 1
    }
    let big_s = h * (sum_q + cl_proteolytic()) / vb

    let cb_old = state.cv[0]
    var rhs0 = (1.0 - big_s) * cb_old + dt * rel_mid / vb

    var a_v: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var b_v: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var a_t: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var b_t: [f64; 14] = [0.0; 14]
    var sum_beta_a = 0.0
    var sum_beta_b = 0.0

    i = 1
    while i < 14 {
        let vi = vref_at(i)
        let vf = vasc_frac_at(i)
        let vv_raw = vi * vf
        let vt_raw = vi * (1.0 - vf)
        let vv = if vv_raw < 1.0e-30 { 1.0e-30 } else { vv_raw }
        let vt = if vt_raw < 1.0e-30 { 1.0e-30 } else { vt_raw }
        let kp = kp_at(i)
        let ps = ps_at(i)
        let qi = q_at(i)

        let beta = h * qi / vb
        let gamma = h * qi / vv
        let p = 1.0 + h * (qi + ps) / vv
        let q = h * ps / (vv * kp)
        let r = h * ps / vt
        let sb = 1.0 + h * ps / (vt * kp)
        let det = p * sb - q * r

        rhs0 = rhs0 + beta * state.cv[i]

        let rhs_v = gamma * cb_old + (1.0 - h * (qi + ps) / vv) * state.cv[i] + q * state.ct[i]
        let rhs_t = r * state.cv[i] + (1.0 - h * ps / (vt * kp)) * state.ct[i]

        let av = (sb * rhs_v + q * rhs_t) / det
        let bv = (sb * gamma) / det
        let at = (r * rhs_v + p * rhs_t) / det
        let bt = (r * gamma) / det

        a_v[i] = av
        b_v[i] = bv
        a_t[i] = at
        b_t[i] = bt

        sum_beta_a = sum_beta_a + beta * av
        sum_beta_b = sum_beta_b + beta * bv
        i = i + 1
    }

    let cb_new = (rhs0 + sum_beta_a) / ((1.0 + big_s) - sum_beta_b)
    var out = state
    out.cv[0] = if cb_new < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { cb_new }
    i = 1
    while i < 14 {
        let cv = a_v[i] + b_v[i] * cb_new
        let ct = a_t[i] + b_t[i] * cb_new
        out.cv[i] = if cv < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { cv }
        out.ct[i] = if ct < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { ct }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return out
}

// ─── Semaglutide PD: glucose-insulin Bergman model (G-δ-3) ───────────────
// Couples pancreas GLP-1R occupancy (i=12) to a 2-state linear system:
//   state.a[12]  =  ΔG  (mg/dL)  plasma glucose deviation from Gb=100
//   state.n[12]  =  ΔI  (mU/L)   plasma insulin deviation from Ib=10
// ─── PD layer — sourced from stdlib/darwin_pbpk/pd/bergman_glucose_insulin.sio
// `use darwin_pbpk::pd::bergman_glucose_insulin::*` (top of file) pulls in:
//   bergman_{gb,ib,sg,si,ki,kbase,alpha}
// Bergman minimal model + GLP-1R-modulated insulin secretion at pancreas (i=12).

fn pd_step_glucose_insulin(state: Pbpk28, dt: f64) -> Pbpk28 with Mut, Div {
    var r = state
    let h = 0.5 * dt
    let denom = r.rfree[12] + r.dr[12]
    let occ = if denom > 1.0e-9 { r.dr[12] / denom } else { 0.0 }

    // dΔI/dt = k_base · α · occ - kI · ΔI
    let di_new = ((1.0 - h * bergman_ki()) * r.n[12]
                  + dt * bergman_kbase() * bergman_alpha() * occ) / (1.0 + h * bergman_ki())
    r.n[12] = di_new

    // dΔG/dt = -(SG + SI·Ib)·ΔG - SI·Gb·ΔI_new   (linearized at G ≈ Gb)
    let lambda_g = bergman_sg() + bergman_si() * bergman_ib()
    let dg_new = ((1.0 - h * lambda_g) * r.a[12]
                  - dt * bergman_si() * bergman_gb() * r.n[12]) / (1.0 + h * lambda_g)
    r.a[12] = dg_new
    return r
}

fn strang_step(state: Pbpk28, t_start: f64, dt: f64) -> Pbpk28 with Mut, Div {
    let rel_mid = release_rate_at(t_start + 0.5 * dt)
    var s = full_cn_step(state, dt, rel_mid)
    s = tmdd_step_organ(s, 3, dt)
    s = tmdd_step_organ(s, 8, dt)
    s = tmdd_step_organ(s, 12, dt)
    s = pd_step_glucose_insulin(s, dt)
    return s
}

fn integrate_to(state: Pbpk28, t_start: f64, t_end: f64, dt: f64) -> Pbpk28 with Mut, Div {
    var C = state
    var t = t_start
    while t + dt * 0.5 < t_end {
        C = strang_step(C, t, dt)
        t = t + dt
    }
    return C
}

fn emit_at(state: &Pbpk28, t: f64) with IO, Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < 14 {
        print("PARITY|t=")
        println(t)
        println("")
        print("PARITY|i=")
        println(i)
        print("PARITY|cv=")
        println(state.cv[i])
        println("")
        print("PARITY|ct=")
        println(state.ct[i])
        println("")
        print("PARITY|cavg=")
        let avg = if i == 0 { state.cv[0] } else { vasc_frac_at(i) * state.cv[i] + (1.0 - vasc_frac_at(i)) * state.ct[i] }
        println(avg)
        println("")
        if glp1r_is_tmdd_organ(i) {
            print("PARITY|rfree=")
            println(state.rfree[i])
            println("")
            print("PARITY|dr=")
            println(state.dr[i])
            println("")
        }
        if i == 12 {
            // PD readout (glucose-insulin) at pancreas index.
            print("PARITY|pd_a=")    // ΔG (mg/dL)
            println(state.a[i])
            println("")
            print("PARITY|pd_n=")    // ΔI (mU/L)
            println(state.n[i])
            println("")
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    println("DISSERTATION_PBPK28_SEMAGLUTIDE_PARITY_REF v1")
    println("compartments=14")
    println("states=28")
    println("dt=0.001")
    println("dose_mg=1.0")
    println("cl_proteolytic_L_per_h=0.077")
    println("ka_h_inv=0.01155")
    println("F_bioavailability=0.89")
    println("integrator=fully_coupled_CN_27state")
    println("drug=semaglutide")
    println("release=sc_depot")
    println("samples=12")

    var C = pbpk28_zero()
    // No IV bolus — drug enters via SC depot release.
    // TMDD organs: initialize R_free at baseline R_total_0, DR at 0.
    C.rfree[3]  = glp1r_rtotal0_at(3)
    C.rfree[8]  = glp1r_rtotal0_at(8)
    C.rfree[12] = glp1r_rtotal0_at(12)

    let dt = 0.001
    var t = 0.0

    C = integrate_to(C, t,  0.1, dt); t =  0.1; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t,  0.5, dt); t =  0.5; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t,  1.0, dt); t =  1.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t,  2.0, dt); t =  2.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t,  4.0, dt); t =  4.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t,  6.0, dt); t =  6.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t,  8.0, dt); t =  8.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 12.0, dt); t = 12.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 16.0, dt); t = 16.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 20.0, dt); t = 20.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 24.0, dt); t = 24.0; emit_at(&C, t)
    C = integrate_to(C, t, 30.0, dt); t = 30.0; emit_at(&C, t)

    println("DISSERTATION_PBPK28_SEMAGLUTIDE_PARITY_DONE")
    return 0
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/dissertation_pbpk_qss_analytical_ref.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ timeout: 30
// ============================================================================
// DISSERTATION 1-STATE QSS ANALYTICAL REFERENCE — RAPAMYCIN
//
// Closed-form quasi-steady-state limit of PBPK28 at (V_v → 0, PS → ∞):
//   V_eff · dC_b/dt = -cl_hep · C_b + release
//   V_eff = V_b + Σ V_i · Kp_i
//   C_b(0+) = M_0 / V_eff (instantaneous redistribution)
//   C_b(t) = C_b(0+) · exp(-cl_hep · t / V_eff)
//   C_avg_i(t) = Kp_i · C_b(t)   [i ≥ 1];  C_avg_0(t) = C_b(t)
//
// Consumed by scripts/ci/dissertation_pbpk28_parity_gate.sh Case 2 — the gate
// compares the PBPK28 fully-coupled-CN degenerate trajectory against this
// analytical limit and reports the convergence residual as the Type B
// model-form uncertainty contribution per JCGM 100:2008 §4.3.
//
// CORRECTED MATH (commits c574ee81 + this commit):
//   PBPK28 at (V_v→0, PS→∞) does NOT reduce to PBPK14. It reduces to *this*
//   1-state QSS model. PBPK14 well-stirred is the *intermediate* model where
//   within-organ redistribution is instantaneous but Q-transport between
//   blood and tissue remains rate-limited. The hierarchy is
//     PBPK28-literature → PBPK14 → 1-state QSS
//   with monotonically decreasing model-form complexity. Discrepancies
//   between successive tiers are Type B uncertainty contributions.
//
// Parameters and 12 sample times match
// tests/run-pass/dissertation_pbpk28_parity_ref_rapamycin.sio.
// ============================================================================

fn vref_at(i: i64) -> f64 {
    if i ==  0 { return 5.0 }
    if i ==  1 { return 1.8 }
    if i ==  2 { return 0.31 }
    if i ==  3 { return 1.45 }
    if i ==  4 { return 0.33 }
    if i ==  5 { return 1.1 }
    if i ==  6 { return 28.0 }
    if i ==  7 { return 20.0 }
    if i ==  8 { return 1.2 }
    if i ==  9 { return 3.6 }
    if i == 10 { return 6.6 }
    if i == 11 { return 0.18 }
    if i == 12 { return 0.09 }
    return 3.7
}

fn kp_at(i: i64) -> f64 {
    if i ==  0 { return 1.00 }
    if i ==  1 { return 5.40 }
    if i ==  2 { return 4.20 }
    if i ==  3 { return 0.10 }
    if i ==  4 { return 2.30 }
    if i ==  5 { return 3.10 }
    if i ==  6 { return 0.50 }
    if i ==  7 { return 0.30 }
    if i ==  8 { return 2.60 }
    if i ==  9 { return 0.80 }
    if i == 10 { return 0.20 }
    if i == 11 { return 2.10 }
    if i == 12 { return 1.80 }
    return 0.40
}

fn cl_hep() -> f64 { return 12.4 }
fn bolus_mg() -> f64 { return 0.05 }

// Taylor-series exp for argument ≤ 0. Range-reduce |s| ≤ 0.5 by halving,
// evaluate to order 8, square back k times.
fn exp_neg(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    if x == 0.0 { return 1.0 }
    var s = x
    var k = 0
    while s < (0.0 - 0.5) {
        s = s * 0.5
        k = k + 1
    }
    let s2 = s * s
    let s3 = s2 * s
    let s4 = s2 * s2
    let s5 = s4 * s
    let s6 = s3 * s3
    let s7 = s6 * s
    let s8 = s4 * s4
    var r = 1.0 + s + s2 / 2.0 + s3 / 6.0 + s4 / 24.0 + s5 / 120.0
              + s6 / 720.0 + s7 / 5040.0 + s8 / 40320.0
    var j = 0
    while j < k {
        r = r * r
        j = j + 1
    }
    return r
}

fn v_eff() -> f64 with Mut {
    var s = vref_at(0)
    var i = 1
    while i < 14 {
        s = s + vref_at(i) * kp_at(i)
        i = i + 1
    }
    return s
}

fn c_blood_at(t: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    let ve = v_eff()
    let cb0 = bolus_mg() / ve
    let arg = 0.0 - cl_hep() * t / ve
    return cb0 * exp_neg(arg)
}

fn emit_at(t: f64) with IO, Mut, Div {
    let cb = c_blood_at(t)
    var i = 0
    while i < 14 {
        print("PARITY|t=")
        println(t)
        println("")
        print("PARITY|i=")
        println(i)
        let cv = cb
        let ct = if i == 0 { 0.0 } else { kp_at(i) * cb }
        let cavg = if i == 0 { cb } else { kp_at(i) * cb }
        print("PARITY|cv=")
        println(cv)
        println("")
        print("PARITY|ct=")
        println(ct)
        println("")
        print("PARITY|cavg=")
        println(cavg)
        println("")
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    println("DISSERTATION_PBPK_QSS_ANALYTICAL_REF v1")
    println("compartments=14")
    println("states=1")
    println("bolus_mg=0.05")
    println("cl_hep_L_per_h=12.4")
    println("integrator=closed_form_1state_QSS")
    println("drug=rapamycin")
    println("samples=12")
    print("v_eff_L=")
    println(v_eff())
    println("")

    emit_at(0.1)
    emit_at(0.5)
    emit_at(1.0)
    emit_at(2.0)
    emit_at(4.0)
    emit_at(6.0)
    emit_at(8.0)
    emit_at(12.0)
    emit_at(16.0)
    emit_at(20.0)
    emit_at(24.0)
    emit_at(30.0)

    println("DISSERTATION_PBPK_QSS_ANALYTICAL_DONE")
    return 0
}

// === FILE: tests/run-pass/door1_dense1024_epistemic.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// Door 1 validation: real 64-input × 32-output dense layer with epistemic uncertainty.
// Exercises: 65K-element weight matrix, GUM uncertainty propagation, forward + backward + update.
// Total arrays: weights[2048], biases[32], uncertainties[2048], input[64], output[32],
//   grad_w[2048], grad_b[32], delta[32] — well within Door 1's 1024-variable limit.

// ─── Math helpers ───

fn sqrt_d1(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 15 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

fn abs_d1(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn exp_d1(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 20.0 { return exp_d1(10.0) * exp_d1(x - 10.0) }
    if x < 0.0 - 20.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); sum = sum + term; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}

fn sigmoid_d1(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    1.0 / (1.0 + exp_d1(0.0 - x))
}

fn sigmoid_deriv_d1(y: f64) -> f64 {
    y * (1.0 - y)
}

// ─── Pseudo-random (LCG) ───

var RNG_STATE: i64 = 42

fn rng_next() -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    RNG_STATE = (RNG_STATE * 6364136223846793005 + 1442695040888963407)
    let bits = RNG_STATE
    var v = bits
    if v < 0 { v = 0 - v }
    let r = (v % 10000) as f64
    r / 10000.0
}

fn rng_normal_approx() -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Box-Muller-like: sum of 12 uniforms - 6 ≈ N(0,1)
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < 12 { sum = sum + rng_next(); i = i + 1 }
    sum - 6.0
}

// ─── Layer dimensions ───
// 64 inputs → 32 outputs via 64×32 = 2048 weights
// This is a real layer size, not a toy 4×4.

fn INPUT_DIM() -> i64 { 64 }
fn OUTPUT_DIM() -> i64 { 32 }
fn WEIGHT_COUNT() -> i64 { 2048 }  // 64 × 32

// ─── Forward pass with GUM uncertainty propagation ───

struct ForwardResult {
    output: [f64; 32],
    output_unc: [f64; 32],
}

fn forward(
    input: &[f64; 64],
    weights: &[f64; 2048],
    biases: &[f64; 32],
    uncertainties: &[f64; 2048]
) -> ForwardResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var output: [f64; 32] = [0.0; 32]
    var output_unc: [f64; 32] = [0.0; 32]

    var j = 0
    while j < 32 {
        var sum = biases[j as usize]
        var var_sum = 0.0  // accumulated variance (GUM)

        var i = 0
        while i < 64 {
            let w_idx = i * 32 + j
            let w = weights[w_idx as usize]
            let x = input[i as usize]
            let u = uncertainties[w_idx as usize]

            sum = sum + w * x
            // GUM law of propagation: var(w*x) = x²·σ_w² + w²·σ_x²
            // Assuming input uncertainty = 0 for now: var = x²·σ_w²
            var_sum = var_sum + x * x * u * u
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Apply sigmoid activation
        let activated = sigmoid_d1(sum)
        output[j as usize] = activated

        // Propagate uncertainty through sigmoid: σ_out = |sigmoid'(z)| · σ_z
        let deriv = sigmoid_deriv_d1(activated)
        output_unc[j as usize] = abs_d1(deriv) * sqrt_d1(var_sum)

        j = j + 1
    }

    ForwardResult { output: output, output_unc: output_unc }
}

// ─── Backward pass (gradient computation) ───

struct GradResult {
    grad_w: [f64; 2048],
    grad_b: [f64; 32],
    delta: [f64; 32],
}

fn backward(
    input: &[f64; 64],
    output: &[f64; 32],
    target: &[f64; 32],
    weights: &[f64; 2048]
) -> GradResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var grad_w: [f64; 2048] = [0.0; 2048]
    var grad_b: [f64; 32] = [0.0; 32]
    var delta: [f64; 32] = [0.0; 32]

    // Compute delta = (output - target) * sigmoid'(output)
    var j = 0
    while j < 32 {
        let err = output[j as usize] - target[j as usize]
        let d = err * sigmoid_deriv_d1(output[j as usize])
        delta[j as usize] = d
        grad_b[j as usize] = d
        j = j + 1
    }

    // Compute weight gradients: grad_w[i,j] = input[i] * delta[j]
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 {
        j = 0
        while j < 32 {
            let w_idx = i * 32 + j
            grad_w[w_idx as usize] = input[i as usize] * delta[j as usize]
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    GradResult { grad_w: grad_w, grad_b: grad_b, delta: delta }
}

// ─── Weight update with uncertainty tracking ───

struct UpdateResult {
    weights: [f64; 2048],
    biases: [f64; 32],
    uncertainties: [f64; 2048],
}

fn update_weights(
    weights: &[f64; 2048],
    biases: &[f64; 32],
    uncertainties: &[f64; 2048],
    grad_w: &[f64; 2048],
    grad_b: &[f64; 32],
    lr: f64
) -> UpdateResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var w_out: [f64; 2048] = [0.0; 2048]
    var u_out: [f64; 2048] = [0.0; 2048]
    var b_out: [f64; 32] = [0.0; 32]

    var i = 0
    while i < 2048 {
        let g = grad_w[i as usize]
        w_out[i as usize] = weights[i as usize] - lr * g
        let u = uncertainties[i as usize]
        var u_new = u * (1.0 - 0.01 * abs_d1(g))
        if u_new < 0.001 { u_new = 0.001 }
        u_out[i as usize] = u_new
        i = i + 1
    }

    var j = 0
    while j < 32 {
        b_out[j as usize] = biases[j as usize] - lr * grad_b[j as usize]
        j = j + 1
    }

    UpdateResult { weights: w_out, biases: b_out, uncertainties: u_out }
}

// ─── Loss computation (MSE) ───

fn mse_loss(output: &[f64; 32], target: &[f64; 32]) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum = 0.0
    var j = 0
    while j < 32 {
        let d = output[j as usize] - target[j as usize]
        sum = sum + d * d
        j = j + 1
    }
    sum / 32.0
}

// ─── Main: initialize, train, verify ───

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var passed = 0
    var failed = 0

    // === T1: Initialize 64×32 weight matrix with Xavier init ===
    var weights: [f64; 2048] = [0.0; 2048]
    var uncertainties: [f64; 2048] = [0.0; 2048]
    var biases: [f64; 32] = [0.0; 32]

    // Xavier: σ = sqrt(2 / (fan_in + fan_out)) = sqrt(2/96) ≈ 0.144
    var wi = 0
    while wi < 2048 {
        weights[wi as usize] = rng_normal_approx() * 0.144
        uncertainties[wi as usize] = 0.1  // initial uncertainty σ_w = 0.1
        wi = wi + 1
    }

    // Verify weights are initialized (not all zero)
    var nonzero = 0
    wi = 0
    while wi < 2048 {
        if abs_d1(weights[wi as usize]) > 0.001 { nonzero = nonzero + 1 }
        wi = wi + 1
    }
    if nonzero > 1900 { print("T1 PASS: Xavier init ("); print_int(nonzero); println(" nonzero weights)"); passed = passed + 1 }
    else { println("T1 FAIL: too many zero weights"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // === T2: Forward pass produces non-trivial output ===
    var input: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]

    // Set input to simple pattern
    var ii = 0
    while ii < 64 {
        input[ii as usize] = (ii as f64) / 64.0
        ii = ii + 1
    }

    var fwd = forward(&input, &weights, &biases, &uncertainties)

    // All outputs should be in (0, 1) due to sigmoid
    var all_valid = 1
    var j = 0
    while j < 32 {
        let v = fwd.output[j as usize]
        if v <= 0.0 || v >= 1.0 { all_valid = 0 }
        j = j + 1
    }
    if all_valid == 1 { println("T2 PASS: forward pass outputs in (0,1)"); passed = passed + 1 }
    else { println("T2 FAIL: output out of range"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // === T3: Uncertainty propagation produces non-zero values ===
    var unc_nonzero = 0
    j = 0
    while j < 32 {
        if fwd.output_unc[j as usize] > 0.0 { unc_nonzero = unc_nonzero + 1 }
        j = j + 1
    }
    if unc_nonzero == 32 { println("T3 PASS: GUM uncertainty propagated to all outputs"); passed = passed + 1 }
    else { print("T3 FAIL: only "); print_int(unc_nonzero); println("/32 outputs have uncertainty"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // === T4: Training reduces loss ===
    var target: [f64; 32] = [0.0; 32]
    j = 0
    while j < 32 {
        // Target: alternating 0.2 / 0.8
        if j % 2 == 0 { target[j as usize] = 0.2 }
        else { target[j as usize] = 0.8 }
        j = j + 1
    }

    let loss_before = mse_loss(&fwd.output, &target)

    // Train for 50 steps
    var step = 0
    while step < 50 {
        fwd = forward(&input, &weights, &biases, &uncertainties)
        let grads = backward(&input, &fwd.output, &target, &weights)
        let upd = update_weights(&weights, &biases, &uncertainties, &grads.grad_w, &grads.grad_b, 0.5)
        weights = upd.weights
        biases = upd.biases
        uncertainties = upd.uncertainties
        step = step + 1
    }

    fwd = forward(&input, &weights, &biases, &uncertainties)
    let loss_after = mse_loss(&fwd.output, &target)

    if loss_after < loss_before {
        print("T4 PASS: loss decreased (")
        print(loss_before)
        print(" -> ")
        print(loss_after)
        println(")")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else { println("T4 FAIL: loss did not decrease"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // === T5: Uncertainty decreased during training ===
    var unc_decreased = 0
    wi = 0
    while wi < 2048 {
        if uncertainties[wi as usize] < 0.1 { unc_decreased = unc_decreased + 1 }
        wi = wi + 1
    }
    if unc_decreased > 1500 {
        print("T5 PASS: uncertainty decreased for ")
        print_int(unc_decreased)
        println("/2048 weights")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else { println("T5 FAIL: uncertainty not decreasing"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // === T6: Array sizes are real (not toy) ===
    // 2048 weights + 2048 uncertainties + 64 input + 32×3 output/unc/target +
    // 2048 grad_w + 32 grad_b + 32 delta + 32 biases = 6,400 f64 values
    // = 51,200 bytes on stack/BSS. Door 1 makes this possible.
    let total_params = 2048 + 32  // weights + biases
    let total_epistemic = 2048    // uncertainty per weight
    if total_params == 2080 && total_epistemic == 2048 {
        print("T6 PASS: real layer size — ")
        print_int(total_params)
        print(" params, ")
        print_int(total_epistemic)
        println(" epistemic values")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else { println("T6 FAIL"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // === Summary ===
    println("")
    print("Passed: ")
    print_int(passed)
    println("")
    print("Failed: ")
    print_int(failed)
    println("")
    if failed == 0 { println("ALL PASS") }
    else { println("SOME TESTS FAILED") }

    failed
}
