// ============================================================================
// MAIN
// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    println("==============================================================")
    println("  Epistemic ODE Solver Validation Suite")
    println("==============================================================")
    var n_pass = 0

    // ---- Part A: Deterministic 14-comp PBPK (no GUM) ----
    println("")
    println("  Part A: Deterministic 14-comp PBPK (dt=0.002h, 12000 steps, 24h)")

    let sys14 = ODESystem { system_id: 2, n_dims: 14 }
    var params = pbpk_14_default_params()
    var state14 = estate_new(14)
    estate_set(&!state14, 13, 2.0, 0.0)  // 2 mg oral, no variance

    var t = 0.0
    let dt14 = 0.002
    var step = 0
    while t < 24.0 && step < 12001 {
        let h = ode_min(dt14, 24.0 - t)
        if h <= 1.0e-15 { t = 24.0 }
        else {
            rk4_step_det(&sys14, t, &!state14, &params, h)
            t = t + h
            step = step + 1
        }
    }

    // T1: Completed
    let t1 = step > 100
    if t1 { println("  PASS T1: 14-comp RK4 completed") } else { println("  FAIL T1") }
    if t1 { n_pass = n_pass + 1 }

    // T2: Plasma concentration is reasonable (not blown up)
    let c_plasma = state14.values[0]
    println("  C_plasma at 24h: "); println(c_plasma)
    let t2 = c_plasma >= 0.0 && c_plasma < 10.0
    if t2 { println("  PASS T2: Plasma concentration reasonable") } else { println("  FAIL T2: C_plasma out of range") }
    if t2 { n_pass = n_pass + 1 }

    // T3: All tissues non-negative
    var all_nn = true
    var d = 0
    while d < 14 {
        if state14.values[d] < -1.0e-6 { all_nn = false }
        d = d + 1
    }
    if all_nn { println("  PASS T3: All tissues non-negative") } else { println("  FAIL T3") }
    if all_nn { n_pass = n_pass + 1 }

    // T4: Gut lumen absorbed
    let lumen = ode_abs(state14.values[13])
    println("  Gut lumen remaining: "); println(lumen)
    let t4 = lumen < 0.001
    if t4 { println("  PASS T4: Oral absorption complete") } else { println("  FAIL T4") }
    if t4 { n_pass = n_pass + 1 }

    // T5: Fat compartment has drug (lipophilic, high Kp_fat=12)
    let c_fat = state14.values[9]
    println("  C_fat at 24h: "); println(c_fat)
    let t5 = c_fat > 0.0
    if t5 { println("  PASS T5: Fat tissue has rapamycin (lipophilic)") } else { println("  FAIL T5") }
    if t5 { n_pass = n_pass + 1 }

    // ---- Part B: GUM on Exponential Decay (1-comp) ----
    println("")
    println("  Part B: GUM Variance on Exponential Decay (1-comp)")

    let sys1 = ODESystem { system_id: 1, n_dims: 1 }
    var p1 = ode_params_new()
    ode_params_set(&!p1, 0, 0.5, 0.01)  // k=0.5 h⁻¹, var(k)=0.01
    var s1 = estate_new(1)
    estate_set(&!s1, 0, 100.0, 4.0)  // y0=100, var(y0)=4

    t = 0.0
    let dt1 = 0.1
    step = 0
    while t < 5.0 && step < 100 {
        rk4_step_gum_1d(&sys1, t, &!s1, &p1, dt1)
        t = t + dt1
        step = step + 1
    }

    // Analytical: y(5) = 100 * exp(-0.5*5) = 100 * exp(-2.5) ≈ 8.208
    let y_final = s1.values[0]
    let v_final = s1.variances[0]
    println("  y(5h): "); println(y_final)
    println("  Var(y) at 5h: "); println(v_final)

    // T6: Value close to analytical (within 5%)
    let y_exact = 8.208  // exp(-2.5)*100
    let rel_err = ode_abs(y_final - y_exact) / y_exact
    println("  Relative error vs analytical: "); println(rel_err)
    let t6 = rel_err < 0.05
    if t6 { println("  PASS T6: RK4 matches analytical exp decay") } else { println("  FAIL T6") }
    if t6 { n_pass = n_pass + 1 }

    // T7: Variance is positive (value decays, so absolute variance may decrease,
    //     but it should remain > 0 from parameter uncertainty contribution)
    let t7 = v_final > 0.0
    if t7 { println("  PASS T7: GUM variance propagated through ODE") } else { println("  FAIL T7: Variance did not propagate") }
    if t7 { n_pass = n_pass + 1 }

    // T8: Variance is reasonable (not blown up to infinity)
    let t8 = v_final < 1.0e10
    if t8 { println("  PASS T8: Variance bounded (no blow-up)") } else { println("  FAIL T8") }
    if t8 { n_pass = n_pass + 1 }

    println("")
    println("==============================================================")
    println("  RESULT: "); println(n_pass); println(" / 8 PASS")
    println("==============================================================")
    if n_pass == 8 { 0 } else { 1 }
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/epistemic_pbpk_multidrug.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// ============================================================================
// SOUNIO MULTI-DRUG EPISTEMIC PBPK — Native ELF Demo
// ============================================================================
// 3 drugs × GUM uncertainty × ASCII concentration curves × 10 validations
// Compiles to native ELF via lean driver — NO runtime, NO libc, NO JIT.
//
// Drugs:
//   R = Rapamycin (Sirolimus) — 5mg IV, 3-compartment, CYP3A4/P-gp
//   C = Caffeine — 200mg oral, 1-compartment, CYP1A2
//   M = Metformin — 500mg oral, 1-compartment, renal clearance
//
// JCGM 100:2008 (GUM) via finite differences
// SOTA: Ferron 1997, Lampen 1998, Schreiber 1991, Lelo 1986, Graham 2011
// ============================================================================

// ---- Global concentration arrays (48 timepoints each) ----
var conc_r: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var conc_c: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var conc_m: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var conc_r_hi: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var conc_c_hi: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var conc_m_hi: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var conc_r_lo: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var conc_c_lo: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var conc_m_lo: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]

// ============================================================================
// LAYER 0: MATH HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn ep_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn ep_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 {
        y = (y + x / y) * 0.5
        i = i + 1
    }
    return y
}

fn ep_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { return a }
    return b
}

fn ep_min(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a < b { return a }
    return b
}

fn ep_ln2() -> f64 { return 0.693147180559945 }

// ============================================================================
// LAYER 1: PRINT HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn print_f64_3(v: f64) -> i64 with IO {
    if v < 0.0 {
        print("-")
        let nv = 0.0 - v
        let ip = nv as i64
        let frac = ((nv - (ip as f64)) * 1000.0) as i64
        print_int(ip)
        print(".")
        if frac < 100 { print("0") }
        if frac < 10 { print("0") }
        print_int(frac)
        return 0
    }
    let ip = v as i64
    let frac = ((v - (ip as f64)) * 1000.0) as i64
    print_int(ip)
    print(".")
    if frac < 100 { print("0") }
    if frac < 10 { print("0") }
    print_int(frac)
    return 0
}

fn print_f64_1(v: f64) -> i64 with IO {
    if v < 0.0 {
        print("-")
        let nv = 0.0 - v
        let ip = nv as i64
        let frac = ((nv - (ip as f64)) * 10.0) as i64
        print_int(ip)
        print(".")
        print_int(frac)
        return 0
    }
    let ip = v as i64
    let frac = ((v - (ip as f64)) * 10.0) as i64
    print_int(ip)
    print(".")
    print_int(frac)
    return 0
}

fn print_spaces(n: i64) -> i64 with IO, Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        print(" ")
        i = i + 1
    }
    return 0
}

// ============================================================================
// LAYER 2: RAPAMYCIN 3-COMPARTMENT MODEL
// ============================================================================

struct Rp3St {
    blood: f64,
    brain: f64,
    periph: f64,
}

struct Rp3Prm {
    v_blood: f64,
    v_brain: f64,
    v_periph: f64,
    q_brain: f64,
    q_periph: f64,
    kp_brain: f64,
    kp_periph: f64,
    cl_hepatic: f64,
    fu_plasma: f64,
}

fn rp3_zero() -> Rp3St {
    return Rp3St { blood: 0.0, brain: 0.0, periph: 0.0 }
}

fn rp3_add(a: Rp3St, b: Rp3St) -> Rp3St {
    return Rp3St { blood: a.blood + b.blood, brain: a.brain + b.brain, periph: a.periph + b.periph }
}

fn rp3_scale(s: Rp3St, f: f64) -> Rp3St {
    return Rp3St { blood: s.blood * f, brain: s.brain * f, periph: s.periph * f }
}

fn rp3_ode(st: Rp3St, p: Rp3Prm) -> Rp3St {
    let cl_eff = p.cl_hepatic * p.fu_plasma
    let inflow_br = p.q_brain / p.v_blood * st.brain / p.kp_brain
    let inflow_pr = p.q_periph / p.v_blood * st.periph / p.kp_periph
    let outflow = (p.q_brain + p.q_periph) / p.v_blood * st.blood
    let clear = cl_eff / p.v_blood * st.blood
    let d_blood = inflow_br + inflow_pr - outflow - clear
    let d_brain = (p.q_brain / p.v_brain) * (st.blood - st.brain / p.kp_brain)
    let d_periph = (p.q_periph / p.v_periph) * (st.blood - st.periph / p.kp_periph)
    return Rp3St { blood: d_blood, brain: d_brain, periph: d_periph }
}

fn rk4_rp3(st: Rp3St, p: Rp3Prm, dt: f64) -> Rp3St {
    let k1 = rp3_ode(st, p)
    let s2 = rp3_add(st, rp3_scale(k1, dt * 0.5))
    let k2 = rp3_ode(s2, p)
    let s3 = rp3_add(st, rp3_scale(k2, dt * 0.5))
    let k3 = rp3_ode(s3, p)
    let s4 = rp3_add(st, rp3_scale(k3, dt))
    let k4 = rp3_ode(s4, p)
    let w = rp3_add(k1, rp3_add(rp3_scale(k2, 2.0), rp3_add(rp3_scale(k3, 2.0), k4)))
    return rp3_add(st, rp3_scale(w, dt / 6.0))
}

fn rp3_mean_params() -> Rp3Prm {
    return Rp3Prm {
        v_blood: 5.0, v_brain: 1.4, v_periph: 50.0,
        q_brain: 0.05, q_periph: 87.0,
        kp_brain: 0.08, kp_periph: 0.5,
        cl_hepatic: 12.4, fu_plasma: 0.08,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// LAYER 3: CAFFEINE 1-COMPARTMENT MODEL
// ============================================================================

struct Oc1St {
    gut: f64,
    plasma: f64,
}

struct CafPrm {
    ka: f64,
    cl: f64,
    v: f64,
    f_oral: f64,
}

fn oc1_ode_caf(st: Oc1St, p: CafPrm) -> Oc1St {
    let ke = p.cl / p.v
    let d_gut = (0.0 - p.ka) * st.gut
    let d_plasma = p.ka * st.gut / p.v - ke * st.plasma
    return Oc1St { gut: d_gut, plasma: d_plasma }
}

fn rk4_caf(st: Oc1St, p: CafPrm, dt: f64) -> Oc1St {
    let k1 = oc1_ode_caf(st, p)
    let s2 = Oc1St { gut: st.gut + k1.gut * dt * 0.5, plasma: st.plasma + k1.plasma * dt * 0.5 }
    let k2 = oc1_ode_caf(s2, p)
    let s3 = Oc1St { gut: st.gut + k2.gut * dt * 0.5, plasma: st.plasma + k2.plasma * dt * 0.5 }
    let k3 = oc1_ode_caf(s3, p)
    let s4 = Oc1St { gut: st.gut + k3.gut * dt, plasma: st.plasma + k3.plasma * dt }
    let k4 = oc1_ode_caf(s4, p)
    let dg = (k1.gut + 2.0 * k2.gut + 2.0 * k3.gut + k4.gut) / 6.0
    let dp = (k1.plasma + 2.0 * k2.plasma + 2.0 * k3.plasma + k4.plasma) / 6.0
    return Oc1St { gut: st.gut + dg * dt, plasma: st.plasma + dp * dt }
}

fn caf_mean_params() -> CafPrm {
    return CafPrm { ka: 4.4, cl: 5.46, v: 42.0, f_oral: 0.99 }
}

// ============================================================================
// LAYER 4: METFORMIN 1-COMPARTMENT MODEL
// ============================================================================

struct MetPrm {
    ka: f64,
    cl: f64,
    v: f64,
    f_oral: f64,
}

fn oc1_ode_met(st: Oc1St, p: MetPrm) -> Oc1St {
    let ke = p.cl / p.v
    let d_gut = (0.0 - p.ka) * st.gut
    let d_plasma = p.ka * st.gut / p.v - ke * st.plasma
    return Oc1St { gut: d_gut, plasma: d_plasma }
}

fn rk4_met(st: Oc1St, p: MetPrm, dt: f64) -> Oc1St {
    let k1 = oc1_ode_met(st, p)
    let s2 = Oc1St { gut: st.gut + k1.gut * dt * 0.5, plasma: st.plasma + k1.plasma * dt * 0.5 }
    let k2 = oc1_ode_met(s2, p)
    let s3 = Oc1St { gut: st.gut + k2.gut * dt * 0.5, plasma: st.plasma + k2.plasma * dt * 0.5 }
    let k3 = oc1_ode_met(s3, p)
    let s4 = Oc1St { gut: st.gut + k3.gut * dt, plasma: st.plasma + k3.plasma * dt }
    let k4 = oc1_ode_met(s4, p)
    let dg = (k1.gut + 2.0 * k2.gut + 2.0 * k3.gut + k4.gut) / 6.0
    let dp = (k1.plasma + 2.0 * k2.plasma + 2.0 * k3.plasma + k4.plasma) / 6.0
    return Oc1St { gut: st.gut + dg * dt, plasma: st.plasma + dp * dt }
}

fn met_mean_params() -> MetPrm {
    return MetPrm { ka: 0.9, cl: 21.0, v: 400.0, f_oral: 0.5 }
}

// ============================================================================
// LAYER 5: SIMULATION COLLECTORS (store hourly into global arrays)
// ============================================================================

struct DrugResult {
    cmax: f64,
    auc: f64,
    bpr: f64,
    thalf: f64,
}

fn sim_rp3(prm: Rp3Prm, dose: f64) -> DrugResult with Mut {
    let c0 = dose / prm.v_blood
    var st = Rp3St { blood: c0, brain: 0.0, periph: 0.0 }
    var t = 0.0
    let dt = 0.1
    var cmax = c0
    var auc = 0.0
    var c_prev = c0
    var hour = 0

    conc_r[0 as usize] = c0

    while t < 48.0 {
        var dt_use = dt
        if t + dt > 48.0 { dt_use = 48.0 - t }
        st = rk4_rp3(st, prm, dt_use)
        if st.blood > cmax { cmax = st.blood }
        auc = auc + (c_prev + st.blood) * 0.5 * dt_use
        c_prev = st.blood
        t = t + dt_use
        // Store hourly snapshots
        let next_hour = (t as i64)
        if next_hour > hour {
            hour = next_hour
            if hour < 48 {
                conc_r[hour as usize] = st.blood
            }
        }
    }

    var bpr = 0.0
    if st.blood > 0.000000000001 { bpr = st.brain / st.blood }

    // Estimate t1/2 from concentration decay
    var thalf = 0.0
    let half_c = cmax * 0.5
    var hi = 1
    while hi < 48 {
        if conc_r[hi as usize] < half_c {
            thalf = hi as f64
            hi = 48
        }
        hi = hi + 1
    }

    return DrugResult { cmax: cmax, auc: auc, bpr: bpr, thalf: thalf }
}

fn sim_caf(prm: CafPrm, dose: f64) -> DrugResult with Mut {
    var st = Oc1St { gut: prm.f_oral * dose, plasma: 0.0 }
    var t = 0.0
    let dt = 0.05
    var cmax = 0.0
    var auc = 0.0
    var c_prev = 0.0
    var hour = 0

    conc_c[0 as usize] = 0.0

    while t < 48.0 {
        var dt_use = dt
        if t + dt > 48.0 { dt_use = 48.0 - t }
        st = rk4_caf(st, prm, dt_use)
        if st.plasma > cmax { cmax = st.plasma }
        auc = auc + (c_prev + st.plasma) * 0.5 * dt_use
        c_prev = st.plasma
        t = t + dt_use
        let next_hour = (t as i64)
        if next_hour > hour {
            hour = next_hour
            if hour < 48 {
                conc_c[hour as usize] = st.plasma
            }
        }
    }

    // Estimate t1/2 from concentration decay curve
    var thalf_val = 0.0
    let half_c_caf = cmax * 0.5
    var hi_caf = 1
    while hi_caf < 48 {
        if conc_c[hi_caf as usize] < half_c_caf {
            thalf_val = hi_caf as f64
            hi_caf = 48
        }
        hi_caf = hi_caf + 1
    }

    return DrugResult { cmax: cmax, auc: auc, bpr: 0.0, thalf: thalf_val }
}

fn sim_met(prm: MetPrm, dose: f64) -> DrugResult with Mut {
    var st = Oc1St { gut: prm.f_oral * dose, plasma: 0.0 }
    var t = 0.0
    let dt = 0.05
    var cmax = 0.0
    var auc = 0.0
    var c_prev = 0.0
    var hour = 0

    conc_m[0 as usize] = 0.0

    while t < 48.0 {
        var dt_use = dt
        if t + dt > 48.0 { dt_use = 48.0 - t }
        st = rk4_met(st, prm, dt_use)
        if st.plasma > cmax { cmax = st.plasma }
        auc = auc + (c_prev + st.plasma) * 0.5 * dt_use
        c_prev = st.plasma
        t = t + dt_use
        let next_hour = (t as i64)
        if next_hour > hour {
            hour = next_hour
            if hour < 48 {
                conc_m[hour as usize] = st.plasma
            }
        }
    }

    // Estimate t1/2 from concentration decay curve
    var thalf_met = 0.0
    let half_c_met = cmax * 0.5
    var hi_met = 1
    while hi_met < 48 {
        if conc_m[hi_met as usize] < half_c_met {
            thalf_met = hi_met as f64
            hi_met = 48
        }
        hi_met = hi_met + 1
    }

    return DrugResult { cmax: cmax, auc: auc, bpr: 0.0, thalf: thalf_met }
}

// ============================================================================
// LAYER 6: GUM EPISTEMIC PROPAGATION
// ============================================================================

fn fdiff_h(mean: f64, variance: f64) -> f64 with Mut {
    let h_rel = 0.000001 * ep_abs(mean)
    let h_abs = 0.01 * ep_sqrt(variance)
    return ep_max(h_rel, h_abs)
}

struct EpDrug {
    cmax: f64,
    auc: f64,
    auc_var: f64,
    cv_auc: f64,
    bpr: f64,
    thalf: f64,
    conf: f64,
    s_p1: f64,
    s_p2: f64,
    s_p3: f64,
}

fn ep_rapamycin() -> EpDrug with Mut {
    let prm = rp3_mean_params()
    let ref_m = sim_rp3(prm, 5.0)

    // CL perturbation
    let h_cl = fdiff_h(12.4, 54.76)
    var prm_cl = rp3_mean_params()
    prm_cl.cl_hepatic = 12.4 + h_cl
    let m_cl = sim_rp3(prm_cl, 5.0)
    let da_cl = (m_cl.auc - ref_m.auc) / h_cl

    // kp_brain perturbation
    let h_kp = fdiff_h(0.08, 0.000625)
    var prm_kp = rp3_mean_params()
    prm_kp.kp_brain = 0.08 + h_kp
    let m_kp = sim_rp3(prm_kp, 5.0)
    let da_kp = (m_kp.auc - ref_m.auc) / h_kp

    // fu perturbation
    let h_fu = fdiff_h(0.08, 0.0004)
    var prm_fu = rp3_mean_params()
    prm_fu.fu_plasma = 0.08 + h_fu
    let m_fu = sim_rp3(prm_fu, 5.0)
    let da_fu = (m_fu.auc - ref_m.auc) / h_fu

    let var_auc = da_cl * da_cl * 54.76 + da_kp * da_kp * 0.000625 + da_fu * da_fu * 0.0004
    let sd_auc = ep_sqrt(var_auc)
    var cv = 0.0
    if ref_m.auc > 0.0 { cv = sd_auc / ref_m.auc }

    var s1 = 0.0
    var s2 = 0.0
    var s3 = 0.0
    if var_auc > 0.0 {
        s1 = da_cl * da_cl * 54.76 / var_auc
        s2 = da_kp * da_kp * 0.000625 / var_auc
        s3 = da_fu * da_fu * 0.0004 / var_auc
    }
    let conf = 0.65 * s1 + 0.55 * s2 + 0.72 * s3

    // Fill confidence bands using CV scaling
    var bi = 0
    while bi < 48 {
        let cv_scale = cv * conc_r[bi as usize]
        conc_r_hi[bi as usize] = conc_r[bi as usize] + cv_scale
        conc_r_lo[bi as usize] = conc_r[bi as usize] - cv_scale
        if conc_r_lo[bi as usize] < 0.0 { conc_r_lo[bi as usize] = 0.0 }
        bi = bi + 1
    }

    return EpDrug { cmax: ref_m.cmax, auc: ref_m.auc, auc_var: var_auc, cv_auc: cv,
                    bpr: ref_m.bpr, thalf: ref_m.thalf, conf: conf,
                    s_p1: s1, s_p2: s2, s_p3: s3 }
}

fn ep_caffeine() -> EpDrug with Mut {
    let prm = caf_mean_params()
    let ref_m = sim_caf(prm, 200.0)

    let h_ka = fdiff_h(4.4, 0.7744)
    var prm_ka = caf_mean_params()
    prm_ka.ka = 4.4 + h_ka
    let m_ka = sim_caf(prm_ka, 200.0)
    let da_ka = (m_ka.auc - ref_m.auc) / h_ka

    let h_cl = fdiff_h(5.46, 3.651)
    var prm_cl = caf_mean_params()
    prm_cl.cl = 5.46 + h_cl
    let m_cl = sim_caf(prm_cl, 200.0)
    let da_cl = (m_cl.auc - ref_m.auc) / h_cl

    let h_v = fdiff_h(42.0, 39.69)
    var prm_v = caf_mean_params()
    prm_v.v = 42.0 + h_v
    let m_v = sim_caf(prm_v, 200.0)
    let da_v = (m_v.auc - ref_m.auc) / h_v

    let var_auc = da_ka * da_ka * 0.7744 + da_cl * da_cl * 3.651 + da_v * da_v * 39.69
    let sd = ep_sqrt(var_auc)
    var cv = 0.0
    if ref_m.auc > 0.0 { cv = sd / ref_m.auc }

    var s1 = 0.0
    var s2 = 0.0
    var s3 = 0.0
    if var_auc > 0.0 {
        s1 = da_ka * da_ka * 0.7744 / var_auc
        s2 = da_cl * da_cl * 3.651 / var_auc
        s3 = da_v * da_v * 39.69 / var_auc
    }
    let conf = 0.70 * s1 + 0.75 * s2 + 0.68 * s3

    var bi = 0
    while bi < 48 {
        let cv_s = cv * conc_c[bi as usize]
        conc_c_hi[bi as usize] = conc_c[bi as usize] + cv_s
        conc_c_lo[bi as usize] = conc_c[bi as usize] - cv_s
        if conc_c_lo[bi as usize] < 0.0 { conc_c_lo[bi as usize] = 0.0 }
        bi = bi + 1
    }

    return EpDrug { cmax: ref_m.cmax, auc: ref_m.auc, auc_var: var_auc, cv_auc: cv,
                    bpr: 0.0, thalf: ref_m.thalf, conf: conf,
                    s_p1: s1, s_p2: s2, s_p3: s3 }
}

fn ep_metformin() -> EpDrug with Mut {
    let prm = met_mean_params()
    let ref_m = sim_met(prm, 500.0)

    let h_ka = fdiff_h(0.9, 0.050625)
    var prm_ka = met_mean_params()
    prm_ka.ka = 0.9 + h_ka
    let m_ka = sim_met(prm_ka, 500.0)
    let da_ka = (m_ka.auc - ref_m.auc) / h_ka

    let h_cl = fdiff_h(21.0, 39.69)
    var prm_cl = met_mean_params()
    prm_cl.cl = 21.0 + h_cl
    let m_cl = sim_met(prm_cl, 500.0)
    let da_cl = (m_cl.auc - ref_m.auc) / h_cl

    let h_v = fdiff_h(400.0, 6400.0)
    var prm_v = met_mean_params()
    prm_v.v = 400.0 + h_v
    let m_v = sim_met(prm_v, 500.0)
    let da_v = (m_v.auc - ref_m.auc) / h_v

    let var_auc = da_ka * da_ka * 0.050625 + da_cl * da_cl * 39.69 + da_v * da_v * 6400.0
    let sd = ep_sqrt(var_auc)
    var cv = 0.0
    if ref_m.auc > 0.0 { cv = sd / ref_m.auc }

    var s1 = 0.0
    var s2 = 0.0
    var s3 = 0.0
    if var_auc > 0.0 {
        s1 = da_ka * da_ka * 0.050625 / var_auc
        s2 = da_cl * da_cl * 39.69 / var_auc
        s3 = da_v * da_v * 6400.0 / var_auc
    }
    let conf = 0.60 * s1 + 0.70 * s2 + 0.65 * s3

    var bi = 0
    while bi < 48 {
        let cv_s = cv * conc_m[bi as usize]
        conc_m_hi[bi as usize] = conc_m[bi as usize] + cv_s
        conc_m_lo[bi as usize] = conc_m[bi as usize] - cv_s
        if conc_m_lo[bi as usize] < 0.0 { conc_m_lo[bi as usize] = 0.0 }
        bi = bi + 1
    }

    return EpDrug { cmax: ref_m.cmax, auc: ref_m.auc, auc_var: var_auc, cv_auc: cv,
                    bpr: 0.0, thalf: ref_m.thalf, conf: conf,
                    s_p1: s1, s_p2: s2, s_p3: s3 }
}

// ============================================================================
// LAYER 7: ASCII PLOT
// ============================================================================

fn plot_find_max() -> f64 with Mut {
    var mx = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < 48 {
        if conc_r_hi[i as usize] > mx { mx = conc_r_hi[i as usize] }
        if conc_c_hi[i as usize] > mx { mx = conc_c_hi[i as usize] }
        if conc_m_hi[i as usize] > mx { mx = conc_m_hi[i as usize] }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return mx
}

fn plot_render(y_max: f64) -> i64 with IO, Mut {
    let rows = 20
    var row = rows
    while row >= 0 {
        // Y-axis label
        let y_val = y_max * (row as f64) / 20.0
        if y_val < 10.0 { print(" ") }
        print_f64_1(y_val)
        print("|")

        var col = 0
        while col < 48 {
            let threshold = y_max * (row as f64) / 20.0
            let rv = conc_r[col as usize]
            let cv = conc_c[col as usize]
            let mv = conc_m[col as usize]
            let rh = conc_r_hi[col as usize]
            let ch = conc_c_hi[col as usize]
            let mh = conc_m_hi[col as usize]

            var printed = 0
            // Mean curves (uppercase)
            if cv >= threshold { if printed == 0 { print("C"); printed = 1 } }
            if rv >= threshold { if printed == 0 { print("R"); printed = 1 } }
            if mv >= threshold { if printed == 0 { print("M"); printed = 1 } }
            // Confidence bands (lowercase)
            if printed == 0 {
                if ch >= threshold { if conc_c_lo[col as usize] < threshold { print("c"); printed = 1 } }
            }
            if printed == 0 {
                if rh >= threshold { if conc_r_lo[col as usize] < threshold { print("r"); printed = 1 } }
            }
            if printed == 0 {
                if mh >= threshold { if conc_m_lo[col as usize] < threshold { print("m"); printed = 1 } }
            }
            if printed == 0 { print(" ") }
            col = col + 1
        }
        print("\n")
        row = row - 1
    }
    // X-axis
    print("     +")
    var xi = 0
    while xi < 48 { print("-"); xi = xi + 1 }
    print("\n")
    print("      0    6   12   18   24   30   36   42  48h\n")
    print("      R=Rapamycin  C=Caffeine  M=Metformin  (lower=+/-1s)\n")
    return 0
}

// ============================================================================
// LAYER 8: COMPARISON TABLE
// ============================================================================

fn print_drug_summary(name_tag: i64, d: EpDrug) -> i64 with IO, Mut {
    if name_tag == 0 {
        print("  Rapamycin  5mg IV   ")
    }
    if name_tag == 1 {
        print("  Caffeine   200mg PO ")
    }
    if name_tag == 2 {
        print("  Metformin  500mg PO ")
    }
    print_f64_3(d.cmax)
    print("     ")
    print_f64_3(d.auc)
    print("+/-")
    print_f64_3(ep_sqrt(d.auc_var))
    print("  ")
    print_f64_1(d.thalf)
    print("h  ")
    print_f64_3(d.cv_auc * 100.0)
    print("%  ")
    print_f64_3(d.conf)
    print("\n")
    return 0
}

// ============================================================================
// LAYER 9: VALIDATION
// ============================================================================

fn run_tests(r: EpDrug, c: EpDrug, m: EpDrug) -> i64 with IO, Mut {
    var passed = 0
    var failed = 0

    // T1: Rapamycin brain/plasma < 0.15
    if r.bpr > 0.0 { if r.bpr < 0.15 {
        print("  PASS T1: brain/plasma < 0.15 (P-gp)\n"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { print("  FAIL T1\n"); failed = failed + 1 }
    } else { print("  FAIL T1: bpr=0\n"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // T2: Rapamycin CV(AUC) > 30%
    if r.cv_auc > 0.30 {
        print("  PASS T2: rapa CV(AUC) > 30%\n"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { print("  FAIL T2\n"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // T3: Caffeine Cmax reasonable (3-6 mg/L for 200mg oral)
    if c.cmax > 2.0 { if c.cmax < 8.0 {
        print("  PASS T3: caffeine Cmax in [2,8] mg/L\n"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { print("  FAIL T3: Cmax too high\n"); failed = failed + 1 }
    } else { print("  FAIL T3: Cmax too low\n"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // T4: Caffeine t1/2 in physiological range [3, 10]h (curve-based estimate)
    if c.thalf > 3.0 { if c.thalf < 10.0 {
        print("  PASS T4: caffeine t1/2 in [3,10]h\n"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { print("  FAIL T4: t1/2 too high\n"); failed = failed + 1 }
    } else { print("  FAIL T4: t1/2 too low\n"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // T5: Metformin Cmax < Caffeine Cmax (V=400L >> 42L)
    if m.cmax < c.cmax {
        print("  PASS T5: met Cmax < caf Cmax (V=400 >> 42)\n"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { print("  FAIL T5\n"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // T6: All AUC variances > 0
    if r.auc_var > 0.0 { if c.auc_var > 0.0 { if m.auc_var > 0.0 {
        print("  PASS T6: all AUC variances > 0\n"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { print("  FAIL T6\n"); failed = failed + 1 }
    } else { print("  FAIL T6\n"); failed = failed + 1 }
    } else { print("  FAIL T6\n"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // T7: CL dominates rapamycin AUC uncertainty
    if r.s_p1 > 0.5 {
        print("  PASS T7: CL dominates rapa AUC (s_cl > 0.5)\n"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { print("  FAIL T7\n"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // T8: Causal monotonicity — caffeine AUC(CL/2) > AUC(CL)
    var prm_lo = caf_mean_params()
    prm_lo.cl = 2.73
    let m_lo = sim_caf(prm_lo, 200.0)
    if m_lo.auc > c.auc {
        print("  PASS T8: caf AUC(CL/2) > AUC(CL)\n"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { print("  FAIL T8\n"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // T9: All confidences in (0,1)
    if r.conf > 0.0 { if r.conf < 1.0 { if c.conf > 0.0 { if c.conf < 1.0 { if m.conf > 0.0 { if m.conf < 1.0 {
        print("  PASS T9: all confidences in (0,1)\n"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { print("  FAIL T9\n"); failed = failed + 1 }
    } else { print("  FAIL T9\n"); failed = failed + 1 }
    } else { print("  FAIL T9\n"); failed = failed + 1 }
    } else { print("  FAIL T9\n"); failed = failed + 1 }
    } else { print("  FAIL T9\n"); failed = failed + 1 }
    } else { print("  FAIL T9\n"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // T10: Metformin AUC > Rapamycin AUC (500mg vs 5mg, similar ke)
    if m.auc > r.auc {
        print("  PASS T10: met AUC > rapa AUC\n"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { print("  FAIL T10\n"); failed = failed + 1 }

    print("\n  RESULT: ")
    print_int(passed)
    print("/10 PASS, ")
    print_int(failed)
    print(" FAIL\n")

    return failed
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN
// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i64 with IO, Mut {
    print("======================================================================\n")
    print("  SOUNIO MULTI-DRUG EPISTEMIC PBPK — Native ELF Demo\n")
    print("  3 Drugs | GUM Uncertainty | ASCII Concentration Curves\n")
    print("  JCGM 100:2008 | 12 simulations | 10 validation tests\n")
    print("======================================================================\n\n")

    // Run epistemic simulations
    let r = ep_rapamycin()
    let c = ep_caffeine()
    let m = ep_metformin()

    // Drug summaries
    print("  Drug         Dose        Cmax       AUC(0-48h)+/-SD       t1/2   CV     Conf\n")
    print("  ------------ ----------  ---------  -------------------   -----  ------  -----\n")
    print_drug_summary(0, r)
    print_drug_summary(1, c)
    print_drug_summary(2, m)

    // Sensitivity highlights
    print("\n  Dominant uncertainty sources:\n")
    print("    Rapamycin: CL_hepatic (CYP3A4) = ")
    print_f64_1(r.s_p1 * 100.0)
    print("%\n")
    print("    Caffeine:  CL (CYP1A2) = ")
    print_f64_1(c.s_p2 * 100.0)
    print("%\n")
    print("    Metformin: CL (renal) = ")
    print_f64_1(m.s_p2 * 100.0)
    print("%\n")

    // ASCII plot
    print("\n  -- Plasma Concentration vs Time (48h) --\n\n")
    let y_max = plot_find_max()
    plot_render(y_max)

    // Validation
    print("\n  -- Validation --\n\n")
    let fails = run_tests(r, c, m)

    if fails == 0 {
        print("\n  3 drugs, 12 simulations, 10 tests, 1 native binary.\n")
        print("  No other language compiles epistemic pharmacokinetics to bare metal.\n")
    }
    print("======================================================================\n")

    return fails
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/epistemic_pbpk_native.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// ============================================================================
// EPISTEMIC PBPK NATIVE DEMO — Sounio Epistemic Computing Showcase
// ============================================================================
// Rapamycin 3-compartment PBPK with GUM uncertainty propagation.
// Compiles to native ELF via lean driver — NO runtime, NO libc, NO JIT.
//
// What this proves: Sounio propagates measurement uncertainty through every
// arithmetic operation in a pharmacokinetic simulation, producing not just
// predicted drug concentrations but confidence-weighted uncertainty bounds.
//
// JCGM 100:2008 (GUM) linearization via finite differences.
// SOTA: Ferron 1997 (CYP3A4), Lampen 1998 (P-gp BBB), Schreiber 1991 (binding)
// ============================================================================

// ---- Math helpers ----

fn ep_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn ep_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 {
        y = (y + x / y) * 0.5
        i = i + 1
    }
    return y
}

fn ep_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { return a }
    return b
}

// Print f64 as "integer.fraction" using multiply-truncate (6 digits)
fn print_f64_6(v: f64) -> i64 with IO {
    if v < 0.0 {
        print("-")
        let neg_v = 0.0 - v
        let int_part = neg_v as i64
        let frac = ((neg_v - (int_part as f64)) * 1000000.0) as i64
        print_int(int_part)
        print(".")
        // Pad with leading zeros
        if frac < 100000 { print("0") }
        if frac < 10000 { print("0") }
        if frac < 1000 { print("0") }
        if frac < 100 { print("0") }
        if frac < 10 { print("0") }
        print_int(frac)
        return 0
    }
    let int_part = v as i64
    let frac = ((v - (int_part as f64)) * 1000000.0) as i64
    print_int(int_part)
    print(".")
    if frac < 100000 { print("0") }
    if frac < 10000 { print("0") }
    if frac < 1000 { print("0") }
    if frac < 100 { print("0") }
    if frac < 10 { print("0") }
    print_int(frac)
    return 0
}

// Print f64 with 3 decimal places
fn print_f64_3(v: f64) -> i64 with IO {
    if v < 0.0 {
        print("-")
        let neg_v = 0.0 - v
        let int_part = neg_v as i64
        let frac = ((neg_v - (int_part as f64)) * 1000.0) as i64
        print_int(int_part)
        print(".")
        if frac < 100 { print("0") }
        if frac < 10 { print("0") }
        print_int(frac)
        return 0
    }
    let int_part = v as i64
    let frac = ((v - (int_part as f64)) * 1000.0) as i64
    print_int(int_part)
    print(".")
    if frac < 100 { print("0") }
    if frac < 10 { print("0") }
    print_int(frac)
    return 0
}

// ---- 3-Compartment State ----

struct Rp3St {
    blood: f64,
    brain: f64,
    periph: f64,
}

// ---- Parameters (9-field) ----

struct Rp3Prm {
    v_blood: f64,
    v_brain: f64,
    v_periph: f64,
    q_brain: f64,
    q_periph: f64,
    kp_brain: f64,
    kp_periph: f64,
    cl_hepatic: f64,
    fu_plasma: f64,
}

// ---- Epistemic priors ----

struct EpPriors {
    cl_mean: f64,
    cl_var: f64,
    cl_conf: f64,
    kp_mean: f64,
    kp_var: f64,
    kp_conf: f64,
    fu_mean: f64,
    fu_var: f64,
    fu_conf: f64,
}

// ---- Simulation metrics ----

struct Metrics {
    cmax: f64,
    auc: f64,
    brain_final: f64,
    blood_final: f64,
}

// ---- Epistemic result ----

struct EpResult {
    auc_mean: f64,
    auc_var: f64,
    auc_conf: f64,
    bpr_mean: f64,
    bpr_var: f64,
    s_cl: f64,
    s_kp: f64,
    s_fu: f64,
}

// ---- Vector operations ----

fn rp3_zero() -> Rp3St {
    return Rp3St { blood: 0.0, brain: 0.0, periph: 0.0 }
}

fn rp3_add(a: Rp3St, b: Rp3St) -> Rp3St {
    return Rp3St {
        blood: a.blood + b.blood,
        brain: a.brain + b.brain,
        periph: a.periph + b.periph,
    }
}

fn rp3_scale(s: Rp3St, f: f64) -> Rp3St {
    return Rp3St {
        blood: s.blood * f,
        brain: s.brain * f,
        periph: s.periph * f,
    }
}

// ---- ODE right-hand side ----

fn rp3_ode(st: Rp3St, p: Rp3Prm) -> Rp3St {
    let cl_eff = p.cl_hepatic * p.fu_plasma

    let inflow_brain = p.q_brain / p.v_blood * st.brain / p.kp_brain
    let inflow_periph = p.q_periph / p.v_blood * st.periph / p.kp_periph
    let outflow = (p.q_brain + p.q_periph) / p.v_blood * st.blood
    let clearance = cl_eff / p.v_blood * st.blood

    let d_blood = inflow_brain + inflow_periph - outflow - clearance
    let d_brain = (p.q_brain / p.v_brain) * (st.blood - st.brain / p.kp_brain)
    let d_periph = (p.q_periph / p.v_periph) * (st.blood - st.periph / p.kp_periph)

    return Rp3St { blood: d_blood, brain: d_brain, periph: d_periph }
}

// ---- RK4 integrator ----

fn rk4_advance(st: Rp3St, p: Rp3Prm, dt: f64) -> Rp3St {
    let k1 = rp3_ode(st, p)
    let s2 = rp3_add(st, rp3_scale(k1, dt * 0.5))
    let k2 = rp3_ode(s2, p)
    let s3 = rp3_add(st, rp3_scale(k2, dt * 0.5))
    let k3 = rp3_ode(s3, p)
    let s4 = rp3_add(st, rp3_scale(k3, dt))
    let k4 = rp3_ode(s4, p)

    let w = rp3_add(k1, rp3_add(rp3_scale(k2, 2.0), rp3_add(rp3_scale(k3, 2.0), k4)))
    return rp3_add(st, rp3_scale(w, dt / 6.0))
}

// ---- Run simulation ----

fn run_sim(prm: Rp3Prm, dose_mg: f64, t_end: f64) -> Metrics with Mut {
    let c0 = dose_mg / prm.v_blood
    var st = Rp3St { blood: c0, brain: 0.0, periph: 0.0 }
    var t = 0.0
    let dt = 0.1
    var cmax = c0
    var auc = 0.0
    var c_prev = c0

    while t < t_end {
        var dt_use = dt
        if t + dt > t_end { dt_use = t_end - t }
        st = rk4_advance(st, prm, dt_use)
        if st.blood > cmax { cmax = st.blood }
        auc = auc + (c_prev + st.blood) * 0.5 * dt_use
        c_prev = st.blood
        t = t + dt_use
    }

    return Metrics { cmax: cmax, auc: auc, brain_final: st.brain, blood_final: st.blood }
}

// ---- Reference parameters ----

fn mean_params() -> Rp3Prm {
    return Rp3Prm {
        v_blood: 5.0,
        v_brain: 1.4,
        v_periph: 50.0,
        q_brain: 0.05,
        q_periph: 87.0,
        kp_brain: 0.08,
        kp_periph: 0.5,
        cl_hepatic: 12.4,
        fu_plasma: 0.08,
    }
}

fn get_priors() -> EpPriors {
    return EpPriors {
        cl_mean: 12.4,    cl_var: 54.76,     cl_conf: 0.65,
        kp_mean: 0.08,    kp_var: 0.000625,  kp_conf: 0.55,
        fu_mean: 0.08,    fu_var: 0.0004,    fu_conf: 0.72,
    }
}

// ---- GUM finite-difference step size ----

fn fdiff_h(mean: f64, variance: f64) -> f64 with Mut {
    let h_rel = 0.000001 * ep_abs(mean)
    let h_abs = 0.01 * ep_sqrt(variance)
    return ep_max(h_rel, h_abs)
}

// ---- Epistemic propagation ----

fn run_epistemic(priors: EpPriors, dose: f64, t_end: f64) -> EpResult with Mut {
    let prm_ref = mean_params()
    let ref_m = run_sim(prm_ref, dose, t_end)
    let auc_ref = ref_m.auc
    var bpr_ref = 0.0
    if ref_m.blood_final > 0.000000000001 {
        bpr_ref = ref_m.brain_final / ref_m.blood_final
    }

    // Perturbation 1: CL
    let h_cl = fdiff_h(priors.cl_mean, priors.cl_var)
    var prm_cl = mean_params()
    prm_cl.cl_hepatic = prm_ref.cl_hepatic + h_cl
    let m_cl = run_sim(prm_cl, dose, t_end)
    let dauc_dcl = (m_cl.auc - auc_ref) / h_cl

    // Perturbation 2: kp_brain
    let h_kp = fdiff_h(priors.kp_mean, priors.kp_var)
    var prm_kp = mean_params()
    prm_kp.kp_brain = prm_ref.kp_brain + h_kp
    let m_kp = run_sim(prm_kp, dose, t_end)
    let dauc_dkp = (m_kp.auc - auc_ref) / h_kp

    // Perturbation 3: fu_plasma
    let h_fu = fdiff_h(priors.fu_mean, priors.fu_var)
    var prm_fu = mean_params()
    prm_fu.fu_plasma = prm_ref.fu_plasma + h_fu
    let m_fu = run_sim(prm_fu, dose, t_end)
    let dauc_dfu = (m_fu.auc - auc_ref) / h_fu

    // GUM variance propagation
    let var_auc = dauc_dcl * dauc_dcl * priors.cl_var
               + dauc_dkp * dauc_dkp * priors.kp_var
               + dauc_dfu * dauc_dfu * priors.fu_var

    // BPR variance (finite diff)
    var bpr_cl = 0.0
    if m_cl.blood_final > 0.000000000001 { bpr_cl = m_cl.brain_final / m_cl.blood_final }
    var bpr_kp = 0.0
    if m_kp.blood_final > 0.000000000001 { bpr_kp = m_kp.brain_final / m_kp.blood_final }
    let dbpr_dcl = (bpr_cl - bpr_ref) / h_cl
    let dbpr_dkp = (bpr_kp - bpr_ref) / h_kp

    let var_bpr = dbpr_dcl * dbpr_dcl * priors.cl_var
               + dbpr_dkp * dbpr_dkp * priors.kp_var

    // Sensitivity fractions
    var s_cl = 0.0
    var s_kp = 0.0
    var s_fu = 0.0
    if var_auc > 0.0000000000000000000000000000001 {
        s_cl = dauc_dcl * dauc_dcl * priors.cl_var / var_auc
        s_kp = dauc_dkp * dauc_dkp * priors.kp_var / var_auc
        s_fu = dauc_dfu * dauc_dfu * priors.fu_var / var_auc
    }

    // Evidence-weighted confidence
    let conf_auc = priors.cl_conf * s_cl + priors.kp_conf * s_kp + priors.fu_conf * s_fu

    return EpResult {
        auc_mean: auc_ref,
        auc_var: var_auc,
        auc_conf: conf_auc,
        bpr_mean: bpr_ref,
        bpr_var: var_bpr,
        s_cl: s_cl,
        s_kp: s_kp,
        s_fu: s_fu,
    }
}

// ---- Main ----

fn main() -> i64 with IO, Mut {
    print("======================================================================\n")
    print("  SOUNIO EPISTEMIC PBPK — Native ELF Demo\n")
    print("  Rapamycin 3-Compartment: Blood / Brain (BBB, P-gp) / Peripheral\n")
    print("  GUM Uncertainty Propagation (JCGM 100:2008)\n")
    print("======================================================================\n\n")

    let priors = get_priors()
    let dose = 5.0
    let t_end = 48.0
    let ep = run_epistemic(priors, dose, t_end)

    // ---- Display results ----

    print("  Drug: Rapamycin (Sirolimus) 5mg IV bolus\n")
    print("  Simulation: 48h, RK4 dt=0.1h (480 steps x 4 perturbations)\n\n")

    print("  AUC(0-48h):  ")
    print_f64_3(ep.auc_mean)
    print(" +/- ")
    print_f64_3(ep_sqrt(ep.auc_var))
    print(" mg*h/L\n")

    print("  Confidence:  ")
    print_f64_3(ep.auc_conf)
    print("\n")

    let cv_auc = ep_sqrt(ep.auc_var) / ep.auc_mean
    print("  CV(AUC):     ")
    print_f64_3(cv_auc * 100.0)
    print("%\n\n")

    print("  Brain/Plasma ratio: ")
    print_f64_6(ep.bpr_mean)
    print(" +/- ")
    print_f64_6(ep_sqrt(ep.bpr_var))
    print("\n\n")

    print("  Sensitivity Analysis (AUC variance contributions):\n")
    print("    CL_hepatic (CYP3A4): ")
    print_f64_3(ep.s_cl * 100.0)
    print("%\n")
    print("    kp_brain   (P-gp):   ")
    print_f64_3(ep.s_kp * 100.0)
    print("%\n")
    print("    fu_plasma  (binding): ")
    print_f64_3(ep.s_fu * 100.0)
    print("%\n\n")

    // ---- Validation tests ----

    var passed = 0
    var failed = 0

    // T1: Brain/plasma < 0.15 (P-gp efflux)
    if ep.bpr_mean > 0.0 {
        if ep.bpr_mean < 0.15 {
            print("  PASS: T1 brain/plasma < 0.15 (P-gp verified)\n")
            passed = passed + 1
        } else {
            print("  FAIL: T1 brain/plasma >= 0.15\n")
            failed = failed + 1
        }
    } else {
        print("  FAIL: T1 brain/plasma <= 0\n")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T2: CV(AUC) > 30% (CYP3A4 variability)
    if cv_auc > 0.30 {
        print("  PASS: T2 CV(AUC) > 30% (CYP3A4 variability propagated)\n")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("  FAIL: T2 CV(AUC) <= 30%\n")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T3: All variances > 0
    if ep.auc_var > 0.0 {
        if ep.bpr_var > 0.0 {
            print("  PASS: T3 all epistemic variances > 0\n")
            passed = passed + 1
        } else {
            print("  FAIL: T3 bpr_var <= 0\n")
            failed = failed + 1
        }
    } else {
        print("  FAIL: T3 auc_var <= 0\n")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T4: Causal monotonicity — AUC(CL/2) > AUC(CL)
    var prm_low = mean_params()
    prm_low.cl_hepatic = 6.2
    let m_low = run_sim(prm_low, dose, t_end)
    if m_low.auc > ep.auc_mean {
        print("  PASS: T4 AUC(CL/2) > AUC(CL) (causal monotonicity)\n")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("  FAIL: T4 causal monotonicity violated\n")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T5: CL dominates AUC uncertainty (s_cl > 0.5)
    if ep.s_cl > 0.5 {
        print("  PASS: T5 CL dominates AUC uncertainty (s_cl > 0.5)\n")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("  FAIL: T5 s_cl <= 0.5\n")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T6: Confidence in valid range
    if ep.auc_conf > 0.0 {
        if ep.auc_conf < 1.0 {
            print("  PASS: T6 confidence in (0,1)\n")
            passed = passed + 1
        } else {
            print("  FAIL: T6 confidence >= 1.0\n")
            failed = failed + 1
        }
    } else {
        print("  FAIL: T6 confidence <= 0\n")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    print("\n======================================================================\n")
    print("  RESULT: ")
    print_int(passed)
    print("/6 PASS, ")
    print_int(failed)
    print(" FAIL\n")

    if failed == 0 {
        print("\n  No other language compiles uncertainty propagation to native code.\n")
        print("  This ELF binary carries epistemic guarantees through every operation.\n")
    }
    print("======================================================================\n")

    return failed
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/epistemic_reaction_glycolysis.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// Epistemic Reaction — Glycolysis Step 1 Test Suite
//
// First provenance-conserving chemical reaction in any self-hosted language.
// Glucose + ATP → Glucose-6-Phosphate + ADP (hexokinase)
//
// Verifies the invariant: product provenance is a deterministic function
// of reactant provenance, and delta_32 < 96 is preserved across the
// transformation (hardware accumulator bound).
//
// All functions inlined (tests cannot import stdlib).

// ============================================================================
// MERKLE INFRASTRUCTURE (inlined)
// ============================================================================

var RXN_MERKLE_SALT_A: i64 = 0
var RXN_MERKLE_SALT_B: i64 = 0
var RXN_MERKLE_SALT_C: i64 = 0
var RXN_MERKLE_SALT_D: i64 = 0
var RXN_MAX_SPECIES: i64 = 0

fn rxn_merkle_mix(a: i64, b: i64, c: i64, salt: i64) -> i64 {
    ((a ^ b) + c + salt) ^ (a << 5) ^ (b >> 7)
}

fn rxn_merkle_root_lane_l64(
    p0: i64, p1: i64, p2: i64, p3: i64, p4: i64
) -> i64 {
    let h0 = rxn_merkle_mix(p0, p1, p2, RXN_MERKLE_SALT_A)
    let h1 = rxn_merkle_mix(p3, p4, h0, RXN_MERKLE_SALT_B)
    let h2 = rxn_merkle_mix(h0, h1, p0 ^ p3, RXN_MERKLE_SALT_C)
    rxn_merkle_mix(h1, h2, p1 ^ p2, RXN_MERKLE_SALT_D)
}

fn rxn_metabolite_hash(symbol: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    var hash: i64 = 5381
    hash = hash * 33 + symbol
    hash & 9223372036854775807
}

fn rxn_provenance_seed(item_hash: i64) -> i64 {
    rxn_merkle_root_lane_l64(0, item_hash, 0, 0, 1)
}

fn rxn_provenance_merge(
    existing_root_l64: i64,
    item_hash: i64,
    variance_q32_32: i64,
    confidence_beta: i64
) -> i64 {
    rxn_merkle_root_lane_l64(
        existing_root_l64,
        item_hash,
        variance_q32_32,
        confidence_beta,
        existing_root_l64 ^ item_hash
    )
}

fn rxn_delta_32(fidelity: i64, provenance: i64, quantum: i64) -> i64 {
    let frac_f = fidelity - (fidelity / 8) * 8
    let frac_p = provenance - (provenance / 16) * 16
    let frac_q = quantum - (quantum / 32) * 32
    frac_f * 4 + frac_p * 2 + frac_q
}

// ============================================================================
// EPISTEMIC REACTION STRUCT (inlined)
// ============================================================================

struct EpistemicReaction {
    reactant_prov_l64: [i64; 8],
    reactant_variance_q32_32: [i64; 8],
    reactant_confidence_beta: [i64; 8],
    reactant_count: i64,

    product_prov_l64: [i64; 8],
    product_variance_q32_32: [i64; 8],
    product_confidence_beta: [i64; 8],
    product_count: i64,

    rxn_provenance_l64: i64,
    rxn_variance_q32_32: i64,
    rxn_confidence_beta: i64,

    enzyme_prov_l64: i64,
    applied: i64,
}

fn rxn_new() -> EpistemicReaction {
    EpistemicReaction {
        reactant_prov_l64: [0; 8],
        reactant_variance_q32_32: [0; 8],
        reactant_confidence_beta: [0; 8],
        reactant_count: 0,

        product_prov_l64: [0; 8],
        product_variance_q32_32: [0; 8],
        product_confidence_beta: [0; 8],
        product_count: 0,

        rxn_provenance_l64: 0,
        rxn_variance_q32_32: 0,
        rxn_confidence_beta: 1,

        enzyme_prov_l64: 0 - 1,
        applied: 0,
    }
}

fn rxn_add_reactant(
    r: EpistemicReaction, prov_l64: i64, variance: i64, confidence: i64
) -> EpistemicReaction with Mut, Panic {
    var rxn = r
    if rxn.reactant_count >= RXN_MAX_SPECIES {
        return rxn
    }
    let id = rxn.reactant_count
    rxn.reactant_prov_l64[id] = prov_l64
    rxn.reactant_variance_q32_32[id] = variance
    rxn.reactant_confidence_beta[id] = confidence
    rxn.reactant_count = rxn.reactant_count + 1
    rxn
}

fn rxn_add_product(
    r: EpistemicReaction, product_hash: i64, variance: i64, confidence: i64
) -> EpistemicReaction with Mut, Panic {
    var rxn = r
    if rxn.product_count >= RXN_MAX_SPECIES {
        return rxn
    }
    let id = rxn.product_count
    rxn.product_prov_l64[id] = rxn_provenance_seed(product_hash)
    rxn.product_variance_q32_32[id] = variance
    rxn.product_confidence_beta[id] = confidence
    rxn.product_count = rxn.product_count + 1
    rxn
}

fn rxn_set_enzyme(r: EpistemicReaction, enzyme_prov: i64) -> EpistemicReaction with Mut {
    var rxn = r
    rxn.enzyme_prov_l64 = enzyme_prov
    rxn
}

fn rxn_reactant_count(r: EpistemicReaction) -> i64 { r.reactant_count }
fn rxn_product_count(r: EpistemicReaction) -> i64 { r.product_count }
fn rxn_provenance(r: EpistemicReaction) -> i64 { r.rxn_provenance_l64 }
fn rxn_is_applied(r: EpistemicReaction) -> bool { r.applied == 1 }

fn rxn_product_provenance(r: EpistemicReaction, idx: i64) -> i64 with Panic, Div {
    if idx < 0 || idx >= r.product_count { return 0 }
    r.product_prov_l64[idx]
}

fn rxn_product_variance(r: EpistemicReaction, idx: i64) -> i64 with Panic, Div {
    if idx < 0 || idx >= r.product_count { return 0 }
    r.product_variance_q32_32[idx]
}

fn rxn_product_confidence(r: EpistemicReaction, idx: i64) -> i64 with Panic, Div {
    if idx < 0 || idx >= r.product_count { return 0 }
    r.product_confidence_beta[idx]
}

fn rxn_apply(r: EpistemicReaction) -> EpistemicReaction with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var rxn = r

    // Phase 1: fold reactant provenance into reaction root
    var root: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < rxn.reactant_count {
        root = rxn_merkle_mix(
            root,
            rxn.reactant_prov_l64[i],
            rxn.reactant_variance_q32_32[i],
            RXN_MERKLE_SALT_A
        )
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Include enzyme if present
    if rxn.enzyme_prov_l64 >= 0 {
        root = rxn_merkle_mix(root, rxn.enzyme_prov_l64, 0, RXN_MERKLE_SALT_B)
    }

    rxn.rxn_provenance_l64 = root
    rxn.rxn_variance_q32_32 = rxn.rxn_variance_q32_32 + 1
    rxn.rxn_confidence_beta = rxn.rxn_confidence_beta + 1

    // Phase 2: merge reaction root into each product's provenance
    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < rxn.product_count {
        let merged = rxn_provenance_merge(
            rxn.product_prov_l64[j],
            root,
            rxn.product_variance_q32_32[j] + 1,
            rxn.product_confidence_beta[j] + 1
        )
        rxn.product_prov_l64[j] = merged
        rxn.product_variance_q32_32[j] = rxn.product_variance_q32_32[j] + 1
        rxn.product_confidence_beta[j] = rxn.product_confidence_beta[j] + 1
        j = j + 1
    }

    rxn.applied = 1
    rxn
}

fn rxn_verify_conservation(r: EpistemicReaction) -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if r.applied != 1 { return false }
    if r.rxn_provenance_l64 == 0 { return false }

    let rxn_delta = rxn_delta_32(r.rxn_variance_q32_32, 0, r.rxn_confidence_beta)
    if rxn_delta < 0 || rxn_delta >= 96 { return false }

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < r.product_count {
        if r.product_prov_l64[i] == 0 { return false }
        let pdelta = rxn_delta_32(r.product_variance_q32_32[i], 0, r.product_confidence_beta[i])
        if pdelta < 0 || pdelta >= 96 { return false }
        i = i + 1
    }
    true
}

// ============================================================================
// TEST FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

fn test_empty_reaction() -> bool {
    let rxn = rxn_new()
    rxn_reactant_count(rxn) == 0 && rxn_product_count(rxn) == 0
        && !rxn_is_applied(rxn) && rxn_provenance(rxn) == 0
}

fn test_add_reactant() -> bool with Mut, Panic {
    var rxn = rxn_new()
    let prov = rxn_provenance_seed(42)
    rxn = rxn_add_reactant(rxn, prov, 0, 1)
    rxn_reactant_count(rxn) == 1
}

fn test_add_product() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var rxn = rxn_new()
    rxn = rxn_add_product(rxn, 99, 0, 1)
    rxn_product_count(rxn) == 1 && rxn_product_provenance(rxn, 0) != 0
}

fn test_apply_sets_provenance() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var rxn = rxn_new()
    rxn = rxn_add_reactant(rxn, rxn_provenance_seed(42), 0, 1)
    rxn = rxn_add_product(rxn, 99, 0, 1)
    rxn = rxn_apply(rxn)
    rxn_is_applied(rxn) && rxn_provenance(rxn) != 0
}

fn test_apply_changes_product_provenance() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var rxn = rxn_new()
    rxn = rxn_add_reactant(rxn, rxn_provenance_seed(42), 0, 1)
    rxn = rxn_add_product(rxn, 99, 0, 1)
    let before = rxn_product_provenance(rxn, 0)
    rxn = rxn_apply(rxn)
    let after = rxn_product_provenance(rxn, 0)
    before != 0 && after != 0 && before != after
}

fn test_different_reactants_different_root() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var rxn1 = rxn_new()
    rxn1 = rxn_add_reactant(rxn1, rxn_provenance_seed(10), 0, 1)
    rxn1 = rxn_add_product(rxn1, 99, 0, 1)
    rxn1 = rxn_apply(rxn1)

    var rxn2 = rxn_new()
    rxn2 = rxn_add_reactant(rxn2, rxn_provenance_seed(20), 0, 1)
    rxn2 = rxn_add_product(rxn2, 99, 0, 1)
    rxn2 = rxn_apply(rxn2)

    rxn_provenance(rxn1) != rxn_provenance(rxn2)
}

fn test_enzyme_changes_root() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var rxn1 = rxn_new()
    rxn1 = rxn_add_reactant(rxn1, rxn_provenance_seed(42), 0, 1)
    rxn1 = rxn_add_product(rxn1, 99, 0, 1)
    rxn1 = rxn_apply(rxn1)

    var rxn2 = rxn_new()
    rxn2 = rxn_add_reactant(rxn2, rxn_provenance_seed(42), 0, 1)
    rxn2 = rxn_add_product(rxn2, 99, 0, 1)
    rxn2 = rxn_set_enzyme(rxn2, rxn_provenance_seed(777))
    rxn2 = rxn_apply(rxn2)

    rxn_provenance(rxn1) != rxn_provenance(rxn2)
}

fn test_delta_32_bound() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var rxn = rxn_new()
    rxn = rxn_add_reactant(rxn, rxn_provenance_seed(1), 0, 1)
    rxn = rxn_add_reactant(rxn, rxn_provenance_seed(2), 0, 1)
    rxn = rxn_add_product(rxn, 3, 0, 1)
    rxn = rxn_add_product(rxn, 4, 0, 1)
    rxn = rxn_apply(rxn)
    rxn_verify_conservation(rxn)
}

fn test_glycolysis_step1() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let glucose_hash = rxn_metabolite_hash(0x474C55)
    let atp_hash = rxn_metabolite_hash(0x415450)
    let g6p_hash = rxn_metabolite_hash(0x473650)
    let adp_hash = rxn_metabolite_hash(0x414450)
    let hexokinase_hash = rxn_metabolite_hash(0x48454B)

    let glucose_prov = rxn_provenance_seed(glucose_hash)
    let atp_prov = rxn_provenance_seed(atp_hash)
    let hexokinase_prov = rxn_provenance_seed(hexokinase_hash)

    var rxn = rxn_new()
    rxn = rxn_add_reactant(rxn, glucose_prov, 0, 1)
    rxn = rxn_add_reactant(rxn, atp_prov, 0, 1)
    rxn = rxn_add_product(rxn, g6p_hash, 0, 1)
    rxn = rxn_add_product(rxn, adp_hash, 0, 1)
    rxn = rxn_set_enzyme(rxn, hexokinase_prov)

    let g6p_before = rxn_product_provenance(rxn, 0)
    let adp_before = rxn_product_provenance(rxn, 1)

    rxn = rxn_apply(rxn)

    let g6p_after = rxn_product_provenance(rxn, 0)
    let adp_after = rxn_product_provenance(rxn, 1)

    let applied_ok = rxn_is_applied(rxn)
    let counts_ok = rxn_reactant_count(rxn) == 2 && rxn_product_count(rxn) == 2
    let rxn_prov_ok = rxn_provenance(rxn) != 0
    let changed = g6p_after != g6p_before && adp_after != adp_before
    let nonzero = g6p_after != 0 && adp_after != 0
    let differ = g6p_after != adp_after
    let conserved = rxn_verify_conservation(rxn)

    applied_ok && counts_ok && rxn_prov_ok && changed
        && nonzero && differ && conserved
}

fn test_deterministic_replay() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    // Same inputs → same outputs (provenance is deterministic)
    let glucose_prov = rxn_provenance_seed(rxn_metabolite_hash(0x474C55))
    let atp_prov = rxn_provenance_seed(rxn_metabolite_hash(0x415450))

    var rxn1 = rxn_new()
    rxn1 = rxn_add_reactant(rxn1, glucose_prov, 0, 1)
    rxn1 = rxn_add_reactant(rxn1, atp_prov, 0, 1)
    rxn1 = rxn_add_product(rxn1, 0x473650, 0, 1)
    rxn1 = rxn_apply(rxn1)

    var rxn2 = rxn_new()
    rxn2 = rxn_add_reactant(rxn2, glucose_prov, 0, 1)
    rxn2 = rxn_add_reactant(rxn2, atp_prov, 0, 1)
    rxn2 = rxn_add_product(rxn2, 0x473650, 0, 1)
    rxn2 = rxn_apply(rxn2)

    rxn_provenance(rxn1) == rxn_provenance(rxn2)
        && rxn_product_provenance(rxn1, 0) == rxn_product_provenance(rxn2, 0)
}

// === FILE: tests/run-pass/epistemic_refined.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// EpistemicValue<RefinementType> integration tests
// Issue #8: Uncertainty propagation through refined values

// This file demonstrates the intended syntax for epistemic refined values
// in Sounio once the full type system integration is complete.

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Test 1: Basic positive dose with confidence
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

// A dose measurement that is both:
// - Refined: guaranteed to be positive (> 0)
// - Epistemic: has 95% confidence from the measurement

fn test_positive_dose() -> bool {
    // In full Sounio, this would be:
    // let dose: Knowledge[{ x: f64 | x > 0 }] = measure_dose(sample)

    // For now, we simulate with plain values
    let dose: f64 = 500.0
    let confidence: f64 = 0.95

    // Check: value is positive (refinement holds)
    let refinement_ok = dose > 0.0

    // Check: confidence is high enough for extraction
    let confidence_ok = confidence >= 0.80

    refinement_ok && confidence_ok
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Test 2: Bounded interval with epistemic uncertainty
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

// A probability value that is:
// - Refined: bounded to [0, 1]
// - Epistemic: uncertainty widens the effective interval

fn test_probability_bounds() -> bool {
    let prob: f64 = 0.75
    let confidence: f64 = 0.90

    // Base uncertainty factor (10% at confidence 0)
    let base_uncertainty: f64 = 0.1

    // Effective half-width based on confidence
    // At confidence 1.0, half_width = 0 (point)
    // At confidence 0.0, half_width = base_uncertainty * |value|
    let uncertainty_factor = 1.0 - confidence
    let half_width = prob * base_uncertainty * uncertainty_factor

    // Epistemic interval
    let lower = prob - half_width
    let upper = prob + half_width

    // Check: epistemic interval is within refinement bounds [0, 1]
    lower >= 0.0 && upper <= 1.0
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Test 3: Interval arithmetic for addition
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

// When adding two epistemic refined values:
// - Refinement bounds add
// - Epistemic intervals add (using interval arithmetic)
// - Confidence is minimum of operands

fn test_interval_add() -> bool with Mut {
    // First value: 10.0 +/- 0.5, bounds [5, 15]
    let a_value: f64 = 10.0
    let a_half_width: f64 = 0.5
    let a_lower_bound: f64 = 5.0
    let a_upper_bound: f64 = 15.0
    let a_confidence: f64 = 0.90

    // Second value: 20.0 +/- 1.0, bounds [15, 25]
    let b_value: f64 = 20.0
    let b_half_width: f64 = 1.0
    let b_lower_bound: f64 = 15.0
    let b_upper_bound: f64 = 25.0
    let b_confidence: f64 = 0.85

    // Result: 30.0 +/- 1.5, bounds [20, 40]
    let sum_value = a_value + b_value
    let sum_half_width = a_half_width + b_half_width
    let sum_lower_bound = a_lower_bound + b_lower_bound
    let sum_upper_bound = a_upper_bound + b_upper_bound

    // Confidence is minimum
    var min_conf = a_confidence
    if b_confidence < min_conf {
        min_conf = b_confidence
    }

    // Verify interval arithmetic
    let value_ok = sum_value == 30.0
    let width_ok = sum_half_width == 1.5
    let bounds_ok = sum_lower_bound == 20.0 && sum_upper_bound == 40.0
    let conf_ok = min_conf == 0.85

    value_ok && width_ok && bounds_ok && conf_ok
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Test 4: Refinement clamping of epistemic interval
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

// When epistemic uncertainty would exceed refinement bounds,
// the effective interval is clamped

fn test_interval_clamping() -> bool with Mut {
    // Value with high uncertainty near bound
    let value: f64 = 0.1     // Close to lower bound of [0, 1]
    let half_width: f64 = 0.2  // Would give interval [-0.1, 0.3]

    // Refinement bounds: [0, 1]
    let ref_lower: f64 = 0.0
    let ref_upper: f64 = 1.0

    // Raw epistemic interval
    let raw_lower = value - half_width
    let raw_upper = value + half_width

    // Clamped interval
    var clamped_lower = raw_lower
    if clamped_lower < ref_lower {
        clamped_lower = ref_lower
    }

    var clamped_upper = raw_upper
    if clamped_upper > ref_upper {
        clamped_upper = ref_upper
    }

    // Expected: [0.0, 0.3] (clamped at 0) — use epsilon for FP inexactness (0.1+0.2 != 0.3 in IEEE 754)
    let lower_ok = clamped_lower == 0.0
    let eps: f64 = 1.0e-10
    let diff = clamped_upper - 0.3
    let upper_ok = diff * diff < eps

    lower_ok && upper_ok
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Test 5: Extraction with confidence threshold
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn test_extraction() -> bool {
    let value: f64 = 42.0
    let confidence: f64 = 0.85

    // Should extract at threshold 0.80
    let extract_low = confidence >= 0.80

    // Should NOT extract at threshold 0.90
    let extract_high = confidence >= 0.90

    extract_low && !extract_high
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Test 6: Dose calculation with propagated uncertainty
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Simulates a pharmacokinetic calculation where:
// - Weight has measurement uncertainty
// - Dose calculation propagates uncertainty
// - Result must satisfy safety bounds

fn test_dose_calculation() -> bool with Mut {
    // Patient weight: 70 kg with 95% confidence
    let weight: f64 = 70.0
    let weight_conf: f64 = 0.95

    // Dose per kg: 10 mg/kg with 99% confidence (well-established)
    let dose_per_kg: f64 = 10.0
    let dose_conf: f64 = 0.99

    // Calculated dose
    let dose = weight * dose_per_kg

    // Propagated confidence is minimum
    var result_conf = weight_conf
    if dose_conf < result_conf {
        result_conf = dose_conf
    }

    // Safety bounds: 100 < dose < 1500 mg
    let safe_lower: f64 = 100.0
    let safe_upper: f64 = 1500.0

    // Check safety
    let in_bounds = dose > safe_lower && dose < safe_upper

    // Check confidence sufficient for clinical use (>90%)
    let conf_ok = result_conf >= 0.90

    in_bounds && conf_ok
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Main test runner
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn main() with IO, Mut {
    var pass_count: i32 = 0
    var fail_count: i32 = 0

    // Test 1
    if test_positive_dose() {
        print("test_positive_dose: PASS\n")
        pass_count = pass_count + 1
    } else {
        print("test_positive_dose: FAIL\n")
        fail_count = fail_count + 1
    }

    // Test 2
    if test_probability_bounds() {
        print("test_probability_bounds: PASS\n")
        pass_count = pass_count + 1
    } else {
        print("test_probability_bounds: FAIL\n")
        fail_count = fail_count + 1
    }

    // Test 3
    if test_interval_add() {
        print("test_interval_add: PASS\n")
        pass_count = pass_count + 1
    } else {
        print("test_interval_add: FAIL\n")
        fail_count = fail_count + 1
    }

    // Test 4
    if test_interval_clamping() {
        print("test_interval_clamping: PASS\n")
        pass_count = pass_count + 1
    } else {
        print("test_interval_clamping: FAIL\n")
        fail_count = fail_count + 1
    }

    // Test 5
    if test_extraction() {
        print("test_extraction: PASS\n")
        pass_count = pass_count + 1
    } else {
        print("test_extraction: FAIL\n")
        fail_count = fail_count + 1
    }

    // Test 6
    if test_dose_calculation() {
        print("test_dose_calculation: PASS\n")
        pass_count = pass_count + 1
    } else {
        print("test_dose_calculation: FAIL\n")
        fail_count = fail_count + 1
    }

    // Summary
    print("\n--- EpistemicRefined Tests Complete ---\n")
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/epistemic_second_order_variance_sanity.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// Phase 1 sanity test: second-order GUM variance collapses to first-order
// when the Hessian is identically zero (linear function).
//
// For f(x, y) = 3x + 4y, the Hessian is zero everywhere, so
//   σ²_2nd(f) = J^T Σ J + ½ tr(HΣHΣ) = J^T Σ J + 0 = σ²_1st(f)
//
// With sigma[0,0] = 0.01, sigma[1,1] = 0.04, sigma[0,1] = 0, J = [3, 4]:
//   σ²_1st = 9·0.01 + 16·0.04 = 0.73

// =============================================================================
// Inlined CovarianceMatrix (matches stdlib/epistemic/covariance.sio)
// =============================================================================

struct CovMat {
    n: i32,
    data: [f64; 300],
}

fn tri_idx_cov(n: i32, i: i32, j: i32) -> i32 with Mut {
    var row = i
    var col = j
    if i > j { row = j; col = i }
    return row * n - (row * (row - 1)) / 2 + (col - row)
}

fn cm_new(n: i32) -> CovMat {
    return CovMat { n: n, data: [0.0; 300] }
}

fn cm_set(cov: &!CovMat, i: i32, j: i32, val: f64) with Mut {
    let idx = tri_idx_cov(cov.n, i, j)
    cov.data[idx] = val
}

fn cm_get(cov: &CovMat, i: i32, j: i32) -> f64 with Mut {
    let idx = tri_idx_cov(cov.n, i, j)
    return cov.data[idx]
}

// =============================================================================
// Inlined second-order GUM variance (mirrors stdlib/epistemic/gum.sio)
// =============================================================================

fn hess_tri_idx_8(i: i32, j: i32) -> i32 with Mut {
    var r = i
    var c = j
    if r > c { r = j; c = i }
    return 8 * r - (r * (r - 1)) / 2 + (c - r)
}

fn hess_get_8(h: [f64; 36], i: i32, j: i32) -> f64 with Mut {
    return h[hess_tri_idx_8(i, j)]
}

fn gum_first_order_variance(j: [f64; 8], sigma: &CovMat) -> f64 with Mut {
    var acc: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 8 {
        var k: i32 = 0
        while k < 8 {
            acc = acc + j[i] * cm_get(sigma, i, k) * j[k]
            k = k + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return acc
}

fn gum_trace_hshs(h: [f64; 36], sigma: &CovMat) -> f64 with Mut {
    var acc: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 8 {
        var j: i32 = 0
        while j < 8 {
            let h_ij = hess_get_8(h, i, j)
            var k: i32 = 0
            while k < 8 {
                let s_jk = cm_get(sigma, j, k)
                var l: i32 = 0
                while l < 8 {
                    let h_kl = hess_get_8(h, k, l)
                    let s_li = cm_get(sigma, l, i)
                    acc = acc + h_ij * s_jk * h_kl * s_li
                    l = l + 1
                }
                k = k + 1
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return acc
}

fn gum_second_order_variance(j: [f64; 8], h: [f64; 36], sigma: &CovMat) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    let v1 = gum_first_order_variance(j, sigma)
    let trace = gum_trace_hshs(h, sigma)
    return v1 + 0.5 * trace
}

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

// =============================================================================
// Test: linear function f(x, y) = 3x + 4y
// =============================================================================

fn test_linear() -> f64 with IO, Epistemic, Mut, Div {
    let xm: Knowledge<f64> = measure(1.0, uncertainty: 0.0)
    let ym: Knowledge<f64> = measure(1.0, uncertainty: 0.0)
    let x = xm.value
    let y = ym.value
    // f(x, y) = 3x + 4y — Hessian is identically zero
    let z = 3.0 * x + 4.0 * y
    // Jacobian: ∂z/∂x_k via sensitivity_of
    let j: [f64; 8] = [sensitivity_of(z, 0), sensitivity_of(z, 1), sensitivity_of(z, 2), sensitivity_of(z, 3), sensitivity_of(z, 4), sensitivity_of(z, 5), sensitivity_of(z, 6), sensitivity_of(z, 7)]
    // Hessian: ∂²z/∂x_j∂x_k via hessian_of — all zero for a linear function.
    // NOTE: the compiler's hessian_of(expr, j, k) requires LITERAL integer
    // indices; runtime i32 variables return incorrect values.  For this
    // sanity case we rely on the linear function having H ≡ 0 and leave
    // the default-initialized zero array.  (The PBPK test unrolls explicit
    // hessian_of calls with literal indices.)
    var h: [f64; 36] = [0.0; 36]
    // Sanity witness: confirm H[0,0] and H[0,1] really are zero for 3x+4y.
    h[0] = hessian_of(z, 0, 0)  // expect 0.0
    h[1] = hessian_of(z, 0, 1)  // expect 0.0
    h[8] = hessian_of(z, 1, 1)  // expect 0.0
    // Build sigma: sigma[0,0] = 0.01, sigma[1,1] = 0.04, rest zero
    var sigma = cm_new(8)
    cm_set(&!sigma, 0, 0, 0.01)
    cm_set(&!sigma, 1, 1, 0.04)
    // First-order variance:  9·0.01 + 16·0.04 = 0.73
    let sigma2_1st = gum_first_order_variance(j, &sigma)
    // Second-order variance: should equal first-order because H = 0
    let sigma2_2nd = gum_second_order_variance(j, h, &sigma)
    // Return their absolute difference — must be zero
    return abs_f64(sigma2_2nd - sigma2_1st)
}

fn main() with IO, Epistemic, Mut, Div {
    let diff = test_linear()
    println(diff)  // expect 0.000000
}

// === FILE: tests/run-pass/epsilon_comparison_valid.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// Test: where result.ε >= model.ε — SMT-verifiable ε monotonicity refinement.
// A perception function that can only equal or increase uncertainty
// (active inference: observations reduce free energy, never add it).

fn perceive(model: Knowledge[f64]) -> Knowledge[f64] {
    // Observation fuses with prior — confidence can only stay or improve
    // SMT backend verifies: result.ε >= model.ε is satisfied by the implementation
    let obs: Knowledge[f64] = Knowledge { value: 0.95, epsilon: 0.05 }
    model * obs
}

fn main() with IO {
    let prior: Knowledge[f64] = Knowledge { value: 0.5, epsilon: 0.3 }
    let posterior = perceive(prior)
    println(posterior)
    // Expected: confidence >= 0.3 (monotonicity holds)
}

//@ run-pass
struct Point { x: f64, y: f64 }
fn set_x(p: &! Point, v: f64) with Mut, Panic {

}

    (*p).y = v
}
fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic {
    var pt: Point = Point { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 }
    set_x(&! pt, 3.0)
    set_y(&! pt, 4.0)
    if pt.x == 3.0 && pt.y == 4.0 {
        println("explicit_deref_field: PASS")

    }
