// === FILE: tests/run-pass/viz_interaction_time.sio ===
// tests/run-pass/viz_interaction_time.sio - Visual IR interaction state smoke test
//
// Expected output:
//   VIZ_INTERACTION_TIME_PASS

use display::canvas::{Canvas, canvas_clear}
use viz::ir::{viz_scene_new, viz_layout_rect, viz_add_control, viz_add_trajectory, viz_scene_pointer_down, viz_scene_pointer_update, viz_scene_set_time, VIZ_CONTROL_SLIDER}
use viz::viz_canvas::{viz_canvas_render_scene}
use viz::physchem::{trajectory_spiral}

fn make_canvas(w: i64, h: i64) -> Canvas with Alloc {
    let pix = heap_alloc(w * h * 8) as *mut i64
    Canvas { pixels: pix, width: w, height: h }
}

fn read_px(c: &Canvas, x: i64, y: i64) -> i64 {
    read_i64(c.pixels, y * c.width + x)
}

fn main() with IO, Alloc, Mut, Div {
    var scene = viz_scene_new()
    let tr = trajectory_spiral(20)
    let traj_node = viz_add_trajectory(&!scene, tr, viz_layout_rect(10, 10, 140, 70))
    let slider = viz_add_control(&!scene, VIZ_CONTROL_SLIDER, viz_layout_rect(10, 92, 140, 20), 0.0, 0.0, 19.0)
    assert(traj_node == 0)
    assert(slider == 1)

    viz_scene_set_time(&!scene, 0.0)
    var c0 = make_canvas(180, 130)
    canvas_clear(&!c0, 0, 0, 0)
    viz_canvas_render_scene(&scene, &!c0)
    let start_cursor_px = read_px(&c0, 92, 45)
    heap_free(c0.pixels as *mut i8)

    let selected = viz_scene_pointer_down(&!scene, 10, 100)
    assert(selected == slider)
    assert(scene.selected_node == slider)
    let updated = viz_scene_pointer_update(&!scene, 150, 100)
    assert(updated == slider)
    assert(scene.nodes[slider as usize].value == 19.0)
    assert(scene.time == 19.0)

    var c1 = make_canvas(180, 130)
    canvas_clear(&!c1, 0, 0, 0)
    viz_canvas_render_scene(&scene, &!c1)
    assert(read_px(&c1, 100, 41) != 0)
    heap_free(c1.pixels as *mut i8)

    let clamped = viz_scene_pointer_update(&!scene, 0, 100)
    assert(clamped == slider)
    assert(scene.nodes[slider as usize].value == 0.0)
    assert(scene.time == 0.0)
    assert(start_cursor_px != 0)

    println("VIZ_INTERACTION_TIME_PASS")
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/viz_lab_interaction.sio ===
// tests/run-pass/viz_lab_interaction.sio - live Visual IR lab interaction proof
//
// Expected output includes:
//   VIZ_LAB_INTERACTION_PASS

use display::canvas::{Canvas, canvas_clear}
use display::event::{Event, EV_KEY_PRESS, EV_MOUSE_PRESS, EV_MOTION, KEY_TAB, KEY_SPACE, KEY_RIGHT, MOUSE_LEFT}
use viz::ir::{
    viz_scene_new, viz_layout_rect, viz_style_rgb,
    viz_add_line_chart, viz_add_uncertainty_band, viz_add_heatmap, viz_add_molecule,
    viz_add_scalar_field, viz_add_control, viz_scene_set_tag,
    viz_scene_set_parent, viz_scene_dump,
    VIZ_CONTROL_SLIDER, VIZ_CONTROL_TABS, VIZ_CONTROL_TOGGLE,
}
use viz::physchem::{molecule_h2o, scalar_field_radial}
use viz::viz_app::{viz_app_new, viz_app_handle_event, viz_app_frame_hash}
use viz::viz_canvas::{viz_canvas_render_scene}

fn make_canvas(w: i64, h: i64) -> Canvas with Alloc {
    let pix = heap_alloc(w * h * 8) as *mut i64
    Canvas { pixels: pix, width: w, height: h }
}

fn read_px(c: &Canvas, x: i64, y: i64) -> i64 {
    read_i64(c.pixels, y * c.width + x)
}

fn ev(kind: i64, key: i64, x: i64, y: i64) -> Event {
    Event { kind: kind, key: key, x: x, y: y, mods: 0 }
}

fn main() with IO, Alloc, Mut, Div {
    var scene = viz_scene_new()
    var app = viz_app_new(8, 12, 18)
    var canvas = make_canvas(320, 240)

    var xs: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var ys: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var vars: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 16 {
        xs[i as usize] = i as f64
        ys[i as usize] = 4.0 + (i as f64) * 0.25
        vars[i as usize] = 0.05 + (i as f64) * 0.01
        i = i + 1
    }

    let mol = molecule_h2o()
    let field = scalar_field_radial(8, 8)

    let plot = viz_add_line_chart(&!scene, &xs, &ys, 16, viz_layout_rect(16, 16, 130, 80), viz_style_rgb(255, 140, 90))
    let band = viz_add_uncertainty_band(&!scene, &xs, &ys, &vars, 16, viz_layout_rect(164, 16, 130, 80), viz_style_rgb(90, 190, 255))
    let heat = viz_add_heatmap(&!scene, &field.values, field.rows, field.cols, field.min_value, field.max_value, viz_layout_rect(16, 116, 110, 80))
    let slider = viz_add_control(&!scene, VIZ_CONTROL_SLIDER, viz_layout_rect(156, 130, 120, 22), 2.0, 0.0, 10.0)
    let toggle = viz_add_control(&!scene, VIZ_CONTROL_TOGGLE, viz_layout_rect(236, 132, 28, 18), 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    let mol_node = viz_add_molecule(&!scene, mol, viz_layout_rect(148, 168, 72, 54), viz_style_rgb(210, 220, 240))
    let field_node = viz_add_scalar_field(&!scene, field, viz_layout_rect(236, 168, 64, 54))
    let tabs = viz_add_control(&!scene, VIZ_CONTROL_TABS, viz_layout_rect(16, 204, 108, 20), 0.0, 0.0, 3.0)

    viz_scene_set_tag(&!scene, plot, 1001)
    viz_scene_set_tag(&!scene, band, 1002)
    viz_scene_set_tag(&!scene, slider, 2001)
    viz_scene_set_tag(&!scene, toggle, 2002)
    viz_scene_set_tag(&!scene, tabs, 2003)
    viz_scene_set_parent(&!scene, band, plot)
    viz_scene_set_parent(&!scene, slider, plot)
    viz_scene_set_parent(&!scene, toggle, band)
    assert(scene.node_count == 8)
    assert(scene.nodes[band as usize].parent_id == scene.nodes[plot as usize].id)
    assert(scene.nodes[slider as usize].tag == 2001)
    assert(heat >= 0)
    assert(mol_node >= 0)
    assert(field_node >= 0)

    canvas_clear(&!canvas, app.bg_r, app.bg_g, app.bg_b)
    viz_canvas_render_scene(&scene, &!canvas)
    app.frame = app.frame + 1
    app.dirty = false
    let initial_hash = viz_app_frame_hash(&app, &scene, &canvas)
    assert(app.frame == 1)
    assert(initial_hash != 0)

    assert(viz_app_handle_event(&!app, &!scene, ev(EV_MOUSE_PRESS, MOUSE_LEFT, 168, 140)))
    assert(scene.selected_node == slider)
    assert(scene.focused_node == slider)
    assert(viz_app_handle_event(&!app, &!scene, ev(EV_MOTION, 0, 216, 140)))
    assert(scene.time == 5.0)
    assert(scene.nodes[slider as usize].value == 5.0)

    assert(viz_app_handle_event(&!app, &!scene, ev(EV_MOUSE_PRESS, MOUSE_LEFT, 98, 212)))
    assert(scene.selected_node == tabs)
    assert(scene.active_tab == 3)
    assert(viz_app_handle_event(&!app, &!scene, ev(EV_KEY_PRESS, KEY_RIGHT, 0, 0)))
    assert(scene.active_tab == 3)

    scene.selected_node = 0 - 1
    scene.hovered_node = 0 - 1
    scene.focused_node = slider
    assert(viz_app_handle_event(&!app, &!scene, ev(EV_KEY_PRESS, KEY_TAB, 0, 0)))
    assert(scene.focused_node == toggle)
    assert(viz_app_handle_event(&!app, &!scene, ev(EV_KEY_PRESS, KEY_SPACE, 0, 0)))
    assert(scene.nodes[toggle as usize].value == 1.0)

    canvas_clear(&!canvas, app.bg_r, app.bg_g, app.bg_b)
    viz_canvas_render_scene(&scene, &!canvas)
    app.frame = app.frame + 1
    app.dirty = false
    let final_hash = viz_app_frame_hash(&app, &scene, &canvas)
    assert(final_hash != initial_hash)
    assert(read_px(&canvas, 30, 30) != 0)
    assert(read_px(&canvas, 20, 120) != 0)
    assert(read_px(&canvas, 160, 195) != 0)

    viz_scene_dump(&scene)

    heap_free(canvas.pixels as *mut i8)
    println("VIZ_LAB_INTERACTION_PASS")
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/viz_layout.sio ===
// tests/run-pass/viz_layout.sio - Visual IR row/column layout smoke test
//
// Expected output:
//   VIZ_LAYOUT_PASS

use display::canvas::{Canvas, canvas_clear}
use viz::ir::{viz_scene_new, viz_layout_rect, viz_layout_row, viz_layout_column, viz_add_control, viz_scene_apply_layout_range, viz_scene_hit_test, VIZ_CONTROL_BUTTON, VIZ_CONTROL_SLIDER, VIZ_CONTROL_TOGGLE}
use viz::viz_canvas::{viz_canvas_render_scene}

fn make_canvas(w: i64, h: i64) -> Canvas with Alloc {
    let pix = heap_alloc(w * h * 8) as *mut i64
    Canvas { pixels: pix, width: w, height: h }
}

fn read_px(c: &Canvas, x: i64, y: i64) -> i64 {
    read_i64(c.pixels, y * c.width + x)
}

fn main() with IO, Alloc, Mut, Div {
    var scene = viz_scene_new()
    let first = viz_add_control(&!scene, VIZ_CONTROL_BUTTON, viz_layout_rect(0, 0, 1, 1), 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    let second = viz_add_control(&!scene, VIZ_CONTROL_SLIDER, viz_layout_rect(0, 0, 1, 1), 0.5, 0.0, 1.0)
    let third = viz_add_control(&!scene, VIZ_CONTROL_TOGGLE, viz_layout_rect(0, 0, 1, 1), 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    assert(first == 0)
    assert(second == 1)
    assert(third == 2)

    viz_scene_apply_layout_range(&!scene, first, 3, viz_layout_row(10, 20, 150, 30, 5))
    assert(scene.nodes[0].layout.x == 10)
    assert(scene.nodes[0].layout.w == 46)
    assert(scene.nodes[1].layout.x == 61)
    assert(scene.nodes[2].layout.x == 112)
    assert(scene.nodes[2].layout.h == 30)
    let row_hit = viz_scene_hit_test(&scene, 70, 25)
    assert(row_hit == 1)

    viz_scene_apply_layout_range(&!scene, first, 3, viz_layout_column(20, 60, 80, 90, 6))
    assert(scene.nodes[0].layout.y == 60)
    assert(scene.nodes[0].layout.h == 26)
    assert(scene.nodes[1].layout.y == 92)
    assert(scene.nodes[2].layout.y == 124)
    let col_hit = viz_scene_hit_test(&scene, 25, 135)
    assert(col_hit == 2)

    var c = make_canvas(160, 180)
    canvas_clear(&!c, 0, 0, 0)
    viz_canvas_render_scene(&scene, &!c)
    assert(read_px(&c, 20, 60) != 0)
    assert(read_px(&c, 20, 103) != 0)
    assert(read_px(&c, 20, 124) != 0)
    heap_free(c.pixels as *mut i8)

    println("VIZ_LAYOUT_PASS")
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/viz_physchem.sio ===
// tests/run-pass/viz_physchem.sio - Physico-chemistry Visual IR smoke test
//
// Expected output:
//   VIZ_PHYSCHEM_PASS

use display::canvas::{Canvas, canvas_clear}
use viz::ir::{viz_scene_new, viz_layout_rect, viz_style_rgb, viz_scene_set_time, viz_add_molecule, viz_add_scalar_field, viz_add_vector_field, viz_add_trajectory, viz_add_spectrum}
use viz::viz_canvas::{viz_canvas_render_scene}
use viz::physchem::{molecule_h2o, molecule_rapamycin_coarse, scalar_field_radial, vector_field_vortex, trajectory_spiral, spectrum_absorption_demo, lattice_field_phonon_demo, particle_event_view_demo}

fn make_canvas(w: i64, h: i64) -> Canvas with Alloc {
    let pix = heap_alloc(w * h * 8) as *mut i64
    Canvas { pixels: pix, width: w, height: h }
}

fn read_px(c: &Canvas, x: i64, y: i64) -> i64 {
    read_i64(c.pixels, y * c.width + x)
}

fn main() with IO, Alloc, Mut, Div {
    let water = molecule_h2o()
    assert(water.atom_count == 3)
    assert(water.bond_count == 2)
    assert(water.atoms[0].atomic_number == 8)
    assert(water.bonds[0].order == 1)
    assert(water.bonds[0].variance > 0.0)

    let rap = molecule_rapamycin_coarse()
    assert(rap.atom_count == 44)
    assert(rap.bond_count == 45)
    assert(rap.atoms[30].atomic_number == 7)
    assert(rap.bonds[30].atom_a == 30)
    assert(rap.bonds[30].atom_b == 0)

    let field = scalar_field_radial(8, 8)
    assert(field.rows == 8)
    assert(field.cols == 8)
    assert(field.max_value > field.min_value)
    assert(field.variances[0] > 0.0)

    let vectors = vector_field_vortex(4, 4)
    assert(vectors.rows == 4)
    assert(vectors.cols == 4)
    assert(vectors.vx[0] != 0.0)
    assert(vectors.vy[15] != 0.0)
    assert(vectors.variance[0] > 0.0)

    let traj = trajectory_spiral(24)
    assert(traj.n == 24)
    assert(traj.x[0] != traj.x[5])
    assert(traj.z[23] > traj.z[0])
    assert(traj.variance[10] > 0.0)

    let spectrum = spectrum_absorption_demo(32)
    assert(spectrum.n == 32)
    assert(spectrum.x_max > spectrum.x_min)
    assert(spectrum.y_max > spectrum.y_min)
    assert(spectrum.variance[5] > 0.0)

    let lattice = lattice_field_phonon_demo(4, 4)
    assert(lattice.rows == 4)
    assert(lattice.cols == 4)
    assert(lattice.phase[5] > 0.0)
    assert(lattice.variance[15] > 0.0)

    let events = particle_event_view_demo(12)
    assert(events.n == 12)
    assert(events.energy[11] > events.energy[0])
    assert(events.kind[5] == 2)
    assert(events.variance[3] > 0.0)

    var scene = viz_scene_new()
    viz_scene_set_time(&!scene, 7.0)
    let water_node = viz_add_molecule(&!scene, water, viz_layout_rect(8, 8, 64, 64), viz_style_rgb(210, 220, 240))
    let rap_node = viz_add_molecule(&!scene, rap, viz_layout_rect(88, 8, 64, 64), viz_style_rgb(180, 210, 160))
    let field_node = viz_add_scalar_field(&!scene, field, viz_layout_rect(8, 88, 64, 64))
    let vector_node = viz_add_vector_field(&!scene, vectors, viz_layout_rect(88, 88, 64, 64))
    let traj_node = viz_add_trajectory(&!scene, traj, viz_layout_rect(8, 156, 144, 64))
    let spectrum_node = viz_add_spectrum(&!scene, spectrum, viz_layout_rect(8, 224, 144, 48))
    assert(water_node == 0)
    assert(rap_node == 1)
    assert(field_node == 2)
    assert(vector_node == 3)
    assert(traj_node == 4)
    assert(spectrum_node == 5)
    assert(scene.time == 7.0)
    assert(scene.molecule_count == 2)
    assert(scene.field_count == 1)
    assert(scene.vector_field_count == 1)
    assert(scene.trajectory_count == 1)
    assert(scene.spectrum_count == 1)
    assert(scene.vector_field_rows[0] == 4)
    assert(scene.vector_field_cols[0] == 4)
    assert(scene.vector_data[0].vx[0] == vectors.vx[0])
    assert(scene.vector_data[0].vy[15] == vectors.vy[15])
    assert(scene.trajectory_data[0].n == 24)
    assert(scene.trajectory_data[0].x[5] == traj.x[5])
    assert(scene.spectrum_data[0].n == 32)
    assert(scene.spectrum_data[0].intensity[5] == spectrum.intensity[5])
    assert(scene.field_heatmap_slots[0] >= 0)
    assert(scene.heatmaps[scene.field_heatmap_slots[0] as usize].values[63] == field.values[63])

    var c = make_canvas(180, 290)
    canvas_clear(&!c, 0, 0, 0)
    viz_canvas_render_scene(&scene, &!c)
    assert(read_px(&c, 40, 40) != 0)
    assert(read_px(&c, 120, 40) != 0)
    assert(read_px(&c, 40, 120) != 0)
    assert(read_px(&c, 88, 88) != 0)
    assert(read_px(&c, 8, 156) != 0)
    assert(read_px(&c, 8, 224) != 0)
    heap_free(c.pixels as *mut i8)

    println("VIZ_PHYSCHEM_PASS")
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/viz_renderer3d_edges.sio ===
// tests/run-pass/viz_renderer3d_edges.sio - renderer3d face and edge proof
//
// Expected output:
//   VIZ_RENDERER3D_EDGES_PASS

use display::canvas::{Canvas, canvas_clear}
use render::renderer3d::{Camera3D, Light3D, Tri3D, r3d_depth_buf_alloc, r3d_depth_buf_clear, r3d_render}

fn make_canvas(w: i64, h: i64) -> Canvas with Alloc {
    let pix = heap_alloc(w * h * 8) as *mut i64
    Canvas { pixels: pix, width: w, height: h }
}

fn read_px(c: &Canvas, x: i64, y: i64) -> i64 {
    read_i64(c.pixels, y * c.width + x)
}

fn count_nonzero_rect(c: &Canvas, x: i64, y: i64, w: i64, h: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    var count: i64 = 0
    var yy: i64 = y
    while yy < y + h {
        var xx: i64 = x
        while xx < x + w {
            if read_px(c, xx, yy) != 0 {
                count = count + 1
            }
            xx = xx + 1
        }
        yy = yy + 1
    }
    count
}

fn main() with IO, Alloc, Mut, Div {
    var c = make_canvas(96, 96)
    canvas_clear(&!c, 0, 0, 0)
    let depth = r3d_depth_buf_alloc(c.width, c.height)
    r3d_depth_buf_clear(depth, c.width, c.height)

    var tris: [Tri3D; 4096] = [Tri3D {
        v0x: -0.45, v0y: -0.35, v0z: -2.0,
        v1x: 0.45, v1y: -0.35, v1z: -2.0,
        v2x: 0.0, v2y: 0.45, v2z: -2.0,
        nx: 0.0, ny: 0.0, nz: 1.0,
        base_r: 90, base_g: 140, base_b: 210,
    }; 4096]
    let cam = Camera3D { pos_x: 0.0, pos_y: 0.0, pos_z: 0.0, focal: 72.0 }
    let light = Light3D { dx: 0.0, dy: 0.0, dz: 1.0, r: 255, g: 255, b: 255, ambient: 0.15 }
    r3d_render(&tris, 1, &cam, &light, depth, &!c)

    let face_px = read_px(&c, 48, 48)
    let edge_count = count_nonzero_rect(&c, 30, 60, 36, 8)
    assert(face_px != 0)
    assert(edge_count > 8)

    heap_free(depth as *mut i8)
    heap_free(c.pixels as *mut i8)
    println("VIZ_RENDERER3D_EDGES_PASS")
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/viz_replay_deterministic.sio ===
// tests/run-pass/viz_replay_deterministic.sio - deterministic replay proof
//
// Expected output:
//   VIZ_REPLAY_DETERMINISTIC_PASS

use display::canvas::{Canvas}
use display::event::{Event, EV_KEY_PRESS, EV_MOUSE_PRESS, EV_MOUSE_RELEASE, EV_MOTION, KEY_TAB, KEY_SPACE, KEY_RIGHT, MOUSE_LEFT}
use viz::ir::{
    VizScene, viz_scene_new, viz_layout_rect, viz_style_rgb,
    viz_add_line_chart, viz_add_slider, viz_add_tabs, viz_add_toggle,
    viz_scene_set_tag,
}
use viz::viz_app::{viz_app_new}
use viz::viz_replay::{viz_replay_events, viz_replay_dump}

fn make_canvas(w: i64, h: i64) -> Canvas with Alloc {
    let pix = heap_alloc(w * h * 8) as *mut i64
    Canvas { pixels: pix, width: w, height: h }
}

fn ev(kind: i64, key: i64, x: i64, y: i64) -> Event {
    Event { kind: kind, key: key, x: x, y: y, mods: 0 }
}

fn build_scene() -> VizScene with Mut {
    var scene = viz_scene_new()
    var xs: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var ys: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 {
        xs[i as usize] = i as f64
        ys[i as usize] = 2.0 + (i as f64) * 0.5
        i = i + 1
    }
    let plot = viz_add_line_chart(&!scene, &xs, &ys, 8, viz_layout_rect(8, 8, 96, 54), viz_style_rgb(255, 150, 80))
    let slider = viz_add_slider(&!scene, viz_layout_rect(112, 12, 96, 18), 0.0, 0.0, 10.0, viz_style_rgb(90, 190, 255))
    let tabs = viz_add_tabs(&!scene, viz_layout_rect(112, 38, 96, 18), 0, 0, 3, viz_style_rgb(180, 130, 250))
    let toggle = viz_add_toggle(&!scene, viz_layout_rect(216, 14, 26, 18), false, viz_style_rgb(120, 220, 150))
    viz_scene_set_tag(&!scene, plot, 3101)
    viz_scene_set_tag(&!scene, slider, 3102)
    viz_scene_set_tag(&!scene, tabs, 3103)
    viz_scene_set_tag(&!scene, toggle, 3104)
    scene
}

fn main() with IO, Alloc, Mut, Div {
    var events: [Event; 32] = [ev(0, 0, 0, 0); 32]
    events[0] = ev(EV_MOUSE_PRESS, MOUSE_LEFT, 112, 20)
    events[1] = ev(EV_MOTION, 0, 160, 20)
    events[2] = ev(EV_MOUSE_RELEASE, MOUSE_LEFT, 160, 20)
    events[3] = ev(EV_MOUSE_PRESS, MOUSE_LEFT, 204, 46)
    events[4] = ev(EV_KEY_PRESS, KEY_RIGHT, 0, 0)
    events[5] = ev(EV_MOUSE_RELEASE, MOUSE_LEFT, 204, 46)
    events[6] = ev(EV_KEY_PRESS, KEY_TAB, 0, 0)
    events[7] = ev(EV_MOTION, 0, 228, 20)
    events[8] = ev(EV_KEY_PRESS, KEY_SPACE, 0, 0)

    var scene_a = build_scene()
    var scene_b = build_scene()
    var app_a = viz_app_new(8, 12, 18)
    var app_b = viz_app_new(8, 12, 18)
    var canvas_a = make_canvas(260, 90)
    var canvas_b = make_canvas(260, 90)

    let hash_a = viz_replay_events(&!app_a, &!scene_a, &!canvas_a, &events, 9)
    let hash_b = viz_replay_events(&!app_b, &!scene_b, &!canvas_b, &events, 9)

    viz_replay_dump(&scene_a)

    assert(hash_a == hash_b)
    assert(hash_a != 0)
    assert(app_a.frame == app_b.frame)
    assert(scene_a.time == scene_b.time)
    assert(scene_a.active_tab == scene_b.active_tab)
    assert(scene_a.focused_node == scene_b.focused_node)
    assert(scene_a.nodes[3].value == 1.0)
    assert(scene_b.nodes[3].value == 1.0)

    heap_free(canvas_a.pixels as *mut i8)
    heap_free(canvas_b.pixels as *mut i8)
    println("VIZ_REPLAY_DETERMINISTIC_PASS")
}

use display::canvas::{Canvas}

use viz::ir::{
    VizScene, viz_scene_new, viz_layout_rect, viz_style_rgb,

}
use viz::audit::{viz_audit_hash}
use viz::viz_app::{viz_app_new}

fn make_canvas(w: i64, h: i64) -> Canvas with Alloc {
    let pix = heap_alloc(w * h * 8) as *mut i64
    Canvas { pixels: pix, width: w, height: h }
}

fn ev(kind: i64, key: i64, x: i64, y: i64) -> Event {

}

fn build_scene() -> VizScene with Mut {
    var scene = viz_scene_new()
    let slider = viz_add_slider(&!scene, viz_layout_rect(16, 16, 120, 18), 0.0, 0.0, 10.0, viz_style_rgb(90, 190, 255))
    let toggle = viz_add_toggle(&!scene, viz_layout_rect(152, 16, 26, 18), false, viz_style_rgb(120, 220, 150))
    viz_scene_set_tag(&!scene, slider, 5101)
    viz_scene_set_tag(&!scene, toggle, 5102)

}

fn main() with IO, Alloc, Mut, Div {
    var events: [Event; 32] = [ev(0, 0, 0, 0); 32]
    events[0] = ev(EV_MOUSE_PRESS, MOUSE_LEFT, 16, 24)
    events[1] = ev(EV_MOTION, 0, 76, 24)
    events[2] = ev(EV_MOUSE_RELEASE, MOUSE_LEFT, 76, 24)
    events[3] = ev(EV_KEY_PRESS, KEY_TAB, 0, 0)
    events[4] = ev(EV_MOTION, 0, 164, 24)
    events[5] = ev(EV_KEY_PRESS, KEY_SPACE, 0, 0)

    var scene = build_scene()
    var app = viz_app_new(8, 12, 18)
    var canvas = make_canvas(220, 64)
    let trace = viz_replay_trace_events(&!app, &!scene, &!canvas, &events, 6)

    assert(trace.count == 7)
    assert(trace.frames[0].frame == 1)
    assert(trace.frames[1].event_kind == EV_MOUSE_PRESS)
    assert(trace.frames[2].time_i == 5)
    assert(trace.frames[6].event_key == KEY_SPACE)
    assert(trace.frames[6].focused_node == 1)
    assert(trace.frames[6].selected_node < 0)
    assert(trace.frames[6].hovered_node == 1)
    assert(trace.frames[6].audit_hash == viz_audit_hash(&scene))
    assert(trace.frames[6].canvas_hash != trace.frames[0].canvas_hash)
    assert(scene.nodes[1].value == 1.0)

// === FILE: tests/run-pass/viz_text_controls.sio ===
// tests/run-pass/viz_text_controls.sio - label, legend, tooltip Visual IR proof

use display::canvas::{Canvas, canvas_clear}
use viz::ir::{viz_scene_new, viz_layout_rect, viz_style_rgb, viz_add_label, viz_add_legend, viz_add_tooltip}
use viz::viz_canvas::{viz_canvas_render_scene}
use viz::viz_html::{viz_html_emit_scene}

fn make_canvas(w: i64, h: i64) -> Canvas with Alloc {
    let pix = heap_alloc(w * h * 8) as *mut i64
    Canvas { pixels: pix, width: w, height: h }
}

fn read_px(c: &Canvas, x: i64, y: i64) -> i64 {
    read_i64(c.pixels, y * c.width + x)
}

fn count_nonzero_rect(c: &Canvas, x: i64, y: i64, w: i64, h: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    var count: i64 = 0
    var yy: i64 = y
    while yy < y + h {
        var xx: i64 = x
        while xx < x + w {
            if read_px(c, xx, yy) != 0 {
                count = count + 1
            }
            xx = xx + 1
        }
        yy = yy + 1
    }

}

fn main() with IO, Alloc, Mut, Div {
    var title: [i8; 64] = [0; 64]
    title[0] = 83  // S
    title[1] = 111 // o
    title[2] = 117 // u
    title[3] = 110 // n
    title[4] = 105 // i
    title[5] = 111 // o
    title[6] = 32
    title[7] = 86  // V
    title[8] = 105 // i
    title[9] = 122 // z

    var legend: [i8; 64] = [0; 64]

    var tip: [i8; 64] = [0; 64]

    tip[4] = 32
    tip[5] = 38  // &

    tip[8] = 34  // "

    var scene = viz_scene_new()
    let label_id = viz_add_label(&!scene, &title, 10, viz_layout_rect(8, 8, 80, 12), viz_style_rgb(230, 235, 240))

    assert(scene.nodes[tip_id as usize].label[7] == 62)
    assert(scene.nodes[tip_id as usize].label[8] == 34)

    var c = make_canvas(140, 90)

    viz_canvas_render_scene(&scene, &!c)
    assert(count_nonzero_rect(&c, 8, 8, 80, 12) > 0)
    assert(count_nonzero_rect(&c, 8, 28, 96, 18) > 0)
    assert(count_nonzero_rect(&c, 8, 54, 110, 18) > 0)
    heap_free(c.pixels as *mut i8)

// === FILE: tests/run-pass/wavelet_haar_roundtrip.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL TESTS PASSED
//@ expect-stdout: Failed: 0
// Haar Wavelet Roundtrip and Energy Preservation Tests
//
// Self-contained tests validating:
//   1. Perfect reconstruction: Haar fwd → inv recovers original signal
//   2. Energy preservation (Parseval): ||signal||^2 = ||approx||^2 + ||detail||^2
//   3. Alternating signal detail extraction
//   4. Zero-threshold denoising is identity
//   5. SNR of perfect reconstruction is effectively infinite
//   6. Hard thresholding reduces energy of high-frequency signal
//
// All functions inlined (tests cannot import stdlib).
//
// References:
//   Daubechies (1992): "Ten Lectures on Wavelets", SIAM
//   Mallat (1989): "A theory for multiresolution signal decomposition"

// ============================================================================
// MATH HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    return y
}

fn log10_approx(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 - 1000.0 }
    var v = x
    var exponent: i64 = 0
    while v > 2.0 { v = v / 2.0 ; exponent = exponent + 1 }
    while v < 0.5 { v = v * 2.0 ; exponent = exponent - 1 }
    let u = (v - 1.0) / (v + 1.0)
    let u2 = u * u
    let ln_v = 2.0 * u * (1.0 + u2 / 3.0 + u2 * u2 / 5.0 + u2 * u2 * u2 / 7.0 + u2 * u2 * u2 * u2 / 9.0)
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    let log10e = 0.4342944819032518
    return log10e * (ln_v + (exponent as f64) * ln2)
}

// ============================================================================
// HAAR WAVELET (inlined from stdlib/signal/wavelets.sio)
//
// Forward:
//   approx[i] = (signal[2i] + signal[2i+1]) / sqrt(2)
//   detail[i]  = (signal[2i] - signal[2i+1]) / sqrt(2)
//
// Inverse:
//   signal[2i]   = (approx[i] + detail[i]) / sqrt(2)
//   signal[2i+1] = (approx[i] - detail[i]) / sqrt(2)
// ============================================================================

fn haar_forward(signal: [f64; 512], n: i64, out_approx: &! [f64; 256], out_detail: &! [f64; 256]) -> i64 with Mut {
    let inv_sqrt2 = 0.70710678118654752440
    let half_n = n / 2
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < half_n {
        let a = signal[(2 * i) as usize]
        let b = signal[(2 * i + 1) as usize]
        out_approx[i as usize] = (a + b) * inv_sqrt2
        out_detail[i as usize]  = (a - b) * inv_sqrt2
        i = i + 1
    }
    return half_n
}

fn haar_inverse(approx: [f64; 256], detail: [f64; 256], n: i64, out: &! [f64; 512]) -> i64 with Mut {
    let inv_sqrt2 = 0.70710678118654752440
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        let a = approx[i as usize]
        let d = detail[i as usize]
        out[(2 * i) as usize]       = (a + d) * inv_sqrt2
        out[(2 * i + 1) as usize]   = (a - d) * inv_sqrt2
        i = i + 1
    }
    return 2 * n
}

// ============================================================================
// ENERGY, SNR, THRESHOLD HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn energy_512(signal: [f64; 512], n: i64) -> f64 with Mut {
    var e = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        let x = signal[i as usize]
        e = e + x * x
        i = i + 1
    }
    return e
}

fn energy_256(signal: [f64; 256], n: i64) -> f64 with Mut {
    var e = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        let x = signal[i as usize]
        e = e + x * x
        i = i + 1
    }
    return e
}

fn snr_512(original: [f64; 512], reconstructed: [f64; 512], n: i64) -> f64 with Mut {
    var e_sig = 0.0
    var e_noise = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        let o = original[i as usize]
        let r = reconstructed[i as usize]
        e_sig = e_sig + o * o
        let d = o - r
        e_noise = e_noise + d * d
        i = i + 1
    }
    if e_noise < 1.0e-300 { return 1000.0 }
    if e_sig < 1.0e-300 { return 0.0 }
    return 10.0 * log10_approx(e_sig / e_noise)
}

// Hard threshold applied inline on detail array
fn hard_threshold_inplace(detail: &! [f64; 256], n: i64, thresh: f64) -> i64 with Mut {
    var surviving: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        let v = detail[i as usize]
        if abs_f64(v) < thresh {
            detail[i as usize] = 0.0
        } else {
            surviving = surviving + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return surviving
}

// ============================================================================
// TEST FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

// Test 1: Haar roundtrip on constant signal — exact reconstruction within 0.0001
fn test_roundtrip_constant() -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var sig: [f64; 512] = [0.0; 512]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 64 {
        sig[i as usize] = 5.0
        i = i + 1
    }
    var approx: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var detail: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    let half = haar_forward(sig, 64, &! approx, &! detail)
    var recon: [f64; 512] = [0.0; 512]
    let _len = haar_inverse(approx, detail, half, &! recon)
    i = 0
    while i < 64 {
        if abs_f64(recon[i as usize] - 5.0) > 0.0001 { return false }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return true
}

// Test 2: Haar roundtrip on linear signal [0, 1, 2, ..., 31]
fn test_roundtrip_linear() -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var sig: [f64; 512] = [0.0; 512]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 32 {
        sig[i as usize] = i as f64
        i = i + 1
    }
    var approx: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var detail: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    let half = haar_forward(sig, 32, &! approx, &! detail)
    var recon: [f64; 512] = [0.0; 512]
    let _len = haar_inverse(approx, detail, half, &! recon)
    i = 0
    while i < 32 {
        if abs_f64(recon[i as usize] - (i as f64)) > 0.0001 { return false }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return true
}

// Test 3: Energy preserved — ||signal||^2 = ||approx||^2 + ||detail||^2
fn test_energy_preserved_constant() -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var sig: [f64; 512] = [0.0; 512]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 16 {
        sig[i as usize] = 3.0
        i = i + 1
    }
    let e_before = energy_512(sig, 16)  // 16 * 9 = 144
    var approx: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var detail: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    let half = haar_forward(sig, 16, &! approx, &! detail)
    let e_after = energy_256(approx, half) + energy_256(detail, half)
    return abs_f64(e_before - e_after) / e_before < 1.0e-10
}

// Test 4: Energy preserved on a mixed signal
fn test_energy_preserved_mixed() -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var sig: [f64; 512] = [0.0; 512]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 64 {
        if i % 2 == 0 {
            sig[i as usize] = (i as f64) * 0.1 + 1.0
        } else {
            sig[i as usize] = 0.0 - ((i as f64) * 0.05 + 0.5)
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    let e_before = energy_512(sig, 64)
    var approx: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var detail: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    let half = haar_forward(sig, 64, &! approx, &! detail)
    let e_after = energy_256(approx, half) + energy_256(detail, half)
    if e_before < 1.0e-15 { return true }
    return abs_f64(e_before - e_after) / e_before < 1.0e-10
}

// Test 5: Alternating signal has zero approximation and nonzero detail
fn test_alternating_all_detail() -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var sig: [f64; 512] = [0.0; 512]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 16 {
        if i % 2 == 0 { sig[i as usize] = 2.0 } else { sig[i as usize] = 0.0 - 2.0 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    var approx: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var detail: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    let half = haar_forward(sig, 16, &! approx, &! detail)
    // Constant pairs cancel → all approx should be 0
    i = 0
    while i < half {
        if abs_f64(approx[i as usize]) > 1.0e-12 { return false }
        i = i + 1
    }
    // Detail should be nonzero
    let e_detail = energy_256(detail, half)
    return e_detail > 1.0
}

// Test 6: SNR of perfect reconstruction is very high (> 200 dB)
// IEEE 754 double accumulates ~1e-16 relative error per multiply,
// giving ~300 dB in practice for this signal.
fn test_snr_perfect_reconstruction() -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var sig: [f64; 512] = [0.0; 512]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 32 {
        sig[i as usize] = (i as f64) * 0.5 + 1.0
        i = i + 1
    }
    var approx: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var detail: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    let half = haar_forward(sig, 32, &! approx, &! detail)
    var recon: [f64; 512] = [0.0; 512]
    let _len = haar_inverse(approx, detail, half, &! recon)
    let snr = snr_512(sig, recon, 32)
    return snr > 200.0
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN
// ============================================================================

fn run_tests(dummy: i64) -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var passed = 0
    var failed = 0

    print("Test 1: Haar roundtrip constant signal (err < 0.0001) . ")
    if test_roundtrip_constant() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    print("Test 2: Haar roundtrip linear signal [0..31] .......... ")
    if test_roundtrip_linear() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    print("Test 3: Energy preserved: E_sig = E_approx + E_detail . ")
    if test_energy_preserved_constant() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    print("Test 4: Energy preserved on mixed signal ............... ")
    if test_energy_preserved_mixed() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    print("Test 5: Alternating signal → all detail, zero approx .. ")
    if test_alternating_all_detail() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    print("Test 6: SNR of perfect reconstruction > 200 dB ........ ")
    if test_snr_perfect_reconstruction() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    println("")
    print("Passed: ")
    println(passed)
    print("Failed: ")
    println(failed)

    if failed > 0 {
        println("SOME TESTS FAILED")
        return 1
    }
    println("ALL TESTS PASSED")
    return 0
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    println("=== Haar Wavelet Roundtrip & Energy Preservation Tests ===")
    println("")
    return run_tests(0)
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/while_for_struct_patterns.sio ===
//@ run-pass

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var passed: i32 = 0
    var failed: i32 = 0

    // T1: for loop basic range (already works)
    var sum: i64 = 0
    for i in 0..5 { sum = sum + i }
    if sum == 10 { passed = passed + 1 } else { println("T1 FAIL"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // T2: for loop with variable upper bound
    let n: i64 = 6
    var cnt: i64 = 0
    for i in 0..n { cnt = cnt + 1 }
    if cnt == 6 { passed = passed + 1 } else { println("T2 FAIL"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // T3: while let Some — new feature
    var wl_sum: i64 = 0
    var wl_v: Option<i64> = Some(1)
    while let Some(x) = wl_v {
        wl_sum = wl_sum + x
        if x >= 3 { wl_v = None } else { wl_v = Some(x + 1) }
    }
    // sum: 1+2+3 = 6
    if wl_sum == 6 { passed = passed + 1 } else { println("T3 FAIL"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // T4: while let exits on None immediately
    var wl_none: Option<i64> = None
    var wl_hit: i64 = 0
    while let Some(x) = wl_none { wl_hit = wl_hit + 1 }
    if wl_hit == 0 { passed = passed + 1 } else { println("T4 FAIL"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // T5: for loop array building
    var arr: [i64; 5] = [0; 5]
    for i in 0..5 { arr[i as usize] = i * i }
    if arr[3] == 9 && arr[4] == 16 { passed = passed + 1 } else { println("T5 FAIL"); failed = failed + 1 }

    if failed == 0 { println("while_for_struct_patterns: ALL PASS") }
    else { println("while_for_struct_patterns: FAIL") }
    failed
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/while_struct_mutation_large.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// Test with larger struct (similar to PBPK compartment models)
// PBPK models have 10+ compartments, this tests scalability

struct Compartment {
    plasma: f64,
    liver: f64,
    kidney: f64,
    muscle: f64,
    fat: f64,
    brain: f64
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Div, Mut {
    var comp = Compartment {
        plasma: 100.0,
        liver: 0.0,
        kidney: 0.0,
        muscle: 0.0,
        fat: 0.0,
        brain: 0.0
    }

    var step = 0
    let k_distribution = 0.1

    // Simulate drug distribution for 20 time steps
    while step < 20 {
        // Simple distribution model: plasma -> organs
        let dose_to_organs = comp.plasma * k_distribution

        comp = Compartment {
            plasma: comp.plasma - dose_to_organs,
            liver: comp.liver + dose_to_organs * 0.3,
            kidney: comp.kidney + dose_to_organs * 0.2,
            muscle: comp.muscle + dose_to_organs * 0.25,
            fat: comp.fat + dose_to_organs * 0.15,
            brain: comp.brain + dose_to_organs * 0.1
        }

        step = step + 1
    }

    return 0
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/while_struct_mutation_minimal.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// Minimal reproduction of while-loop struct mutation bug
// Expected: should complete 20 iterations
// Actual (BUG): freezes after 2-5 iterations

struct State {
    x: f64
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Div, Mut {
    var s = State { x: 0.0 }
    var i = 0

    while i < 20 {
        // Print iteration for debugging
        s = State { x: s.x + 1.0 }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Should reach x = 20.0
    return 0
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/while_struct_mutation_nested.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// Test nested struct mutation in while loop
// This pattern appears in ODE solvers (RK4 state updates)

struct Vec2 {
    x: f64,
    y: f64
}

struct ODEState {
    pos: Vec2,
    vel: Vec2,
    time: f64
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Div, Mut {
    var state = ODEState {
        pos: Vec2 { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 },
        vel: Vec2 { x: 1.0, y: 0.0 },
        time: 0.0
    }

    var step = 0
    let dt = 0.1

    // Simulate 10 time steps
    while step < 10 {
        // Update position (Euler integration)
        let new_x = state.pos.x + state.vel.x * dt
        let new_y = state.pos.y + state.vel.y * dt

        state = ODEState {
            pos: Vec2 { x: new_x, y: new_y },
            vel: state.vel,
            time: state.time + dt
        }

        step = step + 1
    }

    // Should reach time = 1.0
    return 0
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/while_struct_mutation_ode.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// Regression test: 240-step ODE solver with struct mutation in while loop
// This pattern previously failed after 2-5 iterations (see stdlib/ode/PBPK_STABILITY_REPORT.md)
// Validates that struct reassignment inside while loops works for scientific computing

struct PBPKState {
    t: f64,
    gut: f64,
    central: f64,
    auc: f64
}

fn pbpk_euler_step(s: PBPKState, dt: f64) -> PBPKState {
    let ka = 1.0
    let ke = 0.1
    let d_gut = -ka * s.gut
    let d_central = ka * s.gut - ke * s.central

    PBPKState {
        t: s.t + dt,
        gut: s.gut + d_gut * dt,
        central: s.central + d_central * dt,
        auc: s.auc + s.central * dt
    }
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Div, Mut {
    var s = PBPKState { t: 0.0, gut: 500.0, central: 0.0, auc: 0.0 }
    let dt = 0.1
    var i = 0

    while i < 240 {
        s = pbpk_euler_step(s, dt)
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Verify 240 iterations completed correctly:
    // t should be 24.0 (24 simulated hours)
    if s.t < 23.9 { return 1 }
    // gut should be near 0 (fully absorbed after 24h with ka=1.0)
    if s.gut > 1.0 { return 2 }
    // AUC should be positive
    if s.auc < 100.0 { return 3 }

    return 0
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/while_struct_mutation_rk4.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// Regression test: RK4 integrator with nested struct returns in while loop
// 480 steps of a 3-compartment model using Runge-Kutta 2nd order

struct Conc {
    gut: f64,
    liver: f64,
    central: f64
}

struct StepResult {
    state: Conc,
    dt_used: f64
}

fn rk2_step(s: Conc, dt: f64) -> StepResult {
    // k1 derivatives
    let k1_gut = -1.0 * s.gut
    let k1_liver = 0.5 * s.gut - 0.3 * s.liver
    let k1_central = 0.3 * s.liver - 0.1 * s.central

    // k2 at midpoint
    let mid_gut = s.gut + 0.5 * dt * k1_gut
    let mid_liver = s.liver + 0.5 * dt * k1_liver
    let mid_central = s.central + 0.5 * dt * k1_central
    let k2_gut = -1.0 * mid_gut
    let k2_liver = 0.5 * mid_gut - 0.3 * mid_liver
    let k2_central = 0.3 * mid_liver - 0.1 * mid_central

    StepResult {
        state: Conc {
            gut: s.gut + dt * k2_gut,
            liver: s.liver + dt * k2_liver,
            central: s.central + dt * k2_central
        },
        dt_used: dt
    }
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Div, Mut {
    var s = Conc { gut: 500.0, liver: 0.0, central: 0.0 }
    let dt = 0.05
    var t = 0.0
    var i = 0

    while i < 480 {
        let result = rk2_step(s, dt)
        s = result.state
        t = t + result.dt_used
        i = i + 1
    }

    // After 24h: gut fully absorbed
    if s.gut > 1.0 { return 1 }
    // Time should be 24.0
    if t < 23.0 { return 2 }
    // 480 iterations completed
    if i != 480 { return 3 }

    return 0
}


// === FILE: tests/rustless-regressions/01_fibonacci.sio ===
// Rustless Regression Test 01: Fibonacci (Recursion)
//
// Tests: recursion, arithmetic, function calls, base cases

fn fib(n: i64) -> i64 {
    if n <= 1 {
        n
    } else {
        fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)
    }
}

fn main() -> i64 with IO {
    // Return fib(7) = 13 (reduced from fib(10) to avoid stack overflow in interpreter)
    fib(7)
}


// === FILE: tests/rustless-regressions/02_arithmetic.sio ===
// Rustless Regression Test 02: Arithmetic Operations
//
// Tests: add, sub, mul, div, mod, negation, comparisons

fn test_basic_arithmetic() -> i64 {
    let a = 10 + 5  // 15
    let b = 20 - 8  // 12
    let c = 6 * 7   // 42
    let d = 100 / 4 // 25
    let e = 17 % 5  // 2

    if a != 15 { return 1 }
    if b != 12 { return 2 }
    if c != 42 { return 3 }
    if d != 25 { return 4 }
    if e != 2  { return 5 }

    0
}

fn test_comparisons() -> i64 {
    if !(10 < 20)   { return 10 }
    if !(10 <= 10)  { return 11 }
    if !(20 > 10)   { return 12 }
    if !(20 >= 20)  { return 13 }
    if !(42 == 42)  { return 14 }
    if !(42 != 43)  { return 15 }

    0
}

fn test_negation() -> i64 {
    let x = 42
    let neg_x = -x

    if neg_x != -42 { return 20 }
    if -neg_x != 42 { return 21 }

    0
}

fn main() -> i64 with IO {
    let r1 = test_basic_arithmetic()
    if r1 != 0 { return r1 }

    let r2 = test_comparisons()
    if r2 != 0 { return r2 }

    let r3 = test_negation()
    if r3 != 0 { return r3 }

    0  // All tests passed
}


// === FILE: tests/rustless-regressions/03_control_flow.sio ===
// Rustless Regression Test 03: Control Flow
//
// Tests: if/else, nested conditions, boolean logic

fn test_simple_if(x: i64) -> i64 {
    if x > 10 {
        100
    } else {
        200
    }
}

fn test_nested_if(x: i64, y: i64) -> i64 {
    if x > 0 {
        if y > 0 {
            1
        } else {
            2
        }
    } else {
        if y > 0 {
            3
        } else {
            4
        }
    }
}

fn test_boolean_logic(a: bool, b: bool) -> i64 {
    if a && b {
        1
    } else if a || b {
        2
    } else {
        3
    }
}

fn main() -> i64 with IO {
    // Test simple if
    let r1 = test_simple_if(15)
    if r1 != 100 { return 1 }

    let r2 = test_simple_if(5)
    if r2 != 200 { return 2 }

    // Test nested if
    let r3 = test_nested_if(5, 5)
    if r3 != 1 { return 3 }

    let r4 = test_nested_if(5, -5)
    if r4 != 2 { return 4 }

    let r5 = test_nested_if(-5, 5)
    if r5 != 3 { return 5 }

    let r6 = test_nested_if(-5, -5)
    if r6 != 4 { return 6 }

    // Test boolean logic
    let r7 = test_boolean_logic(true, true)
    if r7 != 1 { return 7 }

    let r8 = test_boolean_logic(true, false)
    if r8 != 2 { return 8 }

    let r9 = test_boolean_logic(false, false)
    if r9 != 3 { return 9 }

    0  // All tests passed
}

fn add(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 {
    a + b
}

fn mul(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 {
    a * b
}

fn compute(x: i64, y: i64, z: i64) -> i64 {
    add(mul(x, y), z)
}

    x

    42
}

    if r1 != 30 { return 1 }

    let r2 = mul(6, 7)
    if r2 != 42 { return 2 }

    // Test function composition
    let r3 = compute(5, 6, 10)  // (5*6) + 10 = 40
    if r3 != 40 { return 3 }

    // Test identity
    let r4 = identity(99)
    if r4 != 99 { return 4 }

    // Test constant
    let r5 = constant()
    if r5 != 42 { return 5 }

    0  // All tests passed
}


// === FILE: tests/rustless-regressions/05_loops.sio ===
// Rustless Regression Test 05: Loops
//
// Tests: while loops, iteration, accumulation

fn sum_to_n(n: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    var sum: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 1

    while i <= n {
        sum = sum + i
        i = i + 1
    }

    sum
}

fn count_down(start: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    var count: i64 = start
    var iterations: i64 = 0

    while count > 0 {
        count = count - 1
        iterations = iterations + 1
    }

    iterations
}

fn factorial(n: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    var result: i64 = 1
    var i: i64 = 1

    while i <= n {
        result = result * i
        i = i + 1
    }

    result
}

fn main() -> i64 with IO, Mut {
    // Test sum_to_n
    let r1 = sum_to_n(10)  // 1+2+...+10 = 55
    if r1 != 55 { return 1 }

    // Test count_down
    let r2 = count_down(20)
    if r2 != 20 { return 2 }

    // Test factorial
    let r3 = factorial(5)  // 5! = 120
    if r3 != 120 { return 3 }

    let r4 = factorial(6)  // 6! = 720
    if r4 != 720 { return 4 }

    0  // All tests passed
}


// === FILE: tests/rustless-regressions/06_arrays.sio ===
// Rustless Regression Test 06: Arrays
//
// Tests: array indexing, array literals, array operations

fn sum_array(arr: [i64; 5]) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var sum: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 0

    while i < 5 {
        sum = sum + arr[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    sum
}

fn array_multiply(arr: [i64; 3], factor: i64) -> [i64; 3] with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var result: [i64; 3] = [0; 3]
    var i: i64 = 0

    while i < 3 {
        result[i] = arr[i] * factor
        i = i + 1
    }

    result
}

fn main() -> i64 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    // Test array literal and indexing
    let arr1: [i64; 5] = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

    if arr1[0] != 1 { return 1 }
    if arr1[2] != 3 { return 2 }
    if arr1[4] != 5 { return 3 }

    // Test sum_array
    let total = sum_array(arr1)
    if total != 15 { return 4 }  // 1+2+3+4+5 = 15

    // Test array_multiply
    let arr2: [i64; 3] = [10, 20, 30]
    let arr3 = array_multiply(arr2, 2)

    if arr3[0] != 20 { return 5 }
    if arr3[1] != 40 { return 6 }
    if arr3[2] != 60 { return 7 }

    // Test zero-initialized array
    let zeros: [i64; 4] = [0; 4]
    if zeros[0] != 0 { return 8 }
    if zeros[3] != 0 { return 9 }

    0  // All tests passed
}


// === FILE: tests/rustless-regressions/07_structs.sio ===
// Rustless Regression Test 07: Structs
//
// Tests: struct literals, field access, nested structs

struct Point {
    x: i64,
    y: i64,
}

struct Rectangle {
    top_left: Point,
    width: i64,
    height: i64,
}

fn point_distance_from_origin(p: Point) -> i64 {
    // Simplified Manhattan distance
    let abs_x = if p.x < 0 { -p.x } else { p.x }
    let abs_y = if p.y < 0 { -p.y } else { p.y }
    abs_x + abs_y
}

fn rectangle_area(r: Rectangle) -> i64 {
    r.width * r.height
}

fn main() -> i64 with IO {
    // Test simple struct
    let p1 = Point { x: 3, y: 4 }

    if p1.x != 3 { return 1 }
    if p1.y != 4 { return 2 }

    // Test function with struct parameter
    let dist = point_distance_from_origin(p1)
    if dist != 7 { return 3 }  // 3 + 4 = 7

    // Test nested struct
    let origin = Point { x: 0, y: 0 }
    let rect = Rectangle {
        top_left: origin,
        width: 10,
        height: 20,
    }

    if rect.top_left.x != 0 { return 4 }
    if rect.top_left.y != 0 { return 5 }
    if rect.width != 10 { return 6 }
    if rect.height != 20 { return 7 }

    // Test function with nested struct
    let area = rectangle_area(rect)
    if area != 200 { return 8 }  // 10 * 20 = 200

    0  // All tests passed
}

// === FILE: tests/rustless-regressions/09_integration.sio ===
// Rustless Regression Test 09: Comprehensive Integration
//
// Tests: combination of multiple features in a realistic scenario

struct TestResult {
    test_id: i64,
    passed: bool,
    score: i64,
}

fn run_arithmetic_tests() -> TestResult {
    let a = 100 + 50  // 150
    let b = a - 30    // 120
    let c = b * 2     // 240
    let d = c / 4     // 60

    let passed = (d == 60)

    TestResult {
        test_id: 1,
        passed: passed,
        score: if passed { 100 } else { 0 },
    }
}

fn run_loop_tests() -> TestResult with Mut {
    var sum: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 1

    while i <= 10 {
        sum = sum + i
        i = i + 1
    }

    let passed = (sum == 55)

    TestResult {
        test_id: 2,
        passed: passed,
        score: if passed { 100 } else { 0 },
    }
}

fn factorial_helper(n: i64) -> i64 {
    if n <= 1 {
        1
    } else {
        n * factorial_helper(n - 1)
    }
}

fn run_recursion_tests() -> TestResult {
    let result = factorial_helper(5)
    let passed = (result == 120)

    TestResult {
        test_id: 3,
        passed: passed,
        score: if passed { 100 } else { 0 },
    }
}

fn run_array_tests() -> TestResult with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let arr: [i64; 5] = [2, 4, 6, 8, 10]

    var sum: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 0

    while i < 5 {
        sum = sum + arr[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    let passed = (sum == 30)

    TestResult {
        test_id: 4,
        passed: passed,
        score: if passed { 100 } else { 0 },
    }
}

fn evaluate_results(r1: TestResult, r2: TestResult, r3: TestResult, r4: TestResult) -> i64 {
    if !r1.passed { return 1 }
    if !r2.passed { return 2 }
    if !r3.passed { return 3 }
    if !r4.passed { return 4 }

    let total_score = r1.score + r2.score + r3.score + r4.score

    if total_score == 400 {
        0  // Perfect score
    } else {
        5  // Something went wrong
    }
}

fn main() -> i64 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    // Run all test suites
    let result1 = run_arithmetic_tests()
    let result2 = run_loop_tests()
    let result3 = run_recursion_tests()
    let result4 = run_array_tests()

    // Evaluate combined results
    evaluate_results(result1, result2, result3, result4)
}

// === FILE: tests/selfhost/native_runtime/abi_inline_ptr_write_42.sio ===
extern "C" {
    fn malloc(size: usize) -> *mut u8;
}

struct Pair {
    a: i64,
    b: i64,

// === FILE: tests/selfhost/native_runtime/abi_return_literal_array_field_42.sio ===
struct Source {
    head: f64,
    vals: [f64; 8],
    tail: i64,
}

struct Result {
    head: f64,
    vals: [f64; 8],
    count: i64,
    success: i64,
}

fn make_source() -> Source with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var vals: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    vals[0] = 11.0
    vals[1] = 31.0
    return Source {
        head: 3.0,
        vals: vals,
        tail: 7,
    }
}

fn make_result() -> Result with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let src = make_source()
    return Result {
        head: src.head,
        vals: src.vals,
        count: src.tail + 35,
        success: 1,
    }
}

fn main() -> i32 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let result = make_result()
    if result.vals[0] != 11.0 { return 1 }
    if result.vals[1] != 31.0 { return 2 }
    if result.count != 42 { return 3 }
    if result.success != 1 { return 4 }
    return result.count as i32
}

// === FILE: tests/selfhost/native_runtime/closure_effect_sig_zero_42.sio ===
fn run0(f: fn() -> i64) -> i64 {
    f()
}

fn apply_io(f: fn(i64) -> i64 with IO, x: i64) -> i64 with IO {
    f(x)
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO {
    let const42 = || 42
    let echo = |x: i64| -> i64 with IO { x }
    let a = run0(const42)
    let b = apply_io(echo, 42)
    if a == 42 && b == 42 { 42 } else { 0 }
}

// === FILE: tests/selfhost/native_runtime/closure_higher_order_probe.sio ===
fn dbl(x: i64) -> i64 { x * 2 }
fn sq(x: i64) -> i64 { x * x }
fn add(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { a + b }
fn mul(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { a * b }
fn max2(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }
fn is_positive(x: i64) -> i64 { if x > 0 { 1 } else { 0 } }
fn is_gt3(x: i64) -> i64 { if x > 3 { 1 } else { 0 } }
fn is_gt10(x: i64) -> i64 { if x > 10 { 1 } else { 0 } }
fn is_gt2(x: i64) -> i64 { if x > 2 { 1 } else { 0 } }

fn map4(arr: [i64; 4], f: fn(i64) -> i64) -> [i64; 4] with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var out: [i64; 4] = [0; 4]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 4 { out[i] = f(arr[i]); i = i + 1 }
    out
}

fn fold4(arr: [i64; 4], init: i64, f: fn(i64, i64) -> i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var acc = init
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 4 { acc = f(acc, arr[i]); i = i + 1 }
    acc
}

fn any4(arr: [i64; 4], pred: fn(i64) -> i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 4 {
        if pred(arr[i]) != 0 { return 1 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    0
}

fn all4(arr: [i64; 4], pred: fn(i64) -> i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 4 {
        if pred(arr[i]) == 0 { return 0 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    1
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let data: [i64; 4] = [1, 2, 3, 4]

    let doubled = map4(data, dbl)
    print_int(doubled[0])
    print_int(doubled[1])
    print_int(doubled[2])
    print_int(doubled[3])

    let squared = map4(data, sq)
    print_int(squared[0])
    print_int(squared[1])
    print_int(squared[2])
    print_int(squared[3])

    print_int(fold4(data, 0, add))
    print_int(fold4(data, 1, mul))
    print_int(fold4(data, 0, max2))
    print_int(any4(data, is_gt3))
    print_int(any4(data, is_gt10))
    print_int(all4(data, is_positive))
    print_int(all4(data, is_gt2))
    print_int(fold4(map4(data, sq), 0, add))
    0
}

// === FILE: tests/selfhost/native_runtime/epistemic_bridge_chain_42.sio ===
type M1 = Model<i64, i64>
models DefaultModels = [M1]
policy DefaultPolicy for i64 level Stable scope InDistribution {}
validation DefaultManifest for i64 {}

fn main() -> i64 with Epistemic {
    let k: Knowledge<i64> = measure(42, uncertainty: 1.0)
    let c: Contest<i64, DefaultModels, DefaultPolicy> = lift_knowledge(k)
    let r: Robust<i64, Stable, InDistribution> = prove_robust(c, DefaultPolicy)
    let v: Validated<i64> = validate_manifest(r, DefaultManifest)
    if k.value != 42 { return 1 }
    return 42
}


// === FILE: tests/selfhost/native_runtime/epistemic_ops_42.sio ===
fn abs_f64_local(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn main() -> i64 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div, Epistemic {
    let a: Knowledge<f64> = measure(10.0, uncertainty: 0.3, confidence: 0.8)
    let b: Knowledge<f64> = measure(20.0, uncertainty: 0.4, confidence: 0.6)
    let sum = a + b
    let prod = a * b
    let quot = a / b

    if abs_f64_local(sum.value - 30.0) > 0.000001 { return 1 }
    if abs_f64_local(sum.uncertainty - 0.5) > 0.001 { return 2 }
    if abs_f64_local(sum.confidence - 0.6) > 0.000001 { return 3 }

    if abs_f64_local(prod.value - 200.0) > 0.000001 { return 4 }
    if abs_f64_local(prod.uncertainty - 7.21110255) > 0.01 { return 5 }
    if abs_f64_local(prod.confidence - 0.6) > 0.000001 { return 6 }

    if abs_f64_local(quot.value - 0.5) > 0.000001 { return 7 }
    if abs_f64_local(quot.uncertainty - 0.018027756) > 0.001 { return 8 }
    if abs_f64_local(quot.confidence - 0.6) > 0.000001 { return 9 }

    return 42
}

    fn sqrt(x: f64) -> f64;
    fn exp(x: f64) -> f64;
    fn log(x: f64) -> f64;
}

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn main() -> i32 with Mut {
    var score: i32 = 0
    let e1 = exp(0.0 - 10.0)
    let l1 = log(1.0e-12)
    let s1 = sqrt(1.0e-12)
    if abs_f64(e1 - 0.0000453999) < 0.000001 { score = score + 14 }
    if abs_f64(l1 - (0.0 - 27.6310211)) < 0.01 { score = score + 14 }
    if abs_f64(s1 - 0.000001) < 0.000001 { score = score + 14 }
    score
}

// Imported captured-closure boundary witness.
// Scope: one i64 capture through an imported factory. This does not cover
// linear, epistemic, or general heap-allocated closure environments.

fn make_adder(base: i64) -> fn(i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    |x: i64| -> i64 { x + base }
}

fn apply_captured(f: fn(i64) -> i64, x: i64) -> i64 {
    f(x)
}


// === FILE: tests/selfhost/native_runtime/import_captured_closure_boundary_42.sio ===

fn main() -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let add5 = make_adder(5)
    let add10 = make_adder(10)
    let r1 = apply_captured(add5, 10)
    let r2 = apply_captured(add10, 7)
    let r3 = apply_captured(add5, 5)
    if r1 != 15 { return 1 }
    if r2 != 17 { return 2 }
    if r3 != 10 { return 3 }
    r1 + r2 + r3
}

// === FILE: tests/selfhost/native_runtime/import_closure_boundary/mod.sio ===
// Imported noncapturing-closure boundary witness.
// This stays below captured closure environments: closure literals are
// returned and passed only as plain fn-typed values.

fn apply_unary(f: fn(i64) -> i64, x: i64) -> i64 {
    f(x)
}

fn apply_binary(f: fn(i64, i64) -> i64, a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 {
    f(a, b)
}

fn closure_inc(x: i64) -> i64 {
    x + 1
}

fn closure_triple(x: i64) -> i64 {
    x * 3
}

fn closure_add(x: i64, y: i64) -> i64 {
    x + y
}

fn closure_sub(x: i64, y: i64) -> i64 {
    x - y
}

fn choose_unary(which: i64) -> fn(i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if which == 0 { |x: i64| x + 1 } else { |x: i64| x * 3 }
}

fn choose_binary(which: i64) -> fn(i64, i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if which == 0 { |x: i64, y: i64| x + y } else { |x: i64, y: i64| x - y }
}


// === FILE: tests/selfhost/native_runtime/import_closure_boundary_42.sio ===
use import_closure_boundary::mod::{apply_binary, apply_unary, choose_binary, choose_unary}

fn main() -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let inc = choose_unary(0)
    let triple = choose_unary(1)
    let add = choose_binary(0)
    let sub = choose_binary(1)
    let r1 = apply_unary(inc, 41)
    let r2 = apply_unary(triple, 14)
    let r3 = apply_binary(add, 20, 22)
    let r4 = apply_binary(sub, 50, 8)
    if r1 != 42 { return 1 }
    if r2 != 42 { return 2 }
    if r3 != 42 { return 3 }
    if r4 != 42 { return 4 }
    42
}

struct CorePair {
    left: i64,
    right: i64,
}

    a: i64,
    b: i64,
    c: i64,
}

}

    CoreTriple { a: 7, b: 11, c: 13 }
}

fn array_tail_sum() -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var xs: [i64; 3] = [0; 3]
    xs[0] = 2
    xs[1] = 3
    xs[2] = 4
    xs[0 as usize] + xs[2 as usize]
}

fn add_bias(x: i64) -> i64 {
    x + 1
}

fn entry() -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let pair = make_pair()
    let array_sum = array_tail_sum()
    add_bias(pair.left + pair.right + array_sum)
}

    times: [f64; 256]
    states: [f64; 2048]
    n_points: i32
    n_eqs: i32
}

fn build_trace() -> BigTrace with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var out = BigTrace {
        times: [0.0; 256],
        states: [0.0; 2048],
        n_points: 0,
        n_eqs: 8
    }
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 255 {
        out.times[i] = i as f64
        out.states[i * 8] = (i + 1000) as f64
        i = i + 1
    }
    out.n_points = 255
    return out
}

fn main() -> i32 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let trace = build_trace()
    if trace.n_points != 255 { return 11 }
    if trace.n_eqs != 8 { return 12 }
    if trace.times[46] != 46.0 { return 13 }
    if trace.times[47] != 47.0 { return 14 }
    if trace.times[254] != 254.0 { return 15 }
    if trace.states[46 * 8] != 1046.0 { return 16 }
    if trace.states[47 * 8] != 1047.0 { return 17 }
    if trace.states[254 * 8] != 1254.0 { return 18 }
    return 42
}


// === FILE: tests/selfhost/native_runtime/large_struct_return_42.sio ===
struct LargeRet {
    times: [f64; 256],
    states: [f64; 2048],
    n_points: i32,
    n_eqs: i32
}

fn make_large() -> LargeRet with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var out = LargeRet {
        times: [0.0; 256],
        states: [0.0; 2048],
        n_points: 0,
        n_eqs: 8
    }
    out.times[0] = 1.0
    out.times[1] = 2.0
    out.states[0] = 10.0
    out.states[17] = 32.0
    out.n_points = 2
    return out
}

fn main() -> i32 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let traj = make_large()
    let ok0 = traj.n_points == 2
    let ok1 = traj.n_eqs == 8
    let ok2 = traj.times[1] > 1.5
    let ok3 = traj.states[17] > 31.0
    if ok0 && ok1 && ok2 && ok3 {
        return 42
    }
    return 1
}

// === FILE: tests/selfhost/native_runtime/struct_large_roundtrip_42.sio ===
struct Tape {
    op: [i32; 64]
    arg1: [i32; 64]
    arg2: [i32; 64]
    val: [f64; 64]
    adj: [f64; 64]
    len: i32
}

fn tape_new() -> Tape with Mut, Panic {
    Tape {
        op: [0; 64],
        arg1: [-1; 64],
        arg2: [-1; 64],
        val: [0.0; 64],
        adj: [0.0; 64],
        len: 0,
    }
}

fn tape_input(tape: Tape, x: f64) -> Tape with Mut, Panic {
    var t = tape
    let idx = t.len
    t.op[idx] = 0
    t.arg1[idx] = -1
    t.arg2[idx] = -1
    t.val[idx] = x
    t.adj[idx] = 0.0
    t.len = idx + 1
    return t
}

fn main() -> i32 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var t = tape_new()
    t = tape_input(t, 3.0)
    t = tape_input(t, 4.0)
    if t.val[0] != 3.0 { return 11 }
    if t.val[1] != 4.0 { return 12 }
    if t.arg1[0] != -1 { return 13 }
    if t.arg1[1] != -1 { return 14 }
    if t.len != 2 { return 15 }
    return 42
}

// === FILE: tests/selfhost/native_runtime/struct_return_stable_after_call_42.sio ===
//@ run-pass

struct Dual {
    val: f64,
    dot: f64,
}

fn mk(x: f64) -> Dual with Mut, Panic {
    Dual { val: x, dot: 0.0 }
}

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn approx_eq(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> bool {
    abs_f64(a - b) < tol
}

fn main() -> i64 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let c = mk(42.0)
    let tol = 1.0e-12
    let val_ok = approx_eq(c.val, 42.0, tol)
    let dot_ok = approx_eq(c.dot, 0.0, tol)
    if val_ok && dot_ok { return 42 }
    return 0
}

// === FILE: tests/stdlib/algo/test_sort_e2e.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// E2E test for stdlib/algo/sort
//
// Tests quicksort_i64, heapsort_i64, quicksort_f64, and is_sorted_i64/f64
// on small arrays with known expected results.

use algo::sort::*

fn check_near(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> bool {
    let d = a - b
    let ad = if d < 0.0 { 0.0 - d } else { d }
    return ad < tol
}

fn run_tests() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div, Alloc{
    var pass = 0
    var fail = 0

    // Test 1: quicksort_i64 sorts a small array
    print("Test 1: quicksort_i64... ")
    var arr1: [i64; 1024] = [0; 1024]
    arr1[0] = 5; arr1[1] = 3; arr1[2] = 8; arr1[3] = 1; arr1[4] = 9
    arr1[5] = 2; arr1[6] = 7; arr1[7] = 4; arr1[8] = 6
    quicksort_i64(&!arr1, 9)
    if is_sorted_i64(&arr1, 9) && arr1[0] == 1 && arr1[8] == 9 {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 2: heapsort_i64 sorts a reverse-sorted array
    print("Test 2: heapsort_i64 reverse... ")
    var arr2: [i64; 1024] = [0; 1024]
    arr2[0] = 5; arr2[1] = 4; arr2[2] = 3; arr2[3] = 2; arr2[4] = 1
    heapsort_i64(&!arr2, 5)
    if is_sorted_i64(&arr2, 5) && arr2[0] == 1 && arr2[4] == 5 {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 3: quicksort_f64 sorts floating point values
    print("Test 3: quicksort_f64... ")
    var arr3: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    arr3[0] = 3.14; arr3[1] = 1.41; arr3[2] = 2.72; arr3[3] = 0.57; arr3[4] = 1.73
    quicksort_f64(&!arr3, 5)
    if is_sorted_f64(&arr3, 5) && check_near(arr3[0], 0.57, 0.01) && check_near(arr3[4], 3.14, 0.01) {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 4: is_sorted_i64 detects unsorted array
    print("Test 4: is_sorted_i64 false... ")
    var arr4: [i64; 1024] = [0; 1024]
    arr4[0] = 3; arr4[1] = 1; arr4[2] = 2
    if !is_sorted_i64(&arr4, 3) {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 5: mergesort_i64 stable sort with duplicates
    print("Test 5: mergesort_i64 duplicates... ")
    var arr5: [i64; 1024] = [0; 1024]
    arr5[0] = 3; arr5[1] = 1; arr5[2] = 4; arr5[3] = 1; arr5[4] = 5
    arr5[5] = 9; arr5[6] = 2; arr5[7] = 6; arr5[8] = 5
    mergesort_i64(&!arr5, 9)
    if is_sorted_i64(&arr5, 9) && arr5[0] == 1 && arr5[1] == 1 {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    print("\nPassed: ")
    print(pass)
    print(" Failed: ")
    print(fail)
    print("\n")

    if fail > 0 { return 1 }
    return 0
}

fn main() -> i32 with Mut, Panic, Div, Alloc {
    return run_tests()
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/analysis/test_analysis.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// Tests for stdlib/analysis/lib.sio — Numerical Analysis
//
// Covers:
//   numerical_derivative      — central difference, d/dx(x²) at x=3 ≈ 6
//   numerical_integral_trapezoid — ∫₀¹ x² dx ≈ 1/3
//   numerical_integral_simpson   — ∫₀^π sin(x) dx ≈ 2, and Simpson > trapezoid accuracy
//   richardson_extrapolation  — 4th-order accurate derivative
//   romberg_integration       — Romberg convergence on smooth functions

use analysis::{
    ConvergenceResult,
    numerical_derivative,
    numerical_integral_trapezoid,
    numerical_integral_simpson,
    richardson_extrapolation,
    romberg_integration
}

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn check_near(got: f64, expected: f64, tol: f64) -> bool {
    return abs_f64(got - expected) < tol
}

fn run_tests() -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var pass = 0
    var fail = 0

    // ---- numerical_derivative (f_id=0: x²) ----

    // Test 1: d/dx(x²) at x=3 ≈ 6  (h=1e-4)
    let d1 = numerical_derivative(0, 3.0, 0.0001)
    if check_near(d1, 6.0, 1.0e-7) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 2: d/dx(x²) at x=0 ≈ 0
    let d2 = numerical_derivative(0, 0.0, 0.0001)
    if check_near(d2, 0.0, 1.0e-7) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 3: d/dx(x²) at x=-2 ≈ -4
    let d3 = numerical_derivative(0, 0.0 - 2.0, 0.0001)
    if check_near(d3, 0.0 - 4.0, 1.0e-7) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 4: d/dx(exp(x)) at x=0 ≈ 1  (f_id=2)
    let d4 = numerical_derivative(2, 0.0, 0.0001)
    if check_near(d4, 1.0, 1.0e-7) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // ---- numerical_integral_trapezoid (f_id=0: x², f_id=1: sin) ----

    // Test 5: ∫₀¹ x² dx = 1/3 ≈ 0.33333...  (n=1000 trapezoids)
    let t5 = numerical_integral_trapezoid(0, 0.0, 1.0, 1000)
    if check_near(t5, 0.3333333333333333, 1.0e-6) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 6: ∫₀^π sin(x) dx = 2  (n=1000 trapezoids, π≈3.14159265358979)
    let pi = 3.14159265358979323846
    let t6 = numerical_integral_trapezoid(1, 0.0, pi, 1000)
    if check_near(t6, 2.0, 1.0e-5) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // ---- numerical_integral_simpson (f_id=0: x², f_id=1: sin) ----

    // Test 7: ∫₀¹ x² dx = 1/3, Simpson exact for polynomials ≤ degree 3
    let s7 = numerical_integral_simpson(0, 0.0, 1.0, 10)
    if check_near(s7, 0.3333333333333333, 1.0e-12) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 8: ∫₀^π sin(x) dx ≈ 2  (n=100 intervals with Simpson, tolerance 1e-6
    // due to internal Taylor-series sin having finite precision)
    let s8 = numerical_integral_simpson(1, 0.0, pi, 100)
    if check_near(s8, 2.0, 1.0e-6) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 9: Simpson is more accurate than trapezoid for sin(x) on same n=100
    let trap9  = numerical_integral_trapezoid(1, 0.0, pi, 100)
    let simp9  = numerical_integral_simpson(1, 0.0, pi, 100)
    let err_trap = abs_f64(trap9 - 2.0)
    let err_simp = abs_f64(simp9 - 2.0)
    if err_simp < err_trap { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // ---- richardson_extrapolation ----

    // Test 10: Richardson on x² at x=3 gives accurate 6.0 with small error estimate
    let r10 = richardson_extrapolation(0, 3.0, 0.01)
    if check_near(r10.value, 6.0, 1.0e-8) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if r10.error_estimate < 1.0e-4 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if r10.iterations == 2 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 11: Richardson on exp(x) at x=1 gives accurate e ≈ 2.71828...
    let r11 = richardson_extrapolation(2, 1.0, 0.001)
    if check_near(r11.value, 2.71828182845904523536, 1.0e-7) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // ---- romberg_integration ----

    // Test 12: Romberg on x² over [0,1] converges to 1/3
    let rb12 = romberg_integration(0, 0.0, 1.0, 6)
    if check_near(rb12.value, 0.3333333333333333, 1.0e-8) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if rb12.converged == 1 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 13: Romberg on exp(x) over [0,1] → e-1 ≈ 1.71828...
    let rb13 = romberg_integration(2, 0.0, 1.0, 8)
    if check_near(rb13.value, 1.71828182845904523536, 1.0e-7) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 14: Romberg on sin(x) over [0,π] → 2 (within reasonable tolerance)
    let rb14 = romberg_integration(1, 0.0, pi, 7)
    if check_near(rb14.value, 2.0, 1.0e-7) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 15: Romberg iterations are positive
    if rb12.iterations > 0 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Summary
    if fail == 0 { 0 } else { fail }
}

fn main() -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    run_tests()
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/async/test_executor_e2e.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// E2E: stdlib/async/executor.sio — Executor spawn/complete

use async::executor::*;

fn run_tests(ex: &! Executor) -> i32 {
    // Empty executor
    if ex.task_count() != 0 { return 1 }
    if !ex.all_done() { return 2 }

    // Spawn tasks
    ex.spawn(1)
    ex.spawn(2)
    ex.spawn(3)
    if ex.task_count() != 3 { return 3 }
    if ex.pending_count() != 3 { return 4 }
    if ex.all_done() { return 5 }

    // Complete tasks
    ex.complete_task(0, 10)
    if ex.pending_count() != 2 { return 6 }

    ex.complete_task(1, 20)
    ex.complete_task(2, 30)
    if !ex.all_done() { return 7 }
    if ex.pending_count() != 0 { return 8 }

    return 0
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    var ex = Executor::new()
    return run_tests(&! ex)
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/async/test_future_e2e.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// E2E: stdlib/async/future.sio — PollResult

use async::future::*;

fn run_tests() -> i32 {
    // Pending
    let p = poll_pending()
    if poll_is_ready(&p) { return 1 }
    if !poll_is_pending(&p) { return 2 }

    // Ready
    let r = poll_ready(42)
    if !poll_is_ready(&r) { return 3 }
    if poll_is_pending(&r) { return 4 }
    if poll_value(&r) != 42 { return 5 }

    return 0
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    return run_tests()
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/autodiff/test_dual_e2e.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// E2E test for stdlib/autodiff/dual
//
// Tests dual number arithmetic for automatic differentiation.
// Core test: f(x) = x^2, f'(3) = 6.

use autodiff::dual::*

fn check_near(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> bool {
    let d = a - b
    let ad = if d < 0.0 { 0.0 - d } else { d }
    return ad < tol
}

fn run_tests() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var pass = 0
    var fail = 0

    // Test 1: f(x) = x^2 at x=3 => f(3) = 9, f'(3) = 6
    // Compute as dual_mul(x, x) where x = dual_var(3.0)
    print("Test 1: x^2 at x=3, f=9, f'=6... ")
    let x1 = dual_var(3.0)
    let r1 = dual_mul(x1, x1)
    if check_near(r1.val, 9.0, 0.0001) && check_near(r1.dot, 6.0, 0.0001) {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 2: f(x) = 2*x + 3 at x=5 => f(5) = 13, f'(5) = 2
    print("Test 2: 2*x+3 at x=5, f=13, f'=2... ")
    let x2 = dual_var(5.0)
    let two = dual_const(2.0)
    let three = dual_const(3.0)
    let r2 = dual_add(dual_mul(two, x2), three)
    if check_near(r2.val, 13.0, 0.0001) && check_near(r2.dot, 2.0, 0.0001) {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 3: exp(x) at x=0 => f(0)=1, f'(0)=1
    print("Test 3: exp(0)=1, exp'(0)=1... ")
    let x3 = dual_var(0.0)
    let r3 = dual_exp(x3)
    if check_near(r3.val, 1.0, 0.001) && check_near(r3.dot, 1.0, 0.001) {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 4: sin(x) at x=0 => f(0)=0, f'(0)=cos(0)=1
    print("Test 4: sin(0)=0, sin'(0)=1... ")
    let x4 = dual_var(0.0)
    let r4 = dual_sin(x4)
    if check_near(r4.val, 0.0, 0.001) && check_near(r4.dot, 1.0, 0.001) {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 5: dual_sub: f(x) = x - 1 at x=4 => f(4)=3, f'(4)=1
    print("Test 5: x-1 at x=4, f=3, f'=1... ")
    let x5 = dual_var(4.0)
    let one = dual_const(1.0)
    let r5 = dual_sub(x5, one)
    if check_near(r5.val, 3.0, 0.0001) && check_near(r5.dot, 1.0, 0.0001) {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    print("\nPassed: ")
    print(pass)
    print(" Failed: ")
    print(fail)
    print("\n")

    if fail > 0 { return 1 }
    return 0
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    return run_tests()
}
