// === FILE: tests/stdlib/snn/test_g2_grad_e2e.sio ===
//@ run-pass

// tests/stdlib/snn/test_g2_grad_e2e.sio
//
// Validates analytical gradient of g2_proximity against numerical FD.
// 6 tests: TG1-TG6.

use math::sedenion64::*
use math::g2_variety::*
use snn::g2_grad::*

fn abs64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

// ============================================================================
// TG1: Analytical grad_a matches numerical FD (component-wise)
// ============================================================================

fn tg1_grad_a_matches_fd() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Use a non-trivial pair (not on G₂ variety)
    let a = sed64_normalize(sed64(0.3, 0.1, 0.4, 0.1, 0.5, 0.9, 0.2, 0.6,
                                   0.5, 0.3, 0.5, 0.8, 0.9, 0.7, 0.9, 0.3))
    let b = sed64_normalize(sed64(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 0.8, 0.2, 0.8, 0.1, 0.8,
                                   0.4, 0.5, 0.9, 0.0, 0.4, 0.5, 0.2, 0.3))

    let analytical = g2_grad_a(a, b)
    let a_arr = sed64_to_array(analytical)

    // Numerical FD: (f(a + eps*e_k) - f(a - eps*e_k)) / (2*eps)
    let eps = 0.0001
    var max_err = 0.0
    var k = 0
    while k < 16 {
        let ek = sed64_basis(k)
        let a_plus = sed64_add(a, sed64_scale(ek, eps))
        let a_minus = sed64_sub(a, sed64_scale(ek, eps))
        let fd_k = (g2_proximity(a_plus, b) - g2_proximity(a_minus, b)) / (2.0 * eps)
        let err = abs64(a_arr[k] - fd_k)
        if err > max_err { max_err = err }
        k = k + 1
    }
    max_err < 1e-4
}

// ============================================================================
// TG2: Gradient is zero at canonical ZD pair (score=0 → grad=0)
// ============================================================================

fn tg2_grad_zero_at_zd_pair() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let pair = g2_canonical_pair()
    let gr = g2_grad(pair.a, pair.b)

    // Score should be ~0
    if gr.score > 1e-10 { return false }

    // Both gradients should be ~0
    let ga_norm = sed64_norm_sq(gr.grad_a)
    let gb_norm = sed64_norm_sq(gr.grad_b)
    ga_norm < 1e-10 && gb_norm < 1e-10
}

// ============================================================================
// TG3: Gradient descent direction reduces score
// ============================================================================

fn tg3_descent_reduces_score() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Use a pair that's not on G₂ but has non-trivial mixed components
    let a = sed64_normalize(sed64(0.5, 0.3, 0.1, 0.4, 0.2, 0.6, 0.1, 0.3,
                                   0.7, 0.2, 0.5, 0.1, 0.8, 0.3, 0.4, 0.2))
    let b = sed64_normalize(sed64(0.1, 0.6, 0.3, 0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 0.5, 0.4,
                                   0.3, 0.8, 0.2, 0.6, 0.1, 0.4, 0.7, 0.5))

    let score_before = g2_proximity(a, b)
    let new_a = g2_analytical_step_a(a, b, 0.01)
    let score_after = g2_proximity(new_a, b)

    score_after < score_before
}

// ============================================================================
// TG4: Analytical grad_b matches numerical FD
// ============================================================================

fn tg4_grad_b_matches_fd() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let a = sed64_normalize(sed64(0.3, 0.1, 0.4, 0.1, 0.5, 0.9, 0.2, 0.6,
                                   0.5, 0.3, 0.5, 0.8, 0.9, 0.7, 0.9, 0.3))
    let b = sed64_normalize(sed64(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 0.8, 0.2, 0.8, 0.1, 0.8,
                                   0.4, 0.5, 0.9, 0.0, 0.4, 0.5, 0.2, 0.3))

    let analytical = g2_grad_b(a, b)
    let b_arr = sed64_to_array(analytical)

    let eps = 0.0001
    var max_err = 0.0
    var k = 0
    while k < 16 {
        let ek = sed64_basis(k)
        let b_plus = sed64_add(b, sed64_scale(ek, eps))
        let b_minus = sed64_sub(b, sed64_scale(ek, eps))
        let fd_k = (g2_proximity(a, b_plus) - g2_proximity(a, b_minus)) / (2.0 * eps)
        let err = abs64(b_arr[k] - fd_k)
        if err > max_err { max_err = err }
        k = k + 1
    }
    max_err < 1e-4
}

// ============================================================================
// TG5: Analytical step matches existing g2_step_a direction
// ============================================================================

fn tg5_analytical_step_reduces_score() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Use the same non-trivial pair as TG1
    let a = sed64_normalize(sed64(0.3, 0.1, 0.4, 0.1, 0.5, 0.9, 0.2, 0.6,
                                   0.5, 0.3, 0.5, 0.8, 0.9, 0.7, 0.9, 0.3))
    let b = sed64_normalize(sed64(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 0.8, 0.2, 0.8, 0.1, 0.8,
                                   0.4, 0.5, 0.9, 0.0, 0.4, 0.5, 0.2, 0.3))
    let lr = 0.01

    let score_before = g2_proximity(a, b)
    let new_a = g2_analytical_step_a(a, b, lr)
    let score_after = g2_proximity(new_a, b)

    // Multiple steps should keep reducing
    var a2 = new_a
    var i = 0
    while i < 10 {
        a2 = g2_analytical_step_a(a2, b, lr)
        i = i + 1
    }
    let score_10 = g2_proximity(a2, b)

    score_after < score_before && score_10 < score_after
}

// ============================================================================
// TG6: Both-variable step converges faster than a-only
// ============================================================================

fn tg6_both_faster_than_a_only() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let a0 = sed64_normalize(sed64(0.5, 0.3, 0.1, 0.4, 0.2, 0.6, 0.1, 0.3,
                                    0.7, 0.2, 0.5, 0.1, 0.8, 0.3, 0.4, 0.2))
    let b0 = sed64_normalize(sed64(0.1, 0.6, 0.3, 0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 0.5, 0.4,
                                    0.3, 0.8, 0.2, 0.6, 0.1, 0.4, 0.7, 0.5))
    let lr = 0.01

    // 20 steps with a-only
    var a_only = a0
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 {
        a_only = g2_analytical_step_a(a_only, b0, lr)
        i = i + 1
    }
    let score_a_only = g2_proximity(a_only, b0)

    // 20 steps with both
    var a_both = a0
    var b_both = b0
    i = 0
    while i < 20 {
        let pair = g2_analytical_step_both(a_both, b_both, lr)
        a_both = pair.a
        b_both = pair.b
        i = i + 1
    }
    let score_both = g2_proximity(a_both, b_both)

    score_both < score_a_only
}

// ============================================================================
// Main
// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var fail = 0

    if tg1_grad_a_matches_fd() {
        print("TG1 OK grad_a_matches_fd\n")
    } else {
        print("TG1 FAIL grad_a_matches_fd\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    if tg2_grad_zero_at_zd_pair() {
        print("TG2 OK grad_zero_at_zd_pair\n")
    } else {
        print("TG2 FAIL grad_zero_at_zd_pair\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    if tg3_descent_reduces_score() {
        print("TG3 OK descent_reduces_score\n")
    } else {
        print("TG3 FAIL descent_reduces_score\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    if tg4_grad_b_matches_fd() {
        print("TG4 OK grad_b_matches_fd\n")
    } else {
        print("TG4 FAIL grad_b_matches_fd\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    if tg5_analytical_step_reduces_score() {
        print("TG5 OK analytical_step_reduces_score\n")
    } else {
        print("TG5 FAIL analytical_step_reduces_score\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    if tg6_both_faster_than_a_only() {
        print("TG6 OK both_faster_than_a_only\n")
    } else {
        print("TG6 FAIL both_faster_than_a_only\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    let passed = 6 - fail
    print_int(passed)
    print(" / 6 passed\n")

    if fail == 0 { return 0 }
    return 1
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/snn/test_g2_landscape_stress.sio ===
//@ run-pass

// tests/stdlib/snn/test_g2_landscape_stress.sio
//
// Stress test: push the G₂ landscape explorer with 50 random inits.
// Reports full coverage statistics: classes found, fiber distribution,
// convergence rate. This is the extended version of TC10.
//
// Expected runtime: ~2-5 minutes depending on hardware.

use math::sedenion64::*
use math::g2_variety::*
use snn::g2_grad::*
use snn::g2_optimizer::*
use snn::zd_classifier::*
use snn::g2_landscape::*

// ============================================================================
// DETAILED LANDSCAPE RUN WITH REPORTING
// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("=== G2 Landscape Stress Test ===\n\n")

    let config = G2TrainConfig {
        lr: 0.01,
        max_epochs: 3000,
        tol: 1e-8,
        normalize_every: 5,
        optimize_both: true,
    }

    let n_inits: i64 = 50

    print("Running ")
    print_int(n_inits)
    print(" random initializations...\n\n")

    // Run individual inits and report each
    var n_converged: i64 = 0
    var n_classes_found: i64 = 0
    var class_seen = [0; 168]
    var fiber_seen = [0; 8]
    var i: i64 = 0

    while i < n_inits {
        let seed = 42 + i * 7919
        let result = g2_train_from_seed(seed, config)

        if result.converged {
            n_converged = n_converged + 1
            let cl = zd_classify(result.pair)

            print("  init ")
            print_int(i)
            print(": converged in ")
            print_int(result.epochs)
            print(" epochs, class=")
            print_int(cl.class_id as i64)
            print(" fiber=")
            print_int(cl.fiber as i64)
            print(" support_a=(")
            print_int(cl.support_a.idx_lower as i64)
            print(",")
            print_int(cl.support_a.idx_upper as i64)
            print(") support_b=(")
            print_int(cl.support_b.idx_lower as i64)
            print(",")
            print_int(cl.support_b.idx_upper as i64)
            print(")\n")

            let cid = cl.class_id
            if cid >= 0 {
                if cid < 168 {
                    if class_seen[cid] == 0 {
                        n_classes_found = n_classes_found + 1
                    }
                    class_seen[cid] = class_seen[cid] + 1
                }
            }

            let fiber = cl.fiber
            if fiber >= 1 {
                if fiber <= 7 {
                    fiber_seen[fiber] = fiber_seen[fiber] + 1
                }
            }
        } else {
            print("  init ")
            print_int(i)
            print(": DID NOT CONVERGE (score=")
            // Can't easily print f64, just report failure
            print("...)\n")
        }

        i = i + 1
    }

    // Summary
    print("\n=== SUMMARY ===\n")
    print("Attempted: ")
    print_int(n_inits)
    print("\nConverged: ")
    print_int(n_converged)
    print("\nDistinct classes found: ")
    print_int(n_classes_found)
    print(" / 168\n")

    // Fiber coverage
    var fibers_hit: i64 = 0
    print("Fiber coverage:\n")
    var f: i64 = 1
    while f <= 7 {
        print("  fiber ")
        print_int(f)
        print(": ")
        print_int(fiber_seen[f] as i64)
        print(" hits\n")
        if fiber_seen[f] > 0 {
            fibers_hit = fibers_hit + 1
        }
        f = f + 1
    }
    print("Fibers hit: ")
    print_int(fibers_hit)
    print(" / 7\n")

    // Pass criteria: converge rate > 50%, at least 3 fibers, at least 5 classes
    var fail = 0

    if n_converged * 2 < n_inits {
        print("\nFAIL: convergence rate < 50%\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    } else {
        print("\nOK: convergence rate >= 50%\n")
    }

    if fibers_hit < 3 {
        print("FAIL: fewer than 3 fibers hit\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    } else {
        print("OK: ")
        print_int(fibers_hit)
        print(" fibers hit\n")
    }

    if n_classes_found < 5 {
        print("FAIL: fewer than 5 distinct classes\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    } else {
        print("OK: ")
        print_int(n_classes_found)
        print(" distinct classes found\n")
    }

    if fail == 0 {
        print("\n=== ALL CHECKS PASSED ===\n")
        return 0
    }
    print("\n=== SOME CHECKS FAILED ===\n")
    return 1
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/snn/test_snn_e2e.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: HYPER_SNN_OK

use snn::sedenion_layer_core::*
use math::sedenion::*

fn emit_metric(name: string, value: f64) with IO {
    print("HYPER_METRIC snn ")
    print(name)
    print(" ")
    print(value)
    print("\n")
}

fn bool_to_f64(v: bool) -> f64 {
    if v { 1.0 } else { 0.0 }
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let z = sedenion_zero()
    let one = sedenion_one()
    let sum = sedenion_add(one, one)
    let diff = sedenion_sub(sum, one)

    let add_ok = diff.e0 == 1.0
    let nsq = sedenion_norm_sq(one)

    let layer = sedenion_layer_new(2, 3, SedenionActivation::None)
    let pc = sedenion_layer_param_count(layer)

    emit_metric("sed_norm_sq", nsq as f64)
    emit_metric("layer_param_count", pc as f64)
    emit_metric("add_contract_ok", bool_to_f64(add_ok))

    if z.e0 != 0.0 { return 2 }
    if !add_ok { return 3 }
    if pc != 144 { return 4 }

    print("HYPER_SNN_OK\n")
    0
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/special/test_airy_e2e.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// E2E test for stdlib/special/airy
// Tests: airy_ai, airy_bi, airy_ai_prime, airy_bi_prime

use special::airy::*

fn check_near(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> bool {
    let d = a - b
    let ad = if d < 0.0 { 0.0 - d } else { d }
    return ad < tol
}

fn run_tests() -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var pass = 0
    var fail = 0

    // Test 1: Ai(0) = 1/(3^{2/3} * Gamma(2/3)) approx 0.35503
    let ai0 = airy_ai(0.0)
    if check_near(ai0, 0.35503, 0.001) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 2: Bi(0) = sqrt(3) * Ai(0) approx 0.6149
    let bi0 = airy_bi(0.0)
    if check_near(bi0, 0.6149, 0.01) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 3: Ai(1.0) approx 0.1353 (from DLMF tables)
    let ai1 = airy_ai(1.0)
    if check_near(ai1, 0.1353, 0.01) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 4: Bi(1.0) approx 1.2074
    let bi1 = airy_bi(1.0)
    if check_near(bi1, 1.2074, 0.01) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 5: Ai'(0) approx -0.25882
    let aip0 = airy_ai_prime(0.0)
    if check_near(aip0, 0.0 - 0.25882, 0.01) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 6: Ai is decreasing for positive x: Ai(2) < Ai(1)
    let ai2 = airy_ai(2.0)
    if ai2 < ai1 {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    if fail > 0 { return 1 }
    return 0
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    return run_tests()
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/special/test_bessel_e2e.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// E2E test for stdlib/special/bessel
// Tests: bessel_j0, bessel_j1, bessel_y0, bessel_i0, bessel_k0

use special::bessel::*

fn check_near(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> bool {
    let d = a - b
    let ad = if d < 0.0 { 0.0 - d } else { d }
    return ad < tol
}

fn run_tests() -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var pass = 0
    var fail = 0

    // Test 1: J0(0) = 1.0
    let j0_zero = bessel_j0(0.0)
    if check_near(j0_zero, 1.0, 0.001) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 2: J1(0) = 0.0
    let j1_zero = bessel_j1(0.0)
    if check_near(j1_zero, 0.0, 0.001) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 3: J0(2.4048) approx 0.0 (first zero of J0)
    let j0_first_zero = bessel_j0(2.4048)
    if check_near(j0_first_zero, 0.0, 0.01) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 4: J0(1.0) approx 0.7652 (known value)
    let j0_one = bessel_j0(1.0)
    if check_near(j0_one, 0.7652, 0.01) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 5: J1(1.0) approx 0.4401 (known value)
    let j1_one = bessel_j1(1.0)
    if check_near(j1_one, 0.4401, 0.01) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 6: I0(0) = 1.0
    let i0_zero = bessel_i0(0.0)
    if check_near(i0_zero, 1.0, 0.001) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 7: Jn(0, x) == J0(x)
    let jn0 = bessel_jn(0, 1.5)
    let j0_15 = bessel_j0(1.5)
    if check_near(jn0, j0_15, 0.001) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    if fail > 0 { return 1 }
    return 0
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    return run_tests()
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/special/test_beta.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// E2E tests for stdlib/special/beta.sio
//
// Reference values from SciPy:
//   beta(1,1)          = 1.0
//   beta(2,3)          = 1/12 = 0.083333...
//   beta(0.5,0.5)      = pi   = 3.14159...
//   lbeta(2,3)         = ln(1/12) = -2.484907...
//   ibeta(1,1,0.5)     = 0.5  (uniform)
//   ibeta(2,5,0.4)     = 0.76672...
//   ibeta(0.5,0.5,0.5) = 0.5  (symmetry)
//   ibeta_inv(2,5,0.5) = 0.23437...

use special::beta::{beta, lbeta, ibeta, ibeta_inv}

fn check_near(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> bool {
    let d = a - b
    let ad = if d < 0.0 { 0.0 - d } else { d }
    return ad < tol
}

fn check_rel(a: f64, b: f64, rtol: f64) -> bool {
    let d = a - b
    let ad = if d < 0.0 { 0.0 - d } else { d }
    let ref_ = if b < 0.0 { 0.0 - b } else { b }
    if ref_ < 1.0e-300 { return ad < rtol }
    return ad / ref_ < rtol
}

fn run_tests() -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var pass = 0
    var fail = 0

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Test 1: beta(1, 1) == 1.0
    let v1 = beta(1.0, 1.0)
    if check_near(v1, 1.0, 1.0e-10) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Test 2: beta(2, 3) == 1/12 = 0.083333...
    let v2 = beta(2.0, 3.0)
    if check_rel(v2, 0.08333333333333333, 1.0e-10) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Test 3: beta(0.5, 0.5) == pi = 3.14159265...
    let v3 = beta(0.5, 0.5)
    if check_rel(v3, 3.14159265358979324, 1.0e-8) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Test 4: lbeta(2, 3) == ln(1/12) = -2.4849066497880004
    let v4 = lbeta(2.0, 3.0)
    if check_rel(v4, 0.0 - 2.4849066497880004, 1.0e-10) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Test 5: ibeta(1, 1, 0.5) == 0.5 (uniform CDF at midpoint)
    let v5 = ibeta(1.0, 1.0, 0.5)
    if check_near(v5, 0.5, 1.0e-10) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Test 6: ibeta(2, 5, 0.4) == 0.76671... (SciPy: betainc(2,5,0.4))
    let v6 = ibeta(2.0, 5.0, 0.4)
    if check_rel(v6, 0.766720, 1.0e-4) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Test 7: ibeta(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) == 0.5 (symmetry: I_{0.5}(a,a) = 0.5)
    let v7 = ibeta(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
    if check_near(v7, 0.5, 1.0e-8) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Test 8: ibeta_inv(2, 5, 0.5) == 0.26445...  (SciPy: betaincinv(2,5,0.5))
    // Verified by numerical integration bisection; 0.234375 was incorrect.
    let v8 = ibeta_inv(2.0, 5.0, 0.5)
    if check_rel(v8, 0.26445, 1.0e-4) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    if fail > 0 { return 1 }
    return 0
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    return run_tests()
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/special/test_caputo_scalar.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// E2E tests for stdlib/special/caputo.sio.

use special::caputo::{
    caputo_l1_derivative,
    caputo_l1_scale,
    caputo_power_exact,
    caputo_pow,
    fractional_decay_ml,
    mittag_leffler_e_alpha
}

fn d5_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn d5_rel_close(got: f64, expected: f64, rtol: f64, atol: f64) -> bool with Div {
    let diff = d5_abs(got - expected)
    let scale = if d5_abs(expected) > 1.0 { d5_abs(expected) } else { 1.0 }
    return diff <= atol || diff / scale <= rtol
}

fn fill_constant(value: f64, n: i32) -> [f64; 512] with Mut {
    var samples: [f64; 512] = [0.0; 512]
    var i = 0
    while i <= n {
        samples[i] = value
        i = i + 1
    }
    return samples
}

fn fill_power(beta: f64, dt: f64, n: i32) -> [f64; 512] with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var samples: [f64; 512] = [0.0; 512]
    var i = 0
    while i <= n {
        let t = (i as f64) * dt
        samples[i] = caputo_pow(t, beta)
        i = i + 1
    }
    return samples
}

fn fill_ml_decay(c0: f64, lambda: f64, alpha: f64, dt: f64, n: i32) -> [f64; 512] with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var samples: [f64; 512] = [0.0; 512]
    var i = 0
    while i <= n {
        let t = (i as f64) * dt
        samples[i] = fractional_decay_ml(c0, lambda, t, alpha)
        i = i + 1
    }
    return samples
}

fn l1_fractional_decay(c0: f64, lambda: f64, alpha: f64, dt: f64, n: i32) -> [f64; 512] with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var samples: [f64; 512] = [0.0; 512]
    samples[0] = c0
    let scale = caputo_l1_scale(alpha, dt)
    var step = 1
    while step <= n {
        var history = 0.0
        var compensation = 0.0
        var j = 1
        while j < step {
            let weight = caputo_pow((j + 1) as f64, 1.0 - alpha) - caputo_pow(j as f64, 1.0 - alpha)
            let diff = samples[step - j] - samples[step - j - 1]
            let y = weight * diff - compensation
            let t = history + y
            compensation = (t - history) - y
            history = t
            j = j + 1
        }
        samples[step] = (scale * samples[step - 1] - scale * history) / (scale + lambda)
        step = step + 1
    }
    return samples
}

fn test_constant() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n = 256
    let dt = 1.0 / (n as f64)
    let samples = fill_constant(7.25, n)
    let d = caputo_l1_derivative(samples, n, dt, 0.8)
    return d5_abs(d) < 1.0e-10
}

fn test_power_alpha_beta(alpha: f64, beta: f64, rtol: f64) -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n = 100
    let dt = 0.01
    let samples = fill_power(beta, dt, n)
    let got = caputo_l1_derivative(samples, n, dt, alpha)
    let expected = caputo_power_exact(beta, alpha, 1.0)
    return d5_rel_close(got, expected, rtol, rtol)
}

fn test_ml_decay_identity() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let alpha = 0.8
    let lambda = 0.5
    let t = 1.0
    let y = fractional_decay_ml(1.0, lambda, t, alpha)
    let direct = mittag_leffler_e_alpha(alpha, 0.0 - lambda * caputo_pow(t, alpha))
    return d5_rel_close(y, direct, 1.0e-12, 1.0e-12)
}

fn test_fractional_decay_l2(alpha: f64) -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n = 240
    let dt = 0.1
    let lambda = 0.1
    let numerical = l1_fractional_decay(1.0, lambda, alpha, dt, n)
    let exact = fill_ml_decay(1.0, lambda, alpha, dt, n)
    var sum_sq = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i <= n {
        let err = numerical[i] - exact[i]
        sum_sq = sum_sq + err * err
        i = i + 1
    }
    let l2 = caputo_pow(sum_sq / ((n + 1) as f64), 0.5)
    return l2 < 5.0e-2
}

fn run_tests() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var pass = 0
    var fail = 0

    if test_constant() { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if test_power_alpha_beta(0.7, 1.0, 1.0e-10) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if test_power_alpha_beta(0.8, 1.0, 1.0e-10) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if test_power_alpha_beta(0.9, 1.0, 1.0e-10) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if test_power_alpha_beta(0.7, 2.0, 1.0e-3) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if test_power_alpha_beta(0.8, 2.0, 3.0e-3) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if test_power_alpha_beta(0.9, 2.0, 3.0e-3) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if test_ml_decay_identity() { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if test_fractional_decay_l2(0.7) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if test_fractional_decay_l2(0.9) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    if fail > 0 { return 1 }
    println("D5_CAPUTO_SCALAR_PASS")
    return 0
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    return run_tests()
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/special/test_erf.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// E2E test for stdlib/special/erf
// Tests: erf, erfc, erfinv, normal_cdf, normal_quantile

use special::erf::{erf, erfc, erfinv, normal_cdf, normal_quantile}

fn check_near(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> bool {
    let d = a - b
    let ad = if d < 0.0 { 0.0 - d } else { d }
    return ad < tol
}

fn run_tests() -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var pass = 0
    var fail = 0

    // --- erf ---

    // Test 1: erf(0) == 0
    let v1 = erf(0.0)
    if check_near(v1, 0.0, 1.0e-10) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 2: erf(1) ≈ 0.8427007929...
    let v2 = erf(1.0)
    if check_near(v2, 0.8427007929497148, 1.0e-6) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 3: erf(-1) ≈ -0.8427007929...
    let v3 = erf(0.0 - 1.0)
    if check_near(v3, 0.0 - 0.8427007929497148, 1.0e-6) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 4: erf(2) ≈ 0.9953222650...
    let v4 = erf(2.0)
    if check_near(v4, 0.9953222650189527, 1.0e-6) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 5: erf(3) ≈ 0.9999779095...
    let v5 = erf(3.0)
    if check_near(v5, 0.9999779095030014, 1.0e-6) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 6: erf odd symmetry — erf(-2) == -erf(2)
    let v6a = erf(0.0 - 2.0)
    let v6b = erf(2.0)
    if check_near(v6a, 0.0 - v6b, 1.0e-10) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // --- erfc ---

    // Test 7: erfc(0) == 1
    let v7 = erfc(0.0)
    if check_near(v7, 1.0, 1.0e-10) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 8: erfc(1) ≈ 0.1572992070...
    let v8 = erfc(1.0)
    if check_near(v8, 0.15729920705028513, 1.0e-6) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 9: erfc(x) + erf(x) == 1 for x = 0.5
    let v9a = erf(0.5)
    let v9b = erfc(0.5)
    if check_near(v9a + v9b, 1.0, 1.0e-6) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 10: erfc large x — erfc(5) should be very small but positive
    let v10 = erfc(5.0)
    if v10 > 0.0 && v10 < 1.0e-10 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // --- erfinv ---

    // Test 11: erfinv(0) == 0
    let v11 = erfinv(0.0)
    if check_near(v11, 0.0, 1.0e-8) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 12: erfinv(erf(0.5)) ≈ 0.5
    let erf_half = erf(0.5)
    let v12 = erfinv(erf_half)
    if check_near(v12, 0.5, 1.0e-6) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 13: erf(erfinv(0.3)) ≈ 0.3 — round-trip
    let v13 = erf(erfinv(0.3))
    if check_near(v13, 0.3, 1.0e-6) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 14: erfinv(-0.5) ≈ -erfinv(0.5) — odd symmetry
    let v14a = erfinv(0.5)
    let v14b = erfinv(0.0 - 0.5)
    if check_near(v14a + v14b, 0.0, 1.0e-8) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 15: erfinv of large-region value — erfinv(erf(1.2)) ≈ 1.2
    let v15 = erfinv(erf(1.2))
    if check_near(v15, 1.2, 1.0e-5) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // --- normal_cdf ---

    // Test 16: normal_cdf(0) == 0.5
    let v16 = normal_cdf(0.0)
    if check_near(v16, 0.5, 1.0e-8) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 17: normal_cdf(1.96) ≈ 0.975
    let v17 = normal_cdf(1.96)
    if check_near(v17, 0.9750021048517795, 1.0e-4) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 18: normal_cdf(-1.96) ≈ 0.025
    let v18 = normal_cdf(0.0 - 1.96)
    if check_near(v18, 0.024997895148220488, 1.0e-4) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 19: normal_cdf symmetry: cdf(-x) + cdf(x) == 1
    let v19a = normal_cdf(1.0)
    let v19b = normal_cdf(0.0 - 1.0)
    if check_near(v19a + v19b, 1.0, 1.0e-8) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // --- normal_quantile ---

    // Test 20: normal_quantile(0.5) ≈ 0.0
    let v20 = normal_quantile(0.5)
    if check_near(v20, 0.0, 1.0e-6) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 21: normal_quantile(0.975) ≈ 1.96
    let v21 = normal_quantile(0.975)
    if check_near(v21, 1.959963985, 1.0e-3) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 22: round-trip — normal_cdf(normal_quantile(0.9)) ≈ 0.9
    let v22 = normal_cdf(normal_quantile(0.9))
    if check_near(v22, 0.9, 1.0e-5) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    if fail > 0 { return 1 }
    return 0
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    return run_tests()
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/special/test_gamma.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// E2E test for stdlib/special/gamma
// Validates lgamma, gamma, and digamma against known reference values.

use special::gamma::*

fn gm_abs_local(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn check_near(label: i32, got: f64, expected: f64, tol: f64) -> bool {
    let diff = gm_abs_local(got - expected)
    return diff < tol
}

fn run_tests() -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var pass = 0
    var fail = 0

    // ---- lgamma tests ----

    // lgamma(1) = ln(Γ(1)) = ln(1) = 0.0
    let lg1 = lgamma(1.0)
    if check_near(1, lg1, 0.0, 1.0e-9) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // lgamma(2) = ln(Γ(2)) = ln(1) = 0.0
    let lg2 = lgamma(2.0)
    if check_near(2, lg2, 0.0, 1.0e-9) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // lgamma(0.5) = ln(√π) ≈ 0.5723649429247001
    let lg_half = lgamma(0.5)
    if check_near(3, lg_half, 0.5723649429247001, 1.0e-9) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // lgamma(5) = ln(4!) = ln(24) ≈ 3.1780538303479458
    let lg5 = lgamma(5.0)
    if check_near(4, lg5, 3.1780538303479458, 1.0e-9) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // lgamma(10) = ln(9!) = ln(362880) ≈ 12.801827480081470
    let lg10 = lgamma(10.0)
    if check_near(5, lg10, 12.801827480081470, 1.0e-9) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // ---- gamma tests ----

    // gamma(5) = 4! = 24.0
    let g5 = gamma(5.0)
    if check_near(6, g5, 24.0, 1.0e-8) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // gamma(0.5) = √π ≈ 1.7724538509055159
    let g_half = gamma(0.5)
    if check_near(7, g_half, 1.7724538509055159, 1.0e-8) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // gamma(1) = 1.0
    let g1 = gamma(1.0)
    if check_near(8, g1, 1.0, 1.0e-9) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // gamma(2) = 1.0
    let g2 = gamma(2.0)
    if check_near(9, g2, 1.0, 1.0e-9) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // ---- digamma tests ----

    // digamma(1) = -γ ≈ -0.5772156649015329 (Euler–Mascheroni constant)
    let dg1 = digamma(1.0)
    if check_near(10, dg1, 0.0 - 0.5772156649015329, 1.0e-9) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // digamma(2) = 1 - γ ≈ 0.4227843350984671
    let dg2 = digamma(2.0)
    if check_near(11, dg2, 0.4227843350984671, 1.0e-9) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // digamma(10) ≈ 2.251752589066721
    let dg10 = digamma(10.0)
    if check_near(12, dg10, 2.251752589066721, 1.0e-9) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    if fail > 0 { return 1 }
    return 0
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    return run_tests()
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/special/test_igamma_bessel.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// E2E tests for stdlib/special/igamma and stdlib/special/bessel
//
// Reference values:
//   igamma_lower(1, 1) = 1 - e^{-1}       ≈ 0.63212055882...
//   igamma_lower(2, 1) = 1 - 2*e^{-1}     ≈ 0.26424111765...
//   igamma_upper(1, 1) = e^{-1}            ≈ 0.36787944117...
//   chi2_cdf(3.841, 1) ≈ 0.95              (chi2 p-value 5% threshold)
//   bessel_j0(0)       = 1.0
//   bessel_j0(2.4048)  ≈ 0.0              (first zero of J0)
//   bessel_j1(0)       = 0.0
//   bessel_j1(3.8317)  ≈ 0.0              (first zero of J1)
//   bessel_jn(2, 5.0)  ≈ 0.04656511628...

use special::igamma::{igamma_lower, igamma_upper, chi2_cdf}
use special::bessel::{bessel_j0, bessel_j1, bessel_jn}

// Absolute-value helper
fn t_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

// Check that |a - b| < tol
fn check_near(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> bool {
    let d = a - b
    let ad = if d < 0.0 { 0.0 - d } else { d }
    return ad < tol
}

fn run_tests() -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var pass = 0
    var fail = 0

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // igamma_lower tests
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    // T1: igamma_lower(1, 1) = 1 - e^{-1} ≈ 0.63212
    let p11 = igamma_lower(1.0, 1.0)
    if check_near(p11, 0.6321205588285578, 1.0e-6) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // T2: igamma_lower(2, 1) ≈ 0.26424
    let p21 = igamma_lower(2.0, 1.0)
    if check_near(p21, 0.2642411176571153, 1.0e-6) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // T3: igamma_lower(0.5, 1) — a < 1, uses series; roughly 0.8427...
    // erf(1) = 0.8427007929..., P(0.5, 1) = erf(1) ≈ 0.8427
    let p05_1 = igamma_lower(0.5, 1.0)
    if check_near(p05_1, 0.8427007929497148, 1.0e-5) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // T4: igamma_lower(5, 1) ≈ 0.003659846... (very small, x << a)
    let p51 = igamma_lower(5.0, 1.0)
    if check_near(p51, 0.003659846827343713, 1.0e-6) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // igamma_upper tests
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    // T5: igamma_upper(1, 1) = e^{-1} ≈ 0.36788
    let q11 = igamma_upper(1.0, 1.0)
    if check_near(q11, 0.36787944117144233, 1.0e-6) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // T6: igamma_lower + igamma_upper = 1 for (3, 2)
    let pv = igamma_lower(3.0, 2.0)
    let qv = igamma_upper(3.0, 2.0)
    if check_near(pv + qv, 1.0, 1.0e-12) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // T7: igamma_upper(2, 5) — x >> a, Q should be small
    let q25 = igamma_upper(2.0, 5.0)
    // Q(2,5) = e^{-5}*(1+5) = 6*e^{-5} ≈ 0.04042...
    if check_near(q25, 0.04042768199451344, 1.0e-5) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // chi2_cdf tests
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    // T8: chi2_cdf(3.841, 1) ≈ 0.95  (standard 5% critical value)
    let c2 = chi2_cdf(3.841, 1.0)
    if check_near(c2, 0.95, 5.0e-3) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // T9: chi2_cdf(0, k) = 0 for any k
    let c2_zero = chi2_cdf(0.0, 2.0)
    if check_near(c2_zero, 0.0, 1.0e-12) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // T10: chi2_cdf(9.488, 4) ≈ 0.95
    let c2_k4 = chi2_cdf(9.488, 4.0)
    if check_near(c2_k4, 0.95, 5.0e-3) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // bessel_j0 tests
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    // T11: J0(0) = 1.0 (polynomial approximation; tolerance 1e-7)
    let j0_0 = bessel_j0(0.0)
    if check_near(j0_0, 1.0, 1.0e-7) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // T12: J0(2.4048) ≈ 0.0 (first zero of J0)
    let j0_z1 = bessel_j0(2.4048)
    if check_near(j0_z1, 0.0, 1.0e-3) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // T13: J0(1.0) ≈ 0.7651976...
    let j0_1 = bessel_j0(1.0)
    if check_near(j0_1, 0.7651976865579666, 1.0e-5) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // T14: J0(10.0) ≈ -0.2459357644...
    let j0_10 = bessel_j0(10.0)
    if check_near(j0_10, 0.0 - 0.2459357644513483, 1.0e-4) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // bessel_j1 tests
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    // T15: J1(0) = 0.0 exactly (x=0 makes p=0 exactly)
    let j1_0 = bessel_j1(0.0)
    if check_near(j1_0, 0.0, 1.0e-7) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // T16: J1(3.8317) ≈ 0.0 (first zero of J1)
    let j1_z1 = bessel_j1(3.8317)
    if check_near(j1_z1, 0.0, 1.0e-3) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // T17: J1(1.0) ≈ 0.4400505857...
    let j1_1 = bessel_j1(1.0)
    if check_near(j1_1, 0.4400505857449335, 1.0e-5) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // T18: J1(-1.0) = -J1(1.0)  (odd function)
    let j1_neg1 = bessel_j1(0.0 - 1.0)
    if check_near(j1_neg1, 0.0 - 0.4400505857449335, 1.0e-5) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // bessel_jn tests
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    // T19: Jn(0, x) == J0(x)
    let jn0 = bessel_jn(0, 1.0)
    if check_near(jn0, bessel_j0(1.0), 1.0e-7) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // T20: Jn(1, x) == J1(x)
    let jn1 = bessel_jn(1, 1.0)
    if check_near(jn1, bessel_j1(1.0), 1.0e-7) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // T21: Jn(2, 5.0) ≈ 0.04656511628... (DLMF 10.2)
    let jn2_5 = bessel_jn(2, 5.0)
    if check_near(jn2_5, 0.04656511628246888, 1.0e-5) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // T22: Jn(3, 1.0) ≈ 0.01956335398...
    let jn3_1 = bessel_jn(3, 1.0)
    if check_near(jn3_1, 0.019563353982668403, 1.0e-6) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    if fail > 0 { return 1 }
    return 0
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    return run_tests()
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/special/test_mittag_leffler_d8_grid.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// D.8 negative-real Mittag-Leffler grid regression.

use special::caputo::{
    mittag_leffler_e_alpha
}

fn ml_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn ml_rel_close(got: f64, expected: f64, rtol: f64) -> bool with Div {
    let scale = if ml_abs(expected) > 1.0 { ml_abs(expected) } else { 1.0 }
    return ml_abs(got - expected) / scale <= rtol
}

fn check(alpha: f64, z: f64, expected: f64) -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    return ml_rel_close(mittag_leffler_e_alpha(alpha, z), expected, 1.0e-8)
}

fn run_grid() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var ok = true

    ok = check(0.5, -10.0, 0.056140992743822586) && ok
    ok = check(0.5, -20.0, 0.028174348741051319) && ok
    ok = check(0.5, -50.0, 0.011281536265323773) && ok
    ok = check(0.5, -100.0, 0.005641613782989433) && ok

    ok = check(0.7, -10.0, 0.07736295200035552) && ok
    ok = check(0.7, -20.0, 0.04519513856549234) && ok
    ok = check(0.7, -50.0, 0.022762834959846902) && ok
    ok = check(0.7, -100.0, 0.013738939227872674) && ok

    ok = check(0.8, -10.0, 0.04297930131770153) && ok
    ok = check(0.8, -20.0, 0.022381088674434894) && ok
    ok = check(0.8, -50.0, 0.010076920355356178) && ok
    ok = check(0.8, -100.0, 0.005648323672033756) && ok

    ok = check(0.9, -10.0, 0.0172593795136312) && ok
    ok = check(0.9, -20.0, 0.008036851226133939) && ok
    ok = check(0.9, -50.0, 0.003272422290569466) && ok
    ok = check(0.9, -100.0, 0.0017113705332184073) && ok

    return ok
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    if !run_grid() {
        println("ML_NEGATIVE_Z_FIX_FAIL")
        return 1
    }
    println("ML_NEGATIVE_Z_FIX_PASS")
    return 0
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/spnn/test_spiking_e2e.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: HYPER_SPNN_OK

use spnn::*

fn emit_metric(name: string, value: f64) with IO {
    print("HYPER_METRIC spnn ")
    print(name)
    print(" ")
    print(value)
    print("\n")
}

fn bool_to_f64(v: bool) -> f64 {
    if v { 1.0 } else { 0.0 }
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO {
    print("HYPER_SPNN_START\n")

    let n0 = spiking_neuron_new(1.0, 0.5)
    let n1 = spiking_step(n0, 0.6)
    let n2 = spiking_step(n1, 0.8)

    let fired_first = spiking_fired(n1)
    let fired_second = spiking_fired(n2)
    let membrane_reset = spiking_membrane(n2) < 0.000001

    emit_metric("fired_first", bool_to_f64(fired_first))
    emit_metric("fired_second", bool_to_f64(fired_second))
    emit_metric("membrane_reset", bool_to_f64(membrane_reset))

    if fired_first { return 2 }
    if !fired_second { return 3 }
    if !membrane_reset { return 4 }

    print("HYPER_SPNN_OK\n")
    0
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/stats/test_arima_e2e.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// E2E test for stdlib/stats/timeseries/arima
// Tests: levinson_durbin, acf, fit_ar

use stats::timeseries::arima::*

fn check_near(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> bool {
    let d = a - b
    let ad = if d < 0.0 { 0.0 - d } else { d }
    return ad < tol
}

fn run_tests() -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var pass = 0
    var fail = 0

    // Test 1: Levinson-Durbin for AR(1) with phi=0.7
    // For AR(1) with phi=0.7, the ACF is r(k) = 0.7^k
    // r(0)=1.0, r(1)=0.7, r(2)=0.49, r(3)=0.343
    var acf_vals: [f64; 20] = [0.0; 20]
    acf_vals[0] = 1.0
    acf_vals[1] = 0.7
    acf_vals[2] = 0.49
    acf_vals[3] = 0.343
    acf_vals[4] = 0.2401

    let ar1 = levinson_durbin(acf_vals, 1)
    // Should recover phi_1 = 0.7
    if check_near(ar1[0], 0.7, 0.01) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 2: Levinson-Durbin for AR(2) with phi1=0.5, phi2=0.3
    // ACF: r(1) = phi1/(1-phi2) = 0.5/0.7 = 0.7143
    //       r(2) = phi1*r(1) + phi2 = 0.5*0.7143 + 0.3 = 0.6571
    var acf2: [f64; 20] = [0.0; 20]
    acf2[0] = 1.0
    acf2[1] = 0.7143
    acf2[2] = 0.6571
    acf2[3] = 0.5540
    acf2[4] = 0.4670

    let ar2 = levinson_durbin(acf2, 2)
    // Should approximately recover phi1=0.5, phi2=0.3
    if check_near(ar2[0], 0.5, 0.1) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    if check_near(ar2[1], 0.3, 0.1) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 3: fit_ar on a simple AR(1) process
    // Build an AR(1) process: y[t] = 0.8 * y[t-1] + noise
    var series: [f64; 500] = [0.0; 500]
    series[0] = 1.0
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < 100 {
        series[i as usize] = 0.8 * series[(i - 1) as usize] + 0.1 * ((i % 7) as f64 - 3.0)
        i = i + 1
    }

    let result = fit_ar(series, 100, 1)
    // AR(1) coefficient should be approximately 0.8
    let ar1_coeff = result.ar_coeffs[0]
    let diff = ar1_coeff - 0.8
    let abs_diff = if diff < 0.0 { 0.0 - diff } else { diff }
    if abs_diff < 0.3 {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 4: AIC should be finite (not nan or inf)
    let aic_val = result.aic
    if aic_val > 0.0 - 1.0e20 && aic_val < 1.0e20 {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    if fail > 0 { return 1 }
    return 0
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    return run_tests()
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO { println("STATS_DESCRIPTIVE_OK"); 0 }


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/stats/test_distributions.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//! Run-pass test for epistemic distributions

use stats::distributions::{NormalDist, normal_pdf, normal_cdf, BetaDist, beta_pdf, run_tests};

pub fn main() {
    assert(run_tests());
    println("All tests passed: epistemic Normal/Beta pdf, cdf values correct.");
}

// === FILE: tests/stdlib/stats/test_hypothesis.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// E2E tests for stdlib/stats/hypothesis.sio
//
// Coverage:
//   z_test_one_sample      — μ=5 (no reject), μ=0 (reject)
//   z_test_two_sample      — equal means (no reject), shifted means (reject)
//   t_test_one_sample      — μ=5 (no reject), μ=0 (reject)
//   t_test_two_sample      — Welch: groups with different means (reject)
//   t_test_paired          — before/after with shift (reject)
//   chi2_goodness_of_fit   — uniform vs uniform (no reject), biased (reject)
//   f_test                 — equal variances (no reject)
//   mann_whitney_u         — groups with separation (reject)

use stats::hypothesis::{
    TestResult,
    z_test_one_sample,
    z_test_two_sample,
    t_test_one_sample,
    t_test_two_sample,
    t_test_paired,
    chi2_goodness_of_fit,
    f_test,
    mann_whitney_u
}

fn near_f64(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> bool {
    let d = a - b
    let ad = if d < 0.0 { 0.0 - d } else { d }
    return ad < tol
}

fn run_tests() -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var pass = 0
    var fail = 0

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // data_a: 20 values centred on 5.0
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    var data_a: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    data_a[0]  = 4.8; data_a[1]  = 5.1; data_a[2]  = 4.9; data_a[3]  = 5.2
    data_a[4]  = 4.7; data_a[5]  = 5.3; data_a[6]  = 5.0; data_a[7]  = 4.8
    data_a[8]  = 5.1; data_a[9]  = 5.0; data_a[10] = 4.9; data_a[11] = 5.2
    data_a[12] = 4.8; data_a[13] = 5.1; data_a[14] = 5.0; data_a[15] = 4.9
    data_a[16] = 5.0; data_a[17] = 4.8; data_a[18] = 5.2; data_a[19] = 4.9
    let n_a = 20
    let sigma_a = 1.0

    // data_b: 20 values also centred on 5.0 (for equal-means tests)
    var data_b: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    data_b[0]  = 5.1; data_b[1]  = 4.9; data_b[2]  = 5.0; data_b[3]  = 5.2
    data_b[4]  = 4.8; data_b[5]  = 5.0; data_b[6]  = 4.9; data_b[7]  = 5.1
    data_b[8]  = 5.0; data_b[9]  = 4.8; data_b[10] = 5.1; data_b[11] = 4.9
    data_b[12] = 5.0; data_b[13] = 5.2; data_b[14] = 4.8; data_b[15] = 5.0
    data_b[16] = 5.1; data_b[17] = 4.9; data_b[18] = 5.0; data_b[19] = 4.9
    let n_b = 20

    // data_c: 20 values centred on 9.0 (clearly separated from data_a)
    var data_c: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    data_c[0]  = 8.8; data_c[1]  = 9.1; data_c[2]  = 8.9; data_c[3]  = 9.2
    data_c[4]  = 8.7; data_c[5]  = 9.3; data_c[6]  = 9.0; data_c[7]  = 8.8
    data_c[8]  = 9.1; data_c[9]  = 9.0; data_c[10] = 8.9; data_c[11] = 9.2
    data_c[12] = 8.8; data_c[13] = 9.1; data_c[14] = 9.0; data_c[15] = 8.9
    data_c[16] = 9.0; data_c[17] = 8.8; data_c[18] = 9.2; data_c[19] = 8.9
    let n_c = 20

    // =========================================================================
    // T1-T2: z_test_one_sample — H0: μ=5 — should NOT reject
    // =========================================================================
    let z1 = z_test_one_sample(&data_a, n_a, 5.0, sigma_a)
    if z1.reject == 0 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if z1.p_value > 0.05 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // =========================================================================
    // T3-T4: z_test_one_sample — H0: μ=0 — should reject
    // =========================================================================
    let z2 = z_test_one_sample(&data_a, n_a, 0.0, sigma_a)
    if z2.reject == 1 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if z2.p_value < 0.001 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // =========================================================================
    // T5: z_test_two_sample — equal means → NOT reject
    // =========================================================================
    let z3 = z_test_two_sample(&data_a, n_a, &data_b, n_b, sigma_a, sigma_a)
    if z3.reject == 0 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // =========================================================================
    // T6-T7: z_test_two_sample — data_a(5) vs data_c(9) → reject
    // =========================================================================
    let z4 = z_test_two_sample(&data_a, n_a, &data_c, n_c, sigma_a, sigma_a)
    if z4.reject == 1 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if z4.p_value < 0.001 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // =========================================================================
    // T8-T9: t_test_one_sample — H0: μ=5 — should NOT reject; df = n-1
    // =========================================================================
    let t1 = t_test_one_sample(&data_a, n_a, 5.0)
    if t1.reject == 0 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if near_f64(t1.df, 19.0, 0.01) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // =========================================================================
    // T10-T11: t_test_one_sample — H0: μ=0 — should reject
    // =========================================================================
    let t2 = t_test_one_sample(&data_a, n_a, 0.0)
    if t2.reject == 1 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if t2.p_value < 0.001 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // =========================================================================
    // T12-T14: t_test_two_sample (Welch) — data_a(5) vs data_c(9) → reject
    // =========================================================================
    let w1 = t_test_two_sample(&data_a, n_a, &data_c, n_c)
    if w1.reject == 1 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if w1.p_value < 0.001 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    // Welch-Satterthwaite df should be reasonable for n=20+20
    if w1.df > 10.0 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // =========================================================================
    // T15-T17: t_test_paired — shift of 4 → reject; statistic < 0 (before < after)
    // =========================================================================
    var before: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var after: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var k = 0
    while k < 20 {
        before[k as usize] = data_a[k as usize]
        after[k as usize]  = data_a[k as usize] + 4.0
        k = k + 1
    }
    let pt1 = t_test_paired(&before, &after, 20)
    if pt1.reject == 1 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if pt1.p_value < 0.001 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if pt1.statistic < 0.0 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // =========================================================================
    // T18-T19: chi2_goodness_of_fit — uniform observed = expected → NOT reject
    // =========================================================================
    var obs_uniform: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var exp_uniform: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var b = 0
    while b < 5 {
        obs_uniform[b as usize] = 20.0
        exp_uniform[b as usize] = 20.0
        b = b + 1
    }
    let chi1 = chi2_goodness_of_fit(&obs_uniform, &exp_uniform, 5)
    if chi1.statistic < 1.0e-10 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if chi1.reject == 0 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // =========================================================================
    // T20-T21: chi2_goodness_of_fit — biased observed → reject
    // =========================================================================
    var obs_biased: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var exp_even: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    obs_biased[0] = 80.0; obs_biased[1] = 5.0; obs_biased[2] = 5.0
    obs_biased[3] = 5.0;  obs_biased[4] = 5.0
    exp_even[0] = 20.0; exp_even[1] = 20.0; exp_even[2] = 20.0
    exp_even[3] = 20.0; exp_even[4] = 20.0
    let chi2 = chi2_goodness_of_fit(&obs_biased, &exp_even, 5)
    if chi2.reject == 1 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if chi2.p_value < 0.001 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // =========================================================================
    // T22-T23: f_test — equal variance groups → NOT reject; F near 1
    // =========================================================================
    let ft1 = f_test(&data_a, n_a, &data_b, n_b)
    if ft1.reject == 0 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if near_f64(ft1.statistic, 1.0, 5.0) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // =========================================================================
    // T24-T26: mann_whitney_u — data_a(5) vs data_c(9) → reject; U small
    // =========================================================================
    let mw1 = mann_whitney_u(&data_a, n_a, &data_c, n_c)
    if mw1.reject == 1 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if mw1.p_value < 0.001 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if mw1.statistic < 10.0 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // =========================================================================
    // T27-T28: GUM bridge — as_gum.value == statistic; std_uncertainty > 0
    // =========================================================================
    let gum_z = z_test_one_sample(&data_a, n_a, 5.0, sigma_a)
    if near_f64(gum_z.as_gum.value, gum_z.statistic, 1.0e-10) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if gum_z.as_gum.std_u > 0.0 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    if fail > 0 { return 1 }
    return 0
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    return run_tests()
}

// === FILE: tests/stdlib/stats/test_logistic_e2e.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// E2E test for stdlib/stats/regression/logistic
// Tests: sigmoid, logit, fit_logistic_simple, fit_dose_response

use stats::regression::logistic::*

fn check_near(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> bool {
    let d = a - b
    let ad = if d < 0.0 { 0.0 - d } else { d }
    return ad < tol
}

fn run_tests() -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var pass = 0
    var fail = 0

    // Test 1: sigmoid(0) = 0.5
    let s0 = sigmoid(0.0)
    if check_near(s0, 0.5, 0.001) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 2: sigmoid(large) -> 1.0
    let s_large = sigmoid(20.0)
    if s_large > 0.99 {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 3: logit(0.5) = 0.0
    let l_half = logit(0.5)
    if check_near(l_half, 0.0, 0.001) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 4: logit(sigmoid(x)) = x (round trip for x=2.0)
    let s2 = sigmoid(2.0)
    let l2 = logit(s2)
    if check_near(l2, 2.0, 0.01) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 5: Fit logistic regression on dose-response data
    // Low doses -> 0, high doses -> 1
    var x: [f64; 100] = [0.0; 100]
    var y: [f64; 100] = [0.0; 100]
    x[0] = 1.0;  y[0] = 0.0
    x[1] = 2.0;  y[1] = 0.0
    x[2] = 3.0;  y[2] = 0.0
    x[3] = 4.0;  y[3] = 0.0
    x[4] = 5.0;  y[4] = 1.0
    x[5] = 6.0;  y[5] = 0.0
    x[6] = 7.0;  y[6] = 1.0
    x[7] = 8.0;  y[7] = 1.0
    x[8] = 9.0;  y[8] = 1.0
    x[9] = 10.0; y[9] = 1.0

    let model = fit_logistic_simple(x, y, 10)

    // slope (beta1) should be positive
    if model.beta[1] > 0.0 {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 6: model should converge
    if model.converged {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 7: odds ratio for x should be > 1
    if model.odds_ratios[1] > 1.0 {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    if fail > 0 { return 1 }
    return 0
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    return run_tests()
}

// === FILE: tests/stdlib/stochastic/test_sde.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// E2E tests for stdlib/stochastic/sde.sio
//
// Validates:
//   T1  GBM positivity          — S(t) > 0 for S₀=100, μ=0.05, σ=0.2, t=1
//   T2  GBM uncertainty grows   — x_unc[0] > 0 after simulation
//   T3  OU state is finite       — |X(t)| < 1e10
//   T4  OU uncertainty grows    — x_unc > 0 after steps
//   T5  Milstein finite result  — x[0] is finite after one step
//   T6  Milstein uncertainty    — x_unc[0] >= 0
//   T7  Euler-Maruyama finite   — x[0] finite after one step
//   T8  Euler-Maruyama unc      — x_unc[0] >= 0
//   T9  Epistemic unc > base    — parameter uncertainty → larger x_unc
//   T10 Determinism             — same seed → same result (two runs match)
//   T11 EM vs Milstein differ   — with σ'≠0 the trajectories diverge

use stochastic::sde::{
    SDEState,
    sde_state_new,
    euler_maruyama,
    milstein_step,
    gbm_simulate,
    ou_simulate,
    sde_epistemic_gbm,
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn is_finite(x: f64) -> bool {
    x > 0.0 - 1.0e200 && x < 1.0e200
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Test runner
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn run_tests() -> i32  with IO, Mut, Panic, Div{
    var pass = 0
    var fail = 0

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // T1  GBM positivity
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    let gbm = gbm_simulate(100.0, 0.05, 0.2, 1.0, 100, 42)
    if gbm.x[0] > 0.0 {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // T2  GBM uncertainty grows
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    if gbm.x_unc[0] > 0.0 {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // T3  OU state finite
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    let ou = ou_simulate(5.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 200, 99)
    if is_finite(ou.x[0]) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // T4  OU uncertainty grows
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    if ou.x_unc[0] > 0.0 {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // T5  Milstein finite result
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    var ms_state = sde_state_new(1, 7)
    ms_state.x[0]     = 10.0
    ms_state.x_unc[0] = 0.1
    let drift_ms:    [f64; 16] = [0.1; 16]
    let diffusion_ms:[f64; 16] = [0.3; 16]
    let diff_drv_ms: [f64; 16] = [0.1; 16]
    let ms_out = milstein_step(ms_state, 0.01, &drift_ms, &diffusion_ms, &diff_drv_ms)
    if is_finite(ms_out.x[0]) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // T6  Milstein uncertainty non-negative
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    if ms_out.x_unc[0] >= 0.0 {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // T7  Euler-Maruyama finite
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    var em_state = sde_state_new(1, 13)
    em_state.x[0]     = 10.0
    em_state.x_unc[0] = 0.1
    let drift_em:    [f64; 16] = [0.1; 16]
    let diffusion_em:[f64; 16] = [0.3; 16]
    let em_out = euler_maruyama(em_state, 0.01, &drift_em, &diffusion_em)
    if is_finite(em_out.x[0]) {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // T8  Euler-Maruyama uncertainty non-negative
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    if em_out.x_unc[0] >= 0.0 {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // T9  Epistemic GBM: parameter uncertainty → larger state uncertainty
    //     Compare no-param-uncertainty vs with param uncertainty
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    let ep_zero = sde_epistemic_gbm(100.0, 0.0, 0.05, 0.0, 0.2, 0.0, 1.0, 100, 42)
    let ep_unc  = sde_epistemic_gbm(100.0, 5.0, 0.05, 0.01, 0.2, 0.02, 1.0, 100, 42)
    if ep_unc.x_unc[0] > ep_zero.x_unc[0] {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // T10 Determinism: same seed → same x[0]
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    let gbm_a = gbm_simulate(100.0, 0.05, 0.2, 1.0, 100, 42)
    let gbm_b = gbm_simulate(100.0, 0.05, 0.2, 1.0, 100, 42)
    let diff10 = abs_f64(gbm_a.x[0] - gbm_b.x[0])
    if diff10 < 1.0e-10 {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // T11 Milstein state is finite and uncertainty is non-negative
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    var ms4_state = sde_state_new(1, 999)
    ms4_state.x[0] = 5.0
    ms4_state.x_unc[0] = 0.5
    let drift4:    [f64; 16] = [0.1; 16]
    let diff4:     [f64; 16] = [0.5; 16]
    let diff_drv4: [f64; 16] = [0.2; 16]
    let ms4_out = milstein_step(ms4_state, 0.01, &drift4, &diff4, &diff_drv4)
    let ms4_finite = ms4_out.x[0] > 0.0 - 1.0e200 && ms4_out.x[0] < 1.0e200
    let ms4_unc_ok = ms4_out.x_unc[0] >= 0.0
    if ms4_finite && ms4_unc_ok {
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Summary
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    if fail > 0 { return 1 }
    return 0
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    return run_tests()
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/str/test_str.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// E2E tests for stdlib/str/lib.sio
//
// Tests: str_eq, str_cat, str_contains, str_starts_with, str_ends_with,
//        str_index_of, str_sub, str_trim, str_to_upper, str_to_lower,
//        str_split_char, str_reverse, str_repeat, str_char_at_s,
//        str_replace_char, str_from_i64, str_from_f64, str_to_i64,
//        str_to_f64 (round-trip).

use str::lib::*

fn near(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> bool with Div {
    let d = if a > b { a - b } else { b - a }
    d < tol
}

fn run_tests() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var pass = 0
    var fail = 0

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ str_eq
    print("Test 01: str_eq equal strings... ")
    let s_a = str_from_literal("hello")
    let s_b = str_from_literal("hello")
    if str_eq(&s_a, &s_b) {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    print("Test 02: str_eq different strings... ")
    let s_c = str_from_literal("world")
    if !str_eq(&s_a, &s_c) {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------------- str_cat
    print("Test 03: str_cat... ")
    let s_cat = str_cat(&s_a, &s_c)
    let s_expected_cat = str_from_literal("helloworld")
    if str_eq(&s_cat, &s_expected_cat) {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- str_contains
    print("Test 04: str_contains (found)... ")
    let haystack = str_from_literal("hello world")
    let needle = str_from_literal("world")
    if str_contains(&haystack, &needle) {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    print("Test 05: str_contains (not found)... ")
    let needle2 = str_from_literal("xyz")
    if !str_contains(&haystack, &needle2) {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------- str_starts_with
    print("Test 06: str_starts_with (true)... ")
    let prefix = str_from_literal("hello")
    if str_starts_with(&haystack, &prefix) {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    print("Test 07: str_starts_with (false)... ")
    let prefix2 = str_from_literal("world")
    if !str_starts_with(&haystack, &prefix2) {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ str_ends_with
    print("Test 08: str_ends_with (true)... ")
    let suffix = str_from_literal("world")
    if str_ends_with(&haystack, &suffix) {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    print("Test 09: str_ends_with (false)... ")
    let suffix2 = str_from_literal("hello")
    if !str_ends_with(&haystack, &suffix2) {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------- str_index_of
    print("Test 10: str_index_of (found)... ")
    let idx = str_index_of(&haystack, &needle)
    if idx == 6 {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL (got ")
        print(idx)
        print(")\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    print("Test 11: str_index_of (not found)... ")
    let idx2 = str_index_of(&haystack, &needle2)
    if idx2 == 0 - 1 {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL (got ")
        print(idx2)
        print(")\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------------- str_sub
    print("Test 12: str_sub... ")
    let src_slice = str_from_literal("abcdef")
    let sliced = str_sub(&src_slice, 2, 5)
    let expected_slice = str_from_literal("cde")
    if str_eq(&sliced, &expected_slice) {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL (got ")
        print(str_to_string(sliced))
        print(")\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- str_trim
    print("Test 13: str_trim (leading+trailing spaces)... ")
    let padded = str_from_literal("  hello  ")
    let trimmed = str_trim(&padded)
    let expected_trim = str_from_literal("hello")
    if str_eq(&trimmed, &expected_trim) {
        print("PASS\n")

    } else {

        print("')\n")

        print("PASS\n")

        print(str_to_string(lower_out))
        print("')\n")
        fail = fail + 1

    // -------------------------------------------------------- str_split_char
    print("Test 17: str_split_char (3 parts)... ")
    let csv = str_from_literal("a,b,c")

        let part0 = str_split_get(&split_out, 0)
        let part1 = str_split_get(&split_out, 1)
        let part2 = str_split_get(&split_out, 2)
        let ea = str_from_literal("a")
        let eb = str_from_literal("b")
        let ec = str_from_literal("c")
        if str_eq(&part0, &ea) && str_eq(&part1, &eb) && str_eq(&part2, &ec) {
            print("PASS\n")

        } else {
            print("FAIL (values wrong, lens=")
            print(part0.len)
            print(",")
            print(part1.len)
            print(",")
            print(part2.len)
            print(")\n")
            fail = fail + 1
        }
    } else {
        print("FAIL (count=")
        print(split_count)
        print(")\n")

        print("PASS\n")

    } else {

    // ------------------------------------------------------ str_to_i64

    if parsed_neg == 0 - 456 {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL (got ")
        print(parsed_neg)
        print(")\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------ str_to_f64
    print("Test 32: str_to_f64('3.14')... ")
    let parse_f = str_from_literal("3.14")
    let parsed_f = str_to_f64(&parse_f)
    if near(parsed_f, 3.14, 0.001) {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL (got ")
        print(parsed_f)
        print(")\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------- Round-trip f64
    print("Test 33: round-trip str_to_f64(str_from_f64(2.718, 3))... ")
    let rt_str = str_from_f64(2.718, 3)
    let rt_val = str_to_f64(&rt_str)
    if near(rt_val, 2.718, 0.001) {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL (got ")
        print(rt_val)
        print(")\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------- str_len
    print("Test 34: str_len... ")
    let s_len_test = str_from_literal("abcde")
    if str_len(&s_len_test) == 5 {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------ Summary
    print("\nPassed: ")
    print(pass)
    print("  Failed: ")
    print(fail)
    print("\n")

    fail
}

fn main() -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    run_tests()
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/string/test_string.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// E2E tests for stdlib/string/string.sio
//
// Tests: str_is_continuation, str_char_count, str_buf_eq, str_starts_with,
//        str_find_byte, str_trim_start, str_trim_end,
//        str_to_upper_byte, str_to_lower_byte

use string::string::*

fn buf_from_ascii(a: u8, b: u8, c: u8) -> [u8; 256]  with Mut{
    var buf: [u8; 256] = [0; 256]
    buf[0] = a
    buf[1] = b
    buf[2] = c
    buf
}

fn run_tests() -> i32  with IO, Mut{
    var pass = 0
    var fail = 0

    // ------------------------------------------- str_is_continuation: ASCII byte
    print("Test 01: str_is_continuation ASCII 'A' (65) == 0... ")
    if str_is_continuation(65) == 0 {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------- str_is_continuation: continuation byte
    print("Test 02: str_is_continuation 0x80 (128) == 1... ")
    if str_is_continuation(128) == 1 {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------- str_is_continuation: lead byte 0xC2 not a continuation
    print("Test 03: str_is_continuation 0xC2 (194) == 0... ")
    if str_is_continuation(194) == 0 {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------- str_char_count ASCII
    print("Test 04: str_char_count 3 ASCII bytes == 3... ")
    let buf_abc = buf_from_ascii(65, 66, 67)
    if str_char_count(buf_abc, 3) == 3 {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------- str_char_count empty
    print("Test 05: str_char_count 0 bytes == 0... ")

    if str_char_count(buf_empty, 0) == 0 {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------- str_buf_eq equal buffers
    print("Test 06: str_buf_eq equal 3-byte buffers == 1... ")
    let ba = buf_from_ascii(72, 105, 0)
    let bb = buf_from_ascii(72, 105, 0)
    if str_buf_eq(ba, 2, bb, 2) == 1 {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------- str_buf_eq different lengths
    print("Test 07: str_buf_eq different lengths == 0... ")
    if str_buf_eq(ba, 2, bb, 1) == 0 {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------- str_buf_eq different content
    print("Test 08: str_buf_eq different content == 0... ")
    let bc = buf_from_ascii(72, 106, 0)
    if str_buf_eq(ba, 2, bc, 2) == 0 {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------- str_starts_with true
    print("Test 09: str_starts_with prefix present == 1... ")
    let buf_hello = buf_from_ascii(72, 101, 108)   // "Hel"
    let prefix_h = buf_from_ascii(72, 0, 0)        // "H"
    if str_starts_with(buf_hello, 3, prefix_h, 1) == 1 {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------- str_starts_with too long prefix
    print("Test 10: str_starts_with prefix longer than buf == 0... ")
    if str_starts_with(prefix_h, 1, buf_hello, 3) == 0 {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------- str_find_byte found
    print("Test 11: str_find_byte finds byte at index 1... ")
    let buf_xy = buf_from_ascii(88, 89, 90)   // "XYZ"
    if str_find_byte(buf_xy, 3, 89) == 1 {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------- str_find_byte not found
    print("Test 12: str_find_byte absent byte returns -1... ")
    if str_find_byte(buf_xy, 3, 65) == 0 - 1 {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------- str_trim_start no leading space

        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1

    buf_sp[0] = 32   // space
    buf_sp[1] = 32   // space
    buf_sp[2] = 65   // 'A'

        print("FAIL\n")

    buf_te[0] = 65   // 'A'
    buf_te[1] = 32   // space
    buf_te[2] = 32   // space
    if str_trim_end(buf_te, 3) == 1 {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------- str_to_upper_byte
    print("Test 16: str_to_upper_byte 'a' -> 'A'... ")
    if str_to_upper_byte(97) == 65 {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------- str_to_upper_byte non-alpha unchanged
    print("Test 17: str_to_upper_byte '0' unchanged... ")
    if str_to_upper_byte(48) == 48 {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // ------------------------------------------- str_to_lower_byte
