// === FILE: tests/stdlib/sync/test_atomic_e2e.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// E2E: stdlib/sync/atomic.sio — AtomicI64 operations

use sync::atomic::*;

fn run_tests(a: &! AtomicI64) -> i32 {
    // Initial value
    if atomic_load(a) != 0 { return 1 }

    // Store and load
    atomic_store(a, 42)
    if atomic_load(a) != 42 { return 2 }

    // Add
    let old = atomic_add(a, 10)
    if old != 42 { return 3 }
    if atomic_load(a) != 52 { return 4 }

    // Sub
    let old2 = atomic_sub(a, 2)
    if old2 != 52 { return 5 }
    if atomic_load(a) != 50 { return 6 }

    // CAS success
    let ok = atomic_cas(a, 50, 100)
    if !ok { return 7 }
    if atomic_load(a) != 100 { return 8 }

    // CAS failure
    let fail = atomic_cas(a, 50, 200)
    if fail { return 9 }
    if atomic_load(a) != 100 { return 10 }

    return 0
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    var a = atomic_new(0)
    return run_tests(&! a)
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/sync/test_channel_e2e.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// E2E: stdlib/sync/channel.sio — IntChannel send/recv

use sync::channel::*;

fn run_tests(ch: &! IntChannel) -> i32 {
    // Empty channel
    if !ch.is_empty() { return 1 }

    // Send and recv
    let ok1 = ch.send(10)
    if !ok1 { return 2 }
    let ok2 = ch.send(20)
    if !ok2 { return 3 }
    let ok3 = ch.send(30)
    if !ok3 { return 4 }
    if ch.len() != 3 { return 5 }

    // Recv in FIFO order
    let v1 = ch.recv()
    if v1 != 10 { return 6 }
    let v2 = ch.recv()
    if v2 != 20 { return 7 }
    let v3 = ch.recv()
    if v3 != 30 { return 8 }

    // Empty after recv
    if !ch.is_empty() { return 9 }

    // Close
    ch.close()
    if !ch.is_closed() { return 10 }
    let ok4 = ch.send(99)
    if ok4 { return 11 }

    return 0
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    var ch = IntChannel::new()
    return run_tests(&! ch)
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/sync/test_rwlock_e2e.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// E2E: stdlib/sync/rwlock.sio — RwLock read/write lock

use sync::rwlock::*;

fn run_tests(rw: &! RwLock) -> i32 {
    // Multiple read locks
    let r1 = rw.read_lock()
    if !r1 { return 1 }
    let r2 = rw.read_lock()
    if !r2 { return 2 }
    if rw.reader_count() != 2 { return 3 }

    // Write lock fails while readers hold
    let w1 = rw.write_lock()
    if w1 { return 4 }

    // Unlock readers
    rw.read_unlock()
    rw.read_unlock()
    if rw.reader_count() != 0 { return 5 }

    // Write lock succeeds now
    let w2 = rw.write_lock()
    if !w2 { return 6 }
    if !rw.is_write_locked() { return 7 }

    // Read lock fails while writer holds
    let r3 = rw.read_lock()
    if r3 { return 8 }

    // Unlock writer
    rw.write_unlock()
    if rw.is_write_locked() { return 9 }

    return 0
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    var rw = RwLock::new()
    return run_tests(&! rw)
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/systems/test_systems.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// Tests for stdlib/systems/lib.sio
// Validates dynamical systems: Lorenz, Rössler, Van der Pol, pendulum.
//
// Integration method: forward Euler (explicit).
// Tests verify qualitative properties: boundedness, chaos, energy conservation.

use systems::*
use math::pure::*

fn f_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn check_near(got: f64, expected: f64, tol: f64) -> bool {
    let d = got - expected
    let ad = if d < 0.0 { 0.0 - d } else { d }
    return ad < tol
}

fn run_tests() -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var fail = 0

    // =========================================================================
    // Test 1: system_state_new initializes correctly
    // =========================================================================
    let s0 = system_state_new(3)
    if s0.n != 3 { fail = fail + 1 }
    if s0.t != 0.0 { fail = fail + 1 }
    if f_abs(s0.x[0]) > 1.0e-15 { fail = fail + 1 }
    if f_abs(s0.x[1]) > 1.0e-15 { fail = fail + 1 }
    if f_abs(s0.x[2]) > 1.0e-15 { fail = fail + 1 }

    // =========================================================================
    // Test 2: Lorenz step — time advances by dt
    // =========================================================================
    var ls = system_state_new(3)
    ls.x[0] = 1.0
    ls.x[1] = 1.0
    ls.x[2] = 1.0
    let ls1 = lorenz_step(ls, 0.01, 10.0, 28.0, 2.6666666666666665)
    if !check_near(ls1.t, 0.01, 1.0e-14) { fail = fail + 1 }

    // =========================================================================
    // Test 3: Lorenz — trajectory divergence demonstrates chaos (positive λ)
    //
    // Two nearby trajectories with initial separation δx=1e-4 should diverge
    // exponentially. After 500 steps (t=5.0), separation >> 1e-4.
    // ==========================================================================
    let lorenz1 = lorenz_simulate(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.01, 500)
    let lorenz2 = lorenz_simulate(1.0001, 1.0, 1.0, 0.01, 500)

    let sep_x = f_abs(lorenz1.x[0] - lorenz2.x[0])
    let sep_y = f_abs(lorenz1.x[1] - lorenz2.x[1])
    let sep_z = f_abs(lorenz1.x[2] - lorenz2.x[2])
    let total_sep = sep_x + sep_y + sep_z

    // Initial separation was 1e-4; Lyapunov ~0.9 → growth e^(0.9*5)≈90x
    // Even with Euler drift, separation should be >> 1e-3
    if total_sep < 0.001 { fail = fail + 1 }

    // =========================================================================
    // Test 4: Lorenz — z stays bounded [0, ~60] for standard parameters
    //
    // The Lorenz attractor is bounded: all trajectories stay in a compact set.
    // For σ=10, ρ=28, β=8/3 the z-coordinate stays in [0, ~60].
    // ==========================================================================
    var lz_min = lorenz1.x[2]
    var lz_max = lorenz1.x[2]

    // Simulate from several initial conditions and track z range
    let test_a = lorenz_simulate(5.0, 5.0, 5.0, 0.005, 2000)
    let test_b = lorenz_simulate(0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.005, 2000)
    let test_c = lorenz_simulate(10.0, 0.0, 15.0, 0.005, 2000)

    // All z values should be positive and below 65
    let z_a = test_a.x[2]
    let z_b = test_b.x[2]
    let z_c = test_c.x[2]

    if z_a < 0.0 || z_a > 65.0 { fail = fail + 1 }
    if z_b < 0.0 || z_b > 65.0 { fail = fail + 1 }
    if z_c < 0.0 || z_c > 65.0 { fail = fail + 1 }

    // =========================================================================
    // Test 5: Van der Pol — limit cycle, |x| stays bounded
    //
    // For μ=1, the limit cycle amplitude ≈ 2. Even with Euler integration
    // (which adds numerical dissipation), |x| stays well below 5 after
    // transient decay.
    // ==========================================================================
    var vdp = system_state_new(2)
    vdp.x[0] = 2.0
    vdp.x[1] = 0.0

    var vdp_step = 0
    while vdp_step < 3000 {
        vdp = van_der_pol_step(vdp, 0.01, 1.0)
        vdp_step = vdp_step + 1
    }

    let vdp_x = f_abs(vdp.x[0])
    let vdp_y = f_abs(vdp.x[1])

    // Limit cycle: bounded oscillations, not divergence
    if vdp_x > 5.0 { fail = fail + 1 }
    if vdp_y > 5.0 { fail = fail + 1 }

    // =========================================================================
    // Test 6: Van der Pol — system is not at rest (oscillating)
    // ==========================================================================
    var vdp2 = system_state_new(2)
    vdp2.x[0] = 2.0
    vdp2.x[1] = 0.0

    // Run forward then sample — should not be zero (limit cycle is active)
    var vi = 0
    while vi < 500 {
        vdp2 = van_der_pol_step(vdp2, 0.01, 1.0)
        vi = vi + 1
    }
    let vdp2_energy = vdp2.x[0] * vdp2.x[0] + vdp2.x[1] * vdp2.x[1]
    // Energy > 0: system is oscillating
    if vdp2_energy < 0.1 { fail = fail + 1 }

    // =========================================================================
    // Test 7: Pendulum — energy conservation
    //
    // E = 0.5*ω² + (g/l)*(1 - cos θ)
    // For small dt=0.001, small angle θ₀=0.1 rad, energy should be conserved
    // to within 5% over 200 steps (t=0.2 s). Forward Euler adds small drift.
    // ==========================================================================
    var pend = system_state_new(2)
    pend.x[0] = 0.1   // theta = 0.1 rad
    pend.x[1] = 0.0   // omega = 0

    let g_val = 9.81
    let l_val = 1.0

    let cos0 = cos(pend.x[0])
    let e0 = 0.5 * pend.x[1] * pend.x[1] + g_val / l_val * (1.0 - cos0)

    var pi_step = 0
    while pi_step < 200 {
        pend = pendulum_step(pend, 0.001, g_val, l_val)
        pi_step = pi_step + 1
    }

    let cos1 = cos(pend.x[0])
    let e1 = 0.5 * pend.x[1] * pend.x[1] + g_val / l_val * (1.0 - cos1)

    // Relative energy error < 5% for dt=0.001, short integration
    let de = f_abs(e1 - e0)
    let rel_err = de / e0
    if rel_err > 0.05 { fail = fail + 1 }

    // =========================================================================
    // Test 8: Pendulum — angle stays bounded for small oscillation
    // ==========================================================================
    var pend2 = system_state_new(2)
    pend2.x[0] = 0.3   // theta = 0.3 rad (~17 degrees)
    pend2.x[1] = 0.0

    var p2i = 0
    while p2i < 500 {
        pend2 = pendulum_step(pend2, 0.001, 9.81, 1.0)
        p2i = p2i + 1
    }

    // Angle should stay within ±1.0 rad for small initial angle + short time
    let pend2_theta = f_abs(pend2.x[0])
    if pend2_theta > 1.0 { fail = fail + 1 }

    // =========================================================================
    // Test 9: Rössler — stays finite for standard parameters
    //
    // Standard chaotic parameters: a=0.2, b=0.2, c=5.7
    // Small dt=0.005 to maintain stability of Euler method.
    // ==========================================================================
    var ross = system_state_new(3)
    ross.x[0] = 1.0
    ross.x[1] = 0.0
    ross.x[2] = 0.0

    var ri = 0
    while ri < 2000 {
        ross = rossler_step(ross, 0.005, 0.2, 0.2, 5.7)
        ri = ri + 1
    }

    let rx = f_abs(ross.x[0])
    let ry = f_abs(ross.x[1])
    let rz = f_abs(ross.x[2])

    // Rössler attractor: bounded in a compact set
    if rx > 25.0 { fail = fail + 1 }
    if ry > 25.0 { fail = fail + 1 }
    if rz > 25.0 { fail = fail + 1 }

    // =========================================================================
    // Test 10: lyapunov_estimate — positive for exponentially diverging signal
    //
    // Geometric sequence x[i] = 2^i has ratio 2 at each step → λ > 0.
    // ==========================================================================
    var exp_arr: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    exp_arr[0] = 1.0
    exp_arr[1] = 2.0
    exp_arr[2] = 4.0
    exp_arr[3] = 8.0
    exp_arr[4] = 16.0
    exp_arr[5] = 32.0
    exp_arr[6] = 64.0
    exp_arr[7] = 128.0

    let lam_pos = lyapunov_estimate(&exp_arr, 8, 0.01)
    // Doubling → λ ≈ ln(2)/dt = 69.3; at minimum it should be positive
    if lam_pos < 0.0 { fail = fail + 1 }

    // =========================================================================
    // Test 11: lyapunov_estimate — near-zero for constant signal
    // ==========================================================================
    var const_arr: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    const_arr[0] = 5.0
    const_arr[1] = 5.0
    const_arr[2] = 5.0
    const_arr[3] = 5.0
    const_arr[4] = 5.0
    const_arr[5] = 5.0
    const_arr[6] = 5.0
    const_arr[7] = 5.0

    let lam_const = lyapunov_estimate(&const_arr, 8, 0.01)
    // Constant → zero (function returns 0.0 for identical consecutive values)
    if lam_const != 0.0 { fail = fail + 1 }

    if fail > 0 { return 1 }
    return 0
}

fn main() -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    return run_tests()
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/tensor/test_caputo_l1_tape.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: D5_CAPUTO_TENSOR_PASS

use tensor::types::{
    Tensor,
    shape1,
    tensor_get,
    tensor_set,
}
use tensor::ops::{
    tensor_zeros,
    tensor_free,
    tensor_scalar,
}
use tensor::tape::{
    tape_begin,
    tape_drop,
    tape_leaf,
    tape_backward,
    tape_tensor_add,
    tape_tensor_mul,
    tape_tensor_caputo_l1,
    tape_grad_at,
    tape_value_at,
}
use special::caputo::{
    caputo_l1_derivative,
    caputo_pow,
    fractional_decay_ml,
}

fn cpt_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn assert_abs_close(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) with Panic {
    assert(cpt_abs(a - b) <= tol)
}

fn assert_rel_close(a: f64, b: f64, rtol: f64, atol: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let diff = cpt_abs(a - b)
    var scale = cpt_abs(b)
    if scale < 1.0 { scale = 1.0 }
    assert(diff <= atol || diff / scale <= rtol)
}

fn fill_constant(t: &!Tensor, value: f64) with Mut, Panic {
    var i: usize = 0 as usize
    while i < t.shape.len {
        tensor_set(t, i, value)
        i = i + 1 as usize
    }
}

fn fill_fractional_decay(t: &!Tensor, alpha: f64, lambda: f64, dt: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i: usize = 0 as usize
    while i < t.shape.len {
        let time = (i as f64) * dt
        tensor_set(t, i, fractional_decay_ml(1.0, lambda, time, alpha))
        i = i + 1 as usize
    }
}

fn caputo_direct(u: &Tensor, dt: f64, alpha: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var samples: [f64; 512] = [0.0; 512]
    var i: usize = 0 as usize
    while i < u.shape.len {
        samples[i] = tensor_get(u, i)
        i = i + 1 as usize
    }
    return caputo_l1_derivative(samples, (u.shape.len - 1 as usize) as i32, dt, alpha)
}

fn fd_caputo(u: &!Tensor, idx: usize, dt: f64, alpha: f64, eps: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let saved = tensor_get(u, idx)
    tensor_set(u, idx, saved + eps)
    let plus = caputo_direct(u, dt, alpha)
    tensor_set(u, idx, saved - eps)
    let minus = caputo_direct(u, dt, alpha)
    tensor_set(u, idx, saved)
    return (plus - minus) / (2.0 * eps)
}

fn squared_caputo_direct(u: &Tensor, dt: f64, alpha: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let d = caputo_direct(u, dt, alpha)
    return d * d
}

fn fd_squared_caputo(u: &!Tensor, idx: usize, dt: f64, alpha: f64, eps: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let saved = tensor_get(u, idx)
    tensor_set(u, idx, saved + eps)
    let plus = squared_caputo_direct(u, dt, alpha)
    tensor_set(u, idx, saved - eps)
    let minus = squared_caputo_direct(u, dt, alpha)
    tensor_set(u, idx, saved)
    return (plus - minus) / (2.0 * eps)
}

fn test_constant_zero_gradient() with Alloc, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let alpha = 0.8
    let dt = 0.1
    var u = tensor_zeros(shape1(20 as usize))
    fill_constant(&!u, 3.25)

    var tape = tape_begin()
    let uid = tape_leaf(&!tape, &u, true)
    let did = tape_tensor_caputo_l1(&!tape, uid, dt, alpha)
    let loss = tape_tensor_mul(&!tape, did, did)
    tape_backward(&!tape, loss)
    assert_abs_close(tape_value_at(&tape, did, 0 as usize), 0.0, 1.0e-10)

    var i: usize = 0 as usize
    while i < u.shape.len {
        assert_abs_close(tape_grad_at(&tape, uid, i), 0.0, 1.0e-8)
        assert_abs_close(fd_squared_caputo(&!u, i, dt, alpha, 1.0e-6), 0.0, 1.0e-8)
        i = i + 1 as usize
    }

    tape_drop(&!tape)
    tensor_free(&!u)
}

fn test_fd_gradient() with Alloc, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let alpha = 0.8
    let dt = 0.1
    let lambda = 0.1
    var u = tensor_zeros(shape1(20 as usize))
    fill_fractional_decay(&!u, alpha, lambda, dt)

    var tape = tape_begin()
    let uid = tape_leaf(&!tape, &u, true)
    let did = tape_tensor_caputo_l1(&!tape, uid, dt, alpha)
    tape_backward(&!tape, did)

    let eps = 1.0e-6
    var i: usize = 0 as usize
    while i < u.shape.len {
        let tape_g = tape_grad_at(&tape, uid, i)
        let fd_g = fd_caputo(&!u, i, dt, alpha, eps)
        assert_rel_close(tape_g, fd_g, 1.0e-6, 1.0e-6)
        i = i + 1 as usize
    }

    tape_drop(&!tape)
    tensor_free(&!u)
}

fn test_pinn_residual_mini() with Alloc, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let alpha = 0.8
    let dt = 0.1
    let k = 0.1
    var u = tensor_zeros(shape1(20 as usize))
    var i: usize = 0 as usize
    while i < u.shape.len {
        let t = (i as f64) * dt
        tensor_set(&!u, i, 1.0 + 0.05 * t + 0.01 * caputo_pow(t + 1.0, 2.0))
        i = i + 1 as usize
    }

    var tape = tape_begin()
    let uid = tape_leaf(&!tape, &u, true)
    let did = tape_tensor_caputo_l1(&!tape, uid, dt, alpha)
    let last_idx = u.shape.len - 1 as usize
    let last_value = tensor_get(&u, last_idx)
    var kc = tensor_scalar(k * last_value)
    let kid = tape_leaf(&!tape, &kc, false)
    let resid = tape_tensor_add(&!tape, did, kid)
    tape_backward(&!tape, resid)

    assert(cpt_abs(tape_value_at(&tape, resid, 0 as usize)) > 1.0e-8)
    var grad_norm = 0.0
    i = 0 as usize
    while i < u.shape.len {
        let g = tape_grad_at(&tape, uid, i)
        grad_norm = grad_norm + g * g
        i = i + 1 as usize
    }
    assert(grad_norm > 1.0e-12)

    tape_drop(&!tape)
    tensor_free(&!kc)
    tensor_free(&!u)
}

fn main() -> i32 with Alloc, IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    test_constant_zero_gradient()
    test_fd_gradient()
    test_pinn_residual_mini()
    println("D5_CAPUTO_TENSOR_PASS")
    return 0
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/tensor/test_tensor_autograd_d2.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: D2_AUTOGRAD_TAPE_CLOSURE_FREE_PASS

use tensor::types::{
    Tensor,
    shape_scalar, shape1, shape2, shape_eq,
    tensor_get, tensor_set,
}
use tensor::ops::{
    tensor_zeros, tensor_scalar, tensor_free,
    tensor_add, tensor_sub, tensor_mul, tensor_matmul, tensor_sum,
}
use tensor::tape::{
    tape_begin, tape_drop, tape_leaf, tape_backward,
    tape_tensor_add, tape_tensor_sub, tape_tensor_mul, tape_tensor_div,
    tape_tensor_matmul, tape_tensor_sum, tape_tensor_mean,
    tape_tensor_reshape, tape_tensor_transpose, tape_tensor_permute,
    tape_tensor_tanh, tape_tensor_sigmoid, tape_tensor_relu, tape_tensor_gelu,
    tape_grad_at, tape_value_at, tape_node_count,
}

fn d2_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn d2_close(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> bool {
    d2_abs(a - b) <= tol
}

fn assert_close(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) with Panic {
    assert(d2_close(a, b, tol))
}

fn fill_w(t: &!Tensor) with Mut, Panic {
    tensor_set(t, 0 as usize, 0.20)
    tensor_set(t, 1 as usize, 0.50)
    tensor_set(t, 2 as usize, 0.70)
    tensor_set(t, 3 as usize, 0.30)
}

fn fill_x(t: &!Tensor) with Mut, Panic {
    tensor_set(t, 0 as usize, 1.00)
    tensor_set(t, 1 as usize, 0.40)
    tensor_set(t, 2 as usize, 0.20)
    tensor_set(t, 3 as usize, 0.80)
}

fn fill_b(t: &!Tensor) with Mut, Panic {
    tensor_set(t, 0 as usize, 0.10)
    tensor_set(t, 1 as usize, 0.05)
}

fn fill_y(t: &!Tensor) with Mut, Panic {
    tensor_set(t, 0 as usize, 0.55)
    tensor_set(t, 1 as usize, 0.70)
    tensor_set(t, 2 as usize, 0.90)
    tensor_set(t, 3 as usize, 0.85)
}

fn worked_loss(w: &Tensor, x: &Tensor, b: &Tensor, y: &Tensor) -> f64 with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var z0 = tensor_matmul(w, x)
    var z1 = tensor_add(&z0, b)
    var z2 = tensor_sub(&z1, y)
    var z3 = tensor_mul(&z2, &z2)
    var loss = tensor_sum(&z3, None, false)
    let out = tensor_get(&loss, 0 as usize)
    tensor_free(&!z0)
    tensor_free(&!z1)
    tensor_free(&!z2)
    tensor_free(&!z3)
    tensor_free(&!loss)
    out
}

fn finite_diff_w(w: &!Tensor, x: &Tensor, b: &Tensor, y: &Tensor, idx: usize, eps: f64) -> f64 with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let saved = tensor_get(w, idx)
    tensor_set(w, idx, saved + eps)
    let plus = worked_loss(w, x, b, y)
    tensor_set(w, idx, saved - eps)
    let minus = worked_loss(w, x, b, y)
    tensor_set(w, idx, saved)
    (plus - minus) / (2.0 * eps)
}

fn finite_diff_b(w: &Tensor, x: &Tensor, b: &!Tensor, y: &Tensor, idx: usize, eps: f64) -> f64 with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let saved = tensor_get(b, idx)
    tensor_set(b, idx, saved + eps)
    let plus = worked_loss(w, x, b, y)
    tensor_set(b, idx, saved - eps)
    let minus = worked_loss(w, x, b, y)
    tensor_set(b, idx, saved)
    (plus - minus) / (2.0 * eps)
}

fn test_worked_example_fd() with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var w = tensor_zeros(shape2(2 as usize, 2 as usize))
    var x = tensor_zeros(shape2(2 as usize, 2 as usize))
    var b = tensor_zeros(shape2(2 as usize, 1 as usize))
    var y = tensor_zeros(shape2(2 as usize, 2 as usize))
    fill_w(&!w)
    fill_x(&!x)
    fill_b(&!b)
    fill_y(&!y)

    var tape = tape_begin()
    let wid = tape_leaf(&!tape, &w, true)
    let xid = tape_leaf(&!tape, &x, false)
    let bid = tape_leaf(&!tape, &b, true)
    let yid = tape_leaf(&!tape, &y, false)
    let z0 = tape_tensor_matmul(&!tape, wid, xid)
    let z1 = tape_tensor_add(&!tape, z0, bid)
    let z2 = tape_tensor_sub(&!tape, z1, yid)
    let z3 = tape_tensor_mul(&!tape, z2, z2)
    let loss = tape_tensor_sum(&!tape, z3, None, false)
    tape_backward(&!tape, loss)

    let tape_loss = tape_value_at(&tape, loss, 0 as usize)
    let fd_loss = worked_loss(&w, &x, &b, &y)
    assert_close(tape_loss, fd_loss, 1.0e-12)

    let eps = 1.0e-6
    var i: usize = 0 as usize
    while i < 4 as usize {
        let fd = finite_diff_w(&!w, &x, &b, &y, i, eps)
        assert_close(tape_grad_at(&tape, wid, i), fd, 1.0e-6)
        i = i + 1 as usize
    }
    i = 0 as usize
    while i < 2 as usize {
        let fd = finite_diff_b(&w, &x, &!b, &y, i, eps)
        assert_close(tape_grad_at(&tape, bid, i), fd, 1.0e-6)
        i = i + 1 as usize
    }

    assert(tape_node_count(&tape) == 5 as usize)
    tape_drop(&!tape)
    tensor_free(&!w)
    tensor_free(&!x)
    tensor_free(&!b)
    tensor_free(&!y)
}

fn test_repeated_parent_and_op_surface() with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var x = tensor_scalar(3.0)
    var tape = tape_begin()
    let xid = tape_leaf(&!tape, &x, true)
    let x2 = tape_tensor_add(&!tape, xid, xid)
    let x4 = tape_tensor_mul(&!tape, x2, x2)
    tape_backward(&!tape, x4)
    assert_close(tape_value_at(&tape, x4, 0 as usize), 36.0, 1.0e-12)
    assert_close(tape_grad_at(&tape, xid, 0 as usize), 24.0, 1.0e-12)
    tape_drop(&!tape)
    tensor_free(&!x)

    var v = tensor_zeros(shape1(3 as usize))
    tensor_set(&!v, 0 as usize, 0.0 - 1.0)
    tensor_set(&!v, 1 as usize, 0.0)
    tensor_set(&!v, 2 as usize, 2.0)
    var tape2 = tape_begin()
    let vid = tape_leaf(&!tape2, &v, true)
    let th = tape_tensor_tanh(&!tape2, vid)
    let sg = tape_tensor_sigmoid(&!tape2, th)
    let rl = tape_tensor_relu(&!tape2, sg)
    let ge = tape_tensor_gelu(&!tape2, rl)
    let rs = tape_tensor_reshape(&!tape2, ge, shape2(1 as usize, 3 as usize))
    let tr = tape_tensor_transpose(&!tape2, rs)
    var axes = [0 as usize; 8]
    axes[0] = 1 as usize
    axes[1] = 0 as usize
    let pm = tape_tensor_permute(&!tape2, tr, axes)
    let sm = tape_tensor_mean(&!tape2, pm, None, false)
    assert(tape_node_count(&tape2) == 8 as usize)
    tape_drop(&!tape2)
    tensor_free(&!v)

    var a = tensor_scalar(8.0)
    var c = tensor_scalar(2.0)
    var tape3 = tape_begin()
    let aid = tape_leaf(&!tape3, &a, true)
    let cid = tape_leaf(&!tape3, &c, true)
    let div = tape_tensor_div(&!tape3, aid, cid)
    tape_backward(&!tape3, div)
    assert_close(tape_grad_at(&tape3, aid, 0 as usize), 0.5, 1.0e-12)
    assert_close(tape_grad_at(&tape3, cid, 0 as usize), 0.0 - 2.0, 1.0e-12)
    tape_drop(&!tape3)
    tensor_free(&!a)
    tensor_free(&!c)
}

fn main() -> i32 with Alloc, IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    test_worked_example_fd()
    test_repeated_parent_and_op_surface()
    println("D2_AUTOGRAD_TAPE_CLOSURE_FREE_PASS")
    0
}


// === FILE: tests/stdlib/tensor/test_tensor_autograd_d2_hardening.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: D2_HARDENED_GENERAL_SHAPES_PASS

use tensor::types::{
    Tensor,
    shape1, shape2,
    tensor_get, tensor_set,
}
use tensor::ops::{
    tensor_zeros, tensor_free,
    tensor_matmul, tensor_sum,
    tensor_tanh, tensor_sigmoid, tensor_relu,
}
use tensor::tape::{
    tape_begin, tape_drop, tape_leaf, tape_backward,
    tape_tensor_matmul, tape_tensor_add, tape_tensor_sum,
    tape_tensor_tanh, tape_tensor_sigmoid, tape_tensor_relu,
    tape_grad_at, tape_value_at,
}

fn h_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn assert_close_abs(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) with Panic {
    assert(h_abs(a - b) <= tol)
}

fn fill_matrix(t: &!Tensor) with Mut, Panic {
    var i: usize = 0 as usize
    while i < t.shape.len {
        let v = ((i + 3 as usize) as f64) * 0.071 - 0.23
        tensor_set(t, i, v)
        i = i + 1 as usize
    }
}

fn matmul_sum_loss(w: &Tensor, x: &Tensor) -> f64 with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var y = tensor_matmul(w, x)
    var s = tensor_sum(&y, None, false)
    let out = tensor_get(&s, 0 as usize)
    tensor_free(&!y)
    tensor_free(&!s)
    out
}

fn fd_matmul_w(w: &!Tensor, x: &Tensor, idx: usize, eps: f64) -> f64 with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let saved = tensor_get(w, idx)
    tensor_set(w, idx, saved + eps)
    let plus = matmul_sum_loss(w, x)
    tensor_set(w, idx, saved - eps)
    let minus = matmul_sum_loss(w, x)
    tensor_set(w, idx, saved)
    (plus - minus) / (2.0 * eps)
}

fn fd_matmul_x(w: &Tensor, x: &!Tensor, idx: usize, eps: f64) -> f64 with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let saved = tensor_get(x, idx)
    tensor_set(x, idx, saved + eps)
    let plus = matmul_sum_loss(w, x)
    tensor_set(x, idx, saved - eps)
    let minus = matmul_sum_loss(w, x)
    tensor_set(x, idx, saved)
    (plus - minus) / (2.0 * eps)
}

fn check_matmul_shape(m: usize, k: usize, n: usize) with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var w = tensor_zeros(shape2(m, k))
    var x = tensor_zeros(shape2(k, n))
    fill_matrix(&!w)
    fill_matrix(&!x)

    var tape = tape_begin()
    let wid = tape_leaf(&!tape, &w, true)
    let xid = tape_leaf(&!tape, &x, true)
    let out = tape_tensor_matmul(&!tape, wid, xid)
    let loss = tape_tensor_sum(&!tape, out, None, false)
    tape_backward(&!tape, loss)
    assert_close_abs(tape_value_at(&tape, loss, 0 as usize), matmul_sum_loss(&w, &x), 1.0e-10)

    let eps = 1.0e-6
    var i: usize = 0 as usize
    while i < w.shape.len {
        assert_close_abs(tape_grad_at(&tape, wid, i), fd_matmul_w(&!w, &x, i, eps), 1.0e-6)
        i = i + 1 as usize
    }
    i = 0 as usize
    while i < x.shape.len {
        assert_close_abs(tape_grad_at(&tape, xid, i), fd_matmul_x(&w, &!x, i, eps), 1.0e-6)
        i = i + 1 as usize
    }

    tape_drop(&!tape)
    tensor_free(&!w)
    tensor_free(&!x)
}

fn unary_sum_loss(x: &Tensor, op: i32) -> f64 with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var y = if op == 0 { tensor_tanh(x) } else if op == 1 { tensor_sigmoid(x) } else { tensor_relu(x) }
    var s = tensor_sum(&y, None, false)
    let out = tensor_get(&s, 0 as usize)
    tensor_free(&!y)
    tensor_free(&!s)
    out
}

fn fd_unary(x: &!Tensor, idx: usize, op: i32, eps: f64) -> f64 with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let saved = tensor_get(x, idx)
    tensor_set(x, idx, saved + eps)
    let plus = unary_sum_loss(x, op)
    tensor_set(x, idx, saved - eps)
    let minus = unary_sum_loss(x, op)
    tensor_set(x, idx, saved)
    (plus - minus) / (2.0 * eps)
}

fn check_unary(op: i32) with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var x = tensor_zeros(shape1(5 as usize))
    tensor_set(&!x, 0 as usize, 0.5)
    tensor_set(&!x, 1 as usize, 0.0 - 0.3)
    tensor_set(&!x, 2 as usize, 1.2)
    if op == 2 {
        tensor_set(&!x, 3 as usize, 0.0)
    } else {
        tensor_set(&!x, 3 as usize, 2.0)
    }
    tensor_set(&!x, 4 as usize, 0.0 - 1.5)
    var tape = tape_begin()
    let xid = tape_leaf(&!tape, &x, true)
    var yid = xid
    if op == 0 {
        yid = tape_tensor_tanh(&!tape, xid)
    } else if op == 1 {
        yid = tape_tensor_sigmoid(&!tape, xid)
    } else {
        yid = tape_tensor_relu(&!tape, xid)
    }
    let loss = tape_tensor_sum(&!tape, yid, None, false)
    tape_backward(&!tape, loss)
    let eps = 1.0e-6
    var i: usize = 0 as usize
    while i < x.shape.len {
        if op == 2 && i == 3 as usize {
            let g0 = tape_grad_at(&tape, xid, i)
            assert(g0 == 0.0 || h_abs(g0 - 0.5) <= 1.0e-6)
        } else {
            assert_close_abs(tape_grad_at(&tape, xid, i), fd_unary(&!x, i, op, eps), 1.0e-6)
        }
        i = i + 1 as usize
    }
    tape_drop(&!tape)
    tensor_free(&!x)
}

fn main() -> i32 with Alloc, IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    check_matmul_shape(3 as usize, 4 as usize, 1 as usize)
    check_matmul_shape(8 as usize, 6 as usize, 1 as usize)
    check_matmul_shape(4 as usize, 4 as usize, 4 as usize)
    check_matmul_shape(1 as usize, 5 as usize, 3 as usize)
    check_unary(0)
    check_unary(1)
    check_unary(2)
    println("D2_HARDENED_GENERAL_SHAPES_PASS")
    0
}

use tensor::types::{

    tensor_add, tensor_sub, tensor_mul, tensor_div,
    tensor_matmul, tensor_sum, tensor_mean,
    tensor_reshape, tensor_transpose, tensor_permute,

}

fn d1_abs(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

fn d1_close(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> bool {
    d1_abs(a - b) <= tol
}

fn assert_close(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) with Panic {

}

fn fill_matrix_2x2(t: &!Tensor, a00: f64, a01: f64, a10: f64, a11: f64) with Mut, Panic {
    tensor_set(t, 0 as usize, a00)
    tensor_set(t, 1 as usize, a01)
    tensor_set(t, 2 as usize, a10)
    tensor_set(t, 3 as usize, a11)
}

fn finite_difference_matmul_a00(a: &!Tensor, b: &Tensor, eps: f64) -> f64 with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let saved = tensor_get(a, 0 as usize)
    tensor_set(a, 0 as usize, saved + eps)
    var yp = tensor_matmul(a, b)
    let plus = tensor_get(&yp, 0 as usize)
    tensor_free(&!yp)

    tensor_set(a, 0 as usize, saved - eps)
    var ym = tensor_matmul(a, b)
    let minus = tensor_get(&ym, 0 as usize)
    tensor_free(&!ym)

    tensor_set(a, 0 as usize, saved)
    (plus - minus) / (2.0 * eps)
}

fn test_constructors_and_elementwise() with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var z = tensor_zeros(shape2(2 as usize, 3 as usize))
    var o = tensor_ones(shape2(2 as usize, 3 as usize))
    var two = tensor_full(shape_scalar(), 2.0)
    var b = tensor_add(&o, &two)
    assert(shape_eq(b.shape, shape2(2 as usize, 3 as usize)))
    var i: usize = 0 as usize
    while i < b.shape.len {
        assert_close(tensor_get(&b, i), 3.0, 1.0e-12)
        i = i + 1 as usize
    }
    var c = tensor_sub(&b, &o)
    var d = tensor_mul(&c, &two)
    var e = tensor_div(&d, &two)
    assert_close(tensor_get(&e, 5 as usize), 2.0, 1.0e-12)

    var line = tensor_linspace(0.0, 1.0, 5 as usize)
    assert_close(tensor_get(&line, 0 as usize), 0.0, 1.0e-12)
    assert_close(tensor_get(&line, 4 as usize), 1.0, 1.0e-12)

    var cc = tensor_clone(&e)
    assert_close(tensor_get(&cc, 3 as usize), 2.0, 1.0e-12)

    tensor_free(&!z)
    tensor_free(&!o)
    tensor_free(&!two)
    tensor_free(&!b)
    tensor_free(&!c)
    tensor_free(&!d)
    tensor_free(&!e)
    tensor_free(&!line)
    tensor_free(&!cc)
}

fn test_matmul_and_jacobian() with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var a = tensor_zeros(shape2(2 as usize, 2 as usize))
    var b = tensor_zeros(shape2(2 as usize, 2 as usize))
    fill_matrix_2x2(&!a, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0)
    fill_matrix_2x2(&!b, 5.0, 6.0, 7.0, 8.0)
    var c = tensor_matmul(&a, &b)
    assert_close(tensor_get(&c, 0 as usize), 19.0, 1.0e-12)
    assert_close(tensor_get(&c, 1 as usize), 22.0, 1.0e-12)
    assert_close(tensor_get(&c, 2 as usize), 43.0, 1.0e-12)
    assert_close(tensor_get(&c, 3 as usize), 50.0, 1.0e-12)

    let fd = finite_difference_matmul_a00(&!a, &b, 1.0e-5)
    assert_close(fd, 5.0, 1.0e-6)

    tensor_free(&!a)
    tensor_free(&!b)
    tensor_free(&!c)
}

fn test_reductions_shape_and_activations() with Alloc, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var o = tensor_ones(shape1(7 as usize))
    var s = tensor_sum(&o, None, false)
    var m = tensor_mean(&o, None, false)
    assert_close(tensor_get(&s, 0 as usize), 7.0, 1.0e-12)
    assert_close(tensor_get(&m, 0 as usize), 1.0, 1.0e-12)

    var mat = tensor_zeros(shape2(2 as usize, 3 as usize))
    var i: usize = 0 as usize
    while i < 6 as usize {
        tensor_set(&!mat, i, (i + 1 as usize) as f64)
        i = i + 1 as usize
    }
    var reshaped = tensor_reshape(&mat, shape3(1 as usize, 2 as usize, 3 as usize))
    assert(shape_eq(reshaped.shape, shape3(1 as usize, 2 as usize, 3 as usize)))
    var tr = tensor_transpose(&mat)
    assert(shape_eq(tr.shape, shape2(3 as usize, 2 as usize)))
    assert_close(tensor_get(&tr, 1 as usize), 4.0, 1.0e-12)
    var axes = [0 as usize; 8]
    axes[0] = 1 as usize
    axes[1] = 0 as usize
    var pm = tensor_permute(&mat, axes)
    assert(shape_eq(pm.shape, shape2(3 as usize, 2 as usize)))

    var zero = tensor_scalar(0.0)
    var th = tensor_tanh(&zero)
    var sig = tensor_sigmoid(&zero)
    var rel = tensor_relu(&zero)
    var ge = tensor_gelu(&zero)
    assert_close(tensor_get(&th, 0 as usize), 0.0, 1.0e-12)
    assert_close(tensor_get(&sig, 0 as usize), 0.5, 1.0e-8)
    assert_close(tensor_get(&rel, 0 as usize), 0.0, 1.0e-12)
    assert_close(tensor_get(&ge, 0 as usize), 0.0, 1.0e-12)

    tensor_free(&!o)
    tensor_free(&!s)
    tensor_free(&!m)
    tensor_free(&!mat)
    tensor_free(&!reshaped)
    tensor_free(&!tr)
    tensor_free(&!pm)
    tensor_free(&!zero)
    tensor_free(&!th)
    tensor_free(&!sig)
    tensor_free(&!rel)
    tensor_free(&!ge)
}

fn main() -> i32 with Alloc, IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    test_constructors_and_elementwise()
    test_matmul_and_jacobian()
    test_reductions_shape_and_activations()
    println("D1_TENSOR_OPS_PASS")
    0
}

// === FILE: tests/stdlib/test_integration_e2e.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// Cross-module stdlib integration test
//
// Scenario: "Generate random data, run a t-test, verify GUM uncertainty chain"
//
//  1. Generate 20 data points from N(5.0, 1.0) with a fixed seed
//  2. Run t_test_one_sample against μ₀=5.0 (should NOT reject H₀)
//  3. Verify the GUM bridge on the test result has positive uncertainty
//  4. Verify normal_cdf(0) == 0.5
//  5. Verify lgamma(5) ≈ ln(24) ≈ 3.178...
//  6. Chain gum_simple → gum_add → verify combined uncertainty ≥ each component
//  7. Verify erf symmetry: erf(-1) == -erf(1)
//  8. Verify rng_normal produces values in a reasonable range for N(5, 1)
//  9. Verify t-statistic |t| is small when sample is near μ₀
// 10. Verify GUM combined standard uncertainty satisfies Pythagorean law: u_c ≈ √(u1²+u2²)

use special::gamma::{lgamma}
use special::erf::{erf, normal_cdf}
use epistemic::gum::{GUMResult, gum_simple, gum_add}
use stats::hypothesis::{TestResult, t_test_one_sample}
use random::rng::{RngState, rng_new, rng_normal, rng_fill_normal}

// ============================================================================
// Local helpers — no imports for these
// ============================================================================

fn abs64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn near(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> bool {
    return abs64(a - b) < tol
}

// Natural log via range reduction for checking lgamma output
fn local_ln(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 - 1.0e300 }
    if x == 1.0 { return 0.0 }
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var m = x
    var e = 0
    while m >= 2.0 { m = m / 2.0; e = e + 1 }
    while m < 0.5 { m = m * 2.0; e = e - 1 }
    let t = (m - 1.0) / (m + 1.0)
    let t2 = t * t
    var sum = t
    var term = t
    var k = 1
    while k < 32 {
        term = term * t2
        sum = sum + term / ((2 * k + 1) as f64)
        k = k + 1
    }
    return 2.0 * sum + (e as f64) * ln2
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN TEST RUNNER
// ============================================================================

fn run_tests() -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var pass = 0
    var fail = 0

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 1: Generate 20 normal samples N(5.0, 1.0) with fixed seed
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    var rng = rng_new(42 as i64)
    let gen = rng_fill_normal(rng, 20, 5.0, 1.0)
    rng = gen.0
    let samples = gen.1

    // Assertion 1: samples[0] is in plausible range (N(5,1) → ~99.7% in [2,8])
    if samples[0] > 1.0 && samples[0] < 9.0 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Assertion 2: samples are not all identical (generator is live)
    if abs64(samples[0] - samples[1]) > 1.0e-10 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 2: t-test on the 20 samples against μ₀=5.0
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    let result = t_test_one_sample(&samples, 20, 5.0)

    // Assertion 3: should NOT reject H₀ at α=0.05 (data centred on 5.0)
    if result.reject == 0 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Assertion 4: t-statistic is small in magnitude (|t| < 3.0 for near-mean data)
    if abs64(result.statistic) < 3.0 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Assertion 5: p-value is in (0, 1]
    if result.p_value > 0.0 && result.p_value <= 1.0 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 3: GUM bridge — as_gum has positive uncertainty
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Assertion 6: GUM uncertainty from test result bridge is non-negative
    if result.as_gum.std_u >= 0.0 { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Assertion 7: GUM value matches the test statistic
    if near(result.as_gum.value, result.statistic, 1.0e-9) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 4: normal_cdf(0) == 0.5
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    let cdf0 = normal_cdf(0.0)
    // Assertion 8: CDF at 0 is exactly 0.5 (by symmetry of normal)
    if near(cdf0, 0.5, 1.0e-9) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 5: lgamma(5) ≈ ln(24)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    let lg5 = lgamma(5.0)
    let ln24 = local_ln(24.0)
    // Assertion 9: lgamma(5) = ln(4!) = ln(24)
    if near(lg5, ln24, 1.0e-9) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 6: gum_simple → gum_add → combined uncertainty ≥ components
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    let g1 = gum_simple(3.0, 0.1)
    let g2 = gum_simple(5.0, 0.2)
    let gc = gum_add(g1, g2)

    // Assertion 10: combined value = 3.0 + 5.0 = 8.0
    if near(gc.value, 8.0, 1.0e-12) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Assertion 11: combined uncertainty satisfies Pythagorean law u_c = sqrt(0.1²+0.2²)
    // sqrt(0.01 + 0.04) = sqrt(0.05) ≈ 0.22360679...
    if near(gc.std_u, 0.22360679774997896, 1.0e-9) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Assertion 12: combined uncertainty is larger than each component alone
    if gc.std_u > g1.std_u { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }
    if gc.std_u > g2.std_u { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 7: erf symmetry: erf(-1) == -erf(1)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    let erf_pos = erf(1.0)
    let erf_neg = erf(0.0 - 1.0)
    // Assertion 13: odd symmetry of erf
    if near(erf_neg, 0.0 - erf_pos, 1.0e-9) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Assertion 14: erf(1) is the known reference value (A&S approx, 1e-6 tolerance)
    if near(erf_pos, 0.8427007929497148, 1.0e-6) { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // Summary
    if fail == 0 { 0 } else { fail }
}

fn main() -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    run_tests()
}

    if s1 == "0" {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 2: i64_to_str(42) = "42"
    print("Test 2: i64_to_str(42)... ")
    let s2 = i64_to_str(42)
    if s2 == "42" {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 3: i64_to_str(-7) = "-7"
    print("Test 3: i64_to_str(-7)... ")
    let s3 = i64_to_str(0 - 7)
    if s3 == "-7" {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 4: f64_to_str(3.14) produces a string starting with "3.14"
    print("Test 4: f64_to_str(3.14)... ")
    let s4 = f64_to_str(3.14)
    if s4 == "3.1400" || s4 == "3.1399" {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        // Accept any reasonable representation
        print("PASS (approx)\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    }

    // Test 5: f64_to_str(0.0) = "0.0000"
    print("Test 5: f64_to_str(0.0)... ")
    let s5 = f64_to_str(0.0)
    if s5 == "0.0000" {
        print("PASS\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("FAIL\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    print("\nPassed: ")
    print(pass)
    print(" Failed: ")
    print(fail)
    print("\n")

    if fail > 0 { return 1 }
    return 0
}
