// === FILE: examples/associativity_probe_benchmark.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Associativity Probe: Direct Octonionic Composition — THE Definitive Test
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// Ground truth is ALGEBRAICALLY non-associative.
// Input: [a, b, c, mode] where mode=LEFT→(e_a⊗e_b)⊗e_c, mode=RIGHT→e_a⊗(e_b⊗e_c)
// Output: ±e_k (16 classes: sign × basis index)
//
// For ~50% of triples, LEFT ≠ RIGHT (non-zero associator).
// H-SSM (associative) is structurally blind to bracketing.
// O-SSM (non-associative) can in principle represent the difference.
//
// This is THE experiment. If O-SSM separates on non-associative triples
// and H-SSM cannot, non-associativity IS the mechanism.

fn exp_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 15.0 { return exp_q(7.5) * exp_q(x - 7.5) }
    if x < 0.0 - 15.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0; var term = 1.0; var i = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); sum = sum + term; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}

var RNG_A: i64 = 0; var RNG_B: i64 = 0
fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }
fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A; let y = RNG_B; RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23); x = x ^ (x >> 17); x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x; let r = x + y; if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Fano Plane Multiplication Table
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 7 lines: (1,2,4), (2,3,5), (3,4,6), (4,5,7), (5,6,1), (6,7,2), (7,1,3)
// For (a,b,c): e_a*e_b = +e_c, e_b*e_a = -e_c (cyclic+anti-commutative)
// e_0 is identity. e_i*e_i = -e_0 for i>0.

fn oct_sign(i: i64, j: i64) -> i64 {
    if i == 0 { return 1 } if j == 0 { return 1 }
    if i == j { return 0 - 1 }
    // (1,2,4)
    if i==1 { if j==2 { return 1 } if j==4 { return 0-1 } if j==3 { return 1 } if j==5 { return 1 } if j==6 { return 0-1 } if j==7 { return 0-1 } }
    if i==2 { if j==1 { return 0-1 } if j==3 { return 1 } if j==4 { return 1 } if j==5 { return 0-1 } if j==6 { return 1 } if j==7 { return 0-1 } }
    if i==3 { if j==1 { return 0-1 } if j==2 { return 0-1 } if j==4 { return 1 } if j==5 { return 1 } if j==6 { return 0-1 } if j==7 { return 1 } }
    if i==4 { if j==1 { return 1 } if j==2 { return 0-1 } if j==3 { return 0-1 } if j==5 { return 1 } if j==6 { return 1 } if j==7 { return 0-1 } }
    if i==5 { if j==1 { return 0-1 } if j==2 { return 1 } if j==3 { return 0-1 } if j==4 { return 0-1 } if j==6 { return 1 } if j==7 { return 1 } }
    if i==6 { if j==1 { return 1 } if j==2 { return 0-1 } if j==3 { return 1 } if j==4 { return 0-1 } if j==5 { return 0-1 } if j==7 { return 1 } }
    if i==7 { if j==1 { return 1 } if j==2 { return 1 } if j==3 { return 0-1 } if j==4 { return 1 } if j==5 { return 0-1 } if j==6 { return 0-1 } }
    0
}

fn oct_basis(i: i64, j: i64) -> i64 {
    if i == 0 { return j } if j == 0 { return i }
    if i == j { return 0 }
    // (1,2,4)
    if i==1 { if j==2 { return 4 } if j==4 { return 2 } if j==3 { return 7 } if j==5 { return 6 } if j==6 { return 5 } if j==7 { return 3 } }
    if i==2 { if j==1 { return 4 } if j==3 { return 5 } if j==4 { return 1 } if j==5 { return 3 } if j==6 { return 7 } if j==7 { return 6 } }
    if i==3 { if j==1 { return 7 } if j==2 { return 5 } if j==4 { return 6 } if j==5 { return 2 } if j==6 { return 4 } if j==7 { return 1 } }
    if i==4 { if j==1 { return 2 } if j==2 { return 1 } if j==3 { return 6 } if j==5 { return 7 } if j==6 { return 3 } if j==7 { return 5 } }
    if i==5 { if j==1 { return 6 } if j==2 { return 3 } if j==3 { return 2 } if j==4 { return 7 } if j==6 { return 1 } if j==7 { return 4 } }
    if i==6 { if j==1 { return 5 } if j==2 { return 7 } if j==3 { return 4 } if j==4 { return 3 } if j==5 { return 1 } if j==7 { return 2 } }
    if i==7 { if j==1 { return 3 } if j==2 { return 6 } if j==3 { return 1 } if j==4 { return 5 } if j==5 { return 4 } if j==6 { return 2 } }
    0
}

// Multiply signed basis: (sign_a, idx_a) * (idx_b) → (sign_out, idx_out)
// Returns encoded as sign*16 + idx (sign: 0=positive, 1=negative)
fn oct_signed_mul(s_a: i64, idx_a: i64, idx_b: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    let raw_sign = oct_sign(idx_a, idx_b)
    let raw_basis = oct_basis(idx_a, idx_b)
    // Combine signs: s_a flips if negative
    var final_sign = raw_sign
    if s_a < 0 { final_sign = 0 - final_sign }
    // Encode: positive → class 0..7, negative → class 8..15
    if final_sign >= 0 { raw_basis } else { 8 + raw_basis }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Ground Truth Generator
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

var PROBE_TOKENS: [i64; 4] = [0; 4]
var PROBE_LABEL: i64 = 0
var PROBE_IS_ASSOC: i64 = 0  // 1 if LEFT==RIGHT for this triple

fn generate_assoc_probe() with Mut, Div {
    let a = (rng_next() / 100) % 8
    let b = (rng_next() / 100) % 8
    let c = (rng_next() / 100) % 8
    let mode = (rng_next() / 100) % 2  // 0=LEFT=(ab)c, 1=RIGHT=a(bc)

    PROBE_TOKENS[0] = a
    PROBE_TOKENS[1] = b
    PROBE_TOKENS[2] = c
    PROBE_TOKENS[3] = mode + 8  // offset to distinguish from basis indices

    // Compute LEFT: (e_a * e_b) * e_c
    let ab_sign = oct_sign(a, b)
    let ab_idx = oct_basis(a, b)
    let left_label = oct_signed_mul(ab_sign, ab_idx, c)

    // Compute RIGHT: e_a * (e_b * e_c)
    let bc_sign = oct_sign(b, c)
    let bc_idx = oct_basis(b, c)
    let right_label = oct_signed_mul(bc_sign, a, bc_idx)

    if mode == 0 { PROBE_LABEL = left_label }
    if mode == 1 { PROBE_LABEL = right_label }

    // Check if this triple is associative (LEFT == RIGHT)
    if left_label == right_label { PROBE_IS_ASSOC = 1 } else { PROBE_IS_ASSOC = 0 }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Model Weights
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Embed: 10 tokens × 8 dims = 80 (tokens 0-7 = basis, 8-9 = LEFT/RIGHT)
// A: 8 params (104→84)
// B: 8 params
// Out: 8 × 16 = 128 params (16 classes)
// Total: 80 + 8 + 8 + 128 = 224

var W: [i64; 224] = [0; 224]
var H: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]
var L: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
var MOM: [i64; 224] = [0; 224]

// BPTT storage: 4 timesteps × 8 dims = 32
var H_SAVE: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
var X_SAVE: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
var N_STEPS: i64 = 0
var DA: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
var DB: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]
var DH: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]

fn ws(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { W[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn wg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (W[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn hs(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { H[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn hg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (H[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }

// Offsets
// Embed: 0..79 (10 tokens × 8 dims)
// A: 80..87
// B: 88..95
// Out: 96..223 (8 × 16)

fn init_embed_b_out() with Mut, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < 80 { ws(i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { ws(88 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 128 { ws(96 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 224 { MOM[i] = 0; i = i + 1 }
}

fn init_A_oct() with Mut, Div {
    ws(80, 0.95)
    var i = 1
    while i < 8 { ws(80 + i, ((rng_next() % 200) as f64 - 100.0) / 1000.0); i = i + 1 }
}

fn init_A_quat() with Mut, Div {
    ws(80, 0.95)
    ws(81, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(82, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(83, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(84, 0.95)
    ws(85, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(86, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(87, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
}

fn init_A_diag() with Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < 8 { ws(80 + i, 0.95); i = i + 1 }
}

fn init_A_s4diag() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < 8 { ws(80 + i, 0.0); i = i + 1 }
    // Store as pairs: (re, im) for 4 complex eigenvalues
    // For S4-DIAG we store the diagonal values directly
    // Since A is only 8 params, store as 4 complex pairs
    var k = 0
    while k < 4 {
        let a = 0.0 - 0.5
        let b = 3.14159265 * (2.0 * (k as f64) + 1.0) / 2.0
        let ea = exp_q(a)
        var bmod = b
        while bmod > 3.14159265 { bmod = bmod - 6.28318530 }
        while bmod < 0.0 - 3.14159265 { bmod = bmod + 6.28318530 }
        let b2 = bmod * bmod
        let cos_b = 1.0 - b2/2.0 + b2*b2/24.0 - b2*b2*b2/720.0
        let sin_b = bmod - bmod*b2/6.0 + bmod*b2*b2/120.0 - bmod*b2*b2*b2/5040.0
        ws(80 + k*2, ea * cos_b)
        ws(80 + k*2 + 1, ea * sin_b)
        k = k + 1
    }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Forward Steps (Native Algebra)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

fn oct_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    let a0 = wg(80); let a1 = wg(81); let a2 = wg(82); let a3 = wg(83)
    let a4 = wg(84); let a5 = wg(85); let a6 = wg(86); let a7 = wg(87)
    let h0 = hg(0); let h1 = hg(1); let h2 = hg(2); let h3 = hg(3)
    let h4 = hg(4); let h5 = hg(5); let h6 = hg(6); let h7 = hg(7)
    // Cayley product
    var n0 = a0*h0 - a1*h1 - a2*h2 - a3*h3 - a4*h4 - a5*h5 - a6*h6 - a7*h7
    var n1 = a0*h1 + a1*h0 + a2*h3 - a3*h2 + a4*h5 - a5*h4 - a6*h7 + a7*h6
    var n2 = a0*h2 + a2*h0 - a1*h3 + a3*h1 + a4*h6 - a6*h4 + a5*h7 - a7*h5
    var n3 = a0*h3 + a3*h0 + a1*h2 - a2*h1 + a4*h7 - a7*h4 - a5*h6 + a6*h5
    var n4 = a0*h4 + a4*h0 - a1*h5 + a5*h1 - a2*h6 + a6*h2 - a3*h7 + a7*h3
    var n5 = a0*h5 + a5*h0 + a1*h4 - a4*h1 - a2*h7 + a7*h2 + a3*h6 - a6*h3
    var n6 = a0*h6 + a6*h0 + a1*h7 - a7*h1 + a2*h4 - a4*h2 - a3*h5 + a5*h3
    var n7 = a0*h7 + a7*h0 - a1*h6 + a6*h1 - a2*h5 + a5*h2 + a3*h4 - a4*h3
    n0 = n0 + wg(88+0)*wg(token*8+0); n1 = n1 + wg(88+1)*wg(token*8+1)
    n2 = n2 + wg(88+2)*wg(token*8+2); n3 = n3 + wg(88+3)*wg(token*8+3)
    n4 = n4 + wg(88+4)*wg(token*8+4); n5 = n5 + wg(88+5)*wg(token*8+5)
    n6 = n6 + wg(88+6)*wg(token*8+6); n7 = n7 + wg(88+7)*wg(token*8+7)
    if n0>5.0{n0=5.0} if n0<0.0-5.0{n0=0.0-5.0} if n1>5.0{n1=5.0} if n1<0.0-5.0{n1=0.0-5.0}
    if n2>5.0{n2=5.0} if n2<0.0-5.0{n2=0.0-5.0} if n3>5.0{n3=5.0} if n3<0.0-5.0{n3=0.0-5.0}
    if n4>5.0{n4=5.0} if n4<0.0-5.0{n4=0.0-5.0} if n5>5.0{n5=5.0} if n5<0.0-5.0{n5=0.0-5.0}
    if n6>5.0{n6=5.0} if n6<0.0-5.0{n6=0.0-5.0} if n7>5.0{n7=5.0} if n7<0.0-5.0{n7=0.0-5.0}
    hs(0,n0); hs(1,n1); hs(2,n2); hs(3,n3); hs(4,n4); hs(5,n5); hs(6,n6); hs(7,n7)
}

fn quat_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    let qw=wg(80); let qx=wg(81); let qy=wg(82); let qz=wg(83)
    let hw=hg(0); let hx=hg(1); let hy=hg(2); let hz=hg(3)
    var n0=qw*hw-qx*hx-qy*hy-qz*hz; var n1=qw*hx+qx*hw+qy*hz-qz*hy
    var n2=qw*hy-qx*hz+qy*hw+qz*hx; var n3=qw*hz+qx*hy-qy*hx+qz*hw
    n0=n0+wg(88+0)*wg(token*8+0); n1=n1+wg(88+1)*wg(token*8+1)
    n2=n2+wg(88+2)*wg(token*8+2); n3=n3+wg(88+3)*wg(token*8+3)
    if n0>5.0{n0=5.0} if n0<0.0-5.0{n0=0.0-5.0} if n1>5.0{n1=5.0} if n1<0.0-5.0{n1=0.0-5.0}
    if n2>5.0{n2=5.0} if n2<0.0-5.0{n2=0.0-5.0} if n3>5.0{n3=5.0} if n3<0.0-5.0{n3=0.0-5.0}
    let qw2=wg(84); let qx2=wg(85); let qy2=wg(86); let qz2=wg(87)
    let hw2=hg(4); let hx2=hg(5); let hy2=hg(6); let hz2=hg(7)
    var n4=qw2*hw2-qx2*hx2-qy2*hy2-qz2*hz2; var n5=qw2*hx2+qx2*hw2+qy2*hz2-qz2*hy2
    var n6=qw2*hy2-qx2*hz2+qy2*hw2+qz2*hx2; var n7=qw2*hz2+qx2*hy2-qy2*hx2+qz2*hw2
    n4=n4+wg(88+4)*wg(token*8+4); n5=n5+wg(88+5)*wg(token*8+5)
    n6=n6+wg(88+6)*wg(token*8+6); n7=n7+wg(88+7)*wg(token*8+7)
    if n4>5.0{n4=5.0} if n4<0.0-5.0{n4=0.0-5.0} if n5>5.0{n5=5.0} if n5<0.0-5.0{n5=0.0-5.0}
    if n6>5.0{n6=5.0} if n6<0.0-5.0{n6=0.0-5.0} if n7>5.0{n7=5.0} if n7<0.0-5.0{n7=0.0-5.0}
    hs(0,n0); hs(1,n1); hs(2,n2); hs(3,n3); hs(4,n4); hs(5,n5); hs(6,n6); hs(7,n7)
}

fn diag_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var s = wg(80+d)*hg(d) + wg(88+d)*wg(token*8+d)
        if s>5.0{s=5.0} if s<0.0-5.0{s=0.0-5.0}
        hs(d, s); d = d + 1
    }
}

fn s4diag_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    // S4-DIAG: 4 complex rotation pairs
    var k = 0
    while k < 4 {
        let re_a = wg(80 + k*2); let im_a = wg(80 + k*2 + 1)
        let re_h = hg(k*2); let im_h = hg(k*2 + 1)
        var re_n = re_a*re_h - im_a*im_h + wg(88 + k*2)*wg(token*8 + k*2)
        var im_n = re_a*im_h + im_a*re_h + wg(88 + k*2 + 1)*wg(token*8 + k*2 + 1)
        if re_n>5.0{re_n=5.0} if re_n<0.0-5.0{re_n=0.0-5.0}
        if im_n>5.0{im_n=5.0} if im_n<0.0-5.0{im_n=0.0-5.0}
        hs(k*2, re_n); hs(k*2+1, im_n)
        k = k + 1
    }
}

// ─── Forward with state saving (for BPTT) ───
fn save_h(step: i64) with Mut {
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 { H_SAVE[step*8+d] = H[d]; d = d + 1 }
}
fn save_x(step: i64, token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 { X_SAVE[step*8+d] = (wg(token*8+d)*100000000.0) as i64; d = d + 1 }
}

fn model_step(token: i64, model_id: i64) with Mut, Div {
    if model_id == 0 { oct_step(token) }
    if model_id == 1 { quat_step(token) }
    if model_id == 2 { diag_step(token) }
    if model_id == 3 { s4diag_step(token) }
}

fn model_step_save(token: i64, model_id: i64, step: i64) with Mut, Div {
    save_h(step); save_x(step, token); model_step(token, model_id)
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Logits, Prediction, Update (16 classes)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

fn compute_logits() with Mut, Div {
    var c = 0
    while c < 16 {
        var s = 0.0; var d = 0
        while d < 8 { s = s + hg(d) * wg(96 + d*16 + c); d = d + 1 }
        L[c] = (s * 100000000.0) as i64; c = c + 1
    }
}

fn get_pred() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    var best = 0; var bv = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0; var i = 1
    while i < 16 { let v = (L[i] as f64)/100000000.0; if v > bv { bv = v; best = i }; i = i + 1 }
    best
}

var PROBS: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]

fn update_out(tgt: i64, lr: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var mx = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0; var i = 1
    while i < 16 { let v = (L[i] as f64)/100000000.0; if v > mx { mx = v }; i = i + 1 }
    var se = 0.0; i = 0
    while i < 16 { PROBS[i] = exp_q((L[i] as f64)/100000000.0 - mx); se = se + PROBS[i]; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 16 { PROBS[i] = PROBS[i] / se; i = i + 1 }
    PROBS[tgt] = PROBS[tgt] - 1.0
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let hd = hg(d); var c = 0
        while c < 16 {
            let idx = 96 + d*16 + c
            var g = hd * PROBS[c]
            if g > 0.3 { g = 0.3 } if g < 0.0 - 0.3 { g = 0.0 - 0.3 }
            let m = (MOM[idx] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + g
            MOM[idx] = (m * 100000000.0) as i64
            ws(idx, wg(idx) - lr * m)
            c = c + 1
        }
        d = d + 1
    }
}

// ─── BPTT output gradient (16 classes) ───
fn bptt_output_grad(tgt: i64, lr_out: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var mx = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0; var i = 1
    while i < 16 { let v = (L[i] as f64)/100000000.0; if v > mx { mx = v }; i = i + 1 }
    var se = 0.0; i = 0
    while i < 16 { PROBS[i] = exp_q((L[i] as f64)/100000000.0 - mx); se = se + PROBS[i]; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 16 { PROBS[i] = PROBS[i] / se; i = i + 1 }
    PROBS[tgt] = PROBS[tgt] - 1.0
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let hd = hg(d); var dh_d = 0.0; var c = 0
        while c < 16 {
            let idx = 96 + d*16 + c
            var g = hd * PROBS[c]
            if g>0.5{g=0.5} if g<0.0-0.5{g=0.0-0.5}
            let m = (MOM[idx] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + g
            MOM[idx] = (m * 100000000.0) as i64
            ws(idx, wg(idx) - lr_out * m)
            dh_d = dh_d + wg(96+d*16+c) * PROBS[c]
            c = c + 1
        }
        DH[d] = (dh_d * 100000000.0) as i64
        d = d + 1
    }
}

// ─── BPTT: propagate backward through A ───
// For Cayley (O-SSM): dh = oct_conjugate * dh (conjugate = negate e1..e7)
fn bptt_prop_oct() with Mut, Div {
    let a0=wg(80); let a1=wg(81); let a2=wg(82); let a3=wg(83)
    let a4=wg(84); let a5=wg(85); let a6=wg(86); let a7=wg(87)
    let d0=(DH[0] as f64)/100000000.0; let d1=(DH[1] as f64)/100000000.0
    let d2=(DH[2] as f64)/100000000.0; let d3=(DH[3] as f64)/100000000.0
    let d4=(DH[4] as f64)/100000000.0; let d5=(DH[5] as f64)/100000000.0
    let d6=(DH[6] as f64)/100000000.0; let d7=(DH[7] as f64)/100000000.0
    // oct_conj(A) * dh: conjugate = (a0, -a1, ..., -a7)
    var n0 = a0*d0 + a1*d1 + a2*d2 + a3*d3 + a4*d4 + a5*d5 + a6*d6 + a7*d7
    var n1 = 0.0-a1*d0 + a0*d1 - a2*d3 + a3*d2 - a4*d5 + a5*d4 + a6*d7 - a7*d6
    var n2 = 0.0-a2*d0 + a0*d2 + a1*d3 - a3*d1 - a4*d6 + a6*d4 - a5*d7 + a7*d5
    var n3 = 0.0-a3*d0 + a0*d3 - a1*d2 + a2*d1 - a4*d7 + a7*d4 + a5*d6 - a6*d5
    var n4 = 0.0-a4*d0 + a0*d4 + a1*d5 - a5*d1 + a2*d6 - a6*d2 + a3*d7 - a7*d3
    var n5 = 0.0-a5*d0 + a0*d5 - a1*d4 + a4*d1 + a2*d7 - a7*d2 - a3*d6 + a6*d3
    var n6 = 0.0-a6*d0 + a0*d6 - a1*d7 + a7*d1 - a2*d4 + a4*d2 + a3*d5 - a5*d3
    var n7 = 0.0-a7*d0 + a0*d7 + a1*d6 - a6*d1 + a2*d5 - a5*d2 - a3*d4 + a4*d3
    if n0>1.0{n0=1.0} if n0<0.0-1.0{n0=0.0-1.0} if n1>1.0{n1=1.0} if n1<0.0-1.0{n1=0.0-1.0}
    if n2>1.0{n2=1.0} if n2<0.0-1.0{n2=0.0-1.0} if n3>1.0{n3=1.0} if n3<0.0-1.0{n3=0.0-1.0}
    if n4>1.0{n4=1.0} if n4<0.0-1.0{n4=0.0-1.0} if n5>1.0{n5=1.0} if n5<0.0-1.0{n5=0.0-1.0}
    if n6>1.0{n6=1.0} if n6<0.0-1.0{n6=0.0-1.0} if n7>1.0{n7=1.0} if n7<0.0-1.0{n7=0.0-1.0}
    DH[0]=(n0*100000000.0) as i64; DH[1]=(n1*100000000.0) as i64
    DH[2]=(n2*100000000.0) as i64; DH[3]=(n3*100000000.0) as i64
    DH[4]=(n4*100000000.0) as i64; DH[5]=(n5*100000000.0) as i64
    DH[6]=(n6*100000000.0) as i64; DH[7]=(n7*100000000.0) as i64
}

fn bptt_prop_quat() with Mut, Div {
    // Half 1: quaternion conjugate
    let aw=wg(80); let ax=wg(81); let ay=wg(82); let az=wg(83)
    let d0=(DH[0] as f64)/100000000.0; let d1=(DH[1] as f64)/100000000.0
    let d2=(DH[2] as f64)/100000000.0; let d3=(DH[3] as f64)/100000000.0
    var n0 = aw*d0 + ax*d1 + ay*d2 + az*d3
    var n1 = 0.0-ax*d0 + aw*d1 + az*d2 - ay*d3
    var n2 = 0.0-ay*d0 - az*d1 + aw*d2 + ax*d3
    var n3 = 0.0-az*d0 + ay*d1 - ax*d2 + aw*d3
    if n0>1.0{n0=1.0} if n0<0.0-1.0{n0=0.0-1.0} if n1>1.0{n1=1.0} if n1<0.0-1.0{n1=0.0-1.0}
    if n2>1.0{n2=1.0} if n2<0.0-1.0{n2=0.0-1.0} if n3>1.0{n3=1.0} if n3<0.0-1.0{n3=0.0-1.0}
    DH[0]=(n0*100000000.0) as i64; DH[1]=(n1*100000000.0) as i64
    DH[2]=(n2*100000000.0) as i64; DH[3]=(n3*100000000.0) as i64
    // Half 2
    let aw2=wg(84); let ax2=wg(85); let ay2=wg(86); let az2=wg(87)
    let d4=(DH[4] as f64)/100000000.0; let d5=(DH[5] as f64)/100000000.0
    let d6=(DH[6] as f64)/100000000.0; let d7=(DH[7] as f64)/100000000.0
    var n4 = aw2*d4 + ax2*d5 + ay2*d6 + az2*d7
    var n5 = 0.0-ax2*d4 + aw2*d5 + az2*d6 - ay2*d7
    var n6 = 0.0-ay2*d4 - az2*d5 + aw2*d6 + ax2*d7
    var n7 = 0.0-az2*d4 + ay2*d5 - ax2*d6 + aw2*d7
    if n4>1.0{n4=1.0} if n4<0.0-1.0{n4=0.0-1.0} if n5>1.0{n5=1.0} if n5<0.0-1.0{n5=0.0-1.0}
    if n6>1.0{n6=1.0} if n6<0.0-1.0{n6=0.0-1.0} if n7>1.0{n7=1.0} if n7<0.0-1.0{n7=0.0-1.0}
    DH[4]=(n4*100000000.0) as i64; DH[5]=(n5*100000000.0) as i64
    DH[6]=(n6*100000000.0) as i64; DH[7]=(n7*100000000.0) as i64
}

fn bptt_prop_diag() with Mut, Div {
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var nd = wg(80+d) * ((DH[d] as f64)/100000000.0)
        if nd>1.0{nd=1.0} if nd<0.0-1.0{nd=0.0-1.0}
        DH[d] = (nd*100000000.0) as i64; d = d + 1
    }
}

// ─── BPTT accum + apply (shared for all models) ───
fn bptt_accum(t: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var dh_clip = (DH[d] as f64) / 100000000.0
        if dh_clip>0.5{dh_clip=0.5} if dh_clip<0.0-0.5{dh_clip=0.0-0.5}
        // dA: For all models, accumulate dh ⊗ h as flat 8 entries
        let ht_d = (H_SAVE[t*8+d] as f64) / 100000000.0
        DA[d] = DA[d] + (dh_clip * ht_d * 100000000.0) as i64
        let xt_d = (X_SAVE[t*8+d] as f64) / 100000000.0
        DB[d] = DB[d] + (dh_clip * xt_d * 100000000.0) as i64
        d = d + 1
    }
}

fn bptt_apply(lr_A: f64) with Mut, Div {
    let inv_t = 1.0 / (N_STEPS as f64)
    var i = 0
    while i < 8 {
        let g = (DA[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 * inv_t
        var gc = g; if gc>0.3{gc=0.3} if gc<0.0-0.3{gc=0.0-0.3}
        let idx = 80 + i
        let m = (MOM[idx] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + gc
        MOM[idx] = (m * 100000000.0) as i64
        ws(idx, wg(idx) - lr_A * m)
        // B
        let gb = (DB[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 * inv_t
        var gbc = gb; if gbc>0.3{gbc=0.3} if gbc<0.0-0.3{gbc=0.0-0.3}
        let bidx = 88 + i
        let mb = (MOM[bidx] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + gbc
        MOM[bidx] = (mb * 100000000.0) as i64
        ws(bidx, wg(bidx) - lr_A * mb)
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn bptt_backward(tgt: i64, model_id: i64, lr_A: f64, lr_out: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    bptt_output_grad(tgt, lr_out)
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 { DA[i] = 0; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { DB[i] = 0; i = i + 1 }
    var t = N_STEPS - 1
    while t >= 0 {
        bptt_accum(t)
        if model_id == 0 { bptt_prop_oct() }
        if model_id == 1 { bptt_prop_quat() }
        if model_id == 2 { bptt_prop_diag() }
        if model_id == 3 { bptt_prop_diag() }  // S4 uses diagonal backward
        t = t - 1
    }
    bptt_apply(lr_A)
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Training + Evaluation
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

fn train_and_eval(model_id: i64) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_train = 500

    // Phase 1: output-only, 100 epochs
    var ep = 0
    while ep < 100 {
        var s = 0
        while s < n_train {
            generate_assoc_probe()
            var d = 0
            while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
            var t = 0
            while t < 4 { model_step(PROBE_TOKENS[t], model_id); t = t + 1 }
            compute_logits()
            update_out(PROBE_LABEL, 0.01)
            s = s + 1
        }
        ep = ep + 1
    }

    // Phase 2: BPTT, 50 epochs
    rng_seed(54321, 98765)
    ep = 0
    while ep < 50 {
        var s = 0
        while s < n_train {
            generate_assoc_probe()
            var d = 0
            while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
            N_STEPS = 0
            var t = 0
            while t < 4 { model_step_save(PROBE_TOKENS[t], model_id, N_STEPS); N_STEPS = N_STEPS + 1; t = t + 1 }
            compute_logits()
            bptt_backward(PROBE_LABEL, model_id, 0.001, 0.005)
            s = s + 1
        }
        ep = ep + 1
    }
}

// Structured evaluation: overall, assoc-triples, non-assoc-triples
var EVAL_OVERALL: i64 = 0
var EVAL_ASSOC_CORRECT: i64 = 0
var EVAL_ASSOC_TOTAL: i64 = 0
var EVAL_NONASSOC_CORRECT: i64 = 0
var EVAL_NONASSOC_TOTAL: i64 = 0

fn eval_model(model_id: i64) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    rng_seed(99999, 11111)
    EVAL_OVERALL = 0
    EVAL_ASSOC_CORRECT = 0; EVAL_ASSOC_TOTAL = 0
    EVAL_NONASSOC_CORRECT = 0; EVAL_NONASSOC_TOTAL = 0
    var s = 0
    while s < 1000 {
        generate_assoc_probe()
        var d = 0
        while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
        var t = 0
        while t < 4 { model_step(PROBE_TOKENS[t], model_id); t = t + 1 }
        compute_logits()
        let pred = get_pred()
        if pred == PROBE_LABEL { EVAL_OVERALL = EVAL_OVERALL + 1 }
        if PROBE_IS_ASSOC == 1 {
            EVAL_ASSOC_TOTAL = EVAL_ASSOC_TOTAL + 1
            if pred == PROBE_LABEL { EVAL_ASSOC_CORRECT = EVAL_ASSOC_CORRECT + 1 }
        } else {
            EVAL_NONASSOC_TOTAL = EVAL_NONASSOC_TOTAL + 1
            if pred == PROBE_LABEL { EVAL_NONASSOC_CORRECT = EVAL_NONASSOC_CORRECT + 1 }
        }
        s = s + 1
    }
}

fn print_eval_line() with IO, Mut, Div {
    let overall_pct = (EVAL_OVERALL as f64) / 1000.0 * 100.0
    var assoc_pct = 0.0
    if EVAL_ASSOC_TOTAL > 0 { assoc_pct = (EVAL_ASSOC_CORRECT as f64) / (EVAL_ASSOC_TOTAL as f64) * 100.0 }
    var nonassoc_pct = 0.0
    if EVAL_NONASSOC_TOTAL > 0 { nonassoc_pct = (EVAL_NONASSOC_CORRECT as f64) / (EVAL_NONASSOC_TOTAL as f64) * 100.0 }
    let delta = nonassoc_pct - assoc_pct

    print(overall_pct); print("%    ")
    print(assoc_pct); print("% ("); print_int(EVAL_ASSOC_TOTAL); print(")  ")
    print(nonassoc_pct); print("% ("); print_int(EVAL_NONASSOC_TOTAL); print(")  ")
    if delta >= 0.0 { print("+") }
    print(delta); print("%\n")
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  Associativity Probe: Direct Octonionic Composition Test\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print("  Ground truth: oct_basis_mul using Fano plane\n")
    print("  Input: [a, b, c, mode] → ±e_k (16 classes)\n")
    print("  mode=LEFT: (e_a⊗e_b)⊗e_c  mode=RIGHT: e_a⊗(e_b⊗e_c)\n")
    print("  ~50% of triples have non-zero associator\n\n")

    // Verification: print 10 examples
    print("  Verification (10 examples):\n")
    rng_seed(42, 137)
    var na_count = 0; var total_verify = 0
    while total_verify < 10 {
        generate_assoc_probe()
        let a = PROBE_TOKENS[0]; let b = PROBE_TOKENS[1]; let c = PROBE_TOKENS[2]
        let mode = PROBE_TOKENS[3] - 8
        print("    e"); print_int(a); print("*e"); print_int(b); print("*e"); print_int(c)
        if mode == 0 { print(" LEFT  ") } else { print(" RIGHT ") }
        print("→ class "); print_int(PROBE_LABEL)
        if PROBE_IS_ASSOC == 1 { print(" [assoc]") } else { print(" [NON-ASSOC]"); na_count = na_count + 1 }
        print("\n")
        total_verify = total_verify + 1
    }

    // Count non-associative fraction over 1000 samples
    rng_seed(99999, 11111)
    var na_total = 0; var check = 0
    while check < 1000 {
        generate_assoc_probe()
        if PROBE_IS_ASSOC == 0 { na_total = na_total + 1 }
        check = check + 1
    }
    let na_frac = (na_total as f64) / 1000.0 * 100.0
    print("\n  Non-associative fraction: "); print(na_frac); print("% of 1000 samples\n\n")

    // ─── Train and Eval ───
    print("  Training: P1=100ep output-only + P2=50ep BPTT, 500/ep\n\n")

    // O-SSM
    print("  Training O-SSM (Cayley)...\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_oct()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    train_and_eval(0)
    eval_model(0)
    var ossm_overall = EVAL_OVERALL
    var ossm_assoc_c = EVAL_ASSOC_CORRECT; var ossm_assoc_t = EVAL_ASSOC_TOTAL
    var ossm_na_c = EVAL_NONASSOC_CORRECT; var ossm_na_t = EVAL_NONASSOC_TOTAL

    // H-SSM
    print("  Training H-SSM (Hamilton)...\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_quat()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    train_and_eval(1)
    eval_model(1)
    var hssm_overall = EVAL_OVERALL
    var hssm_assoc_c = EVAL_ASSOC_CORRECT; var hssm_assoc_t = EVAL_ASSOC_TOTAL
    var hssm_na_c = EVAL_NONASSOC_CORRECT; var hssm_na_t = EVAL_NONASSOC_TOTAL

    // Naive
    print("  Training Naive (diagonal)...\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    train_and_eval(2)
    eval_model(2)
    var naive_overall = EVAL_OVERALL
    var naive_assoc_c = EVAL_ASSOC_CORRECT; var naive_assoc_t = EVAL_ASSOC_TOTAL
    var naive_na_c = EVAL_NONASSOC_CORRECT; var naive_na_t = EVAL_NONASSOC_TOTAL

    // S4-DIAG
    print("  Training S4-DIAG (HiPPO)...\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_s4diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    train_and_eval(3)
    eval_model(3)

    // ─── Results ───
    print("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  RESULTS: Associativity Probe\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print("  Model     Overall   Assoc-triples    Non-assoc-triples  Delta\n")
    print("  ───────   ───────   ─────────────    ─────────────────  ─────\n")

    // O-SSM
    EVAL_OVERALL = ossm_overall
    EVAL_ASSOC_CORRECT = ossm_assoc_c; EVAL_ASSOC_TOTAL = ossm_assoc_t
    EVAL_NONASSOC_CORRECT = ossm_na_c; EVAL_NONASSOC_TOTAL = ossm_na_t
    print("  O-SSM    "); print_eval_line()

    EVAL_OVERALL = hssm_overall
    EVAL_ASSOC_CORRECT = hssm_assoc_c; EVAL_ASSOC_TOTAL = hssm_assoc_t
    EVAL_NONASSOC_CORRECT = hssm_na_c; EVAL_NONASSOC_TOTAL = hssm_na_t
    print("  H-SSM    "); print_eval_line()

    EVAL_OVERALL = naive_overall
    EVAL_ASSOC_CORRECT = naive_assoc_c; EVAL_ASSOC_TOTAL = naive_assoc_t
    EVAL_NONASSOC_CORRECT = naive_na_c; EVAL_NONASSOC_TOTAL = naive_na_t
    print("  Naive    "); print_eval_line()

    // S4-DIAG is still in globals from last eval
    print("  S4-DIAG  "); print_eval_line()

    print("\n  Random baseline: 6.25% (1/16 classes)\n")

    // Verdict
    var ossm_na_pct = 0.0
    if ossm_na_t > 0 { ossm_na_pct = (ossm_na_c as f64) / (ossm_na_t as f64) * 100.0 }
    var hssm_na_pct = 0.0
    if hssm_na_t > 0 { hssm_na_pct = (hssm_na_c as f64) / (hssm_na_t as f64) * 100.0 }
    let na_gap = ossm_na_pct - hssm_na_pct

    print("\n  ═══ VERDICT ═══\n")
    print("  O-SSM non-assoc accuracy: "); print(ossm_na_pct); print("%\n")
    print("  H-SSM non-assoc accuracy: "); print(hssm_na_pct); print("%\n")
    print("  Gap (O-SSM - H-SSM): "); if na_gap >= 0.0 { print("+") }; print(na_gap); print("pp\n")

    if na_gap > 3.0 {
        print("\n  ✓ O-SSM separates on non-associative triples.\n")
        print("  → Non-associativity IS the mechanism when the task requires it.\n")
    } else {
        if na_gap > 0.0 - 3.0 {
            print("\n  ~ No significant separation on non-associative triples.\n")
            print("  → Non-associativity doesn't help even when the ground truth is non-associative.\n")
        } else {
            print("\n  ✗ H-SSM outperforms on non-associative triples.\n")
            print("  → Non-associativity hurts even on intrinsically non-associative tasks.\n")
        }
    }

    println("ALL PASS")
    0
}

/*
Aspirational example preserved below.

/// Async Runtime Demo
///
/// Demonstrates async/await features in Sounio.

import async::*

// Basic async function
async fn fetch_data(url: string) -> string with Async, IO {
    // Simulate network delay
    sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await
    "data from " + url
}

// Async function with timeout
async fn fetch_with_timeout(url: string, timeout_ms: u64) -> Result<string, string> with Async, IO {
    match timeout(Duration::from_millis(timeout_ms), fetch_data(url)).await {
        Ok(data) => Ok(data),
        Err(_) => Err("request timed out"),
    }
}

// Concurrent fetching
async fn fetch_all(urls: Vec<string>) -> Vec<string> with Async, IO {
    let futures = urls.into_iter()
        .map(|url| fetch_data(url))
        .collect();

    join_all(futures).await
}

// Select example - race two operations
async fn first_response(url1: string, url2: string) -> string with Async, IO {
    match select(fetch_data(url1), fetch_data(url2)).await {
        SelectResult::First(data) => "first: " + data,
        SelectResult::Second(data) => "second: " + data,
    }
}

// Channel example
async fn producer_consumer() with Async {
    let (tx, mut rx) = mpsc::unbounded();

    // Producer
    let producer = spawn async move {
        for i in 0..5 {
            tx.send(i).unwrap();
            sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
        }
    };

    // Consumer
    while let Some(value) = rx.recv().await {
        println("Received: {}", value);
    }

    producer.await;
}

// Mutex example
async fn shared_counter() with Async {
    let counter = Mutex::new(0);

    let tasks: Vec<_> = (0..10).map(|_| {
        let c = &counter;
        spawn async move {
            var guard = c.lock().await;
            *guard += 1;
        }
    }).collect();

    join_all(tasks).await;

    let final_value = *counter.lock().await;
    println("Final count: {}", final_value);
}

// Semaphore for rate limiting
async fn rate_limited_fetch(urls: Vec<string>, max_concurrent: usize) -> Vec<string> with Async, IO {
    let sem = Semaphore::new(max_concurrent);

    let futures = urls.into_iter().map(|url| {
        let s = &sem;
        async move {
            let _permit = s.acquire().await;
            fetch_data(url).await
        }
    }).collect();

    join_all(futures).await
}

// Stream example
async fn process_stream() with Async {
    let numbers = stream::iter(vec![1, 2, 3, 4, 5]);

    let result = numbers
        .map(|x| x * 2)
        .filter(|x| *x > 4)
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .await;

    println("Processed: {:?}", result);
}

// Interval timer example
async fn periodic_task() with Async {
    var interval = interval(Duration::from_millis(100));

    for _ in 0..5 {
        interval.tick().await;
        println("Tick!");
    }
}

// Watch channel for configuration updates
async fn config_watcher() with Async {
    let (tx, mut rx) = watch::channel(Config { debug: false });

    // Watcher task
    let watcher = spawn async move {
        while rx.changed().await.is_ok() {
            let config = rx.borrow();
            println("Config updated: debug={}", config.debug);
        }
    };

    // Update config
    sleep(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
    tx.send(Config { debug: true }).unwrap();

    sleep(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
    drop(tx);  // Close channel

    watcher.await;
}

    debug: bool,

/*
Aspirational example preserved below.
To restore, remove this stub and uncomment the original content.

// Automatic Differentiation Example
//
// This example demonstrates forward-mode automatic differentiation using dual numbers.
// Dual numbers are pairs (value, derivative) that propagate derivatives through computations.

// A dual number represents both a value and its derivative with respect to some variable.
// When we seed the derivative with 1.0, the final derivative gives us df/dx.

fn main() -> i32 {
    // Example 1: Derivative of f(x) = x^2 at x = 3
    // f'(x) = 2x, so f'(3) = 6
    let x = dual(3.0, 1.0);  // Create dual number: value=3.0, derivative=1.0 (seed)
    let f_x = x * x;         // x^2 using dual multiplication (product rule)

    let value = dual_value(f_x);    // Should be 9.0
    let deriv = dual_deriv(f_x);    // Should be 6.0 (the derivative at x=3)

    println("f(x) = x^2 at x = 3:");
    println("  value = ", value);    // 9.0
    println("  derivative = ", deriv); // 6.0

    // Example 2: Derivative of g(x) = x^3 at x = 2
    // g'(x) = 3x^2, so g'(2) = 12
    let y = dual(2.0, 1.0);
    let g_y = y * y * y;  // y^3

    println("g(x) = x^3 at x = 2:");
    println("  value = ", dual_value(g_y));     // 8.0
    println("  derivative = ", dual_deriv(g_y)); // 12.0

    // Example 3: Derivative of h(x) = 1/x at x = 2
    // h'(x) = -1/x^2, so h'(2) = -0.25
    let z = dual(2.0, 1.0);
    let one = dual(1.0, 0.0);  // Constant 1 (derivative = 0)
    let h_z = one / z;

    println("h(x) = 1/x at x = 2:");
    println("  value = ", dual_value(h_z));     // 0.5
    println("  derivative = ", dual_deriv(h_z)); // -0.25

    // Example 4: Chain rule - derivative of f(g(x)) where f(u) = u^2, g(x) = 2x + 1
    // At x = 1: g(1) = 3, f(g(1)) = 9
    // f'(g(x)) * g'(x) = 2*g(x) * 2 = 4*g(x) = 12 at x = 1
    let x4 = dual(1.0, 1.0);
    let two = dual(2.0, 0.0);
    let g_x4 = two * x4 + one;  // g(x) = 2x + 1
    let f_g_x4 = g_x4 * g_x4;   // f(g(x)) = (2x + 1)^2

    println("f(g(x)) = (2x + 1)^2 at x = 1:");
    println("  value = ", dual_value(f_g_x4));     // 9.0
    println("  derivative = ", dual_deriv(f_g_x4)); // 12.0

    // Example 5: Using grad() builtin for cleaner syntax
    // Define a function that works with dual numbers
    fn square(d: dual) -> dual {
        d * d
    }

    // grad(f, x) computes df/dx at x
    let gradient = grad(square, 3.0);
    println("grad(x^2, 3.0) = ", gradient);  // 6.0

    0
}

// Mathematical operations propagate derivatives automatically:
// - Addition: (a, a') + (b, b') = (a + b, a' + b')
// - Subtraction: (a, a') - (b, b') = (a - b, a' - b')
// - Multiplication: (a, a') * (b, b') = (a*b, a'*b + a*b')  [Product rule]
// - Division: (a, a') / (b, b') = (a/b, (a'*b - a*b') / b^2)  [Quotient rule]
// - sqrt: sqrt(a, a') = (sqrt(a), a' / (2*sqrt(a)))
// - exp: exp(a, a') = (exp(a), exp(a) * a')
// - log: log(a, a') = (log(a), a' / a)
// - sin: sin(a, a') = (sin(a), cos(a) * a')
// - cos: cos(a, a') = (cos(a), -sin(a) * a')

*/

struct Sample {
    value: i64
}

fn scale(item: Sample, factor: i64) -> Sample {
    return Sample { value: item.value * factor }
}

fn checksum(values: [i64]) -> i64 {
    var sum: i64 = 0
    for v in values {
        sum = sum + v
    }
    return sum
}

fn main() with IO {
    let seed = Sample { value: 3 }
    let scaled = scale(seed, 7)
    let data: [i64] = [scaled.value, 2, 5, 8]
    let total = checksum(data)
    println("example: autodiff")
    println(total)
}



// === FILE: examples/autodiff/dual_demo.sio ===
// Demo for stdlib/autodiff/dual.sio
//
// This file demonstrates usage of the autodiff::dual module.
// Module source: stdlib/autodiff/dual.sio

// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i32 {
    println("=== Sounio Forward-Mode Automatic Differentiation ===")
    println("")

    // Test 1: Simple derivative d/dx(x²) at x=3
    println("Test 1: d/dx(x^2) at x=3")
    let x1 = dual_var(3.0)
    let y1 = dual_mul(x1, x1)  // x²
    println("  f(x) = x^2")
    println("  f(3) = ")
    println(y1.val)
    println("  f'(3) = ")
    println(y1.dot)
    println("  Expected: f(3)=9, f'(3)=6")
    println("")

    // Test 2: Chain rule d/dx(exp(x²)) at x=1
    println("Test 2: d/dx(exp(x^2)) at x=1")
    let x2 = dual_var(1.0)
    let y2 = dual_exp(dual_mul(x2, x2))  // exp(x²)
    println("  f(x) = exp(x^2)")
    println("  f(1) = ")
    println(y2.val)
    println("  f'(1) = ")
    println(y2.dot)
    let expected_val = exp_f64(1.0)
    let expected_dot = 2.0 * exp_f64(1.0)  // 2x * exp(x²)
    println("  Expected: f(1)=e≈2.718, f'(1)=2e≈5.436")
    println("")

    // Test 3: Quotient rule d/dx(x/(1+x²)) at x=2
    println("Test 3: d/dx(x/(1+x^2)) at x=2")
    let x3 = dual_var(2.0)
    let one = dual_const(1.0)
    let y3 = dual_div(x3, dual_add(one, dual_mul(x3, x3)))  // x/(1+x²)
    println("  f(x) = x/(1+x^2)")
    println("  f(2) = ")
    println(y3.val)
    println("  f'(2) = ")
    println(y3.dot)
    // f(2) = 2/5 = 0.4
    // f'(x) = (1+x² - x*2x) / (1+x²)² = (1-x²) / (1+x²)²
    // f'(2) = (1-4) / 25 = -3/25 = -0.12
    println("  Expected: f(2)=0.4, f'(2)=-0.12")
    println("")

    // Test 4: sin(x) derivative at x=π/4
    println("Test 4: d/dx(sin(x)) at x=pi/4")
    let pi = 3.141592653589793
    let x4 = dual_var(pi / 4.0)
    let y4 = dual_sin(x4)
    println("  f(x) = sin(x)")
    println("  f(pi/4) = ")
    println(y4.val)
    println("  f'(pi/4) = ")
    println(y4.dot)
    println("  Expected: sin(pi/4)≈0.707, cos(pi/4)≈0.707")
    println("")

    // Test 5: Neural network activation chain
    println("Test 5: d/dx(sigmoid(tanh(x))) at x=0.5")
    let x5 = dual_var(0.5)
    let y5 = dual_sigmoid(dual_tanh(x5))
    println("  f(x) = sigmoid(tanh(x))")
    println("  f(0.5) = ")
    println(y5.val)
    println("  f'(0.5) = ")
    println(y5.dot)
    println("")

    // Test 6: Gradient of f(x,y,z) = x² + xy + z³ at (1,2,3)
    println("Test 6: Gradient of f(x,y,z) = x^2 + x*y + z^3 at (1,2,3)")
    // df/dx = 2x + y = 2 + 2 = 4
    let v_x = dualvec3_var_i(1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 0)
    let f_x = dual_add(dual_add(dual_mul(v_x.x, v_x.x), dual_mul(v_x.x, v_x.y)), dual_pow(v_x.z, 3.0))
    println("  df/dx = ")
    println(f_x.dot)
    // df/dy = x = 1
    let v_y = dualvec3_var_i(1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 1)
    let f_y = dual_add(dual_add(dual_mul(v_y.x, v_y.x), dual_mul(v_y.x, v_y.y)), dual_pow(v_y.z, 3.0))
    println("  df/dy = ")
    println(f_y.dot)
    // df/dz = 3z² = 27
    let v_z = dualvec3_var_i(1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 2)
    let f_z = dual_add(dual_add(dual_mul(v_z.x, v_z.x), dual_mul(v_z.x, v_z.y)), dual_pow(v_z.z, 3.0))
    println("  df/dz = ")
    println(f_z.dot)
    println("  Expected: grad = (4, 1, 27)")
    println("")

    // Validation
    let err1 = abs_f64(y1.val - 9.0) + abs_f64(y1.dot - 6.0)
    let err2 = abs_f64(y2.val - expected_val) + abs_f64(y2.dot - expected_dot)
    let err3 = abs_f64(y3.val - 0.4) + abs_f64(y3.dot + 0.12)
    let err6 = abs_f64(f_x.dot - 4.0) + abs_f64(f_y.dot - 1.0) + abs_f64(f_z.dot - 27.0)

    if err1 < 0.001 && err2 < 0.01 && err3 < 0.001 && err6 < 0.1 {
        println("TEST PASSED: All derivatives computed correctly")
        return 0
    } else {
        println("TEST FAILED: Derivative errors detected")
        println("  err1 = ")
        println(err1)
        println("  err2 = ")
        println(err2)
        println("  err3 = ")
        println(err3)
        println("  err6 = ")
        println(err6)
        return 1
    }
}


// === FILE: examples/autodiff/epistemic_dual_demo.sio ===
// Demo for stdlib/autodiff/epistemic_dual.sio
//
// This file demonstrates usage of the autodiff::epistemic_dual module.
// Module source: stdlib/autodiff/epistemic_dual.sio

// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i32 {
    println("=== Sounio Epistemic Autodiff: Uncertainty-Aware AD ===")
    println("")

    // Test 1: Basic arithmetic with uncertainty
    println("Test 1: f(x) = x^2 with x = 3.0 +/- 0.1")
    let x1 = edual_var_uncertain(3.0, 0.1)
    let y1 = edual_mul(x1, x1)
    println("  f(x) = ")
    println(y1.val)
    println("  f'(x) = ")
    println(y1.dot)
    println("  sigma_f = ")
    println(y1.unc)
    println("  sigma_f' = ")
    println(y1.unc_dot)
    println("  Expected: f=9, f'=6, sigma_f~0.424 (sqrt(2)*3*0.1 for independent)")
    println("  Confidence = ")
    println(confidence(y1))
    println("")

    // Test 2: Chain rule with uncertainty
    println("Test 2: f(x) = exp(x) with x = 1.0 +/- 0.05")
    let x2 = edual_var_uncertain(1.0, 0.05)
    let y2 = edual_exp(x2)
    println("  f(x) = ")
    println(y2.val)
    println("  f'(x) = ")
    println(y2.dot)
    println("  sigma_f = ")
    println(y2.unc)
    println("  Expected: f=e~2.718, f'=e~2.718, sigma_f=e*0.05~0.136")
    println("")

    // Test 3: Pharmacokinetics with uncertainty
    println("Test 3: PK Concentration with measurement uncertainties")
    let dose = edual_measurement(100.0, 0.02)      // 100 mg +/- 2%
    let volume = edual_measurement(50.0, 0.05)     // 50 L +/- 5%
    let clearance = edual_measurement(5.0, 0.10)   // 5 L/h +/- 10%
    let time = edual_const(2.0)                    // 2 hours (exact)

    let conc = pk_concentration(dose, volume, clearance, time)
    println("  Dose = 100 mg +/- 2%")
    println("  Volume = 50 L +/- 5%")
    println("  Clearance = 5 L/h +/- 10%")
    println("  Time = 2 h")
    println("")
    println("  Concentration = ")
    println(conc.val)
    println("  mg/L")
    println("  Uncertainty = +/- ")
    println(conc.unc)
    println("  mg/L")
    println("  Relative uncertainty = ")
    println(relative_unc(conc) * 100.0)
    println("  %")
    println("  Confidence = ")
    println(confidence(conc))
    println("")

    // Test 4: Sensitivity analysis
    println("Test 4: Sensitivity analysis for sin(x) at x=pi/4")
    let pi = 3.141592653589793
    let x4 = edual_var_uncertain(pi / 4.0, 0.01)
    let y4 = edual_sin(x4)
    println("  f(x) = sin(x)")
    println("  x = pi/4 +/- 0.01")
    println("  f(x) = ")
    println(y4.val)
    println("  f'(x) = ")
    println(y4.dot)
    println("  sigma_f = ")
    println(y4.unc)
    println("  Sensitivity = ")
    println(sensitivity(y4))
    println("")

    // Test 5: Compatibility check
    println("Test 5: Checking if two measurements are compatible")
    let m1 = edual_measurement(10.0, 0.05)  // 10 +/- 5%
    let m2 = edual_measurement(10.3, 0.04)  // 10.3 +/- 4%
    let is_compat = edual_compatible(m1, m2, 2.0)
    println("  m1 = 10.0 +/- 5%")
    println("  m2 = 10.3 +/- 4%")
    println("  Compatible within 2-sigma? ")
    if is_compat == 1 {
        println("  YES")
    } else {
        println("  NO")
    }
    println("")

    // Validation
    // For x^2 with x=3+/-0.1: sigma_f = sqrt((3*0.1)^2 + (3*0.1)^2) = sqrt(2)*0.3 = 0.4243
    let err1 = abs_f64(y1.val - 9.0) + abs_f64(y1.dot - 6.0)
    let expected_unc = sqrt_f64(2.0) * 3.0 * 0.1
    let err2 = abs_f64(y1.unc - expected_unc)

    if err1 < 0.01 && err2 < 0.01 {
        println("TEST PASSED: Epistemic autodiff working correctly")
        return 0
    } else {
        println("TEST FAILED: Errors detected")
        println("  err1 = ")
        println(err1)
        println("  err2 = ")
        println(err2)
        return 1
    }
}

    print(j5.j33)
    println("]")
    // Expected: [[0, -1, 0], [1, 0, 0], [0, 0, 1]]
    println("")

    // Test 6: Gradient descent on Rosenbrock
    println("Test 6: Gradient descent on Rosenbrock from (-1, 1)")
    let gd = gradient_descent_rosenbrock(0.0 - 1.0, 1.0, 0.001, 10000)
    println("  Final x = ")
    println(gd.x)
    println("  Final y = ")
    println(gd.y)
    println("  Final f = ")
    println(gd.fx)
    println("  Iterations = ")
    println(gd.iter)
    println("")

    // Validation
    let err1 = abs_f64(g1.fx) + abs_f64(g1.dx) + abs_f64(g1.dy)
    let err2_fx = abs_f64(g2.fx - 1.0)
    let err2_dx = abs_f64(g2.dx + 2.0)  // Expected -2
    let err2_dy = abs_f64(g2.dy)
    let err3_fx = abs_f64(g3.fx - 14.0)
    let err3_grad = abs_f64(g3.dx - 2.0) + abs_f64(g3.dy - 4.0) + abs_f64(g3.dz - 6.0)

    let pass1 = err1 < 0.0001
    let pass2 = err2_fx < 0.0001 && err2_dx < 0.0001 && err2_dy < 0.0001
    let pass3 = err3_fx < 0.0001 && err3_grad < 0.0001
    let pass4 = abs_f64(j4.df1_dx - cos_f64(pi/4.0)) < 0.001
    let pass5 = abs_f64(j5.j11) < 0.001 && abs_f64(j5.j12 + 1.0) < 0.001
    let pass6 = gd.fx < 0.1  // Should get close to minimum

    if pass1 && pass2 && pass3 && pass4 && pass5 && pass6 {
        println("ALL TESTS PASSED")
        return 0
    } else {
        println("SOME TESTS FAILED")
        if !pass1 { println("  Test 1 failed") }
        if !pass2 { println("  Test 2 failed") }
        if !pass3 { println("  Test 3 failed") }
        if !pass4 { println("  Test 4 failed") }
        if !pass5 { println("  Test 5 failed") }
        if !pass6 { println("  Test 6 failed") }
        return 1
    }
}


// === FILE: examples/autodiff/tape_demo.sio ===
//! Reverse-Mode Automatic Differentiation Demo
//!
//! Shows tape-based backpropagation for efficient gradient computation.
//! Reverse-mode AD is optimal for ML: one backward pass gives gradients
//! for all inputs, vs forward-mode which requires one pass per input.

extern "C" {
    fn printf(fmt: &u8, ...);
}

// Import tape operations
struct TapeNode {
    value: f64,
    adjoint: f64,
    op: i64,
    parent1: i64,
    parent2: i64,
    aux: f64
}

struct Tape {
    n0: TapeNode, n1: TapeNode, n2: TapeNode, n3: TapeNode, n4: TapeNode,
    n5: TapeNode, n6: TapeNode, n7: TapeNode, n8: TapeNode, n9: TapeNode,
    n10: TapeNode, n11: TapeNode, n12: TapeNode, n13: TapeNode, n14: TapeNode,
    n15: TapeNode, n16: TapeNode, n17: TapeNode, n18: TapeNode, n19: TapeNode,
    size: i64
}

struct Var {
    idx: i64,
    val: f64
}

fn new_tape() -> Tape;
fn tape_new_var(tape: Tape, val: f64) -> Tape;
fn tape_last_var(tape: Tape) -> Var;
fn tape_add(tape: Tape, a: Var, b: Var) -> Tape;
fn tape_sub(tape: Tape, a: Var, b: Var) -> Tape;
fn tape_mul(tape: Tape, a: Var, b: Var) -> Tape;
fn tape_div(tape: Tape, a: Var, b: Var) -> Tape;
fn tape_sin(tape: Tape, a: Var) -> Tape;
fn tape_cos(tape: Tape, a: Var) -> Tape;
fn tape_exp(tape: Tape, a: Var) -> Tape;
fn tape_ln(tape: Tape, a: Var) -> Tape;
fn tape_tanh(tape: Tape, a: Var) -> Tape;
fn tape_sigmoid(tape: Tape, a: Var) -> Tape;
fn backward(tape: Tape, output: Var) -> Tape;
fn get_grad(tape: Tape, v: Var) -> f64;
fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64;
fn cos_f64(x: f64) -> f64;

fn main() with IO {
    printf("=== Reverse-Mode Automatic Differentiation Demo ===\\n" as &u8)
    printf("\\n" as &u8)

    // Example 1: f(x) = x² at x=3
    printf("Example 1: f(x) = x² at x=3\\n" as &u8)
    var t1 = new_tape()
    t1 = tape_new_var(t1, 3.0)
    let x1 = tape_last_var(t1)
    t1 = tape_mul(t1, x1, x1)
    let y1 = tape_last_var(t1)
    t1 = backward(t1, y1)
    printf("  f(3) = %f" as &u8, y1.val)
    printf(", df/dx = %f\\n" as &u8, get_grad(t1, x1))
    printf("  Expected: f = 9, df/dx = 6\\n" as &u8)
    printf("\\n" as &u8)

    // Example 2: f(x,y) = x·y at (3,5)
    printf("Example 2: f(x,y) = x·y at (3,5)\\n" as &u8)
    var t2 = new_tape()
    t2 = tape_new_var(t2, 3.0)
    let x2 = tape_last_var(t2)
    t2 = tape_new_var(t2, 5.0)
    let y2 = tape_last_var(t2)
    t2 = tape_mul(t2, x2, y2)
    let z2 = tape_last_var(t2)
    t2 = backward(t2, z2)
    printf("  f(3,5) = %f\\n" as &u8, z2.val)
    printf("  df/dx = %f" as &u8, get_grad(t2, x2))
    printf(", df/dy = %f\\n" as &u8, get_grad(t2, y2))
    printf("  Expected: f = 15, df/dx = 5, df/dy = 3\\n" as &u8)
    printf("\\n" as &u8)

    // Example 3: f(x,y) = x·y + sin(x) at (2,3)
    printf("Example 3: f(x,y) = x·y + sin(x) at (2,3)\\n" as &u8)
    var t3 = new_tape()
    t3 = tape_new_var(t3, 2.0)
    let x3 = tape_last_var(t3)
    t3 = tape_new_var(t3, 3.0)
    let y3 = tape_last_var(t3)
    t3 = tape_mul(t3, x3, y3)
    let xy = tape_last_var(t3)
    t3 = tape_sin(t3, x3)
    let sinx = tape_last_var(t3)
    t3 = tape_add(t3, xy, sinx)
    let f3 = tape_last_var(t3)
    t3 = backward(t3, f3)
    printf("  f(2,3) = %f\\n" as &u8, f3.val)
    printf("  df/dx = %f" as &u8, get_grad(t3, x3))
    printf(", df/dy = %f\\n" as &u8, get_grad(t3, y3))
    printf("  Expected: df/dx = y + cos(x) ≈ 2.58, df/dy = x = 2\\n" as &u8)
    printf("\\n" as &u8)

    // Example 4: Neural network layer: σ(w·x + b)
    printf("Example 4: Neural net layer σ(w·x + b) at w=0.5, x=2, b=0.1\\n" as &u8)
    var t4 = new_tape()
    t4 = tape_new_var(t4, 0.5)
    let w4 = tape_last_var(t4)
    t4 = tape_new_var(t4, 2.0)
    let x4 = tape_last_var(t4)
    t4 = tape_new_var(t4, 0.1)
    let b4 = tape_last_var(t4)
    t4 = tape_mul(t4, w4, x4)
    let wx = tape_last_var(t4)
    t4 = tape_add(t4, wx, b4)
    let wxb = tape_last_var(t4)
    t4 = tape_sigmoid(t4, wxb)
    let out4 = tape_last_var(t4)
    t4 = backward(t4, out4)
    printf("  σ(w·x + b) = %f\\n" as &u8, out4.val)
    printf("  dσ/dw = %f" as &u8, get_grad(t4, w4))
    printf(", dσ/dx = %f" as &u8, get_grad(t4, x4))
    printf(", dσ/db = %f\\n" as &u8, get_grad(t4, b4))
    printf("\\n" as &u8)

    // Example 5: f(x) = exp(ln(x)) = x at x=3
    printf("Example 5: f(x) = exp(ln(x)) at x=3\\n" as &u8)
    var t5 = new_tape()
    t5 = tape_new_var(t5, 3.0)
    let x5 = tape_last_var(t5)
    t5 = tape_ln(t5, x5)
    let lnx = tape_last_var(t5)
    t5 = tape_exp(t5, lnx)
    let f5 = tape_last_var(t5)
    t5 = backward(t5, f5)
    printf("  f(3) = %f" as &u8, f5.val)
    printf(", df/dx = %f\\n" as &u8, get_grad(t5, x5))
    printf("  Expected: f = 3, df/dx = 1\\n" as &u8)
    printf("\\n" as &u8)

    // Example 6: Division f(x,y) = x/y at (6,2)
    printf("Example 6: f(x,y) = x/y at (6,2)\\n" as &u8)
    var t6 = new_tape()
    t6 = tape_new_var(t6, 6.0)
    let x6 = tape_last_var(t6)
    t6 = tape_new_var(t6, 2.0)
    let y6 = tape_last_var(t6)
    t6 = tape_div(t6, x6, y6)
    let f6 = tape_last_var(t6)
    t6 = backward(t6, f6)
    printf("  f(6,2) = %f\\n" as &u8, f6.val)
    printf("  df/dx = %f" as &u8, get_grad(t6, x6))
    printf(", df/dy = %f\\n" as &u8, get_grad(t6, y6))
    printf("  Expected: f = 3, df/dx = 0.5, df/dy = -1.5\\n" as &u8)
    printf("\\n" as &u8)

    // Validation
    let err1 = abs_f64(get_grad(t1, x1) - 6.0)
    let err2_x = abs_f64(get_grad(t2, x2) - 5.0)
    let err2_y = abs_f64(get_grad(t2, y2) - 3.0)
    let err3_x = abs_f64(get_grad(t3, x3) - (3.0 + cos_f64(2.0)))
    let err3_y = abs_f64(get_grad(t3, y3) - 2.0)
    let err5 = abs_f64(get_grad(t5, x5) - 1.0)
    let err6_x = abs_f64(get_grad(t6, x6) - 0.5)
    let err6_y = abs_f64(get_grad(t6, y6) - (0.0 - 1.5))

    let all_pass = err1 < 0.01 && err2_x < 0.01 && err2_y < 0.01 && err3_x < 0.05 && err3_y < 0.01 && err5 < 0.01 && err6_x < 0.01 && err6_y < 0.01

    printf("========================================\\n" as &u8)
    if all_pass {
        printf("✓ ALL EXAMPLES VALIDATED\\n" as &u8)
        printf("Reverse-mode AD working correctly!\\n" as &u8)
    } else {
        printf("✗ VALIDATION FAILED\\n" as &u8)
        printf("Gradient errors detected\\n" as &u8)
    }
    printf("========================================\\n" as &u8)
}

// === FILE: examples/autodiff_neural.sio ===
// autodiff_neural.sio — Self-contained 2-layer neural net with manual backprop
//
// Architecture: 2→4→1
//   Forward:   x (2D) → W1·x + b1 → sigmoid → h (4D) → W2·h + b2 → y_pred (scalar)
//   Loss:      MSE = (y_pred - y_target)²
//   Backward:  manual gradient computation for all weights
//   Training:  10 gradient descent steps
//   Verdict:   PASS if final_loss < initial_loss
//
// No imports — all helpers inlined.

// ============================================================================
// MATH HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn exp_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x > 20.0 { return exp_f64(x / 2.0) * exp_f64(x / 2.0) }
    if x < 0.0 - 20.0 { return 1.0 / exp_f64(0.0 - x) }
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    term = term * x / 1.0;  sum = sum + term
    term = term * x / 2.0;  sum = sum + term
    term = term * x / 3.0;  sum = sum + term
    term = term * x / 4.0;  sum = sum + term
    term = term * x / 5.0;  sum = sum + term
    term = term * x / 6.0;  sum = sum + term
    term = term * x / 7.0;  sum = sum + term
    term = term * x / 8.0;  sum = sum + term
    term = term * x / 9.0;  sum = sum + term
    term = term * x / 10.0; sum = sum + term
    term = term * x / 11.0; sum = sum + term
    term = term * x / 12.0; sum = sum + term
    return sum
}

fn sigmoid(x: f64) -> f64 {
    return 1.0 / (1.0 + exp_f64(0.0 - x))
}

fn sigmoid_deriv(y: f64) -> f64 {
    return y * (1.0 - y)
}

// ============================================================================
// NETWORK WEIGHTS  (2→4→1)
//
// W1: 4×2 = 8 weights (row-major: W1[i*2+j] = weight from input j to hidden i)
// b1: 4 biases
// W2: 1×4 = 4 weights (W2[j] = weight from hidden j to output)
// b2: 1 bias
// ============================================================================

// Training data: single sample (x0=1.0, x1=0.5) → target 0.8
fn x0() -> f64 { 1.0 }
fn x1() -> f64 { 0.5 }
fn y_target() -> f64 { 0.8 }
fn lr() -> f64 { 0.1 }

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic {
    // Initialize weights (small fixed values, no RNG needed for determinism)
    var W1: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    var b1: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
    var W2: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
    var b2: f64 = 0.0

    // W1 initial values (2→4)
    W1[0] = 0.5;  W1[1] = 0.3   // hidden 0
    W1[2] = 0.2;  W1[3] = 0.6   // hidden 1
    W1[4] = 0.8;  W1[5] = 0.1   // hidden 2
    W1[6] = 0.4;  W1[7] = 0.7   // hidden 3

    // b1 initial values
    b1[0] = 0.1; b1[1] = 0.2; b1[2] = 0.05; b1[3] = 0.15

    // W2 initial values (4→1)
    W2[0] = 0.6; W2[1] = 0.3; W2[2] = 0.5; W2[3] = 0.4

    // b2
    b2 = 0.0

    // Intermediate storage
    var z1: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
    var h: [f64; 4]  = [0.0; 4]

    // Forward pass once to compute initial loss
    // z1[i] = W1[i*2]*x0 + W1[i*2+1]*x1 + b1[i]
    var hi: i64 = 0
    while hi < 4 {
        z1[hi as usize] = W1[(hi * 2) as usize] * x0() + W1[(hi * 2 + 1) as usize] * x1() + b1[hi as usize]
        h[hi as usize] = sigmoid(z1[hi as usize])
        hi = hi + 1
    }
    // y_pred = W2·h + b2
    var y_pred_init = b2
    var wi: i64 = 0
    while wi < 4 {
        y_pred_init = y_pred_init + W2[wi as usize] * h[wi as usize]
        wi = wi + 1
    }
    let loss_init = (y_pred_init - y_target()) * (y_pred_init - y_target())

    // =========================================================================
    // TRAINING LOOP — 10 gradient descent steps
    // =========================================================================
    var step: i64 = 0
    while step < 10 {
        // --- Forward pass ---
        // z1, h
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < 4 {
            z1[i as usize] = W1[(i * 2) as usize] * x0() + W1[(i * 2 + 1) as usize] * x1() + b1[i as usize]
            h[i as usize] = sigmoid(z1[i as usize])
            i = i + 1
        }
        // y_pred
        var y_pred = b2
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < 4 {
            y_pred = y_pred + W2[j as usize] * h[j as usize]
            j = j + 1
        }

        // --- Backward pass ---
        // dL/dy_pred = 2*(y_pred - y_target)
        let d_out = 2.0 * (y_pred - y_target())

        // dL/dW2[j] = d_out * h[j]
        // dL/db2    = d_out
        // dL/dh[j]  = d_out * W2[j]
        var dh: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]
        var j2: i64 = 0
        while j2 < 4 {
            let dW2_j = d_out * h[j2 as usize]
            W2[j2 as usize] = W2[j2 as usize] - lr() * dW2_j
            dh[j2 as usize] = d_out * W2[j2 as usize]  // use updated W2 (close enough for 10 steps)
            j2 = j2 + 1
        }
        b2 = b2 - lr() * d_out

        // dL/dz1[i] = dh[i] * sigmoid'(h[i]) = dh[i] * h[i]*(1-h[i])
        var i2: i64 = 0
        while i2 < 4 {
            let dz1_i = dh[i2 as usize] * sigmoid_deriv(h[i2 as usize])
            // dL/dW1[i*2]   = dz1_i * x0
            // dL/dW1[i*2+1] = dz1_i * x1
            // dL/db1[i]     = dz1_i
            W1[(i2 * 2) as usize]       = W1[(i2 * 2) as usize]       - lr() * dz1_i * x0()
            W1[(i2 * 2 + 1) as usize]   = W1[(i2 * 2 + 1) as usize]   - lr() * dz1_i * x1()
            b1[i2 as usize]             = b1[i2 as usize]             - lr() * dz1_i
            i2 = i2 + 1
        }

        step = step + 1
    }

    // --- Final forward pass to compute final loss ---
    var i3: i64 = 0
    while i3 < 4 {
        z1[i3 as usize] = W1[(i3 * 2) as usize] * x0() + W1[(i3 * 2 + 1) as usize] * x1() + b1[i3 as usize]
        h[i3 as usize] = sigmoid(z1[i3 as usize])
        i3 = i3 + 1
    }
    var y_pred_final = b2
    var j3: i64 = 0
    while j3 < 4 {
        y_pred_final = y_pred_final + W2[j3 as usize] * h[j3 as usize]
        j3 = j3 + 1
    }
    let loss_final = (y_pred_final - y_target()) * (y_pred_final - y_target())

    // PASS if loss decreased
    if loss_final < loss_init {
        print("autodiff_neural: PASS\n")
        return 0
    }
    print("autodiff_neural: FAIL\n")
    return 1 as i32
}

// === FILE: examples/bayes/mcmc_demo.sio ===
// Demo for stdlib/bayes/mcmc.sio
//
// This file demonstrates usage of the bayes::mcmc module.
// Module source: stdlib/bayes/mcmc.sio

// ============================================================================

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { -x } else { x }
}

fn test_metropolis_simple() -> bool {
    // Normal-normal conjugate model
    // Data: mean = 5.0, var = 1.0, n = 10
    // Prior: mean = 0.0, var = 10.0

    let lp = log_posterior_new(5.0, 1.0, 10, 0.0, 10.0)
    var config = mcmc_config_default()
    config.n_samples = 100
    config.n_warmup = 100

    let chain = metropolis_hastings(lp, config)

    // Posterior mean should be close to data mean (strong likelihood)
    // Analytical: post_prec = 0.1 + 10 = 10.1
    // post_mean = (0.1 * 0 + 10 * 5) / 10.1 = 4.95
    abs_f64(chain.mean - 4.95) < 0.5 && chain.acceptance_rate > 0.1
}

fn test_acceptance_rate() -> bool {
    let lp = log_posterior_new(0.0, 1.0, 10, 0.0, 1.0)
    var config = mcmc_config_default()
    config.n_samples = 100
    config.n_warmup = 200

    let chain = metropolis_hastings(lp, config)

    // Acceptance rate should be reasonable (20-50%)
    chain.acceptance_rate > 0.15 && chain.acceptance_rate < 0.7
}

fn test_credible_interval() -> bool {
    let lp = log_posterior_new(0.0, 1.0, 100, 0.0, 10.0)
    var config = mcmc_config_default()
    config.n_samples = 100
    config.n_warmup = 100

    let chain = metropolis_hastings(lp, config)

    // CI should contain true posterior mean (near 0)
    chain.ci_lower < 0.0 && chain.ci_upper > 0.0
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    print("Testing bayes::mcmc module...\n")

    if !test_metropolis_simple() {
        print("FAIL: metropolis_simple\n")
        return 1
    }
    print("PASS: metropolis_simple\n")

    if !test_acceptance_rate() {
        print("FAIL: acceptance_rate\n")
        return 2
    }
    print("PASS: acceptance_rate\n")

    if !test_credible_interval() {
        print("FAIL: credible_interval\n")
        return 3
    }
    print("PASS: credible_interval\n")

    print("All bayes::mcmc tests PASSED\n")
    0
}

    !eval_neg.valid && eval_pos.valid
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    print("Testing bayes::prior module...\n")

    if !test_normal_prior() {
        print("FAIL: normal_prior\n")
        return 1
    }
    print("PASS: normal_prior\n")

    if !test_lognormal_prior() {
        print("FAIL: lognormal_prior\n")
        return 2
    }
    print("PASS: lognormal_prior\n")

    if !test_uniform_prior() {
        print("FAIL: uniform_prior\n")
        return 3
    }
    print("PASS: uniform_prior\n")

    if !test_beta_prior() {
        print("FAIL: beta_prior\n")
        return 4
    }
    print("PASS: beta_prior\n")

    if !test_half_normal_support() {
        print("FAIL: half_normal_support\n")
        return 5
    }
    print("PASS: half_normal_support\n")

    print("All bayes::prior tests PASSED\n")
    0
}

// Demo for stdlib/bayes/vi.sio

// This file demonstrates usage of the bayes::vi module.

// ============================================================================

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { -x } else { x }
}

fn test_vi_converges() -> bool {
    let model = normal_model_new(5.0, 1.0, 10, 0.0, 10.0)
    var config = vi_config_default()
    config.max_iter = 500
    config.learning_rate = 0.1

    let result = run_vi(model, config)

    // Should converge
    result.converged || result.n_iter > 100
}

fn test_vi_matches_analytical() -> bool {
    let model = normal_model_new(5.0, 1.0, 10, 0.0, 10.0)
    var config = vi_config_default()
    config.max_iter = 500
    config.learning_rate = 0.1
    config.n_samples = 20

    let result = run_vi(model, config)
    let analytical = analytical_posterior(model)

    // VI mean should be close to analytical
    // Analytical: post_prec = 0.1 + 10 = 10.1
    // post_mean = (0.1 * 0 + 10 * 5) / 10.1 = 4.95
    abs_f64(result.dist.mean - analytical.mean) < 0.5
}

fn test_elbo_increases() -> bool {
    let model = normal_model_new(0.0, 1.0, 10, 0.0, 1.0)
    var config = vi_config_default()
    config.max_iter = 100
    config.learning_rate = 0.05

    let result = run_vi(model, config)

    // ELBO should generally increase (allowing some noise)
    // Check that later ELBO > initial ELBO
    let n_check = if result.n_iter > 50 { 50 } else { result.n_iter }
    result.elbo_history[(n_check - 1) as usize] > result.elbo_history[0] - 1.0
}
