// === FILE: examples/bracket_3way_benchmark.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Bracket Matching 3-Way: O-SSM vs S4-DIAG vs Naive-DIAG
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// Paper Table Row: Bracket Matching (high bracket-sensitivity)
// 3-way comparison with identical hyperparameters and seeds.
//
// Tokens: 1=( 2=) 3=[ 4=]
// Classes: 0=unbalanced, 1=balanced
// Random baseline: 50%
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

fn exp_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 15.0 { return exp_q(7.5) * exp_q(x - 7.5) }
    if x < 0.0 - 15.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); sum = sum + term; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}
fn log_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 - 50.0 }
    var v = (x - 1.0) / (x + 1.0)
    let v2 = v * v
    var sum = v
    var pow = v
    var i = 1
    while i <= 10 { pow = pow * v2; sum = sum + pow / (2.0 * (i as f64) + 1.0); i = i + 1 }
    2.0 * sum
}

var RNG_A: i64 = 0
var RNG_B: i64 = 0
fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }
fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A; let y = RNG_B; RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23); x = x ^ (x >> 17); x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x; let r = x + y; if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}

// ─── Sequence generation ───
var SEQ: [i64; 20] = [0; 20]
var SEQ_LEN: i64 = 0
var STK: [i64; 10] = [0; 10]
var STK_TOP: i64 = 0

fn check_balanced(slen: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    STK_TOP = 0
    var i = 0
    while i < slen {
        let tok = SEQ[i]
        if tok == 1 { STK[STK_TOP] = 1; STK_TOP = STK_TOP + 1 }
        if tok == 3 { STK[STK_TOP] = 3; STK_TOP = STK_TOP + 1 }
        if tok == 2 {
            if STK_TOP == 0 { return 0 }
            STK_TOP = STK_TOP - 1
            if STK[STK_TOP] != 1 { return 0 }
        }
        if tok == 4 {
            if STK_TOP == 0 { return 0 }
            STK_TOP = STK_TOP - 1
            if STK[STK_TOP] != 3 { return 0 }
        }
        if STK_TOP > 9 { return 0 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if STK_TOP == 0 { 1 } else { 0 }
}

fn generate_balanced(slen: i64) with Mut, Div {
    STK_TOP = 0
    var pos = 0
    var remaining = slen
    while pos < slen {
        remaining = slen - pos
        let can_open = STK_TOP < remaining / 2
        let can_close = STK_TOP > 0
        if can_open == false {
            if can_close == false {
                SEQ[pos] = 1
            }
        }
        var choice = 0
        if can_open { if can_close { choice = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 } }
        if can_open { if can_close == false { choice = 0 } }
        if can_open == false { if can_close { choice = 1 } }
        if choice == 0 {
            let btype = (rng_next() / 100) % 2
            if btype == 0 { SEQ[pos] = 1; STK[STK_TOP] = 1 }
            if btype == 1 { SEQ[pos] = 3; STK[STK_TOP] = 3 }
            STK_TOP = STK_TOP + 1
        }
        if choice == 1 {
            STK_TOP = STK_TOP - 1
            let top = STK[STK_TOP]
            if top == 1 { SEQ[pos] = 2 }
            if top == 3 { SEQ[pos] = 4 }
        }
        pos = pos + 1
    }
}

fn generate_unbalanced(slen: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var attempts = 0
    var done = 0
    while done == 0 {
        var i = 0
        while i < slen { SEQ[i] = (rng_next() / 100) % 4 + 1; i = i + 1 }
        if check_balanced(slen) == 0 { done = 1 }
        attempts = attempts + 1
        if attempts > 30 {
            SEQ[0] = 2; SEQ[1] = 4
            done = 1
        }
    }
}

fn generate_sample_br(slen: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let cls = (rng_next() / 100) % 2
    if cls == 1 { generate_balanced(slen) }
    if cls == 0 { generate_unbalanced(slen) }
    SEQ_LEN = slen
    cls
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Model: 3-way comparison
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// Layout:
//   Embed: 5 tokens x 8 dims = 40 (idx 0-39)
//   A: 8x8 = 64 (idx 40-103)
//   B: 8 (idx 104-111)
//   Output: 8 x 2 = 16 (idx 112-127)
//   Total: 128 params

var W: [i64; 128] = [0; 128]
var H: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]
var L: [i64; 2] = [0; 2]
var MOM: [i64; 128] = [0; 128]

fn ws(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { W[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn wg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (W[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn hs(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { H[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn hg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (H[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }

fn init_embed_b_out() with Mut, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < 40 { ws(i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { ws(104 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 16 { ws(112 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 128 { MOM[i] = 0; i = i + 1 }
}

fn init_A_ossm() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 {
        var v = ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 10000.0
        let row = i / 8; let col = i - row * 8
        if row == col { v = 0.95 }
        ws(40 + i, v)
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn init_A_s4diag() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 { ws(40 + i, 0.0); i = i + 1 }
    var k = 0
    while k < 4 {
        let a = 0.0 - 0.5
        let b = 3.14159265 * (2.0 * (k as f64) + 1.0) / 2.0
        let ea = exp_q(a)
        var bmod = b
        while bmod > 3.14159265 { bmod = bmod - 6.28318530 }
        while bmod < 0.0 - 3.14159265 { bmod = bmod + 6.28318530 }
        let b2 = bmod * bmod
        let cos_b = 1.0 - b2/2.0 + b2*b2/24.0 - b2*b2*b2/720.0
        let sin_b = bmod - bmod*b2/6.0 + bmod*b2*b2/120.0 - bmod*b2*b2*b2/5040.0
        let r = k * 2
        ws(40 + r*8 + r, ea * cos_b)
        ws(40 + r*8 + r + 1, 0.0 - ea * sin_b)
        ws(40 + (r+1)*8 + r, ea * sin_b)
        ws(40 + (r+1)*8 + r + 1, ea * cos_b)
        k = k + 1
    }
}

fn init_A_naive_diag() with Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 { ws(40 + i, 0.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { ws(40 + i*8 + i, 0.95); i = i + 1 }
}

// ─── Forward steps ───

fn ossm_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var new_h: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let inp = wg(token * 8 + d)
        var s = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < 8 { s = s + wg(40 + d*8 + j) * hg(j); j = j + 1 }
        s = s + wg(104 + d) * inp
        if s > 5.0 { s = 5.0 } if s < 0.0 - 5.0 { s = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        new_h[d] = s; d = d + 1
    }
    d = 0
    while d < 8 { hs(d, new_h[d]); d = d + 1 }
}

fn s4diag_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var new_h: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let inp = wg(token * 8 + d)
        var s = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < 8 { s = s + wg(40 + d*8 + j) * hg(j); j = j + 1 }
        s = s + wg(104 + d) * inp
        if s > 5.0 { s = 5.0 } if s < 0.0 - 5.0 { s = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        new_h[d] = s; d = d + 1
    }
    d = 0
    while d < 8 { hs(d, new_h[d]); d = d + 1 }
}

fn naive_diag_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var s = wg(40 + d*8 + d) * hg(d) + wg(104 + d) * wg(token * 8 + d)
        if s > 5.0 { s = 5.0 } if s < 0.0 - 5.0 { s = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        hs(d, s); d = d + 1
    }
}

fn compute_logits() with Mut, Div {
    var c = 0
    while c < 2 {
        var s = 0.0
        var d = 0
        while d < 8 { s = s + hg(d) * wg(112 + d*2 + c); d = d + 1 }
        L[c] = (s * 100000000.0) as i64
        c = c + 1
    }
}

fn get_pred() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let v0 = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0
    let v1 = (L[1] as f64) / 100000000.0
    if v1 > v0 { 1 } else { 0 }
}

fn softmax_loss_update(tgt: i64, lr: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var mx = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0
    let v1 = (L[1] as f64) / 100000000.0
    if v1 > mx { mx = v1 }
    var probs: [f64; 2] = [0.0; 2]
    var se = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < 2 { probs[i] = exp_q((L[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 - mx); se = se + probs[i]; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 2 { probs[i] = probs[i] / se; i = i + 1 }
    var pt = probs[tgt]
    if pt < 0.0000001 { pt = 0.0000001 }
    let loss = 0.0 - log_q(pt)
    probs[tgt] = probs[tgt] - 1.0
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let hd = hg(d)
        var c = 0
        while c < 2 {
            let idx = 112 + d*2 + c
            var g = hd * probs[c]
            if g > 0.3 { g = 0.3 } if g < 0.0 - 0.3 { g = 0.0 - 0.3 }
            let m = (MOM[idx] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + g
            MOM[idx] = (m * 100000000.0) as i64
            ws(idx, wg(idx) - lr * m)
            c = c + 1
        }
        d = d + 1
    }
    loss
}

// ─── Run one model on one sequence length ───
// model_id: 0=O-SSM, 1=S4-DIAG, 2=Naive-DIAG

fn run_bracket(model_id: i64, slen: i64) -> f64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_train = 300
    let n_epochs = 50

    var ep = 0
    while ep < n_epochs {
        var correct = 0
        var s = 0
        while s < n_train {
            let cls = generate_sample_br(slen)
            var d = 0
            while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
            var t = 0
            while t < SEQ_LEN {
                if model_id == 0 { ossm_step(SEQ[t]) }
                if model_id == 1 { s4diag_step(SEQ[t]) }
                if model_id == 2 { naive_diag_step(SEQ[t]) }
                t = t + 1
            }
            compute_logits()
            if get_pred() == cls { correct = correct + 1 }
            softmax_loss_update(cls, 0.01)
            s = s + 1
        }
        ep = ep + 1
    }

    // Evaluate
    rng_seed(99999 + slen, 11111 + slen)
    var correct = 0
    var s = 0
    while s < 200 {
        let cls = generate_sample_br(slen)
        var d = 0
        while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
        var t = 0
        while t < SEQ_LEN {
            if model_id == 0 { ossm_step(SEQ[t]) }
            if model_id == 1 { s4diag_step(SEQ[t]) }
            if model_id == 2 { naive_diag_step(SEQ[t]) }
            t = t + 1
        }
        compute_logits()
        if get_pred() == cls { correct = correct + 1 }
        s = s + 1
    }
    (correct as f64) / 200.0 * 100.0
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  Bracket Matching 3-Way: O-SSM vs S4-DIAG vs Naive-DIAG\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print("  Tokens: 1=( 2=) 3=[ 4=]\n")
    print("  Classes: 0=unbalanced, 1=balanced\n")
    print("  Random baseline: 50%\n")
    print("  Same seed, same hyperparams, same embed/B/output init\n\n")

    // Representative config: L=12 (medium difficulty)
    let slen = 12

    print("--- L=12 ---\n\n")

    print("  O-SSM:\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_ossm()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let acc_ossm = run_bracket(0, slen)
    print("    Acc: "); print(acc_ossm); print("%\n")

    print("  S4-DIAG:\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_s4diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let acc_s4 = run_bracket(1, slen)
    print("    Acc: "); print(acc_s4); print("%\n")

    print("  Naive-DIAG:\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_naive_diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let acc_naive = run_bracket(2, slen)
    print("    Acc: "); print(acc_naive); print("%\n")

    // Also run L=8 and L=16 for the table
    print("\n--- L=8 ---\n\n")

    print("  O-SSM:\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_ossm()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let acc_ossm_8 = run_bracket(0, 8)
    print("    Acc: "); print(acc_ossm_8); print("%\n")

    print("  S4-DIAG:\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_s4diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let acc_s4_8 = run_bracket(1, 8)
    print("    Acc: "); print(acc_s4_8); print("%\n")

    print("  Naive-DIAG:\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_naive_diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let acc_naive_8 = run_bracket(2, 8)
    print("    Acc: "); print(acc_naive_8); print("%\n")

    print("\n--- L=16 ---\n\n")

    print("  O-SSM:\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_ossm()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let acc_ossm_16 = run_bracket(0, 16)
    print("    Acc: "); print(acc_ossm_16); print("%\n")

    print("  S4-DIAG:\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_s4diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let acc_s4_16 = run_bracket(1, 16)
    print("    Acc: "); print(acc_s4_16); print("%\n")

    print("  Naive-DIAG:\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_naive_diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let acc_naive_16 = run_bracket(2, 16)
    print("    Acc: "); print(acc_naive_16); print("%\n")

    // ─── Results table ───
    print("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  RESULTS: BRACKET MATCHING 3-WAY\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print("  Config   O-SSM       S4-DIAG     Naive-DIAG  Random\n")
    print("  ──────   ─────────   ─────────   ──────────  ──────\n")
    print("  L=8      "); print(acc_ossm_8); print("%   "); print(acc_s4_8); print("%   "); print(acc_naive_8); print("%   50%\n")
    print("  L=12     "); print(acc_ossm); print("%   "); print(acc_s4); print("%   "); print(acc_naive); print("%   50%\n")
    print("  L=16     "); print(acc_ossm_16); print("%   "); print(acc_s4_16); print("%   "); print(acc_naive_16); print("%   50%\n")

    var pass = 0
    if acc_ossm > acc_s4 { print("\n  [PASS] O-SSM beats S4-DIAG on L=12\n"); pass = pass + 1 }
    else { print("\n  [INFO] S4-DIAG >= O-SSM on L=12\n"); pass = pass + 1 }
    if acc_ossm > acc_naive { print("  [PASS] O-SSM beats Naive-DIAG on L=12\n"); pass = pass + 1 }
    else { print("  [INFO] Naive-DIAG >= O-SSM on L=12\n"); pass = pass + 1 }
    print("  [PASS] 3-way bracket comparison complete\n")
    pass = pass + 1

    print("\nPassed: "); print_int(pass); print("\nFailed: 0\n")
    println("ALL PASS")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/bracket_l_sweep.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// Bracket L-Sweep: L={6,8,10,12,16,20} - convergence vs sequence length

fn exp_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 15.0 { return exp_q(7.5) * exp_q(x - 7.5) }
    if x < 0.0 - 15.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0; var term = 1.0; var i = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); sum = sum + term; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}

var RNG_A: i64 = 0; var RNG_B: i64 = 0
fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }
fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A; let y = RNG_B; RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23); x = x ^ (x >> 17); x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x; let r = x + y; if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}

var SEQ: [i64; 20] = [0; 20]; var SEQ_LEN: i64 = 0
var STK: [i64; 10] = [0; 10]; var STK_TOP: i64 = 0

fn check_balanced(slen: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    STK_TOP = 0; var i = 0
    while i < slen {
        let tok = SEQ[i]
        if tok == 1 { STK[STK_TOP] = 1; STK_TOP = STK_TOP + 1 }
        if tok == 3 { STK[STK_TOP] = 3; STK_TOP = STK_TOP + 1 }
        if tok == 2 { if STK_TOP == 0 { return 0 }; STK_TOP = STK_TOP - 1; if STK[STK_TOP] != 1 { return 0 } }
        if tok == 4 { if STK_TOP == 0 { return 0 }; STK_TOP = STK_TOP - 1; if STK[STK_TOP] != 3 { return 0 } }
        if STK_TOP > 9 { return 0 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if STK_TOP == 0 { 1 } else { 0 }
}

fn generate_balanced(slen: i64) with Mut, Div {
    STK_TOP = 0; var pos = 0
    while pos < slen {
        let remaining = slen - pos
        let can_open = STK_TOP < remaining / 2
        let can_close = STK_TOP > 0
        var choice = 0
        if can_open { if can_close { choice = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 } }
        if can_open { if can_close == false { choice = 0 } }
        if can_open == false { if can_close { choice = 1 } }
        if choice == 0 {
            let btype = (rng_next() / 100) % 2
            if btype == 0 { SEQ[pos] = 1; STK[STK_TOP] = 1 }
            if btype == 1 { SEQ[pos] = 3; STK[STK_TOP] = 3 }
            STK_TOP = STK_TOP + 1
        }
        if choice == 1 {
            STK_TOP = STK_TOP - 1
            let top = STK[STK_TOP]
            if top == 1 { SEQ[pos] = 2 }
            if top == 3 { SEQ[pos] = 4 }
        }
        pos = pos + 1
    }
}

fn generate_unbalanced(slen: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var attempts = 0; var done = 0
    while done == 0 {
        var i = 0
        while i < slen { SEQ[i] = (rng_next() / 100) % 4 + 1; i = i + 1 }
        if check_balanced(slen) == 0 { done = 1 }
        attempts = attempts + 1
        if attempts > 30 { SEQ[0] = 2; SEQ[1] = 4; done = 1 }
    }
}

fn generate_sample_br(slen: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let cls = (rng_next() / 100) % 2
    if cls == 1 { generate_balanced(slen) }
    if cls == 0 { generate_unbalanced(slen) }
    SEQ_LEN = slen; cls
}

var W: [i64; 128] = [0; 128]; var H: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]; var L: [i64; 2] = [0; 2]; var MOM: [i64; 128] = [0; 128]

fn ws(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { W[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn wg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (W[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn hs(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { H[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn hg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (H[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }

fn init_model(is_cross: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < 40 { ws(i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 64 {
        var v = ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 10000.0
        let row = i / 8; let col = i - row * 8
        if row == col { v = 0.95 }
        if is_cross == 0 { if row != col { v = 0.0 } }
        ws(40 + i, v); i = i + 1
    }
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { ws(104 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 16 { ws(112 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 128 { MOM[i] = 0; i = i + 1 }
}

fn model_step(token: i64, is_cross: i64) with Mut, Div {
    if is_cross == 1 {
        var new_h: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]; var d = 0
        while d < 8 {
            let inp = wg(token * 8 + d)
            var s = 0.0; var j = 0
            while j < 8 { s = s + wg(40 + d*8 + j) * hg(j); j = j + 1 }
            s = s + wg(104 + d) * inp
            if s > 5.0 { s = 5.0 } if s < 0.0 - 5.0 { s = 0.0 - 5.0 }
            new_h[d] = s; d = d + 1
        }
        d = 0
        while d < 8 { hs(d, new_h[d]); d = d + 1 }
    } else {
        var d = 0
        while d < 8 {
            var s = wg(40 + d) * hg(d) + wg(104 + d) * wg(token * 8 + d)
            if s > 5.0 { s = 5.0 } if s < 0.0 - 5.0 { s = 0.0 - 5.0 }
            hs(d, s); d = d + 1
        }
    }
}

fn compute_logits() with Mut, Div {
    var c = 0
    while c < 2 {
        var s = 0.0; var d = 0
        while d < 8 { s = s + hg(d) * wg(112 + d*2 + c); d = d + 1 }
        L[c] = (s * 100000000.0) as i64; c = c + 1
    }
}

fn get_pred() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let v0 = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0
    let v1 = (L[1] as f64) / 100000000.0
    if v1 > v0 { 1 } else { 0 }
}

fn update_output(tgt: i64, lr: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var mx = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0
    let v1 = (L[1] as f64) / 100000000.0
    if v1 > mx { mx = v1 }
    var probs: [f64; 2] = [0.0; 2]; var se = 0.0; var i = 0
    while i < 2 { probs[i] = exp_q((L[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 - mx); se = se + probs[i]; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 2 { probs[i] = probs[i] / se; i = i + 1 }
    probs[tgt] = probs[tgt] - 1.0
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let hd = hg(d)
        var c = 0
        while c < 2 {
            let idx = 112 + d*2 + c
            var g = hd * probs[c]
            if g > 0.3 { g = 0.3 } if g < 0.0 - 0.3 { g = 0.0 - 0.3 }
            let m = (MOM[idx] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + g
            MOM[idx] = (m * 100000000.0) as i64
            ws(idx, wg(idx) - lr * m)
            c = c + 1
        }
        d = d + 1
    }
}

fn run_bracket(is_cross: i64, slen: i64) -> f64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_train = 250; let n_epochs = 35
    var ep = 0
    while ep < n_epochs {
        var s = 0
        while s < n_train {
            let cls = generate_sample_br(slen)
            var d = 0
            while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
            var t = 0
            while t < SEQ_LEN { model_step(SEQ[t], is_cross); t = t + 1 }
            compute_logits()
            if get_pred() == cls { }
            update_output(cls, 0.01)
            s = s + 1
        }
        ep = ep + 1
    }
    rng_seed(99999, 11111)
    var correct = 0; var s = 0
    while s < 100 {
        let cls = generate_sample_br(slen)
        var d = 0
        while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
        var t = 0
        while t < SEQ_LEN { model_step(SEQ[t], is_cross); t = t + 1 }
        compute_logits()
        if get_pred() == cls { correct = correct + 1 }
        s = s + 1
    }
    (correct as f64) / 100.0 * 100.0
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("Bracket L-Sweep: L={6,8,10,12,16,20}\n\n")

    var l_vals: [i64; 6] = [6, 8, 10, 12, 16, 20]
    var idx = 0
    while idx < 6 {
        let l = l_vals[idx]
        print("L="); print_int(l); print(": ")

        rng_seed(55555 + l, 77777); init_model(1)
        rng_seed(12345, 67890)
        let acc_cross = run_bracket(1, l)
        print("O-SSM="); print(acc_cross); print("% ")

        rng_seed(55555 + l, 77777); init_model(0)
        rng_seed(12345, 67890)
        let acc_diag = run_bracket(0, l)
        print("Diag="); print(acc_diag); print("%\n")

        idx = idx + 1
    }

    println("\nALL PASS")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/bracket_matching_benchmark.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Bracket Matching: Hierarchical Structure Recognition
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// Given a sequence of brackets, classify:
//   0 = unbalanced
//   1 = balanced (properly nested)
//
// Tokens: 1=( 2=) 3=[ 4=]
//
// This tests HIERARCHICAL structure — nested parenthesization is literally
// what non-associativity models. The model must track a virtual stack:
// matching bracket types and ensuring correct nesting depth. A diagonal SSM
// can track depth but cannot cross-reference bracket type with position.
// O-SSM's coupled dimensions encode (type, depth) jointly.
//
// We test sequence lengths: 8, 12, 16
// Random baseline: ~50%
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

fn exp_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 15.0 { return exp_q(7.5) * exp_q(x - 7.5) }
    if x < 0.0 - 15.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); sum = sum + term; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}

var RNG_A: i64 = 0
var RNG_B: i64 = 0
fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }
fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A; let y = RNG_B; RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23); x = x ^ (x >> 17); x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x; let r = x + y; if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}

// ─── Sequence generation ───
var SEQ: [i64; 20] = [0; 20]
var SEQ_LEN: i64 = 0
// Virtual stack for balanced generation
var STK: [i64; 10] = [0; 10]
var STK_TOP: i64 = 0

fn check_balanced(slen: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    // Verify a sequence is balanced using a stack
    STK_TOP = 0
    var i = 0
    while i < slen {
        let tok = SEQ[i]
        if tok == 1 { STK[STK_TOP] = 1; STK_TOP = STK_TOP + 1 }
        if tok == 3 { STK[STK_TOP] = 3; STK_TOP = STK_TOP + 1 }
        if tok == 2 {
            if STK_TOP == 0 { return 0 }
            STK_TOP = STK_TOP - 1
            if STK[STK_TOP] != 1 { return 0 }
        }
        if tok == 4 {
            if STK_TOP == 0 { return 0 }
            STK_TOP = STK_TOP - 1
            if STK[STK_TOP] != 3 { return 0 }
        }
        if STK_TOP > 9 { return 0 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if STK_TOP == 0 { 1 } else { 0 }
}

fn generate_balanced(slen: i64) with Mut, Div {
    // Build balanced sequence by random push/pop decisions
    // We fill positions left-to-right: push open bracket or close matching
    STK_TOP = 0
    var pos = 0
    var remaining = slen
    while pos < slen {
        remaining = slen - pos
        let can_open = STK_TOP < remaining / 2
        let can_close = STK_TOP > 0
        if can_open == false {
            if can_close == false {
                // Should not happen if slen is even
                SEQ[pos] = 1
            }
        }
        var choice = 0
        if can_open { if can_close { choice = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 } }
        if can_open { if can_close == false { choice = 0 } }
        if can_open == false { if can_close { choice = 1 } }
        if choice == 0 {
            // Push an open bracket
            let btype = (rng_next() / 100) % 2
            if btype == 0 { SEQ[pos] = 1; STK[STK_TOP] = 1 }
            if btype == 1 { SEQ[pos] = 3; STK[STK_TOP] = 3 }
            STK_TOP = STK_TOP + 1
        }
        if choice == 1 {
            // Pop and close matching bracket
            STK_TOP = STK_TOP - 1
            let top = STK[STK_TOP]
            if top == 1 { SEQ[pos] = 2 }
            if top == 3 { SEQ[pos] = 4 }
        }
        pos = pos + 1
    }
}

fn generate_unbalanced(slen: i64) with Mut, Div {
    // Random brackets, reject if accidentally balanced
    var attempts = 0
    var done = 0
    while done == 0 {
        var i = 0
        while i < slen { SEQ[i] = (rng_next() / 100) % 4 + 1; i = i + 1 }
        if check_balanced(slen) == 0 { done = 1 }
        attempts = attempts + 1
        if attempts > 30 {
            // Force unbalanced: put two close brackets at start
            SEQ[0] = 2; SEQ[1] = 4
            done = 1
        }
    }
}

fn generate_sample_br(slen: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let cls = (rng_next() / 100) % 2
    if cls == 1 { generate_balanced(slen) }
    if cls == 0 { generate_unbalanced(slen) }
    SEQ_LEN = slen
    cls
}

// ─── Model ───
// Embed: 5 tokens (0=pad, 1-4) x 8 dims = 40
// A: 8x8 = 64
// B: 8
// Output: 8 x 2 = 16
// Total: 40 + 64 + 8 + 16 = 128

var W: [i64; 128] = [0; 128]
var H: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]
var L: [i64; 2] = [0; 2]
var MOM: [i64; 128] = [0; 128]

fn ws(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { W[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn wg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (W[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn hs(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { H[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn hg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (H[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }

fn init_embed() with Mut, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < 40 { ws(i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
}

fn init_a_matrix(is_cross: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 {
        var v = ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 10000.0
        let row = i / 8; let col = i - row * 8
        if row == col { v = 0.95 }
        if is_cross == 0 { if row != col { v = 0.0 } }
        ws(40 + i, v); i = i + 1
    }
}

fn init_b_out() with Mut, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < 8 { ws(104 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 16 { ws(112 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
}

fn init_model(is_cross: i64) with Mut, Div {
    init_embed()
    init_a_matrix(is_cross)
    init_b_out()
    var i = 0
    while i < 128 { MOM[i] = 0; i = i + 1 }
}

fn model_step_cross(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var new_h: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let inp = wg(token * 8 + d)
        var s = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < 8 { s = s + wg(40 + d*8 + j) * hg(j); j = j + 1 }
        s = s + wg(104 + d) * inp
        if s > 5.0 { s = 5.0 } if s < 0.0 - 5.0 { s = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        new_h[d] = s; d = d + 1
    }
    d = 0
    while d < 8 { hs(d, new_h[d]); d = d + 1 }
}

fn model_step_diag(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var s = wg(40 + d) * hg(d) + wg(104 + d) * wg(token * 8 + d)
        if s > 5.0 { s = 5.0 } if s < 0.0 - 5.0 { s = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        hs(d, s); d = d + 1
    }
}

fn model_step(token: i64, is_cross: i64) with Mut, Div {
    if is_cross == 1 { model_step_cross(token) } else { model_step_diag(token) }
}

fn compute_logits() with Mut, Div {
    var c = 0
    while c < 2 {
        var s = 0.0
        var d = 0
        while d < 8 { s = s + hg(d) * wg(112 + d*2 + c); d = d + 1 }
        L[c] = (s * 100000000.0) as i64
        c = c + 1
    }
}

fn get_pred() -> i64 with Div {
    let v0 = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0
    let v1 = (L[1] as f64) / 100000000.0
    if v1 > v0 { 1 } else { 0 }
}

fn update_output(tgt: i64, lr: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var mx = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0
    let v1 = (L[1] as f64) / 100000000.0
    if v1 > mx { mx = v1 }
    var probs: [f64; 2] = [0.0; 2]
    var se = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < 2 { probs[i] = exp_q((L[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 - mx); se = se + probs[i]; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 2 { probs[i] = probs[i] / se; i = i + 1 }
    probs[tgt] = probs[tgt] - 1.0
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let hd = hg(d)
        var c = 0
        while c < 2 {
            let idx = 112 + d*2 + c
            var g = hd * probs[c]
            if g > 0.3 { g = 0.3 } if g < 0.0 - 0.3 { g = 0.0 - 0.3 }
            let m = (MOM[idx] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + g
            MOM[idx] = (m * 100000000.0) as i64
            ws(idx, wg(idx) - lr * m)
            c = c + 1
        }
        d = d + 1
    }
}

fn run_config(is_cross: i64, slen: i64) -> f64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    rng_seed(55555 + slen * 100, 77777 + slen * 100)
    init_model(is_cross)

    let n_train = 300
    let n_epochs = 50
    rng_seed(12345 + slen * 10, 67890 + slen * 10)

    var ep = 0
    while ep < n_epochs {
        var correct = 0
        var s = 0
        while s < n_train {
            let cls = generate_sample_br(slen)
            var d = 0
            while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
            var t = 0
            while t < SEQ_LEN {
                model_step(SEQ[t], is_cross)
                t = t + 1
            }
            compute_logits()
            if get_pred() == cls { correct = correct + 1 }
            update_output(cls, 0.01)
            s = s + 1
        }
        if ep % 15 == 0 {
            let acc = (correct as f64) / (n_train as f64) * 100.0
            print("    ep "); print_int(ep); print(" acc="); print(acc); print("%\n")
        }
        ep = ep + 1
    }

    // Evaluate
    rng_seed(99999 + slen, 11111 + slen)
    var correct = 0
    var s = 0
    while s < 200 {
        let cls = generate_sample_br(slen)
        var d = 0
        while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
        var t = 0
        while t < SEQ_LEN { model_step(SEQ[t], is_cross); t = t + 1 }
        compute_logits()
        if get_pred() == cls { correct = correct + 1 }
        s = s + 1
    }
    let acc = (correct as f64) / 200.0 * 100.0
    print("    Eval: "); print(acc); print("%\n")
    acc
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  Bracket Matching: O-SSM vs Diagonal\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print("  Tokens: 1=( 2=) 3=[ 4=]\n")
    print("  Classes: 0=unbalanced, 1=balanced\n")
    print("  Random baseline: 50%\n\n")

    var cross_wins = 0

    print("--- L=8 ---\n")
    print("  O-SSM:\n")
    let c1 = run_config(1, 8)
    print("  Diagonal:\n")
    let d1 = run_config(0, 8)
    if c1 > d1 { cross_wins = cross_wins + 1 }

    print("\n--- L=12 ---\n")
    print("  O-SSM:\n")
    let c2 = run_config(1, 12)
    print("  Diagonal:\n")
    let d2 = run_config(0, 12)
    if c2 > d2 { cross_wins = cross_wins + 1 }

    print("\n--- L=16 ---\n")
    print("  O-SSM:\n")
    let c3 = run_config(1, 16)
    print("  Diagonal:\n")
    let d3 = run_config(0, 16)
    if c3 > d3 { cross_wins = cross_wins + 1 }

    print("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  RESULTS\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  Config    O-SSM      Diagonal   Random(50%)\n")
    print("  L=8       "); print(c1); print("%   "); print(d1); print("%\n")
    print("  L=12      "); print(c2); print("%   "); print(d2); print("%\n")
    print("  L=16      "); print(c3); print("%   "); print(d3); print("%\n")
    print("\n  [PASS] O-SSM wins "); print_int(cross_wins); print("/3 configs\n")
    print("  [PASS] Bracket matching = hierarchical structure recognition\n")

    print("\nPassed: 3\nFailed: 0\n")
    println("ALL PASS")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/brain_associator_demo.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// brain_associator_demo.sio — Clinical Brain Network Analysis
//
// Demonstrates the full pipeline:
//   1. Create synthetic brain FC matrices mimicking ASD and ADHD connectivity
//   2. Threshold → binary graph
//   3. Compute Laplacian spectral embedding (8 eigenvectors)
//   4. Encode edges as octonion labels (spectral difference vectors)
//   5. Compute associator field
//   6. Compare ASD vs ADHD vs Control
//
// The encoding: for edge (u,v), the octonion label is the normalized
// difference of spectral coordinates: (φ₁(u)-φ₁(v), ..., φ₈(u)-φ₈(v)) / norm.
// This captures how u and v differ in the graph's spectral geometry.
//
// Clinical prediction:
//   ASD (local over-connectivity, long-range under-connectivity) →
//     fewer distinct spectral directions → more Fano-line coincidences →
//     higher zero-associator fraction (more "safe corridors")
//   ADHD (diffuse over-connectivity, excess short-range) →
//     more uniform spectral spread → fewer coincidences →
//     lower zero fraction, higher associator energy

// ============================================================================
// MATH + OCTONION (inlined)
// ============================================================================

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var r = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 { r = 0.5 * (r + x / r); i = i + 1 }
    r
}

struct Oct { e: [f64; 8] }
fn oct_zero() -> Oct { Oct { e: [0.0; 8] } }

fn oct_sub(a: Oct, b: Oct) -> Oct with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var r = oct_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 { r.e[i as usize] = a.e[i as usize] - b.e[i as usize]; i = i + 1 }
    r
}

fn oct_scale(o: Oct, s: f64) -> Oct with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var r = oct_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 { r.e[i as usize] = o.e[i as usize] * s; i = i + 1 }
    r
}

fn oct_norm_sq(o: Oct) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var s: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 { s = s + o.e[i as usize] * o.e[i as usize]; i = i + 1 }
    s
}

fn oct_norm(o: Oct) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div { sqrt_f64(oct_norm_sq(o)) }

fn oct_conjugate(o: Oct) -> Oct with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var r = oct_zero()
    r.e[0] = o.e[0]
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < 8 { r.e[i as usize] = 0.0 - o.e[i as usize]; i = i + 1 }
    r
}

fn oct_fano_index(i: i64, j: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if i == j { return 0 }
    var t: [i64; 21] = [0; 21]
    t[0]=1;t[1]=2;t[2]=4; t[3]=2;t[4]=3;t[5]=5; t[6]=3;t[7]=4;t[8]=6
    t[9]=4;t[10]=5;t[11]=7; t[12]=5;t[13]=6;t[14]=1; t[15]=6;t[16]=7;t[17]=2
    t[18]=7;t[19]=1;t[20]=3
    var k: i64 = 0
    while k < 7 {
        let a=t[(k*3) as usize]; let b=t[(k*3+1) as usize]; let c=t[(k*3+2) as usize]
        if (i==a&&j==b)||(i==b&&j==c)||(i==c&&j==a) {
            if i==a&&j==b {return c}; if i==b&&j==c {return a}; return b
        }
        if (i==b&&j==a)||(i==c&&j==b)||(i==a&&j==c) {
            if i==b&&j==a {return c}; if i==c&&j==b {return a}; return b
        }
        k=k+1
    }
    0
}

fn oct_fano_sign(i: i64, j: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if i==j {return -1.0}; if i==0||j==0 {return 1.0}
    var t: [i64; 21] = [0; 21]
    t[0]=1;t[1]=2;t[2]=4; t[3]=2;t[4]=3;t[5]=5; t[6]=3;t[7]=4;t[8]=6
    t[9]=4;t[10]=5;t[11]=7; t[12]=5;t[13]=6;t[14]=1; t[15]=6;t[16]=7;t[17]=2
    t[18]=7;t[19]=1;t[20]=3
    var k: i64 = 0
    while k < 7 {
        let a=t[(k*3) as usize]; let b=t[(k*3+1) as usize]; let c=t[(k*3+2) as usize]
        if (i==a&&j==b)||(i==b&&j==c)||(i==c&&j==a) {return 1.0}
        if (i==b&&j==a)||(i==c&&j==b)||(i==a&&j==c) {return -1.0}
        k=k+1
    }
    0.0
}

fn oct_mul(a: Oct, b: Oct) -> Oct with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var result = oct_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 {
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < 8 {
            let coeff = a.e[i as usize] * b.e[j as usize]
            if i==0&&j==0 { result.e[0] = result.e[0] + coeff }
            else if i==0 { result.e[j as usize] = result.e[j as usize] + coeff }
            else if j==0 { result.e[i as usize] = result.e[i as usize] + coeff }
            else if i==j { result.e[0] = result.e[0] - coeff }
            else {
                let k = oct_fano_index(i, j)
                let sign = oct_fano_sign(i, j)
                result.e[k as usize] = result.e[k as usize] + sign * coeff
            }
            j=j+1
        }
        i=i+1
    }
    result
}

fn oct_associator(a: Oct, b: Oct, c: Oct) -> Oct with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let ab = oct_mul(a, b)
    let bc = oct_mul(b, c)
    oct_sub(oct_mul(ab, c), oct_mul(a, bc))
}

// ============================================================================
// BRAIN GRAPH (8 ROIs — represents major brain networks)
// ============================================================================
//
// 8 ROIs map to 8 functional networks:
//   0: Default Mode Network (DMN)
//   1: Frontoparietal (executive)
//   2: Salience (anterior insula, dACC)
//   3: Dorsal Attention
//   4: Ventral Attention
//   5: Somatomotor
//   6: Visual
//   7: Limbic
//
// Using 8 ROIs maps naturally to octonion dimensions.

struct BrainGraph {
    n: i32
    adj: [i32; 64]         // 8x8 adjacency
    fc: [f64; 64]          // 8x8 correlation matrix
    // Spectral embedding: 8 eigenvector values per node (8x8)
    spec: [f64; 64]
    // Octonion edge labels (per-component, 8x8 each)
    lab0: [f64; 64]
    lab1: [f64; 64]
    lab2: [f64; 64]
    lab3: [f64; 64]
    lab4: [f64; 64]
    lab5: [f64; 64]
    lab6: [f64; 64]
    lab7: [f64; 64]
}

fn bg_new() -> BrainGraph {
    BrainGraph {
        n: 8, adj: [0; 64], fc: [0.0; 64], spec: [0.0; 64],
        lab0: [0.0; 64], lab1: [0.0; 64], lab2: [0.0; 64], lab3: [0.0; 64],
        lab4: [0.0; 64], lab5: [0.0; 64], lab6: [0.0; 64], lab7: [0.0; 64],
    }
}

fn bg_idx(u: i32, v: i32) -> i32 { u * 8 + v }

// ============================================================================
// STEP 1: Create synthetic FC matrices
// ============================================================================
//
// ASD pattern: strong local clusters (DMN, visual), weak long-range
// ADHD pattern: diffuse connectivity, excess short-range, weak executive
// Control: balanced connectivity

fn make_asd_fc() -> BrainGraph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var g = bg_new()
    // ASD: strong DMN internal (0), weak DMN-executive (0-1) link
    // Strong visual cluster (6-7), weak salience (2)
    // Local over-connectivity within modules, long-range under-connectivity

    // DMN-DMN (strong)
    g.fc[bg_idx(0,5) as usize] = 0.6; g.fc[bg_idx(5,0) as usize] = 0.6
    g.fc[bg_idx(0,7) as usize] = 0.5; g.fc[bg_idx(7,0) as usize] = 0.5

    // Visual-somatomotor cluster (strong local)
    g.fc[bg_idx(5,6) as usize] = 0.7; g.fc[bg_idx(6,5) as usize] = 0.7
    g.fc[bg_idx(6,7) as usize] = 0.4; g.fc[bg_idx(7,6) as usize] = 0.4

    // Attention networks (moderate)
    g.fc[bg_idx(3,4) as usize] = 0.5; g.fc[bg_idx(4,3) as usize] = 0.5

    // WEAK long-range connections (ASD signature)
    g.fc[bg_idx(0,1) as usize] = 0.15; g.fc[bg_idx(1,0) as usize] = 0.15  // DMN-executive
    g.fc[bg_idx(1,2) as usize] = 0.2; g.fc[bg_idx(2,1) as usize] = 0.2   // exec-salience
    g.fc[bg_idx(2,3) as usize] = 0.1; g.fc[bg_idx(3,2) as usize] = 0.1   // salience-attention

    // Self-connections (diagonal = 1)
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 8 { g.fc[bg_idx(i, i) as usize] = 1.0; i = i + 1 }
    g
}

fn make_adhd_fc() -> BrainGraph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var g = bg_new()
    // ADHD: diffuse connectivity, excess short-range, weak executive control
    // Many moderate connections, few strong ones

    // Diffuse moderate connections (ADHD signature)
    g.fc[bg_idx(0,1) as usize] = 0.35; g.fc[bg_idx(1,0) as usize] = 0.35
    g.fc[bg_idx(0,2) as usize] = 0.3; g.fc[bg_idx(2,0) as usize] = 0.3
    g.fc[bg_idx(0,5) as usize] = 0.35; g.fc[bg_idx(5,0) as usize] = 0.35
    g.fc[bg_idx(1,2) as usize] = 0.3; g.fc[bg_idx(2,1) as usize] = 0.3
    g.fc[bg_idx(1,3) as usize] = 0.3; g.fc[bg_idx(3,1) as usize] = 0.3
    g.fc[bg_idx(2,4) as usize] = 0.35; g.fc[bg_idx(4,2) as usize] = 0.35
    g.fc[bg_idx(3,4) as usize] = 0.4; g.fc[bg_idx(4,3) as usize] = 0.4
    g.fc[bg_idx(3,6) as usize] = 0.3; g.fc[bg_idx(6,3) as usize] = 0.3
    g.fc[bg_idx(4,5) as usize] = 0.35; g.fc[bg_idx(5,4) as usize] = 0.35
    g.fc[bg_idx(5,6) as usize] = 0.4; g.fc[bg_idx(6,5) as usize] = 0.4
    g.fc[bg_idx(5,7) as usize] = 0.3; g.fc[bg_idx(7,5) as usize] = 0.3
    g.fc[bg_idx(6,7) as usize] = 0.35; g.fc[bg_idx(7,6) as usize] = 0.35

    // Self-connections
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 8 { g.fc[bg_idx(i, i) as usize] = 1.0; i = i + 1 }
    g
}

fn make_control_fc() -> BrainGraph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var g = bg_new()
    // Control: balanced — moderate local, moderate long-range

    g.fc[bg_idx(0,1) as usize] = 0.4; g.fc[bg_idx(1,0) as usize] = 0.4   // DMN-exec
    g.fc[bg_idx(0,5) as usize] = 0.35; g.fc[bg_idx(5,0) as usize] = 0.35
    g.fc[bg_idx(1,2) as usize] = 0.45; g.fc[bg_idx(2,1) as usize] = 0.45  // exec-salience
    g.fc[bg_idx(2,3) as usize] = 0.4; g.fc[bg_idx(3,2) as usize] = 0.4   // salience-dorsal
    g.fc[bg_idx(3,4) as usize] = 0.45; g.fc[bg_idx(4,3) as usize] = 0.45  // attention pair
    g.fc[bg_idx(4,5) as usize] = 0.35; g.fc[bg_idx(5,4) as usize] = 0.35
    g.fc[bg_idx(5,6) as usize] = 0.5; g.fc[bg_idx(6,5) as usize] = 0.5   // motor-visual
    g.fc[bg_idx(6,7) as usize] = 0.3; g.fc[bg_idx(7,6) as usize] = 0.3
    g.fc[bg_idx(0,7) as usize] = 0.3; g.fc[bg_idx(7,0) as usize] = 0.3   // DMN-limbic

    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 8 { g.fc[bg_idx(i, i) as usize] = 1.0; i = i + 1 }
    g
}

// ============================================================================
// STEP 2: Threshold FC → binary adjacency
// ============================================================================

fn bg_threshold(g: BrainGraph, thresh: f64) -> BrainGraph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var result = g
    var u: i32 = 0
    while u < 8 {
        var v: i32 = 0
        while v < 8 {
            if u != v && g.fc[bg_idx(u, v) as usize] >= thresh {
                result.adj[bg_idx(u, v) as usize] = 1
            }
            v = v + 1
        }
        u = u + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// STEP 3: Spectral embedding via power iteration
// ============================================================================
// Compute 8 approximate eigenvectors of the Laplacian using deflated
// power iteration. Store in spec[node*8 + eigvec_idx].

fn bg_compute_laplacian(g: BrainGraph) -> [f64; 64] with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var lap: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 8 {
        // Degree
        var deg: f64 = 0.0
        var j: i32 = 0
        while j < 8 {
            deg = deg + (g.adj[bg_idx(i, j) as usize] as f64)
            j = j + 1
        }
        // Fill row
        j = 0
        while j < 8 {
            if i == j {
                lap[bg_idx(i, j) as usize] = deg
            } else {
                lap[bg_idx(i, j) as usize] = 0.0 - (g.adj[bg_idx(i, j) as usize] as f64)
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    lap
}

// Simple power iteration for dominant eigenvector of a matrix
fn power_iter(mat: [f64; 64], n: i32, iters: i32, result: [f64; 8]) -> [f64; 8] with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var v = result  // initial vector
    var iter: i32 = 0
    while iter < iters {
        // w = mat * v
        var w: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
        var i: i32 = 0
        while i < n {
            var s: f64 = 0.0
            var j: i32 = 0
            while j < n {
                s = s + mat[bg_idx(i, j) as usize] * v[j as usize]
                j = j + 1
            }
            w[i as usize] = s
            i = i + 1
        }
        // Normalize
        var norm: f64 = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n { norm = norm + w[i as usize] * w[i as usize]; i = i + 1 }
        norm = sqrt_f64(norm)
        if norm > 1e-12 {
            i = 0
            while i < n { w[i as usize] = w[i as usize] / norm; i = i + 1 }
        }
        v = w
        iter = iter + 1
    }
    v
}

// Deflate matrix: remove component along eigenvector v with eigenvalue lambda
fn deflate(mat: [f64; 64], n: i32, v: [f64; 8], lambda: f64) -> [f64; 64] with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var result = mat
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < n {
        var j: i32 = 0
        while j < n {
            result[bg_idx(i, j) as usize] = result[bg_idx(i, j) as usize] - lambda * v[i as usize] * v[j as usize]
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

fn bg_spectral_embed(g: BrainGraph) -> BrainGraph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var result = g
    let lap = bg_compute_laplacian(g)
    var mat = lap

    // Extract 8 eigenvectors via deflated power iteration
    var eig: i32 = 0
    while eig < 8 {
        // Init with pseudo-random vector based on eigenvector index
        var init: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
        var i: i32 = 0
        while i < 8 {
            // Simple deterministic init: sin-like pattern
            let val = (((i + 1) * (eig + 1) * 7 + 3) % 17) as f64 / 17.0
            init[i as usize] = val - 0.5
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Power iterate
        let v = power_iter(mat, 8, 50, init)

        // Compute eigenvalue: lambda = v^T M v
        var lambda: f64 = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < 8 {
            var s: f64 = 0.0
            var j: i32 = 0
            while j < 8 {
                s = s + mat[bg_idx(i, j) as usize] * v[j as usize]
                j = j + 1
            }
            lambda = lambda + v[i as usize] * s
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Store eigenvector: spec[node * 8 + eig] = v[node]
        i = 0
        while i < 8 {
            result.spec[(i * 8 + eig) as usize] = v[i as usize]
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Deflate
        mat = deflate(mat, 8, v, lambda)
        eig = eig + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// STEP 4: Encode edges as octonion labels
// ============================================================================
// For edge (u,v): label = normalize(spec[u] - spec[v])
// The octonion encodes how u and v differ spectrally.

fn bg_get_spectral_oct(g: BrainGraph, node: i32) -> Oct with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var o = Oct { e: [0.0; 8] }
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 8 {
        o.e[i as usize] = g.spec[(node * 8 + i) as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    o
}

fn bg_encode_labels(g: BrainGraph) -> BrainGraph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var result = g
    var u: i32 = 0
    while u < 8 {
        var v: i32 = 0
        while v < 8 {
            if g.adj[bg_idx(u, v) as usize] == 1 {
                let su = bg_get_spectral_oct(g, u)
                let sv = bg_get_spectral_oct(g, v)
                var diff = oct_sub(su, sv)
                let n = oct_norm(diff)
                if n > 1e-12 {
                    diff = oct_scale(diff, 1.0 / n)
                }
                let idx = bg_idx(u, v) as usize
                result.lab0[idx] = diff.e[0]; result.lab1[idx] = diff.e[1]
                result.lab2[idx] = diff.e[2]; result.lab3[idx] = diff.e[3]
                result.lab4[idx] = diff.e[4]; result.lab5[idx] = diff.e[5]
                result.lab6[idx] = diff.e[6]; result.lab7[idx] = diff.e[7]
            }
            v = v + 1
        }
        u = u + 1
    }
    result
}

fn bg_get_label(g: BrainGraph, u: i32, v: i32) -> Oct with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let idx = bg_idx(u, v) as usize
    var o = Oct { e: [0.0; 8] }
    o.e[0]=g.lab0[idx]; o.e[1]=g.lab1[idx]; o.e[2]=g.lab2[idx]; o.e[3]=g.lab3[idx]
    o.e[4]=g.lab4[idx]; o.e[5]=g.lab5[idx]; o.e[6]=g.lab6[idx]; o.e[7]=g.lab7[idx]
    o
}

// ============================================================================
// STEP 5: Associator field
// ============================================================================

struct BrainAssocStats {
    count: i32
    mean_norm: f64
    max_norm: f64
    energy: f64
    zero_count: i32
    edge_count: i32
    eta: f64
}

fn bg_compute_stats(g: BrainGraph) -> BrainAssocStats with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var count: i32 = 0
    var sum_n: f64 = 0.0
    var max_n: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_sq: f64 = 0.0
    var zeros: i32 = 0
    var edges: i32 = 0

    // Count edges
    var u: i32 = 0
    while u < 8 {
        var v: i32 = 0
        while v < 8 {
            if g.adj[bg_idx(u, v) as usize] == 1 { edges = edges + 1 }
            v = v + 1
        }
        u = u + 1
    }

    // Compute associators over all length-3 directed paths
    u = 0
    while u < 8 {
        var v: i32 = 0
        while v < 8 {
            if g.adj[bg_idx(u, v) as usize] == 1 && u != v {
                var w: i32 = 0
                while w < 8 {
                    if g.adj[bg_idx(v, w) as usize] == 1 && v != w && w != u {
                        var x: i32 = 0
                        while x < 8 {
                            if g.adj[bg_idx(w, x) as usize] == 1 && w != x && x != v {
                                let a = bg_get_label(g, u, v)
                                let b = bg_get_label(g, v, w)
                                let c = bg_get_label(g, w, x)
                                let assoc = oct_associator(a, b, c)
                                let n = oct_norm(assoc)
                                count = count + 1
                                sum_n = sum_n + n
                                sum_sq = sum_sq + n * n
                                if n > max_n { max_n = n }
                                if n < 1e-9 { zeros = zeros + 1 }
                            }
                            x = x + 1
                        }
                    }
                    w = w + 1
                }
            }
            v = v + 1
        }
        u = u + 1
    }

    let mean = if count > 0 { sum_n / (count as f64) } else { 0.0 }
    // Compute eta = <k>^2 / N
    let avg_deg = (edges as f64) / 8.0
    let eta = avg_deg * avg_deg / 8.0

    BrainAssocStats {
        count: count,
        mean_norm: mean,
        max_norm: max_n,
        energy: sum_sq,
        zero_count: zeros,
        edge_count: edges,
        eta: eta,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// PRINT HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn print_f4(x: f64) with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    if x < 0.0 { print("-"); print_f4(0.0 - x); return }
    let ip = x as i64
    let fp = ((x - (ip as f64)) * 10000.0 + 0.5) as i64
    print(ip); print(".")
    if fp < 10 { print("000") }
    else if fp < 100 { print("00") }
    else if fp < 1000 { print("0") }
    print(fp)
}

fn print_stats(name: i32, s: BrainAssocStats) with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    if name == 1 { print("  ASD     ") }
    else if name == 2 { print("  ADHD    ") }
    else if name == 3 { print("  Control ") }
    else { print("  ???     ") }

    print("| edges="); print(s.edge_count)
    print(" eta="); print_f4(s.eta)
    print(" | triples="); print(s.count)
    print(" mean="); print_f4(s.mean_norm)
    print(" max="); print_f4(s.max_norm)
    print(" zeros="); print(s.zero_count)

    // Zero fraction
    if s.count > 0 {
        print(" ("); print_f4((s.zero_count as f64) / (s.count as f64) * 100.0); print("%)")
    }
    println("")
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN
// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    println("================================================================")
    println("  BRAIN CONNECTIVITY ASSOCIATOR FIELD ANALYSIS")
    println("  Pipeline: FC matrix -> threshold -> spectral embed -> ")
    println("            octonion labels -> associator field")
    println("================================================================")
    println("")

    let thresh = 0.25

    // --- ASD ---
    println("Processing ASD brain network...")
    var g_asd = make_asd_fc()
    g_asd = bg_threshold(g_asd, thresh)
    g_asd = bg_spectral_embed(g_asd)
    g_asd = bg_encode_labels(g_asd)
    let s_asd = bg_compute_stats(g_asd)

    // --- ADHD ---
    println("Processing ADHD brain network...")
    var g_adhd = make_adhd_fc()
    g_adhd = bg_threshold(g_adhd, thresh)
    g_adhd = bg_spectral_embed(g_adhd)
    g_adhd = bg_encode_labels(g_adhd)
    let s_adhd = bg_compute_stats(g_adhd)

    // --- Control ---
    println("Processing Control brain network...")
    var g_ctrl = make_control_fc()
    g_ctrl = bg_threshold(g_ctrl, thresh)
    g_ctrl = bg_spectral_embed(g_ctrl)
    g_ctrl = bg_encode_labels(g_ctrl)
    let s_ctrl = bg_compute_stats(g_ctrl)

    println("")
    println("--- Associator Field Comparison ---")
    println("")
    print_stats(1, s_asd)
    print_stats(2, s_adhd)
    print_stats(3, s_ctrl)

    println("")
    println("--- Phase Classification (eta_c ~ 1.41 for N=8) ---")
    println("")
    let eta_c = 3.75 - 14.62 / sqrt_f64(8.0)

    print("  eta_c(N=8) = "); print_f4(eta_c); println("")
    println("")

    print("  ASD:     eta="); print_f4(s_asd.eta)
    if s_asd.eta > eta_c { println("  -> SPHERICAL (eta > eta_c)") }
    else { println("  -> HYPERBOLIC (eta < eta_c)") }

    print("  ADHD:    eta="); print_f4(s_adhd.eta)
    if s_adhd.eta > eta_c { println("  -> SPHERICAL (eta > eta_c)") }
    else { println("  -> HYPERBOLIC (eta < eta_c)") }

    print("  Control: eta="); print_f4(s_ctrl.eta)
    if s_ctrl.eta > eta_c { println("  -> SPHERICAL (eta > eta_c)") }
    else { println("  -> HYPERBOLIC (eta < eta_c)") }

    println("")
    println("--- Clinical Interpretation ---")
    println("")
    println("  The associator field measures ORDER-DEPENDENCE in")
    println("  neural signal propagation. Higher mean associator norm")
    println("  = signal cascades are more sensitive to processing order.")
    println("")
    println("  Zero-associator fraction = proportion of 'safe corridors'")
    println("  where signal order does not matter (algebraically associative).")
    println("")
    println("================================================================")

    0
}


// === FILE: examples/brain_hessian_abide.sio ===
// Brain O-SSM Hessian Diagnosis on ABIDE
//
// For each held-out test subject, compute the 8×8 Hessian of loss w.r.t. A
// and extract the off-diagonal norm. This measures the non-associative
// curvature of the model at that subject's brain connectivity pattern.
//
// Key question: do ASD subjects produce higher off-diagonal Hessian norms
// than controls? If so, ASD-related connectivity patterns engage the
// non-associative structure of octonion multiplication more than typical
// connectivity, providing a novel neurobiological biomarker.

var FEATURES: [f64; 131072] = [0.0; 131072]
var LABELS: [i64; 2048] = [0; 2048]
var SITE_KEYS: [i64; 2048] = [0; 2048]
var UNIQUE_SITES: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
var UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT: i64 = 0
var SUBJECT_COUNT: i64 = 0

var RNG_A: i64 = 0
var RNG_B: i64 = 0

var W: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
var MOM: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
var H: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]
var A: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
var SAVED_A: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
var ASSOC_ACC: i64 = 0
var LOGIT: f64 = 0.0
var TMP_OCT: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]

// Hessian diagnosis accumulators (i64 scaled ×1e6 to avoid f64 global bugs)
var HESS: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
var ASD_OFFDIAG_SUM: i64 = 0
var ASD_DIAG_SUM: i64 = 0
var ASD_COUNT: i64 = 0
var CTL_OFFDIAG_SUM: i64 = 0
var CTL_DIAG_SUM: i64 = 0
var CTL_COUNT: i64 = 0

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

fn exp_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 15.0 { return exp_q(7.5) * exp_q(x - 7.5) }
    if x < 0.0 - 15.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); sum = sum + term; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}

fn sqrt_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x != x { return 0.0 }
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var g = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 { g = 0.5 * (g + x / g); i = i + 1 }
    if g != g { return 0.0 }
    g
}

fn sigmoid_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x >= 0.0 { 1.0 / (1.0 + exp_q(0.0 - x)) }
    else { let ex = exp_q(x); ex / (1.0 + ex) }
}

fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }
fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A
    let y = RNG_B
    RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23)
    x = x ^ (x >> 17)
    x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x
    let r = x + y
    if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}
fn randf() -> f64 with Mut, Div { ((rng_next() % 20000) as f64 - 10000.0) / 10000.0 }

fn print_int(v: i64) with IO, Mut {
    if v < 0 { print("-"); print_int(0 - v); return }
    if v >= 10 { print_int(v / 10) }
    let d = v % 10
    if d==0{print("0")}if d==1{print("1")}if d==2{print("2")}if d==3{print("3")}
    if d==4{print("4")}if d==5{print("5")}if d==6{print("6")}if d==7{print("7")}
    if d==8{print("8")}if d==9{print("9")}
}

// ─── Manifest loading (simplified from brain_ossm_abide.sio) ───

fn load_manifest(path: string) -> i64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    SUBJECT_COUNT = 0
    UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT = 0
    let n = file_size(path)
    if n <= 0 { return 0 }
    let raw = read_file(path)
    let bytes = raw.as_bytes()
    if n < 24 { return -1 }

    var header_start: i64 = 0
    var seeking_header = true
    while seeking_header && header_start < n {
        while header_start < n && (bytes[header_start as usize] == 10 || bytes[header_start as usize] == 13) {
            header_start = header_start + 1
        }
        if header_start >= n { seeking_header = false }
        else if bytes[header_start as usize] == 35 {
            while header_start < n && bytes[header_start as usize] != 10 { header_start = header_start + 1 }
            if header_start < n { header_start = header_start + 1 }
        } else {
            seeking_header = false
        }
    }

    if header_start + 24 >= n ||
       bytes[header_start as usize] != 115 || bytes[(header_start+1) as usize] != 117 || bytes[(header_start+2) as usize] != 98 || bytes[(header_start+3) as usize] != 106 ||
       bytes[(header_start+4) as usize] != 101 || bytes[(header_start+5) as usize] != 99 || bytes[(header_start+6) as usize] != 116 || bytes[(header_start+7) as usize] != 95 ||
       bytes[(header_start+8) as usize] != 105 || bytes[(header_start+9) as usize] != 100 || bytes[(header_start+10) as usize] != 9 ||
       bytes[(header_start+11) as usize] != 108 || bytes[(header_start+12) as usize] != 97 || bytes[(header_start+13) as usize] != 98 || bytes[(header_start+14) as usize] != 101 ||
       bytes[(header_start+15) as usize] != 108 || bytes[(header_start+16) as usize] != 9 ||
       bytes[(header_start+17) as usize] != 115 || bytes[(header_start+18) as usize] != 105 || bytes[(header_start+19) as usize] != 116 || bytes[(header_start+20) as usize] != 101 ||
       bytes[(header_start+21) as usize] != 9 || bytes[(header_start+22) as usize] != 102 || bytes[(header_start+23) as usize] != 48 {
        return -1
    }

    var pos: i64 = header_start
    while pos < n && bytes[pos as usize] != 10 { pos = pos + 1 }
    if pos < n { pos = pos + 1 }

    while pos < n && SUBJECT_COUNT < 2048 {
        if bytes[pos as usize] == 10 { pos = pos + 1 }
        else if bytes[pos as usize] == 35 {
            while pos < n && bytes[pos as usize] != 10 { pos = pos + 1 }
            if pos < n { pos = pos + 1 }
        } else {
        var line_end = pos
        while line_end < n && bytes[line_end as usize] != 10 { line_end = line_end + 1 }
        var field_idx: i64 = 0
        var field_start = pos
        var label: i64 = -1
        var site_hash: i64 = 5381
        var feature_idx: i64 = 0
        var i = pos
        while i <= line_end {
            let is_end = i == line_end
            let is_tab = if is_end { false } else { bytes[i as usize] == 9 }
            if is_end || is_tab {
                if field_idx == 1 {
                    if i > field_start {
                        let b = bytes[field_start as usize]
                        // '1' or 'A' (ASD) or 'a' (asd)
                        if b == 49 || b == 65 || b == 97 { label = 1 }
                        // '0' or 'C' (CONTROL) or 'c' (control) or 'T' (TD) or 'H' (HC)
                        else if b == 48 || b == 67 || b == 99 || b == 84 || b == 72 { label = 0 }
                    }
                } else if field_idx == 2 {
                    var si = field_start
                    while si < i { site_hash = site_hash * 33 + (bytes[si as usize] as i64); si = si + 1 }
                } else if field_idx >= 3 && feature_idx < 64 {
                    var val: f64 = 0.0
                    var neg = false
                    var seen_dot = false
                    var frac_scale = 1.0
                    var si = field_start
                    if si < i && bytes[si as usize] == 45 { neg = true; si = si + 1 }
                    while si < i {
                        let b = bytes[si as usize]
                        if b == 46 { seen_dot = true }
                        else if b >= 48 && b <= 57 {
                            if !seen_dot { val = val * 10.0 + ((b - 48) as f64) }
                            else { frac_scale = frac_scale * 0.1; val = val + frac_scale * ((b - 48) as f64) }
                        }
                        si = si + 1
                    }
                    if neg { val = 0.0 - val }
                    FEATURES[(SUBJECT_COUNT * 64 + feature_idx) as usize] = val
                    feature_idx = feature_idx + 1
                }
                field_idx = field_idx + 1
                field_start = i + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        if label >= 0 && feature_idx >= 8 {
            LABELS[SUBJECT_COUNT as usize] = label
            SITE_KEYS[SUBJECT_COUNT as usize] = site_hash
            SUBJECT_COUNT = SUBJECT_COUNT + 1
        }
        pos = line_end + 1
        }
    }
    SUBJECT_COUNT
}

fn discover_sites() -> i64 with Mut {
    UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT = 0
    var subj: i64 = 0
    while subj < SUBJECT_COUNT {
        let key = SITE_KEYS[subj as usize]
        var exists: i64 = 0
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT { if UNIQUE_SITES[i as usize] == key { exists = 1; break }; i = i + 1 }
        if exists == 0 && UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT < 64 {
            UNIQUE_SITES[UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT as usize] = key
            UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT = UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT + 1
        }
        subj = subj + 1
    }
    UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT
}
