// ─── Model ───

fn ws(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { W[i as usize] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn wg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (W[i as usize] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn hs(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { H[i as usize] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn hg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (H[i as usize] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn assoc_s(v: f64) with Mut { ASSOC_ACC = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn assoc_g() -> f64 with Div { (ASSOC_ACC as f64) / 100000000.0 }

fn init_model() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 10 { ws(i, randf() / 6.0); MOM[i as usize] = 0; i = i + 1 }
    var nsq = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { A[i as usize] = randf(); nsq = nsq + A[i as usize] * A[i as usize]; i = i + 1 }
    let n = sqrt_q(nsq)
    i = 0
    while i < 8 {
        if n > 0.000000001 { A[i as usize] = A[i as usize] / n }
        else if i == 0 { A[i as usize] = 1.0 } else { A[i as usize] = 0.0 }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn reset_state() with Mut {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 { H[i as usize] = 0; i = i + 1 }
    hs(0, 1.0)
    ASSOC_ACC = 0
    LOGIT = 0.0
}

fn do_oct_mul(
    a0: f64, a1: f64, a2: f64, a3: f64, a4: f64, a5: f64, a6: f64, a7: f64,
    b0: f64, b1: f64, b2: f64, b3: f64, b4: f64, b5: f64, b6: f64, b7: f64
) with Mut {
    TMP_OCT[0] = a0*b0 - a1*b1 - a2*b2 - a3*b3 - a4*b4 - a5*b5 - a6*b6 - a7*b7
    TMP_OCT[1] = a0*b1 + a1*b0 + a2*b3 - a3*b2 + a4*b5 - a5*b4 - a6*b7 + a7*b6
    TMP_OCT[2] = a0*b2 + a2*b0 - a1*b3 + a3*b1 + a4*b6 - a6*b4 + a5*b7 - a7*b5
    TMP_OCT[3] = a0*b3 + a3*b0 + a1*b2 - a2*b1 + a4*b7 - a7*b4 - a5*b6 + a6*b5
    TMP_OCT[4] = a0*b4 + a4*b0 - a1*b5 + a5*b1 - a2*b6 + a6*b2 - a3*b7 + a7*b3
    TMP_OCT[5] = a0*b5 + a5*b0 + a1*b4 - a4*b1 - a2*b7 + a7*b2 + a3*b6 - a6*b3
    TMP_OCT[6] = a0*b6 + a6*b0 + a1*b7 - a7*b1 + a2*b4 - a4*b2 - a3*b5 + a5*b3
    TMP_OCT[7] = a0*b7 + a7*b0 - a1*b6 + a6*b1 - a2*b5 + a5*b2 + a3*b4 - a4*b3
}

fn oct_step(x0: f64, x1: f64, x2: f64, x3: f64, x4: f64, x5: f64, x6: f64, x7: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    do_oct_mul(A[0],A[1],A[2],A[3],A[4],A[5],A[6],A[7], hg(0),hg(1),hg(2),hg(3),hg(4),hg(5),hg(6),hg(7))
    let t0=TMP_OCT[0]; let t1=TMP_OCT[1]; let t2=TMP_OCT[2]; let t3=TMP_OCT[3]
    let t4=TMP_OCT[4]; let t5=TMP_OCT[5]; let t6=TMP_OCT[6]; let t7=TMP_OCT[7]
    do_oct_mul(t0,t1,t2,t3,t4,t5,t6,t7, x0,x1,x2,x3,x4,x5,x6,x7)
    var left: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    var d: i64 = 0
    while d < 8 { left[d as usize] = TMP_OCT[d as usize]; d = d + 1 }
    do_oct_mul(hg(0),hg(1),hg(2),hg(3),hg(4),hg(5),hg(6),hg(7), x0,x1,x2,x3,x4,x5,x6,x7)
    let hx0=TMP_OCT[0]; let hx1=TMP_OCT[1]; let hx2=TMP_OCT[2]; let hx3=TMP_OCT[3]
    let hx4=TMP_OCT[4]; let hx5=TMP_OCT[5]; let hx6=TMP_OCT[6]; let hx7=TMP_OCT[7]
    do_oct_mul(A[0],A[1],A[2],A[3],A[4],A[5],A[6],A[7], hx0,hx1,hx2,hx3,hx4,hx5,hx6,hx7)
    var asq = 0.0
    d = 0
    while d < 8 { let diff = left[d as usize] - TMP_OCT[d as usize]; asq = asq + diff*diff; d = d + 1 }
    var assoc_step = sqrt_q(asq)
    if assoc_step != assoc_step { assoc_step = 0.0 }
    if assoc_step > 1000.0 { assoc_step = 1000.0 }
    assoc_s(assoc_g() + assoc_step)
    d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var v = left[d as usize] + 0.2 * TMP_OCT[d as usize]
        if v != v { v = 0.0 }
        if v > 5.0 { v = 5.0 } if v < 0.0 - 5.0 { v = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        hs(d, v)
        d = d + 1
    }
}

fn forward_subject(subj: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    reset_state()
    let base = subj * 64
    var step: i64 = 0
    while step < 8 {
        let off = base + step * 8
        oct_step(
            FEATURES[off as usize], FEATURES[(off+1) as usize],
            FEATURES[(off+2) as usize], FEATURES[(off+3) as usize],
            FEATURES[(off+4) as usize], FEATURES[(off+5) as usize],
            FEATURES[(off+6) as usize], FEATURES[(off+7) as usize]
        )
        step = step + 1
    }
    var assoc_feature = assoc_g() / 8.0
    if assoc_feature != assoc_feature { assoc_feature = 0.0 }
    assoc_s(assoc_feature)
    var s = wg(9)
    var d: i64 = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var proj = hg(d) * wg(d)
        if proj != proj { proj = 0.0 }
        s = s + proj
        d = d + 1
    }
    var assoc_proj = assoc_feature * wg(8)
    if assoc_proj != assoc_proj { assoc_proj = 0.0 }
    LOGIT = s + assoc_proj
}

fn update_binary(target: i64, lr: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let prob = sigmoid_q(LOGIT)
    var grad = prob - (target as f64)
    if grad > 0.5 { grad = 0.5 } if grad < 0.0 - 0.5 { grad = 0.0 - 0.5 }
    var d: i64 = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let g = hg(d) * grad
        let m = (MOM[d as usize] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + g
        MOM[d as usize] = (m * 100000000.0) as i64
        ws(d, wg(d) - lr * m)
        d = d + 1
    }
    let ag = assoc_g() * grad
    let am = (MOM[8] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + ag
    MOM[8] = (am * 100000000.0) as i64
    ws(8, wg(8) - lr * am)
    let bg = grad
    let bm = (MOM[9] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + bg
    MOM[9] = (bm * 100000000.0) as i64
    ws(9, wg(9) - lr * bm)
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HESSIAN DIAGNOSIS per subject
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// For a given subject, compute d²L/dA_i dA_j where L = -log(sigmoid(logit))
// by perturbing A_i and A_j and re-running forward_subject.

fn compute_loss_subj(subj: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    forward_subject(subj)
    let prob = sigmoid_q(LOGIT)
    let target = LABELS[subj as usize] as f64
    // Binary cross-entropy (simplified: just use neg prob of correct class)
    0.0 - (target * prob + (1.0 - target) * (1.0 - prob))
}

fn compute_subject_hessian(subj: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let eps = 0.001
    let eps2 = eps * eps
    let f0 = compute_loss_subj(subj)

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 {
        let orig_i = A[i as usize]
        // Diagonal
        A[i as usize] = orig_i + eps
        let fip = compute_loss_subj(subj)
        A[i as usize] = orig_i - eps
        let fim = compute_loss_subj(subj)
        A[i as usize] = orig_i
        HESS[i * 8 + i] = ((fip - 2.0 * f0 + fim) / eps2 * 1000000.0) as i64

        // Off-diagonal (upper triangle, then symmetrize)
        var j = i + 1
        while j < 8 {
            let orig_j = A[j as usize]
            A[i as usize] = orig_i + eps
            A[j as usize] = orig_j + eps
            let fpp = compute_loss_subj(subj)
            A[j as usize] = orig_j - eps
            let fpm = compute_loss_subj(subj)
            A[i as usize] = orig_i - eps
            let fmm = compute_loss_subj(subj)
            A[j as usize] = orig_j + eps
            let fmp = compute_loss_subj(subj)
            A[i as usize] = orig_i
            A[j as usize] = orig_j
            let hij = ((fpp - fpm - fmp + fmm) / (4.0 * eps2) * 1000000.0) as i64
            HESS[i * 8 + j] = hij
            HESS[j * 8 + i] = hij
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn subject_offdiag_norm() -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var s: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 {
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < 8 {
            if i != j {
                let v = HESS[i * 8 + j]
                if v < 0 { s = s + (0 - v) } else { s = s + v }
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    s
}

fn subject_diag_norm() -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var s: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 {
        let v = HESS[i * 8 + i]
        if v < 0 { s = s + (0 - v) } else { s = s + v }
        i = i + 1
    }
    s
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Main: train per fold, then measure Hessian on test subjects
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var loaded = load_manifest("abide_roi_manifest.tsv")
    if loaded <= 0 {
        loaded = load_manifest("/workspace/sounio/artifacts/research/brain_ossm_full_cohort/abide_roi_manifest.tsv")
    }
    if loaded <= 0 {
        println("No manifest found")
        return 1
    }
    discover_sites()

    var asd_n: i64 = 0
    var ctrl_n: i64 = 0
    var subj: i64 = 0
    while subj < SUBJECT_COUNT {
        if LABELS[subj as usize] == 1 { asd_n = asd_n + 1 } else { ctrl_n = ctrl_n + 1 }
        subj = subj + 1
    }

    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════")
    println("  Brain O-SSM: Hessian Non-Associativity Diagnosis")
    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════")
    print("  Subjects: "); print_int(SUBJECT_COUNT)
    print(" (ASD="); print_int(asd_n); print(" CTL="); print_int(ctrl_n); print(")\n")
    print("  Sites: "); print_int(UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT); print("\n")
    println("  Method: train O-SSM per fold, compute 8x8 Hessian per test subject")
    println("  Metric: ||H_offdiag|| = sum |d²L/dA_i dA_j| for i≠j")
    println("")

    ASD_OFFDIAG_SUM = 0
    ASD_DIAG_SUM = 0
    ASD_COUNT = 0
    CTL_OFFDIAG_SUM = 0
    CTL_DIAG_SUM = 0
    CTL_COUNT = 0

    // 3 seeds for stability
    var seeds_a: [i64; 3] = [55555, 11111, 99887]
    var seeds_b: [i64; 3] = [77777, 33333, 44556]

    var seed_i: i64 = 0
    while seed_i < 3 {
        let s1 = seeds_a[seed_i as usize]
        let s2 = seeds_b[seed_i as usize]
        print("  Seed "); print_int(seed_i); print("/3: s1="); print_int(s1); print("\n")

        var site_i: i64 = 0
        while site_i < UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT {
            let holdout_key = UNIQUE_SITES[site_i as usize]

            // Train on non-holdout subjects
            rng_seed(s1 + holdout_key, s2 + holdout_key * 17)
            init_model()
            var ep: i64 = 0
            while ep < 60 {
                var seen: i64 = 0
                var train_count: i64 = 0
                subj = 0
                while subj < SUBJECT_COUNT {
                    if SITE_KEYS[subj as usize] != holdout_key { train_count = train_count + 1 }
                    subj = subj + 1
                }
                while seen < train_count {
                    subj = (rng_next() / 100) % SUBJECT_COUNT
                    if SITE_KEYS[subj as usize] != holdout_key {
                        forward_subject(subj)
                        update_binary(LABELS[subj as usize], 0.03)
                    }
                    seen = seen + 1
                }
                ep = ep + 1
            }

            // Save trained A
            var ai: i64 = 0
            while ai < 8 { SAVED_A[ai as usize] = A[ai as usize]; ai = ai + 1 }

            // Compute Hessian for each test subject
            subj = 0
            while subj < SUBJECT_COUNT {
                if SITE_KEYS[subj as usize] == holdout_key {
                    // Restore A before each Hessian computation
                    ai = 0
                    while ai < 8 { A[ai as usize] = SAVED_A[ai as usize]; ai = ai + 1 }

                    compute_subject_hessian(subj)
                    let od = subject_offdiag_norm()
                    let dg = subject_diag_norm()

                    if LABELS[subj as usize] == 1 {
                        ASD_OFFDIAG_SUM = ASD_OFFDIAG_SUM + od
                        ASD_DIAG_SUM = ASD_DIAG_SUM + dg
                        ASD_COUNT = ASD_COUNT + 1
                    } else {
                        CTL_OFFDIAG_SUM = CTL_OFFDIAG_SUM + od
                        CTL_DIAG_SUM = CTL_DIAG_SUM + dg
                        CTL_COUNT = CTL_COUNT + 1
                    }
                }
                subj = subj + 1
            }

            site_i = site_i + 1
        }
        seed_i = seed_i + 1
    }

    // Results
    println("")
    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════")
    println("  RESULTS: Hessian Non-Associativity by Diagnosis")
    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════")

    print("  ASD subjects measured: "); print_int(ASD_COUNT); print("\n")
    print("  CTL subjects measured: "); print_int(CTL_COUNT); print("\n")

    if ASD_COUNT > 0 && CTL_COUNT > 0 {
        let asd_od = (ASD_OFFDIAG_SUM as f64) / (ASD_COUNT as f64)
        let ctl_od = (CTL_OFFDIAG_SUM as f64) / (CTL_COUNT as f64)
        let asd_dg = (ASD_DIAG_SUM as f64) / (ASD_COUNT as f64)
        let ctl_dg = (CTL_DIAG_SUM as f64) / (CTL_COUNT as f64)

        println("")
        print("  Mean ||H_offdiag|| (×1e6):\n")
        print("    ASD: "); print(asd_od); print("\n")
        print("    CTL: "); print(ctl_od); print("\n")
        let ratio_od = asd_od / ctl_od
        print("    Ratio ASD/CTL: "); print(ratio_od); print("\n")

        println("")
        print("  Mean ||H_diag|| (×1e6):\n")
        print("    ASD: "); print(asd_dg); print("\n")
        print("    CTL: "); print(ctl_dg); print("\n")
        let ratio_dg = asd_dg / ctl_dg
        print("    Ratio ASD/CTL: "); print(ratio_dg); print("\n")

        println("")
        print("  Off-diag / diag ratio (non-assoc fraction):\n")
        var asd_frac = 0.0
        if asd_dg > 0.0 { asd_frac = asd_od / asd_dg }
        var ctl_frac = 0.0
        if ctl_dg > 0.0 { ctl_frac = ctl_od / ctl_dg }
        print("    ASD: "); print(asd_frac); print("\n")
        print("    CTL: "); print(ctl_frac); print("\n")

        println("")
        if ratio_od > 1.1 {
            println("  -> ASD has MORE non-associative curvature than controls")
            println("  -> Suggests non-associative functional connectivity biomarker")
        } else if ratio_od < 0.9 {
            println("  -> Controls have MORE non-associative curvature than ASD")
            println("  -> Suggests ASD connectivity is more 'associative' (path-independent)")
        } else {
            println("  -> No significant difference in non-associative curvature")
        }
    }

    println("")
    println("DONE")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/brain_orc_demo.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// brain_orc_demo.sio — Brain ORC + Associator Field Pipeline
//
// End-to-end demonstration of the Paper 4 connectome analysis pipeline:
//   1. Generate synthetic ASD and TD connectomes
//   2. Compute Ollivier-Ricci Curvature (LLY) on each
//   3. Classify geometric phases
//   4. Extract subgraphs and compute octonion associator fields
//   5. Compare ASD vs TD across curvature and algebraic measures
//
// This is the computational backbone for:
//   "Brain ORC + Associator Field: Non-Associative Geometry of
//    Functional Connectomes in ASD"
//   Target: Network Neuroscience
//
// References:
//   - Ollivier 2009, "Ricci curvature of Markov chains"
//   - Lin, Lu, Yau 2011, "Ricci curvature of graphs"
//   - Di Martino et al. 2014, "The ABIDE Initiative"
//   - Baez 2002, "The Octonions"

// ============================================================================
// MATH HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var r = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 { r = 0.5 * (r + x / r); i = i + 1 }
    r
}

// ============================================================================
// ADJACENCY MATRIX — 50x50 for demo (full pipeline uses 200x200)
// ============================================================================

struct DemoMatrix {
    data: [f64; 2500]     // 50*50 flattened
    n: i64
}

fn dm_new(n: i64) -> DemoMatrix {
    DemoMatrix { data: [0.0; 2500], n: n }
}

fn dm_get(m: DemoMatrix, i: i64, j: i64) -> f64 with Panic {
    m.data[(i * m.n + j) as usize]
}

fn dm_set_sym(m: DemoMatrix, i: i64, j: i64, val: f64) -> DemoMatrix with Mut, Panic {
    var out = m
    out.data[(i * m.n + j) as usize] = val
    out.data[(j * m.n + i) as usize] = val
    out
}

// ============================================================================
// LCG RNG
// ============================================================================

fn lcg_next(s: i64) -> i64 { s * 6364136223846793005 + 1442695040888963407 }

fn lcg_f64(s: i64) -> f64 with Div, Panic {
    let v = if s < 0 { 0 - s } else { s }
    (v as f64) / 9223372036854775807.0
}

// ============================================================================
// CONNECTOME GENERATORS
// ============================================================================

fn generate_connectome(
    n: i64, n_modules: i64, p_within: f64, p_between: f64, seed: i64
) -> DemoMatrix with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var m = dm_new(n)
    var s = seed

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        var j: i64 = i + 1
        while j < n {
            s = lcg_next(s)
            let r = lcg_f64(s)
            let mod_i = i * n_modules / n
            let mod_j = j * n_modules / n
            let same_mod = mod_i == mod_j
            let p = if same_mod { p_within } else { p_between }

            if r < p {
                s = lcg_next(s)
                let w = 0.2 + 0.6 * lcg_f64(s)
                m = dm_set_sym(m, i, j, w)
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    m
}

fn generate_td(n: i64, seed: i64) -> DemoMatrix with Mut, Panic, Div {
    generate_connectome(n, 5, 0.70, 0.15, seed)
}

fn generate_asd(n: i64, seed: i64) -> DemoMatrix with Mut, Panic, Div {
    generate_connectome(n, 5, 0.55, 0.25, seed)
}

// ============================================================================
// BINARY GRAPH — for ORC computation
// ============================================================================

struct BinGraph {
    adj: [i32; 2500]       // 50*50
    n: i64
}

fn bg_new(n: i64) -> BinGraph { BinGraph { adj: [0; 2500], n: n } }

fn bg_from_matrix(m: DemoMatrix, threshold: f64) -> BinGraph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var g = bg_new(m.n)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < m.n {
        var j: i64 = i + 1
        while j < m.n {
            if dm_get(m, i, j) > threshold {
                g.adj[(i * m.n + j) as usize] = 1
                g.adj[(j * m.n + i) as usize] = 1
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    g
}

fn bg_degree(g: BinGraph, v: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var d: i64 = 0
    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < g.n {
        if g.adj[(v * g.n + j) as usize] == 1 { d = d + 1 }
        j = j + 1
    }
    d
}

fn bg_common_neighbors(g: BinGraph, u: i64, v: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var count: i64 = 0
    var w: i64 = 0
    while w < g.n {
        if w != u && w != v {
            if g.adj[(u * g.n + w) as usize] == 1 && g.adj[(v * g.n + w) as usize] == 1 {
                count = count + 1
            }
        }
        w = w + 1
    }
    count
}

fn bg_edge_count(g: BinGraph) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var count: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < g.n {
        var j: i64 = i + 1
        while j < g.n {
            if g.adj[(i * g.n + j) as usize] == 1 { count = count + 1 }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    count
}

// ============================================================================
// LIN-LU-YAU RICCI CURVATURE
// ============================================================================

fn orc_lly(g: BinGraph, u: i64, v: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let d_u = bg_degree(g, u)
    let d_v = bg_degree(g, v)
    if d_u == 0 || d_v == 0 { return 0.0 }

    let t = bg_common_neighbors(g, u, v)
    let inv_du = 1.0 / (d_u as f64)
    let inv_dv = 1.0 / (d_v as f64)
    (t as f64) * (inv_du + inv_dv) + inv_du + inv_dv - 1.0
}

// Curvature statistics for all edges
struct OrcStats {
    n_edges: i64
    mean_k: f64
    min_k: f64
    max_k: f64
    std_k: f64
    n_pos: i64
    n_zero: i64
    n_neg: i64
}

fn compute_orc_stats(g: BinGraph) -> OrcStats with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var n_edges: i64 = 0
    var sum_k: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_k2: f64 = 0.0
    var min_k: f64 = 1000.0
    var max_k: f64 = 0.0 - 1000.0
    var n_pos: i64 = 0
    var n_zero: i64 = 0
    var n_neg: i64 = 0
    let eps = 0.01

    var u: i64 = 0
    while u < g.n {
        var v: i64 = u + 1
        while v < g.n {
            if g.adj[(u * g.n + v) as usize] == 1 {
                let k = orc_lly(g, u, v)
                n_edges = n_edges + 1
                sum_k = sum_k + k
                sum_k2 = sum_k2 + k * k
                if k < min_k { min_k = k }
                if k > max_k { max_k = k }
                if k > eps { n_pos = n_pos + 1 }
                else if k < (0.0 - eps) { n_neg = n_neg + 1 }
                else { n_zero = n_zero + 1 }
            }
            v = v + 1
        }
        u = u + 1
    }

    let mean = if n_edges > 0 { sum_k / (n_edges as f64) } else { 0.0 }
    let var_k = if n_edges > 0 {
        sum_k2 / (n_edges as f64) - mean * mean
    } else { 0.0 }

    OrcStats {
        n_edges: n_edges,
        mean_k: mean,
        min_k: if n_edges > 0 { min_k } else { 0.0 },
        max_k: if n_edges > 0 { max_k } else { 0.0 },
        std_k: sqrt_f64(abs_f64(var_k)),
        n_pos: n_pos, n_zero: n_zero, n_neg: n_neg,
    }
}

fn phase_name(stats: OrcStats) -> i64 with Div, Panic {
    if stats.n_edges == 0 { return 3 }
    let ne = stats.n_edges as f64
    let frac_pos = (stats.n_pos as f64) / ne
    let frac_neg = (stats.n_neg as f64) / ne
    if frac_pos > 0.5 { return 0 }
    if frac_neg > 0.5 { return 2 }
    if abs_f64(stats.mean_k) < 0.05 && stats.std_k < 0.1 { return 1 }
    3
}

// ============================================================================
// OCTONION (inlined for demo)
// ============================================================================

struct Oct { e: [f64; 8] }

fn oct_zero() -> Oct { Oct { e: [0.0; 8] } }

fn oct_unit(idx: i64) -> Oct with Mut, Panic {
    var o = Oct { e: [0.0; 8] }
    if idx >= 0 && idx < 8 { o.e[idx as usize] = 1.0 }
    o
}

fn oct_scale(o: Oct, s: f64) -> Oct with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var r = oct_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 { r.e[i as usize] = o.e[i as usize] * s; i = i + 1 }
    r
}

fn oct_sub(a: Oct, b: Oct) -> Oct with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var r = oct_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 { r.e[i as usize] = a.e[i as usize] - b.e[i as usize]; i = i + 1 }
    r
}

fn oct_conjugate(o: Oct) -> Oct with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var r = oct_zero()
    r.e[0] = o.e[0]
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < 8 { r.e[i as usize] = 0.0 - o.e[i as usize]; i = i + 1 }
    r
}

fn oct_norm_sq(o: Oct) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var s: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 { s = s + o.e[i as usize] * o.e[i as usize]; i = i + 1 }
    s
}

fn oct_norm(o: Oct) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div { sqrt_f64(oct_norm_sq(o)) }

fn oct_fano_index(i: i64, j: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if i == j { return 0 }
    var t: [i64; 21] = [0; 21]
    t[0]=1;t[1]=2;t[2]=4; t[3]=2;t[4]=3;t[5]=5; t[6]=3;t[7]=4;t[8]=6
    t[9]=4;t[10]=5;t[11]=7; t[12]=5;t[13]=6;t[14]=1; t[15]=6;t[16]=7;t[17]=2
    t[18]=7;t[19]=1;t[20]=3
    var k: i64 = 0
    while k < 7 {
        let a=t[(k*3) as usize]; let b=t[(k*3+1) as usize]; let c=t[(k*3+2) as usize]
        if (i==a&&j==b)||(i==b&&j==c)||(i==c&&j==a) {
            if i==a&&j==b {return c}; if i==b&&j==c {return a}; return b
        }
        if (i==b&&j==a)||(i==c&&j==b)||(i==a&&j==c) {
            if i==b&&j==a {return c}; if i==c&&j==b {return a}; return b
        }
        k=k+1
    }
    0
}

fn oct_fano_sign(i: i64, j: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if i==j {return -1.0}; if i==0||j==0 {return 1.0}
    var t: [i64; 21] = [0; 21]
    t[0]=1;t[1]=2;t[2]=4; t[3]=2;t[4]=3;t[5]=5; t[6]=3;t[7]=4;t[8]=6
    t[9]=4;t[10]=5;t[11]=7; t[12]=5;t[13]=6;t[14]=1; t[15]=6;t[16]=7;t[17]=2
    t[18]=7;t[19]=1;t[20]=3
    var k: i64 = 0
    while k < 7 {
        let a=t[(k*3) as usize]; let b=t[(k*3+1) as usize]; let c=t[(k*3+2) as usize]
        if (i==a&&j==b)||(i==b&&j==c)||(i==c&&j==a) {return 1.0}
        if (i==b&&j==a)||(i==c&&j==b)||(i==a&&j==c) {return -1.0}
        k=k+1
    }
    0.0
}

fn oct_mul(a: Oct, b: Oct) -> Oct with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var result = oct_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 {
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < 8 {
            let coeff = a.e[i as usize] * b.e[j as usize]
            if i==0&&j==0 { result.e[0] = result.e[0] + coeff }
            else if i==0 { result.e[j as usize] = result.e[j as usize] + coeff }
            else if j==0 { result.e[i as usize] = result.e[i as usize] + coeff }
            else if i==j { result.e[0] = result.e[0] - coeff }
            else {
                let k = oct_fano_index(i, j)
                let sign = oct_fano_sign(i, j)
                result.e[k as usize] = result.e[k as usize] + sign * coeff
            }
            j=j+1
        }
        i=i+1
    }
    result
}

fn oct_associator(a: Oct, b: Oct, c: Oct) -> Oct with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let ab = oct_mul(a, b)
    let bc = oct_mul(b, c)
    oct_sub(oct_mul(ab, c), oct_mul(a, bc))
}

// ============================================================================
// OCTGRAPH (16-node subgraph for demo)
// ============================================================================

struct OctGraph {
    n: i32
    adj: [i32; 256]
    lab0: [f64; 256]
    lab1: [f64; 256]
    lab2: [f64; 256]
    lab3: [f64; 256]
    lab4: [f64; 256]
    lab5: [f64; 256]
    lab6: [f64; 256]
    lab7: [f64; 256]
}

fn og_new(n: i32) -> OctGraph {
    OctGraph {
        n: n, adj: [0; 256],
        lab0: [0.0; 256], lab1: [0.0; 256], lab2: [0.0; 256], lab3: [0.0; 256],
        lab4: [0.0; 256], lab5: [0.0; 256], lab6: [0.0; 256], lab7: [0.0; 256],
    }
}

fn og_idx(u: i32, v: i32) -> i32 { u * 16 + v }

fn og_set_edge(g: OctGraph, u: i32, v: i32, label: Oct) -> OctGraph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var r = g
    let idx = og_idx(u, v) as usize
    r.adj[idx] = 1
    r.lab0[idx]=label.e[0]; r.lab1[idx]=label.e[1]; r.lab2[idx]=label.e[2]; r.lab3[idx]=label.e[3]
    r.lab4[idx]=label.e[4]; r.lab5[idx]=label.e[5]; r.lab6[idx]=label.e[6]; r.lab7[idx]=label.e[7]
    r
}

fn og_add_undir(g: OctGraph, u: i32, v: i32, label: Oct) -> OctGraph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var r = og_set_edge(g, u, v, label)
    r = og_set_edge(r, v, u, oct_conjugate(label))
    r
}

fn og_get_label(g: OctGraph, u: i32, v: i32) -> Oct with Mut, Panic {
    let idx = og_idx(u, v) as usize
    var o = Oct { e: [0.0; 8] }
    o.e[0]=g.lab0[idx]; o.e[1]=g.lab1[idx]; o.e[2]=g.lab2[idx]; o.e[3]=g.lab3[idx]
    o.e[4]=g.lab4[idx]; o.e[5]=g.lab5[idx]; o.e[6]=g.lab6[idx]; o.e[7]=g.lab7[idx]
    o
}

// Build OctGraph from first n_nodes of DemoMatrix (n_nodes <= 16)
fn matrix_to_octgraph(m: DemoMatrix, n_nodes: i32, threshold: f64) -> OctGraph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var g = og_new(n_nodes)
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < n_nodes {
        var j: i32 = i + 1
        while j < n_nodes {
            let w = dm_get(m, i as i64, j as i64)
            if w > threshold {
                // Cyclic basis labeling: weight * e_{(i+j) mod 7 + 1}
                let basis = (((i + j) as i64) % 7) + 1
                let label = oct_scale(oct_unit(basis), w)
                g = og_add_undir(g, i, j, label)
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    g
}

// ============================================================================
// ASSOCIATOR FIELD STATISTICS
// ============================================================================

struct AssocStats {
    count: i32
    mean_norm: f64
    max_norm: f64
    energy: f64
    zero_count: i32
}

fn compute_assoc_stats(g: OctGraph) -> AssocStats with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var count: i32 = 0
    var sum_norm: f64 = 0.0
    var max_n: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_sq: f64 = 0.0
    var zeros: i32 = 0

    var u: i32 = 0
    while u < g.n {
        var v: i32 = 0
        while v < g.n {
            if g.adj[og_idx(u, v) as usize] == 1 && u != v {
                var w: i32 = 0
                while w < g.n {
                    if g.adj[og_idx(v, w) as usize] == 1 && v != w && w != u {
                        var x: i32 = 0
                        while x < g.n {
                            if g.adj[og_idx(w, x) as usize] == 1 && w != x && x != v {
                                let a = og_get_label(g, u, v)
                                let b = og_get_label(g, v, w)
                                let c = og_get_label(g, w, x)
                                let assoc = oct_associator(a, b, c)
                                let n = oct_norm(assoc)
                                count = count + 1
                                sum_norm = sum_norm + n
                                sum_sq = sum_sq + n * n
                                if n > max_n { max_n = n }
                                if n < 1e-9 { zeros = zeros + 1 }
                            }
                            x = x + 1
                        }
                    }
                    w = w + 1
                }
            }
            v = v + 1
        }
        u = u + 1
    }

    let mean = if count > 0 { sum_norm / (count as f64) } else { 0.0 }
    AssocStats {
        count: count, mean_norm: mean, max_norm: max_n,
        energy: sum_sq, zero_count: zeros,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// PRINT HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn print_f64(x: f64) with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    if x < 0.0 { print("-"); print_f64(0.0 - x); return }
    let integer_part = x as i64
    let frac = x - (integer_part as f64)
    let frac_scaled = (frac * 10000.0 + 0.5) as i64
    print(integer_part)
    print(".")
    if frac_scaled < 10 { print("000") }
    else if frac_scaled < 100 { print("00") }
    else if frac_scaled < 1000 { print("0") }
    print(frac_scaled)
}

fn print_phase(p: i64) with IO {
    if p == 0 { print("SPHERICAL") }
    else if p == 1 { print("FLAT") }
    else if p == 2 { print("HYPERBOLIC") }
    else { print("MIXED") }
}

fn print_orc_stats(name: i64, s: OrcStats) with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    if name == 0 { print("  TD  connectome: ") }
    else { print("  ASD connectome: ") }
    print("edges="); print(s.n_edges)
    print(" mean_k="); print_f64(s.mean_k)
    print(" std_k="); print_f64(s.std_k)
    print(" [+"); print(s.n_pos)
    print(" 0:"); print(s.n_zero)
    print(" -"); print(s.n_neg)
    print("]")
    println("")
}

fn print_assoc_stats(name: i64, s: AssocStats) with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    if name == 0 { print("  TD  subgraph: ") }
    else { print("  ASD subgraph: ") }
    print("triples="); print(s.count)
    print(" mean="); print_f64(s.mean_norm)
    print(" max="); print_f64(s.max_norm)
    print(" energy="); print_f64(s.energy)
    print(" zeros="); print(s.zero_count)
    println("")
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN — THE EXPERIMENT
// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    println("================================================================")
    println("  BRAIN ORC + ASSOCIATOR FIELD — Paper 4 Pipeline")
    println("  Connectome Geometry via Ollivier-Ricci Curvature")
    println("  and Octonion Associator Fields")
    println("================================================================")
    println("")

    let n: i64 = 30       // 30 nodes for demo (manageable computation)
    let threshold = 0.3    // edge weight threshold

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Phase 1: Generate synthetic connectomes
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    println("--- Phase 1: Synthetic Connectome Generation ---")
    println("")

    let td_matrix = generate_td(n, 42)
    let asd_matrix = generate_asd(n, 42)

    // Count edges
    var td_edges: i64 = 0
    var asd_edges: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        var j: i64 = i + 1
        while j < n {
            if dm_get(td_matrix, i, j) > threshold { td_edges = td_edges + 1 }
            if dm_get(asd_matrix, i, j) > threshold { asd_edges = asd_edges + 1 }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    print("  TD  connectome: n="); print(n); print(" edges="); print(td_edges)
    print(" density="); print_f64((td_edges as f64) / (((n * (n - 1)) / 2) as f64))
    println("")
    print("  ASD connectome: n="); print(n); print(" edges="); print(asd_edges)
    print(" density="); print_f64((asd_edges as f64) / (((n * (n - 1)) / 2) as f64))
    println("")
    println("")

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Phase 2: Ollivier-Ricci Curvature
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    println("--- Phase 2: Ollivier-Ricci Curvature (Lin-Lu-Yau) ---")
    println("")

    let bg_td = bg_from_matrix(td_matrix, threshold)
    let bg_asd = bg_from_matrix(asd_matrix, threshold)

    let orc_td = compute_orc_stats(bg_td)
    let orc_asd = compute_orc_stats(bg_asd)

    print_orc_stats(0, orc_td)
    print_orc_stats(1, orc_asd)
    println("")

    // Phase classification
    let phase_td = phase_name(orc_td)
    let phase_asd = phase_name(orc_asd)
    print("  TD  geometric phase: "); print_phase(phase_td); println("")
    print("  ASD geometric phase: "); print_phase(phase_asd); println("")

    // Curvature difference
    println("")
    print("  Mean curvature difference (TD - ASD): ")
    print_f64(orc_td.mean_k - orc_asd.mean_k)
    println("")

    let td_frac_neg = if orc_td.n_edges > 0 {
        (orc_td.n_neg as f64) / (orc_td.n_edges as f64)
    } else { 0.0 }
    let asd_frac_neg = if orc_asd.n_edges > 0 {
        (orc_asd.n_neg as f64) / (orc_asd.n_edges as f64)
    } else { 0.0 }
    print("  Negative curvature fraction — TD: ")
    print_f64(td_frac_neg)
    print("  ASD: ")
    print_f64(asd_frac_neg)
    println("")
    println("")

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Phase 3: Octonion Associator Field (on subgraph)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    println("--- Phase 3: Octonion Associator Field (10-node subgraph) ---")
    println("")

    let sub_n: i32 = 10    // 10-node subgraph for tractable associator computation
    let og_td = matrix_to_octgraph(td_matrix, sub_n, threshold)
    let og_asd = matrix_to_octgraph(asd_matrix, sub_n, threshold)

    let af_td = compute_assoc_stats(og_td)
    let af_asd = compute_assoc_stats(og_asd)

    print_assoc_stats(0, af_td)
    print_assoc_stats(1, af_asd)
    println("")

    // Comparison
    print("  Associator mean diff (TD - ASD): ")
    print_f64(af_td.mean_norm - af_asd.mean_norm)
    println("")
    print("  Associator energy diff (TD - ASD): ")
    print_f64(af_td.energy - af_asd.energy)
    println("")

    let zf_td = if af_td.count > 0 { (af_td.zero_count as f64) / (af_td.count as f64) } else { 0.0 }
    let zf_asd = if af_asd.count > 0 { (af_asd.zero_count as f64) / (af_asd.count as f64) } else { 0.0 }
    print("  Zero-associator fraction — TD: ")
    print_f64(zf_td)
    print("  ASD: ")
    print_f64(zf_asd)
    println("")
    println("")

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Phase 4: Node-level curvature (top-5 highest/lowest)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    println("--- Phase 4: Node-Level Curvature Profile ---")
    println("")

    // Compute mean curvature per node for TD
    var td_node_k: [f64; 50] = [0.0; 50]
    var td_node_cnt: [i64; 50] = [0; 50]
    var u: i64 = 0
    while u < n {
        var v: i64 = u + 1
        while v < n {
            if bg_td.adj[(u * n + v) as usize] == 1 {
                let k = orc_lly(bg_td, u, v)
                td_node_k[u as usize] = td_node_k[u as usize] + k
                td_node_cnt[u as usize] = td_node_cnt[u as usize] + 1
                td_node_k[v as usize] = td_node_k[v as usize] + k
                td_node_cnt[v as usize] = td_node_cnt[v as usize] + 1
            }
            v = v + 1
        }
        u = u + 1
    }

    // Print nodes with highest mean curvature
    print("  TD top-5 highest mean curvature nodes: ")
    var printed: i64 = 0
    while printed < 5 {
        var best_node: i64 = 0
        var best_k: f64 = 0.0 - 10000.0
        var ni: i64 = 0
        while ni < n {
            if td_node_cnt[ni as usize] > 0 {
                let avg = td_node_k[ni as usize] / (td_node_cnt[ni as usize] as f64)
                if avg > best_k {
                    best_k = avg
                    best_node = ni
                }
            }
            ni = ni + 1
        }
        print("n"); print(best_node); print("(")
        print_f64(best_k)
        print(") ")
        // Mark as visited by zeroing count
        td_node_cnt[best_node as usize] = 0
        printed = printed + 1
    }
    println("")
    println("")

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Phase 5: Summary
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    println("================================================================")
    println("  SUMMARY — Paper 4 Hypotheses")
    println("================================================================")
    println("")
    println("  H1: ASD connectomes show more negative Ricci curvature")
    println("      (hyperbolic geometry → tree-like, disrupted communities)")
    print("      Result: ASD neg frac = "); print_f64(asd_frac_neg)
    print(" vs TD = "); print_f64(td_frac_neg); println("")
    println("")
    println("  H2: ASD connectomes produce different associator field patterns")
    println("      (non-associative algebra detects structural differences)")
    print("      Result: energy diff = "); print_f64(af_td.energy - af_asd.energy); println("")
    println("")
    println("  H3: Phase classification separates ASD from TD")
    print("      Result: TD="); print_phase(phase_td)
    print(" ASD="); print_phase(phase_asd); println("")
    println("")
    println("  Next: Apply to real ABIDE-I CC200 matrices")
    println("================================================================")

    0
}

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn abs_i64(x: i64) -> i64 {
    if x < 0 { 0 - x } else { x }
}

fn clip_f64(x: f64, lo: f64, hi: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x }
}

fn squash_pos_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    x / (1.0 + x)
}

fn head_count() -> i64 { 2 }
fn head_width() -> i64 { 8 }
fn hidden_dim() -> i64 { 16 }
fn assoc_offset() -> i64 { 16 }
fn input_mean_offset() -> i64 { 18 }
fn input_delta_offset() -> i64 { 26 }
fn step_delta_offset() -> i64 { 34 }
fn input_flat_offset() -> i64 { 42 }
fn encoder_scale_offset() -> i64 { 554 }
fn encoder_bias_offset() -> i64 { 562 }
fn bias_offset() -> i64 { 570 }
fn head_base(head: i64) -> i64 { head * head_width() }
fn feature_cap() -> i64 { 512 }

fn bp_to_f64(v: i64) -> f64 with Div {
    (v as f64) / 1000000.0
}

fn f64_to_bp(v: f64) -> i64 {
    if v <= 0.0 { return 0 }
    let scaled = v * 1000000.0 + 0.5
    if scaled > 1000000.0 { 1000000 } else { scaled as i64 }
}

fn scaled_keep_count(total: i64, bp: i64) -> i64 with Div {
    if total <= 0 { return 0 }
    if bp >= 1000000 { return total }
    var keep = (total * bp + 500000) / 1000000
    if keep < 1 { keep = 1 }
    if keep > total { keep = total }
    keep
}

fn cfg_train_epochs(is_oct: i64) -> i64 {
    if is_oct == 1 && CFG_OCT_TRAIN_EPOCHS > 0 {
        return CFG_OCT_TRAIN_EPOCHS
    }
    if is_oct == 0 && CFG_H_TRAIN_EPOCHS > 0 {
        return CFG_H_TRAIN_EPOCHS
    }
    CFG_GLOBAL_TRAIN_EPOCHS
}

fn oct_profile_name(id: i64) -> string {
    if id == 1 { "o_g2_transfer" }
    else if id == 2 { "o_assoc_stable" }
    else if id == 3 { "o_alg_v1" }
    else if id == 4 { "o_alg_v1_mandel" }
    else { "o_default" }
}

fn oct_train_mode_name(id: i64) -> string {
    if id == 3 { "o_alg_v1" }
    else if id == 4 { "o_alg_v1_mandel" }
    else if id == 2 { "o_assoc_stable" }
    else if id == 1 { "o_g2_transfer" }
    else { "o_default" }
}

fn assoc_schedule_mode_name(id: i64) -> string {
    if id == 1 { "tri_band" }
    else { "fixed" }
}

fn proj_mode_name(mode: i64) -> string {
    if mode == 1 { "learned_linear" }
    else if mode == 2 { "residual_linear" }
    else if mode == 3 { "mandelbrot_d2_residual" }
    else if mode == 4 { "mandelbrot_d2_hybrid" }
    else { "identity" }
}

fn lerp_f64(a: f64, b: f64, t: f64) -> f64 {
    a + (b - a) * t
}

fn trust_region_clip(step: f64, radius: f64) -> f64 with Div {
    if radius <= 0.0 { return step }
    clip_f64(step, 0.0 - radius, radius)
}

fn md2_squash(v: f64) -> f64 with Div {
    if v >= 0.0 {
        v / (1.0 + v)
    } else {
        v / (1.0 + (0.0 - v))
    }
}

fn mandelbrot_d2_feature(seed: f64, delta: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var z = clip_f64(0.55 * seed + 0.20 * delta, 0.0 - 2.0, 2.0)
    let c = clip_f64(0.35 * seed + 0.25 * delta, 0.0 - 2.0, 2.0)
    var dz = 1.0 + 0.10 * delta
    var ddz = 0.0
    var it: i64 = 0
    while it < 3 {
        ddz = 2.0 * (dz * dz + z * ddz)
        dz = 2.0 * z * dz + 1.0 + 0.15 * delta
        z = z * z + c
        z = clip_f64(z, 0.0 - 4.0, 4.0)
        dz = clip_f64(dz, 0.0 - 6.0, 6.0)
        ddz = clip_f64(ddz, 0.0 - 8.0, 8.0)
        it = it + 1
    }
    clip_f64(md2_squash(ddz), 0.0 - 1.5, 1.5)
}

fn scheduled_assoc_target() -> f64 with Div {
    if cfg_assoc_schedule_mode() <= 0 || TRAIN_EPOCH_TOTAL <= 1 {
        return cfg_assoc_target(1)
    }
    let denom = if TRAIN_EPOCH_TOTAL > 1 { TRAIN_EPOCH_TOTAL - 1 } else { 1 }
    let prog = clip_f64((TRAIN_EPOCH_CURSOR as f64) / (denom as f64), 0.0, 1.0)
    if prog <= 0.5 {
        lerp_f64(cfg_assoc_schedule_start(), cfg_assoc_schedule_mid(), prog / 0.5)
    } else {
        lerp_f64(cfg_assoc_schedule_mid(), cfg_assoc_schedule_end(), (prog - 0.5) / 0.5)
    }
}

fn scaled_optional_count(total: i64, bp: i64) -> i64 with Div {
    if total <= 0 || bp <= 0 { return 0 }
    if bp >= 1000000 { return total }
    var keep = (total * bp + 500000) / 1000000
    if keep < 0 { keep = 0 }
    if keep > total { keep = total }
    keep
}

fn exp_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 15.0 { return exp_q(7.5) * exp_q(x - 7.5) }
    if x < 0.0 - 15.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 20 {
        term = term * x / (i as f64)
        sum = sum + term
        i = i + 1
    }
    sum
}

fn sqrt_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x != x { return 0.0 }
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var g = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        g = 0.5 * (g + x / g)
        i = i + 1
    }
    if g != g { return 0.0 }
    g
}

fn sigmoid_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x >= 0.0 {
        1.0 / (1.0 + exp_q(0.0 - x))
    } else {
        let ex = exp_q(x)
        ex / (1.0 + ex)
    }
}

fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut {
    RNG_A = a
    RNG_B = b
}

fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A
    let y = RNG_B
    RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23)
    x = x ^ (x >> 17)
    x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x
    let r = x + y
    if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}

fn randf() -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    ((rng_next() % 20000) as f64 - 10000.0) / 10000.0
}

fn i64_to_string(v: i64) -> string with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if v == 0 { return "0" }
    var n = v
    var neg = false
    if n < 0 {
        neg = true
        n = 0 - n
    }
    var rev: [i8; 32] = [0; 32]
    var rev_len: i64 = 0
    while n > 0 && rev_len < 31 {
        let digit = n % 10
        rev[rev_len as usize] = (48 + digit) as i8
        rev_len = rev_len + 1
        n = n / 10
    }
    var out: [i8; 64] = [0; 64]
    var out_len: i64 = 0
    if neg {
        out[out_len as usize] = 45 as i8
        out_len = out_len + 1
    }
    var i = rev_len - 1
    while i >= 0 {
        out[out_len as usize] = rev[i as usize]
        out_len = out_len + 1
        if i == 0 { break }
        i = i - 1
    }
    str_from_bytes(out, out_len)
}

fn read_text_file(path: string) -> string with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let size = file_size(path)
    if size <= 0 { return "" }
    let raw = read_file(path)
    str_from_bytes(raw, size)
}

fn load_run_config(path: string) -> i64 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    CFG_TRAIN_FRACTION_BP = 1000000
    CFG_DROP_CHANNEL_FRAC_BP = 0
    CFG_NOISE_STD_BP = 0
    CFG_GLOBAL_TRAIN_EPOCHS = 90
    CFG_GLOBAL_TRAIN_LR_BP = 20000
    CFG_GLOBAL_CORE_LR_SCALE_BP = 350000
    CFG_OCT_TRAIN_EPOCHS = 0
    CFG_OCT_TRAIN_LR_BP = 0
    CFG_OCT_CORE_LR_SCALE_BP = 0
    CFG_OCT_WARMUP_EPOCHS = 0
    CFG_OCT_PROFILE_ID = 0
    CFG_OCT_TRAIN_MODE = 0
    CFG_OCT_INIT_PRESET = 0
    CFG_OCT_ASSOC_REG_BP = 0
    CFG_OCT_ASSOC_TARGET_BP = 0
    CFG_OCT_ASSOC_SCHEDULE_MODE = 0
    CFG_OCT_ASSOC_SCHEDULE_START_BP = 0
    CFG_OCT_ASSOC_SCHEDULE_MID_BP = 0
    CFG_OCT_ASSOC_SCHEDULE_END_BP = 0
    CFG_OCT_ASSOC_DRIFT_REG_BP = 0
    CFG_OCT_HEAD_TRUST_REGION_BP = 0
    CFG_OCT_HEAD_RENORM = 1
    CFG_OCT_INPUT_PROJ_MODE = 0
    CFG_OCT_PROJ_LR_SCALE_BP = 600000
    CFG_OCT_PROJ_STRUCTURED_SCALE_BP = 350000
    CFG_OCT_PROJ_DELTA_SCALE_BP = 180000
    CFG_OCT_PROJ_HYBRID_SCALE_BP = 120000
    CFG_H_TRAIN_EPOCHS = 0
    CFG_H_TRAIN_LR_BP = 0
    CFG_H_CORE_LR_SCALE_BP = 0
    CFG_H_WARMUP_EPOCHS = 0
    CFG_H_INIT_PRESET = 0
    CFG_H_INPUT_PROJ_MODE = 0
    CFG_H_PROJ_LR_SCALE_BP = 600000
    let n = file_size(path)
    if n <= 0 { return 0 }
    let raw = read_file(path)
    let bytes = raw.as_bytes()
    var pos: i64 = 0
    while pos < n {
        while pos < n && (bytes[pos as usize] == 10 || bytes[pos as usize] == 13) {
            pos = pos + 1
        }
        if pos >= n { break }
        var line_end = pos
        while line_end < n && bytes[line_end as usize] != 10 && bytes[line_end as usize] != 13 {
            line_end = line_end + 1
        }
        let line = str_slice(raw, pos, line_end)
        let line_n = str_len(line)
        if starts_with(line, "oct_profile_id=") {
            CFG_OCT_PROFILE_ID = parse_i64_basic(str_slice(line, 15, line_n))
            pos = line_end
            continue
        }
        if starts_with(line, "oct_train_mode=") {
            CFG_OCT_TRAIN_MODE = parse_i64_basic(str_slice(line, 15, line_n))
            pos = line_end
            continue
        }
        if starts_with(line, "oct_assoc_schedule_mode=") {
            CFG_OCT_ASSOC_SCHEDULE_MODE = parse_i64_basic(str_slice(line, 24, line_n))
            pos = line_end
            continue
        }
        if starts_with(line, "oct_assoc_schedule_start=") {
            CFG_OCT_ASSOC_SCHEDULE_START_BP = f64_to_bp(parse_f64_basic(str_slice(line, 25, line_n)))
            pos = line_end
            continue
        }
        if starts_with(line, "oct_assoc_schedule_mid=") {
            CFG_OCT_ASSOC_SCHEDULE_MID_BP = f64_to_bp(parse_f64_basic(str_slice(line, 23, line_n)))
            pos = line_end
            continue
        }
        if starts_with(line, "oct_assoc_schedule_end=") {
            CFG_OCT_ASSOC_SCHEDULE_END_BP = f64_to_bp(parse_f64_basic(str_slice(line, 23, line_n)))
            pos = line_end
            continue
        }
        if starts_with(line, "oct_assoc_drift_reg=") {
            CFG_OCT_ASSOC_DRIFT_REG_BP = f64_to_bp(parse_f64_basic(str_slice(line, 20, line_n)))
            pos = line_end
            continue
        }
        if starts_with(line, "oct_head_trust_region=") {
            CFG_OCT_HEAD_TRUST_REGION_BP = f64_to_bp(parse_f64_basic(str_slice(line, 22, line_n)))
            pos = line_end
            continue
        }
        if starts_with(line, "oct_head_renorm=") {
            CFG_OCT_HEAD_RENORM = parse_i64_basic(str_slice(line, 16, line_n))
            pos = line_end
            continue
        }
        if starts_with(line, "oct_input_proj_mode=") {
            CFG_OCT_INPUT_PROJ_MODE = parse_i64_basic(str_slice(line, 20, line_n))
            pos = line_end
            continue
        }
        if starts_with(line, "h_input_proj_mode=") {
            CFG_H_INPUT_PROJ_MODE = parse_i64_basic(str_slice(line, 18, line_n))
            pos = line_end
            continue
        }
        if starts_with(line, "oct_proj_lr_scale=") {
            CFG_OCT_PROJ_LR_SCALE_BP = f64_to_bp(parse_f64_basic(str_slice(line, 18, line_n)))
            pos = line_end
            continue
        }
        if starts_with(line, "oct_proj_structured_scale=") {
            CFG_OCT_PROJ_STRUCTURED_SCALE_BP = f64_to_bp(parse_f64_basic(str_slice(line, 26, line_n)))
            pos = line_end
            continue
        }
        if starts_with(line, "oct_proj_delta_scale=") {
            CFG_OCT_PROJ_DELTA_SCALE_BP = f64_to_bp(parse_f64_basic(str_slice(line, 21, line_n)))
            pos = line_end
            continue
        }
        if starts_with(line, "oct_proj_hybrid_scale=") {
            CFG_OCT_PROJ_HYBRID_SCALE_BP = f64_to_bp(parse_f64_basic(str_slice(line, 22, line_n)))
            pos = line_end
            continue
        }
        if starts_with(line, "h_proj_lr_scale=") {
            CFG_H_PROJ_LR_SCALE_BP = f64_to_bp(parse_f64_basic(str_slice(line, 16, line_n)))
            pos = line_end
            continue
        }

        var value_start: i64 = 0
        if line_end - pos > 15 &&
           bytes[pos as usize] == 116 && bytes[(pos + 1) as usize] == 114 && bytes[(pos + 2) as usize] == 97 &&
           bytes[(pos + 3) as usize] == 105 && bytes[(pos + 4) as usize] == 110 && bytes[(pos + 5) as usize] == 95 &&
           bytes[(pos + 6) as usize] == 102 && bytes[(pos + 7) as usize] == 114 && bytes[(pos + 8) as usize] == 97 &&
           bytes[(pos + 9) as usize] == 99 && bytes[(pos + 10) as usize] == 116 && bytes[(pos + 11) as usize] == 105 &&
           bytes[(pos + 12) as usize] == 111 && bytes[(pos + 13) as usize] == 110 && bytes[(pos + 14) as usize] == 61 {
            value_start = pos + 15
        } else if line_end - pos > 20 &&
           bytes[pos as usize] == 103 && bytes[(pos + 1) as usize] == 108 && bytes[(pos + 2) as usize] == 111 &&
           bytes[(pos + 3) as usize] == 98 && bytes[(pos + 4) as usize] == 97 && bytes[(pos + 5) as usize] == 108 &&
           bytes[(pos + 6) as usize] == 95 && bytes[(pos + 7) as usize] == 116 && bytes[(pos + 8) as usize] == 114 &&
           bytes[(pos + 9) as usize] == 97 && bytes[(pos + 10) as usize] == 105 && bytes[(pos + 11) as usize] == 110 &&
           bytes[(pos + 12) as usize] == 95 && bytes[(pos + 13) as usize] == 101 && bytes[(pos + 14) as usize] == 112 &&
            bytes[(pos + 15) as usize] == 111 && bytes[(pos + 16) as usize] == 99 && bytes[(pos + 17) as usize] == 104 &&
           bytes[(pos + 18) as usize] == 115 && bytes[(pos + 19) as usize] == 61 {
            value_start = pos + 20
            let digits = parse_i64_basic(str_slice(raw, value_start, line_end))
            if digits > 0 { CFG_GLOBAL_TRAIN_EPOCHS = digits }
            pos = line_end
            continue
        } else if line_end - pos > 16 &&
           bytes[pos as usize] == 103 && bytes[(pos + 1) as usize] == 108 && bytes[(pos + 2) as usize] == 111 &&
           bytes[(pos + 3) as usize] == 98 && bytes[(pos + 4) as usize] == 97 && bytes[(pos + 5) as usize] == 108 &&
           bytes[(pos + 6) as usize] == 95 && bytes[(pos + 7) as usize] == 116 && bytes[(pos + 8) as usize] == 114 &&
           bytes[(pos + 9) as usize] == 97 && bytes[(pos + 10) as usize] == 105 && bytes[(pos + 11) as usize] == 110 &&
           bytes[(pos + 12) as usize] == 95 && bytes[(pos + 13) as usize] == 108 && bytes[(pos + 14) as usize] == 114 &&
           bytes[(pos + 15) as usize] == 61 {
            value_start = pos + 16
            CFG_GLOBAL_TRAIN_LR_BP = f64_to_bp(parse_f64_basic(str_slice(raw, value_start, line_end)))
            pos = line_end
            continue
        } else if line_end - pos > 20 &&
           bytes[pos as usize] == 103 && bytes[(pos + 1) as usize] == 108 && bytes[(pos + 2) as usize] == 111 &&
           bytes[(pos + 3) as usize] == 98 && bytes[(pos + 4) as usize] == 97 && bytes[(pos + 5) as usize] == 108 &&
           bytes[(pos + 6) as usize] == 95 && bytes[(pos + 7) as usize] == 99 && bytes[(pos + 8) as usize] == 111 &&
           bytes[(pos + 9) as usize] == 114 && bytes[(pos + 10) as usize] == 101 && bytes[(pos + 11) as usize] == 95 &&
           bytes[(pos + 12) as usize] == 108 && bytes[(pos + 13) as usize] == 114 && bytes[(pos + 14) as usize] == 95 &&
           bytes[(pos + 15) as usize] == 115 && bytes[(pos + 16) as usize] == 99 && bytes[(pos + 17) as usize] == 97 &&

fn parse_decimal_digit(ch: string) -> i64 {
    if str_eq(ch, "0") { 0 }
    else if str_eq(ch, "1") { 1 }
    else if str_eq(ch, "2") { 2 }
    else if str_eq(ch, "3") { 3 }
    else if str_eq(ch, "4") { 4 }
    else if str_eq(ch, "5") { 5 }
    else if str_eq(ch, "6") { 6 }
    else if str_eq(ch, "7") { 7 }
    else if str_eq(ch, "8") { 8 }
    else if str_eq(ch, "9") { 9 }
    else { -1 }
}

fn parse_i64_basic(raw: string) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let len = str_len(raw)
    if len <= 0 { return 0 }
    var i: i64 = 0
    var neg = false
    if str_eq(str_slice(raw, 0, 1), "-") {
        neg = true
        i = 1
    } else if str_eq(str_slice(raw, 0, 1), "+") {
        i = 1
    }
    var value: i64 = 0
    while i < len {
        let d = parse_decimal_digit(str_slice(raw, i, i + 1))
        if d >= 0 {
            value = value * 10 + d
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if neg { 0 - value } else { value }
}

fn parse_f64_basic(raw: string) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    let len = str_len(raw)
    if len <= 0 { return 0.0 }
    var i: i64 = 0
    var neg = false
    if str_eq(str_slice(raw, 0, 1), "-") {
        neg = true
        i = 1
    } else if str_eq(str_slice(raw, 0, 1), "+") {
        i = 1
    }
    var int_part: f64 = 0.0
    var frac_part: f64 = 0.0
    var frac_scale: f64 = 1.0
    var seen_dot = false
    while i < len {
        let ch = str_slice(raw, i, i + 1)
        if str_eq(ch, ".") {
            seen_dot = true
        } else {
            let d = parse_decimal_digit(ch)
            if d >= 0 {
                if !seen_dot {
                    int_part = int_part * 10.0 + (d as f64)
                } else {
                    frac_scale = frac_scale * 0.1
                    frac_part = frac_part + frac_scale * (d as f64)
                }
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    let value = int_part + frac_part
    if neg { 0.0 - value } else { value }
}

fn starts_with(s: string, prefix: string) -> bool with Mut, Div {
    let ns = str_len(s)
    let np = str_len(prefix)
    if np > ns { return false }
    str_eq(str_slice(s, 0, np), prefix)
}

fn hash_djb2(s: string) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let n = str_len(s)
    var h: i64 = 5381
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        h = h * 33 + str_char_at(s, i)
        i = i + 1
    }
    h
}

fn tsv_get_field(line: string, target_idx: i64) -> string with Mut, Div {
    let n = str_len(line)
    var field_idx: i64 = 0
    var field_start: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i <= n {
        let is_end = i == n
        let is_tab = if is_end { false } else { str_char_at(line, i) == 9 }
        if is_end || is_tab {
            if field_idx == target_idx {
                return str_slice(line, field_start, i)
            }
            field_idx = field_idx + 1
            field_start = i + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    ""
}

fn tsv_find_col(header: string, name: string) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let n = str_len(header)
    var idx: i64 = 0
    var start: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i <= n {
        let is_end = i == n
        let is_tab = if is_end { false } else { str_char_at(header, i) == 9 }
        if is_end || is_tab {
            let field = str_slice(header, start, i)
            if str_eq(field, name) { return idx }
            idx = idx + 1
            start = i + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    -1
}

fn clear_subject_site_slot(subj: i64) with Mut {
    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < 32 {
        SUBJECT_SITE_TEXT[(subj * 32 + j) as usize] = 0
        j = j + 1
    }
    SUBJECT_SITE_LEN[subj as usize] = 0
}

fn clear_feature_slot(subj: i64) with Mut {
    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < feature_cap() {
        FEATURES[(subj * feature_cap() + j) as usize] = 0.0
        j = j + 1
    }
}
