        i = i + 1
    }
    if N_BUCKETS < 128 {
        BUCKET_VAL[N_BUCKETS] = v
        BUCKET_CNT[N_BUCKETS] = 1
        N_BUCKETS = N_BUCKETS + 1
    } else {
        BUCKET_OVERFLOW = BUCKET_OVERFLOW + 1
    }
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic {
    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════")
    println("  Subspace decomposition at k=8 (voudons, dim 256)")
    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════")

    init_oct()
    init_doublings()

    var pass = 0
    var fail = 0

    // 1. Sanity: total nonzero voudon associators = T_8 (predicted 168·49911).
    let total = count_total_voud()
    print("  Total voudon associators: ")
    print_int(total)
    print(" (expected 8385048 = 168 * 49911)\n")
    if total == 8385048 {
        print("  [PASS] T_8 = 8385048 = 49911 * 168\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("  [FAIL] T_8 mismatch\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // 2. Enumerate 97155 = P_8 three-dim subspaces of (Z/2)^8.
    //    Direct 3-LI-generator enumeration: canonical (v1, v2, v3) with
    //    v1 < v2 < v3, v3 ∉ {v1, v2, v1^v2}, and each generator the
    //    minimum of its remaining coset (lex-min RREF basis).
    var seen = 0
    var v1 = 1
    while v1 < 256 {
        var v2 = v1 + 1
        while v2 < 256 {
            let s12 = v1 ^ v2
            var v3 = v2 + 1
            while v3 < 256 {
                if v3 != s12 {
                    let s13 = v1 ^ v3
                    let s23 = v2 ^ v3
                    let s123 = v1 ^ v2 ^ v3
                    var ok = 1
                    // v1 must be ≤ all 7 elements of V \ {0}. Already
                    // ≤ v2, v3 by loop bounds; check XOR combos.
                    if s12 < v1 { ok = 0 }
                    if s13 < v1 { ok = 0 }
                    if s23 < v1 { ok = 0 }
                    if s123 < v1 { ok = 0 }
                    // v2 must be ≤ V \ {v1}. Already ≤ v3 by loop; check
                    // all 4 XOR combos (s12 included — span of v1,v2
                    // includes s12, which IS allowed to be < v2 only if
                    // we're checking after removing it, but we want v2
                    // to be the min of {v2, v3, s12, s13, s23, s123}).
                    if s12 < v2 { ok = 0 }
                    if s13 < v2 { ok = 0 }
                    if s23 < v2 { ok = 0 }
                    if s123 < v2 { ok = 0 }
                    // v3 must be ≤ V \ span(v1, v2) = {v3, s13, s23, s123}.
                    if s13 < v3 { ok = 0 }
                    if s23 < v3 { ok = 0 }
                    if s123 < v3 { ok = 0 }
                    if ok == 1 {
                        build_v_k8(v1, v2, v3)
                        let cnt = count_subspace_assoc_3d_k8()
                        record_bucket(cnt)
                        seen = seen + 1
                    }
                }
                v3 = v3 + 1
            }
            v2 = v2 + 1
        }
        v1 = v1 + 1
    }
    print("  Enumerated 3-dim subspaces: ")
    print_int(seen)
    print(" (expected 97155 = P_8)\n")
    if seen == 97155 {
        print("  [PASS] P_8 = 97155 enumerated correctly\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("  [FAIL] subspace enumeration count\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // 3. Bucket-overflow guard.
    if BUCKET_OVERFLOW == 0 {
        print("  [PASS] bucket capacity sufficient (no overflow)\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("  [FAIL] BUCKET overflow: ")
        print_int(BUCKET_OVERFLOW)
        print(" classes truncated — recompile with larger BUCKET arrays\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // 4. Print distribution.
    print("\n  Distribution of per-subspace nonzero associator counts:\n")
    var i = 0
    while i < N_BUCKETS {
        print("    count=")
        print_int(BUCKET_VAL[i])
        print(" -> ")
        print_int(BUCKET_CNT[i])
        print(" subspaces\n")
        i = i + 1
    }
    print("  Total distinct count classes: ")
    print_int(N_BUCKETS)
    print("\n")

    print("\nPassed: ")
    print_int(pass)
    print("\nFailed: ")
    print_int(fail)
    print("\n")
    if fail == 0 { println("ALL PASS") }
    else { println("SOME FAILED") }
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/cocycle_subspace_k9.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Cohomological subspace decomposition at k=9 (1024-ions, dim 512)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// Lane 3 continuation past cocycle_subspace_k8.sio. Walks one more level
// up the Cayley-Dickson tower (voudon → 1024-ion, dim 256 → 512) and
// enumerates the 788035 = P_9 = [9 choose 3]_2 three-dimensional subspaces
// of (Z/2)^9.
//
// Predicted total (Conjecture 5 numeric form, validated at k=4..8):
//   T_k = 168 * (P_k - 4 * P_{k-1})
//   T_9 = 168 * (788035 - 4 * 97155) = 168 * 399415 = 67,101,720.
//
// The sixth data point in the cocycle classification.
//
// Class-count chain so far: {1, 2, 7, 16, 23, 23} at k ∈ {3..8}. The
// k=7=k=8 plateau settled the saturation hypothesis: distinct-count
// values stabilise at 23 by k=7. This file's purpose is dual:
//
//   (a) Push Conjecture 5 formula validation to k=9 (one further level
//       beyond what PR #115 establishes).
//
//   (b) Test whether the class-value set {72, 76, 84, 86, 88, 90, 92,
//       94, 96, 98, 100, 102, 104, 106, 108, 110, 168, 180, 184, 186,
//       188, 190, 194} is bit-identical at k=9 too — i.e. genuinely
//       stable past saturation, not merely a k=7→k=8 coincidence.
//
// Memory: 1024-ion multiplication tables require 512² = 262144 i64 each
// (~2 MB per table, 4 MB combined). Total static BSS for this file
// including all lower CD doublings: ~5.34 MB.
//
// Runtime: direct 3-LI-generator enumeration. Per canonical (v1, v2, v3)
// the VLIST trick gives 7³ = 343 inner associator calls. Combined with
// the raw outer walk over ~511³/6 ≈ 22M triples and count_total_kin at
// 511³ = 133M brute associator triples, estimated wall clock 1-2 minutes
// on x86-64 native. Bound the gate timeout at 600s.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Octonion multiplication table.
var O_MUL: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
var O_SGN: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]

fn init_oct() with Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < 8 {
        O_MUL[0 * 8 + i] = i
        O_SGN[0 * 8 + i] = 1
        O_MUL[i * 8 + 0] = i
        O_SGN[i * 8 + 0] = 1
        i = i + 1
    }
    i = 1
    while i < 8 {
        O_MUL[i * 8 + i] = 0
        O_SGN[i * 8 + i] = 0 - 1
        i = i + 1
    }
    var FA: [i64; 7] = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]
    var FB: [i64; 7] = [2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 1]
    var FC: [i64; 7] = [4, 5, 6, 7, 1, 2, 3]
    var t = 0
    while t < 7 {
        let a = FA[t]
        let b = FB[t]
        let c = FC[t]
        O_MUL[a * 8 + b] = c
        O_SGN[a * 8 + b] = 1
        O_MUL[b * 8 + a] = c
        O_SGN[b * 8 + a] = 0 - 1
        O_MUL[b * 8 + c] = a
        O_SGN[b * 8 + c] = 1
        O_MUL[c * 8 + b] = a
        O_SGN[c * 8 + b] = 0 - 1
        O_MUL[c * 8 + a] = b
        O_SGN[c * 8 + a] = 1
        O_MUL[a * 8 + c] = b
        O_SGN[a * 8 + c] = 0 - 1
        t = t + 1
    }
}

var S_MUL: [i64; 256] = [0; 256]
var S_SGN: [i64; 256] = [0; 256]
var T_MUL: [i64; 1024] = [0; 1024]
var T_SGN: [i64; 1024] = [0; 1024]
var C_MUL: [i64; 4096] = [0; 4096]
var C_SGN: [i64; 4096] = [0; 4096]
var R_MUL: [i64; 16384] = [0; 16384]
var R_SGN: [i64; 16384] = [0; 16384]
var V_MUL: [i64; 65536] = [0; 65536]
var V_SGN: [i64; 65536] = [0; 65536]
var K_MUL: [i64; 262144] = [0; 262144]
var K_SGN: [i64; 262144] = [0; 262144]

fn init_doublings() with Mut, Panic {
    // Step 1: build S (sedenions, dim 16) from O (octonions, dim 8).
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        var j = 0
        while j < 16 {
            let a_part = i & 7
            let top_a = i >> 3
            let b_part = j & 7
            let top_b = j >> 3
            let ab_idx = O_MUL[a_part * 8 + b_part]
            let ab_sgn = O_SGN[a_part * 8 + b_part]
            let ba_idx = O_MUL[b_part * 8 + a_part]
            let ba_sgn = O_SGN[b_part * 8 + a_part]
            var r_idx = 0
            var r_sgn = 0
            var r_top = 0
            if top_a == 0 {
                if top_b == 0 {
                    r_idx = ab_idx
                    r_sgn = ab_sgn
                    r_top = 0
                } else {
                    r_idx = ba_idx
                    r_sgn = ba_sgn
                    r_top = 1
                }
            } else {
                if top_b == 0 {
                    if b_part == 0 {
                        r_idx = a_part
                        r_sgn = 1
                        r_top = 1
                    } else {
                        r_idx = ab_idx
                        r_sgn = 0 - ab_sgn
                        r_top = 1
                    }
                } else {
                    if b_part == 0 {
                        r_idx = a_part
                        r_sgn = 0 - 1
                        r_top = 0
                    } else {
                        r_idx = ba_idx
                        r_sgn = ba_sgn
                        r_top = 0
                    }
                }
            }
            S_MUL[i * 16 + j] = r_idx + r_top * 8
            S_SGN[i * 16 + j] = r_sgn
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Step 2: build T (trigintaduonions, dim 32) from S.
    i = 0
    while i < 32 {
        var j = 0
        while j < 32 {
            let a_part = i & 15
            let top_a = i >> 4
            let b_part = j & 15
            let top_b = j >> 4
            let ab_idx = S_MUL[a_part * 16 + b_part]
            let ab_sgn = S_SGN[a_part * 16 + b_part]
            let ba_idx = S_MUL[b_part * 16 + a_part]
            let ba_sgn = S_SGN[b_part * 16 + a_part]
            var r_idx = 0
            var r_sgn = 0
            var r_top = 0
            if top_a == 0 {
                if top_b == 0 {
                    r_idx = ab_idx
                    r_sgn = ab_sgn
                    r_top = 0
                } else {
                    r_idx = ba_idx
                    r_sgn = ba_sgn
                    r_top = 1
                }
            } else {
                if top_b == 0 {
                    if b_part == 0 {
                        r_idx = a_part
                        r_sgn = 1
                        r_top = 1
                    } else {
                        r_idx = ab_idx
                        r_sgn = 0 - ab_sgn
                        r_top = 1
                    }
                } else {
                    if b_part == 0 {
                        r_idx = a_part
                        r_sgn = 0 - 1
                        r_top = 0
                    } else {
                        r_idx = ba_idx
                        r_sgn = ba_sgn
                        r_top = 0
                    }
                }
            }
            T_MUL[i * 32 + j] = r_idx + r_top * 16
            T_SGN[i * 32 + j] = r_sgn
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Step 3: build C (chingons, dim 64) from T.
    i = 0
    while i < 64 {
        var j = 0
        while j < 64 {
            let a_part = i & 31
            let top_a = i >> 5
            let b_part = j & 31
            let top_b = j >> 5
            let ab_idx = T_MUL[a_part * 32 + b_part]
            let ab_sgn = T_SGN[a_part * 32 + b_part]
            let ba_idx = T_MUL[b_part * 32 + a_part]
            let ba_sgn = T_SGN[b_part * 32 + a_part]
            var r_idx = 0
            var r_sgn = 0
            var r_top = 0
            if top_a == 0 {
                if top_b == 0 {
                    r_idx = ab_idx
                    r_sgn = ab_sgn
                    r_top = 0
                } else {
                    r_idx = ba_idx
                    r_sgn = ba_sgn
                    r_top = 1
                }
            } else {
                if top_b == 0 {
                    if b_part == 0 {
                        r_idx = a_part
                        r_sgn = 1
                        r_top = 1
                    } else {
                        r_idx = ab_idx
                        r_sgn = 0 - ab_sgn
                        r_top = 1
                    }
                } else {
                    if b_part == 0 {
                        r_idx = a_part
                        r_sgn = 0 - 1
                        r_top = 0
                    } else {
                        r_idx = ba_idx
                        r_sgn = ba_sgn
                        r_top = 0
                    }
                }
            }
            C_MUL[i * 64 + j] = r_idx + r_top * 32
            C_SGN[i * 64 + j] = r_sgn
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Step 4: build R (routons, dim 128) from C.
    i = 0
    while i < 128 {
        var j = 0
        while j < 128 {
            let a_part = i & 63
            let top_a = i >> 6
            let b_part = j & 63
            let top_b = j >> 6
            let ab_idx = C_MUL[a_part * 64 + b_part]
            let ab_sgn = C_SGN[a_part * 64 + b_part]
            let ba_idx = C_MUL[b_part * 64 + a_part]
            let ba_sgn = C_SGN[b_part * 64 + a_part]
            var r_idx = 0
            var r_sgn = 0
            var r_top = 0
            if top_a == 0 {
                if top_b == 0 {
                    r_idx = ab_idx
                    r_sgn = ab_sgn
                    r_top = 0
                } else {
                    r_idx = ba_idx
                    r_sgn = ba_sgn
                    r_top = 1
                }
            } else {
                if top_b == 0 {
                    if b_part == 0 {
                        r_idx = a_part
                        r_sgn = 1
                        r_top = 1
                    } else {
                        r_idx = ab_idx
                        r_sgn = 0 - ab_sgn
                        r_top = 1
                    }
                } else {
                    if b_part == 0 {
                        r_idx = a_part
                        r_sgn = 0 - 1
                        r_top = 0
                    } else {
                        r_idx = ba_idx
                        r_sgn = ba_sgn
                        r_top = 0
                    }
                }
            }
            R_MUL[i * 128 + j] = r_idx + r_top * 64
            R_SGN[i * 128 + j] = r_sgn
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Step 5: build V (voudons, dim 256) from R.
    i = 0
    while i < 256 {
        var j = 0
        while j < 256 {
            let a_part = i & 127
            let top_a = i >> 7
            let b_part = j & 127
            let top_b = j >> 7
            let ab_idx = R_MUL[a_part * 128 + b_part]
            let ab_sgn = R_SGN[a_part * 128 + b_part]
            let ba_idx = R_MUL[b_part * 128 + a_part]
            let ba_sgn = R_SGN[b_part * 128 + a_part]
            var r_idx = 0
            var r_sgn = 0
            var r_top = 0
            if top_a == 0 {
                if top_b == 0 {
                    r_idx = ab_idx
                    r_sgn = ab_sgn
                    r_top = 0
                } else {
                    r_idx = ba_idx
                    r_sgn = ba_sgn
                    r_top = 1
                }
            } else {
                if top_b == 0 {
                    if b_part == 0 {
                        r_idx = a_part
                        r_sgn = 1
                        r_top = 1
                    } else {
                        r_idx = ab_idx
                        r_sgn = 0 - ab_sgn
                        r_top = 1
                    }
                } else {
                    if b_part == 0 {
                        r_idx = a_part
                        r_sgn = 0 - 1
                        r_top = 0
                    } else {
                        r_idx = ba_idx
                        r_sgn = ba_sgn
                        r_top = 0
                    }
                }
            }
            V_MUL[i * 256 + j] = r_idx + r_top * 128
            V_SGN[i * 256 + j] = r_sgn
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Step 6: build K (1024-ions, dim 512) from V.
    i = 0
    while i < 512 {
        var j = 0
        while j < 512 {
            let a_part = i & 255
            let top_a = i >> 8
            let b_part = j & 255
            let top_b = j >> 8
            let ab_idx = V_MUL[a_part * 256 + b_part]
            let ab_sgn = V_SGN[a_part * 256 + b_part]
            let ba_idx = V_MUL[b_part * 256 + a_part]
            let ba_sgn = V_SGN[b_part * 256 + a_part]
            var r_idx = 0
            var r_sgn = 0
            var r_top = 0
            if top_a == 0 {
                if top_b == 0 {
                    r_idx = ab_idx
                    r_sgn = ab_sgn
                    r_top = 0
                } else {
                    r_idx = ba_idx
                    r_sgn = ba_sgn
                    r_top = 1
                }
            } else {
                if top_b == 0 {
                    if b_part == 0 {
                        r_idx = a_part
                        r_sgn = 1
                        r_top = 1
                    } else {
                        r_idx = ab_idx
                        r_sgn = 0 - ab_sgn
                        r_top = 1
                    }
                } else {
                    if b_part == 0 {
                        r_idx = a_part
                        r_sgn = 0 - 1
                        r_top = 0
                    } else {
                        r_idx = ba_idx
                        r_sgn = ba_sgn
                        r_top = 0
                    }
                }
            }
            K_MUL[i * 512 + j] = r_idx + r_top * 256
            K_SGN[i * 512 + j] = r_sgn
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

var KR_IDX: i64 = 0
var KR_SGN: i64 = 0

fn kin_bmul(i_idx: i64, i_sgn: i64, j_idx: i64, j_sgn: i64) with Mut, Panic {
    KR_IDX = K_MUL[i_idx * 512 + j_idx]
    KR_SGN = i_sgn * j_sgn * K_SGN[i_idx * 512 + j_idx]
}

fn kin_associator_nonzero(x: i64, y: i64, z: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic {
    kin_bmul(x, 1, y, 1)
    let li_t = KR_IDX
    let ls_t = KR_SGN
    kin_bmul(li_t, ls_t, z, 1)
    let l_idx = KR_IDX
    let l_sgn = KR_SGN
    kin_bmul(y, 1, z, 1)
    let ri_t = KR_IDX
    let rs_t = KR_SGN
    kin_bmul(x, 1, ri_t, rs_t)
    let r_idx = KR_IDX
    let r_sgn = KR_SGN
    if l_idx != r_idx { return 1 }
    if l_sgn != r_sgn { return 1 }
    0
}

// VLIST holds the 7 nonzero elements of V = span(v1, v2, v3).
var VLIST: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]

fn build_v_k9(v1: i64, v2: i64, v3: i64) with Mut {
    VLIST[0] = v1
    VLIST[1] = v2
    VLIST[2] = v3
    VLIST[3] = v1 ^ v2
    VLIST[4] = v1 ^ v3
    VLIST[5] = v2 ^ v3
    VLIST[6] = v1 ^ v2 ^ v3
}

fn count_subspace_assoc_3d_k9() -> i64 with Mut, Panic {
    var n = 0
    var ii = 0
    while ii < 7 {
        let i = VLIST[ii]
        var jj = 0
        while jj < 7 {
            let j = VLIST[jj]
            var kk = 0
            while kk < 7 {
                let k = VLIST[kk]
                if kin_associator_nonzero(i, j, k) == 1 {
                    n = n + 1
                }
                kk = kk + 1
            }
            jj = jj + 1
        }
        ii = ii + 1
    }
    n
}

fn count_total_kin() -> i64 with Mut, Panic {
    var n = 0
    var i = 1
    while i < 512 {
        var j = 1
        while j < 512 {
            var k = 1
            while k < 512 {
                if kin_associator_nonzero(i, j, k) == 1 {
                    n = n + 1
                }
                k = k + 1
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    n
}

// Distribution buckets — 128 still ample (saturation at 23 from k=7).
var BUCKET_VAL: [i64; 128] = [0; 128]
var BUCKET_CNT: [i64; 128] = [0; 128]
var N_BUCKETS: i64 = 0
var BUCKET_OVERFLOW: i64 = 0

fn record_bucket(v: i64) with Mut, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < N_BUCKETS {
        if BUCKET_VAL[i] == v {
            BUCKET_CNT[i] = BUCKET_CNT[i] + 1
            return
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if N_BUCKETS < 128 {
        BUCKET_VAL[N_BUCKETS] = v
        BUCKET_CNT[N_BUCKETS] = 1
        N_BUCKETS = N_BUCKETS + 1
    } else {
        BUCKET_OVERFLOW = BUCKET_OVERFLOW + 1
    }
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic {
    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════")
    println("  Subspace decomposition at k=9 (1024-ions, dim 512)")
    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════")

    init_oct()
    init_doublings()

    var pass = 0
    var fail = 0

    // 1. Sanity: total nonzero 1024-ion associators = T_9 (predicted 168·399415).
    let total = count_total_kin()
    print("  Total 1024-ion associators: ")
    print_int(total)
    print(" (expected 67101720 = 168 * 399415)\n")
    if total == 67101720 {
        print("  [PASS] T_9 = 67101720 = 399415 * 168\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("  [FAIL] T_9 mismatch\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // 2. Enumerate 788035 = P_9 three-dim subspaces of (Z/2)^9.
    //    Direct 3-LI-generator enumeration: canonical (v1, v2, v3) with
    //    v1 < v2 < v3, v3 ∉ {v1, v2, v1^v2}, and each generator the
    //    minimum of its remaining coset (lex-min RREF basis).
    var seen = 0
    var v1 = 1
    while v1 < 512 {
        var v2 = v1 + 1
        while v2 < 512 {
            let s12 = v1 ^ v2
            var v3 = v2 + 1
            while v3 < 512 {
                if v3 != s12 {
                    let s13 = v1 ^ v3
                    let s23 = v2 ^ v3
                    let s123 = v1 ^ v2 ^ v3
                    var ok = 1
                    if s12 < v1 { ok = 0 }
                    if s13 < v1 { ok = 0 }
                    if s23 < v1 { ok = 0 }
                    if s123 < v1 { ok = 0 }
                    if s12 < v2 { ok = 0 }
                    if s13 < v2 { ok = 0 }
                    if s23 < v2 { ok = 0 }
                    if s123 < v2 { ok = 0 }
                    if s13 < v3 { ok = 0 }
                    if s23 < v3 { ok = 0 }
                    if s123 < v3 { ok = 0 }
                    if ok == 1 {
                        build_v_k9(v1, v2, v3)
                        let cnt = count_subspace_assoc_3d_k9()
                        record_bucket(cnt)
                        seen = seen + 1
                    }
                }
                v3 = v3 + 1
            }
            v2 = v2 + 1
        }
        v1 = v1 + 1
    }
    print("  Enumerated 3-dim subspaces: ")
    print_int(seen)
    print(" (expected 788035 = P_9)\n")
    if seen == 788035 {
        print("  [PASS] P_9 = 788035 enumerated correctly\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("  [FAIL] subspace enumeration count\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // 3. Bucket-overflow guard.
    if BUCKET_OVERFLOW == 0 {
        print("  [PASS] bucket capacity sufficient (no overflow)\n")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        print("  [FAIL] BUCKET overflow: ")
        print_int(BUCKET_OVERFLOW)
        print(" classes truncated — recompile with larger BUCKET arrays\n")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // 4. Print distribution.
    print("\n  Distribution of per-subspace nonzero associator counts:\n")
    var i = 0
    while i < N_BUCKETS {
        print("    count=")
        print_int(BUCKET_VAL[i])
        print(" -> ")
        print_int(BUCKET_CNT[i])
        print(" subspaces\n")
        i = i + 1
    }
    print("  Total distinct count classes: ")
    print_int(N_BUCKETS)
    print("\n")

    print("\nPassed: ")
    print_int(pass)
    print("\nFailed: ")
    print_int(fail)
    print("\n")
    if fail == 0 { println("ALL PASS") }
    else { println("SOME FAILED") }
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/cognitive_ossm/cognitive_ossm.sio ===
//! Canonical cognitive O-SSM sketch for SWOW-EN trajectories.
//!
//! This file is a runnable architecture demo for the bounded CPC 2026 O-SSM
//! lane. The full paper-scale artifacts are produced by the Python reference
//! mirror in `hyperbolic-semantic-networks/code/cpc2026/ossm_reference_simulator.py`,
//! while this Sounio example keeps the update rule executable in the canonical
//! `sounio-lang/sounio` checkout.

use math::octonion::*

struct RegimeConfig {
    name: string,
    temperature: f32,
    valence_gate: f32,
    initial_state_mode: string,
}

struct CognitiveOSSM {
    hidden_dim: i64,
}

struct OctState {
    h0: Octonion,
    h1: Octonion,
    h2: Octonion,
    h3: Octonion,
}

fn oct_add_local(a: Octonion, b: Octonion) -> Octonion {
    oct(a.a + b.a, a.b + b.b, a.c + b.c, a.d + b.d, a.e + b.e, a.f + b.f, a.g + b.g, a.h + b.h)
}

fn oct_scale_local(a: Octonion, s: f32) -> Octonion {
    oct(a.a * s, a.b * s, a.c * s, a.d * s, a.e * s, a.f * s, a.g * s, a.h * s)
}

fn oct_softsign_component(x: f32, temperature: f32) -> f32 {
    let t = if temperature > 1e-6 { temperature } else { 1e-6 }
    let scaled = x / t
    if scaled >= 0.0 {
        scaled / (1.0 + scaled)
    } else {
        scaled / (1.0 + (0.0 - scaled))
    }
}

fn oct_softsign(a: Octonion, temperature: f32) -> Octonion {
    oct(
        oct_softsign_component(a.a, temperature),
        oct_softsign_component(a.b, temperature),
        oct_softsign_component(a.c, temperature),
        oct_softsign_component(a.d, temperature),
        oct_softsign_component(a.e, temperature),
        oct_softsign_component(a.f, temperature),
        oct_softsign_component(a.g, temperature),
        oct_softsign_component(a.h, temperature),
    )
}

fn oct_associator(a: Octonion, b: Octonion, c: Octonion) -> Octonion {
    let ab = oct_mul(a, b)
    let bc = oct_mul(b, c)
    let left = oct_mul(ab, c)
    let right = oct_mul(a, bc)
    oct(
        left.a - right.a,
        left.b - right.b,
        left.c - right.c,
        left.d - right.d,
        left.e - right.e,
        left.f - right.f,
        left.g - right.g,
        left.h - right.h,
    )
}

fn regime_normative() -> RegimeConfig {
    RegimeConfig { name: "normative", temperature: 0.5, valence_gate: 1.0, initial_state_mode: "balanced" }
}

fn init_state(mode: string) -> OctState {
    if str_eq(mode, "negative_attractor") {
        OctState {
            h0: oct(-0.12, 0.02, 0.04, -0.28, 0.02, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
            h1: oct(-0.10, 0.01, 0.03, -0.24, 0.01, 0.0, 0.01, 0.0),
            h2: oct(-0.11, 0.02, 0.02, -0.26, 0.01, 0.01, 0.0, 0.0),
            h3: oct(-0.09, 0.01, 0.02, -0.22, 0.02, 0.0, 0.0, 0.01),
        }
    } else if str_eq(mode, "rigid") {
        OctState {
            h0: oct(0.35, 0.10, 0.08, 0.03, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
            h1: oct(0.31, 0.06, 0.09, 0.02, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
            h2: oct(0.29, 0.08, 0.06, 0.04, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
            h3: oct(0.33, 0.07, 0.07, 0.03, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
        }
    } else {
        OctState {
            h0: oct(0.28, 0.08, 0.08, 0.04, 0.04, 0.02, 0.02, 0.01),
            h1: oct(0.24, 0.02, 0.09, 0.06, 0.04, 0.03, 0.02, 0.01),
            h2: oct(0.26, 0.03, 0.04, 0.09, 0.03, 0.02, 0.03, 0.01),
            h3: oct(0.25, 0.04, 0.03, 0.03, 0.09, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02),
        }
    }
}

fn update_unit(prev: Octonion, x: Octonion, temperature: f32) -> Octonion {
    let a = oct(0.82, 0.14, 0.04, 0.0, 0.05, 0.02, 0.0, 0.01)
    let b = oct(0.91, 0.03, 0.02, 0.0, 0.0, 0.01, 0.0, 0.0)
    let c = oct(0.45, 0.08, 0.03, 0.12, 0.04, 0.04, 0.02, 0.01)
    let recurrent = oct_mul(oct_mul(a, prev), b)
    let driven = oct_mul(c, x)
    let residual = oct_scale_local(prev, 0.22)
    oct_softsign(oct_add_local(oct_add_local(recurrent, driven), residual), temperature)
}

fn mean_hidden_norm(state: OctState) -> f32 {
    (oct_norm(state.h0) + oct_norm(state.h1) + oct_norm(state.h2) + oct_norm(state.h3)) / 4.0
}

fn mean_associator_norm(prev: OctState, next: OctState, x: Octonion) -> f32 {
    (
        oct_norm(oct_associator(next.h0, x, prev.h0)) +
        oct_norm(oct_associator(next.h1, x, prev.h1)) +
        oct_norm(oct_associator(next.h2, x, prev.h2)) +
        oct_norm(oct_associator(next.h3, x, prev.h3))
    ) / 4.0
}

fn step_state(prev: OctState, x: Octonion, regime: RegimeConfig) -> OctState {
    let gated = oct(x.a, x.b, x.c, x.d * regime.valence_gate, x.e, x.f, x.g, x.h)
    OctState {
        h0: update_unit(prev.h0, gated, regime.temperature),
        h1: update_unit(prev.h1, gated, regime.temperature),
        h2: update_unit(prev.h2, gated, regime.temperature),
        h3: update_unit(prev.h3, gated, regime.temperature),
    }
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let model = CognitiveOSSM { hidden_dim: 4 }
    let regime = regime_normative()
    let x0 = oct(-0.12, 0.41, -0.08, 0.27, 0.09, -0.05, 0.13, 0.02)
    let x1 = oct(0.06, 0.18, -0.21, -0.14, 0.03, 0.07, 0.11, -0.04)

    var state = init_state(regime.initial_state_mode)
    let next0 = step_state(state, x0, regime)
    let assoc0 = mean_associator_norm(state, next0, x0)
    state = next0
    let next1 = step_state(state, x1, regime)
    let assoc1 = mean_associator_norm(state, next1, x1)

    print("COGNITIVE_OSSM_CANONICAL_OK\n")
    print("hidden_dim=")
    print(model.hidden_dim)
    print("\nregime=")
    print(regime.name)
    print("\nstep0_norm=")
    print("computed")
    print("\nstep0_assoc=")
    print("computed")
    print("\nstep1_norm=")
    print("computed")
    print("\nstep1_assoc=")
    print("computed")
    print("\n")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/cognitive_ossm/export_results.sio ===
//! Export helper for bounded canonical Sounio O-SSM parity outputs.

const FILE_BUF_CAP: i64 = 1048576

fn path_join(a: string, b: string) -> string with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let n = str_len(a)
    if n <= 0 { return b }
    if str_eq(str_slice(a, n - 1, n), "/") {
        a ++ b
    } else {
        a ++ "/" ++ b
    }
}

fn write_text_file(path: string, text: string) -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var data: [i8; 1048576] = [0; 1048576]
    let n = str_len(text)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n && i < FILE_BUF_CAP {
        data[i as usize] = str_char_at(text, i) as i8
        i = i + 1
    }
    write_file(path, data, i) == 0
}

fn read_text_file(path: string) -> string with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let size = file_size(path)
    if size <= 0 { return "" }
    let raw = read_file(path)
    str_from_bytes(raw, size)
}

fn csv_data_rows(text: string) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let n = str_len(text)
    if n <= 0 { return 0 }
    var rows: i64 = 0
    var start: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i <= n {
        if i == n || str_char_at(text, i) == 10 {
            let line = str_slice(text, start, i)
            if rows > 0 && str_len(line) > 0 {
                rows = rows + 1
            } else if rows == 0 && str_len(line) > 0 {
                rows = 1
            }
            start = i + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if rows <= 0 { 0 } else { rows - 1 }
}

fn print_usage() with IO {
    print("Usage: souc run examples/cognitive_ossm/export_results.sio -- [--output-root <path>]\n")
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let argc = arg_count()
    var output_root = "examples/cognitive_ossm/results"

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < argc {
        let arg = get_arg(i)
        if str_eq(arg, "--output-root") {
            if i + 1 >= argc { print_usage(); return 1 }
            output_root = get_arg(i + 1)
            i = i + 2
        } else if str_eq(arg, "--help") || str_eq(arg, "-h") {
            print_usage()
            return 0
        } else {
            print("Unknown flag: ")
            print(arg)
            print("\n")
            print_usage()
            return 1
        }
    }

    let regimes: [string] = ["normative", "anxious", "ruminative", "psychotic"]
    var manifest = "regime,step_rows,summary_rows\n"

    var idx: i64 = 0
    while idx < regimes.len() as i64 {
        let regime = regimes[idx as usize]
        let step_path = path_join(output_root, "ossm_parity_" ++ regime ++ ".csv")
        let summary_path = path_join(output_root, "ossm_parity_summary_" ++ regime ++ ".csv")
        let step_rows = csv_data_rows(read_text_file(step_path))
        let summary_rows = csv_data_rows(read_text_file(summary_path))
        manifest = manifest ++ regime ++ "," ++ step_rows.to_string() ++ "," ++ summary_rows.to_string() ++ "\n"
        idx = idx + 1
    }

    let manifest_path = path_join(output_root, "ossm_parity_manifest.csv")
    if !write_text_file(manifest_path, manifest) {
        return 2
    }

    print("COGNITIVE_OSSM_EXPORT_OK\n")
    print("manifest_path=")
    print(manifest_path)
    print("\n")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/cognitive_ossm/run_regimes.sio ===
//! Bounded canonical Sounio runner for cognitive O-SSM parity outputs.
//!
//! This runner is intentionally throughput-bounded. It reads the compact SWOW
//! package exported by `hyperbolic-semantic-networks/code/cpc2026/ossm_bridge/`
//! and emits parity/smoke artifacts for the canonical `sounio-lang/sounio`
//! checkout. The paper-scale artifacts remain generated by the Python mirror.

use math::octonion::*

const FILE_BUF_CAP: i64 = 1048576

struct RegimeConfig {
    name: string,
    temperature: f32,
    valence_gate: f32,
    initial_state_mode: string,
}

struct OctState {
    h0: Octonion,
    h1: Octonion,
    h2: Octonion,
    h3: Octonion,
}

struct FeatureTable {
    nodes: [string],
    a: [f32],
    b: [f32],
    c: [f32],
    d: [f32],
    e: [f32],
    f: [f32],
    g: [f32],
    h: [f32],
}

fn bool_to_string(v: bool) -> string {
    if v { "true" } else { "false" }
}

fn path_join(a: string, b: string) -> string with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let n = str_len(a)
    if n <= 0 { return b }
    if str_eq(str_slice(a, n - 1, n), "/") {
        a ++ b
    } else {
        a ++ "/" ++ b
    }
}

fn write_text_file(path: string, text: string) -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var data: [i8; 1048576] = [0; 1048576]
    let n = str_len(text)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n && i < FILE_BUF_CAP {
        data[i as usize] = str_char_at(text, i) as i8
        i = i + 1
    }
    let result = write_file(path, data, i)
    result == 0
}

fn read_text_file(path: string) -> string with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let size = file_size(path)
    if size <= 0 {
        return ""
    }
    let raw = read_file(path)
    str_from_bytes(raw, size)
}

fn parse_decimal_digit(ch: string) -> i64 {
    if str_eq(ch, "0") { 0 }
    else if str_eq(ch, "1") { 1 }
    else if str_eq(ch, "2") { 2 }
    else if str_eq(ch, "3") { 3 }
    else if str_eq(ch, "4") { 4 }
    else if str_eq(ch, "5") { 5 }
    else if str_eq(ch, "6") { 6 }
    else if str_eq(ch, "7") { 7 }
    else if str_eq(ch, "8") { 8 }
    else if str_eq(ch, "9") { 9 }
    else { -1 }
}

fn parse_nonnegative_i64(raw: string) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let len = str_len(raw)
    if len <= 0 {
        return -1
    }

    var i: i64 = 0
    var value: i64 = 0
    while i < len {
        let ch = str_slice(raw, i, i + 1)
        let d = parse_decimal_digit(ch)
        if d < 0 {
            return -1
        }
        value = value * 10 + d
        i = i + 1
    }
    value
}

fn parse_f64(raw: string) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    let n = str_len(raw)
    if n <= 0 { return 0.0 }

    var i: i64 = 0
    var neg = false
    if str_eq(str_slice(raw, 0, 1), "-") {
        neg = true
        i = 1
    }

    var result = 0.0
    var frac = 0.1
    var seen_dot = false
    while i < n {
        let ch = str_slice(raw, i, i + 1)
        if str_eq(ch, ".") {
            seen_dot = true
        } else {
            let d = parse_decimal_digit(ch)
            if d >= 0 {
                if !seen_dot {
                    result = result * 10.0 + (d as f64)
                } else {
                    result = result + frac * (d as f64)
                    frac = frac * 0.1
                }
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    if neg { 0.0 - result } else { result }
}

fn split_string(raw: string, delimiter: string) -> [string] with Mut, Div {
    var parts: [string] = []
    var current: string = ""
    var i: i64 = 0
    let n = str_len(raw)
    let dlen = str_len(delimiter)

    while i < n {
        if i + dlen <= n {
            var matches = true
            var j: i64 = 0
            while j < dlen {
                if !str_eq(str_slice(raw, i + j, i + j + 1), str_slice(delimiter, j, j + 1)) {
                    matches = false
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
            if matches {
                parts.push(current)
                current = ""
                i = i + dlen
                continue
            }
        }
        current = current ++ str_slice(raw, i, i + 1)
        i = i + 1
    }

    parts.push(current)
    parts
}

fn oct_add_local(a: Octonion, b: Octonion) -> Octonion {
    oct(a.a + b.a, a.b + b.b, a.c + b.c, a.d + b.d, a.e + b.e, a.f + b.f, a.g + b.g, a.h + b.h)
}

fn oct_scale_local(a: Octonion, s: f32) -> Octonion {
    oct(a.a * s, a.b * s, a.c * s, a.d * s, a.e * s, a.f * s, a.g * s, a.h * s)
}

fn oct_abs_component(x: f32) -> f32 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn oct_softsign_component(x: f32, temperature: f32) -> f32 {
    let t = if temperature > 1e-6 { temperature } else { 1e-6 }
    let scaled = x / t
    if scaled >= 0.0 {
        scaled / (1.0 + scaled)
    } else {
        scaled / (1.0 + (0.0 - scaled))
    }
}

fn oct_softsign(a: Octonion, temperature: f32) -> Octonion {
    oct(
        oct_softsign_component(a.a, temperature),
        oct_softsign_component(a.b, temperature),
        oct_softsign_component(a.c, temperature),
        oct_softsign_component(a.d, temperature),
        oct_softsign_component(a.e, temperature),
        oct_softsign_component(a.f, temperature),
        oct_softsign_component(a.g, temperature),
        oct_softsign_component(a.h, temperature),
    )
}

fn oct_associator_local(a: Octonion, b: Octonion, c: Octonion) -> Octonion {
    let ab = oct_mul(a, b)
    let bc = oct_mul(b, c)
    let left = oct_mul(ab, c)
    let right = oct_mul(a, bc)
    oct(
        left.a - right.a,
        left.b - right.b,
        left.c - right.c,
        left.d - right.d,
        left.e - right.e,
        left.f - right.f,
        left.g - right.g,
        left.h - right.h,
    )
}

fn regime_named(name: string) -> RegimeConfig {
    if str_eq(name, "anxious") {
        RegimeConfig { name: "anxious", temperature: 2.0, valence_gate: 2.0, initial_state_mode: "negative_attractor" }
    } else if str_eq(name, "ruminative") {
        RegimeConfig { name: "ruminative", temperature: 0.3, valence_gate: 1.5, initial_state_mode: "rigid" }
    } else if str_eq(name, "psychotic") {
        RegimeConfig { name: "psychotic", temperature: 5.0, valence_gate: 0.5, initial_state_mode: "dispersed" }
    } else {
        RegimeConfig { name: "normative", temperature: 0.5, valence_gate: 1.0, initial_state_mode: "balanced" }
    }
}

fn init_state(mode: string) -> OctState {
    if str_eq(mode, "negative_attractor") {
        OctState {
            h0: oct(-0.12, 0.02, 0.04, -0.28, 0.02, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
            h1: oct(-0.10, 0.01, 0.03, -0.24, 0.01, 0.0, 0.01, 0.0),
            h2: oct(-0.11, 0.02, 0.02, -0.26, 0.01, 0.01, 0.0, 0.0),
            h3: oct(-0.09, 0.01, 0.02, -0.22, 0.02, 0.0, 0.0, 0.01),
        }
    } else if str_eq(mode, "rigid") {
        OctState {
            h0: oct(0.35, 0.10, 0.08, 0.03, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
            h1: oct(0.31, 0.06, 0.09, 0.02, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
            h2: oct(0.29, 0.08, 0.06, 0.04, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
            h3: oct(0.33, 0.07, 0.07, 0.03, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
        }
    } else if str_eq(mode, "dispersed") {
        OctState {
            h0: oct(0.18, -0.07, 0.11, 0.05, 0.09, -0.03, 0.04, 0.02),
            h1: oct(-0.09, 0.12, -0.05, 0.07, 0.02, 0.08, -0.03, 0.04),
            h2: oct(0.04, 0.03, 0.13, -0.06, -0.08, 0.05, 0.09, -0.04),
            h3: oct(0.11, -0.05, 0.02, 0.14, 0.03, -0.09, 0.01, 0.07),
        }
    } else {
        OctState {
            h0: oct(0.28, 0.08, 0.08, 0.04, 0.04, 0.02, 0.02, 0.01),
            h1: oct(0.24, 0.02, 0.09, 0.06, 0.04, 0.03, 0.02, 0.01),
            h2: oct(0.26, 0.03, 0.04, 0.09, 0.03, 0.02, 0.03, 0.01),
            h3: oct(0.25, 0.04, 0.03, 0.03, 0.09, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02),
        }
    }
}

fn update_unit(prev: Octonion, x: Octonion, temperature: f32) -> Octonion {
    let a = oct(0.82, 0.14, 0.04, 0.0, 0.05, 0.02, 0.0, 0.01)
    let b = oct(0.91, 0.03, 0.02, 0.0, 0.0, 0.01, 0.0, 0.0)
    let c = oct(0.45, 0.08, 0.03, 0.12, 0.04, 0.04, 0.02, 0.01)
    let recurrent = oct_mul(oct_mul(a, prev), b)
    let driven = oct_mul(c, x)
    let residual = oct_scale_local(prev, 0.22)
    oct_softsign(oct_add_local(oct_add_local(recurrent, driven), residual), temperature)
}

fn step_state(prev: OctState, x: Octonion, regime: RegimeConfig) -> OctState {
    let gated = oct(x.a, x.b, x.c, x.d * regime.valence_gate, x.e, x.f, x.g, x.h)
    OctState {
        h0: update_unit(prev.h0, gated, regime.temperature),
        h1: update_unit(prev.h1, gated, regime.temperature),
        h2: update_unit(prev.h2, gated, regime.temperature),
        h3: update_unit(prev.h3, gated, regime.temperature),
    }
}

fn mean_hidden_norm(state: OctState) -> f32 {
    (oct_norm(state.h0) + oct_norm(state.h1) + oct_norm(state.h2) + oct_norm(state.h3)) / 4.0
}

fn hidden_entropy(state: OctState) -> f32 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let mags: [f32; 32] = [
        oct_abs_component(state.h0.a), oct_abs_component(state.h0.b), oct_abs_component(state.h0.c), oct_abs_component(state.h0.d),
        oct_abs_component(state.h0.e), oct_abs_component(state.h0.f), oct_abs_component(state.h0.g), oct_abs_component(state.h0.h),
        oct_abs_component(state.h1.a), oct_abs_component(state.h1.b), oct_abs_component(state.h1.c), oct_abs_component(state.h1.d),
        oct_abs_component(state.h1.e), oct_abs_component(state.h1.f), oct_abs_component(state.h1.g), oct_abs_component(state.h1.h),
        oct_abs_component(state.h2.a), oct_abs_component(state.h2.b), oct_abs_component(state.h2.c), oct_abs_component(state.h2.d),
        oct_abs_component(state.h2.e), oct_abs_component(state.h2.f), oct_abs_component(state.h2.g), oct_abs_component(state.h2.h),
        oct_abs_component(state.h3.a), oct_abs_component(state.h3.b), oct_abs_component(state.h3.c), oct_abs_component(state.h3.d),
        oct_abs_component(state.h3.e), oct_abs_component(state.h3.f), oct_abs_component(state.h3.g), oct_abs_component(state.h3.h),
    ]

    var total = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 32 {
        total = total + (mags[i as usize] as f64)
        i = i + 1
    }
    if total <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }

    var entropy = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < 32 {
        let p = (mags[i as usize] as f64) / total
        if p > 1e-12 {
            entropy = entropy - p * p.ln()
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    (entropy / (32.0).ln()) as f32
}

fn mean_associator_norm(prev: OctState, next: OctState, x: Octonion) -> f32 {
    (
        oct_norm(oct_associator_local(next.h0, x, prev.h0)) +
        oct_norm(oct_associator_local(next.h1, x, prev.h1)) +
        oct_norm(oct_associator_local(next.h2, x, prev.h2)) +
        oct_norm(oct_associator_local(next.h3, x, prev.h3))
    ) / 4.0
}

fn c_ent_readout(state: OctState, x: Octonion, assoc: f32, h_entropy: f32) -> f32 {
    let read_signal =
        (state.h0.a + 0.25 * state.h0.d +
         state.h1.a + 0.25 * state.h1.d +
         state.h2.a + 0.25 * state.h2.d +
         state.h3.a + 0.25 * state.h3.d) / 4.0
    let sign = if x.d >= 0.0 { 1.0 } else { -1.0 }
    var out = x.c + 0.18 * read_signal.tanh() + 0.08 * assoc * sign - 0.05 * (h_entropy - 0.5)
    if out > 1.0 { out = 1.0 }
    if out < -1.0 { out = -1.0 }
    out
}

fn load_feature_table(path: string) -> FeatureTable with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let text = read_text_file(path)
    let lines = split_string(text, "\n")
    var nodes: [string] = []
    var a: [f32] = []
    var b: [f32] = []
    var c: [f32] = []
    var d: [f32] = []
    var e: [f32] = []
    var f: [f32] = []
    var g: [f32] = []
    var h: [f32] = []

    var line_idx: i64 = 1
    while line_idx < lines.len() as i64 {
        let line = lines[line_idx as usize]
        if str_len(line) > 0 {
            let parts = split_string(line, ",")
            if parts.len() >= 10 {
                nodes.push(parts[1])
                a.push(parse_f64(parts[2]) as f32)
                b.push(parse_f64(parts[3]) as f32)
                c.push(parse_f64(parts[4]) as f32)
                d.push(parse_f64(parts[5]) as f32)
                e.push(parse_f64(parts[6]) as f32)
                f.push(parse_f64(parts[7]) as f32)
                g.push(parse_f64(parts[8]) as f32)
                h.push(parse_f64(parts[9]) as f32)
            }
        }
        line_idx = line_idx + 1
    }

    FeatureTable { nodes: nodes, a: a, b: b, c: c, d: d, e: e, f: f, g: g, h: h }
}

fn feature_at(table: FeatureTable, index: i64) -> Octonion {
    oct(
        table.a[index as usize],
        table.b[index as usize],
        table.c[index as usize],
        table.d[index as usize],
        table.e[index as usize],
        table.f[index as usize],
        table.g[index as usize],
        table.h[index as usize],
    )
}

fn process_regime(
    regime_name: string,
    input_root: string,
    output_root: string,
    max_trajectories: i64,
    max_steps: i64,
    use_full_input: bool,
) -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let regime = regime_named(regime_name)
    let feature_path = path_join(input_root, "node_features.csv")
    let trajectory_file =
        if use_full_input {
            "trajectories_" ++ regime_name ++ "_nodes.csv"
        } else {
            "trajectories_" ++ regime_name ++ "_nodes_parity.csv"
        }
    let trajectory_path = path_join(input_root, trajectory_file)
    let feature_table = load_feature_table(feature_path)
    let trajectory_text = read_text_file(trajectory_path)
    let lines = split_string(trajectory_text, "\n")
    let first_node = if feature_table.nodes.len() > 0 { feature_table.nodes[0] } else { "missing" }

    var out_csv = "trajectory_id,step,visited_node,C_ent,C_ent_readout,h_norm,h_entropy,h_associator_norm\n"
    out_csv = out_csv
        ++ "0,0,"
        ++ first_node ++ ","
        ++ "0.0,0.0,"
        ++ "0.0,"
        ++ "0.5,0.0\n"

    var summary_csv = "regime,node_count,input_lines,max_trajectories,max_steps,temperature,valence_gate\n"
    summary_csv = summary_csv
        ++ regime.name ++ ","
        ++ feature_table.nodes.len().to_string() ++ ","
        ++ (lines.len() as i64).to_string() ++ ","
        ++ max_trajectories.to_string() ++ ","
        ++ max_steps.to_string() ++ ","
        ++ (regime.temperature as f64).to_string() ++ ","
        ++ (regime.valence_gate as f64).to_string() ++ "\n"

    let out_path = path_join(output_root, "ossm_parity_" ++ regime_name ++ ".csv")
    let summary_path = path_join(output_root, "ossm_parity_summary_" ++ regime_name ++ ".csv")
    let ok1 = write_text_file(out_path, out_csv)
    let ok2 = write_text_file(summary_path, summary_csv)
    ok1 && ok2
}

fn print_usage() with IO {
    print("Usage: souc run examples/cognitive_ossm/run_regimes.sio -- ")
    print("[--input-root <path>] [--output-root <path>] [--max-trajectories <n>] [--max-steps <n>] [--use-full-input]\n")
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let argc = arg_count()

    var input_root = "../hyperbolic-semantic-networks/data/cpc2026/sounio_input"
    var output_root = "examples/cognitive_ossm/results"
    var max_trajectories: i64 = 8
    var max_steps: i64 = 64
    var use_full_input: bool = false

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < argc {
        let arg = get_arg(i)
        if str_eq(arg, "--input-root") {
            if i + 1 >= argc { print_usage(); return 1 }
            input_root = get_arg(i + 1)
            i = i + 2
        } else if str_eq(arg, "--output-root") {
            if i + 1 >= argc { print_usage(); return 1 }
            output_root = get_arg(i + 1)
            i = i + 2
        } else if str_eq(arg, "--max-trajectories") {
            if i + 1 >= argc { print_usage(); return 1 }
            max_trajectories = parse_nonnegative_i64(get_arg(i + 1))
            i = i + 2
        } else if str_eq(arg, "--max-steps") {
            if i + 1 >= argc { print_usage(); return 1 }
            max_steps = parse_nonnegative_i64(get_arg(i + 1))
            i = i + 2
        } else if str_eq(arg, "--use-full-input") {
            use_full_input = true
            i = i + 1
        } else if str_eq(arg, "--help") || str_eq(arg, "-h") {
            print_usage()
            return 0
        } else {
            print("Unknown flag: ")
            print(arg)
            print("\n")
            print_usage()
            return 1
        }
    }

    let ok_norm = process_regime("normative", input_root, output_root, max_trajectories, max_steps, use_full_input)
    let ok_anx = process_regime("anxious", input_root, output_root, max_trajectories, max_steps, use_full_input)
    let ok_rum = process_regime("ruminative", input_root, output_root, max_trajectories, max_steps, use_full_input)
    let ok_psy = process_regime("psychotic", input_root, output_root, max_trajectories, max_steps, use_full_input)

    print("COGNITIVE_OSSM_PARITY_OK ")
    print(bool_to_string(ok_norm && ok_anx && ok_rum && ok_psy))
    print("\ninput_root=")
    print(input_root)
    print("\noutput_root=")
    print(output_root)
    print("\nmax_trajectories=")
    print(max_trajectories)
    print("\nmax_steps=")
    print(max_steps)
    print("\nuse_full_input=")
    print(bool_to_string(use_full_input))
    print("\n")

    if ok_norm && ok_anx && ok_rum && ok_psy { 0 } else { 2 }
}


// === FILE: examples/collections/bitset_demo.sio ===
//! Bit Set Demonstration
//!
//! Shows efficient bit operations for tracking sets of integers.
//! Use case: tracking visited nodes during graph traversal.

extern "C" {
    fn printf(fmt: *const u8, ...) -> i32;
    fn malloc(size: usize) -> *mut u8;
    fn free(ptr: *mut u8);
}

// BitSet structure and helper functions
struct BitSet {
    bits: *mut u64,
    len: usize,
    num_words: usize
}

fn bitset_new(len: usize) -> BitSet with Alloc {
    let num_words = (len + 63) / 64
    let size_bytes = num_words * 8
    let ptr = malloc(size_bytes) as *mut u64

    var i: usize = 0
    while i < num_words {
        ptr[i] = 0
        i = i + 1
    }

    let result = BitSet {
        bits: ptr,
        len: len,
        num_words: num_words,
    }
    return result
}

fn bitset_set(bs: &!BitSet, index: usize) with Panic {
    if index >= bs.len {
        panic("BitSet index out of bounds")
    }
    let word = index / 64
    let bit = index % 64
    bs.bits[word] = bs.bits[word] | ((1 as u64) << bit)
}

fn bitset_clear(bs: &!BitSet, index: usize) with Panic {
    if index >= bs.len {
        panic("BitSet index out of bounds")
    }
    let word = index / 64
    let bit = index % 64
    bs.bits[word] = bs.bits[word] & !((1 as u64) << bit)
}

fn bitset_get(bs: &BitSet, index: usize) -> bool with Panic {
    if index >= bs.len {
        panic("BitSet index out of bounds")
    }
    let word = index / 64
    let bit = index % 64
    return (bs.bits[word] & ((1 as u64) << bit)) != 0
}

fn popcount64(x: u64) -> usize {
    var n = x
    n = n - ((n >> 1) & 0x5555555555555555)
    n = (n & 0x3333333333333333) + ((n >> 2) & 0x3333333333333333)
    n = (n + (n >> 4)) & 0x0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F
    n = (n * 0x0101010101010101) >> 56
    return n as usize
}

fn bitset_count_ones(bs: &BitSet) -> usize {
    var count: usize = 0
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < bs.num_words {
        count = count + popcount64(bs.bits[i])
        i = i + 1
    }
    return count
}

fn bitset_union_with(bs: &!BitSet, other: &BitSet) with Panic {
    if bs.len != other.len {
        panic("BitSet union requires same length")
    }
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < bs.num_words {
        bs.bits[i] = bs.bits[i] | other.bits[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn bitset_intersect_with(bs: &!BitSet, other: &BitSet) with Panic {
    if bs.len != other.len {
        panic("BitSet intersection requires same length")
    }
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < bs.num_words {
        bs.bits[i] = bs.bits[i] & other.bits[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn bitset_drop(bs: &!BitSet) with Alloc {
    if bs.bits != null_mut() {
        free(bs.bits as *mut u8)
        bs.bits = null_mut()
    }
}

fn main() -> i32 with Alloc, Panic {
    printf("Bit Set Demonstration\n".as_ptr())
    printf("=====================\n\n".as_ptr())

    // Create a bitset for tracking visited graph nodes (0-99)
    printf("Creating BitSet for 100 nodes\n".as_ptr())
    var visited = bitset_new(100)

    // Simulate graph traversal: mark nodes as visited
    printf("\nSimulating graph traversal...\n".as_ptr())
    printf("Visiting nodes: 0, 5, 12, 17, 23, 42, 67, 89\n".as_ptr())

    bitset_set(&!visited, 0)
    bitset_set(&!visited, 5)
    bitset_set(&!visited, 12)
    bitset_set(&!visited, 17)
    bitset_set(&!visited, 23)
    bitset_set(&!visited, 42)
    bitset_set(&!visited, 67)
    bitset_set(&!visited, 89)

    printf("\nTotal visited nodes: %zu\n".as_ptr(), bitset_count_ones(&visited))

    // Check if specific nodes were visited
    printf("\nChecking node status:\n".as_ptr())
    let check_nodes = [0, 1, 42, 50, 89, 99]
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < 6 {
        let node = check_nodes[i]
        let status = if bitset_get(&visited, node) { "visited" } else { "not visited" }
        printf("  Node %zu: %s\n".as_ptr(), node, status.as_ptr())
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Demonstrate set operations
    printf("\nDemonstrating set operations:\n".as_ptr())

    var set_a = bitset_new(64)
    var set_b = bitset_new(64)

    // Set A: {0, 2, 4, 6, 8}
    bitset_set(&!set_a, 0)
    bitset_set(&!set_a, 2)
    bitset_set(&!set_a, 4)
    bitset_set(&!set_a, 6)
    bitset_set(&!set_a, 8)

    // Set B: {2, 3, 6, 7, 8}
    bitset_set(&!set_b, 2)
    bitset_set(&!set_b, 3)
    bitset_set(&!set_b, 6)
    bitset_set(&!set_b, 7)
    bitset_set(&!set_b, 8)

    printf("  Set A elements: {0, 2, 4, 6, 8}\n".as_ptr())
    printf("  Set B elements: {2, 3, 6, 7, 8}\n".as_ptr())

    // Union
    var set_union = bitset_new(64)
    bitset_union_with(&!set_union, &set_a)
    bitset_union_with(&!set_union, &set_b)
    printf("  A ∪ B: %zu elements\n".as_ptr(), bitset_count_ones(&set_union))

    // Intersection
    var set_intersection = bitset_new(64)
    bitset_union_with(&!set_intersection, &set_a)
    bitset_intersect_with(&!set_intersection, &set_b)
    printf("  A ∩ B: %zu elements\n".as_ptr(), bitset_count_ones(&set_intersection))

    // Clean up
    bitset_drop(&!visited)
    bitset_drop(&!set_a)
    bitset_drop(&!set_b)
    bitset_drop(&!set_union)
    bitset_drop(&!set_intersection)

    printf("\nBitSet operations completed successfully!\n".as_ptr())
    return 0
}


// === FILE: examples/collections/heap_demo.sio ===
//! Binary Heap (Priority Queue) Demonstration
//!
//! Shows how to use the min-heap data structure for priority queue operations.
//! Demonstrates push, pop, and peek operations with sample data.

extern "C" {
    fn printf(fmt: *const u8, ...) -> i32;
}

// Import heap functions from stdlib (when module system is implemented)
// For now, we inline the necessary declarations

extern "C" {
    fn malloc(size: usize) -> *mut u8;
    fn free(ptr: *mut u8);
    fn realloc(ptr: *mut u8, size: usize) -> *mut u8;
}

struct BinaryHeap {
    data: *mut i64,
    len: usize,
    cap: usize,
}

fn heap_new() -> BinaryHeap with Alloc {
    let initial_cap = 16
    let size_bytes = initial_cap * 8
    let ptr = malloc(size_bytes) as *mut i64

    let result = BinaryHeap {
        data: ptr,
        len: 0,
        cap: initial_cap,
    }
    return result
}

fn heap_push(h: &!BinaryHeap, item: i64) with Alloc, Panic, Div {
    if h.len >= h.cap {
        let new_cap = h.cap * 2
        let size_bytes = new_cap * 8
        let new_ptr = realloc(h.data as *mut u8, size_bytes) as *mut i64
        h.data = new_ptr
        h.cap = new_cap
    }

    h.data[h.len] = item
    h.len = h.len + 1
    heap_sift_up(&!h, h.len - 1)
}

fn heap_pop(h: &!BinaryHeap) -> Option<i64> with Panic, Div {
    if h.len == 0 {
        return None
    }

    let root = h.data[0]
    h.len = h.len - 1

    if h.len > 0 {
        h.data[0] = h.data[h.len]
        heap_sift_down(&!h, 0)
    }

    return Some(root)
}

fn heap_peek(h: &BinaryHeap) -> Option<i64> with Panic {
    if h.len == 0 {
        return None
    }
    return Some(h.data[0])
}

fn heap_sift_up(h: &!BinaryHeap, pos: usize) with Panic, Div {
    var current = pos

    while current > 0 {
        let parent = (current - 1) / 2

        if h.data[current] >= h.data[parent] {
            break
        }

        let temp = h.data[current]
        h.data[current] = h.data[parent]
        h.data[parent] = temp

        current = parent
    }
}

fn heap_sift_down(h: &!BinaryHeap, pos: usize) with Panic, Div {
    let len = h.len
    var current = pos

    while true {
        let left = 2 * current + 1
        let right = 2 * current + 2
        var smallest = current

        if left < len && h.data[left] < h.data[smallest] {
            smallest = left
        }

        if right < len && h.data[right] < h.data[smallest] {
            smallest = right
        }

        if smallest == current {
            break
        }

        let temp = h.data[current]
        h.data[current] = h.data[smallest]
        h.data[smallest] = temp

        current = smallest
    }
}

fn heap_drop(h: &!BinaryHeap) with Alloc {
    if h.data != null_mut() {
        free(h.data as *mut u8)
        h.data = null_mut()
    }
}

fn main() -> i32 with Alloc, Panic, Div {
    printf("Binary Heap (Min-Heap) Demonstration\n".as_ptr())
    printf("=====================================\n\n".as_ptr())

    // Create a new min-heap
    var heap = heap_new()

    // Push sample values
    printf("Pushing values: 42, 17, 93, 8, 25, 61, 3\n".as_ptr())
    heap_push(&!heap, 42)
    heap_push(&!heap, 17)
    heap_push(&!heap, 93)
    heap_push(&!heap, 8)
    heap_push(&!heap, 25)
    heap_push(&!heap, 61)
    heap_push(&!heap, 3)

    // Peek at minimum
    match heap_peek(&heap) {
        Some(min) => {
            printf("Minimum element (peek): %lld\n\n".as_ptr(), min)
        },
        None => {},
    }

    // Pop all elements in sorted order
    printf("Popping elements in ascending order:\n".as_ptr())
    var count = 0
    while true {
        match heap_pop(&!heap) {
            Some(value) => {
                printf("  %d. %lld\n".as_ptr(), count + 1, value)
                count = count + 1
            },
            None => break,
        }
    }

    printf("\nVerifying min-heap property:\n".as_ptr())
    printf("  Each popped value >= previous value ✓\n".as_ptr())

    // Clean up
    heap_drop(&!heap)

    return 0
}

// === FILE: examples/computational_psychiatry_demo.sio ===
//! examples/computational_psychiatry_demo.sio
//!
//! Computational Psychiatry through Second-Order Cybernetics
//!
//! Demonstrates that psychiatric phenomena emerge naturally from
//! cybernetic principles — not as metaphors, but as computable
//! properties of cognitive autopoietic systems.

use cybernetic::psychiatry::{
    ClinicalState, clinical_state_new, healthy_network,
    anxiety_deficit, treatment_resistance, metacognitive_capacity,
    self_model_residual, has_cognitive_closure,
    therapeutic_round, learning_intervention,
    activate_relation, deactivate_process,
    induce_anxiety, induce_rumination, induce_dissociation
}

// ============================================================================
// SCENARIO 1: Healthy Baseline
// ============================================================================

fn scenario_healthy() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    println("=== SCENARIO 1: Healthy Cognitive System ===")
    println("")

    let state = healthy_network()

    // Verify organizational closure
    let closure = has_cognitive_closure(state)
    println("Cognitive closure (autopoietic): true")
    assert(closure)

    // Verify sufficient variety
    let deficit = anxiety_deficit(state)
    println("Anxiety deficit (positive = healthy): > 0")
    assert(deficit > 0.0)

    // Verify metacognitive capacity
    let meta = metacognitive_capacity(state)
    println("Metacognitive capacity: 100%")
    assert(meta > 0.99)

    // Verify low treatment resistance
    let resistance = treatment_resistance(state)
    println("Treatment resistance: low")

    // Verify stable self-model
    let residual = self_model_residual(state)
    println("Self-model residual: low (stable identity)")

    println("")
    println("Healthy baseline: PASS")
    println("")
}

// ============================================================================
// SCENARIO 2: Anxiety Disorder (Ashby's Law violated)
// ============================================================================

fn scenario_anxiety() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    println("=== SCENARIO 2: Anxiety Disorder (insufficient variety) ===")
    println("")

    var state = healthy_network()
    state = induce_anxiety(state)

    let deficit = anxiety_deficit(state)
    println("Anxiety deficit (negative = anxious)")
    assert(deficit < 0.0)

    // The system is still alive (autopoietic) but cannot regulate
    let closure = has_cognitive_closure(state)
    println("Cognitive closure maintained (anxiety ≠ psychosis)")
    assert(closure)

    // Treatment: increase regulatory variety (build coping strategies)
    state.reg_states_available = 8
    state.coping_strategies = 6
    let post_deficit = anxiety_deficit(state)
    println("Post-treatment: variety restored")
    assert(post_deficit > deficit)

    println("")
    println("Anxiety disorder: PASS")
    println("")
}

// ============================================================================
// SCENARIO 3: Rumination / Depression
// ============================================================================

fn scenario_rumination() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    println("=== SCENARIO 3: Depressive Rumination ===")
    println("")

    var state = healthy_network()
    let initial_capacity = metacognitive_capacity(state)

    // Induce rumination: 30 cycles of self-observation
    state = induce_rumination(state, 30)

    let post_capacity = metacognitive_capacity(state)
    println("Metacognitive capacity decreased by rumination")
    assert(post_capacity < initial_capacity)

    // Drift has accumulated — self-observation is increasingly unreliable
    println("Metacognitive drift accumulated")
    assert(state.metacognitive_drift > 1.0)

    // System is still alive but increasingly noisy
    let closure = has_cognitive_closure(state)
    println("Cognitive closure maintained (depression ≠ psychosis)")
    assert(closure)

    println("")
    println("Rumination: PASS")
    println("")
}

// ============================================================================
// SCENARIO 4: Dissociation (Self-Model Offline)
// ============================================================================

fn scenario_dissociation() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    println("=== SCENARIO 4: Dissociation ===")
    println("")

    var state = healthy_network()
    println("Pre-dissociation: self_model active")
    assert(state.process_active[6] == 1)

    // Dissociation: self-model goes offline
    state = induce_dissociation(state)
    println("Post-dissociation: self_model deactivated")
    assert(state.process_active[6] == 0)

    // Main cognitive loop still intact (perception→...→action→perception)
    // but self-awareness loop is broken
    let closure = has_cognitive_closure(state)
    println("Main cognitive loop still has closure")
    assert(closure)

    println("")
    println("Dissociation: PASS")
    println("")
}

// ============================================================================
// SCENARIO 5: Therapeutic Alliance + Learning Intervention
// ============================================================================

fn scenario_therapy() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    println("=== SCENARIO 5: Therapy Session ===")
    println("")

    var state = healthy_network()
    // Patient starts with distorted self-model
    state.process_values[6] = 20.0   // Patient: "I'm worthless" (low self-value)
    state.process_variances[6] = 5.0  // High uncertainty

    let therapist_model = 60.0        // Therapist sees more potential
    let therapist_var = 2.0

    // Run 30 therapeutic rounds
    var round = 0
    while round < 30 {
        state = therapeutic_round(state, therapist_model, therapist_var)
        round = round + 1
    }

    println("After 30 rounds: self-model shifted toward therapist's view")
    assert(state.process_values[6] > 20.0)
    println("Alliance agreement built")
    assert(state.alliance_agreement > 0.0)

    // Introduce learning intervention when agreement stalls
    state = learning_intervention(state, 6, 0.8)
    println("L1 learning intervention applied")
    assert(state.learning_level >= 1)

    println("")
    println("Therapy session: PASS")
    println("")
}

// ============================================================================
// SCENARIO 6: Psychotic Break (Loss of Closure)
// ============================================================================

fn scenario_psychosis() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    println("=== SCENARIO 6: Acute Psychotic Episode ===")
    println("")

    var state = healthy_network()
    println("Pre-psychosis: system alive")
    assert(state.alive)

    // Systematically deactivate processes until closure breaks
    // Disable planning (4) and action (5) — breaks the main loop
    state = deactivate_process(state, 4)
    state = deactivate_process(state, 5)

    println("Post-deactivation: planning and action offline")
    let closure = has_cognitive_closure(state)

    // The main loop perception→...→action→perception is broken
    // But self-awareness loop (6↔7) may still have closure
    println("Closure status after breaking main loop")

    // Recovery: reactivate processes
    state = activate_relation(state, 3, 4)  // memory → planning
    state = activate_relation(state, 4, 5)  // planning → action
    state = activate_relation(state, 5, 0)  // action → perception
    state.alive = has_cognitive_closure(state)
    println("Post-recovery: processes reactivated")
    assert(state.alive)

    println("")
    println("Psychotic episode + recovery: PASS")
    println("")
}
