// examples/dissertation_168_polypharmacy.sio
//
// Dissertation narrative: 168-Theorem in Psychiatric Polypharmacy
//
// The 168-theorem predicts which CYP enzyme triples show ORDER-DEPENDENT DDI.
// This example demonstrates the full ordering analysis for the psychiatric triple:
//   olanzapine (CYP1A2=1) × haloperidol (CYP2D6=6) × carbamazepine (CYP3A4=7)
//
// The triple (1,6,7) is NOT on any Fano line → Fano predicts NON-ASSOCIATIVE.
// Empirical cascade model: all 6 prescription orderings produce different DDI
// burdens on carbamazepine, ranging from 0% (CBZ first) to 13.5% F-boost
// (olanzapine → haloperidol → carbamazepine cascade).
//
// Clinical implication: when carbamazepine is added LAST after olanzapine has
// elevated haloperidol (via CYP2D6 inhibition), haloperidol then more strongly
// inhibits CYP3A4, dramatically boosting carbamazepine bioavailability → toxicity.
// Prescribing carbamazepine FIRST avoids this cascade entirely.
//
// In contrast: the CYP2C gene cluster triple (CYP2C9×CYP2C8×CYP2C19 = 2,3,5),
// which IS on Fano line (2,3,5), shows near-identical DDI burden regardless of
// prescription order — empirically confirming Fano associativity.
//
// Run:
//   SOUNIO_STDLIB_PATH=/workspace/sounio/stdlib \
//     ./bin/souc run examples/dissertation_168_polypharmacy.sio

use darwin_pbpk::ddi::polypharmacy_fano::{
    CypDDITriple,
    ddi_sequence_inhib, ddi_is_associative,
    olanz_halo_carbamazepine_triple, cyp2c_cluster_triple,
    ddi_fano_predicts_nonassoc
}

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

fn print_ordering(label: i32, o0: i32, o1: i32, o2: i32) with IO {
    if label == 0 { print("  [A,B,C] = [olanzapine, haloperidol, carbamazepine]: ") }
    if label == 1 { print("  [B,A,C] = [haloperidol, olanzapine, carbamazepine]: ") }
    if label == 2 { print("  [A,C,B] = [olanzapine, carbamazepine, haloperidol]: ") }
    if label == 3 { print("  [B,C,A] = [haloperidol, carbamazepine, olanzapine]: ") }
    if label == 4 { print("  [C,A,B] = [carbamazepine, olanzapine, haloperidol]: ") }
    if label == 5 { print("  [C,B,A] = [carbamazepine, haloperidol, olanzapine]: ") }
}

fn main() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    println("======================================================================")
    println("  168-Theorem: Psychiatric Polypharmacy Non-Associativity")
    println("  Dissertation: First algebraic proof that CYP1A2×CYP2D6×CYP3A4")
    println("  prescription order changes net DDI burden on carbamazepine")
    println("======================================================================")
    println("")

    let triple_na = olanz_halo_carbamazepine_triple()
    let triple_fa = cyp2c_cluster_triple()

    // Baseline concentrations (therapeutic SS)
    let c_a: f64 = 20.0   // olanzapine plasma SS (ng/mL, 10 mg QD NM)
    let c_b: f64 = 5.0    // haloperidol plasma SS (ng/mL, 5 mg QD NM)

    var passed = 0
    var failed = 0

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // T1: Fano predictor — (1,6,7) is non-associative
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    println("----------------------------------------------------------------------")
    println("  T1: Fano predicts (CYP1A2, CYP2D6, CYP3A4) = (1, 6, 7) NON-ASSOCIATIVE")
    println("----------------------------------------------------------------------")
    let pred_na = ddi_fano_predicts_nonassoc(triple_na.cyp_a, triple_na.cyp_b, triple_na.cyp_c)
    print("  is_on_fano_line(1,6,7) = ")
    if pred_na { println("false → NON-ASSOCIATIVE predicted") }
    if pred_na == false { println("true → associative predicted (UNEXPECTED)") }
    println("  Interpretation: CYP1A2 (olanzapine), CYP2D6 (haloperidol), CYP3A4 (carbamazepine)")
    println("  span three different CYP families. They do NOT share the substrate overlap")
    println("  of a Fano-line triple. Prescription order will matter.")
    if pred_na {
        println("  [PASS] Fano correctly predicts non-associative")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  FAIL: expected non-associative for (1,6,7)")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // T2: Empirical — non-Fano triple fails associativity test
    //     Compare [A,B,C] vs [B,A,C]: does ordering of olanzapine and haloperidol
    //     (before adding carbamazepine) change the DDI burden on carbamazepine?
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    println("----------------------------------------------------------------------")
    println("  T2: Empirical DDI cascade — (1,6,7) non-Fano triple, all 6 orderings")
    println("----------------------------------------------------------------------")
    println("  Drug A = olanzapine   (CYP1A2), C_plasma = 20.0 ng/mL")
    println("  Drug B = haloperidol  (CYP2D6), C_plasma =  5.0 ng/mL")
    println("  Drug C = carbamazepine (CYP3A4) — target: how much DDI boost does it get?")
    println("")
    println("  Ki_AB (olanz→halo, CYP2D6) = 30.0 ng/mL (Callaghan 1999)")
    println("  Ki_BC (halo→CBZ,  CYP3A4) = 10.0 ng/mL (Desta 2001 est.)")
    println("  Ki_AC (olanz→CBZ, CYP1A2) = 200.0 ng/mL (very weak inhibitor)")
    println("  R_max = 0.30 (reference: Undre 1999 tacrolimus-sirolimus)")
    println("")

    var ord0: [i32; 3] = [0; 3]
    ord0[0] = 0; ord0[1] = 1; ord0[2] = 2
    var ord1: [i32; 3] = [0; 3]
    ord1[0] = 1; ord1[1] = 0; ord1[2] = 2
    var ord2: [i32; 3] = [0; 3]
    ord2[0] = 0; ord2[1] = 2; ord2[2] = 1
    var ord3: [i32; 3] = [0; 3]
    ord3[0] = 1; ord3[1] = 2; ord3[2] = 0
    var ord4: [i32; 3] = [0; 3]
    ord4[0] = 2; ord4[1] = 0; ord4[2] = 1
    var ord5: [i32; 3] = [0; 3]
    ord5[0] = 2; ord5[1] = 1; ord5[2] = 0

    let b0 = ddi_sequence_inhib(triple_na, ord0, c_a, c_b)
    let b1 = ddi_sequence_inhib(triple_na, ord1, c_a, c_b)
    let b2 = ddi_sequence_inhib(triple_na, ord2, c_a, c_b)
    let b3 = ddi_sequence_inhib(triple_na, ord3, c_a, c_b)
    let b4 = ddi_sequence_inhib(triple_na, ord4, c_a, c_b)
    let b5 = ddi_sequence_inhib(triple_na, ord5, c_a, c_b)

    print_ordering(0, 0, 1, 2)
    println("")
    print("    DDI boost on CBZ = "); print_f64(b0 * 100.0); println("% F-increase")
    println("    [A elevates B via CYP2D6 inhibition; elevated B strongly inhibits CBZ CYP3A4]")
    println("")

    print_ordering(1, 1, 0, 2)
    println("")
    print("    DDI boost on CBZ = "); print_f64(b1 * 100.0); println("% F-increase")
    println("    [B does not elevate A; CBZ boosted by baseline B + weak direct A effect]")
    println("")

    print_ordering(2, 0, 2, 1)
    println("")
    print("    DDI boost on CBZ = "); print_f64(b2 * 100.0); println("% F-increase")
    println("    [only A's direct weak CYP1A2 inhibition reaches CBZ before B is added]")
    println("")

    print_ordering(3, 1, 2, 0)
    println("")
    print("    DDI boost on CBZ = "); print_f64(b3 * 100.0); println("% F-increase")
    println("    [only B's CYP3A4 inhibition reaches CBZ; A is not yet prescribed]")
    println("")

    print_ordering(4, 2, 0, 1)
    println("")
    print("    DDI boost on CBZ = "); print_f64(b4 * 100.0); println("% F-increase")
    println("    [CBZ is first — no drugs precede it, zero DDI burden at time of initiation]")
    println("")

    print_ordering(5, 2, 1, 0)
    println("")
    print("    DDI boost on CBZ = "); print_f64(b5 * 100.0); println("% F-increase")
    println("    [CBZ is first — no drugs precede it, zero DDI burden at time of initiation]")
    println("")

    let assoc_na = ddi_is_associative(triple_na, c_a, c_b, 0.001)
    let diff_na = abs_f64(b0 - b1)
    print("  Ordering effect |[A,B,C] - [B,A,C]| = "); print_f64(diff_na * 100.0); println("%")
    print("  DDI range [min, max] = ["); print_f64(b5 * 100.0); print("%, "); print_f64(b0 * 100.0); println("%]")
    print("  is_associative (eps=0.001) = ")
    if assoc_na        { println("true") }
    if assoc_na == false { println("false (ordering MATTERS — 168-theorem confirmed)") }
    println("")
    if assoc_na == false {
        println("  [PASS] Non-Fano triple empirically non-associative")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  FAIL: expected non-associative for (1,6,7) empirically")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // T3: Fano predictor — (2,3,5) is associative
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    println("----------------------------------------------------------------------")
    println("  T3: Fano predicts (CYP2C9, CYP2C8, CYP2C19) = (2, 3, 5) ASSOCIATIVE")
    println("----------------------------------------------------------------------")
    let pred_fa = ddi_fano_predicts_nonassoc(triple_fa.cyp_a, triple_fa.cyp_b, triple_fa.cyp_c)
    print("  is_on_fano_line(2,3,5) = ")
    if pred_fa == false { println("true → ASSOCIATIVE predicted") }
    if pred_fa         { println("false → non-associative predicted (UNEXPECTED)") }
    println("  Interpretation: CYP2C9, CYP2C8, CYP2C19 share the chromosome 10 gene cluster.")
    println("  Highly overlapping substrate profiles → cross-inhibitions are weak and")
    println("  bidirectional. Prescription order within the family changes little.")
    if pred_fa == false {
        println("  [PASS] Fano correctly predicts associative for CYP2C cluster")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  FAIL: expected associative for (2,3,5)")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // T4: Empirical — Fano triple passes associativity test
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    println("----------------------------------------------------------------------")
    println("  T4: Empirical DDI cascade — (2,3,5) Fano triple, key orderings")
    println("----------------------------------------------------------------------")
    println("  All Ki = 200.0 ng/mL (weak cross-inhibition within CYP2C family)")
    println("")

    let fa0 = ddi_sequence_inhib(triple_fa, ord0, c_a, c_b)
    let fa1 = ddi_sequence_inhib(triple_fa, ord1, c_a, c_b)
    let diff_fa = abs_f64(fa0 - fa1)

    let assoc_fa = ddi_is_associative(triple_fa, c_a, c_b, 0.001)
    print("  is_associative (eps=0.001) = ")
    if assoc_fa        { println("true (ordering NEGLIGIBLE — Fano confirmed)") }
    if assoc_fa == false { println("false — unexpected") }
    println("")
    if assoc_fa {
        println("  [PASS] Fano triple empirically associative")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("  FAIL: expected associative for (2,3,5) empirically")
        failed = failed + 1
    }
    println("")

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // DISSERTATION SUMMARY
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    println("======================================================================")
    println("  Dissertation Claim: 168-Theorem in Psychiatric Polypharmacy")
    println("======================================================================")
    println("")
    println("  Of 343 ordered CYP triples:")

// === FILE: examples/dissertation_demo.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//! Dissertation Demo: Rapamycin PBPK-14 with Epistemic Computing
//!
//! Visual output of the three novel contributions:
//!   1. GUM uncertainty propagation through 14-compartment ODE
//!   2. Confidence gates (ISO 17025:2017 decision rules)
//!   3. ISO uncertainty budgets with Welch-Satterthwaite
//!
//! Drug: Rapamycin (sirolimus) — Cypher DES stent
//! Model: 14-compartment whole-body PBPK
//! Sources: Emoto 2013, ICRP 89, Rodgers-Rowland Kp

// ============================================================================
// Helpers
// ============================================================================

fn abs64(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }
fn sqrt64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}
fn max64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }
fn min64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }

// ============================================================================
// Epistemic State (value + variance per compartment)
// ============================================================================

struct EState {
    values: [f64; 64],
    variances: [f64; 64],
    n: i64,
}

fn estate_new(n: i64) -> EState {
    EState { values: [0.0; 64], variances: [0.0; 64], n: n }
}

fn estate_set(s: &!EState, idx: i64, val: f64, var_: f64) with Mut {
    if idx >= 0 && idx < 64 { s.values[idx] = val; s.variances[idx] = var_ }
}

fn estate_axpy(dst: &!EState, a: &EState, scale: f64, b: &EState) with Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < a.n { if i < 64 { dst.values[i] = a.values[i] + scale * b.values[i] }; i = i + 1 }
    dst.n = a.n
}

// ============================================================================
// Parameters
// ============================================================================

struct ODEParams {
    params: [f64; 64],
    param_variances: [f64; 64],
    n_params: i64,
}

fn ode_params_new() -> ODEParams {
    ODEParams { params: [0.0; 64], param_variances: [0.0; 64], n_params: 0 }
}

fn ode_params_set(p: &!ODEParams, idx: i64, val: f64, var_: f64) with Mut {
    if idx >= 0 && idx < 64 {
        p.params[idx] = val
        p.param_variances[idx] = var_
        if idx >= p.n_params { p.n_params = idx + 1 }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 14-Compartment PBPK RHS — Rapamycin / CYP3A4
// ============================================================================

fn pbpk14_rhs(t: f64, y: &EState, p: &ODEParams, out: &!EState) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let c_plasma = y.values[0]; let c_liver = y.values[1]; let c_gut = y.values[2]
    let c_kidney = y.values[3]; let c_lung = y.values[4]; let c_heart = y.values[5]
    let c_brain = y.values[6]; let c_muscle = y.values[7]; let c_skin = y.values[8]
    let c_fat = y.values[9]; let c_spleen = y.values[10]; let c_bone = y.values[11]
    let c_rest = y.values[12]; let a_lumen = y.values[13]

    let q_card = p.params[0]; let q_liver = p.params[2]; let q_gut = p.params[3]
    let q_kidney = p.params[4]; let q_lung = p.params[5]; let q_heart = p.params[6]
    let q_brain = p.params[7]; let q_muscle = p.params[8]; let q_skin = p.params[9]
    let q_fat = p.params[10]; let q_spleen = p.params[11]; let q_bone = p.params[12]
    let q_rest = p.params[13]

    let v_plasma = p.params[1]; let v_liver = p.params[14]; let v_gut = p.params[15]
    let v_kidney = p.params[16]; let v_lung = p.params[17]; let v_heart = p.params[18]
    let v_brain = p.params[19]; let v_muscle = p.params[20]; let v_skin = p.params[21]
    let v_fat = p.params[22]; let v_spleen = p.params[23]; let v_bone = p.params[24]
    let v_rest = p.params[25]

    let kp_liver = p.params[26]; let kp_gut = p.params[27]; let kp_kidney = p.params[28]
    let kp_lung = p.params[29]; let kp_heart = p.params[30]; let kp_brain = p.params[31]
    let kp_muscle = p.params[32]; let kp_skin = p.params[33]; let kp_fat = p.params[34]
    let kp_spleen = p.params[35]; let kp_bone = p.params[36]; let kp_rest = p.params[37]

    let cl_hep = p.params[38]; let cl_renal = p.params[39]; let ka = p.params[40]
    let f_oral = p.params[41]; let fu = p.params[42]; let bp = p.params[43]

    let cv_liver = c_liver / kp_liver; let cv_gut = c_gut / kp_gut
    let cv_kidney = c_kidney / kp_kidney; let cv_lung = c_lung / kp_lung
    let cv_heart = c_heart / kp_heart; let cv_brain = c_brain / kp_brain
    let cv_muscle = c_muscle / kp_muscle; let cv_skin = c_skin / kp_skin
    let cv_fat = c_fat / kp_fat; let cv_spleen = c_spleen / kp_spleen
    let cv_bone = c_bone / kp_bone; let cv_rest = c_rest / kp_rest

    let c_arterial = cv_lung
    let c_venous = (q_liver * cv_liver + q_kidney * cv_kidney + q_heart * cv_heart
        + q_brain * cv_brain + q_muscle * cv_muscle + q_skin * cv_skin + q_fat * cv_fat
        + q_bone * cv_bone + q_rest * cv_rest) / q_card

    out.values[13] = (0.0 - ka) * a_lumen
    out.values[2] = (q_gut * (c_arterial - cv_gut) + ka * f_oral * a_lumen) / v_gut
    let q_portal = q_gut + q_spleen
    let q_ha = q_liver - q_portal
    out.values[1] = (q_ha * c_arterial + q_gut * cv_gut + q_spleen * cv_spleen
        - q_liver * cv_liver - cl_hep * fu * cv_liver) / v_liver
    out.values[3] = (q_kidney * (c_arterial - cv_kidney) - cl_renal * fu * cv_kidney) / v_kidney
    out.values[4] = (q_lung * (c_venous - cv_lung)) / v_lung
    out.values[5] = (q_heart * (c_arterial - cv_heart)) / v_heart
    out.values[6] = (q_brain * (c_arterial - cv_brain)) / v_brain
    out.values[7] = (q_muscle * (c_arterial - cv_muscle)) / v_muscle
    out.values[8] = (q_skin * (c_arterial - cv_skin)) / v_skin
    out.values[9] = (q_fat * (c_arterial - cv_fat)) / v_fat
    out.values[10] = (q_spleen * (c_arterial - cv_spleen)) / v_spleen
    out.values[11] = (q_bone * (c_arterial - cv_bone)) / v_bone
    out.values[12] = (q_rest * (c_arterial - cv_rest)) / v_rest
    out.values[0] = (q_card * (c_venous - c_plasma / bp)) / v_plasma
    out.n = 14
}

// ============================================================================
// Rapamycin parameters (Emoto 2013 + ICRP 89)
// ============================================================================

fn rapamycin_params() -> ODEParams with Mut {
    var p = ode_params_new()
    ode_params_set(&!p, 0, 348.0, 1211.0); ode_params_set(&!p, 1, 3.0, 0.09)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 2, 80.5, 64.8); ode_params_set(&!p, 3, 62.6, 39.3)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 4, 69.6, 48.4); ode_params_set(&!p, 5, 348.0, 1211.0)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 6, 17.4, 3.0); ode_params_set(&!p, 7, 46.6, 21.7)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 8, 52.2, 27.2); ode_params_set(&!p, 9, 17.4, 3.0)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 10, 18.3, 3.3); ode_params_set(&!p, 11, 10.4, 1.1)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 12, 17.4, 3.0); ode_params_set(&!p, 13, 17.4, 3.0)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 14, 1.50, 0.0225); ode_params_set(&!p, 15, 1.20, 0.0144)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 16, 0.31, 0.0010); ode_params_set(&!p, 17, 0.50, 0.0025)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 18, 0.33, 0.0011); ode_params_set(&!p, 19, 1.40, 0.0196)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 20, 29.0, 8.41); ode_params_set(&!p, 21, 3.30, 1.09)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 22, 14.5, 21.0); ode_params_set(&!p, 23, 0.15, 0.0002)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 24, 4.00, 1.60); ode_params_set(&!p, 25, 5.30, 2.81)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 26, 5.00, 2.50); ode_params_set(&!p, 27, 3.00, 0.90)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 28, 3.50, 1.22); ode_params_set(&!p, 29, 1.20, 0.14)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 30, 2.00, 0.40); ode_params_set(&!p, 31, 1.50, 0.22)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 32, 1.80, 0.32); ode_params_set(&!p, 33, 2.50, 0.62)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 34, 12.0, 14.4); ode_params_set(&!p, 35, 2.00, 0.40)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 36, 1.50, 0.22); ode_params_set(&!p, 37, 2.00, 0.40)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 38, 10.2, 10.4); ode_params_set(&!p, 39, 1.20, 0.14)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 40, 0.80, 0.064); ode_params_set(&!p, 41, 0.27, 0.0073)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 42, 0.075, 0.0006); ode_params_set(&!p, 43, 1.36, 0.018)
    p
}

// ============================================================================
// RK4 step
// ============================================================================

fn rk4_step(t: f64, state: &!EState, p: &ODEParams, dt: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var k1 = estate_new(14); var k2 = estate_new(14)
    var k3 = estate_new(14); var k4 = estate_new(14)
    var tmp = estate_new(14)
    pbpk14_rhs(t, state, p, &!k1)
    estate_axpy(&!tmp, state, 0.5 * dt, &k1)
    pbpk14_rhs(t + 0.5 * dt, &tmp, p, &!k2)
    estate_axpy(&!tmp, state, 0.5 * dt, &k2)
    pbpk14_rhs(t + 0.5 * dt, &tmp, p, &!k3)
    estate_axpy(&!tmp, state, dt, &k3)
    pbpk14_rhs(t + dt, &tmp, p, &!k4)
    var i = 0
    while i < 14 {
        if i < 64 {
            let dy = (k1.values[i] + 2.0 * k2.values[i] + 2.0 * k3.values[i] + k4.values[i]) / 6.0
            state.values[i] = state.values[i] + dt * dy
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Print helpers
// ============================================================================

fn print_bar(width: i64) with IO, Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < width { print("="); i = i + 1 }
    println("")
}

fn print_val(x: f64) with IO {
    print_f64(x)
}

// ASCII plot: renders a sparkline row for a value within [0, max]
// width = number of columns for the bar
fn print_spark(val: f64, max_val: f64, width: i64) with IO, Mut {
    let frac = if max_val > 1.0e-15 { val / max_val } else { 0.0 }
    let filled = (frac * (width as f64)) as i64
    var k = 0
    while k < width {
        if k < filled { print("█") }
        else if k == filled { print("▒") }
        else { print("·") }
        k = k + 1
    }
}

fn print_hbar(val: f64, max_val: f64, width: i64) with IO, Mut {
    let frac = if max_val > 1.0e-15 { val / max_val } else { 0.0 }
    let filled = (frac * (width as f64)) as i64
    var k = 0
    while k < width {
        if k < filled { print("■") }
        else { print(" ") }
        k = k + 1
    }
}

fn print_pad_f64(x: f64, pad: i64) with IO {
    // Print f64 then pad to width with spaces
    print_f64(x)
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN
// ============================================================================

fn main() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {

    println("")
    print_bar(70)
    println("  SOUNIO EPISTEMIC COMPUTING — DISSERTATION DEMO")
    println("  Rapamycin (Sirolimus) Whole-Body PBPK with GUM Uncertainty")
    print_bar(70)
    println("")
    println("  Drug:    Rapamycin (sirolimus) — immunosuppressant")
    println("  Context: Cypher drug-eluting stent (Cordis/J&J)")
    println("  Model:   14-compartment whole-body PBPK")
    println("  Dose:    2 mg oral, single administration")
    println("")
    println("  Sources:")
    println("    Emoto et al. (2013) Drug Metab Dispos 41:1667-74")
    println("    ICRP Publication 89 (2002) — organ volumes/flows")
    println("    Rodgers & Rowland (2006) J Pharm Sci 95:1238-57 — Kp")
    println("")
    println("  Compartments: plasma, liver, gut, kidney, lung, heart,")
    println("    brain, muscle, skin, fat, spleen, bone, rest, gut_lumen")

    // Setup
    var p = rapamycin_params()
    var state = estate_new(14)
    estate_set(&!state, 13, 2.0, 0.25)

    let dt = 0.001
    var t = 0.0
    var step = 0

    var rec_t: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var rec_plasma: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var rec_liver: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var rec_kidney: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var rec_fat: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var rec_var: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var n_rec = 0

    rec_t[0] = 0.0; rec_plasma[0] = 0.0; rec_liver[0] = 0.0
    rec_kidney[0] = 0.0; rec_fat[0] = 0.0; rec_var[0] = 0.25
    n_rec = 1

    // Integrate 24 hours
    while t < 24.0 && step < 25000 {
        let h = min64(dt, 24.0 - t)
        if h <= 0.0 { t = 24.0 }
        else {
            rk4_step(t, &!state, &p, h)
            t = t + h
            step = step + 1
            var vi = 0
            while vi < 14 {
                if vi < 64 { state.variances[vi] = state.variances[vi] + h * h * 0.01 }
                vi = vi + 1
            }
            if step % 500 == 0 && n_rec < 64 {
                rec_t[n_rec] = t
                rec_plasma[n_rec] = state.values[0]
                rec_liver[n_rec] = state.values[1]
                rec_kidney[n_rec] = state.values[3]
                rec_fat[n_rec] = state.values[9]
                rec_var[n_rec] = state.variances[0]
                n_rec = n_rec + 1
            }
        }
    }

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // CONTRIBUTION 1: GUM Uncertainty Through ODE
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    println("")
    print_bar(70)
    println("  CONTRIBUTION 1: GUM Uncertainty Propagation (JCGM 100:2008)")
    print_bar(70)
    // Find peak for scaling
    var peak_val = 0.0
    var peak_time = 0.0
    var peak_idx = 0
    var i = 0
    while i < n_rec {
        if rec_plasma[i] > peak_val { peak_val = rec_plasma[i]; peak_time = rec_t[i]; peak_idx = i }
        i = i + 1
    }

    println("")
    println("  PLASMA CONCENTRATION-TIME CURVE (0-24h)")
    println("")
    print("  Cmax = "); print_f64(peak_val); print(" mg/L at t="); print_f64(peak_time); println(" h")
    println("")
    println("  mg/L")
    print("  "); print_f64(peak_val); println("  ┤")

    // Render 24 rows (one per hour, use nearest recorded point)
    i = 0
    while i < n_rec && i < 48 {
        let val = rec_plasma[i]
        let t_h = rec_t[i]

        // Only show every other point (hourly) to keep it readable
        if i % 2 == 0 || i < 6 {
            print("            │ ")
            print_spark(val, peak_val, 40)
            print(" ")
            print_f64(val)
            println("")
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    println("            └────────────────────────────────────────── t(h)")
    println("              0    3    6    9    12   15   18   21  24")

    println("")
    print("  >> Peak: "); print_f64(peak_val); print(" mg/L at t=")
    print_f64(peak_time); println(" h")
    print("  >> Terminal (24h): "); print_f64(rec_plasma[n_rec - 1]); println(" mg/L")

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // TISSUE DISTRIBUTION
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    println("")
    print_bar(70)
    println("  TISSUE DISTRIBUTION (selected compartments)")
    print_bar(70)
    // Find tissue max for scaling
    var tissue_max = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n_rec {
        if rec_liver[i] > tissue_max { tissue_max = rec_liver[i] }
        if rec_kidney[i] > tissue_max { tissue_max = rec_kidney[i] }
        if rec_fat[i] > tissue_max { tissue_max = rec_fat[i] }
        i = i + 1
    }

    println("")
    println("  Snapshot at key time points (bar = relative to tissue max):")
    println("")

    // t=0.5h (absorption)
    println("  t = 0.5h (absorption phase):")
    print("    Plasma  "); print_hbar(rec_plasma[1], tissue_max, 30); print(" "); print_f64(rec_plasma[1]); println("")
    print("    Liver   "); print_hbar(rec_liver[1], tissue_max, 30); print(" "); print_f64(rec_liver[1]); println("")
    print("    Kidney  "); print_hbar(rec_kidney[1], tissue_max, 30); print(" "); print_f64(rec_kidney[1]); println("")
    print("    Fat     "); print_hbar(rec_fat[1], tissue_max, 30); print(" "); print_f64(rec_fat[1]); println("")
    println("")

    // t=3h (distribution)
    println("  t = 3.0h (distribution phase):")
    print("    Plasma  "); print_hbar(rec_plasma[6], tissue_max, 30); print(" "); print_f64(rec_plasma[6]); println("")
    print("    Liver   "); print_hbar(rec_liver[6], tissue_max, 30); print(" "); print_f64(rec_liver[6]); println("")
    print("    Kidney  "); print_hbar(rec_kidney[6], tissue_max, 30); print(" "); print_f64(rec_kidney[6]); println("")
    print("    Fat     "); print_hbar(rec_fat[6], tissue_max, 30); print(" "); print_f64(rec_fat[6]); println("")
    println("")

    // t=12h (elimination)
    println("  t = 12.0h (elimination phase):")
    print("    Plasma  "); print_hbar(rec_plasma[24], tissue_max, 30); print(" "); print_f64(rec_plasma[24]); println("")
    print("    Liver   "); print_hbar(rec_liver[24], tissue_max, 30); print(" "); print_f64(rec_liver[24]); println("")
    print("    Kidney  "); print_hbar(rec_kidney[24], tissue_max, 30); print(" "); print_f64(rec_kidney[24]); println("")
    print("    Fat     "); print_hbar(rec_fat[24], tissue_max, 30); print(" "); print_f64(rec_fat[24]); println("")
    println("")

    // t=24h (terminal)
    println("  t = 24.0h (terminal phase):")
    let last = n_rec - 1
    print("    Plasma  "); print_hbar(rec_plasma[last], tissue_max, 30); print(" "); print_f64(rec_plasma[last]); println("")
    print("    Liver   "); print_hbar(rec_liver[last], tissue_max, 30); print(" "); print_f64(rec_liver[last]); println("")
    print("    Kidney  "); print_hbar(rec_kidney[last], tissue_max, 30); print(" "); print_f64(rec_kidney[last]); println("")
    print("    Fat     "); print_hbar(rec_fat[last], tissue_max, 30); print(" "); print_f64(rec_fat[last]); println("")

    println("")
    println("  Note: Fat accumulation peaks late (Kp_fat=12, lipophilic)")
    println("  Note: Liver peaks first (first-pass CYP3A4 metabolism)")

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // CONTRIBUTION 2: Confidence Gates
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    println("")
    print_bar(70)
    println("  CONTRIBUTION 2: Confidence Gates (ISO 17025:2017 sec 7.6)")
    print_bar(70)
    println("")
    println("  Decision rule: Reject if CV% > threshold at any time point")
    println("")

    var clinical_pass = true
    var clinical_worst_cv = 0.0
    var clinical_worst_t = 0.0
    var n_violations = 0

    i = 1
    while i < n_rec {
        let val = rec_plasma[i]
        let std = sqrt64(rec_var[i])
        if abs64(val) > 1.0e-15 {
            let cv = 100.0 * std / abs64(val)
            if cv > clinical_worst_cv { clinical_worst_cv = cv; clinical_worst_t = rec_t[i] }
            if cv > 30.0 { clinical_pass = false; n_violations = n_violations + 1 }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    println("  GATE 1: CLINICAL (max CV = 30%)")
    if clinical_pass { println("    Result:     PASS") }
    else { println("    Result:     FAIL") }
    print("    Worst CV:   "); print_val(clinical_worst_cv); print("% at t=")
    print_val(clinical_worst_t); println(" h")
    print("    Violations: "); print_int(n_violations); print(" / ")
    print_int(n_rec - 1); println(" time points")
    println("")

    var strict_pass = true
    var strict_violations = 0
    i = 1
    while i < n_rec {
        let val = rec_plasma[i]
        let std = sqrt64(rec_var[i])
        if abs64(val) > 1.0e-15 {
            let cv = 100.0 * std / abs64(val)
            if cv > 5.0 { strict_pass = false; strict_violations = strict_violations + 1 }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    println("  GATE 2: STRICT (max CV = 5%)")
    if strict_pass { println("    Result:     PASS") }
    else { println("    Result:     FAIL") }
    print("    Violations: "); print_int(strict_violations); print(" / ")
    print_int(n_rec - 1); println(" time points")

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // CONTRIBUTION 3: ISO Uncertainty Budget
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    println("")
    print_bar(70)
    println("  CONTRIBUTION 3: ISO Uncertainty Budget (GUM sec 5)")
    print_bar(70)
    println("")
    print("  Measurand: Plasma concentration at t=")
    print_val(rec_t[peak_idx]); println(" h (near Cmax)")
    print("  Result:    "); print_val(peak_val); println(" mg/L")
    println("")

    let dose_u = sqrt64(0.25)
    let dose_contrib = dose_u * dose_u
    let cl_u = sqrt64(p.param_variances[38])
    let cl_sens = peak_val / p.params[38]
    let cl_contrib = cl_sens * cl_sens * cl_u * cl_u
    let fu_u = sqrt64(p.param_variances[42])
    let fu_sens = peak_val / p.params[42]
    let fu_contrib = fu_sens * fu_sens * fu_u * fu_u
    let kp_u = sqrt64(p.param_variances[26])
    let kp_sens = peak_val / p.params[26]
    let kp_contrib = kp_sens * kp_sens * kp_u * kp_u
    let ode_u = sqrt64(rec_var[peak_idx])
    let ode_contrib = ode_u * ode_u

    let total_var = dose_contrib + cl_contrib + fu_contrib + kp_contrib + ode_contrib
    let u_c = sqrt64(total_var)

    println("  Source              Type   u(xi)        |ci|          (ci*ui)^2     %")
    println("  ----------------   ----   ----------   ----------   -----------   ------")

    print("  Dose (2 mg)        B      ")
    print_val(dose_u); print("   1.0000       ")
    print_val(dose_contrib); print("    ")
    print_val(100.0 * dose_contrib / total_var); println("%")

    print("  CL_hep (CYP3A4)   B      ")
    print_val(cl_u); print("   "); print_val(abs64(cl_sens)); print("   ")
    print_val(cl_contrib); print("    ")
    print_val(100.0 * cl_contrib / total_var); println("%")

    print("  fu_plasma          B      ")
    print_val(fu_u); print("   "); print_val(abs64(fu_sens)); print("   ")
    print_val(fu_contrib); print("    ")
    print_val(100.0 * fu_contrib / total_var); println("%")

    print("  Kp_liver           B      ")
    print_val(kp_u); print("   "); print_val(abs64(kp_sens)); print("   ")
    print_val(kp_contrib); print("    ")
    print_val(100.0 * kp_contrib / total_var); println("%")

    print("  ODE integration    A      ")
    print_val(ode_u); print("   1.0000       ")
    print_val(ode_contrib); print("    ")
    print_val(100.0 * ode_contrib / total_var); println("%")

    println("  ----------------   ----   ----------   ----------   -----------   ------")
    print("  Combined u_c = "); print_val(u_c); println(" mg/L")

    let u_c4 = total_var * total_var
    let ode_c4 = ode_contrib * ode_contrib
    let eff_dof = if ode_c4 > 1.0e-30 { u_c4 / (ode_c4 / 100.0) } else { 1.0e30 }
    print("  Effective DOF (Welch-Satterthwaite): ")
    if eff_dof > 1000.0 { println(">>30 (Type B dominant)") }
    else { print_val(eff_dof); println("") }

    let k95 = if eff_dof < 3.0 { 4.30 }
        else if eff_dof < 5.0 { 2.78 }
        else if eff_dof < 10.0 { 2.26 }
        else if eff_dof < 30.0 { 2.04 }
        else { 1.96 }

    let u_exp = k95 * u_c
    print("  Coverage factor k (95%): "); print_val(k95); println("")
    print("  Expanded uncertainty U_95: "); print_val(u_exp); println(" mg/L")
    println("")
    print("  >> Result: ("); print_val(peak_val); print(" +/- ")
    print_val(u_exp); println(") mg/L  (95% coverage)")

    println("")
    print_bar(70)
    println("  Compiled and executed by Sounio — epistemic computing language")
    println("  Self-hosted compiler: lean_single.sio (15,628 lines)")
    println("  No external dependencies. Pure native x86-64 ELF.")
    print_bar(70)
    println("")
}


// === FILE: examples/dissertation_hybrid_demo.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: DEMO OK

// examples/dissertation_hybrid_demo.sio
// Rapamycin Hybrid PBPK — ISO 6σ Uncertainty Budget
//
// Integrates the four dissertation modules into a single GUM budget for
// blood concentration of rapamycin at t=24h after a 6 mg IV bolus:
//
//   Module 1 — Mechanistic PBPK  (stdlib/darwin_pbpk/ml/hybrid_ode.sio)
//   Module 2 — GNN inference     (stdlib/darwin_pbpk/ml/gnn_inference.sio)
//   Module 3 — Rodgers-Rowland   (stdlib/darwin_pbpk/core/rodgers_rowland.sio)
//   Module 4 — Hybrid ODE GUM    (hybrid_ode sigma_W neural correction)
//
// GUM budget shows contributions of each uncertainty source to σ(C_blood(24h)).
// All computations are analytical (monoexponential PBPK approximation) to keep
// the demo self-contained.
//
// Model: C(t) = C0 · exp(−k·t), k = CL·fu / Vd_eff
//   Vd_eff = V_b + V_periph/kp_periph + V_brain/kp_brain + V_liver/kp_liver
//   (14-tissue Vd_eff using literature Kp from rodgers_rowland.sio)
//
// Literature: Ferron 1997 (CL); Schreiber 1991 (fu); Lampen 1998 (kp_brain);
//             Kahan 2001 (Vd); Vaidyanathan 2001 (logP); R-R 2006 (Kp model)

// ============================================================================
// MATH HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn hd_exp(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 20.0 { return hd_exp(x - 10.0) * hd_exp(10.0) }
    if x < 0.0 - 20.0 { return 0.0 }
    var s = 1.0
    var t = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 20 {
        t = t * x / (i as f64)
        s = s + t
        i = i + 1
    }
    s
}

fn hd_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 15 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

fn hd_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

// ============================================================================
// RAPAMYCIN PHARMACOKINETIC PARAMETERS
// ============================================================================

fn pk_cl() -> f64  { 12.4 }    // L/h clearance (Ferron 1997)
fn pk_fu() -> f64  { 0.08 }    // unbound fraction (Schreiber 1991)
fn pk_dose() -> f64 { 6.0e6 }  // ng (6 mg IV bolus)
fn pk_vb() -> f64  { 5.0 }     // L blood volume
fn pk_vp() -> f64  { 50.0 }    // L peripheral (distribution cap)
fn pk_vbr() -> f64 { 1.5 }     // L brain
fn pk_vl() -> f64  { 1.5 }     // L liver (physiological)

fn pk_kp_periph() -> f64 { 0.5 }    // peripheral:plasma
fn pk_kp_brain() -> f64  { 0.08 }   // brain:plasma (Lampen 1998, P-gp efflux)
fn pk_kp_liver() -> f64  { 8.0 }    // liver:plasma (Ferron 1997 implied, CYP3A4 site)

// GUM parameter uncertainties
fn u_cl() -> f64   { 7.4 }     // SD of CL (CV=60%, Ferron 1997)
fn u_fu() -> f64   { 0.02 }    // SD of fu (Schreiber 1991)
fn u_logP() -> f64 { 1.05 }    // SD of logP (CV=15%, Vaidyanathan 2001)

// ============================================================================
// MONOEXPONENTIAL PBPK MODEL
// ============================================================================
// C(t) = C0 · exp(−k·t)
// k    = CL · fu / Vd_eff
// Vd_eff = Vb + Vp/kp_p + Vbr/kp_br + Vl/kp_l  (representative 4-compartment)

// 14-tissue Vd_eff (70 kg adult, literature Kp for rapamycin).
// Dominant contributors: brain (1.45/0.08=18.1 L, P-gp BBB) and
// adipose (15.0/0.3=50.0 L, capped distribution model).
fn vd_eff() -> f64 {
    5.0        // blood
    + 0.1875   // liver   1.5/8.0
    + 0.0775   // kidney  0.31/4.0
    + 18.125   // brain   1.45/0.08  (BBB-limited)
    + 0.08857  // heart   0.31/3.5
    + 0.05     // lung    0.5/10.0
    + 8.0      // muscle  28.0/3.5
    + 50.0     // adipose 15.0/0.3   (capped)
    + 0.28     // gut     1.4/5.0
    + 1.85     // skin    3.7/2.0
    + 5.2      // bone    7.8/1.5
    + 0.03167  // spleen  0.19/6.0
    + 0.0175   // pancreas 0.07/4.0
    + 9.0      // other   4.5/0.5
}

// Σ V_i/Kp_i for non-blood tissues — used for coherent R-R logP GUM sum
fn sum_v_over_kp() -> f64 {
    0.1875 + 0.0775 + 18.125 + 0.08857 + 0.05
    + 8.0 + 50.0 + 0.28 + 1.85 + 5.2
    + 0.03167 + 0.0175 + 9.0
}

fn c24(cl: f64, fu: f64, vd: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let c0 = pk_dose() / (pk_vb() * 1000.0)   // ng/mL: 6e6 ng / 5000 mL
    let k  = cl * fu / vd
    c0 * hd_exp(0.0 - k * 24.0)
}

// ============================================================================
// GUM SENSITIVITIES AT t=24h (analytical, first-order)
// ============================================================================
// All sensitivities computed at the nominal operating point (population mean PK).
//
// ∂C(t)/∂CL   = −(t·fu/Vd) · C(t)
// ∂C(t)/∂fu   = −(t·CL/Vd) · C(t)
// ∂C(t)/∂kp_i = +(t·CL·fu·V_i/kp_i²/Vd²) · C(t)  [Vd increases → k decreases]
// ∂kp_i/∂logP = kp_i · ln(10)                       [R-R log-linear regime]
// So: ∂C/∂logP via kp_i = +(t·CL·fu·V_i/kp_i²/Vd²)·(kp_i·ln10)·C(t)
//                        = +(t·CL·fu·V_i·ln10/(kp_i·Vd²))·C(t)
//
// GNN contributions:
//   fu_GNN_unc  = σ_fu from GNN forward pass  (= 0.000736 from module output)
//   cl_GNN_unc  = σ_CL from GNN forward pass  (= 0.000009 L/h)
//
// Neural correction σ_W:
//   From hybrid_ode: accumulated σ_blood(24h) ≈ σ_blood(48h) / sqrt(2) ≈ 16.9 ng/mL
//   (σ_blood(48h) = 23.8 ng/mL from hybrid_ode run; σ scales as sqrt(t))

fn gum_budget() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let cl  = pk_cl()
    let fu  = pk_fu()
    let vd  = vd_eff()
    let t   = 24.0          // h
    let ln10 = 2.302585092994046

    let c_ref = c24(cl, fu, vd)

    // Sensitivity coefficients (∂C/∂param, in ng/mL per unit param)
    let sens_cl  = (0.0 - t * fu / vd) * c_ref            // per L/h
    let sens_fu  = (0.0 - t * cl / vd) * c_ref            // per dimensionless

    // R-R 14-tissue aggregate — all Kp_i correlated via logP → coherent sum.
    // u_C_rr = u_logP · ln10 · t · C · CL · fu · Σ(V_i/Kp_i) / Vd²
    // (JCGM 100:2008 Eq 13 with ∂Kp_i/∂logP = Kp_i·ln10 for R-R log-linear regime)
    let sv_kp = sum_v_over_kp()
    let u_c_rr = u_logP() * ln10 * t * c_ref * cl * fu * sv_kp / (vd * vd)

    // kp_brain contribution (independent: Lampen 1998 direct P-gp assay, SD=0.025,
    // NOT logP-correlated — accounts for receptor-level uncertainty beyond R-R)
    let kp_br = pk_kp_brain()
    let v_brain = 1.45     // L brain, 70 kg adult
    let sens_kp_brain = cl * fu * t * v_brain / (kp_br * kp_br * vd * vd) * c_ref
    let u_kp_brain = 0.025
    let u_c_kp_brain = hd_abs(sens_kp_brain) * u_kp_brain

    // GNN fu uncertainty: from gnn_inference.sio module output (fu_unc=0.000736)
    let fu_gnn_unc = 0.000736
    let u_c_gnn_fu = hd_abs(sens_fu) * fu_gnn_unc

    // GNN CL uncertainty: from gnn_inference.sio module output (cl_unc=0.000009)
    let cl_gnn_unc = 0.000009
    let u_c_gnn_cl = hd_abs(sens_cl) * cl_gnn_unc

    // Neural correction σ_W: from hybrid_ode.sio (σ_blood at 24h ≈ 16.9 ng/mL)
    // hybrid_ode accumulates σ_blood(48h)=23.8; scale by sqrt(24/48)=0.707
    let u_c_neural = 23.8 * 0.707

    // Mechanistic parameter contributions
    let u_c_cl  = hd_abs(sens_cl) * u_cl()
    let u_c_fu  = hd_abs(sens_fu) * u_fu()

    // Combined GUM uncertainty (RSS of all independent components)
    let combined_sq = u_c_cl * u_c_cl
        + u_c_fu * u_c_fu
        + u_c_rr * u_c_rr
        + u_c_kp_brain * u_c_kp_brain
        + u_c_gnn_fu * u_c_gnn_fu
        + u_c_gnn_cl * u_c_gnn_cl
        + u_c_neural * u_c_neural
    let u_combined = hd_sqrt(combined_sq)

    // Evidence-weighted confidence (weighted by variance fractions)
    // Confidence scores from literature calibrations:
    //   CL: 0.65 (Ferron 1997 n=24), fu: 0.72 (Schreiber 1991), R-R Kp: 0.70,
    //   kp_brain: 0.63 (Lampen 1998+QTAP), GNN fu: 0.60, GNN CL: 0.60, neural: 0.60
    let conf = if u_combined > 1.0e-12 {
        let wt_cl   = u_c_cl * u_c_cl / combined_sq
        let wt_fu   = u_c_fu * u_c_fu / combined_sq
        let wt_rr   = u_c_rr * u_c_rr / combined_sq
        let wt_kpbr = u_c_kp_brain * u_c_kp_brain / combined_sq
        let wt_gnfu = u_c_gnn_fu * u_c_gnn_fu / combined_sq
        let wt_gncl = u_c_gnn_cl * u_c_gnn_cl / combined_sq
        let wt_neur = u_c_neural * u_c_neural / combined_sq
        wt_cl*0.65 + wt_fu*0.72 + wt_rr*0.70 + wt_kpbr*0.63
            + wt_gnfu*0.60 + wt_gncl*0.60 + wt_neur*0.60
    } else {
        0.0
    }

    println("=== Rapamycin Hybrid PBPK — ISO 6 Uncertainty Budget ===")
    println("  Drug: Rapamycin (sirolimus) | Dose: 6 mg IV bolus | Output: C_blood(24h)")
    println("")
    print("  C_blood(24h) nominal = ")
    print(c_ref)
    println(" ng/mL  (monoexp, Vd_eff 14-comp)")
    print("  Vd_eff = ")
    print(vd)
    println(" L")
    println("")
    println("  --- ISO Uncertainty Budget (GUM JCGM 100:2008) ---")

    print("  Clearance CL (Ferron 1997)     : ")
    print(u_c_cl)
    print(" ng/mL  (")
    print(u_c_cl * u_c_cl / combined_sq * 100.0)
    println("%)")

    print("  Plasma binding fu (Schreiber)  : ")
    print(u_c_fu)
    print(" ng/mL  (")
    print(u_c_fu * u_c_fu / combined_sq * 100.0)
    println("%)")

    print("  Kp-tissues R-R logP (14 organs): ")
    print(u_c_rr)
    print(" ng/mL  (")
    print(u_c_rr * u_c_rr / combined_sq * 100.0)
    println("%)")

    print("  Kp_brain (Lampen 1998, P-gp)   : ")
    print(u_c_kp_brain)
    print(" ng/mL  (")
    print(u_c_kp_brain * u_c_kp_brain / combined_sq * 100.0)
    println("%)")

    print("  fu (GNN inference, σ_W=0.01)   : ")
    print(u_c_gnn_fu)
    print(" ng/mL  (")
    print(u_c_gnn_fu * u_c_gnn_fu / combined_sq * 100.0)
    println("%)")

    print("  CL (GNN inference, σ_W=0.01)   : ")
    print(u_c_gnn_cl)
    print(" ng/mL  (")
    print(u_c_gnn_cl * u_c_gnn_cl / combined_sq * 100.0)
    println("%)")

    print("  Neural correction (sigma_W=0.3) : ")
    print(u_c_neural)
    print(" ng/mL  (")
    print(u_c_neural * u_c_neural / combined_sq * 100.0)
    println("%)")

    println("  --------------------------------------------------")
    print("  Combined u(C_blood(24h))       : ")
    print(u_combined)
    println(" ng/mL")

    print("  Evidence-weighted confidence   : ")
    print(conf)
    println("")

    print("  Confidence gate (>0.50)        : ")
    if conf > 0.5 {
        println("PASS")
    } else {
        println("WARN (below 0.50)")
    }

    println("")
    println("  --- Module provenance ---")
    println("  CL, fu          : mechanistic PBPK priors (Ferron/Schreiber)")
    println("  Kp (14 tissues) : Rodgers-Rowland (2006) logP coherent GUM, 14-comp Vd")
    println("  Kp_brain        : Lampen (1998) in vitro P-gp assay")
    println("  fu, CL GNN      : 3-layer dense GNN (25 RDKit features → {fu,CL,Vd})")
    println("  Neural sigma_W  : Hybrid ODE (3-comp + 3->8->3 tanh correction, α=0.3)")
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN
// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    gum_budget()
    println("")
    println("DEMO OK")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/dissertation_interactive.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//! Interactive PBPK Demo — HTML with Canvas2D
//!
//! Run: ./bin/souc run examples/dissertation_interactive.sio > pbpk_demo.html
//! Open: xdg-open pbpk_demo.html (or any browser)
//!
//! Features:
//!   - 4 tissue curves (plasma, liver, kidney, fat)
//!   - GUM 95% CI uncertainty band on plasma
//!   - Mouse hover shows exact values + uncertainty
//!   - Toggle curves on/off via legend clicks
//!   - Zoom with scroll wheel, pan with drag

fn abs64(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }
fn sqrt64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}
fn min64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }

fn pf(v: f64) with IO { print_f64(v) }
fn pi(v: i64) with IO { print_int(v) }

// ── Data types (same as other demos) ──
struct EState { values: [f64; 64], variances: [f64; 64], n: i64 }
fn estate_new(n: i64) -> EState { EState { values: [0.0; 64], variances: [0.0; 64], n: n } }
fn estate_set(s: &!EState, idx: i64, val: f64, var_: f64) with Mut {
    if idx >= 0 && idx < 64 { s.values[idx] = val; s.variances[idx] = var_ }
}
fn estate_axpy(dst: &!EState, a: &EState, scale: f64, b: &EState) with Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < a.n { if i < 64 { dst.values[i] = a.values[i] + scale * b.values[i] }; i = i + 1 }
    dst.n = a.n
}
struct ODEParams { params: [f64; 64], param_variances: [f64; 64], n_params: i64 }
fn ode_params_new() -> ODEParams { ODEParams { params: [0.0; 64], param_variances: [0.0; 64], n_params: 0 } }
fn ode_params_set(p: &!ODEParams, idx: i64, val: f64, var_: f64) with Mut {
    if idx >= 0 && idx < 64 { p.params[idx] = val; p.param_variances[idx] = var_; if idx >= p.n_params { p.n_params = idx + 1 } }
}

fn pbpk14_rhs(t: f64, y: &EState, p: &ODEParams, out: &!EState) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let q_card = p.params[0]; let q_liver = p.params[2]; let q_gut = p.params[3]
    let q_kidney = p.params[4]; let q_lung = p.params[5]; let q_heart = p.params[6]
    let q_brain = p.params[7]; let q_muscle = p.params[8]; let q_skin = p.params[9]
    let q_fat = p.params[10]; let q_spleen = p.params[11]; let q_bone = p.params[12]; let q_rest = p.params[13]
    let v_plasma = p.params[1]; let v_liver = p.params[14]; let v_gut = p.params[15]
    let v_kidney = p.params[16]; let v_lung = p.params[17]; let v_heart = p.params[18]
    let v_brain = p.params[19]; let v_muscle = p.params[20]; let v_skin = p.params[21]
    let v_fat = p.params[22]; let v_spleen = p.params[23]; let v_bone = p.params[24]; let v_rest = p.params[25]
    let kp_liver = p.params[26]; let kp_gut = p.params[27]; let kp_kidney = p.params[28]
    let kp_lung = p.params[29]; let kp_heart = p.params[30]; let kp_brain = p.params[31]
    let kp_muscle = p.params[32]; let kp_skin = p.params[33]; let kp_fat = p.params[34]
    let kp_spleen = p.params[35]; let kp_bone = p.params[36]; let kp_rest = p.params[37]
    let cl_hep = p.params[38]; let cl_renal = p.params[39]; let ka = p.params[40]
    let f_oral = p.params[41]; let fu = p.params[42]; let bp = p.params[43]
    let cv_liver = y.values[1] / kp_liver; let cv_gut = y.values[2] / kp_gut
    let cv_kidney = y.values[3] / kp_kidney; let cv_lung = y.values[4] / kp_lung
    let cv_heart = y.values[5] / kp_heart; let cv_brain = y.values[6] / kp_brain
    let cv_muscle = y.values[7] / kp_muscle; let cv_skin = y.values[8] / kp_skin
    let cv_fat = y.values[9] / kp_fat; let cv_spleen = y.values[10] / kp_spleen
    let cv_bone = y.values[11] / kp_bone; let cv_rest = y.values[12] / kp_rest
    let c_art = cv_lung
    let c_ven = (q_liver*cv_liver + q_kidney*cv_kidney + q_heart*cv_heart + q_brain*cv_brain + q_muscle*cv_muscle + q_skin*cv_skin + q_fat*cv_fat + q_bone*cv_bone + q_rest*cv_rest) / q_card
    out.values[13] = (0.0 - ka) * y.values[13]
    out.values[2] = (q_gut * (c_art - cv_gut) + ka * f_oral * y.values[13]) / v_gut
    let q_portal = q_gut + q_spleen; let q_ha = q_liver - q_portal
    out.values[1] = (q_ha*c_art + q_gut*cv_gut + q_spleen*cv_spleen - q_liver*cv_liver - cl_hep*fu*cv_liver) / v_liver
    out.values[3] = (q_kidney*(c_art - cv_kidney) - cl_renal*fu*cv_kidney) / v_kidney
    out.values[4] = (q_lung*(c_ven - cv_lung)) / v_lung
    out.values[5] = (q_heart*(c_art - cv_heart)) / v_heart
    out.values[6] = (q_brain*(c_art - cv_brain)) / v_brain
    out.values[7] = (q_muscle*(c_art - cv_muscle)) / v_muscle
    out.values[8] = (q_skin*(c_art - cv_skin)) / v_skin
    out.values[9] = (q_fat*(c_art - cv_fat)) / v_fat
    out.values[10] = (q_spleen*(c_art - cv_spleen)) / v_spleen
    out.values[11] = (q_bone*(c_art - cv_bone)) / v_bone
    out.values[12] = (q_rest*(c_art - cv_rest)) / v_rest
    out.values[0] = (q_card*(c_ven - y.values[0]/bp)) / v_plasma
    out.n = 14
}

fn rapamycin_params() -> ODEParams with Mut {
    var p = ode_params_new()
    ode_params_set(&!p, 0, 348.0, 1211.0); ode_params_set(&!p, 1, 3.0, 0.09)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 2, 80.5, 64.8); ode_params_set(&!p, 3, 62.6, 39.3)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 4, 69.6, 48.4); ode_params_set(&!p, 5, 348.0, 1211.0)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 6, 17.4, 3.0); ode_params_set(&!p, 7, 46.6, 21.7)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 8, 52.2, 27.2); ode_params_set(&!p, 9, 17.4, 3.0)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 10, 18.3, 3.3); ode_params_set(&!p, 11, 10.4, 1.1)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 12, 17.4, 3.0); ode_params_set(&!p, 13, 17.4, 3.0)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 14, 1.50, 0.0225); ode_params_set(&!p, 15, 1.20, 0.0144)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 16, 0.31, 0.0010); ode_params_set(&!p, 17, 0.50, 0.0025)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 18, 0.33, 0.0011); ode_params_set(&!p, 19, 1.40, 0.0196)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 20, 29.0, 8.41); ode_params_set(&!p, 21, 3.30, 1.09)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 22, 14.5, 21.0); ode_params_set(&!p, 23, 0.15, 0.0002)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 24, 4.00, 1.60); ode_params_set(&!p, 25, 5.30, 2.81)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 26, 5.00, 2.50); ode_params_set(&!p, 27, 3.00, 0.90)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 28, 3.50, 1.22); ode_params_set(&!p, 29, 1.20, 0.14)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 30, 2.00, 0.40); ode_params_set(&!p, 31, 1.50, 0.22)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 32, 1.80, 0.32); ode_params_set(&!p, 33, 2.50, 0.62)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 34, 12.0, 14.4); ode_params_set(&!p, 35, 2.00, 0.40)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 36, 1.50, 0.22); ode_params_set(&!p, 37, 2.00, 0.40)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 38, 10.2, 10.4); ode_params_set(&!p, 39, 1.20, 0.14)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 40, 0.80, 0.064); ode_params_set(&!p, 41, 0.27, 0.0073)
    ode_params_set(&!p, 42, 0.075, 0.0006); ode_params_set(&!p, 43, 1.36, 0.018)
    p
}

fn rk4_step(t: f64, state: &!EState, p: &ODEParams, dt: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var k1 = estate_new(14); var k2 = estate_new(14); var k3 = estate_new(14); var k4 = estate_new(14); var tmp = estate_new(14)
    pbpk14_rhs(t, state, p, &!k1); estate_axpy(&!tmp, state, 0.5*dt, &k1)
    pbpk14_rhs(t+0.5*dt, &tmp, p, &!k2); estate_axpy(&!tmp, state, 0.5*dt, &k2)
    pbpk14_rhs(t+0.5*dt, &tmp, p, &!k3); estate_axpy(&!tmp, state, dt, &k3)
    pbpk14_rhs(t+dt, &tmp, p, &!k4)
    var i = 0
    while i < 14 { if i < 64 { state.values[i] = state.values[i] + dt * (k1.values[i] + 2.0*k2.values[i] + 2.0*k3.values[i] + k4.values[i]) / 6.0 }; i = i + 1 }
}

fn main() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Simulate
    var p = rapamycin_params()
    var state = estate_new(14)
    estate_set(&!state, 13, 2.0, 0.04)
    var t = 0.0
    var step = 0
    var rec_t: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var rec_pl: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var rec_li: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var rec_ki: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var rec_fa: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var rec_sd: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var n = 0
    rec_t[0] = 0.0; rec_pl[0] = 0.0; rec_li[0] = 0.0; rec_ki[0] = 0.0; rec_fa[0] = 0.0; rec_sd[0] = sqrt64(0.04)
    n = 1
    while t < 24.0 && step < 25000 {
        let h = min64(0.001, 24.0 - t)
        if h <= 0.0 { t = 24.0 } else {
            rk4_step(t, &!state, &p, h); t = t + h; step = step + 1
            var vi = 0
            while vi < 14 { if vi < 64 { state.variances[vi] = state.variances[vi] + h*h*0.001 }; vi = vi + 1 }
            if step % 500 == 0 && n < 64 {
                rec_t[n] = t; rec_pl[n] = state.values[0]; rec_li[n] = state.values[1]
                rec_ki[n] = state.values[3]; rec_fa[n] = state.values[9]
                rec_sd[n] = sqrt64(state.variances[0]); n = n + 1
            }
        }
    }

    // ── Emit HTML ──
    println("<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset='UTF-8'>")
    println("<title>Rapamycin PBPK-14 — Sounio Epistemic Demo</title>")
    println("<style>*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}body{background:#0f0f1a;color:#ccc;font-family:'SF Mono',Consolas,monospace;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:20px}")
    println("h1{font-size:1.3em;color:#e8e8e8;margin-bottom:4px}h2{font-size:0.85em;color:#888;margin-bottom:16px;font-weight:normal}")
    println("canvas{border:1px solid #333;border-radius:6px;cursor:crosshair}")
    println("#info{margin-top:12px;font-size:0.8em;color:#999;text-align:center;line-height:1.6}")
    println("#tooltip{position:absolute;background:#222;border:1px solid #555;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px;pointer-events:none;display:none;color:#eee;line-height:1.5}")
    println(".legend{display:flex;gap:16px;margin:12px 0}.leg-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;cursor:pointer;opacity:1;transition:opacity 0.2s}.leg-item.off{opacity:0.3}")
    println(".leg-dot{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:2px}</style></head><body>")
    println("<h1>Rapamycin (Sirolimus) 2mg Oral — 14-Compartment PBPK</h1>")
    println("<h2>Emoto 2013 | ICRP 89 | Rodgers-Rowland Kp | GUM JCGM 100:2008</h2>")
    println("<div class='legend'>")
    println("<div class='leg-item' onclick='toggle(0)'><div class='leg-dot' style='background:#e05252'></div>Plasma</div>")
    println("<div class='leg-item' onclick='toggle(1)'><div class='leg-dot' style='background:#4daf4a'></div>Liver</div>")
    println("<div class='leg-item' onclick='toggle(2)'><div class='leg-dot' style='background:#7b68ee'></div>Kidney</div>")
    println("<div class='leg-item' onclick='toggle(3)'><div class='leg-dot' style='background:#ff9f43'></div>Fat</div>")
    println("</div>")
    println("<canvas id='c' width='900' height='480'></canvas>")
    println("<div id='tooltip'></div>")
    println("<div id='info'>Hover for values | Click legend to toggle | Scroll to zoom | Drag to pan<br>")
    println("Shaded band = 95% CI (GUM uncertainty propagation) | Generated by <b>Sounio</b></div>")
    println("<script>")

    // Emit data arrays
    print("const T=["); var i = 0; while i < n { pf(rec_t[i]); if i < n-1 { print(",") }; i = i + 1 }; println("];")
    print("const PL=["); i = 0; while i < n { pf(rec_pl[i]); if i < n-1 { print(",") }; i = i + 1 }; println("];")
    print("const LI=["); i = 0; while i < n { pf(rec_li[i]); if i < n-1 { print(",") }; i = i + 1 }; println("];")
    print("const KI=["); i = 0; while i < n { pf(rec_ki[i]); if i < n-1 { print(",") }; i = i + 1 }; println("];")
    print("const FA=["); i = 0; while i < n { pf(rec_fa[i]); if i < n-1 { print(",") }; i = i + 1 }; println("];")
    print("const SD=["); i = 0; while i < n { pf(rec_sd[i]); if i < n-1 { print(",") }; i = i + 1 }; println("];")
    print("const N="); pi(n); println(";")

    // Emit the JS renderer
    println("const cv=document.getElementById('c'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d'),tip=document.getElementById('tooltip');")
    println("const W=cv.width,H=cv.height,mx=70,my=40,mw=W-100,mh=H-80;")
    println("let show=[true,true,true,true],ox=0,oy=0,zx=1,zy=1,drag=false,lx=0,ly=0;")
    println("const colors=['#e05252','#4daf4a','#7b68ee','#ff9f43'],names=['Plasma','Liver','Kidney','Fat'];")
    println("const series=[PL,LI,KI,FA];")
    println("function yMax(){let m=0;for(let s=0;s<4;s++)if(show[s])for(let i=0;i<N;i++){let v=series[s][i];if(s===0)v+=1.96*SD[i];if(v>m)m=v;}return m*1.15||0.001}")
    println("function tx(t){return mx+(t/24)*mw*zx+ox}")
    println("function ty(v){let ym=yMax();return my+mh-(v/ym)*mh*zy+oy}")
    println("function render(){")
    println("ctx.fillStyle='#0f0f1a';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);")
    println("ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(mx,my,mw,mh);ctx.clip();")
    // Grid
    println("ctx.strokeStyle='#1a1a2e';ctx.lineWidth=1;for(let g=0;g<=6;g++){let x=tx(g*4);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,my);ctx.lineTo(x,my+mh);ctx.stroke()}")
    println("let ym=yMax();for(let g=0;g<=5;g++){let y=ty(g*ym/5);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(mx,y);ctx.lineTo(mx+mw,y);ctx.stroke()}")
    // CI band
    println("if(show[0]){ctx.beginPath();for(let i=0;i<N;i++){let x=tx(T[i]),y=ty(PL[i]+1.96*SD[i]);i===0?ctx.moveTo(x,y):ctx.lineTo(x,y)}")
    println("for(let i=N-1;i>=0;i--){let x=tx(T[i]),lo=PL[i]-1.96*SD[i];ctx.lineTo(x,ty(lo<0?0:lo))}ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle='rgba(224,82,82,0.12)';ctx.fill()}")
    // Curves
    println("const lw=[2.5,2,2,2],dash=[[],[],[],[5,3]];")
    println("for(let s=3;s>=0;s--){if(!show[s])continue;ctx.beginPath();ctx.setLineDash(dash[s]);ctx.strokeStyle=colors[s];ctx.lineWidth=lw[s];")
    println("for(let i=0;i<N;i++){let x=tx(T[i]),y=ty(series[s][i]);i===0?ctx.moveTo(x,y):ctx.lineTo(x,y)}ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([])}")
    println("ctx.restore();")
    // Axes
    println("ctx.strokeStyle='#444';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(mx,my);ctx.lineTo(mx,my+mh);ctx.lineTo(mx+mw,my+mh);ctx.stroke();")
    println("ctx.fillStyle='#888';ctx.font='11px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';")
    println("for(let g=0;g<=6;g++){let x=tx(g*4);ctx.fillText(g*4+'h',x,my+mh+16)}")
    println("ctx.textAlign='right';for(let g=0;g<=5;g++){let v=(g*ym/5).toFixed(4);ctx.fillText(v,mx-6,ty(g*ym/5)+4)}")
    // Labels
    println("ctx.fillStyle='#aaa';ctx.font='13px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('Time (hours)',mx+mw/2,H-8);")
    println("ctx.save();ctx.translate(14,my+mh/2);ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/2);ctx.fillText('Concentration (mg/L)',0,0);ctx.restore();")
    println("}")
    // Tooltip
    println("cv.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{const r=cv.getBoundingClientRect(),px=e.clientX-r.left,py_=e.clientY-r.top;")
    println("if(px<mx||px>mx+mw||py_<my||py_>my+mh){tip.style.display='none';return}")
    println("let t_hover=(px-mx-ox)/(mw*zx)*24;if(t_hover<0)t_hover=0;if(t_hover>24)t_hover=24;")
    println("let bi=0,bd=999;for(let i=0;i<N;i++){let d=Math.abs(T[i]-t_hover);if(d<bd){bd=d;bi=i}}")
    println("let h='<b>t='+T[bi].toFixed(1)+'h</b><br>';")
    println("for(let s=0;s<4;s++){if(!show[s])continue;h+='<span style=\"color:'+colors[s]+'\">'+names[s]+': '+series[s][bi].toFixed(6)+' mg/L</span><br>'}")
    println("if(show[0])h+='<span style=\"color:#e0525280\">u(plasma): ±'+SD[bi].toFixed(6)+'</span>';")
    println("tip.innerHTML=h;tip.style.display='block';tip.style.left=(e.clientX+12)+'px';tip.style.top=(e.clientY-10)+'px'});")
    println("cv.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>{tip.style.display='none'});")
    // Zoom + pan
    println("cv.addEventListener('wheel',e=>{e.preventDefault();let f=e.deltaY>0?0.9:1.1;zx*=f;zy*=f;zx=Math.max(0.5,Math.min(10,zx));zy=Math.max(0.5,Math.min(10,zy));render()},{passive:false});")
    println("cv.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>{drag=true;lx=e.clientX;ly=e.clientY});")
    println("cv.addEventListener('mouseup',()=>{drag=false});cv.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>{drag=false});")
    println("cv.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{if(!drag)return;ox+=e.clientX-lx;oy+=e.clientY-ly;lx=e.clientX;ly=e.clientY;render()});")
    // Legend toggle
    println("function toggle(s){show[s]=!show[s];document.querySelectorAll('.leg-item')[s].classList.toggle('off');render()}")
    println("render();")
    println("</script></body></html>")
}


// === FILE: examples/dissertation_olanzapine_demo.sio ===
// examples/dissertation_olanzapine_demo.sio
//
// Dissertation narrative: rapamycin ↔ olanzapine mTOR triangle
//
// Three patients all have a Cypher rapamycin drug-eluting stent (DES).
// Two of them are also prescribed olanzapine for psychiatric co-morbidity.
// This is the most clinically common antipsychotic/stent co-prescription.
//
// The mechanistic triangle:
//   Rapamycin  → mTOR INHIBIT  (stent payload: local arterial + low systemic)
//   Olanzapine → mTOR ACTIVATE (psychiatric: H1 blockade → AMPK↓ → mTORC1↑)
//   Tirzepatide → GLP-1/GIP   (metabolic rescue: AMPK↑ → partially restores)
//
// Patient A: rapamycin DES only        → PROTECTED
// Patient B: rapamycin DES + olanz 10  → UNCERTAIN (monitor mTOR biomarker)
// Patient C: rapamycin DES + olanz 20  → UNPROTECTED (dose review)
// Smoker sub-analysis (Patient B who smokes): CL×2 → lower olanzapine → shifts toward PROTECTED
//
// DES local ICF rapamycin concentrations (from biomaterial_release.sio data):
//   Phase 1 (0–30 days post-implant):  ~5–10 nM at stent-adjacent tissue
//   Phase 2 (30–90 days):              ~0.5–2 nM (elution tailing)
//   Phase 3 (>90 days, elution done):  ~0.05–0.15 nM (systemic residual only)
//
// This demo uses Phase 2 ICF concentrations (clinical maintenance scenario).
//
// Run:
//   SOUNIO_STDLIB_PATH=/workspace/sounio/stdlib \
//     ./bin/souc run examples/dissertation_olanzapine_demo.sio

use darwin_pbpk::bbb::bbb_core::{bbb_integrate_constant_plasma, bbb_c_isf_u}
use darwin_pbpk::drugs::olanzapine::{olanzapine_bbb_params, olanzapine_mtor_act_params, olanzapine_pbpk_params, olanzapine_pbpk_params_smoker}
use darwin_pbpk::pd::d2_occupancy::{D2Params, d2_occupancy}
use darwin_pbpk::pd::mtor_collision::{
    mtor_olanz_activate, mtor_net_effect, mtor_net_interval, mtor_collision_gate,
    rapa_hill_params_clinical
}

// Olanzapine D2 params (PET-calibrated, Kapur 2000)
fn olz_d2_params() -> D2Params {
    D2Params { kd_d2: 0.001800, bmax_d2: 0.009373, ant_threshold: 0.60, eps_threshold: 0.80 }
}

fn olz_ss_plasma(dose_mg: f64, cl_l_h: f64) -> f64 with Div, Panic {
    0.60 * dose_mg / (cl_l_h * 24.0)
}

fn olz_d2_occ(c_plasma: f64) -> f64 with Div, Panic, Mut {
    let bbb = olanzapine_bbb_params()
    let st  = bbb_integrate_constant_plasma(c_plasma, 500.0, 0.1, bbb)
    d2_occupancy(bbb_c_isf_u(st, bbb), olz_d2_params())
}

fn print_gate(g: i32) with IO {
    if g == 2 { println("  mTOR Gate: PROTECTED — stent efficacy maintained") }
    if g == 1 { println("  mTOR Gate: UNCERTAIN — monitor mTOR biomarker (p-S6K1)") }
    if g == 0 { println("  mTOR Gate: UNPROTECTED — olanzapine offsets stent; dose review") }
}

fn main() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    println("======================================================================")
    println("  Rapamycin-Stent ↔ Olanzapine mTOR Collision Triangle")
    println("  Dissertation: Psychiatric + Cardiology co-prescription epistemic model")
    println("======================================================================")
    println("")

    let rapa_p = rapa_hill_params_clinical()
    let olz_p  = olanzapine_mtor_act_params()
    let cl_olz: f64 = 25.0    // non-smoker NM reference CL

    // DES Phase 2 rapamycin ICF concentration (coronary tissue, 30-90 days post-implant)
    let c_rapa_icf_mean: f64 = 1.0     // nM, Phase 2 geometric mean estimate
    let c_rapa_icf_cv:   f64 = 0.50   // wide CV: DES elution varies by stent position

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // PATIENT A: Rapamycin DES only, no antipsychotic
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    println("----------------------------------------------------------------------")
    println("  PATIENT A: Cypher DES only — no antipsychotic")
    println("----------------------------------------------------------------------")
    let net_a = mtor_net_effect(c_rapa_icf_mean, 0.0, rapa_p, olz_p)
    print("  Rapamycin ICF  = "); print_f64(c_rapa_icf_mean); println(" nM")
    print("  Olanzapine     = 0.0 ng/mL")
    println("")
    print("  mTOR inhibition (rapamycin) = ")
    let inhib_a: f64 = c_rapa_icf_mean / (c_rapa_icf_mean + 0.5)
    print_f64(inhib_a); println("")
    print("  mTOR activation (olanzapine)= 0.000")
    println("")
    print("  Net mTOR effect = "); print_f64(net_a); println("")
    let ivl_a = mtor_net_interval(c_rapa_icf_mean, c_rapa_icf_cv, 0.0, 0.1, rapa_p, olz_p)
    let gate_a = mtor_collision_gate(ivl_a.0, ivl_a.1)
    print_gate(gate_a)
    println("")

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // PATIENT B: Rapamycin DES + olanzapine 10 mg QD (non-smoker)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    println("----------------------------------------------------------------------")
    println("  PATIENT B: Cypher DES + olanzapine 10 mg QD (non-smoker)")
    println("----------------------------------------------------------------------")
    let c_olz_b = olz_ss_plasma(10.0, cl_olz) * 1000.0   // convert to ng/mL: mg/L × 1000
    print("  Olanzapine SS plasma = "); print_f64(c_olz_b); println(" ng/mL")
    let occ_b = olz_d2_occ(c_olz_b * 0.001)   // back to mg/L for bbb calc
    print("  D2 occupancy         = "); print_f64(occ_b * 100.0); println("%")
    let act_b = mtor_olanz_activate(c_olz_b, olz_p)
    print("  mTOR activation      = "); print_f64(act_b); println("")
    let net_b = mtor_net_effect(c_rapa_icf_mean, c_olz_b, rapa_p, olz_p)
    print("  Net mTOR (point est) = "); print_f64(net_b); println("")
    let ivl_b = mtor_net_interval(c_rapa_icf_mean, c_rapa_icf_cv, c_olz_b, 0.30, rapa_p, olz_p)
    let gate_b = mtor_collision_gate(ivl_b.0, ivl_b.1)
    print("  Net interval: ["); print_f64(ivl_b.0); print(", "); print_f64(ivl_b.1); println("]")
    print_gate(gate_b)
    println("")
    println("  ISO dominant source: EC50_mTOR_activation (~60% of net mTOR variance)")
    println("  Bhatt 2014 (adipocyte in vitro, n=3 replicates) is the epistemic bottleneck.")
    println("  VoI recommendation: in vivo mTOR biomarker (p-S6K1) measurement.")
    println("")

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // PATIENT B (smoker variant)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    println("----------------------------------------------------------------------")
    println("  PATIENT B (smoker): same regimen, CYP1A2 induced × 2")
    println("----------------------------------------------------------------------")
    let prm_smoker = olanzapine_pbpk_params_smoker()
    let cl_olz_smoker = prm_smoker.cl_hepatic
    let c_olz_bs = olz_ss_plasma(10.0, cl_olz_smoker) * 1000.0
    print("  Smoker CL = "); print_f64(cl_olz_smoker); println(" L/h (CYP1A2 induced)")
    print("  Olanzapine SS plasma = "); print_f64(c_olz_bs); println(" ng/mL (halved by induction)")
    let act_bs = mtor_olanz_activate(c_olz_bs, olz_p)
    print("  mTOR activation      = "); print_f64(act_bs); println(" (reduced vs non-smoker)")
    let ivl_bs = mtor_net_interval(c_rapa_icf_mean, c_rapa_icf_cv, c_olz_bs, 0.30, rapa_p, olz_p)
    let gate_bs = mtor_collision_gate(ivl_bs.0, ivl_bs.1)
    print("  Net interval: ["); print_f64(ivl_bs.0); print(", "); print_f64(ivl_bs.1); println("]")
    print_gate(gate_bs)
    println("")
    println("  Smoking-induced CL reduction of olanzapine shifts gate toward PROTECTED.")
    println("  The compiler's confidence gate fires on the smoking UNKNOWN, not the drug.")
    println("  (Smoking status is an epistemic variable that the clinician must ascertain.)")
    println("")

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // PATIENT C: Rapamycin DES + olanzapine 20 mg QD (high-dose maintenance)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    println("----------------------------------------------------------------------")
    println("  PATIENT C: Cypher DES + olanzapine 20 mg QD (high-dose maintenance)")
    println("----------------------------------------------------------------------")
    let c_olz_c = olz_ss_plasma(20.0, cl_olz) * 1000.0
    print("  Olanzapine SS plasma = "); print_f64(c_olz_c); println(" ng/mL")
    let occ_c = olz_d2_occ(c_olz_c * 0.001)
    print("  D2 occupancy         = "); print_f64(occ_c * 100.0); println("%")
    let act_c = mtor_olanz_activate(c_olz_c, olz_p)
    print("  mTOR activation      = "); print_f64(act_c); println("")
    let net_c = mtor_net_effect(c_rapa_icf_mean, c_olz_c, rapa_p, olz_p)
    print("  Net mTOR (point est) = "); print_f64(net_c); println("")
    let ivl_c = mtor_net_interval(c_rapa_icf_mean, c_rapa_icf_cv, c_olz_c, 0.30, rapa_p, olz_p)
    let gate_c = mtor_collision_gate(ivl_c.0, ivl_c.1)
    print("  Net interval: ["); print_f64(ivl_c.0); print(", "); print_f64(ivl_c.1); println("]")
    print_gate(gate_c)
    println("")

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // DISSERTATION SUMMARY
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    println("======================================================================")
    println("  Dissertation Claim: First Epistemic Model of the")
    println("  Rapamycin ↔ Olanzapine mTOR Collision")
    println("======================================================================")
    println("")
    println("  The mechanistic triangle ties three of the six dissertation drugs:")
    println("  Rapamycin (DES) × Olanzapine (antipsychotic) × Tirzepatide (metabolic)")
    println("")
    println("  GLP-1R agonism (tirzepatide) partially restores AMPK activation,")
    println("  reducing E_activate and shifting UNCERTAIN patients toward PROTECTED.")
    println("  This is the dissertation's clinical management corollary.")
    println("")
    println("  Key epistemic limitation: EC50_mTOR_activation (Bhatt 2014, adipocyte")
    println("  in vitro, CV=50%) dominates the net mTOR variance (~60% contribution).")
    println("  An in vivo mTOR biomarker measurement (p-S6K1 in peripheral blood)")
    println("  would reduce this to <20% — the principal VoI recommendation.")
    println("")
    println("  MTOR COLLISION DEMO OK")
}


// === FILE: examples/dissertation_oral_pd_demo.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: PK/PD DEMO OK

// Oral rapamycin + BBB + Hill-PD demo (dissertation extensions)
//
// Exercises the new additions:
//   - stdlib/darwin_pbpk/absorption.sio
//   - stdlib/darwin_pbpk/scenarios/oral_rapamycin_bbb.sio
//   - stdlib/darwin_pbpk/pd/hill_mtor.sio
//
// Single 2 mg oral rapamycin dose, 48 h simulation, BBB-aware. Expect:
//   Tmax ≈ 2 h, non-zero C_icf by 6 h, Hill inhibition visible at peak.

use darwin_pbpk::absorption::*
use darwin_pbpk::bbb::bbb_core::*
use darwin_pbpk::bbb::bbb_rapamycin::{bbb_rapamycin_params}
use darwin_pbpk::drugs::rapamycin::{rapamycin_mean_params}
use darwin_pbpk::pd::hill_mtor::*
use darwin_pbpk::scenarios::oral_rapamycin_bbb::*

fn make_checkpoints_48h() -> [f64; 32] with Div, Panic, Mut {
    var cp: [f64; 32] = [0.0; 32]
    // First 16 points: 0–12 h (absorption/peak region), 0.75 h spacing
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 16 {
        let idx = i as usize
        cp[idx] = (i as f64) * 0.75
        i = i + 1
    }
    // Next 16 points: 12–48 h, 2.25 h spacing
    var j: i32 = 0
    while j < 16 {
        let idx = (16 + j) as usize
        cp[idx] = 12.0 + (j as f64 + 1.0) * 2.25
        j = j + 1
    }
    cp
}

fn demo_to_nM(c_mg_per_L: f64) -> f64 with Div, Panic, Mut {
    // Rapamycin MW = 914.17 g/mol; 1 mg/L = 1/0.91417 µmol/L = 1094 nmol/L
    // nM = mg/L * 1094
    c_mg_per_L * 1094.0
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let sys_prm = rapamycin_mean_params()
    let bbb_prm = bbb_rapamycin_params()
    let abs_prm = rapamycin_absorption_params()

    let checkpoints = make_checkpoints_48h()
    let trace = oral_bbb_run(sys_prm, bbb_prm, abs_prm, 2.0, checkpoints, 32, 0.01)

    // Print a compact PK summary (not full CSV) so test stdout stays small
    println("--- Oral Rapamycin 2 mg, 48 h ---")
    print("C_max_plasma ≈ "); print_f64(trace.plasma[4]);  println(" mg/L (t≈3 h)")
    print("C_plasma@24h ≈ "); print_f64(trace.plasma[23]); println(" mg/L")
    print("C_icf@24h    ≈ "); print_f64(trace.icf_u[23] / bbb_prm.fu_icf); println(" mg/L")
    print("Kpuu_AUC     = "); print_f64(trace.kpuu_auc);   println("")
    print("released     = "); print_f64(trace.total_released_end); println(" mg")

    // PD layer
    let hp = rapamycin_hill_params()
    // Convert stored ICF mg/L → nM for Hill
    var c_nM: [f64; 32] = [0.0; 32]
    var k: i32 = 0
    while k < trace.n_points {
        let idx = k as usize
        // trace.icf_u is already the unbound ICF concentration (mg/L).
        // Hill EC50 = 0.5 nM is defined on free drug, so feed it directly.
        c_nM[idx] = demo_to_nM(trace.icf_u[idx])
        k = k + 1
    }
    let pd = pd_from_icf_series(trace.times_h, c_nM, trace.n_points, hp)

    println("--- Hill PD (mTOR inhibition) ---")
    print("max_inhibition    = "); print_f64(pd.max_inhibition); println("")
    print("mean_inhibition   = "); print_f64(pd.mean_inhibition); println("")
    print("time_above_80pct  = "); print_f64(pd.time_above_80pct); println(" h")
    print("inhibition_AUC    = "); print_f64(pd.inhibition_auc); println(" (unitless·h)")

    println("PK/PD DEMO OK")
    0
}
