// ─── Main ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    init_data()

    let a: Sedenion = make_a(0.2)
    train_c(a)

    // Baseline: interictal holdout MSE and associator
    let baseline_mse:   f64 = mse_II_holdout(a)
    let baseline_assoc: f64 = assoc_II(a)

    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════")
    println("  Door F: Pre-ictal sweep — MSE vs Associator Norm  (α=0.2)")
    println("  chb06, seizure at 327s, 256Hz, 16ch")
    println("  Baseline: interictal holdout at t=10s")
    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════")
    println("")
    print("  baseline_mse=");   print(baseline_mse);   println("")
    print("  baseline_assoc="); print(baseline_assoc); println("")
    println("")
    println("  label    t_rel  mse        mse_ratio  assoc      assoc_ratio")
    println("  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────")

    let mse_FAR:   f64 = mse_FAR(a)
    let assoc_FAR: f64 = assoc_FAR(a)
    let mse_r_FAR: f64 = if baseline_mse   > 0.000001 { mse_FAR   / baseline_mse   } else { 0.0 }
    let asc_r_FAR: f64 = if baseline_assoc > 0.000001 { assoc_FAR / baseline_assoc } else { 0.0 }
    print("  FAR      -60s  "); print(mse_FAR); print("  "); print(mse_r_FAR)
    print("  "); print(assoc_FAR); print("  "); print(asc_r_FAR); println("")

    let mse_PRE30:   f64 = mse_PRE30(a)
    let assoc_PRE30: f64 = assoc_PRE30(a)
    let mse_r_PRE30: f64 = if baseline_mse   > 0.000001 { mse_PRE30   / baseline_mse   } else { 0.0 }
    let asc_r_PRE30: f64 = if baseline_assoc > 0.000001 { assoc_PRE30 / baseline_assoc } else { 0.0 }
    print("  PRE30    -30s  "); print(mse_PRE30); print("  "); print(mse_r_PRE30)
    print("  "); print(assoc_PRE30); print("  "); print(asc_r_PRE30); println("")

    let mse_PRE10:   f64 = mse_PRE10(a)
    let assoc_PRE10: f64 = assoc_PRE10(a)
    let mse_r_PRE10: f64 = if baseline_mse   > 0.000001 { mse_PRE10   / baseline_mse   } else { 0.0 }
    let asc_r_PRE10: f64 = if baseline_assoc > 0.000001 { assoc_PRE10 / baseline_assoc } else { 0.0 }
    print("  PRE10    -10s  "); print(mse_PRE10); print("  "); print(mse_r_PRE10)
    print("  "); print(assoc_PRE10); print("  "); print(asc_r_PRE10); println("")

    let mse_PRE5:   f64 = mse_PRE5(a)
    let assoc_PRE5: f64 = assoc_PRE5(a)
    let mse_r_PRE5: f64 = if baseline_mse   > 0.000001 { mse_PRE5   / baseline_mse   } else { 0.0 }
    let asc_r_PRE5: f64 = if baseline_assoc > 0.000001 { assoc_PRE5 / baseline_assoc } else { 0.0 }
    print("  PRE5      -5s  "); print(mse_PRE5); print("  "); print(mse_r_PRE5)
    print("  "); print(assoc_PRE5); print("  "); print(asc_r_PRE5); println("")

    let mse_IC:   f64 = mse_IC(a)
    let assoc_IC: f64 = assoc_IC(a)
    let mse_r_IC: f64 = if baseline_mse   > 0.000001 { mse_IC   / baseline_mse   } else { 0.0 }
    let asc_r_IC: f64 = if baseline_assoc > 0.000001 { assoc_IC / baseline_assoc } else { 0.0 }
    print("  IC        +0s  "); print(mse_IC); print("  "); print(mse_r_IC)
    print("  "); print(assoc_IC); print("  "); print(asc_r_IC); println("")

    let mse_POST:   f64 = mse_POST(a)
    let assoc_POST: f64 = assoc_POST(a)
    let mse_r_POST: f64 = if baseline_mse   > 0.000001 { mse_POST   / baseline_mse   } else { 0.0 }
    let asc_r_POST: f64 = if baseline_assoc > 0.000001 { assoc_POST / baseline_assoc } else { 0.0 }
    print("  POST      +5s  "); print(mse_POST); print("  "); print(mse_r_POST)
    print("  "); print(assoc_POST); print("  "); print(asc_r_POST); println("")

    println("")

    // ── Sanity checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    var passed: i32 = 0
    var failed: i32 = 0

    // T1: IC window MSE > baseline (seizure is detectable by MSE at onset)
    let mse_ic_val:   f64 = mse_IC(a)
    let mse_ic_r:     f64 = if baseline_mse > 0.000001 { mse_ic_val / baseline_mse } else { 0.0 }
    if mse_ic_r > 1.0 {
        print("T1 PASS: MSE at onset = "); print(mse_ic_r); println("× baseline (>1.0)")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("T1 FAIL: MSE at onset = "); print(mse_ic_r); println("× baseline (expected >1.0)")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T2: Associator is non-zero at baseline (sedenion non-associativity active)
    if baseline_assoc > 0.0 {
        print("T2 PASS: baseline assoc = "); print(baseline_assoc); println(" > 0")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("T2 FAIL: baseline assoc = 0 (associator vanished)")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T3: IC associator != baseline (structural disruption at onset)
    let assoc_ic_val: f64 = assoc_IC(a)
    let assoc_ic_r:   f64 = if baseline_assoc > 0.000001 { assoc_ic_val / baseline_assoc } else { 0.0 }
    if assoc_ic_r > 0.5 {
        print("T3 PASS: assoc at onset = "); print(assoc_ic_r); println("× baseline (structural change)")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("T3 FAIL: assoc at onset = "); print(assoc_ic_r); println("× (no change)")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T4 (exploratory): does assoc_ratio rise pre-ictally before MSE?
    //   Check PRE10: assoc_ratio > 1.1 or (assoc_ratio > mse_ratio + 0.1)
    let assoc_pre10: f64 = assoc_PRE10(a)
    let mse_pre10:   f64 = mse_PRE10(a)
    let asc_r_pre10: f64 = if baseline_assoc > 0.000001 { assoc_pre10 / baseline_assoc } else { 0.0 }
    let mse_r_pre10: f64 = if baseline_mse   > 0.000001 { mse_pre10   / baseline_mse   } else { 0.0 }
    if asc_r_pre10 > mse_r_pre10 {
        print("T4 PASS (exploratory): assoc_ratio at −10s = "); print(asc_r_pre10)
        print(" > mse_ratio = "); print(mse_r_pre10); println("")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("T4 FAIL (exploratory): assoc_ratio at −10s = "); print(asc_r_pre10)
        print(" ≤ mse_ratio = "); print(mse_r_pre10); println("")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    println("")
    if failed == 0 { println("ALL PASS") }
    else { print("FAILURES: "); print(failed); println("") }

    print("  Passed: "); print(passed); println("")
    print("  Failed: "); print(failed); println("")

    0
}


// === FILE: examples/door_f_assoc_preictal_chb10.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Door F: Pre-ictal sweep — MSE vs Associator Norm
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// Data: CHB-MIT chb10  (data/chbmit/chb10_12.edf)
// Seizure onset at 6313s, 256 Hz, 16 channels.
// α fixed = 0.2 (interior optimum confirmed Door III + E)
//
// Door II found NO pre-ictal MSE ramp (null). MSE measures prediction error.
// The associator ||(A⊗h)⊗x − A⊗(h⊗x)|| measures geometric non-associativity:
// the structural coupling between brain dynamics and the sedenion gate.
//
// Hypothesis: assoc_ratio rises >1.0 pre-ictally while mse_ratio stays ≈1.0.
//
// Probe windows (each 80 samples = ~312ms at 256Hz):
//   FAR   t=6253s  (−60s from onset) — far pre-ictal baseline
//   PRE30 t=6283s  (−30s)
//   PRE10 t=6303s  (−10s)
//   PRE5  t=6308s  (−5s)
//   IC    t=6313s  (onset, 0s)
//   POST  t=6318s  (+5s)

use math::sedenion::*;

// ─── Math helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fn sqrt_s(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y: f64 = x
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 20 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

fn exp_s(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 20.0 { return exp_s(10.0) * exp_s(x - 10.0) }
    if x < 0.0 - 20.0 { return 0.0 }
    var s: f64 = 1.0
    var term: f64 = 1.0
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); s = s + term; i = i + 1 }
    s
}

fn tanh_s(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 10.0 { return 1.0 }
    if x < 0.0 - 10.0 { return 0.0 - 1.0 }
    let e2 = exp_s(2.0 * x)
    (e2 - 1.0) / (e2 + 1.0)
}

fn sed_tanh_s(s: Sedenion) -> Sedenion with Mut, Div, Panic {
    Sedenion {
        e0: tanh_s(s.e0),   e1: tanh_s(s.e1),   e2: tanh_s(s.e2),   e3: tanh_s(s.e3),
        e4: tanh_s(s.e4),   e5: tanh_s(s.e5),   e6: tanh_s(s.e6),   e7: tanh_s(s.e7),
        e8: tanh_s(s.e8),   e9: tanh_s(s.e9),   e10: tanh_s(s.e10), e11: tanh_s(s.e11),
        e12: tanh_s(s.e12), e13: tanh_s(s.e13), e14: tanh_s(s.e14), e15: tanh_s(s.e15)
    }
}

// ─── Sedenion gate (lerp-to-ZD parameterization, same as Door I/E) ────────────

fn make_a(alpha: f64) -> Sedenion with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let inv2: f64 = 1.0 / sqrt_s(2.0)
    let zd0: f64 = 0.5; let zd1: f64 = 0.5; let zd4: f64 = 0.5; let zd5: f64 = 0.0 - 0.5
    let g0: f64 = (1.0 - alpha) * inv2 + alpha * zd0
    let g1: f64 = (1.0 - alpha) * inv2 + alpha * zd1
    let g4: f64 =                         alpha * zd4
    let g5: f64 =                         alpha * zd5
    let n: f64 = sqrt_s(g0*g0 + g1*g1 + g4*g4 + g5*g5)
    let s: f64 = if n < 0.0000001 { 1.0 } else { 1.0 / n }
    Sedenion { e0: g0*s, e1: g1*s, e2: 0.0, e3: 0.0,
               e4: g4*s, e5: g5*s, e6: 0.0, e7: 0.0,
               e8: 0.0,  e9: 0.0,  e10: 0.0, e11: 0.0,
               e12: 0.0, e13: 0.0, e14: 0.0, e15: 0.0 }
}

// ─── Readout C (scaled i64 to avoid BSS-zero f64 init bug) ───────────────────

var WC: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
fn cg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (WC[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn cs(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { WC[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn get_c() -> Sedenion with Div {
    Sedenion { e0:cg(0), e1:cg(1), e2:cg(2), e3:cg(3),
               e4:cg(4), e5:cg(5), e6:cg(6), e7:cg(7),
               e8:cg(8), e9:cg(9), e10:cg(10), e11:cg(11),
               e12:cg(12), e13:cg(13), e14:cg(14), e15:cg(15) }
}
fn init_c() with Mut { var i: i64 = 0; while i < 16 { WC[i] = 0; i = i + 1 } }

// ─── Hidden state for training ────────────────────────────────────────────────

var H0:  [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]   var H1:  [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var H2:  [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]   var H3:  [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var H4:  [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]   var H5:  [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var H6:  [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]   var H7:  [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var H8:  [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]   var H9:  [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var H10: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]   var H11: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var H12: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]   var H13: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var H14: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]   var H15: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]

fn save_h(t: i64, h: Sedenion) with Mut {

// ─── Training (II only, 64 samples) ──────────────────────────────────────────

fn ssm_forward_ii(a: Sedenion) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var h: Sedenion = sed_one()
    var t: i64 = 0
    while t < 64 {
        let xt: Sedenion = load_II(t)
        let ah: Sedenion = sed_mul(a, h)
        let raw: Sedenion = sed_add(ah, xt)
        let act: Sedenion = sed_tanh_s(raw)
        let n: f64 = sed_norm(act)
        if n > 0.0000001 { h = sed_scale(act, 1.0 / n) } else { h = act }
        save_h(t, h)
        t = t + 1
    }
}

fn ssm_update_c(lr: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let c: Sedenion = get_c()
    var gc: Sedenion = Sedenion { e0:0.0, e1:0.0, e2:0.0, e3:0.0,
                                   e4:0.0, e5:0.0, e6:0.0, e7:0.0,
                                   e8:0.0, e9:0.0, e10:0.0, e11:0.0,
                                   e12:0.0, e13:0.0, e14:0.0, e15:0.0 }
    var t: i64 = 0
    while t < 64 {
        let ht: Sedenion = load_h(t)
        let y: f64 = sed_dot(ht, c)
        let err: f64 = y - II_TGT[t]
        gc = sed_add(gc, sed_scale(ht, err))
        t = t + 1
    }
    let scale: f64 = lr * 2.0 / 64.0
    let new_c: Sedenion = sed_sub(c, sed_scale(gc, scale))
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 16 {
        let v: f64 = if i == 0 { new_c.e0 } else if i == 1 { new_c.e1 }
            else if i == 2 { new_c.e2 } else if i == 3 { new_c.e3 }
            else if i == 4 { new_c.e4 } else if i == 5 { new_c.e5 }
            else if i == 6 { new_c.e6 } else if i == 7 { new_c.e7 }
            else if i == 8 { new_c.e8 } else if i == 9 { new_c.e9 }
            else if i == 10 { new_c.e10 } else if i == 11 { new_c.e11 }
            else if i == 12 { new_c.e12 } else if i == 13 { new_c.e13 }
            else if i == 14 { new_c.e14 } else { new_c.e15 }
        cs(i, v)
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn train_c(a: Sedenion) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    init_c()
    var ep: i64 = 0
    while ep < 200 { ssm_forward_ii(a); ssm_update_c(0.2); ep = ep + 1 }
}

// ─── MSE and associator per probe window ─────────────────────────────────────

fn mse_II_holdout(a: Sedenion) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Evaluate on samples 64..79 (holdout after training)
    // Re-run forward on train split to get warm hidden state
    var h: Sedenion = sed_one()
    var t: i64 = 0
    while t < 64 {
        let xt: Sedenion = load_II(t)
        let ah: Sedenion = sed_mul(a, h)
        let raw: Sedenion = sed_add(ah, xt)
        let act: Sedenion = sed_tanh_s(raw)
        let n: f64 = sed_norm(act)
        if n > 0.0000001 { h = sed_scale(act, 1.0 / n) } else { h = act }
        t = t + 1
    }
    var total: f64 = 0.0
    while t < 80 {
        let xt: Sedenion = load_II(t)
        let ah: Sedenion = sed_mul(a, h)
        let raw: Sedenion = sed_add(ah, xt)
        let act: Sedenion = sed_tanh_s(raw)
        let n: f64 = sed_norm(act)
        if n > 0.0000001 { h = sed_scale(act, 1.0 / n) } else { h = act }
        let y: f64 = sed_dot(h, get_c())
        let err: f64 = y - II_TGT[t]
        total = total + err * err
        t = t + 1
    }
    total / 16.0
}

fn assoc_II(a: Sedenion) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var h: Sedenion = sed_one()
    var total: f64 = 0.0
    var t: i64 = 0
    while t < 80 {
        let xt: Sedenion = load_II(t)
        let ah:   Sedenion = sed_mul(a, h)
        let ahx:  Sedenion = sed_mul(ah, xt)
        let hx:   Sedenion = sed_mul(h, xt)
        let a_hx: Sedenion = sed_mul(a, hx)
        let diff: Sedenion = sed_sub(ahx, a_hx)
        let an:   f64 = sed_norm(diff)
        total = total + an
        let raw: Sedenion = sed_add(ah, xt)
        let act: Sedenion = sed_tanh_s(raw)
        let n: f64 = sed_norm(act)
        if n > 0.0000001 { h = sed_scale(act, 1.0 / n) } else { h = act }
        t = t + 1
    }
    total / 80.0
}

// ─── Main ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    init_data()

    let a: Sedenion = make_a(0.2)
    train_c(a)

    // Baseline: interictal holdout MSE and associator
    let baseline_mse:   f64 = mse_II_holdout(a)
    let baseline_assoc: f64 = assoc_II(a)

    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════")
    println("  Door F: Pre-ictal sweep — MSE vs Associator Norm  (α=0.2)")
    println("  chb10, seizure at 6313s, 256Hz, 16ch")
    println("  Baseline: interictal holdout at t=10s")
    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════")
    println("")
    print("  baseline_mse=");   print(baseline_mse);   println("")
    print("  baseline_assoc="); print(baseline_assoc); println("")
    println("")
    println("  label    t_rel  mse        mse_ratio  assoc      assoc_ratio")
    println("  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────")

    let mse_FAR:   f64 = mse_FAR(a)
    let assoc_FAR: f64 = assoc_FAR(a)
    let mse_r_FAR: f64 = if baseline_mse   > 0.000001 { mse_FAR   / baseline_mse   } else { 0.0 }
    let asc_r_FAR: f64 = if baseline_assoc > 0.000001 { assoc_FAR / baseline_assoc } else { 0.0 }
    print("  FAR      -60s  "); print(mse_FAR); print("  "); print(mse_r_FAR)
    print("  "); print(assoc_FAR); print("  "); print(asc_r_FAR); println("")

    let mse_PRE30:   f64 = mse_PRE30(a)
    let assoc_PRE30: f64 = assoc_PRE30(a)
    let mse_r_PRE30: f64 = if baseline_mse   > 0.000001 { mse_PRE30   / baseline_mse   } else { 0.0 }
    let asc_r_PRE30: f64 = if baseline_assoc > 0.000001 { assoc_PRE30 / baseline_assoc } else { 0.0 }
    print("  PRE30    -30s  "); print(mse_PRE30); print("  "); print(mse_r_PRE30)
    print("  "); print(assoc_PRE30); print("  "); print(asc_r_PRE30); println("")

    let mse_PRE10:   f64 = mse_PRE10(a)
    let assoc_PRE10: f64 = assoc_PRE10(a)
    let mse_r_PRE10: f64 = if baseline_mse   > 0.000001 { mse_PRE10   / baseline_mse   } else { 0.0 }
    let asc_r_PRE10: f64 = if baseline_assoc > 0.000001 { assoc_PRE10 / baseline_assoc } else { 0.0 }
    print("  PRE10    -10s  "); print(mse_PRE10); print("  "); print(mse_r_PRE10)
    print("  "); print(assoc_PRE10); print("  "); print(asc_r_PRE10); println("")

    let mse_PRE5:   f64 = mse_PRE5(a)
    let assoc_PRE5: f64 = assoc_PRE5(a)
    let mse_r_PRE5: f64 = if baseline_mse   > 0.000001 { mse_PRE5   / baseline_mse   } else { 0.0 }
    let asc_r_PRE5: f64 = if baseline_assoc > 0.000001 { assoc_PRE5 / baseline_assoc } else { 0.0 }
    print("  PRE5      -5s  "); print(mse_PRE5); print("  "); print(mse_r_PRE5)
    print("  "); print(assoc_PRE5); print("  "); print(asc_r_PRE5); println("")

    let mse_IC:   f64 = mse_IC(a)
    let assoc_IC: f64 = assoc_IC(a)
    let mse_r_IC: f64 = if baseline_mse   > 0.000001 { mse_IC   / baseline_mse   } else { 0.0 }
    let asc_r_IC: f64 = if baseline_assoc > 0.000001 { assoc_IC / baseline_assoc } else { 0.0 }
    print("  IC        +0s  "); print(mse_IC); print("  "); print(mse_r_IC)
    print("  "); print(assoc_IC); print("  "); print(asc_r_IC); println("")

    let mse_POST:   f64 = mse_POST(a)
    let assoc_POST: f64 = assoc_POST(a)
    let mse_r_POST: f64 = if baseline_mse   > 0.000001 { mse_POST   / baseline_mse   } else { 0.0 }
    let asc_r_POST: f64 = if baseline_assoc > 0.000001 { assoc_POST / baseline_assoc } else { 0.0 }
    print("  POST      +5s  "); print(mse_POST); print("  "); print(mse_r_POST)
    print("  "); print(assoc_POST); print("  "); print(asc_r_POST); println("")

    println("")

    // ── Sanity checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    var passed: i32 = 0
    var failed: i32 = 0

    // T1: IC window MSE > baseline (seizure is detectable by MSE at onset)
    let mse_ic_val:   f64 = mse_IC(a)
    let mse_ic_r:     f64 = if baseline_mse > 0.000001 { mse_ic_val / baseline_mse } else { 0.0 }
    if mse_ic_r > 1.0 {
        print("T1 PASS: MSE at onset = "); print(mse_ic_r); println("× baseline (>1.0)")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("T1 FAIL: MSE at onset = "); print(mse_ic_r); println("× baseline (expected >1.0)")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T2: Associator is non-zero at baseline (sedenion non-associativity active)
    if baseline_assoc > 0.0 {
        print("T2 PASS: baseline assoc = "); print(baseline_assoc); println(" > 0")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("T2 FAIL: baseline assoc = 0 (associator vanished)")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T3: IC associator != baseline (structural disruption at onset)
    let assoc_ic_val: f64 = assoc_IC(a)
    let assoc_ic_r:   f64 = if baseline_assoc > 0.000001 { assoc_ic_val / baseline_assoc } else { 0.0 }
    if assoc_ic_r > 0.5 {
        print("T3 PASS: assoc at onset = "); print(assoc_ic_r); println("× baseline (structural change)")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("T3 FAIL: assoc at onset = "); print(assoc_ic_r); println("× (no change)")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T4 (exploratory): does assoc_ratio rise pre-ictally before MSE?
    //   Check PRE10: assoc_ratio > 1.1 or (assoc_ratio > mse_ratio + 0.1)
    let assoc_pre10: f64 = assoc_PRE10(a)
    let mse_pre10:   f64 = mse_PRE10(a)
    let asc_r_pre10: f64 = if baseline_assoc > 0.000001 { assoc_pre10 / baseline_assoc } else { 0.0 }
    let mse_r_pre10: f64 = if baseline_mse   > 0.000001 { mse_pre10   / baseline_mse   } else { 0.0 }
    if asc_r_pre10 > mse_r_pre10 {
        print("T4 PASS (exploratory): assoc_ratio at −10s = "); print(asc_r_pre10)
        print(" > mse_ratio = "); print(mse_r_pre10); println("")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("T4 FAIL (exploratory): assoc_ratio at −10s = "); print(asc_r_pre10)
        print(" ≤ mse_ratio = "); print(mse_r_pre10); println("")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    println("")
    if failed == 0 { println("ALL PASS") }
    else { print("FAILURES: "); print(failed); println("") }

    print("  Passed: "); print(passed); println("")
    print("  Failed: "); print(failed); println("")

    0
}


// === FILE: examples/drug_cascade_168_demo.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// drug_cascade_168_demo.sio
//
// Is the brain non-associative?
// The 168 theorem applied to psychiatric drug cascades.

// ============================================================================
// INLINE: Fano plane + classification (self-contained for JIT)
// ============================================================================

fn fano_lines() -> [i32; 21] with Mut, Panic {
    var t: [i32; 21] = [0; 21]
    t[0]=1;t[1]=2;t[2]=4; t[3]=2;t[4]=3;t[5]=5; t[6]=3;t[7]=4;t[8]=6
    t[9]=4;t[10]=5;t[11]=7; t[12]=5;t[13]=6;t[14]=1; t[15]=6;t[16]=7;t[17]=2
    t[18]=7;t[19]=1;t[20]=3
    t
}

fn is_on_fano_line(a: i32, b: i32, c: i32) -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if a == b || b == c || a == c { return true }
    let t = fano_lines()
    var line: i32 = 0
    while line < 7 {
        let p=t[(line*3) as usize]; let q=t[(line*3+1) as usize]; let r=t[(line*3+2) as usize]
        let ha = a==p||a==q||a==r; let hb = b==p||b==q||b==r; let hc = c==p||c==q||c==r
        if ha && hb && hc { return true }
        line = line + 1
    }
    false
}

fn classify(a: i32, b: i32, c: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if a==b||b==c||a==c { return 0 }
    if is_on_fano_line(a,b,c) { return 1 }
    return 2
}

fn drug_name(d: i32) with IO {
    if d==1 { print("SSRI") }
    else if d==2 { print("SNRI") }
    else if d==3 { print("Benzo") }
    else if d==4 { print("TypAP") }
    else if d==5 { print("AtyAP") }
    else if d==6 { print("MoodS") }
    else if d==7 { print("Stim") }
    else { print("???") }
}

fn class_name(c: i32) with IO {
    if c==0 { print("TRIVIAL     ") }
    else if c==1 { print("ASSOCIATIVE ") }
    else { print("NON-ASSOC   ") }
}

fn line_name(l: i32) with IO {
    if l==0 { print("monoamine triad") }
    else if l==1 { print("anxiolytic-AP bridge") }
    else if l==2 { print("sedation-stabilization") }
    else if l==3 { print("dopamine spectrum") }
    else if l==4 { print("maintenance triad") }
    else if l==5 { print("activation axis") }
    else if l==6 { print("anxiety management") }
    else { print("(none)") }
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    println("================================================================")
    println("  IS THE BRAIN NON-ASSOCIATIVE?")
    println("  The 168 Theorem Applied to Psychiatric Drug Cascades")
    println("================================================================")
    println("")

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // Part 1: The 168 partition
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    println("--- PART 1: The 168 Partition ---")
    println("")

    var trivial: i32 = 0
    var assoc: i32 = 0
    var nonassoc: i32 = 0

    var i: i32 = 1
    while i <= 7 {
        var j: i32 = 1
        while j <= 7 {
            var k: i32 = 1
            while k <= 7 {
                let c = classify(i, j, k)
                if c == 0 { trivial = trivial + 1 }
                else if c == 1 { assoc = assoc + 1 }
                else { nonassoc = nonassoc + 1 }
                k = k + 1
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    println("  Of 343 ordered drug triples (i,j,k):")
    print("    Trivial (repeated class):       "); println(trivial)
    print("    Associative (Fano line):         "); println(assoc)
    print("    NON-ASSOCIATIVE (order matters): "); println(nonassoc)
    print("    Total:                           "); println(trivial + assoc + nonassoc)
    println("")
    print("  168 = |PSL(2,7)| = "); println(nonassoc)
    if nonassoc == 168 { println("  VERIFIED.") }
    println("")

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // Part 2: The 7 Fano lines (associative corridors)
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    println("--- PART 2: The 7 Fano Lines (Associative Drug Triads) ---")
    println("")

    let t = fano_lines()
    var line: i32 = 0
    while line < 7 {
        let p=t[(line*3) as usize]; let q=t[(line*3+1) as usize]; let r=t[(line*3+2) as usize]
        print("  Line "); print(line + 1); print(": ")
        drug_name(p); print(" - "); drug_name(q); print(" - "); drug_name(r)
        print("  ("); line_name(line); println(")")
        line = line + 1
    }
    println("")
    println("  Drugs on the SAME line: order doesn't matter.")
    println("  Drugs on DIFFERENT lines: order MATTERS.")
    println("")

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // Part 3: Clinical cascade analysis
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    println("--- PART 3: Clinical Cascade Analysis ---")
    println("")

    // STAR*D cascade: SSRI → SNRI → AtypicalAP → MoodStab
    println("  STAR*D depression sequence: SSRI → SNRI → AtyAP → MoodS")
    let s1 = classify(1, 2, 5)  // SSRI, SNRI, AtypicalAP
    let s2 = classify(2, 5, 6)  // SNRI, AtypicalAP, MoodStab
    print("    (SSRI,SNRI,AtyAP):   "); class_name(s1)
    if s1 == 1 { print(" — on line: "); line_name(0) }
    println("")
    print("    (SNRI,AtyAP,MoodS):  "); class_name(s2)
    println("")

    var star_d_na: i32 = 0
    if s1 == 2 { star_d_na = star_d_na + 1 }
    if s2 == 2 { star_d_na = star_d_na + 1 }
    print("    Non-associative triples: "); print(star_d_na); println("/2")
    println("")

    // Alternative: Benzo → SSRI → AtypicalAP → MoodStab
    println("  Alternative: Benzo → SSRI → AtyAP → MoodS")
    let a1 = classify(3, 1, 5)  // Benzo, SSRI, AtypicalAP
    let a2 = classify(1, 5, 6)  // SSRI, AtypicalAP, MoodStab
    print("    (Benzo,SSRI,AtyAP):  "); class_name(a1); println("")
    print("    (SSRI,AtyAP,MoodS):  "); class_name(a2)
    if a2 == 1 { print(" — on line: "); line_name(4) }
    println("")

    var alt_na: i32 = 0
    if a1 == 2 { alt_na = alt_na + 1 }
    if a2 == 2 { alt_na = alt_na + 1 }
    print("    Non-associative triples: "); print(alt_na); println("/2")
    println("")

    // Schizophrenia: TypAP → AtyAP → MoodS → Benzo → SSRI
    println("  Schizophrenia: TypAP → AtyAP → MoodS → Benzo → SSRI")
    let z1 = classify(4, 5, 6); let z2 = classify(5, 6, 3); let z3 = classify(6, 3, 1)
    print("    (TypAP,AtyAP,MoodS): "); class_name(z1); println("")
    print("    (AtyAP,MoodS,Benzo): "); class_name(z2); println("")
    print("    (MoodS,Benzo,SSRI):  "); class_name(z3)
    if z3 == 1 { print(" — on line: "); line_name(4) }
    println("")

    var sch_na: i32 = 0
    if z1 == 2 { sch_na = sch_na + 1 }
    if z2 == 2 { sch_na = sch_na + 1 }
    if z3 == 2 { sch_na = sch_na + 1 }
    print("    Non-associative triples: "); print(sch_na); println("/3")
    println("")

    // ADHD + anxiety: Stim → SSRI → Benzo
    println("  ADHD+anxiety: Stim → SSRI → Benzo")
    let h1 = classify(7, 1, 3)
    print("    (Stim,SSRI,Benzo):   "); class_name(h1)
    if h1 == 1 { print(" — on line: "); line_name(6) }
    println("")
    println("")

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // Part 4: Predictions
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    println("--- PART 4: Predictions ---")
    println("")
    println("  1. STAR*D vs Alternative cascade:")
    if star_d_na != alt_na {
        println("     DIFFERENT non-associative content.")
        println("     The 168 theorem predicts different clinical outcomes")
        println("     purely from the order of drug classes.")
    } else {
        println("     Same non-associative content.")
        println("     The order difference is within an associative corridor.")
    }
    println("")
    println("  2. ADHD+anxiety (Stim→SSRI→Benzo):")
    if h1 == 1 {
        println("     ASSOCIATIVE — these three share Fano line 7.")
        println("     Prediction: the order of introduction should NOT matter.")
        println("     Clinically testable: does Stim-first vs SSRI-first")
        println("     produce equivalent outcomes for ADHD+anxiety?")
    } else {
        println("     NON-ASSOCIATIVE — order should matter.")
    }
    println("")
    println("  3. The binary property ||[A,B,C]|| in {0,2} predicts:")
    println("     Drug cascade effects are BIMODAL.")
    println("     Either order completely matters or completely doesn't.")
    println("     No partial order-dependence should exist.")
    println("     This is FALSIFIABLE against clinical trial data.")
    println("")
    println("================================================================")
    println("  The question: Is the brain non-associative?")
    println("  The test: Do the 168 order-dependent drug triples")
    println("            match clinical order-dependence data?")
    println("  The tool: Sounio — the only language that can compute")
    println("            associators with epistemic tracking on the")
    println("            same object that carries the clinical data.")
    println("================================================================")

    0
}


// === FILE: examples/eeg_hessian_temporal.sio ===
// EEG O-SSM Hessian: Temporal Non-Associativity in Motor Imagery
//
// Uses EEGMMIDB data: 8 fronto-central channels, 8-timestep windows
//   label 0 = rest (R01, eyes open baseline)
//   label 1 = task (R03, motor imagery)
//
// Hypothesis: motor imagery recruits path-dependent cortical propagation
// more than rest. The O-SSM Hessian off-diagonal should be larger for
// task windows because the signal routing is more non-associative.
//
// This is a proxy for the epilepsy case: if task vs rest separates,
// then ictal vs interictal (much stronger path-dependence) should
// separate even more.

var FEATURES: [f64; 262144] = [0.0; 262144] // 4096 * 64
var LABELS: [i64; 4096] = [0; 4096]
var SITE_KEYS: [i64; 4096] = [0; 4096]
var UNIQUE_SITES: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
var UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT: i64 = 0
var SUBJECT_COUNT: i64 = 0

var RNG_A: i64 = 0
var RNG_B: i64 = 0

var W: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
var MOM: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
var H: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]
var A: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
var SAVED_A: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
var ASSOC_ACC: i64 = 0
var LOGIT: f64 = 0.0
var TMP_OCT: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]

var HESS: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
var TASK_OD_SUM: i64 = 0
var TASK_DG_SUM: i64 = 0
var TASK_COUNT: i64 = 0
var REST_OD_SUM: i64 = 0
var REST_DG_SUM: i64 = 0
var REST_COUNT: i64 = 0

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

fn exp_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 15.0 { return exp_q(7.5) * exp_q(x - 7.5) }
    if x < 0.0 - 15.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); sum = sum + term; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}

fn sqrt_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x != x { return 0.0 }
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var g = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 { g = 0.5 * (g + x / g); i = i + 1 }
    if g != g { return 0.0 }
    g
}

fn sigmoid_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x >= 0.0 { 1.0 / (1.0 + exp_q(0.0 - x)) }
    else { let ex = exp_q(x); ex / (1.0 + ex) }
}

fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }
fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A
    let y = RNG_B
    RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23); x = x ^ (x >> 17); x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x
    let r = x + y
    if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}
fn randf() -> f64 with Mut, Div { ((rng_next() % 20000) as f64 - 10000.0) / 10000.0 }

fn print_int(v: i64) with IO, Mut {
    if v < 0 { print("-"); print_int(0 - v); return }
    if v >= 10 { print_int(v / 10) }
    let d = v % 10
    if d==0{print("0")}if d==1{print("1")}if d==2{print("2")}if d==3{print("3")}
    if d==4{print("4")}if d==5{print("5")}if d==6{print("6")}if d==7{print("7")}
    if d==8{print("8")}if d==9{print("9")}
}

// ─── Manifest loading ───

fn load_manifest(path: string) -> i64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    SUBJECT_COUNT = 0
    UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT = 0
    let n = file_size(path)
    if n <= 0 { return 0 }
    let raw = read_file(path)
    let bytes = raw.as_bytes()
    if n < 24 { return -1 }

    // Skip comment lines
    var header_start: i64 = 0
    var seeking = true
    while seeking && header_start < n {
        while header_start < n && (bytes[header_start as usize] == 10 || bytes[header_start as usize] == 13) {
            header_start = header_start + 1
        }
        if header_start >= n { seeking = false }
        else if bytes[header_start as usize] == 35 {
            while header_start < n && bytes[header_start as usize] != 10 { header_start = header_start + 1 }
            if header_start < n { header_start = header_start + 1 }
        } else { seeking = false }
    }

    // Validate "subject_id\tlabel\tsite\tf0" header
    if header_start + 24 >= n ||
       bytes[header_start as usize] != 115 || bytes[(header_start+1) as usize] != 117 ||
       bytes[(header_start+2) as usize] != 98 || bytes[(header_start+3) as usize] != 106 {
        return -1
    }

    // Skip header line
    var pos: i64 = header_start
    while pos < n && bytes[pos as usize] != 10 { pos = pos + 1 }
    if pos < n { pos = pos + 1 }

    // Parse data rows
    while pos < n && SUBJECT_COUNT < 4096 {
        if bytes[pos as usize] == 10 { pos = pos + 1 }
        else if bytes[pos as usize] == 35 {
            while pos < n && bytes[pos as usize] != 10 { pos = pos + 1 }
            if pos < n { pos = pos + 1 }
        } else {
        var line_end = pos
        while line_end < n && bytes[line_end as usize] != 10 { line_end = line_end + 1 }
        var field_idx: i64 = 0
        var field_start = pos
        var label: i64 = -1
        var site_hash: i64 = 5381
        var feature_idx: i64 = 0
        var i = pos
        while i <= line_end {
            let is_end = i == line_end
            let is_tab = if is_end { false } else { bytes[i as usize] == 9 }
            if is_end || is_tab {
                if field_idx == 1 {
                    if i > field_start {
                        let b = bytes[field_start as usize]
                        if b == 49 { label = 1 } else if b == 48 { label = 0 }
                    }
                } else if field_idx == 2 {
                    var si = field_start
                    while si < i { site_hash = site_hash * 33 + (bytes[si as usize] as i64); si = si + 1 }
                } else if field_idx >= 3 && feature_idx < 64 {
                    var val: f64 = 0.0
                    var neg = false
                    var seen_dot = false
                    var frac_scale = 1.0
                    var si = field_start
                    if si < i && bytes[si as usize] == 45 { neg = true; si = si + 1 }
                    while si < i {
                        let b = bytes[si as usize]
                        if b == 46 { seen_dot = true }
                        else if b >= 48 && b <= 57 {
                            if !seen_dot { val = val * 10.0 + ((b - 48) as f64) }
                            else { frac_scale = frac_scale * 0.1; val = val + frac_scale * ((b - 48) as f64) }
                        }
                        si = si + 1
                    }
                    if neg { val = 0.0 - val }
                    FEATURES[(SUBJECT_COUNT * 64 + feature_idx) as usize] = val
                    feature_idx = feature_idx + 1
                }
                field_idx = field_idx + 1
                field_start = i + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        if label >= 0 && feature_idx >= 8 {
            LABELS[SUBJECT_COUNT as usize] = label
            SITE_KEYS[SUBJECT_COUNT as usize] = site_hash
            SUBJECT_COUNT = SUBJECT_COUNT + 1
        }
        pos = line_end + 1
        }
    }
    SUBJECT_COUNT
}

fn discover_sites() -> i64 with Mut {
    UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT = 0
    var subj: i64 = 0
    while subj < SUBJECT_COUNT {
        let key = SITE_KEYS[subj as usize]
        var exists: i64 = 0
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT { if UNIQUE_SITES[i as usize] == key { exists = 1; break }; i = i + 1 }
        if exists == 0 && UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT < 64 {
            UNIQUE_SITES[UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT as usize] = key
            UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT = UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT + 1
        }
        subj = subj + 1
    }
    UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT
}

// ─── Model ───

fn ws(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { W[i as usize] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn wg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (W[i as usize] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn hs(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { H[i as usize] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn hg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (H[i as usize] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn assoc_s(v: f64) with Mut { ASSOC_ACC = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn assoc_g() -> f64 with Div { (ASSOC_ACC as f64) / 100000000.0 }

fn init_model() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 10 { ws(i, randf() / 6.0); MOM[i as usize] = 0; i = i + 1 }
    var nsq = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { A[i as usize] = randf(); nsq = nsq + A[i as usize] * A[i as usize]; i = i + 1 }
    let n = sqrt_q(nsq)
    i = 0
    while i < 8 {
        if n > 0.000000001 { A[i as usize] = A[i as usize] / n }
        else if i == 0 { A[i as usize] = 1.0 } else { A[i as usize] = 0.0 }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn reset_state() with Mut {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 { H[i as usize] = 0; i = i + 1 }
    hs(0, 1.0)
    ASSOC_ACC = 0
    LOGIT = 0.0
}

fn do_oct_mul(
    a0: f64, a1: f64, a2: f64, a3: f64, a4: f64, a5: f64, a6: f64, a7: f64,
    b0: f64, b1: f64, b2: f64, b3: f64, b4: f64, b5: f64, b6: f64, b7: f64
) with Mut {
    TMP_OCT[0] = a0*b0 - a1*b1 - a2*b2 - a3*b3 - a4*b4 - a5*b5 - a6*b6 - a7*b7
    TMP_OCT[1] = a0*b1 + a1*b0 + a2*b3 - a3*b2 + a4*b5 - a5*b4 - a6*b7 + a7*b6
    TMP_OCT[2] = a0*b2 + a2*b0 - a1*b3 + a3*b1 + a4*b6 - a6*b4 + a5*b7 - a7*b5
    TMP_OCT[3] = a0*b3 + a3*b0 + a1*b2 - a2*b1 + a4*b7 - a7*b4 - a5*b6 + a6*b5
    TMP_OCT[4] = a0*b4 + a4*b0 - a1*b5 + a5*b1 - a2*b6 + a6*b2 - a3*b7 + a7*b3
    TMP_OCT[5] = a0*b5 + a5*b0 + a1*b4 - a4*b1 - a2*b7 + a7*b2 + a3*b6 - a6*b3
    TMP_OCT[6] = a0*b6 + a6*b0 + a1*b7 - a7*b1 + a2*b4 - a4*b2 - a3*b5 + a5*b3
    TMP_OCT[7] = a0*b7 + a7*b0 - a1*b6 + a6*b1 - a2*b5 + a5*b2 + a3*b4 - a4*b3
}

fn oct_step(x0: f64, x1: f64, x2: f64, x3: f64, x4: f64, x5: f64, x6: f64, x7: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    do_oct_mul(A[0],A[1],A[2],A[3],A[4],A[5],A[6],A[7], hg(0),hg(1),hg(2),hg(3),hg(4),hg(5),hg(6),hg(7))
    let t0=TMP_OCT[0]; let t1=TMP_OCT[1]; let t2=TMP_OCT[2]; let t3=TMP_OCT[3]
    let t4=TMP_OCT[4]; let t5=TMP_OCT[5]; let t6=TMP_OCT[6]; let t7=TMP_OCT[7]
    do_oct_mul(t0,t1,t2,t3,t4,t5,t6,t7, x0,x1,x2,x3,x4,x5,x6,x7)
    var left: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    var d: i64 = 0
    while d < 8 { left[d as usize] = TMP_OCT[d as usize]; d = d + 1 }
    do_oct_mul(hg(0),hg(1),hg(2),hg(3),hg(4),hg(5),hg(6),hg(7), x0,x1,x2,x3,x4,x5,x6,x7)
    let hx0=TMP_OCT[0]; let hx1=TMP_OCT[1]; let hx2=TMP_OCT[2]; let hx3=TMP_OCT[3]
    let hx4=TMP_OCT[4]; let hx5=TMP_OCT[5]; let hx6=TMP_OCT[6]; let hx7=TMP_OCT[7]
    do_oct_mul(A[0],A[1],A[2],A[3],A[4],A[5],A[6],A[7], hx0,hx1,hx2,hx3,hx4,hx5,hx6,hx7)
    var asq = 0.0
    d = 0
    while d < 8 { let diff = left[d as usize] - TMP_OCT[d as usize]; asq = asq + diff*diff; d = d + 1 }
    var assoc_step = sqrt_q(asq)
    if assoc_step != assoc_step { assoc_step = 0.0 }
    if assoc_step > 1000.0 { assoc_step = 1000.0 }
    assoc_s(assoc_g() + assoc_step)
    d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var v = left[d as usize] + 0.2 * TMP_OCT[d as usize]
        if v != v { v = 0.0 }
        if v > 5.0 { v = 5.0 } if v < 0.0 - 5.0 { v = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        hs(d, v)
        d = d + 1
    }
}

fn forward_subject(subj: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    reset_state()
    let base = subj * 64
    var step: i64 = 0
    while step < 8 {
        let off = base + step * 8
        oct_step(
            FEATURES[off as usize], FEATURES[(off+1) as usize],
            FEATURES[(off+2) as usize], FEATURES[(off+3) as usize],
            FEATURES[(off+4) as usize], FEATURES[(off+5) as usize],
            FEATURES[(off+6) as usize], FEATURES[(off+7) as usize]
        )
        step = step + 1
    }
    var af = assoc_g() / 8.0
    if af != af { af = 0.0 }
    assoc_s(af)
    var s = wg(9)
    var d: i64 = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var proj = hg(d) * wg(d)
        if proj != proj { proj = 0.0 }
        s = s + proj
        d = d + 1
    }
    var ap = af * wg(8)
    if ap != ap { ap = 0.0 }
    LOGIT = s + ap
}

fn update_binary(target: i64, lr: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let prob = sigmoid_q(LOGIT)
    var grad = prob - (target as f64)
    if grad > 0.5 { grad = 0.5 } if grad < 0.0 - 0.5 { grad = 0.0 - 0.5 }
    var d: i64 = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let g = hg(d) * grad
        let m = (MOM[d as usize] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + g
        MOM[d as usize] = (m * 100000000.0) as i64
        ws(d, wg(d) - lr * m)
        d = d + 1
    }
    let ag = assoc_g() * grad
    let am = (MOM[8] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + ag
    MOM[8] = (am * 100000000.0) as i64
    ws(8, wg(8) - lr * am)
    let bm = (MOM[9] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + grad
    MOM[9] = (bm * 100000000.0) as i64
    ws(9, wg(9) - lr * bm)
}

// ─── Hessian per window ───

fn compute_loss_subj(subj: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    forward_subject(subj)
    let prob = sigmoid_q(LOGIT)
    let target = LABELS[subj as usize] as f64
    0.0 - (target * prob + (1.0 - target) * (1.0 - prob))
}

fn compute_subject_hessian(subj: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let eps = 0.001
    let eps2 = eps * eps
    let f0 = compute_loss_subj(subj)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 {
        let orig_i = A[i as usize]
        A[i as usize] = orig_i + eps
        let fip = compute_loss_subj(subj)
        A[i as usize] = orig_i - eps
        let fim = compute_loss_subj(subj)
        A[i as usize] = orig_i
        HESS[i * 8 + i] = ((fip - 2.0 * f0 + fim) / eps2 * 1000000.0) as i64
        var j = i + 1
        while j < 8 {
            let orig_j = A[j as usize]
            A[i as usize] = orig_i + eps
            A[j as usize] = orig_j + eps
            let fpp = compute_loss_subj(subj)
            A[j as usize] = orig_j - eps
            let fpm = compute_loss_subj(subj)
            A[i as usize] = orig_i - eps
            let fmm = compute_loss_subj(subj)
            A[j as usize] = orig_j + eps
            let fmp = compute_loss_subj(subj)
            A[i as usize] = orig_i
            A[j as usize] = orig_j
            let hij = ((fpp - fpm - fmp + fmm) / (4.0 * eps2) * 1000000.0) as i64
            HESS[i * 8 + j] = hij
            HESS[j * 8 + i] = hij
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn subject_offdiag_norm() -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var s: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 {
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < 8 {
            if i != j { let v = HESS[i*8+j]; if v < 0 { s = s + (0-v) } else { s = s + v } }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    s
}

fn subject_diag_norm() -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var s: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 {
        let v = HESS[i*8+i]
        if v < 0 { s = s + (0-v) } else { s = s + v }
        i = i + 1
    }
    s
}

// ─── Main ───

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var loaded = load_manifest("eeg_temporal_manifest.tsv")
    if loaded <= 0 {
        loaded = load_manifest("/workspace/sounio/eeg_temporal_manifest.tsv")
    }
    if loaded <= 0 { println("No EEG manifest found"); return 1 }
    discover_sites()

    var task_n: i64 = 0
    var rest_n: i64 = 0
    var subj: i64 = 0
    while subj < SUBJECT_COUNT {
        if LABELS[subj as usize] == 1 { task_n = task_n + 1 } else { rest_n = rest_n + 1 }
        subj = subj + 1
    }

    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════")
    println("  EEG O-SSM: Temporal Hessian Non-Associativity")
    println("  Rest (baseline) vs Task (motor imagery)")
    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════")
    print("  Windows: "); print_int(SUBJECT_COUNT)
    print(" (task="); print_int(task_n); print(" rest="); print_int(rest_n); print(")\n")
    print("  Subjects: "); print_int(UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT); print("\n")
    println("  Method: leave-one-subject-out, 8×8 Hessian per test window")
    println("")

    TASK_OD_SUM = 0; TASK_DG_SUM = 0; TASK_COUNT = 0
    REST_OD_SUM = 0; REST_DG_SUM = 0; REST_COUNT = 0

    // Use first 10 subjects as holdouts (enough for statistics)
    var max_folds = UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT
    if max_folds > 10 { max_folds = 10 }

    var fold: i64 = 0
    while fold < max_folds {
        let holdout_key = UNIQUE_SITES[fold as usize]
        print("  Fold "); print_int(fold); print("/"); print_int(max_folds); print("...\n")

        // Train on non-holdout
        rng_seed(55555 + holdout_key, 77777 + holdout_key * 17)
        init_model()
        var ep: i64 = 0
        while ep < 40 {
            var seen: i64 = 0
            while seen < 200 {
                subj = (rng_next() / 100) % SUBJECT_COUNT
                if SITE_KEYS[subj as usize] != holdout_key {
                    forward_subject(subj)
                    update_binary(LABELS[subj as usize], 0.03)
                }
                seen = seen + 1
            }
            ep = ep + 1
        }

        // Save trained A
        var ai: i64 = 0
        while ai < 8 { SAVED_A[ai as usize] = A[ai as usize]; ai = ai + 1 }

        // Hessian on holdout windows
        subj = 0
        while subj < SUBJECT_COUNT {
            if SITE_KEYS[subj as usize] == holdout_key {
                ai = 0
                while ai < 8 { A[ai as usize] = SAVED_A[ai as usize]; ai = ai + 1 }
                compute_subject_hessian(subj)
                let od = subject_offdiag_norm()
                let dg = subject_diag_norm()
                if LABELS[subj as usize] == 1 {
                    TASK_OD_SUM = TASK_OD_SUM + od
                    TASK_DG_SUM = TASK_DG_SUM + dg
                    TASK_COUNT = TASK_COUNT + 1
                } else {
                    REST_OD_SUM = REST_OD_SUM + od
                    REST_DG_SUM = REST_DG_SUM + dg
                    REST_COUNT = REST_COUNT + 1
                }
            }
            subj = subj + 1
        }
        fold = fold + 1
    }

    // Results
    println("")
    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════")
    println("  RESULTS: EEG Hessian Non-Associativity")
    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════")
    print("  Task windows: "); print_int(TASK_COUNT); print("\n")
    print("  Rest windows: "); print_int(REST_COUNT); print("\n")

    if TASK_COUNT > 0 && REST_COUNT > 0 {
        let task_od = (TASK_OD_SUM as f64) / (TASK_COUNT as f64)
        let rest_od = (REST_OD_SUM as f64) / (REST_COUNT as f64)
        let task_dg = (TASK_DG_SUM as f64) / (TASK_COUNT as f64)
        let rest_dg = (REST_DG_SUM as f64) / (REST_COUNT as f64)

        println("")
        print("  Mean ||H_offdiag|| (×1e6):\n")
        print("    Task:  "); print(task_od); print("\n")
        print("    Rest:  "); print(rest_od); print("\n")
        let ratio = task_od / rest_od
        print("    Ratio Task/Rest: "); print(ratio); print("\n")

        println("")
        print("  Mean ||H_diag|| (×1e6):\n")
        print("    Task:  "); print(task_dg); print("\n")
        print("    Rest:  "); print(rest_dg); print("\n")

        println("")
        print("  Off-diag / diag ratio:\n")
        var task_frac = 0.0
        if task_dg > 0.0 { task_frac = task_od / task_dg }
        var rest_frac = 0.0
        if rest_dg > 0.0 { rest_frac = rest_od / rest_dg }
        print("    Task:  "); print(task_frac); print("\n")
        print("    Rest:  "); print(rest_frac); print("\n")

        println("")
        if ratio > 1.1 {
            println("  -> Task has MORE non-associative curvature than rest")
            println("  -> Motor imagery engages path-dependent propagation")
        } else if ratio < 0.9 {
            println("  -> Rest has MORE non-associative curvature")
        } else {
            println("  -> No significant difference")
        }
    }

    println("")
    println("DONE")
    0
}

struct Sample {
    value: i64
}

fn scale(item: Sample, factor: i64) -> Sample {
    return Sample { value: item.value * factor }
}

fn checksum(values: [i64]) -> i64 {
    var sum: i64 = 0
    for v in values {
        sum = sum + v
    }
    return sum
}

fn main() with IO {
    let seed = Sample { value: 3 }
    let scaled = scale(seed, 7)
    let data: [i64] = [scaled.value, 2, 5, 8]
    let total = checksum(data)
    println("example: effects")
    println(total)
}
