    var lits: [i32; 8] = [0; 8]
    lits[0] = a
    lits[1] = b
    lits[2] = c
    smt_add_clause(ctx, &lits, 3)
}

// Generate n_cls random 3-clauses over vars [0, n_vars). LCG must be seeded first.
fn add_background(ctx: &!SmtContext, n_vars: i32, n_cls: i32) with Mut, Div {
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < n_cls {
        let v0 = (lrand(n_vars as i64)) as i32
        let s0 = (lrand(2)) as i32
        let v1 = (lrand(n_vars as i64)) as i32
        let s1 = (lrand(2)) as i32
        let v2 = (lrand(n_vars as i64)) as i32
        let s2 = (lrand(2)) as i32
        add3(ctx, v0*2 + s0, v1*2 + s1, v2*2 + s2)
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// 3-coloring base (at-least-one + at-most-one) for 7 vertices, vars 0..20.
fn add_color_base(ctx: &!SmtContext) with Mut, Div {
    var v: i32 = 0
    while v < 7 {
        add3(ctx, (v*3+0)*2, (v*3+1)*2, (v*3+2)*2)
        add2(ctx, (v*3+0)*2+1, (v*3+1)*2+1)
        add2(ctx, (v*3+0)*2+1, (v*3+2)*2+1)
        add2(ctx, (v*3+1)*2+1, (v*3+2)*2+1)
        v = v + 1
    }
}

// Add edge-conflict clauses for the 6-edge classical graph.
// Edges: (0,2)(1,2)(1,6)(3,5)(3,6)(4,5)
fn add_edges_6(ctx: &!SmtContext) with Mut, Div {
    var c: i32 = 0
    // (0,2)
    while c < 3 { add2(ctx, (0*3+c)*2+1, (2*3+c)*2+1); c = c + 1 }
    c = 0
    // (1,2)
    while c < 3 { add2(ctx, (1*3+c)*2+1, (2*3+c)*2+1); c = c + 1 }
    c = 0
    // (1,6)
    while c < 3 { add2(ctx, (1*3+c)*2+1, (6*3+c)*2+1); c = c + 1 }
    c = 0
    // (3,5)
    while c < 3 { add2(ctx, (3*3+c)*2+1, (5*3+c)*2+1); c = c + 1 }
    c = 0
    // (3,6)
    while c < 3 { add2(ctx, (3*3+c)*2+1, (6*3+c)*2+1); c = c + 1 }
    c = 0
    // (4,5)
    while c < 3 { add2(ctx, (4*3+c)*2+1, (5*3+c)*2+1); c = c + 1 }
}

// Add edge-conflict clauses for the 9-edge surgical graph.
// Edges: (0,2)(1,2)(1,5)(1,6)(2,4)(3,5)(3,6)(4,5)(4,6)
fn add_edges_9(ctx: &!SmtContext) with Mut, Div {
    var c: i32 = 0
    // (0,2)
    while c < 3 { add2(ctx, (0*3+c)*2+1, (2*3+c)*2+1); c = c + 1 }
    c = 0
    // (1,2)
    while c < 3 { add2(ctx, (1*3+c)*2+1, (2*3+c)*2+1); c = c + 1 }
    c = 0
    // (1,5)
    while c < 3 { add2(ctx, (1*3+c)*2+1, (5*3+c)*2+1); c = c + 1 }
    c = 0
    // (1,6)
    while c < 3 { add2(ctx, (1*3+c)*2+1, (6*3+c)*2+1); c = c + 1 }
    c = 0
    // (2,4)
    while c < 3 { add2(ctx, (2*3+c)*2+1, (4*3+c)*2+1); c = c + 1 }
    c = 0
    // (3,5)
    while c < 3 { add2(ctx, (3*3+c)*2+1, (5*3+c)*2+1); c = c + 1 }
    c = 0
    // (3,6)
    while c < 3 { add2(ctx, (3*3+c)*2+1, (6*3+c)*2+1); c = c + 1 }
    c = 0
    // (4,5)
    while c < 3 { add2(ctx, (4*3+c)*2+1, (5*3+c)*2+1); c = c + 1 }
    c = 0
    // (4,6)
    while c < 3 { add2(ctx, (4*3+c)*2+1, (6*3+c)*2+1); c = c + 1 }
}

// Run one SMT instance and return regime_recent_hardness.
fn run_one(n_bg: i32, use_9_edges: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    var ctx = smt_new()
    add_background(&! ctx, 21, n_bg)
    add_color_base(&! ctx)
    if use_9_edges == 1 {
        add_edges_9(&! ctx)
    } else {
        add_edges_6(&! ctx)
    }
    smt_set_score_mode(&! ctx, 3)
    smt_set_no_ple(&! ctx, 1)
    let _r = smt_solve(&! ctx)
    return smt_get_regime_hardness(&ctx)
}

fn main() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("=== 168 ZD Regime Chromatic Probe v3 (Paired) ===\n")
    print("Background: 40 random 3-SAT clauses over 21 coloring vars, seeded by idx.\n")
    print("6-edge: (0,2)(1,2)(1,6)(3,5)(3,6)(4,5)  — 86 cls, ratio 4.10\n")
    print("9-edge: (0,2)(1,2)(1,5)(1,6)(2,4)(3,5)(3,6)(4,5)(4,6)  — 95 cls, ratio 4.52\n")
    print("Prediction: n_pos > n_neg  (e=9 raises hardness more often than lowers)\n")
    print("\n")
    print("idx  hard6  hard9  delta  sign\n")
    print("---- ------ ------ ------ ----\n")

    var n_pos: i32 = 0
    var n_neg: i32 = 0
    var n_zero: i32 = 0
    var sum_delta: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_hard6: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_hard9: f64 = 0.0

    var idx: i32 = 0
    while idx < 84 {
        // Seed LCG with idx for run 1 (6-edge).
        lcg_state = idx as i64
        let h6 = run_one(40, 0)

        // Reseed with same idx for run 2 (9-edge) — same background, different edges.
        lcg_state = idx as i64
        let h9 = run_one(40, 1)

        let delta = h9 - h6
        sum_delta = sum_delta + delta
        sum_hard6 = sum_hard6 + h6
        sum_hard9 = sum_hard9 + h9

        if delta > 0.001 { n_pos = n_pos + 1 }
        if delta < 0.0 - 0.001 { n_neg = n_neg + 1 }
        if delta >= 0.0 - 0.001 && delta <= 0.001 { n_zero = n_zero + 1 }

        pri(idx); print("  ")
        prf(h6); print("  ")
        prf(h9); print("  ")
        if delta >= 0.0 { prf(delta) } else { print("-"); prf(0.0 - delta) }
        print("  ")
        if delta > 0.001 { print("+") }
        if delta < 0.0 - 0.001 { print("-") }
        if delta >= 0.0 - 0.001 && delta <= 0.001 { print("=") }
        print("\n")

        idx = idx + 1
    }

    print("\n=== Summary ===\n")
    print("Pairs: 84  n_pos(+): "); pri(n_pos)
    print("  n_neg(-): "); pri(n_neg)
    print("  n_zero(=): "); pri(n_zero); print("\n")
    print("Mean hard6: "); prf(sum_hard6 / 84.0); print("\n")
    print("Mean hard9: "); prf(sum_hard9 / 84.0); print("\n")
    print("Mean delta: ")
    let md = sum_delta / 84.0
    if md >= 0.0 { prf(md) } else { print("-"); prf(0.0 - md) }
    print("\n\n")

    print("--- Verdict ---\n")
    if n_pos > n_neg && n_pos > 42 {
        print("CONFIRMED: e=9 raises hardness in majority of pairs (")
        pri(n_pos); print("/84).\n")
        print("Adding 3 extra ZD-surgery edges increases epistemic SMT difficulty.\n")
    } else if n_neg > n_pos && n_neg > 42 {
        print("INVERTED: e=9 lowers hardness in majority of pairs (")
        pri(n_neg); print("/84).\n")
        print("Extra edge clauses aid UNSAT proof (above-threshold effect).\n")
    } else {
        print("NULL — no consistent direction (n_pos=")
        pri(n_pos); print(", n_neg="); pri(n_neg); print(").\n")
        print("Edge-count variation does not discriminate regime at this background density.\n")
        print("Consider: (a) larger graph, (b) k-coloring with k near chi(G),\n")
        print("          (c) MIS encoding with k near alpha(G).\n")
    }

    print("\nRegime-Chromatic Probe complete.\n")
    print("See: docs/research/locus-coeruleus-surgical-controller-sounio-note.md §5\n")
}


// === FILE: examples/erdos/168_zd_regime_a2.sio ===
// examples/erdos/168_zd_regime_a2.sio
//
// A2 probe: 84 near-threshold 3-SAT instances, one per ZD primitive.
// Formula seeded by the primitive's algebraic coordinates (lo, hi, neg),
// NOT by sequential index — so the formula structure reflects ZD algebra.
//
// Design:
//   n_vars = 30, n_cls = 128  (ratio 4.27 ≈ threshold for maximum CDCL hardness)
//   seed(idx) = (lo * 16 + hi) * 2 + neg_val  (unique per primitive)
//
// Falsifiable prediction:
//   Primitives from the same fiber (same lo value, 12 per fiber) show
//   correlated hardness — mean hardness within fiber has lower variance
//   than between fibers.  If ZD algebra maps to epistemic difficulty,
//   the 7 fibers should produce 7 distinct hardness levels.
//
// Connection:
//   docs/research/locus-coeruleus-surgical-controller-sounio-note.md §5(c)
//   Stepping stone to A1 (14-vertex probe with structurally diverse surgeries).

use hypercomplex_graph::erdos_unit_distance::*
use theorem::smt::*

var lcg_state: i64 = 0

fn lcg_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    lcg_state = (lcg_state * 1664525 + 1013904223) & 0x7FFFFFFF
    return lcg_state
}

fn lrand(n: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    return lcg_next() % n
}

fn pri(x: i32) with IO, Div, Panic {
    if x < 0 { print("-"); pri(0 - x); return }
    if x == 0 { print("0"); return }
    if x >= 10 { pri(x / 10) }
    let d = x - (x / 10) * 10
    if d == 0 { print("0") } if d == 1 { print("1") } if d == 2 { print("2") }
    if d == 3 { print("3") } if d == 4 { print("4") } if d == 5 { print("5") }
    if d == 6 { print("6") } if d == 7 { print("7") } if d == 8 { print("8") }
    if d == 9 { print("9") }
}

fn prf(x: f64) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x < 0.0 { print("-"); prf(0.0 - x); return }
    let ip = x as i32
    pri(ip)
    print(".")
    let f0 = (x - (ip as f64)) * 10.0
    let d0 = f0 as i32
    let f1 = (f0 - (d0 as f64)) * 10.0
    let d1 = f1 as i32
    pri(d0)
    pri(d1)
}

fn add3(ctx: &!SmtContext, a: i32, b: i32, c: i32) with Mut, Div {
    var lits: [i32; 8] = [0; 8]
    lits[0] = a; lits[1] = b; lits[2] = c
    smt_add_clause(ctx, &lits, 3)
}

// Generate n_cls random 3-clauses over vars [0, n_vars). LCG must be seeded.
fn add_nsat(ctx: &!SmtContext, n_vars: i32, n_cls: i32) with Mut, Div {
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < n_cls {
        let v0 = (lrand(n_vars as i64)) as i32
        let s0 = (lrand(2)) as i32
        let v1 = (lrand(n_vars as i64)) as i32
        let s1 = (lrand(2)) as i32
        let v2 = (lrand(n_vars as i64)) as i32
        let s2 = (lrand(2)) as i32
        add3(ctx, v0*2 + s0, v1*2 + s1, v2*2 + s2)
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn main() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    build_prims()

    print("=== A2: ZD-seeded near-threshold 3-SAT regime probe ===\n")
    print("30 vars / 128 cls (ratio 4.27). Seed = (lo*16+hi)*2+neg.\n")
    print("Prediction: prims from same fiber cluster in hardness.\n\n")
    print("idx lo hi ng seed  confl trust  hard\n")
    print("--- -- -- -- ----  ----- -----  ----\n")

    // Per-fiber accumulators (fibers lo=1..7 → index 0..6)
    var fiber_sum:   [f64; 7] = [0.0; 7]
    var fiber_sum2:  [f64; 7] = [0.0; 7]   // for variance
    var fiber_n:     [i32; 7] = [0; 7]

    var idx: i64 = 0
    while idx < 84 {
        let lo  = get_prim_lo(idx)
        let hi  = get_prim_hi(idx)
        let neg = get_prim_neg(idx)

        // Algebraic seed unique per primitive.
        let seed = (lo * 16 + hi) * 2 + neg
        lcg_state = seed

        var ctx = smt_new()
        add_nsat(&! ctx, 30, 128)
        smt_set_score_mode(&! ctx, 3)
        smt_set_no_ple(&! ctx, 1)
        let _r = smt_solve(&! ctx)

        let confl = smt_get_conflicts(&ctx)
        let trust = smt_get_explore_trust(&ctx)
        let hard  = smt_get_regime_hardness(&ctx)

        // Fiber index 0-based: lo ranges 1..7.
        let fi = (lo - 1) as usize
        fiber_sum[fi]  = fiber_sum[fi]  + hard
        fiber_sum2[fi] = fiber_sum2[fi] + hard * hard
        fiber_n[fi]    = fiber_n[fi] + 1

        pri(idx as i32);  print(" ")
        pri(lo as i32);   print("  ")
        pri(hi as i32);   print("  ")
        pri(neg as i32);  print("  ")
        pri(seed as i32); print("  ")
        pri(confl);       print("  ")
        prf(trust);       print("  ")
        prf(hard);        print("\n")

        idx = idx + 1
    }

    print("\n=== Fiber summary (lo=1..7, 12 prims each) ===\n")
    print("lo  mean_hard  var_hard  n\n")
    print("--  ---------  --------  --\n")

    var grand_mean: f64 = 0.0
    var grand_n: i32 = 0
    var fi2: i32 = 0
    while fi2 < 7 {
        let n = fiber_n[fi2]
        let s = fiber_sum[fi2]
        let s2 = fiber_sum2[fi2]
        let mean = s / (n as f64)
        let variance = s2 / (n as f64) - mean * mean
        grand_mean = grand_mean + s
        grand_n = grand_n + n
        pri(fi2 + 1); print("   ")
        prf(mean); print("     ")
        prf(variance); print("     ")
        pri(n); print("\n")
        fi2 = fi2 + 1
    }

    let gm = grand_mean / (grand_n as f64)
    print("\nGrand mean hardness: "); prf(gm); print("\n")

    print("\n--- Verdict ---\n")
    // Fiber clustering: if between-fiber variance >> within-fiber variance,
    // the ZD fiber structure correlates with epistemic difficulty.
    // Simple proxy: does max_fiber_mean / min_fiber_mean > 1.5?
    var min_mean: f64 = 999.0
    var max_mean: f64 = 0.0
    var fi3: i32 = 0
    while fi3 < 7 {
        let n = fiber_n[fi3]
        let mean = fiber_sum[fi3] / (n as f64)
        if mean < min_mean { min_mean = mean }
        if mean > max_mean { max_mean = mean }
        fi3 = fi3 + 1
    }
    print("Max fiber mean: "); prf(max_mean); print("  Min: "); prf(min_mean); print("\n")
    if min_mean > 0.001 {
        let ratio = max_mean / min_mean
        print("Max/min ratio: "); prf(ratio); print("\n")
        if ratio > 1.5 {
            print("CONFIRMED: fiber hardness spread >1.5x — ZD fiber maps to epistemic regime.\n")
            print("Proceed to A1 (14-vertex graph probe).\n")
        } else {
            print("WEAK: spread < 1.5x — fiber structure does not strongly discriminate regime.\n")
            print("A1 may still show stronger signal via graph-structural diversity.\n")
        }
    } else {
        print("NULL: min fiber mean near zero — formula too easy or EWMA not calibrated.\n")
        print("Try n_vars=20, n_cls=85 (same ratio but smaller, faster EWMA warmup).\n")
    }
}


// === FILE: examples/erdos/cdcl_fast.sio ===
// examples/erdos/cdcl_fast.sio (GENERATED gen_solver.py php)
// Fast CDCL (two-watched-literal) correctness harness; cross-checked by drat-trim.


var nvars: i32 = 0
var nclauses: i32 = 0
var cstart: [i32; 262144] = [0; 262144]
var clen: [i32; 262144] = [0; 262144]
var clits: [i64; 4194304] = [0; 4194304]

// clause deletion (LBD-based) state
var lbd: [i32; 262144] = [0; 262144]
var keepf: [i32; 262144] = [0; 262144]
var cmap: [i32; 262144] = [0; 262144]
var lblmark: [i32; 8192] = [0; 8192]
var n_orig: i32 = 0
var last_lbd: i32 = 0
var max_learnts: i32 = 400
var LBD_KEEP: i32 = 3
var n_reduces: i64 = 0
var n_deleted: i64 = 0

// two-watched-literal scheme: clause c watches clits[cstart[c]+0] and +1.
// watch node id = 2*c + slot. wnext chains nodes within one literal's list.
var whead: [i32; 16386] = [0 - 1; 16386]
var wnext: [i32; 524288] = [0; 524288]

var assign: [i32; 8192] = [0; 8192]
var vlevel: [i32; 8192] = [0; 8192]
var reason: [i32; 8192] = [0; 8192]
var phase:  [i32; 8192] = [0; 8192]
var activity: [i64; 8192] = [0; 8192]
var trail_lit: [i64; 8192] = [0; 8192]
var trail_len: i32 = 0
var trail_lim: [i32; 8192] = [0; 8192]
var cur_level: i32 = 0
var qhead: i32 = 0

var seen: [i32; 8192] = [0; 8192]
var LEARNT: [i64; 8192] = [0; 8192]
var llen: i32 = 0

var P_n: i32 = 0
var P_start: [i32; 1048576] = [0; 1048576]
var P_len: [i32; 1048576] = [0; 1048576]
var P_tag: [i32; 1048576] = [0; 1048576]
var P_lits: [i64; 16777216] = [0; 16777216]
var P_pos: i64 = 0

var n_conflicts: i64 = 0
var n_decisions: i64 = 0
var n_restarts: i64 = 0
var CONFLICT_CAP: i64 = 200000000
var var_inc: i64 = 1000000

fn print_digit(d: i64) with IO {
    if d == 0 { print("0") } else if d == 1 { print("1") } else if d == 2 { print("2") }
    else if d == 3 { print("3") } else if d == 4 { print("4") } else if d == 5 { print("5") }
    else if d == 6 { print("6") } else if d == 7 { print("7") } else if d == 8 { print("8") }
    else { print("9") }
}
fn print_dec(n: i64) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    if n == 0 { print("0") return }
    var x = n
    if x < 0 { print("-") x = 0 - x }
    var buf: [i64; 24] = [0; 24]
    var len: i32 = 0
    while x > 0 { buf[len] = x % 10  x = x / 10  len = len + 1 }
    var i: i32 = len - 1
    while i >= 0 { print_digit(buf[i])  i = i - 1 }
}

fn lit_var(l: i64) -> i32 with Panic {
    if l < 0 { return (0 - l) as i32 }
    return l as i32
}
fn litidx(l: i64) -> i32 with Panic {
    let v = lit_var(l)
    if l < 0 { return v * 2 + 1 }
    return v * 2
}
fn litval(l: i64) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    let v = lit_var(l)
    var a = assign[v]
    if l < 0 { a = 0 - a }
    return a
}

fn watch_clause(c: i32) with Mut, Panic {
    let st = cstart[c]
    let i0 = litidx(clits[st + 0])
    wnext[2 * c] = whead[i0]
    whead[i0] = 2 * c
    let i1 = litidx(clits[st + 1])
    wnext[2 * c + 1] = whead[i1]
    whead[i1] = 2 * c + 1
}

fn db_add(arr: &[i64; 8192], n: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    if nclauses >= 262144 { return 0 - 1 }
    let idx = nclauses
    var start: i32 = 0
    if idx > 0 { start = cstart[idx - 1] + clen[idx - 1] }
    if (start as i64) + (n as i64) > 4194304 { return 0 - 1 }
    cstart[idx] = start
    clen[idx] = n
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < n {
        clits[start + i] = arr[i]
        let v = lit_var(arr[i])
        if v > nvars { nvars = v }
        i = i + 1
    }
    nclauses = idx + 1
    if n >= 2 { watch_clause(idx) }
    return idx
}

fn enqueue(lit: i64, rs: i32) with Mut, Panic {
    let v = lit_var(lit)
    if lit < 0 { assign[v] = 0 - 1 } else { assign[v] = 1 }
    vlevel[v] = cur_level
    reason[v] = rs
    trail_lit[trail_len] = lit
    trail_len = trail_len + 1
}

// two-watched-literal unit propagation; returns conflict clause idx or -1.
fn propagate() -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    while qhead < trail_len {
        let p = trail_lit[qhead]
        qhead = qhead + 1
        let f = 0 - p
        let fi = litidx(f)
        var prev: i32 = 0 - 1
        var node = whead[fi]
        while node != (0 - 1) {
            let nextnode = wnext[node]
            let c = node / 2
            let s = node - 2 * c
            let st = cstart[c]
            let other = clits[st + (1 - s)]
            var handled: i32 = 0
            if litval(other) == 1 {
                prev = node
                handled = 1
            }
            if handled == 0 {
                let ln = clen[c]
                var found: i32 = 0 - 1
                var k: i32 = 2
                while k < ln {
                    if litval(clits[st + k]) != (0 - 1) { found = k  k = ln }
                    else { k = k + 1 }
                }
                if found != (0 - 1) {
                    let tmp = clits[st + s]
                    clits[st + s] = clits[st + found]
                    clits[st + found] = tmp
                    let newlit = clits[st + s]
                    if prev == (0 - 1) { whead[fi] = nextnode } else { wnext[prev] = nextnode }
                    let ni = litidx(newlit)
                    wnext[node] = whead[ni]
                    whead[ni] = node
                    handled = 1
                }
            }
            if handled == 0 {
                if litval(other) == (0 - 1) { return c }
                enqueue(other, c)
                prev = node
            }
            node = nextnode
        }
    }
    return 0 - 1
}

fn rescale() with Mut, Panic {
    var i: i32 = 1
    while i <= nvars { activity[i] = activity[i] / 1000000000  i = i + 1 }
    var_inc = var_inc / 1000000000
    if var_inc < 1 { var_inc = 1 }
}
fn bump(v: i32) with Mut, Panic {
    activity[v] = activity[v] + var_inc
    if activity[v] > 1000000000000000000 { rescale() }
}

// proof stream: ordered records, P_tag 0 = add lemma, 1 = delete clause.
// emit_drat writes "d ..." for tag 1; the native RUP checker skips tag 1
// records entirely (a lemma RUP w.r.t. a superset DB is still RUP -> sound).
fn emit_proof_clause() with Mut, Panic {
    let idx = P_n
    if idx >= 1048576 { return }
    let start = P_pos
    if start + (llen as i64) > 16777216 { return }
    P_start[idx] = start as i32
    P_len[idx] = llen
    P_tag[idx] = 0
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < llen { P_lits[(start as i32) + i] = LEARNT[i]  i = i + 1 }
    P_pos = start + (llen as i64)
    P_n = idx + 1
}
fn emit_delete(c: i32) with Mut, Panic {
    let idx = P_n
    if idx >= 1048576 { return }
    let ln = clen[c]
    let start = P_pos
    if start + (ln as i64) > 16777216 { return }
    P_start[idx] = start as i32
    P_len[idx] = ln
    P_tag[idx] = 1
    let st = cstart[c]
    var k: i32 = 0
    while k < ln { P_lits[(start as i32) + k] = clits[st + k]  k = k + 1 }
    P_pos = start + (ln as i64)
    P_n = idx + 1
}
fn emit_empty() with Mut, Panic {
    let idx = P_n
    if idx >= 1048576 { return }
    P_start[idx] = P_pos as i32
    P_len[idx] = 0
    P_tag[idx] = 0
    P_n = idx + 1
}

// LBD = number of distinct decision levels among the learned literals.
fn comp_lbd() -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    var cnt: i32 = 0
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < llen {
        let lv = vlevel[lit_var(LEARNT[i])]
        if lblmark[lv] == 0 { lblmark[lv] = 1  cnt = cnt + 1 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    i = 0
    while i < llen { lblmark[vlevel[lit_var(LEARNT[i])]] = 0  i = i + 1 }
    return cnt
}

// 1-UIP analysis; LEARNT[0]=asserting UIP literal, LEARNT[1]=second watch
// (max-level literal). Returns backjump level. Bumps VSIDS activity.
fn analyze(confl: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    var pathC: i32 = 0
    llen = 1
    var p: i64 = 0
    var ci: i32 = confl
    var index: i32 = trail_len - 1
    var go: i32 = 1
    while go == 1 {
        let st = cstart[ci]
        let ln = clen[ci]
        var k: i32 = 0
        while k < ln {
            let q = clits[st + k]
            let vq = lit_var(q)
            var skip: i32 = 0
            if p != 0 { if vq == lit_var(p) { skip = 1 } }
            if skip == 0 {
                if seen[vq] == 0 {
                    if vlevel[vq] > 0 {
                        seen[vq] = 1
                        bump(vq)
                        if vlevel[vq] >= cur_level { pathC = pathC + 1 }
                        else { LEARNT[llen] = q  llen = llen + 1 }
                    }
                }
            }
            k = k + 1
        }
        while seen[lit_var(trail_lit[index])] == 0 { index = index - 1 }
        p = trail_lit[index]
        seen[lit_var(p)] = 0
        pathC = pathC - 1
        if pathC <= 0 { go = 0 }
        else { ci = reason[lit_var(p)]  index = index - 1 }
    }
    LEARNT[0] = 0 - p

    var btlevel: i32 = 0
    if llen >= 2 {
        var maxi: i32 = 1
        var maxl: i32 = vlevel[lit_var(LEARNT[1])]
        var j2: i32 = 2
        while j2 < llen {
            let lv = vlevel[lit_var(LEARNT[j2])]
            if lv > maxl { maxl = lv  maxi = j2 }
            j2 = j2 + 1
        }
        let tmp = LEARNT[1]  LEARNT[1] = LEARNT[maxi]  LEARNT[maxi] = tmp
        btlevel = maxl
    }
    var j: i32 = 1
    while j < llen { seen[lit_var(LEARNT[j])] = 0  j = j + 1 }
    var_inc = var_inc + var_inc / 20
    if var_inc > 1000000000000000 { rescale() }
    last_lbd = comp_lbd()
    emit_proof_clause()
    return btlevel
}

fn cancel_to(level: i32) with Mut, Panic {
    if cur_level <= level { return }
    let target = trail_lim[level + 1]
    var i: i32 = trail_len - 1
    while i >= target {
        let v = lit_var(trail_lit[i])
        if assign[v] == 1 { phase[v] = 1 } else { phase[v] = 0 }
        assign[v] = 0
        reason[v] = 0 - 1
        vlevel[v] = 0
        i = i - 1
    }
    trail_len = target
    qhead = target
    cur_level = level
}

// Clause-DB reduction, MUST be called only at decision level 0.
// Keeps: all originals (c < n_orig), glue clauses (lbd <= LBD_KEEP), and
// locked clauses (reason of a current level-0 unit). Deletes the rest,
// emitting a DRUP 'd' record for each so drat-trim stays in sync. Then
// compacts clits/cstart/clen/lbd, remaps reason[] via cmap, rebuilds the
// watch lists, and resets qhead so propagate() restores the watch invariant.
fn reduce_db() with Mut, Panic {
    var c: i32 = 0
    while c < nclauses {
        if c < n_orig { keepf[c] = 1 }
        else if lbd[c] <= LBD_KEEP { keepf[c] = 1 }
        else { keepf[c] = 0 }
        c = c + 1
    }
    // lock clauses that justify current (level-0) assignments
    var t: i32 = 0
    while t < trail_len {
        let v = lit_var(trail_lit[t])
        let r = reason[v]
        if r >= 0 { keepf[r] = 1 }
        t = t + 1
    }
    // emit deletions BEFORE compaction (literals still live in clits)
    c = n_orig
    while c < nclauses {
        if keepf[c] == 0 { emit_delete(c)  n_deleted = n_deleted + 1 }
        c = c + 1
    }
    // compact kept clauses to the front (forward copy: dest <= src, safe)
    var newidx: i32 = 0
    var newpos: i32 = 0
    c = 0
    while c < nclauses {
        if keepf[c] == 1 {
            let oldst = cstart[c]
            let ln = clen[c]
            let lb = lbd[c]
            cmap[c] = newidx
            var k: i32 = 0
            while k < ln { clits[newpos + k] = clits[oldst + k]  k = k + 1 }
            cstart[newidx] = newpos
            clen[newidx] = ln
            lbd[newidx] = lb
            newpos = newpos + ln
            newidx = newidx + 1
        }
        c = c + 1
    }
    nclauses = newidx
    // remap reasons of the surviving (level-0) trail
    t = 0
    while t < trail_len {
        let v = lit_var(trail_lit[t])
        if reason[v] >= 0 { reason[v] = cmap[reason[v]] }
        t = t + 1
    }
    // rebuild all watch lists from the compacted DB
    var li: i32 = 0
    while li < 16386 { whead[li] = 0 - 1  li = li + 1 }
    c = 0
    while c < nclauses { if clen[c] >= 2 { watch_clause(c) }  c = c + 1 }
    qhead = 0
    n_reduces = n_reduces + 1
    let learned = nclauses - n_orig
    if learned > max_learnts - max_learnts / 4 {
        if max_learnts < 1000000 { max_learnts = max_learnts + max_learnts / 2 }
    }
}

fn pick() -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    var best: i32 = 0
    var bestact: i64 = 0 - 1
    var v: i32 = 1
    while v <= nvars {
        if assign[v] == 0 {
            if activity[v] > bestact { bestact = activity[v]  best = v }
        }
        v = v + 1
    }
    return best
}

fn solve() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    cur_level = 0
    trail_lim[0] = 0
    qhead = 0
    // inner/outer (MiniSat-style) restarts: keep restarts frequent and
    // well-distributed (far better for hard UNSAT than unbounded geometric).
    var restart_inner: i64 = 100
    var restart_outer: i64 = 100
    var since_restart: i64 = 0
    var rephase_flag: i32 = 0
    var loops: i32 = 1
    while loops == 1 {
        let confl = propagate()
        if confl >= 0 {
            n_conflicts = n_conflicts + 1
            since_restart = since_restart + 1
            if n_conflicts % 100000 == 0 {
                print("  [progress] conflicts="); print_dec(n_conflicts)
                print(" lemmas="); print_dec(P_n as i64)
                print(" clauses="); print_dec(nclauses as i64)
                print(" reduces="); print_dec(n_reduces)
                print(" deleted="); print_dec(n_deleted)
                print(" restarts="); print_dec(n_restarts)
                print(" trail="); print_dec(trail_len as i64); print("\n")
            }
            if n_conflicts > CONFLICT_CAP { return 2 }
            if cur_level == 0 { emit_empty()  return 0 }
            let bt = analyze(confl)
            let lidx = db_add(&LEARNT, llen)
            if lidx < 0 { return 3 }
            lbd[lidx] = last_lbd
            cancel_to(bt)
            enqueue(LEARNT[0], lidx)
            if (nclauses - n_orig) >= max_learnts {
                cancel_to(0)
                qhead = 0
                since_restart = 0
                n_restarts = n_restarts + 1
                reduce_db()
            } else if since_restart >= restart_inner {
                cancel_to(0)
                qhead = 0
                since_restart = 0
                n_restarts = n_restarts + 1
                restart_inner = restart_inner + restart_inner / 10
                if restart_inner > restart_outer {
                    restart_inner = 100
                    restart_outer = restart_outer + restart_outer / 10
                }
                // periodic rephasing to diversify saved polarities
                if n_restarts % 128 == 0 {
                    rephase_flag = 1 - rephase_flag
                    var rv: i32 = 1
                    while rv <= nvars { phase[rv] = rephase_flag  rv = rv + 1 }
                }
            }
        } else {
            let x = pick()
            if x == 0 { return 1 }
            n_decisions = n_decisions + 1
            cur_level = cur_level + 1
            trail_lim[cur_level] = trail_len
            if phase[x] == 1 { enqueue(x as i64, 0 - 1) } else { enqueue(0 - (x as i64), 0 - 1) }
        }
    }
    return 2
}

// ---- full-scan RUP checker (small instances; de Grey uses drat-trim) ----
fn reset_assign_full() with Mut, Panic {
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i <= nvars { assign[i] = 0  i = i + 1 }
}
fn rup_add_lemma(pst: i32, pln: i32) with Mut, Panic {
    if nclauses >= 262144 { return }
    let idx = nclauses
    var start: i32 = 0
    if idx > 0 { start = cstart[idx - 1] + clen[idx - 1] }
    if (start as i64) + (pln as i64) > 4194304 { return }
    cstart[idx] = start
    clen[idx] = pln
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < pln { clits[start + i] = P_lits[pst + i]  i = i + 1 }
    nclauses = idx + 1
}
fn propagate_noenq() -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    var changed: i32 = 1
    while changed == 1 {
        changed = 0
        var c: i32 = 0
        while c < nclauses {
            let st = cstart[c]
            let ln = clen[c]
            var sat: i32 = 0
            var un: i32 = 0
            var last: i64 = 0
            var k: i32 = 0
            while k < ln {
                let l = clits[st + k]
                let v = lit_var(l)
                var a = assign[v]
                if l < 0 { a = 0 - a }
                if a == 1 { sat = 1 }
                if a == 0 { un = un + 1  last = l }
                k = k + 1
            }
            if sat == 0 {
                if un == 0 { return 1 }
                if un == 1 {
                    let v = lit_var(last)
                    if last < 0 { assign[v] = 0 - 1 } else { assign[v] = 1 }
                    changed = 1
                }
            }
            c = c + 1
        }
    }
    return 0
}
fn verify(orig_nc: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    nclauses = orig_nc
    var pi: i32 = 0
    while pi < P_n {
        if P_tag[pi] == 1 { pi = pi + 1  continue }
        let pst = P_start[pi]
        let pln = P_len[pi]
        reset_assign_full()
        var taut: i32 = 0
        var k: i32 = 0
        while k < pln {
            let l = P_lits[pst + k]
            let v = lit_var(l)
            var want: i32 = 0 - 1
            if l < 0 { want = 1 }
            if assign[v] != 0 { if assign[v] != want { taut = 1 } }
            assign[v] = want
            k = k + 1
        }
        var ok: i32 = 0
        if taut == 1 { ok = 1 } else {
            let cf = propagate_noenq()
            if cf == 1 { ok = 1 }
        }
        if ok == 0 { return 0 - 1 }
        if pln == 0 { return 1 }
        rup_add_lemma(pst, pln)
        pi = pi + 1
    }
    return 0
}

fn emit_dimacs(orig_nc: i32) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("p cnf ")  print_dec(nvars as i64)  print(" ")  print_dec(orig_nc as i64)  print("\n")
    var c: i32 = 0
    while c < orig_nc {
        let st = cstart[c]
        let ln = clen[c]
        var k: i32 = 0
        while k < ln { print_dec(clits[st + k])  print(" ")  k = k + 1 }
        print("0\n")
        c = c + 1
    }
}
fn emit_drat() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var pi: i32 = 0
    while pi < P_n {
        let pst = P_start[pi]
        let pln = P_len[pi]
        if P_tag[pi] == 1 { print("d ") }
        var k: i32 = 0
        while k < pln { print_dec(P_lits[pst + k])  print(" ")  k = k + 1 }
        print("0\n")
        pi = pi + 1
    }
}

fn build_clique(n: i64, k: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var arr: [i64; 8192] = [0; 8192]
    var v: i64 = 0
    while v < n {
        var c: i64 = 0
        while c < k { arr[c as usize] = v*k + c + 1  c = c + 1 }
        let _ = db_add(&arr, k as i32)
        v = v + 1
    }
    var a: i64 = 0
    while a < n {
        var b: i64 = a + 1
        while b < n {
            var c: i64 = 0
            while c < k {
                arr[0] = 0 - (a*k + c + 1)
                arr[1] = 0 - (b*k + c + 1)
                let _ = db_add(&arr, 2)
                c = c + 1
            }
            b = b + 1
        }
        a = a + 1
    }
}

fn reset_all() with Mut, Panic {
    // clear the full static arrays (not just up to the stale nvars) so no
    // VSIDS/phase/reason state leaks across run_case invocations [xai-review #1]
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 8192 { assign[i]=0 vlevel[i]=0 reason[i]=0 seen[i]=0 phase[i]=0 activity[i]=0 i=i+1 }
    var li: i32 = 0
    while li < 16386 { whead[li] = 0 - 1  li = li + 1 }
    nvars=0 nclauses=0 trail_len=0 cur_level=0 qhead=0
    P_n=0 n_conflicts=0 n_decisions=0 n_restarts=0 var_inc=1000000
    P_pos=0 n_reduces=0 n_deleted=0 n_orig=0 max_learnts=400
}

fn run_case(n: i64) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    reset_all()
    build_clique(n, n - 1)
    let orig_nc = nclauses
    n_orig = orig_nc
    print("K_")  print_dec(n)  print("/")  print_dec(n - 1)  print("-col vars=")
    print_dec(nvars as i64)  print(" clauses=")  print_dec(orig_nc as i64)
    let r = solve()
    if r == 1 { print("  SAT (UNEXPECTED)\n")  return }
    if r >= 2 { print("  WALL/CAP code=")  print_dec(r as i64)  print("\n")  return }
    let conf = n_conflicts
    let lemmas = P_n
    reset_assign_full()
    let vr = verify(orig_nc)
    print("  conflicts=")  print_dec(conf)  print(" decisions=")  print_dec(n_decisions)
    print(" restarts=")  print_dec(n_restarts)  print(" reduces=")  print_dec(n_reduces)
    print(" deleted=")  print_dec(n_deleted)  print(" lemmas=")  print_dec(lemmas as i64)
    if vr == 1 { print("  RUP:VERIFIED\n") } else { print("  RUP:FAIL(")  print_dec(vr as i64)  print(")\n") }
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("=== fast CDCL (2-watched + int-VSIDS + phase + restarts) : pigeonhole ===\n")
    run_case(4)
    run_case(5)
    run_case(6)
    run_case(7)
    print("\n-- K_7/6 certificate for drat-trim (contains 'd' deletions) --\n")
    reset_all()
    build_clique(7, 6)
    let onc = nclauses
    n_orig = onc
    let s = solve()
    if s == 0 {
        nclauses = onc
        print("%%DIMACS%%\n")  emit_dimacs(onc)
        print("%%DRAT%%\n")  emit_drat()  print("%%END%%\n")
    }
    return 0
}


// === FILE: examples/erdos/cdcl_proof.sio ===
// examples/erdos/cdcl_proof.sio
//
// CDCL with 1-UIP clause learning + DRUP proof emission — the scalable successor
// to the chronological DPLL emitter (dpll_scale_wall.sio). The learned clause from
// 1-UIP conflict analysis is a resolution consequence of existing clauses, hence
// RUP; emitting the sequence of learned clauses (ending in the empty clause) is a
// valid DRUP proof — exactly how production SAT solvers produce DRAT.
//
// Correctness net: every emitted proof is replayed by our independent native RUP
// checker AND by external drat-trim. A bug in the CDCL bookkeeping cannot produce
// a "VERIFIED" — the checker would reject it.
//
// Honest scope: the pigeonhole family K_n/(n-1)-col is exponential for *general*
// resolution (Haken 1985), so CDCL does not crack it either — but it learns, so it
// reaches further than tree-resolution DPLL before the wall, and on STRUCTURED
// instances (the de Grey unit-distance regime) clause learning is the mechanism
// that makes 4-colouring UNSAT tractable. This file builds and certifies that
// engine so the pipeline is ready when de Grey's graph data is available.
//
// All integer arithmetic; flat global arrays; DIMACS-style signed literals.

// ---- clause DB (originals + learned clauses appended) ----
var nvars: i32 = 0
var nclauses: i32 = 0
var cstart: [i32; 262144] = [0; 262144]
var clen: [i32; 262144] = [0; 262144]
var clits: [i64; 2097152] = [0; 2097152]

// ---- assignment / trail ----
var assign: [i32; 2048] = [0; 2048]     // 0 unknown, 1 true, -1 false (var 1-indexed)
var vlevel: [i32; 2048] = [0; 2048]
var reason: [i32; 2048] = [0; 2048]     // clause idx that implied v, or -1 (decision/none)
var trail_lit: [i64; 2048] = [0; 2048]  // assigned literals, in order (true literal)
var trail_len: i32 = 0
var trail_lim: [i32; 2048] = [0; 2048]  // trail_lim[L] = first trail index of level L
var cur_level: i32 = 0

// ---- conflict analysis scratch ----
var seen: [i32; 2048] = [0; 2048]
var LEARNT: [i64; 2048] = [0; 2048]
var llen: i32 = 0

// ---- DRUP proof ----
var P_n: i32 = 0
var P_start: [i32; 262144] = [0; 262144]
var P_len: [i32; 262144] = [0; 262144]
var P_lits: [i64; 2097152] = [0; 2097152]

var n_conflicts: i64 = 0
var CONFLICT_CAP: i64 = 5000000

fn lit_var(l: i64) -> i32 with Panic {
    if l < 0 { return (0 - l) as i32 }
    return l as i32
}

fn db_add(arr: &[i64; 2048], n: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    if nclauses >= 262144 { return 0 - 1 }
    let idx = nclauses
    var start: i32 = 0
    if idx > 0 { start = cstart[idx - 1] + clen[idx - 1] }
    if (start as i64) + (n as i64) > 2097152 { return 0 - 1 }
    cstart[idx] = start
    clen[idx] = n
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < n {
        clits[start + i] = arr[i]
        let v = lit_var(arr[i])
        if v > nvars { nvars = v }
        i = i + 1
    }
    nclauses = idx + 1
    return idx
}

// value of a literal under current assignment: 1 true, -1 false, 0 unknown.
fn litval(l: i64) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    let v = lit_var(l)
    var a = assign[v]
    if l < 0 { a = 0 - a }
    return a
}

fn enqueue(lit: i64, rs: i32) with Mut, Panic {
    let v = lit_var(lit)
    if lit < 0 { assign[v] = 0 - 1 } else { assign[v] = 1 }
    vlevel[v] = cur_level
    reason[v] = rs
    trail_lit[trail_len] = lit
    trail_len = trail_len + 1
}

// Full-scan unit propagation. Returns conflicting clause index, or -1 at fixpoint.
fn propagate() -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    var changed: i32 = 1
    while changed == 1 {
        changed = 0
        var c: i32 = 0
        while c < nclauses {
            let st = cstart[c]
            let ln = clen[c]
            var sat: i32 = 0
            var unassigned: i32 = 0
            var last_lit: i64 = 0
            var k: i32 = 0
            while k < ln {
                let l = clits[st + k]
                let val = litval(l)
                if val == 1 { sat = 1 }
                if val == 0 { unassigned = unassigned + 1  last_lit = l }
                k = k + 1
            }
            if sat == 0 {
                if unassigned == 0 { return c }
                if unassigned == 1 {
                    enqueue(last_lit, c)
                    changed = 1
                }
            }
            c = c + 1
        }
    }
    return 0 - 1
}

fn emit_proof_clause() with Mut, Panic {
    let idx = P_n
    var start: i32 = 0
    if idx > 0 { start = P_start[idx - 1] + P_len[idx - 1] }
    P_start[idx] = start
    P_len[idx] = llen
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < llen { P_lits[start + i] = LEARNT[i]  i = i + 1 }
    P_n = idx + 1
}

fn emit_empty() with Mut, Panic {
    let idx = P_n
    var start: i32 = 0
    if idx > 0 { start = P_start[idx - 1] + P_len[idx - 1] }
    P_start[idx] = start
    P_len[idx] = 0
    P_n = idx + 1
}

// 1-UIP conflict analysis. Fills LEARNT[0..llen] (LEARNT[0] = asserting UIP literal),
// emits it as a DRUP lemma, returns the backjump level.
fn analyze(confl: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    var pathC: i32 = 0
    llen = 1                 // reserve LEARNT[0] for the UIP literal
    var p: i64 = 0           // 0 = undefined (no variable is 0)
    var ci: i32 = confl
    var index: i32 = trail_len - 1

    var go: i32 = 1
    while go == 1 {
        let st = cstart[ci]
        let ln = clen[ci]
        var k: i32 = 0
        while k < ln {
            let q = clits[st + k]
            let vq = lit_var(q)
            var skip: i32 = 0
            if p != 0 { if vq == lit_var(p) { skip = 1 } }
            if skip == 0 {
                if seen[vq] == 0 {
                    if vlevel[vq] > 0 {
                        seen[vq] = 1
                        if vlevel[vq] >= cur_level {
                            pathC = pathC + 1
                        } else {
                            LEARNT[llen] = q
                            llen = llen + 1
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            k = k + 1
        }
        while seen[lit_var(trail_lit[index])] == 0 { index = index - 1 }
        p = trail_lit[index]
        seen[lit_var(p)] = 0
        pathC = pathC - 1
        if pathC <= 0 {
            go = 0
        } else {
            // invariant: pathC>0 means p is NOT the UIP, so p was unit-propagated
            // (the lone current-level decision is deepest and resolved last) =>
            // reason[var(p)] is a real clause index, never -1.
            ci = reason[lit_var(p)]
            index = index - 1
        }
    }
    LEARNT[0] = 0 - p

    var btlevel: i32 = 0
    var j: i32 = 1
    while j < llen {
        let lv = vlevel[lit_var(LEARNT[j])]
        if lv > btlevel { btlevel = lv }
        j = j + 1
    }
    j = 1
    while j < llen { seen[lit_var(LEARNT[j])] = 0  j = j + 1 }

    emit_proof_clause()
    return btlevel
}

fn backjump(btlevel: i32) with Mut, Panic {
    // invariant: the UIP is the unique current-level literal in LEARNT, so every
    // other learnt literal sits at a level < cur_level => btlevel < cur_level and
    // trail_lim[btlevel+1] (<= trail_lim[cur_level]) was set during the descent.
    let target = trail_lim[btlevel + 1]
    var i: i32 = trail_len - 1
    while i >= target {
        let v = lit_var(trail_lit[i])
        assign[v] = 0
        reason[v] = 0 - 1
        vlevel[v] = 0
        i = i - 1
    }
    trail_len = target
    cur_level = btlevel
}

fn pick_unassigned() -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    var v: i32 = 1
    while v <= nvars {
        if assign[v] == 0 { return v }
        v = v + 1
    }
    return 0
}

// Returns 1 = SAT, 0 = UNSAT (DRUP proof in P_*), 2 = conflict cap hit.
fn solve_cdcl() -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    cur_level = 0
    trail_lim[0] = 0
    var loops: i32 = 1
    while loops == 1 {
        let confl = propagate()
        if confl >= 0 {
            n_conflicts = n_conflicts + 1
            if n_conflicts > CONFLICT_CAP { return 2 }
            if cur_level == 0 {
                emit_empty()
                return 0
            }
            let bt = analyze(confl)
            let lidx = db_add(&LEARNT, llen)
            backjump(bt)
            enqueue(LEARNT[0], lidx)
        } else {
            let x = pick_unassigned()
            if x == 0 { return 1 }
            cur_level = cur_level + 1
            trail_lim[cur_level] = trail_len
            enqueue(x as i64, 0 - 1)
        }
    }
    return 2
}

// ---- independent RUP checker (replays P_* against the original formula) ----

var ramount: i32 = 0   // unused placeholder to keep section separable

fn reset_assign_full() with Mut, Panic {
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i <= nvars { assign[i] = 0  i = i + 1 }
}

fn rup_add_lemma(pst: i32, pln: i32) with Mut, Panic {
    if nclauses >= 262144 { return }
    let idx = nclauses
    var start: i32 = 0
    if idx > 0 { start = cstart[idx - 1] + clen[idx - 1] }
    if (start as i64) + (pln as i64) > 2097152 { return }
    cstart[idx] = start
    clen[idx] = pln
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < pln { clits[start + i] = P_lits[pst + i]  i = i + 1 }
    nclauses = idx + 1
}

// Verify the DRUP proof against clauses [0, orig_nc). Returns 1 = VERIFIED UNSAT.
fn verify(orig_nc: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    nclauses = orig_nc
    var pi: i32 = 0
    while pi < P_n {
        let pst = P_start[pi]
        let pln = P_len[pi]
        reset_assign_full()
        var taut: i32 = 0
        var k: i32 = 0
        while k < pln {
            let l = P_lits[pst + k]
            let v = lit_var(l)
            var want: i32 = 0 - 1
            if l < 0 { want = 1 }
            if assign[v] != 0 { if assign[v] != want { taut = 1 } }
            assign[v] = want
            k = k + 1
        }
        var ok: i32 = 0
        if taut == 1 { ok = 1 } else {
            let cf = propagate_noenq()
            if cf == 1 { ok = 1 }
        }
        if ok == 0 { return 0 - 1 }
        if pln == 0 { return 1 }
        rup_add_lemma(pst, pln)
        pi = pi + 1
    }
    return 0
}

// Propagation for the RUP checker: assigns implied units (level 0), returns 1 on
// conflict. Independent of trail/levels — pure clause logic.
fn propagate_noenq() -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    var changed: i32 = 1
    while changed == 1 {
        changed = 0
        var c: i32 = 0
        while c < nclauses {
            let st = cstart[c]
            let ln = clen[c]
            var sat: i32 = 0
            var un: i32 = 0
            var last: i64 = 0
            var k: i32 = 0
            while k < ln {
                let l = clits[st + k]
                let v = lit_var(l)
                var a = assign[v]
                if l < 0 { a = 0 - a }
                if a == 1 { sat = 1 }
                if a == 0 { un = un + 1  last = l }
                k = k + 1
            }
            if sat == 0 {
                if un == 0 { return 1 }
                if un == 1 {
                    let v = lit_var(last)
                    if last < 0 { assign[v] = 0 - 1 } else { assign[v] = 1 }
                    changed = 1
                }
            }
            c = c + 1
        }
    }
    return 0
}

// ---- inline decimal + DIMACS/DRAT ----
fn print_digit(d: i64) with IO {
    if d == 0 { print("0") } else if d == 1 { print("1") } else if d == 2 { print("2") }
    else if d == 3 { print("3") } else if d == 4 { print("4") } else if d == 5 { print("5") }
    else if d == 6 { print("6") } else if d == 7 { print("7") } else if d == 8 { print("8") }
    else { print("9") }
}
fn print_dec(n: i64) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    if n == 0 { print("0") return }
    var x = n
    if x < 0 { print("-") x = 0 - x }
    var buf: [i64; 24] = [0; 24]
    var len: i32 = 0
    while x > 0 { buf[len] = x % 10  x = x / 10  len = len + 1 }
    var i: i32 = len - 1
    while i >= 0 { print_digit(buf[i])  i = i - 1 }
}
fn emit_dimacs(orig_nc: i32) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("p cnf ")  print_dec(nvars as i64)  print(" ")  print_dec(orig_nc as i64)  print("\n")
    var c: i32 = 0
    while c < orig_nc {
        let st = cstart[c]
        let ln = clen[c]
        var k: i32 = 0
        while k < ln { print_dec(clits[st + k])  print(" ")  k = k + 1 }
        print("0\n")
        c = c + 1
    }
}
fn emit_drat() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var pi: i32 = 0
    while pi < P_n {
        let pst = P_start[pi]
        let pln = P_len[pi]
        var k: i32 = 0
        while k < pln { print_dec(P_lits[pst + k])  print(" ")  k = k + 1 }
        print("0\n")
        pi = pi + 1
    }
}

fn reset_all() with Mut, Panic {
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i <= nvars { assign[i] = 0  vlevel[i] = 0  reason[i] = 0  seen[i] = 0  i = i + 1 }
    nvars = 0
    nclauses = 0
    trail_len = 0
    cur_level = 0
    P_n = 0
    n_conflicts = 0
}

// K_n with k colors (= pigeonhole PHP(n,k) when k=n-1). UNSAT iff k < n.
fn build_clique(n: i64, k: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var arr: [i64; 2048] = [0; 2048]
    var v: i64 = 0
    while v < n {
        var c: i64 = 0
        while c < k { arr[c as usize] = v*k + c + 1  c = c + 1 }
        let _ = db_add(&arr, k as i32)
        v = v + 1
    }
    var a: i64 = 0
    while a < n {
        var b: i64 = a + 1
        while b < n {
            var c: i64 = 0
            while c < k {
                arr[0] = 0 - (a*k + c + 1)
                arr[1] = 0 - (b*k + c + 1)
                let _ = db_add(&arr, 2)
                c = c + 1
            }
            b = b + 1
        }
        a = a + 1
    }
}

fn run_case(n: i64) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    reset_all()
    build_clique(n, n - 1)
    let orig_nc = nclauses
    print("K_")  print_dec(n)  print("/")  print_dec(n - 1)  print("-col  vars=")
    print_dec(nvars as i64)  print("  clauses=")  print_dec(orig_nc as i64)
    let r = solve_cdcl()
    if r == 2 {
        print("  conflicts>")  print_dec(CONFLICT_CAP)  print("  => CAP\n")
        return
    }
    if r == 1 { print("  SAT (UNEXPECTED)\n")  return }
    let conf = n_conflicts
    let lemmas = P_n
    reset_assign_full()
    let vr = verify(orig_nc)
    print("  conflicts=")  print_dec(conf)  print("  DRUP-lemmas=")  print_dec(lemmas as i64)
    if vr == 1 { print("  native RUP: VERIFIED\n") } else { print("  native RUP: FAILED("); print_dec(vr as i64); print(")\n") }
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("=== CDCL (1-UIP) + DRUP emission — pigeonhole K_n/(n-1)-col ===\n")
    print("(CDCL learns, so it reaches further than tree-resolution DPLL before the\n")
    print(" Haken wall; structured instances are where learning gives big speedups)\n\n")

    run_case(4)
    run_case(5)
    run_case(6)
    run_case(7)
    run_case(8)
    run_case(9)
    run_case(10)

    print("\n-- certificate for external drat-trim: K_7 / 6-coloring --\n")
    reset_all()
    build_clique(7, 6)
    let onc = nclauses
    let s = solve_cdcl()
    if s == 0 {
        nclauses = onc
        print("%%DIMACS%%\n")
        emit_dimacs(onc)
        print("%%DRAT%%\n")
        emit_drat()
        print("%%END%%\n")
    }
    return 0
}

// ---- clause DB (originals + learned) ----
var nvars: i32 = 0
var nclauses: i32 = 0
var cstart: [i32; 1048576] = [0; 1048576]
var clen: [i32; 1048576] = [0; 1048576]
var clits: [i64; 8388608] = [0; 8388608]

// ---- assignment / trail ----
var assign: [i32; 6400] = [0; 6400]
var vlevel: [i32; 6400] = [0; 6400]
var reason: [i32; 6400] = [0; 6400]
var trail_lit: [i64; 6400] = [0; 6400]
var trail_len: i32 = 0
var trail_lim: [i32; 6400] = [0; 6400]
var cur_level: i32 = 0

var seen: [i32; 6400] = [0; 6400]
var LEARNT: [i64; 8192] = [0; 8192]
var llen: i32 = 0

var P_n: i32 = 0
var P_start: [i32; 1048576] = [0; 1048576]
var P_len: [i32; 1048576] = [0; 1048576]
var P_lits: [i64; 8388608] = [0; 8388608]

var n_conflicts: i64 = 0
var CONFLICT_CAP: i64 = 200000
var n_decisions: i64 = 0

fn print_digit(d: i64) with IO {
    if d == 0 { print("0") } else if d == 1 { print("1") } else if d == 2 { print("2") }
    else if d == 3 { print("3") } else if d == 4 { print("4") } else if d == 5 { print("5") }
    else if d == 6 { print("6") } else if d == 7 { print("7") } else if d == 8 { print("8") }
    else { print("9") }
}
fn print_dec(n: i64) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    if n == 0 { print("0") return }
    var x = n
    if x < 0 { print("-") x = 0 - x }
    var buf: [i64; 24] = [0; 24]
    var len: i32 = 0
    while x > 0 { buf[len] = x % 10  x = x / 10  len = len + 1 }
    var i: i32 = len - 1
    while i >= 0 { print_digit(buf[i])  i = i - 1 }
}

fn lit_var(l: i64) -> i32 with Panic {
    if l < 0 { return (0 - l) as i32 }
    return l as i32
}

fn db_add(arr: &[i64; 8192], n: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    if nclauses >= 1048576 { return 0 - 1 }
    let idx = nclauses
    var start: i32 = 0
    if idx > 0 { start = cstart[idx - 1] + clen[idx - 1] }
    if (start as i64) + (n as i64) > 8388608 { return 0 - 1 }
    cstart[idx] = start
    clen[idx] = n
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < n {
        clits[start + i] = arr[i]
        let v = lit_var(arr[i])
        if v > nvars { nvars = v }
        i = i + 1
    }
    nclauses = idx + 1
    return idx
}

fn litval(l: i64) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    let v = lit_var(l)
    var a = assign[v]
    if l < 0 { a = 0 - a }
    return a
}

fn enqueue(lit: i64, rs: i32) with Mut, Panic {
    let v = lit_var(lit)
    if lit < 0 { assign[v] = 0 - 1 } else { assign[v] = 1 }
    vlevel[v] = cur_level
    reason[v] = rs
    trail_lit[trail_len] = lit
    trail_len = trail_len + 1
}

fn propagate() -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    var changed: i32 = 1
    while changed == 1 {
        changed = 0
        var c: i32 = 0
        while c < nclauses {
            let st = cstart[c]
            let ln = clen[c]
            var sat: i32 = 0
            var unassigned: i32 = 0
            var last_lit: i64 = 0
            var k: i32 = 0
            while k < ln {
                let l = clits[st + k]
                let val = litval(l)
                if val == 1 { sat = 1 }
                if val == 0 { unassigned = unassigned + 1  last_lit = l }
                k = k + 1
            }
            if sat == 0 {
                if unassigned == 0 { return c }
                if unassigned == 1 { enqueue(last_lit, c)  changed = 1 }
            }
            c = c + 1
        }
    }
    return 0 - 1
}

fn emit_proof_clause() with Mut, Panic {
    let idx = P_n
    var start: i32 = 0
    if idx > 0 { start = P_start[idx - 1] + P_len[idx - 1] }
    if (start as i64) + (llen as i64) > 8388608 { return }
    P_start[idx] = start
    P_len[idx] = llen
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < llen { P_lits[start + i] = LEARNT[i]  i = i + 1 }
    P_n = idx + 1
}

fn emit_empty() with Mut, Panic {
    let idx = P_n
    var start: i32 = 0
    if idx > 0 { start = P_start[idx - 1] + P_len[idx - 1] }
    P_start[idx] = start
    P_len[idx] = 0
    P_n = idx + 1
}

fn analyze(confl: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    var pathC: i32 = 0
    llen = 1
    var p: i64 = 0
    var ci: i32 = confl
    var index: i32 = trail_len - 1
    var go: i32 = 1
    while go == 1 {
        let st = cstart[ci]
        let ln = clen[ci]
        var k: i32 = 0
        while k < ln {
            let q = clits[st + k]
            let vq = lit_var(q)
            var skip: i32 = 0
            if p != 0 { if vq == lit_var(p) { skip = 1 } }
            if skip == 0 {
                if seen[vq] == 0 {
                    if vlevel[vq] > 0 {
                        seen[vq] = 1
                        if vlevel[vq] >= cur_level { pathC = pathC + 1 }
                        else { LEARNT[llen] = q  llen = llen + 1 }
                    }
                }
            }
            k = k + 1
        }
        while seen[lit_var(trail_lit[index])] == 0 { index = index - 1 }
        p = trail_lit[index]
        seen[lit_var(p)] = 0
        pathC = pathC - 1
        if pathC <= 0 { go = 0 }
        else { ci = reason[lit_var(p)]  index = index - 1 }
    }
    LEARNT[0] = 0 - p
    var btlevel: i32 = 0
    var j: i32 = 1
    while j < llen {
        let lv = vlevel[lit_var(LEARNT[j])]
        if lv > btlevel { btlevel = lv }
        j = j + 1
    }
    j = 1
    while j < llen { seen[lit_var(LEARNT[j])] = 0  j = j + 1 }
    emit_proof_clause()
    return btlevel
}

fn backjump(btlevel: i32) with Mut, Panic {
    let target = trail_lim[btlevel + 1]
    var i: i32 = trail_len - 1
    while i >= target {
        let v = lit_var(trail_lit[i])
        assign[v] = 0
        reason[v] = 0 - 1
        vlevel[v] = 0
        i = i - 1
    }
    trail_len = target
    cur_level = btlevel
}

var search_ptr: i32 = 1
fn pick_unassigned() -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    var v: i32 = 1
    while v <= nvars {
        if assign[v] == 0 { return v }
        v = v + 1
    }
    return 0
}

fn solve_cdcl() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    cur_level = 0
    trail_lim[0] = 0
    var loops: i32 = 1
    while loops == 1 {
        let confl = propagate()
        if confl >= 0 {
            n_conflicts = n_conflicts + 1
            if n_conflicts % 20000 == 0 {
                print("  [progress] conflicts="); print_dec(n_conflicts)
                print(" lemmas="); print_dec(P_n as i64)
                print(" clauses="); print_dec(nclauses as i64); print("\n")
            }
            if n_conflicts > CONFLICT_CAP { return 2 }
            if cur_level == 0 { emit_empty()  return 0 }
            let bt = analyze(confl)
            let lidx = db_add(&LEARNT, llen)
            if lidx < 0 { return 3 }
            backjump(bt)
            enqueue(LEARNT[0], lidx)
        } else {
            let x = pick_unassigned()
            if x == 0 { return 1 }
            n_decisions = n_decisions + 1
            cur_level = cur_level + 1
            trail_lim[cur_level] = trail_len
            enqueue(x as i64, 0 - 1)
        }
    }
    return 2
}

fn reset_assign_full() with Mut, Panic {
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i <= nvars { assign[i] = 0  i = i + 1 }
}

fn rup_add_lemma(pst: i32, pln: i32) with Mut, Panic {
    if nclauses >= 1048576 { return }
    let idx = nclauses
    var start: i32 = 0
    if idx > 0 { start = cstart[idx - 1] + clen[idx - 1] }
    if (start as i64) + (pln as i64) > 8388608 { return }
    cstart[idx] = start
    clen[idx] = pln
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < pln { clits[start + i] = P_lits[pst + i]  i = i + 1 }
    nclauses = idx + 1
}

fn propagate_noenq() -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    var changed: i32 = 1
    while changed == 1 {
        changed = 0
        var c: i32 = 0
        while c < nclauses {
            let st = cstart[c]
            let ln = clen[c]
            var sat: i32 = 0
            var un: i32 = 0
            var last: i64 = 0
            var k: i32 = 0
            while k < ln {
                let l = clits[st + k]
                let v = lit_var(l)
                var a = assign[v]
                if l < 0 { a = 0 - a }
                if a == 1 { sat = 1 }
                if a == 0 { un = un + 1  last = l }
                k = k + 1
            }
            if sat == 0 {
                if un == 0 { return 1 }
                if un == 1 {
                    let v = lit_var(last)
                    if last < 0 { assign[v] = 0 - 1 } else { assign[v] = 1 }
                    changed = 1
                }
            }
            c = c + 1
        }
    }
    return 0
}

fn verify(orig_nc: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    nclauses = orig_nc
    var pi: i32 = 0
    while pi < P_n {
        let pst = P_start[pi]
        let pln = P_len[pi]
        reset_assign_full()
        var taut: i32 = 0
        var k: i32 = 0
        while k < pln {
            let l = P_lits[pst + k]
            let v = lit_var(l)
            var want: i32 = 0 - 1
            if l < 0 { want = 1 }
            if assign[v] != 0 { if assign[v] != want { taut = 1 } }
            assign[v] = want
            k = k + 1
        }
        var ok: i32 = 0
        if taut == 1 { ok = 1 } else {
            let cf = propagate_noenq()
            if cf == 1 { ok = 1 }
        }
        if ok == 0 { return 0 - 1 }
        if pln == 0 { return 1 }
        rup_add_lemma(pst, pln)
        pi = pi + 1
    }
    return 0
}

fn emit_dimacs(orig_nc: i32) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("p cnf ")  print_dec(nvars as i64)  print(" ")  print_dec(orig_nc as i64)  print("\n")
    var c: i32 = 0
    while c < orig_nc {
        let st = cstart[c]
        let ln = clen[c]
        var k: i32 = 0
        while k < ln { print_dec(clits[st + k])  print(" ")  k = k + 1 }
        print("0\n")
        c = c + 1
    }
}

fn emit_drat() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var pi: i32 = 0
    while pi < P_n {
        let pst = P_start[pi]
        let pln = P_len[pi]
        var k: i32 = 0
        while k < pln { print_dec(P_lits[pst + k])  print(" ")  k = k + 1 }
        print("0\n")
        pi = pi + 1
    }
}

// ---- de Grey graph data check (integer fixed-point, scale 1e7) ----
fn validate_geometry() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic {
    var ok: i32 = 0
    var e: i32 = 0
    while e < 7877 {
        let u = E[2*e] - 1
        let w = E[2*e + 1] - 1
        let dx = CX[u] - CX[w]
        let dy = CY[u] - CY[w]
        let d2 = dx*dx + dy*dy
        var err = d2 - 100000000000000
        if err < 0 { err = 0 - err }
        if err < 100000000000 { ok = ok + 1 }
        e = e + 1
    }
    return ok
}

// 4-coloring CNF: var(v,c) = (v-1)*4 + c + 1, v in 1..1581, c in 0..3.
fn vc(v: i32, c: i32) -> i64 { return ((v - 1) * 4 + c + 1) as i64 }

fn build_coloring() with Mut, Panic {
    var v: i32 = 1
    while v <= 1581 {
        LEARNT[0] = vc(v, 0)  LEARNT[1] = vc(v, 1)  LEARNT[2] = vc(v, 2)  LEARNT[3] = vc(v, 3)
        let _ = db_add(&LEARNT, 4)
        v = v + 1
    }
    var e: i32 = 0
    while e < 7877 {
        let u = E[2*e]
        let w = E[2*e + 1]
        var c: i32 = 0
        while c < 4 {
            LEARNT[0] = 0 - vc(u, c)
            LEARNT[1] = 0 - vc(w, c)
            let _ = db_add(&LEARNT, 2)
            c = c + 1
        }
        e = e + 1
    }
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("=== de Grey unit-distance graph -> chi(R^2) >= 5 attempt ===\n")
    print("vertices=1581  edges=7877  (data: de Grey 2018)\n")
    ginit_all()
    let okg = validate_geometry()
    print("[geometry] unit-distance edges (|d2-1|<tol, exact i64, scale 1e7): ")
    print_dec(okg as i64)  print(" / 7877\n")
    if okg == 7877 { print("[geometry] PASS: all edges are unit-distance.\n") }
    else { print("[geometry] FAIL.\n") }

    build_coloring()
    let orig_nc = nclauses
    print("[cnf] 4-coloring CNF: vars="); print_dec(nvars as i64)
    print(" clauses="); print_dec(orig_nc as i64); print("\n")
    print("[solve] CDCL (1-UIP, naive full-scan prop, no watches/VSIDS) budget=")
    print_dec(CONFLICT_CAP); print(" conflicts...\n")

    let r = solve_cdcl()
    print("[solve] result code="); print_dec(r as i64)
    print("  conflicts="); print_dec(n_conflicts)
    print("  decisions="); print_dec(n_decisions)
    print("  lemmas="); print_dec(P_n as i64); print("\n")

    if r == 0 {
        print("[solve] UNSAT => this unit-distance graph is NOT 4-colorable => chi(R^2) >= 5\n")
        reset_assign_full()
        let vr = verify(orig_nc)
        if vr == 1 { print("[verify] native RUP checker: VERIFIED\n") }
        else { print("[verify] native RUP: FAILED code="); print_dec(vr as i64); print("\n") }
    } else if r == 1 {
        print("[solve] SAT: a 4-coloring exists (this graph alone does not force chi>=5)\n")
    } else if r == 2 {
        print("[solve] WALL: hit conflict budget (naive solver). No claim made.\n")
    } else {
        print("[solve] capacity exhausted (arrays). No claim made.\n")
    }
    return 0
}

var n_deleted: i64 = 0

// two-watched-literal scheme: clause c watches clits[cstart[c]+0] and +1.
// watch node id = 2*c + slot. wnext chains nodes within one literal's list.
var whead: [i32; 16386] = [0 - 1; 16386]
var wnext: [i32; 2097152] = [0; 2097152]

var assign: [i32; 8192] = [0; 8192]
var vlevel: [i32; 8192] = [0; 8192]
var reason: [i32; 8192] = [0; 8192]
var phase:  [i32; 8192] = [0; 8192]
var activity: [i64; 8192] = [0; 8192]
var trail_lit: [i64; 8192] = [0; 8192]
var trail_len: i32 = 0
var trail_lim: [i32; 8192] = [0; 8192]
var cur_level: i32 = 0
var qhead: i32 = 0

var seen: [i32; 8192] = [0; 8192]
var LEARNT: [i64; 8192] = [0; 8192]
var llen: i32 = 0

var P_n: i32 = 0
var P_start: [i32; 67108864] = [0; 67108864]
var P_len: [i32; 67108864] = [0; 67108864]
var P_tag: [i32; 67108864] = [0; 67108864]
var P_lits: [i64; 1073741824] = [0; 1073741824]
var P_pos: i64 = 0

var n_conflicts: i64 = 0
var n_decisions: i64 = 0
var n_restarts: i64 = 0
var CONFLICT_CAP: i64 = 200000000
var var_inc: i64 = 1000000

fn print_digit(d: i64) with IO {
    if d == 0 { print("0") } else if d == 1 { print("1") } else if d == 2 { print("2") }
    else if d == 3 { print("3") } else if d == 4 { print("4") } else if d == 5 { print("5") }
    else if d == 6 { print("6") } else if d == 7 { print("7") } else if d == 8 { print("8") }
    else { print("9") }
}
fn print_dec(n: i64) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    if n == 0 { print("0") return }
    var x = n
    if x < 0 { print("-") x = 0 - x }
    var buf: [i64; 24] = [0; 24]
    var len: i32 = 0
    while x > 0 { buf[len] = x % 10  x = x / 10  len = len + 1 }
    var i: i32 = len - 1
    while i >= 0 { print_digit(buf[i])  i = i - 1 }
}

fn lit_var(l: i64) -> i32 with Panic {
    if l < 0 { return (0 - l) as i32 }
    return l as i32
}
fn litidx(l: i64) -> i32 with Panic {
    let v = lit_var(l)
    if l < 0 { return v * 2 + 1 }
    return v * 2
}
fn litval(l: i64) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    let v = lit_var(l)
    var a = assign[v]
    if l < 0 { a = 0 - a }
    return a
}

fn watch_clause(c: i32) with Mut, Panic {
    let st = cstart[c]
    let i0 = litidx(clits[st + 0])
    wnext[2 * c] = whead[i0]
    whead[i0] = 2 * c
    let i1 = litidx(clits[st + 1])
    wnext[2 * c + 1] = whead[i1]
    whead[i1] = 2 * c + 1
}

fn db_add(arr: &[i64; 8192], n: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    if nclauses >= 1048576 { return 0 - 1 }
    let idx = nclauses
    var start: i32 = 0
    if idx > 0 { start = cstart[idx - 1] + clen[idx - 1] }
    if (start as i64) + (n as i64) > 100000000 { return 0 - 1 }
    cstart[idx] = start
    clen[idx] = n
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < n {
        clits[start + i] = arr[i]
        let v = lit_var(arr[i])
        if v > nvars { nvars = v }
        i = i + 1
    }
    nclauses = idx + 1
    if n >= 2 { watch_clause(idx) }
    return idx
}

fn enqueue(lit: i64, rs: i32) with Mut, Panic {
    let v = lit_var(lit)
    if lit < 0 { assign[v] = 0 - 1 } else { assign[v] = 1 }
    vlevel[v] = cur_level
    reason[v] = rs
    trail_lit[trail_len] = lit
    trail_len = trail_len + 1
}

// two-watched-literal unit propagation; returns conflict clause idx or -1.
fn propagate() -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    while qhead < trail_len {
        let p = trail_lit[qhead]
        qhead = qhead + 1
        let f = 0 - p
        let fi = litidx(f)
        var prev: i32 = 0 - 1
        var node = whead[fi]
        while node != (0 - 1) {
            let nextnode = wnext[node]
            let c = node / 2
            let s = node - 2 * c
            let st = cstart[c]
            let other = clits[st + (1 - s)]
            var handled: i32 = 0
            if litval(other) == 1 {
                prev = node
                handled = 1
            }
            if handled == 0 {
                let ln = clen[c]
                var found: i32 = 0 - 1
                var k: i32 = 2
                while k < ln {
                    if litval(clits[st + k]) != (0 - 1) { found = k  k = ln }
                    else { k = k + 1 }
                }
                if found != (0 - 1) {
                    let tmp = clits[st + s]
                    clits[st + s] = clits[st + found]
                    clits[st + found] = tmp
                    let newlit = clits[st + s]
                    if prev == (0 - 1) { whead[fi] = nextnode } else { wnext[prev] = nextnode }
                    let ni = litidx(newlit)
                    wnext[node] = whead[ni]
                    whead[ni] = node
                    handled = 1
                }
            }
            if handled == 0 {
                if litval(other) == (0 - 1) { return c }
                enqueue(other, c)
                prev = node
            }
            node = nextnode
        }
    }
    return 0 - 1
}

fn rescale() with Mut, Panic {
    var i: i32 = 1
    while i <= nvars { activity[i] = activity[i] / 1000000000  i = i + 1 }
    var_inc = var_inc / 1000000000
    if var_inc < 1 { var_inc = 1 }
}
fn bump(v: i32) with Mut, Panic {
    activity[v] = activity[v] + var_inc
    if activity[v] > 1000000000000000000 { rescale() }
}

// proof stream: ordered records, P_tag 0 = add lemma, 1 = delete clause.
// emit_drat writes "d ..." for tag 1; the native RUP checker skips tag 1
// records entirely (a lemma RUP w.r.t. a superset DB is still RUP -> sound).
fn emit_proof_clause() with Mut, Panic {
    let idx = P_n
    if idx >= 67108864 { return }
    let start = P_pos
    if start + (llen as i64) > 1073741824 { return }
    P_start[idx] = start as i32
    P_len[idx] = llen
    P_tag[idx] = 0
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < llen { P_lits[(start as i32) + i] = LEARNT[i]  i = i + 1 }
    P_pos = start + (llen as i64)
    P_n = idx + 1
}
fn emit_delete(c: i32) with Mut, Panic {
    let idx = P_n
    if idx >= 67108864 { return }
    let ln = clen[c]
    let start = P_pos
    if start + (ln as i64) > 1073741824 { return }
    P_start[idx] = start as i32
    P_len[idx] = ln
    P_tag[idx] = 1
    let st = cstart[c]
    var k: i32 = 0
    while k < ln { P_lits[(start as i32) + k] = clits[st + k]  k = k + 1 }
    P_pos = start + (ln as i64)
    P_n = idx + 1
}
fn emit_empty() with Mut, Panic {
    let idx = P_n
    if idx >= 67108864 { return }
    P_start[idx] = P_pos as i32
    P_len[idx] = 0
    P_tag[idx] = 0
    P_n = idx + 1
}

// LBD = number of distinct decision levels among the learned literals.
fn comp_lbd() -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    var cnt: i32 = 0
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < llen {
        let lv = vlevel[lit_var(LEARNT[i])]
        if lblmark[lv] == 0 { lblmark[lv] = 1  cnt = cnt + 1 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    i = 0
    while i < llen { lblmark[vlevel[lit_var(LEARNT[i])]] = 0  i = i + 1 }
    return cnt
}

// 1-UIP analysis; LEARNT[0]=asserting UIP literal, LEARNT[1]=second watch
// (max-level literal). Returns backjump level. Bumps VSIDS activity.
fn analyze(confl: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    var pathC: i32 = 0
    llen = 1
    var p: i64 = 0
    var ci: i32 = confl
    var index: i32 = trail_len - 1
    var go: i32 = 1
    while go == 1 {
        let st = cstart[ci]
        let ln = clen[ci]
        var k: i32 = 0
        while k < ln {
            let q = clits[st + k]
            let vq = lit_var(q)
            var skip: i32 = 0
            if p != 0 { if vq == lit_var(p) { skip = 1 } }
            if skip == 0 {
                if seen[vq] == 0 {
                    if vlevel[vq] > 0 {
                        seen[vq] = 1
                        bump(vq)
                        if vlevel[vq] >= cur_level { pathC = pathC + 1 }
                        else { LEARNT[llen] = q  llen = llen + 1 }
                    }
                }
            }
            k = k + 1
        }
        while seen[lit_var(trail_lit[index])] == 0 { index = index - 1 }
        p = trail_lit[index]
        seen[lit_var(p)] = 0
        pathC = pathC - 1
        if pathC <= 0 { go = 0 }
        else { ci = reason[lit_var(p)]  index = index - 1 }
    }
    LEARNT[0] = 0 - p

    var btlevel: i32 = 0
    if llen >= 2 {
        var maxi: i32 = 1
        var maxl: i32 = vlevel[lit_var(LEARNT[1])]
        var j2: i32 = 2
        while j2 < llen {
            let lv = vlevel[lit_var(LEARNT[j2])]
            if lv > maxl { maxl = lv  maxi = j2 }
            j2 = j2 + 1
        }
        let tmp = LEARNT[1]  LEARNT[1] = LEARNT[maxi]  LEARNT[maxi] = tmp
        btlevel = maxl
    }
    var j: i32 = 1
    while j < llen { seen[lit_var(LEARNT[j])] = 0  j = j + 1 }
    var_inc = var_inc + var_inc / 20
    if var_inc > 1000000000000000 { rescale() }
    last_lbd = comp_lbd()
    emit_proof_clause()
    return btlevel
}

fn cancel_to(level: i32) with Mut, Panic {
    if cur_level <= level { return }
    let target = trail_lim[level + 1]
    var i: i32 = trail_len - 1
    while i >= target {
        let v = lit_var(trail_lit[i])
        if assign[v] == 1 { phase[v] = 1 } else { phase[v] = 0 }
        assign[v] = 0
        reason[v] = 0 - 1
        vlevel[v] = 0
        i = i - 1
    }
    trail_len = target
    qhead = target
    cur_level = level
}

// Clause-DB reduction, MUST be called only at decision level 0.
// Keeps: all originals (c < n_orig), glue clauses (lbd <= LBD_KEEP), and
// locked clauses (reason of a current level-0 unit). Deletes the rest,
// emitting a DRUP 'd' record for each so drat-trim stays in sync. Then
// compacts clits/cstart/clen/lbd, remaps reason[] via cmap, rebuilds the
// watch lists, and resets qhead so propagate() restores the watch invariant.
fn reduce_db() with Mut, Panic {
    var c: i32 = 0
    while c < nclauses {
        if c < n_orig { keepf[c] = 1 }
        else if lbd[c] <= LBD_KEEP { keepf[c] = 1 }
        else { keepf[c] = 0 }
        c = c + 1
    }
    // lock clauses that justify current (level-0) assignments
    var t: i32 = 0
    while t < trail_len {
        let v = lit_var(trail_lit[t])
        let r = reason[v]
        if r >= 0 { keepf[r] = 1 }
        t = t + 1
    }
    // emit deletions BEFORE compaction (literals still live in clits)
    c = n_orig
    while c < nclauses {
        if keepf[c] == 0 { emit_delete(c)  n_deleted = n_deleted + 1 }
        c = c + 1
    }
    // compact kept clauses to the front (forward copy: dest <= src, safe)
    var newidx: i32 = 0
    var newpos: i32 = 0
    c = 0
    while c < nclauses {
        if keepf[c] == 1 {
            let oldst = cstart[c]
            let ln = clen[c]
            let lb = lbd[c]
            cmap[c] = newidx
            var k: i32 = 0
            while k < ln { clits[newpos + k] = clits[oldst + k]  k = k + 1 }
            cstart[newidx] = newpos
            clen[newidx] = ln
            lbd[newidx] = lb
            newpos = newpos + ln
            newidx = newidx + 1
        }
        c = c + 1
    }
    nclauses = newidx
    // remap reasons of the surviving (level-0) trail
    t = 0
    while t < trail_len {
        let v = lit_var(trail_lit[t])
        if reason[v] >= 0 { reason[v] = cmap[reason[v]] }
        t = t + 1
    }
    // rebuild all watch lists from the compacted DB
    var li: i32 = 0
    while li < 16386 { whead[li] = 0 - 1  li = li + 1 }
    c = 0
    while c < nclauses { if clen[c] >= 2 { watch_clause(c) }  c = c + 1 }
    qhead = 0
    n_reduces = n_reduces + 1
    let learned = nclauses - n_orig
    if learned > max_learnts - max_learnts / 4 {
        if max_learnts < 800000 { max_learnts = max_learnts + max_learnts / 2 }
    }
}

fn pick() -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    var best: i32 = 0
    var bestact: i64 = 0 - 1
    var v: i32 = 1
    while v <= nvars {
        if assign[v] == 0 {
            if activity[v] > bestact { bestact = activity[v]  best = v }
        }
        v = v + 1
    }
    return best
}

fn solve() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    cur_level = 0
    trail_lim[0] = 0
    qhead = 0
    // inner/outer (MiniSat-style) restarts: keep restarts frequent and
    // well-distributed (far better for hard UNSAT than unbounded geometric).
    var restart_inner: i64 = 100
    var restart_outer: i64 = 100
    var since_restart: i64 = 0
    var rephase_flag: i32 = 0
    var loops: i32 = 1
    while loops == 1 {
        let confl = propagate()
        if confl >= 0 {
            n_conflicts = n_conflicts + 1
            since_restart = since_restart + 1
            if n_conflicts % 100000 == 0 {
                print("  [progress] conflicts="); print_dec(n_conflicts)
                print(" lemmas="); print_dec(P_n as i64)
                print(" clauses="); print_dec(nclauses as i64)
                print(" reduces="); print_dec(n_reduces)
                print(" deleted="); print_dec(n_deleted)
                print(" restarts="); print_dec(n_restarts)
                print(" trail="); print_dec(trail_len as i64); print("\n")
            }
            if n_conflicts > CONFLICT_CAP { return 2 }
            if cur_level == 0 { emit_empty()  return 0 }
            let bt = analyze(confl)
            let lidx = db_add(&LEARNT, llen)
            if lidx < 0 { return 3 }
            lbd[lidx] = last_lbd
            cancel_to(bt)
            enqueue(LEARNT[0], lidx)
            if (nclauses - n_orig) >= max_learnts {
                cancel_to(0)
                qhead = 0
                since_restart = 0
                n_restarts = n_restarts + 1
                reduce_db()
            } else if since_restart >= restart_inner {
                cancel_to(0)
                qhead = 0
                since_restart = 0
                n_restarts = n_restarts + 1
                restart_inner = restart_inner + restart_inner / 10
                if restart_inner > restart_outer {
                    restart_inner = 100
                    restart_outer = restart_outer + restart_outer / 10
                }
                // periodic rephasing to diversify saved polarities
                if n_restarts % 128 == 0 {
                    rephase_flag = 1 - rephase_flag
                    var rv: i32 = 1
                    while rv <= nvars { phase[rv] = rephase_flag  rv = rv + 1 }
                }
            }
        } else {
            let x = pick()
            if x == 0 { return 1 }
            n_decisions = n_decisions + 1
            cur_level = cur_level + 1
            trail_lim[cur_level] = trail_len
            if phase[x] == 1 { enqueue(x as i64, 0 - 1) } else { enqueue(0 - (x as i64), 0 - 1) }
        }
    }
    return 2
}

// ---- full-scan RUP checker (small instances; de Grey uses drat-trim) ----
fn reset_assign_full() with Mut, Panic {
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i <= nvars { assign[i] = 0  i = i + 1 }
}
fn rup_add_lemma(pst: i32, pln: i32) with Mut, Panic {
    if nclauses >= 1048576 { return }
    let idx = nclauses
    var start: i32 = 0
    if idx > 0 { start = cstart[idx - 1] + clen[idx - 1] }
    if (start as i64) + (pln as i64) > 100000000 { return }
    cstart[idx] = start
    clen[idx] = pln
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < pln { clits[start + i] = P_lits[pst + i]  i = i + 1 }
    nclauses = idx + 1
}
fn propagate_noenq() -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    var changed: i32 = 1
    while changed == 1 {
        changed = 0
        var c: i32 = 0
        while c < nclauses {
            let st = cstart[c]
            let ln = clen[c]
            var sat: i32 = 0
            var un: i32 = 0
            var last: i64 = 0
            var k: i32 = 0
            while k < ln {
                let l = clits[st + k]
                let v = lit_var(l)
                var a = assign[v]
                if l < 0 { a = 0 - a }
                if a == 1 { sat = 1 }
                if a == 0 { un = un + 1  last = l }
                k = k + 1
            }
            if sat == 0 {
                if un == 0 { return 1 }
                if un == 1 {
                    let v = lit_var(last)
                    if last < 0 { assign[v] = 0 - 1 } else { assign[v] = 1 }
                    changed = 1
                }
            }
            c = c + 1
        }
    }
    return 0
}
fn verify(orig_nc: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    nclauses = orig_nc
    var pi: i32 = 0
    while pi < P_n {
        if P_tag[pi] == 1 { pi = pi + 1  continue }
        let pst = P_start[pi]
        let pln = P_len[pi]
        reset_assign_full()
        var taut: i32 = 0
        var k: i32 = 0
        while k < pln {
            let l = P_lits[pst + k]
            let v = lit_var(l)
            var want: i32 = 0 - 1
            if l < 0 { want = 1 }
            if assign[v] != 0 { if assign[v] != want { taut = 1 } }
            assign[v] = want
            k = k + 1
        }
        var ok: i32 = 0
        if taut == 1 { ok = 1 } else {
            let cf = propagate_noenq()
            if cf == 1 { ok = 1 }
        }
        if ok == 0 { return 0 - 1 }
        if pln == 0 { return 1 }
        rup_add_lemma(pst, pln)
        pi = pi + 1
    }
    return 0
}

fn emit_dimacs(orig_nc: i32) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("p cnf ")  print_dec(nvars as i64)  print(" ")  print_dec(orig_nc as i64)  print("\n")
    var c: i32 = 0
    while c < orig_nc {
        let st = cstart[c]
        let ln = clen[c]
        var k: i32 = 0
        while k < ln { print_dec(clits[st + k])  print(" ")  k = k + 1 }
        print("0\n")
        c = c + 1
    }
}
fn emit_drat() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var pi: i32 = 0
    while pi < P_n {
        let pst = P_start[pi]
        let pln = P_len[pi]
        if P_tag[pi] == 1 { print("d ") }
        var k: i32 = 0
        while k < pln { print_dec(P_lits[pst + k])  print(" ")  k = k + 1 }
        print("0\n")
        pi = pi + 1
    }
}

fn validate_geometry() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic {
    var ok: i32 = 0
    var e: i32 = 0
    while e < 7877 {
        let u = E[2*e] - 1
        let w = E[2*e + 1] - 1
        let dx = CX[u] - CX[w]
        let dy = CY[u] - CY[w]
        let d2 = dx*dx + dy*dy
        var err = d2 - 100000000000000
        if err < 0 { err = 0 - err }
        if err < 100000000000 { ok = ok + 1 }
        e = e + 1
    }
    return ok
}
fn vc(v: i32, c: i32) -> i64 { return ((v - 1) * 4 + c + 1) as i64 }
fn build_coloring() with Mut, Panic {
    var v: i32 = 1
    while v <= 1581 {
        LEARNT[0]=vc(v,0) LEARNT[1]=vc(v,1) LEARNT[2]=vc(v,2) LEARNT[3]=vc(v,3)
        let _ = db_add(&LEARNT, 4)
        v = v + 1
    }
    var e: i32 = 0
    while e < 7877 {
        let u = E[2*e]
        let w = E[2*e + 1]
        var c: i32 = 0
        while c < 4 {
