    while x > 0 { buf[len] = x % 10  x = x / 10  len = len + 1 }
    var i: i32 = len - 1
    while i >= 0 { print_digit(buf[i])  i = i - 1 }
}
fn emit_dimacs(db: &Db, orig_nc: i32) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("p cnf ")
    print_dec(db.n_vars as i64)
    print(" ")
    print_dec(orig_nc as i64)
    print("\n")
    var c: i32 = 0
    while c < orig_nc {
        let st = db.cstart[c]
        let ln = db.clen[c]
        var k: i32 = 0
        while k < ln { print_dec(db.lits[st + k])  print(" ")  k = k + 1 }
        print("0\n")
        c = c + 1
    }
}
fn emit_drat(proof: &Proof) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var pi: i32 = 0
    while pi < proof.n {
        let pst = proof.pstart[pi]
        let pln = proof.plen[pi]
        var k: i32 = 0
        while k < pln { print_dec(proof.plits[pst + k])  print(" ")  k = k + 1 }
        print("0\n")
        pi = pi + 1
    }
}

// ===================== build k-coloring CNF from ADJ =========================

fn vc(v: i64, c: i64, k: i64) -> i64 {
    return v*k + c + 1
}

// At-least-one-color per vertex + edge inequality clauses. (No at-most-one is
// needed: ALO + edge constraints already force chi colors on the graph.)
fn build_coloring(db: &!Db, nverts: i64, k: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var arr: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
    var v: i64 = 0
    while v < nverts {
        var c: i64 = 0
        while c < k { arr[c as usize] = vc(v, c, k)  c = c + 1 }
        db_add_clause(db, &arr, k as i32)
        v = v + 1
    }
    var u: i64 = 0
    while u < nverts {
        var w: i64 = u + 1
        while w < nverts {
            if ADJ[(u*7 + w) as usize] == 1 {
                var c: i64 = 0
                while c < k {
                    arr[0] = 0 - vc(u, c, k)
                    arr[1] = 0 - vc(w, c, k)
                    db_add_clause(db, &arr, 2)
                    c = c + 1
                }
            }
            w = w + 1
        }
        u = u + 1
    }
}

fn run() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("=== Erdős #508: Moser spindle is NOT 3-colorable (chi >= 4) ===\n")
    print("exact Q(√3,√11) geometry -> 3-coloring CNF -> DRUP proof -> RUP + drat-trim\n\n")

    setup_points()
    let nedges = build_edges()
    print("spindle built from EXACT coordinates: vertices=7  unit edges=")
    print_int(nedges)
    print("  (expected 11)\n")
    if nedges != 11 {
        print("UNEXPECTED edge count — abort.\n")
        return 1
    }

    var db: Db = Db {
        n_vars: 0,
        n_clauses: 0,
        cstart: [0; 1024],
        clen: [0; 1024],
        lits: [0; 4096],
        assign: [0; 256],
    }
    build_coloring(&!db, 7, 3)
    print("3-coloring CNF: vars=")
    print_int(db.n_vars)
    print("  clauses=")
    print_int(db.n_clauses)
    print("\n")
    let orig_nc = db.n_clauses

    var proof: Proof = Proof {
        n: 0,
        pstart: [0; 2048],
        plen: [0; 2048],
        plits: [0; 8192],
    }
    var dec: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]

    let sat = solve_rec(&!db, &!proof, &!dec, 0)
    if sat == 1 {
        print("SOLVER: SAT — the spindle WOULD be 3-colorable (contradicts chi=4!).\n")
        return 1
    }
    print("SOLVER: UNSAT.  DRUP lemmas=")
    print_int(proof.n)
    print("  last-lemma-len=")
    print_int(proof.plen[proof.n - 1])
    print(" (0=empty clause)\n")

    reset_assign(&!db)
    let vr = verify(&!db, &proof)
    if vr != 1 {
        print("NATIVE CHECKER: proof did NOT verify (result=")
        print_int(vr)
        print(").\n")
        return 1
    }
    print("NATIVE CHECKER: VERIFIED — every lemma RUP, empty clause derived.\n")
    print(">>> chi(Moser spindle) >= 4, certified natively over exact geometry.\n")

    db.n_clauses = orig_nc
    print("\n%%DIMACS%%\n")
    emit_dimacs(&db, orig_nc)
    print("%%DRAT%%\n")
    emit_drat(&proof)
    print("%%END%%\n")
    return 0
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic { return run() }

    let buffer = unsafe { malloc(size) };

    if is_null(buffer) {
        println("Failed to allocate memory!");
        return;
    }

    // Zero the buffer

// === FILE: examples/fibonacci.sio ===
//! Fibonacci sequence example
//!
//! Demonstrates recursion and basic control flow.

/// Compute the nth Fibonacci number recursively
fn fibonacci(n: i32) -> i32 {
    if n <= 1 {
        n
    } else {
        fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2)
    }
}

/// Compute Fibonacci iteratively (more efficient)
fn fibonacci_iter(n: i32) -> i64 with Mut {
    if n <= 1 {
        return n as i64
    }

    var prev: i64 = 0
    var curr: i64 = 1

    for i in 2..=n {
        let next = prev + curr
        prev = curr
        curr = next
    }

    curr
}

fn main() -> i32 with Mut {
    print("Fibonacci Sequence (recursive):")
    println()

    for i in 0..15 {
        let fib = fibonacci(i)
        print("F(")
        print(i)
        print(") = ")
        print(fib)
        println()
    }

    println()
    print("Fibonacci Sequence (iterative, larger values):")
    println()

    for i in [20, 30, 40, 50] {
        let fib = fibonacci_iter(i)
        print("F(")
        print(i)
        print(") = ")
        print(fib)
        println()
    }

    0
}

/// World Fidelity Verification Demo
///
/// This example demonstrates Sounio'ss epistemic fidelity system
/// that verifies computed knowledge against real-world ontologies.
///
/// Fidelity = knowledge is faithful to reality with:
/// - Valid ontology term binding (CHEBI, GO, etc.)
/// - Quantified confidence (Beta posterior)
/// - Auditable provenance (Merkle chain)
/// - Subsumption verification against expected domain

// Import epistemic and ontology types
use std::epistemic::{Knowledge, Confidence, Source}
use std::ontology::{CHEBI, GO, UBERON, MONDO}

// Define a fidelity policy for pharmaceutical computations
struct PharmacologyFidelity {
    // Required ontologies from OBO Foundry
    world_ontologies: [string] = ["chebi", "go", "uberon", "mondo", "hp"],

    // Minimum confidence for critical parameters (drug dosing, etc.)
    critical_min_confidence: f64 = 0.95,

    // Maximum allowed semantic distance for type compatibility
    max_semantic_distance: f64 = 0.10,

    // Require non-obsolete terms
    require_non_obsolete: bool = true,

    // Require subsumption to expected domain
    require_subsumption: bool = true
}

// A drug molecule grounded to CHEBI ontology
struct Drug {
    // Knowledge type: value grounded to ontology with confidence tracking
    name: Knowledge[string, CHEBI:drug],

    // Aspirin: CHEBI:15365 (acetylsalicylic acid)
    // This binding is verified at compile-time against OBO Foundry
    chebi_id: Knowledge[string, CHEBI:15365],

    // Molecular weight with units and uncertainty
    molecular_weight: Knowledge[f64 with unit g/mol],

    // Therapeutic indication grounded to disease ontology
    indication: Knowledge[string, MONDO:disease]
}

// A biological process grounded to Gene Ontology
struct BiologicalEffect {
    // GO term for the process
    process: Knowledge[string, GO:biological_process],

    // Target organ grounded to Uberon anatomy ontology
    target: Knowledge[string, UBERON:organ],

    // Effect magnitude with confidence interval
    magnitude: Knowledge[f64] with confidence >= 0.9
}

// Example: Create an aspirin drug entry with verified fidelity
fn create_aspirin() -> Drug with Fidelity {
    // All ontology bindings are verified against OBO Foundry
    let aspirin = Drug {

struct Sample {
    value: i64
}

fn scale(item: Sample, factor: i64) -> Sample {
    return Sample { value: item.value * factor }
}

fn checksum(values: [i64]) -> i64 {
    var sum: i64 = 0
    for v in values {
        sum = sum + v
    }
    return sum
}

fn main() with IO {
    let seed = Sample { value: 3 }
    let scaled = scale(seed, 7)
    let data: [i64] = [scaled.value, 2, 5, 8]
    let total = checksum(data)
    println("example: fidelity_demo")
    println(total)
}



// === FILE: examples/financial_risk_epistemic.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//! Financial Risk — Epistemic Uncertainty Pipeline
//!
//! End-to-end demonstration combining:
//!   1. SDE simulation    — Geometric Brownian Motion + Ornstein-Uhlenbeck spread
//!   2. Causal inference  — Backdoor adjustment for confounded P&L attribution
//!   3. Graph algorithms  — Dijkstra shortest-path for correlated risk graph
//!   4. Spline fitting    — Cubic spline interpolation of volatility surface
//!   5. GUM uncertainty   — Type A (historical) + Type B (model) risk budget
//!   6. Regulatory output — VaR(95%) + CVaR(95%) with uncertainty intervals
//!
//! All results verified via assertions — no println.
//! Reference: Basel III / FRTB SA-TB, JCGM 100:2008 §H.2

// Self-contained pipeline — all math inlined, no external stdlib calls needed

// ============================================================================
// Math helpers
// ============================================================================

fn fr_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn fr_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 30 {
        y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
        i = i + 1
    }
    y
}

fn fr_exp(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 20.0 { return 485165195.4 }
    if x < 0.0 - 20.0 { return 0.0 }
    let x2 = x * x
    let x3 = x2 * x
    let x4 = x2 * x2
    let x5 = x4 * x
    let x6 = x4 * x2
    1.0 + x + x2/2.0 + x3/6.0 + x4/24.0 + x5/120.0 + x6/720.0
}

fn fr_ln(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 - 1e30 }
    // Range-reduce to [0.5, 2.0) then use atanh series
    var y = x
    var k: i64 = 0
    while y >= 2.0 { y = y / 2.0; k = k + 1 }
    while y < 0.5  { y = y * 2.0; k = k - 1 }
    // y ∈ [0.5, 2.0) → u ∈ [-1/3, 1/3] → series converges fast
    let u  = (y - 1.0) / (y + 1.0)
    let u2 = u * u
    let s  = u * (1.0 + u2/3.0 + u2*u2/5.0 + u2*u2*u2/7.0 + u2*u2*u2*u2/9.0)
    2.0 * s + (k as f64) * 0.6931471805599453
}

// ============================================================================
// Stage 1 — GBM simulation: 250 daily returns for a portfolio
// ============================================================================
//
// S(t+dt) = S(t) * exp((μ - σ²/2)*dt + σ*√dt*Z)
// where Z ~ N(0,1) via Box-Muller from LCG state

fn lcg(state: i64) -> i64 {
    6364136223846793005 * state + 1442695040888963407
}

fn lcg_uniform(s: i64) -> f64 {
    let pos = if s < 0 { 0 - s } else { s }
    (pos % 1000000) as f64 / 1000000.0 + 1e-10
}

// cos with [0, π/2] argument reduction — accurate throughout [0, 2π)
fn cos_full(theta: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let pi2  = 6.283185307
    let pi   = 3.141592653
    let pi_2 = 1.570796327
    // Reduce to [0, 2π)
    var t = theta
    while t < 0.0   { t = t + pi2 }
    while t >= pi2  { t = t - pi2 }
    // Fold to [0, π/2] tracking sign
    var sign: f64 = 1.0
    if t > pi   { t = t - pi; sign = 0.0 - sign }
    if t > pi_2 { t = pi - t; sign = 0.0 - sign }
    // Taylor for t ∈ [0, π/2]: max error < 0.015 (good enough for PRNG)
    let t2 = t * t
    sign * (1.0 - t2/2.0 + t2*t2/24.0 - t2*t2*t2/720.0)
}

fn bm_normal(s1: i64, s2: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let u1 = lcg_uniform(s1) + 1e-10
    let u2 = lcg_uniform(s2)
    let r  = fr_sqrt(0.0 - 2.0 * fr_ln(u1))
    r * cos_full(6.283185307 * u2)
}

// Simulate 250 log-returns from GBM
fn simulate_gbm_returns(mu: f64, sigma: f64, dt: f64, seed: i64) -> [f64; 250] with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var rets: [f64; 250] = [0.0; 250]
    var s = seed
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 250 {
        let s1 = lcg(s)
        let s2 = lcg(s1)
        s = lcg(s2)
        let z = bm_normal(s1, s2)
        rets[i as usize] = (mu - 0.5*sigma*sigma)*dt + sigma*fr_sqrt(dt)*z
        i = i + 1
    }
    rets
}

// ============================================================================
// Stage 2 — VaR and CVaR from simulated return distribution
// ============================================================================
//
// Parametric VaR(95%) = μ - 1.645*σ (for daily P&L = w * ret)
// CVaR(95%) = μ - σ * φ(1.645) / (1 - 0.95) ≈ μ - 2.063*σ

fn mean_250(arr: [f64; 250]) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var s: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 250 {
        s = s + arr[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    s / 250.0
}

fn std_250(arr: [f64; 250], m: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var s: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 250 {
        let d = arr[i as usize] - m
        s = s + d * d
        i = i + 1
    }
    fr_sqrt(s / 249.0)
}

// Parametric VaR(95%) — loss is positive
fn var_95(mu: f64, sigma: f64, portfolio_value: f64) -> f64 {
    portfolio_value * (0.0 - mu + 1.645 * sigma)
}

// Parametric CVaR(95%) ≈ 2.063σ - μ  (Gaussian tail expectation)
fn cvar_95(mu: f64, sigma: f64, portfolio_value: f64) -> f64 {
    portfolio_value * (0.0 - mu + 2.063 * sigma)
}

// ============================================================================
// Stage 3 — OU process for credit spread (mean-reverting)
// ============================================================================
//
// dX = θ(μ - X)dt + σ dW
// Euler: X(t+dt) = X(t) + θ(μ - X(t))*dt + σ*√dt*Z

fn simulate_ou_spread(x0: f64, theta: f64, mu: f64, sigma: f64, dt: f64, seed: i64) -> [f64; 250] with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var path: [f64; 250] = [0.0; 250]
    var x = x0
    var s = seed
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 250 {
        let s1 = lcg(s)
        let s2 = lcg(s1)
        s = lcg(s2)
        let z = bm_normal(s1, s2)
        x = x + theta * (mu - x) * dt + sigma * fr_sqrt(dt) * z
        if x < 0.0 { x = 0.0 }
        path[i as usize] = x
        i = i + 1
    }
    path
}

fn mean_spread(spreads: [f64; 250]) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var s: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 250 {
        s = s + spreads[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    s / 250.0
}

// ============================================================================
// Stage 4 — Causal backdoor: de-confound α from market factor
// ============================================================================
//
// Confounded OLS: β_obs = β_true + γ * δ (factor correlation)
// Backdoor-adjusted estimator (given market factor M, confounder W):
//   α_adj = ȳ - β_adj * x̄   (within-stratum regression, 2-strata demo)
//
// Here we demonstrate the adjustment formula rather than full do-calculus.

fn backdoor_alpha_adjust(
    raw_mean_ret: f64,
    factor_corr: f64,
    factor_ret: f64,
    factor_loading: f64
) -> f64 {
    // α_adj = raw_mean - factor_loading * factor_corr * factor_ret
    raw_mean_ret - factor_loading * factor_corr * factor_ret
}

// ============================================================================
// Stage 5 — Volatility surface: cubic spline interpolation
// ============================================================================
//
// 5 strike points (moneyness) with implied vol — fit and evaluate at ATM

fn vol_surface_eval() -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Strike-to-spot ratios: 0.85, 0.925, 1.0, 1.075, 1.15
    // Implied vols (SABR-like smile):
    var knots: [f64; 5] = [0.85, 0.925, 1.0, 1.075, 1.15]
    var vols:  [f64; 5] = [0.28, 0.24, 0.20, 0.22, 0.26]

    // Natural cubic spline interpolation at ATM (K/S = 1.0)
    // For 5 points, solve tridiagonal system for second derivatives.
    // h_i = knots[i+1] - knots[i] (uniform h = 0.075)
    let h: f64 = 0.075

    // Right-hand side: b_i = 6*(f[i+1]-2*f[i]+f[i-1])/h^2
    var rhs: [f64; 3] = [0.0; 3]
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < 3 {
        let im1 = i as usize
        let i0  = (i + 1) as usize
        let ip1 = (i + 2) as usize
        rhs[im1] = 6.0 * (vols[ip1] - 2.0*vols[i0] + vols[im1]) / (h * h)
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Tridiagonal [4, 1, 0; 1, 4, 1; 0, 1, 4] * m = rhs  (natural BC: m0=m4=0)
    // Forward elimination
    var diag: [f64; 3] = [4.0, 4.0, 4.0]
    var off:  f64 = 1.0
    var m:    [f64; 3] = [0.0; 3]

    // Forward sweep
    let d0 = diag[0]
    let r0 = rhs[0]
    let d1 = diag[1] - off * off / d0
    let r1 = rhs[1]  - off * r0 / d0
    let d2 = diag[2] - off * off / d1
    let r2 = rhs[2]  - off * r1 / d1

    // Back substitution (m[0..2] = second derivatives at interior knots)
    m[2] = r2 / d2
    m[1] = (r1 - off * m[2]) / d1
    m[0] = (r0 - off * m[1]) / d0

    // Evaluate at ATM = knots[2] = 1.0 (segment 1→2)
    // x - knots[1] = 1.0 - 0.925 = 0.075 = h  → exactly at right endpoint
    // Use segment [knots[1], knots[2]]: u = (x - x1)/h = 1.0
    let m1: f64 = m[0]  // second deriv at knot[1]
    let m2: f64 = m[1]  // second deriv at knot[2]
    let f1 = vols[1]
    let f2 = vols[2]

    let u: f64 = 1.0  // t = (x - x1) / h
    // S(u) = (1-u)*f1 + u*f2 + h^2/6 * ((1-u)^3 - (1-u))*m1 + h^2/6*(u^3 - u)*m2
    let om_u = 1.0 - u
    let c1 = h*h/6.0 * (om_u*om_u*om_u - om_u) * m1
    let c2 = h*h/6.0 * (u*u*u - u) * m2
    om_u * f1 + u * f2 + c1 + c2
}

// ============================================================================
// Stage 6 — GUM uncertainty budget for VaR
// ============================================================================
//
// u_A: estimation uncertainty from 250-day sample (σ/√(2n))
// u_B: model uncertainty (rectangular ±10% of VaR)
// Combined standard uncertainty: uc = √(uA² + uB²)
// Expanded U_95 = 1.96 * uc

fn var_uncertainty(var_val: f64, sigma_ret: f64, n: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Type A: Var(VaR̂) ≈ q²*σ²*(1/n + z²/(2n)) where z=1.645, q=σ
    // Simplified: u_A ≈ VaR / sqrt(2*n) * 1.96
    let u_a = var_val / fr_sqrt(2.0 * n) * 0.5
    // Type B: systematic model error ±10%
    let u_b = var_val * 0.10 / fr_sqrt(3.0)
    fr_sqrt(u_a*u_a + u_b*u_b)
}

// ============================================================================
// Main — integrate all stages
// ============================================================================

pub fn main() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let portfolio_value: f64 = 1000000.0  // $1M portfolio

    // --- Stage 1: GBM simulation (S&P 500-like) ---
    let dt: f64 = 1.0 / 252.0  // daily
    let mu_ann: f64 = 0.08      // 8% annual return
    let sigma_ann: f64 = 0.18   // 18% annual vol
    let mu_daily = mu_ann * dt
    let sigma_daily = sigma_ann * fr_sqrt(dt)

    let gbm_rets = simulate_gbm_returns(mu_daily, sigma_daily, 1.0, 42001)

    // --- Stage 2: Risk measures ---
    let ret_mean = mean_250(gbm_rets)
    let ret_std  = std_250(gbm_rets, ret_mean)

    let var_1d  = var_95(ret_mean, ret_std, portfolio_value)
    let cvar_1d = cvar_95(ret_mean, ret_std, portfolio_value)

    // VaR should be positive (a loss) and reasonable for $1M 18% vol portfolio
    // 1-day 95% VaR ≈ 1.645 * 0.18/sqrt(252) * 1M ≈ $18,600
    assert(var_1d > 5000.0)
    assert(var_1d < 100000.0)
    assert(cvar_1d > var_1d)  // CVaR > VaR always

    // --- Stage 3: Credit spread (OU process) ---
    // θ=5 (mean-revert fast), μ=0.02 (2% long-run spread), σ=0.005
    let spreads = simulate_ou_spread(0.02, 5.0, 0.02, 0.005, dt, 98765)
    let mean_sp = mean_spread(spreads)
    // OU long-run mean should be ≈ 0.02
    assert(mean_sp > 0.005)
    assert(mean_sp < 0.05)

    // --- Stage 4: Causal backdoor adjustment ---
    let raw_alpha = ret_mean - 0.0004  // subtract risk-free rate proxy
    let adj_alpha = backdoor_alpha_adjust(raw_alpha, 0.7, 0.0004, 0.9)
    // Adjusted alpha has smaller magnitude (de-confounded)
    assert(fr_abs(adj_alpha) < fr_abs(raw_alpha) + 0.01)  // reasonableness check

    // --- Stage 5: Vol surface spline ---
    let atm_vol = vol_surface_eval()
    // ATM vol should be near the knot value 0.20 (with some spline curvature)
    assert(atm_vol > 0.15)
    assert(atm_vol < 0.30)

    // --- Stage 6: GUM uncertainty budget ---
    let uc_var  = var_uncertainty(var_1d, ret_std, 250.0)
    let U_95    = 1.96 * uc_var

    // Relative uncertainty < 25% of VaR
    let rel_unc = U_95 / var_1d
    assert(rel_unc < 0.25)
    assert(uc_var > 0.0)

    // Combined risk report: all metrics consistent
    let risk_ok = var_1d > 0.0 && cvar_1d > var_1d && atm_vol > 0.15 && uc_var < var_1d
    assert(risk_ok)

    // Annualized VaR (√252 scaling)
    let var_ann = var_1d * fr_sqrt(252.0)
    assert(var_ann > var_1d)

    var sentinel: i64 = 0
    while sentinel < 6 { sentinel = sentinel + 1 }
}


// === FILE: examples/flow_viz/main.sio ===
// examples/flow_viz/main.sio — 2D vector field streamlines demo
//
// Left panel  (x: 10-305): vortex+source flow — Euler-integrated streamlines
//   colored by seed speed magnitude via viridis.
// Right panel (x: 330-630): same field shown as quiver arrows + hex-bin
//   of streamline density (particle dwell-time visualization).
//
// Flow field: vortex (rotation) + source (radial outflow)
//   vx = (-y + 0.3*x) / (x² + y² + 0.05)
//   vy = ( x + 0.3*y) / (x² + y² + 0.05)
// defined on 24×18 grid, x∈[-2.5,2.5], y∈[-1.875,1.875]
//
// Press ESC or close to exit.

use display::window::{Window, window_open, window_set_title, window_present, window_pending,
                       window_next_event, window_close}
use display::canvas::{Canvas, canvas_from_window, canvas_clear, canvas_fill_rect}
use display::event::{EV_CLOSE, EV_KEY_PRESS}
use display::canvas_ext::{canvas_draw_line_aa, canvas_bloom, canvas_fxaa}
use viz::epiviz::{epiviz_streamlines, epiviz_hexbin}
use display::font::{font_draw_string}

fn fv_sin(t: f64) -> f64 with Div {
    let t2 = t * t
    t * (1.0 - t2 * (1.0 / 6.0 - t2 * (1.0 / 120.0 - t2 / 5040.0)))
}

fn fv_cos(t: f64) -> f64 with Div {
    let t2 = t * t
    1.0 - t2 * (0.5 - t2 * (1.0 / 24.0 - t2 / 720.0))
}

fn fv_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    let g0 = x * 0.5 + 0.5
    let g1 = 0.5 * (g0 + x / g0)
    let g2 = 0.5 * (g1 + x / g1)
    let g3 = 0.5 * (g2 + x / g2)
    0.5 * (g3 + x / g3)
}

fn main() with IO, Alloc, Mut, Div {
    let W: i64 = 640
    let H: i64 = 480
    let scratch = heap_alloc(W * H * 8) as *mut i64

    var win = window_open(W, H)

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // Build vortex+source vector field: 24×18 grid
    // --------------------------------------------------------
    let ROWS: i64 = 18
    let COLS: i64 = 24
    var vx_f: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var vy_f: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]

    var fj: i64 = 0
    while fj < ROWS {
        var fi: i64 = 0
        while fi < COLS {
            // Map grid cell → data coords x∈[-2.5,2.5], y∈[-1.875,1.875]
            let x = (fi as f64 - (COLS as f64 - 1.0) * 0.5) * 5.0 / (COLS as f64 - 1.0)
            let y = (fj as f64 - (ROWS as f64 - 1.0) * 0.5) * 3.75 / (ROWS as f64 - 1.0)
            let r2 = x*x + y*y + 0.05
            vx_f[(fj * COLS + fi) as usize] = (0.0 - y + 0.3 * x) / r2
            vy_f[(fj * COLS + fi) as usize] = (x + 0.3 * y) / r2
            fi = fi + 1
        }
        fj = fj + 1
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // Pre-generate hex-bin scatter: 400 points from 4 particle
    // trajectories traced in data space (Euler, 100 steps each)
    // --------------------------------------------------------
    var hx_pts: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var hy_pts: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    let N_TRAJ: i64 = 8
    let TRAJ_STEPS: i64 = 49
    // Seed positions (evenly spaced ring)
    var traj_idx: i64 = 0
    var ti: i64 = 0
    while ti < N_TRAJ {
        let angle = 6.28318530718 * (ti as f64) / (N_TRAJ as f64)
        var px = fv_cos(angle) * 1.8
        var py = fv_sin(angle) * 1.8
        var ts: i64 = 0
        while ts < TRAJ_STEPS {
            if traj_idx < 1024 {
                hx_pts[traj_idx as usize] = px
                hy_pts[traj_idx as usize] = py
                traj_idx = traj_idx + 1
            }
            // Euler step in data space (step 0.06)
            let r2 = px*px + py*py + 0.05
            let dvx = (0.0 - py + 0.3 * px) / r2
            let dvy = (px + 0.3 * py) / r2
            let mag = fv_sqrt(dvx*dvx + dvy*dvy)
            let sc = 0.06 / (mag + 0.01)
            px = px + dvx * sc
            py = py + dvy * sc
            ts = ts + 1
        }
        ti = ti + 1
    }
    let N_HEX: i64 = traj_idx

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // Title bytes
    // --------------------------------------------------------
    var title: [i8; 128] = [0; 128]
    title[0] = 70  // F
    title[1] = 108 // l
    title[2] = 111 // o
    title[3] = 119 // w
    title[4] = 32  //
    title[5] = 86  // V
    title[6] = 105 // i
    title[7] = 122 // z
    let title_len: i64 = 8
    window_set_title(&!win, &title, title_len)

    var running = true
    while running {
        while window_pending(&!win) > 0 {
            let ev = window_next_event(&!win)
            if ev.kind == EV_CLOSE { running = false }
            if ev.kind == EV_KEY_PRESS && ev.key == 27 { running = false }
        }

        var c = canvas_from_window(&!win)
        canvas_clear(&!c, 12, 13, 22)

        // Vertical divider
        canvas_fill_rect(&!c, 316, 0, 2, H, 35, 38, 55)

        // ---- Left panel: streamlines (8×6 seed grid) ----
        epiviz_streamlines(&vx_f, &vy_f, ROWS, COLS,
                           8, 6,        // 8×6 = 48 seeds
                           120,         // max steps per streamline
                           3.5,         // step_px
                           &!c,
                           10, 10, 296, 460)

        // ---- Right panel: hex-bin particle density ----
        canvas_fill_rect(&!c, 320, 10, 308, 460, 15, 16, 28)
        epiviz_hexbin(&hx_pts, &hy_pts, N_HEX,
                      0.0 - 2.5, 2.5, 0.0 - 2.0, 2.0,
                      11,   // hex circumradius px
                      &!c,
                      322, 12, 304, 456)

        // Panel labels (small dots at corners as decorative markers)
        canvas_fill_rect(&!c, 12, 12, 4, 4, 60, 100, 180)
        canvas_fill_rect(&!c, 322, 12, 4, 4, 60, 180, 120)

        // Bloom + FXAA
        canvas_bloom(&!c, scratch, 180, 140)
        canvas_fxaa(&!c, scratch)

        window_present(&!win)
    }

    heap_free(scratch as *mut i8)
    window_close(&!win)
}

fn test_pearson_perfect() -> bool {
    // Perfect positive correlation
    var x: [f64; 100] = [0.0; 100]
    var y: [f64; 100] = [0.0; 100]

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 5 {
        x[i as usize] = (i + 1) as f64  // 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
        y[i as usize] = 2.0 * ((i + 1) as f64)  // 2, 4, 6, 8, 10
        i = i + 1
    }

    let r = pearson_corr(x, y, 5)
    abs_f64(r - 1.0) < 0.01
}

fn test_fisher_z() -> bool {
    // z(0.5) ≈ 0.549
    let z = fisher_z(0.5)
    if abs_f64(z - 0.549) > 0.01 {
        return false
    }

    // Inverse
    let r_back = fisher_z_inv(z)
    abs_f64(r_back - 0.5) < 0.01
}

fn test_mean_fc() -> bool {
    var corr: [[f64; 3]; 3] = [[0.0; 3]; 3]
    corr[0][0] = 1.0
    corr[0][1] = 0.6
    corr[0][2] = 0.4
    corr[1][0] = 0.6
    corr[1][1] = 1.0
    corr[1][2] = 0.5
    corr[2][0] = 0.4
    corr[2][1] = 0.5
    corr[2][2] = 1.0

    let mean_fc = mean_fc_strength_3x3(corr)
    // (0.6 + 0.4 + 0.5) / 3 = 0.5
    abs_f64(mean_fc - 0.5) < 0.01
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    print("Testing fmri::connectivity module...\n")

    if !test_pearson_perfect() {

        return 1

    print("PASS: pearson_perfect\n")

    if !test_fisher_z() {
        print("FAIL: fisher_z\n")
        return 2
    }
    print("PASS: fisher_z\n")

        print("FAIL: mean_fc\n")
        return 3
    }
    print("PASS: mean_fc\n")

    print("All fmri::connectivity tests PASSED\n")

// === FILE: examples/fractal/curvature_demo.sio ===
// Demo for stdlib/fractal/curvature.sio
//
// This file demonstrates usage of the fractal::curvature module.
// Module source: stdlib/fractal/curvature.sio

// ============================================================================

/// Compute angle at vertex a in triangle (a, b, c)
fn compute_angle(a: &Vertex, b: &Vertex, c: &Vertex) -> f64 {
    let ab = vec_sub(b, a)
    let ac = vec_sub(c, a)

    let dot = vec_dot(&ab, &ac)
    let len_ab = vec_length(&ab)
    let len_ac = vec_length(&ac)

    if len_ab < 1e-10 || len_ac < 1e-10 {
        return 0.0
    }

    let cos_angle = dot / (len_ab * len_ac)
    acos_f64(cos_angle)
}

/// Compute cotangent of angle opposite to edge (v_edge1, v_edge2) at v_opposite
fn cotangent_opposite(v_edge1: &Vertex, v_edge2: &Vertex, v_opposite: &Vertex) -> f64 {
    let e1 = vec_sub(v_edge1, v_opposite)
    let e2 = vec_sub(v_edge2, v_opposite)

    let dot = vec_dot(&e1, &e2)
    let cross = vec_cross(&e1, &e2)
    let sin_angle = vec_length(&cross)

    if abs_f64(sin_angle) < 1e-10 {
        return 0.0
    }

    dot / sin_angle
}

/// Compute triangle area
fn triangle_area(a: &Vertex, b: &Vertex, c: &Vertex) -> f64 {
    let ab = vec_sub(b, a)
    let ac = vec_sub(c, a)
    let cross = vec_cross(&ab, &ac)
    vec_length(&cross) / 2.0
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    print("Curvature module loaded\n")

    // Simple test: create a triangle
    var mesh = TriMesh {
        vertices: vec![],
        faces: vec![],
    }

    mesh.vertices.push(Vertex { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 })
    mesh.vertices.push(Vertex { x: 1.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 })
    mesh.vertices.push(Vertex { x: 0.5, y: 1.0, z: 0.0 })

    mesh.faces.push(Face { i0: 0, i1: 1, i2: 2 })

    let result = gaussian_curvature(&mesh)
    print("Gaussian curvature: ")
    print(result.gaussian)
    print("\n")

    0
}

// === FILE: examples/fractal/kec_demo.sio ===
// Demo for stdlib/fractal/kec.sio
//
// This file demonstrates usage of the fractal::kec module.
// Module source: stdlib/fractal/kec.sio

// ============================================================================

fn extract_pore_sizes(scaffold: &VoxelScaffold) -> Vec<f64> {
    var sizes: Vec<f64> = vec![]

    let nx = scaffold.size_x as usize
    let ny = scaffold.size_y as usize
    let nz = scaffold.size_z as usize

    for z in 0..nz {
        for y in 0..ny {
            for x in 0..nx {
                let idx = z * ny * nx + y * nx + x

                if idx < scaffold.data.len() && !scaffold.data[idx] {
                    // Count connected void voxels in small neighborhood
                    var pore_count: u64 = 0

                    for dz in 0..3 {
                        for dy in 0..3 {
                            for dx in 0..3 {
                                let nx2 = x + dx
                                let ny2 = y + dy
                                let nz2 = z + dz
                                if nx2 < nx && ny2 < ny && nz2 < nz {
                                    let idx2 = nz2 * ny * nx + ny2 * nx + nx2
                                    if idx2 < scaffold.data.len() && !scaffold.data[idx2] {
                                        pore_count = pore_count + 1
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if pore_count > 1 {
                        sizes.push(pore_count as f64)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    sizes
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    print("KEC Framework loaded\n")
    print("Golden ratio target: ")
    print(PHI)
    print("\n")

    // Simple test
    var scaffold = VoxelScaffold {
        data: vec![],
        size_x: 10,
        size_y: 10,
        size_z: 10,
    }

    // Fill with pattern
    for i in 0..1000 {
        scaffold.data.push(i % 2 == 0)
    }

    let params = kec_params_default()
    let metrics = compute_kec(&scaffold, &params)

    print("KEC Score: ")
    print(metrics.score)
    print("\n")
    print("Coherence (D): ")
    print(metrics.coherence)
    print("\n")
    print("Valid: ")
    print(metrics.valid)
    print("\n")

    0
}


// === FILE: examples/fractal/lacunarity_demo.sio ===
// Demo for stdlib/fractal/lacunarity.sio
//
// This file demonstrates usage of the fractal::lacunarity module.
// Module source: stdlib/fractal/lacunarity.sio

// ============================================================================

/// Simplified gliding box lacunarity for 1D data
pub fn gliding_box_lacunarity(data: &Vec<f64>, box_size: u32) -> LacunarityValue {
    let n = data.len()
    let r = box_size as usize

    if n < r {
        return LacunarityValue { value: 0.0, std_dev: 1.0 }
    }

    let n_boxes = n - r + 1

    // Compute box sums
    var sum_m: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_m2: f64 = 0.0

    for i in 0..n_boxes {
        var mass = 0.0
        for j in 0..r {
            mass = mass + data[i + j]
        }
        sum_m = sum_m + mass
        sum_m2 = sum_m2 + mass * mass
    }

    let mean_m = sum_m / (n_boxes as f64)
    let mean_m2 = sum_m2 / (n_boxes as f64)

    let lac = if mean_m > 0.0 {
        mean_m2 / (mean_m * mean_m) - 1.0
    } else {
        0.0
    }

    let var_m = (mean_m2 - mean_m * mean_m) / (n_boxes as f64)
    let relative_var = if mean_m > 0.0 { 4.0 * var_m / (mean_m * mean_m) } else { 1.0 }
    let total_var = relative_var * lac * lac

    LacunarityValue {
        value: lac,
        std_dev: sqrt_f64(total_var),
    }
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    print("Lacunarity module loaded\n")

    // Simple test
    var test_grid = VoxelGrid {
        data: vec![],
        size_x: 10,
        size_y: 10,
        size_z: 10,
    }

    // Fill with some pattern
    for i in 0..1000 {
        test_grid.data.push(i % 3 == 0)
    }

    let result = lacunarity(&test_grid, 2, 8)
    print("Lacunarity scales: ")
    print(result.scales.len())
    print("\n")

    0
}

// === FILE: examples/fractal_g2_ossm.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// Fractal-G2 O-SSM: CONFIRMATION RUN
// O-SSM vs H-SSM control, 3 seeds, associator trajectory per epoch.
// If H-SSM also reaches 9% → signal is Riemannian, not non-associativity.
// If H-SSM stays at 5-6% → signal is genuinely non-associative.

fn exp_q(x:f64)->f64 with Mut,Div,Panic{if x>15.0{return exp_q(7.5)*exp_q(x-7.5)}if x<0.0-15.0{return 0.0}var sum=1.0;var term=1.0;var i=1;while i<=20{term=term*x/(i as f64);sum=sum+term;i=i+1};sum}
fn sqrt_q(x:f64)->f64 with Mut,Div,Panic{if x<=0.0{return 0.0}var g=x;var i=0;while i<15{g=0.5*(g+x/g);i=i+1};g}
var RNG_A:i64=0;var RNG_B:i64=0
fn rng_seed(a:i64,b:i64) with Mut{RNG_A=a;RNG_B=b}
fn rng_next()->i64 with Mut{var x=RNG_A;let y=RNG_B;RNG_A=y;x=x^(x<<23);x=x^(x>>17);x=x^(y^(y>>26));RNG_B=x;let r=x+y;if r<0{0-r}else{r}}

// Fano plane
fn oct_sign(i:i64,j:i64)->i64{if i==0{return 1}if j==0{return 1}if i==j{return 0-1}
if i==1{if j==2{return 1}if j==4{return 0-1}if j==3{return 1}if j==5{return 1}if j==6{return 0-1}if j==7{return 0-1}}
if i==2{if j==1{return 0-1}if j==3{return 1}if j==4{return 1}if j==5{return 0-1}if j==6{return 1}if j==7{return 0-1}}
if i==3{if j==1{return 0-1}if j==2{return 0-1}if j==4{return 1}if j==5{return 1}if j==6{return 0-1}if j==7{return 1}}
if i==4{if j==1{return 1}if j==2{return 0-1}if j==3{return 0-1}if j==5{return 1}if j==6{return 1}if j==7{return 0-1}}
if i==5{if j==1{return 0-1}if j==2{return 1}if j==3{return 0-1}if j==4{return 0-1}if j==6{return 1}if j==7{return 1}}
if i==6{if j==1{return 1}if j==2{return 0-1}if j==3{return 1}if j==4{return 0-1}if j==5{return 0-1}if j==7{return 1}}
if i==7{if j==1{return 1}if j==2{return 1}if j==3{return 0-1}if j==4{return 1}if j==5{return 0-1}if j==6{return 0-1}}
0}
fn oct_basis(i:i64,j:i64)->i64{if i==0{return j}if j==0{return i}if i==j{return 0}
if i==1{if j==2{return 4}if j==4{return 2}if j==3{return 7}if j==5{return 6}if j==6{return 5}if j==7{return 3}}
if i==2{if j==1{return 4}if j==3{return 5}if j==4{return 1}if j==5{return 3}if j==6{return 7}if j==7{return 6}}
if i==3{if j==1{return 7}if j==2{return 5}if j==4{return 6}if j==5{return 2}if j==6{return 4}if j==7{return 1}}
if i==4{if j==1{return 2}if j==2{return 1}if j==3{return 6}if j==5{return 7}if j==6{return 3}if j==7{return 5}}
if i==5{if j==1{return 6}if j==2{return 3}if j==3{return 2}if j==4{return 7}if j==6{return 1}if j==7{return 4}}
if i==6{if j==1{return 5}if j==2{return 7}if j==3{return 4}if j==4{return 3}if j==5{return 1}if j==7{return 2}}
if i==7{if j==1{return 3}if j==2{return 6}if j==3{return 1}if j==4{return 5}if j==5{return 4}if j==6{return 2}}
0}
fn oct_signed_mul(s_a:i64,idx_a:i64,idx_b:i64)->i64 with Mut{let rs=oct_sign(idx_a,idx_b);let rb=oct_basis(idx_a,idx_b);var fs=rs;if s_a<0{fs=0-fs};if fs>=0{rb}else{8+rb}}
var PT:[i64;4]=[0;4];var PL:i64=0;var PIA:i64=0
fn gen_probe() with Mut,Div{let a=(rng_next()/100)%8;let b=(rng_next()/100)%8;let c=(rng_next()/100)%8;let mode=(rng_next()/100)%2;PT[0]=a;PT[1]=b;PT[2]=c;PT[3]=mode+8;let ab_s=oct_sign(a,b);let ab_i=oct_basis(a,b);let left=oct_signed_mul(ab_s,ab_i,c);let bc_s=oct_sign(b,c);let bc_i=oct_basis(b,c);let right=oct_signed_mul(bc_s,a,bc_i);if mode==0{PL=left}if mode==1{PL=right};if left==right{PIA=1}else{PIA=0}}

var T1:[f64;8]=[0.0;8];var T2:[f64;8]=[0.0;8]
fn do_oct_mul(a0:f64,a1:f64,a2:f64,a3:f64,a4:f64,a5:f64,a6:f64,a7:f64,
              b0:f64,b1:f64,b2:f64,b3:f64,b4:f64,b5:f64,b6:f64,b7:f64) with Mut{
    T1[0]=a0*b0-a1*b1-a2*b2-a3*b3-a4*b4-a5*b5-a6*b6-a7*b7;T1[1]=a0*b1+a1*b0+a2*b3-a3*b2+a4*b5-a5*b4-a6*b7+a7*b6
    T1[2]=a0*b2+a2*b0-a1*b3+a3*b1+a4*b6-a6*b4+a5*b7-a7*b5;T1[3]=a0*b3+a3*b0+a1*b2-a2*b1+a4*b7-a7*b4-a5*b6+a6*b5
    T1[4]=a0*b4+a4*b0-a1*b5+a5*b1-a2*b6+a6*b2-a3*b7+a7*b3;T1[5]=a0*b5+a5*b0+a1*b4-a4*b1-a2*b7+a7*b2+a3*b6-a6*b3
    T1[6]=a0*b6+a6*b0+a1*b7-a7*b1+a2*b4-a4*b2-a3*b5+a5*b3;T1[7]=a0*b7+a7*b0-a1*b6+a6*b1-a2*b5+a5*b2+a3*b4-a4*b3}
fn oct_grad_a(dc0:f64,dc1:f64,dc2:f64,dc3:f64,dc4:f64,dc5:f64,dc6:f64,dc7:f64,
              b0:f64,b1:f64,b2:f64,b3:f64,b4:f64,b5:f64,b6:f64,b7:f64) with Mut{
    T2[0]=b0*dc0+b1*dc1+b2*dc2+b3*dc3+b4*dc4+b5*dc5+b6*dc6+b7*dc7
    T2[1]=0.0-b1*dc0+b0*dc1-b3*dc2+b2*dc3-b5*dc4+b4*dc5+b7*dc6-b6*dc7
    T2[2]=0.0-b2*dc0+b3*dc1+b0*dc2-b1*dc3-b6*dc4-b7*dc5+b4*dc6-b5*dc7
    T2[3]=0.0-b3*dc0-b2*dc1+b1*dc2+b0*dc3-b7*dc4+b6*dc5-b5*dc6+b4*dc7
    T2[4]=0.0-b4*dc0+b5*dc1+b6*dc2+b7*dc3+b0*dc4-b1*dc5-b2*dc6-b3*dc7
    T2[5]=0.0-b5*dc0-b4*dc1+b7*dc2-b6*dc3+b1*dc4+b0*dc5+b3*dc6+b2*dc7
    T2[6]=0.0-b6*dc0-b7*dc1-b4*dc2+b5*dc3+b2*dc4-b3*dc5+b0*dc6+b1*dc7
    T2[7]=0.0-b7*dc0+b6*dc1-b5*dc2-b4*dc3+b3*dc4+b2*dc5-b1*dc6+b0*dc7}

// Weights: embed(416) + A(32) + B(32) + out(576) = 1056
var W:[i64;1056]=[0;1056];var H:[i64;32]=[0;32];var L:[i64;16]=[0;16]
var MOM:[i64;1056]=[0;1056];var ASSOC:[f64;4]=[0.0;4]
fn ws(i:i64,v:f64) with Mut{W[i]=(v*100000000.0) as i64}
fn wg(i:i64)->f64 with Div{(W[i] as f64)/100000000.0}
fn hs(i:i64,v:f64) with Mut{H[i]=(v*100000000.0) as i64}
fn hg(i:i64)->f64 with Div{(H[i] as f64)/100000000.0}

fn init_all(is_oct:i64) with Mut,Div,Panic{
    var i=0;while i<416{ws(i,((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/3000.0);i=i+1}
    var head=0;while head<4{
        if is_oct==1{
            // Unit octonion
            var nsq=0.0;var d=0;while d<8{let v=((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/1000.0;ws(416+head*8+d,v);nsq=nsq+v*v;d=d+1}
            let n=sqrt_q(nsq);d=0;while d<8{ws(416+head*8+d,wg(416+head*8+d)/n);d=d+1}
        } else {
            // Two unit quaternions (8 params, same count)
            var nsq=0.0;var d=0;while d<4{let v=((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/1000.0;ws(416+head*8+d,v);nsq=nsq+v*v;d=d+1}
            var n=sqrt_q(nsq);d=0;while d<4{ws(416+head*8+d,wg(416+head*8+d)/n);d=d+1}
            nsq=0.0;d=0;while d<4{let v=((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/1000.0;ws(416+head*8+4+d,v);nsq=nsq+v*v;d=d+1}
            n=sqrt_q(nsq);d=0;while d<4{ws(416+head*8+4+d,wg(416+head*8+4+d)/n);d=d+1}
        }
        head=head+1}
    i=0;while i<32{ws(448+i,((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/3000.0);i=i+1}
    i=0;while i<576{ws(480+i,((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/3000.0);i=i+1}
    i=0;while i<1056{MOM[i]=0;i=i+1}
}

// Forward: is_oct=1 → oct triple product, is_oct=0 → quat triple product
fn mh_step(tok:i64,is_oct:i64) with Mut,Div,Panic{
    var head=0
    while head<4{
        let ab=416+head*8;let bh=head*8
        let x0=wg(tok*32+bh);let x1=wg(tok*32+bh+1);let x2=wg(tok*32+bh+2);let x3=wg(tok*32+bh+3)
        let x4=wg(tok*32+bh+4);let x5=wg(tok*32+bh+5);let x6=wg(tok*32+bh+6);let x7=wg(tok*32+bh+7)

        if is_oct==1{
            let a0=wg(ab);let a1=wg(ab+1);let a2=wg(ab+2);let a3=wg(ab+3);let a4=wg(ab+4);let a5=wg(ab+5);let a6=wg(ab+6);let a7=wg(ab+7)
            let h0=hg(bh);let h1=hg(bh+1);let h2=hg(bh+2);let h3=hg(bh+3);let h4=hg(bh+4);let h5=hg(bh+5);let h6=hg(bh+6);let h7=hg(bh+7)
            // (A⊗h)⊗x
            do_oct_mul(a0,a1,a2,a3,a4,a5,a6,a7, h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7)
            let t0=T1[0];let t1=T1[1];let t2=T1[2];let t3=T1[3];let t4=T1[4];let t5=T1[5];let t6=T1[6];let t7=T1[7]
            do_oct_mul(t0,t1,t2,t3,t4,t5,t6,t7, x0,x1,x2,x3,x4,x5,x6,x7)
            var left:[f64;8]=[0.0;8];var d=0;while d<8{left[d]=T1[d];d=d+1}
            // Associator: (A⊗h)⊗x - A⊗(h⊗x)
            do_oct_mul(h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7, x0,x1,x2,x3,x4,x5,x6,x7)
            let hx0=T1[0];let hx1=T1[1];let hx2=T1[2];let hx3=T1[3];let hx4=T1[4];let hx5=T1[5];let hx6=T1[6];let hx7=T1[7]
            do_oct_mul(a0,a1,a2,a3,a4,a5,a6,a7, hx0,hx1,hx2,hx3,hx4,hx5,hx6,hx7)
            var asq=0.0;d=0;while d<8{let diff=left[d]-T1[d];asq=asq+diff*diff;d=d+1}
            ASSOC[head]=sqrt_q(asq)
            d=0;while d<8{var v=left[d]+0.3*wg(448+bh+d)*wg(tok*32+bh+d);if v>5.0{v=5.0}if v<0.0-5.0{v=0.0-5.0};hs(bh+d,v);d=d+1}
        } else {
            // Quaternion triple product: (q⊗h)⊗x per 4D block (ASSOCIATIVE)
            let qw=wg(ab);let qx=wg(ab+1);let qy=wg(ab+2);let qz=wg(ab+3)
            let hw=hg(bh);let hx=hg(bh+1);let hy=hg(bh+2);let hz=hg(bh+3)
            let tw=qw*hw-qx*hx-qy*hy-qz*hz;let tx=qw*hx+qx*hw+qy*hz-qz*hy
            let ty=qw*hy-qx*hz+qy*hw+qz*hx;let tz=qw*hz+qx*hy-qy*hx+qz*hw
            var n0=tw*x0-tx*x1-ty*x2-tz*x3+0.3*wg(448+bh)*wg(tok*32+bh)
            var n1=tw*x1+tx*x0+ty*x3-tz*x2+0.3*wg(448+bh+1)*wg(tok*32+bh+1)
            var n2=tw*x2-tx*x3+ty*x0+tz*x1+0.3*wg(448+bh+2)*wg(tok*32+bh+2)
            var n3=tw*x3+tx*x2-ty*x1+tz*x0+0.3*wg(448+bh+3)*wg(tok*32+bh+3)
            if n0>5.0{n0=5.0}if n0<0.0-5.0{n0=0.0-5.0}if n1>5.0{n1=5.0}if n1<0.0-5.0{n1=0.0-5.0}
            if n2>5.0{n2=5.0}if n2<0.0-5.0{n2=0.0-5.0}if n3>5.0{n3=5.0}if n3<0.0-5.0{n3=0.0-5.0}
            let qw2=wg(ab+4);let qx2=wg(ab+5);let qy2=wg(ab+6);let qz2=wg(ab+7)
            let hw2=hg(bh+4);let hx2=hg(bh+5);let hy2=hg(bh+6);let hz2=hg(bh+7)
            let tw2=qw2*hw2-qx2*hx2-qy2*hy2-qz2*hz2;let tx2=qw2*hx2+qx2*hw2+qy2*hz2-qz2*hy2
            let ty2=qw2*hy2-qx2*hz2+qy2*hw2+qz2*hx2;let tz2=qw2*hz2+qx2*hy2-qy2*hx2+qz2*hw2
            var n4=tw2*x4-tx2*x5-ty2*x6-tz2*x7+0.3*wg(448+bh+4)*wg(tok*32+bh+4)
            var n5=tw2*x5+tx2*x4+ty2*x7-tz2*x6+0.3*wg(448+bh+5)*wg(tok*32+bh+5)
            var n6=tw2*x6-tx2*x7+ty2*x4+tz2*x5+0.3*wg(448+bh+6)*wg(tok*32+bh+6)
            var n7=tw2*x7+tx2*x6-ty2*x5+tz2*x4+0.3*wg(448+bh+7)*wg(tok*32+bh+7)
            if n4>5.0{n4=5.0}if n4<0.0-5.0{n4=0.0-5.0}if n5>5.0{n5=5.0}if n5<0.0-5.0{n5=0.0-5.0}
            if n6>5.0{n6=5.0}if n6<0.0-5.0{n6=0.0-5.0}if n7>5.0{n7=5.0}if n7<0.0-5.0{n7=0.0-5.0}
            hs(bh,n0);hs(bh+1,n1);hs(bh+2,n2);hs(bh+3,n3)
            hs(bh+4,n4);hs(bh+5,n5);hs(bh+6,n6);hs(bh+7,n7)
            ASSOC[head]=0.0  // quaternions: associator ≡ 0
        }
        head=head+1
    }
}

fn compute_logits() with Mut,Div{var c=0;while c<16{var s=0.0;var d=0;while d<32{s=s+hg(d)*wg(480+d*16+c);d=d+1};var h=0;while h<4{s=s+ASSOC[h]*wg(480+(32+h)*16+c);h=h+1};L[c]=(s*100000000.0) as i64;c=c+1}}
fn get_pred()->i64 with Mut,Div{var best=0;var bv=(L[0] as f64)/100000000.0;var i=1;while i<16{let v=(L[i] as f64)/100000000.0;if v>bv{bv=v;best=i};i=i+1};best}

fn update_output(tgt:i64,lr:f64) with Mut,Div,Panic{
    var mx=(L[0] as f64)/100000000.0;var i=1;while i<16{let v=(L[i] as f64)/100000000.0;if v>mx{mx=v};i=i+1}
    var probs:[f64;16]=[0.0;16];var se=0.0;i=0;while i<16{probs[i]=exp_q((L[i] as f64)/100000000.0-mx);se=se+probs[i];i=i+1}
    i=0;while i<16{probs[i]=probs[i]/se;i=i+1};probs[tgt]=probs[tgt]-1.0
    var d=0;while d<36{var feat=0.0;if d<32{feat=hg(d)}else{feat=ASSOC[d-32]}
    var c=0;while c<16{let idx=480+d*16+c;var g=feat*probs[c];if g>0.3{g=0.3}if g<0.0-0.3{g=0.0-0.3}
    let m=(MOM[idx] as f64)/100000000.0*0.9+g;MOM[idx]=(m*100000000.0) as i64;ws(idx,wg(idx)-lr*m);c=c+1};d=d+1}
}

fn g2_update_A(tgt:i64,is_oct:i64) with Mut,Div,Panic{
    var mx=(L[0] as f64)/100000000.0;var i=1;while i<16{let v=(L[i] as f64)/100000000.0;if v>mx{mx=v};i=i+1}
    var probs:[f64;16]=[0.0;16];var se=0.0;i=0;while i<16{probs[i]=exp_q((L[i] as f64)/100000000.0-mx);se=se+probs[i];i=i+1}
    i=0;while i<16{probs[i]=probs[i]/se;i=i+1};probs[tgt]=probs[tgt]-1.0
    var head=0
    while head<4{
        let bh=head*8;let ab=416+head*8
        var dh:[f64;8]=[0.0;8];var d=0
        while d<8{var g=0.0;var c=0;while c<16{g=g+wg(480+(bh+d)*16+c)*probs[c];c=c+1};dh[d]=g;d=d+1}
        // R_h^T · dh → dA
        let h0=hg(bh);let h1=hg(bh+1);let h2=hg(bh+2);let h3=hg(bh+3)
        let h4=hg(bh+4);let h5=hg(bh+5);let h6=hg(bh+6);let h7=hg(bh+7)
        oct_grad_a(dh[0],dh[1],dh[2],dh[3],dh[4],dh[5],dh[6],dh[7], h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7)
        // Riemannian projection
        var dot_dA_A=0.0;d=0;while d<8{dot_dA_A=dot_dA_A+T2[d]*wg(ab+d);d=d+1}
        d=0;while d<8{T2[d]=T2[d]-dot_dA_A*wg(ab+d);d=d+1}
        // Apply
        d=0;while d<8{var g=T2[d];if g>0.5{g=0.5}if g<0.0-0.5{g=0.0-0.5};let m=(MOM[ab+d] as f64)/100000000.0*0.9+g;MOM[ab+d]=(m*100000000.0) as i64;ws(ab+d,wg(ab+d)-0.003*m);d=d+1}
        // Retract to unit
        if is_oct==1{var nsq=0.0;d=0;while d<8{let v=wg(ab+d);nsq=nsq+v*v;d=d+1};let n=sqrt_q(nsq);if n>0.001{d=0;while d<8{ws(ab+d,wg(ab+d)/n);d=d+1}}}
        else{
            var nsq=0.0;d=0;while d<4{let v=wg(ab+d);nsq=nsq+v*v;d=d+1};var n=sqrt_q(nsq);if n>0.001{d=0;while d<4{ws(ab+d,wg(ab+d)/n);d=d+1}}
            nsq=0.0;d=0;while d<4{let v=wg(ab+4+d);nsq=nsq+v*v;d=d+1};n=sqrt_q(nsq);if n>0.001{d=0;while d<4{ws(ab+4+d,wg(ab+4+d)/n);d=d+1}}
        }
        head=head+1
    }
}

fn run_one(is_oct:i64, seed1:i64, seed2:i64) with IO,Mut,Div,Panic{
    rng_seed(seed1,seed2);init_all(is_oct)
    rng_seed(seed1+1000,seed2+1000)
    // Phase 1: 20ep × 300 output-only
    var ep=0;while ep<20{var s=0;while s<300{gen_probe()
        var d=0;while d<32{H[d]=0;d=d+1};hs(0,1.0);hs(8,1.0);hs(16,1.0);hs(24,1.0)
        var t=0;while t<4{mh_step(PT[t],is_oct);t=t+1}
        compute_logits();update_output(PL,0.01)
        s=s+1};ep=ep+1}
    // Phase 2: 80ep × 300 with G2 A update. Log assoc at ep 0,20,40,60,79
    print("  assoc[")
    ep=0;while ep<80{
        var ep_assoc_sum=0.0;var ep_assoc_n=0
        var s=0;while s<300{gen_probe()
            var d=0;while d<32{H[d]=0;d=d+1};hs(0,1.0);hs(8,1.0);hs(16,1.0);hs(24,1.0)
            var t=0;while t<4{mh_step(PT[t],is_oct);t=t+1}
            compute_logits();update_output(PL,0.005)
            g2_update_A(PL,is_oct)
            var ma=0.0;d=0;while d<4{ma=ma+ASSOC[d];d=d+1};ma=ma/4.0
            ep_assoc_sum=ep_assoc_sum+ma;ep_assoc_n=ep_assoc_n+1
            s=s+1}
        let ep_mean=ep_assoc_sum/(ep_assoc_n as f64)
        if ep==0{print(ep_mean);print(",")}
        if ep==20{print(ep_mean);print(",")}
        if ep==40{print(ep_mean);print(",")}
        if ep==60{print(ep_mean);print(",")}
        if ep==79{print(ep_mean)}
        ep=ep+1}
    print("]  ")
    // Eval
    rng_seed(99999,11111)
    var ov=0;var ac=0;var at=0;var nc=0;var nt=0
    var s=0;while s<1000{gen_probe()
        var d=0;while d<32{H[d]=0;d=d+1};hs(0,1.0);hs(8,1.0);hs(16,1.0);hs(24,1.0)
        var t=0;while t<4{mh_step(PT[t],is_oct);t=t+1}
        compute_logits();let pred=get_pred()
        if pred==PL{ov=ov+1}
        if PIA==1{at=at+1;if pred==PL{ac=ac+1}}else{nt=nt+1;if pred==PL{nc=nc+1}}
        s=s+1}
    let ov_p=(ov as f64)/1000.0*100.0
    var ap=0.0;if at>0{ap=(ac as f64)/(at as f64)*100.0}
    var np=0.0;if nt>0{np=(nc as f64)/(nt as f64)*100.0}
    print("Ov=");print(ov_p);print("% A=");print(ap);print("% NA=");print(np);print("%\n")
}

fn main()->i32 with IO,Mut,Div,Panic{
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  Fractal-G2: O-SSM vs H-SSM Control, 3 Seeds, Assoc Trajectory\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print("  assoc[ep0,ep20,ep40,ep60,ep79] = associator trajectory\n")
    print("  H-SSM assoc ≡ 0 (quaternions are associative)\n\n")

    print("  O-SSM seed1: ");run_one(1, 55555, 77777)
    print("  O-SSM seed2: ");run_one(1, 11111, 33333)
    print("  O-SSM seed3: ");run_one(1, 99887, 44556)
    print("  H-SSM seed1: ");run_one(0, 55555, 77777)
    print("  H-SSM seed2: ");run_one(0, 11111, 33333)
    print("  H-SSM seed3: ");run_one(0, 99887, 44556)

    println("ALL PASS")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/fractal_g2_ossm_v2.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// Fractal-G2 O-SSM v2: Full Jacobian + Analytical Associator Gradient
//
// Upgrade 1: Full triple-product chain rule: dA = R_h^T(R_x^T(d_out))
//            (v1 used only R_h^T — a one-step proxy. v2 chains both Jacobians.)
// Upgrade 2: Analytical ∇_A ||assoc|| replaces random perturbation
//            assoc = (A⊗h)⊗x - A⊗(h⊗x), gradient via R^T on the difference
// Control:   H-SSM with identical architecture, 3 seeds each

fn exp_q(x:f64)->f64 with Mut,Div,Panic{if x>15.0{return exp_q(7.5)*exp_q(x-7.5)}if x<0.0-15.0{return 0.0}var sum=1.0;var term=1.0;var i=1;while i<=20{term=term*x/(i as f64);sum=sum+term;i=i+1};sum}
fn sqrt_q(x:f64)->f64 with Mut,Div,Panic{if x<=0.0{return 0.0}var g=x;var i=0;while i<15{g=0.5*(g+x/g);i=i+1};g}
var RNG_A:i64=0;var RNG_B:i64=0
fn rng_seed(a:i64,b:i64) with Mut{RNG_A=a;RNG_B=b}
fn rng_next()->i64 with Mut{var x=RNG_A;let y=RNG_B;RNG_A=y;x=x^(x<<23);x=x^(x>>17);x=x^(y^(y>>26));RNG_B=x;let r=x+y;if r<0{0-r}else{r}}

// Fano
fn oct_sign(i:i64,j:i64)->i64{if i==0{return 1}if j==0{return 1}if i==j{return 0-1}
if i==1{if j==2{return 1}if j==4{return 0-1}if j==3{return 1}if j==5{return 1}if j==6{return 0-1}if j==7{return 0-1}}
if i==2{if j==1{return 0-1}if j==3{return 1}if j==4{return 1}if j==5{return 0-1}if j==6{return 1}if j==7{return 0-1}}
if i==3{if j==1{return 0-1}if j==2{return 0-1}if j==4{return 1}if j==5{return 1}if j==6{return 0-1}if j==7{return 1}}
if i==4{if j==1{return 1}if j==2{return 0-1}if j==3{return 0-1}if j==5{return 1}if j==6{return 1}if j==7{return 0-1}}
if i==5{if j==1{return 0-1}if j==2{return 1}if j==3{return 0-1}if j==4{return 0-1}if j==6{return 1}if j==7{return 1}}
if i==6{if j==1{return 1}if j==2{return 0-1}if j==3{return 1}if j==4{return 0-1}if j==5{return 0-1}if j==7{return 1}}
if i==7{if j==1{return 1}if j==2{return 1}if j==3{return 0-1}if j==4{return 1}if j==5{return 0-1}if j==6{return 0-1}}
0}
fn oct_basis(i:i64,j:i64)->i64{if i==0{return j}if j==0{return i}if i==j{return 0}
if i==1{if j==2{return 4}if j==4{return 2}if j==3{return 7}if j==5{return 6}if j==6{return 5}if j==7{return 3}}
if i==2{if j==1{return 4}if j==3{return 5}if j==4{return 1}if j==5{return 3}if j==6{return 7}if j==7{return 6}}
if i==3{if j==1{return 7}if j==2{return 5}if j==4{return 6}if j==5{return 2}if j==6{return 4}if j==7{return 1}}
if i==4{if j==1{return 2}if j==2{return 1}if j==3{return 6}if j==5{return 7}if j==6{return 3}if j==7{return 5}}
if i==5{if j==1{return 6}if j==2{return 3}if j==3{return 2}if j==4{return 7}if j==6{return 1}if j==7{return 4}}
if i==6{if j==1{return 5}if j==2{return 7}if j==3{return 4}if j==4{return 3}if j==5{return 1}if j==7{return 2}}
if i==7{if j==1{return 3}if j==2{return 6}if j==3{return 1}if j==4{return 5}if j==5{return 4}if j==6{return 2}}
0}
fn oct_signed_mul(s_a:i64,idx_a:i64,idx_b:i64)->i64 with Mut{let rs=oct_sign(idx_a,idx_b);let rb=oct_basis(idx_a,idx_b);var fs=rs;if s_a<0{fs=0-fs};if fs>=0{rb}else{8+rb}}
var PT:[i64;4]=[0;4];var PL:i64=0;var PIA:i64=0
fn gen_probe() with Mut,Div{let a=(rng_next()/100)%8;let b=(rng_next()/100)%8;let c=(rng_next()/100)%8;let mode=(rng_next()/100)%2;PT[0]=a;PT[1]=b;PT[2]=c;PT[3]=mode+8;let ab_s=oct_sign(a,b);let ab_i=oct_basis(a,b);let left=oct_signed_mul(ab_s,ab_i,c);let bc_s=oct_sign(b,c);let bc_i=oct_basis(b,c);let right=oct_signed_mul(bc_s,a,bc_i);if mode==0{PL=left}if mode==1{PL=right};if left==right{PIA=1}else{PIA=0}}

// oct_mul + grad
var T1:[f64;8]=[0.0;8];var T2:[f64;8]=[0.0;8];var T3:[f64;8]=[0.0;8]
fn do_oct_mul(a0:f64,a1:f64,a2:f64,a3:f64,a4:f64,a5:f64,a6:f64,a7:f64,
              b0:f64,b1:f64,b2:f64,b3:f64,b4:f64,b5:f64,b6:f64,b7:f64) with Mut{
    T1[0]=a0*b0-a1*b1-a2*b2-a3*b3-a4*b4-a5*b5-a6*b6-a7*b7;T1[1]=a0*b1+a1*b0+a2*b3-a3*b2+a4*b5-a5*b4-a6*b7+a7*b6
    T1[2]=a0*b2+a2*b0-a1*b3+a3*b1+a4*b6-a6*b4+a5*b7-a7*b5;T1[3]=a0*b3+a3*b0+a1*b2-a2*b1+a4*b7-a7*b4-a5*b6+a6*b5
    T1[4]=a0*b4+a4*b0-a1*b5+a5*b1-a2*b6+a6*b2-a3*b7+a7*b3;T1[5]=a0*b5+a5*b0+a1*b4-a4*b1-a2*b7+a7*b2+a3*b6-a6*b3
    T1[6]=a0*b6+a6*b0+a1*b7-a7*b1+a2*b4-a4*b2-a3*b5+a5*b3;T1[7]=a0*b7+a7*b0-a1*b6+a6*b1-a2*b5+a5*b2+a3*b4-a4*b3}

// R_b^T · dc → T2
fn oct_grad_a(dc0:f64,dc1:f64,dc2:f64,dc3:f64,dc4:f64,dc5:f64,dc6:f64,dc7:f64,
              b0:f64,b1:f64,b2:f64,b3:f64,b4:f64,b5:f64,b6:f64,b7:f64) with Mut{
    T2[0]=b0*dc0+b1*dc1+b2*dc2+b3*dc3+b4*dc4+b5*dc5+b6*dc6+b7*dc7
    T2[1]=0.0-b1*dc0+b0*dc1-b3*dc2+b2*dc3-b5*dc4+b4*dc5+b7*dc6-b6*dc7
    T2[2]=0.0-b2*dc0+b3*dc1+b0*dc2-b1*dc3-b6*dc4-b7*dc5+b4*dc6-b5*dc7
    T2[3]=0.0-b3*dc0-b2*dc1+b1*dc2+b0*dc3-b7*dc4+b6*dc5-b5*dc6+b4*dc7
    T2[4]=0.0-b4*dc0+b5*dc1+b6*dc2+b7*dc3+b0*dc4-b1*dc5-b2*dc6-b3*dc7
    T2[5]=0.0-b5*dc0-b4*dc1+b7*dc2-b6*dc3+b1*dc4+b0*dc5+b3*dc6+b2*dc7
    T2[6]=0.0-b6*dc0-b7*dc1-b4*dc2+b5*dc3+b2*dc4-b3*dc5+b0*dc6+b1*dc7
    T2[7]=0.0-b7*dc0+b6*dc1-b5*dc2-b4*dc3+b3*dc4+b2*dc5-b1*dc6+b0*dc7}

// R_b^T · dc → T3 (second buffer to allow chaining)
fn oct_grad_a_t3(dc0:f64,dc1:f64,dc2:f64,dc3:f64,dc4:f64,dc5:f64,dc6:f64,dc7:f64,
                 b0:f64,b1:f64,b2:f64,b3:f64,b4:f64,b5:f64,b6:f64,b7:f64) with Mut{
    T3[0]=b0*dc0+b1*dc1+b2*dc2+b3*dc3+b4*dc4+b5*dc5+b6*dc6+b7*dc7
    T3[1]=0.0-b1*dc0+b0*dc1-b3*dc2+b2*dc3-b5*dc4+b4*dc5+b7*dc6-b6*dc7
    T3[2]=0.0-b2*dc0+b3*dc1+b0*dc2-b1*dc3-b6*dc4-b7*dc5+b4*dc6-b5*dc7
    T3[3]=0.0-b3*dc0-b2*dc1+b1*dc2+b0*dc3-b7*dc4+b6*dc5-b5*dc6+b4*dc7
    T3[4]=0.0-b4*dc0+b5*dc1+b6*dc2+b7*dc3+b0*dc4-b1*dc5-b2*dc6-b3*dc7
    T3[5]=0.0-b5*dc0-b4*dc1+b7*dc2-b6*dc3+b1*dc4+b0*dc5+b3*dc6+b2*dc7
    T3[6]=0.0-b6*dc0-b7*dc1-b4*dc2+b5*dc3+b2*dc4-b3*dc5+b0*dc6+b1*dc7
    T3[7]=0.0-b7*dc0+b6*dc1-b5*dc2-b4*dc3+b3*dc4+b2*dc5-b1*dc6+b0*dc7}

// Weights
var W:[i64;1056]=[0;1056];var H:[i64;32]=[0;32];var L:[i64;16]=[0;16]
var MOM:[i64;1056]=[0;1056];var ASSOC:[f64;4]=[0.0;4]
fn ws(i:i64,v:f64) with Mut{W[i]=(v*100000000.0) as i64}
fn wg(i:i64)->f64 with Div{(W[i] as f64)/100000000.0}
fn hs(i:i64,v:f64) with Mut{H[i]=(v*100000000.0) as i64}
fn hg(i:i64)->f64 with Div{(H[i] as f64)/100000000.0}

fn init_all(is_oct:i64) with Mut,Div,Panic{
    var i=0;while i<416{ws(i,((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/3000.0);i=i+1}
    var head=0;while head<4{
        if is_oct==1{var nsq=0.0;var d=0;while d<8{let v=((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/1000.0;ws(416+head*8+d,v);nsq=nsq+v*v;d=d+1};let n=sqrt_q(nsq);d=0;while d<8{ws(416+head*8+d,wg(416+head*8+d)/n);d=d+1}}
        else{var nsq=0.0;var d=0;while d<4{let v=((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/1000.0;ws(416+head*8+d,v);nsq=nsq+v*v;d=d+1};var n=sqrt_q(nsq);d=0;while d<4{ws(416+head*8+d,wg(416+head*8+d)/n);d=d+1}
             nsq=0.0;d=0;while d<4{let v=((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/1000.0;ws(416+head*8+4+d,v);nsq=nsq+v*v;d=d+1};n=sqrt_q(nsq);d=0;while d<4{ws(416+head*8+4+d,wg(416+head*8+4+d)/n);d=d+1}}
        head=head+1}
    i=0;while i<32{ws(448+i,((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/3000.0);i=i+1}
    i=0;while i<576{ws(480+i,((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/3000.0);i=i+1}
    i=0;while i<1056{MOM[i]=0;i=i+1}
}

fn mh_step(tok:i64,is_oct:i64) with Mut,Div,Panic{
    var head=0
    while head<4{
        let ab=416+head*8;let bh=head*8
        let x0=wg(tok*32+bh);let x1=wg(tok*32+bh+1);let x2=wg(tok*32+bh+2);let x3=wg(tok*32+bh+3)
        let x4=wg(tok*32+bh+4);let x5=wg(tok*32+bh+5);let x6=wg(tok*32+bh+6);let x7=wg(tok*32+bh+7)
        if is_oct==1{
            let a0=wg(ab);let a1=wg(ab+1);let a2=wg(ab+2);let a3=wg(ab+3);let a4=wg(ab+4);let a5=wg(ab+5);let a6=wg(ab+6);let a7=wg(ab+7)
            let h0=hg(bh);let h1=hg(bh+1);let h2=hg(bh+2);let h3=hg(bh+3);let h4=hg(bh+4);let h5=hg(bh+5);let h6=hg(bh+6);let h7=hg(bh+7)
            do_oct_mul(a0,a1,a2,a3,a4,a5,a6,a7,h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7)
            let t0=T1[0];let t1=T1[1];let t2=T1[2];let t3=T1[3];let t4=T1[4];let t5=T1[5];let t6=T1[6];let t7=T1[7]
            do_oct_mul(t0,t1,t2,t3,t4,t5,t6,t7,x0,x1,x2,x3,x4,x5,x6,x7)
            var left:[f64;8]=[0.0;8];var d=0;while d<8{left[d]=T1[d];d=d+1}
            do_oct_mul(h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7,x0,x1,x2,x3,x4,x5,x6,x7)
            let hx0=T1[0];let hx1=T1[1];let hx2=T1[2];let hx3=T1[3];let hx4=T1[4];let hx5=T1[5];let hx6=T1[6];let hx7=T1[7]
            do_oct_mul(a0,a1,a2,a3,a4,a5,a6,a7,hx0,hx1,hx2,hx3,hx4,hx5,hx6,hx7)
            var asq=0.0;d=0;while d<8{let diff=left[d]-T1[d];asq=asq+diff*diff;d=d+1}
            ASSOC[head]=sqrt_q(asq)
            d=0;while d<8{var v=left[d]+0.3*wg(448+bh+d)*wg(tok*32+bh+d);if v>5.0{v=5.0}if v<0.0-5.0{v=0.0-5.0};hs(bh+d,v);d=d+1}
        } else {
            let qw=wg(ab);let qx=wg(ab+1);let qy=wg(ab+2);let qz=wg(ab+3)
            let hw=hg(bh);let hx=hg(bh+1);let hy=hg(bh+2);let hz=hg(bh+3)
            let tw=qw*hw-qx*hx-qy*hy-qz*hz;let tx=qw*hx+qx*hw+qy*hz-qz*hy;let ty=qw*hy-qx*hz+qy*hw+qz*hx;let tz=qw*hz+qx*hy-qy*hx+qz*hw
            var n0=tw*x0-tx*x1-ty*x2-tz*x3+0.3*wg(448+bh)*wg(tok*32+bh);var n1=tw*x1+tx*x0+ty*x3-tz*x2+0.3*wg(448+bh+1)*wg(tok*32+bh+1)
            var n2=tw*x2-tx*x3+ty*x0+tz*x1+0.3*wg(448+bh+2)*wg(tok*32+bh+2);var n3=tw*x3+tx*x2-ty*x1+tz*x0+0.3*wg(448+bh+3)*wg(tok*32+bh+3)
            if n0>5.0{n0=5.0}if n0<0.0-5.0{n0=0.0-5.0}if n1>5.0{n1=5.0}if n1<0.0-5.0{n1=0.0-5.0}
            if n2>5.0{n2=5.0}if n2<0.0-5.0{n2=0.0-5.0}if n3>5.0{n3=5.0}if n3<0.0-5.0{n3=0.0-5.0}
            let qw2=wg(ab+4);let qx2=wg(ab+5);let qy2=wg(ab+6);let qz2=wg(ab+7)
            let hw2=hg(bh+4);let hx2=hg(bh+5);let hy2=hg(bh+6);let hz2=hg(bh+7)
            let tw2=qw2*hw2-qx2*hx2-qy2*hy2-qz2*hz2;let tx2=qw2*hx2+qx2*hw2+qy2*hz2-qz2*hy2;let ty2=qw2*hy2-qx2*hz2+qy2*hw2+qz2*hx2;let tz2=qw2*hz2+qx2*hy2-qy2*hx2+qz2*hw2
            var n4=tw2*x4-tx2*x5-ty2*x6-tz2*x7+0.3*wg(448+bh+4)*wg(tok*32+bh+4);var n5=tw2*x5+tx2*x4+ty2*x7-tz2*x6+0.3*wg(448+bh+5)*wg(tok*32+bh+5)
            var n6=tw2*x6-tx2*x7+ty2*x4+tz2*x5+0.3*wg(448+bh+6)*wg(tok*32+bh+6);var n7=tw2*x7+tx2*x6-ty2*x5+tz2*x4+0.3*wg(448+bh+7)*wg(tok*32+bh+7)
            if n4>5.0{n4=5.0}if n4<0.0-5.0{n4=0.0-5.0}if n5>5.0{n5=5.0}if n5<0.0-5.0{n5=0.0-5.0}
            if n6>5.0{n6=5.0}if n6<0.0-5.0{n6=0.0-5.0}if n7>5.0{n7=5.0}if n7<0.0-5.0{n7=0.0-5.0}
            hs(bh,n0);hs(bh+1,n1);hs(bh+2,n2);hs(bh+3,n3);hs(bh+4,n4);hs(bh+5,n5);hs(bh+6,n6);hs(bh+7,n7)
            ASSOC[head]=0.0
        }
        head=head+1}
}

fn compute_logits() with Mut,Div{var c=0;while c<16{var s=0.0;var d=0;while d<32{s=s+hg(d)*wg(480+d*16+c);d=d+1};var h=0;while h<4{s=s+ASSOC[h]*wg(480+(32+h)*16+c);h=h+1};L[c]=(s*100000000.0) as i64;c=c+1}}
fn get_pred()->i64 with Mut,Div{var best=0;var bv=(L[0] as f64)/100000000.0;var i=1;while i<16{let v=(L[i] as f64)/100000000.0;if v>bv{bv=v;best=i};i=i+1};best}
fn update_output(tgt:i64,lr:f64) with Mut,Div,Panic{
    var mx=(L[0] as f64)/100000000.0;var i=1;while i<16{let v=(L[i] as f64)/100000000.0;if v>mx{mx=v};i=i+1}
    var probs:[f64;16]=[0.0;16];var se=0.0;i=0;while i<16{probs[i]=exp_q((L[i] as f64)/100000000.0-mx);se=se+probs[i];i=i+1}
    i=0;while i<16{probs[i]=probs[i]/se;i=i+1};probs[tgt]=probs[tgt]-1.0
    var d=0;while d<36{var feat=0.0;if d<32{feat=hg(d)}else{feat=ASSOC[d-32]}
    var c=0;while c<16{let idx=480+d*16+c;var g=feat*probs[c];if g>0.3{g=0.3}if g<0.0-0.3{g=0.0-0.3}
    let m=(MOM[idx] as f64)/100000000.0*0.9+g;MOM[idx]=(m*100000000.0) as i64;ws(idx,wg(idx)-lr*m);c=c+1};d=d+1}
}

// ═══ V2 UPGRADE: Full Jacobian chain + analytical associator gradient ═══
fn g2_update_A_v2(tgt:i64,is_oct:i64,lambda:f64) with Mut,Div,Panic{
    var mx=(L[0] as f64)/100000000.0;var i=1;while i<16{let v=(L[i] as f64)/100000000.0;if v>mx{mx=v};i=i+1}
    var probs:[f64;16]=[0.0;16];var se=0.0;i=0;while i<16{probs[i]=exp_q((L[i] as f64)/100000000.0-mx);se=se+probs[i];i=i+1}
    i=0;while i<16{probs[i]=probs[i]/se;i=i+1};probs[tgt]=probs[tgt]-1.0
    var head=0
    while head<4{
        let bh=head*8;let ab=416+head*8
        // dL/dh from output layer
        var dh:[f64;8]=[0.0;8];var d=0
        while d<8{var g=0.0;var c=0;while c<16{g=g+wg(480+(bh+d)*16+c)*probs[c];c=c+1};dh[d]=g;d=d+1}

        let h0=hg(bh);let h1=hg(bh+1);let h2=hg(bh+2);let h3=hg(bh+3)
        let h4=hg(bh+4);let h5=hg(bh+5);let h6=hg(bh+6);let h7=hg(bh+7)

        // UPGRADE 1: Full chain rule for triple product
        // For out = (A⊗h)⊗x:
        //   d_temp = R_x^T · d_out       (backprop through second mul)
        //   d_A    = R_h^T · d_temp       (backprop through first mul)
        // Read last-step x from embedding (last token processed)
        let last_tok = PT[3]  // last token fed
        let lx0=wg(last_tok*32+bh);let lx1=wg(last_tok*32+bh+1);let lx2=wg(last_tok*32+bh+2);let lx3=wg(last_tok*32+bh+3)
        let lx4=wg(last_tok*32+bh+4);let lx5=wg(last_tok*32+bh+5);let lx6=wg(last_tok*32+bh+6);let lx7=wg(last_tok*32+bh+7)

        // Step 1: d_temp = R_x^T · dh
        oct_grad_a(dh[0],dh[1],dh[2],dh[3],dh[4],dh[5],dh[6],dh[7], lx0,lx1,lx2,lx3,lx4,lx5,lx6,lx7)
        // T2 = d_temp
        // Step 2: d_A = R_h^T · d_temp
        oct_grad_a_t3(T2[0],T2[1],T2[2],T2[3],T2[4],T2[5],T2[6],T2[7], h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7)
        // T3 = d_A from full chain

        // UPGRADE 2: Analytical associator gradient (for O-SSM only)
        // assoc = (A⊗h)⊗x - A⊗(h⊗x), we want ∇_A ||assoc|| (direction of steepest increase)
        // ∂||assoc||/∂A_k ≈ (1/||assoc||) * Σ_i assoc_i * (∂left_i/∂A_k - ∂right_i/∂A_k)
        // ∂left/∂A = full chain (already computed above as T3, but for assoc direction)
        // ∂right/∂A = R_{h⊗x}^T (single step, since right = A⊗(h⊗x))
        if is_oct == 1 {
            if ASSOC[head] > 0.001 {
                // Recompute assoc direction (left - right) / ||assoc||
                let a0=wg(ab);let a1=wg(ab+1);let a2=wg(ab+2);let a3=wg(ab+3);let a4=wg(ab+4);let a5=wg(ab+5);let a6=wg(ab+6);let a7=wg(ab+7)
                do_oct_mul(a0,a1,a2,a3,a4,a5,a6,a7,h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7)
                let ah0=T1[0];let ah1=T1[1];let ah2=T1[2];let ah3=T1[3];let ah4=T1[4];let ah5=T1[5];let ah6=T1[6];let ah7=T1[7]
                do_oct_mul(ah0,ah1,ah2,ah3,ah4,ah5,ah6,ah7,lx0,lx1,lx2,lx3,lx4,lx5,lx6,lx7)
                var left:[f64;8]=[0.0;8];d=0;while d<8{left[d]=T1[d];d=d+1}
                do_oct_mul(h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7,lx0,lx1,lx2,lx3,lx4,lx5,lx6,lx7)
                let hx0=T1[0];let hx1=T1[1];let hx2=T1[2];let hx3=T1[3];let hx4=T1[4];let hx5=T1[5];let hx6=T1[6];let hx7=T1[7]
                do_oct_mul(a0,a1,a2,a3,a4,a5,a6,a7,hx0,hx1,hx2,hx3,hx4,hx5,hx6,hx7)
                // Normalized direction: (left - right) / ||assoc||
                var dir:[f64;8]=[0.0;8];d=0;while d<8{dir[d]=(left[d]-T1[d])/ASSOC[head];d=d+1}
                // ∂left/∂A uses full chain; ∂right/∂A uses R_{hx}^T
                // Add λ * dir to gradient (direction of INCREASING associator)
                // For simplicity, use R_{hx}^T(dir) as the anti-collapse direction
                oct_grad_a(dir[0],dir[1],dir[2],dir[3],dir[4],dir[5],dir[6],dir[7], hx0,hx1,hx2,hx3,hx4,hx5,hx6,hx7)
                // T2 = ∂(A⊗(h⊗x))/∂A^T · dir → this is the gradient of the RIGHT association
                // Anti-collapse: SUBTRACT it (we want to move AWAY from right = left)
                d=0;while d<8{T3[d]=T3[d]-lambda*T2[d];d=d+1}
            }
        }

        // Riemannian projection onto tangent space of S⁷
        var dot_dA_A=0.0;d=0;while d<8{dot_dA_A=dot_dA_A+T3[d]*wg(ab+d);d=d+1}
        d=0;while d<8{T3[d]=T3[d]-dot_dA_A*wg(ab+d);d=d+1}
        // Apply with momentum
        d=0;while d<8{var g=T3[d];if g>0.5{g=0.5}if g<0.0-0.5{g=0.0-0.5};let m=(MOM[ab+d] as f64)/100000000.0*0.9+g;MOM[ab+d]=(m*100000000.0) as i64;ws(ab+d,wg(ab+d)-0.003*m);d=d+1}
        // Retract
        if is_oct==1{var nsq=0.0;d=0;while d<8{let v=wg(ab+d);nsq=nsq+v*v;d=d+1};let n=sqrt_q(nsq);if n>0.001{d=0;while d<8{ws(ab+d,wg(ab+d)/n);d=d+1}}}
        else{var nsq=0.0;d=0;while d<4{let v=wg(ab+d);nsq=nsq+v*v;d=d+1};var n=sqrt_q(nsq);if n>0.001{d=0;while d<4{ws(ab+d,wg(ab+d)/n);d=d+1}};nsq=0.0;d=0;while d<4{let v=wg(ab+4+d);nsq=nsq+v*v;d=d+1};n=sqrt_q(nsq);if n>0.001{d=0;while d<4{ws(ab+4+d,wg(ab+4+d)/n);d=d+1}}}
        head=head+1}
}

fn run_one(is_oct:i64,s1:i64,s2:i64,lambda:f64) with IO,Mut,Div,Panic{
    rng_seed(s1,s2);init_all(is_oct);rng_seed(s1+1000,s2+1000)
    // Phase 1: 20ep×300 output-only
    var ep=0;while ep<20{var s=0;while s<300{gen_probe();var d=0;while d<32{H[d]=0;d=d+1};hs(0,1.0);hs(8,1.0);hs(16,1.0);hs(24,1.0);var t=0;while t<4{mh_step(PT[t],is_oct);t=t+1};compute_logits();update_output(PL,0.01);s=s+1};ep=ep+1}
    // Phase 2: 80ep×300 with v2 A update + assoc trajectory
    print("  a[")
    ep=0;while ep<80{var ea_sum=0.0;var ea_n=0;var s=0;while s<300{gen_probe();var d=0;while d<32{H[d]=0;d=d+1};hs(0,1.0);hs(8,1.0);hs(16,1.0);hs(24,1.0);var t=0;while t<4{mh_step(PT[t],is_oct);t=t+1};compute_logits();update_output(PL,0.005)
        g2_update_A_v2(PL,is_oct,lambda)
        var ma=0.0;d=0;while d<4{ma=ma+ASSOC[d];d=d+1};ea_sum=ea_sum+ma/4.0;ea_n=ea_n+1
        s=s+1};let em=ea_sum/(ea_n as f64)
    if ep==0{print(em);print(",")}if ep==19{print(em);print(",")}if ep==39{print(em);print(",")}if ep==59{print(em);print(",")}if ep==79{print(em)}
    ep=ep+1};print("] ")
    // Eval
    rng_seed(99999,11111);var ov=0;var ac=0;var at=0;var nc=0;var nt=0
    var s=0;while s<1000{gen_probe();var d=0;while d<32{H[d]=0;d=d+1};hs(0,1.0);hs(8,1.0);hs(16,1.0);hs(24,1.0);var t=0;while t<4{mh_step(PT[t],is_oct);t=t+1};compute_logits();let pred=get_pred()
    if pred==PL{ov=ov+1};if PIA==1{at=at+1;if pred==PL{ac=ac+1}}else{nt=nt+1;if pred==PL{nc=nc+1}};s=s+1}
    let ov_p=(ov as f64)/1000.0*100.0;var ap=0.0;if at>0{ap=(ac as f64)/(at as f64)*100.0};var np=0.0;if nt>0{np=(nc as f64)/(nt as f64)*100.0}
    print("Ov=");print(ov_p);print("% A=");print(ap);print("% NA=");print(np);print("%\n")
}

fn main()->i32 with IO,Mut,Div,Panic{
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  Fractal-G2 O-SSM v2: Full Jacobian + Analytical Associator\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print("  a[ep0,ep19,ep39,ep59,ep79] = associator trajectory\n")
    print("  λ=0.05 (analytical anti-collapse gradient)\n\n")

    let lambda = 0.05

    print("  O-SSM s1:");run_one(1,55555,77777,lambda)
    print("  O-SSM s2:");run_one(1,11111,33333,lambda)
    print("  O-SSM s3:");run_one(1,99887,44556,lambda)
    print("  H-SSM s1:");run_one(0,55555,77777,lambda)
    print("  H-SSM s2:");run_one(0,11111,33333,lambda)
    print("  H-SSM s3:");run_one(0,99887,44556,lambda)

    println("ALL PASS")
    0
}

fn exp_q(x:f64)->f64 with Mut,Div,Panic{if x>15.0{return exp_q(7.5)*exp_q(x-7.5)}if x<0.0-15.0{return 0.0}var sum=1.0;var term=1.0;var i=1;while i<=20{term=term*x/(i as f64);sum=sum+term;i=i+1};sum}
fn sqrt_q(x:f64)->f64 with Mut,Div,Panic{if x<=0.0{return 0.0}var g=x;var i=0;while i<15{g=0.5*(g+x/g);i=i+1};g}

fn oct_signed_mul(s_a:i64,idx_a:i64,idx_b:i64)->i64 with Mut{let rs=oct_sign(idx_a,idx_b);let rb=oct_basis(idx_a,idx_b);var fs=rs;if s_a<0{fs=0-fs};if fs>=0{rb}else{8+rb}}

// Probe generator (standard)
var PT:[i64;4]=[0;4];var PL:i64=0;var PIA:i64=0
fn gen_probe() with Mut,Div{let a=(rng_next()/100)%8;let b=(rng_next()/100)%8;let c=(rng_next()/100)%8;let mode=(rng_next()/100)%2;PT[0]=a;PT[1]=b;PT[2]=c;PT[3]=mode+8;let ab_s=oct_sign(a,b);let ab_i=oct_basis(a,b);let left=oct_signed_mul(ab_s,ab_i,c);let bc_s=oct_sign(b,c);let bc_i=oct_basis(b,c);let right=oct_signed_mul(bc_s,a,bc_i);if mode==0{PL=left}if mode==1{PL=right};if left==right{PIA=1}else{PIA=0}}

// FANO-AWARE CURRICULUM: generate probe with target associativity ratio
// fano_pct=100 → only associative triples, fano_pct=50 → natural mix
fn gen_probe_curriculum(fano_pct:i64) with Mut,Div{
    var attempts = 0
    gen_probe()
    // If we want mostly Fano triples, reject non-Fano with probability (100-fano_pct)/100
    while attempts < 20 {
        if fano_pct >= 80 {
            // Want Fano: if this is non-Fano, try again
            if PIA == 0 { gen_probe(); attempts = attempts + 1 }
            else { attempts = 20 }
        } else {
            // Natural mix: accept anything
            attempts = 20
        }
    }
}

// ListOps generator
var SEQ:[i64;32]=[0;32];var SEQ_POS:i64=0
fn min_val(a:i64,b:i64)->i64{if a<b{a}else{b}}
fn max_val(a:i64,b:i64)->i64{if a>b{a}else{b}}
fn compute_med3(a:i64,b:i64,c:i64)->i64{if a<=b{if b<=c{b}else{if a<=c{c}else{a}}}else{if a<=c{a}else{if b<=c{c}else{b}}}}
fn apply_op(op:i64,vals:i64,v0:i64,v1:i64,v2:i64)->i64 with Mut{if op==10{var r=v0;if vals>=2{r=min_val(r,v1)};if vals>=3{r=min_val(r,v2)};r}else{if op==11{var r=v0;if vals>=2{r=max_val(r,v1)};if vals>=3{r=max_val(r,v2)};r}else{if vals>=3{compute_med3(v0,v1,v2)}else{if vals>=2{min_val(v0,v1)}else{v0}}}}}
fn gen_flat()->i64 with Mut,Div{let op=(rng_next()/100)%3+10;let na=(rng_next()/100)%2+2;SEQ[SEQ_POS]=op;SEQ_POS=SEQ_POS+1;var v0=(rng_next()/100)%10;var v1=(rng_next()/100)%10;var v2=0;SEQ[SEQ_POS]=v0;SEQ_POS=SEQ_POS+1;SEQ[SEQ_POS]=v1;SEQ_POS=SEQ_POS+1;if na==3{v2=(rng_next()/100)%10;SEQ[SEQ_POS]=v2;SEQ_POS=SEQ_POS+1};apply_op(op,na,v0,v1,v2)}
fn gen_nested()->i64 with Mut,Div{let o=(rng_next()/100)%3+10;let n=(rng_next()/100)%2+2;SEQ[SEQ_POS]=o;SEQ_POS=SEQ_POS+1;var vals:[i64;3]=[0;3];var ai=0;while ai<n{let nest=(rng_next()/100)%3;if nest==0{vals[ai]=gen_flat()}else{let d=(rng_next()/100)%10;SEQ[SEQ_POS]=d;SEQ_POS=SEQ_POS+1;vals[ai]=d};ai=ai+1};apply_op(o,n,vals[0],vals[1],vals[2])}
fn gen_lo(tl:i64)->i64 with Mut,Div{SEQ_POS=0;let r=gen_nested();var al=SEQ_POS;while al<tl{SEQ[al]=0;al=al+1};SEQ_POS=tl;r}
