fn print_char_code(code: i32) with IO {
    if code == 32 { print(" ") }
    else { if code == 35 { print("#") }
    else { if code == 42 { print("*") }
    else { if code == 43 { print("+") }
    else { if code == 46 { print(".") }
    else { if code == 64 { print("@") }
    else { print("?") }
    }}}}}
}

fn print_i32(x: i32) with IO, Div, Panic {
    if x == 0 { print("0"); return }
    if x < 0 { print("-"); print_i32_unsigned(0 - x) }
    else { print_i32_unsigned(x) }
}

fn print_i32_unsigned(x: i32) with IO, Div, Panic {
    if x == 0 { return }
    let digit = x % 10
    let rest = x / 10
    if rest > 0 { print_i32_unsigned(rest) }
    print_digit(digit)
}

fn print_digit(d: i32) with IO {
    if d == 0 { print("0") }
    else { if d == 1 { print("1") }
    else { if d == 2 { print("2") }
    else { if d == 3 { print("3") }
    else { if d == 4 { print("4") }
    else { if d == 5 { print("5") }
    else { if d == 6 { print("6") }
    else { if d == 7 { print("7") }
    else { if d == 8 { print("8") }
    else { if d == 9 { print("9") }
    }}}}}}}}}}
}

fn print_f64(x: f64) with IO, Div, Panic {
    if x < 0.0 { print("-"); let x = 0.0 - x }
    let int_part = x as i32
    print_i32(int_part)
    print(".")
    let frac = x - (int_part as f64)
    let frac_scaled = (frac * 100.0) as i32
    if frac_scaled < 10 { print("0") }
    print_i32_unsigned(frac_scaled)
}

// ============================================================================
// Main Demo
// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("Computing Poincare section for Lorenz system...\n")

    // Create section at z = 27 (near the attractor's saddle point)
    var section = poincare_new(27.0, -25.0, 25.0, -35.0, 35.0, 60, 30)
    poincare_set_integration(&!section, 0.005, 2000.0)

    // Initial condition on the attractor
    let init = state3d_new(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)

    // Compute the section
    poincare_compute(&!section, init, lorenz_deriv)

    // Render
    poincare_render(&section)

    print("\nLorenz attractor Poincare section\n")
    print("Shows the fractal structure of the strange attractor\n")

    return 0
}


// === FILE: examples/graphics/lib/53_streamlines.sio ===
// 53_streamlines.sio - Streamline visualization for vector fields
//
// Streamlines show the paths particles would follow in a steady vector field.
// Essential for visualizing:
// - Fluid flow patterns
// - Electric and magnetic field lines
// - Gradient descent paths
// - Phase portraits of 2D dynamical systems
//
// Features:
// - Multiple seeding strategies
// - Adaptive step size integration
// - Direction arrows
// - Line Integral Convolution (simplified)

// ============================================================================
// Vector Field Types
// ============================================================================

struct Vec2 {
    x: f64,
    y: f64
}

fn vec2_new(x: f64, y: f64) -> Vec2 {
    return Vec2 { x: x, y: y }
}

fn vec2_add(a: Vec2, b: Vec2) -> Vec2 {
    return Vec2 { x: a.x + b.x, y: a.y + b.y }
}

fn vec2_scale(v: Vec2, s: f64) -> Vec2 {
    return Vec2 { x: v.x * s, y: v.y * s }
}

fn vec2_length(v: Vec2) -> f64 {
    let len_sq = v.x * v.x + v.y * v.y
    return sqrt_approx(len_sq)
}

fn vec2_normalize(v: Vec2) -> Vec2 with Div, Panic {
    let len = vec2_length(v)
    if len < 0.0001 {
        return vec2_new(0.0, 0.0)
    }
    return Vec2 { x: v.x / len, y: v.y / len }
}

fn sqrt_approx(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }

    // Newton-Raphson iteration
    var guess = x * 0.5
    if guess < 1.0 { guess = 1.0 }

    var i = 0
    while i < 10 {
        guess = 0.5 * (guess + x / guess)
        i = i + 1
    }
    return guess
}

// ============================================================================
// Streamline Structure
// ============================================================================

struct Streamline {
    // Points along the streamline
    points_x: [f64; 500],
    points_y: [f64; 500],
    num_points: i32,

    // Direction at each point (for arrows)
    dirs_x: [f64; 500],
    dirs_y: [f64; 500]
}

struct StreamlineField {
    // Domain bounds
    x_min: f64,
    x_max: f64,
    y_min: f64,
    y_max: f64,

    // Display dimensions
    width: i32,
    height: i32,

    // Streamlines (up to 50)
    streamlines: [Streamline; 50],
    num_streamlines: i32,

    // Integration parameters
    step_size: f64,
    max_steps: i32,

    // Display buffer
    display: [i32; 4096]  // Character codes
}

// ============================================================================
// Initialization
// ============================================================================

fn empty_streamline() -> Streamline {
    return Streamline {
        points_x: [0.0; 500],
        points_y: [0.0; 500],
        num_points: 0,
        dirs_x: [0.0; 500],
        dirs_y: [0.0; 500]
    }
}

fn streamline_field_new(
    x_min: f64, x_max: f64,
    y_min: f64, y_max: f64,
    width: i32, height: i32
) -> StreamlineField {
    return StreamlineField {
        x_min: x_min,
        x_max: x_max,
        y_min: y_min,
        y_max: y_max,
        width: width,
        height: height,
        streamlines: [empty_streamline(); 50],
        num_streamlines: 0,
        step_size: 0.1,
        max_steps: 200,
        display: [32; 4096]  // Initialize with spaces
    }
}

fn streamline_field_set_params(
    field: &!StreamlineField,
    step_size: f64,
    max_steps: i32
) with Mut {
    field.step_size = step_size
    field.max_steps = max_steps
}

fn streamline_field_clear(field: &!StreamlineField) with Mut {
    field.num_streamlines = 0
    var i = 0
    while i < 4096 {
        field.display[i] = 32
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Streamline Integration
// ============================================================================

fn integrate_streamline(
    field: &!StreamlineField,
    seed_x: f64,
    seed_y: f64,
    vector_fn: fn(f64, f64) -> Vec2
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if field.num_streamlines >= 50 {
        return
    }

    let idx = field.num_streamlines
    field.num_streamlines = field.num_streamlines + 1

    var x = seed_x
    var y = seed_y
    var step = 0
    let dt = field.step_size

    while step < field.max_steps {
        // Check bounds
        if x < field.x_min { return }
        if x > field.x_max { return }
        if y < field.y_min { return }
        if y > field.y_max { return }

        // Store point
        if step < 500 {
            field.streamlines[idx].points_x[step] = x
            field.streamlines[idx].points_y[step] = y

            let v = vector_fn(x, y)
            let vnorm = vec2_normalize(v)
            field.streamlines[idx].dirs_x[step] = vnorm.x
            field.streamlines[idx].dirs_y[step] = vnorm.y
            field.streamlines[idx].num_points = step + 1
        }

        // RK4 integration
        let k1 = vector_fn(x, y)
        let k2 = vector_fn(x + k1.x * dt * 0.5, y + k1.y * dt * 0.5)
        let k3 = vector_fn(x + k2.x * dt * 0.5, y + k2.y * dt * 0.5)
        let k4 = vector_fn(x + k3.x * dt, y + k3.y * dt)

        let dx = (k1.x + 2.0 * k2.x + 2.0 * k3.x + k4.x) * dt / 6.0
        let dy = (k1.y + 2.0 * k2.y + 2.0 * k3.y + k4.y) * dt / 6.0

        // Check for stagnation
        let move_dist = sqrt_approx(dx * dx + dy * dy)
        if move_dist < 0.0001 {
            return
        }

        x = x + dx
        y = y + dy
        step = step + 1
    }
}

// Integrate both forward and backward from seed
fn integrate_streamline_bidirectional(
    field: &!StreamlineField,
    seed_x: f64,
    seed_y: f64,
    vector_fn: fn(f64, f64) -> Vec2
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Forward
    integrate_streamline(field, seed_x, seed_y, vector_fn)

    // Backward (negate vector field)
    // Note: Sounio doesn't support closures, so we'd need a separate function
    // For now, just do forward integration
}

// ============================================================================
// Seeding Strategies
// ============================================================================

// Grid seeding
fn seed_grid(
    field: &!StreamlineField,
    nx: i32,
    ny: i32,
    vector_fn: fn(f64, f64) -> Vec2
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let dx = (field.x_max - field.x_min) / ((nx + 1) as f64)
    let dy = (field.y_max - field.y_min) / ((ny + 1) as f64)

    var iy = 0
    while iy < ny {
        var ix = 0
        while ix < nx {
            let x = field.x_min + (ix + 1) as f64 * dx
            let y = field.y_min + (iy + 1) as f64 * dy
            integrate_streamline(field, x, y, vector_fn)
            ix = ix + 1
        }
        iy = iy + 1
    }
}

// Random seeding (using simple LCG)
fn seed_random(
    field: &!StreamlineField,
    count: i32,
    seed: i32,
    vector_fn: fn(f64, f64) -> Vec2
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var rng = seed

    var i = 0
    while i < count {
        // LCG: next = (a * current + c) mod m
        rng = (rng * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483647
        let rx = (rng as f64) / 2147483647.0

        rng = (rng * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483647
        let ry = (rng as f64) / 2147483647.0

        let x = field.x_min + rx * (field.x_max - field.x_min)
        let y = field.y_min + ry * (field.y_max - field.y_min)

        integrate_streamline(field, x, y, vector_fn)
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Rendering to Display Buffer
// ============================================================================

fn x_to_grid(field: &StreamlineField, x: f64) -> i32 with Div, Panic {
    let t = (x - field.x_min) / (field.x_max - field.x_min)
    return (t * ((field.width - 1) as f64)) as i32
}

fn y_to_grid(field: &StreamlineField, y: f64) -> i32 with Div, Panic {
    let t = (y - field.y_min) / (field.y_max - field.y_min)
    return (t * ((field.height - 1) as f64)) as i32
}

fn display_set(field: &!StreamlineField, x: i32, y: i32, ch: i32) with Mut {
    if x >= 0 {
        if x < field.width {
            if y >= 0 {
                if y < field.height {
                    let idx = y * field.width + x
                    if idx < 4096 {
                        field.display[idx] = ch
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

fn display_get(field: &StreamlineField, x: i32, y: i32) -> i32 {
    if x >= 0 {
        if x < field.width {
            if y >= 0 {
                if y < field.height {
                    let idx = y * field.width + x
                    if idx < 4096 {
                        return field.display[idx]
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return 32
}

// Get direction character based on angle
fn direction_char(dx: f64, dy: f64) -> i32 {
    // 8 directions: - | / \ arrows
    let angle = atan2_approx(dy, dx)  // Returns [-pi, pi]

    // Normalize to [0, 8)
    var sector = ((angle + 3.14159) / 0.7854) as i32  // 0.7854 = pi/4
    if sector < 0 { sector = 0 }
    if sector > 7 { sector = 7 }

    // Character codes for each direction
    if sector == 0 { return 45 }       // '-' left
    else { if sector == 1 { return 47 }   // '/' up-left
    else { if sector == 2 { return 124 }  // '|' up
    else { if sector == 3 { return 92 }   // '\' up-right
    else { if sector == 4 { return 45 }   // '-' right
    else { if sector == 5 { return 47 }   // '/' down-right
    else { if sector == 6 { return 124 }  // '|' down
    else { return 92 }}}}}}}               // '\' down-left
}

fn atan2_approx(y: f64, x: f64) -> f64 with Div, Panic {
    // Approximate atan2 using polynomial
    if x == 0.0 {
        if y > 0.0 { return 1.5708 }
        else { if y < 0.0 { return -1.5708 }
        else { return 0.0 }}
    }

    let ratio = y / x
    var atan_val = atan_approx(ratio)

    if x < 0.0 {
        if y >= 0.0 {
            atan_val = atan_val + 3.14159
        } else {
            atan_val = atan_val - 3.14159
        }
    }

    return atan_val
}

fn atan_approx(x: f64) -> f64 {
    // For small x, atan(x) ≈ x - x³/3 + x⁵/5
    if x > 1.0 {
        return 1.5708 - atan_approx(1.0 / x)
    }
    if x < -1.0 {
        return -1.5708 - atan_approx(1.0 / x)
    }

    let x2 = x * x
    let x3 = x2 * x
    let x5 = x3 * x2

    return x - x3 * 0.333 + x5 * 0.2
}

fn streamline_field_render_to_buffer(field: &!StreamlineField) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Clear display
    var i = 0
    while i < 4096 {
        field.display[i] = 32
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Draw each streamline
    var si = 0
    while si < field.num_streamlines {
        let sl = &field.streamlines[si]
        var pi = 0
        while pi < sl.num_points {
            let x = sl.points_x[pi]
            let y = sl.points_y[pi]
            let dx = sl.dirs_x[pi]
            let dy = sl.dirs_y[pi]

            let gx = x_to_grid(field, x)
            let gy = y_to_grid(field, y)

            let ch = direction_char(dx, dy)
            display_set(field, gx, gy, ch)

            pi = pi + 1
        }
        si = si + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Display Rendering
// ============================================================================

fn streamline_field_render(field: &StreamlineField) with IO, Div, Panic {
    print("\x1b[2J\x1b[H")

    print("\x1b[1m=== Streamline Visualization ===\x1b[0m\n")
    print("Streamlines: ")
    print_i32(field.num_streamlines)
    print("\n\n")

    // Y-axis
    print("  y\n")
    print("  ^\n")

    // Render from top to bottom
    var y = field.height - 1
    while y >= 0 {
        print("  |")

        var x = 0
        while x < field.width {
            let ch = display_get(field, x, y)
            print("\x1b[36m")  // Cyan
            print_char_code(ch)
            print("\x1b[0m")
            x = x + 1
        }

        print("\n")
        y = y - 1
    }

    // X-axis
    print("  +")
    var xi = 0
    while xi < field.width {
        print("-")
        xi = xi + 1
    }
    print("> x\n\n")
}

// ============================================================================
// Example Vector Fields
// ============================================================================

// Simple rotation (circular flow)
fn rotation_field(x: f64, y: f64) -> Vec2 {
    return vec2_new(0.0 - y, x)
}

// Saddle point
fn saddle_field(x: f64, y: f64) -> Vec2 {
    return vec2_new(x, 0.0 - y)
}

// Source at origin
fn source_field(x: f64, y: f64) -> Vec2 with Div, Panic {
    let r2 = x * x + y * y
    if r2 < 0.01 {
        return vec2_new(0.0, 0.0)
    }
    return vec2_new(x / r2, y / r2)
}

// Dipole field
fn dipole_field(x: f64, y: f64) -> Vec2 with Div, Panic {
    // Two sources at (-1, 0) and (1, 0) with opposite signs
    let r1_x = x + 1.0
    let r1_y = y
    let r1_sq = r1_x * r1_x + r1_y * r1_y + 0.1

    let r2_x = x - 1.0
    let r2_y = y
    let r2_sq = r2_x * r2_x + r2_y * r2_y + 0.1

    let vx = r1_x / r1_sq - r2_x / r2_sq
    let vy = r1_y / r1_sq - r2_y / r2_sq

    return vec2_new(vx, vy)
}

// Vortex pair
fn vortex_pair(x: f64, y: f64) -> Vec2 with Div, Panic {
    // Two vortices at (-1, 0) and (1, 0)
    let r1_x = x + 1.0
    let r1_y = y
    let r1_sq = r1_x * r1_x + r1_y * r1_y + 0.1

    let r2_x = x - 1.0
    let r2_y = y
    let r2_sq = r2_x * r2_x + r2_y * r2_y + 0.1

    // Vortex: perpendicular to radius
    let v1x = 0.0 - r1_y / r1_sq
    let v1y = r1_x / r1_sq

    let v2x = r2_y / r2_sq  // Opposite rotation
    let v2y = 0.0 - r2_x / r2_sq

    return vec2_new(v1x + v2x, v1y + v2y)
}

// Lorenz attractor (x-y projection of z derivative)
fn lorenz_xy(x: f64, y: f64) -> Vec2 {
    let sigma = 10.0
    return vec2_new(sigma * (y - x), x * 28.0 - y)
}

// ============================================================================
// Helper Functions
// ============================================================================

fn print_char_code(code: i32) with IO {
    if code == 32 { print(" ") }
    else { if code == 45 { print("-") }
    else { if code == 47 { print("/") }
    else { if code == 92 { print("\\") }
    else { if code == 124 { print("|") }
    else { print(".") }
    }}}}
}

fn print_i32(x: i32) with IO, Div, Panic {
    if x == 0 { print("0"); return }
    if x < 0 { print("-"); print_i32_unsigned(0 - x) }
    else { print_i32_unsigned(x) }
}

fn print_i32_unsigned(x: i32) with IO, Div, Panic {
    if x == 0 { return }
    let digit = x % 10
    let rest = x / 10
    if rest > 0 { print_i32_unsigned(rest) }
    print_digit(digit)
}

fn print_digit(d: i32) with IO {
    if d == 0 { print("0") }
    else { if d == 1 { print("1") }
    else { if d == 2 { print("2") }
    else { if d == 3 { print("3") }
    else { if d == 4 { print("4") }
    else { if d == 5 { print("5") }
    else { if d == 6 { print("6") }
    else { if d == 7 { print("7") }
    else { if d == 8 { print("8") }
    else { if d == 9 { print("9") }
    }}}}}}}}}}
}

// ============================================================================
// Main Demo
// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("Computing streamlines for dipole field...\n")

    // Create field
    var field = streamline_field_new(-3.0, 3.0, -3.0, 3.0, 60, 30)
    streamline_field_set_params(&!field, 0.05, 300)

    // Seed with a grid
    seed_grid(&!field, 6, 6, dipole_field)

    // Render to buffer
    streamline_field_render_to_buffer(&!field)

    // Display
    streamline_field_render(&field)

    print("\nDipole field: source at (-1,0), sink at (1,0)\n")
    print("Streamlines show electric field lines between opposite charges\n")

    return 0
}


// === FILE: examples/graphics/lib/60_graph.sio ===
// 60_graph.sio - Graph data structure for network visualization
//
// Provides fundamental graph structures for network analysis and visualization:
// - Nodes with position, label, color, and size
// - Edges with weight, direction, and styling
// - Adjacency operations and graph queries
//
// This module is the foundation for force-directed layouts, tree layouts,
// and graph rendering.

// ============================================================================
// Node Structure
// ============================================================================

struct GraphNode {
    id: i32,
    x: f64,           // Position x
    y: f64,           // Position y
    z: f64,           // Position z (for 3D layouts, usually 0)
    label_code: i32,  // Character code for label (A=65, B=66, etc.)
    color: i32,       // ANSI color code
    size: i32,        // Display size (1-3)
    fixed: i32        // 0 = movable, 1 = fixed position
}

fn node_new(id: i32) -> GraphNode {
    return GraphNode {
        id: id,
        x: 0.0,
        y: 0.0,
        z: 0.0,
        label_code: 65 + id,  // A, B, C, ...
        color: 37,            // White
        size: 1,
        fixed: 0
    }
}

fn node_new_at(id: i32, x: f64, y: f64) -> GraphNode {
    return GraphNode {
        id: id,
        x: x,
        y: y,
        z: 0.0,
        label_code: 65 + id,
        color: 37,
        size: 1,
        fixed: 0
    }
}

fn node_set_position(node: &!GraphNode, x: f64, y: f64) with Mut {
    node.x = x
    node.y = y
}

fn node_set_color(node: &!GraphNode, color: i32) with Mut {
    node.color = color
}

fn node_set_size(node: &!GraphNode, size: i32) with Mut {
    node.size = size
}

fn node_set_fixed(node: &!GraphNode, fixed: i32) with Mut {
    node.fixed = fixed
}

fn node_distance(n1: &GraphNode, n2: &GraphNode) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let dx = n2.x - n1.x
    let dy = n2.y - n1.y
    return sqrt_approx(dx * dx + dy * dy)
}

// ============================================================================
// Edge Structure
// ============================================================================

struct GraphEdge {
    from_id: i32,
    to_id: i32,
    weight: f64,
    color: i32,
    directed: i32,    // 0 = undirected, 1 = directed
    style: i32        // 0 = solid, 1 = dashed, 2 = dotted
}

fn edge_new(from_id: i32, to_id: i32) -> GraphEdge {
    return GraphEdge {
        from_id: from_id,
        to_id: to_id,
        weight: 1.0,
        color: 37,
        directed: 0,
        style: 0
    }
}

fn edge_new_weighted(from_id: i32, to_id: i32, weight: f64) -> GraphEdge {
    return GraphEdge {
        from_id: from_id,
        to_id: to_id,
        weight: weight,
        color: 37,
        directed: 0,
        style: 0
    }
}

fn edge_new_directed(from_id: i32, to_id: i32) -> GraphEdge {
    return GraphEdge {
        from_id: from_id,
        to_id: to_id,
        weight: 1.0,
        color: 37,
        directed: 1,
        style: 0
    }
}

fn edge_set_color(edge: &!GraphEdge, color: i32) with Mut {
    edge.color = color
}

fn edge_set_style(edge: &!GraphEdge, style: i32) with Mut {
    edge.style = style
}

// ============================================================================
// Graph Structure
// ============================================================================

struct Graph {
    nodes: [GraphNode; 100],
    edges: [GraphEdge; 500],
    n_nodes: i32,
    n_edges: i32,

    // Adjacency list (flat array with offsets)
    // adj_list[adj_offset[i]..adj_offset[i+1]] = neighbors of node i
    adj_list: [i32; 1000],
    adj_offset: [i32; 101],  // n_nodes + 1 offsets
    adj_built: i32           // 0 = needs rebuild, 1 = valid
}

fn graph_new() -> Graph {
    return Graph {
        nodes: [node_new(0); 100],
        edges: [edge_new(0, 0); 500],
        n_nodes: 0,
        n_edges: 0,
        adj_list: [0; 1000],
        adj_offset: [0; 101],
        adj_built: 0
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Node Operations
// ============================================================================

fn graph_add_node(graph: &!Graph, node: GraphNode) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    if graph.n_nodes >= 100 {
        return -1
    }
    let id = graph.n_nodes
    graph.nodes[id] = node
    graph.nodes[id].id = id
    graph.n_nodes = graph.n_nodes + 1
    graph.adj_built = 0
    return id
}

fn graph_add_node_at(graph: &!Graph, x: f64, y: f64) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    let node = node_new_at(graph.n_nodes, x, y)
    return graph_add_node(graph, node)
}

fn graph_get_node(graph: &Graph, id: i32) -> GraphNode with Panic {
    if id >= 0 {
        if id < graph.n_nodes {
            return graph.nodes[id]
        }
    }
    return node_new(-1)
}

fn graph_set_node_position(graph: &!Graph, id: i32, x: f64, y: f64) with Mut, Panic {
    if id >= 0 {
        if id < graph.n_nodes {
            graph.nodes[id].x = x
            graph.nodes[id].y = y
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Value-Passing Node Operations (for use in loops)
// ============================================================================

fn graph_add_node_v(graph: Graph, node: GraphNode) -> Graph with Mut, Panic {
    if graph.n_nodes >= 100 {
        return graph
    }
    var g = graph
    let id = g.n_nodes
    g.nodes[id] = node
    g.nodes[id].id = id
    g.n_nodes = g.n_nodes + 1
    g.adj_built = 0
    return g
}

fn graph_add_node_at_v(graph: Graph, x: f64, y: f64) -> Graph with Mut, Panic {
    let node = node_new_at(graph.n_nodes, x, y)
    return graph_add_node_v(graph, node)
}

// ============================================================================
// Edge Operations
// ============================================================================

fn graph_add_edge(graph: &!Graph, edge: GraphEdge) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    if graph.n_edges >= 500 {
        return -1
    }
    let id = graph.n_edges
    graph.edges[id] = edge
    graph.n_edges = graph.n_edges + 1
    graph.adj_built = 0
    return id
}

fn graph_connect(graph: &!Graph, from_id: i32, to_id: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    let edge = edge_new(from_id, to_id)
    return graph_add_edge(graph, edge)
}

fn graph_connect_weighted(graph: &!Graph, from_id: i32, to_id: i32, weight: f64) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    let edge = edge_new_weighted(from_id, to_id, weight)
    return graph_add_edge(graph, edge)
}

fn graph_connect_directed(graph: &!Graph, from_id: i32, to_id: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    let edge = edge_new_directed(from_id, to_id)
    return graph_add_edge(graph, edge)
}

// ============================================================================
// Value-Passing Edge Operations (for use in loops)
// ============================================================================

fn graph_add_edge_v(graph: Graph, edge: GraphEdge) -> Graph with Mut, Panic {
    if graph.n_edges >= 500 {
        return graph
    }
    var g = graph
    let id = g.n_edges
    g.edges[id] = edge
    g.n_edges = g.n_edges + 1
    g.adj_built = 0
    return g
}

fn graph_connect_v(graph: Graph, from_id: i32, to_id: i32) -> Graph with Mut, Panic {
    let edge = edge_new(from_id, to_id)
    return graph_add_edge_v(graph, edge)
}

fn graph_connect_weighted_v(graph: Graph, from_id: i32, to_id: i32, weight: f64) -> Graph with Mut, Panic {
    let edge = edge_new_weighted(from_id, to_id, weight)
    return graph_add_edge_v(graph, edge)
}

fn graph_connect_directed_v(graph: Graph, from_id: i32, to_id: i32) -> Graph with Mut, Panic {
    let edge = edge_new_directed(from_id, to_id)
    return graph_add_edge_v(graph, edge)
}

fn graph_has_edge(graph: &Graph, from_id: i32, to_id: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < graph.n_edges {
        let e = graph.edges[i]
        if e.from_id == from_id {
            if e.to_id == to_id {
                return 1
            }
        }
        // Check reverse for undirected
        if e.directed == 0 {
            if e.from_id == to_id {
                if e.to_id == from_id {
                    return 1
                }
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return 0
}

// ============================================================================
// Adjacency List
// ============================================================================

fn graph_build_adjacency(graph: &!Graph) with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if graph.adj_built == 1 {
        return
    }

    // Count neighbors for each node
    var counts: [i32; 100] = [0; 100]

    var e = 0
    while e < graph.n_edges {
        let edge = graph.edges[e]
        counts[edge.from_id] = counts[edge.from_id] + 1
        if edge.directed == 0 {
            counts[edge.to_id] = counts[edge.to_id] + 1
        }
        e = e + 1
    }

    // Build offsets
    graph.adj_offset[0] = 0
    var n = 0
    while n < graph.n_nodes {
        graph.adj_offset[n + 1] = graph.adj_offset[n] + counts[n]
        n = n + 1
    }

    // Reset counts for filling
    var c = 0
    while c < 100 {
        counts[c] = 0
        c = c + 1
    }

    // Fill adjacency list
    e = 0
    while e < graph.n_edges {
        let edge = graph.edges[e]
        let from = edge.from_id
        let to = edge.to_id

        let idx1 = graph.adj_offset[from] + counts[from]
        if idx1 < 1000 {
            graph.adj_list[idx1] = to
            counts[from] = counts[from] + 1
        }

        if edge.directed == 0 {
            let idx2 = graph.adj_offset[to] + counts[to]
            if idx2 < 1000 {
                graph.adj_list[idx2] = from
                counts[to] = counts[to] + 1
            }
        }

        e = e + 1
    }

    graph.adj_built = 1
}

// Value-passing version for use with local variables
fn graph_build_adjacency_v(graph: Graph) -> Graph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if graph.adj_built == 1 {
        return graph
    }

    var g = graph

    // Count neighbors for each node
    var counts: [i32; 100] = [0; 100]

    var e = 0
    while e < g.n_edges {
        let edge = g.edges[e]
        counts[edge.from_id] = counts[edge.from_id] + 1
        if edge.directed == 0 {
            counts[edge.to_id] = counts[edge.to_id] + 1
        }
        e = e + 1
    }

    // Build offsets
    g.adj_offset[0] = 0
    var n = 0
    while n < g.n_nodes {
        g.adj_offset[n + 1] = g.adj_offset[n] + counts[n]
        n = n + 1
    }

    // Reset counts for filling
    var c = 0
    while c < 100 {
        counts[c] = 0
        c = c + 1
    }

    // Fill adjacency list
    e = 0
    while e < g.n_edges {
        let edge = g.edges[e]
        let from = edge.from_id
        let to = edge.to_id

        let idx1 = g.adj_offset[from] + counts[from]
        if idx1 < 1000 {
            g.adj_list[idx1] = to
            counts[from] = counts[from] + 1
        }

        if edge.directed == 0 {
            let idx2 = g.adj_offset[to] + counts[to]
            if idx2 < 1000 {
                g.adj_list[idx2] = from
                counts[to] = counts[to] + 1
            }
        }

        e = e + 1
    }

    g.adj_built = 1
    return g
}

fn graph_degree(graph: &!Graph, node_id: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    graph_build_adjacency(graph)
    if node_id >= 0 {
        if node_id < graph.n_nodes {
            return graph.adj_offset[node_id + 1] - graph.adj_offset[node_id]
        }
    }
    return 0
}

fn graph_neighbor(graph: &!Graph, node_id: i32, neighbor_idx: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    graph_build_adjacency(graph)
    if node_id >= 0 {
        if node_id < graph.n_nodes {
            let start = graph.adj_offset[node_id]
            let end = graph.adj_offset[node_id + 1]
            let idx = start + neighbor_idx
            if idx >= start {
                if idx < end {
                    return graph.adj_list[idx]
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return -1
}

// ============================================================================
// Graph Queries
// ============================================================================

fn graph_center_of_mass(graph: &Graph) -> GraphNode with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if graph.n_nodes == 0 {
        return node_new(-1)
    }

    var cx = 0.0
    var cy = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < graph.n_nodes {
        cx = cx + graph.nodes[i].x
        cy = cy + graph.nodes[i].y
        i = i + 1
    }

    let n = graph.n_nodes as f64
    var result = node_new(-1)
    result.x = cx / n
    result.y = cy / n
    return result
}

fn graph_bounding_box(
    graph: &Graph
) -> GraphNode with Mut, Div, Panic {  // Returns (min_x, min_y) in x,y and (max_x, max_y) in z (hack)
    if graph.n_nodes == 0 {
        var empty = node_new(-1)
        empty.x = 0.0
        empty.y = 0.0
        empty.z = 0.0
        return empty
    }

    var min_x = graph.nodes[0].x
    var max_x = graph.nodes[0].x
    var min_y = graph.nodes[0].y
    var max_y = graph.nodes[0].y

    var i = 1
    while i < graph.n_nodes {
        let node = graph.nodes[i]
        if node.x < min_x { min_x = node.x }
        if node.x > max_x { max_x = node.x }
        if node.y < min_y { min_y = node.y }
        if node.y > max_y { max_y = node.y }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Encode both corners in result
    var result = node_new(-1)
    result.x = min_x
    result.y = min_y
    result.z = max_x  // Hack: store max values
    result.label_code = max_y as i32  // Another hack
    return result
}

// ============================================================================
// Graph Builders (Common Patterns)
// ============================================================================

fn graph_create_complete(n: i32) -> Graph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var graph = graph_new()

    // Add nodes in a circle
    let angle_step = 6.28318 / (n as f64)
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let angle = (i as f64) * angle_step
        let x = cos_approx(angle) * 10.0
        let y = sin_approx(angle) * 10.0
        graph = graph_add_node_at_v(graph, x, y)
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Connect all pairs
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        var j = i + 1
        while j < n {
            graph = graph_connect_v(graph, i, j)
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    return graph
}

fn graph_create_cycle(n: i32) -> Graph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var graph = graph_new()

    let angle_step = 6.28318 / (n as f64)
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let angle = (i as f64) * angle_step
        let x = cos_approx(angle) * 10.0
        let y = sin_approx(angle) * 10.0
        graph = graph_add_node_at_v(graph, x, y)
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Connect in cycle
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        let next = (i + 1) % n
        graph = graph_connect_v(graph, i, next)
        i = i + 1
    }

    return graph
}

fn graph_create_star(n: i32) -> Graph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var graph = graph_new()

    // Center node
    graph = graph_add_node_at_v(graph, 0.0, 0.0)

    // Outer nodes
    let angle_step = 6.28318 / ((n - 1) as f64)
    var i = 1
    while i < n {
        let angle = ((i - 1) as f64) * angle_step
        let x = cos_approx(angle) * 10.0
        let y = sin_approx(angle) * 10.0
        graph = graph_add_node_at_v(graph, x, y)

        // Connect to center
        graph = graph_connect_v(graph, 0, i)
        i = i + 1
    }

    return graph
}

fn graph_create_grid(rows: i32, cols: i32) -> Graph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var graph = graph_new()

    // Add nodes
    var r = 0
    while r < rows {
        var c = 0
        while c < cols {
            let x = (c as f64) * 3.0
            let y = (r as f64) * 3.0
            graph = graph_add_node_at_v(graph, x, y)
            c = c + 1
        }
        r = r + 1
    }

    // Connect horizontally and vertically
    r = 0
    while r < rows {
        var c = 0
        while c < cols {
            let id = r * cols + c

            // Right neighbor
            if c + 1 < cols {
                graph = graph_connect_v(graph, id, id + 1)
            }

            // Down neighbor
            if r + 1 < rows {
                graph = graph_connect_v(graph, id, id + cols)
            }

            c = c + 1
        }
        r = r + 1
    }

    return graph
}

fn graph_create_binary_tree(depth: i32) -> Graph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var graph = graph_new()

    // Number of nodes: 2^depth - 1
    var n = 1
    var d = 0
    while d < depth {
        n = n * 2
        d = d + 1
    }
    n = n - 1

    // Add nodes
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        graph = graph_add_node_at_v(graph, 0.0, 0.0)  // Positions set later
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Connect parent to children
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        let left = 2 * i + 1
        let right = 2 * i + 2
        if left < n {
            graph = graph_connect_v(graph, i, left)
        }
        if right < n {
            graph = graph_connect_v(graph, i, right)
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    return graph
}

// ============================================================================
// Math Helpers
// ============================================================================

fn sqrt_approx(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var guess = x * 0.5
    var i = 0
    while i < 10 {
        guess = (guess + x / guess) * 0.5
        i = i + 1
    }
    return guess
}

fn sin_approx(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    var xx = x
    while xx > 3.14159 { xx = xx - 6.28318 }
    while xx < -3.14159 { xx = xx + 6.28318 }
    let x2 = xx * xx
    let x3 = x2 * xx
    let x5 = x3 * x2
    return xx - x3 * 0.16667 + x5 * 0.00833
}

fn cos_approx(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    return sin_approx(x + 1.5708)
}

// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("Graph Data Structure Demo\n")
    print("========================\n\n")

    // Create a small social network graph using value-passing
    var graph = graph_new()

    // Add people (nodes) using value-passing
    graph = graph_add_node_at_v(graph, 0.0, 0.0)    // Alice (0)
    graph = graph_add_node_at_v(graph, 5.0, 0.0)    // Bob (1)
    graph = graph_add_node_at_v(graph, 2.5, 4.0)    // Carol (2)
    graph = graph_add_node_at_v(graph, -2.0, 3.0)   // Dave (3)
    graph = graph_add_node_at_v(graph, 7.0, 3.0)    // Eve (4)

    // Set node labels
    graph.nodes[0].label_code = 65  // A
    graph.nodes[1].label_code = 66  // B
    graph.nodes[2].label_code = 67  // C
    graph.nodes[3].label_code = 68  // D
    graph.nodes[4].label_code = 69  // E

    // Add friendships (edges) using value-passing
    graph = graph_connect_v(graph, 0, 1)  // Alice - Bob
    graph = graph_connect_v(graph, 0, 2)  // Alice - Carol
    graph = graph_connect_v(graph, 0, 3)  // Alice - Dave
    graph = graph_connect_v(graph, 1, 2)  // Bob - Carol
    graph = graph_connect_v(graph, 1, 4)  // Bob - Eve
    graph = graph_connect_v(graph, 2, 4)  // Carol - Eve

    print("Created graph with ")
    print_i32(graph.n_nodes)
    print(" nodes and ")
    print_i32(graph.n_edges)
    print(" edges\n\n")

    // Build adjacency list once before the loops (use value-passing)
    graph = graph_build_adjacency_v(graph)

    // Show degrees (adjacency already built, use direct lookup)
    print("Node degrees:\n")
    var i = 0
    while i < graph.n_nodes {
        let deg = graph.adj_offset[i + 1] - graph.adj_offset[i]
        print("  Node ")
        print_char(graph.nodes[i].label_code)
        print(": degree ")
        print_i32(deg)
        print("\n")
        i = i + 1
    }

    print("\nAdjacency lists:\n")
    i = 0
    while i < graph.n_nodes {
        let deg = graph.adj_offset[i + 1] - graph.adj_offset[i]
        print("  ")
        print_char(graph.nodes[i].label_code)
        print(" -> ")
        var j = 0
        while j < deg {
            let idx = graph.adj_offset[i] + j
            let neighbor = graph.adj_list[idx]
            print_char(graph.nodes[neighbor].label_code)
            if j < deg - 1 {
                print(", ")
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        print("\n")
        i = i + 1
    }

    print("\n--- Pre-built Graph Patterns ---\n\n")

    let complete = graph_create_complete(5)
    print("Complete K5: ")
    print_i32(complete.n_nodes)
    print(" nodes, ")
    print_i32(complete.n_edges)
    print(" edges\n")

    let cycle = graph_create_cycle(6)
    print("Cycle C6: ")
    print_i32(cycle.n_nodes)
    print(" nodes, ")
    print_i32(cycle.n_edges)
    print(" edges\n")

    let star = graph_create_star(7)
    print("Star S7: ")
    print_i32(star.n_nodes)
    print(" nodes, ")
    print_i32(star.n_edges)
    print(" edges\n")

    let grid = graph_create_grid(3, 4)
    print("Grid 3x4: ")
    print_i32(grid.n_nodes)
    print(" nodes, ")
    print_i32(grid.n_edges)
    print(" edges\n")

    let tree = graph_create_binary_tree(4)
    print("Binary tree depth 4: ")
    print_i32(tree.n_nodes)
    print(" nodes, ")
    print_i32(tree.n_edges)
    print(" edges\n")

    return 0
}

// ============================================================================
// Helper Functions
// ============================================================================

fn print_i32(x: i32) with IO, Div, Panic {
    if x == 0 { print("0"); return }
    if x < 0 { print("-"); print_i32_unsigned(0 - x) }
    else { print_i32_unsigned(x) }
}

fn print_i32_unsigned(x: i32) with IO, Div, Panic {
    if x == 0 { return }
    let digit = x % 10
    let rest = x / 10
    if rest > 0 { print_i32_unsigned(rest) }
    print_digit(digit)
}

fn print_digit(d: i32) with IO {
    if d == 0 { print("0") }
    else { if d == 1 { print("1") }
    else { if d == 2 { print("2") }
    else { if d == 3 { print("3") }
    else { if d == 4 { print("4") }
    else { if d == 5 { print("5") }
    else { if d == 6 { print("6") }
    else { if d == 7 { print("7") }
    else { if d == 8 { print("8") }
    else { if d == 9 { print("9") }
    }}}}}}}}}
}

fn print_char(code: i32) with IO {
    if code == 65 { print("A") }
    else { if code == 66 { print("B") }
    else { if code == 67 { print("C") }
    else { if code == 68 { print("D") }
    else { if code == 69 { print("E") }
    else { if code == 70 { print("F") }
    else { if code == 71 { print("G") }
    else { if code == 72 { print("H") }
    else { if code == 73 { print("I") }
    else { if code == 74 { print("J") }
    else { print("?") }
    }}}}}}}}}
}


// === FILE: examples/graphics/lib/61_force_directed.sio ===
// 61_force_directed.sio - Force-directed graph layout
//
// Implements the Fruchterman-Reingold algorithm for automatic graph layout.
// This physics-based approach models:
// - Repulsive forces between all node pairs (like electric charges)
// - Attractive forces along edges (like springs)
//
// The algorithm iteratively moves nodes to minimize energy, resulting in
// aesthetically pleasing layouts where connected nodes are close together
// and unconnected nodes are spread apart.

// ============================================================================
// Force Vector
// ============================================================================

struct ForceVec {
    fx: f64,
    fy: f64
}

fn force_new() -> ForceVec {
    return ForceVec { fx: 0.0, fy: 0.0 }
}

// ============================================================================
// Layout State
// ============================================================================

struct ForceDirectedLayout {
    // Layout area
    width: f64,
    height: f64,

    // Algorithm parameters
    k: f64,             // Optimal distance between nodes
    temperature: f64,   // Current temperature (decreases over time)
    cooling_rate: f64,  // Temperature reduction per iteration
    min_temp: f64,      // Stop when temperature falls below this

    // Force storage
    forces: [ForceVec; 100],

    // Iteration tracking
    iteration: i32,
    max_iterations: i32,
    converged: i32      // 1 if layout has converged
}

fn layout_new(width: f64, height: f64, n_nodes: i32) -> ForceDirectedLayout with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Optimal distance: proportional to sqrt(area / n_nodes)
    let area = width * height
    let k = sqrt_approx(area / (n_nodes as f64 + 1.0)) * 0.8

    return ForceDirectedLayout {
        width: width,
        height: height,
        k: k,
        temperature: width * 0.1,  // Start with large temperature
        cooling_rate: 0.95,
        min_temp: 0.01,
        forces: [force_new(); 100],
        iteration: 0,
        max_iterations: 500,
        converged: 0
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Graph Node/Edge Types (must match 60_graph.sio)
// ============================================================================

struct GraphNode {
    id: i32,
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
    z: f64,
    label_code: i32,
    color: i32,
    size: i32,
    fixed: i32
}

struct GraphEdge {
    from_id: i32,
    to_id: i32,
    weight: f64,
    color: i32,
    directed: i32,
    style: i32
}

// ============================================================================
// Value-Passing Layout Functions
// ============================================================================

// Single iteration of force-directed layout (value-passing version)
fn layout_step_v(
    layout: ForceDirectedLayout,
    nodes: [GraphNode; 100],
    n_nodes: i32,
    edges: &[GraphEdge],
    n_edges: i32
) -> LayoutResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var lay = layout
    var nds = nodes

    if lay.converged == 1 {
        return LayoutResult { layout: lay, nodes: nds }
    }
    if lay.iteration >= lay.max_iterations {
        lay.converged = 1
        return LayoutResult { layout: lay, nodes: nds }
    }

    // Reset forces
    var i = 0
    while i < n_nodes {
        lay.forces[i] = force_new()
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Compute repulsive forces between all node pairs
    let k = lay.k
    let k2 = k * k
    i = 0
    while i < n_nodes {
        let ni = nds[i]
        var j = 0
        while j < n_nodes {
            if i != j {
                let nj = nds[j]
                let dx = ni.x - nj.x
                let dy = ni.y - nj.y
                let dist2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + 0.0001
                let dist = sqrt_approx(dist2)
                let force_mag = k2 / dist
                let fx = (dx / dist) * force_mag
                let fy = (dy / dist) * force_mag
                lay.forces[i].fx = lay.forces[i].fx + fx
                lay.forces[i].fy = lay.forces[i].fy + fy
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Compute attractive forces along edges
    var e = 0
    while e < n_edges {
        let edge = edges[e]
        let from = edge.from_id
        let to = edge.to_id
        let n1 = nds[from]
        let n2 = nds[to]
        let dx = n2.x - n1.x
        let dy = n2.y - n1.y
        let dist = sqrt_approx(dx * dx + dy * dy) + 0.0001
        let force_mag = (dist * dist / k) * edge.weight
        let fx = (dx / dist) * force_mag
        let fy = (dy / dist) * force_mag
        lay.forces[from].fx = lay.forces[from].fx + fx
        lay.forces[from].fy = lay.forces[from].fy + fy
        lay.forces[to].fx = lay.forces[to].fx - fx
        lay.forces[to].fy = lay.forces[to].fy - fy
        e = e + 1
    }

    // Apply forces with temperature limiting
    let temp = lay.temperature
    let half_w = lay.width * 0.5
    let half_h = lay.height * 0.5
    var max_displacement = 0.0

    i = 0
    while i < n_nodes {
        if nds[i].fixed == 0 {
            // Limit force by temperature
            let mag = sqrt_approx(lay.forces[i].fx * lay.forces[i].fx + lay.forces[i].fy * lay.forces[i].fy)
            if mag > temp {
                if mag > 0.0001 {
                    lay.forces[i].fx = lay.forces[i].fx * temp / mag
                    lay.forces[i].fy = lay.forces[i].fy * temp / mag
                }
            }

            let fx = lay.forces[i].fx
            let fy = lay.forces[i].fy

            // Track displacement
            let disp = sqrt_approx(fx * fx + fy * fy)
            if disp > max_displacement {
                max_displacement = disp
            }

            // Update position
            nds[i].x = nds[i].x + fx
            nds[i].y = nds[i].y + fy

            // Keep within bounds
            if nds[i].x < 0.0 - half_w { nds[i].x = 0.0 - half_w }
            if nds[i].x > half_w { nds[i].x = half_w }
            if nds[i].y < 0.0 - half_h { nds[i].y = 0.0 - half_h }
            if nds[i].y > half_h { nds[i].y = half_h }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Check for convergence
    if max_displacement < lay.min_temp {
        lay.converged = 1
    }

    // Cool temperature
    lay.temperature = lay.temperature * lay.cooling_rate
    if lay.temperature < lay.min_temp {
        lay.temperature = lay.min_temp
    }
    lay.iteration = lay.iteration + 1

    return LayoutResult { layout: lay, nodes: nds }
}

// Result type for value-passing layout
struct LayoutResult {
    layout: ForceDirectedLayout,
    nodes: [GraphNode; 100]
}

// Run layout to completion (value-passing version)
fn layout_run_v(
    layout: ForceDirectedLayout,
    nodes: [GraphNode; 100],
    n_nodes: i32,
    edges: &[GraphEdge],
    n_edges: i32
) -> LayoutResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var result = LayoutResult { layout: layout, nodes: nodes }

    while result.layout.converged == 0 {
        if result.layout.iteration >= result.layout.max_iterations {
            break
        }
        result = layout_step_v(result.layout, result.nodes, n_nodes, edges, n_edges)
    }

    return result
}

// Initialize random positions for nodes (value-passing version)
fn layout_randomize_v(
    nodes: [GraphNode; 100],
    n_nodes: i32,
    width: f64,
    height: f64,
    seed: i32
) -> [GraphNode; 100] with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var nds = nodes
    var rng_state = seed
    if rng_state == 0 {
        rng_state = 12345
    }

    var i = 0
    while i < n_nodes {
        rng_state = (rng_state * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483647
        let rx = ((rng_state % 1000) as f64) / 1000.0
        rng_state = (rng_state * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483647
        let ry = ((rng_state % 1000) as f64) / 1000.0

        nds[i].x = (rx - 0.5) * width
        nds[i].y = (ry - 0.5) * height
        i = i + 1
    }
    return nds
}

// Center the layout around origin (value-passing version)
fn layout_center_v(
    nodes: [GraphNode; 100],
    n_nodes: i32
) -> [GraphNode; 100] with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if n_nodes == 0 { return nodes }

    var nds = nodes

    // Find center of mass
    var cx = 0.0
    var cy = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n_nodes {
        cx = cx + nds[i].x
        cy = cy + nds[i].y
        i = i + 1
    }
    cx = cx / (n_nodes as f64)
    cy = cy / (n_nodes as f64)

    // Shift all nodes
    i = 0
    while i < n_nodes {
        nds[i].x = nds[i].x - cx
        nds[i].y = nds[i].y - cy
        i = i + 1
    }
    return nds
}

// ============================================================================
// Math Helpers
// ============================================================================

fn sqrt_approx(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var guess = x * 0.5
    var i = 0
    while i < 10 {
        guess = (guess + x / guess) * 0.5
        i = i + 1
    }
    return guess
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("Force-Directed Layout Demo\n")

    // Create a sample graph (social network)

    edges[3] = GraphEdge { from_id: 1, to_id: 3, weight: 1.0, color: 37, directed: 0, style: 0 }
    edges[4] = GraphEdge { from_id: 2, to_id: 4, weight: 1.0, color: 37, directed: 0, style: 0 }
    edges[5] = GraphEdge { from_id: 3, to_id: 4, weight: 1.0, color: 37, directed: 0, style: 0 }
    edges[6] = GraphEdge { from_id: 3, to_id: 5, weight: 1.0, color: 37, directed: 0, style: 0 }
    edges[7] = GraphEdge { from_id: 4, to_id: 6, weight: 1.0, color: 37, directed: 0, style: 0 }
    edges[8] = GraphEdge { from_id: 5, to_id: 6, weight: 1.0, color: 37, directed: 0, style: 0 }
    edges[9] = GraphEdge { from_id: 5, to_id: 7, weight: 1.0, color: 37, directed: 0, style: 0 }
    edges[10] = GraphEdge { from_id: 6, to_id: 7, weight: 1.0, color: 37, directed: 0, style: 0 }
    edges[11] = GraphEdge { from_id: 0, to_id: 7, weight: 1.0, color: 37, directed: 0, style: 0 }

    // Randomize initial positions

    // Create layout and run
    var layout = layout_new(40.0, 40.0, n_nodes)
    print("\nRunning Fruchterman-Reingold layout...\n")
    print("k = ")
    print_f64(layout.k)
    print("\n\n")

    let result = layout_run_v(layout, nodes, n_nodes, &edges, n_edges)
    layout = result.layout
    nodes = result.nodes

    print("Layout completed after ")
    print_i32(layout.iteration)
    print(" iterations\n\n")

    // Center and show final positions
    nodes = layout_center_v(nodes, n_nodes)

    print("Final positions:\n")
    print_positions(&nodes, n_nodes)

    print("\nLayout quality indicators:\n")
    print("- Converged: ")
    if layout.converged == 1 { print("yes\n") } else { print("no\n") }
    print("- Final temperature: ")
    print_f64(layout.temperature)
    print("\n")

    return 0
}

fn print_positions(nodes: &[GraphNode], n: i32) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        print("  ")
        print_char(nodes[i].label_code)
        print(": (")
        print_f64(nodes[i].x)
        print(", ")
        print_f64(nodes[i].y)
        print(")\n")
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// === FILE: examples/graphics/lib/62_tree_layout.sio ===
// 62_tree_layout.sio - Tree layout algorithms
//
// Provides hierarchical tree layout algorithms for visualizing tree structures:
// - Binary tree layout: classic top-down arrangement
// - Radial tree layout: circular arrangement from center
// - Reingold-Tilford algorithm: space-efficient tree drawing
//
// Trees are a special case of graphs with no cycles and a designated root.

// ============================================================================
// Tree Node (extends GraphNode with tree-specific data)
// ============================================================================

struct TreeNode {
    // Core graph properties
    id: i32,
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
    label_code: i32,
    color: i32,
    size: i32,

    // Tree-specific properties
    parent: i32,           // Parent node ID (-1 for root)
    children: [i32; 20],   // Child node IDs
    n_children: i32,
    depth: i32,            // Distance from root

    // Layout helpers
    subtree_width: f64,    // Width of subtree rooted here
    prelim: f64,           // Preliminary x-coordinate
    modifier: f64          // Modifier for subtree positioning
}

fn tree_node_new(id: i32) -> TreeNode {
    return TreeNode {
        id: id,
        x: 0.0,
        y: 0.0,
        label_code: 65 + id,
        color: 37,
        size: 1,
        parent: -1,
        children: [-1; 20],
        n_children: 0,
        depth: 0,
        subtree_width: 1.0,
        prelim: 0.0,
        modifier: 0.0
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Tree Structure
// ============================================================================

struct Tree {
    nodes: [TreeNode; 100],
    n_nodes: i32,
    root: i32,             // Root node ID

    // Layout parameters
    level_height: f64,     // Vertical distance between levels
    node_separation: f64,  // Horizontal distance between siblings
    subtree_separation: f64 // Horizontal distance between subtrees
}

fn tree_new() -> Tree {
    return Tree {
        nodes: [tree_node_new(0); 100],
        n_nodes: 0,
        root: -1,
        level_height: 3.0,
        node_separation: 2.0,
        subtree_separation: 3.0
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Tree Construction (Value-Passing)
// ============================================================================

fn tree_add_root_v(tree: Tree, label: i32) -> Tree with Mut, Panic {
    var t = tree
    if t.n_nodes >= 100 { return t }

    let id = t.n_nodes
    t.nodes[id] = tree_node_new(id)
    t.nodes[id].label_code = label
    t.nodes[id].depth = 0
    t.root = id
    t.n_nodes = t.n_nodes + 1
    return t
}

fn tree_add_child_v(tree: Tree, parent_id: i32, label: i32) -> Tree with Mut, Panic {
    var t = tree
    if t.n_nodes >= 100 { return t }
    if parent_id < 0 { return t }
    if parent_id >= t.n_nodes { return t }

    let id = t.n_nodes
    t.nodes[id] = tree_node_new(id)
    t.nodes[id].label_code = label
    t.nodes[id].parent = parent_id
    t.nodes[id].depth = t.nodes[parent_id].depth + 1

    // Add child to parent's children array
    if t.nodes[parent_id].n_children < 20 {
        t.nodes[parent_id].children[t.nodes[parent_id].n_children] = id
        t.nodes[parent_id].n_children = t.nodes[parent_id].n_children + 1
    }

    t.n_nodes = t.n_nodes + 1
    return t
}

fn tree_depth(tree: &Tree) -> i32 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var max_depth = 0
    var i = 0
    while i < tree.n_nodes {
        if tree.nodes[i].depth > max_depth {
            max_depth = tree.nodes[i].depth
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return max_depth
}

// ============================================================================
// Simple Binary Tree Layout (Value-Passing)
// ============================================================================

fn tree_layout_simple_v(tree: Tree) -> Tree with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var t = tree
    if t.root < 0 { return t }

    // Compute subtree widths bottom-up
    t = compute_subtree_widths_v(t)

    // Position root
    t.nodes[t.root].x = 0.0
    t.nodes[t.root].y = 0.0

    // Position children top-down
    t = position_children_simple_v(t, t.root)
    return t
}

fn compute_subtree_widths_v(tree: Tree) -> Tree with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var t = tree
    // Process nodes in reverse order (children before parents)
    var i = t.n_nodes - 1
    while i >= 0 {
        if t.nodes[i].n_children == 0 {
            t.nodes[i].subtree_width = 1.0
        } else {
            var width = 0.0
            var c = 0
            while c < t.nodes[i].n_children {
                let child = t.nodes[i].children[c]
                if child >= 0 {
                    width = width + t.nodes[child].subtree_width
                }
                c = c + 1
            }
            // Add separation between children
            let n_gaps = t.nodes[i].n_children - 1
            if n_gaps > 0 {
                width = width + (n_gaps as f64) * t.node_separation
            }
            t.nodes[i].subtree_width = width
        }
        i = i - 1
    }
    return t
}

fn position_children_simple_v(tree: Tree, node_id: i32) -> Tree with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var t = tree
    let node = t.nodes[node_id]
    let n_children = node.n_children

    if n_children == 0 { return t }

    // Starting x position for leftmost child
    var x_offset = node.x - node.subtree_width * 0.5

    var c = 0
    while c < n_children {
        let child_id = node.children[c]
        if child_id >= 0 {
            let child_width = t.nodes[child_id].subtree_width

            // Center child within its subtree space
            t.nodes[child_id].x = x_offset + child_width * 0.5
            t.nodes[child_id].y = node.y + t.level_height

            // Move offset for next child
            x_offset = x_offset + child_width + t.node_separation

            // Recursively position grandchildren
            t = position_children_simple_v(t, child_id)
        }
        c = c + 1
    }
    return t
}

// ============================================================================
// Radial Tree Layout (Value-Passing)
// ============================================================================

fn tree_layout_radial_v(tree: Tree, radius_step: f64) -> Tree with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var t = tree
    if t.root < 0 { return t }

    // Root at center
    t.nodes[t.root].x = 0.0
    t.nodes[t.root].y = 0.0

    // Compute angular extents for each subtree
    t = compute_angular_widths_v(t)

    // Position nodes radially
    t = position_children_radial_v(t, t.root, 0.0, 6.28318, radius_step)
    return t
}

fn compute_angular_widths_v(tree: Tree) -> Tree with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var t = tree
    var i = t.n_nodes - 1
    while i >= 0 {
        if t.nodes[i].n_children == 0 {
            t.nodes[i].subtree_width = 1.0
        } else {
            var width = 0.0
            var c = 0
            while c < t.nodes[i].n_children {
                let child = t.nodes[i].children[c]
                if child >= 0 {
                    width = width + t.nodes[child].subtree_width
                }
                c = c + 1
            }
            t.nodes[i].subtree_width = width
        }
        i = i - 1
    }
    return t
}

fn position_children_radial_v(
    tree: Tree,
    node_id: i32,
    angle_start: f64,
    angle_end: f64,
    radius_step: f64
) -> Tree with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var t = tree
    let node = t.nodes[node_id]
    let n_children = node.n_children

    if n_children == 0 { return t }

    let radius = (node.depth as f64 + 1.0) * radius_step
    let total_angular_span = angle_end - angle_start

    var current_angle = angle_start

    var c = 0
    while c < n_children {
        let child_id = node.children[c]
        if child_id >= 0 {
            let child_width = t.nodes[child_id].subtree_width
            let parent_width = t.nodes[node_id].subtree_width

            let angular_width = if parent_width > 0.0 {
                (child_width / parent_width) * total_angular_span
            } else {
                total_angular_span / (n_children as f64)
            }

            let mid_angle = current_angle + angular_width * 0.5
            t.nodes[child_id].x = cos_approx(mid_angle) * radius
            t.nodes[child_id].y = sin_approx(mid_angle) * radius

            t = position_children_radial_v(
                t, child_id,
                current_angle, current_angle + angular_width,
                radius_step
            )

            current_angle = current_angle + angular_width
        }
        c = c + 1
    }
    return t
}

// ============================================================================
// Reingold-Tilford Algorithm (Value-Passing)
// ============================================================================

fn tree_layout_reingold_tilford_v(tree: Tree) -> Tree with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var t = tree
    if t.root < 0 { return t }

    // First pass: compute preliminary positions bottom-up
    t = rt_first_walk_v(t, t.root)

    // Second pass: compute final positions top-down
    t = rt_second_walk_v(t, t.root, 0.0)

    // Set y-coordinates based on depth
    var i = 0
    while i < t.n_nodes {
        t.nodes[i].y = (t.nodes[i].depth as f64) * t.level_height
        i = i + 1
    }
    return t
}

fn rt_first_walk_v(tree: Tree, node_id: i32) -> Tree with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var t = tree
    let n_children = t.nodes[node_id].n_children

    if n_children == 0 {
        t.nodes[node_id].prelim = 0.0
        return t
    }

    // Process children first
    var c = 0
    while c < n_children {
        let child_id = t.nodes[node_id].children[c]
        if child_id >= 0 {
            t = rt_first_walk_v(t, child_id)
        }
        c = c + 1
    }

    // Position children relative to each other
    c = 0
    while c < n_children {
        let child_id = t.nodes[node_id].children[c]
        if child_id >= 0 {
            if c == 0 {
                t.nodes[child_id].prelim = 0.0
            } else {
                let prev_child = t.nodes[node_id].children[c - 1]
                if prev_child >= 0 {
                    let min_sep = t.node_separation +
                        t.nodes[prev_child].subtree_width * 0.5 +
                        t.nodes[child_id].subtree_width * 0.5

                    t.nodes[child_id].prelim =
                        t.nodes[prev_child].prelim + min_sep
                }
            }
        }
        c = c + 1
    }

    // Center parent over children
    let first_child = t.nodes[node_id].children[0]
    let last_child = t.nodes[node_id].children[n_children - 1]

    if first_child >= 0 {
        if last_child >= 0 {
            let midpoint = (t.nodes[first_child].prelim +
                           t.nodes[last_child].prelim) * 0.5
            t.nodes[node_id].prelim = midpoint
        }
    }

    // Compute subtree width for this node
    t = compute_subtree_widths_v(t)
    return t
}

fn rt_second_walk_v(tree: Tree, node_id: i32, modifier: f64) -> Tree with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var t = tree
    t.nodes[node_id].x = t.nodes[node_id].prelim + modifier

    let n_children = t.nodes[node_id].n_children
    var c = 0
    while c < n_children {
        let child_id = t.nodes[node_id].children[c]
        if child_id >= 0 {
            t = rt_second_walk_v(t, child_id, modifier + t.nodes[node_id].modifier)
        }
        c = c + 1
    }
    return t
}

// ============================================================================
// Tree Builders (Value-Passing)
// ============================================================================

fn tree_create_binary(depth: i32) -> Tree with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var tree = tree_new()

    // Create root
    tree = tree_add_root_v(tree, 65)  // 'A'

    // Build binary tree level by level
    var level_start = 0
    var level_size = 1
    var d = 0

    while d < depth - 1 {
        var i = 0
        while i < level_size {
            let parent = level_start + i
            // Add left child
            tree = tree_add_child_v(tree, parent, tree.n_nodes + 65)
            // Add right child
            tree = tree_add_child_v(tree, parent, tree.n_nodes + 65)
            i = i + 1
        }
        level_start = level_start + level_size
        level_size = level_size * 2
        d = d + 1
    }

    return tree
}

fn tree_create_random(n_nodes: i32, max_children: i32, seed: i32) -> Tree with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var tree = tree_new()
    var rng = seed
    if rng == 0 { rng = 12345 }

    // Create root
    tree = tree_add_root_v(tree, 65)

    // Add remaining nodes
    var i = 1
    while i < n_nodes {
        // Pick a random existing node as parent
        rng = (rng * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483647
        let parent = rng % tree.n_nodes

        // Check if parent can have more children
        if tree.nodes[parent].n_children < max_children {
            tree = tree_add_child_v(tree, parent, 65 + i)
        } else {
            // Try to find another parent
            var found = 0
            var try_idx = 0
            while try_idx < tree.n_nodes {
                if tree.nodes[try_idx].n_children < max_children {
                    tree = tree_add_child_v(tree, try_idx, 65 + i)
                    found = 1
                    try_idx = tree.n_nodes  // Break
                }
                try_idx = try_idx + 1
            }
            if found == 0 {
                i = n_nodes  // Can't add more, stop
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    return tree
}

// ============================================================================
// Math Helpers
// ============================================================================

fn sin_approx(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    var xx = x
    while xx > 3.14159 { xx = xx - 6.28318 }
    while xx < -3.14159 { xx = xx + 6.28318 }
    let x2 = xx * xx
    let x3 = x2 * xx
    let x5 = x3 * x2
    return xx - x3 * 0.16667 + x5 * 0.00833
}

fn cos_approx(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    return sin_approx(x + 1.5708)
}

// ============================================================================
// Main Demo
// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("Tree Layout Demo\n")
    print("================\n\n")

    // Create a binary tree of depth 4
    var tree = tree_create_binary(4)

    print("Created binary tree with ")
    print_i32(tree.n_nodes)
    print(" nodes, depth ")
    print_i32(tree_depth(&tree))
    print("\n\n")

    // Apply simple layout
    print("=== Simple Layout ===\n")
    tree = tree_layout_simple_v(tree)
    print_tree_positions(&tree)

    // Apply radial layout
    print("\n=== Radial Layout ===\n")
    tree = tree_layout_radial_v(tree, 5.0)
    print_tree_positions(&tree)

    // Apply Reingold-Tilford layout
    print("\n=== Reingold-Tilford Layout ===\n")
    tree = tree_layout_reingold_tilford_v(tree)
    print_tree_positions(&tree)

    // Create and layout a random tree
    print("\n=== Random Tree (10 nodes, max 3 children) ===\n")
    var random_tree = tree_create_random(10, 3, 42)
    random_tree = tree_layout_simple_v(random_tree)
    print_tree_positions(&random_tree)

    return 0
}

fn print_tree_positions(tree: &Tree) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < tree.n_nodes {
        let node = tree.nodes[i]
        print("  ")
        print_char(node.label_code)
        print(" (depth ")
        print_i32(node.depth)
        print("): (")
        print_f64(node.x)
        print(", ")
        print_f64(node.y)
        print(")")
        if node.parent >= 0 {
            print(" parent=")
            print_char(tree.nodes[node.parent].label_code)
        } else {
            print(" [root]")
        }
        print("\n")
        i = i + 1
    }
}
