// === FILE: examples/hssm_4way_benchmark.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// H-SSM 4-Way Benchmark: O-SSM vs S4-DIAG vs Naive-DIAG vs H-SSM
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// H-SSM uses TRUE Hamilton quaternion multiplication (non-commutative, associative).
// 8-dim state = 2 independent 4D quaternions.
// State update: h' = quat_mul(q_A, h) + B * embed[token]
//
// Tests on ListOps (L=15) and Bracket (L=12):
// - If O-SSM >> H-SSM: non-associativity is the driver
// - If O-SSM ≈ H-SSM: cross-dimensional coupling suffices

fn exp_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 15.0 { return exp_q(7.5) * exp_q(x - 7.5) }
    if x < 0.0 - 15.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0; var term = 1.0; var i = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); sum = sum + term; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}

var RNG_A: i64 = 0; var RNG_B: i64 = 0
fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }
fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A; let y = RNG_B; RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23); x = x ^ (x >> 17); x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x; let r = x + y; if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}

// ─── ListOps Task ───
var SEQ: [i64; 32] = [0; 32]; var SEQ_POS: i64 = 0
fn min_val(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }
fn max_val(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }
fn compute_med3(a: i64, b: i64, c: i64) -> i64 {
    if a <= b { if b <= c { b } else { if a <= c { c } else { a } } }
    else { if a <= c { a } else { if b <= c { c } else { b } } }
}

fn apply_op(op: i64, vals: i64, v0: i64, v1: i64, v2: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    if op == 10 {
        var r = v0; if vals >= 2 { r = min_val(r, v1) }; if vals >= 3 { r = min_val(r, v2) }; r
    } else {
        if op == 11 {
            var r = v0; if vals >= 2 { r = max_val(r, v1) }; if vals >= 3 { r = max_val(r, v2) }; r
        } else {
            if vals >= 3 { compute_med3(v0, v1, v2) } else { if vals >= 2 { min_val(v0, v1) } else { v0 } }
        }
    }
}

fn gen_flat_expr() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let op = (rng_next() / 100) % 3 + 10; let nargs = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 + 2
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = op; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    var v0 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; var v1 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; var v2 = 0
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v0; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1; SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v1; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    if nargs == 3 { v2 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v2; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1 }
    apply_op(op, nargs, v0, v1, v2)
}

fn gen_nested_expr() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let outer_op = (rng_next() / 100) % 3 + 10; let outer_nargs = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 + 2
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = outer_op; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    var vals: [i64; 3] = [0; 3]; var ai = 0
    while ai < outer_nargs {
        let nest = (rng_next() / 100) % 3
        if nest == 0 { vals[ai] = gen_flat_expr() }
        else { let d = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; SEQ[SEQ_POS] = d; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1; vals[ai] = d }
        ai = ai + 1
    }
    apply_op(outer_op, outer_nargs, vals[0], vals[1], vals[2])
}

fn generate_sample_lo(target_len: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    SEQ_POS = 0; let result = gen_nested_expr()
    var actual_len = SEQ_POS
    while actual_len < target_len { SEQ[actual_len] = 0; actual_len = actual_len + 1 }
    if SEQ_POS > target_len { SEQ_POS = target_len } else { SEQ_POS = target_len }
    result
}

// ─── Bracket Task ───
var BR_SEQ: [i64; 20] = [0; 20]; var BR_SEQ_LEN: i64 = 0
var STK: [i64; 10] = [0; 10]; var STK_TOP: i64 = 0

fn check_balanced(slen: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    STK_TOP = 0; var i = 0
    while i < slen {
        let tok = BR_SEQ[i]
        if tok == 1 { STK[STK_TOP] = 1; STK_TOP = STK_TOP + 1 }
        if tok == 3 { STK[STK_TOP] = 3; STK_TOP = STK_TOP + 1 }
        if tok == 2 { if STK_TOP == 0 { return 0 }; STK_TOP = STK_TOP - 1; if STK[STK_TOP] != 1 { return 0 } }
        if tok == 4 { if STK_TOP == 0 { return 0 }; STK_TOP = STK_TOP - 1; if STK[STK_TOP] != 3 { return 0 } }
        if STK_TOP > 9 { return 0 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if STK_TOP == 0 { 1 } else { 0 }
}

fn generate_balanced(slen: i64) with Mut, Div {
    STK_TOP = 0; var pos = 0
    while pos < slen {
        let remaining = slen - pos; let can_open = STK_TOP < remaining / 2; let can_close = STK_TOP > 0
        var choice = 0
        if can_open { if can_close { choice = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 } }
        if can_open { if can_close == false { choice = 0 } }
        if can_open == false { if can_close { choice = 1 } }
        if choice == 0 {
            let btype = (rng_next() / 100) % 2
            if btype == 0 { BR_SEQ[pos] = 1; STK[STK_TOP] = 1 }
            if btype == 1 { BR_SEQ[pos] = 3; STK[STK_TOP] = 3 }
            STK_TOP = STK_TOP + 1
        }
        if choice == 1 { STK_TOP = STK_TOP - 1; let top = STK[STK_TOP]; if top == 1 { BR_SEQ[pos] = 2 }; if top == 3 { BR_SEQ[pos] = 4 } }
        pos = pos + 1
    }
}

fn generate_unbalanced(slen: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var attempts = 0; var done = 0
    while done == 0 {
        var i = 0
        while i < slen { BR_SEQ[i] = (rng_next() / 100) % 4 + 1; i = i + 1 }
        if check_balanced(slen) == 0 { done = 1 }
        attempts = attempts + 1
        if attempts > 30 { BR_SEQ[0] = 2; BR_SEQ[1] = 4; done = 1 }
    }
}

fn generate_sample_br(slen: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let cls = (rng_next() / 100) % 2
    if cls == 1 { generate_balanced(slen) }
    if cls == 0 { generate_unbalanced(slen) }
    BR_SEQ_LEN = slen; cls
}

// ─── Models ───
var W: [i64; 256] = [0; 256]
var H: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]
var L: [i64; 10] = [0; 10]
var MOM: [i64; 256] = [0; 256]

fn ws(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { W[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn wg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (W[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn hs(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { H[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn hg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (H[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }

fn init_embed_b_out() with Mut, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < 104 { ws(i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { ws(168 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 80 { ws(176 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 256 { MOM[i] = 0; i = i + 1 }
}

fn init_A_ossm() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 {
        var v = ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 10000.0
        let row = i / 8; let col = i - row * 8
        if row == col { v = 0.95 }
        ws(104 + i, v); i = i + 1
    }
}

fn init_A_s4diag() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 { ws(104 + i, 0.0); i = i + 1 }
    var k = 0
    while k < 4 {
        let a = 0.0 - 0.5; let b = 3.14159265 * (2.0 * (k as f64) + 1.0) / 2.0; let ea = exp_q(a)
        var bmod = b
        while bmod > 3.14159265 { bmod = bmod - 6.28318530 }
        while bmod < 0.0 - 3.14159265 { bmod = bmod + 6.28318530 }
        let b2 = bmod * bmod
        let cos_b = 1.0 - b2/2.0 + b2*b2/24.0 - b2*b2*b2/720.0
        let sin_b = bmod - bmod*b2/6.0 + bmod*b2*b2/120.0 - bmod*b2*b2*b2/5040.0
        let r = k * 2
        ws(104 + r*8 + r, ea * cos_b); ws(104 + r*8 + r + 1, 0.0 - ea * sin_b)
        ws(104 + (r+1)*8 + r, ea * sin_b); ws(104 + (r+1)*8 + r + 1, ea * cos_b)
        k = k + 1
    }
}

fn init_A_naive_diag() with Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 { ws(104 + i, 0.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { ws(104 + i*8 + i, 0.95); i = i + 1 }
}

fn init_A_hssm() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // H-SSM: 8 quaternion params (A[0..7]) = two independent 4D quaternions
    // First quat: w,x,y,z at A[0..3], normalized to near-unit with decay 0.95
    // Second quat: w,x,y,z at A[4..7]
    // A[8..63] unused (zeroed)
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 { ws(104 + i, 0.0); i = i + 1 }

    // Quat 1: (w=0.95, xyz=small_random)
    ws(104 + 0, 0.95)  // w
    ws(104 + 1, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)  // x
    ws(104 + 2, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)  // y
    ws(104 + 3, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)  // z

    // Quat 2: (w=0.95, xyz=small_random)
    ws(104 + 4, 0.95)  // w
    ws(104 + 5, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)  // x
    ws(104 + 6, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)  // y
    ws(104 + 7, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)  // z
}

// ─── Model Steps ───

fn ossm_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var new_h: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]; var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let inp = wg(token * 8 + d); var s = 0.0; var j = 0
        while j < 8 { s = s + wg(104 + d*8 + j) * hg(j); j = j + 1 }
        s = s + wg(168 + d) * inp
        if s > 5.0 { s = 5.0 } if s < 0.0 - 5.0 { s = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        new_h[d] = s; d = d + 1
    }
    d = 0
    while d < 8 { hs(d, new_h[d]); d = d + 1 }
}

fn s4diag_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var new_h: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]; var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let inp = wg(token * 8 + d); var s = 0.0; var j = 0
        while j < 8 { s = s + wg(104 + d*8 + j) * hg(j); j = j + 1 }
        s = s + wg(168 + d) * inp
        if s > 5.0 { s = 5.0 } if s < 0.0 - 5.0 { s = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        new_h[d] = s; d = d + 1
    }
    d = 0
    while d < 8 { hs(d, new_h[d]); d = d + 1 }
}

fn naive_diag_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var s = wg(104 + d*8 + d) * hg(d) + wg(168 + d) * wg(token * 8 + d)
        if s > 5.0 { s = 5.0 } if s < 0.0 - 5.0 { s = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        hs(d, s); d = d + 1
    }
}

fn hssm_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    // H-SSM: h' = quat_mul(q_A, h) + B * embed[token]
    // Dims 0-3: quat_mul(A[0..3], h[0..3])
    // Dims 4-7: quat_mul(A[4..7], h[4..7]) independently

    // Half 1: Hamilton product on dims 0-3
    let aw = wg(104 + 0); let ax = wg(104 + 1); let ay = wg(104 + 2); let az = wg(104 + 3)
    let hw0 = hg(0); let hx0 = hg(1); let hy0 = hg(2); let hz0 = hg(3)

    let nw0 = aw*hw0 - ax*hx0 - ay*hy0 - az*hz0
    let nx0 = aw*hx0 + ax*hw0 + ay*hz0 - az*hy0
    let ny0 = aw*hy0 - ax*hz0 + ay*hw0 + az*hx0
    let nz0 = aw*hz0 + ax*hy0 - ay*hx0 + az*hw0

    var new_h0 = nw0 + wg(168 + 0) * wg(token * 8 + 0)
    var new_h1 = nx0 + wg(168 + 1) * wg(token * 8 + 1)
    var new_h2 = ny0 + wg(168 + 2) * wg(token * 8 + 2)
    var new_h3 = nz0 + wg(168 + 3) * wg(token * 8 + 3)

    if new_h0 > 5.0 { new_h0 = 5.0 } if new_h0 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h0 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if new_h1 > 5.0 { new_h1 = 5.0 } if new_h1 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h1 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if new_h2 > 5.0 { new_h2 = 5.0 } if new_h2 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h2 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if new_h3 > 5.0 { new_h3 = 5.0 } if new_h3 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h3 = 0.0 - 5.0 }

    // Half 2: Hamilton product on dims 4-7
    let aw2 = wg(104 + 4); let ax2 = wg(104 + 5); let ay2 = wg(104 + 6); let az2 = wg(104 + 7)
    let hw1 = hg(4); let hx1 = hg(5); let hy1 = hg(6); let hz1 = hg(7)

    let nw1 = aw2*hw1 - ax2*hx1 - ay2*hy1 - az2*hz1
    let nx1 = aw2*hx1 + ax2*hw1 + ay2*hz1 - az2*hy1
    let ny1 = aw2*hy1 - ax2*hz1 + ay2*hw1 + az2*hx1
    let nz1 = aw2*hz1 + ax2*hy1 - ay2*hx1 + az2*hw1

    var new_h4 = nw1 + wg(168 + 4) * wg(token * 8 + 4)
    var new_h5 = nx1 + wg(168 + 5) * wg(token * 8 + 5)
    var new_h6 = ny1 + wg(168 + 6) * wg(token * 8 + 6)
    var new_h7 = nz1 + wg(168 + 7) * wg(token * 8 + 7)

    if new_h4 > 5.0 { new_h4 = 5.0 } if new_h4 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h4 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if new_h5 > 5.0 { new_h5 = 5.0 } if new_h5 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h5 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if new_h6 > 5.0 { new_h6 = 5.0 } if new_h6 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h6 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if new_h7 > 5.0 { new_h7 = 5.0 } if new_h7 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h7 = 0.0 - 5.0 }

    // Update hidden state
    hs(0, new_h0); hs(1, new_h1); hs(2, new_h2); hs(3, new_h3)
    hs(4, new_h4); hs(5, new_h5); hs(6, new_h6); hs(7, new_h7)
}

fn compute_logits() with Mut, Div {
    var c = 0
    while c < 10 {
        var s = 0.0; var d = 0
        while d < 8 { s = s + hg(d) * wg(176 + d * 10 + c); d = d + 1 }
        L[c] = (s * 100000000.0) as i64; c = c + 1
    }
}

fn get_pred() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    var best = 0; var bv = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0; var i = 1
    while i < 10 { let v = (L[i] as f64)/100000000.0; if v > bv { bv = v; best = i }; i = i + 1 }
    best
}

fn update_out(tgt: i64, lr: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var mx = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0; var i = 1
    while i < 10 { let v = (L[i] as f64)/100000000.0; if v > mx { mx = v }; i = i + 1 }
    var probs: [f64; 10] = [0.0; 10]; var se = 0.0; i = 0
    while i < 10 { probs[i] = exp_q((L[i] as f64)/100000000.0 - mx); se = se + probs[i]; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 10 { probs[i] = probs[i] / se; i = i + 1 }
    probs[tgt] = probs[tgt] - 1.0
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let hd = hg(d); var c = 0
        while c < 10 {
            let idx = 176 + d * 10 + c
            var g = hd * probs[c]
            if g > 0.3 { g = 0.3 } if g < 0.0 - 0.3 { g = 0.0 - 0.3 }
            let m = (MOM[idx] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + g
            MOM[idx] = (m * 100000000.0) as i64
            ws(idx, wg(idx) - lr * m)
            c = c + 1
        }
        d = d + 1
    }
}

fn run_listops(model_id: i64, seq_len: i64) -> f64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_train = 200; let n_epochs = 40
    var ep = 0
    while ep < n_epochs {
        var correct = 0; var s = 0
        while s < n_train {
            let label = generate_sample_lo(seq_len)
            var tgt = label % 10
            if tgt < 0 { tgt = tgt + 10 }
            var d = 0
            while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
            var t = 0
            while t < SEQ_POS {
                if model_id == 0 { ossm_step(SEQ[t]) }
                if model_id == 1 { s4diag_step(SEQ[t]) }
                if model_id == 2 { naive_diag_step(SEQ[t]) }
                if model_id == 3 { hssm_step(SEQ[t]) }
                t = t + 1
            }
            compute_logits()
            if get_pred() == tgt { correct = correct + 1 }
            update_out(tgt, 0.01)
            s = s + 1
        }
        ep = ep + 1
    }
    rng_seed(99999 + seq_len, 11111 + seq_len)
    var correct = 0; var s = 0
    while s < 200 {
        let label = generate_sample_lo(seq_len)
        var tgt = label % 10
        if tgt < 0 { tgt = tgt + 10 }
        var d = 0
        while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
        var t = 0
        while t < SEQ_POS {
            if model_id == 0 { ossm_step(SEQ[t]) }
            if model_id == 1 { s4diag_step(SEQ[t]) }
            if model_id == 2 { naive_diag_step(SEQ[t]) }
            if model_id == 3 { hssm_step(SEQ[t]) }
            t = t + 1
        }
        compute_logits()
        if get_pred() == tgt { correct = correct + 1 }
        s = s + 1
    }
    (correct as f64) / 200.0 * 100.0
}

fn run_bracket(model_id: i64, slen: i64) -> f64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_train = 300; let n_epochs = 50
    var ep = 0
    while ep < n_epochs {
        var s = 0
        while s < n_train {
            let cls = generate_sample_br(slen)
            var d = 0
            while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
            var t = 0
            while t < BR_SEQ_LEN {
                if model_id == 0 { ossm_step(BR_SEQ[t]) }
                if model_id == 1 { s4diag_step(BR_SEQ[t]) }
                if model_id == 2 { naive_diag_step(BR_SEQ[t]) }
                if model_id == 3 { hssm_step(BR_SEQ[t]) }
                t = t + 1
            }
            compute_logits()
            if get_pred() == cls { }
            update_out(cls, 0.01)
            s = s + 1
        }
        ep = ep + 1
    }
    rng_seed(99999 + slen, 11111 + slen)
    var correct = 0; var s = 0
    while s < 200 {
        let cls = generate_sample_br(slen)
        var d = 0
        while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
        var t = 0
        while t < BR_SEQ_LEN {
            if model_id == 0 { ossm_step(BR_SEQ[t]) }
            if model_id == 1 { s4diag_step(BR_SEQ[t]) }
            if model_id == 2 { naive_diag_step(BR_SEQ[t]) }
            if model_id == 3 { hssm_step(BR_SEQ[t]) }
            t = t + 1
        }
        compute_logits()
        if get_pred() == cls { correct = correct + 1 }
        s = s + 1
    }
    (correct as f64) / 200.0 * 100.0
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  H-SSM 4-Way: O-SSM vs S4-DIAG vs Naive-DIAG vs H-SSM\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print("  H-SSM uses TRUE Hamilton quaternion multiplication\n")
    print("  (non-commutative, associative)\n\n")

    // ListOps L=15
    print("=== ListOps L=15 ===\n")

    print("O-SSM:   ")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_ossm()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let lo_ossm = run_listops(0, 15)
    print(lo_ossm); print("%\n")

    print("S4-DIAG: ")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_s4diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let lo_s4 = run_listops(1, 15)
    print(lo_s4); print("%\n")

    print("Naive:   ")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_naive_diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let lo_naive = run_listops(2, 15)
    print(lo_naive); print("%\n")

    print("H-SSM:   ")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_hssm()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let lo_hssm = run_listops(3, 15)
    print(lo_hssm); print("%\n")

    // Bracket L=12
    print("\n=== Bracket L=12 ===\n")

    print("O-SSM:   ")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_ossm()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let br_ossm = run_bracket(0, 12)
    print(br_ossm); print("%\n")

    print("S4-DIAG: ")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_s4diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let br_s4 = run_bracket(1, 12)
    print(br_s4); print("%\n")

    print("Naive:   ")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_naive_diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let br_naive = run_bracket(2, 12)
    print(br_naive); print("%\n")

    print("H-SSM:   ")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_hssm()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let br_hssm = run_bracket(3, 12)
    print(br_hssm); print("%\n")

    // Results
    print("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  RESULTS: H-SSM Ablation\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print("  Task      O-SSM   S4-DIAG  Naive   H-SSM   Random\n")
    print("  ListOps   "); print(lo_ossm); print("%  "); print(lo_s4); print("%  "); print(lo_naive); print("%  "); print(lo_hssm); print("%  10%\n")
    print("  Bracket   "); print(br_ossm); print("%  "); print(br_s4); print("%  "); print(br_naive); print("%  "); print(br_hssm); print("%  50%\n")

    print("\n  Interpretation:\n")
    if lo_ossm > lo_hssm {
        print("  ✓ O-SSM > H-SSM on ListOps → non-associativity is the driver\n")
    } else {
        print("  ✗ O-SSM ≤ H-SSM on ListOps → coupling suffices (non-assoc. not essential)\n")
    }

    println("ALL PASS")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/hssm_bptt_ablation.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// H-SSM BPTT Ablation: O-SSM vs H-SSM with Full Backprop Through A
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// Tests whether BPTT through A reveals algebraic differences between
// O-SSM (non-associative, non-commutative) and H-SSM (associative, non-commutative).
//
// Phase 1: output-only (30 epochs) — baseline, A untrained
// Phase 2: full BPTT (50 epochs) — train A with backprop
//
// H-SSM backward: dh = q_conjugate * dh  where q* = (w, -x, -y, -z)
// O-SSM backward: dh = A^T * dh  (standard matrix transpose)
//
// Task: ListOps L=15, 10-class, 500 train/epoch, 500 eval samples

fn exp_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 15.0 { return exp_q(7.5) * exp_q(x - 7.5) }
    if x < 0.0 - 15.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0; var term = 1.0; var i = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); sum = sum + term; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}

var RNG_A: i64 = 0; var RNG_B: i64 = 0
fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }
fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A; let y = RNG_B; RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23); x = x ^ (x >> 17); x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x; let r = x + y; if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}

// ─── ListOps task (same as hssm_4way_benchmark) ───
var SEQ: [i64; 32] = [0; 32]; var SEQ_POS: i64 = 0
fn min_val(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }
fn max_val(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }
fn compute_med3(a: i64, b: i64, c: i64) -> i64 {
    if a <= b { if b <= c { b } else { if a <= c { c } else { a } } }
    else { if a <= c { a } else { if b <= c { c } else { b } } }
}

fn apply_op(op: i64, vals: i64, v0: i64, v1: i64, v2: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    if op == 10 {
        var r = v0; if vals >= 2 { r = min_val(r, v1) }; if vals >= 3 { r = min_val(r, v2) }; r
    } else {
        if op == 11 {
            var r = v0; if vals >= 2 { r = max_val(r, v1) }; if vals >= 3 { r = max_val(r, v2) }; r
        } else {
            if vals >= 3 { compute_med3(v0, v1, v2) } else { if vals >= 2 { min_val(v0, v1) } else { v0 } }
        }
    }
}

fn gen_flat_expr() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let op = (rng_next() / 100) % 3 + 10; let nargs = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 + 2
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = op; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    var v0 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; var v1 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; var v2 = 0
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v0; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1; SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v1; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    if nargs == 3 { v2 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v2; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1 }
    apply_op(op, nargs, v0, v1, v2)
}

fn gen_nested_expr() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let outer_op = (rng_next() / 100) % 3 + 10; let outer_nargs = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 + 2
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = outer_op; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    var vals: [i64; 3] = [0; 3]; var ai = 0
    while ai < outer_nargs {
        let nest = (rng_next() / 100) % 3
        if nest == 0 { vals[ai] = gen_flat_expr() }
        else { let d = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; SEQ[SEQ_POS] = d; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1; vals[ai] = d }
        ai = ai + 1
    }
    apply_op(outer_op, outer_nargs, vals[0], vals[1], vals[2])
}

fn generate_sample_lo(target_len: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    SEQ_POS = 0; let result = gen_nested_expr()
    var actual_len = SEQ_POS
    while actual_len < target_len { SEQ[actual_len] = 0; actual_len = actual_len + 1 }
    if SEQ_POS > target_len { SEQ_POS = target_len } else { SEQ_POS = target_len }
    result
}

// ─── Model weights ───
// Layout: Embed 104 (0-103), A 64 (104-167), B 8 (168-175), Out 80 (176-255) = 256
var W: [i64; 256] = [0; 256]
var H: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]
var L: [i64; 10] = [0; 10]
var MOM: [i64; 256] = [0; 256]

// BPTT storage: max 20 timesteps x 8 dims = 160 (use 256 for safety)
var H_SAVE: [i64; 256] = [0; 256]
var X_SAVE: [i64; 256] = [0; 256]
var N_STEPS: i64 = 0

// Gradient accumulators
var DA: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
var DB: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]
var DH: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]

fn ws(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { W[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn wg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (W[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn hs(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { H[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn hg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (H[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }

fn init_embed_b_out() with Mut, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < 104 { ws(i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { ws(168 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 80 { ws(176 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 256 { MOM[i] = 0; i = i + 1 }
}

fn init_A_ossm() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 {
        var v = ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 10000.0
        let row = i / 8; let col = i - row * 8
        if row == col { v = 0.95 }
        ws(104 + i, v); i = i + 1
    }
}

fn init_A_hssm() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 { ws(104 + i, 0.0); i = i + 1 }
    ws(104 + 0, 0.95)
    ws(104 + 1, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(104 + 2, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(104 + 3, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(104 + 4, 0.95)
    ws(104 + 5, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(104 + 6, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(104 + 7, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
}

// ─── Forward steps ───

fn ossm_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var new_h: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]; var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let inp = wg(token * 8 + d); var s = 0.0; var j = 0
        while j < 8 { s = s + wg(104 + d*8 + j) * hg(j); j = j + 1 }
        s = s + wg(168 + d) * inp
        if s > 5.0 { s = 5.0 } if s < 0.0 - 5.0 { s = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        new_h[d] = s; d = d + 1
    }
    d = 0
    while d < 8 { hs(d, new_h[d]); d = d + 1 }
}

fn hssm_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    let aw = wg(104 + 0); let ax = wg(104 + 1); let ay = wg(104 + 2); let az = wg(104 + 3)
    let hw0 = hg(0); let hx0 = hg(1); let hy0 = hg(2); let hz0 = hg(3)
    let nw0 = aw*hw0 - ax*hx0 - ay*hy0 - az*hz0
    let nx0 = aw*hx0 + ax*hw0 + ay*hz0 - az*hy0
    let ny0 = aw*hy0 - ax*hz0 + ay*hw0 + az*hx0
    let nz0 = aw*hz0 + ax*hy0 - ay*hx0 + az*hw0
    var new_h0 = nw0 + wg(168 + 0) * wg(token * 8 + 0)
    var new_h1 = nx0 + wg(168 + 1) * wg(token * 8 + 1)
    var new_h2 = ny0 + wg(168 + 2) * wg(token * 8 + 2)
    var new_h3 = nz0 + wg(168 + 3) * wg(token * 8 + 3)
    if new_h0 > 5.0 { new_h0 = 5.0 } if new_h0 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h0 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if new_h1 > 5.0 { new_h1 = 5.0 } if new_h1 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h1 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if new_h2 > 5.0 { new_h2 = 5.0 } if new_h2 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h2 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if new_h3 > 5.0 { new_h3 = 5.0 } if new_h3 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h3 = 0.0 - 5.0 }

    let aw2 = wg(104 + 4); let ax2 = wg(104 + 5); let ay2 = wg(104 + 6); let az2 = wg(104 + 7)
    let hw1 = hg(4); let hx1 = hg(5); let hy1 = hg(6); let hz1 = hg(7)
    let nw1 = aw2*hw1 - ax2*hx1 - ay2*hy1 - az2*hz1
    let nx1 = aw2*hx1 + ax2*hw1 + ay2*hz1 - az2*hy1
    let ny1 = aw2*hy1 - ax2*hz1 + ay2*hw1 + az2*hx1
    let nz1 = aw2*hz1 + ax2*hy1 - ay2*hx1 + az2*hw1
    var new_h4 = nw1 + wg(168 + 4) * wg(token * 8 + 4)
    var new_h5 = nx1 + wg(168 + 5) * wg(token * 8 + 5)
    var new_h6 = ny1 + wg(168 + 6) * wg(token * 8 + 6)
    var new_h7 = nz1 + wg(168 + 7) * wg(token * 8 + 7)
    if new_h4 > 5.0 { new_h4 = 5.0 } if new_h4 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h4 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if new_h5 > 5.0 { new_h5 = 5.0 } if new_h5 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h5 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if new_h6 > 5.0 { new_h6 = 5.0 } if new_h6 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h6 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if new_h7 > 5.0 { new_h7 = 5.0 } if new_h7 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h7 = 0.0 - 5.0 }

    hs(0, new_h0); hs(1, new_h1); hs(2, new_h2); hs(3, new_h3)
    hs(4, new_h4); hs(5, new_h5); hs(6, new_h6); hs(7, new_h7)
}

// ─── Forward with state saving (for BPTT) ───
fn save_h(step: i64) with Mut {
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 { H_SAVE[step * 8 + d] = H[d]; d = d + 1 }
}

fn save_x(step: i64, token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let inp = wg(token * 8 + d)
        X_SAVE[step * 8 + d] = (inp * 100000000.0) as i64
        d = d + 1
    }
}

fn ossm_step_save(token: i64, step: i64) with Mut, Div {
    save_h(step); save_x(step, token); ossm_step(token)
}

fn hssm_step_save(token: i64, step: i64) with Mut, Div {
    save_h(step); save_x(step, token); hssm_step(token)
}

// ─── Logits + prediction ───
fn compute_logits() with Mut, Div {
    var c = 0
    while c < 10 {
        var s = 0.0; var d = 0
        while d < 8 { s = s + hg(d) * wg(176 + d * 10 + c); d = d + 1 }
        L[c] = (s * 100000000.0) as i64; c = c + 1
    }
}

fn get_pred() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    var best = 0; var bv = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0; var i = 1
    while i < 10 { let v = (L[i] as f64)/100000000.0; if v > bv { bv = v; best = i }; i = i + 1 }
    best
}

// ─── Softmax probs (shared) ───
var PROBS: [f64; 10] = [0.0; 10]

fn compute_probs(tgt: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var mx = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0; var i = 1
    while i < 10 { let v = (L[i] as f64)/100000000.0; if v > mx { mx = v }; i = i + 1 }
    var se = 0.0; i = 0
    while i < 10 { PROBS[i] = exp_q((L[i] as f64)/100000000.0 - mx); se = se + PROBS[i]; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 10 { PROBS[i] = PROBS[i] / se; i = i + 1 }
    PROBS[tgt] = PROBS[tgt] - 1.0
}

// ─── Phase 1: Output-only gradient ───
fn update_output_only(tgt: i64, lr: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    compute_probs(tgt)
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let hd = hg(d); var c = 0
        while c < 10 {
            let idx = 176 + d * 10 + c
            var g = hd * PROBS[c]
            if g > 0.3 { g = 0.3 } if g < 0.0 - 0.3 { g = 0.0 - 0.3 }
            let m = (MOM[idx] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + g
            MOM[idx] = (m * 100000000.0) as i64
            ws(idx, wg(idx) - lr * m)
            c = c + 1
        }
        d = d + 1
    }
}

// ─── BPTT: output gradient → dL/dh_final + update output weights ───
fn bptt_output_grad(tgt: i64, lr_out: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    compute_probs(tgt)
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let hd = hg(d); var dh_d = 0.0; var c = 0
        while c < 10 {
            let idx = 176 + d * 10 + c
            var g = hd * PROBS[c]
            if g > 0.5 { g = 0.5 } if g < 0.0 - 0.5 { g = 0.0 - 0.5 }
            let m = (MOM[idx] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + g
            MOM[idx] = (m * 100000000.0) as i64
            ws(idx, wg(idx) - lr_out * m)
            dh_d = dh_d + wg(176 + d * 10 + c) * PROBS[c]
            c = c + 1
        }
        DH[d] = (dh_d * 100000000.0) as i64
        d = d + 1
    }
}

// ─── BPTT: accumulate dA, dB for O-SSM (full A^T) ───
fn bptt_accum_ossm(t: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var dh_clip = (DH[d] as f64) / 100000000.0
        if dh_clip > 0.5 { dh_clip = 0.5 } if dh_clip < 0.0 - 0.5 { dh_clip = 0.0 - 0.5 }
        var j = 0
        while j < 8 {
            let ht_j = (H_SAVE[t * 8 + j] as f64) / 100000000.0
            DA[d * 8 + j] = DA[d * 8 + j] + (dh_clip * ht_j * 100000000.0) as i64
            j = j + 1
        }
        let xt_d = (X_SAVE[t * 8 + d] as f64) / 100000000.0
        DB[d] = DB[d] + (dh_clip * xt_d * 100000000.0) as i64
        d = d + 1
    }
}

// ─── BPTT: propagate dh backward through A^T (O-SSM) ───
fn bptt_prop_ossm() with Mut, Div {
    var new_dh: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]; var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var j = 0
        while j < 8 {
            new_dh[d] = new_dh[d] + wg(104 + j * 8 + d) * ((DH[j] as f64) / 100000000.0)
            j = j + 1
        }
        if new_dh[d] > 1.0 { new_dh[d] = 1.0 } if new_dh[d] < 0.0 - 1.0 { new_dh[d] = 0.0 - 1.0 }
        d = d + 1
    }
    d = 0
    while d < 8 { DH[d] = (new_dh[d] * 100000000.0) as i64; d = d + 1 }
}

// ─── BPTT: accumulate dA, dB for H-SSM (quaternion outer product) ───
fn bptt_accum_hssm(t: i64) with Mut, Div {
    // For H-SSM, A is structured as two independent quaternions.
    // dA accumulation: dh ⊗ h (outer product per 4D half)
    // Only A[0..7] are quaternion params, but we accumulate into the
    // 4x4 block-diagonal structure for proper gradient projection.

    // Half 1: dims 0-3
    var i = 0
    while i < 4 {
        var dh_i = (DH[i] as f64) / 100000000.0
        if dh_i > 0.5 { dh_i = 0.5 } if dh_i < 0.0 - 0.5 { dh_i = 0.0 - 0.5 }
        var j = 0
        while j < 4 {
            let h_j = (H_SAVE[t * 8 + j] as f64) / 100000000.0
            DA[i * 8 + j] = DA[i * 8 + j] + (dh_i * h_j * 100000000.0) as i64
            j = j + 1
        }
        let xt_i = (X_SAVE[t * 8 + i] as f64) / 100000000.0
        DB[i] = DB[i] + (dh_i * xt_i * 100000000.0) as i64
        i = i + 1
    }
    // Half 2: dims 4-7
    i = 0
    while i < 4 {
        var dh_i = (DH[4 + i] as f64) / 100000000.0
        if dh_i > 0.5 { dh_i = 0.5 } if dh_i < 0.0 - 0.5 { dh_i = 0.0 - 0.5 }
        var j = 0
        while j < 4 {
            let h_j = (H_SAVE[t * 8 + 4 + j] as f64) / 100000000.0
            DA[(4 + i) * 8 + (4 + j)] = DA[(4 + i) * 8 + (4 + j)] + (dh_i * h_j * 100000000.0) as i64
            j = j + 1
        }
        let xt_i = (X_SAVE[t * 8 + 4 + i] as f64) / 100000000.0
        DB[4 + i] = DB[4 + i] + (dh_i * xt_i * 100000000.0) as i64
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ─── BPTT: propagate dh backward through quaternion conjugate (H-SSM) ───
fn bptt_prop_hssm() with Mut, Div {
    // Half 1: q_conjugate * dh where q* = (aw, -ax, -ay, -az)
    let aw = wg(104 + 0); let ax = wg(104 + 1); let ay = wg(104 + 2); let az = wg(104 + 3)
    let dw_in = (DH[0] as f64) / 100000000.0
    let dx_in = (DH[1] as f64) / 100000000.0
    let dy_in = (DH[2] as f64) / 100000000.0
    let dz_in = (DH[3] as f64) / 100000000.0

    // Conjugate quaternion product: q* * dh
    // q* = (aw, -ax, -ay, -az), applied to (dw, dx, dy, dz)
    var dw_out = aw*dw_in + ax*dx_in + ay*dy_in + az*dz_in
    var dx_out = 0.0 - ax*dw_in + aw*dx_in + az*dy_in - ay*dz_in
    var dy_out = 0.0 - ay*dw_in - az*dx_in + aw*dy_in + ax*dz_in
    var dz_out = 0.0 - az*dw_in + ay*dx_in - ax*dy_in + aw*dz_in

    if dw_out > 1.0 { dw_out = 1.0 } if dw_out < 0.0 - 1.0 { dw_out = 0.0 - 1.0 }
    if dx_out > 1.0 { dx_out = 1.0 } if dx_out < 0.0 - 1.0 { dx_out = 0.0 - 1.0 }
    if dy_out > 1.0 { dy_out = 1.0 } if dy_out < 0.0 - 1.0 { dy_out = 0.0 - 1.0 }
    if dz_out > 1.0 { dz_out = 1.0 } if dz_out < 0.0 - 1.0 { dz_out = 0.0 - 1.0 }

    DH[0] = (dw_out * 100000000.0) as i64
    DH[1] = (dx_out * 100000000.0) as i64
    DH[2] = (dy_out * 100000000.0) as i64
    DH[3] = (dz_out * 100000000.0) as i64

    // Half 2: same with second quaternion
    let aw2 = wg(104 + 4); let ax2 = wg(104 + 5); let ay2 = wg(104 + 6); let az2 = wg(104 + 7)
    let dw_in2 = (DH[4] as f64) / 100000000.0
    let dx_in2 = (DH[5] as f64) / 100000000.0
    let dy_in2 = (DH[6] as f64) / 100000000.0
    let dz_in2 = (DH[7] as f64) / 100000000.0

    var dw_out2 = aw2*dw_in2 + ax2*dx_in2 + ay2*dy_in2 + az2*dz_in2
    var dx_out2 = 0.0 - ax2*dw_in2 + aw2*dx_in2 + az2*dy_in2 - ay2*dz_in2
    var dy_out2 = 0.0 - ay2*dw_in2 - az2*dx_in2 + aw2*dy_in2 + ax2*dz_in2
    var dz_out2 = 0.0 - az2*dw_in2 + ay2*dx_in2 - ax2*dy_in2 + aw2*dz_in2

    if dw_out2 > 1.0 { dw_out2 = 1.0 } if dw_out2 < 0.0 - 1.0 { dw_out2 = 0.0 - 1.0 }
    if dx_out2 > 1.0 { dx_out2 = 1.0 } if dx_out2 < 0.0 - 1.0 { dx_out2 = 0.0 - 1.0 }
    if dy_out2 > 1.0 { dy_out2 = 1.0 } if dy_out2 < 0.0 - 1.0 { dy_out2 = 0.0 - 1.0 }
    if dz_out2 > 1.0 { dz_out2 = 1.0 } if dz_out2 < 0.0 - 1.0 { dz_out2 = 0.0 - 1.0 }

    DH[4] = (dw_out2 * 100000000.0) as i64
    DH[5] = (dx_out2 * 100000000.0) as i64
    DH[6] = (dy_out2 * 100000000.0) as i64
    DH[7] = (dz_out2 * 100000000.0) as i64
}

// ─── BPTT: apply accumulated gradients ───
fn bptt_apply_A(lr_A: f64, model_id: i64) with Mut, Div {
    let inv_t = 1.0 / (N_STEPS as f64)
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 {
        let g = (DA[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 * inv_t
        var gc = g
        if gc > 0.3 { gc = 0.3 } if gc < 0.0 - 0.3 { gc = 0.0 - 0.3 }
        // For H-SSM, only update A[0..7] (quaternion params in first 8 positions)
        // A is stored at indices 104..167, meaning DA[0..63] maps to W[104..167]
        // For H-SSM: only update if the A param is active (first 8 in each 4x4 block)
        let idx = 104 + i
        let m = (MOM[idx] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + gc
        MOM[idx] = (m * 100000000.0) as i64
        if model_id == 0 {
            // O-SSM: update all 64 A params
            ws(idx, wg(idx) - lr_A * m)
        }
        if model_id == 1 {
            // H-SSM: only update the 4x4 block diagonal params
            let row = i / 8; let col = i - row * 8
            let in_block1 = row < 4; let col_block1 = col < 4
            let in_block2 = row >= 4; let col_block2 = col >= 4
            if in_block1 {
                if col_block1 { ws(idx, wg(idx) - lr_A * m) }
            }
            if in_block2 {
                if col_block2 { ws(idx, wg(idx) - lr_A * m) }
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn bptt_apply_B(lr_B: f64) with Mut, Div {
    let inv_t = 1.0 / (N_STEPS as f64)
    var i = 0
    while i < 8 {
        let g = (DB[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 * inv_t
        var gc = g
        if gc > 0.3 { gc = 0.3 } if gc < 0.0 - 0.3 { gc = 0.0 - 0.3 }
        let idx = 168 + i
        let m = (MOM[idx] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + gc
        MOM[idx] = (m * 100000000.0) as i64
        ws(idx, wg(idx) - lr_B * m)
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ─── BPTT: full backward pass ───
fn bptt_backward(tgt: i64, model_id: i64, lr_A: f64, lr_out: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    bptt_output_grad(tgt, lr_out)
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 { DA[i] = 0; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { DB[i] = 0; i = i + 1 }
    var t = N_STEPS - 1
    while t >= 0 {
        if model_id == 0 { bptt_accum_ossm(t); bptt_prop_ossm() }
        if model_id == 1 { bptt_accum_hssm(t); bptt_prop_hssm() }
        t = t - 1
    }
    bptt_apply_A(lr_A, model_id)
    bptt_apply_B(lr_A)
}

// ─── Forward pass for one sample ───
fn forward_sample(seq_len: i64, model_id: i64, do_save: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
    N_STEPS = 0
    var t = 0
    while t < seq_len {
        let tok = SEQ[t]
        if do_save == 1 {
            if model_id == 0 { ossm_step_save(tok, N_STEPS) }
            if model_id == 1 { hssm_step_save(tok, N_STEPS) }
        } else {
            if model_id == 0 { ossm_step(tok) }
            if model_id == 1 { hssm_step(tok) }
        }
        N_STEPS = N_STEPS + 1
        t = t + 1
    }
}

// ─── Training + Evaluation ───
fn train_two_phase(model_id: i64, seq_len: i64) -> f64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_train = 500
    let p1_epochs = 30
    let p2_epochs = 50

    // Phase 1: output-only
    var ep = 0
    while ep < p1_epochs {
        var s = 0
        while s < n_train {
            let label = generate_sample_lo(seq_len)
            var tgt = label % 10
            if tgt < 0 { tgt = tgt + 10 }
            forward_sample(SEQ_POS, model_id, 0)
            compute_logits()
            update_output_only(tgt, 0.01)
            s = s + 1
        }
        ep = ep + 1
    }

    // Eval after Phase 1
    rng_seed(99999 + seq_len, 11111 + seq_len)
    var p1_correct = 0; var s = 0
    while s < 500 {
        let label = generate_sample_lo(seq_len)
        var tgt = label % 10
        if tgt < 0 { tgt = tgt + 10 }
        forward_sample(SEQ_POS, model_id, 0)
        compute_logits()
        if get_pred() == tgt { p1_correct = p1_correct + 1 }
        s = s + 1
    }
    let p1_acc = (p1_correct as f64) / 500.0 * 100.0
    if model_id == 0 { print("  O-SSM  P1: ") }
    if model_id == 1 { print("  H-SSM  P1: ") }
    print(p1_acc); print("%\n")

    // Phase 2: full BPTT
    rng_seed(54321, 98765)
    ep = 0
    while ep < p2_epochs {
        s = 0
        while s < n_train {
            let label = generate_sample_lo(seq_len)
            var tgt = label % 10
            if tgt < 0 { tgt = tgt + 10 }
            forward_sample(SEQ_POS, model_id, 1)
            compute_logits()
            bptt_backward(tgt, model_id, 0.0005, 0.005)
            s = s + 1
        }
        ep = ep + 1
    }

    // Eval after Phase 2
    rng_seed(99999 + seq_len, 11111 + seq_len)
    var p2_correct = 0; s = 0
    while s < 500 {
        let label = generate_sample_lo(seq_len)
        var tgt = label % 10
        if tgt < 0 { tgt = tgt + 10 }
        forward_sample(SEQ_POS, model_id, 0)
        compute_logits()
        if get_pred() == tgt { p2_correct = p2_correct + 1 }
        s = s + 1
    }
    let p2_acc = (p2_correct as f64) / 500.0 * 100.0
    if model_id == 0 { print("  O-SSM  P2: ") }
    if model_id == 1 { print("  H-SSM  P2: ") }
    print(p2_acc); print("% (after BPTT)\n")

    p2_acc
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  H-SSM BPTT Ablation: O-SSM vs H-SSM with Full BPTT\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print("  Task: ListOps L=15, 10-class\n")
    print("  Phase 1: output-only, 30 epochs, LR=0.01\n")
    print("  Phase 2: full BPTT through A, 50 epochs, LR_A=0.0005\n")
    print("  500 train/epoch, 500 eval samples\n\n")

    let seq_len = 15

    // O-SSM (model_id=0)
    print("=== O-SSM (full 8x8 A) ===\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_ossm()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let ossm_acc = train_two_phase(0, seq_len)

    // H-SSM (model_id=1)
    print("\n=== H-SSM (quaternion A) ===\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_hssm()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let hssm_acc = train_two_phase(1, seq_len)

    print("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  RESULTS: BPTT Ablation\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print("  Model   Phase 2 (BPTT)  Random=10%\n")
    print("  O-SSM   "); print(ossm_acc); print("%\n")
    print("  H-SSM   "); print(hssm_acc); print("%\n")

    print("\n  Interpretation:\n")
    let gap = ossm_acc - hssm_acc
    if gap > 5.0 {
        print("  >> O-SSM > H-SSM by >5pp with BPTT: NON-ASSOCIATIVITY MATTERS for gradient flow\n")
    } else {
        if gap > 0.0 - 5.0 {
            print("  >> O-SSM ≈ H-SSM with BPTT (within ±5pp): coupling suffices even with training\n")
        } else {
            print("  >> H-SSM > O-SSM with BPTT: quaternion BPTT may be more stable\n")
        }
    }

    println("ALL PASS")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/hssm_deep_listops.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Deep ListOps: O-SSM vs S4-DIAG vs Naive-DIAG vs H-SSM at Depth-3
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// Tests whether non-associativity matters at DEEPER nesting.
// True recursive depth-3 generator (vs depth-1 in hssm_4way_benchmark).
// L=30 to accommodate longer expressions.
// 500 train/epoch, 80 epochs (40K total), 1000 eval samples (SE ≈ ±1.6%).
//
// If O-SSM > H-SSM by ≥3pp at depth-3: non-associativity IS the mechanism
// If O-SSM ≈ H-SSM (±2pp): coupling suffices, non-associativity decorative

fn exp_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 15.0 { return exp_q(7.5) * exp_q(x - 7.5) }
    if x < 0.0 - 15.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0; var term = 1.0; var i = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); sum = sum + term; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}

var RNG_A: i64 = 0; var RNG_B: i64 = 0
fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }
fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A; let y = RNG_B; RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23); x = x ^ (x >> 17); x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x; let r = x + y; if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}

// ─── Expression generation with true recursive nesting ───
var SEQ: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
var SEQ_POS: i64 = 0
var SEQ_MAX: i64 = 30

fn min_val(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }
fn max_val(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }
fn compute_med3(a: i64, b: i64, c: i64) -> i64 {
    if a <= b { if b <= c { b } else { if a <= c { c } else { a } } }
    else { if a <= c { a } else { if b <= c { c } else { b } } }
}

fn apply_op(op: i64, vals: i64, v0: i64, v1: i64, v2: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    if op == 10 {
        var r = v0; if vals >= 2 { r = min_val(r, v1) }; if vals >= 3 { r = min_val(r, v2) }; r
    } else {
        if op == 11 {
            var r = v0; if vals >= 2 { r = max_val(r, v1) }; if vals >= 3 { r = max_val(r, v2) }; r
        } else {
            if vals >= 3 { compute_med3(v0, v1, v2) } else { if vals >= 2 { min_val(v0, v1) } else { v0 } }
        }
    }
}

// Depth 0: flat expression, op(d1, d2[, d3])
fn gen_flat_expr() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    if SEQ_POS >= SEQ_MAX { return (rng_next() / 100) % 10 }
    let op = (rng_next() / 100) % 3 + 10; let nargs = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 + 2
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = op; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    var v0 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; var v1 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; var v2 = 0
    if SEQ_POS < SEQ_MAX { SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v0; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1 }
    if SEQ_POS < SEQ_MAX { SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v1; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1 }
    if nargs == 3 { v2 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; if SEQ_POS < SEQ_MAX { SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v2; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1 } }
    apply_op(op, nargs, v0, v1, v2)
}

// Depth 1: op with args that are flat_expr (40%) or raw digit (60%)
fn gen_depth1_expr() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    if SEQ_POS >= SEQ_MAX { return (rng_next() / 100) % 10 }
    let outer_op = (rng_next() / 100) % 3 + 10; let outer_nargs = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 + 2
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = outer_op; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    var vals: [i64; 3] = [0; 3]; var ai = 0
    while ai < outer_nargs {
        let nest = (rng_next() / 100) % 5
        if nest < 2 {
            if SEQ_POS < SEQ_MAX - 2 { vals[ai] = gen_flat_expr() }
            else { let d = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; if SEQ_POS < SEQ_MAX { SEQ[SEQ_POS] = d; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1 }; vals[ai] = d }
        } else {
            let d = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; if SEQ_POS < SEQ_MAX { SEQ[SEQ_POS] = d; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1 }; vals[ai] = d
        }
        ai = ai + 1
    }
    apply_op(outer_op, outer_nargs, vals[0], vals[1], vals[2])
}

// Depth 2: op with args that are depth1_expr (40%) or raw digit (60%)
fn gen_depth2_expr() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    if SEQ_POS >= SEQ_MAX { return (rng_next() / 100) % 10 }
    let outer_op = (rng_next() / 100) % 3 + 10; let outer_nargs = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 + 2
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = outer_op; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    var vals: [i64; 3] = [0; 3]; var ai = 0
    while ai < outer_nargs {
        let nest = (rng_next() / 100) % 5
        if nest < 2 {
            if SEQ_POS < SEQ_MAX - 4 { vals[ai] = gen_depth1_expr() }
            else { let d = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; if SEQ_POS < SEQ_MAX { SEQ[SEQ_POS] = d; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1 }; vals[ai] = d }
        } else {
            let d = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; if SEQ_POS < SEQ_MAX { SEQ[SEQ_POS] = d; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1 }; vals[ai] = d
        }
        ai = ai + 1
    }
    apply_op(outer_op, outer_nargs, vals[0], vals[1], vals[2])
}

// Depth 3: op with args that are depth2_expr (40%) or raw digit (60%)
fn gen_depth3_expr() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    if SEQ_POS >= SEQ_MAX { return (rng_next() / 100) % 10 }
    let outer_op = (rng_next() / 100) % 3 + 10; let outer_nargs = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 + 2
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = outer_op; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    var vals: [i64; 3] = [0; 3]; var ai = 0
    while ai < outer_nargs {
        let nest = (rng_next() / 100) % 5
        if nest < 2 {
            if SEQ_POS < SEQ_MAX - 6 { vals[ai] = gen_depth2_expr() }
            else { let d = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; if SEQ_POS < SEQ_MAX { SEQ[SEQ_POS] = d; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1 }; vals[ai] = d }
        } else {
            let d = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; if SEQ_POS < SEQ_MAX { SEQ[SEQ_POS] = d; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1 }; vals[ai] = d
        }
        ai = ai + 1
    }
    apply_op(outer_op, outer_nargs, vals[0], vals[1], vals[2])
}

fn generate_sample_deep(target_len: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    SEQ_POS = 0; SEQ_MAX = target_len
    let result = gen_depth3_expr()
    var actual_len = SEQ_POS
    while actual_len < target_len { SEQ[actual_len] = 0; actual_len = actual_len + 1 }
    if SEQ_POS > target_len { SEQ_POS = target_len } else { SEQ_POS = target_len }
    result
}

// ─── Models (same as hssm_4way_benchmark) ───
var W: [i64; 256] = [0; 256]
var H: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]
var L: [i64; 10] = [0; 10]
var MOM: [i64; 256] = [0; 256]

fn ws(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { W[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn wg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (W[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn hs(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { H[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn hg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (H[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }

fn init_embed_b_out() with Mut, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < 104 { ws(i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { ws(168 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 80 { ws(176 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 256 { MOM[i] = 0; i = i + 1 }
}

fn init_A_ossm() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 {
        var v = ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 10000.0
        let row = i / 8; let col = i - row * 8
        if row == col { v = 0.95 }
        ws(104 + i, v); i = i + 1
    }
}

fn init_A_s4diag() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 { ws(104 + i, 0.0); i = i + 1 }
    var k = 0
    while k < 4 {
        let a = 0.0 - 0.5; let b = 3.14159265 * (2.0 * (k as f64) + 1.0) / 2.0; let ea = exp_q(a)
        var bmod = b
        while bmod > 3.14159265 { bmod = bmod - 6.28318530 }
        while bmod < 0.0 - 3.14159265 { bmod = bmod + 6.28318530 }
        let b2 = bmod * bmod
        let cos_b = 1.0 - b2/2.0 + b2*b2/24.0 - b2*b2*b2/720.0
        let sin_b = bmod - bmod*b2/6.0 + bmod*b2*b2/120.0 - bmod*b2*b2*b2/5040.0
        let r = k * 2
        ws(104 + r*8 + r, ea * cos_b); ws(104 + r*8 + r + 1, 0.0 - ea * sin_b)
        ws(104 + (r+1)*8 + r, ea * sin_b); ws(104 + (r+1)*8 + r + 1, ea * cos_b)
        k = k + 1
    }
}

fn init_A_naive_diag() with Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 { ws(104 + i, 0.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { ws(104 + i*8 + i, 0.95); i = i + 1 }
}

fn init_A_hssm() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 { ws(104 + i, 0.0); i = i + 1 }
    ws(104 + 0, 0.95)
    ws(104 + 1, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(104 + 2, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(104 + 3, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(104 + 4, 0.95)
    ws(104 + 5, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(104 + 6, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(104 + 7, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
}

// ─── Model steps ───
fn ossm_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var new_h: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]; var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let inp = wg(token * 8 + d); var s = 0.0; var j = 0
        while j < 8 { s = s + wg(104 + d*8 + j) * hg(j); j = j + 1 }
        s = s + wg(168 + d) * inp
        if s > 5.0 { s = 5.0 } if s < 0.0 - 5.0 { s = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        new_h[d] = s; d = d + 1
    }
    d = 0
    while d < 8 { hs(d, new_h[d]); d = d + 1 }
}

fn s4diag_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var new_h: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]; var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let inp = wg(token * 8 + d); var s = 0.0; var j = 0
        while j < 8 { s = s + wg(104 + d*8 + j) * hg(j); j = j + 1 }
        s = s + wg(168 + d) * inp
        if s > 5.0 { s = 5.0 } if s < 0.0 - 5.0 { s = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        new_h[d] = s; d = d + 1
    }
    d = 0
    while d < 8 { hs(d, new_h[d]); d = d + 1 }
}

fn naive_diag_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var s = wg(104 + d*8 + d) * hg(d) + wg(168 + d) * wg(token * 8 + d)
        if s > 5.0 { s = 5.0 } if s < 0.0 - 5.0 { s = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        hs(d, s); d = d + 1
    }
}

fn hssm_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    let aw = wg(104 + 0); let ax = wg(104 + 1); let ay = wg(104 + 2); let az = wg(104 + 3)
    let hw0 = hg(0); let hx0 = hg(1); let hy0 = hg(2); let hz0 = hg(3)
    let nw0 = aw*hw0 - ax*hx0 - ay*hy0 - az*hz0
    let nx0 = aw*hx0 + ax*hw0 + ay*hz0 - az*hy0
    let ny0 = aw*hy0 - ax*hz0 + ay*hw0 + az*hx0
    let nz0 = aw*hz0 + ax*hy0 - ay*hx0 + az*hw0
    var new_h0 = nw0 + wg(168 + 0) * wg(token * 8 + 0)
    var new_h1 = nx0 + wg(168 + 1) * wg(token * 8 + 1)
    var new_h2 = ny0 + wg(168 + 2) * wg(token * 8 + 2)
    var new_h3 = nz0 + wg(168 + 3) * wg(token * 8 + 3)
    if new_h0 > 5.0 { new_h0 = 5.0 } if new_h0 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h0 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if new_h1 > 5.0 { new_h1 = 5.0 } if new_h1 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h1 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if new_h2 > 5.0 { new_h2 = 5.0 } if new_h2 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h2 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if new_h3 > 5.0 { new_h3 = 5.0 } if new_h3 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h3 = 0.0 - 5.0 }

    let aw2 = wg(104 + 4); let ax2 = wg(104 + 5); let ay2 = wg(104 + 6); let az2 = wg(104 + 7)
    let hw1 = hg(4); let hx1 = hg(5); let hy1 = hg(6); let hz1 = hg(7)
    let nw1 = aw2*hw1 - ax2*hx1 - ay2*hy1 - az2*hz1
    let nx1 = aw2*hx1 + ax2*hw1 + ay2*hz1 - az2*hy1
    let ny1 = aw2*hy1 - ax2*hz1 + ay2*hw1 + az2*hx1
    let nz1 = aw2*hz1 + ax2*hy1 - ay2*hx1 + az2*hw1
    var new_h4 = nw1 + wg(168 + 4) * wg(token * 8 + 4)
    var new_h5 = nx1 + wg(168 + 5) * wg(token * 8 + 5)
    var new_h6 = ny1 + wg(168 + 6) * wg(token * 8 + 6)
    var new_h7 = nz1 + wg(168 + 7) * wg(token * 8 + 7)
    if new_h4 > 5.0 { new_h4 = 5.0 } if new_h4 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h4 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if new_h5 > 5.0 { new_h5 = 5.0 } if new_h5 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h5 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if new_h6 > 5.0 { new_h6 = 5.0 } if new_h6 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h6 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if new_h7 > 5.0 { new_h7 = 5.0 } if new_h7 < 0.0 - 5.0 { new_h7 = 0.0 - 5.0 }

    hs(0, new_h0); hs(1, new_h1); hs(2, new_h2); hs(3, new_h3)
    hs(4, new_h4); hs(5, new_h5); hs(6, new_h6); hs(7, new_h7)
}

fn compute_logits() with Mut, Div {
    var c = 0
    while c < 10 {
        var s = 0.0; var d = 0
        while d < 8 { s = s + hg(d) * wg(176 + d * 10 + c); d = d + 1 }
        L[c] = (s * 100000000.0) as i64; c = c + 1
    }
}

fn get_pred() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    var best = 0; var bv = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0; var i = 1
    while i < 10 { let v = (L[i] as f64)/100000000.0; if v > bv { bv = v; best = i }; i = i + 1 }
    best
}

fn update_out(tgt: i64, lr: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var mx = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0; var i = 1
    while i < 10 { let v = (L[i] as f64)/100000000.0; if v > mx { mx = v }; i = i + 1 }
    var probs: [f64; 10] = [0.0; 10]; var se = 0.0; i = 0
    while i < 10 { probs[i] = exp_q((L[i] as f64)/100000000.0 - mx); se = se + probs[i]; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 10 { probs[i] = probs[i] / se; i = i + 1 }
    probs[tgt] = probs[tgt] - 1.0
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let hd = hg(d); var c = 0
        while c < 10 {
            let idx = 176 + d * 10 + c
            var g = hd * probs[c]
            if g > 0.3 { g = 0.3 } if g < 0.0 - 0.3 { g = 0.0 - 0.3 }
            let m = (MOM[idx] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + g
            MOM[idx] = (m * 100000000.0) as i64
            ws(idx, wg(idx) - lr * m)
            c = c + 1
        }
        d = d + 1
    }
}

// ─── Training + Evaluation ───
fn run_deep_listops(model_id: i64, seq_len: i64) -> f64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_train = 500; let n_epochs = 80
    var ep = 0
    while ep < n_epochs {
        var s = 0
        while s < n_train {
            let label = generate_sample_deep(seq_len)
            var tgt = label % 10
            if tgt < 0 { tgt = tgt + 10 }
            var d = 0
            while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
            var t = 0
            while t < SEQ_POS {
                if model_id == 0 { ossm_step(SEQ[t]) }
                if model_id == 1 { s4diag_step(SEQ[t]) }
                if model_id == 2 { naive_diag_step(SEQ[t]) }
                if model_id == 3 { hssm_step(SEQ[t]) }
                t = t + 1
            }
            compute_logits()
            update_out(tgt, 0.01)
            s = s + 1
        }
        ep = ep + 1
    }
    // Eval: 1000 samples for statistical reliability
    rng_seed(99999 + seq_len, 11111 + seq_len)
    var correct = 0; var s = 0
    while s < 1000 {
        let label = generate_sample_deep(seq_len)
        var tgt = label % 10
        if tgt < 0 { tgt = tgt + 10 }
        var d = 0
        while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
        var t = 0
        while t < SEQ_POS {
            if model_id == 0 { ossm_step(SEQ[t]) }
            if model_id == 1 { s4diag_step(SEQ[t]) }
            if model_id == 2 { naive_diag_step(SEQ[t]) }
            if model_id == 3 { hssm_step(SEQ[t]) }
            t = t + 1
        }
        compute_logits()
        if get_pred() == tgt { correct = correct + 1 }
        s = s + 1
    }
    (correct as f64) / 1000.0 * 100.0
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  Deep ListOps (Depth-3): 4-Way Comparison\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print("  True recursive depth-3 nesting, L=30\n")
    print("  500 train/epoch x 80 epochs = 40K total\n")
    print("  1000 eval samples (SE ≈ ±1.6%)\n\n")

    let seq_len = 30

    print("O-SSM:      ")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_ossm()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let acc_ossm = run_deep_listops(0, seq_len)
    print(acc_ossm); print("%\n")

    print("S4-DIAG:    ")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_s4diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let acc_s4 = run_deep_listops(1, seq_len)
    print(acc_s4); print("%\n")

    print("Naive-DIAG: ")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_naive_diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let acc_naive = run_deep_listops(2, seq_len)
    print(acc_naive); print("%\n")

    print("H-SSM:      ")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_hssm()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let acc_hssm = run_deep_listops(3, seq_len)
    print(acc_hssm); print("%\n")

    print("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  RESULTS: Deep ListOps Depth-3, L=30\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print("  Model       Accuracy  Random=10%\n")
    print("  O-SSM       "); print(acc_ossm); print("%\n")
    print("  S4-DIAG     "); print(acc_s4); print("%\n")
    print("  Naive-DIAG  "); print(acc_naive); print("%\n")
    print("  H-SSM       "); print(acc_hssm); print("%\n")

    print("\n  Interpretation:\n")
    let gap = acc_ossm - acc_hssm
    if gap > 3.0 {
        print("  >> O-SSM > H-SSM by >3pp: NON-ASSOCIATIVITY MATTERS at depth-3\n")
    } else {
        if gap > 0.0 - 3.0 {
            print("  >> O-SSM ≈ H-SSM (within ±3pp): coupling suffices, non-assoc. decorative\n")
        } else {
            print("  >> H-SSM > O-SSM: coupling alone is sufficient (non-assoc. not needed)\n")
        }
    }

    println("ALL PASS")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/hssm_native_algebra.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Native Algebra SSM Benchmark: True Octonion vs True Quaternion vs Diagonal
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// CRITICAL FIX: Previous benchmarks used A @ h (dense linear matrix multiply)
// for O-SSM. This is NOT octonion multiplication — it's just a general 8x8
// linear map with 64 free parameters. True octonion multiplication has only
// 8 parameters and specific Cayley structure (non-associative, non-commutative).
//
// This benchmark uses NATIVE ALGEBRA TYPES:
//   O-SSM: oct_mul(A, h) — Cayley product, 120 FLOPs, 8 params
//   H-SSM: qmul(q, h_half) × 2 — Hamilton product, 32 FLOPs, 8 params
//   Naive: A[d] * h[d] — diagonal multiply, 8 FLOPs, 8 params
//
// ALL MODELS ARE PARAMETER-MATCHED AT 8 A-PARAMS.
// The ONLY difference is the algebraic structure of the state transition.
//
// Tasks: ListOps (L=15, 10-class) and Bracket (L=12, binary)
// Training: 500 samples/epoch, 80 epochs = 40K samples, output-only
// Eval: 1000 samples (SE ≈ ±1.6%)

fn exp_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 15.0 { return exp_q(7.5) * exp_q(x - 7.5) }
    if x < 0.0 - 15.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0; var term = 1.0; var i = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); sum = sum + term; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}

var RNG_A: i64 = 0; var RNG_B: i64 = 0
fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }
fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A; let y = RNG_B; RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23); x = x ^ (x >> 17); x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x; let r = x + y; if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}

// ─── ListOps Task ───
var SEQ: [i64; 32] = [0; 32]; var SEQ_POS: i64 = 0
fn min_val(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }
fn max_val(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }
fn compute_med3(a: i64, b: i64, c: i64) -> i64 {
    if a <= b { if b <= c { b } else { if a <= c { c } else { a } } }
    else { if a <= c { a } else { if b <= c { c } else { b } } }
}

fn apply_op(op: i64, vals: i64, v0: i64, v1: i64, v2: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    if op == 10 {
        var r = v0; if vals >= 2 { r = min_val(r, v1) }; if vals >= 3 { r = min_val(r, v2) }; r
    } else {
        if op == 11 {
            var r = v0; if vals >= 2 { r = max_val(r, v1) }; if vals >= 3 { r = max_val(r, v2) }; r
        } else {
            if vals >= 3 { compute_med3(v0, v1, v2) } else { if vals >= 2 { min_val(v0, v1) } else { v0 } }
        }
    }
}

fn gen_flat_expr() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let op = (rng_next() / 100) % 3 + 10; let nargs = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 + 2
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = op; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    var v0 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; var v1 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; var v2 = 0
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v0; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1; SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v1; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    if nargs == 3 { v2 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v2; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1 }
    apply_op(op, nargs, v0, v1, v2)
}

fn gen_nested_expr() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let outer_op = (rng_next() / 100) % 3 + 10; let outer_nargs = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 + 2
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = outer_op; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    var vals: [i64; 3] = [0; 3]; var ai = 0
    while ai < outer_nargs {
        let nest = (rng_next() / 100) % 3
        if nest == 0 { vals[ai] = gen_flat_expr() }
        else { let d = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; SEQ[SEQ_POS] = d; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1; vals[ai] = d }
        ai = ai + 1
    }
    apply_op(outer_op, outer_nargs, vals[0], vals[1], vals[2])
}

fn generate_sample_lo(target_len: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    SEQ_POS = 0; let result = gen_nested_expr()
    var actual_len = SEQ_POS
    while actual_len < target_len { SEQ[actual_len] = 0; actual_len = actual_len + 1 }
    if SEQ_POS > target_len { SEQ_POS = target_len } else { SEQ_POS = target_len }
    result
}

// ─── Bracket Task ───
var BR_SEQ: [i64; 20] = [0; 20]; var BR_SEQ_LEN: i64 = 0
var STK: [i64; 10] = [0; 10]; var STK_TOP: i64 = 0

fn check_balanced(slen: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    STK_TOP = 0; var i = 0
    while i < slen {
        let tok = BR_SEQ[i]
        if tok == 1 { STK[STK_TOP] = 1; STK_TOP = STK_TOP + 1 }
        if tok == 3 { STK[STK_TOP] = 3; STK_TOP = STK_TOP + 1 }
        if tok == 2 { if STK_TOP == 0 { return 0 }; STK_TOP = STK_TOP - 1; if STK[STK_TOP] != 1 { return 0 } }
        if tok == 4 { if STK_TOP == 0 { return 0 }; STK_TOP = STK_TOP - 1; if STK[STK_TOP] != 3 { return 0 } }
        if STK_TOP > 9 { return 0 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if STK_TOP == 0 { 1 } else { 0 }
}

fn generate_balanced(slen: i64) with Mut, Div {
    STK_TOP = 0; var pos = 0
    while pos < slen {
        let remaining = slen - pos; let can_open = STK_TOP < remaining / 2; let can_close = STK_TOP > 0
        var choice = 0
        if can_open { if can_close { choice = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 } }
        if can_open { if can_close == false { choice = 0 } }
        if can_open == false { if can_close { choice = 1 } }
        if choice == 0 {
            let btype = (rng_next() / 100) % 2
            if btype == 0 { BR_SEQ[pos] = 1; STK[STK_TOP] = 1 }
            if btype == 1 { BR_SEQ[pos] = 3; STK[STK_TOP] = 3 }
            STK_TOP = STK_TOP + 1
        }
        if choice == 1 { STK_TOP = STK_TOP - 1; let top = STK[STK_TOP]; if top == 1 { BR_SEQ[pos] = 2 }; if top == 3 { BR_SEQ[pos] = 4 } }
        pos = pos + 1
    }
}

fn generate_unbalanced(slen: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var attempts = 0; var done = 0
    while done == 0 {
        var i = 0
        while i < slen { BR_SEQ[i] = (rng_next() / 100) % 4 + 1; i = i + 1 }
        if check_balanced(slen) == 0 { done = 1 }
        attempts = attempts + 1
        if attempts > 30 { BR_SEQ[0] = 2; BR_SEQ[1] = 4; done = 1 }
    }
}

fn generate_sample_br(slen: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let cls = (rng_next() / 100) % 2
    if cls == 1 { generate_balanced(slen) }
    if cls == 0 { generate_unbalanced(slen) }
    BR_SEQ_LEN = slen; cls
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Model Weights
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Layout: Embed 104 (0-103), A 8 (104-111), B 8 (112-119), Out 80 (120-199)
// Total: 200 params (parameter-matched: all models have exactly 8 A params)

var W: [i64; 200] = [0; 200]
var H: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]
var L: [i64; 10] = [0; 10]
var MOM: [i64; 200] = [0; 200]

fn ws(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { W[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn wg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (W[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn hs(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { H[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn hg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (H[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }

fn init_embed_b_out() with Mut, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < 104 { ws(i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { ws(112 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 80 { ws(120 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 200 { MOM[i] = 0; i = i + 1 }
}

// ─── A initialization: 8 params stored at W[104..111] ───

fn init_A_oct() with Mut, Div {
    // O-SSM: One octonion A = (e0, e1, ..., e7)
    // Init: e0 = 0.95 (real part, controls decay), e1..e7 = small random
    ws(104, 0.95)
    var i = 1
    while i < 8 { ws(104 + i, ((rng_next() % 200) as f64 - 100.0) / 1000.0); i = i + 1 }
}

fn init_A_quat() with Mut, Div {
    // H-SSM: Two quaternions q1=(w,x,y,z), q2=(w,x,y,z) at A[0..3], A[4..7]
    // Init: w=0.95, xyz=small random (same as hssm_4way_benchmark)
    ws(104 + 0, 0.95)
    ws(104 + 1, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(104 + 2, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(104 + 3, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(104 + 4, 0.95)
    ws(104 + 5, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(104 + 6, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(104 + 7, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
}

fn init_A_diag() with Mut {
    // Naive diagonal: A[0..7] = 0.95 each (same magnitude, no coupling)
    var i = 0
    while i < 8 { ws(104 + i, 0.95); i = i + 1 }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Native Algebra Forward Steps
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// O-SSM: h' = oct_mul(A, h) + B * embed[token]
// Full Cayley multiplication (120 FLOPs) — from octonion_ssm.sio
fn oct_ssm_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    // Read A octonion (8 components)
    let a0 = wg(104); let a1 = wg(105); let a2 = wg(106); let a3 = wg(107)
    let a4 = wg(108); let a5 = wg(109); let a6 = wg(110); let a7 = wg(111)
    // Read h octonion (8 components)
    let h0 = hg(0); let h1 = hg(1); let h2 = hg(2); let h3 = hg(3)
    let h4 = hg(4); let h5 = hg(5); let h6 = hg(6); let h7 = hg(7)

    // Cayley product: oct_mul(A, h) — exactly from octonion_ssm.sio lines 52-59
    var n0 = a0*h0 - a1*h1 - a2*h2 - a3*h3 - a4*h4 - a5*h5 - a6*h6 - a7*h7
    var n1 = a0*h1 + a1*h0 + a2*h3 - a3*h2 + a4*h5 - a5*h4 - a6*h7 + a7*h6
    var n2 = a0*h2 + a2*h0 - a1*h3 + a3*h1 + a4*h6 - a6*h4 + a5*h7 - a7*h5
    var n3 = a0*h3 + a3*h0 + a1*h2 - a2*h1 + a4*h7 - a7*h4 - a5*h6 + a6*h5
    var n4 = a0*h4 + a4*h0 - a1*h5 + a5*h1 - a2*h6 + a6*h2 - a3*h7 + a7*h3
    var n5 = a0*h5 + a5*h0 + a1*h4 - a4*h1 - a2*h7 + a7*h2 + a3*h6 - a6*h3
    var n6 = a0*h6 + a6*h0 + a1*h7 - a7*h1 + a2*h4 - a4*h2 - a3*h5 + a5*h3
    var n7 = a0*h7 + a7*h0 - a1*h6 + a6*h1 - a2*h5 + a5*h2 + a3*h4 - a4*h3

    // Add B * embed[token]
    n0 = n0 + wg(112 + 0) * wg(token * 8 + 0)
    n1 = n1 + wg(112 + 1) * wg(token * 8 + 1)
    n2 = n2 + wg(112 + 2) * wg(token * 8 + 2)
    n3 = n3 + wg(112 + 3) * wg(token * 8 + 3)
    n4 = n4 + wg(112 + 4) * wg(token * 8 + 4)
    n5 = n5 + wg(112 + 5) * wg(token * 8 + 5)
    n6 = n6 + wg(112 + 6) * wg(token * 8 + 6)
    n7 = n7 + wg(112 + 7) * wg(token * 8 + 7)

    // Clamp
    if n0 > 5.0 { n0 = 5.0 } if n0 < 0.0 - 5.0 { n0 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if n1 > 5.0 { n1 = 5.0 } if n1 < 0.0 - 5.0 { n1 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if n2 > 5.0 { n2 = 5.0 } if n2 < 0.0 - 5.0 { n2 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if n3 > 5.0 { n3 = 5.0 } if n3 < 0.0 - 5.0 { n3 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if n4 > 5.0 { n4 = 5.0 } if n4 < 0.0 - 5.0 { n4 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if n5 > 5.0 { n5 = 5.0 } if n5 < 0.0 - 5.0 { n5 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if n6 > 5.0 { n6 = 5.0 } if n6 < 0.0 - 5.0 { n6 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if n7 > 5.0 { n7 = 5.0 } if n7 < 0.0 - 5.0 { n7 = 0.0 - 5.0 }

    hs(0, n0); hs(1, n1); hs(2, n2); hs(3, n3)
    hs(4, n4); hs(5, n5); hs(6, n6); hs(7, n7)
}

// H-SSM: h'[0:3] = qmul(q1, h[0:3]) + B*embed; h'[4:7] = qmul(q2, h[4:7]) + B*embed
// Hamilton product (16 FLOPs per half) — from gpu_hypercomplex.sio
fn quat_ssm_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    // Half 1: quaternion q1 = A[0..3]
    let qw = wg(104); let qx = wg(105); let qy = wg(106); let qz = wg(107)
    let hw = hg(0); let hx = hg(1); let hy = hg(2); let hz = hg(3)
    var n0 = qw*hw - qx*hx - qy*hy - qz*hz
    var n1 = qw*hx + qx*hw + qy*hz - qz*hy
    var n2 = qw*hy - qx*hz + qy*hw + qz*hx
    var n3 = qw*hz + qx*hy - qy*hx + qz*hw
    n0 = n0 + wg(112 + 0) * wg(token * 8 + 0)
    n1 = n1 + wg(112 + 1) * wg(token * 8 + 1)
    n2 = n2 + wg(112 + 2) * wg(token * 8 + 2)
    n3 = n3 + wg(112 + 3) * wg(token * 8 + 3)
    if n0 > 5.0 { n0 = 5.0 } if n0 < 0.0 - 5.0 { n0 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if n1 > 5.0 { n1 = 5.0 } if n1 < 0.0 - 5.0 { n1 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if n2 > 5.0 { n2 = 5.0 } if n2 < 0.0 - 5.0 { n2 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if n3 > 5.0 { n3 = 5.0 } if n3 < 0.0 - 5.0 { n3 = 0.0 - 5.0 }

    // Half 2: quaternion q2 = A[4..7]
    let qw2 = wg(108); let qx2 = wg(109); let qy2 = wg(110); let qz2 = wg(111)
    let hw2 = hg(4); let hx2 = hg(5); let hy2 = hg(6); let hz2 = hg(7)
    var n4 = qw2*hw2 - qx2*hx2 - qy2*hy2 - qz2*hz2
    var n5 = qw2*hx2 + qx2*hw2 + qy2*hz2 - qz2*hy2
    var n6 = qw2*hy2 - qx2*hz2 + qy2*hw2 + qz2*hx2
    var n7 = qw2*hz2 + qx2*hy2 - qy2*hx2 + qz2*hw2
    n4 = n4 + wg(112 + 4) * wg(token * 8 + 4)
    n5 = n5 + wg(112 + 5) * wg(token * 8 + 5)
    n6 = n6 + wg(112 + 6) * wg(token * 8 + 6)
    n7 = n7 + wg(112 + 7) * wg(token * 8 + 7)
    if n4 > 5.0 { n4 = 5.0 } if n4 < 0.0 - 5.0 { n4 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if n5 > 5.0 { n5 = 5.0 } if n5 < 0.0 - 5.0 { n5 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if n6 > 5.0 { n6 = 5.0 } if n6 < 0.0 - 5.0 { n6 = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    if n7 > 5.0 { n7 = 5.0 } if n7 < 0.0 - 5.0 { n7 = 0.0 - 5.0 }

    hs(0, n0); hs(1, n1); hs(2, n2); hs(3, n3)
    hs(4, n4); hs(5, n5); hs(6, n6); hs(7, n7)
}

// Naive diagonal: h'[d] = A[d] * h[d] + B[d] * embed[token][d]
fn diag_ssm_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var s = wg(104 + d) * hg(d) + wg(112 + d) * wg(token * 8 + d)
        if s > 5.0 { s = 5.0 } if s < 0.0 - 5.0 { s = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        hs(d, s); d = d + 1
    }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Logits, Prediction, Update
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

fn compute_logits(n_classes: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var c = 0
    while c < n_classes {
        var s = 0.0; var d = 0
        while d < 8 { s = s + hg(d) * wg(120 + d * n_classes + c); d = d + 1 }
        L[c] = (s * 100000000.0) as i64; c = c + 1
    }
}

fn get_pred(n_classes: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    var best = 0; var bv = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0; var i = 1
    while i < n_classes { let v = (L[i] as f64)/100000000.0; if v > bv { bv = v; best = i }; i = i + 1 }
    best
}

fn update_out(tgt: i64, lr: f64, n_classes: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var mx = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0; var i = 1
    while i < n_classes { let v = (L[i] as f64)/100000000.0; if v > mx { mx = v }; i = i + 1 }
    var probs: [f64; 10] = [0.0; 10]; var se = 0.0; i = 0
    while i < n_classes { probs[i] = exp_q((L[i] as f64)/100000000.0 - mx); se = se + probs[i]; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < n_classes { probs[i] = probs[i] / se; i = i + 1 }
    probs[tgt] = probs[tgt] - 1.0
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let hd = hg(d); var c = 0
        while c < n_classes {
            let idx = 120 + d * n_classes + c
            var g = hd * probs[c]
            if g > 0.3 { g = 0.3 } if g < 0.0 - 0.3 { g = 0.0 - 0.3 }
            let m = (MOM[idx] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + g
            MOM[idx] = (m * 100000000.0) as i64
            ws(idx, wg(idx) - lr * m)
            c = c + 1
        }
        d = d + 1
    }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Training + Evaluation
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

fn run_listops(model_id: i64, seq_len: i64) -> f64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_train = 500; let n_epochs = 80
    var ep = 0
    while ep < n_epochs {
        var s = 0
        while s < n_train {
            let label = generate_sample_lo(seq_len)
            var tgt = label % 10
            if tgt < 0 { tgt = tgt + 10 }
            var d = 0
            while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
            var t = 0
            while t < SEQ_POS {
                if model_id == 0 { oct_ssm_step(SEQ[t]) }
                if model_id == 1 { quat_ssm_step(SEQ[t]) }
                if model_id == 2 { diag_ssm_step(SEQ[t]) }
                t = t + 1
            }
            compute_logits(10)
            update_out(tgt, 0.01, 10)
            s = s + 1
        }
        ep = ep + 1
    }
    // Eval: 1000 samples
    rng_seed(99999 + seq_len, 11111 + seq_len)
    var correct = 0; var s = 0
    while s < 1000 {
        let label = generate_sample_lo(seq_len)
        var tgt = label % 10
        if tgt < 0 { tgt = tgt + 10 }
        var d = 0
        while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
        var t = 0
        while t < SEQ_POS {
            if model_id == 0 { oct_ssm_step(SEQ[t]) }
            if model_id == 1 { quat_ssm_step(SEQ[t]) }
            if model_id == 2 { diag_ssm_step(SEQ[t]) }
            t = t + 1
        }
        compute_logits(10)
        if get_pred(10) == tgt { correct = correct + 1 }
        s = s + 1
    }
    (correct as f64) / 1000.0 * 100.0
}

fn run_bracket(model_id: i64, slen: i64) -> f64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_train = 500; let n_epochs = 80
    var ep = 0
    while ep < n_epochs {
        var s = 0
        while s < n_train {
            let cls = generate_sample_br(slen)
            var d = 0
            while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
            var t = 0
            while t < BR_SEQ_LEN {
                if model_id == 0 { oct_ssm_step(BR_SEQ[t]) }
                if model_id == 1 { quat_ssm_step(BR_SEQ[t]) }
                if model_id == 2 { diag_ssm_step(BR_SEQ[t]) }
                t = t + 1
            }
            compute_logits(2)
            update_out(cls, 0.01, 2)
            s = s + 1
        }
        ep = ep + 1
    }
    // Eval: 1000 samples
    rng_seed(99999 + slen, 11111 + slen)
    var correct = 0; var s = 0
    while s < 1000 {
        let cls = generate_sample_br(slen)
        var d = 0
        while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
        var t = 0
        while t < BR_SEQ_LEN {
            if model_id == 0 { oct_ssm_step(BR_SEQ[t]) }
            if model_id == 1 { quat_ssm_step(BR_SEQ[t]) }
            if model_id == 2 { diag_ssm_step(BR_SEQ[t]) }
            t = t + 1
        }
        compute_logits(2)
        if get_pred(2) == cls { correct = correct + 1 }
        s = s + 1
    }
    (correct as f64) / 1000.0 * 100.0
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {

    print("  500 train/epoch x 80 epochs = 40K samples\n")

    print(lo_diag); print("%\n")

    // ─── Bracket L=12 ───
    print("\n=== Bracket L=12 ===\n")

    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_oct()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let br_oct = run_bracket(0, 12)

    print("  Bracket   "); print(br_oct); print("%      "); print(br_quat); print("%       "); print(br_diag); print("%   50%\n")

    print("\n  Algebra Properties:\n")
    print("  O-SSM:  non-assoc, non-commut, full 8D coupling (Cayley/Fano)\n")
    print("  H-SSM:  ASSOC, non-commut, two independent 4D blocks (Hamilton)\n")
    print("  Naive:  ASSOC, COMMUT, no coupling (diagonal)\n")

    print("\n  Key Comparisons:\n")

    let lo_gap_oh = lo_oct - lo_quat
    if lo_gap_oh > 3.0 {
        print("  ListOps: O-SSM > H-SSM by >3pp → Cayley structure matters\n")
    } else {
        if lo_gap_oh < 0.0 - 3.0 {
            print("  ListOps: H-SSM > O-SSM by >3pp → Hamilton structure preferred\n")
        } else {
            print("  ListOps: O-SSM ≈ H-SSM (within ±3pp)\n")
        }
    }

    let lo_gap_hd = lo_quat - lo_diag
    if lo_gap_hd > 3.0 {
        print("  ListOps: H-SSM > Naive by >3pp → coupling matters\n")
    } else {
        print("  ListOps: H-SSM ≈ Naive → coupling doesn't help (or random baseline too strong)\n")
    }

    println("ALL PASS")
    0
}
