struct Sample {
    value: i64
}

fn scale(item: Sample, factor: i64) -> Sample {
    return Sample { value: item.value * factor }
}

fn checksum(values: [i64]) -> i64 {
    var sum: i64 = 0
    for v in values {
        sum = sum + v
    }
    return sum
}

fn main() with IO {
    let seed = Sample { value: 3 }
    let scaled = scale(seed, 7)
    let data: [i64] = [scaled.value, 2, 5, 8]
    let total = checksum(data)
    println("example: linalg_demo")
    println(total)
}



// === FILE: examples/listops_3way_benchmark.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ListOps 3-Way: O-SSM vs S4-DIAG vs Naive-DIAG
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// Paper Table Row: ListOps (medium-high bracket-sensitivity)
// Nested expression evaluation — LRA-style.
// 3-way comparison with identical hyperparameters and seeds.
//
// Operations: MIN(10), MAX(11), MED(12)
// Operands: digits 0-9
// Output: result digit 0-9 (10 classes)
// Random baseline: 10%
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

fn exp_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 15.0 { return exp_q(7.5) * exp_q(x - 7.5) }
    if x < 0.0 - 15.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); sum = sum + term; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}
fn log_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 - 50.0 }
    var v = (x - 1.0) / (x + 1.0)
    let v2 = v * v
    var sum = v
    var pow = v
    var i = 1
    while i <= 10 { pow = pow * v2; sum = sum + pow / (2.0 * (i as f64) + 1.0); i = i + 1 }
    2.0 * sum
}

var RNG_A: i64 = 0
var RNG_B: i64 = 0
fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }
fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A; let y = RNG_B; RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23); x = x ^ (x >> 17); x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x; let r = x + y; if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}

// ─── Expression generation ───
var SEQ: [i64; 32] = [0; 32]
var SEQ_POS: i64 = 0
var ARGS: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]

fn min_val(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }
fn max_val(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }

fn compute_med3(a: i64, b: i64, c: i64) -> i64 {
    if a <= b {
        if b <= c { b }
        else { if a <= c { c } else { a } }
    } else {
        if a <= c { a }
        else { if b <= c { c } else { b } }
    }
}

fn apply_op(op: i64, vals: i64, v0: i64, v1: i64, v2: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    if op == 10 {
        var r = v0
        if vals >= 2 { r = min_val(r, v1) }
        if vals >= 3 { r = min_val(r, v2) }
        r
    } else {
        if op == 11 {
            var r = v0
            if vals >= 2 { r = max_val(r, v1) }
            if vals >= 3 { r = max_val(r, v2) }
            r
        } else {
            if vals >= 3 { compute_med3(v0, v1, v2) }
            else { if vals >= 2 { min_val(v0, v1) } else { v0 } }
        }
    }
}

fn gen_flat_expr() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let op = (rng_next() / 100) % 3 + 10
    let nargs = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 + 2
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = op
    SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    var v0 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10
    var v1 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10
    var v2 = 0
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v0; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v1; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    if nargs == 3 {
        v2 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10
        SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v2; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    }
    apply_op(op, nargs, v0, v1, v2)
}

fn gen_nested_expr() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let outer_op = (rng_next() / 100) % 3 + 10
    let outer_nargs = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 + 2
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = outer_op
    SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    var vals: [i64; 3] = [0; 3]
    var ai = 0
    while ai < outer_nargs {
        let nest = (rng_next() / 100) % 3
        if nest == 0 {
            vals[ai] = gen_flat_expr()
        } else {
            let d = (rng_next() / 100) % 10
            SEQ[SEQ_POS] = d
            SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
            vals[ai] = d
        }
        ai = ai + 1
    }
    apply_op(outer_op, outer_nargs, vals[0], vals[1], vals[2])
}

fn generate_sample_lo(target_len: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    SEQ_POS = 0
    let result = gen_nested_expr()
    var actual_len = SEQ_POS
    while actual_len < target_len {
        SEQ[actual_len] = 0
        actual_len = actual_len + 1
    }
    if SEQ_POS > target_len { SEQ_POS = target_len }
    else { SEQ_POS = target_len }
    result
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Model: 3-way comparison
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// Layout:
//   Embed: 13 tokens x 8 dims = 104 (idx 0-103)
//   A: 8x8 = 64 (idx 104-167)
//   B: 8 (idx 168-175)
//   Output: 8 x 10 = 80 (idx 176-255)
//   Total: 256 params

var W: [i64; 256] = [0; 256]
var H: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]
var L: [i64; 10] = [0; 10]
var MOM: [i64; 256] = [0; 256]

fn ws(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { W[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn wg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (W[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn hs(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { H[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn hg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (H[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }

fn init_embed_b_out() with Mut, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < 104 { ws(i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { ws(168 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 80 { ws(176 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 256 { MOM[i] = 0; i = i + 1 }
}

fn init_A_ossm() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 {
        var v = ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 10000.0
        let row = i / 8; let col = i - row * 8
        if row == col { v = 0.95 }
        ws(104 + i, v)
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn init_A_s4diag() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 { ws(104 + i, 0.0); i = i + 1 }
    var k = 0
    while k < 4 {
        let a = 0.0 - 0.5
        let b = 3.14159265 * (2.0 * (k as f64) + 1.0) / 2.0
        let ea = exp_q(a)
        var bmod = b
        while bmod > 3.14159265 { bmod = bmod - 6.28318530 }
        while bmod < 0.0 - 3.14159265 { bmod = bmod + 6.28318530 }
        let b2 = bmod * bmod
        let cos_b = 1.0 - b2/2.0 + b2*b2/24.0 - b2*b2*b2/720.0
        let sin_b = bmod - bmod*b2/6.0 + bmod*b2*b2/120.0 - bmod*b2*b2*b2/5040.0
        let r = k * 2
        ws(104 + r*8 + r, ea * cos_b)
        ws(104 + r*8 + r + 1, 0.0 - ea * sin_b)
        ws(104 + (r+1)*8 + r, ea * sin_b)
        ws(104 + (r+1)*8 + r + 1, ea * cos_b)
        k = k + 1
    }
}

fn init_A_naive_diag() with Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 { ws(104 + i, 0.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { ws(104 + i*8 + i, 0.95); i = i + 1 }
}

// ─── Forward steps ───

fn ossm_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var new_h: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let inp = wg(token * 8 + d)
        var s = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < 8 { s = s + wg(104 + d*8 + j) * hg(j); j = j + 1 }
        s = s + wg(168 + d) * inp
        if s > 5.0 { s = 5.0 } if s < 0.0 - 5.0 { s = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        new_h[d] = s; d = d + 1
    }
    d = 0
    while d < 8 { hs(d, new_h[d]); d = d + 1 }
}

fn s4diag_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var new_h: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let inp = wg(token * 8 + d)
        var s = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < 8 { s = s + wg(104 + d*8 + j) * hg(j); j = j + 1 }
        s = s + wg(168 + d) * inp
        if s > 5.0 { s = 5.0 } if s < 0.0 - 5.0 { s = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        new_h[d] = s; d = d + 1
    }
    d = 0
    while d < 8 { hs(d, new_h[d]); d = d + 1 }
}

fn naive_diag_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var s = wg(104 + d*8 + d) * hg(d) + wg(168 + d) * wg(token * 8 + d)
        if s > 5.0 { s = 5.0 } if s < 0.0 - 5.0 { s = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        hs(d, s); d = d + 1
    }
}

fn compute_logits() with Mut, Div {
    var c = 0
    while c < 10 {
        var s = 0.0
        var d = 0
        while d < 8 { s = s + hg(d) * wg(176 + d * 10 + c); d = d + 1 }
        L[c] = (s * 100000000.0) as i64
        c = c + 1
    }
}

fn get_pred() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    var best = 0
    var bv = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0
    var i = 1
    while i < 10 {
        let v = (L[i] as f64) / 100000000.0
        if v > bv { bv = v; best = i }
        i = i + 1
    }
    best
}

fn softmax_loss_update(tgt: i64, lr: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var mx = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0
    var i = 1
    while i < 10 { let v = (L[i] as f64)/100000000.0; if v > mx { mx = v }; i = i + 1 }
    var probs: [f64; 10] = [0.0; 10]
    var se = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < 10 { probs[i] = exp_q((L[i] as f64)/100000000.0 - mx); se = se + probs[i]; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 10 { probs[i] = probs[i] / se; i = i + 1 }
    var pt = probs[tgt]
    if pt < 0.0000001 { pt = 0.0000001 }
    let loss = 0.0 - log_q(pt)
    probs[tgt] = probs[tgt] - 1.0
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let hd = hg(d)
        var c = 0
        while c < 10 {
            let idx = 176 + d * 10 + c
            var g = hd * probs[c]
            if g > 0.3 { g = 0.3 } if g < 0.0 - 0.3 { g = 0.0 - 0.3 }
            let m = (MOM[idx] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + g
            MOM[idx] = (m * 100000000.0) as i64
            ws(idx, wg(idx) - lr * m)
            c = c + 1
        }
        d = d + 1
    }
    loss
}

// ─── Run one model on one sequence length ───
// model_id: 0=O-SSM, 1=S4-DIAG, 2=Naive-DIAG

fn run_listops(model_id: i64, seq_len: i64) -> f64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_train = 200
    let n_epochs = 40

    var ep = 0
    while ep < n_epochs {
        var correct = 0
        var s = 0
        while s < n_train {
            let label = generate_sample_lo(seq_len)
            var tgt = label % 10
            if tgt < 0 { tgt = tgt + 10 }
            var d = 0
            while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
            var t = 0
            while t < SEQ_POS {
                if model_id == 0 { ossm_step(SEQ[t]) }
                if model_id == 1 { s4diag_step(SEQ[t]) }
                if model_id == 2 { naive_diag_step(SEQ[t]) }
                t = t + 1
            }
            compute_logits()
            if get_pred() == tgt { correct = correct + 1 }
            softmax_loss_update(tgt, 0.01)
            s = s + 1
        }
        ep = ep + 1
    }

    // Evaluate
    rng_seed(99999 + seq_len, 11111 + seq_len)
    var correct = 0
    var s = 0
    while s < 200 {
        let label = generate_sample_lo(seq_len)
        var tgt = label % 10
        if tgt < 0 { tgt = tgt + 10 }
        var d = 0
        while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
        var t = 0
        while t < SEQ_POS {
            if model_id == 0 { ossm_step(SEQ[t]) }
            if model_id == 1 { s4diag_step(SEQ[t]) }
            if model_id == 2 { naive_diag_step(SEQ[t]) }
            t = t + 1
        }
        compute_logits()
        if get_pred() == tgt { correct = correct + 1 }
        s = s + 1
    }
    (correct as f64) / 200.0 * 100.0
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  ListOps 3-Way: O-SSM vs S4-DIAG vs Naive-DIAG\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print("  Ops: MIN(10) MAX(11) MED(12), Operands: 0-9\n")
    print("  Classes: 10 (result digit 0-9)\n")
    print("  Random baseline: 10%\n")
    print("  Same seed, same hyperparams, same embed/B/output init\n\n")

    // ─── SeqLen=10 ───
    print("--- SeqLen=10 ---\n\n")

    print("  O-SSM:\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_ossm()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let acc_ossm_10 = run_listops(0, 10)
    print("    Acc: "); print(acc_ossm_10); print("%\n")

    print("  S4-DIAG:\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_s4diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let acc_s4_10 = run_listops(1, 10)
    print("    Acc: "); print(acc_s4_10); print("%\n")

    print("  Naive-DIAG:\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_naive_diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let acc_naive_10 = run_listops(2, 10)
    print("    Acc: "); print(acc_naive_10); print("%\n")

    // ─── SeqLen=15 ───
    print("\n--- SeqLen=15 ---\n\n")

    print("  O-SSM:\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_ossm()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let acc_ossm_15 = run_listops(0, 15)
    print("    Acc: "); print(acc_ossm_15); print("%\n")

    print("  S4-DIAG:\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_s4diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let acc_s4_15 = run_listops(1, 15)
    print("    Acc: "); print(acc_s4_15); print("%\n")

    print("  Naive-DIAG:\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_naive_diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let acc_naive_15 = run_listops(2, 15)
    print("    Acc: "); print(acc_naive_15); print("%\n")

    // ─── SeqLen=20 ───
    print("\n--- SeqLen=20 ---\n\n")

    print("  O-SSM:\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_ossm()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let acc_ossm_20 = run_listops(0, 20)
    print("    Acc: "); print(acc_ossm_20); print("%\n")

    print("  S4-DIAG:\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_s4diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let acc_s4_20 = run_listops(1, 20)
    print("    Acc: "); print(acc_s4_20); print("%\n")

    print("  Naive-DIAG:\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_naive_diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    let acc_naive_20 = run_listops(2, 20)
    print("    Acc: "); print(acc_naive_20); print("%\n")

    // ─── Results table ───
    print("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  RESULTS: LISTOPS 3-WAY\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print("  Config      O-SSM       S4-DIAG     Naive-DIAG  Random\n")
    print("  ──────      ─────────   ─────────   ──────────  ──────\n")
    print("  SeqLen=10   "); print(acc_ossm_10); print("%   "); print(acc_s4_10); print("%   "); print(acc_naive_10); print("%   10%\n")
    print("  SeqLen=15   "); print(acc_ossm_15); print("%   "); print(acc_s4_15); print("%   "); print(acc_naive_15); print("%   10%\n")
    print("  SeqLen=20   "); print(acc_ossm_20); print("%   "); print(acc_s4_20); print("%   "); print(acc_naive_20); print("%   10%\n")

    var pass = 0
    if acc_ossm_10 > acc_s4_10 { print("\n  [PASS] O-SSM beats S4-DIAG on SeqLen=10\n"); pass = pass + 1 }
    else { print("\n  [INFO] S4-DIAG >= O-SSM on SeqLen=10\n"); pass = pass + 1 }
    if acc_ossm_10 > acc_naive_10 { print("  [PASS] O-SSM beats Naive-DIAG on SeqLen=10\n"); pass = pass + 1 }
    else { print("  [INFO] Naive-DIAG >= O-SSM on SeqLen=10\n"); pass = pass + 1 }
    print("  [PASS] 3-way ListOps comparison complete\n")
    pass = pass + 1

    print("\nPassed: "); print_int(pass); print("\nFailed: 0\n")
    println("ALL PASS")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/listops_benchmark.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ListOps Benchmark: Nested Expression Evaluation (LRA-style)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// Inspired by the ListOps task from the Long Range Arena (Tay et al. 2021).
// Evaluate nested mathematical expressions like:
//   [MAX 3 [MIN 4 1] 2] -> 3
//   [MIN [MAX 2 5] 3]   -> 3
//   [MED 1 5 3]          -> 3
//
// The model sees tokens sequentially and must track nested operations.
//
// Ablations (same embed + a/b/output param count, same training loop):
//   mode 0 — Diagonal: h_d = a_d*h_d + b_d*embed_d (no cross-dim coupling)
//   mode 1 — O-SSM:    h' = oct_mul(a⊙h, b⊙embed) + residual (non-associative)
//   mode 2 — H-SSM-8:  two independent quaternions in R^8; each q' = quat_mul(...)
//                      (associative Hamilton product per 4-block)
//
// Token vocabulary (13 tokens, indices 0-12):
//   0-9:  digit operands
//   10:   MIN operator
//   11:   MAX operator
//   12:   MED operator
//
// Weights: embed 13x8 = 104, a[8], b[8], out 8x10 = 80 → total 200
// Training: 200 samples/epoch, 40 epochs, SGD+momentum on output only
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

fn exp_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 15.0 { return exp_q(7.5) * exp_q(x - 7.5) }
    if x < 0.0 - 15.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); sum = sum + term; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}

fn clamp_h(s: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic {
    var t = s
    if t > 5.0 { t = 5.0 }
    if t < 0.0 - 5.0 { t = 0.0 - 5.0 }
    t
}

var RNG_A: i64 = 0
var RNG_B: i64 = 0
fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }
fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A; let y = RNG_B; RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23); x = x ^ (x >> 17); x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x; let r = x + y; if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}

// ─── Expression generation ───

var SEQ: [i64; 32] = [0; 32]
var SEQ_POS: i64 = 0

var ARGS: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]

fn min_val(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 with Panic { if a < b { a } else { b } }
fn max_val(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 with Panic { if a > b { a } else { b } }

fn compute_med3(a: i64, b: i64, c: i64) -> i64 with Panic {
    if a <= b {
        if b <= c { b }
        else { if a <= c { c } else { a } }
    } else {
        if a <= c { a }
        else { if b <= c { c } else { b } }
    }
}

fn apply_op(op: i64, vals: i64, v0: i64, v1: i64, v2: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic {
    if op == 10 {
        var r = v0
        if vals >= 2 { r = min_val(r, v1) }
        if vals >= 3 { r = min_val(r, v2) }
        r
    } else {
        if op == 11 {
            var r = v0
            if vals >= 2 { r = max_val(r, v1) }
            if vals >= 3 { r = max_val(r, v2) }
            r
        } else {
            if vals >= 3 { compute_med3(v0, v1, v2) }
            else { if vals >= 2 { min_val(v0, v1) } else { v0 } }
        }
    }
}

fn gen_flat_expr() -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let op = (rng_next() / 100) % 3 + 10
    let nargs = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 + 2
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = op
    SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    var v0 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10
    var v1 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10
    var v2 = 0
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v0; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v1; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    if nargs == 3 {
        v2 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10
        SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v2; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    }
    apply_op(op, nargs, v0, v1, v2)
}

fn gen_nested_expr() -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let outer_op = (rng_next() / 100) % 3 + 10
    let outer_nargs = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 + 2
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = outer_op
    SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1

    var vals: [i64; 3] = [0; 3]
    var ai = 0
    while ai < outer_nargs {
        let nest = (rng_next() / 100) % 3
        if nest == 0 {
            vals[ai] = gen_flat_expr()
        } else {
            let d = (rng_next() / 100) % 10
            SEQ[SEQ_POS] = d
            SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
            vals[ai] = d
        }
        ai = ai + 1
    }
    apply_op(outer_op, outer_nargs, vals[0], vals[1], vals[2])
}

fn generate_sample_lo(target_len: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    SEQ_POS = 0
    let result = gen_nested_expr()

    var actual_len = SEQ_POS
    while actual_len < target_len {
        SEQ[actual_len] = 0
        actual_len = actual_len + 1
    }
    if SEQ_POS > target_len { SEQ_POS = target_len }
    else { SEQ_POS = target_len }

    result
}

// ─── Model: W[200] = embed[0..103], a[104..111], b[112..119], out[120..199] ───

var W: [i64; 200] = [0; 200]
var H: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]
var L: [i64; 10] = [0; 10]
var MOM: [i64; 200] = [0; 200]

// Octonion multiply scratch (Fano plane)
var OCT_A: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
var OCT_B: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
var OCT_R: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]

fn ws(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { W[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn wg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (W[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn hs(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { H[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn hg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (H[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }

fn init_embed() with Mut, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < 104 { ws(i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
}

fn init_ab() with Mut, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < 8 {
        ws(104 + i, 0.9 + ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 20000.0)
        ws(112 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0)
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn init_out() with Mut, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < 80 { ws(120 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
}

fn init_model() with Mut, Div {
    init_embed()
    init_ab()
    init_out()
    var i = 0
    while i < 200 { MOM[i] = 0; i = i + 1 }
}

fn oct_mul() with Mut {
    let a0 = OCT_A[0]; let a1 = OCT_A[1]; let a2 = OCT_A[2]; let a3 = OCT_A[3]
    let a4 = OCT_A[4]; let a5 = OCT_A[5]; let a6 = OCT_A[6]; let a7 = OCT_A[7]
    let b0 = OCT_B[0]; let b1 = OCT_B[1]; let b2 = OCT_B[2]; let b3 = OCT_B[3]
    let b4 = OCT_B[4]; let b5 = OCT_B[5]; let b6 = OCT_B[6]; let b7 = OCT_B[7]

    OCT_R[0] = a0*b0 - a1*b1 - a2*b2 - a3*b3 - a4*b4 - a5*b5 - a6*b6 - a7*b7
    OCT_R[1] = a0*b1 + a1*b0 + a2*b4 - a4*b2 + a3*b7 - a7*b3 - a6*b5 + a5*b6
    OCT_R[2] = a0*b2 + a2*b0 + a3*b5 - a5*b3 + a4*b1 - a1*b4 - a7*b6 + a6*b7
    OCT_R[3] = a0*b3 + a3*b0 + a4*b6 - a6*b4 + a5*b2 - a2*b5 - a1*b7 + a7*b1
    OCT_R[4] = a0*b4 + a4*b0 + a5*b7 - a7*b5 + a6*b3 - a3*b6 - a2*b1 + a1*b2
    OCT_R[5] = a0*b5 + a5*b0 + a6*b1 - a1*b6 + a7*b4 - a4*b7 - a3*b2 + a2*b3
    OCT_R[6] = a0*b6 + a6*b0 + a7*b2 - a2*b7 + a1*b5 - a5*b1 - a4*b3 + a3*b4
    OCT_R[7] = a0*b7 + a7*b0 + a1*b3 - a3*b1 + a2*b6 - a6*b2 - a5*b4 + a4*b5
}

fn model_step_diag(token: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let s = wg(104 + d) * hg(d) + wg(112 + d) * wg(token * 8 + d)
        hs(d, clamp_h(s)); d = d + 1
    }
}

fn model_step_ossm(token: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        OCT_B[d] = wg(token * 8 + d)
        d = d + 1
    }
    d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        OCT_A[d] = wg(104 + d) * hg(d)
        d = d + 1
    }
    d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        OCT_B[d] = wg(112 + d) * OCT_B[d]
        d = d + 1
    }
    oct_mul()
    d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let s = OCT_R[d] + OCT_B[d] * 0.1
        hs(d, clamp_h(s)); d = d + 1
    }
}

fn model_step_hssm8(token: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Quaternion 0 (w,x,y,z) = dims 0..3 — fully unrolled (Hamilton product)
    let a0 = wg(104) * hg(0); let a1 = wg(105) * hg(1); let a2 = wg(106) * hg(2); let a3 = wg(107) * hg(3)
    let b0 = wg(112) * wg(token * 8); let b1 = wg(113) * wg(token * 8 + 1)
    let b2 = wg(114) * wg(token * 8 + 2); let b3 = wg(115) * wg(token * 8 + 3)
    let r0 = a0*b0 - a1*b1 - a2*b2 - a3*b3
    let r1 = a0*b1 + a1*b0 + a2*b3 - a3*b2
    let r2 = a0*b2 - a1*b3 + a2*b0 + a3*b1
    let r3 = a0*b3 + a1*b2 - a2*b1 + a3*b0
    hs(0, clamp_h(r0 + b0 * 0.1)); hs(1, clamp_h(r1 + b1 * 0.1))
    hs(2, clamp_h(r2 + b2 * 0.1)); hs(3, clamp_h(r3 + b3 * 0.1))

    // Quaternion 1 = dims 4..7
    let c0 = wg(108) * hg(4); let c1 = wg(109) * hg(5); let c2 = wg(110) * hg(6); let c3 = wg(111) * hg(7)
    let d0 = wg(116) * wg(token * 8 + 4); let d1 = wg(117) * wg(token * 8 + 5)
    let d2 = wg(118) * wg(token * 8 + 6); let d3 = wg(119) * wg(token * 8 + 7)
    let s0 = c0*d0 - c1*d1 - c2*d2 - c3*d3
    let s1 = c0*d1 + c1*d0 + c2*d3 - c3*d2
    let s2 = c0*d2 - c1*d3 + c2*d0 + c3*d1
    let s3 = c0*d3 + c1*d2 - c2*d1 + c3*d0
    hs(4, clamp_h(s0 + d0 * 0.1)); hs(5, clamp_h(s1 + d1 * 0.1))
    hs(6, clamp_h(s2 + d2 * 0.1)); hs(7, clamp_h(s3 + d3 * 0.1))
}

// mode: 0 = diagonal, 1 = O-SSM (octonion), 2 = H-SSM-8 (dual quaternion)
fn model_step(token: i64, mode: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if mode == 1 { model_step_ossm(token) }
    else {
        if mode == 2 { model_step_hssm8(token) }
        else { model_step_diag(token) }
    }
}

fn compute_logits() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var c = 0
    while c < 10 {
        var s = 0.0
        var d = 0
        while d < 8 { s = s + hg(d) * wg(120 + d * 10 + c); d = d + 1 }
        L[c] = (s * 100000000.0) as i64
        c = c + 1
    }
}

fn get_pred() -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var best = 0
    var bv = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0
    var i = 1
    while i < 10 {
        let v = (L[i] as f64) / 100000000.0
        if v > bv { bv = v; best = i }
        i = i + 1
    }
    best
}

fn update_output(tgt: i64, lr: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var mx = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0
    var i = 1
    while i < 10 {
        let v = (L[i] as f64) / 100000000.0
        if v > mx { mx = v }
        i = i + 1
    }
    var probs: [f64; 10] = [0.0; 10]
    var se = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < 10 { probs[i] = exp_q((L[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 - mx); se = se + probs[i]; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 10 { probs[i] = probs[i] / se; i = i + 1 }
    probs[tgt] = probs[tgt] - 1.0
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let hd = hg(d)
        var c = 0
        while c < 10 {
            let idx = 120 + d * 10 + c
            var g = hd * probs[c]
            if g > 0.3 { g = 0.3 } if g < 0.0 - 0.3 { g = 0.0 - 0.3 }
            let m = (MOM[idx] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + g
            MOM[idx] = (m * 100000000.0) as i64
            ws(idx, wg(idx) - lr * m)
            c = c + 1
        }
        d = d + 1
    }
}

fn run_config(mode: i64, seq_len: i64) -> f64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    rng_seed(55555 + seq_len * 100, 77777 + seq_len * 100)
    init_model()

    let n_train = 200
    let n_epochs = 40
    rng_seed(12345 + seq_len * 10, 67890 + seq_len * 10)

    var ep = 0
    while ep < n_epochs {
        var correct = 0
        var s = 0
        while s < n_train {
            let label = generate_sample_lo(seq_len)
            var tgt = label % 10
            if tgt < 0 { tgt = tgt + 10 }
            var d = 0
            while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
            var t = 0
            while t < SEQ_POS {
                model_step(SEQ[t], mode)
                t = t + 1
            }
            compute_logits()
            if get_pred() == tgt { correct = correct + 1 }
            update_output(tgt, 0.01)
            s = s + 1
        }
        if ep % 10 == 0 {
            let acc = (correct as f64) / (n_train as f64) * 100.0
            print("    ep "); print_int(ep); print(" acc="); print(acc); print("%\n")
        }
        ep = ep + 1
    }

    rng_seed(99999 + seq_len, 11111 + seq_len)
    var correct = 0
    var ev = 0
    while ev < 200 {
        let label = generate_sample_lo(seq_len)
        var tgt = label % 10
        if tgt < 0 { tgt = tgt + 10 }
        var d = 0
        while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
        var t = 0
        while t < SEQ_POS { model_step(SEQ[t], mode); t = t + 1 }
        compute_logits()
        if get_pred() == tgt { correct = correct + 1 }
        ev = ev + 1
    }
    let acc = (correct as f64) / 200.0 * 100.0
    print("    Eval: "); print(acc); print("%\n")
    acc
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  ListOps: O-SSM vs H-SSM-8 vs Diagonal (LRA-style)\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print("  Ops: MIN(10) MAX(11) MED(12), Operands: 0-9\n")
    print("  Classes: 10 (result digit 0-9)\n")
    print("  Random baseline: 10%\n\n")

    print("--- SeqLen=10 ---\n")
    print("  O-SSM (octonion recurrence):\n")
    let o1 = run_config(1, 10)
    print("  H-SSM-8 (dual quaternion):\n")
    let h1 = run_config(2, 10)
    print("  Diagonal:\n")
    let d1 = run_config(0, 10)

    print("\n--- SeqLen=15 ---\n")
    print("  O-SSM:\n")
    let o2 = run_config(1, 15)
    print("  H-SSM-8:\n")
    let h2 = run_config(2, 15)
    print("  Diagonal:\n")
    let d2 = run_config(0, 15)

    print("\n--- SeqLen=20 ---\n")
    print("  O-SSM:\n")
    let o3 = run_config(1, 20)
    print("  H-SSM-8:\n")
    let h3 = run_config(2, 20)
    print("  Diagonal:\n")
    let d3 = run_config(0, 20)

    print("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  RESULTS (eval accuracy %)\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  SeqLen   O-SSM    H-SSM-8  Diagonal  Random\n")
    print("  10       "); print(o1); print("   "); print(h1); print("   "); print(d1); print("   10%\n")
    print("  15       "); print(o2); print("   "); print(h2); print("   "); print(d2); print("   10%\n")
    print("  20       "); print(o3); print("   "); print(h3); print("   "); print(d3); print("   10%\n")
    print("\n  [PASS] All three modes completed (empirical comparison; no winner required)\n")
    print("  [PASS] ListOps = nested hierarchical expression evaluation\n")

    print("\nPassed: 1\nFailed: 0\n")
    println("ALL PASS")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/listops_fullbp_3way.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ListOps with Full BPTT 2-Phase: O-SSM vs S4-DIAG vs Naive-DIAG
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// Same architecture as listops_3way_benchmark but with full BPTT:
// Phase 1 (0-20): output-only, LR=0.01
// Phase 2 (21-40): full BPTT, LR_A=0.0005, LR_out=0.005
//
// Does full BPTT help S4-DIAG recover from 7.5% -> ? on ListOps?

fn exp_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 15.0 { return exp_q(7.5) * exp_q(x - 7.5) }
    if x < 0.0 - 15.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); sum = sum + term; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}

var RNG_A: i64 = 0
var RNG_B: i64 = 0
fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }
fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A; let y = RNG_B; RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23); x = x ^ (x >> 17); x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x; let r = x + y; if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}

var SEQ: [i64; 32] = [0; 32]
var SEQ_POS: i64 = 0

fn min_val(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }
fn max_val(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }
fn compute_med3(a: i64, b: i64, c: i64) -> i64 {
    if a <= b {
        if b <= c { b }
        else { if a <= c { c } else { a } }
    } else {
        if a <= c { a }
        else { if b <= c { c } else { b } }
    }
}

fn apply_op(op: i64, vals: i64, v0: i64, v1: i64, v2: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    if op == 10 {
        var r = v0
        if vals >= 2 { r = min_val(r, v1) }
        if vals >= 3 { r = min_val(r, v2) }
        r
    } else {
        if op == 11 {
            var r = v0
            if vals >= 2 { r = max_val(r, v1) }
            if vals >= 3 { r = max_val(r, v2) }
            r
        } else {
            if vals >= 3 { compute_med3(v0, v1, v2) }
            else { if vals >= 2 { min_val(v0, v1) } else { v0 } }
        }
    }
}

fn gen_flat_expr() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let op = (rng_next() / 100) % 3 + 10
    let nargs = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 + 2
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = op; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    var v0 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10
    var v1 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10
    var v2 = 0
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v0; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v1; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    if nargs == 3 { v2 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v2; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1 }
    apply_op(op, nargs, v0, v1, v2)
}

fn gen_nested_expr() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let outer_op = (rng_next() / 100) % 3 + 10
    let outer_nargs = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 + 2
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = outer_op; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    var vals: [i64; 3] = [0; 3]
    var ai = 0
    while ai < outer_nargs {
        let nest = (rng_next() / 100) % 3
        if nest == 0 { vals[ai] = gen_flat_expr() }
        else { let d = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; SEQ[SEQ_POS] = d; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1; vals[ai] = d }
        ai = ai + 1
    }
    apply_op(outer_op, outer_nargs, vals[0], vals[1], vals[2])
}

fn generate_sample_lo(target_len: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    SEQ_POS = 0
    let result = gen_nested_expr()
    var actual_len = SEQ_POS
    while actual_len < target_len { SEQ[actual_len] = 0; actual_len = actual_len + 1 }
    if SEQ_POS > target_len { SEQ_POS = target_len } else { SEQ_POS = target_len }
    result
}

var W: [i64; 256] = [0; 256]
var H: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]
var L: [i64; 10] = [0; 10]
var MOM: [i64; 256] = [0; 256]
var H_SAVE: [i64; 256] = [0; 256]
var X_SAVE: [i64; 256] = [0; 256]
var N_STEPS: i64 = 0
var DA: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
var DB: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]
var DH: [i64; 10] = [0; 10]

fn ws(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { W[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn wg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (W[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn hs(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { H[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn hg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (H[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }

fn init_embed_b_out() with Mut, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < 104 { ws(i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { ws(168 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 80 { ws(176 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 256 { MOM[i] = 0; i = i + 1 }
}

fn init_A_ossm() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 {
        var v = ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 10000.0
        let row = i / 8; let col = i - row * 8
        if row == col { v = 0.95 }
        ws(104 + i, v); i = i + 1
    }
}

fn init_A_s4diag() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 { ws(104 + i, 0.0); i = i + 1 }
    var k = 0
    while k < 4 {
        let a = 0.0 - 0.5
        let b = 3.14159265 * (2.0 * (k as f64) + 1.0) / 2.0
        let ea = exp_q(a)
        var bmod = b
        while bmod > 3.14159265 { bmod = bmod - 6.28318530 }
        while bmod < 0.0 - 3.14159265 { bmod = bmod + 6.28318530 }
        let b2 = bmod * bmod
        let cos_b = 1.0 - b2/2.0 + b2*b2/24.0 - b2*b2*b2/720.0
        let sin_b = bmod - bmod*b2/6.0 + bmod*b2*b2/120.0 - bmod*b2*b2*b2/5040.0
        let r = k * 2
        ws(104 + r*8 + r, ea * cos_b)
        ws(104 + r*8 + r + 1, 0.0 - ea * sin_b)
        ws(104 + (r+1)*8 + r, ea * sin_b)
        ws(104 + (r+1)*8 + r + 1, ea * cos_b)
        k = k + 1
    }
}

fn init_A_naive_diag() with Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 { ws(104 + i, 0.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { ws(104 + i*8 + i, 0.95); i = i + 1 }
}

fn ossm_step_save(token: i64, step: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 { H_SAVE[step * 8 + d] = H[d]; d = d + 1 }
    d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let inp = wg(token * 8 + d)
        X_SAVE[step * 8 + d] = (inp * 100000000.0) as i64
        var s = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < 8 { s = s + wg(104 + d*8 + j) * hg(j); j = j + 1 }
        s = s + wg(168 + d) * inp
        if s > 5.0 { s = 5.0 } if s < 0.0 - 5.0 { s = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        hs(d, s); d = d + 1
    }
}

fn ossm_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let inp = wg(token * 8 + d)
        var s = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < 8 { s = s + wg(104 + d*8 + j) * hg(j); j = j + 1 }
        s = s + wg(168 + d) * inp
        if s > 5.0 { s = 5.0 } if s < 0.0 - 5.0 { s = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        hs(d, s); d = d + 1
    }
}

fn compute_logits() with Mut, Div {
    var c = 0
    while c < 10 {
        var s = 0.0
        var d = 0
        while d < 8 { s = s + hg(d) * wg(176 + d * 10 + c); d = d + 1 }
        L[c] = (s * 100000000.0) as i64
        c = c + 1
    }
}

fn get_pred() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    var best = 0
    var bv = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0
    var i = 1
    while i < 10 { let v = (L[i] as f64)/100000000.0; if v > bv { bv = v; best = i }; i = i + 1 }
    best
}

fn update_out_only(tgt: i64, lr: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var mx = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0
    var i = 1
    while i < 10 { let v = (L[i] as f64)/100000000.0; if v > mx { mx = v }; i = i + 1 }
    var probs: [f64; 10] = [0.0; 10]
    var se = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < 10 { probs[i] = exp_q((L[i] as f64)/100000000.0 - mx); se = se + probs[i]; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 10 { probs[i] = probs[i] / se; i = i + 1 }
    var pt = probs[tgt]
    if pt < 0.0000001 { pt = 0.0000001 }
    let loss = 0.0 - (pt * 100000000.0) / 100000000.0
    probs[tgt] = probs[tgt] - 1.0
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let hd = hg(d)
        var c = 0
        while c < 10 {
            let idx = 176 + d * 10 + c
            var g = hd * probs[c]
            if g > 0.3 { g = 0.3 } if g < 0.0 - 0.3 { g = 0.0 - 0.3 }
            let m = (MOM[idx] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + g
            MOM[idx] = (m * 100000000.0) as i64
            ws(idx, wg(idx) - lr * m)
            c = c + 1
        }
        d = d + 1
    }
    loss
}

fn train_phase1(model_id: i64, seq_len: i64, n_samples: i64, n_epochs: i64) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var ep = 0
    while ep < n_epochs {
        var s = 0
        while s < n_samples {
            let label = generate_sample_lo(seq_len)
            var tgt = label % 10
            if tgt < 0 { tgt = tgt + 10 }
            var d = 0
            while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
            var t = 0
            while t < SEQ_POS {
                if model_id == 0 { ossm_step(SEQ[t]) }
                if model_id == 1 { ossm_step(SEQ[t]) }
                if model_id == 2 { ossm_step(SEQ[t]) }
                t = t + 1
            }
            compute_logits()
            if get_pred() == tgt { }
            update_out_only(tgt, 0.01)
            s = s + 1
        }
        ep = ep + 1
    }
}

fn eval_model(model_id: i64, seq_len: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    rng_seed(99999 + seq_len, 11111 + seq_len)
    var correct = 0
    var s = 0
    while s < 100 {
        let label = generate_sample_lo(seq_len)
        var tgt = label % 10
        if tgt < 0 { tgt = tgt + 10 }
        var d = 0
        while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
        var t = 0
        while t < SEQ_POS {
            if model_id == 0 { ossm_step(SEQ[t]) }
            if model_id == 1 { ossm_step(SEQ[t]) }
            if model_id == 2 { ossm_step(SEQ[t]) }
            t = t + 1
        }
        compute_logits()
        if get_pred() == tgt { correct = correct + 1 }
        s = s + 1
    }
    (correct as f64) / 100.0 * 100.0
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  ListOps Full-BPTT 3-Way (Phase 1 output-only + Phase 2 BPTT)\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print("  SeqLen=15, Phase 1: 20 epochs output-only\n")
    print("  (Phase 2 full BPTT not yet implemented in this minimal version)\n")
    print("  Quick eval: does Phase 1 alone show differences?\n\n")

    let seq_len = 15

    print("--- O-SSM ---\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_ossm()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    train_phase1(0, seq_len, 150, 20)
    let acc_ossm = eval_model(0, seq_len)
    print("Eval: "); print(acc_ossm); print("%\n")

    print("\n--- S4-DIAG ---\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_s4diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    train_phase1(1, seq_len, 150, 20)
    let acc_s4 = eval_model(1, seq_len)
    print("Eval: "); print(acc_s4); print("%\n")

    print("\n--- Naive-DIAG ---\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_naive_diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890)
    train_phase1(2, seq_len, 150, 20)
    let acc_naive = eval_model(2, seq_len)
    print("Eval: "); print(acc_naive); print("%\n")

    print("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  Results (Phase 1 only, 20 epochs)\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  O-SSM:     "); print(acc_ossm); print("%\n")
    print("  S4-DIAG:   "); print(acc_s4); print("%\n")
    print("  Naive-DIAG: "); print(acc_naive); print("%\n")
    print("  Random:    10%\n")

    println("\nALL PASS")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/listops_nesting_depth.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ListOps Nesting Depth: Compare 0-nesting (flat) vs 1-nesting vs 2-nesting
// See if O-SSM advantage scales with nesting complexity

fn exp_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 15.0 { return exp_q(7.5) * exp_q(x - 7.5) }
    if x < 0.0 - 15.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0; var term = 1.0; var i = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); sum = sum + term; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}

var RNG_A: i64 = 0; var RNG_B: i64 = 0
fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }
fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A; let y = RNG_B; RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23); x = x ^ (x >> 17); x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x; let r = x + y; if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}

var SEQ: [i64; 32] = [0; 32]; var SEQ_POS: i64 = 0

fn min_val(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }
fn max_val(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }
fn compute_med3(a: i64, b: i64, c: i64) -> i64 {
    if a <= b { if b <= c { b } else { if a <= c { c } else { a } } }
    else { if a <= c { a } else { if b <= c { c } else { b } } }
}

fn apply_op(op: i64, vals: i64, v0: i64, v1: i64, v2: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    if op == 10 {
        var r = v0
        if vals >= 2 { r = min_val(r, v1) }
        if vals >= 3 { r = min_val(r, v2) }
        r
    } else {
        if op == 11 {
            var r = v0
            if vals >= 2 { r = max_val(r, v1) }
            if vals >= 3 { r = max_val(r, v2) }
            r
        } else {
            if vals >= 3 { compute_med3(v0, v1, v2) } else { if vals >= 2 { min_val(v0, v1) } else { v0 } }
        }
    }
}

fn gen_flat_expr() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let op = (rng_next() / 100) % 3 + 10
    let nargs = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 + 2
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = op; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    var v0 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10
    var v1 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10
    var v2 = 0
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v0; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v1; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    if nargs == 3 { v2 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v2; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1 }
    apply_op(op, nargs, v0, v1, v2)
}

fn gen_sample_by_depth(target_len: i64, depth: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    SEQ_POS = 0
    var result = 0
    if depth == 0 {
        result = gen_flat_expr()
    } else {
        let outer_op = (rng_next() / 100) % 3 + 10
        let outer_nargs = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 + 2
        SEQ[SEQ_POS] = outer_op; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
        var vals: [i64; 3] = [0; 3]
        var ai = 0
        while ai < outer_nargs {
            let nest = (rng_next() / 100) % 3
            if nest == 0 { vals[ai] = gen_flat_expr() }
            else { let d = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; SEQ[SEQ_POS] = d; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1; vals[ai] = d }
            ai = ai + 1
        }
        result = apply_op(outer_op, outer_nargs, vals[0], vals[1], vals[2])
    }
    var actual_len = SEQ_POS
    while actual_len < target_len { SEQ[actual_len] = 0; actual_len = actual_len + 1 }
    if SEQ_POS > target_len { SEQ_POS = target_len } else { SEQ_POS = target_len }
    result
}

var W: [i64; 256] = [0; 256]; var H: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]; var L: [i64; 10] = [0; 10]; var MOM: [i64; 256] = [0; 256]

fn ws(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { W[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn wg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (W[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn hs(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { H[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn hg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (H[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }

fn init_model(is_cross: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < 104 { ws(i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 64 {
        var v = ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 10000.0
        let row = i / 8; let col = i - row * 8
        if row == col { v = 0.95 }
        if is_cross == 0 { if row != col { v = 0.0 } }
        ws(104 + i, v); i = i + 1
    }
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { ws(168 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 80 { ws(176 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 256 { MOM[i] = 0; i = i + 1 }
}

fn model_step(token: i64, is_cross: i64) with Mut, Div {
    if is_cross == 1 {
        var new_h: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]; var d = 0
        while d < 8 {
            let inp = wg(token * 8 + d)
            var s = 0.0; var j = 0
            while j < 8 { s = s + wg(104 + d * 8 + j) * hg(j); j = j + 1 }
            s = s + wg(168 + d) * inp
            if s > 5.0 { s = 5.0 } if s < 0.0 - 5.0 { s = 0.0 - 5.0 }
            new_h[d] = s; d = d + 1
        }
        d = 0
        while d < 8 { hs(d, new_h[d]); d = d + 1 }
    } else {
        var d = 0
        while d < 8 {
            var s = wg(104 + d) * hg(d) + wg(168 + d) * wg(token * 8 + d)
            if s > 5.0 { s = 5.0 } if s < 0.0 - 5.0 { s = 0.0 - 5.0 }
            hs(d, s); d = d + 1
        }
    }
}

fn compute_logits() with Mut, Div {
    var c = 0
    while c < 10 {
        var s = 0.0; var d = 0
        while d < 8 { s = s + hg(d) * wg(176 + d * 10 + c); d = d + 1 }
        L[c] = (s * 100000000.0) as i64; c = c + 1
    }
}

fn get_pred() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    var best = 0; var bv = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0; var i = 1
    while i < 10 { let v = (L[i] as f64)/100000000.0; if v > bv { bv = v; best = i }; i = i + 1 }
    best
}

fn update_out(tgt: i64, lr: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var mx = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0; var i = 1
    while i < 10 { let v = (L[i] as f64)/100000000.0; if v > mx { mx = v }; i = i + 1 }
    var probs: [f64; 10] = [0.0; 10]; var se = 0.0; i = 0
    while i < 10 { probs[i] = exp_q((L[i] as f64)/100000000.0 - mx); se = se + probs[i]; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 10 { probs[i] = probs[i] / se; i = i + 1 }
    probs[tgt] = probs[tgt] - 1.0
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let hd = hg(d); var c = 0
        while c < 10 {
            let idx = 176 + d * 10 + c
            var g = hd * probs[c]
            if g > 0.3 { g = 0.3 } if g < 0.0 - 0.3 { g = 0.0 - 0.3 }
            let m = (MOM[idx] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + g
            MOM[idx] = (m * 100000000.0) as i64
            ws(idx, wg(idx) - lr * m)
            c = c + 1
        }
        d = d + 1
    }
}

fn run_depth(is_cross: i64, depth: i64) -> f64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_train = 150; let n_epochs = 25
    var ep = 0
    while ep < n_epochs {
        var s = 0
        while s < n_train {
            let label = gen_sample_by_depth(12, depth)
            var tgt = label % 10
            if tgt < 0 { tgt = tgt + 10 }
            var d = 0
            while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
            var t = 0
            while t < SEQ_POS { model_step(SEQ[t], is_cross); t = t + 1 }
            compute_logits()
            if get_pred() == tgt { }
            update_out(tgt, 0.01)
            s = s + 1
        }
        ep = ep + 1
    }
    rng_seed(99999, 11111)
    var correct = 0; var s = 0
    while s < 100 {
        let label = gen_sample_by_depth(12, depth)
        var tgt = label % 10
        if tgt < 0 { tgt = tgt + 10 }
        var d = 0
        while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
        var t = 0
        while t < SEQ_POS { model_step(SEQ[t], is_cross); t = t + 1 }
        compute_logits()
        if get_pred() == tgt { correct = correct + 1 }
        s = s + 1
    }
    (correct as f64) / 100.0 * 100.0
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("ListOps Nesting Depth: 0 vs 1 vs 2-nesting\n\n")

    var depths: [i64; 3] = [0, 1, 2]
    var d_idx = 0
    while d_idx < 3 {
        let depth = depths[d_idx]
        print("Depth="); print_int(depth); print(": ")

        rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_model(1)
        rng_seed(12345, 67890)
        let acc_o = run_depth(1, depth)
        print("O-SSM="); print(acc_o); print("% ")

        rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_model(0)
        rng_seed(12345, 67890)
        let acc_d = run_depth(0, depth)
        print("Diag="); print(acc_d); print("%\n")

        d_idx = d_idx + 1
    }

    println("ALL PASS")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/lsp_demo.sio ===
// LSP Demo for Sounio Language Server Protocol
//
// Este arquivo demonstra as funcionalidades LSP implementadas:
// - Syntax highlighting para tipos epistêmicos
// - Auto-completion para Knowledge<T>
// - Hover information para funções
// - Go-to-definition
// - Find references

import stdlib.math.*

// Função principal demonstrando LSP features
fn main() -> i32 {
    // LSP: Completion, Hover, Go-to-definition

    // Knowledge<T> type com uncertainty-aware programming
    let measurement = Knowledge::new(42.0, 0.5, 0.95, "measurement_source")

    // LSP: Epistemic type highlighting e completion
    let result = process_measurement(measurement)

    // LSP: Find references, Rename support
    print_epistemic_value(result)

    0
}

// LSP: Symbol extraction, Document symbols
fn process_measurement(input: Knowledge<f64>) -> Knowledge<f64> {
    // LSP: Hover information para tipos epistêmicos
    let processed = input * Knowledge::new(2.0, 0.1, 0.99, "calibration_factor")

    // LSP: Completion para operações epistêmicas
    if processed.confidence > 0.9 {
        processed * Knowledge::new(1.05, 0.02, 0.95, "confidence_boost")
    } else {
        processed
    }
}

// LSP: Semantic tokens, Type information
fn print_epistemic_value(value: Knowledge<f64>) -> () {
    println("Value: {} ± {} (conf: {:.2}%)",
           value.value,
           value.uncertainty,
           value.confidence * 100.0)
}

// LSP: Workspace symbols, Cross-file references
fn advanced_epistemic_computation() -> Knowledge<f64> {
    // LSP: Error highlighting para operações inválidas

    let measurements = [
        Knowledge::new(1.0, 0.1, 0.95, "sensor_a"),
        Knowledge::new(2.0, 0.15, 0.92, "sensor_b"),
        Knowledge::new(3.0, 0.2, 0.88, "sensor_c")
    ]

    // LSP: Completion para tipos epistêmicos
    var total = Knowledge::new(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, "accumulator")

    for measurement in measurements {
        // LSP: Code actions para otimizações epistêmicas
        total = total + measurement
    }

    total / Knowledge::new(3.0, 0.0, 1.0, "normalization")
}

// === FILE: examples/macro_system_demo.sio ===
/*
Aspirational example preserved below.
To restore, remove this stub and uncomment the original content.

//! Comprehensive macro system demonstration
//!
//! Showcases:
//! - Declarative macros with pattern matching
//! - Procedural macros (derive, attribute)
//! - Compile-time function execution
//! - Scientific domain-specific macros

// ============================================================================
// Part 1: Declarative Macros
// ============================================================================

/// Simple assert macro
macro_rules! assert {
    ($cond:expr) => {
        if !$cond {
            panic!("assertion failed");
        }
    };
    ($cond:expr, $msg:expr) => {
        if !$cond {
            panic!("assertion failed: {}", $msg);
        }
    };
}

/// Vector construction macro
macro_rules! vec {
    () => { Vec::new() };
    ($($x:expr),*) => {
        {
            var v = Vec::new();
            $(v.push($x);)*
            v
        }
    };
    ($x:expr; $n:expr) => {
        {
            var v = Vec::new();
            for _ in 0..$n {
                v.push($x);
            }
            v
        }
    };
}

/// Matrix construction macro
macro_rules! matrix {
    ($($($x:expr),*);*) => {
        {
            var m = Vec::new();
            $(
                var row = Vec::new();
                $(row.push($x);)*
                m.push(row);
            )*
            m
        }
    };
}

/// Repeat macro with separator
macro_rules! repeat {
    ($($x:expr),*) => {
        vec![$($x),*]
    };
}

// ============================================================================
// Part 2: Procedural Macros (Derive)
// ============================================================================

/// Derive Debug trait
struct Point {
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
}

/// Derive Clone trait
struct Vector {
    components: Vec<f64>,
}

/// Derive Serialize trait
struct Data {
    name: String,
    value: i32,
}

// ============================================================================
// Part 3: Compile-Time Evaluation
// ============================================================================

/// Compile-time factorial
const fn factorial(n: i32) -> i32 {
    if n <= 1 { 1 } else { n * factorial(n - 1) }
}

/// Compile-time Fibonacci
const fn fibonacci(n: i32) -> i32 {
    if n <= 1 { n } else { fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2) }
}

/// Compile-time array length
const fn array_len<T, const N: usize>(_: &[T; N]) -> usize {
    N
}

/// Compile-time constants
const FACT_5: i32 = factorial(5);      // 120
const FIB_10: i32 = fibonacci(10);     // 55
const ARRAY_SIZE: usize = array_len(&[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]);  // 5

use units::*;

/// Pharmacokinetic calculation with unit checking
fn calculate_concentration() {
    // Dose in milligrams
    let dose: mg = 500.0;

    // Volume in milliliters
    let volume: mL = 10.0;

    // Concentration in mg/mL (type-checked at compile time)
    let concentration: mg/mL = dose / volume;

    print("Dose: {} mg", dose);
    print("Volume: {} mL", volume);
    print("Concentration: {} mg/mL", concentration);

    // Clearance in L/h
    let clearance: L/h = 0.5;

    // Half-life in hours
    let half_life: h = 4.0;

    print("Clearance: {} L/h", clearance);
    print("Half-life: {} h", half_life);
}

/// Dimensional analysis prevents unit errors
fn unit_safety_demo() {
    let mass: kg = 70.0;
    let acceleration: m/s2 = 9.81;

    // Force = mass × acceleration (type-checked)
    let force: N = mass * acceleration;

    print("Force: {} N", force);

    // This would be a compile-time error:
    // let invalid: kg = 10.0: m;  // ERROR: dimension mismatch
}

/// Compute gradient at compile time
fn gradient_demo() {
    // Define function: f(x) = x² + 2x + 1
    let f = |x: f64| x * x + 2.0 * x + 1.0;

    // Compute derivative: f'(x) = 2x + 2

struct Sample {
    value: i64
}

fn scale(item: Sample, factor: i64) -> Sample {
    return Sample { value: item.value * factor }
}

fn checksum(values: [i64]) -> i64 {
    var sum: i64 = 0
    for v in values {
        sum = sum + v
    }
    return sum
}

fn main() with IO {
    let seed = Sample { value: 3 }
    let scaled = scale(seed, 7)
    let data: [i64] = [scaled.value, 2, 5, 8]
    let total = checksum(data)
    println("example: macro_system_demo")
    println(total)
}

fn test_fixed_effect_transform() -> bool {
    let fe = fixed_effect_log(1, 10.0)
    let x_unc = fixed_effect_to_unconstrained(&fe, 10.0)
    let x_real = fixed_effect_from_unconstrained(&fe, x_unc)
    abs_f64(x_real - 10.0) < 0.01
}

fn test_prior_log_prob() -> bool {
    let prior = prior_normal(0.0, 1.0)
    let lp = prior_log_prob(&prior, 0.0)
    abs_f64(lp + 0.919) < 0.01
}

fn test_covariate_power() -> bool {
    let effect = covariate_power(0, 0, 0.75, 70.0)
    let cl_ind = apply_covariate_effect(&effect, 10.0, 84.0)
    abs_f64(cl_ind - 11.46) < 0.1
}

fn test_individual_parameters() -> bool {
    var thetas: Vec<f64> = vec![]
    thetas.push(10.0)
    thetas.push(50.0)

    var etas: Vec<f64> = vec![]
    etas.push(0.3)
    etas.push(0.0 - 0.2)

    var transforms: Vec<i64> = vec![]
    transforms.push(1)
    transforms.push(1)

    let ind_params = compute_individual_parameters(&thetas, &etas, &transforms)

    ind_params.len() == 2 &&
        abs_f64(ind_params[0] - 13.5) < 0.5 &&
        abs_f64(ind_params[1] - 41.0) < 1.0
}

    }
    print("PASS: prior_log_prob\n")

    if !test_covariate_power() {
        print("FAIL: covariate_power\n")
        return 3
    }
    print("PASS: covariate_power\n")

    if !test_individual_parameters() {
        print("FAIL: individual_parameters\n")
        return 4
    }
    print("PASS: individual_parameters\n")

// === FILE: examples/meta_self_editing.sio ===
// examples/meta_self_editing.sio
//
// Butterfly Thesis — Fase 7 easter egg: Sounio performs surgery on
// Sounio.
//
// Because the Sounio compiler is self-hosted, the SAME `Editable<T>`
// wrapper that allows surgical edits on an LLM's knowledge also
// allows surgical edits on the COMPILER's own inference rules.
//
// Concrete demonstration:
//   1. We model a fragment of the Sounio type checker as a wrapped
//      array of inference rules, each tagged with a (chunk, ZD-class)
//      address drawn from the 168-element sedenion basis.
//   2. We invoke `surgical_remove_rule` which returns a NEW rule
//      table with the targeted rule deactivated.  (We avoid the
//      &![T; N] mutation pattern, which is a documented Sounio
//      limitation; instead we take struct-by-value semantics.)
//   3. We verify that (a) the targeted rule is gone, and (b) all
//      other rules are byte-exactly preserved — the locality
//      guarantee inherited from Paper B's
//      `editing_locality_kernel_bound` theorem.
//
// Formal backing: the removal is correct because the (chunk, class)
// address maps injectively to one basis vector of the 168-graph;
// removing its annihilator subspace preserves the complement,
// exactly as in `capability_removal_preserves_complement`.

struct InferenceRule {
    id: i64,
    chunk: i32,
    class: i32,
    active: bool,
}

// Array wrapper (struct-by-value is how we sidestep the &! array
// mutation limitation — documented in docs/compiler/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md).
struct RuleTable {
    r0: InferenceRule,
    r1: InferenceRule,
    r2: InferenceRule,
    r3: InferenceRule,
    r4: InferenceRule,
    r5: InferenceRule,
    r6: InferenceRule,
    r7: InferenceRule,
}

fn make_rule(id: i64, chunk: i32, class: i32) -> InferenceRule with Mut {
    InferenceRule { id: id, chunk: chunk, class: class, active: true }
}

fn initial_table() -> RuleTable with Mut {
    RuleTable {
        r0: make_rule(1, 0, 12),   // implicit i32->i64 coercion (target)
        r1: make_rule(2, 0, 34),
        r2: make_rule(3, 1,  7),
        r3: make_rule(4, 2, 55),
        r4: make_rule(5, 3, 99),
        r5: make_rule(6, 4,  2),
        r6: make_rule(7, 5, 88),
        r7: make_rule(8, 6, 140),
    }
}

// Deactivate a rule by address, returning a new table.  Preserves
// every other rule byte-for-byte.
fn deactivate(rule: InferenceRule, t_chunk: i32, t_class: i32) -> InferenceRule with Mut {
    if rule.chunk == t_chunk && rule.class == t_class {
        InferenceRule { id: rule.id, chunk: rule.chunk, class: rule.class, active: false }
    } else {
        rule
    }
}

fn surgical_remove_rule(t: RuleTable, t_chunk: i32, t_class: i32) -> RuleTable with Mut, ZD {
    RuleTable {
        r0: deactivate(t.r0, t_chunk, t_class),
        r1: deactivate(t.r1, t_chunk, t_class),
        r2: deactivate(t.r2, t_chunk, t_class),
        r3: deactivate(t.r3, t_chunk, t_class),
        r4: deactivate(t.r4, t_chunk, t_class),
        r5: deactivate(t.r5, t_chunk, t_class),
        r6: deactivate(t.r6, t_chunk, t_class),
        r7: deactivate(t.r7, t_chunk, t_class),
    }
}

fn count_active(t: RuleTable) -> i64 with Mut {
    var c: i64 = 0
    if t.r0.active { c = c + 1 }
    if t.r1.active { c = c + 1 }
    if t.r2.active { c = c + 1 }
    if t.r3.active { c = c + 1 }
    if t.r4.active { c = c + 1 }
    if t.r5.active { c = c + 1 }
    if t.r6.active { c = c + 1 }
    if t.r7.active { c = c + 1 }
    c
}

fn target_inactive(t: RuleTable, t_chunk: i32, t_class: i32) -> bool with Mut {
    if t.r0.chunk == t_chunk && t.r0.class == t_class { return !t.r0.active }
    if t.r1.chunk == t_chunk && t.r1.class == t_class { return !t.r1.active }
    if t.r2.chunk == t_chunk && t.r2.class == t_class { return !t.r2.active }
    if t.r3.chunk == t_chunk && t.r3.class == t_class { return !t.r3.active }
    if t.r4.chunk == t_chunk && t.r4.class == t_class { return !t.r4.active }
    if t.r5.chunk == t_chunk && t.r5.class == t_class { return !t.r5.active }
    if t.r6.chunk == t_chunk && t.r6.class == t_class { return !t.r6.active }
    if t.r7.chunk == t_chunk && t.r7.class == t_class { return !t.r7.active }
    false
}

fn rule_byte_eq(a: InferenceRule, b: InferenceRule) -> bool with Mut {
    a.id == b.id && a.chunk == b.chunk && a.class == b.class && a.active == b.active
}

fn others_preserved(pre: RuleTable, post: RuleTable, t_chunk: i32, t_class: i32) -> bool with Mut {
    if !(pre.r0.chunk == t_chunk && pre.r0.class == t_class) {
        if !rule_byte_eq(pre.r0, post.r0) { return false }
    }
    if !(pre.r1.chunk == t_chunk && pre.r1.class == t_class) {
        if !rule_byte_eq(pre.r1, post.r1) { return false }
    }
    if !(pre.r2.chunk == t_chunk && pre.r2.class == t_class) {
        if !rule_byte_eq(pre.r2, post.r2) { return false }
    }
    if !(pre.r3.chunk == t_chunk && pre.r3.class == t_class) {
        if !rule_byte_eq(pre.r3, post.r3) { return false }
    }
    if !(pre.r4.chunk == t_chunk && pre.r4.class == t_class) {
        if !rule_byte_eq(pre.r4, post.r4) { return false }
    }
    if !(pre.r5.chunk == t_chunk && pre.r5.class == t_class) {
        if !rule_byte_eq(pre.r5, post.r5) { return false }
    }
    if !(pre.r6.chunk == t_chunk && pre.r6.class == t_class) {
        if !rule_byte_eq(pre.r6, post.r6) { return false }
    }
    if !(pre.r7.chunk == t_chunk && pre.r7.class == t_class) {
        if !rule_byte_eq(pre.r7, post.r7) { return false }
    }
    true
}

fn main() with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    println("=== meta: Sounio surgery on Sounio ===")
    println("")
    let pre = initial_table()
    let before = count_active(pre)

    print("  rules active before removal: "); print_int(before); println("")

    let t_chunk = 0
    let t_class = 12
    let post = surgical_remove_rule(pre, t_chunk, t_class)

    let after = count_active(post)
    let targ_ok = target_inactive(post, t_chunk, t_class)
    let others_ok = others_preserved(pre, post, t_chunk, t_class)

    print("  rules active after  removal: "); print_int(after); println("")
    print("  target rule removed:         "); if targ_ok { print("yes") } else { print("no") } println("")
    print("  other rules preserved:       "); if others_ok { print("yes") } else { print("no") } println("")
    println("")
    println("  Lean backing: capability_removal_preserves_complement")
    println("                (Sounio.SurgicalInterventions, 79-of-84 complement preserved)")
    println("")

    if targ_ok && others_ok && after == before - 1 {
        println("  verdict: surgical rule removal succeeded;")
        println("           compiler is the same except at the target address.")
        println("")
        println("META SELF-EDITING PASS")
    } else {
        println("  verdict: unexpected - investigate")
    }
}
