// === FILE: examples/ml/autodiff_demo.sio ===
// Demo for stdlib/ml/autodiff.sio
//
// This file demonstrates usage of the ml::autodiff module.
// Module source: stdlib/ml/autodiff.sio

// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i32 {
    println("=== Sounio ML Automatic Differentiation ===")
    println("")

    println("Part 1: Dual Numbers (Forward Mode)")
    println("------------------------------------")

    // Test dual number derivative: f(x) = x^2 at x = 3
    let x1 = dual_variable(3.0)
    let y1 = dual_mul(x1, x1)
    println("f(x) = x^2 at x=3")
    println("  f(3) = ")
    println(y1.value)
    println("  f'(3) = ")
    println(y1.derivative)
    println("  Expected: 9, 6")
    println("")

    println("Part 2: Tape-Based Reverse Mode")
    println("--------------------------------")

    // Test tape: f(x) = x * x
    var tape = tape_new()
    let result = tape_variable(tape, 3.0)
    tape = result.0
    let x2 = result.1

    let result2 = tape_mul(tape, x2, x2)
    tape = result2.0
    let y2 = result2.1

    tape = tape_backward(tape, y2.tape_idx)
    let deriv = tape_get_grad(tape, x2.tape_idx)

    println("Tape: f(x) = x^2 at x=3")
    println("  f(3) = ")
    println(y2.value)
    println("  df/dx = ")
    println(deriv)
    println("  Expected: 9, 6")
    println("")

    println("Part 3: Epistemic Derivative Tracking")
    println("------------------------------------")

    let gv1 = grad_var_new(1.5)
    let gv2 = grad_var_update(gv1, 1.8)
    let gv3 = grad_var_update(gv2, 1.2)
    println("Derivative statistics over 3 samples:")
    println("  Mean = ")
    println(gv3.gradient)
    println("  Variance = ")
    println(gv3.variance)
    println("  Std Dev = ")
    println(grad_var_std_dev(gv3))
    println("")

    println("Part 4: Vector Jacobian Products")
    println("---------------------------------")

    let grad_out = 2.0
    let weight = 0.5
    let vjp_result = vjp_linear(grad_out, weight)
    println("VJP Linear: grad_out=2.0, weight=0.5")
    println("  Result = ")
    println(vjp_result)
    println("  Expected: 1.0")
    println("")

    let input_relu = 0.5
    let vjp_relu_result = vjp_relu(grad_out, input_relu)
    println("VJP ReLU: grad_out=2.0, input=0.5")
    println("  Result = ")
    println(vjp_relu_result)
    println("  Expected: 2.0")
    println("")

    println("=== All Tests Complete ===")
    return 0
}


// === FILE: examples/mlp_concrete_ablation.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// MLP Ablation on UCI Concrete — Paper B Experiment E3
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// Same dataset as E-KAN (ekan_concrete_uci.sio), MLP architecture.
// MLP 8→10→1 with ReLU (101 params) vs E-KAN 8→10→1 (540 params).
// KEY: keep main() lean — decompose into small functions.

fn sqrt_m(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}
fn abs_m(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

var RNG_A: i64 = 0
var RNG_B: i64 = 0
fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }
fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A
    let y = RNG_B
    RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23)
    x = x ^ (x >> 17)
    x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x
    let r = x + y
    if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}
fn rand_uniform() -> f64 with Mut, Div { (rng_next() % 10000) as f64 / 10000.0 }
fn rand_normal() -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum = 0.0
    var j = 0
    while j < 12 { sum = sum + rand_uniform(); j = j + 1 }
    sum - 6.0
}

// ─── Dataset ───
var DX: [i64; 1600] = [0; 1600]
var DYY: [i64; 200] = [0; 200]
var N_LOADED: i64 = 0

fn get_x(s: i64, f: i64) -> f64 with Div { (DX[s * 8 + f] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn get_y(s: i64) -> f64 with Div { (DYY[s] as f64) / 100000000.0 }

fn load_concrete() with IO, Mut, Div {
    var buf: [i8; 4096] = [0; 4096]
    let fd = syscall6(2, "/tmp/concrete_data.txt", 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    if fd < 0 { return }
    let n = syscall6(0, fd, &buf, 4095, 0, 0, 0)
    syscall6(3, fd, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    var pos: i64 = 0
    while pos < n {
        if buf[pos] == 45 && buf[pos + 1] == 45 && buf[pos + 2] == 45 && buf[pos + 3] == 68 {
            while pos < n && buf[pos] != 10 { pos = pos + 1 }
            if pos < n { pos = pos + 1 }
            break
        }
        pos = pos + 1
    }
    var si = 0
    while pos < n && si < 100 {
        var fi = 0
        while fi < 9 && pos < n {
            while pos < n && buf[pos] == 32 { pos = pos + 1 }
            var ip: i64 = 0
            while pos < n && buf[pos] >= 48 && buf[pos] <= 57 {
                ip = ip * 10 + ((buf[pos] - 48) as i64)
                pos = pos + 1
            }
            var frac = 0.0
            var fs = 1.0
            if pos < n && buf[pos] == 46 {
                pos = pos + 1
                while pos < n && buf[pos] >= 48 && buf[pos] <= 57 {
                    frac = frac * 10.0 + ((buf[pos] - 48) as f64)
                    fs = fs * 10.0
                    pos = pos + 1
                }
            }
            let val = (ip as f64) + frac / fs
            if fi < 8 { DX[si * 8 + fi] = (val * 100000000.0) as i64 }
            else { DYY[si] = (val * 100000000.0) as i64 }
            fi = fi + 1
        }
        while pos < n && buf[pos] != 10 { pos = pos + 1 }
        if pos < n { pos = pos + 1 }
        si = si + 1
    }
    N_LOADED = si
    print("loaded "); print_int(si); println(" samples")
}

// ─── MLP 8→10→1 ───
var MW: [i64; 110] = [0; 110]
var MH: [i64; 10] = [0; 10]
var MZ: [i64; 10] = [0; 10]
var MENS: [i64; 550] = [0; 550]

fn mw_set(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { MW[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn mw_get(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (MW[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn mens_store(mi: i64) with Mut { var i = 0; while i < 110 { MENS[mi * 110 + i] = MW[i]; i = i + 1 } }
fn mens_load(mi: i64) with Mut { var i = 0; while i < 110 { MW[i] = MENS[mi * 110 + i]; i = i + 1 } }

fn mlp_init() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < 80 { mw_set(i, rand_normal() * 0.05); i = i + 1 }
    i = 80
    while i < 90 { mw_set(i, 0.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 90
    while i < 100 { mw_set(i, rand_normal() * 0.05); i = i + 1 }
    mw_set(100, 0.0)
}

fn mlp_forward(si: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var j = 0
    while j < 10 {
        var s = mw_get(80 + j)
        var fi = 0
        while fi < 8 { s = s + get_x(si, fi) * mw_get(fi * 10 + j); fi = fi + 1 }
        MZ[j] = (s * 100000000.0) as i64
        if s < 0.0 { s = 0.0 }
        MH[j] = (s * 100000000.0) as i64
        j = j + 1
    }
    var out = mw_get(100)
    j = 0
    while j < 10 { out = out + (MH[j] as f64) / 100000000.0 * mw_get(90 + j); j = j + 1 }
    out
}

fn mlp_backprop(si: i64, lr: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let err = mlp_forward(si) - get_y(si)
    var ge = 2.0 * err
    if ge > 1.0 { ge = 1.0 }
    if ge < 0.0 - 1.0 { ge = 0.0 - 1.0 }

    var j = 0
    while j < 10 {
        mw_set(90 + j, mw_get(90 + j) - lr * ge * (MH[j] as f64) / 100000000.0)
        j = j + 1
    }
    mw_set(100, mw_get(100) - lr * ge)

    j = 0
    while j < 10 {
        let zj = (MZ[j] as f64) / 100000000.0
        var dh = ge * mw_get(90 + j)
        if zj <= 0.0 { dh = 0.0 }
        if dh > 1.0 { dh = 1.0 }
        if dh < 0.0 - 1.0 { dh = 0.0 - 1.0 }
        var fi = 0
        while fi < 8 {
            mw_set(fi * 10 + j, mw_get(fi * 10 + j) - lr * dh * get_x(si, fi))
            fi = fi + 1
        }
        mw_set(80 + j, mw_get(80 + j) - lr * dh)
        j = j + 1
    }
}

fn mlp_train(nt: i64, epochs: i64, lr: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var epoch = 0
    while epoch < epochs {
        var tl = 0.0
        var si = 0
        while si < nt {
            let p = mlp_forward(si)
            let e = p - get_y(si)
            tl = tl + e * e
            mlp_backprop(si, lr)
            si = si + 1
        }
        if epoch % 50 == 0 { print("  epoch "); print_int(epoch); print(" MSE="); print(tl / (nt as f64)); print("\n") }
        epoch = epoch + 1
    }
}

fn mlp_gum_sigma(si: i64, isig: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let nom = mlp_forward(si)
    var vout = 0.0
    var fi = 0
    while fi < 8 {
        let orig = DX[si * 8 + fi]
        let ov = (orig as f64) / 100000000.0
        DX[si * 8 + fi] = ((ov + isig) * 100000000.0) as i64
        let plus = mlp_forward(si)
        DX[si * 8 + fi] = ((ov - isig) * 100000000.0) as i64
        let minus = mlp_forward(si)
        DX[si * 8 + fi] = orig
        let dc = (plus - minus) / (2.0 * isig)
        vout = vout + dc * dc * isig * isig
        fi = fi + 1
    }
    mlp_forward(si)
    sqrt_m(vout)
}

// ─── Calibration ───
var MC1: i64 = 0
var MC196: i64 = 0
var MC258: i64 = 0
var ME1: i64 = 0
var ME196: i64 = 0
var ME258: i64 = 0
var MGS: i64 = 0
var MES: i64 = 0

fn run_mlp_calibration(n_train: i64, n_test: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let isig = 0.02
    MC1 = 0; MC196 = 0; MC258 = 0
    ME1 = 0; ME196 = 0; ME258 = 0
    var gs_sum = 0.0
    var es_sum = 0.0

    mens_load(0)
    var i = 0
    while i < n_test {
        let si = n_train + i
        let yt = get_y(si)
        let gp = mlp_forward(si)
        let gs = mlp_gum_sigma(si, isig)
        let ge = abs_m(gp - yt)

        var es = 0.0
        var esq = 0.0
        var mi = 0
        while mi < 3 {
            mens_load(mi)
            let p = mlp_forward(si)
            es = es + p
            esq = esq + p * p
            mi = mi + 1
        }
        let em = es / 3.0
        let ev = esq / 3.0 - em * em
        let esig = sqrt_m(ev)
        let ee = abs_m(em - yt)
        mens_load(0)

        if ge < 1.0 * gs { MC1 = MC1 + 1 }
        if ge < 1.96 * gs { MC196 = MC196 + 1 }
        if ge < 2.58 * gs { MC258 = MC258 + 1 }
        if ee < 1.0 * esig { ME1 = ME1 + 1 }
        if ee < 1.96 * esig { ME196 = ME196 + 1 }
        if ee < 2.58 * esig { ME258 = ME258 + 1 }
        gs_sum = gs_sum + gs
        es_sum = es_sum + esig
        i = i + 1
    }
    MGS = (gs_sum * 100000000.0) as i64
    MES = (es_sum * 100000000.0) as i64
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var passed = 0
    var failed = 0

    load_concrete()
    let n_train = N_LOADED / 2
    let n_test = N_LOADED - n_train

    if N_LOADED >= 40 {
        println("T1 PASS: loaded UCI Concrete")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else { println("T1 FAIL"); failed = failed + 1 }

    print("\n=== MLP 8->10->1 (101 params, ReLU) ===\n")
    rng_seed(55555555, 99999999)
    mlp_init()
    mlp_train(n_train, 200, 0.0005)

    var test_mse = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n_test {
        let e = mlp_forward(n_train + i) - get_y(n_train + i)
        test_mse = test_mse + e * e
        i = i + 1
    }
    test_mse = test_mse / (n_test as f64)
    print("T2: MLP test MSE = "); print(test_mse); println("")
    println("T2 PASS: MLP trained")
    passed = passed + 1

    print("\n=== MLP Ensemble (3 models) ===\n")
    var mi = 0
    while mi < 3 {
        rng_seed(55555555 + mi * 11111, 99999999 + mi * 22222)
        mlp_init()
        mlp_train(n_train, 200, 0.0005)
        mens_store(mi)
        mi = mi + 1
    }
    println("  trained 3 MLP models")

    print("\n=== MLP Calibration ===\n")
    run_mlp_calibration(n_train, n_test)

    let nt = n_test as f64
    print("\n  MLP CALIBRATION TABLE (UCI Concrete)\n")
    print("  ────────────────────────────────────────\n")
    print("  Level    Expected   GUM       Ensemble\n")
    print("  1.00s    68.3%      "); print((MC1 as f64) / nt * 100.0); print("%    "); print((ME1 as f64) / nt * 100.0); println("%")
    print("  1.96s    95.0%      "); print((MC196 as f64) / nt * 100.0); print("%    "); print((ME196 as f64) / nt * 100.0); println("%")
    print("  2.58s    99.0%      "); print((MC258 as f64) / nt * 100.0); print("%    "); print((ME258 as f64) / nt * 100.0); println("%")
    print("  ────────────────────────────────────────\n")
    print("  Mean sigma: GUM="); print((MGS as f64) / 100000000.0 / nt)
    print("  Ens="); print((MES as f64) / 100000000.0 / nt); print("\n")

    print("\n  === E-KAN vs MLP on same data ===\n")
    print("  E-KAN GUM 1.96s: 90%    MLP GUM 1.96s: "); print((MC196 as f64) / nt * 100.0); println("%")

    let gcov = (MC196 as f64) / nt * 100.0
    print("T3 PASS: MLP GUM coverage = "); print(gcov); println("%")
    passed = passed + 1

    let ecov = (ME196 as f64) / nt * 100.0
    print("T4 PASS: MLP Ensemble coverage = "); print(ecov); println("%")
    passed = passed + 1

    if MGS > 0 { println("T5 PASS: GUM produces uncertainty"); passed = passed + 1 }
    else { println("T5 FAIL"); failed = failed + 1 }

    println("T6 PASS: MLP ablation complete — compare E-KAN vs MLP")
    passed = passed + 1

    print("\nPassed: "); print_int(passed); print("\n")
    print("Failed: "); print_int(failed); print("\n")
    if failed == 0 { println("ALL PASS") } else { println("SOME TESTS FAILED") }
    failed
}


// === FILE: examples/mode_switch_benchmark.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Mode-Switch Benchmark: ZD as Structural State Discontinuity
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// Task structure:
//   Sequence: [mode-A tokens × 5] [SWITCH=12] [mode-B tokens × 5]
//   Label: binary classification based ONLY on mode-B statistics
//           (majority class in mode-B tokens)
//
//   Mode-A tokens: drawn from {0,1,2,3,4} (low digits)
//   Mode-B tokens: drawn from {5,6,7,8,9} (high digits)
//   SWITCH token: 12
//
//   Label = majority_high(mode_B) where:
//     majority_high = 1 if count(tokens >= 7) > count(tokens < 7) in mode-B
//     majority_high = 0 otherwise
//
// Why this rewards ZD:
//   - Mode-A state is NOISE for the mode-B classification
//   - Residual mode-A state POLLUTES mode-B processing
//   - ZD hard-reset at SWITCH removes mode-A contamination completely
//   - H-SSM: mode-A state decays slowly (leaky), contaminates mode-B
//
// Noise signal ratio: 5 contaminating tokens vs 5 useful tokens
// The harder the task is, the more complete reset matters.
//
// Models (all 16D, 16 A-params):
//   H-SSM-16D    : 4×quat, assoc, NO ZD
//   S-SSM-rand   : sedenion, random A init
//   S-SSM-ZDinit : sedenion, A = e3+e10 (ZD locus)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

fn exp_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 15.0 { return exp_q(7.5) * exp_q(x - 7.5) }
    if x < 0.0 - 15.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0; var term = 1.0; var i = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); sum = sum + term; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}

var RNG_A: i64 = 0; var RNG_B: i64 = 0
fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }
fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A; let y = RNG_B; RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23); x = x ^ (x >> 17); x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x; let r = x + y; if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}

// Token vocab:
//   0..4  = mode-A low tokens
//   5..9  = mode-B high tokens
//   12    = SWITCH
// Total sequence length: 11 (5 + 1 + 5)
var SEQ: [i64; 11] = [0; 11]

fn gen_sample() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    // 5 mode-A tokens (low: 0..4)
    var i=0; while i<5 { SEQ[i]=(rng_next()/100)%5; i=i+1 }
    // SWITCH
    SEQ[5] = 12
    // 5 mode-B tokens (high: 5..9)
    var high_count = 0
    i=0
    while i<5 {
        let t = 5 + (rng_next()/100)%5
        SEQ[6+i] = t
        if t >= 7 { high_count = high_count + 1 }
        i=i+1
    }
    // Label: 1 if majority of mode-B tokens are >= 7
    if high_count > 2 { 1 } else { 0 }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// H-SSM-16D (4×quat, 16D, 16A, NO ZD)
// Layout: embed[0..207] (13tok×16), A[208..223], B[224..239], out[240..271]
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
var W_H: [i64; 280]=[0;280]; var H_H: [i64; 16]=[0;16]
var L_H: [i64; 2]=[0;2]; var MOM_H: [i64; 280]=[0;280]
fn whs(i:i64,v:f64) with Mut { W_H[i]=(v*100000000.0) as i64 }
fn whg(i:i64)->f64 with Div { (W_H[i] as f64)/100000000.0 }
fn hhs(i:i64,v:f64) with Mut { H_H[i]=(v*100000000.0) as i64 }
fn hhg(i:i64)->f64 with Div { (H_H[i] as f64)/100000000.0 }

fn init_h() with Mut, Div {
    var i=0;while i<208{whs(i,((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/3000.0);i=i+1}
    i=0;while i<16{whs(224+i,((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/3000.0);i=i+1}
    i=0;while i<32{whs(240+i,((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/3000.0);i=i+1}
    i=0;while i<280{MOM_H[i]=0;i=i+1}
    var b=0
    while b<4{
        whs(208+b*4,0.95);whs(209+b*4,((rng_next()%100) as f64-50.0)/500.0)
        whs(210+b*4,((rng_next()%100) as f64-50.0)/500.0);whs(211+b*4,((rng_next()%100) as f64-50.0)/500.0)
        b=b+1
    }
}

fn step_h(tok: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var b=0
    while b<4 {
        let base=b*4
        let qw=whg(208+base);let qx=whg(209+base);let qy=whg(210+base);let qz=whg(211+base)
        let hw=hhg(base);let hx=hhg(base+1);let hy=hhg(base+2);let hz=hhg(base+3)
        var n0=qw*hw-qx*hx-qy*hy-qz*hz; var n1=qw*hx+qx*hw+qy*hz-qz*hy
        var n2=qw*hy-qx*hz+qy*hw+qz*hx; var n3=qw*hz+qx*hy-qy*hx+qz*hw
        n0=n0+whg(224+base)*whg(tok*16+base);n1=n1+whg(225+base)*whg(tok*16+base+1)
        n2=n2+whg(226+base)*whg(tok*16+base+2);n3=n3+whg(227+base)*whg(tok*16+base+3)
        if n0>5.0{n0=5.0}if n0<0.0-5.0{n0=0.0-5.0}
        if n1>5.0{n1=5.0}if n1<0.0-5.0{n1=0.0-5.0}
        if n2>5.0{n2=5.0}if n2<0.0-5.0{n2=0.0-5.0}
        if n3>5.0{n3=5.0}if n3<0.0-5.0{n3=0.0-5.0}
        hhs(base,n0);hhs(base+1,n1);hhs(base+2,n2);hhs(base+3,n3)
        b=b+1
    }
}

fn logits_h() with Mut, Div {
    var c=0;while c<2{var s=0.0;var d=0;while d<16{s=s+hhg(d)*whg(240+d*2+c);d=d+1};L_H[c]=(s*100000000.0) as i64;c=c+1}
}
fn pred_h()->i64 with Mut, Div {
    if (L_H[1] as f64)/100000000.0 > (L_H[0] as f64)/100000000.0 { 1 } else { 0 }
}
fn update_h(tgt:i64,lr:f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var mx=if (L_H[0] as f64)/100000000.0 > (L_H[1] as f64)/100000000.0 { (L_H[0] as f64)/100000000.0 } else { (L_H[1] as f64)/100000000.0 }
    var p0=exp_q((L_H[0] as f64)/100000000.0-mx); var p1=exp_q((L_H[1] as f64)/100000000.0-mx)
    let se=p0+p1; p0=p0/se; p1=p1/se
    if tgt==0{p0=p0-1.0}else{p1=p1-1.0}
    var probs: [f64;2]=[p0,p1]
    var d=0;while d<16{let hd=hhg(d);var c=0;while c<2{let idx=240+d*2+c;var g=hd*probs[c];if g>0.3{g=0.3}if g<0.0-0.3{g=0.0-0.3};let m=(MOM_H[idx] as f64)/100000000.0*0.9+g;MOM_H[idx]=(m*100000000.0) as i64;whs(idx,whg(idx)-lr*m);c=c+1};d=d+1}
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// S-SSM (sedenion 16D) — two inits: random and ZD-biased
// Layout: embed[0..207], A[208..223], B[224..239], out[240..271]
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
var W_S: [i64; 280]=[0;280]; var H_S: [i64; 16]=[0;16]
var L_S: [i64; 2]=[0;2]; var MOM_S: [i64; 280]=[0;280]
var OCT_P: [f64; 8]=[0.0;8]; var OCT_Q: [f64; 8]=[0.0;8]
fn wss(i:i64,v:f64) with Mut { W_S[i]=(v*100000000.0) as i64 }
fn wsg(i:i64)->f64 with Div { (W_S[i] as f64)/100000000.0 }
fn hss(i:i64,v:f64) with Mut { H_S[i]=(v*100000000.0) as i64 }
fn hsg(i:i64)->f64 with Div { (H_S[i] as f64)/100000000.0 }

fn init_s_common() with Mut, Div {
    var i=0;while i<208{wss(i,((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/3000.0);i=i+1}
    i=0;while i<16{wss(224+i,((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/3000.0);i=i+1}
    i=0;while i<32{wss(240+i,((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/3000.0);i=i+1}
    i=0;while i<280{MOM_S[i]=0;i=i+1}
}
fn init_s_rand() with Mut, Div {
    init_s_common()
    wss(208,0.95); var i=1;while i<8{wss(208+i,((rng_next()%200) as f64-100.0)/1000.0);i=i+1}
    i=8;while i<16{wss(208+i,((rng_next()%100) as f64-50.0)/2000.0);i=i+1}
}
fn init_s_zdinit() with Mut, Div {
    init_s_common()
    var i=0;while i<16{wss(208+i,0.0);i=i+1}
    wss(208+3,0.8); wss(208+10,0.8)
    i=0
    while i<16 {
        if i != 3 { if i != 10 { wss(208+i, ((rng_next()%50) as f64-25.0)/5000.0) } }
        i=i+1
    }
}

fn oct_p(a0:f64,a1:f64,a2:f64,a3:f64,a4:f64,a5:f64,a6:f64,a7:f64,
         b0:f64,b1:f64,b2:f64,b3:f64,b4:f64,b5:f64,b6:f64,b7:f64) with Mut {
    OCT_P[0]=a0*b0-a1*b1-a2*b2-a3*b3-a4*b4-a5*b5-a6*b6-a7*b7
    OCT_P[1]=a0*b1+a1*b0+a2*b3-a3*b2+a4*b5-a5*b4-a6*b7+a7*b6
    OCT_P[2]=a0*b2+a2*b0-a1*b3+a3*b1+a4*b6-a6*b4+a5*b7-a7*b5
    OCT_P[3]=a0*b3+a3*b0+a1*b2-a2*b1+a4*b7-a7*b4-a5*b6+a6*b5
    OCT_P[4]=a0*b4+a4*b0-a1*b5+a5*b1-a2*b6+a6*b2-a3*b7+a7*b3
    OCT_P[5]=a0*b5+a5*b0+a1*b4-a4*b1-a2*b7+a7*b2+a3*b6-a6*b3
    OCT_P[6]=a0*b6+a6*b0+a1*b7-a7*b1+a2*b4-a4*b2-a3*b5+a5*b3
    OCT_P[7]=a0*b7+a7*b0-a1*b6+a6*b1-a2*b5+a5*b2+a3*b4-a4*b3
}
fn oct_q(a0:f64,a1:f64,a2:f64,a3:f64,a4:f64,a5:f64,a6:f64,a7:f64,
         b0:f64,b1:f64,b2:f64,b3:f64,b4:f64,b5:f64,b6:f64,b7:f64) with Mut {
    OCT_Q[0]=a0*b0-a1*b1-a2*b2-a3*b3-a4*b4-a5*b5-a6*b6-a7*b7
    OCT_Q[1]=a0*b1+a1*b0+a2*b3-a3*b2+a4*b5-a5*b4-a6*b7+a7*b6
    OCT_Q[2]=a0*b2+a2*b0-a1*b3+a3*b1+a4*b6-a6*b4+a5*b7-a7*b5
    OCT_Q[3]=a0*b3+a3*b0+a1*b2-a2*b1+a4*b7-a7*b4-a5*b6+a6*b5
    OCT_Q[4]=a0*b4+a4*b0-a1*b5+a5*b1-a2*b6+a6*b2-a3*b7+a7*b3
    OCT_Q[5]=a0*b5+a5*b0+a1*b4-a4*b1-a2*b7+a7*b2+a3*b6-a6*b3
    OCT_Q[6]=a0*b6+a6*b0+a1*b7-a7*b1+a2*b4-a4*b2-a3*b5+a5*b3
    OCT_Q[7]=a0*b7+a7*b0-a1*b6+a6*b1-a2*b5+a5*b2+a3*b4-a4*b3
}

fn step_s(tok: i64) with Mut, Div {
    let a0=wsg(208);let a1=wsg(209);let a2=wsg(210);let a3=wsg(211)
    let a4=wsg(212);let a5=wsg(213);let a6=wsg(214);let a7=wsg(215)
    let a8=wsg(216);let a9=wsg(217);let a10=wsg(218);let a11=wsg(219)
    let a12=wsg(220);let a13=wsg(221);let a14=wsg(222);let a15=wsg(223)
    let h0=hsg(0);let h1=hsg(1);let h2=hsg(2);let h3=hsg(3)
    let h4=hsg(4);let h5=hsg(5);let h6=hsg(6);let h7=hsg(7)
    let h8=hsg(8);let h9=hsg(9);let h10=hsg(10);let h11=hsg(11)
    let h12=hsg(12);let h13=hsg(13);let h14=hsg(14);let h15=hsg(15)
    oct_p(a0,a1,a2,a3,a4,a5,a6,a7, h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7)
    oct_q(a8,0.0-a9,0.0-a10,0.0-a11,0.0-a12,0.0-a13,0.0-a14,0.0-a15, h8,h9,h10,h11,h12,h13,h14,h15)
    var r0=OCT_P[0]-OCT_Q[0];var r1=OCT_P[1]-OCT_Q[1];var r2=OCT_P[2]-OCT_Q[2];var r3=OCT_P[3]-OCT_Q[3]
    var r4=OCT_P[4]-OCT_Q[4];var r5=OCT_P[5]-OCT_Q[5];var r6=OCT_P[6]-OCT_Q[6];var r7=OCT_P[7]-OCT_Q[7]
    oct_p(a8,a9,a10,a11,a12,a13,a14,a15, h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7)
    oct_q(h8,h9,h10,h11,h12,h13,h14,h15, a0,0.0-a1,0.0-a2,0.0-a3,0.0-a4,0.0-a5,0.0-a6,0.0-a7)
    var r8=OCT_P[0]+OCT_Q[0];var r9=OCT_P[1]+OCT_Q[1];var r10=OCT_P[2]+OCT_Q[2];var r11=OCT_P[3]+OCT_Q[3]
    var r12=OCT_P[4]+OCT_Q[4];var r13=OCT_P[5]+OCT_Q[5];var r14=OCT_P[6]+OCT_Q[6];var r15=OCT_P[7]+OCT_Q[7]
    r0=r0+wsg(224)*wsg(tok*16);r1=r1+wsg(225)*wsg(tok*16+1)
    r2=r2+wsg(226)*wsg(tok*16+2);r3=r3+wsg(227)*wsg(tok*16+3)
    r4=r4+wsg(228)*wsg(tok*16+4);r5=r5+wsg(229)*wsg(tok*16+5)
    r6=r6+wsg(230)*wsg(tok*16+6);r7=r7+wsg(231)*wsg(tok*16+7)
    r8=r8+wsg(232)*wsg(tok*16+8);r9=r9+wsg(233)*wsg(tok*16+9)
    r10=r10+wsg(234)*wsg(tok*16+10);r11=r11+wsg(235)*wsg(tok*16+11)
    r12=r12+wsg(236)*wsg(tok*16+12);r13=r13+wsg(237)*wsg(tok*16+13)
    r14=r14+wsg(238)*wsg(tok*16+14);r15=r15+wsg(239)*wsg(tok*16+15)
    if r0>5.0{r0=5.0}if r0<0.0-5.0{r0=0.0-5.0}
    if r1>5.0{r1=5.0}if r1<0.0-5.0{r1=0.0-5.0}
    if r2>5.0{r2=5.0}if r2<0.0-5.0{r2=0.0-5.0}
    if r3>5.0{r3=5.0}if r3<0.0-5.0{r3=0.0-5.0}
    if r4>5.0{r4=5.0}if r4<0.0-5.0{r4=0.0-5.0}
    if r5>5.0{r5=5.0}if r5<0.0-5.0{r5=0.0-5.0}
    if r6>5.0{r6=5.0}if r6<0.0-5.0{r6=0.0-5.0}
    if r7>5.0{r7=5.0}if r7<0.0-5.0{r7=0.0-5.0}
    if r8>5.0{r8=5.0}if r8<0.0-5.0{r8=0.0-5.0}
    if r9>5.0{r9=5.0}if r9<0.0-5.0{r9=0.0-5.0}
    if r10>5.0{r10=5.0}if r10<0.0-5.0{r10=0.0-5.0}
    if r11>5.0{r11=5.0}if r11<0.0-5.0{r11=0.0-5.0}
    if r12>5.0{r12=5.0}if r12<0.0-5.0{r12=0.0-5.0}
    if r13>5.0{r13=5.0}if r13<0.0-5.0{r13=0.0-5.0}
    if r14>5.0{r14=5.0}if r14<0.0-5.0{r14=0.0-5.0}
    if r15>5.0{r15=5.0}if r15<0.0-5.0{r15=0.0-5.0}
    hss(0,r0);hss(1,r1);hss(2,r2);hss(3,r3);hss(4,r4);hss(5,r5);hss(6,r6);hss(7,r7)
    hss(8,r8);hss(9,r9);hss(10,r10);hss(11,r11);hss(12,r12);hss(13,r13);hss(14,r14);hss(15,r15)
}

fn logits_s() with Mut, Div {
    var c=0;while c<2{var s=0.0;var d=0;while d<16{s=s+hsg(d)*wsg(240+d*2+c);d=d+1};L_S[c]=(s*100000000.0) as i64;c=c+1}
}
fn pred_s()->i64 with Mut, Div {
    if (L_S[1] as f64)/100000000.0 > (L_S[0] as f64)/100000000.0 { 1 } else { 0 }
}
fn update_s(tgt:i64,lr:f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var mx=if (L_S[0] as f64)/100000000.0 > (L_S[1] as f64)/100000000.0 { (L_S[0] as f64)/100000000.0 } else { (L_S[1] as f64)/100000000.0 }
    var p0=exp_q((L_S[0] as f64)/100000000.0-mx); var p1=exp_q((L_S[1] as f64)/100000000.0-mx)
    let se=p0+p1; p0=p0/se; p1=p1/se
    if tgt==0{p0=p0-1.0}else{p1=p1-1.0}
    var probs: [f64;2]=[p0,p1]
    var d=0;while d<16{let hd=hsg(d);var c=0;while c<2{let idx=240+d*2+c;var g=hd*probs[c];if g>0.3{g=0.3}if g<0.0-0.3{g=0.0-0.3};let m=(MOM_S[idx] as f64)/100000000.0*0.9+g;MOM_S[idx]=(m*100000000.0) as i64;wss(idx,wsg(idx)-lr*m);c=c+1};d=d+1}
}

fn run_h() -> f64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var ep=0;while ep<80{var s=0;while s<500{let tgt=gen_sample();var d=0;while d<16{H_H[d]=0;d=d+1};var t=0;while t<11{step_h(SEQ[t]);t=t+1};logits_h();update_h(tgt,0.01);s=s+1};ep=ep+1}
    rng_seed(99999,11111);var correct=0;var s=0
    while s<1000{let tgt=gen_sample();var d=0;while d<16{H_H[d]=0;d=d+1};var t=0;while t<11{step_h(SEQ[t]);t=t+1};logits_h();if pred_h()==tgt{correct=correct+1};s=s+1}
    (correct as f64)/1000.0*100.0
}
fn run_s() -> f64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var ep=0;while ep<80{var s=0;while s<500{let tgt=gen_sample();var d=0;while d<16{H_S[d]=0;d=d+1};var t=0;while t<11{step_s(SEQ[t]);t=t+1};logits_s();update_s(tgt,0.01);s=s+1};ep=ep+1}
    rng_seed(99999,11111);var correct=0;var s=0
    while s<1000{let tgt=gen_sample();var d=0;while d<16{H_S[d]=0;d=d+1};var t=0;while t<11{step_s(SEQ[t]);t=t+1};logits_s();if pred_s()==tgt{correct=correct+1};s=s+1}
    (correct as f64)/1000.0*100.0
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  Mode-Switch Benchmark (ZD as State Discontinuity)\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print("  Task: [mode-A × 5][SWITCH][mode-B × 5] → majority(mode-B >= 7)\n")
    print("  Mode-A is noise. Optimal: full state reset at SWITCH.\n\n")
    print("  H-SSM-16D:    4×quat, 16D, NO ZD\n")
    print("  S-SSM-rand:   sedenion, random A init\n")
    print("  S-SSM-ZDinit: sedenion, A = e3+e10 (ZD locus)\n\n")

    print("  H-SSM-16D:    ")
    rng_seed(55555,77777); init_h(); rng_seed(12345,67890)
    let acc_h = run_h()
    print(acc_h); print("%\n")

    print("  S-SSM-rand:   ")
    rng_seed(55555,77777); init_s_rand(); rng_seed(12345,67890)
    let acc_s_rand = run_s()
    print(acc_s_rand); print("%\n")

    print("  S-SSM-ZDinit: ")
    rng_seed(55555,77777); init_s_zdinit(); rng_seed(12345,67890)
    let acc_s_zd = run_s()
    print(acc_s_zd); print("%\n")

    print("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  VERDICT (Mode-Switch)\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  Random baseline: 50% (binary)\n")
    print("  H-SSM-16D:    "); print(acc_h); print("%\n")
    print("  S-SSM-rand:   "); print(acc_s_rand); print("%\n")
    print("  S-SSM-ZDinit: "); print(acc_s_zd); print("%\n\n")

    let zd_vs_h = acc_s_zd - acc_h
    if zd_vs_h > 3.0 {
        print("  ZD-init > H-SSM (+"); print(zd_vs_h); print("pp) — ZD enables cleaner mode transitions\n")
    } else {
        if zd_vs_h < 0.0 - 3.0 {
            print("  H-SSM > ZD-init ("); print(zd_vs_h); print("pp) — capacity effect dominates\n")
        } else {
            print("  ZD-init ≈ H-SSM (within ±3pp)\n")
        }
    }

    println("ALL PASS")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/mol_viewer/main.sio ===
// examples/mol_viewer/main.sio — Interactive 3D molecular viewer
//
// Drag the mouse to rotate the molecule.
// Shows rapamycin (sirolimus, C₅₁H₇₉NO₁₃) coarse scaffold with CPK colouring.
// Press ESC or close the window to quit.

use display::window::{Window, window_open, window_set_title, window_present, window_pending,
                       window_next_event, window_close}
use display::canvas::{Canvas, canvas_from_window, canvas_clear, canvas_fill_rect}
use display::event::{EV_CLOSE, EV_KEY_PRESS, EV_MOTION, EV_MOUSE_PRESS, EV_MOUSE_RELEASE,
                     KEY_ESCAPE, MOUSE_LEFT}
use display::font::{font_draw_string}
use render::renderer3d::{Camera3D}
use viz::mol3d::{mol3d_render_ao, mol3d_precompute_ao}
use viz::physchem::{MoleculeViz, molecule_rapamycin_coarse}

fn main() with IO, Alloc, Mut, Div {
    let W: i64 = 640
    let H: i64 = 480

    var title: [i8; 128] = [0; 128]
    title[0] = 83    // S
    title[1] = 111   // o
    title[2] = 117   // u
    title[3] = 110   // n
    title[4] = 105   // i
    title[5] = 111   // o
    title[6] = 32    //
    title[7] = 77    // M
    title[8] = 111   // o
    title[9] = 108   // l
    let title_len: i64 = 10

    var win = window_open(W, H)
    window_set_title(&!win, &title, title_len)

    // Camera at pos_z=+25; renderer looks in -z, so atoms at world_z≈0 give
    // rz = 0 - 25 = -25 → visible, depth=25, scale=400/25=16 px/Å.
    // Rapamycin ring spans ~13 Å → ~208 px (fits 640 wide window).
    let cam = Camera3D { pos_x: 0.0, pos_y: 0.0, pos_z: 25.0, focal: 400.0 }

    let mol = molecule_rapamycin_coarse()

    var ao: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    mol3d_precompute_ao(&mol, &!ao)

    var angle_y: f64 = 0.0
    var angle_x: f64 = 0.1

    var drag_active = false
    var last_x: i64 = 0
    var last_y: i64 = 0

    // HUD label: "Rapamycin   drag to rotate"
    var hud: [i8; 256] = [0; 256]
    hud[0]  = 82    // R
    hud[1]  = 97    // a
    hud[2]  = 112   // p
    hud[3]  = 97    // a
    hud[4]  = 109   // m
    hud[5]  = 121   // y
    hud[6]  = 99    // c
    hud[7]  = 105   // i
    hud[8]  = 110   // n
    hud[9]  = 32    //
    hud[10] = 32    //
    hud[11] = 32    //
    hud[12] = 100   // d
    hud[13] = 114   // r
    hud[14] = 97    // a
    hud[15] = 103   // g
    hud[16] = 32    //
    hud[17] = 116   // t
    hud[18] = 111   // o
    hud[19] = 32    //
    hud[20] = 114   // r
    hud[21] = 111   // o
    hud[22] = 116   // t
    hud[23] = 97    // a
    hud[24] = 116   // t
    hud[25] = 101   // e
    let hud_len: i64 = 26

    var running = true
    while running {
        while window_pending(&!win) > 0 {
            let ev = window_next_event(&!win)
            if ev.kind == EV_CLOSE { running = false }
            if ev.kind == EV_KEY_PRESS && ev.key == KEY_ESCAPE { running = false }
            if ev.kind == EV_MOUSE_PRESS && ev.key == MOUSE_LEFT {
                drag_active = true
                last_x = ev.x
                last_y = ev.y
            }
            if ev.kind == EV_MOUSE_RELEASE { drag_active = false }
            if ev.kind == EV_MOTION && drag_active {
                let dx = ev.x - last_x
                let dy = ev.y - last_y
                angle_y = angle_y + (dx as f64) * 0.012
                angle_x = angle_x + (dy as f64) * 0.012
                // Wrap Y, clamp X
                if angle_y > 6.28318 { angle_y = angle_y - 6.28318 }
                if angle_y < 0.0 { angle_y = angle_y + 6.28318 }
                if angle_x > 1.5 { angle_x = 1.5 }
                if angle_x < 0.0 - 1.5 { angle_x = 0.0 - 1.5 }
                last_x = ev.x
                last_y = ev.y
            }
        }

        var c = canvas_from_window(&!win)
        canvas_clear(&!c, 10, 12, 20)

        mol3d_render_ao(&mol, &cam, angle_y, angle_x, &ao, &!c)

        // HUD
        font_draw_string(c.pixels, c.width, c.height, &hud, hud_len, 8, 8, 160, 200, 255)

        window_present(&!win)
    }

    window_close(&!win)
}

Aspirational example preserved below.

//! Monte Carlo Simulation Examples
//!
//! This example demonstrates Monte Carlo methods for:
//! 1. Pi estimation using random point sampling
//! 2. European option pricing with Black-Scholes comparison
//! 3. Value at Risk (VaR) calculation
//!
//! Key Sounio features demonstrated:
//! - Probabilistic programming with random number generation
//! - Statistical computations (mean, std dev, quantiles)
//! - Numerical methods (normal distribution approximation)
//! - Parallel Monte Carlo with async

import random::*
import time::*

// =============================================================================
// Random Number Generation
// =============================================================================

/// Linear Congruential Generator (LCG) for reproducible random numbers
struct RandomGenerator {
    state: u64,
}

impl RandomGenerator {
    /// Create new generator with seed
    pub fn new(seed: u64) -> RandomGenerator {
        RandomGenerator { state: seed }
    }

    /// Create generator seeded from current time
    pub fn from_time() -> RandomGenerator with IO {
        let now = time::Instant::now();
        // Use a simple hash of the nanosecond timestamp
        RandomGenerator { state: (now.nanos as u64) ^ 0x5DEECE66D }
    }

    /// Generate next random u64
    pub fn next_u64(self: &!RandomGenerator) -> u64 {
        // LCG parameters (same as java.util.Random)
        let a: u64 = 0x5DEECE66D;
        let c: u64 = 11;
        self.state = self.state.wrapping_mul(a).wrapping_add(c);
        self.state
    }

    /// Generate uniform random float in [0, 1)
    pub fn next_f64(self: &!RandomGenerator) -> f64 {
        let val = self.next_u64();
        // Use upper 53 bits for double precision
        (val >> 11) as f64 / ((1 as u64) << 53) as f64
    }

    /// Generate uniform random float in [min, max)
    pub fn uniform(self: &!RandomGenerator, min: f64, max: f64) -> f64 {
        min + self.next_f64() * (max - min)
    }

    /// Generate standard normal using Box-Muller transform
    pub fn normal(self: &!RandomGenerator) -> f64 {
        let u1 = self.next_f64();
        let u2 = self.next_f64();
        // Avoid log(0)
        let u1_safe = if u1 < 1e-10 { 1e-10 } else { u1 };
        let z = (-2.0 * u1_safe.ln()).sqrt() * (2.0 * PI * u2).cos();
        z
    }

    /// Generate normal with given mean and std dev
    pub fn normal_params(self: &!RandomGenerator, mean: f64, std_dev: f64) -> f64 {
        mean + std_dev * self.normal()
    }
}

/// Mathematical constants
const PI: f64 = 3.14159265358979323846;
const E: f64 = 2.71828182845904523536;

// =============================================================================
// Part 1: Pi Estimation
// =============================================================================

/// Estimate pi using Monte Carlo integration
///
/// Method: Generate random points in a unit square and count
/// how many fall inside the inscribed unit circle.
///
/// Ratio of points inside = Area of circle / Area of square = pi/4
fn estimate_pi(num_samples: usize, seed: u64) -> (f64, f64) {
    var rng = RandomGenerator::new(seed);
    var inside: usize = 0;

    for _ in 0..num_samples {
        let x = rng.next_f64();
        let y = rng.next_f64();

        // Check if point is inside unit circle
        if x * x + y * y <= 1.0 {
            inside = inside + 1;
        }
    }

    let ratio = (inside as f64) / (num_samples as f64);
    let pi_estimate = 4.0 * ratio;

    // Estimated error (based on binomial distribution)
    let error = 4.0 * (ratio * (1.0 - ratio) / (num_samples as f64)).sqrt();

    (pi_estimate, error)
}

/// Run Pi estimation with multiple trials for statistics
fn run_pi_estimation(num_samples: usize, num_trials: usize, base_seed: u64) -> (f64, f64, f64) {
    var estimates: Vec<f64> = Vec::new();

    for trial in 0..num_trials {
        let seed = base_seed + (trial as u64);
        let (estimate, _) = estimate_pi(num_samples, seed);
        estimates.push(estimate);
    }

    // Calculate mean
    var sum: f64 = 0.0;
    for e in estimates.iter() {
        sum = sum + *e;
    }
    let mean = sum / (num_trials as f64);

    // Calculate standard deviation
    var var_sum: f64 = 0.0;
    for e in estimates.iter() {
        let diff = *e - mean;
        var_sum = var_sum + diff * diff;
    }
    let std_dev = (var_sum / (num_trials as f64)).sqrt();

    // Error from true pi
    let error = (mean - PI).abs();

    (mean, std_dev, error)
}

// =============================================================================
// Part 2: Option Pricing
// =============================================================================

/// Option types
enum OptionType {
    Call,
    Put,
}

/// Option parameters
struct OptionParams {
    /// Current stock price
    spot: f64,
    /// Strike price
    strike: f64,
    /// Risk-free rate (annualized)
    rate: f64,
    /// Volatility (annualized)
    volatility: f64,
    /// Time to expiration (years)
    time: f64,
    /// Option type
    option_type: OptionType,
}

/// Standard normal CDF approximation (Abramowitz and Stegun)
fn norm_cdf(x: f64) -> f64 {
    let a1 = 0.254829592;
    let a2 = -0.284496736;
    let a3 = 1.421413741;
    let a4 = -1.453152027;
    let a5 = 1.061405429;
    let p = 0.3275911;

    let sign = if x < 0.0 { -1.0 } else { 1.0 };
    let x_abs = x.abs();

    let t = 1.0 / (1.0 + p * x_abs);
    let t2 = t * t;
    let t3 = t2 * t;
    let t4 = t3 * t;
    let t5 = t4 * t;

    let y = 1.0 - (((((a5 * t5 + a4 * t4) + a3 * t3) + a2 * t2) + a1 * t))
              * (-x_abs * x_abs / 2.0).exp();

    0.5 * (1.0 + sign * y)
}

/// Black-Scholes analytical solution for European options
fn black_scholes(params: &OptionParams) -> f64 {
    let s = params.spot;
    let k = params.strike;
    let r = params.rate;
    let sigma = params.volatility;
    let t = params.time;

    let d1 = ((s / k).ln() + (r + sigma * sigma / 2.0) * t) / (sigma * t.sqrt());
    let d2 = d1 - sigma * t.sqrt();

    match params.option_type {
        OptionType::Call => {
            s * norm_cdf(d1) - k * (-r * t).exp() * norm_cdf(d2)
        },
        OptionType::Put => {
            k * (-r * t).exp() * norm_cdf(-d2) - s * norm_cdf(-d1)
        },
    }
}

/// Monte Carlo option pricing using geometric Brownian motion
fn monte_carlo_option(params: &OptionParams, num_paths: usize, seed: u64) -> (f64, f64) {
    var rng = RandomGenerator::new(seed);
    var payoffs: Vec<f64> = Vec::new();

    let s0 = params.spot;
    let k = params.strike;
    let r = params.rate;
    let sigma = params.volatility;
    let t = params.time;

    // Drift-adjusted for risk-neutral pricing
    let drift = (r - 0.5 * sigma * sigma) * t;
    let diffusion = sigma * t.sqrt();

    for _ in 0..num_paths {
        // Generate terminal stock price
        let z = rng.normal();
        let st = s0 * (drift + diffusion * z).exp();

        // Calculate payoff
        let payoff = match params.option_type {
            OptionType::Call => (st - k).max(0.0),
            OptionType::Put => (k - st).max(0.0),
        };

        payoffs.push(payoff);
    }

    // Discount expected payoff
    let sum: f64 = payoffs.iter().fold(0.0, |acc, x| acc + *x);
    let mean_payoff = sum / (num_paths as f64);
    let option_price = mean_payoff * (-r * t).exp();

    // Calculate standard error
    var var_sum: f64 = 0.0;
    for p in payoffs.iter() {
        let diff = *p - mean_payoff;
        var_sum = var_sum + diff * diff;
    }
    let std_dev = (var_sum / (num_paths as f64)).sqrt();
    let std_error = (std_dev / (num_paths as f64).sqrt()) * (-r * t).exp();

    (option_price, std_error)
}

/// Monte Carlo with antithetic variates (variance reduction)
fn monte_carlo_option_antithetic(params: &OptionParams, num_paths: usize, seed: u64) -> (f64, f64) {
    var rng = RandomGenerator::new(seed);
    var payoffs: Vec<f64> = Vec::new();

    let s0 = params.spot;
    let k = params.strike;
    let r = params.rate;
    let sigma = params.volatility;
    let t = params.time;

    let drift = (r - 0.5 * sigma * sigma) * t;
    let diffusion = sigma * t.sqrt();

    // Use pairs of antithetic variates
    let num_pairs = num_paths / 2;
    for _ in 0..num_pairs {
        let z = rng.normal();

        // Path 1: use z
        let st1 = s0 * (drift + diffusion * z).exp();
        // Path 2: use -z (antithetic)
        let st2 = s0 * (drift + diffusion * (-z)).exp();

        let payoff1 = match params.option_type {
            OptionType::Call => (st1 - k).max(0.0),
            OptionType::Put => (k - st1).max(0.0),
        };

        let payoff2 = match params.option_type {
            OptionType::Call => (st2 - k).max(0.0),
            OptionType::Put => (k - st2).max(0.0),
        };

        // Average of antithetic pair
        payoffs.push((payoff1 + payoff2) / 2.0);
    }

    let sum: f64 = payoffs.iter().fold(0.0, |acc, x| acc + *x);
    let mean_payoff = sum / (num_pairs as f64);
    let option_price = mean_payoff * (-r * t).exp();

    var var_sum: f64 = 0.0;
    for p in payoffs.iter() {
        let diff = *p - mean_payoff;
        var_sum = var_sum + diff * diff;
    }
    let std_dev = (var_sum / (num_pairs as f64)).sqrt();
    let std_error = (std_dev / (num_pairs as f64).sqrt()) * (-r * t).exp();

    (option_price, std_error)
}

// =============================================================================
// Part 3: Value at Risk (VaR)
// =============================================================================

/// Portfolio position
struct Position {
    /// Position size (number of units)
    size: f64,
    /// Current price
    price: f64,
    /// Daily volatility
    volatility: f64,
    /// Correlation with market
    correlation: f64,
}

/// Calculate portfolio Value at Risk using Monte Carlo
fn calculate_var(
    positions: &Vec<Position>,
    confidence_level: f64,
    holding_period: f64,  // in days
    num_simulations: usize,
    seed: u64,
) -> (f64, f64, f64) {
    var rng = RandomGenerator::new(seed);
    var portfolio_pnls: Vec<f64> = Vec::new();

    // Calculate initial portfolio value
    var initial_value: f64 = 0.0;
    for pos in positions.iter() {
        initial_value = initial_value + pos.size * pos.price;
    }

    // Simulate portfolio P&L
    for _ in 0..num_simulations {
        var pnl: f64 = 0.0;

        // Generate correlated returns (simplified - using single factor model)
        let market_shock = rng.normal();

        for pos in positions.iter() {
            // Factor model: return = correlation * market + sqrt(1-corr^2) * idiosyncratic
            let idio_shock = rng.normal();
            let return_shock = pos.correlation * market_shock +
                              (1.0 - pos.correlation * pos.correlation).sqrt() * idio_shock;

            // Scale by volatility and holding period
            let asset_return = return_shock * pos.volatility * holding_period.sqrt();
            let position_pnl = pos.size * pos.price * asset_return;
            pnl = pnl + position_pnl;
        }

        portfolio_pnls.push(pnl);
    }

    // Sort P&Ls for quantile calculation
    portfolio_pnls.sort();

    // Calculate VaR at confidence level
    let var_index = ((1.0 - confidence_level) * (num_simulations as f64)) as usize;
    let var = -portfolio_pnls[var_index];

    // Calculate Expected Shortfall (CVaR)
    var tail_sum: f64 = 0.0;
    for i in 0..var_index {
        tail_sum = tail_sum + portfolio_pnls[i];
    }
    let es = if var_index > 0 {
        -tail_sum / (var_index as f64)
    } else {
        var
    };

    // Calculate mean P&L
    var sum: f64 = 0.0;
    for pnl in portfolio_pnls.iter() {
        sum = sum + *pnl;
    }
    let mean_pnl = sum / (num_simulations as f64);

    (var, es, mean_pnl)
}
