// === FILE: examples/native_algebra_4way_benchmark.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 4-Way Native Algebra Benchmark: O-SSM vs H-SSM vs S-SSM vs Naive
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// Extends hssm_native_algebra.sio (definitive 3-way) with S-SSM:
//   S-SSM: Selective Sedenion SSM — 16D state, Mamba-style gate, zero-divisors
//
// Model summary:
//   O-SSM:  Cayley product, 8D, 8 A-params, non-assoc, non-commut
//   H-SSM:  Hamilton product, 8D, 8 A-params, assoc, non-commut  ← prev winner
//   S-SSM:  Sedenion (CayleyDickson), 16D, 16 A-params, +Mamba gate
//           NOTE: 16 A-params vs 8 — not fully param-matched.
//           Gate adds 1 scalar per token (13 gate params).
//   Naive:  diagonal, 8D, 8 A-params, assoc, commut
//
// S-SSM unique properties (impossible in division algebras):
//   - Zero-divisors: A ⊗ h = 0 for nonzero A,h (hard reset mechanism)
//   - Selective gating: Δ_t = sigmoid(W_Δ[token]) controls state update rate
//   - 16D state: more capacity (but also more params)
//
// Tasks: ListOps (L=15, 10-class), Bracket (L=12, binary)
// Training: 500 train/epoch × 80 epochs = 40K samples, output-only
// Eval: 1000 samples (SE ≈ ±1.6%)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

fn exp_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 15.0 { return exp_q(7.5) * exp_q(x - 7.5) }
    if x < 0.0 - 15.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0; var term = 1.0; var i = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); sum = sum + term; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}

fn sigmoid_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 10.0 { return 1.0 }
    if x < 0.0 - 10.0 { return 0.0 }
    1.0 / (1.0 + exp_q(0.0 - x))
}

var RNG_A: i64 = 0; var RNG_B: i64 = 0
fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }
fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A; let y = RNG_B; RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23); x = x ^ (x >> 17); x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x; let r = x + y; if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}

// ─── ListOps Task ───
var SEQ: [i64; 32] = [0; 32]; var SEQ_POS: i64 = 0
fn min_v(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }
fn max_v(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }
fn med3(a: i64, b: i64, c: i64) -> i64 {
    if a <= b { if b <= c { b } else { if a <= c { c } else { a } } }
    else { if a <= c { a } else { if b <= c { c } else { b } } }
}
fn apply_op(op: i64, nv: i64, v0: i64, v1: i64, v2: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    if op == 10 {
        var r = v0; if nv >= 2 { r = min_v(r, v1) }; if nv >= 3 { r = min_v(r, v2) }; r
    } else {
        if op == 11 {
            var r = v0; if nv >= 2 { r = max_v(r, v1) }; if nv >= 3 { r = max_v(r, v2) }; r
        } else {
            if nv >= 3 { med3(v0, v1, v2) } else { if nv >= 2 { min_v(v0, v1) } else { v0 } }
        }
    }
}
fn gen_flat() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let op = (rng_next() / 100) % 3 + 10; let na = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 + 2
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = op; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    var v0 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; var v1 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; var v2 = 0
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v0; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1; SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v1; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    if na == 3 { v2 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; SEQ[SEQ_POS] = v2; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1 }
    apply_op(op, na, v0, v1, v2)
}
fn gen_nested() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let oop = (rng_next() / 100) % 3 + 10; let ona = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 + 2
    SEQ[SEQ_POS] = oop; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1
    var vals: [i64; 3] = [0; 3]; var ai = 0
    while ai < ona {
        let nest = (rng_next() / 100) % 3
        if nest == 0 { vals[ai] = gen_flat() }
        else { let d = (rng_next() / 100) % 10; SEQ[SEQ_POS] = d; SEQ_POS = SEQ_POS + 1; vals[ai] = d }
        ai = ai + 1
    }
    apply_op(oop, ona, vals[0], vals[1], vals[2])
}
fn gen_lo(tlen: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    SEQ_POS = 0; let res = gen_nested()
    var al = SEQ_POS
    while al < tlen { SEQ[al] = 0; al = al + 1 }
    SEQ_POS = tlen; res
}

// ─── Bracket Task ───
var BR: [i64; 20] = [0; 20]; var BR_LEN: i64 = 0
var STK: [i64; 10] = [0; 10]; var STK_TOP: i64 = 0
fn check_bal(sl: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    STK_TOP = 0; var i = 0
    while i < sl {
        let t = BR[i]
        if t == 1 { STK[STK_TOP] = 1; STK_TOP = STK_TOP + 1 }
        if t == 3 { STK[STK_TOP] = 3; STK_TOP = STK_TOP + 1 }
        if t == 2 { if STK_TOP == 0 { return 0 }; STK_TOP = STK_TOP - 1; if STK[STK_TOP] != 1 { return 0 } }
        if t == 4 { if STK_TOP == 0 { return 0 }; STK_TOP = STK_TOP - 1; if STK[STK_TOP] != 3 { return 0 } }
        if STK_TOP > 9 { return 0 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if STK_TOP == 0 { 1 } else { 0 }
}
fn gen_bal(sl: i64) with Mut, Div {
    STK_TOP = 0; var pos = 0
    while pos < sl {
        let rem = sl - pos; let can_o = STK_TOP < rem / 2; let can_c = STK_TOP > 0
        var ch = 0
        if can_o { if can_c { ch = (rng_next() / 100) % 2 } }
        if can_o { if can_c == false { ch = 0 } }
        if can_o == false { if can_c { ch = 1 } }
        if ch == 0 {
            let bt = (rng_next() / 100) % 2
            if bt == 0 { BR[pos] = 1; STK[STK_TOP] = 1 }
            if bt == 1 { BR[pos] = 3; STK[STK_TOP] = 3 }
            STK_TOP = STK_TOP + 1
        }
        if ch == 1 { STK_TOP = STK_TOP - 1; let top = STK[STK_TOP]; if top == 1 { BR[pos] = 2 }; if top == 3 { BR[pos] = 4 } }
        pos = pos + 1
    }
}
fn gen_unbal(sl: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var att = 0; var done = 0
    while done == 0 {
        var i = 0; while i < sl { BR[i] = (rng_next() / 100) % 4 + 1; i = i + 1 }
        if check_bal(sl) == 0 { done = 1 }
        att = att + 1
        if att > 30 { BR[0] = 2; BR[1] = 4; done = 1 }
    }
}
fn gen_br(sl: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    let cls = (rng_next() / 100) % 2
    if cls == 1 { gen_bal(sl) }
    if cls == 0 { gen_unbal(sl) }
    BR_LEN = sl; cls
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 8D Models (O-SSM, H-SSM, Naive) — shared weight array W8
// Layout: embed 104 (tokens 0-12 × 8), A 8 (104-111), B 8 (112-119), out 80 (120-199)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
var W8: [i64; 200] = [0; 200]
var H8: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]
var L8: [i64; 10] = [0; 10]
var MOM8: [i64; 200] = [0; 200]

fn w8s(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { W8[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn w8g(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (W8[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn h8s(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { H8[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn h8g(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (H8[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }

fn init8_embed_b_out() with Mut, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < 104 { w8s(i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0; while i < 8  { w8s(112 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0; while i < 80 { w8s(120 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0; while i < 200 { MOM8[i] = 0; i = i + 1 }
}
fn init8_A_oct() with Mut, Div {
    w8s(104, 0.95)
    var i = 1; while i < 8 { w8s(104 + i, ((rng_next() % 200) as f64 - 100.0) / 1000.0); i = i + 1 }
}
fn init8_A_quat() with Mut, Div {
    w8s(104 + 0, 0.95); w8s(104 + 1, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    w8s(104 + 2, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    w8s(104 + 3, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    w8s(104 + 4, 0.95); w8s(104 + 5, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    w8s(104 + 6, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    w8s(104 + 7, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
}
fn init8_A_diag() with Mut { var i = 0; while i < 8 { w8s(104 + i, 0.95); i = i + 1 } }

fn oct_step(tok: i64) with Mut, Div {
    let a0=w8g(104);let a1=w8g(105);let a2=w8g(106);let a3=w8g(107)
    let a4=w8g(108);let a5=w8g(109);let a6=w8g(110);let a7=w8g(111)
    let h0=h8g(0);let h1=h8g(1);let h2=h8g(2);let h3=h8g(3)
    let h4=h8g(4);let h5=h8g(5);let h6=h8g(6);let h7=h8g(7)
    var n0=a0*h0-a1*h1-a2*h2-a3*h3-a4*h4-a5*h5-a6*h6-a7*h7
    var n1=a0*h1+a1*h0+a2*h3-a3*h2+a4*h5-a5*h4-a6*h7+a7*h6
    var n2=a0*h2+a2*h0-a1*h3+a3*h1+a4*h6-a6*h4+a5*h7-a7*h5
    var n3=a0*h3+a3*h0+a1*h2-a2*h1+a4*h7-a7*h4-a5*h6+a6*h5
    var n4=a0*h4+a4*h0-a1*h5+a5*h1-a2*h6+a6*h2-a3*h7+a7*h3
    var n5=a0*h5+a5*h0+a1*h4-a4*h1-a2*h7+a7*h2+a3*h6-a6*h3
    var n6=a0*h6+a6*h0+a1*h7-a7*h1+a2*h4-a4*h2-a3*h5+a5*h3
    var n7=a0*h7+a7*h0-a1*h6+a6*h1-a2*h5+a5*h2+a3*h4-a4*h3
    n0=n0+w8g(112)*w8g(tok*8+0); n1=n1+w8g(113)*w8g(tok*8+1)
    n2=n2+w8g(114)*w8g(tok*8+2); n3=n3+w8g(115)*w8g(tok*8+3)
    n4=n4+w8g(116)*w8g(tok*8+4); n5=n5+w8g(117)*w8g(tok*8+5)
    n6=n6+w8g(118)*w8g(tok*8+6); n7=n7+w8g(119)*w8g(tok*8+7)
    if n0>5.0{n0=5.0}if n0<0.0-5.0{n0=0.0-5.0}
    if n1>5.0{n1=5.0}if n1<0.0-5.0{n1=0.0-5.0}
    if n2>5.0{n2=5.0}if n2<0.0-5.0{n2=0.0-5.0}
    if n3>5.0{n3=5.0}if n3<0.0-5.0{n3=0.0-5.0}
    if n4>5.0{n4=5.0}if n4<0.0-5.0{n4=0.0-5.0}
    if n5>5.0{n5=5.0}if n5<0.0-5.0{n5=0.0-5.0}
    if n6>5.0{n6=5.0}if n6<0.0-5.0{n6=0.0-5.0}
    if n7>5.0{n7=5.0}if n7<0.0-5.0{n7=0.0-5.0}
    h8s(0,n0);h8s(1,n1);h8s(2,n2);h8s(3,n3);h8s(4,n4);h8s(5,n5);h8s(6,n6);h8s(7,n7)
}

fn quat_step(tok: i64) with Mut, Div {
    let qw=w8g(104);let qx=w8g(105);let qy=w8g(106);let qz=w8g(107)
    let hw=h8g(0);let hx=h8g(1);let hy=h8g(2);let hz=h8g(3)
    var n0=qw*hw-qx*hx-qy*hy-qz*hz; var n1=qw*hx+qx*hw+qy*hz-qz*hy
    var n2=qw*hy-qx*hz+qy*hw+qz*hx; var n3=qw*hz+qx*hy-qy*hx+qz*hw
    n0=n0+w8g(112)*w8g(tok*8+0); n1=n1+w8g(113)*w8g(tok*8+1)
    n2=n2+w8g(114)*w8g(tok*8+2); n3=n3+w8g(115)*w8g(tok*8+3)
    if n0>5.0{n0=5.0}if n0<0.0-5.0{n0=0.0-5.0}
    if n1>5.0{n1=5.0}if n1<0.0-5.0{n1=0.0-5.0}
    if n2>5.0{n2=5.0}if n2<0.0-5.0{n2=0.0-5.0}
    if n3>5.0{n3=5.0}if n3<0.0-5.0{n3=0.0-5.0}
    let qw2=w8g(108);let qx2=w8g(109);let qy2=w8g(110);let qz2=w8g(111)
    let hw2=h8g(4);let hx2=h8g(5);let hy2=h8g(6);let hz2=h8g(7)
    var n4=qw2*hw2-qx2*hx2-qy2*hy2-qz2*hz2; var n5=qw2*hx2+qx2*hw2+qy2*hz2-qz2*hy2
    var n6=qw2*hy2-qx2*hz2+qy2*hw2+qz2*hx2; var n7=qw2*hz2+qx2*hy2-qy2*hx2+qz2*hw2
    n4=n4+w8g(116)*w8g(tok*8+4); n5=n5+w8g(117)*w8g(tok*8+5)
    n6=n6+w8g(118)*w8g(tok*8+6); n7=n7+w8g(119)*w8g(tok*8+7)
    if n4>5.0{n4=5.0}if n4<0.0-5.0{n4=0.0-5.0}
    if n5>5.0{n5=5.0}if n5<0.0-5.0{n5=0.0-5.0}
    if n6>5.0{n6=5.0}if n6<0.0-5.0{n6=0.0-5.0}
    if n7>5.0{n7=5.0}if n7<0.0-5.0{n7=0.0-5.0}
    h8s(0,n0);h8s(1,n1);h8s(2,n2);h8s(3,n3);h8s(4,n4);h8s(5,n5);h8s(6,n6);h8s(7,n7)
}

fn diag_step(tok: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var s=w8g(104+d)*h8g(d)+w8g(112+d)*w8g(tok*8+d)
        if s>5.0{s=5.0}if s<0.0-5.0{s=0.0-5.0}
        h8s(d,s); d=d+1
    }
}

fn logits8(nc: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var c = 0
    while c < nc {
        var s=0.0; var d=0
        while d < 8 { s=s+h8g(d)*w8g(120+d*nc+c); d=d+1 }
        L8[c]=(s*100000000.0) as i64; c=c+1
    }
}
fn pred8(nc: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    var best=0; var bv=(L8[0] as f64)/100000000.0; var i=1
    while i<nc { let v=(L8[i] as f64)/100000000.0; if v>bv{bv=v;best=i}; i=i+1 }
    best
}
fn update8(tgt: i64, lr: f64, nc: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var mx=(L8[0] as f64)/100000000.0; var i=1
    while i<nc { let v=(L8[i] as f64)/100000000.0; if v>mx{mx=v}; i=i+1 }
    var probs: [f64; 10]=[0.0;10]; var se=0.0; i=0
    while i<nc { probs[i]=exp_q((L8[i] as f64)/100000000.0-mx); se=se+probs[i]; i=i+1 }
    i=0; while i<nc { probs[i]=probs[i]/se; i=i+1 }
    probs[tgt]=probs[tgt]-1.0
    var d=0
    while d<8 {
        let hd=h8g(d); var c=0
        while c<nc {
            let idx=120+d*nc+c
            var g=hd*probs[c]
            if g>0.3{g=0.3}if g<0.0-0.3{g=0.0-0.3}
            let m=(MOM8[idx] as f64)/100000000.0*0.9+g
            MOM8[idx]=(m*100000000.0) as i64
            w8s(idx, w8g(idx)-lr*m)
            c=c+1
        }
        d=d+1
    }
}

fn run_lo8(model_id: i64, sl: i64) -> f64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ne=80; var ep=0
    while ep<ne {
        var s=0; while s<500 {
            let lbl=gen_lo(sl); var tgt=lbl%10; if tgt<0{tgt=tgt+10}
            var d=0; while d<8{H8[d]=0;d=d+1}
            var t=0; while t<SEQ_POS {
                if model_id==0{oct_step(SEQ[t])}
                if model_id==1{quat_step(SEQ[t])}
                if model_id==2{diag_step(SEQ[t])}
                t=t+1
            }
            logits8(10); update8(tgt,0.01,10); s=s+1
        }; ep=ep+1
    }
    rng_seed(99999+sl,11111+sl)
    var correct=0; var s=0
    while s<1000 {
        let lbl=gen_lo(sl); var tgt=lbl%10; if tgt<0{tgt=tgt+10}
        var d=0; while d<8{H8[d]=0;d=d+1}
        var t=0; while t<SEQ_POS {
            if model_id==0{oct_step(SEQ[t])}
            if model_id==1{quat_step(SEQ[t])}
            if model_id==2{diag_step(SEQ[t])}
            t=t+1
        }
        logits8(10); if pred8(10)==tgt{correct=correct+1}; s=s+1
    }
    (correct as f64)/1000.0*100.0
}

fn run_br8(model_id: i64, sl: i64) -> f64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ne=80; var ep=0
    while ep<ne {
        var s=0; while s<500 {
            let cls=gen_br(sl)
            var d=0; while d<8{H8[d]=0;d=d+1}
            var t=0; while t<BR_LEN {
                if model_id==0{oct_step(BR[t])}
                if model_id==1{quat_step(BR[t])}
                if model_id==2{diag_step(BR[t])}
                t=t+1
            }
            logits8(2); update8(cls,0.01,2); s=s+1
        }; ep=ep+1
    }
    rng_seed(99999+sl,11111+sl)
    var correct=0; var s=0
    while s<1000 {
        let cls=gen_br(sl)
        var d=0; while d<8{H8[d]=0;d=d+1}
        var t=0; while t<BR_LEN {
            if model_id==0{oct_step(BR[t])}
            if model_id==1{quat_step(BR[t])}
            if model_id==2{diag_step(BR[t])}
            t=t+1
        }
        logits8(2); if pred8(2)==cls{correct=correct+1}; s=s+1
    }
    (correct as f64)/1000.0*100.0
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// S-SSM: Selective Sedenion SSM (16D)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Weight layout (W16):
//   [0..207]   embed: 13 tokens × 16 dims
//   [208..223] A: 16 sedenion components (A_lo = A[0..7], A_hi = A[8..15])
//   [224..239] B: 16 input projection weights
//   [240..252] gate: 13 scalar gate weights (one per token class)
//   [253..412] out_listops: 16 × 10 = 160 weights
//   [253..284] out_bracket: 16 × 2 = 32 weights (same start, different n_class)
//
// Total params: 208+16+16+13+160 = 413 (ListOps), 289 (Bracket)
// A-params alone: 16 (vs 8 for O/H/Naive)
// Gate-params: 13 additional

var W16: [i64; 450] = [0; 450]
var H16: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
var L16: [i64; 10] = [0; 10]
var MOM16: [i64; 450] = [0; 450]
// Scratch buffers for sedenion multiplication (oct_mul results)
var OCT_P: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
var OCT_Q: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]

fn w16s(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { W16[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn w16g(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (W16[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn h16s(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { H16[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn h16g(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (H16[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }

fn init16_weights() with Mut, Div {
    var i = 0
    // embed
    while i < 208 { w16s(i, ((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/3000.0); i=i+1 }
    // A: e0=0.95, rest small
    w16s(208, 0.95)
    i = 1; while i < 8 { w16s(208+i, ((rng_next()%200) as f64-100.0)/1000.0); i=i+1 }
    // A_hi: e8=0.0 (initially no cross-oct coupling, lets ZD emerge via learning)
    i = 8; while i < 16 { w16s(208+i, ((rng_next()%100) as f64-50.0)/2000.0); i=i+1 }
    // B
    i = 0; while i < 16 { w16s(224+i, ((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/3000.0); i=i+1 }
    // gate: init near 0.5 (sigmoid(0)=0.5, moderate initial mixing)
    i = 0; while i < 13 { w16s(240+i, 0.0); i=i+1 }
    // out (enough for both tasks: 160 weights)
    i = 0; while i < 160 { w16s(253+i, ((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/3000.0); i=i+1 }
    // momentum
    i = 0; while i < 450 { MOM16[i] = 0; i=i+1 }
}

// oct_mul_into_p: computes A[a0..a7] * B[b0..b7], stores in OCT_P
fn oct_mul_p(a0:f64,a1:f64,a2:f64,a3:f64,a4:f64,a5:f64,a6:f64,a7:f64,
             b0:f64,b1:f64,b2:f64,b3:f64,b4:f64,b5:f64,b6:f64,b7:f64) with Mut {
    OCT_P[0]=a0*b0-a1*b1-a2*b2-a3*b3-a4*b4-a5*b5-a6*b6-a7*b7
    OCT_P[1]=a0*b1+a1*b0+a2*b3-a3*b2+a4*b5-a5*b4-a6*b7+a7*b6
    OCT_P[2]=a0*b2+a2*b0-a1*b3+a3*b1+a4*b6-a6*b4+a5*b7-a7*b5
    OCT_P[3]=a0*b3+a3*b0+a1*b2-a2*b1+a4*b7-a7*b4-a5*b6+a6*b5
    OCT_P[4]=a0*b4+a4*b0-a1*b5+a5*b1-a2*b6+a6*b2-a3*b7+a7*b3
    OCT_P[5]=a0*b5+a5*b0+a1*b4-a4*b1-a2*b7+a7*b2+a3*b6-a6*b3
    OCT_P[6]=a0*b6+a6*b0+a1*b7-a7*b1+a2*b4-a4*b2-a3*b5+a5*b3
    OCT_P[7]=a0*b7+a7*b0-a1*b6+a6*b1-a2*b5+a5*b2+a3*b4-a4*b3
}
// oct_mul_into_q: same but stores in OCT_Q
fn oct_mul_q(a0:f64,a1:f64,a2:f64,a3:f64,a4:f64,a5:f64,a6:f64,a7:f64,
             b0:f64,b1:f64,b2:f64,b3:f64,b4:f64,b5:f64,b6:f64,b7:f64) with Mut {
    OCT_Q[0]=a0*b0-a1*b1-a2*b2-a3*b3-a4*b4-a5*b5-a6*b6-a7*b7
    OCT_Q[1]=a0*b1+a1*b0+a2*b3-a3*b2+a4*b5-a5*b4-a6*b7+a7*b6
    OCT_Q[2]=a0*b2+a2*b0-a1*b3+a3*b1+a4*b6-a6*b4+a5*b7-a7*b5
    OCT_Q[3]=a0*b3+a3*b0+a1*b2-a2*b1+a4*b7-a7*b4-a5*b6+a6*b5
    OCT_Q[4]=a0*b4+a4*b0-a1*b5+a5*b1-a2*b6+a6*b2-a3*b7+a7*b3
    OCT_Q[5]=a0*b5+a5*b0+a1*b4-a4*b1-a2*b7+a7*b2+a3*b6-a6*b3
    OCT_Q[6]=a0*b6+a6*b0+a1*b7-a7*b1+a2*b4-a4*b2-a3*b5+a5*b3
    OCT_Q[7]=a0*b7+a7*b0-a1*b6+a6*b1-a2*b5+a5*b2+a3*b4-a4*b3
}

// Sedenion multiplication (Cayley-Dickson):
// A=(Alo,Ahi), h=(hlo,hhi)
// result_lo = oct_mul(Alo,hlo) - oct_mul(conj(Ahi),hhi)
// result_hi = oct_mul(Ahi,hlo) + oct_mul(hhi,conj(Alo))
// conj(x) = (x0, -x1..-x7)
// Stores result in H16 (as pre-activation, before gating)
var SED_PRE: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]

fn sed_product() with Mut, Div {
    // Read A from W16[208..223]
    let a0=w16g(208);let a1=w16g(209);let a2=w16g(210);let a3=w16g(211)
    let a4=w16g(212);let a5=w16g(213);let a6=w16g(214);let a7=w16g(215)
    let a8=w16g(216);let a9=w16g(217);let a10=w16g(218);let a11=w16g(219)
    let a12=w16g(220);let a13=w16g(221);let a14=w16g(222);let a15=w16g(223)
    // Read h from H16
    let h0=h16g(0);let h1=h16g(1);let h2=h16g(2);let h3=h16g(3)
    let h4=h16g(4);let h5=h16g(5);let h6=h16g(6);let h7=h16g(7)
    let h8=h16g(8);let h9=h16g(9);let h10=h16g(10);let h11=h16g(11)
    let h12=h16g(12);let h13=h16g(13);let h14=h16g(14);let h15=h16g(15)

    // result_lo = oct_mul(Alo,hlo) - oct_mul(conj(Ahi),hhi)
    // Step 1: oct_mul(Alo, hlo) → OCT_P
    oct_mul_p(a0,a1,a2,a3,a4,a5,a6,a7, h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7)
    // Step 2: oct_mul(conj(Ahi), hhi) where conj(Ahi)=(a8,-a9..-a15) → OCT_Q
    oct_mul_q(a8,0.0-a9,0.0-a10,0.0-a11,0.0-a12,0.0-a13,0.0-a14,0.0-a15,
              h8,h9,h10,h11,h12,h13,h14,h15)
    // result_lo = P - Q
    var i = 0
    while i < 8 { SED_PRE[i] = OCT_P[i] - OCT_Q[i]; i=i+1 }

    // result_hi = oct_mul(Ahi,hlo) + oct_mul(hhi,conj(Alo))
    // Step 3: oct_mul(Ahi, hlo) → OCT_P
    oct_mul_p(a8,a9,a10,a11,a12,a13,a14,a15, h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7)
    // Step 4: oct_mul(hhi, conj(Alo)) where conj(Alo)=(a0,-a1..-a7) → OCT_Q
    oct_mul_q(h8,h9,h10,h11,h12,h13,h14,h15, a0,0.0-a1,0.0-a2,0.0-a3,0.0-a4,0.0-a5,0.0-a6,0.0-a7)
    // result_hi = P + Q
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { SED_PRE[8+i] = OCT_P[i] + OCT_Q[i]; i=i+1 }
}

// Selective S-SSM step:
//   gate = sigmoid(W_gate[token])
//   pre[d] = sed_product()[d] + B[d] * embed[token][d]
//   h[d] = (1-gate)*h[d] + gate*clip(pre[d])
fn sed_step(tok: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Compute sedenion product (stored in SED_PRE)
    sed_product()

    // Gate: single scalar for whole state
    let gate_w = w16g(240 + tok)
    let gate = sigmoid_q(gate_w)
    let keep = 1.0 - gate

    // Add B * embed and apply gate
    var d = 0
    while d < 16 {
        var pre = SED_PRE[d] + w16g(224+d) * w16g(tok*16+d)
        if pre > 5.0 { pre = 5.0 }
        if pre < 0.0 - 5.0 { pre = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        let new_h = keep * h16g(d) + gate * pre
        h16s(d, new_h)
        d = d + 1
    }
}

fn logits16(nc: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var c = 0
    while c < nc {
        var s = 0.0; var d = 0
        while d < 16 { s = s + h16g(d) * w16g(253 + d*nc + c); d=d+1 }
        L16[c] = (s * 100000000.0) as i64; c=c+1
    }
}
fn pred16(nc: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    var best=0; var bv=(L16[0] as f64)/100000000.0; var i=1
    while i<nc { let v=(L16[i] as f64)/100000000.0; if v>bv{bv=v;best=i}; i=i+1 }
    best
}
fn update16(tgt: i64, lr: f64, nc: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var mx=(L16[0] as f64)/100000000.0; var i=1
    while i<nc { let v=(L16[i] as f64)/100000000.0; if v>mx{mx=v}; i=i+1 }
    var probs: [f64; 10]=[0.0;10]; var se=0.0; i=0
    while i<nc { probs[i]=exp_q((L16[i] as f64)/100000000.0-mx); se=se+probs[i]; i=i+1 }
    i=0; while i<nc { probs[i]=probs[i]/se; i=i+1 }
    probs[tgt]=probs[tgt]-1.0
    var d=0
    while d<16 {
        let hd=h16g(d); var c=0
        while c<nc {
            let idx=253+d*nc+c
            var g=hd*probs[c]
            if g>0.3{g=0.3}if g<0.0-0.3{g=0.0-0.3}
            let m=(MOM16[idx] as f64)/100000000.0*0.9+g
            MOM16[idx]=(m*100000000.0) as i64
            w16s(idx, w16g(idx)-lr*m)
            c=c+1
        }
        d=d+1
    }
}

fn run_lo16(sl: i64) -> f64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ne=80; var ep=0
    while ep<ne {
        var s=0; while s<500 {
            let lbl=gen_lo(sl); var tgt=lbl%10; if tgt<0{tgt=tgt+10}
            var d=0; while d<16{H16[d]=0;d=d+1}
            var t=0; while t<SEQ_POS { sed_step(SEQ[t]); t=t+1 }
            logits16(10); update16(tgt,0.01,10); s=s+1
        }; ep=ep+1
    }
    rng_seed(99999+sl,11111+sl)
    var correct=0; var s=0
    while s<1000 {
        let lbl=gen_lo(sl); var tgt=lbl%10; if tgt<0{tgt=tgt+10}
        var d=0; while d<16{H16[d]=0;d=d+1}
        var t=0; while t<SEQ_POS { sed_step(SEQ[t]); t=t+1 }
        logits16(10); if pred16(10)==tgt{correct=correct+1}; s=s+1
    }
    (correct as f64)/1000.0*100.0
}

fn run_br16(sl: i64) -> f64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ne=80; var ep=0
    while ep<ne {
        var s=0; while s<500 {
            let cls=gen_br(sl)
            var d=0; while d<16{H16[d]=0;d=d+1}
            var t=0; while t<BR_LEN { sed_step(BR[t]); t=t+1 }
            logits16(2); update16(cls,0.01,2); s=s+1
        }; ep=ep+1
    }
    rng_seed(99999+sl,11111+sl)
    var correct=0; var s=0
    while s<1000 {
        let cls=gen_br(sl)
        var d=0; while d<16{H16[d]=0;d=d+1}
        var t=0; while t<BR_LEN { sed_step(BR[t]); t=t+1 }
        logits16(2); if pred16(2)==cls{correct=correct+1}; s=s+1
    }
    (correct as f64)/1000.0*100.0
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  4-Way Algebra Benchmark: O-SSM / H-SSM / S-SSM / Naive\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print("  O-SSM:  Cayley/octonion, 8D,  8 A-params, non-assoc\n")
    print("  H-SSM:  Hamilton/quat,   8D,  8 A-params, assoc     <- prev winner\n")
    print("  S-SSM:  Sedenion+gate,  16D, 16 A-params, ZD+select  <- new\n")
    print("  Naive:  diagonal,        8D,  8 A-params, commut\n")
    print("  NOTE: S-SSM has 16 A-params and 13 gate-params (not param-matched)\n\n")

    // ─── ListOps L=15 ───
    print("=== ListOps L=15 (10-class) ===\n")

    print("  O-SSM: ")
    rng_seed(55555,77777); init8_embed_b_out(); init8_A_oct()
    rng_seed(12345,67890)
    let lo_oct = run_lo8(0, 15)
    print(lo_oct); print("%\n")

    print("  H-SSM: ")
    rng_seed(55555,77777); init8_embed_b_out(); init8_A_quat()
    rng_seed(12345,67890)
    let lo_quat = run_lo8(1, 15)
    print(lo_quat); print("%\n")

    print("  S-SSM: ")
    rng_seed(55555,77777); init16_weights()
    rng_seed(12345,67890)
    let lo_sed = run_lo16(15)
    print(lo_sed); print("%\n")

    print("  Naive: ")
    rng_seed(55555,77777); init8_embed_b_out(); init8_A_diag()
    rng_seed(12345,67890)
    let lo_diag = run_lo8(2, 15)
    print(lo_diag); print("%\n")

    // ─── Bracket L=12 ───
    print("\n=== Bracket L=12 (binary) ===\n")

    print("  O-SSM: ")
    rng_seed(55555,77777); init8_embed_b_out(); init8_A_oct()
    rng_seed(12345,67890)
    let br_oct = run_br8(0, 12)
    print(br_oct); print("%\n")

    print("  H-SSM: ")
    rng_seed(55555,77777); init8_embed_b_out(); init8_A_quat()
    rng_seed(12345,67890)
    let br_quat = run_br8(1, 12)
    print(br_quat); print("%\n")

    print("  S-SSM: ")
    rng_seed(55555,77777); init16_weights()
    rng_seed(12345,67890)
    let br_sed = run_br16(12)
    print(br_sed); print("%\n")

    print("  Naive: ")
    rng_seed(55555,77777); init8_embed_b_out(); init8_A_diag()
    rng_seed(12345,67890)
    let br_diag = run_br8(2, 12)
    print(br_diag); print("%\n")

    // ─── Summary ───
    print("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  RESULTS\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  Task       O-SSM   H-SSM   S-SSM*  Naive   Random\n")
    print("  ListOps    "); print(lo_oct); print("%  "); print(lo_quat)
    print("%  "); print(lo_sed); print("%  "); print(lo_diag); print("%   10%\n")
    print("  Bracket    "); print(br_oct); print("%  "); print(br_quat)
    print("%  "); print(br_sed); print("%  "); print(br_diag); print("%   50%\n")
    print("  * S-SSM has 16 A-params + 13 gate-params (2x A-params vs others)\n\n")

    print("  Algebra:  non-assoc / assoc+non-comm / sed+ZD+gate / commut\n")
    print("  S-SSM unique: zero-divisors (hard forget) + Mamba gate\n\n")

    // Analysis
    let ssm_lo_winner = if lo_sed > lo_quat { if lo_sed > lo_oct { "S-SSM" } else { "O-SSM" } } else { if lo_quat > lo_oct { "H-SSM" } else { "O-SSM" } }
    print("  ListOps winner: "); print(ssm_lo_winner); print("\n")
    let ssm_br_winner = if br_sed > br_quat { if br_sed > br_oct { "S-SSM" } else { "O-SSM" } } else { if br_quat > br_oct { "H-SSM" } else { "O-SSM" } }
    print("  Bracket winner: "); print(ssm_br_winner); print("\n")

    let sed_lo_gap = lo_sed - lo_quat
    if sed_lo_gap > 3.0 {
        print("  ListOps: S-SSM > H-SSM (+"); print(sed_lo_gap); print("pp) — gating+16D helps\n")
    } else {
        if sed_lo_gap < 0.0 - 3.0 {
            print("  ListOps: H-SSM > S-SSM ("); print(sed_lo_gap); print("pp) — extra capacity not compensating\n")
        } else {
            print("  ListOps: S-SSM ≈ H-SSM (within ±3pp)\n")
        }
    }

    let sed_br_gap = br_sed - br_quat
    if sed_br_gap > 3.0 {
        print("  Bracket: S-SSM > H-SSM (+"); print(sed_br_gap); print("pp) — ZD gating helps hierarchy\n")
    } else {
        if sed_br_gap < 0.0 - 3.0 {
            print("  Bracket: H-SSM > S-SSM ("); print(sed_br_gap); print("pp) — associativity still key\n")
        } else {
            print("  Bracket: S-SSM ≈ H-SSM (within ±3pp)\n")
        }
    }

    println("ALL PASS")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/native_calculus.sio ===
// Sprint 230: Functional Calculus - Native ELF Demo
//
// Real f64 numerical computing: differentiate, integrate, find roots, optimize.
// Every algorithm takes fn(f64) -> f64 as argument.
// Pure Sounio - no libc, no runtime, no extern C.
//
// Compile:
//   $SOUC run self-hosted/compiler/render_native_compile_driver_lean.sio \
//     -- examples/native_calculus.sio /tmp/calculus.elf
// Run:
//   /tmp/calculus.elf; echo $?  # -> 50

fn fc_abs(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

fn my_sin(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let pi = 3.14159265358979
    let two_pi = 6.28318530717959
    var r = x
    while r > pi { r = r - two_pi }
    while r < 0.0 - pi { r = r + two_pi }
    let x2 = r * r
    let t1 = r
    let t3 = 0.0 - r * x2 / 6.0
    let t5 = 0.0 - t3 * x2 / 20.0
    let t7 = 0.0 - t5 * x2 / 42.0
    let t9 = 0.0 - t7 * x2 / 72.0
    let t11 = 0.0 - t9 * x2 / 110.0
    t1 + t3 + t5 + t7 + t9 + t11
}

fn parabola(x: f64) -> f64 { x * x - 4.0 * x + 3.0 }

fn deriv(f: fn(f64) -> f64, x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let h = 0.00000001
    (f(x + h) - f(x - h)) / (2.0 * h)
}

fn integrate(f: fn(f64) -> f64, a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let n: i64 = 100
    let h = (b - a) / 100.0
    var sum = f(a) + f(b)
    var i: i64 = 1
    var x = a + h
    while i < n {
        if i % 2 == 0 { sum = sum + 2.0 * f(x) }
        else { sum = sum + 4.0 * f(x) }
        i = i + 1
        x = x + h
    }
    sum * h / 3.0
}

fn minimize(f: fn(f64) -> f64, a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let resphi = 0.3819660113
    var lo = a
    var hi = b
    var x1 = lo + resphi * (hi - lo)
    var x2 = hi - resphi * (hi - lo)
    var f1 = f(x1)
    var f2 = f(x2)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 100 {
        if fc_abs(hi - lo) < 0.0000000001 { return 0.5 * (lo + hi) }
        if f1 < f2 {
            hi = x2
            x2 = x1
            f2 = f1
            x1 = lo + resphi * (hi - lo)
            f1 = f(x1)
        } else {
            lo = x1
            x1 = x2
            f1 = f2
            x2 = hi - resphi * (hi - lo)
            f2 = f(x2)
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    0.5 * (lo + hi)
}

fn f2exit(x: f64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var result: i64 = 0
    var rem = if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
    while rem >= 1.0 {
        rem = rem - 1.0
        result = result + 1
    }
    if x < 0.0 { 0 - result } else { result }
}

fn main() -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let pi = 3.14159265358979

    // d/dx sin(0) = cos(0) = 1.0 -> f2exit(1.0 * 10) = 10
    let d = deriv(my_sin, 0.0)

    // integral of sin from 0 to pi = 2.0 -> f2exit(2.0 * 10) = 20
    let area = integrate(my_sin, 0.0, pi)

    // minimize x^2-4x+3 on [0,5] = 2.0 -> f2exit(2.0 * 10) = 20
    let min_x = minimize(parabola, 0.0, 5.0)

    // Total: 10 + 20 + 20 = 50
    f2exit(d * 10.0) + f2exit(area * 10.0) + f2exit(min_x * 10.0)
}


// === FILE: examples/native_epistemic_pk.sio ===
// Native Epistemic PK: Full 6-Observation Gauss-Newton
// Pure Sounio. No libc. No imports. Static ELF.
// Split into helper functions for lean emitter compatibility.

fn pk_abs(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

fn pk_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var g = x * 0.5
    if x < 1.0 { g = 1.0 }
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 60 { g = 0.5 * (g + x / g)
        i = i + 1 }
    g
}

fn pk_exp_pos(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var d = 0.0
    var n: i64 = 0
    while n < 25 { d = d + 1.0
        term = term * x / d
        sum = sum + term
        n = n + 1 }
    sum
}

fn pk_conc(t: f64, ka: f64, ke: f64, dose: f64, vd: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let diff = ka - ke
    if pk_abs(diff) < 0.0001 { return 0.0 }
    let factor = dose * ka / (vd * diff)
    let ek = 1.0 / pk_exp_pos(ke * t)
    let ea = 1.0 / pk_exp_pos(ka * t)
    factor * (ek - ea)
}

fn jac_ka(t: f64, ka: f64, ke: f64, d: f64, v: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let h = 0.0001
    (pk_conc(t, ka + h, ke, d, v) - pk_conc(t, ka, ke, d, v)) / h
}

fn jac_ke(t: f64, ka: f64, ke: f64, d: f64, v: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let h = 0.0001
    (pk_conc(t, ka, ke + h, d, v) - pk_conc(t, ka, ke, d, v)) / h
}

fn fisher_aa(ka: f64, ke: f64, d: f64, v: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let j0 = jac_ka(0.5, ka, ke, d, v)
    let j1 = jac_ka(1.0, ka, ke, d, v)
    let j2 = jac_ka(2.0, ka, ke, d, v)
    let j3 = jac_ka(4.0, ka, ke, d, v)
    let j4 = jac_ka(8.0, ka, ke, d, v)
    let j5 = jac_ka(12.0, ka, ke, d, v)
    j0 * j0 + j1 * j1 + j2 * j2 + j3 * j3 + j4 * j4 + j5 * j5
}

fn fisher_ab(ka: f64, ke: f64, d: f64, v: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let a0 = jac_ka(0.5, ka, ke, d, v)
    let b0 = jac_ke(0.5, ka, ke, d, v)
    let a1 = jac_ka(1.0, ka, ke, d, v)
    let b1 = jac_ke(1.0, ka, ke, d, v)
    let a2 = jac_ka(2.0, ka, ke, d, v)
    let b2 = jac_ke(2.0, ka, ke, d, v)
    let a3 = jac_ka(4.0, ka, ke, d, v)
    let b3 = jac_ke(4.0, ka, ke, d, v)
    let a4 = jac_ka(8.0, ka, ke, d, v)
    let b4 = jac_ke(8.0, ka, ke, d, v)
    let a5 = jac_ka(12.0, ka, ke, d, v)
    let b5 = jac_ke(12.0, ka, ke, d, v)
    a0 * b0 + a1 * b1 + a2 * b2 + a3 * b3 + a4 * b4 + a5 * b5
}

fn fisher_bb(ka: f64, ke: f64, d: f64, v: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let j0 = jac_ke(0.5, ka, ke, d, v)
    let j1 = jac_ke(1.0, ka, ke, d, v)
    let j2 = jac_ke(2.0, ka, ke, d, v)
    let j3 = jac_ke(4.0, ka, ke, d, v)
    let j4 = jac_ke(8.0, ka, ke, d, v)
    let j5 = jac_ke(12.0, ka, ke, d, v)
    j0 * j0 + j1 * j1 + j2 * j2 + j3 * j3 + j4 * j4 + j5 * j5
}

fn grad_ka(ka: f64, ke: f64, d: f64, v: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    jac_ka(0.5, ka, ke, d, v) * (pk_conc(0.5, ka, ke, d, v) - 2.206)
    + jac_ka(1.0, ka, ke, d, v) * (pk_conc(1.0, ka, ke, d, v) - 3.360)
    + jac_ka(2.0, ka, ke, d, v) * (pk_conc(2.0, ka, ke, d, v) - 5.293)
    + jac_ka(4.0, ka, ke, d, v) * (pk_conc(4.0, ka, ke, d, v) - 4.971)
    + jac_ka(8.0, ka, ke, d, v) * (pk_conc(8.0, ka, ke, d, v) - 3.213)
    + jac_ka(12.0, ka, ke, d, v) * (pk_conc(12.0, ka, ke, d, v) - 1.392)
}

fn grad_ke(ka: f64, ke: f64, d: f64, v: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    jac_ke(0.5, ka, ke, d, v) * (pk_conc(0.5, ka, ke, d, v) - 2.206)
    + jac_ke(1.0, ka, ke, d, v) * (pk_conc(1.0, ka, ke, d, v) - 3.360)
    + jac_ke(2.0, ka, ke, d, v) * (pk_conc(2.0, ka, ke, d, v) - 5.293)
    + jac_ke(4.0, ka, ke, d, v) * (pk_conc(4.0, ka, ke, d, v) - 4.971)
    + jac_ke(8.0, ka, ke, d, v) * (pk_conc(8.0, ka, ke, d, v) - 3.213)
    + jac_ke(12.0, ka, ke, d, v) * (pk_conc(12.0, ka, ke, d, v) - 1.392)
}

fn pk_fit(dose: f64, vd: f64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var ka = 0.6
    var ke = 0.25
    var converged: i64 = 0
    var iter: i64 = 0
    while iter < 40 {
        if pk_abs(ka - ke) < 0.001 { ke = ke + 0.01 }
        let a11 = fisher_aa(ka, ke, dose, vd)
        let a12 = fisher_ab(ka, ke, dose, vd)
        let a22 = fisher_bb(ka, ke, dose, vd)
        let g1 = grad_ka(ka, ke, dose, vd)
        let g2 = grad_ke(ka, ke, dose, vd)
        let det = a11 * a22 - a12 * a12
        if pk_abs(det) < 0.0000000001 { break }
        var dka = 0.0 - (a22 * g1 - a12 * g2) / det
        var dke = 0.0 - (a11 * g2 - a12 * g1) / det
        let delta = pk_sqrt(dka * dka + dke * dke)
        if delta > 0.3 { dka = dka * 0.3 / delta
            dke = dke * 0.3 / delta }
        ka = ka + dka
        ke = ke + dke
        if ka < 0.01 { ka = 0.01 }
        if ke < 0.01 { ke = 0.01 }
        if delta < 0.000001 { converged = 1
            break }
        iter = iter + 1
    }
    var result: i64 = 0
    if pk_abs(ka - 0.5) / 0.5 < 0.15 { result = result + 32 }
    if pk_abs(ke - 0.2) / 0.2 < 0.15 { result = result + 16 }
    if ka > 0.3 { result = result + 8 }
    if ke > 0.1 { result = result + 4 }
    if ka < 0.8 { result = result + 2 }
    result = result + converged
    result
}

fn main() -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div { pk_fit(100.0, 10.0) }


// === FILE: examples/native_higher_order.sio ===
// Sprint 229: Native Higher-Order Functions Demo
//
// Compiles to a ~6KB static ELF binary with ZERO runtime dependencies.
// Demonstrates: fn refs, indirect calls, higher-order apply, fold, select.
//
// Compile:
//   $SOUC run self-hosted/compiler/render_native_compile_driver_lean.sio \
//     -- examples/native_higher_order.sio /tmp/higher_order.elf
//
// Run:
//   /tmp/higher_order.elf
//   echo $?  # → 75

// Pure functions as first-class values
fn double(x: i64) -> i64 { x * 2 }
fn triple(x: i64) -> i64 { x * 3 }
fn square(x: i64) -> i64 { x * x }
fn negate(x: i64) -> i64 { 0 - x }
fn add_one(x: i64) -> i64 { x + 1 }

// Binary operations
fn add(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { a + b }
fn mul(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { a * b }
fn max2(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }

// Higher-order: apply function to value
fn apply(f: fn(i64) -> i64, x: i64) -> i64 { f(x) }
fn apply2(f: fn(i64, i64) -> i64, a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { f(a, b) }

// Higher-order: apply N times (functional iteration)
fn apply_n(f: fn(i64) -> i64, x: i64, n: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var result = x
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        result = f(result)
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// Dynamic dispatch: return different functions based on condition
fn select_op(which: i64) -> fn(i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if which == 0 { double }
    else if which == 1 { triple }
    else if which == 2 { negate }
    else { add_one }
}

fn main() -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    // --- Test 1: apply(double, 5) = 10 ---
    let r1 = apply(double, 5)

    // --- Test 2: apply(square, 4) = 16 ---
    let r2 = apply(square, 4)

    // --- Test 3: apply2(add, 3, 7) = 10 ---
    let r3 = apply2(add, 3, 7)

    // --- Test 4: fn stored in variable ---
    let f = triple
    let r4 = f(5) // = 15

    // --- Test 5: fn returned from function ---
    let op = select_op(2)
    let r5 = op(10) // = -10

    // --- Test 6: manual fold (sum 1..4) via fn ref ---
    let s1 = apply2(add, 0, 1)
    let s2 = apply2(add, s1, 2)
    let s3 = apply2(add, s2, 3)
    let s4 = apply2(add, s3, 4)
    // s4 = 10

    // --- Test 7: manual fold (product 1..4) via fn ref ---
    let p1 = apply2(mul, 1, 2)
    let p2 = apply2(mul, p1, 3)
    let p3 = apply2(mul, p2, 4)
    // p3 = 24

    // --- Test 8: apply_n — double 3 times: 1→2→4→8 ---
    let r8 = apply_n(double, 1, 3)
    // r8 = 8, but we subtract 8 to keep total clean

    // Total: r1(10) + r2(16) + r3(10) + r4(15) + r5(-10) + s4(10) + p3(24) = 75
    r1 + r2 + r3 + r4 + r5 + s4 + p3
}


// === FILE: examples/network/null_hypothesis_demo.sio ===
//! Null Hypothesis Testing for Network Analysis
//!
//! Demonstrates the complete workflow for statistical network analysis:
//! 1. Load network data (typically from CSV edge list)
//! 2. Compute observed network metric (e.g., clustering coefficient)
//! 3. Generate null models with preserved degree sequence
//! 4. Compute null distribution of the metric
//! 5. Calculate z-score and p-value using effect size statistics
//!
//! This workflow addresses GitHub Issue #17 (Phase 2 research):
//! Testing if network properties are statistically significant by
//! comparing against configuration model null hypotheses.

fn main() with IO, Alloc {
    log_info("=== Network Null Hypothesis Testing ===\n")

    // Create a synthetic network as adjacency list
    // (In practice, this would be loaded from CSV via csv_loader module)
    var adj = vec_new()

    // Node 0: connected to 1, 2, 3
    var neighbors_0 = vec_new()
    vec_push(&!neighbors_0, 1)
    vec_push(&!neighbors_0, 2)
    vec_push(&!neighbors_0, 3)
    vec_push(&!adj, neighbors_0)

    // Node 1: connected to 0, 2, 4
    var neighbors_1 = vec_new()
    vec_push(&!neighbors_1, 0)
    vec_push(&!neighbors_1, 2)
    vec_push(&!neighbors_1, 4)
    vec_push(&!adj, neighbors_1)

    // Node 2: connected to 0, 1, 3, 4
    var neighbors_2 = vec_new()
    vec_push(&!neighbors_2, 0)
    vec_push(&!neighbors_2, 1)
    vec_push(&!neighbors_2, 3)
    vec_push(&!neighbors_2, 4)
    vec_push(&!adj, neighbors_2)

    // Node 3: connected to 0, 2, 4
    var neighbors_3 = vec_new()
    vec_push(&!neighbors_3, 0)
    vec_push(&!neighbors_3, 2)
    vec_push(&!neighbors_3, 4)
    vec_push(&!adj, neighbors_3)

    // Node 4: connected to 1, 2, 3
    var neighbors_4 = vec_new()
    vec_push(&!neighbors_4, 1)
    vec_push(&!neighbors_4, 2)
    vec_push(&!neighbors_4, 3)
    vec_push(&!adj, neighbors_4)

    log_info("Network Summary:\n")
    log_info(&format_usize(adj.len(), "  Nodes: "))
    log_info(&string_from("\n"))

    // Count total edges
    var edge_count = 0
    var i = 0
    while i < adj.len() {
        edge_count = edge_count + adj[i].len()
        i = i + 1
    }
    // Divide by 2 for undirected graph
    edge_count = edge_count / 2
    log_info(&format_usize(edge_count, "  Edges: "))
    log_info(&string_from("\n\n"))

    // Step 1: Compute observed clustering coefficient
    log_info("Step 1: Observed Network Metric\n")
    let observed_clustering = clustering_coefficient(&adj)
    log_info(&string_from("  Clustering Coefficient: "))
    log_info(&format_float(observed_clustering))
    log_info(&string_from("\n\n"))

    // Step 2: Generate null models (configuration model)
    log_info("Step 2: Generate Null Models (Configuration Model)\n")
    let num_nulls = 10
    log_info(&format_usize(num_nulls, "  Generating "))
    log_info(&string_from(" null models...\n"))

    var null_clusterings = vec_new()
    var j = 0
    while j < num_nulls {
        // Generate random graph with same degree sequence
        let null_adj = configuration_model_from_graph(&adj)
        let null_clustering = clustering_coefficient(&null_adj)
        vec_push(&!null_clusterings, null_clustering)
        j = j + 1
    }
    log_info(&string_from("  Done.\n\n"))

    // Step 3: Compute null distribution statistics
    log_info("Step 3: Null Distribution Statistics\n")

    // Calculate mean
    var null_sum = 0.0
    var k = 0
    while k < null_clusterings.len() {
        null_sum = null_sum + null_clusterings[k]
        k = k + 1
    }
    let null_mean = null_sum / (null_clusterings.len() as f64)
    log_info(&string_from("  Null Mean: "))
    log_info(&format_float(null_mean))
    log_info(&string_from("\n"))

    // Calculate std dev
    var null_var_sum = 0.0
    k = 0
    while k < null_clusterings.len() {
        let diff = null_clusterings[k] - null_mean
        null_var_sum = null_var_sum + (diff * diff)
        k = k + 1
    }
    let null_std = (null_var_sum / (null_clusterings.len() as f64)).sqrt()
    log_info(&string_from("  Null Std Dev: "))
    log_info(&format_float(null_std))
    log_info(&string_from("\n\n"))

    // Step 4: Statistical significance testing
    log_info("Step 4: Significance Test\n")

    // Calculate z-score
    let z_score = if null_std > 0.0 {
        (observed_clustering - null_mean) / null_std
    } else {
        0.0
    }

    log_info(&string_from("  Z-score: "))
    log_info(&format_float(z_score))
    log_info(&string_from("\n"))

    // Approximate two-tailed p-value
    let p_value = 2.0 * normal_tail_probability(z_score.abs())
    log_info(&string_from("  P-value (two-tailed): "))
    log_info(&format_float(p_value))
    log_info(&string_from("\n\n"))

    // Step 5: Effect size (Cliff's delta between observed and null)
    log_info("Step 5: Effect Size\n")
    let cliffs_delta_val = cliffs_delta(&[observed_clustering], &null_clusterings)
    log_info(&string_from("  Cliff's Delta: "))
    log_info(&format_float(cliffs_delta_val))
    log_info(&string_from("\n\n"))

    // Interpretation
    log_info("=== Results Interpretation ===\n")
    if p_value < 0.05 {
        log_info("Network clustering is SIGNIFICANTLY different from null model (p < 0.05)\n")
    } else {
        log_info("Network clustering is NOT significantly different from null model (p >= 0.05)\n")
    }

    let abs_cliffs = if cliffs_delta_val < 0.0 { -cliffs_delta_val } else { cliffs_delta_val }
    if abs_cliffs < 0.147 {
        log_info("  Effect size: NEGLIGIBLE\n")
    } else if abs_cliffs < 0.330 {
        log_info("  Effect size: SMALL\n")
    } else if abs_cliffs < 0.474 {
        log_info("  Effect size: MEDIUM\n")
    } else {
        log_info("  Effect size: LARGE\n")
    }

    log_info("\n=== End of Demo ===\n")
}

// ============================================================================
// Network Metrics
// ============================================================================

/// Calculate clustering coefficient of a network
fn clustering_coefficient(adj: &[Vec<usize>]) -> f64 with Alloc {
    if adj.len() < 3 {
        return 0.0
    }

    var triangles = 0
    var triplets = 0

    var i = 0
    while i < adj.len() {
        let ki = adj[i].len()

        if ki < 2 {
            i = i + 1
            continue
        }

        // Count triangles
        var j = 0
        while j < adj[i].len() {
            let neighbor_j = adj[i][j]

            var k = j + 1
            while k < adj[i].len() {
                let neighbor_k = adj[i][k]

                // Check if neighbor_j and neighbor_k are connected
                var connected = false
                var n = 0
                while n < adj[neighbor_j].len() {
                    if adj[neighbor_j][n] == neighbor_k {
                        connected = true
                        break
                    }
                    n = n + 1
                }

                if connected {
                    triangles = triangles + 1
                }

                k = k + 1
            }

            j = j + 1
        }

        // Count possible triplets
        triplets = triplets + ki * (ki - 1) / 2

        i = i + 1
    }

    if triplets == 0 {
        return 0.0
    }

    (triangles as f64) / (triplets as f64)
}

/// Generate configuration model (random graph with same degree sequence)
fn configuration_model_from_graph(adj: &[Vec<usize>]) -> Vec<Vec<usize>> with IO, Alloc {
    let degrees = get_degree_sequence_from_adj(adj)
    configuration_model_from_degrees(&degrees)
}

fn get_degree_sequence_from_adj(adj: &[Vec<usize>]) -> Vec<usize> with Alloc {
    var degrees = vec_new()
    var i = 0
    while i < adj.len() {
        vec_push(&!degrees, adj[i].len())
        i = i + 1
    }
    degrees
}

fn configuration_model_from_degrees(degrees: &[usize]) -> Vec<Vec<usize>> with IO, Alloc {
    let n = degrees.len()

    // Initialize adjacency list
    var adj = vec_new()
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        vec_push(&!adj, vec_new())
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Calculate total degree
    var total_degree = 0
    var j = 0
    while j < degrees.len() {
        total_degree = total_degree + degrees[j]
        j = j + 1
    }

    if total_degree == 0 {
        return adj
    }

    // Chung-Lu probabilistic model
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        j = i + 1
        while j < n {
            let prob = (degrees[i] as f64 * degrees[j] as f64) / (total_degree as f64)
            if prob > 0.5 {
                vec_push(&!adj[i], j)
                vec_push(&!adj[j], i)
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    adj
}

// ============================================================================
// Statistics
// ============================================================================

/// Cliff's delta for non-parametric effect size
fn cliffs_delta(data1: &[f64], data2: &[f64]) -> f64 {
    if data1.len() == 0 || data2.len() == 0 {
        return 0.0
    }

    var greater: i64 = 0
    var less: i64 = 0

    var i = 0
    while i < data1.len() {
        var j = 0
        while j < data2.len() {
            if data1[i] > data2[j] {
                greater = greater + 1
            } else if data1[i] < data2[j] {
                less = less + 1
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    let total = (data1.len() * data2.len()) as i64
    ((greater - less) as f64) / (total as f64)
}

/// Approximate normal tail probability
fn normal_tail_probability(z: f64) -> f64 {
    if z > 6.0 {
        return 0.0
    }
    if z < -6.0 {
        return 1.0
    }

    let p = 0.47047
    let b1 = 0.3480242
    let b2 = -0.0958798
    let t = 1.0 / (1.0 + p * z)

    let tau = t * (b1 + b2 * t * t)
    let erf_approx = 1.0 - tau * (-z * z / 2.0).exp()

    (1.0 - erf_approx) / 2.0
}

// ============================================================================
// Utilities
// ============================================================================

fn log_info(msg: &str) with IO {
    let bytes = msg.as_bytes()
    write(1, bytes.as_ptr(), bytes.len())
}

fn format_float(val: f64) -> String with Alloc {
    var s = string_new()
    let int_part = (val as i64) as f64
    let frac_part = (val - int_part) * 1000.0

    var i = int_part as i64
    if i < 0 {
        string_push(&!s, '-')
        i = -i
    }
    var int_str = string_new()
    if i == 0 {
        string_push(&!int_str, '0')
    } else {
        while i > 0 {
            let digit = ((i % 10) as u8 + ('0' as u8)) as char
            string_push(&!int_str, digit)
            i = i / 10
        }
        string_reverse(&!int_str)
    }
    string_push_str(&!s, &int_str)
    string_push(&!s, '.')

    var frac_int = frac_part as i64
    var j = 0
    while j < 3 {
        let digit = ((frac_int / ((100 as i64).pow((2 - j) as u32)) % 10) as u8 + ('0' as u8)) as char
        string_push(&!s, digit)
        j = j + 1
    }

    s
}

fn format_usize(val: usize, prefix: &str) -> String with Alloc {
    var s = string_from(prefix)
    var n = val
    var digits = string_new()

    if n == 0 {
        string_push(&!digits, '0')
    } else {
        while n > 0 {
            let digit = ((n % 10) as u8 + ('0' as u8)) as char
            string_push(&!digits, digit)
            n = n / 10
        }
        string_reverse(&!digits)
    }

    string_push_str(&!s, &digits)
    s
}

    fn write(fd: i32, buf: *const u8, count: usize) -> i64
}


// === FILE: examples/neuroreceptor_pet/pet_2tcm_epistemic.sio ===
// examples/neuroreceptor_pet/pet_2tcm_epistemic.sio
//
// Executable Epistemic PET 2-Tissue Compartment Model (2TCM) — NRM 2026
//
// AUDITED implementation with EIGHT epistemic priors:
//   0 = K1         (ml/cm³/min)
//   1 = k2         (/min)
//   2 = k3         (/min)
//   3 = k4         (/min)
//   4 = cp_amp     (synthetic plasma amplitude)
//   5 = cp_decay   (/min)
//   6 = fu_plasma  (unbound plasma fraction; PBPK-informed)
//   7 = bbb_scalar (blood-brain transport scalar; PBPK-informed)
//
// Effective transport into C1 uses:
//   K1_eff = K1 * fu_plasma * bbb_scalar
//
// Model:
//   dC1/dt = K1_eff*Cp(t) - (k2+k3)*C1 + k4*C2
//   dC2/dt = k3*C1 - k4*C2
//   CT(t)  = C1(t) + C2(t)
//
// Derived:
//   BP_ND = k3/k4                           (unaffected by fu, bbb)
//   V_T   = (K1_eff/k2) * (1 + k3/k4)
//
// Synthetic input:
//   Cp(t) = cp_amp * exp(-cp_decay * t),  t in minutes
//
// GUM method: finite-difference Jacobian (JCGM 100:2008 §5.1.3).
// Mirrors the numerical pattern of stdlib/darwin_pbpk/epistemic_pbpk14.sio.
//
// Proof-of-concept only. Not a clinical tool.

// ============================================================================
// NUMERIC HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn max_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { return a }
    return b
}

fn min_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a < b { return a }
    return b
}

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var g = x
    if g < 1.0 { g = 1.0 }
    var i = 0
    while i < 40 {
        g = 0.5 * (g + x / g)
        i = i + 1
    }
    return g
}

// exp(x) via aggressive range reduction to |x| <= 0.5 + 20-term Taylor.
// Accurate to ~1e-10 across the physical range used by this example.
fn exp_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    if x < 0.0 { return 1.0 / exp_f64(0.0 - x) }
    if x > 0.5 {
        let half = exp_f64(x * 0.5)
        return half * half
    }
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 20 {
        let di = i as f64
        term = term * x / di
        sum = sum + term
        i = i + 1
    }
    return sum
}

fn ep_finite(x: f64) -> bool {
    if x != x { return false }
    return abs_f64(x) < 1.0e12
}

// ============================================================================
// STRUCTS (8 priors)
// ============================================================================

struct PET2TCMParams {
    k1: f64,
    k2: f64,
    k3: f64,
    k4: f64,
    cp_amp: f64,
    cp_decay: f64,
    fu_plasma: f64,
    bbb_scalar: f64,
}

struct PET2TCMState {
    c1: f64,
    c2: f64,
}

struct PETMetrics {
    tac_auc: f64,
    tac_peak: f64,
    t_peak: f64,
    vt: f64,
    bpnd: f64,
    c_final: f64,
    success: bool,
}

struct EpPETPrior {
    mean: [f64; 8],
    variance: [f64; 8],
    confidence: [f64; 8],
    n: i32,
}

struct EpPETResult {
    tac_auc_mean: f64,
    tac_auc_var: f64,
    tac_peak_mean: f64,
    tac_peak_var: f64,
    vt_mean: f64,
    vt_var: f64,
    bpnd_mean: f64,
    bpnd_var: f64,
    confidence: f64,
    sensitivity: [f64; 8],
    d_vt: [f64; 8],
    d_bpnd: [f64; 8],
    success: bool,
}

// ============================================================================
// PLASMA INPUT FUNCTION
// ============================================================================

fn cp_t(t: f64, amp: f64, decay: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    if t < 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    return amp * exp_f64(0.0 - decay * t)
}

// ============================================================================
// RK4 INTEGRATOR — uses effective K1 (K1 * fu_plasma * bbb_scalar)
// ============================================================================

fn rk4_step(state: PET2TCMState, t: f64, dt: f64, p: PET2TCMParams) -> PET2TCMState with Mut, Div {
    let k1_eff = p.k1 * p.fu_plasma * p.bbb_scalar

    let cp0 = cp_t(t, p.cp_amp, p.cp_decay)
    let k1_1 = dt * (k1_eff * cp0 - (p.k2 + p.k3) * state.c1 + p.k4 * state.c2)
    let k2_1 = dt * (p.k3 * state.c1 - p.k4 * state.c2)

    let s2_c1 = state.c1 + 0.5 * k1_1
    let s2_c2 = state.c2 + 0.5 * k2_1
    let cp_mid = cp_t(t + 0.5 * dt, p.cp_amp, p.cp_decay)
    let k1_2 = dt * (k1_eff * cp_mid - (p.k2 + p.k3) * s2_c1 + p.k4 * s2_c2)
    let k2_2 = dt * (p.k3 * s2_c1 - p.k4 * s2_c2)

    let s3_c1 = state.c1 + 0.5 * k1_2
    let s3_c2 = state.c2 + 0.5 * k2_2
    let k1_3 = dt * (k1_eff * cp_mid - (p.k2 + p.k3) * s3_c1 + p.k4 * s3_c2)
    let k2_3 = dt * (p.k3 * s3_c1 - p.k4 * s3_c2)

    let s4_c1 = state.c1 + k1_3
    let s4_c2 = state.c2 + k2_3
    let cp_end = cp_t(t + dt, p.cp_amp, p.cp_decay)
    let k1_4 = dt * (k1_eff * cp_end - (p.k2 + p.k3) * s4_c1 + p.k4 * s4_c2)
    let k2_4 = dt * (p.k3 * s4_c1 - p.k4 * s4_c2)

    PET2TCMState {
        c1: state.c1 + (k1_1 + 2.0 * k1_2 + 2.0 * k1_3 + k1_4) / 6.0,
        c2: state.c2 + (k2_1 + 2.0 * k2_2 + 2.0 * k2_3 + k2_4) / 6.0,
    }
}

fn simulate_pet(p: PET2TCMParams, t_end: f64, dt: f64) -> PETMetrics with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var st = PET2TCMState { c1: 0.0, c2: 0.0 }
    var t = 0.0
    var auc = 0.0
    var peak = 0.0
    var t_peak = 0.0
    var prev_ct = 0.0
    var n = 0
    let max_steps = 10000

    while t < t_end && n < max_steps {
        let ct = st.c1 + st.c2
        if ct > peak {
            peak = ct
            t_peak = t
        }
        if n > 0 {
            auc = auc + 0.5 * (ct + prev_ct) * dt
        }
        prev_ct = ct
        st = rk4_step(st, t, dt, p)
        t = t + dt
        n = n + 1
    }

    let final_ct = st.c1 + st.c2
    let bpnd = if p.k4 > 1.0e-9 { p.k3 / p.k4 } else { 0.0 }
    let k1_eff = p.k1 * p.fu_plasma * p.bbb_scalar
    let vt = if p.k2 > 1.0e-9 { (k1_eff / p.k2) * (1.0 + bpnd) } else { 0.0 }

    PETMetrics {
        tac_auc: auc,
        tac_peak: peak,
        t_peak: t_peak,
        vt: vt,
        bpnd: bpnd,
        c_final: final_ct,
        success: t >= t_end * 0.98 && ep_finite(auc) && ep_finite(peak) && n > 100,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// GUM FINITE-DIFFERENCE PROPAGATION
// ============================================================================

fn gum_finite_h(mean: f64, var_i: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    let scale_mean = 1.0e-6 * abs_f64(mean)
    let scale_sd = 1.0e-2 * sqrt_f64(max_f64(var_i, 1.0e-10))
    max_f64(scale_mean, scale_sd)
}

fn perturbed_params(ref_p: PET2TCMParams, idx: i32, h: f64) -> PET2TCMParams {
    if idx == 0 {
        return PET2TCMParams {
            k1: ref_p.k1 + h, k2: ref_p.k2, k3: ref_p.k3, k4: ref_p.k4,
            cp_amp: ref_p.cp_amp, cp_decay: ref_p.cp_decay,
            fu_plasma: ref_p.fu_plasma, bbb_scalar: ref_p.bbb_scalar,
        }
    }
    if idx == 1 {
        return PET2TCMParams {
            k1: ref_p.k1, k2: ref_p.k2 + h, k3: ref_p.k3, k4: ref_p.k4,
            cp_amp: ref_p.cp_amp, cp_decay: ref_p.cp_decay,
            fu_plasma: ref_p.fu_plasma, bbb_scalar: ref_p.bbb_scalar,
        }
    }
    if idx == 2 {
        return PET2TCMParams {
            k1: ref_p.k1, k2: ref_p.k2, k3: ref_p.k3 + h, k4: ref_p.k4,
            cp_amp: ref_p.cp_amp, cp_decay: ref_p.cp_decay,
            fu_plasma: ref_p.fu_plasma, bbb_scalar: ref_p.bbb_scalar,
        }
    }
    if idx == 3 {
        return PET2TCMParams {
            k1: ref_p.k1, k2: ref_p.k2, k3: ref_p.k3, k4: ref_p.k4 + h,
            cp_amp: ref_p.cp_amp, cp_decay: ref_p.cp_decay,
            fu_plasma: ref_p.fu_plasma, bbb_scalar: ref_p.bbb_scalar,
        }
    }
    if idx == 4 {
        return PET2TCMParams {
            k1: ref_p.k1, k2: ref_p.k2, k3: ref_p.k3, k4: ref_p.k4,
            cp_amp: ref_p.cp_amp + h, cp_decay: ref_p.cp_decay,
            fu_plasma: ref_p.fu_plasma, bbb_scalar: ref_p.bbb_scalar,
        }
    }
    if idx == 5 {
        return PET2TCMParams {
            k1: ref_p.k1, k2: ref_p.k2, k3: ref_p.k3, k4: ref_p.k4,
            cp_amp: ref_p.cp_amp, cp_decay: ref_p.cp_decay + h,
            fu_plasma: ref_p.fu_plasma, bbb_scalar: ref_p.bbb_scalar,
        }
    }
    if idx == 6 {
        return PET2TCMParams {
            k1: ref_p.k1, k2: ref_p.k2, k3: ref_p.k3, k4: ref_p.k4,
            cp_amp: ref_p.cp_amp, cp_decay: ref_p.cp_decay,
            fu_plasma: ref_p.fu_plasma + h, bbb_scalar: ref_p.bbb_scalar,
        }
    }
    // idx == 7
    return PET2TCMParams {
        k1: ref_p.k1, k2: ref_p.k2, k3: ref_p.k3, k4: ref_p.k4,
        cp_amp: ref_p.cp_amp, cp_decay: ref_p.cp_decay,
        fu_plasma: ref_p.fu_plasma, bbb_scalar: ref_p.bbb_scalar + h,
    }
}

fn run_gum_pet(prior: EpPETPrior, t_end: f64, dt: f64) -> EpPETResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ref_p = PET2TCMParams {
        k1: prior.mean[0],
        k2: prior.mean[1],
        k3: prior.mean[2],
        k4: prior.mean[3],
        cp_amp: prior.mean[4],
        cp_decay: prior.mean[5],
        fu_plasma: prior.mean[6],
        bbb_scalar: prior.mean[7],
    }

    let ref_m = simulate_pet(ref_p, t_end, dt)

    if !ref_m.success {
        return EpPETResult {
            tac_auc_mean: 0.0, tac_auc_var: 0.0,
            tac_peak_mean: 0.0, tac_peak_var: 0.0,
            vt_mean: 0.0, vt_var: 0.0,
            bpnd_mean: 0.0, bpnd_var: 0.0,
            confidence: 0.0,
            sensitivity: [0.0; 8],
            d_vt: [0.0; 8],
            d_bpnd: [0.0; 8],
            success: false,
        }
    }

    var d_auc = [0.0; 8]
    var d_peak = [0.0; 8]
    var d_vt = [0.0; 8]
    var d_bpnd = [0.0; 8]
    var i = 0

    while i < 8 {
        let h = gum_finite_h(prior.mean[i], prior.variance[i])
        let pert_p = perturbed_params(ref_p, i, h)
        let pert_m = simulate_pet(pert_p, t_end, dt)

        if pert_m.success && h > 0.0 {
            d_auc[i] = (pert_m.tac_auc - ref_m.tac_auc) / h
            d_peak[i] = (pert_m.tac_peak - ref_m.tac_peak) / h
            d_vt[i] = (pert_m.vt - ref_m.vt) / h
            d_bpnd[i] = (pert_m.bpnd - ref_m.bpnd) / h
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    var var_auc = 0.0
    var var_peak = 0.0
    var var_vt = 0.0
    var var_bpnd = 0.0
    var total_vt_contrib = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < 8 {
        let v = prior.variance[i]
        var_auc = var_auc + d_auc[i] * d_auc[i] * v
        var_peak = var_peak + d_peak[i] * d_peak[i] * v
        var_vt = var_vt + d_vt[i] * d_vt[i] * v
        var_bpnd = var_bpnd + d_bpnd[i] * d_bpnd[i] * v
        total_vt_contrib = total_vt_contrib + d_vt[i] * d_vt[i] * v
        i = i + 1
    }

    var sens = [0.0; 8]
    if total_vt_contrib > 1.0e-12 {
        i = 0
        while i < 8 {
            sens[i] = (d_vt[i] * d_vt[i] * prior.variance[i]) / total_vt_contrib
            i = i + 1
        }
    }

    var conf = 0.0
    if total_vt_contrib > 1.0e-12 {
        i = 0
        while i < 8 {
            conf = conf + prior.confidence[i] * sens[i]
            i = i + 1
        }
    } else {
        conf = 0.5
    }

    EpPETResult {
        tac_auc_mean: ref_m.tac_auc,
        tac_auc_var: var_auc,
        tac_peak_mean: ref_m.tac_peak,
        tac_peak_var: var_peak,
        vt_mean: ref_m.vt,
        vt_var: var_vt,
        bpnd_mean: ref_m.bpnd,
        bpnd_var: var_bpnd,
        confidence: conf,
        sensitivity: sens,
        d_vt: d_vt,
        d_bpnd: d_bpnd,
        success: true,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN — AUDITED ACCEPTANCE TESTS
// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    println("======================================================================")
    println("  EXECUTABLE EPISTEMIC PET 2TCM — NRM 2026 (AUDITED, 8 PRIORS)")
    println("  Method: GUM finite-difference Jacobian (JCGM 100:2008 §5.1.3)")
    println("  PBPK coupling: fu_plasma, bbb_scalar")
    println("======================================================================")
    println("")

    // Priors: baseline mean fu_plasma=1.0 and bbb_scalar=1.0 preserve V_T=2.25.
    // Variance captures PBPK-informed epistemic uncertainty in plasma binding
    // and BBB transport (typical 10% CV for receptor tracers).
    let prior = EpPETPrior {
        mean: [0.15, 0.20, 0.10, 0.05, 1.00, 0.20, 1.00, 1.00],
        variance: [0.0004, 0.0009, 0.0004, 0.0001, 0.0025, 0.0004, 0.01, 0.01],
        confidence: [0.70, 0.70, 0.60, 0.60, 0.65, 0.65, 0.55, 0.50],
        n: 8,
    }

    let t_end = 60.0
    let dt = 0.05

    println("Synthetic epistemic priors (mean):")
    println("  K1        ="); println(prior.mean[0])
    println("  k2        ="); println(prior.mean[1])
    println("  k3        ="); println(prior.mean[2])
    println("  k4        ="); println(prior.mean[3])
    println("  cp_amp    ="); println(prior.mean[4])
    println("  cp_decay  ="); println(prior.mean[5])
    println("  fu_plasma ="); println(prior.mean[6])
    println("  bbb_scalar="); println(prior.mean[7])
    println("")

    println("AUDIT 1: Plasma input function Cp(t) = exp(-0.2*t)")
    println("  Cp(0)  (expected ~1.0000):");  println(cp_t(0.0, prior.mean[4], prior.mean[5]))
    println("  Cp(1)  (expected ~0.8187):");  println(cp_t(1.0, prior.mean[4], prior.mean[5]))
    println("  Cp(5)  (expected ~0.3679):");  println(cp_t(5.0, prior.mean[4], prior.mean[5]))
    println("  Cp(10) (expected ~0.1353):");  println(cp_t(10.0, prior.mean[4], prior.mean[5]))
    println("  Cp(60) (expected ~6.14e-6):"); println(cp_t(60.0, prior.mean[4], prior.mean[5]))
    println("")

    let result = run_gum_pet(prior, t_end, dt)

    if !result.success {
        println("SIMULATION FAILED")
        return 1
    }

    let auc_sd = sqrt_f64(result.tac_auc_var)
    let peak_sd = sqrt_f64(result.tac_peak_var)
    let vt_sd = sqrt_f64(result.vt_var)
    let bpnd_sd = sqrt_f64(result.bpnd_var)

    println("RESULTS (GUM-propagated, 8 priors):")
    println("  TAC AUC mean (expected ~9.47):");    println(result.tac_auc_mean)
    println("  TAC AUC SD:");                       println(auc_sd)
    println("  TAC Peak mean (expected ~0.31):");   println(result.tac_peak_mean)
    println("  TAC Peak SD:");                      println(peak_sd)
    println("  V_T mean (expected exact 2.25):");   println(result.vt_mean)
    println("  V_T SD (delta-method ~0.695):");     println(vt_sd)
    println("  BP_ND mean (expected exact 2.00):"); println(result.bpnd_mean)
    println("  BP_ND SD (delta-method ~0.566):");   println(bpnd_sd)
    println("  Evidence-weighted confidence:");     println(result.confidence)
    println("")

    // d(V_T)/d(fu) = K1*bbb*(1+k3/k4)/k2 = 0.15*1*3/0.2 = 2.25
    // d(V_T)/d(bbb) = K1*fu*(1+k3/k4)/k2 = 2.25
    // d(BP_ND)/d(fu) = 0  (structural insensitivity — scientific insight)
    // d(BP_ND)/d(bbb) = 0
    println("AUDIT 2: Finite-difference derivatives")
    println("  d(BP_ND)/d(k3)  fd (analytic = 20.0):");  println(result.d_bpnd[2])
    println("  d(BP_ND)/d(k4)  fd (analytic = -40.0):"); println(result.d_bpnd[3])
    println("  d(BP_ND)/d(fu)  fd (analytic = 0.0):");   println(result.d_bpnd[6])
    println("  d(BP_ND)/d(bbb) fd (analytic = 0.0):");   println(result.d_bpnd[7])
    println("  d(V_T)/d(K1)    fd (analytic = 15.0):");  println(result.d_vt[0])
    println("  d(V_T)/d(k2)    fd (analytic = -11.25):");println(result.d_vt[1])
    println("  d(V_T)/d(fu)    fd (analytic = 2.25):");  println(result.d_vt[6])
    println("  d(V_T)/d(bbb)   fd (analytic = 2.25):");  println(result.d_vt[7])
    println("")

    println("Normalized sensitivity fractions (to V_T):")
    println("  K1:");         println(result.sensitivity[0])
    println("  k2:");         println(result.sensitivity[1])
    println("  k3:");         println(result.sensitivity[2])
    println("  k4:");         println(result.sensitivity[3])
    println("  cp_amp:");     println(result.sensitivity[4])
    println("  cp_decay:");   println(result.sensitivity[5])
    println("  fu_plasma:");  println(result.sensitivity[6])
    println("  bbb_scalar:"); println(result.sensitivity[7])
    println("")

    // ACCEPTANCE TESTS
    println("ACCEPTANCE TESTS:")
    println("")
    var passed = 0
    var failed = 0

    if result.success { println("  [PASS] 1. Simulation completes"); passed = passed + 1 }
    else { println("  [FAIL] 1. Simulation"); failed = failed + 1 }

    if result.tac_auc_mean > 5.0 && result.tac_auc_mean < 20.0 {
        println("  [PASS] 2. TAC AUC in [5, 20]"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { println("  [FAIL] 2. TAC AUC out of range"); failed = failed + 1 }

    if result.tac_peak_mean > 0.05 && result.tac_peak_mean < 1.0 {
        println("  [PASS] 3. TAC Peak in [0.05, 1.0]"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { println("  [FAIL] 3. TAC Peak out of range"); failed = failed + 1 }

    if abs_f64(result.vt_mean - 2.25) < 0.01 {
        println("  [PASS] 4. V_T = 2.25 analytic"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { println("  [FAIL] 4. V_T deviates"); failed = failed + 1 }

    if abs_f64(result.bpnd_mean - 2.00) < 0.01 {
        println("  [PASS] 5. BP_ND = 2.00 analytic"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { println("  [FAIL] 5. BP_ND deviates"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // BP_ND variance analytic: 20²*0.0004 + 40²*0.0001 = 0.32; fu/bbb contribute 0
    if result.bpnd_var > 0.20 && result.bpnd_var < 0.50 {
        println("  [PASS] 6. BP_ND variance ~0.32 (delta-method)"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { println("  [FAIL] 6. BP_ND variance off"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // V_T variance analytic: kinetic part ~0.382 + PBPK part 2.25²*0.02 ~0.1 = ~0.48
    if result.vt_var > 0.25 && result.vt_var < 0.80 {
        println("  [PASS] 7. V_T variance in [0.25, 0.80] (delta-method)"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { println("  [FAIL] 7. V_T variance off"); failed = failed + 1 }

    if abs_f64(result.d_bpnd[2] - 20.0) < 1.0 {
        println("  [PASS] 8. d(BP_ND)/dk3 matches analytic 20"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { println("  [FAIL] 8. d(BP_ND)/dk3 off"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // Structural insensitivity: fu and bbb should NOT affect BP_ND
    if abs_f64(result.d_bpnd[6]) < 1.0e-6 && abs_f64(result.d_bpnd[7]) < 1.0e-6 {
        println("  [PASS] 9. Structural insensitivity: BP_ND independent of fu, bbb"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { println("  [FAIL] 9. BP_ND unexpectedly depends on fu or bbb"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // Halving k4 increases BP_ND
    let p_low_k4 = PET2TCMParams {
        k1: prior.mean[0], k2: prior.mean[1], k3: prior.mean[2],
        k4: prior.mean[3] * 0.5,
        cp_amp: prior.mean[4], cp_decay: prior.mean[5],
        fu_plasma: prior.mean[6], bbb_scalar: prior.mean[7],
    }
    let m_low = simulate_pet(p_low_k4, t_end, dt)
    if m_low.success && m_low.bpnd > result.bpnd_mean {
        println("  [PASS] 10. Halving k4 increases BP_ND"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { println("  [FAIL] 10. Monotonicity test"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // Sensitivity fractions sum ~1
    var sum_s = 0.0
    var j = 0
    while j < 8 { sum_s = sum_s + result.sensitivity[j]; j = j + 1 }
    println("  Sensitivity fractions sum:"); println(sum_s)
    if sum_s > 0.95 && sum_s < 1.05 {
        println("  [PASS] 11. Sensitivity fractions sum ~1.0"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { println("  [FAIL] 11. Sensitivity normalization off"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // d(V_T)/d(fu) ~ 2.25 (PBPK coupling is real and quantified)
    if abs_f64(result.d_vt[6] - 2.25) < 0.1 {
        println("  [PASS] 12. d(V_T)/d(fu_plasma) matches analytic 2.25"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { println("  [FAIL] 12. PBPK coupling derivative off"); failed = failed + 1 }

    println("")
    println("======================================================================")
    println("  TEST SUMMARY")
    println("======================================================================")
    println("  Passed:"); println(passed)
    println("  Failed:"); println(failed)
    println("")

    if failed == 0 {
        println("  ALL NUMERICAL AUDITS PASSED (12/12)")
        println("")
        println("  GUM-propagated V_T and BP_ND agree with analytic delta-method.")
        println("  Structural insensitivity of BP_ND to fu_plasma / bbb_scalar is")
        println("  correctly recovered — a scientifically meaningful result that")
        println("  separates kinetic-binding uncertainty from PBPK input uncertainty.")
        return 0
    } else {
        println("  AUDIT FAILURES — not publication-ready.")
        return 1
    }
}


// === FILE: examples/neuroreceptor_pet/pet_2tcm_export.sio ===
// examples/neuroreceptor_pet/pet_2tcm_export.sio
//
// CSV export companion to pet_2tcm_epistemic.sio.
//
// Prints ONLY a CSV stream to stdout:
//   t,Cp,C1,C2,CT
//
// Intended usage:
//   $SOUC_BIN run examples/neuroreceptor_pet/pet_2tcm_export.sio \
//       > examples/neuroreceptor_pet/results/tac_curve.csv
//
// Uses the same priors and RK4 integrator as the main audit example.
// Deterministic and reproducible.

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn exp_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    if x < 0.0 { return 1.0 / exp_f64(0.0 - x) }
    if x > 0.5 {
        let half = exp_f64(x * 0.5)
        return half * half
    }
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 20 {
        let di = i as f64
        term = term * x / di
        sum = sum + term
        i = i + 1
    }
    return sum
}

struct P {
    k1: f64, k2: f64, k3: f64, k4: f64,
    cp_amp: f64, cp_decay: f64,
    fu: f64, bbb: f64,
}

struct S { c1: f64, c2: f64 }

fn cp_of(t: f64, amp: f64, decay: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    if t < 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    return amp * exp_f64(0.0 - decay * t)
}

fn rk4(st: S, t: f64, dt: f64, p: P) -> S with Mut, Div {
    let k1e = p.k1 * p.fu * p.bbb

    let cp0 = cp_of(t, p.cp_amp, p.cp_decay)
    let a1 = dt * (k1e * cp0 - (p.k2 + p.k3) * st.c1 + p.k4 * st.c2)
    let b1 = dt * (p.k3 * st.c1 - p.k4 * st.c2)

    let c1m = st.c1 + 0.5 * a1
    let c2m = st.c2 + 0.5 * b1
    let cpm = cp_of(t + 0.5 * dt, p.cp_amp, p.cp_decay)
    let a2 = dt * (k1e * cpm - (p.k2 + p.k3) * c1m + p.k4 * c2m)
    let b2 = dt * (p.k3 * c1m - p.k4 * c2m)

    let c1n = st.c1 + 0.5 * a2
    let c2n = st.c2 + 0.5 * b2
    let a3 = dt * (k1e * cpm - (p.k2 + p.k3) * c1n + p.k4 * c2n)
    let b3 = dt * (p.k3 * c1n - p.k4 * c2n)

    let c1o = st.c1 + a3
    let c2o = st.c2 + b3
    let cpe = cp_of(t + dt, p.cp_amp, p.cp_decay)
    let a4 = dt * (k1e * cpe - (p.k2 + p.k3) * c1o + p.k4 * c2o)
    let b4 = dt * (p.k3 * c1o - p.k4 * c2o)

    S {
        c1: st.c1 + (a1 + 2.0 * a2 + 2.0 * a3 + a4) / 6.0,
        c2: st.c2 + (b1 + 2.0 * b2 + 2.0 * b3 + b4) / 6.0,
    }
}

fn main() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let p = P {
        k1: 0.15, k2: 0.20, k3: 0.10, k4: 0.05,
        cp_amp: 1.00, cp_decay: 0.20,
        fu: 1.00, bbb: 1.00,
    }
    let t_end = 60.0
    let dt = 0.05
    // Sample every 20 steps = once per 1.0 min for a compact CSV
    let sample_every = 20

    // CSV header
    print("t,Cp,C1,C2,CT")
    println("")

    var st = S { c1: 0.0, c2: 0.0 }
    var t = 0.0
    var n = 0

    // Emit initial sample
    print("0.00,")
    print(cp_of(0.0, p.cp_amp, p.cp_decay))
    print(",0.000000,0.000000,0.000000")
    println("")

    while t < t_end && n < 5000 {
        st = rk4(st, t, dt, p)
        t = t + dt
        n = n + 1

        if n - (n / sample_every) * sample_every == 0 {
            let cp_val = cp_of(t, p.cp_amp, p.cp_decay)
            let ct = st.c1 + st.c2
            print(t)
            print(",")
            print(cp_val)
            print(",")
            print(st.c1)
            print(",")
            print(st.c2)
            print(",")
            print(ct)
            println("")
        }
    }
}


// === FILE: examples/neuroreceptor_pet/pet_fit_montecarlo.sio ===
// examples/neuroreceptor_pet/pet_fit_montecarlo.sio
//
// Monte Carlo parameter-recovery demonstration for PET 2TCM.
//
// SCOPE (proof-of-concept only):
//   - Generate N independent noisy TACs from the same synthetic ground truth.
//   - Fit each with a simple coordinate-descent search over a 9-point
//     multiplicative grid per parameter.
//   - Report mean and SD of recovered parameters across realisations.
//   - The mean characterises bias, the SD characterises precision for
//     this specific optimiser + noise model.
//
// LIMITATIONS:
//   - The optimiser is a limited coordinate-descent on a discrete
//     multiplier grid; it is NOT a production Levenberg-Marquardt fitter
//     and can plateau at non-global minima. Reported bias on individual
//     k3, k4 reflects that optimiser, not a fundamental identifiability
//     limit.
//   - All noise is LCG + Irwin-Hall (sum of 12 uniforms - 6): an
//     approximate Gaussian, reproducible by seed.
//   - Not a test-retest reproducibility claim; not a clinical fit.
//
// Observation (consistent with, not a reproduction of, the general PET
// finding that macroscopic kinetic combinations tend to be more stable
// than individual rate constants; see Lammertsma 1996 for a specific
// report of 19-77 % standard errors on direct method-A BP estimates):
//   - V_T and BP_ND recovered with lower CV than individual k3, k4
//     across our 20 realisations.

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x } ; return x }

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var g = x
    if g < 1.0 { g = 1.0 }
    var i = 0
    while i < 40 { g = 0.5 * (g + x / g); i = i + 1 }
    return g
}

fn exp_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    if x < 0.0 { return 1.0 / exp_f64(0.0 - x) }
    if x > 0.5 {
        let half = exp_f64(x * 0.5)
        return half * half
    }
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 20 {
        let di = i as f64
        term = term * x / di
        sum = sum + term
        i = i + 1
    }
    return sum
}

// --- LCG + uniform ---
struct Rng { state: i64 }
fn rng_next(r: Rng) -> Rng {
    Rng { state: r.state * 6364136223846793005 + 1442695040888963407 }
}
fn rng_uniform(r: Rng) -> f64 {
    let v = r.state
    let bits = (v / 2048) - ((v / 2048) / 4503599627370496) * 4503599627370496
    let bits2 = if bits < 0 { bits + 4503599627370496 } else { bits }
    return (bits2 as f64) / 4503599627370496.0
}

// --- 2TCM ---
struct P { k1: f64, k2: f64, k3: f64, k4: f64, cp_amp: f64, cp_decay: f64 }
struct S { c1: f64, c2: f64 }

fn cp_of(t: f64, amp: f64, decay: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    if t < 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    return amp * exp_f64(0.0 - decay * t)
}

fn rk4(st: S, t: f64, dt: f64, p: P) -> S with Mut, Div {
    let cp0 = cp_of(t, p.cp_amp, p.cp_decay)
    let a1 = dt * (p.k1 * cp0 - (p.k2 + p.k3) * st.c1 + p.k4 * st.c2)
    let b1 = dt * (p.k3 * st.c1 - p.k4 * st.c2)
    let c1m = st.c1 + 0.5 * a1
    let c2m = st.c2 + 0.5 * b1
    let cpm = cp_of(t + 0.5 * dt, p.cp_amp, p.cp_decay)
    let a2 = dt * (p.k1 * cpm - (p.k2 + p.k3) * c1m + p.k4 * c2m)
    let b2 = dt * (p.k3 * c1m - p.k4 * c2m)
    let c1n = st.c1 + 0.5 * a2
    let c2n = st.c2 + 0.5 * b2
    let a3 = dt * (p.k1 * cpm - (p.k2 + p.k3) * c1n + p.k4 * c2n)
    let b3 = dt * (p.k3 * c1n - p.k4 * c2n)
    let c1o = st.c1 + a3
    let c2o = st.c2 + b3
    let cpe = cp_of(t + dt, p.cp_amp, p.cp_decay)
    let a4 = dt * (p.k1 * cpe - (p.k2 + p.k3) * c1o + p.k4 * c2o)
    let b4 = dt * (p.k3 * c1o - p.k4 * c2o)
    S {
        c1: st.c1 + (a1 + 2.0 * a2 + 2.0 * a3 + a4) / 6.0,
        c2: st.c2 + (b1 + 2.0 * b2 + 2.0 * b3 + b4) / 6.0,
    }
}

fn simulate_tac(p: P, obs: &![f64; 80]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let t_end = 60.0
    let dt = 0.05
    var st = S { c1: 0.0, c2: 0.0 }
    var t = 0.0
    var n = 0
    var ck = 1
    (*obs)[0] = 0.0
    let n_obs = 60
    while t < t_end && n < 5000 {
        st = rk4(st, t, dt, p)
        t = t + dt
        n = n + 1
        while ck <= n_obs {
            if t >= (ck as f64) - 1.0e-9 {
                (*obs)[ck as usize] = st.c1 + st.c2
                ck = ck + 1
            } else { break }
        }
    }
}

fn chi2(pred: [f64; 80], obs: [f64; 80], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut {
    var s = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let d = pred[i as usize] - obs[i as usize]
        s = s + d * d
        i = i + 1
    }
    return s
}

fn eval_at(k1: f64, k2: f64, k3: f64, k4: f64, obs: [f64; 80], n: i32,
           cp_amp: f64, cp_decay: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let p = P { k1: k1, k2: k2, k3: k3, k4: k4, cp_amp: cp_amp, cp_decay: cp_decay }
    var pred = [0.0; 80]
    simulate_tac(p, &!pred)
    return chi2(pred, obs, n + 1)
}

struct Fit { k1: f64, k2: f64, k3: f64, k4: f64, conv: bool }

fn fit_2tcm(k1_0: f64, k2_0: f64, k3_0: f64, k4_0: f64,
            obs: [f64; 80], n: i32,
            cp_amp: f64, cp_decay: f64) -> Fit with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var k1 = k1_0
    var k2 = k2_0
    var k3 = k3_0
    var k4 = k4_0
    var c = eval_at(k1, k2, k3, k4, obs, n, cp_amp, cp_decay)
    var iter = 0
    var conv = false
    let mults = [0.80, 0.90, 0.95, 0.98, 1.0, 1.02, 1.05, 1.10, 1.20]
    while iter < 30 {
        let cprev = c
        var m = 0
        while m < 9 {
            let tr = k1 * mults[m as usize]
            let nc = eval_at(tr, k2, k3, k4, obs, n, cp_amp, cp_decay)
            if nc < c { c = nc; k1 = tr }
            m = m + 1
        }
        m = 0
        while m < 9 {
            let tr = k2 * mults[m as usize]
            let nc = eval_at(k1, tr, k3, k4, obs, n, cp_amp, cp_decay)
            if nc < c { c = nc; k2 = tr }
            m = m + 1
        }
        m = 0
        while m < 9 {
            let tr = k3 * mults[m as usize]
            let nc = eval_at(k1, k2, tr, k4, obs, n, cp_amp, cp_decay)
            if nc < c { c = nc; k3 = tr }
            m = m + 1
        }
        m = 0
        while m < 9 {
            let tr = k4 * mults[m as usize]
            let nc = eval_at(k1, k2, k3, tr, obs, n, cp_amp, cp_decay)
            if nc < c { c = nc; k4 = tr }
            m = m + 1
        }
        iter = iter + 1
        let imp = if cprev > 1.0e-12 { (cprev - c) / cprev } else { 0.0 }
        if imp < 1.0e-5 { conv = true; break }
    }
    Fit { k1: k1, k2: k2, k3: k3, k4: k4, conv: conv }
}

struct Stat2 { mean: f64, sd: f64 }

fn stats_of(vals: [f64; 32], n: i32) -> Stat2 with Mut, Div {
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n { sum = sum + vals[i as usize]; i = i + 1 }
    let mean = sum / (n as f64)
