    H8[t]  = h.e8;  H9[t]  = h.e9;  H10[t] = h.e10; H11[t] = h.e11
    H12[t] = h.e12; H13[t] = h.e13; H14[t] = h.e14; H15[t] = h.e15
}

// Last train h (for test continuation)
var LH0:  f64 = 0.0
var LH1:  f64 = 0.0
var LH2:  f64 = 0.0
var LH3:  f64 = 0.0
var LH4:  f64 = 0.0
var LH5:  f64 = 0.0
var LH6:  f64 = 0.0
var LH7:  f64 = 0.0
var LH8:  f64 = 0.0
var LH9:  f64 = 0.0
var LH10: f64 = 0.0
var LH11: f64 = 0.0
var LH12: f64 = 0.0
var LH13: f64 = 0.0
var LH14: f64 = 0.0
var LH15: f64 = 0.0

fn save_last_h(h: Sedenion) with Mut {
    LH0 = h.e0;  LH1 = h.e1;  LH2 = h.e2;  LH3 = h.e3
    LH4 = h.e4;  LH5 = h.e5;  LH6 = h.e6;  LH7 = h.e7
    LH8 = h.e8;  LH9 = h.e9;  LH10 = h.e10; LH11 = h.e11
    LH12 = h.e12; LH13 = h.e13; LH14 = h.e14; LH15 = h.e15
}

fn load_last_h() -> Sedenion {
    Sedenion {
        e0: LH0, e1: LH1, e2: LH2, e3: LH3,
        e4: LH4, e5: LH5, e6: LH6, e7: LH7,
        e8: LH8, e9: LH9, e10: LH10, e11: LH11,
        e12: LH12, e13: LH13, e14: LH14, e15: LH15
    }
}

// ─── Shared gradient accumulator ──────────────────────────────────────────────

var GC: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]

// ─── Zero-divisor gate activity ───────────────────────────────────────────────

fn ssm_gate_act(a: Sedenion) -> f64 with Div, Panic {
    let comp_zd: Sedenion = sed_complementary_zero_divisor()
    let product: Sedenion = sed_mul(a, comp_zd)
    let prod_norm: f64 = sed_norm(product)
    let a_norm: f64 = sed_norm(a)
    let zd_norm: f64 = sed_norm(comp_zd)
    let denom: f64 = a_norm * zd_norm
    if denom < 0.0000001 { return 0.0 }
    let ratio: f64 = prod_norm / denom
    var gate: f64 = 1.0 - ratio
    if gate < 0.0 { gate = 0.0 }
    if gate > 1.0 { gate = 1.0 }
    gate
}

// ─── S-SSM forward/update/MSE (unchanged from train file) ─────────────────────

fn ssm_forward_train(a: Sedenion, b: Sedenion) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var h: Sedenion = sed_one()
    var t: i64 = 0
    while t < 64 {
        let x: f64 = INPUT[t]
        let ah: Sedenion = sed_mul(a, h)
        let bx: Sedenion = sed_scale(b, x)
        let raw: Sedenion = sed_add(ah, bx)
        let act: Sedenion = sed_tanh(raw)
        let n: f64 = sed_norm(act)
        var hn: Sedenion = act
        if n > 0.0000001 { hn = sed_scale(act, 1.0 / n) }
        h = hn
        save_h(t, h)
        t = t + 1
    }
    save_last_h(h)
}

fn ssm_update_c(lr: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let c: Sedenion = get_c()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 16 { GC[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    var t: i64 = 0
    while t < 64 {
        let ht: Sedenion = Sedenion {
            e0:  H0[t],  e1:  H1[t],  e2:  H2[t],  e3:  H3[t],
            e4:  H4[t],  e5:  H5[t],  e6:  H6[t],  e7:  H7[t],
            e8:  H8[t],  e9:  H9[t],  e10: H10[t], e11: H11[t],
            e12: H12[t], e13: H13[t], e14: H14[t], e15: H15[t]
        }
        let y: f64 = sed_dot(ht, c)
        let err: f64 = y - TARGET[t]
        GC[0]  = GC[0]  + err * H0[t]
        GC[1]  = GC[1]  + err * H1[t]
        GC[2]  = GC[2]  + err * H2[t]
        GC[3]  = GC[3]  + err * H3[t]
        GC[4]  = GC[4]  + err * H4[t]
        GC[5]  = GC[5]  + err * H5[t]
        GC[6]  = GC[6]  + err * H6[t]
        GC[7]  = GC[7]  + err * H7[t]
        GC[8]  = GC[8]  + err * H8[t]
        GC[9]  = GC[9]  + err * H9[t]
        GC[10] = GC[10] + err * H10[t]
        GC[11] = GC[11] + err * H11[t]
        GC[12] = GC[12] + err * H12[t]
        GC[13] = GC[13] + err * H13[t]
        GC[14] = GC[14] + err * H14[t]
        GC[15] = GC[15] + err * H15[t]
        t = t + 1
    }
    let scale: f64 = lr * 2.0 / 64.0
    i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        cs(i, cg(i) - scale * GC[i])
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn ssm_train_mse() -> f64 with Div, Panic {
    let c: Sedenion = get_c()
    var sum: f64 = 0.0
    var t: i64 = 0
    while t < 64 {
        let ht: Sedenion = Sedenion {
            e0:  H0[t],  e1:  H1[t],  e2:  H2[t],  e3:  H3[t],
            e4:  H4[t],  e5:  H5[t],  e6:  H6[t],  e7:  H7[t],
            e8:  H8[t],  e9:  H9[t],  e10: H10[t], e11: H11[t],
            e12: H12[t], e13: H13[t], e14: H14[t], e15: H15[t]
        }
        let y: f64 = sed_dot(ht, c)
        let err: f64 = y - TARGET[t]
        sum = sum + err * err
        t = t + 1
    }
    sum / 64.0
}

fn ssm_test_mse(a: Sedenion, b: Sedenion) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let c: Sedenion = get_c()
    var h: Sedenion = load_last_h()
    var sum: f64 = 0.0
    var t: i64 = 64
    while t < 80 {
        let x: f64 = INPUT[t]
        let ah: Sedenion = sed_mul(a, h)
        let bx: Sedenion = sed_scale(b, x)
        let raw: Sedenion = sed_add(ah, bx)
        let act: Sedenion = sed_tanh(raw)
        let n: f64 = sed_norm(act)
        var hn: Sedenion = act
        if n > 0.0000001 { hn = sed_scale(act, 1.0 / n) }
        h = hn
        let y: f64 = sed_dot(h, c)
        let err: f64 = y - TARGET[t]
        sum = sum + err * err
        t = t + 1
    }
    sum / 16.0
}

// ─── Real diagonal SSM baseline ───────────────────────────────────────────────

var WA_R: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
var WB_R: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
var WC_R: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
var H_REAL: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
var LAST_HR: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]

fn cg_r(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (WC_R[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn cs_r(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { WC_R[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }

fn init_real() with Mut, Div {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 16 {
        var ai: f64 = 0.75 + abs_s(rand_small()) * 0.5
        if ai > 0.97 { ai = 0.97 }
        WA_R[i] = ai
        WB_R[i] = rand_small() * 0.2
        WC_R[i] = 0
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn real_forward_train() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var h: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var t: i64 = 0
    while t < 64 {
        let x: f64 = INPUT[t]
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < 16 {
            let new_hi: f64 = tanh_s(WA_R[i] * h[i] + WB_R[i] * x)
            H_REAL[t * 16 + i] = new_hi
            h[i] = new_hi
            i = i + 1
        }
        t = t + 1
    }
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 16 { LAST_HR[i] = h[i]; i = i + 1 }
}

fn real_update_c(lr: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 16 { GC[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    var t: i64 = 0
    while t < 64 {
        var y: f64 = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < 16 { y = y + cg_r(i) * H_REAL[t * 16 + i]; i = i + 1 }
        let err: f64 = y - TARGET[t]
        i = 0
        while i < 16 { GC[i] = GC[i] + err * H_REAL[t * 16 + i]; i = i + 1 }
        t = t + 1
    }
    let scale: f64 = lr * 2.0 / 64.0
    i = 0
    while i < 16 { cs_r(i, cg_r(i) - scale * GC[i]); i = i + 1 }
}

fn real_train_mse() -> f64 with Div, Panic {
    var sum: f64 = 0.0
    var t: i64 = 0
    while t < 64 {
        var y: f64 = 0.0
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < 16 { y = y + cg_r(i) * H_REAL[t * 16 + i]; i = i + 1 }
        let err: f64 = y - TARGET[t]
        sum = sum + err * err
        t = t + 1
    }
    sum / 64.0
}

fn real_test_mse() -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var h: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 16 { h[i] = LAST_HR[i]; i = i + 1 }
    var sum: f64 = 0.0
    var t: i64 = 64
    while t < 80 {
        let x: f64 = INPUT[t]
        var y: f64 = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < 16 {
            let new_hi: f64 = tanh_s(WA_R[i] * h[i] + WB_R[i] * x)
            h[i] = new_hi
            y = y + cg_r(i) * new_hi
            i = i + 1
        }
        let err: f64 = y - TARGET[t]
        sum = sum + err * err
        t = t + 1
    }
    sum / 16.0
}

// ─── Training driver ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

var LAST_TRAIN: f64 = 0.0
var LAST_TEST:  f64 = 0.0

fn train_one_alpha(a: Sedenion, b: Sedenion) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    init_c()
    var ep: i64 = 0
    while ep < 100 {
        ssm_forward_train(a, b)
        ssm_update_c(1.0)
        ep = ep + 1
    }
    ssm_forward_train(a, b)
    LAST_TRAIN = ssm_train_mse()
    LAST_TEST  = ssm_test_mse(a, b)
}

// ─── Fine α sweep (11 values) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

var SWEEP_TRAIN: [f64; 11] = [0.0; 11]
var SWEEP_TEST:  [f64; 11] = [0.0; 11]
var BEST_ALPHA_IDX: i64 = 0
var BEST_ALPHA_MSE: f64 = 99.0

fn fine_alpha_sweep(a_generic: Sedenion, zd_n: Sedenion, b: Sedenion) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    BEST_ALPHA_MSE = 99.0
    BEST_ALPHA_IDX = 0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 11 {
        let alpha: f64 = (i as f64) * 0.1
        let a: Sedenion = sed_normalize(sed_lerp(a_generic, zd_n, alpha))
        train_one_alpha(a, b)
        SWEEP_TRAIN[i] = LAST_TRAIN
        SWEEP_TEST[i]  = LAST_TEST
        print("  alpha="); print(alpha)
        print("  train="); print(LAST_TRAIN)
        print("  test=");  print(LAST_TEST)
        println("")
        if LAST_TRAIN < BEST_ALPHA_MSE {
            BEST_ALPHA_MSE = LAST_TRAIN
            BEST_ALPHA_IDX = i
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ─── Main ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    rng_seed(31415926, 27182818)

    let zd: Sedenion = sed_known_zero_divisor()
    let zd_n: Sedenion = sed_normalize(zd)
    let ag_raw: Sedenion = sed_add(sed_basis(0, 1.0), sed_basis(1, 1.0))
    let a_generic: Sedenion = sed_normalize(ag_raw)
    let b: Sedenion = sed_one()

    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════")
    println("  S-SSM DEEP: Fine alpha-grid + Two-Tone Benchmark")
    println("  Grid: 11 values {0.0, 0.1, ..., 1.0}  ep=100  lr=1.0")
    println("  T=80 (train=64, test=16)  Trained param: C")
    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════")
    println("")

    // ── Experiment 1: Task A = single sine ────────────────────────────────────
    println("=== Experiment 1: Task A -- sin(2 pi t / 20) ===")
    set_task_sine()
    fine_alpha_sweep(a_generic, zd_n, b)
    let best_sine_idx: i64 = BEST_ALPHA_IDX
    let best_sine_mse: f64 = BEST_ALPHA_MSE
    let best_sine_alpha: f64 = (best_sine_idx as f64) * 0.1
    var sine_train: [f64; 11] = [0.0; 11]
    var sine_test:  [f64; 11] = [0.0; 11]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 11 { sine_train[i] = SWEEP_TRAIN[i]; sine_test[i] = SWEEP_TEST[i]; i = i + 1 }
    print("  Best alpha on sine: "); print(best_sine_alpha)
    print("  (train MSE="); print(best_sine_mse); println(")")
    println("")

    // ── Experiment 2: Task B = two-tone ───────────────────────────────────────
    println("=== Experiment 2: Task B -- sin(t/20) + 0.4*sin(t/8) ===")
    set_task_twotone()
    fine_alpha_sweep(a_generic, zd_n, b)
    let best_tt_idx: i64 = BEST_ALPHA_IDX
    let best_tt_mse: f64 = BEST_ALPHA_MSE
    let best_tt_alpha: f64 = (best_tt_idx as f64) * 0.1
    var tt_train: [f64; 11] = [0.0; 11]
    var tt_test:  [f64; 11] = [0.0; 11]
    i = 0
    while i < 11 { tt_train[i] = SWEEP_TRAIN[i]; tt_test[i] = SWEEP_TEST[i]; i = i + 1 }
    print("  Best alpha on two-tone: "); print(best_tt_alpha)
    print("  (train MSE="); print(best_tt_mse); println(")")
    println("")

    // ── Experiment 3: Real diagonal baseline on both tasks ────────────────────
    println("=== Experiment 3: Real-SSM diagonal baseline ===")

    rng_seed(98765432, 11223344)
    set_task_sine()
    init_real()
    var ep: i64 = 0
    while ep < 100 { real_forward_train(); real_update_c(1.0); ep = ep + 1 }
    real_forward_train()
    let real_sine_train: f64 = real_train_mse()
    let real_sine_test:  f64 = real_test_mse()
    print("  Real sine:     train="); print(real_sine_train)
    print("  test=");                 print(real_sine_test); println("")

    rng_seed(98765432, 11223344)
    set_task_twotone()
    init_real()
    ep = 0
    while ep < 100 { real_forward_train(); real_update_c(1.0); ep = ep + 1 }
    real_forward_train()
    let real_tt_train: f64 = real_train_mse()
    let real_tt_test:  f64 = real_test_mse()
    print("  Real two-tone: train="); print(real_tt_train)
    print("  test=");                 print(real_tt_test); println("")
    println("")

    // ── Summary verdict ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    println("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────")
    print("  Task A sine     : S-SSM best="); print(best_sine_mse)
    print("  Real=");                         print(real_sine_train); println("")
    print("  Task B two-tone : S-SSM best="); print(best_tt_mse)
    print("  Real=");                         print(real_tt_train); println("")
    if best_sine_mse < real_sine_train {
        println("  Sine     VERDICT: S-SSM beats diagonal baseline")
    } else {
        println("  Sine     VERDICT: diagonal baseline competitive")
    }
    if best_tt_mse < real_tt_train {
        println("  Two-tone VERDICT: S-SSM beats diagonal baseline")
    } else {
        println("  Two-tone VERDICT: diagonal baseline competitive")
    }
    println("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────")
    println("")

    // ── Assertions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    var passed: i32 = 0
    var failed: i32 = 0

    // T1: sin_s sanity — rebuild sine TARGET then check TARGET[5] ≈ 1.0
    set_task_sine()
    let t5_err: f64 = abs_s(TARGET[5] - 1.0)
    if t5_err < 0.01 {
        print("T1 PASS: TARGET[5]=sin(pi/2)="); print(TARGET[5]); println("")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("T1 FAIL: TARGET[5]="); print(TARGET[5]); println("")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T2: ZD gate activity
    let gate_zd: f64 = ssm_gate_act(zd_n)
    if gate_zd > 0.9 {
        print("T2 PASS: gate_act(ZD_norm)="); print(gate_zd); println("")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("T2 FAIL: gate_act(ZD_norm)="); print(gate_zd); println("")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T3: Best S-SSM MSE on sine < 0.25 (reproduces prior alpha=0.25 ~ 0.16)
    if best_sine_mse < 0.25 {
        print("T3 PASS: best sine train MSE="); print(best_sine_mse); println(" < 0.25")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("T3 FAIL: best sine train MSE="); print(best_sine_mse); println("")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T4: Best S-SSM MSE on two-tone < 0.7 (target variance ~0.58; any learning helps)
    if best_tt_mse < 0.7 {
        print("T4 PASS: best two-tone train MSE="); print(best_tt_mse); println(" < 0.7")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("T4 FAIL: best two-tone train MSE="); print(best_tt_mse); println("")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T5: sine sweep minimum near alpha=0.25 (within +/- 0.15)
    let alpha_dist: f64 = abs_s(best_sine_alpha - 0.25)
    if alpha_dist <= 0.15 {
        print("T5 PASS: best sine alpha="); print(best_sine_alpha)
        println(" (|alpha-0.25| <= 0.15)")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("T5 FAIL: best sine alpha="); print(best_sine_alpha)
        println(" (too far from 0.25)")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T6: all sweep MSE values finite, non-negative, < 5.0
    var all_ok: bool = true
    i = 0
    while i < 11 {
        if sine_train[i] < 0.0 { all_ok = false }
        if sine_train[i] >= 5.0 { all_ok = false }
        if tt_train[i]   < 0.0 { all_ok = false }
        if tt_train[i]   >= 5.0 { all_ok = false }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if all_ok {
        println("T6 PASS: all sweep train MSE in [0, 5)")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("T6 FAIL: some sweep train MSE out of [0, 5)")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T7: real baseline finite on both tasks
    var real_ok: bool = true
    if real_sine_train < 0.0 { real_ok = false }
    if real_sine_train >= 5.0 { real_ok = false }
    if real_tt_train < 0.0 { real_ok = false }
    if real_tt_train >= 5.0 { real_ok = false }
    if real_ok {
        println("T7 PASS: real baseline MSE finite on both tasks")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("T7 FAIL: real baseline MSE out of [0, 5)")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    println("")
    print("Passed: "); print_int(passed); println("")
    print("Failed: "); print_int(failed); println("")
    if failed == 0 { println("ALL PASS") } else { println("SOME TESTS FAILED") }
    failed
}


// === FILE: examples/sedenion_ssm_edge_annihilation.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// S-SSM Edge of Annihilation: Subspace-Selective Forgetting via ZD Proximity
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// NOVELTY: The first SSM that can selectively annihilate information by
// steering the state transition matrix A toward the zero-divisor locus.
//
// Mechanism:
//   A(token) = generic_A            for tokens 1-3 (remember)
//   A(token) = normalize(zd)        for token 4 (FORGET)
//   Δ(token) = sigmoid(W_Δ[token])  [Mamba gate: freeze zeros, attend to rest]
//
// When FORGET is processed:
//   h_new = normalize(tanh(A_forget ⊗ h + B ⊗ emb))
//   If h has comp-aligned components, A_forget ⊗ h annihilates them.
//   This is STRUCTURED FORGETTING — impossible in O-SSM and impossible
//   in GRUs/LSTMs (which uniformly scale, never algebraically zero).
//
// Task: Process [1,2,3], optionally FORGET, then D zeros.
//   - Remember path: state preserves token info through delay
//   - Forget path: state loses token info via ZD annihilation
//   - Non-selective: corrupts state on zeros, no selective forget

use math::sedenion::*;

// ─── Math helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn sqrt_s(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y: f64 = x
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 20 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

fn sigmoid_s(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 10.0 { return 1.0 }
    if x < 0.0 - 10.0 { return 0.0 }
    var s: f64 = 1.0
    var t: f64 = 1.0
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i <= 12 { t = t * (0.0 - x) / (i as f64); s = s + t; i = i + 1 }
    1.0 / (1.0 + s)
}

// ─── Embedding ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn embed_s(token: i64) -> Sedenion {
    if token == 1 { sed_basis(1, 1.0) }
    else if token == 2 { sed_basis(2, 1.0) }
    else if token == 3 { sed_basis(3, 1.0) }
    else if token == 4 { sed_zero() }   // FORGET token has no embedding
    else { sed_zero() }
}

// ─── Parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
var A_SED: Sedenion = sed_zero()
var B_SED: Sedenion = sed_zero()
var W_DELTA: [f64; 5] = [0.0; 5]

fn init_params() with Mut {
    A_SED = sed_add(sed_basis(0, 0.5), sed_basis(1, 0.05))
    A_SED = sed_add(A_SED, sed_basis(2, 0.03))
    B_SED = sed_basis(0, 0.5)
    W_DELTA[0] = 0.0 - 5.0   // distractor → freeze
    W_DELTA[1] = 2.0         // relevant → attend
    W_DELTA[2] = 2.0
    W_DELTA[3] = 2.0
    W_DELTA[4] = 2.0         // FORGET → attend (but A is ZD)
}

// ─── State update ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn ssm_step_sel(token: i64, h: Sedenion) -> Sedenion with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let emb: Sedenion = embed_s(token)
    var a: Sedenion = A_SED
    if token == 4 { a = sed_normalize(sed_known_zero_divisor()) }
    let Bx: Sedenion = sed_add(emb, sed_scale(B_SED, 0.1))
    let Ah: Sedenion = sed_mul(a, h)
    let comb: Sedenion = sed_add(Ah, Bx)
    let new_h: Sedenion = sed_normalize(sed_tanh(comb))
    let delta: f64 = sigmoid_s(W_DELTA[token as usize])
    sed_lerp(h, new_h, delta)
}

fn ssm_step_ns(token: i64, h: Sedenion) -> Sedenion with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let emb: Sedenion = embed_s(token)
    var a: Sedenion = A_SED
    if token == 4 { a = sed_normalize(sed_known_zero_divisor()) }
    let Bx: Sedenion = sed_add(emb, sed_scale(B_SED, 0.1))
    let Ah: Sedenion = sed_mul(a, h)
    let comb: Sedenion = sed_add(Ah, Bx)
    sed_normalize(sed_tanh(comb))
}

// Full replacement (no lerp) — for testing pure ZD effect
fn ssm_step_full(token: i64, h: Sedenion) -> Sedenion with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let emb: Sedenion = embed_s(token)
    var a: Sedenion = A_SED
    if token == 4 { a = sed_normalize(sed_known_zero_divisor()) }
    let Bx: Sedenion = sed_add(emb, sed_scale(B_SED, 0.1))
    let Ah: Sedenion = sed_mul(a, h)
    let comb: Sedenion = sed_add(Ah, Bx)
    sed_normalize(sed_tanh(comb))
}

// ─── Forward passes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn forward_sel(tok1: i64, tok2: i64, tok3: i64, forget: i64, delay: i64) -> Sedenion
    with Mut, Div, Panic
{
    var h: Sedenion = sed_one()
    h = ssm_step_sel(tok1, h)
    h = ssm_step_sel(tok2, h)
    h = ssm_step_sel(tok3, h)
    if forget == 1 { h = ssm_step_sel(4, h) }
    var d: i64 = 0
    while d < delay { h = ssm_step_sel(0, h); d = d + 1 }
    h
}

fn forward_ns(tok1: i64, tok2: i64, tok3: i64, forget: i64, delay: i64) -> Sedenion
    with Mut, Div, Panic
{
    var h: Sedenion = sed_one()
    h = ssm_step_ns(tok1, h)
    h = ssm_step_ns(tok2, h)
    h = ssm_step_ns(tok3, h)
    if forget == 1 { h = ssm_step_ns(4, h) }
    var d: i64 = 0
    while d < delay { h = ssm_step_ns(0, h); d = d + 1 }
    h
}

// ─── Distance & classifier ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn state_dist(a: Sedenion, b: Sedenion) -> f64 with Div {
    sed_norm(sed_sub(a, b))
}

fn classify_nn(h: Sedenion, ref0: Sedenion, ref1: Sedenion) -> i64 with Div {
    let d0: f64 = state_dist(h, ref0)
    let d1: f64 = state_dist(h, ref1)
    if d0 < d1 { 0 } else { 1 }
}

fn meta_class(p: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    var t1: i64 = 0; var t3: i64 = 0
    if p == 0 { t1 = 1; t3 = 3 }
    if p == 1 { t1 = 1; t3 = 2 }
    if p == 2 { t1 = 2; t3 = 3 }
    if p == 3 { t1 = 2; t3 = 1 }
    if p == 4 { t1 = 3; t3 = 2 }
    if p == 5 { t1 = 3; t3 = 1 }
    if t1 < t3 { 0 } else { 1 }
}

fn eval_accuracy_sel(forget: i64, delay: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ref0: Sedenion = forward_sel(1, 2, 3, 0, 0)
    let ref1: Sedenion = forward_sel(3, 2, 1, 0, 0)
    var correct: i64 = 0
    var p: i64 = 0
    while p < 6 {
        var t1: i64 = 0; var t2: i64 = 0; var t3: i64 = 0
        if p == 0 { t1 = 1; t2 = 2; t3 = 3 }
        if p == 1 { t1 = 1; t2 = 3; t3 = 2 }
        if p == 2 { t1 = 2; t2 = 1; t3 = 3 }
        if p == 3 { t1 = 2; t2 = 3; t3 = 1 }
        if p == 4 { t1 = 3; t2 = 1; t3 = 2 }
        if p == 5 { t1 = 3; t2 = 2; t3 = 1 }
        let h: Sedenion = forward_sel(t1, t2, t3, forget, delay)
        let pred: i64 = classify_nn(h, ref0, ref1)
        if pred == meta_class(p) { correct = correct + 1 }
        p = p + 1
    }
    correct
}

fn eval_accuracy_ns(forget: i64, delay: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ref0: Sedenion = forward_ns(1, 2, 3, 0, 0)
    let ref1: Sedenion = forward_ns(3, 2, 1, 0, 0)
    var correct: i64 = 0
    var p: i64 = 0
    while p < 6 {
        var t1: i64 = 0; var t2: i64 = 0; var t3: i64 = 0
        if p == 0 { t1 = 1; t2 = 2; t3 = 3 }
        if p == 1 { t1 = 1; t2 = 3; t3 = 2 }
        if p == 2 { t1 = 2; t2 = 1; t3 = 3 }
        if p == 3 { t1 = 2; t2 = 3; t3 = 1 }
        if p == 4 { t1 = 3; t2 = 1; t3 = 2 }
        if p == 5 { t1 = 3; t2 = 2; t3 = 1 }
        let h: Sedenion = forward_ns(t1, t2, t3, forget, delay)
        let pred: i64 = classify_nn(h, ref0, ref1)
        if pred == meta_class(p) { correct = correct + 1 }
        p = p + 1
    }
    correct
}

// ─── Main ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var passed: i32 = 0
    var failed: i32 = 0
    init_params()
    // T1: Basic forward pass nonzero
    let h_basic: Sedenion = forward_sel(1, 2, 3, 0, 5)
    if sed_norm(h_basic) > 0.001 {
        print("T1 PASS: forward nonzero, norm="); print(sed_norm(h_basic)); println("")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("T1 FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T2: Delta gates correct
    let d0: f64 = sigmoid_s(W_DELTA[0])
    let d1: f64 = sigmoid_s(W_DELTA[1])
    let d4: f64 = sigmoid_s(W_DELTA[4])
    if d0 < 0.1 && d1 > 0.5 && d4 > 0.5 {
        print("T2 PASS: Δ(distractor)="); print(d0)
        print(" Δ(relevant)="); print(d1)
        print(" Δ(forget)="); print(d4); println("")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("T2 FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T3: Selective accuracy >= non-selective at D=40 (remember path)
    let acc_ns_40: i64 = eval_accuracy_ns(0, 40)
    let acc_sel_40: i64 = eval_accuracy_sel(0, 40)
    if acc_sel_40 >= acc_ns_40 {
        print("T3 PASS: D=40 remember sel="); print_int(acc_sel_40)
        print("/6 >= ns="); print_int(acc_ns_40); println("/6")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("T3 FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T4: ZD annihilation — normalize(zd) ⊗ comp = 0
    let comp: Sedenion = sed_complementary_zero_divisor()
    let a_forget: Sedenion = sed_normalize(sed_known_zero_divisor())
    let annih_norm: f64 = sed_norm(sed_mul(a_forget, comp))
    if annih_norm < 0.001 {
        print("T4 PASS: ZD annihilation norm="); print(annih_norm); println("")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("T4 FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T5: ZD Ah=0 for comp-aligned state; generic Ah is nonzero.
    // This is the algebraic root of structured forgetting: the Ah term vanishes,
    // so the step output depends only on Bx (the input embedding), not on h.
    let h_c: Sedenion = sed_complementary_zero_divisor()
    let ah_zd_norm: f64 = sed_norm(sed_mul(a_forget, h_c))
    // Construct generic A locally to avoid compiler bug with global-to-local copy in main()
    let a_gen: Sedenion = sed_add(sed_add(sed_basis(0, 0.5), sed_basis(1, 0.05)), sed_basis(2, 0.03))
    let ah_gen_norm: f64 = sed_norm(sed_mul(a_gen, h_c))
    if ah_zd_norm < 0.001 && ah_gen_norm > 0.01 {
        print("T5 PASS: ZD Ah="); print(ah_zd_norm)
        print(" gen Ah="); print(ah_gen_norm); println(" (ZD annihilates Ah term)")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("T5 FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T6: ZD pre-activation norm < generic — Ah=0 removes state contribution.
    // ZD step (token 4): Ah=0, embed=0 → pre-activation = 0.1*B_SED only (tiny).
    // Generic step (token 1): Ah≠0, embed=e1 → pre-activation = Ah + embed + 0.1*B.
    // Token 4 has no embedding and no Ah contribution → smallest possible activation.
    let bx_zd6: Sedenion = sed_scale(B_SED, 0.1)
    let a_gen2: Sedenion = sed_add(sed_add(sed_basis(0, 0.5), sed_basis(1, 0.05)), sed_basis(2, 0.03))
    let Ah_gen6: Sedenion = sed_mul(a_gen2, h_c)
    let Bx_gen6: Sedenion = sed_add(embed_s(1), sed_scale(B_SED, 0.1))
    let norm_comb_zd6: f64 = sed_norm(bx_zd6)
    let norm_comb_gen6: f64 = sed_norm(sed_add(Ah_gen6, Bx_gen6))
    if norm_comb_zd6 < norm_comb_gen6 {
        print("T6 PASS: ZD pre-activation="); print(norm_comb_zd6)
        print(" < generic="); print(norm_comb_gen6); println(" (Ah=0 removes state contribution)")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("T6 FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T7: Accuracy COLLAPSES after FORGET at D=40 (selective loses info)
    let acc_remember: i64 = eval_accuracy_sel(0, 40)
    let acc_forget: i64 = eval_accuracy_sel(1, 40)
    if acc_forget < acc_remember {
        print("T7 PASS: forget degrades accuracy "); print_int(acc_forget)
        print("/6 < remember "); print_int(acc_remember); println("/6")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("T7 FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T8: Stability
    var max_norm: f64 = 0.0
    var p: i64 = 0
    while p < 6 {
        var t1: i64 = 0; var t2: i64 = 0; var t3: i64 = 0
        if p == 0 { t1 = 1; t2 = 2; t3 = 3 }
        if p == 1 { t1 = 1; t2 = 3; t3 = 2 }
        if p == 2 { t1 = 2; t2 = 1; t3 = 3 }
        if p == 3 { t1 = 2; t2 = 3; t3 = 1 }
        if p == 4 { t1 = 3; t2 = 1; t3 = 2 }
        if p == 5 { t1 = 3; t2 = 2; t3 = 1 }
        let h: Sedenion = forward_sel(t1, t2, t3, 1, 40)
        let n: f64 = sed_norm(h)
        if n > max_norm { max_norm = n }
        p = p + 1
    }
    if max_norm < 100.0 {
        print("T8 PASS: max_norm="); print(max_norm); println(" (stable)")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("T8 FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    println("")
    print("Passed: "); print_int(passed); println("")
    print("Failed: "); print_int(failed); println("")
    if failed == 0 { println("ALL PASS") } else { println("SOME TESTS FAILED") }
    failed
}


// === FILE: examples/sedenion_ssm_eeg_real.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// S-SSM on REAL EEG: 16-channel motor-cortex strip, cross-hemisphere
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// First real-data contact for the S-SSM.
//
// Data: PhysioNet EEGMMIDB 1.0.0, subject S001, run R01 (baseline eyes-open,
// 160 Hz, 64 channels, 60.75 s). Downloaded to data/eegmmidb/S001R01.edf.
//
// Extracted window: samples [2000..2080] (80 samples ≈ 0.5 s starting at
// ~12.5 s into the recording). First 16 channels are the fronto-central
// strip Fc5 Fc3 Fc1 Fcz Fc2 Fc4 Fc6 C5  C3 C1 Cz C2 C4 C6 Cp5 Cp3.
//
// Scalar prediction task:
//   INPUT[t]  = mean of channels 0..7  (frontal side)
//   TARGET[t] = mean of channels 8..15, shifted by +1 sample (one-step-ahead)
// Both normalized to [-1, 1] by train-window max-abs.
//
// Why this is a real test: the two channel groups share strong biophysical
// coupling (volume conduction, bilateral motor cortex, near-field sources),
// so the target correlates with the input (corr ≈ 0.87 in this window).
// A model has to learn to phase-lag and weight the input to predict the
// target. Training window correlation guarantees the task is learnable;
// the interesting question is whether S-SSM's cross-channel coupling gives
// it a measurable edge over the diagonal baseline on real neural data.
//
// Architecture unchanged: α=0.2 fixed, B=e0, C trained, 100 epochs, lr=1.0.
//
// Regenerate data with: python3 scripts/extract_eeg_for_sounio.py > init.sio

use math::sedenion::*;

// ─── Math helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fn sqrt_s(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y: f64 = x
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 20 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

fn abs_s(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

fn exp_s(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 20.0 { return exp_s(10.0) * exp_s(x - 10.0) }
    if x < 0.0 - 20.0 { return 0.0 }
    var s: f64 = 1.0
    var term: f64 = 1.0
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); s = s + term; i = i + 1 }
    s
}

fn tanh_s(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 10.0 { return 1.0 }
    if x < 0.0 - 10.0 { return 0.0 - 1.0 }
    let e2: f64 = exp_s(2.0 * x)
    (e2 - 1.0) / (e2 + 1.0)
}

// ─── RNG (for diagonal baseline only) ─────────────────────────────────────────

var RNG_A: i64 = 0
var RNG_B: i64 = 0

fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }

fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x: i64 = RNG_A
    let y: i64 = RNG_B
    RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23)
    x = x ^ (x >> 17)
    x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x
    let r: i64 = x + y
    if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}

fn rand_small() -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0
}
