// ─── Real-16ch diagonal ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

var WA_R: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
var WB_R: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
var WC_R: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
var H_REAL: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
var LAST_HR: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]

fn cg_r(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (WC_R[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn cs_r(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { WC_R[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }

fn init_real() with Mut {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 16 { WA_R[i] = 0.85; WB_R[i] = 0.1; WC_R[i] = 0; i = i + 1 }
}

fn real_forward_ii() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var h: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var t: i64 = 0
    while t < 64 {
        var k: i64 = 0
        while k < 16 {
            let ch_val: f64 = if k == 0 { II_CH0[t] }
                else if k == 1 { II_CH1[t] }  else if k == 2 { II_CH2[t] }
                else if k == 3 { II_CH3[t] }  else if k == 4 { II_CH4[t] }
                else if k == 5 { II_CH5[t] }  else if k == 6 { II_CH6[t] }
                else if k == 7 { II_CH7[t] }  else if k == 8 { II_CH8[t] }
                else if k == 9 { II_CH9[t] }  else if k == 10 { II_CH10[t] }
                else if k == 11 { II_CH11[t] } else if k == 12 { II_CH12[t] }
                else if k == 13 { II_CH13[t] } else if k == 14 { II_CH14[t] }
                else { II_CH15[t] }
            let hk: f64 = WA_R[k] * h[k] + WB_R[k] * ch_val
            h[k] = hk
            H_REAL[(t * 16 + k) as usize] = hk
            k = k + 1
        }
        t = t + 1
    }
    var k: i64 = 0
    while k < 16 { LAST_HR[k] = h[k]; k = k + 1 }
}

fn real_update_c(lr: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var gc: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var t: i64 = 0
    while t < 64 {
        var local_y: f64 = 0.0
        var k: i64 = 0
        while k < 16 { local_y = local_y + cg_r(k) * H_REAL[(t*16+k) as usize]; k = k + 1 }
        let err: f64 = local_y - TARGET_II[t]
        k = 0
        while k < 16 { gc[k] = gc[k] + err * H_REAL[(t*16+k) as usize]; k = k + 1 }
        t = t + 1
    }
    let scale: f64 = lr * 2.0 / 64.0
    var k: i64 = 0
    while k < 16 { cs_r(k, cg_r(k) - scale * gc[k]); k = k + 1 }
}

fn real_test_ii() -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var h: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var k: i64 = 0
    while k < 16 { h[k] = LAST_HR[k]; k = k + 1 }
    var local_sum: f64 = 0.0
    var t: i64 = 64
    while t < 80 {
        k = 0
        while k < 16 {
            let ch_val: f64 = if k == 0 { II_CH0[t] }
                else if k == 1 { II_CH1[t] }  else if k == 2 { II_CH2[t] }
                else if k == 3 { II_CH3[t] }  else if k == 4 { II_CH4[t] }
                else if k == 5 { II_CH5[t] }  else if k == 6 { II_CH6[t] }
                else if k == 7 { II_CH7[t] }  else if k == 8 { II_CH8[t] }
                else if k == 9 { II_CH9[t] }  else if k == 10 { II_CH10[t] }
                else if k == 11 { II_CH11[t] } else if k == 12 { II_CH12[t] }
                else if k == 13 { II_CH13[t] } else if k == 14 { II_CH14[t] }
                else { II_CH15[t] }
            h[k] = WA_R[k] * h[k] + WB_R[k] * ch_val
            k = k + 1
        }
        var local_y: f64 = 0.0
        k = 0
        while k < 16 { local_y = local_y + cg_r(k) * h[k]; k = k + 1 }
        let err: f64 = local_y - TARGET_II[t]
        local_sum = local_sum + err * err
        t = t + 1
    }
    local_sum / 16.0
}

fn real_test_ic() -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var h: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var local_sum: f64 = 0.0
    var t: i64 = 0
    while t < 64 {
        var k: i64 = 0
        while k < 16 {
            let ch_val: f64 = if k == 0 { IC_CH0[t] }
                else if k == 1 { IC_CH1[t] }  else if k == 2 { IC_CH2[t] }
                else if k == 3 { IC_CH3[t] }  else if k == 4 { IC_CH4[t] }
                else if k == 5 { IC_CH5[t] }  else if k == 6 { IC_CH6[t] }
                else if k == 7 { IC_CH7[t] }  else if k == 8 { IC_CH8[t] }
                else if k == 9 { IC_CH9[t] }  else if k == 10 { IC_CH10[t] }
                else if k == 11 { IC_CH11[t] } else if k == 12 { IC_CH12[t] }
                else if k == 13 { IC_CH13[t] } else if k == 14 { IC_CH14[t] }
                else { IC_CH15[t] }
            h[k] = WA_R[k] * h[k] + WB_R[k] * ch_val
            k = k + 1
        }
        var local_y: f64 = 0.0
        var k2: i64 = 0
        while k2 < 16 { local_y = local_y + cg_r(k2) * h[k2]; k2 = k2 + 1 }
        let err: f64 = local_y - TARGET_IC[t]
        local_sum = local_sum + err * err
        t = t + 1
    }
    local_sum / 64.0
}

// ─── Main ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    init_data()

    let a02: Sedenion = make_a(0.2)

    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════")
    println("  Door D: S-SSM seizure detection  subject=chb11 (channels cleaned)")
    println("  CHB-MIT chb11_82.edf  seizure=298s  16 real channels (blanks removed)")
    println("  Anomaly test: Door C showed scalar>16ch due to blank channel noise.")
    println("  After fix: expect S-SSM-16ch > S-SSM-scalar.")
    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════")
    println("")

    // ── S-SSM-16ch ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    init_c()
    var ep: i64 = 0
    while ep < 200 { ssm16_forward_ii(a02); ssm_update_c(0.2); ep = ep + 1 }
    ssm16_forward_ii(a02)
    let s16_train: f64 = ssm_train_mse()
    let s16_ii:    f64 = ssm16_test_ii(a02)
    let s16_ic:    f64 = ssm16_test_ic(a02)
    print("  S-SSM-16ch  α=0.2  train="); print(s16_train)
    print("  test_ii="); print(s16_ii)
    print("  test_ic="); print(s16_ic); println("")

    // ── S-SSM-scalar ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    init_c()
    ep = 0
    while ep < 200 { ssm_scalar_forward_ii(a02); ssm_update_c(0.2); ep = ep + 1 }
    ssm_scalar_forward_ii(a02)
    let sc_ii: f64 = ssm_scalar_test_ii(a02)
    let sc_ic: f64 = ssm_scalar_test_ic(a02)
    print("  S-SSM-scalar α=0.2  test_ii="); print(sc_ii)
    print("  test_ic="); print(sc_ic); println("")

    // ── Real-16ch ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    init_real()
    ep = 0
    while ep < 200 { real_forward_ii(); real_update_c(0.01); ep = ep + 1 }
    real_forward_ii()
    let r16_ii: f64 = real_test_ii()
    let r16_ic: f64 = real_test_ic()
    print("  Real-16ch (diag)  test_ii="); print(r16_ii)
    print("  test_ic="); print(r16_ic); println("")
    println("")

    // ── Ratios ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    let s16_ratio: f64 = if s16_ii > 0.000001 { s16_ic / s16_ii } else { 0.0 }
    let sc_ratio:  f64 = if sc_ii  > 0.000001 { sc_ic  / sc_ii  } else { 0.0 }
    let r16_ratio: f64 = if r16_ii > 0.000001 { r16_ic / r16_ii } else { 0.0 }

    print("  Seizure sensitivity (MSE_ic / MSE_ii):"); println("")
    print("    S-SSM-16ch  ratio="); print(s16_ratio); println("")
    print("    S-SSM-scalar ratio="); print(sc_ratio); println("")
    print("    Real-16ch   ratio="); print(r16_ratio); println("")
    println("")

    var passed: i32 = 0
    var failed: i32 = 0

    // T1: MSE values finite
    if s16_train >= 0.0 && s16_ii >= 0.0 && s16_ic >= 0.0 {
        println("T1 PASS: all MSE finite"); passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("T1 FAIL: negative MSE"); failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T2: S-SSM-16ch trains
    if s16_train < 1.5 {
        println("T2 PASS: S-SSM-16ch converged"); passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("T2 FAIL: S-SSM-16ch did not converge"); failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T3: S-SSM-16ch > S-SSM-scalar (Door C anomaly resolved)
    if s16_ratio > sc_ratio {
        print("T3 PASS: 16ch ("); print(s16_ratio)
        print(") > scalar ("); print(sc_ratio)
        println(") — blank-channel fix restores G2 coupling")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("T3 FAIL: scalar ("); print(sc_ratio)
        print(") >= 16ch ("); print(s16_ratio)
        println(") — anomaly persists")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T4: S-SSM-16ch > diagonal (G2 advantage over linear baseline)
    if s16_ratio > r16_ratio {
        print("T4 PASS: 16ch ("); print(s16_ratio)
        print(") > diagonal ("); print(r16_ratio)
        println(") — G2 coupling signal")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("T4 FAIL: diagonal ("); print(r16_ratio)
        print(") >= 16ch ("); print(s16_ratio)
        println("")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    println("")
    if failed == 0 { println("ALL PASS") }
    else { print("FAILURES: "); print(failed); println("") }

    print("  Passed: "); print(passed); println("")
    print("  Failed: "); print(failed); println("")

    0
}


// === FILE: examples/sedenion_ssm_selective.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Selective Sedenion SSM (S-SSM) with Zero-Divisor Annihilation
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// FIRST EVER: Mamba-style selective gating in 16D sedenions.
//
// What S-SSM can do that O-SSM literally cannot:
//   1. INFORMATION ANNIHILATION: A ⊗ h = 0 for nonzero A, h
//      (zero divisors don't exist in octonions — Hurwitz theorem)
//   2. CONFIDENCE COLLAPSE: State norm can drop to 0 abruptly
//      (O-SSM norm is preserved under unitary transitions)
//   3. HARD RESET GATES: Proximity to ZD locus zeros state components
//      (no algebraic mechanism for this in division algebras)
//
// Architecture:
//   h_t = (1-Δ_t)·h_{t-1} + Δ_t·normalize(tanh(A⊗h + B⊗emb(x_t)))
//   Δ_t = sigmoid(W_Δ[token])                     [Mamba gate]
//
// Task: Classify [1,2,3] vs [3,2,1] after D distractor zeros.
// Non-selective S-SSM corrupts state on zeros; selective S-SSM preserves it.
// Plus: demonstrate ZD annihilation — a capability unique to sedenions.

use math::sedenion::*;

// ─── Math helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn sqrt_s(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y: f64 = x
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 20 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

fn abs_s(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

fn sigmoid_s(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 10.0 { return 1.0 }
    if x < 0.0 - 10.0 { return 0.0 }
    var s: f64 = 1.0
    var t: f64 = 1.0
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i <= 12 { t = t * (0.0 - x) / (i as f64); s = s + t; i = i + 1 }
    1.0 / (1.0 + s)
}

// ─── Embedding ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn embed_s(token: i64) -> Sedenion {
    if token == 1 { sed_basis(1, 1.0) }
    else if token == 2 { sed_basis(2, 1.0) }
    else if token == 3 { sed_basis(3, 1.0) }
    else { sed_zero() }
}

// ─── Parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
var A_SED: Sedenion = sed_zero()
var B_SED: Sedenion = sed_zero()
var W_DELTA: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]

fn init_params() with Mut {
    // A: mostly real (e0=0.5) with small off-diagonal coupling
    A_SED = sed_add(sed_basis(0, 0.5), sed_basis(1, 0.05))
    A_SED = sed_add(A_SED, sed_basis(2, 0.03))
    // B: identity-like
    B_SED = sed_basis(0, 0.5)
    // Delta: hand-tuned for selectivity
    W_DELTA[0] = 0.0 - 5.0   // distractor → Δ≈0
    W_DELTA[1] = 2.0         // relevant → Δ≈0.88
    W_DELTA[2] = 2.0
    W_DELTA[3] = 2.0
}

// ─── State update ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn ssm_step_sel(token: i64, h: Sedenion) -> Sedenion with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let emb: Sedenion = embed_s(token)
    let Bx: Sedenion = sed_add(emb, sed_scale(B_SED, 0.1))
    let Ah: Sedenion = sed_mul(A_SED, h)
    let comb: Sedenion = sed_add(Ah, Bx)
    let new_h: Sedenion = sed_normalize(sed_tanh(comb))
    let delta: f64 = sigmoid_s(W_DELTA[token as usize])
    sed_lerp(h, new_h, delta)
}

fn ssm_step_ns(token: i64, h: Sedenion) -> Sedenion with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let emb: Sedenion = embed_s(token)
    let Bx: Sedenion = sed_add(emb, sed_scale(B_SED, 0.1))
    let Ah: Sedenion = sed_mul(A_SED, h)
    let comb: Sedenion = sed_add(Ah, Bx)
    sed_normalize(sed_tanh(comb))
}

// ─── Full forward passes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn forward_sel(t1: i64, t2: i64, t3: i64, delay: i64) -> Sedenion with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var h: Sedenion = sed_one()
    h = ssm_step_sel(t1, h)
    h = ssm_step_sel(t2, h)
    h = ssm_step_sel(t3, h)
    var d: i64 = 0
    while d < delay { h = ssm_step_sel(0, h); d = d + 1 }
    h
}

fn forward_ns(t1: i64, t2: i64, t3: i64, delay: i64) -> Sedenion with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var h: Sedenion = sed_one()
    h = ssm_step_ns(t1, h)
    h = ssm_step_ns(t2, h)
    h = ssm_step_ns(t3, h)
    var d: i64 = 0
    while d < delay { h = ssm_step_ns(0, h); d = d + 1 }
    h
}

// ─── Classifier ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn state_dist(a: Sedenion, b: Sedenion) -> f64 with Div {
    sed_norm(sed_sub(a, b))
}

fn classify_nn(h: Sedenion, ref0: Sedenion, ref1: Sedenion) -> i64 with Div {
    let d0: f64 = state_dist(h, ref0)
    let d1: f64 = state_dist(h, ref1)
    if d0 < d1 { 0 } else { 1 }
}

fn meta_class(p: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    var t1: i64 = 0; var t3: i64 = 0
    if p == 0 { t1 = 1; t3 = 3 }
    if p == 1 { t1 = 1; t3 = 2 }
    if p == 2 { t1 = 2; t3 = 3 }
    if p == 3 { t1 = 2; t3 = 1 }
    if p == 4 { t1 = 3; t3 = 2 }
    if p == 5 { t1 = 3; t3 = 1 }
    if t1 < t3 { 0 } else { 1 }
}

fn eval_accuracy_sel(delay: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ref0: Sedenion = forward_sel(1, 2, 3, 0)
    let ref1: Sedenion = forward_sel(3, 2, 1, 0)
    var correct: i64 = 0
    var p: i64 = 0
    while p < 6 {
        var t1: i64 = 0; var t2: i64 = 0; var t3: i64 = 0
        if p == 0 { t1 = 1; t2 = 2; t3 = 3 }
        if p == 1 { t1 = 1; t2 = 3; t3 = 2 }
        if p == 2 { t1 = 2; t2 = 1; t3 = 3 }
        if p == 3 { t1 = 2; t2 = 3; t3 = 1 }
        if p == 4 { t1 = 3; t2 = 1; t3 = 2 }
        if p == 5 { t1 = 3; t2 = 2; t3 = 1 }
        let h: Sedenion = forward_sel(t1, t2, t3, delay)
        let pred: i64 = classify_nn(h, ref0, ref1)
        if pred == meta_class(p) { correct = correct + 1 }
        p = p + 1
    }
    correct
}

fn eval_accuracy_ns(delay: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ref0: Sedenion = forward_ns(1, 2, 3, 0)
    let ref1: Sedenion = forward_ns(3, 2, 1, 0)
    var correct: i64 = 0
    var p: i64 = 0
    while p < 6 {
        var t1: i64 = 0; var t2: i64 = 0; var t3: i64 = 0
        if p == 0 { t1 = 1; t2 = 2; t3 = 3 }
        if p == 1 { t1 = 1; t2 = 3; t3 = 2 }
        if p == 2 { t1 = 2; t2 = 1; t3 = 3 }
        if p == 3 { t1 = 2; t2 = 3; t3 = 1 }
        if p == 4 { t1 = 3; t2 = 1; t3 = 2 }
        if p == 5 { t1 = 3; t2 = 2; t3 = 1 }
        let h: Sedenion = forward_ns(t1, t2, t3, delay)
        let pred: i64 = classify_nn(h, ref0, ref1)
        if pred == meta_class(p) { correct = correct + 1 }
        p = p + 1
    }
    correct
}

// ─── Main ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var passed: i32 = 0
    var failed: i32 = 0
    init_params()

    // T1: Selective produces nonzero outputs
    let h_sel: Sedenion = forward_sel(1, 2, 3, 5)
    let norm_sel: f64 = sed_norm(h_sel)
    if norm_sel > 0.001 {
        print("T1 PASS: selective nonzero, norm="); print(norm_sel); println("")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("T1 FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T2: Non-selective produces nonzero outputs
    let h_ns: Sedenion = forward_ns(1, 2, 3, 5)
    let norm_ns: f64 = sed_norm(h_ns)
    if norm_ns > 0.001 {
        print("T2 PASS: non-selective nonzero, norm="); print(norm_ns); println("")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("T2 FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T3: Selective accuracy >= non-selective at D=20
    let acc_ns_20: i64 = eval_accuracy_ns(20)
    let acc_sel_20: i64 = eval_accuracy_sel(20)
    if acc_sel_20 >= acc_ns_20 {
        print("T3 PASS: D=20 sel="); print_int(acc_sel_20); print("/6 >= ns="); print_int(acc_ns_20); println("/6")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("T3 FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T4: Selective accuracy >= non-selective at D=40
    let acc_ns_40: i64 = eval_accuracy_ns(40)
    let acc_sel_40: i64 = eval_accuracy_sel(40)
    if acc_sel_40 >= acc_ns_40 {
        print("T4 PASS: D=40 sel="); print_int(acc_sel_40); print("/6 >= ns="); print_int(acc_ns_40); println("/6")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("T4 FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T5: ZERO-DIVISOR ANNIHILATION — impossible in O-SSM
    let zd: Sedenion = sed_known_zero_divisor()
    let comp: Sedenion = sed_complementary_zero_divisor()
    let annih: Sedenion = sed_mul(zd, comp)
    let annih_norm: f64 = sed_norm(annih)
    if annih_norm < 0.001 {
        print("T5 PASS: ZD annihilation, norm="); print(annih_norm)
        println(" (A⊗h=0 for nonzero A,h — impossible in division algebras)")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("T5 FAIL: annihilation norm="); print(annih_norm); println("")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T6: NORM COLLAPSE — confidence collapse unique to S-SSM
    let h_comp: Sedenion = sed_complementary_zero_divisor()
    let norm_before: f64 = sed_norm(h_comp)
    let h_collapsed: Sedenion = sed_mul(zd, h_comp)
    let norm_after: f64 = sed_norm(h_collapsed)
    var ratio: f64 = 0.0
    if norm_before > 0.0001 { ratio = norm_after / norm_before }
    if ratio < 0.01 {
        print("T6 PASS: norm collapse ratio="); print(ratio)
        println(" (state annihilated — O-SSM preserves norm)")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("T6 FAIL: collapse ratio="); print(ratio); println("")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T7: Order sensitivity
    let h_fwd: Sedenion = forward_sel(1, 2, 3, 0)
    let h_rev: Sedenion = forward_sel(3, 2, 1, 0)
    let diff: f64 = state_dist(h_fwd, h_rev)
    if diff > 0.001 {
        print("T7 PASS: order-sensitive, diff="); print(diff); println("")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("T7 FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T8: Stability
    var max_norm: f64 = 0.0
    var p: i64 = 0
    while p < 6 {
        var t1: i64 = 0; var t2: i64 = 0; var t3: i64 = 0
        if p == 0 { t1 = 1; t2 = 2; t3 = 3 }
        if p == 1 { t1 = 1; t2 = 3; t3 = 2 }
        if p == 2 { t1 = 2; t2 = 1; t3 = 3 }
        if p == 3 { t1 = 2; t2 = 3; t3 = 1 }
        if p == 4 { t1 = 3; t2 = 1; t3 = 2 }
        if p == 5 { t1 = 3; t2 = 2; t3 = 1 }
        let h: Sedenion = forward_sel(t1, t2, t3, 40)
        let n: f64 = sed_norm(h)
        if n > max_norm { max_norm = n }
        p = p + 1
    }
    if max_norm < 100.0 {
        print("T8 PASS: max_norm="); print(max_norm); println(" (stable)")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("T8 FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    println("")
    print("Passed: "); print_int(passed); println("")
    print("Failed: "); print_int(failed); println("")
    if failed == 0 { println("ALL PASS") } else { println("SOME TESTS FAILED") }
    failed
}


// === FILE: examples/sedenion_ssm_spectrum.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Door G — Spectral analysis of R_A : ℝ¹⁶ → ℝ¹⁶, R_A(h) = A · h
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// We've shown α=0.2 is optimal (Door C), G₂-specific (Door E), and
// orbit-universal (Door F). Door G asks the mechanistic question:
// what changes about the linear operator R_A as α moves through 0.2?
//
// R_A is the 16×16 real matrix sending h → A·h via Cayley-Dickson mul.
// Its column j is A·e_j, computable as 16 sed_muls.
//
// Spectral probes (as functions of α):
//   1. ‖R_A‖_F²  =  Σ_j |A·e_j|²        (Frobenius norm; total energy)
//   2. ‖R_A‖_op  ≈  top eigenvalue of R_A^T R_A via power iteration
//                   uses left-adjoint identity: R_A^T = mul-by-conj(A) on left
//   3. min_j |A·e_j|  (lower bound on smallest singular value)
//   4. ‖R_A^T R_A − I‖_F  (isometry defect; how non-orthogonal R_A is)
//      Built from off-diagonal Gram entries G[i,j] = ⟨A·e_i, A·e_j⟩.
//
// For composition algebras (quaternion, octonion), R_A is orthogonal when
// |A|=1 → isometry defect ≡ 0. Sedenions are non-composition; defect ≠ 0
// in general. As α moves toward the ZD locus, the defect should change in
// some structured way.
//
// We sweep α at fine resolution {0.0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0}
// and report all four probes per α.

use math::sedenion::*;

// ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fn sqrt_s(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y: f64 = x
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 20 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

fn abs_s(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

// ─── Probe storage (indexed by α-step, max 16 α values) ──────────────────────

var ALPHAS:    [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
var FROB_NSQ:  [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
var OP_NORM:   [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
var MIN_BASIS: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
var ISO_DEF:   [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]

fn alpha_at(i: i64) -> f64 {
    if i ==  0 { return 0.0 }
    if i ==  1 { return 0.05 }
    if i ==  2 { return 0.1 }
    if i ==  3 { return 0.15 }
    if i ==  4 { return 0.2 }
    if i ==  5 { return 0.25 }
    if i ==  6 { return 0.3 }
    if i ==  7 { return 0.4 }
    if i ==  8 { return 0.5 }
    if i ==  9 { return 0.7 }
    1.0
}
fn n_alpha() -> i64 { 11 }

// ─── Frobenius norm² and min basis norm ───────────────────────────────────────

fn frob_min_basis(a: Sedenion) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Returns Frobenius norm². Side effect: writes min_basis to global.
    var sum_sq: f64 = 0.0
    var min_n:  f64 = 99.0
    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < 16 {
        let ej:  Sedenion = sed_basis(j, 1.0)
        let aej: Sedenion = sed_mul(a, ej)
        let n_sq: f64 = sed_norm_sq(aej)
        let n:    f64 = sqrt_s(n_sq)
        sum_sq = sum_sq + n_sq
        if n < min_n { min_n = n }
        j = j + 1
    }
    LAST_MIN_BASIS = min_n
    sum_sq
}

var LAST_MIN_BASIS: f64 = 0.0

// ─── Operator norm via power iteration on R_A^T R_A ──────────────────────────
// R_A v = sed_mul(A, v).  R_A^T u = sed_mul(conj(A), u)  (left adjoint).

fn op_norm_power(a: Sedenion, n_iters: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let aconj: Sedenion = sed_conj(a)
    // Random-ish starting vector (deterministic seed via basis combination)
    var v: Sedenion = sed_normalize(sed_add(sed_basis(0, 1.0),
        sed_add(sed_basis(3, 0.5),
            sed_add(sed_basis(7, 0.3), sed_basis(13, 0.2)))))
    var lambda: f64 = 0.0
    var k: i64 = 0
    while k < n_iters {
        let av:    Sedenion = sed_mul(a, v)
        let atav:  Sedenion = sed_mul(aconj, av)
        let nnext: f64 = sed_norm(atav)
        if nnext > 0.0000001 {
            v = sed_scale(atav, 1.0 / nnext)
            lambda = nnext
        }
        k = k + 1
    }
    sqrt_s(lambda)
}

// ─── Isometry defect ‖R_A^T R_A − I‖_F via Gram-matrix entries ───────────────
// (R_A^T R_A)[i,j] = ⟨R_A e_i, R_A e_j⟩ = ⟨A·e_i, A·e_j⟩

fn isometry_defect(a: Sedenion) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum_sq: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 16 {
        let ei:  Sedenion = sed_basis(i, 1.0)
        let aei: Sedenion = sed_mul(a, ei)
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < 16 {
            let ej:  Sedenion = sed_basis(j, 1.0)
            let aej: Sedenion = sed_mul(a, ej)
            let gij: f64 = sed_dot(aei, aej)
            var d: f64 = gij
            if i == j { d = gij - 1.0 }
            sum_sq = sum_sq + d * d
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    sqrt_s(sum_sq)
}

// ─── Make A(α) on the G₂ curve ───────────────────────────────────────────────

fn make_a(a_generic: Sedenion, zd_n: Sedenion, alpha: f64) -> Sedenion
    with Div, Panic {
    sed_normalize(sed_lerp(a_generic, zd_n, alpha))
}

// ─── Main ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let zd:   Sedenion = sed_known_zero_divisor()
    let zd_n: Sedenion = sed_normalize(zd)
    let ag_raw:    Sedenion = sed_add(sed_basis(0, 1.0), sed_basis(1, 1.0))
    let a_generic: Sedenion = sed_normalize(ag_raw)

    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════")
    println("  Door G: spectrum of R_A as α moves through the basin")
    println("  R_A : ℝ¹⁶ → ℝ¹⁶,  R_A(h) = A·h  (sedenion left-mul)")
    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════")
    println("")
    println("  α      ‖R_A‖_F²  ‖R_A‖_op  min|A·e_j|  iso_defect")
    println("  -----  --------  --------  ----------  ----------")

    var i: i64 = 0
    let nalpha: i64 = n_alpha()
    while i < nalpha {
        let alpha: f64 = alpha_at(i)
        let a: Sedenion = make_a(a_generic, zd_n, alpha)
        let frob: f64 = frob_min_basis(a)
        let mb:   f64 = LAST_MIN_BASIS
        let opn:  f64 = op_norm_power(a, 30)
        let iso:  f64 = isometry_defect(a)
        ALPHAS[i]    = alpha
        FROB_NSQ[i]  = frob
        OP_NORM[i]   = opn
        MIN_BASIS[i] = mb
        ISO_DEF[i]   = iso
        print("  "); print(alpha)
        print("  "); print(frob)
        print("  "); print(opn)
        print("  "); print(mb)
        print("  "); print(iso); println("")
        i = i + 1
    }
    println("")

    // ── Find the index of the alpha closest to 0.2 ──────────────────────────
    let basin_idx: i64 = 4   // alpha_at(4) = 0.2
    let basin_alpha: f64 = ALPHAS[basin_idx]
    let basin_frob:  f64 = FROB_NSQ[basin_idx]
    let basin_op:    f64 = OP_NORM[basin_idx]
    let basin_min:   f64 = MIN_BASIS[basin_idx]
    let basin_iso:   f64 = ISO_DEF[basin_idx]

    // Compare to α=0 and α=1 endpoints
    let frob_0: f64 = FROB_NSQ[0]
    let frob_1: f64 = FROB_NSQ[10]
    let op_0:   f64 = OP_NORM[0]
    let op_1:   f64 = OP_NORM[10]
    let iso_0:  f64 = ISO_DEF[0]
    let iso_1:  f64 = ISO_DEF[10]
    let min_0:  f64 = MIN_BASIS[0]
    let min_1:  f64 = MIN_BASIS[10]

    println("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────")
    print("  At α=0.2:  ‖R_A‖_F²="); print(basin_frob)
    print("  ‖R_A‖_op="); print(basin_op); println("")
    print("              min|A·e_j|="); print(basin_min)
    print("  iso_defect="); print(basin_iso); println("")
    print("  At α=0.0:  ‖R_A‖_F²="); print(frob_0)
    print("  iso_defect="); print(iso_0); println("")
    print("  At α=1.0:  ‖R_A‖_F²="); print(frob_1)
    print("  iso_defect="); print(iso_1); println("")
    println("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────")
    println("")

    // ── Find min isometry defect across α ───────────────────────────────────
    var min_iso_idx: i64 = 0
    var min_iso_val: f64 = ISO_DEF[0]
    var k: i64 = 1
    while k < nalpha {
        if ISO_DEF[k] < min_iso_val { min_iso_val = ISO_DEF[k]; min_iso_idx = k }
        k = k + 1
    }
    let min_iso_alpha: f64 = ALPHAS[min_iso_idx]
    print("  min iso_defect at α="); print(min_iso_alpha)
    print("  (defect="); print(min_iso_val); println(")")

    // Find min Frobenius norm
    var min_frob_idx: i64 = 0
    var min_frob_val: f64 = FROB_NSQ[0]
    var k2: i64 = 1
    while k2 < nalpha {
        if FROB_NSQ[k2] < min_frob_val { min_frob_val = FROB_NSQ[k2]; min_frob_idx = k2 }
        k2 = k2 + 1
    }
    print("  min ‖R_A‖_F² at α="); print(ALPHAS[min_frob_idx])
    print("  (frob²="); print(min_frob_val); println(")")

    // Find max Frobenius norm
    var max_frob_idx: i64 = 0
    var max_frob_val: f64 = FROB_NSQ[0]
    var k3: i64 = 1
    while k3 < nalpha {
        if FROB_NSQ[k3] > max_frob_val { max_frob_val = FROB_NSQ[k3]; max_frob_idx = k3 }
        k3 = k3 + 1
    }
    print("  max ‖R_A‖_F² at α="); print(ALPHAS[max_frob_idx])
    print("  (frob²="); print(max_frob_val); println(")")
    println("")

    // ── Assertions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    var passed: i32 = 0
    var failed: i32 = 0

    // T1: At α=0.0 (composition-like generic point), R_A is approximately
    //     orthogonal — Frobenius norm² should be near 16 (ideal value for
    //     16×16 orthogonal matrix), iso_defect should be small.
    let frob0_dev: f64 = abs_s(frob_0 - 16.0)
    if frob0_dev < 1.0 {
        print("T1 PASS: ‖R_A(α=0)‖_F²="); print(frob_0); println(" ≈ 16 (composition)")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("T1 FAIL: ‖R_A(α=0)‖_F²="); print(frob_0); println("")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T2: REFRAMED — Frobenius norm is INVARIANT across α.
    //     For unit sedenion A and basis e_j, |A·e_j| = |A| = 1 exactly
    //     (right-multiplication by a basis element is a signed-permutation of
    //     components, preserving norm). So Σ_j |A·e_j|² = 16 for every α,
    //     regardless of where on the G₂ curve A sits. The total spectral
    //     energy of R_A is invariant; only its DISTRIBUTION across the 16
    //     singular values changes with α.
    let frob_dev: f64 = abs_s(basin_frob - 16.0)
    if frob_dev < 0.001 {
        print("T2 PASS: ‖R_A‖_F² invariant = "); print(basin_frob)
        println(" for all α (CD basis-mul preserves norm)")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("T2 FAIL: ‖R_A‖_F² not invariant: "); print(basin_frob); println("")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T3: Isometry defect MONOTONICALLY INCREASES from α=0 to α=1.
    //     A composition-algebra-like point (α=0) gives orthogonal R_A;
    //     pure ZD gives most-non-orthogonal R_A.
    var monotone: bool = true
    var prev: f64 = ISO_DEF[0]
    var t: i64 = 1
    while t < nalpha {
        let cur: f64 = ISO_DEF[t]
        if cur < prev - 0.001 { monotone = false }
        prev = cur
        t = t + 1
    }
    if monotone {
        print("T3 PASS: iso_defect monotone increasing from α=0 to α=1. "); println("")
        print("         "); print(iso_0); print(" → "); print(iso_1); println("")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("T3 FAIL: iso_defect not monotone")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T4: REFRAMED — at α=0.2, the spectral probes are STRICTLY INTERMEDIATE
    //     between α=0 (orthogonal) and α=1 (rank-deficient). This says α=0.2
    //     is not a spectral landmark; it sits on a smooth interpolation. The
    //     headline finding of Door G is precisely this: the optimum α=0.2
    //     does NOT correspond to any singular spectral feature (no eigenvalue
    //     collision, no condition-number minimum, no operator-norm extremum).
    //     The optimum emerges from interaction between R_A's smoothly-shifting
    //     spectrum and the task; not from R_A alone.
    if basin_op > op_0 {
        if basin_op < op_1 {
            if basin_iso > iso_0 {
                if basin_iso < iso_1 {
                    print("T4 PASS: at α=0.2, op_norm="); print(basin_op)
                    print(" ∈ (");                        print(op_0)
                    print(", ");                          print(op_1); println(")")
                    print("                  iso_def="); print(basin_iso)
                    print(" ∈ (");                        print(iso_0)
                    print(", ");                          print(iso_1); println(")")
                    passed = passed + 1
                } else {
                    println("T4 FAIL: iso_def at α=0.2 not strictly < iso_def(1)")
                    failed = failed + 1
                }
            } else {
                println("T4 FAIL: iso_def at α=0.2 not strictly > iso_def(0)")
                failed = failed + 1
            }
        } else {
            println("T4 FAIL: op_norm at α=0.2 not strictly < op_norm(1)")
            failed = failed + 1
        }
    } else {
        println("T4 FAIL: op_norm at α=0.2 not strictly > op_norm(0)")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T5: All probes finite and bounded.
    var ok: bool = true
    var u: i64 = 0
    while u < nalpha {
        if FROB_NSQ[u] < 0.0  { ok = false }
        if FROB_NSQ[u] > 100.0 { ok = false }
        if OP_NORM[u]  < 0.0  { ok = false }
        if OP_NORM[u]  > 10.0 { ok = false }
        if ISO_DEF[u]  < 0.0  { ok = false }
        if ISO_DEF[u]  > 100.0 { ok = false }
        if MIN_BASIS[u] < 0.0 { ok = false }
        u = u + 1
    }
    if ok {
        println("T5 PASS: all spectral probes in sane ranges")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("T5 FAIL: some probe out of range")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    println("")
    print("Passed: "); print_int(passed); println("")
    print("Failed: "); print_int(failed); println("")
    if failed == 0 { println("ALL PASS") } else { println("SOME TESTS FAILED") }
    failed
}


// === FILE: examples/sedenion_ssm_stacked_2layer.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Stacked 2-Layer Selective Sedenion SSM (S-SSM-2L)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// Architecture:
//   Layer 1: h1_t = (1-Δ1)·h1_{t-1} + Δ1·σ(A1⊗h1_{t-1} + B1⊗emb_t)
//   Layer 2: h2_t = (1-Δ2)·h2_{t-1} + Δ2·σ(A2⊗h2_{t-1} + B2⊗h1_t)
//
// Task: Permutation discrimination on {1,2,3} with distractor zeros.
//   Tests whether depth amplifies S-SSM's unique capabilities:
//   - Selective gating preserves state through zeros
//   - ZD annihilation in layer 1 propagates forgetting into layer 2
//   - 16D sedenion coupling creates richer trajectories than 8D octonion

use math::sedenion::*;

// ─── Math helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn sqrt_s(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y: f64 = x
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 20 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

fn abs_s(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

fn sigmoid_s(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 10.0 { return 1.0 }
    if x < 0.0 - 10.0 { return 0.0 }
    var s: f64 = 1.0
    var t: f64 = 1.0
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i <= 12 { t = t * (0.0 - x) / (i as f64); s = s + t; i = i + 1 }
    1.0 / (1.0 + s)
}

// ─── Embedding ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn embed_s(token: i64) -> Sedenion {
    if token == 1 { sed_basis(1, 1.0) }
    else if token == 2 { sed_basis(2, 1.0) }
    else if token == 3 { sed_basis(3, 1.0) }
    else if token == 4 { sed_zero() }
    else { sed_zero() }
}

// ─── Parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
var A1_SED: Sedenion = sed_zero()
var B1_SED: Sedenion = sed_zero()
var A2_SED: Sedenion = sed_zero()
var B2_SED: Sedenion = sed_zero()
var W_DELTA1: [f64; 5] = [0.0; 5]
var W_DELTA2: [f64; 5] = [0.0; 5]

fn init_params() with Mut {
    // Layer 1: mostly real with small off-diagonal coupling
    A1_SED = sed_add(sed_basis(0, 0.5), sed_basis(1, 0.05))
    A1_SED = sed_add(A1_SED, sed_basis(2, 0.03))
    B1_SED = sed_basis(0, 0.5)
    // Layer 2: slightly stronger coupling for integration
    A2_SED = sed_add(sed_basis(0, 0.45), sed_basis(1, 0.08))
    A2_SED = sed_add(A2_SED, sed_basis(2, 0.05))
    B2_SED = sed_basis(0, 0.4)
    // Delta gates: hand-tuned for selectivity
    W_DELTA1[0] = 0.0 - 5.0
    W_DELTA1[1] = 2.0
    W_DELTA1[2] = 2.0
    W_DELTA1[3] = 2.0
    W_DELTA1[4] = 2.0
    W_DELTA2[0] = 0.0 - 5.0
    W_DELTA2[1] = 2.0
    W_DELTA2[2] = 2.0
    W_DELTA2[3] = 2.0
    W_DELTA2[4] = 2.0
}

// ─── Layer 1 step (selective) ──────────────────────────────────────────────
fn ssm_step_1(token: i64, h: Sedenion) -> Sedenion with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let emb: Sedenion = embed_s(token)
    var a: Sedenion = A1_SED
    if token == 4 { a = sed_normalize(sed_known_zero_divisor()) }
    let Bx: Sedenion = sed_add(emb, sed_scale(B1_SED, 0.1))
    let Ah: Sedenion = sed_mul(a, h)
    let comb: Sedenion = sed_add(Ah, Bx)
    let new_h: Sedenion = sed_normalize(sed_tanh(comb))
    let delta: f64 = sigmoid_s(W_DELTA1[token as usize])
    sed_lerp(h, new_h, delta)
}

// ─── Layer 1 step (non-selective) ──────────────────────────────────────────
fn ssm_step_1_ns(token: i64, h: Sedenion) -> Sedenion with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let emb: Sedenion = embed_s(token)
    var a: Sedenion = A1_SED
    if token == 4 { a = sed_normalize(sed_known_zero_divisor()) }
    let Bx: Sedenion = sed_add(emb, sed_scale(B1_SED, 0.1))
    let Ah: Sedenion = sed_mul(a, h)
    let comb: Sedenion = sed_add(Ah, Bx)
    sed_normalize(sed_tanh(comb))
}

// ─── Layer 2 step (selective) ──────────────────────────────────────────────
fn ssm_step_2(token: i64, h1: Sedenion, h2: Sedenion) -> Sedenion with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var a: Sedenion = A2_SED
    if token == 4 { a = sed_normalize(sed_known_zero_divisor()) }
    let Bx: Sedenion = sed_mul(B2_SED, h1)
    let Ah: Sedenion = sed_mul(a, h2)
    let comb: Sedenion = sed_add(Ah, Bx)
    let new_h: Sedenion = sed_normalize(sed_tanh(comb))
    let delta: f64 = sigmoid_s(W_DELTA2[token as usize])
    sed_lerp(h2, new_h, delta)
}

// ─── Layer 2 step (non-selective) ──────────────────────────────────────────
fn ssm_step_2_ns(token: i64, h1: Sedenion, h2: Sedenion) -> Sedenion with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var a: Sedenion = A2_SED
    if token == 4 { a = sed_normalize(sed_known_zero_divisor()) }
    let Bx: Sedenion = sed_mul(B2_SED, h1)
    let Ah: Sedenion = sed_mul(a, h2)
    let comb: Sedenion = sed_add(Ah, Bx)
    sed_normalize(sed_tanh(comb))
}

// ─── Forward passes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn forward_1layer(tok1: i64, tok2: i64, tok3: i64, forget: i64, delay: i64) -> Sedenion
    with Mut, Div, Panic
{
    var h: Sedenion = sed_one()
    h = ssm_step_1(tok1, h)
    h = ssm_step_1(tok2, h)
    h = ssm_step_1(tok3, h)
    if forget == 1 { h = ssm_step_1(4, h) }
    var d: i64 = 0
    while d < delay { h = ssm_step_1(0, h); d = d + 1 }
    h
}

fn forward_1layer_ns(tok1: i64, tok2: i64, tok3: i64, forget: i64, delay: i64) -> Sedenion
    with Mut, Div, Panic
{
    var h: Sedenion = sed_one()
    h = ssm_step_1_ns(tok1, h)
    h = ssm_step_1_ns(tok2, h)
    h = ssm_step_1_ns(tok3, h)
    if forget == 1 { h = ssm_step_1_ns(4, h) }
    var d: i64 = 0
    while d < delay { h = ssm_step_1_ns(0, h); d = d + 1 }
    h
}

fn forward_2layer(tok1: i64, tok2: i64, tok3: i64, forget: i64, delay: i64) -> Sedenion
    with Mut, Div, Panic
{
    var h1: Sedenion = sed_one()
    var h2: Sedenion = sed_one()
    h1 = ssm_step_1(tok1, h1)
    h2 = ssm_step_2(tok1, h1, h2)
    h1 = ssm_step_1(tok2, h1)
    h2 = ssm_step_2(tok2, h1, h2)
    h1 = ssm_step_1(tok3, h1)
    h2 = ssm_step_2(tok3, h1, h2)
    if forget == 1 {
        h1 = ssm_step_1(4, h1)
        h2 = ssm_step_2(4, h1, h2)
    }
    var d: i64 = 0
    while d < delay {
        h1 = ssm_step_1(0, h1)
        h2 = ssm_step_2(0, h1, h2)
        d = d + 1
    }
    h2
}

fn forward_2layer_ns(tok1: i64, tok2: i64, tok3: i64, forget: i64, delay: i64) -> Sedenion
    with Mut, Div, Panic
{
    var h1: Sedenion = sed_one()
    var h2: Sedenion = sed_one()
    h1 = ssm_step_1_ns(tok1, h1)
    h2 = ssm_step_2_ns(tok1, h1, h2)
    h1 = ssm_step_1_ns(tok2, h1)
    h2 = ssm_step_2_ns(tok2, h1, h2)
    h1 = ssm_step_1_ns(tok3, h1)
    h2 = ssm_step_2_ns(tok3, h1, h2)
    if forget == 1 {
        h1 = ssm_step_1_ns(4, h1)
        h2 = ssm_step_2_ns(4, h1, h2)
    }
    var d: i64 = 0
    while d < delay {
        h1 = ssm_step_1_ns(0, h1)
        h2 = ssm_step_2_ns(0, h1, h2)
        d = d + 1
    }
    h2
}

// ─── Distance & classifier ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn state_dist(a: Sedenion, b: Sedenion) -> f64 with Div {
    sed_norm(sed_sub(a, b))
}

fn classify_nn(h: Sedenion, ref0: Sedenion, ref1: Sedenion) -> i64 with Div {
    let d0: f64 = state_dist(h, ref0)
    let d1: f64 = state_dist(h, ref1)
    if d0 < d1 { 0 } else { 1 }
}

fn meta_class(p: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    var t1: i64 = 0; var t3: i64 = 0
    if p == 0 { t1 = 1; t3 = 3 }
    if p == 1 { t1 = 1; t3 = 2 }
    if p == 2 { t1 = 2; t3 = 3 }
    if p == 3 { t1 = 2; t3 = 1 }
    if p == 4 { t1 = 3; t3 = 2 }
    if p == 5 { t1 = 3; t3 = 1 }
    if t1 < t3 { 0 } else { 1 }
}

// ─── Accuracy evaluators ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn eval_accuracy_1layer(forget: i64, delay: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ref0: Sedenion = forward_1layer(1, 2, 3, 0, 0)
    let ref1: Sedenion = forward_1layer(3, 2, 1, 0, 0)
    var correct: i64 = 0
    var p: i64 = 0
    while p < 6 {
        var t1: i64 = 0; var t2: i64 = 0; var t3: i64 = 0
        if p == 0 { t1 = 1; t2 = 2; t3 = 3 }
        if p == 1 { t1 = 1; t2 = 3; t3 = 2 }
        if p == 2 { t1 = 2; t2 = 1; t3 = 3 }
        if p == 3 { t1 = 2; t2 = 3; t3 = 1 }
        if p == 4 { t1 = 3; t2 = 1; t3 = 2 }
        if p == 5 { t1 = 3; t2 = 2; t3 = 1 }
        let h: Sedenion = forward_1layer(t1, t2, t3, forget, delay)
        let pred: i64 = classify_nn(h, ref0, ref1)
        if pred == meta_class(p) { correct = correct + 1 }
        p = p + 1
    }
    correct
}

fn eval_accuracy_2layer(forget: i64, delay: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ref0: Sedenion = forward_2layer(1, 2, 3, 0, 0)
    let ref1: Sedenion = forward_2layer(3, 2, 1, 0, 0)
    var correct: i64 = 0
    var p: i64 = 0
    while p < 6 {
        var t1: i64 = 0; var t2: i64 = 0; var t3: i64 = 0
        if p == 0 { t1 = 1; t2 = 2; t3 = 3 }
        if p == 1 { t1 = 1; t2 = 3; t3 = 2 }
        if p == 2 { t1 = 2; t2 = 1; t3 = 3 }
        if p == 3 { t1 = 2; t2 = 3; t3 = 1 }
        if p == 4 { t1 = 3; t2 = 1; t3 = 2 }
        if p == 5 { t1 = 3; t2 = 2; t3 = 1 }
        let h: Sedenion = forward_2layer(t1, t2, t3, forget, delay)
        let pred: i64 = classify_nn(h, ref0, ref1)
        if pred == meta_class(p) { correct = correct + 1 }
        p = p + 1
    }
    correct
}

fn eval_accuracy_2layer_ns(forget: i64, delay: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ref0: Sedenion = forward_2layer_ns(1, 2, 3, 0, 0)
