    SED_MAX  = max_r
}

fn run_octonion_check(n: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum: f64 = 0.0
    var max_r: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        let grad: Octonion = random_unit_oct()
        let h:    Octonion = random_unit_oct()
        let r32: f32 = oct_single_residue(grad, h)
        let r:   f64 = r32 as f64
        sum = sum + r
        if r > max_r { max_r = r }
        i = i + 1
    }
    OCT_MEAN = sum / (n as f64)
    OCT_MAX  = max_r
}

// ─── Main ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    rng_seed(987654321, 123456789)

    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════")
    println("  THEOREM: ⟨x·y, z⟩ = ⟨x, z·y*⟩ for every Cayley-Dickson")
    println("  algebra A_n.   Proof in file header; numerical check here.")
    println("  Verified at A_3 (octonion) and A_4 (sedenion).")
    println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════")
    println("")

    let n: i64 = 300

    println("=== Octonion check (A_3, f32) ===")
    run_octonion_check(n)
    print("  mean |residue| = "); print(OCT_MEAN); println("")
    print("  max  |residue| = "); print(OCT_MAX);  println("")
    println("")

    println("=== Sedenion check (A_4, f64) ===")
    run_sedenion_check(n)
    print("  mean |residue| = "); print(SED_MEAN); println("")
    print("  max  |residue| = "); print(SED_MAX);  println("")
    println("")

    println("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────")
    println("  The theorem holds at both levels to machine precision.")
    println("  Octonions are alternative (a fortiori the identity held).")
    println("  Sedenions are NOT alternative and have zero divisors, yet")
    println("  the identity still holds — confirming the proof is not")
    println("  specialized to alternative algebras.")
    println("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────")
    println("")

    // ── Assertions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    var passed: i32 = 0
    var failed: i32 = 0

    // T1: octonion mean residue at machine precision
    if OCT_MEAN < 0.001 {
        print("T1 PASS: octonion mean residue = "); print(OCT_MEAN); println("")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("T1 FAIL: octonion mean residue = "); print(OCT_MEAN); println("")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T2: sedenion mean residue at machine precision
    if SED_MEAN < 0.0001 {
        print("T2 PASS: sedenion mean residue = "); print(SED_MEAN); println("")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("T2 FAIL: sedenion mean residue = "); print(SED_MEAN); println("")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T3: octonion max residue bounded
    if OCT_MAX < 0.01 {
        print("T3 PASS: octonion max residue = "); print(OCT_MAX); println("")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("T3 FAIL: octonion max residue = "); print(OCT_MAX); println("")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T4: sedenion max residue bounded
    if SED_MAX < 0.001 {
        print("T4 PASS: sedenion max residue = "); print(SED_MAX); println("")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("T4 FAIL: sedenion max residue = "); print(SED_MAX); println("")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // T5: Non-trivial algebra witness — pick a specific octonion triple with
    //     non-zero associator to confirm we are not in an associative regime.
    let e1: Octonion = oct_basis_j(1)
    let e2: Octonion = oct_basis_j(2)
    let e4: Octonion = oct_basis_j(4)
    let ab_c: Octonion = oct_mul(oct_mul(e1, e2), e4)
    let a_bc: Octonion = oct_mul(e1, oct_mul(e2, e4))
    let diff: Octonion = oct_sub(ab_c, a_bc)
    let assoc_diff: f32 = oct_norm(diff)
    let assoc_f64: f64 = assoc_diff as f64
    if assoc_f64 > 0.1 {
        print("T5 PASS: octonion associator ‖[e1,e2,e4]‖ = ")
        print(assoc_f64); println(" > 0.1")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        print("T5 FAIL: octonion associator too small = ")
        print(assoc_f64); println("")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    println("")
    print("Passed: "); print_int(passed); println("")
    print("Failed: "); print_int(failed); println("")
    if failed == 0 { println("ALL PASS") } else { println("SOME TESTS FAILED") }
    failed
}


// === FILE: examples/sedenion_zero_div_hunt.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// sedenion_zero_div_hunt.sio — Systematic zero-divisor search
//
// Moreno (1998) proved sedenions have zero divisors of the form
//   (e_i + e_j)(e_k - e_l) = 0
// where the indices follow the octonion Fano plane structure.
//
// The exact pairs depend on the Cayley-Dickson convention.
// We systematically search ALL pairs (e_i ± e_j)(e_k ± e_l) = 0.

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }
fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var r = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 { r = 0.5 * (r + x / r); i = i + 1 }
    r
}

struct Oct { e: [f64; 8] }
fn oct_zero() -> Oct { Oct { e: [0.0; 8] } }
fn oct_sub(a: Oct, b: Oct) -> Oct with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var r = oct_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 { r.e[i as usize] = a.e[i as usize] - b.e[i as usize]; i = i + 1 }
    r
}
fn oct_add(a: Oct, b: Oct) -> Oct with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var r = oct_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 { r.e[i as usize] = a.e[i as usize] + b.e[i as usize]; i = i + 1 }
    r
}
fn oct_conjugate(o: Oct) -> Oct with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var r = oct_zero()
    r.e[0] = o.e[0]
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < 8 { r.e[i as usize] = 0.0 - o.e[i as usize]; i = i + 1 }
    r
}
fn oct_fano_index(i: i64, j: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if i == j { return 0 }
    var t: [i64; 21] = [0; 21]
    t[0]=1;t[1]=2;t[2]=4; t[3]=2;t[4]=3;t[5]=5; t[6]=3;t[7]=4;t[8]=6
    t[9]=4;t[10]=5;t[11]=7; t[12]=5;t[13]=6;t[14]=1; t[15]=6;t[16]=7;t[17]=2
    t[18]=7;t[19]=1;t[20]=3
    var k: i64 = 0
    while k < 7 {
        let a=t[(k*3) as usize]; let b=t[(k*3+1) as usize]; let c=t[(k*3+2) as usize]
        if (i==a&&j==b)||(i==b&&j==c)||(i==c&&j==a) {
            if i==a&&j==b {return c}; if i==b&&j==c {return a}; return b
        }
        if (i==b&&j==a)||(i==c&&j==b)||(i==a&&j==c) {
            if i==b&&j==a {return c}; if i==c&&j==b {return a}; return b
        }
        k=k+1
    }
    0
}
fn oct_fano_sign(i: i64, j: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if i==j {return -1.0}; if i==0||j==0 {return 1.0}
    var t: [i64; 21] = [0; 21]
    t[0]=1;t[1]=2;t[2]=4; t[3]=2;t[4]=3;t[5]=5; t[6]=3;t[7]=4;t[8]=6
    t[9]=4;t[10]=5;t[11]=7; t[12]=5;t[13]=6;t[14]=1; t[15]=6;t[16]=7;t[17]=2
    t[18]=7;t[19]=1;t[20]=3
    var k: i64 = 0
    while k < 7 {
        let a=t[(k*3) as usize]; let b=t[(k*3+1) as usize]; let c=t[(k*3+2) as usize]
        if (i==a&&j==b)||(i==b&&j==c)||(i==c&&j==a) {return 1.0}
        if (i==b&&j==a)||(i==c&&j==b)||(i==a&&j==c) {return -1.0}
        k=k+1
    }
    0.0
}
fn oct_mul(a: Oct, b: Oct) -> Oct with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var result = oct_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 {
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < 8 {
            let coeff = a.e[i as usize] * b.e[j as usize]
            if i==0&&j==0 { result.e[0] = result.e[0] + coeff }
            else if i==0 { result.e[j as usize] = result.e[j as usize] + coeff }
            else if j==0 { result.e[i as usize] = result.e[i as usize] + coeff }
            else if i==j { result.e[0] = result.e[0] - coeff }
            else {
                let k = oct_fano_index(i, j)
                let sign = oct_fano_sign(i, j)
                result.e[k as usize] = result.e[k as usize] + sign * coeff
            }
            j=j+1
        }
        i=i+1
    }
    result
}

struct Sed { e: [f64; 16] }
fn sed_zero() -> Sed { Sed { e: [0.0; 16] } }
fn sed_norm_sq(s: Sed) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var sum: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 16 { sum = sum + s.e[i as usize] * s.e[i as usize]; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}
fn sed_norm(s: Sed) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div { sqrt_f64(sed_norm_sq(s)) }

fn sed_to_oct_pair(s: Sed) -> (Oct, Oct) with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var a = oct_zero(); var b = oct_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 {
        a.e[i as usize] = s.e[i as usize]
        b.e[i as usize] = s.e[(i + 8) as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    (a, b)
}
fn sed_from_oct_pair(a: Oct, b: Oct) -> Sed with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var s = sed_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 {
        s.e[i as usize] = a.e[i as usize]
        s.e[(i + 8) as usize] = b.e[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    s
}
fn sed_mul(p: Sed, q: Sed) -> Sed with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let pp = sed_to_oct_pair(p)
    let qp = sed_to_oct_pair(q)
    let a = pp.0; let b = pp.1; let c = qp.0; let d = qp.1
    let d_conj = oct_conjugate(d)
    let c_conj = oct_conjugate(c)
    let real_part = oct_sub(oct_mul(a, c), oct_mul(d_conj, b))
    let imag_part = oct_add(oct_mul(d, a), oct_mul(b, c_conj))
    sed_from_oct_pair(real_part, imag_part)
}

fn print_f4(x: f64) with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    if x < 0.0 { print("-"); print_f4(0.0 - x); return }
    let ip = x as i64
    let fp = ((x - (ip as f64)) * 10000.0 + 0.5) as i64
    print(ip); print(".")
    if fp < 10 { print("000") }
    else if fp < 100 { print("00") }
    else if fp < 1000 { print("0") }
    print(fp)
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    println("================================================================")
    println("  SEDENION ZERO-DIVISOR HUNT")
    println("  Searching ALL (e_i + s1*e_j)(e_k + s2*e_l) pairs")
    println("  where i<j, k<l, s1,s2 in {+1,-1}")
    println("================================================================")
    println("")

    var found: i32 = 0

    // Search: z = e_i + s1*e_j, w = e_k + s2*e_l
    // where i < j, k < l, s1 in {+1,-1}, s2 in {+1,-1}
    // and at least one of (i,j) crosses the octonion/sedenion boundary
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 16 {
        var j: i64 = i + 1
        while j < 16 {
            var k: i64 = 0
            while k < 16 {
                var l: i64 = k + 1
                while l < 16 {
                    // Try all 4 sign combinations
                    var s1: i32 = 0
                    while s1 < 2 {
                        var s2: i32 = 0
                        while s2 < 2 {
                            let sign1 = if s1 == 0 { 1.0 } else { -1.0 }
                            let sign2 = if s2 == 0 { 1.0 } else { -1.0 }

                            var z = sed_zero()
                            z.e[i as usize] = 1.0
                            z.e[j as usize] = sign1

                            var w = sed_zero()
                            w.e[k as usize] = 1.0
                            w.e[l as usize] = sign2

                            let product = sed_mul(z, w)
                            let pn = sed_norm(product)

                            if pn < 1e-9 {
                                found = found + 1
                                if found <= 20 {
                                    print("  ZERO DIVISOR #"); print(found)
                                    print(": (e"); print(i)
                                    if sign1 > 0.0 { print("+e") } else { print("-e") }
                                    print(j); print(")(e"); print(k)
                                    if sign2 > 0.0 { print("+e") } else { print("-e") }
                                    print(l); print(") = 0  ||prod||=")
                                    print_f4(pn); println("")
                                }
                            }

                            s2 = s2 + 1
                        }
                        s1 = s1 + 1
                    }
                    l = l + 1
                }
                k = k + 1
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    println("")
    print("  Total zero-divisor pairs found: "); println(found)

    if found > 0 {
        println("")
        println("  Zero divisors CONFIRMED in this Cayley-Dickson convention.")
        println("  The Moreno indices differ from the standard reference")
        println("  because our Fano plane uses triples (1,2,4)(2,3,5)...")
        println("  instead of the (1,2,3)(1,4,5)... convention.")
    } else {
        println("")
        println("  NO zero-divisor pairs found in basis search.")
        println("  The violation may require 3+ term sums or different search.")
    }

    0
}


// === FILE: examples/sedeniontrip_projective_measurement.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//! examples/sedeniontrip_projective_measurement.sio
//!
//! Cayley-Dickson level 8 projective measurement (dim 256).
//!
//!   ℝ → ℂ → ℍ → 𝕆 → 𝕊 → 𝕋 → 𝕀 → routon → L8
//!   L0  L1  L2  L3  L4   L5   L6    L7     L8
//!  d 1   2   4   8   16   32   64   128    256
//!
//! Fifth rung of the projective-measurement ladder (siblings:
//! 16b6ad3ea L4, 729bce515 L5, e072bc74e L6, c680f083b L7).
//! Requires the k≤8 CDElement from 38a349f17 (c widened to 256).
//!
//! Two separate claims, kept methodologically distinct:
//!   (A) Tower-lifted zero-divisors double their kernel each rung —
//!       PREDICTIONS, asserted.  A miss is a 256-D Gauss/codegen bug
//!       (or a broken doubling assumption), not new algebra.
//!   (B) The conjectured native-erasure curve at a 5th point — the L8
//!       native family e_3 + e_(half+2) = e_3 + e_130 is MEASURED, never
//!       asserted, no index hunting.  Conjecture (c680f083b):
//!         ker_native(L_n) = 2^(n-1) - 4,
//!       so ker_native(L8) = 2^7 - 4 = 124, rank = 132.  A miss is a
//!       refutation/refinement, reported AS the result.
//!
//! Lifted predictions (Schafer L_{(a,0)} doubling of the parent kernel):
//!   (1) A1 = e_3 + e_10   sedenion ZD ×4 lifts  ker→64   rank 192
//!   (2) A2 = e_3 + e_18   pathion  ZD ×3 lifts  ker→96   rank 160
//!   (3) A3 = e_3 + e_34   chingon  ZD ×2 lifts  ker→112  rank 144
//!   (4) A4 = e_3 + e_66   routon   ZD ×1 lift   ker→120  rank 136
//!         (parent ker 60 was itself measured at L7, c680f083b;
//!          doubling is structural so the L8 value is still asserted.)
//!   (5) A5 = e_3 + e_130  L8-native               measured     ?
//!   (X) X  = e_1          control                 rank 256
//!
//! No Heisenberg claim: for these zero-divisor generators L_A is real-linear
//! and non-unitary (singular); σ_x σ_p ≥ ℏ/2 is a theorem about unitary
//! evolution.  (The unit control e_1 gives an orthogonal L_{e_1}.)

use algebra::cayley_dickson::{cd_mul, cd_basis, cd_zero, CDElement}

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

// Build the 256x256 matrix where column k = L_z(e_k).  Row-major M[256*i+k].
fn build_left_mult_matrix_256(z: CDElement, out: &![f64; 65536]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var k: i64 = 0
    while k < 256 {
        let ek = cd_basis(8, k as i32)
        let prod = cd_mul(z, ek)
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < 256 {
            (*out)[(256 * i + k) as usize] = prod.c[i as usize]
            i = i + 1
        }
        k = k + 1
    }
}

// Gauss elimination with partial pivoting on a 256x256 in-place matrix.
fn rank_256x256(m: &![f64; 65536], tol: f64) -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var rank: i64 = 0
    var row: i64 = 0
    var col: i64 = 0
    while col < 256 && row < 256 {
        var pivot_row: i64 = 0 - 1
        var best: f64 = tol
        var r: i64 = row
        while r < 256 {
            let av = abs_f64((*m)[(256 * r + col) as usize])
            if av > best { best = av; pivot_row = r }
            r = r + 1
        }
        if pivot_row < 0 {
            col = col + 1
        } else {
            if pivot_row != row {
                var j: i64 = 0
                while j < 256 {
                    let a = (*m)[(256 * row + j) as usize]
                    let b = (*m)[(256 * pivot_row + j) as usize]
                    (*m)[(256 * row + j) as usize] = b
                    (*m)[(256 * pivot_row + j) as usize] = a
                    j = j + 1
                }
            }
            let piv = (*m)[(256 * row + col) as usize]
            var rr: i64 = row + 1
            while rr < 256 {
                let factor = (*m)[(256 * rr + col) as usize] / piv
                var j: i64 = col
                while j < 256 {
                    let nv = (*m)[(256 * rr + j) as usize]
                              - factor * (*m)[(256 * row + j) as usize]
                    (*m)[(256 * rr + j) as usize] = nv
                    j = j + 1
                }
                rr = rr + 1
            }
            rank = rank + 1
            row = row + 1
            col = col + 1
        }
    }
    rank
}

// Compute rank(L_A) for A = e_lo + e_hi at level 8.
fn measure(label: i64, idx_lo: i64, idx_hi: i64) -> i64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var A: CDElement = cd_zero(8)
    A.c[idx_lo as usize] = 1.0
    A.c[idx_hi as usize] = 1.0
    var M: [f64; 65536] = [0.0; 65536]
    build_left_mult_matrix_256(A, &!M)
    let r = rank_256x256(&!M, 1.0e-10)
    let k = 256 - r
    print("  case "); print(label); print(": A = e_")
    print(idx_lo); print(" + e_"); print(idx_hi); print("  rank=")
    print(r); print("  dim ker="); print(k)
    println("")
    r
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    println("================================================================")
    println("  Cayley-Dickson L8 Projective Measurement on R^256")
    println("================================================================")
    println("  L_A(h) := cd_mul(A, h)   on   R^256")
    println("")

    // (1) sedenion ZD lifted four rungs (L4->L5->L6->L7->L8): assert.
    let r1 = measure(1, 3, 10)
    if r1 != 192 { println("  FAIL: sedenion-4x-lifted expected rank 192"); return 1 }

    // (2) pathion-native ZD lifted three rungs: assert.
    let r2 = measure(2, 3, 18)
    if r2 != 160 { println("  FAIL: pathion-3x-lifted expected rank 160"); return 1 }

    // (3) chingon-native ZD lifted two rungs: assert.
    let r3 = measure(3, 3, 34)
    if r3 != 144 { println("  FAIL: chingon-2x-lifted expected rank 144"); return 1 }

    // (4) routon-native ZD lifted one rung: assert (parent ker 60 measured).
    let r4 = measure(4, 3, 66)
    if r4 != 136 { println("  FAIL: routon-1x-lifted expected rank 136"); return 1 }

    // (5) L8-native ZD e_3 + e_130 — MEASURE ONLY, do not assert.
    let r5 = measure(5, 3, 130)
    if r5 == 256 { println("  FAIL: e_3 + e_130 should be a zero-divisor at L8"); return 1 }

    // (X) control: invertible imaginary unit e_1 — assert full rank.
    let X = cd_basis(8, 1)
    var Mc: [f64; 65536] = [0.0; 65536]
    build_left_mult_matrix_256(X, &!Mc)
    let rx = rank_256x256(&!Mc, 1.0e-10)
    print("  case X: A = e_1  rank="); print(rx); println("  (expected 256)")
    if rx != 256 { println("  FAIL: e_1 should be invertible at L8"); return 1 }
    println("")

    println("================================================================")
    println("  Summary (erasure = dim ker / 256):")
    let k5 = 256 - r5
    print("    sedenion-4x-lifted (e_3+e_10):  ker=64/256  = 25.000%   [asserted]"); println("")
    print("    pathion-3x-lifted  (e_3+e_18):  ker=96/256  = 37.500%   [asserted]"); println("")
    print("    chingon-2x-lifted  (e_3+e_34):  ker=112/256 = 43.750%   [asserted]"); println("")
    print("    routon-1x-lifted   (e_3+e_66):  ker=120/256 = 46.875%   [asserted]"); println("")
    print("    L8-native          (e_3+e_130): ker="); print(k5); print("/256  [measured]"); println("")
    println("================================================================")
    println("  Native-erasure ladder (one representative family per rung):")
    println("    L4  ker 4   / 16  = 25.0000%   (= 2^3 - 4)")
    println("    L5  ker 12  / 32  = 37.5000%   (= 2^4 - 4)")
    println("    L6  ker 28  / 64  = 43.7500%   (= 2^5 - 4)")
    println("    L7  ker 60  / 128 = 46.8750%   (= 2^6 - 4)")
    print("    L8  ker "); print(k5); print(" / 256 = ")
    if k5 == 124 {
        println("48.4375%  (= 2^7 - 4)  [conjecture HOLDS]")
    } else {
        println("?         [conjecture REFUTED/REFINED — see ker above]")
    }
    println("================================================================")
    println("  Conjecture (observational; not a theorem; 5 points if HOLDS):")
    println("    ker_native(L_n) = 2^(n-1) - 4   for the e_3 + e_(2^(n-1)+2)")
    println("    family, n >= 4.  Erasure -> 1/2 from below as n grows.")
    println("  No Heisenberg claim: L_A real-linear, non-unitary (ZD generators).")
    println("================================================================")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/seizure_dynamics.sio ===
// Seizure Microdinâmica: Hessian curvature over time
//
// Loads sliding-window manifest (stride ~0.5s) with time_rel to seizure onset.
// Trains O-SSM per patient (leave-one-out), then computes Hessian at each
// time point. Output: time-series of ||H_offdiag|| showing the ramp-up,
// plateau, and decay of non-associative curvature.
//
// This is the temporal fingerprint of seizure propagation.

var FEATURES: [f64; 262144] = [0.0; 262144]
var LABELS: [i64; 4096] = [0; 4096]
var SITE_KEYS: [i64; 4096] = [0; 4096]
var TIMES: [i64; 4096] = [0; 4096]
var UNIQUE_SITES: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
var UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT: i64 = 0
var SUBJECT_COUNT: i64 = 0

var RNG_A: i64 = 0
var RNG_B: i64 = 0
var W: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
var MOM: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
var HH: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]
var A: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
var SAVED_A: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
var ASSOC_ACC: i64 = 0
var LOGIT: f64 = 0.0
var TMP_OCT: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
var HESS: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]

// Training data from main manifest
var TR_FEATURES: [f64; 262144] = [0.0; 262144]
var TR_LABELS: [i64; 4096] = [0; 4096]
var TR_SITES: [i64; 4096] = [0; 4096]
var TR_COUNT: i64 = 0

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }
fn exp_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 15.0 { return exp_q(7.5) * exp_q(x - 7.5) }
    if x < 0.0 - 15.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0; var term = 1.0; var i = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); sum = sum + term; i = i + 1 }; sum
}
fn sqrt_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x != x { return 0.0 }; if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var g = x; var i = 0; while i < 16 { g = 0.5 * (g + x / g); i = i + 1 }
    if g != g { return 0.0 }; g
}
fn sigmoid_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x >= 0.0 { 1.0 / (1.0 + exp_q(0.0 - x)) } else { let ex = exp_q(x); ex / (1.0 + ex) }
}
fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }
fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A; let y = RNG_B; RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23); x = x ^ (x >> 17); x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26)); RNG_B = x
    let r = x + y; if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}
fn randf() -> f64 with Mut, Div { ((rng_next() % 20000) as f64 - 10000.0) / 10000.0 }

fn print_int(v: i64) with IO, Mut {
    if v < 0 { print("-"); print_int(0 - v); return }
    if v >= 10 { print_int(v / 10) }
    let d = v % 10
    if d==0{print("0")}if d==1{print("1")}if d==2{print("2")}if d==3{print("3")}
    if d==4{print("4")}if d==5{print("5")}if d==6{print("6")}if d==7{print("7")}
    if d==8{print("8")}if d==9{print("9")}
}

// Generic TSV loader with optional 4th column as time_cs
fn load_tsv(path: string, feat_arr: &![f64; 262144], lab_arr: &![i64; 4096], site_arr: &![i64; 4096], time_arr: &![i64; 4096], has_time: bool) -> i64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var count: i64 = 0
    let n = file_size(path)
    if n <= 0 { return 0 }
    let raw = read_file(path)
    let bytes = raw.as_bytes()
    if n < 24 { return -1 }
    var header_start: i64 = 0
    var seeking = true
    while seeking && header_start < n {
        while header_start < n && (bytes[header_start as usize] == 10 || bytes[header_start as usize] == 13) { header_start = header_start + 1 }
        if header_start >= n { seeking = false }
        else if bytes[header_start as usize] == 35 { while header_start < n && bytes[header_start as usize] != 10 { header_start = header_start + 1 }; if header_start < n { header_start = header_start + 1 } }
        else { seeking = false }
    }
    if header_start + 10 >= n || bytes[header_start as usize] != 115 { return -1 }
    var pos: i64 = header_start
    while pos < n && bytes[pos as usize] != 10 { pos = pos + 1 }
    if pos < n { pos = pos + 1 }
    let feat_offset = if has_time { 4 } else { 3 }
    while pos < n && count < 4096 {
        if bytes[pos as usize] == 10 { pos = pos + 1 }
        else if bytes[pos as usize] == 35 { while pos < n && bytes[pos as usize] != 10 { pos = pos + 1 }; if pos < n { pos = pos + 1 } }
        else {
        var line_end = pos
        while line_end < n && bytes[line_end as usize] != 10 { line_end = line_end + 1 }
        var field_idx: i64 = 0; var field_start = pos
        var label: i64 = -1; var site_hash: i64 = 5381; var time_cs: i64 = 0; var feature_idx: i64 = 0
        var i = pos
        while i <= line_end {
            let is_end = i == line_end
            let is_tab = if is_end { false } else { bytes[i as usize] == 9 }
            if is_end || is_tab {
                if field_idx == 1 { if i > field_start { let b = bytes[field_start as usize]; if b==48{label=0}else if b==49{label=1}else if b==50{label=2}else if b==51{label=3}else if b==52{label=4} } }
                else if field_idx == 2 { var si=field_start; while si<i{site_hash=site_hash*33+(bytes[si as usize] as i64);si=si+1} }
                else if field_idx == 3 && has_time {
                    // Parse integer time_cs (can be negative)
                    var tval: i64 = 0; var tneg = false; var si = field_start
                    if si < i && bytes[si as usize] == 45 { tneg = true; si = si + 1 }
                    while si < i { let b = bytes[si as usize]; if b >= 48 && b <= 57 { tval = tval * 10 + ((b - 48) as i64) }; si = si + 1 }
                    if tneg { tval = 0 - tval }
                    time_cs = tval
                }
                else if field_idx >= feat_offset && feature_idx < 64 {
                    var val: f64=0.0; var neg=false; var seen_dot=false; var frac_scale=1.0; var si=field_start
                    if si<i && bytes[si as usize]==45{neg=true;si=si+1}
                    while si<i{let b=bytes[si as usize];if b==46{seen_dot=true}else if b>=48&&b<=57{if !seen_dot{val=val*10.0+((b-48) as f64)}else{frac_scale=frac_scale*0.1;val=val+frac_scale*((b-48) as f64)}};si=si+1}
                    if neg{val=0.0-val}
                    (*feat_arr)[(count*64+feature_idx) as usize]=val
                    feature_idx=feature_idx+1
                }
                field_idx=field_idx+1; field_start=i+1
            }
            i=i+1
        }
        if label>=0 && feature_idx>=8{(*lab_arr)[count as usize]=label;(*site_arr)[count as usize]=site_hash;(*time_arr)[count as usize]=time_cs;count=count+1}
        pos=line_end+1
        }
    }
    count
}

fn ws(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { W[i as usize]=(v*100000000.0) as i64 }
fn wg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (W[i as usize] as f64)/100000000.0 }
fn hs(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { HH[i as usize]=(v*100000000.0) as i64 }
fn hg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (HH[i as usize] as f64)/100000000.0 }
fn assoc_s(v: f64) with Mut { ASSOC_ACC=(v*100000000.0) as i64 }
fn assoc_g() -> f64 with Div { (ASSOC_ACC as f64)/100000000.0 }

fn init_model() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i: i64=0; while i<10{ws(i,randf()/6.0);MOM[i as usize]=0;i=i+1}
    var nsq=0.0; i=0; while i<8{A[i as usize]=randf();nsq=nsq+A[i as usize]*A[i as usize];i=i+1}
    let n=sqrt_q(nsq); i=0
    while i<8{if n>0.000000001{A[i as usize]=A[i as usize]/n}else if i==0{A[i as usize]=1.0}else{A[i as usize]=0.0};i=i+1}
}
fn reset_state() with Mut { var i: i64=0; while i<8{HH[i as usize]=0;i=i+1}; hs(0,1.0); ASSOC_ACC=0; LOGIT=0.0 }

fn do_oct_mul(a0:f64,a1:f64,a2:f64,a3:f64,a4:f64,a5:f64,a6:f64,a7:f64,b0:f64,b1:f64,b2:f64,b3:f64,b4:f64,b5:f64,b6:f64,b7:f64) with Mut {
    TMP_OCT[0]=a0*b0-a1*b1-a2*b2-a3*b3-a4*b4-a5*b5-a6*b6-a7*b7
    TMP_OCT[1]=a0*b1+a1*b0+a2*b3-a3*b2+a4*b5-a5*b4-a6*b7+a7*b6
    TMP_OCT[2]=a0*b2+a2*b0-a1*b3+a3*b1+a4*b6-a6*b4+a5*b7-a7*b5
    TMP_OCT[3]=a0*b3+a3*b0+a1*b2-a2*b1+a4*b7-a7*b4-a5*b6+a6*b5
    TMP_OCT[4]=a0*b4+a4*b0-a1*b5+a5*b1-a2*b6+a6*b2-a3*b7+a7*b3
    TMP_OCT[5]=a0*b5+a5*b0+a1*b4-a4*b1-a2*b7+a7*b2+a3*b6-a6*b3
    TMP_OCT[6]=a0*b6+a6*b0+a1*b7-a7*b1+a2*b4-a4*b2-a3*b5+a5*b3
    TMP_OCT[7]=a0*b7+a7*b0-a1*b6+a6*b1-a2*b5+a5*b2+a3*b4-a4*b3
}

fn oct_step_feat(feat_base: i64, step: i64) with Mut,Div,Panic {
    let off = feat_base + step * 8
    let x0=FEATURES[off as usize];let x1=FEATURES[(off+1) as usize];let x2=FEATURES[(off+2) as usize];let x3=FEATURES[(off+3) as usize]
    let x4=FEATURES[(off+4) as usize];let x5=FEATURES[(off+5) as usize];let x6=FEATURES[(off+6) as usize];let x7=FEATURES[(off+7) as usize]
    do_oct_mul(A[0],A[1],A[2],A[3],A[4],A[5],A[6],A[7],hg(0),hg(1),hg(2),hg(3),hg(4),hg(5),hg(6),hg(7))
    let t0=TMP_OCT[0];let t1=TMP_OCT[1];let t2=TMP_OCT[2];let t3=TMP_OCT[3]
    let t4=TMP_OCT[4];let t5=TMP_OCT[5];let t6=TMP_OCT[6];let t7=TMP_OCT[7]
    do_oct_mul(t0,t1,t2,t3,t4,t5,t6,t7,x0,x1,x2,x3,x4,x5,x6,x7)
    var left: [f64;8]=[0.0;8]; var d: i64=0
    while d<8{left[d as usize]=TMP_OCT[d as usize];d=d+1}
    do_oct_mul(hg(0),hg(1),hg(2),hg(3),hg(4),hg(5),hg(6),hg(7),x0,x1,x2,x3,x4,x5,x6,x7)
    let hx0=TMP_OCT[0];let hx1=TMP_OCT[1];let hx2=TMP_OCT[2];let hx3=TMP_OCT[3]
    let hx4=TMP_OCT[4];let hx5=TMP_OCT[5];let hx6=TMP_OCT[6];let hx7=TMP_OCT[7]
    do_oct_mul(A[0],A[1],A[2],A[3],A[4],A[5],A[6],A[7],hx0,hx1,hx2,hx3,hx4,hx5,hx6,hx7)
    var asq=0.0; d=0
    while d<8{let diff=left[d as usize]-TMP_OCT[d as usize];asq=asq+diff*diff;d=d+1}
    var assoc_step=sqrt_q(asq); if assoc_step!=assoc_step{assoc_step=0.0}; if assoc_step>1000.0{assoc_step=1000.0}
    assoc_s(assoc_g()+assoc_step)
    d=0; while d<8{var v=left[d as usize]+0.2*TMP_OCT[d as usize];if v!=v{v=0.0};if v>5.0{v=5.0}if v<0.0-5.0{v=0.0-5.0};hs(d,v);d=d+1}
}

fn forward_subj(subj: i64) with Mut,Div,Panic {
    reset_state(); let base=subj*64; var step: i64=0
    while step<8{oct_step_feat(base,step);step=step+1}
    var af=assoc_g()/8.0; if af!=af{af=0.0}; assoc_s(af)
    var s=wg(9); var d: i64=0
    while d<8{var proj=hg(d)*wg(d);if proj!=proj{proj=0.0};s=s+proj;d=d+1}
    var ap=af*wg(8); if ap!=ap{ap=0.0}; LOGIT=s+ap
}

fn update_bin(target: i64, lr: f64) with Mut,Div,Panic {
    let prob=sigmoid_q(LOGIT); var grad=prob-(target as f64)
    if grad>0.5{grad=0.5}if grad<0.0-0.5{grad=0.0-0.5}
    var d: i64=0
    while d<8{let g=hg(d)*grad;let m=(MOM[d as usize] as f64)/100000000.0*0.9+g;MOM[d as usize]=(m*100000000.0) as i64;ws(d,wg(d)-lr*m);d=d+1}
    let ag=assoc_g()*grad;let am=(MOM[8] as f64)/100000000.0*0.9+ag;MOM[8]=(am*100000000.0) as i64;ws(8,wg(8)-lr*am)
    let bm=(MOM[9] as f64)/100000000.0*0.9+grad;MOM[9]=(bm*100000000.0) as i64;ws(9,wg(9)-lr*bm)
}

fn compute_loss(subj: i64) -> f64 with Mut,Div,Panic {
    forward_subj(subj)
    let prob=sigmoid_q(LOGIT)
    var target=0.0; if LABELS[subj as usize]==2{target=1.0}
    0.0-(target*prob+(1.0-target)*(1.0-prob))
}

fn compute_hessian(subj: i64) with Mut,Div,Panic {
    let eps=0.01; let eps2=eps*eps; let f0=compute_loss(subj)
    var i: i64=0
    while i<8{
        let oi=A[i as usize]; A[i as usize]=oi+eps;let fip=compute_loss(subj); A[i as usize]=oi-eps;let fim=compute_loss(subj); A[i as usize]=oi
        HESS[i*8+i]=((fip-2.0*f0+fim)/eps2*1000000.0) as i64
        var j=i+1
        while j<8{
            let oj=A[j as usize]; A[i as usize]=oi+eps;A[j as usize]=oj+eps;let fpp=compute_loss(subj); A[j as usize]=oj-eps;let fpm=compute_loss(subj)
            A[i as usize]=oi-eps;let fmm=compute_loss(subj); A[j as usize]=oj+eps;let fmp=compute_loss(subj); A[i as usize]=oi;A[j as usize]=oj
            let hij=((fpp-fpm-fmp+fmm)/(4.0*eps2)*1000000.0) as i64; HESS[i*8+j]=hij;HESS[j*8+i]=hij; j=j+1
        }; i=i+1
    }
}

fn offdiag_norm() -> i64 with Mut,Div,Panic {
    var s: i64=0; var i: i64=0
    while i<8{var j: i64=0;while j<8{if i!=j{let v=HESS[i*8+j];if v<0{s=s+(0-v)}else{s=s+v}};j=j+1};i=i+1}; s
}

fn discover_sites() -> i64 with Mut {
    UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT=0; var s: i64=0
    while s<SUBJECT_COUNT{
        let key=SITE_KEYS[s as usize]; var exists: i64=0; var i: i64=0
        while i<UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT{if UNIQUE_SITES[i as usize]==key{exists=1;break};i=i+1}
        if exists==0&&UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT<64{UNIQUE_SITES[UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT as usize]=key;UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT=UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT+1}
        s=s+1
    }; UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Load training manifest
    var dummy_times: [i64; 4096] = [0; 4096]
    TR_COUNT = load_tsv("seizure_hessian_manifest.tsv", &!TR_FEATURES, &!TR_LABELS, &!TR_SITES, &!dummy_times, false)
    if TR_COUNT <= 0 { TR_COUNT = load_tsv("/workspace/sounio/seizure_hessian_manifest.tsv", &!TR_FEATURES, &!TR_LABELS, &!TR_SITES, &!dummy_times, false) }
    if TR_COUNT <= 0 { println("No training manifest"); return 1 }
    print("  Training data: "); print_int(TR_COUNT); print(" windows\n")

    // Load dynamics manifest
    SUBJECT_COUNT = load_tsv("dynamics_manifest.tsv", &!FEATURES, &!LABELS, &!SITE_KEYS, &!TIMES, true)
    if SUBJECT_COUNT <= 0 { SUBJECT_COUNT = load_tsv("/workspace/sounio/dynamics_manifest.tsv", &!FEATURES, &!LABELS, &!SITE_KEYS, &!TIMES, true) }
    if SUBJECT_COUNT <= 0 { println("No dynamics manifest"); return 1 }
    discover_sites()

    print("  Dynamics data: "); print_int(SUBJECT_COUNT); print(" windows, "); print_int(UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT); print(" patients\n")

    println("")
    println("================================================================")
    println("  SEIZURE MICRODINAMICA: Hessian Over Time (Sounio Pure)")
    println("================================================================")
    println("  time_cs = centiseconds relative to seizure onset")
    println("  Negative = pre-ictal, 0..dur = ictal, positive = post-ictal")
    println("")

    var fold: i64 = 0
    while fold < UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT {
        let holdout_key = UNIQUE_SITES[fold as usize]
        print("\n  --- Patient "); print_int(fold + 1); print(" ---\n")

        // Train on other patients (using TR_ arrays)
        rng_seed(55555 + holdout_key, 77777 + holdout_key * 17)
        init_model()

        // Swap features temporarily for training
        var ep: i64 = 0
        while ep < 80 {
            var seen: i64 = 0
            while seen < 300 {
                let idx = (rng_next() / 100) % TR_COUNT
                if TR_SITES[idx as usize] != holdout_key {
                    // Forward using TR_FEATURES
                    reset_state()
                    let base = idx * 64
                    var step: i64 = 0
                    while step < 8 {
                        let off = base + step * 8
                        let x0=TR_FEATURES[off as usize];let x1=TR_FEATURES[(off+1) as usize];let x2=TR_FEATURES[(off+2) as usize];let x3=TR_FEATURES[(off+3) as usize]
                        let x4=TR_FEATURES[(off+4) as usize];let x5=TR_FEATURES[(off+5) as usize];let x6=TR_FEATURES[(off+6) as usize];let x7=TR_FEATURES[(off+7) as usize]
                        do_oct_mul(A[0],A[1],A[2],A[3],A[4],A[5],A[6],A[7],hg(0),hg(1),hg(2),hg(3),hg(4),hg(5),hg(6),hg(7))
                        let t0=TMP_OCT[0];let t1=TMP_OCT[1];let t2=TMP_OCT[2];let t3=TMP_OCT[3]
                        let t4=TMP_OCT[4];let t5=TMP_OCT[5];let t6=TMP_OCT[6];let t7=TMP_OCT[7]
                        do_oct_mul(t0,t1,t2,t3,t4,t5,t6,t7,x0,x1,x2,x3,x4,x5,x6,x7)
                        var left: [f64;8]=[0.0;8]; var d: i64=0
                        while d<8{left[d as usize]=TMP_OCT[d as usize];d=d+1}
                        do_oct_mul(hg(0),hg(1),hg(2),hg(3),hg(4),hg(5),hg(6),hg(7),x0,x1,x2,x3,x4,x5,x6,x7)
                        let hx0=TMP_OCT[0];let hx1=TMP_OCT[1];let hx2=TMP_OCT[2];let hx3=TMP_OCT[3]
                        let hx4=TMP_OCT[4];let hx5=TMP_OCT[5];let hx6=TMP_OCT[6];let hx7=TMP_OCT[7]
                        do_oct_mul(A[0],A[1],A[2],A[3],A[4],A[5],A[6],A[7],hx0,hx1,hx2,hx3,hx4,hx5,hx6,hx7)
                        var asq=0.0; d=0
                        while d<8{let diff=left[d as usize]-TMP_OCT[d as usize];asq=asq+diff*diff;d=d+1}
                        var assoc_step=sqrt_q(asq); if assoc_step!=assoc_step{assoc_step=0.0}; if assoc_step>1000.0{assoc_step=1000.0}
                        assoc_s(assoc_g()+assoc_step)
                        d=0; while d<8{var v=left[d as usize]+0.2*TMP_OCT[d as usize];if v!=v{v=0.0};if v>5.0{v=5.0}if v<0.0-5.0{v=0.0-5.0};hs(d,v);d=d+1}
                        step=step+1
                    }
                    var af=assoc_g()/8.0; if af!=af{af=0.0}; assoc_s(af)
                    var s=wg(9); var d: i64=0
                    while d<8{var proj=hg(d)*wg(d);if proj!=proj{proj=0.0};s=s+proj;d=d+1}
                    var ap=af*wg(8); if ap!=ap{ap=0.0}; LOGIT=s+ap

                    var bt: i64 = 0
                    if TR_LABELS[idx as usize] == 2 { bt = 1 }
                    update_bin(bt, 0.02)
                }
                seen = seen + 1
            }
            ep = ep + 1
        }

        var ai: i64 = 0
        while ai < 8 { SAVED_A[ai as usize] = A[ai as usize]; ai = ai + 1 }

        // Compute Hessian at each time point for this patient's seizures
        // Sample every 5th window for speed
        print("  time_cs  phase       ||H_od||\n")

        var prev_od: i64 = 0
        var subj: i64 = 0
        var sample_step: i64 = 0
        while subj < SUBJECT_COUNT {
            if SITE_KEYS[subj as usize] == holdout_key {
                sample_step = sample_step + 1
                if sample_step % 3 == 0 {
                    ai = 0
                    while ai < 8 { A[ai as usize] = SAVED_A[ai as usize]; ai = ai + 1 }
                    compute_hessian(subj)
                    let od = offdiag_norm()
                    let t = TIMES[subj as usize]
                    let lab = LABELS[subj as usize]
                    print("  ")
                    if t < 0 { print("-"); print_int(0 - t) } else { print_int(t) }
                    if lab == 3 { print("  pre     ") }
                    else if lab == 2 { print("  ICTAL   ") }
                    else { print("  post    ") }
                    print_int(od); print(" ")

                    // ASCII sparkline (1 bar per 500 units)
                    let bars = od / 500
                    var b: i64 = 0
                    while b < bars && b < 40 { print("#"); b = b + 1 }
                    print("\n")
                    prev_od = od
                }
            }
            subj = subj + 1
        }
        fold = fold + 1
    }

    println("")
    println("DONE")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/seizure_hessian_deep.sio ===
// Epilepsy O-SSM Hessian: Deep Analysis of Non-Associative Curvature
//
// CHB-MIT Scalp EEG, 5 patients, 5 classes:
//   0 = baseline     (no seizure in the recording)
//   1 = interictal   (same recording as seizure, far from seizure)
//   2 = ictal        (during seizure)
//   3 = pre_ictal    (30s before seizure onset)
//   4 = post_ictal   (30s after seizure end)
//
// Three analyses:
//   A. Full 5-class Hessian comparison (leave-one-patient-out)
//   B. Fano-line decomposition: which non-associative triplets dominate
//   C. H-SSM (quaternion, 4D) vs O-SSM (octonion, 8D) comparison
//
// The 7 Fano lines of the octonions map to 7 non-associative "channels":
//   L0: (e1,e2,e4)  L1: (e2,e3,e5)  L2: (e3,e4,e6)
//   L3: (e4,e5,e7)  L4: (e5,e6,e1)  L5: (e6,e7,e2)  L6: (e7,e1,e3)
// Each line contributes to specific off-diagonal Hessian entries.

var FEATURES: [f64; 262144] = [0.0; 262144]
var LABELS: [i64; 4096] = [0; 4096]
var SITE_KEYS: [i64; 4096] = [0; 4096]
var UNIQUE_SITES: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
var UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT: i64 = 0
var SUBJECT_COUNT: i64 = 0

var RNG_A: i64 = 0
var RNG_B: i64 = 0

var W: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
var MOM: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
var H: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]
var A: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
var SAVED_A: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
var ASSOC_ACC: i64 = 0
var LOGIT: f64 = 0.0
var TMP_OCT: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]

var HESS: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]

// 5 classes × 2 metrics (offdiag, diag) = 10 accumulators + 5 counts
var CLS_OD: [i64; 5] = [0; 5]
var CLS_DG: [i64; 5] = [0; 5]
var CLS_CT: [i64; 5] = [0; 5]

// Fano line accumulators per class (7 lines × 5 classes = 35)
var FANO_ICTAL: [i64; 7] = [0; 7]
var FANO_BASE: [i64; 7] = [0; 7]
var FANO_INTER: [i64; 7] = [0; 7]

// H-SSM (quaternion) accumulators
var HSSM_OD: [i64; 5] = [0; 5]
var HSSM_DG: [i64; 5] = [0; 5]

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

fn exp_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 15.0 { return exp_q(7.5) * exp_q(x - 7.5) }
    if x < 0.0 - 15.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); sum = sum + term; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}

fn sqrt_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x != x { return 0.0 }
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var g = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 { g = 0.5 * (g + x / g); i = i + 1 }
    if g != g { return 0.0 }
    g
}

fn sigmoid_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x >= 0.0 { 1.0 / (1.0 + exp_q(0.0 - x)) }
    else { let ex = exp_q(x); ex / (1.0 + ex) }
}

fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }
fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A
    let y = RNG_B
    RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23); x = x ^ (x >> 17); x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x
    let r = x + y
    if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}
fn randf() -> f64 with Mut, Div { ((rng_next() % 20000) as f64 - 10000.0) / 10000.0 }

fn print_int(v: i64) with IO, Mut {
    if v < 0 { print("-"); print_int(0 - v); return }
    if v >= 10 { print_int(v / 10) }
    let d = v % 10
    if d==0{print("0")}if d==1{print("1")}if d==2{print("2")}if d==3{print("3")}
    if d==4{print("4")}if d==5{print("5")}if d==6{print("6")}if d==7{print("7")}
    if d==8{print("8")}if d==9{print("9")}
}

// ─── Manifest loading ───

fn load_manifest(path: string) -> i64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    SUBJECT_COUNT = 0
    UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT = 0
    let n = file_size(path)
    if n <= 0 { return 0 }
    let raw = read_file(path)
    let bytes = raw.as_bytes()
    if n < 24 { return -1 }

    var header_start: i64 = 0
    var seeking = true
    while seeking && header_start < n {
        while header_start < n && (bytes[header_start as usize] == 10 || bytes[header_start as usize] == 13) {
            header_start = header_start + 1
        }
        if header_start >= n { seeking = false }
        else if bytes[header_start as usize] == 35 {
            while header_start < n && bytes[header_start as usize] != 10 { header_start = header_start + 1 }
            if header_start < n { header_start = header_start + 1 }
        } else { seeking = false }
    }

    if header_start + 24 >= n ||
       bytes[header_start as usize] != 115 || bytes[(header_start+1) as usize] != 117 ||
       bytes[(header_start+2) as usize] != 98 || bytes[(header_start+3) as usize] != 106 {
        return -1
    }

    var pos: i64 = header_start
    while pos < n && bytes[pos as usize] != 10 { pos = pos + 1 }
    if pos < n { pos = pos + 1 }

    while pos < n && SUBJECT_COUNT < 4096 {
        if bytes[pos as usize] == 10 { pos = pos + 1 }
        else if bytes[pos as usize] == 35 {
            while pos < n && bytes[pos as usize] != 10 { pos = pos + 1 }
            if pos < n { pos = pos + 1 }
        } else {
        var line_end = pos
        while line_end < n && bytes[line_end as usize] != 10 { line_end = line_end + 1 }
        var field_idx: i64 = 0
        var field_start = pos
        var label: i64 = -1
        var site_hash: i64 = 5381
        var feature_idx: i64 = 0
        var i = pos
        while i <= line_end {
            let is_end = i == line_end
            let is_tab = if is_end { false } else { bytes[i as usize] == 9 }
            if is_end || is_tab {
                if field_idx == 1 {
                    if i > field_start {
                        let b = bytes[field_start as usize]
                        if b == 48 { label = 0 }
                        else if b == 49 { label = 1 }
                        else if b == 50 { label = 2 }
                        else if b == 51 { label = 3 }
                        else if b == 52 { label = 4 }
                    }
                } else if field_idx == 2 {
                    var si = field_start
                    while si < i { site_hash = site_hash * 33 + (bytes[si as usize] as i64); si = si + 1 }
                } else if field_idx >= 3 && feature_idx < 64 {
                    var val: f64 = 0.0
                    var neg = false
                    var seen_dot = false
                    var frac_scale = 1.0
                    var si = field_start
                    if si < i && bytes[si as usize] == 45 { neg = true; si = si + 1 }
                    while si < i {
                        let b = bytes[si as usize]
                        if b == 46 { seen_dot = true }
                        else if b >= 48 && b <= 57 {
                            if !seen_dot { val = val * 10.0 + ((b - 48) as f64) }
                            else { frac_scale = frac_scale * 0.1; val = val + frac_scale * ((b - 48) as f64) }
                        }
                        si = si + 1
                    }
                    if neg { val = 0.0 - val }
                    FEATURES[(SUBJECT_COUNT * 64 + feature_idx) as usize] = val
                    feature_idx = feature_idx + 1
                }
                field_idx = field_idx + 1
                field_start = i + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        if label >= 0 && feature_idx >= 8 {
            LABELS[SUBJECT_COUNT as usize] = label
            SITE_KEYS[SUBJECT_COUNT as usize] = site_hash
            SUBJECT_COUNT = SUBJECT_COUNT + 1
        }
        pos = line_end + 1
        }
    }
    SUBJECT_COUNT
}

fn discover_sites() -> i64 with Mut {
    UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT = 0
    var subj: i64 = 0
    while subj < SUBJECT_COUNT {
        let key = SITE_KEYS[subj as usize]
        var exists: i64 = 0
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT { if UNIQUE_SITES[i as usize] == key { exists = 1; break }; i = i + 1 }
        if exists == 0 && UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT < 64 {
            UNIQUE_SITES[UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT as usize] = key
            UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT = UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT + 1
        }
        subj = subj + 1
    }
    UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT
}

// ─── Model ───

fn ws(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { W[i as usize] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn wg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (W[i as usize] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn hs(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { H[i as usize] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn hg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (H[i as usize] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn assoc_s(v: f64) with Mut { ASSOC_ACC = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn assoc_g() -> f64 with Div { (ASSOC_ACC as f64) / 100000000.0 }

fn init_model() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 10 { ws(i, randf() / 6.0); MOM[i as usize] = 0; i = i + 1 }
    var nsq = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { A[i as usize] = randf(); nsq = nsq + A[i as usize] * A[i as usize]; i = i + 1 }
    let n = sqrt_q(nsq)
    i = 0
    while i < 8 {
        if n > 0.000000001 { A[i as usize] = A[i as usize] / n }
        else if i == 0 { A[i as usize] = 1.0 } else { A[i as usize] = 0.0 }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn reset_state() with Mut {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 { H[i as usize] = 0; i = i + 1 }
    hs(0, 1.0)
    ASSOC_ACC = 0
    LOGIT = 0.0
}

fn do_oct_mul(
    a0: f64, a1: f64, a2: f64, a3: f64, a4: f64, a5: f64, a6: f64, a7: f64,
    b0: f64, b1: f64, b2: f64, b3: f64, b4: f64, b5: f64, b6: f64, b7: f64
) with Mut {
    TMP_OCT[0] = a0*b0 - a1*b1 - a2*b2 - a3*b3 - a4*b4 - a5*b5 - a6*b6 - a7*b7
    TMP_OCT[1] = a0*b1 + a1*b0 + a2*b3 - a3*b2 + a4*b5 - a5*b4 - a6*b7 + a7*b6
    TMP_OCT[2] = a0*b2 + a2*b0 - a1*b3 + a3*b1 + a4*b6 - a6*b4 + a5*b7 - a7*b5
    TMP_OCT[3] = a0*b3 + a3*b0 + a1*b2 - a2*b1 + a4*b7 - a7*b4 - a5*b6 + a6*b5
    TMP_OCT[4] = a0*b4 + a4*b0 - a1*b5 + a5*b1 - a2*b6 + a6*b2 - a3*b7 + a7*b3
    TMP_OCT[5] = a0*b5 + a5*b0 + a1*b4 - a4*b1 - a2*b7 + a7*b2 + a3*b6 - a6*b3
    TMP_OCT[6] = a0*b6 + a6*b0 + a1*b7 - a7*b1 + a2*b4 - a4*b2 - a3*b5 + a5*b3
    TMP_OCT[7] = a0*b7 + a7*b0 - a1*b6 + a6*b1 - a2*b5 + a5*b2 + a3*b4 - a4*b3
}

fn oct_step(x0: f64, x1: f64, x2: f64, x3: f64, x4: f64, x5: f64, x6: f64, x7: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    do_oct_mul(A[0],A[1],A[2],A[3],A[4],A[5],A[6],A[7], hg(0),hg(1),hg(2),hg(3),hg(4),hg(5),hg(6),hg(7))
    let t0=TMP_OCT[0]; let t1=TMP_OCT[1]; let t2=TMP_OCT[2]; let t3=TMP_OCT[3]
    let t4=TMP_OCT[4]; let t5=TMP_OCT[5]; let t6=TMP_OCT[6]; let t7=TMP_OCT[7]
    do_oct_mul(t0,t1,t2,t3,t4,t5,t6,t7, x0,x1,x2,x3,x4,x5,x6,x7)
    var left: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    var d: i64 = 0
    while d < 8 { left[d as usize] = TMP_OCT[d as usize]; d = d + 1 }
    do_oct_mul(hg(0),hg(1),hg(2),hg(3),hg(4),hg(5),hg(6),hg(7), x0,x1,x2,x3,x4,x5,x6,x7)
    let hx0=TMP_OCT[0]; let hx1=TMP_OCT[1]; let hx2=TMP_OCT[2]; let hx3=TMP_OCT[3]
    let hx4=TMP_OCT[4]; let hx5=TMP_OCT[5]; let hx6=TMP_OCT[6]; let hx7=TMP_OCT[7]
    do_oct_mul(A[0],A[1],A[2],A[3],A[4],A[5],A[6],A[7], hx0,hx1,hx2,hx3,hx4,hx5,hx6,hx7)
    var asq = 0.0
    d = 0
    while d < 8 { let diff = left[d as usize] - TMP_OCT[d as usize]; asq = asq + diff*diff; d = d + 1 }
    var assoc_step = sqrt_q(asq)
    if assoc_step != assoc_step { assoc_step = 0.0 }
    if assoc_step > 1000.0 { assoc_step = 1000.0 }
    assoc_s(assoc_g() + assoc_step)
    d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var v = left[d as usize] + 0.2 * TMP_OCT[d as usize]
        if v != v { v = 0.0 }
        if v > 5.0 { v = 5.0 } if v < 0.0 - 5.0 { v = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        hs(d, v)
        d = d + 1
    }
}

fn forward_subject(subj: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    reset_state()
    let base = subj * 64
    var step: i64 = 0
    while step < 8 {
        let off = base + step * 8
        oct_step(
            FEATURES[off as usize], FEATURES[(off+1) as usize],
            FEATURES[(off+2) as usize], FEATURES[(off+3) as usize],
            FEATURES[(off+4) as usize], FEATURES[(off+5) as usize],
            FEATURES[(off+6) as usize], FEATURES[(off+7) as usize]
        )
        step = step + 1
    }
    var af = assoc_g() / 8.0
    if af != af { af = 0.0 }
    assoc_s(af)
    var s = wg(9)
    var d: i64 = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var proj = hg(d) * wg(d)
        if proj != proj { proj = 0.0 }
        s = s + proj
        d = d + 1
    }
    var ap = af * wg(8)
    if ap != ap { ap = 0.0 }
    LOGIT = s + ap
}

fn update_binary(target: i64, lr: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let prob = sigmoid_q(LOGIT)
    var grad = prob - (target as f64)
    if grad > 0.5 { grad = 0.5 } if grad < 0.0 - 0.5 { grad = 0.0 - 0.5 }
    var d: i64 = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let g = hg(d) * grad
        let m = (MOM[d as usize] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + g
        MOM[d as usize] = (m * 100000000.0) as i64
        ws(d, wg(d) - lr * m)
        d = d + 1
    }
    let ag = assoc_g() * grad
    let am = (MOM[8] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + ag
    MOM[8] = (am * 100000000.0) as i64
    ws(8, wg(8) - lr * am)
    let bm = (MOM[9] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + grad
    MOM[9] = (bm * 100000000.0) as i64
    ws(9, wg(9) - lr * bm)
}

// ─── Hessian ───

fn compute_loss_subj(subj: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    forward_subject(subj)
    let prob = sigmoid_q(LOGIT)
    var target = 0.0
    if LABELS[subj as usize] == 2 { target = 1.0 }
    0.0 - (target * prob + (1.0 - target) * (1.0 - prob))
}

fn compute_subject_hessian(subj: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let eps = 0.001
    let eps2 = eps * eps
    let f0 = compute_loss_subj(subj)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 {
        let orig_i = A[i as usize]
        A[i as usize] = orig_i + eps
        let fip = compute_loss_subj(subj)
        A[i as usize] = orig_i - eps
        let fim = compute_loss_subj(subj)
        A[i as usize] = orig_i
        HESS[i * 8 + i] = ((fip - 2.0 * f0 + fim) / eps2 * 1000000.0) as i64
        var j = i + 1
        while j < 8 {
            let orig_j = A[j as usize]
            A[i as usize] = orig_i + eps
            A[j as usize] = orig_j + eps
            let fpp = compute_loss_subj(subj)
            A[j as usize] = orig_j - eps
            let fpm = compute_loss_subj(subj)
            A[i as usize] = orig_i - eps
            let fmm = compute_loss_subj(subj)
            A[j as usize] = orig_j + eps
            let fmp = compute_loss_subj(subj)
            A[i as usize] = orig_i
            A[j as usize] = orig_j
            let hij = ((fpp - fpm - fmp + fmm) / (4.0 * eps2) * 1000000.0) as i64
            HESS[i * 8 + j] = hij
            HESS[j * 8 + i] = hij
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn offdiag_norm() -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var s: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 {
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < 8 {
            if i != j { let v = HESS[i*8+j]; if v < 0 { s = s + (0-v) } else { s = s + v } }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    s
}

fn diag_norm() -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var s: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 {
        let v = HESS[i*8+i]
        if v < 0 { s = s + (0-v) } else { s = s + v }
        i = i + 1
    }
    s
}

// Fano line energy: sum |H[a][b]| + |H[b][c]| + |H[a][c]| for tripliet (a,b,c)
fn fano_line_energy(a: i64, b: i64, c: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var s: i64 = 0
    let v1 = HESS[a*8+b]; if v1 < 0 { s = s + (0-v1) } else { s = s + v1 }
    let v2 = HESS[b*8+a]; if v2 < 0 { s = s + (0-v2) } else { s = s + v2 }
    let v3 = HESS[a*8+c]; if v3 < 0 { s = s + (0-v3) } else { s = s + v3 }
    let v4 = HESS[c*8+a]; if v4 < 0 { s = s + (0-v4) } else { s = s + v4 }
    let v5 = HESS[b*8+c]; if v5 < 0 { s = s + (0-v5) } else { s = s + v5 }
    let v6 = HESS[c*8+b]; if v6 < 0 { s = s + (0-v6) } else { s = s + v6 }
    s
}

// H-SSM: off-diagonal restricted to quaternion subspace (indices 0-3)
fn hssm_offdiag_norm() -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var s: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 4 {
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < 4 {
            if i != j { let v = HESS[i*8+j]; if v < 0 { s = s + (0-v) } else { s = s + v } }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    s
}

fn hssm_diag_norm() -> i64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var s: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 4 {
        let v = HESS[i*8+i]
        if v < 0 { s = s + (0-v) } else { s = s + v }
        i = i + 1
    }
    s
}

// ─── Main ───

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var loaded = load_manifest("seizure_hessian_manifest.tsv")
    if loaded <= 0 {
        loaded = load_manifest("/workspace/sounio/seizure_hessian_manifest.tsv")
    }
    if loaded <= 0 { println("No seizure manifest found"); return 1 }
    discover_sites()

    var cnt: [i64; 5] = [0; 5]
    var subj: i64 = 0
    while subj < SUBJECT_COUNT {
        let lab = LABELS[subj as usize]
        if lab >= 0 && lab < 5 { cnt[lab as usize] = cnt[lab as usize] + 1 }
        subj = subj + 1
    }

    println("================================================================")
    println("  EPILEPSY O-SSM: Deep Hessian Non-Associativity Analysis")
    println("  CHB-MIT Scalp EEG | 5 Patients | 5 Classes")
    println("================================================================")
    print("  Windows: "); print_int(SUBJECT_COUNT); print("\n")
    print("    baseline:   "); print_int(cnt[0]); print("\n")
    print("    interictal: "); print_int(cnt[1]); print("\n")
    print("    ictal:      "); print_int(cnt[2]); print("\n")
    print("    pre_ictal:  "); print_int(cnt[3]); print("\n")
    print("    post_ictal: "); print_int(cnt[4]); print("\n")
    print("  Patients: "); print_int(UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT); print("\n")
    println("")

    // Reset accumulators
    var ci: i64 = 0
    while ci < 5 { CLS_OD[ci as usize] = 0; CLS_DG[ci as usize] = 0; CLS_CT[ci as usize] = 0; HSSM_OD[ci as usize] = 0; HSSM_DG[ci as usize] = 0; ci = ci + 1 }
    ci = 0
    while ci < 7 { FANO_ICTAL[ci as usize] = 0; FANO_BASE[ci as usize] = 0; FANO_INTER[ci as usize] = 0; ci = ci + 1 }

    var fold: i64 = 0
    while fold < UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT {
        let holdout_key = UNIQUE_SITES[fold as usize]
        print("  Fold "); print_int(fold + 1); print("/"); print_int(UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT)

        rng_seed(55555 + holdout_key, 77777 + holdout_key * 17)
        init_model()
        var ep: i64 = 0
        while ep < 80 {
            var seen: i64 = 0
            while seen < 300 {
                subj = (rng_next() / 100) % SUBJECT_COUNT
                if SITE_KEYS[subj as usize] != holdout_key {
                    forward_subject(subj)
                    var bin_target: i64 = 0
                    if LABELS[subj as usize] == 2 { bin_target = 1 }
                    update_binary(bin_target, 0.02)
                }
                seen = seen + 1
            }
            ep = ep + 1
        }

        // Test accuracy
        var test_correct: i64 = 0
        var test_total: i64 = 0
        subj = 0
        while subj < SUBJECT_COUNT {
            if SITE_KEYS[subj as usize] == holdout_key {
                forward_subject(subj)
                let pred = if LOGIT > 0.0 { 1 } else { 0 }
                var bin_target: i64 = 0
                if LABELS[subj as usize] == 2 { bin_target = 1 }
                if pred == bin_target { test_correct = test_correct + 1 }
                test_total = test_total + 1
            }
            subj = subj + 1
        }
        print(" acc="); print_int(test_correct * 100 / test_total); print("%")

        var ai: i64 = 0
        while ai < 8 { SAVED_A[ai as usize] = A[ai as usize]; ai = ai + 1 }

        // Hessian on holdout windows
        var h_count: i64 = 0
        subj = 0
        while subj < SUBJECT_COUNT {
            if SITE_KEYS[subj as usize] == holdout_key {
                ai = 0
                while ai < 8 { A[ai as usize] = SAVED_A[ai as usize]; ai = ai + 1 }
                compute_subject_hessian(subj)
                let od = offdiag_norm()
                let dg = diag_norm()
                let hod = hssm_offdiag_norm()
                let hdg = hssm_diag_norm()
                let lab = LABELS[subj as usize]
                if lab >= 0 && lab < 5 {
                    CLS_OD[lab as usize] = CLS_OD[lab as usize] + od
                    CLS_DG[lab as usize] = CLS_DG[lab as usize] + dg
                    CLS_CT[lab as usize] = CLS_CT[lab as usize] + 1
                    HSSM_OD[lab as usize] = HSSM_OD[lab as usize] + hod
                    HSSM_DG[lab as usize] = HSSM_DG[lab as usize] + hdg
                }

                // Fano lines: (e1,e2,e4), (e2,e3,e5), (e3,e4,e6), (e4,e5,e7), (e5,e6,e1), (e6,e7,e2), (e7,e1,e3)
                if lab == 2 {
                    FANO_ICTAL[0] = FANO_ICTAL[0] + fano_line_energy(1, 2, 4)
                    FANO_ICTAL[1] = FANO_ICTAL[1] + fano_line_energy(2, 3, 5)
                    FANO_ICTAL[2] = FANO_ICTAL[2] + fano_line_energy(3, 4, 6)
                    FANO_ICTAL[3] = FANO_ICTAL[3] + fano_line_energy(4, 5, 7)
                    FANO_ICTAL[4] = FANO_ICTAL[4] + fano_line_energy(5, 6, 1)
                    FANO_ICTAL[5] = FANO_ICTAL[5] + fano_line_energy(6, 7, 2)
                    FANO_ICTAL[6] = FANO_ICTAL[6] + fano_line_energy(7, 1, 3)
                } else if lab == 0 {
                    FANO_BASE[0] = FANO_BASE[0] + fano_line_energy(1, 2, 4)
                    FANO_BASE[1] = FANO_BASE[1] + fano_line_energy(2, 3, 5)
                    FANO_BASE[2] = FANO_BASE[2] + fano_line_energy(3, 4, 6)
                    FANO_BASE[3] = FANO_BASE[3] + fano_line_energy(4, 5, 7)
                    FANO_BASE[4] = FANO_BASE[4] + fano_line_energy(5, 6, 1)
                    FANO_BASE[5] = FANO_BASE[5] + fano_line_energy(6, 7, 2)
                    FANO_BASE[6] = FANO_BASE[6] + fano_line_energy(7, 1, 3)
                } else if lab == 1 {
                    FANO_INTER[0] = FANO_INTER[0] + fano_line_energy(1, 2, 4)
                    FANO_INTER[1] = FANO_INTER[1] + fano_line_energy(2, 3, 5)
                    FANO_INTER[2] = FANO_INTER[2] + fano_line_energy(3, 4, 6)
                    FANO_INTER[3] = FANO_INTER[3] + fano_line_energy(4, 5, 7)
                    FANO_INTER[4] = FANO_INTER[4] + fano_line_energy(5, 6, 1)
                    FANO_INTER[5] = FANO_INTER[5] + fano_line_energy(6, 7, 2)
                    FANO_INTER[6] = FANO_INTER[6] + fano_line_energy(7, 1, 3)
                }

                h_count = h_count + 1
            }
            subj = subj + 1
        }
        print(" n="); print_int(h_count); print("\n")
        fold = fold + 1
    }

    // ═══ RESULTS A: Full 5-class comparison ═══
    println("")
    println("================================================================")
    println("  A. Hessian Off-Diagonal by Clinical Phase")
    println("================================================================")
    println("  Expected gradient: Ictal > Pre > Post > Interictal > Baseline")
    println("")

    var class_names: [i64; 5] = [0; 5]

    ci = 0
    while ci < 5 {
        let c = CLS_CT[ci as usize]
        if ci == 0 { print("  baseline:   ") }
        else if ci == 1 { print("  interictal: ") }
        else if ci == 2 { print("  ictal:      ") }
        else if ci == 3 { print("  pre_ictal:  ") }
        else { print("  post_ictal: ") }
        if c > 0 {
            let mean_od = CLS_OD[ci as usize] / c
            let mean_dg = CLS_DG[ci as usize] / c
            print("||H_od||="); print_int(mean_od)
            print("  ||H_dg||="); print_int(mean_dg)
            print("  n="); print_int(c)
        } else {
            print("(no data)")
        }
        print("\n")
        ci = ci + 1
    }

    // Ratios vs baseline
    let base_c = CLS_CT[0]
    if base_c > 0 {
        let base_od = CLS_OD[0] / base_c
        println("")
        println("  Ratios vs Baseline (x1000):")
        ci = 0
        while ci < 5 {
            let c = CLS_CT[ci as usize]
            if c > 0 && base_od > 0 {
                let mean_od = CLS_OD[ci as usize] / c
                let ratio = mean_od * 1000 / base_od
                if ci == 0 { print("    baseline:   ") }
                else if ci == 1 { print("    interictal: ") }
                else if ci == 2 { print("    ictal:      ") }
                else if ci == 3 { print("    pre_ictal:  ") }
                else { print("    post_ictal: ") }
                print_int(ratio); print("\n")
            }
            ci = ci + 1
        }
    }

    // ═══ RESULTS B: Fano-line decomposition ═══
    println("")
    println("================================================================")
    println("  B. Fano-Line Decomposition (7 Non-Associative Channels)")
    println("================================================================")
    println("  Which non-associative triplets carry the seizure signal?")
    println("")

    let ict_c = CLS_CT[2]
    let bas_c = CLS_CT[0]
    let int_c = CLS_CT[1]

    if ict_c > 0 && bas_c > 0 {
        println("  Line  Tripliet    Ictal/win   Base/win   Ratio")
        println("  ----  ---------   ---------   --------   -----")
        var fl: i64 = 0
        while fl < 7 {
            print("  L"); print_int(fl); print("    ")
            if fl == 0 { print("(e1,e2,e4)  ") }
            else if fl == 1 { print("(e2,e3,e5)  ") }
            else if fl == 2 { print("(e3,e4,e6)  ") }
            else if fl == 3 { print("(e4,e5,e7)  ") }
            else if fl == 4 { print("(e5,e6,e1)  ") }
            else if fl == 5 { print("(e6,e7,e2)  ") }
            else { print("(e7,e1,e3)  ") }
            let ict_mean = FANO_ICTAL[fl as usize] / ict_c
            let bas_mean = FANO_BASE[fl as usize] / bas_c
            print_int(ict_mean); print("    ")
            print_int(bas_mean); print("    ")
            if bas_mean > 0 {
                print_int(ict_mean * 100 / bas_mean); print("%")
            } else {
                print("inf")
            }
            print("\n")
            fl = fl + 1
        }
    }

    // ═══ RESULTS C: O-SSM vs H-SSM ═══
    println("")
    println("================================================================")
    println("  C. O-SSM (Octonion, 8D) vs H-SSM (Quaternion, 4D subspace)")
    println("================================================================")
    println("  If non-associativity matters, O-SSM off-diag should dominate.")
    println("")

    ci = 0
    while ci < 5 {
        let c = CLS_CT[ci as usize]
        if c > 0 {
            let o_od = CLS_OD[ci as usize] / c
            let h_od = HSSM_OD[ci as usize] / c
            let extra = o_od - h_od

            if ci == 0 { print("  baseline:   ") }
            else if ci == 1 { print("  interictal: ") }
            else if ci == 2 { print("  ictal:      ") }
            else if ci == 3 { print("  pre_ictal:  ") }
            else { print("  post_ictal: ") }

            print("O-SSM="); print_int(o_od)
            print("  H-SSM="); print_int(h_od)
            print("  extra_from_octonionic="); print_int(extra)
            if h_od > 0 {
                print(" (+"); print_int(extra * 100 / h_od); print("%)")
            }
            print("\n")
        }
        ci = ci + 1
    }

    println("")
    // Verdict
    let ict_od = if CLS_CT[2] > 0 { CLS_OD[2] / CLS_CT[2] } else { 0 }
    let bas_od = if CLS_CT[0] > 0 { CLS_OD[0] / CLS_CT[0] } else { 1 }
    let int_od = if CLS_CT[1] > 0 { CLS_OD[1] / CLS_CT[1] } else { 0 }
    let pre_od = if CLS_CT[3] > 0 { CLS_OD[3] / CLS_CT[3] } else { 0 }

    if ict_od > int_od && ict_od > bas_od {
        println("  CONFIRMED: Seizure produces highest non-associative curvature")
        if pre_od > int_od {
            println("  BONUS: Pre-ictal > Interictal (pre-seizure buildup detected)")
        }
    } else {
        println("  Result inconclusive at this sample size")
    }

    println("")
    println("DONE")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/seizure_hessian_ossm.sio ===
// Epilepsy O-SSM Hessian: Non-Associative Curvature in Seizure EEG
//
// CHB-MIT Scalp EEG: 8 bipolar channels (fronto-temporal), 8-timestep windows
//   label 0 = baseline  (no seizure in the recording)
//   label 1 = interictal (same recording as seizure, but outside seizure)
//   label 2 = ictal      (during seizure)
//
// Hypothesis: seizure propagation is inherently path-dependent —
// signal cascades A→B→C where order matters, producing (A⊗B)⊗C ≠ A⊗(B⊗C).
// The O-SSM Hessian off-diagonal captures this non-associative curvature.
// Ictal windows should have the highest off-diagonal norm, then interictal,
// then baseline. This gradient reflects the degree of path-dependent
// cortical recruitment.
//
// Training: binary classification (ictal vs non-ictal)
// Diagnosis: per-window 8×8 Hessian of loss w.r.t. A parameter

var FEATURES: [f64; 262144] = [0.0; 262144]
var LABELS: [i64; 4096] = [0; 4096]
var SITE_KEYS: [i64; 4096] = [0; 4096]
var UNIQUE_SITES: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
var UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT: i64 = 0
var SUBJECT_COUNT: i64 = 0

var RNG_A: i64 = 0
var RNG_B: i64 = 0

// Seed offset added for P1.3 seed-robustness sweep.
// Rewritten per run by scripts/research/hessian_seed_sweep/run_sweep.py
// to a distinct value in each seeded copy. Default 0 reproduces the
// original deterministic per-patient seeding.
var SEED_OFFSET: i64 = 0

var W: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
var MOM: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
var H: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]
var A: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
var SAVED_A: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
var ASSOC_ACC: i64 = 0
var LOGIT: f64 = 0.0
var TMP_OCT: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]

var HESS: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]

// Per-class accumulators
var ICTAL_OD_SUM: i64 = 0
var ICTAL_DG_SUM: i64 = 0
var ICTAL_COUNT: i64 = 0
var INTER_OD_SUM: i64 = 0
var INTER_DG_SUM: i64 = 0
var INTER_COUNT: i64 = 0
var BASE_OD_SUM: i64 = 0
var BASE_DG_SUM: i64 = 0
var BASE_COUNT: i64 = 0

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

fn exp_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 15.0 { return exp_q(7.5) * exp_q(x - 7.5) }
    if x < 0.0 - 15.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); sum = sum + term; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}

fn sqrt_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x != x { return 0.0 }
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var g = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 { g = 0.5 * (g + x / g); i = i + 1 }
    if g != g { return 0.0 }
    g
}

fn sigmoid_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x >= 0.0 { 1.0 / (1.0 + exp_q(0.0 - x)) }
    else { let ex = exp_q(x); ex / (1.0 + ex) }
}

fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }
fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A
    let y = RNG_B
    RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23); x = x ^ (x >> 17); x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x
    let r = x + y
    if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}
fn randf() -> f64 with Mut, Div { ((rng_next() % 20000) as f64 - 10000.0) / 10000.0 }

fn print_int(v: i64) with IO, Mut {
    if v < 0 { print("-"); print_int(0 - v); return }
    if v >= 10 { print_int(v / 10) }
    let d = v % 10
    if d==0{print("0")}if d==1{print("1")}if d==2{print("2")}if d==3{print("3")}
    if d==4{print("4")}if d==5{print("5")}if d==6{print("6")}if d==7{print("7")}
    if d==8{print("8")}if d==9{print("9")}
}

// ─── Manifest loading ───

fn load_manifest(path: string) -> i64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    SUBJECT_COUNT = 0
    UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT = 0
    let n = file_size(path)
    if n <= 0 { return 0 }
    let raw = read_file(path)
    let bytes = raw.as_bytes()
    if n < 24 { return -1 }

    var header_start: i64 = 0
    var seeking = true
    while seeking && header_start < n {
        while header_start < n && (bytes[header_start as usize] == 10 || bytes[header_start as usize] == 13) {
            header_start = header_start + 1
        }
        if header_start >= n { seeking = false }
        else if bytes[header_start as usize] == 35 {
            while header_start < n && bytes[header_start as usize] != 10 { header_start = header_start + 1 }
            if header_start < n { header_start = header_start + 1 }
        } else { seeking = false }
    }

    if header_start + 24 >= n ||
       bytes[header_start as usize] != 115 || bytes[(header_start+1) as usize] != 117 ||
       bytes[(header_start+2) as usize] != 98 || bytes[(header_start+3) as usize] != 106 {
        return -1
    }

    var pos: i64 = header_start
    while pos < n && bytes[pos as usize] != 10 { pos = pos + 1 }
    if pos < n { pos = pos + 1 }

    while pos < n && SUBJECT_COUNT < 4096 {
        if bytes[pos as usize] == 10 { pos = pos + 1 }
        else if bytes[pos as usize] == 35 {
            while pos < n && bytes[pos as usize] != 10 { pos = pos + 1 }
            if pos < n { pos = pos + 1 }
        } else {
        var line_end = pos
        while line_end < n && bytes[line_end as usize] != 10 { line_end = line_end + 1 }
        var field_idx: i64 = 0
        var field_start = pos
        var label: i64 = -1
        var site_hash: i64 = 5381
        var feature_idx: i64 = 0
        var i = pos
        while i <= line_end {
            let is_end = i == line_end
            let is_tab = if is_end { false } else { bytes[i as usize] == 9 }
            if is_end || is_tab {
                if field_idx == 1 {
                    if i > field_start {
                        let b = bytes[field_start as usize]
                        if b == 48 { label = 0 }
                        else if b == 49 { label = 1 }
                        else if b == 50 { label = 2 }
                    }
                } else if field_idx == 2 {
                    var si = field_start
                    while si < i { site_hash = site_hash * 33 + (bytes[si as usize] as i64); si = si + 1 }
                } else if field_idx >= 3 && feature_idx < 64 {
                    var val: f64 = 0.0
                    var neg = false
                    var seen_dot = false
                    var frac_scale = 1.0
                    var si = field_start
                    if si < i && bytes[si as usize] == 45 { neg = true; si = si + 1 }
                    while si < i {
                        let b = bytes[si as usize]
                        if b == 46 { seen_dot = true }
                        else if b >= 48 && b <= 57 {
                            if !seen_dot { val = val * 10.0 + ((b - 48) as f64) }
                            else { frac_scale = frac_scale * 0.1; val = val + frac_scale * ((b - 48) as f64) }
                        }
                        si = si + 1
                    }
                    if neg { val = 0.0 - val }
                    FEATURES[(SUBJECT_COUNT * 64 + feature_idx) as usize] = val
                    feature_idx = feature_idx + 1
                }
                field_idx = field_idx + 1
                field_start = i + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        if label >= 0 && feature_idx >= 8 {
            LABELS[SUBJECT_COUNT as usize] = label
            SITE_KEYS[SUBJECT_COUNT as usize] = site_hash
            SUBJECT_COUNT = SUBJECT_COUNT + 1
        }
        pos = line_end + 1
        }
    }
    SUBJECT_COUNT
}

fn discover_sites() -> i64 with Mut {
    UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT = 0
    var subj: i64 = 0
    while subj < SUBJECT_COUNT {
        let key = SITE_KEYS[subj as usize]
        var exists: i64 = 0
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT { if UNIQUE_SITES[i as usize] == key { exists = 1; break }; i = i + 1 }
        if exists == 0 && UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT < 64 {
            UNIQUE_SITES[UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT as usize] = key
            UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT = UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT + 1
        }
        subj = subj + 1
    }
    UNIQUE_SITE_COUNT
}

// ─── Model ───

fn ws(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { W[i as usize] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn wg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (W[i as usize] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn hs(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { H[i as usize] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn hg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (H[i as usize] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn assoc_s(v: f64) with Mut { ASSOC_ACC = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn assoc_g() -> f64 with Div { (ASSOC_ACC as f64) / 100000000.0 }

fn init_model() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 10 { ws(i, randf() / 6.0); MOM[i as usize] = 0; i = i + 1 }
    var nsq = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { A[i as usize] = randf(); nsq = nsq + A[i as usize] * A[i as usize]; i = i + 1 }
    let n = sqrt_q(nsq)
    i = 0
    while i < 8 {
        if n > 0.000000001 { A[i as usize] = A[i as usize] / n }
        else if i == 0 { A[i as usize] = 1.0 } else { A[i as usize] = 0.0 }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn reset_state() with Mut {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 { H[i as usize] = 0; i = i + 1 }
    hs(0, 1.0)
    ASSOC_ACC = 0
    LOGIT = 0.0
}

fn do_oct_mul(
    a0: f64, a1: f64, a2: f64, a3: f64, a4: f64, a5: f64, a6: f64, a7: f64,
    b0: f64, b1: f64, b2: f64, b3: f64, b4: f64, b5: f64, b6: f64, b7: f64
) with Mut {
    TMP_OCT[0] = a0*b0 - a1*b1 - a2*b2 - a3*b3 - a4*b4 - a5*b5 - a6*b6 - a7*b7
    TMP_OCT[1] = a0*b1 + a1*b0 + a2*b3 - a3*b2 + a4*b5 - a5*b4 - a6*b7 + a7*b6
    TMP_OCT[2] = a0*b2 + a2*b0 - a1*b3 + a3*b1 + a4*b6 - a6*b4 + a5*b7 - a7*b5
    TMP_OCT[3] = a0*b3 + a3*b0 + a1*b2 - a2*b1 + a4*b7 - a7*b4 - a5*b6 + a6*b5
    TMP_OCT[4] = a0*b4 + a4*b0 - a1*b5 + a5*b1 - a2*b6 + a6*b2 - a3*b7 + a7*b3
    TMP_OCT[5] = a0*b5 + a5*b0 + a1*b4 - a4*b1 - a2*b7 + a7*b2 + a3*b6 - a6*b3
    TMP_OCT[6] = a0*b6 + a6*b0 + a1*b7 - a7*b1 + a2*b4 - a4*b2 - a3*b5 + a5*b3
    TMP_OCT[7] = a0*b7 + a7*b0 - a1*b6 + a6*b1 - a2*b5 + a5*b2 + a3*b4 - a4*b3
}

fn oct_step(x0: f64, x1: f64, x2: f64, x3: f64, x4: f64, x5: f64, x6: f64, x7: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    do_oct_mul(A[0],A[1],A[2],A[3],A[4],A[5],A[6],A[7], hg(0),hg(1),hg(2),hg(3),hg(4),hg(5),hg(6),hg(7))
    let t0=TMP_OCT[0]; let t1=TMP_OCT[1]; let t2=TMP_OCT[2]; let t3=TMP_OCT[3]
    let t4=TMP_OCT[4]; let t5=TMP_OCT[5]; let t6=TMP_OCT[6]; let t7=TMP_OCT[7]
    do_oct_mul(t0,t1,t2,t3,t4,t5,t6,t7, x0,x1,x2,x3,x4,x5,x6,x7)
    var left: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    var d: i64 = 0
    while d < 8 { left[d as usize] = TMP_OCT[d as usize]; d = d + 1 }
    do_oct_mul(hg(0),hg(1),hg(2),hg(3),hg(4),hg(5),hg(6),hg(7), x0,x1,x2,x3,x4,x5,x6,x7)
    let hx0=TMP_OCT[0]; let hx1=TMP_OCT[1]; let hx2=TMP_OCT[2]; let hx3=TMP_OCT[3]
    let hx4=TMP_OCT[4]; let hx5=TMP_OCT[5]; let hx6=TMP_OCT[6]; let hx7=TMP_OCT[7]
    do_oct_mul(A[0],A[1],A[2],A[3],A[4],A[5],A[6],A[7], hx0,hx1,hx2,hx3,hx4,hx5,hx6,hx7)
    var asq = 0.0
    d = 0
    while d < 8 { let diff = left[d as usize] - TMP_OCT[d as usize]; asq = asq + diff*diff; d = d + 1 }
    var assoc_step = sqrt_q(asq)
    if assoc_step != assoc_step { assoc_step = 0.0 }
    if assoc_step > 1000.0 { assoc_step = 1000.0 }
    assoc_s(assoc_g() + assoc_step)
    d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var v = left[d as usize] + 0.2 * TMP_OCT[d as usize]
        if v != v { v = 0.0 }
        if v > 5.0 { v = 5.0 } if v < 0.0 - 5.0 { v = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        hs(d, v)
        d = d + 1
    }
}

fn forward_subject(subj: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    reset_state()
    let base = subj * 64
    var step: i64 = 0
    while step < 8 {
        let off = base + step * 8
        oct_step(
            FEATURES[off as usize], FEATURES[(off+1) as usize],
            FEATURES[(off+2) as usize], FEATURES[(off+3) as usize],
            FEATURES[(off+4) as usize], FEATURES[(off+5) as usize],
            FEATURES[(off+6) as usize], FEATURES[(off+7) as usize]
        )
        step = step + 1
    }
    var af = assoc_g() / 8.0
    if af != af { af = 0.0 }
    assoc_s(af)
    var s = wg(9)
    var d: i64 = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var proj = hg(d) * wg(d)
        if proj != proj { proj = 0.0 }
        s = s + proj
        d = d + 1
    }
    var ap = af * wg(8)
    if ap != ap { ap = 0.0 }
    LOGIT = s + ap
}

fn update_binary(target: i64, lr: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let prob = sigmoid_q(LOGIT)
    var grad = prob - (target as f64)
    if grad > 0.5 { grad = 0.5 } if grad < 0.0 - 0.5 { grad = 0.0 - 0.5 }
    var d: i64 = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let g = hg(d) * grad
        let m = (MOM[d as usize] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + g
        MOM[d as usize] = (m * 100000000.0) as i64
        ws(d, wg(d) - lr * m)
        d = d + 1
    }
    let ag = assoc_g() * grad
    let am = (MOM[8] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + ag
    MOM[8] = (am * 100000000.0) as i64
    ws(8, wg(8) - lr * am)
    let bm = (MOM[9] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + grad
    MOM[9] = (bm * 100000000.0) as i64
    ws(9, wg(9) - lr * bm)
}

// ─── Hessian per window ───

fn compute_loss_subj(subj: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    forward_subject(subj)
    let prob = sigmoid_q(LOGIT)
    // Binary target: ictal (label 2) → 1, else → 0
    var target = 0.0
    if LABELS[subj as usize] == 2 { target = 1.0 }
    0.0 - (target * prob + (1.0 - target) * (1.0 - prob))
}

fn compute_subject_hessian(subj: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let eps = 0.001
    let eps2 = eps * eps
    let f0 = compute_loss_subj(subj)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 {
        let orig_i = A[i as usize]
        A[i as usize] = orig_i + eps
        let fip = compute_loss_subj(subj)
        A[i as usize] = orig_i - eps
        let fim = compute_loss_subj(subj)
        A[i as usize] = orig_i
        HESS[i * 8 + i] = ((fip - 2.0 * f0 + fim) / eps2 * 1000000.0) as i64
        var j = i + 1
        while j < 8 {
