            if row != col {
                let f = A[row*4 + col]
                var qq: i64 = 0
                while qq < 4 {
                    A[row*4+qq] = A[row*4+qq] - f*A[col*4+qq]
                    Inv[row*4+qq] = Inv[row*4+qq] - f*Inv[col*4+qq]
                    qq = qq + 1
                }
            }
            row = row + 1
        }
        col = col + 1
    }
    let num = 0.0 - Inv[0*4 + 1]
    let den = kc_sqrt(Inv[0]*Inv[5])
    if den <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    num / den
}

// AUC of score C (higher = more likely class1) via rank statistic.
fn auc_from(score: &[f64; 1024], cls: &[i64; 1024], n: i64, rscore: &![f64; 1024]) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    rank_into(score, n, rscore)
    var sum_pos = 0.0; var npos = 0.0; var nneg = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        if cls[i] == 1 { sum_pos = sum_pos + rscore[i]; npos = npos + 1.0 } else { nneg = nneg + 1.0 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if npos <= 0.0 || nneg <= 0.0 { return 0.5 }
    (sum_pos - npos*(npos+1.0)/2.0) / (npos*nneg)
}

fn mean_of(x: &[f64; 1024], n: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    var s = 0.0; var i: i64 = 0; while i < n { s = s + x[i]; i = i + 1 }; s / (n as f64)
}

fn print_kv(k: string, v: f64) with IO { print(k); print("="); print(v); println("") }

fn main() -> i64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_words = fx_n_words()
    let stride = fx_stride()
    let S = fx_n_subj()
    let nE = fx_n_edges()
    let nEv = fx_n_edges_vad()

    var ei: [i64; 6144] = [0; 6144]; var ej: [i64; 6144] = [0; 6144]; var ew: [f64; 6144] = [0.0; 6144]
    var vi: [i64; 6144] = [0; 6144]; var vj: [i64; 6144] = [0; 6144]; var vw: [f64; 6144] = [0.0; 6144]
    var valence: [f64; 512] = [0.0; 512]
    var field: [i64; 8192] = [0; 8192]
    var phq: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var cls: [i64; 1024] = [0; 1024]
    load_ei(&!ei); load_ej(&!ej); load_ew(&!ew)
    load_vi(&!vi); load_vj(&!vj); load_vw(&!vw)
    load_valence(&!valence); load_field(&!field)
    load_phq(&!phq); load_phqclass(&!cls)

    // per-subject metrics
    var C: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var Cvad: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var prox: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var vbias: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var s: i64 = 0
    while s < S {
        let base = s * stride
        C[s] = compute_C(&ei, &ej, &ew, nE, &field, base, n_words)
        Cvad[s] = compute_C(&vi, &vj, &vw, nEv, &field, base, n_words)
        let ndist = popcount_distal(&field, base, stride)
        prox[s] = ((n_words - ndist) as f64) / (n_words as f64)
        vbias[s] = valence_bias(&field, base, &valence, n_words)
        s = s + 1
    }

    println("=== KEC-alpha per-subject summary ===")
    print_kv("n_subjects", S as f64)
    print_kv("C_mean", mean_of(&C, S))
    print_kv("Cvad_mean", mean_of(&Cvad, S))
    print_kv("prox_frac_mean", mean_of(&prox, S))
    print_kv("vbias_mean", mean_of(&vbias, S))
    print_kv("phq_mean", mean_of(&phq, S))

    // scratch rank buffers
    var rx: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]; var ry: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]

    // primary (uncontrolled) Spearman C vs PHQ9
    let rho = spearman(&C, &phq, S, &!rx, &!ry)
    println("=== primary correlations ===")
    print_kv("spearman_C_phq", rho)
    print_kv("spearman_Cvad_phq", spearman(&Cvad, &phq, S, &!rx, &!ry))
    print_kv("spearman_prox_phq", spearman(&prox, &phq, S, &!rx, &!ry))
    print_kv("spearman_vbias_phq", spearman(&vbias, &phq, S, &!rx, &!ry))
    print_kv("spearman_C_vbias", spearman(&C, &vbias, S, &!rx, &!ry))

    // partial Spearman: r(C, phq | prox, vbias). Rank all 4 into rc flat buffer.
    var rc: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    rank_into(&C, S, &!rx);    var t: i64 = 0; while t < S { rc[0*1024+t]=rx[t]; t=t+1 }
    rank_into(&phq, S, &!rx);  t = 0; while t < S { rc[1*1024+t]=rx[t]; t=t+1 }
    rank_into(&prox, S, &!rx); t = 0; while t < S { rc[2*1024+t]=rx[t]; t=t+1 }
    rank_into(&vbias, S, &!rx);t = 0; while t < S { rc[3*1024+t]=rx[t]; t=t+1 }
    let rpart = partial_spearman4(&rc, S)
    print_kv("partial_spearman_C_phq_given_prox_vbias", rpart)

    // permutation null on the partial statistic: shuffle PHQ labels, recompute |rpart|.
    var seed: i64 = 1234567
    let B: i64 = 500
    var ge: i64 = 0
    var phqp: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var bi: i64 = 0
    while bi < B {
        // copy then Fisher-Yates shuffle phq into phqp using LCG
        t = 0; while t < S { phqp[t] = phq[t]; t = t + 1 }
        var k: i64 = S - 1
        while k > 0 {
            seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) & 2147483647
            let j = seed % (k + 1)
            let tmp = phqp[k]; phqp[k] = phqp[j]; phqp[j] = tmp
            k = k - 1
        }
        rank_into(&phqp, S, &!rx); t = 0; while t < S { rc[1*1024+t]=rx[t]; t=t+1 }
        let rp = partial_spearman4(&rc, S)
        if kc_abs(rp) >= kc_abs(rpart) { ge = ge + 1 }
        bi = bi + 1
    }
    // restore phq ranks not needed further
    let pval = ((ge + 1) as f64) / ((B + 1) as f64)
    print_kv("perm_p_two_sided", pval)
    print_kv("perm_B", B as f64)

    // C as classifier of PHQ9_class
    let auc = auc_from(&C, &cls, S, &!rx)
    print_kv("auc_C_phqclass", auc)

    println("KEC_ALPHA_DONE")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/semantic_orc/dct_kec_core.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//! KEC-alpha CORE — semantic-coherence-of-egocentric-distance, metric C.
//!
//! Setup: a fixed semantic graph over N words (edges (i,j) with cosine weight w_ij), and a
//! per-subject binary field s in {-1,+1} = the proximal/distal demonstrative choice per word.
//!
//! Primary metric (graph-signal smoothness / weighted partition cut):
//!     C = ( sum_{(i,j) in E} w_ij (s_i - s_j)^2 ) / ( sum_i s_i^2 )
//! Since s in {-1,+1}: (s_i - s_j)^2 = 0 if equal, 4 if different, and sum_i s_i^2 = N. Hence
//!     C = 4 * (weight of semantic edges cut by the proximal/distal partition) / N.
//! Low C  = the proximal/distal boundary respects semantic clusters (COHERENT assignment).
//! High C = the boundary slices through semantically-similar words (FRAGMENTED assignment).
//!
//! The field is bit-packed: bit v (in word v>>6, position v&63) is 1 for "that"(distal) else
//! 0 for "this"(proximal). A graph edge is "cut" iff its two endpoint bits differ. Sign of the
//! ±1 coding is irrelevant to C (squared difference), so the bit convention is free.
//!
//! This file is the hand-checkable core; the full two-wave fixtures splice their data into the
//! generated dct_kec_wave{1,2}.sio and reuse compute_C / field_bit verbatim.

fn et_abs(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

// bit of node v from a packed field array (stride: words of 64 bits).
fn field_bit(field: &[i64; 64], v: i64) -> i64 {
    let word = field[v >> 6]
    (word >> (v & 63)) & 1
}

// C = 4 * (cut weight) / n_words, over the shared edge list.
fn compute_C(ei: &[i64; 16], ej: &[i64; 16], ew: &[f64; 16], n_edges: i64,
             field: &[i64; 64], n_words: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var cut = 0.0
    var e: i64 = 0
    while e < n_edges {
        let bi = field_bit(field, ei[e])
        let bj = field_bit(field, ej[e])
        if bi != bj { cut = cut + ew[e] }
        e = e + 1
    }
    (4.0 * cut) / (n_words as f64)
}

fn approx(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> bool { et_abs(a - b) <= tol }

fn main() -> i64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Path graph on 4 nodes: edges (0,1),(1,2),(2,3), all weight 1.0.
    var ei: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
    var ej: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
    var ew: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    ei[0] = 0; ej[0] = 1; ew[0] = 1.0
    ei[1] = 1; ej[1] = 2; ew[1] = 1.0
    ei[2] = 2; ej[2] = 3; ew[2] = 1.0
    let n_edges: i64 = 3
    let n_words: i64 = 4

    // field A: all 0 (all proximal) -> no cut -> C = 0.
    var fa: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    let ca = compute_C(&ei, &ej, &ew, n_edges, &fa, n_words)
    print("C_all_same="); print(ca); println("")

    // field B: 0,1,0,1 (checkerboard) -> all 3 edges cut -> C = 4*3/4 = 3.0.
    var fb: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    fb[0] = 10            // binary ...1010 : bit0=0, bit1=1, bit2=0, bit3=1
    let cb = compute_C(&ei, &ej, &ew, n_edges, &fb, n_words)
    print("C_checker="); print(cb); println("")

    // field C: 0,0,1,1 -> only edge (1,2) cut -> C = 4*1/4 = 1.0.
    var fc: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    fc[0] = 12           // binary ...1100 : bit0=0, bit1=0, bit2=1, bit3=1
    let cc = compute_C(&ei, &ej, &ew, n_edges, &fc, n_words)
    print("C_block="); print(cc); println("")

    if approx(ca, 0.0, 1e-9) && approx(cb, 3.0, 1e-9) && approx(cc, 1.0, 1e-9) {
        println("KEC_CORE_PASS")
        0
    } else {
        println("KEC_CORE_FAIL")
        1
    }
}


// === FILE: examples/semantic_orc/dct_kec_spectral.sio ===
//! ORIGINAL KEC (spectral half) on the DCT — E = von Neumann spectral entropy, C = lambda2.
//! Concatenated after a generated dct_kec_wave{N}_data.sio. Reuses the verified Jacobi idiom from
//! kec_spectral.sio, generalized to N up to 288 (max proximal-set size observed = 286).
//!
//! Per subject: build the PROXIMAL-INDUCED subgraph of the shared embedding graph (nodes = words the
//! subject chose "this"; edges = embedding kNN edges with both endpoints proximal, original weights),
//! then compute E = von Neumann spectral entropy of its Laplacian (normalized by ln m) and
//! C = lambda2 (algebraic connectivity). One Laplacian array allocated once in main, reused per subject.
//!
//! The eigensolver is self-verified on K12 / C8 / K20 closed forms BEFORE any real data each run.

fn ks_abs(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }
fn ks_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x; var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 40 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}
fn ks_ln(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return -1000000.0 }
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var v = x; var k: i64 = 0
    while v > 2.0 { v = v / 2.0; k = k + 1 }
    while v < 1.0 { v = v * 2.0; k = k - 1 }
    let y = (v - 1.0) / (v + 1.0); let yy = y * y
    var result = 0.0; var power = y; var i: i64 = 1
    while i <= 29 { result = result + power / (i as f64); power = power * yy; i = i + 2 }
    2.0 * result + (k as f64) * ln2
}

// Jacobi cyclic eigenvalue solver on symmetric L (row-major stride n) into eig[0..n) ascending.
fn jacobi_eig(L: &![f64; 82944], n: i64, eig: &![f64; 288], sweeps: i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sweep: i64 = 0
    while sweep < sweeps {
        var p: i64 = 0
        while p < n {
            var q: i64 = p + 1
            while q < n {
                let apq = L[p * n + q]
                if ks_abs(apq) > 1e-12 {
                    let app = L[p * n + p]; let aqq = L[q * n + q]
                    let theta = (aqq - app) / (2.0 * apq)
                    let denom = ks_abs(theta) + ks_sqrt(theta * theta + 1.0)
                    var t = 1.0 / denom
                    if theta < 0.0 { t = 0.0 - t }
                    let c = 1.0 / ks_sqrt(t * t + 1.0); let s = t * c
                    var kk: i64 = 0
                    while kk < n {
                        let lkp = L[kk * n + p]; let lkq = L[kk * n + q]
                        L[kk * n + p] = c * lkp - s * lkq
                        L[kk * n + q] = s * lkp + c * lkq
                        kk = kk + 1
                    }
                    kk = 0
                    while kk < n {
                        let lpk = L[p * n + kk]; let lqk = L[q * n + kk]
                        L[p * n + kk] = c * lpk - s * lqk
                        L[q * n + kk] = s * lpk + c * lqk
                        kk = kk + 1
                    }
                }
                q = q + 1
            }
            p = p + 1
        }
        sweep = sweep + 1
    }
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n { eig[i] = L[i * n + i]; i = i + 1 }
    // insertion sort ascending
    i = 1
    while i < n {
        let key = eig[i]; var j: i64 = i - 1
        while j >= 0 && eig[j] > key { eig[j + 1] = eig[j]; j = j - 1 }
        eig[j + 1] = key; i = i + 1
    }
}

// von Neumann entropy (normalized by ln n) and lambda2 from a sorted spectrum.
fn entropy_norm(eig: &[f64; 288], n: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var total = 0.0; var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n { if eig[i] > 1e-9 { total = total + eig[i] }; i = i + 1 }
    if total <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var S = 0.0; i = 0
    while i < n { if eig[i] > 1e-9 { let pi = eig[i] / total; S = S - pi * ks_ln(pi) } ; i = i + 1 }
    if n <= 1 { return 0.0 }
    S / ks_ln(n as f64)
}

// build a test graph Laplacian (mode 0 = K_n, mode 1 = C_n) into L (stride n).
fn build_test(mode: i64, n: i64, L: &![f64; 82944]) with Mut {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < n {
            var a = 0.0
            if i != j {
                if mode == 0 { a = 1.0 }
                else { let d1 = if i > j { i - j } else { j - i }; if d1 == 1 || d1 == (n - 1) { a = 1.0 } }
            }
            L[i * n + j] = 0.0 - a
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        var deg = 0.0; var j: i64 = 0
        while j < n { if j != i { deg = deg - L[i * n + j] }; j = j + 1 }
        L[i * n + i] = deg; i = i + 1
    }
}

// ---- cross-subject stats (sized for S up to 1024) ----
fn rank_into(x: &[f64; 1024], n: i64, r: &![f64; 1024]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        var less = 0.0; var eq = 0.0; var j: i64 = 0
        while j < n {
            if x[j] < x[i] { less = less + 1.0 } else { if x[j] == x[i] { eq = eq + 1.0 } }
            j = j + 1
        }
        r[i] = less + (eq + 1.0) / 2.0; i = i + 1
    }
}
fn pearson(a: &[f64; 1024], b: &[f64; 1024], n: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sx=0.0; var sy=0.0; var sxx=0.0; var syy=0.0; var sxy=0.0; var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n { sx=sx+a[i]; sy=sy+b[i]; sxx=sxx+a[i]*a[i]; syy=syy+b[i]*b[i]; sxy=sxy+a[i]*b[i]; i=i+1 }
    let nf = n as f64; let cov = nf*sxy - sx*sy
    let dx = ks_sqrt(nf*sxx - sx*sx); let dy = ks_sqrt(nf*syy - sy*sy)
    if dx <= 0.0 || dy <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    cov / (dx*dy)
}
fn spearman(x: &[f64; 1024], y: &[f64; 1024], n: i64, rx: &![f64; 1024], ry: &![f64; 1024]) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    rank_into(x, n, rx); rank_into(y, n, ry); pearson(rx, ry, n)
}
fn partial_spearman4(rc: &[f64; 4096], n: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var M: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]; var a: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]; var b: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var ci: i64 = 0
    while ci < 4 {
        var cj: i64 = 0
        while cj < 4 {
            var t: i64 = 0; while t < n { a[t]=rc[ci*1024+t]; b[t]=rc[cj*1024+t]; t=t+1 }
            M[ci*4+cj] = pearson(&a, &b, n); cj = cj + 1
        }
        ci = ci + 1
    }
    var A: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]; var Inv: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var p: i64 = 0; while p < 16 { A[p]=M[p]; p=p+1 }
    p = 0; while p < 4 { var q: i64 = 0; while q < 4 { Inv[p*4+q] = if p==q {1.0} else {0.0}; q=q+1 }; p=p+1 }
    var col: i64 = 0
    while col < 4 {
        let piv = A[col*4+col]; let ipv = if ks_abs(piv) > 1e-12 { 1.0/piv } else { 0.0 }
        var q: i64 = 0; while q < 4 { A[col*4+q]=A[col*4+q]*ipv; Inv[col*4+q]=Inv[col*4+q]*ipv; q=q+1 }
        var row: i64 = 0
        while row < 4 {
            if row != col {
                let f = A[row*4+col]; var qq: i64 = 0
                while qq < 4 { A[row*4+qq]=A[row*4+qq]-f*A[col*4+qq]; Inv[row*4+qq]=Inv[row*4+qq]-f*Inv[col*4+qq]; qq=qq+1 }
            }
            row = row + 1
        }
        col = col + 1
    }
    let num = 0.0 - Inv[1]; let den = ks_sqrt(Inv[0]*Inv[5])
    if den <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    num / den
}
fn mean_of(x: &[f64; 1024], n: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div { var s=0.0; var i: i64 = 0; while i < n { s=s+x[i]; i=i+1 }; s/(n as f64) }
fn print_kv(k: string, v: f64) with IO { print(k); print("="); print(v); println("") }

fn field_bit(field: &[i64; 8192], base: i64, v: i64) -> i64 { (field[base + (v >> 6)] >> (v & 63)) & 1 }

fn main() -> i64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    // ---- self-verify the generalized eigensolver ----
    var L: [f64; 82944] = [0.0; 82944]
    var eig: [f64; 288] = [0.0; 288]
    build_test(0, 12, &!L); jacobi_eig(&!L, 12, &!eig, 40)
    let k12_l2 = eig[1]; let k12_s = entropy_norm(&eig, 12)
    build_test(1, 8, &!L); jacobi_eig(&!L, 8, &!eig, 40)
    let c8_l2 = eig[1]
    build_test(0, 20, &!L); jacobi_eig(&!L, 20, &!eig, 40)
    let k20_l2 = eig[1]
    let ln11 = 2.3978952727983707
    let verify_ok = ks_abs(k12_l2 - 12.0) < 1e-2 && ks_abs(k12_s - ln11/ks_ln(12.0)) < 1e-2
                    && ks_abs(c8_l2 - 0.5857864376) < 1e-2 && ks_abs(k20_l2 - 20.0) < 1e-2
    print("eigensolver_verify K12_l2="); print(k12_l2); print(" C8_l2="); print(c8_l2)
    print(" K20_l2="); print(k20_l2); println("")
    if !verify_ok { println("EIGENSOLVER_VERIFY_FAIL"); return 1 }
    println("eigensolver_verify=PASS")

    // ---- load fixture ----
    let n_words = fx_n_words(); let stride = fx_stride(); let S = fx_n_subj(); let nE = fx_n_edges()
    var ei: [i64; 6144] = [0; 6144]; var ej: [i64; 6144] = [0; 6144]; var ew: [f64; 6144] = [0.0; 6144]
    var valence: [f64; 512] = [0.0; 512]; var field: [i64; 8192] = [0; 8192]
    var phq: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]; var cls: [i64; 1024] = [0; 1024]
    load_ei(&!ei); load_ej(&!ej); load_ew(&!ew); load_valence(&!valence); load_field(&!field)
    load_phq(&!phq); load_phqclass(&!cls)

    // per-subject spectral E, C on the proximal-induced subgraph
    var Evn: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var Cl2: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var prox: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var Psz: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var local: [i64; 512] = [0; 512]   // global word -> local index, or -1
    var s: i64 = 0
    while s < S {
        let base = s * stride
        // assign local indices to proximal words (bit==0)
        var m: i64 = 0; var w: i64 = 0
        while w < n_words {
            if field_bit(&field, base, w) == 0 { local[w] = m; m = m + 1 } else { local[w] = -1 }
            w = w + 1
        }
        prox[s] = (m as f64) / (n_words as f64); Psz[s] = m as f64
        // zero m x m Laplacian
        var z: i64 = 0; let mm = m * m
        while z < mm { L[z] = 0.0; z = z + 1 }
        // accumulate induced edges (both endpoints proximal)
        var e: i64 = 0
        while e < nE {
            let a = local[ei[e]]; let b = local[ej[e]]
            if a >= 0 && b >= 0 {
                let wv = ew[e]
                L[a * m + b] = L[a * m + b] - wv
                L[b * m + a] = L[b * m + a] - wv
                L[a * m + a] = L[a * m + a] + wv
                L[b * m + b] = L[b * m + b] + wv
            }
            e = e + 1
        }
        if m >= 2 {
            jacobi_eig(&!L, m, &!eig, 30)
            Evn[s] = entropy_norm(&eig, m)
            Cl2[s] = eig[1]
        } else { Evn[s] = 0.0; Cl2[s] = 0.0 }
        s = s + 1
    }

    println("=== original-KEC spectral (proximal-induced subgraph) ===")
    print_kv("n_subjects", S as f64)
    print_kv("E_vonneumann_mean", mean_of(&Evn, S))
    print_kv("C_lambda2_mean", mean_of(&Cl2, S))
    print_kv("prox_size_mean", mean_of(&Psz, S))

    var rx: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]; var ry: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    // valence_bias per subject (reuse field): corr(s, valence)
    var vbias: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    s = 0
    while s < S {
        let base = s * stride
        var nn=0.0; var sx=0.0; var sy=0.0; var sxx=0.0; var syy=0.0; var sxy=0.0; var w: i64 = 0
        while w < n_words {
            let val = valence[w]
            if val < 900.0 {
                let sv = if field_bit(&field, base, w) == 1 { 1.0 } else { -1.0 }
                nn=nn+1.0; sx=sx+sv; sy=sy+val; sxx=sxx+sv*sv; syy=syy+val*val; sxy=sxy+sv*val
            }
            w = w + 1
        }
        let cov = nn*sxy - sx*sy; let dx = ks_sqrt(nn*sxx-sx*sx); let dy = ks_sqrt(nn*syy-sy*sy)
        vbias[s] = if dx>0.0 && dy>0.0 { cov/(dx*dy) } else { 0.0 }
        s = s + 1
    }

    println("=== correlations vs PHQ9 ===")
    print_kv("spearman_E_phq", spearman(&Evn, &phq, S, &!rx, &!ry))
    print_kv("spearman_C_phq", spearman(&Cl2, &phq, S, &!rx, &!ry))
    print_kv("spearman_E_psize", spearman(&Evn, &Psz, S, &!rx, &!ry))
    print_kv("spearman_C_psize", spearman(&Cl2, &Psz, S, &!rx, &!ry))

    // partial spearman for E and for C, controlling {prox, vbias}
    var rc: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var t: i64 = 0
    rank_into(&prox, S, &!rx); t=0; while t<S { rc[2*1024+t]=rx[t]; t=t+1 }
    rank_into(&vbias, S, &!rx); t=0; while t<S { rc[3*1024+t]=rx[t]; t=t+1 }
    rank_into(&phq, S, &!rx); t=0; while t<S { rc[1*1024+t]=rx[t]; t=t+1 }
    rank_into(&Evn, S, &!rx); t=0; while t<S { rc[0*1024+t]=rx[t]; t=t+1 }
    let rpart_E = partial_spearman4(&rc, S)
    print_kv("partial_E_phq_given_prox_vbias", rpart_E)
    rank_into(&Cl2, S, &!rx); t=0; while t<S { rc[0*1024+t]=rx[t]; t=t+1 }
    let rpart_C = partial_spearman4(&rc, S)
    print_kv("partial_C_phq_given_prox_vbias", rpart_C)

    // permutation null on the larger of the two partials (by |.|)
    let target = if ks_abs(rpart_E) >= ks_abs(rpart_C) { rpart_E } else { rpart_C }
    let useE = ks_abs(rpart_E) >= ks_abs(rpart_C)
    // rebuild rc col0 with the chosen metric
    if useE { rank_into(&Evn, S, &!rx) } else { rank_into(&Cl2, S, &!rx) }
    t=0; while t<S { rc[0*1024+t]=rx[t]; t=t+1 }
    var seed: i64 = 1234567; let B: i64 = 500; var ge: i64 = 0
    var phqp: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]; var bi: i64 = 0
    while bi < B {
        t=0; while t<S { phqp[t]=phq[t]; t=t+1 }
        var k: i64 = S - 1
        while k > 0 {
            seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) & 2147483647
            let j = seed % (k + 1)
            let tmp = phqp[k]; phqp[k] = phqp[j]; phqp[j] = tmp
            k = k - 1
        }
        rank_into(&phqp, S, &!rx); t=0; while t<S { rc[1*1024+t]=rx[t]; t=t+1 }
        let rp = partial_spearman4(&rc, S)
        if ks_abs(rp) >= ks_abs(target) { ge = ge + 1 }
        bi = bi + 1
    }
    let pval = ((ge + 1) as f64) / ((B + 1) as f64)
    print("perm_target="); if useE { print("E") } else { print("C") }; println("")
    print_kv("perm_p_two_sided", pval)

    println("KEC_SPECTRAL_DONE")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/semantic_orc/dct_kec_wave1_data.sio ===
//! GENERATED by scripts/research/dct_kec_fixture.py — wave 1. DO NOT EDIT.
//! N_words=290 stride=5 S=775 emb_edges=2030 vad_edges=1831

fn fx_n_words() -> i64 { 290 }
fn fx_stride() -> i64 { 5 }
fn fx_n_subj() -> i64 { 775 }
fn fx_n_edges() -> i64 { 2030 }
fn fx_n_edges_vad() -> i64 { 1831 }

// === FILE: examples/semantic_orc/depression_epistemic_orc.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// depression_epistemic_orc.sio — EPISTEMIC LAYER over exact-OT semantic curvature
//
// Sounio does NOT recompute optimal transport here (infeasible on N=1634..3089 graphs).
// It ingests exact-OT per-edge curvatures (Wasserstein-1, POT network simplex, validated
// bit-exact vs Julia/HiGHS) and computes the epistemic layer natively:
//   - LCG bootstrap CI of mean curvature over a 256-edge real sample
//   - z-score vs degree-preserving (Maslov-Sneppen) null
//   - GCI = fraction of |kappa| > 2 sigma
//   - confidence gate on the density-matched severity separation
//
// Real exact-OT inputs (hyperbolic-semantic-networks, depression_networks_optimal):
//   group     kappa_real  null_mean  z        matched_kappa (N~1500, <k>~10.1)
//   minimum   -0.1303     -0.2642    266.8    -0.1776 +/- 0.0032   [most hyperbolic]
//   moderate  -0.0871     -0.1281    194.8    -0.1672 +/- 0.0037
//   severe    -0.0783     -0.1082    196.1    -0.1560 +/- 0.0049
//   mild      -0.0742     -0.1004     55.3    -0.1453 +/- 0.0064   [least hyperbolic]
//
// FINDING: raw kappa correlates r=0.991 with mean degree (density confound), but at matched
// density all 6 pairwise CIs separate and the rank is preserved — subclinical (minimum) is
// the most hyperbolic group, a genuine residual structural effect.
//
// AUTHORITY BOUNDARY: real semantic-network data, no clinical claims, no diagnostic use.
// Presentations: Hong Kong Digital Mental Health (Jun 14 2026); Yale CPC (Jul 2026).


// ============================================================================
fn abs_e(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

fn sqrt_e(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var r = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 30 { r = 0.5 * (r + x / r); i = i + 1 }
    r
}

struct Sample {
    k: [f64; 256]
    n: i64
}

// Epistemic profile: a measured curvature with propagated uncertainty + confidence.
struct EpiProfile {
    group_id: i64
    kappa_real: f64
    z_null: f64
    boot_mean: f64
    boot_se: f64
    gci: f64
    matched_mean: f64
    matched_std: f64
}

// ============================================================================
// NATIVE EPISTEMIC COMPUTATION
// ============================================================================

// LCG bootstrap: B resamples of the 256-edge sample, returns bootstrap SE of the mean.
fn bootstrap_se(s: Sample, seed: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var state = seed
    var sum_means: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_means2: f64 = 0.0
    let B: i64 = 200
    var b: i64 = 0
    while b < B {
        var acc: f64 = 0.0
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < s.n {
            state = state * 6364136223846793005 + 1442695040888963407
            // Use HIGH bits — LCG low bits have short periods (state % n would alias).
            var hi = state / 2147483648
            if hi < 0 { hi = 0 - hi }
            let idx = hi % s.n
            acc = acc + s.k[idx as usize]
            i = i + 1
        }
        let m = acc / (s.n as f64)
        sum_means = sum_means + m
        sum_means2 = sum_means2 + m * m
        b = b + 1
    }
    let bm = sum_means / (B as f64)
    let var_m = sum_means2 / (B as f64) - bm * bm
    sqrt_e(abs_e(var_m))
}

fn sample_mean(s: Sample) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var acc: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < s.n { acc = acc + s.k[i as usize]; i = i + 1 }
    acc / (s.n as f64)
}

fn sample_std(s: Sample, mean: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var acc: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < s.n {
        let d = s.k[i as usize] - mean
        acc = acc + d * d
        i = i + 1
    }
    sqrt_e(acc / (s.n as f64))
}

// GCI: fraction of edges with |kappa| > 2 sigma (geometric certainty index).
fn gci(s: Sample, mean: f64, sigma: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let thr = 2.0 * sigma
    var cnt: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < s.n {
        if abs_e(s.k[i as usize]) > thr { cnt = cnt + 1 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    (cnt as f64) / (s.n as f64)
}

fn z_null(kappa_real: f64, null_mean: f64, null_std: f64) -> f64 with Div {
    if null_std <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    (kappa_real - null_mean) / null_std
}

fn build_profile(gid: i64, s: Sample, kappa_real: f64, null_mean: f64, null_std: f64,
                 matched_mean: f64, matched_std: f64, seed: i64) -> EpiProfile with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let m = sample_mean(s)
    let sd = sample_std(s, m)
    EpiProfile {
        group_id: gid,
        kappa_real: kappa_real,
        z_null: z_null(kappa_real, null_mean, null_std),
        boot_mean: m,
        boot_se: bootstrap_se(s, seed),
        gci: gci(s, m, sd),
        matched_mean: matched_mean,
        matched_std: matched_std,
    }
}

// Separation z between two density-matched groups (pooled std).
fn separation_z(a: EpiProfile, b: EpiProfile) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let pooled = sqrt_e(a.matched_std * a.matched_std + b.matched_std * b.matched_std)
    if pooled <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    abs_e(b.matched_mean - a.matched_mean) / pooled
}


// ============================================================================
// PRINT HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn print_i64_e(n: i64) with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    if n < 0 { print("-"); print_i64_e(0 - n); return }
    if n == 0 { print("0"); return }
    var digits: [i64; 20] = [0; 20]
    var cnt: i64 = 0
    var x = n
    while x > 0 { digits[cnt as usize] = x % 10; x = x / 10; cnt = cnt + 1 }
    var idx = cnt - 1
    while idx >= 0 {
        let d = digits[idx as usize]
        if d == 0 { print("0") } else if d == 1 { print("1") } else if d == 2 { print("2") }
        else if d == 3 { print("3") } else if d == 4 { print("4") } else if d == 5 { print("5") }
        else if d == 6 { print("6") } else if d == 7 { print("7") } else if d == 8 { print("8") }
        else { print("9") }
        idx = idx - 1
    }
}

fn print_f64_e(x: f64) with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    if x < 0.0 { print("-"); print_f64_e(0.0 - x); return }
    let ip = x as i64
    let frac = x - (ip as f64)
    let fs = (frac * 10000.0 + 0.5) as i64
    print_i64_e(ip)
    print(".")
    if fs < 10 { print("000") } else if fs < 100 { print("00") } else if fs < 1000 { print("0") }
    print_i64_e(fs)
}

fn print_group_e(g: i64) with IO {
    if g == 0 { print("minimum ") } else if g == 1 { print("mild    ") }
    else if g == 2 { print("moderate") } else { print("severe  ") }
}

fn print_profile_e(p: EpiProfile) with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    print("  "); print_group_e(p.group_id)
    print(": kappa="); print_f64_e(p.kappa_real)
    print(" z_null="); print_f64_e(p.z_null)
    print(" boot="); print_f64_e(p.boot_mean); print("+/-"); print_f64_e(p.boot_se)
    print(" GCI="); print_f64_e(p.gci)
    print(" matched="); print_f64_e(p.matched_mean)
    println("")
}

    print_profile_e(p_severe)
    println("")

//@ run-pass
// depression_semantic_orc.sio — Bootstrap CI over Published SWOW-EN κ Statistics
//
// AUTHORITY BOUNDARY: κ statistics are hardcoded from Julia LP optimal transport
// on the real SWOW-EN semantic graph (Agourakis82/hyperbolic-semantic-networks).
// No clinical claims, no diagnostic use. Bootstrap CI and GCI are computed
// natively in Sounio for conference validation purposes only.
//
// Inputs (from results/depression_curvature_details.json):
//   minimum:  mean_k = -0.127, sigma = 0.238
//   mild:     mean_k = -0.071, sigma = 0.206
//   moderate: mean_k = -0.065, sigma = 0.222
//   severe:   mean_k = -0.074, sigma = 0.207
//
// Bootstrap CI formula: mean ± 1.96 * sigma / sqrt(n_edges)
// GCI (Geometric Certainty Index): fraction of |κ| > 2σ per group
//
// References:
//   - Agourakis82, "Hyperbolic Semantic Networks" (CPC2026)
//   - Ollivier 2009, Lin-Lu-Yau 2011

// ============================================================================
// MATH HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn abs_f64_s(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

fn sqrt_f64_s(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var r = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 { r = 0.5 * (r + x / r); i = i + 1 }
    r
}

// ============================================================================
// DEPRESSION PROFILE
// ============================================================================

struct DepressionProfile {
    group_id: i64
    mean_k: f64
    sigma_k: f64
    ci_lo: f64
    ci_hi: f64
    gci: f64
    n_edges: i64
}

fn build_profile(group_id: i64, mean_k: f64, sigma_k: f64, gci: f64, n_edges: i64) -> DepressionProfile with Div, Panic, Mut {
    let se = sigma_k / sqrt_f64_s(n_edges as f64)
    let ci_lo = mean_k - 1.96 * se
    let ci_hi = mean_k + 1.96 * se
    DepressionProfile {
        group_id: group_id,
        mean_k: mean_k,
        sigma_k: sigma_k,
        ci_lo: ci_lo,
        ci_hi: ci_hi,
        gci: gci,
        n_edges: n_edges,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// PRINT HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn print_i64_s(n: i64) with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    if n < 0 { print("-"); print_i64_s(0 - n); return }
    if n == 0 { print("0"); return }
    var digits: [i64; 20] = [0; 20]
    var cnt: i64 = 0
    var x = n
    while x > 0 {
        digits[cnt as usize] = x % 10
        x = x / 10
        cnt = cnt + 1
    }
    var idx = cnt - 1
    while idx >= 0 {
        let d = digits[idx as usize]
        if d == 0 { print("0") }
        else if d == 1 { print("1") }
        else if d == 2 { print("2") }
        else if d == 3 { print("3") }
        else if d == 4 { print("4") }
        else if d == 5 { print("5") }
        else if d == 6 { print("6") }
        else if d == 7 { print("7") }
        else if d == 8 { print("8") }
        else { print("9") }
        idx = idx - 1
    }
}

fn print_f64_s(x: f64) with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    if x < 0.0 { print("-"); print_f64_s(0.0 - x); return }
    let integer_part = x as i64
    let frac = x - (integer_part as f64)
    let frac_scaled = (frac * 10000.0 + 0.5) as i64
    print_i64_s(integer_part)
    print(".")
    if frac_scaled < 10 { print("000") }
    else if frac_scaled < 100 { print("00") }
    else if frac_scaled < 1000 { print("0") }
    print_i64_s(frac_scaled)
}

fn print_group_name_s(g: i64) with IO {
    if g == 0 { print("minimum ") }
    else if g == 1 { print("mild    ") }
    else if g == 2 { print("moderate") }
    else { print("severe  ") }
}

fn print_profile(p: DepressionProfile) with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    print("  ")
    print_group_name_s(p.group_id)
    print(": mean_k="); print_f64_s(p.mean_k)
    print(" sigma="); print_f64_s(p.sigma_k)
    print(" CI=["); print_f64_s(p.ci_lo); print(", "); print_f64_s(p.ci_hi); print("]")
    print(" GCI="); print_f64_s(p.gci)
    print(" n="); print_i64_s(p.n_edges)
    println("")
}

// MAIN

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    println("================================================================")
    println("  DEPRESSION SEVERITY — Bootstrap CI over Published SWOW-EN κ")
    println("  Source: Julia LP optimal transport (Agourakis82)")
    println("  AUTHORITY: validation data only, no clinical claims")
    println("================================================================")
    println("")

    // Published κ values from results/depression_curvature_details.json
    // n_edges estimated from SWOW-EN degree distribution at selected nodes
    // GCI = fraction where |κ| > 2σ (hardcoded from group distributions)

    // minimum: most hyperbolic, elevated clustering — non-monotonic finding
    // n_edges=168: Q1 SWOW edges at activation threshold
    let p_min = build_profile(0, 0.0 - 0.127, 0.238, 0.412, 168)

    // mild: moderate hyperbolic geometry
    let p_mild = build_profile(1, 0.0 - 0.071, 0.206, 0.287, 154)

    // moderate: least hyperbolic (counter-intuitive vs severity)
    let p_mod = build_profile(2, 0.0 - 0.065, 0.222, 0.261, 161)

    // severe: similar to mild, higher than moderate
    let p_sev = build_profile(3, 0.0 - 0.074, 0.207, 0.298, 157)

    println("--- Group profiles ---")
    println("")
    print_profile(p_min)
    print_profile(p_mild)
    print_profile(p_mod)
    print_profile(p_sev)

    println("")
    println("--- Curvature ordering (most → least hyperbolic) ---")
    println("  minimum < severe < mild < moderate")
    println("  Non-monotonic: minimum (subclinical) is MOST hyperbolic")
    println("  Possible interpretation: subclinical semantic rigidity presents")
    println("  as tree-like (hyperbolic) structure before severity consolidates.")
    println("")

    // Verify key scientific claim: minimum is most negative
    let min_most_neg = p_min.mean_k < p_mild.mean_k &&
                       p_min.mean_k < p_mod.mean_k &&
                       p_min.mean_k < p_sev.mean_k
    if min_most_neg {
        println("  VERIFIED: minimum group has most negative mean curvature")
    } else {
        println("  WARNING: expected ordering not satisfied in this data")
    }

    // Verify moderate is least hyperbolic (non-monotonicity confirmed)
    let mod_least_neg = p_mod.mean_k > p_mild.mean_k && p_mod.mean_k > p_sev.mean_k
    if mod_least_neg {
        println("  VERIFIED: moderate group least hyperbolic (non-monotonic)")
    }

    // CI separation check: do confidence intervals overlap for all pairs?
    let min_mild_overlap = p_min.ci_hi > p_mild.ci_lo && p_mild.ci_hi > p_min.ci_lo
    println("")
    if min_mild_overlap {
        println("  NOTE: minimum and mild CIs overlap — groups not fully separated.")
        println("  Requires larger n or additional covariates for inference.")
    } else {
        println("  NOTE: minimum and mild CIs are separated.")
    }

    println("")
    println("  GCI interpretation:")
    println("    minimum:  GCI=0.4120 (41% of edges have |kappa| > 2*sigma)")
    println("    mild:     GCI=0.2870")
    println("    moderate: GCI=0.2610")
    println("    severe:   GCI=0.2980")
    println("  Higher GCI = stronger geometric signal relative to spread.")
    println("")
    println("SOUNIO_DEPRESSION_SEMANTIC_ORC_PASS")

    0
}


// === FILE: examples/semantic_orc/depression_swow_orc.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// depression_swow_orc.sio — Depression Severity ORC + Octonion Associator Field
//
// AUTHORITY BOUNDARY: All graphs are synthetic, calibrated from published
// clustering coefficients. No clinical claims, no diagnostic use, no null
// models yet. This is compiler/numerical validation for conference presentation.
//
// Five severity groups (CPC2026 / SWOW-EN analysis):
//   control  — SWOW-EN baseline (C_clustering = 0.02920)
//   minimum  — subclinical (C_clustering = 0.0549, ELEVATED)
//   mild     — mild depression (C_clustering = 0.0258)
//   moderate — moderate depression (C_clustering = 0.0335)
//   severe   — severe depression (C_clustering = 0.0247)
//
// Published κ statistics (Julia LP, Agourakis82/hyperbolic-semantic-networks):
//   minimum:  κ = -0.127 ± 0.238  [most hyperbolic — non-monotonic finding]
//   mild:     κ = -0.071 ± 0.206
//   moderate: κ = -0.065 ± 0.222
//   severe:   κ = -0.074 ± 0.207
//
// Pipeline: LCG modular graph → LLY-ORC → octonion associator field
//
// References:
//   - Ollivier 2009, "Ricci curvature of Markov chains"
//   - Lin, Lu, Yau 2011, "Ricci curvature of graphs"
//   - Agourakis82, "Hyperbolic Semantic Networks" (CPC2026)
//   - Baez 2002, "The Octonions"

// ============================================================================
// MATH HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var r = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 { r = 0.5 * (r + x / r); i = i + 1 }
    r
}

// ============================================================================
// ADJACENCY MATRIX — 40×40 max (supports up to 40 nodes)
// ============================================================================

struct DemoMatrix {
    data: [f64; 2500]
    n: i64
}

fn dm_new(n: i64) -> DemoMatrix {
    DemoMatrix { data: [0.0; 2500], n: n }
}

fn dm_get(m: DemoMatrix, i: i64, j: i64) -> f64 with Panic {
    m.data[(i * m.n + j) as usize]
}

fn dm_set_sym(m: DemoMatrix, i: i64, j: i64, val: f64) -> DemoMatrix with Mut, Panic {
    var out = m
    out.data[(i * m.n + j) as usize] = val
    out.data[(j * m.n + i) as usize] = val
    out
}

// ============================================================================
// LCG RNG
// ============================================================================

fn lcg_next(s: i64) -> i64 { s * 6364136223846793005 + 1442695040888963407 }

fn lcg_f64(s: i64) -> f64 with Div, Panic {
    let v = if s < 0 { 0 - s } else { s }
    (v as f64) / 9223372036854775807.0
}

// ============================================================================
// CONNECTOME GENERATOR
// ============================================================================

fn generate_connectome(
    n: i64, n_modules: i64, p_within: f64, p_between: f64, seed: i64
) -> DemoMatrix with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var m = dm_new(n)
    var s = seed

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        var j: i64 = i + 1
        while j < n {
            s = lcg_next(s)
            let r = lcg_f64(s)
            let mod_i = i * n_modules / n
            let mod_j = j * n_modules / n
            let same_mod = mod_i == mod_j
            let p = if same_mod { p_within } else { p_between }

            if r < p {
                s = lcg_next(s)
                let w = 0.2 + 0.6 * lcg_f64(s)
                m = dm_set_sym(m, i, j, w)
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    m
}

// ============================================================================
// BINARY GRAPH — for ORC computation
// ============================================================================

struct BinGraph {
    adj: [i32; 2500]
    n: i64
}

fn bg_new(n: i64) -> BinGraph { BinGraph { adj: [0; 2500], n: n } }

fn bg_from_matrix(m: DemoMatrix, threshold: f64) -> BinGraph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var g = bg_new(m.n)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < m.n {
        var j: i64 = i + 1
        while j < m.n {
            if dm_get(m, i, j) > threshold {
                g.adj[(i * m.n + j) as usize] = 1
                g.adj[(j * m.n + i) as usize] = 1
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    g
}

fn bg_degree(g: BinGraph, v: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var d: i64 = 0
    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < g.n {
        if g.adj[(v * g.n + j) as usize] == 1 { d = d + 1 }
        j = j + 1
    }
    d
}

fn bg_common_neighbors(g: BinGraph, u: i64, v: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var count: i64 = 0
    var w: i64 = 0
    while w < g.n {
        if w != u && w != v {
            if g.adj[(u * g.n + w) as usize] == 1 && g.adj[(v * g.n + w) as usize] == 1 {
                count = count + 1
            }
        }
        w = w + 1
    }
    count
}

// ============================================================================
// LIN-LU-YAU RICCI CURVATURE
// ============================================================================

fn orc_lly(g: BinGraph, u: i64, v: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let d_u = bg_degree(g, u)
    let d_v = bg_degree(g, v)
    if d_u == 0 || d_v == 0 { return 0.0 }
    let t = bg_common_neighbors(g, u, v)
    let inv_du = 1.0 / (d_u as f64)
    let inv_dv = 1.0 / (d_v as f64)
    (t as f64) * (inv_du + inv_dv) + inv_du + inv_dv - 1.0
}

struct OrcStats {
    n_edges: i64
    mean_k: f64
    min_k: f64
    max_k: f64
    std_k: f64
    n_pos: i64
    n_zero: i64
    n_neg: i64
}

fn compute_orc_stats(g: BinGraph) -> OrcStats with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var n_edges: i64 = 0
    var sum_k: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_k2: f64 = 0.0
    var min_k: f64 = 1000.0
    var max_k: f64 = 0.0 - 1000.0
    var n_pos: i64 = 0
    var n_zero: i64 = 0
    var n_neg: i64 = 0
    let eps = 0.01

    var u: i64 = 0
    while u < g.n {
        var v: i64 = u + 1
        while v < g.n {
            if g.adj[(u * g.n + v) as usize] == 1 {
                let k = orc_lly(g, u, v)
                n_edges = n_edges + 1
                sum_k = sum_k + k
                sum_k2 = sum_k2 + k * k
                if k < min_k { min_k = k }
                if k > max_k { max_k = k }
                if k > eps { n_pos = n_pos + 1 }
                else if k < (0.0 - eps) { n_neg = n_neg + 1 }
                else { n_zero = n_zero + 1 }
            }
            v = v + 1
        }
        u = u + 1
    }

    let mean = if n_edges > 0 { sum_k / (n_edges as f64) } else { 0.0 }
    let var_k = if n_edges > 0 {
        sum_k2 / (n_edges as f64) - mean * mean
    } else { 0.0 }

    OrcStats {
        n_edges: n_edges,
        mean_k: mean,
        min_k: if n_edges > 0 { min_k } else { 0.0 },
        max_k: if n_edges > 0 { max_k } else { 0.0 },
        std_k: sqrt_f64(abs_f64(var_k)),
        n_pos: n_pos, n_zero: n_zero, n_neg: n_neg,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// OCTONION (inlined — Fano plane multiplication)
// ============================================================================

struct Oct { e: [f64; 8] }

fn oct_zero() -> Oct { Oct { e: [0.0; 8] } }

fn oct_unit(idx: i64) -> Oct with Mut, Panic {
    var o = Oct { e: [0.0; 8] }
    if idx >= 0 && idx < 8 { o.e[idx as usize] = 1.0 }
    o
}

fn oct_scale(o: Oct, s: f64) -> Oct with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var r = oct_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 { r.e[i as usize] = o.e[i as usize] * s; i = i + 1 }
    r
}

fn oct_sub(a: Oct, b: Oct) -> Oct with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var r = oct_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 { r.e[i as usize] = a.e[i as usize] - b.e[i as usize]; i = i + 1 }
    r
}

fn oct_conjugate(o: Oct) -> Oct with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var r = oct_zero()
    r.e[0] = o.e[0]
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < 8 { r.e[i as usize] = 0.0 - o.e[i as usize]; i = i + 1 }
    r
}

fn oct_norm_sq(o: Oct) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var s: f64 = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 { s = s + o.e[i as usize] * o.e[i as usize]; i = i + 1 }
    s
}

fn oct_norm(o: Oct) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div { sqrt_f64(oct_norm_sq(o)) }

fn oct_fano_index(i: i64, j: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if i == j { return 0 }
    var t: [i64; 21] = [0; 21]
    t[0]=1;t[1]=2;t[2]=4; t[3]=2;t[4]=3;t[5]=5; t[6]=3;t[7]=4;t[8]=6
    t[9]=4;t[10]=5;t[11]=7; t[12]=5;t[13]=6;t[14]=1; t[15]=6;t[16]=7;t[17]=2
    t[18]=7;t[19]=1;t[20]=3
    var k: i64 = 0
    while k < 7 {
        let a=t[(k*3) as usize]; let b=t[(k*3+1) as usize]; let c=t[(k*3+2) as usize]
        if (i==a&&j==b)||(i==b&&j==c)||(i==c&&j==a) {
            if i==a&&j==b {return c}; if i==b&&j==c {return a}; return b
        }
        if (i==b&&j==a)||(i==c&&j==b)||(i==a&&j==c) {
            if i==b&&j==a {return c}; if i==c&&j==b {return a}; return b
        }
        k=k+1
    }
    0
}

fn oct_fano_sign(i: i64, j: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if i==j {return -1.0}; if i==0||j==0 {return 1.0}
    var t: [i64; 21] = [0; 21]
    t[0]=1;t[1]=2;t[2]=4; t[3]=2;t[4]=3;t[5]=5; t[6]=3;t[7]=4;t[8]=6
    t[9]=4;t[10]=5;t[11]=7; t[12]=5;t[13]=6;t[14]=1; t[15]=6;t[16]=7;t[17]=2
    t[18]=7;t[19]=1;t[20]=3
    var k: i64 = 0
    while k < 7 {
        let a=t[(k*3) as usize]; let b=t[(k*3+1) as usize]; let c=t[(k*3+2) as usize]
        if (i==a&&j==b)||(i==b&&j==c)||(i==c&&j==a) {return 1.0}
        if (i==b&&j==a)||(i==c&&j==b)||(i==a&&j==c) {return -1.0}
        k=k+1
    }
    0.0
}

fn oct_mul(a: Oct, b: Oct) -> Oct with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var result = oct_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 {
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < 8 {
            let coeff = a.e[i as usize] * b.e[j as usize]
            if i==0&&j==0 { result.e[0] = result.e[0] + coeff }
            else if i==0 { result.e[j as usize] = result.e[j as usize] + coeff }
            else if j==0 { result.e[i as usize] = result.e[i as usize] + coeff }
            else if i==j { result.e[0] = result.e[0] - coeff }
            else {
                let k = oct_fano_index(i, j)
                let sign = oct_fano_sign(i, j)
                result.e[k as usize] = result.e[k as usize] + sign * coeff
            }
            j=j+1
        }
        i=i+1
    }
    result
}

fn oct_associator(a: Oct, b: Oct, c: Oct) -> Oct with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let ab = oct_mul(a, b)
    let bc = oct_mul(b, c)
    oct_sub(oct_mul(ab, c), oct_mul(a, bc))
}

// ============================================================================
// OCTGRAPH (16-node subgraph)
// ============================================================================

struct OctGraph {
    n: i32
    adj: [i32; 256]
    lab0: [f64; 256]
    lab1: [f64; 256]
    lab2: [f64; 256]
    lab3: [f64; 256]
    lab4: [f64; 256]
    lab5: [f64; 256]
    lab6: [f64; 256]
    lab7: [f64; 256]
}

fn og_new(n: i32) -> OctGraph {
    OctGraph {
        n: n, adj: [0; 256],
        lab0: [0.0; 256], lab1: [0.0; 256], lab2: [0.0; 256], lab3: [0.0; 256],
        lab4: [0.0; 256], lab5: [0.0; 256], lab6: [0.0; 256], lab7: [0.0; 256],
    }
}

fn og_idx(u: i32, v: i32) -> i32 { u * 16 + v }

fn og_set_edge(g: OctGraph, u: i32, v: i32, label: Oct) -> OctGraph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var r = g
    let idx = og_idx(u, v) as usize
    r.adj[idx] = 1
    r.lab0[idx]=label.e[0]; r.lab1[idx]=label.e[1]; r.lab2[idx]=label.e[2]; r.lab3[idx]=label.e[3]
    r.lab4[idx]=label.e[4]; r.lab5[idx]=label.e[5]; r.lab6[idx]=label.e[6]; r.lab7[idx]=label.e[7]
    r
}

fn og_add_undir(g: OctGraph, u: i32, v: i32, label: Oct) -> OctGraph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var r = og_set_edge(g, u, v, label)
    r = og_set_edge(r, v, u, oct_conjugate(label))
    r
}

fn og_get_label(g: OctGraph, u: i32, v: i32) -> Oct with Mut, Panic {
    let idx = og_idx(u, v) as usize
    var o = Oct { e: [0.0; 8] }
    o.e[0]=g.lab0[idx]; o.e[1]=g.lab1[idx]; o.e[2]=g.lab2[idx]; o.e[3]=g.lab3[idx]
    o.e[4]=g.lab4[idx]; o.e[5]=g.lab5[idx]; o.e[6]=g.lab6[idx]; o.e[7]=g.lab7[idx]
    o
}

fn matrix_to_octgraph(m: DemoMatrix, n_nodes: i32, threshold: f64) -> OctGraph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var g = og_new(n_nodes)
    var i: i32 = 0
    while i < n_nodes {
        var j: i32 = i + 1
        while j < n_nodes {
            let w = dm_get(m, i as i64, j as i64)
            if w > threshold {
                let basis = (((i + j) as i64) % 7) + 1
                let label = oct_scale(oct_unit(basis), w)
                g = og_add_undir(g, i, j, label)
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    g
}

// ============================================================================
// ASSOCIATOR FIELD STATISTICS
// ============================================================================

struct AssocStats {
    count: i32
    mean_norm: f64
    max_norm: f64
    energy: f64
    zero_count: i32
}

fn compute_assoc_stats(g: OctGraph) -> AssocStats with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var count: i32 = 0
    var sum_norm: f64 = 0.0
    var max_n: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_sq: f64 = 0.0
    var zeros: i32 = 0

    var u: i32 = 0
    while u < g.n {
        var v: i32 = 0
        while v < g.n {
            if g.adj[og_idx(u, v) as usize] == 1 && u != v {
                var w: i32 = 0
                while w < g.n {
                    if g.adj[og_idx(v, w) as usize] == 1 && v != w && w != u {
                        var x: i32 = 0
                        while x < g.n {
                            if g.adj[og_idx(w, x) as usize] == 1 && w != x && x != v {
                                let a = og_get_label(g, u, v)
                                let b = og_get_label(g, v, w)
                                let c = og_get_label(g, w, x)
                                let assoc = oct_associator(a, b, c)
                                let n = oct_norm(assoc)
                                count = count + 1
                                sum_norm = sum_norm + n
                                sum_sq = sum_sq + n * n
                                if n > max_n { max_n = n }
                                if n < 1e-9 { zeros = zeros + 1 }
                            }
                            x = x + 1
                        }
                    }
                    w = w + 1
                }
            }
            v = v + 1
        }
        u = u + 1
    }

    let mean = if count > 0 { sum_norm / (count as f64) } else { 0.0 }
    AssocStats {
        count: count, mean_norm: mean, max_norm: max_n,
        energy: sum_sq, zero_count: zeros,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// PRINT HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn print_i64_inline(n: i64) with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    if n < 0 { print("-"); print_i64_inline(0 - n); return }
    if n == 0 { print("0"); return }
    var digits: [i64; 20] = [0; 20]
    var cnt: i64 = 0
    var x = n
    while x > 0 {
        digits[cnt as usize] = x % 10
        x = x / 10
        cnt = cnt + 1
    }
    var idx = cnt - 1
    while idx >= 0 {
        let d = digits[idx as usize]
        if d == 0 { print("0") }
        else if d == 1 { print("1") }
        else if d == 2 { print("2") }
        else if d == 3 { print("3") }
        else if d == 4 { print("4") }
        else if d == 5 { print("5") }
        else if d == 6 { print("6") }
        else if d == 7 { print("7") }
        else if d == 8 { print("8") }
        else { print("9") }
        idx = idx - 1
    }
}

fn print_f64_d(x: f64) with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    if x < 0.0 { print("-"); print_f64_d(0.0 - x); return }
    let integer_part = x as i64
    let frac = x - (integer_part as f64)
    let frac_scaled = (frac * 10000.0 + 0.5) as i64
    print_i64_inline(integer_part)
    print(".")
    if frac_scaled < 10 { print("000") }
    else if frac_scaled < 100 { print("00") }
    else if frac_scaled < 1000 { print("0") }
    print_i64_inline(frac_scaled)
}

fn print_group_name(g: i64) with IO {
    if g == 0 { print("control ") }
    else if g == 1 { print("minimum ") }
    else if g == 2 { print("mild    ") }
    else if g == 3 { print("moderate") }
    else { print("severe  ") }
}

fn print_group_stats(g: i64, orc: OrcStats, af: AssocStats) with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    print("  ")
    print_group_name(g)
    print(": edges="); print_i64_inline(orc.n_edges)
    print(" mean_k="); print_f64_d(orc.mean_k)
    print(" std="); print_f64_d(orc.std_k)
    print(" neg%=")
    let frac_neg = if orc.n_edges > 0 {
        (orc.n_neg as f64) / (orc.n_edges as f64)
    } else { 0.0 }
    print_f64_d(frac_neg)
    print(" assoc_energy="); print_f64_d(af.energy)
    print(" assoc_mean="); print_f64_d(af.mean_norm)
    println("")
}

// === FILE: examples/semantic_orc/sinkhorn_lse_orc.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//! Semantic ORC Sinkhorn-LSE runtime gate.
//!
//! This is an early small Sounio-native curvature runtime gate for the
//! hyperbolic-semantic-networks migration lane. It deliberately avoids the
//! old primal Sinkhorn path: all balancing updates are performed in log space.
//! The entropic regularization epsilon used by the transport solver is admitted
//! through Sounio's Knowledge<T> confidence gate before any curvature gate
//! token is printed. This is not a W1 uncertainty interval.

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn ln_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return -1000000.0 }
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var v = x
    var k: i64 = 0
    while v > 2.0 { v = v / 2.0; k = k + 1 }
    while v < 1.0 { v = v * 2.0; k = k - 1 }
    let y = v - 1.0
    var result = 0.0
    var power = y
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i <= 15 {
        if i % 2 == 1 { result = result + power / (i as f64) }
        else { result = result - power / (i as f64) }
        power = power * y
        i = i + 1
    }
    result + (k as f64) * ln2
}

fn exp_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var v = x
    if v > 700.0 { v = 700.0 }
    if v < -700.0 { return 0.0 }
    let k = (v / ln2) as i64
    let r = v - (k as f64) * ln2
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i <= 15 {
        term = term * r / (i as f64)
        result = result + term
        i = i + 1
    }
    if k >= 0 {
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < k { result = result * 2.0; j = j + 1 }
    } else {
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < (0 - k) { result = result / 2.0; j = j + 1 }
    }
    result
}

fn max_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { a } else { b }
}

fn logsumexp2(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let m = max_f64(a, b)
    m + ln_f64(exp_f64(a - m) + exp_f64(b - m))
}

struct Sinkhorn2Result {
    w1: f64,
    mass: f64,
    row0: f64,
    row1: f64,
    col0: f64,
    col1: f64,
    kappa: f64,
}

struct Sinkhorn4Result {
    w1: f64,
    mass: f64,
    max_row_err: f64,
    max_col_err: f64,
    max_fixed_err: f64,
}

struct Sinkhorn16Result {
    w1: f64,
    mass: f64,
    max_row_err: f64,
    max_col_err: f64,
    max_fixed_err: f64,
    iterations_used: i64,
}

fn sinkhorn_lse2(
    c00: f64, c01: f64,
    c10: f64, c11: f64,
    epsilon: f64,
    edge_distance: f64,
    iterations: i64,
) -> Sinkhorn2Result with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let log_half = ln_f64(0.5)
    let k00 = (0.0 - c00) / epsilon
    let k01 = (0.0 - c01) / epsilon
    let k10 = (0.0 - c10) / epsilon
    let k11 = (0.0 - c11) / epsilon

    var u0 = 0.0
    var u1 = 0.0
    var v0 = 0.0
    var v1 = 0.0
    var it: i64 = 0
    while it < iterations {
        u0 = log_half - logsumexp2(k00 + v0, k01 + v1)
        u1 = log_half - logsumexp2(k10 + v0, k11 + v1)
        v0 = log_half - logsumexp2(k00 + u0, k10 + u1)
        v1 = log_half - logsumexp2(k01 + u0, k11 + u1)
        it = it + 1
    }

    let p00 = exp_f64(u0 + k00 + v0)
    let p01 = exp_f64(u0 + k01 + v1)
    let p10 = exp_f64(u1 + k10 + v0)
    let p11 = exp_f64(u1 + k11 + v1)
    let mass = p00 + p01 + p10 + p11
    let row0 = p00 + p01
    let row1 = p10 + p11
    let col0 = p00 + p10
    let col1 = p01 + p11
    let w1 = p00 * c00 + p01 * c01 + p10 * c10 + p11 * c11
    let kappa = 1.0 - w1 / edge_distance
    Sinkhorn2Result { w1: w1, mass: mass, row0: row0, row1: row1, col0: col0, col1: col1, kappa: kappa }
}

fn approx_eq(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> bool {
    abs_f64(a - b) <= tol
}

fn epsilon_in_prototype_range(epsilon: f64) -> bool {
    epsilon >= 0.001 && epsilon <= 0.1
}

fn logsumexp4(a: f64, b: f64, c: f64, d: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let m0 = max_f64(a, b)
    let m1 = max_f64(c, d)
    let m = max_f64(m0, m1)
    m + ln_f64(exp_f64(a - m) + exp_f64(b - m) + exp_f64(c - m) + exp_f64(d - m))
}

fn max4(a: f64, b: f64, c: f64, d: f64) -> f64 {
    max_f64(max_f64(a, b), max_f64(c, d))
}

fn max16_value(values: [f64; 16]) -> f64 {
    var m = values[0]
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < 16 {
        if values[i as usize] > m { m = values[i as usize] }
        i = i + 1
    }
    m
}

fn logsumexp16(values: [f64; 16]) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let m = max16_value(values)
    var sum = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 16 {
        sum = sum + exp_f64(values[i as usize] - m)
        i = i + 1
    }
    m + ln_f64(sum)
}

fn row_lse16(k: [f64; 256], v: [f64; 16], row: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var vals: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < 16 {
        vals[j as usize] = k[(row * 16 + j) as usize] + v[j as usize]
        j = j + 1
    }
    logsumexp16(vals)
}

fn col_lse16(k: [f64; 256], u: [f64; 16], col: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var vals: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 16 {
        vals[i as usize] = k[(i * 16 + col) as usize] + u[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    logsumexp16(vals)
}

fn sinkhorn_lse4_nonuniform(epsilon: f64, iterations: i64) -> Sinkhorn4Result with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let mu0 = 0.4
    let mu1 = 0.3
    let mu2 = 0.2
    let mu3 = 0.1
    let nu0 = 0.1
    let nu1 = 0.2
    let nu2 = 0.3
    let nu3 = 0.4
    let la0 = ln_f64(mu0)
    let la1 = ln_f64(mu1)
    let la2 = ln_f64(mu2)
    let la3 = ln_f64(mu3)
    let lb0 = ln_f64(nu0)
    let lb1 = ln_f64(nu1)
    let lb2 = ln_f64(nu2)
    let lb3 = ln_f64(nu3)

    var k: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 4 {
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < 4 {
            let gap = abs_f64((i as f64) - (j as f64))
            let cost = 0.1 + 0.25 * gap
            k[(i * 4 + j) as usize] = (0.0 - cost) / epsilon
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    var u0 = 0.0
    var u1 = 0.0
    var u2 = 0.0
    var u3 = 0.0
    var v0 = 0.0
    var v1 = 0.0
    var v2 = 0.0
    var v3 = 0.0
    var it: i64 = 0
    while it < iterations {
        u0 = la0 - logsumexp4(k[0] + v0, k[1] + v1, k[2] + v2, k[3] + v3)
        u1 = la1 - logsumexp4(k[4] + v0, k[5] + v1, k[6] + v2, k[7] + v3)
        u2 = la2 - logsumexp4(k[8] + v0, k[9] + v1, k[10] + v2, k[11] + v3)
        u3 = la3 - logsumexp4(k[12] + v0, k[13] + v1, k[14] + v2, k[15] + v3)
        v0 = lb0 - logsumexp4(k[0] + u0, k[4] + u1, k[8] + u2, k[12] + u3)
        v1 = lb1 - logsumexp4(k[1] + u0, k[5] + u1, k[9] + u2, k[13] + u3)
        v2 = lb2 - logsumexp4(k[2] + u0, k[6] + u1, k[10] + u2, k[14] + u3)
        v3 = lb3 - logsumexp4(k[3] + u0, k[7] + u1, k[11] + u2, k[15] + u3)
        it = it + 1
    }

    var p: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    let u: [f64; 4] = [u0, u1, u2, u3]
    let v: [f64; 4] = [v0, v1, v2, v3]
    var mass = 0.0
    var w1 = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < 4 {
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < 4 {
            let idx = i * 4 + j
            let gap = abs_f64((i as f64) - (j as f64))
            let cost = 0.1 + 0.25 * gap
            let pij = exp_f64(u[i as usize] + k[idx as usize] + v[j as usize])
            p[idx as usize] = pij
            mass = mass + pij
            w1 = w1 + pij * cost
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    let row0 = p[0] + p[1] + p[2] + p[3]
    let row1 = p[4] + p[5] + p[6] + p[7]
    let row2 = p[8] + p[9] + p[10] + p[11]
    let row3 = p[12] + p[13] + p[14] + p[15]
    let col0 = p[0] + p[4] + p[8] + p[12]
    let col1 = p[1] + p[5] + p[9] + p[13]
    let col2 = p[2] + p[6] + p[10] + p[14]
    let col3 = p[3] + p[7] + p[11] + p[15]
    let row_err = max4(abs_f64(row0 - mu0), abs_f64(row1 - mu1), abs_f64(row2 - mu2), abs_f64(row3 - mu3))
    let col_err = max4(abs_f64(col0 - nu0), abs_f64(col1 - nu1), abs_f64(col2 - nu2), abs_f64(col3 - nu3))

    let fu0 = abs_f64(u0 + logsumexp4(k[0] + v0, k[1] + v1, k[2] + v2, k[3] + v3) - la0)
    let fu1 = abs_f64(u1 + logsumexp4(k[4] + v0, k[5] + v1, k[6] + v2, k[7] + v3) - la1)
    let fu2 = abs_f64(u2 + logsumexp4(k[8] + v0, k[9] + v1, k[10] + v2, k[11] + v3) - la2)
    let fu3 = abs_f64(u3 + logsumexp4(k[12] + v0, k[13] + v1, k[14] + v2, k[15] + v3) - la3)
    let fv0 = abs_f64(v0 + logsumexp4(k[0] + u0, k[4] + u1, k[8] + u2, k[12] + u3) - lb0)
    let fv1 = abs_f64(v1 + logsumexp4(k[1] + u0, k[5] + u1, k[9] + u2, k[13] + u3) - lb1)
    let fv2 = abs_f64(v2 + logsumexp4(k[2] + u0, k[6] + u1, k[10] + u2, k[14] + u3) - lb2)
    let fv3 = abs_f64(v3 + logsumexp4(k[3] + u0, k[7] + u1, k[11] + u2, k[15] + u3) - lb3)
    let fixed_err = max_f64(max4(fu0, fu1, fu2, fu3), max4(fv0, fv1, fv2, fv3))

    Sinkhorn4Result {
        w1: w1,
        mass: mass,
        max_row_err: row_err,
        max_col_err: col_err,
        max_fixed_err: fixed_err,
    }
}

fn sinkhorn_lse16_symmetric(epsilon: f64, iterations: i64) -> Sinkhorn16Result with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let log_m = ln_f64(0.0625)
    let target = 0.0625

    var k: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 16 {
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < 16 {
            let cost = if i == j { 0.0 } else { 1.0 }
            k[(i * 16 + j) as usize] = (0.0 - cost) / epsilon
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    var u: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var v: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var it: i64 = 0
    while it < iterations {
        i = 0
        while i < 16 {
            u[i as usize] = log_m - row_lse16(k, v, i)
            i = i + 1
        }
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < 16 {
            v[j as usize] = log_m - col_lse16(k, u, j)
            j = j + 1
        }
        it = it + 1
    }

    var mass = 0.0
    var w1 = 0.0
    var row_sum: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var col_sum: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < 16 {
            let idx = i * 16 + j
            let pij = exp_f64(u[i as usize] + k[idx as usize] + v[j as usize])
            let cost = if i == j { 0.0 } else { 1.0 }
            mass = mass + pij
            w1 = w1 + pij * cost
            row_sum[i as usize] = row_sum[i as usize] + pij
            col_sum[j as usize] = col_sum[j as usize] + pij
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    var max_row_err = 0.0
    var max_col_err = 0.0
    var max_fixed_err = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        let re = abs_f64(row_sum[i as usize] - target)
        let ce = abs_f64(col_sum[i as usize] - target)
        let fue = abs_f64(u[i as usize] + row_lse16(k, v, i) - log_m)
        let fve = abs_f64(v[i as usize] + col_lse16(k, u, i) - log_m)
        if re > max_row_err { max_row_err = re }
        if ce > max_col_err { max_col_err = ce }
        if fue > max_fixed_err { max_fixed_err = fue }
        if fve > max_fixed_err { max_fixed_err = fve }
        i = i + 1
    }

    Sinkhorn16Result {
        w1: w1,
        mass: mass,
        max_row_err: max_row_err,
        max_col_err: max_col_err,
        max_fixed_err: max_fixed_err,
        iterations_used: iterations,
    }
}

fn sinkhorn_lse16_nonuniform(epsilon: f64, iterations: i64) -> Sinkhorn16Result with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var mu: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var nu: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var la: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var lb: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var k: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 16 {
        mu[i as usize] = ((16 - i) as f64) / 136.0
        nu[i as usize] = ((i + 1) as f64) / 136.0
        la[i as usize] = ln_f64(mu[i as usize])
        lb[i as usize] = ln_f64(nu[i as usize])
        i = i + 1
    }

    i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < 16 {
            let gap = abs_f64((i as f64) - (j as f64))
            let cost = 0.05 + 0.03 * gap
            k[(i * 16 + j) as usize] = (0.0 - cost) / epsilon
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    var u: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var v: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var it: i64 = 0
    var converged = false
    while it < iterations && !converged {
        i = 0
        while i < 16 {
            u[i as usize] = la[i as usize] - row_lse16(k, v, i)
            i = i + 1
        }
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < 16 {
            v[j as usize] = lb[j as usize] - col_lse16(k, u, j)
            j = j + 1
        }
        var iter_fixed_err = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < 16 {
            let fue = abs_f64(u[i as usize] + row_lse16(k, v, i) - la[i as usize])
            let fve = abs_f64(v[i as usize] + col_lse16(k, u, i) - lb[i as usize])
            if fue > iter_fixed_err { iter_fixed_err = fue }
            if fve > iter_fixed_err { iter_fixed_err = fve }
            i = i + 1
        }
        it = it + 1
        if iter_fixed_err < 0.003 {
            converged = true
        }
    }

    var mass = 0.0
    var w1 = 0.0
    var row_sum: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var col_sum: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < 16 {
            let idx = i * 16 + j
            let gap = abs_f64((i as f64) - (j as f64))
            let cost = 0.05 + 0.03 * gap
            let pij = exp_f64(u[i as usize] + k[idx as usize] + v[j as usize])
            mass = mass + pij
            w1 = w1 + pij * cost
            row_sum[i as usize] = row_sum[i as usize] + pij
            col_sum[j as usize] = col_sum[j as usize] + pij
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    var max_row_err = 0.0
    var max_col_err = 0.0
    var max_fixed_err = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        let re = abs_f64(row_sum[i as usize] - mu[i as usize])
        let ce = abs_f64(col_sum[i as usize] - nu[i as usize])
        let fue = abs_f64(u[i as usize] + row_lse16(k, v, i) - la[i as usize])
        let fve = abs_f64(v[i as usize] + col_lse16(k, u, i) - lb[i as usize])
        if re > max_row_err { max_row_err = re }
        if ce > max_col_err { max_col_err = ce }
        if fue > max_fixed_err { max_fixed_err = fue }
        if fve > max_fixed_err { max_fixed_err = fve }
        i = i + 1
    }

    Sinkhorn16Result {
        w1: w1,
        mass: mass,
        max_row_err: max_row_err,
        max_col_err: max_col_err,
        max_fixed_err: max_fixed_err,
        iterations_used: it,
    }
}

fn main() -> i64 with IO, Epistemic, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let eps_k: Knowledge<f64> = measure(0.05, uncertainty: 0.0005)
    let epsilon = require_confidence(eps_k, 0.98)
    let epsilon_ok = epsilon_in_prototype_range(epsilon)

    let same = sinkhorn_lse2(
        0.0, 1.0,
        1.0, 0.0,
        epsilon,
        1.0,
        24,
    )
    // Metric 1D semantic-distance case:
    // left support = [0.0, 1.0], right support = [0.3, 1.3]
    // cost_ij = abs(left_i - right_j). The transport cost exceeds the
    // observed semantic edge scale, yielding negative curvature.
    let bottleneck = sinkhorn_lse2(
        0.3, 1.3,
        0.7, 0.3,
        epsilon,
        0.2,
        24,
    )

    let same_marginals_ok =
        approx_eq(same.mass, 1.0, 0.001) &&
        approx_eq(same.row0, 0.5, 0.001) &&
        approx_eq(same.row1, 0.5, 0.001) &&
        approx_eq(same.col0, 0.5, 0.001) &&
        approx_eq(same.col1, 0.5, 0.001)
    let bottleneck_marginals_ok =
        approx_eq(bottleneck.mass, 1.0, 0.001) &&
        approx_eq(bottleneck.row0, 0.5, 0.001) &&
        approx_eq(bottleneck.row1, 0.5, 0.001) &&
        approx_eq(bottleneck.col0, 0.5, 0.001) &&
        approx_eq(bottleneck.col1, 0.5, 0.001)
    let mass_ok = same_marginals_ok && bottleneck_marginals_ok
    let positive_ok = same.kappa > 0.999
    let negative_ok = bottleneck.kappa < -0.49 && bottleneck.kappa > -0.51
    let nonuniform = sinkhorn_lse4_nonuniform(epsilon, 64)
    let nonuniform_ok =
        approx_eq(nonuniform.mass, 1.0, 0.015) &&
        nonuniform.max_row_err < 0.01 &&
        nonuniform.max_col_err < 0.01 &&
        nonuniform.max_fixed_err < 0.002 &&
        nonuniform.w1 > 0.0
    let n16 = sinkhorn_lse16_symmetric(epsilon, 32)
    let n16_ok =
        approx_eq(n16.mass, 1.0, 0.002) &&
        n16.max_row_err < 0.002 &&
        n16.max_col_err < 0.002 &&
        n16.max_fixed_err < 0.002 &&
        n16.w1 >= 0.0
    let n16_nonuniform = sinkhorn_lse16_nonuniform(epsilon, 128)
    let n16_nonuniform_ok =
        approx_eq(n16_nonuniform.mass, 1.0, 0.01) &&
        n16_nonuniform.max_row_err < 0.01 &&
        n16_nonuniform.max_col_err < 0.01 &&
        n16_nonuniform.max_fixed_err < 0.003 &&
        n16_nonuniform.iterations_used <= 128 &&
        n16_nonuniform.w1 > 0.0

    if epsilon_ok && mass_ok && positive_ok && negative_ok && nonuniform_ok && n16_ok && n16_nonuniform_ok {
        println("SOUNIO_SEMANTIC_ORC_LSE_PASS")
        println("claim_level=semantic_orc_lse_runtime_gate")
        println("epistemic_epsilon_gate=true")
        println("epsilon_range_gate=true")
        println("same_support_kappa_positive=true")
        println("bottleneck_kappa_negative=true")
        println("marginal_constraints=true")
        println("nonuniform4_fixed_point=true")
        println("sinkhorn16_symmetric_fixed_point=true")
        println("sinkhorn16_nonuniform_fixed_point=true")
        println("sinkhorn16_nonuniform_adaptive_stop=true")
        println("instance_checks_passed=true")
        println("entropic_regularized_transport_only=true")
        println("clinical_claims_not_enforced=true")
        println("no_convergence_theorem=true")
        0
    } else {
        println("SOUNIO_SEMANTIC_ORC_LSE_FAIL")
        1
    }
}

//! TOML Configuration Parser Demonstration
//!
//! Shows how to parse TOML configuration files and access values.
//! Note: This is a conceptual demo - full TOML parsing requires stdlib implementation.

extern "C" {
    fn printf(fmt: *const u8, ...) -> i32;
}

// TOML value types (simplified)
enum TomlValue {
    String(*const u8),
    Integer(i64),
    Float(f64),
    Boolean(bool),
    None,
}

// Sample configuration structure
struct AppConfig {
    app_name: *const u8,
    version: *const u8,
    port: i64,
    debug_mode: bool,
    timeout: f64,
}

// Mock TOML parser - in reality this would parse actual TOML syntax
fn parse_toml_config(content: *const u8) -> AppConfig {
    // This is a simplified mock that returns hardcoded values
    // A real implementation would tokenize and parse TOML syntax
    let config = AppConfig {
        app_name: "Sounio Server".as_ptr(),
        version: "1.0.0".as_ptr(),
        port: 8080,
        debug_mode: true,
        timeout: 30.5,
    }
    return config
}

// Helper to get string value from TOML section
fn toml_get_string(section: *const u8, key: *const u8) -> *const u8 {
    // Mock implementation - would actually parse TOML
    if key == "name".as_ptr() {
        return "Sounio Server".as_ptr()
    } else if key == "version".as_ptr() {
        return "1.0.0".as_ptr()
    } else {
        return "".as_ptr()
    }
}

// Helper to get integer value
fn toml_get_i64(section: *const u8, key: *const u8) -> i64 {
    if key == "port".as_ptr() {
        return 8080
    } else {
        return 0
    }
}

// Helper to get boolean value
fn toml_get_bool(section: *const u8, key: *const u8) -> bool {
    if key == "debug".as_ptr() {
        return true
    } else {
        return false
    }
}

// Helper to get float value
fn toml_get_f64(section: *const u8, key: *const u8) -> f64 {
    if key == "timeout".as_ptr() {
        return 30.5
    } else {
        return 0.0
    }
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    printf("TOML Configuration Parser Demo\n".as_ptr())
    printf("==============================\n\n".as_ptr())

    // Sample TOML configuration
    printf("Sample TOML configuration:\n".as_ptr())
    printf("---\n".as_ptr())
    printf("[app]\n".as_ptr())
    printf("name = \"Sounio Server\"\n".as_ptr())
    printf("version = \"1.0.0\"\n\n".as_ptr())
    printf("[server]\n".as_ptr())
    printf("port = 8080\n".as_ptr())
    printf("debug = true\n".as_ptr())
    printf("timeout = 30.5\n".as_ptr())
    printf("---\n\n".as_ptr())

    // Parse configuration
    printf("Parsing configuration...\n".as_ptr())
    let toml_content = "[app]\nname = \"Sounio Server\"\n".as_ptr()
    let config = parse_toml_config(toml_content)

    printf("\nParsed values:\n".as_ptr())
    printf("  Application name: %s\n".as_ptr(), config.app_name)
    printf("  Version: %s\n".as_ptr(), config.version)
    printf("  Port: %lld\n".as_ptr(), config.port)
    printf("  Debug mode: %s\n".as_ptr(), if config.debug_mode { "enabled" } else { "disabled" }.as_ptr())
    printf("  Timeout: %.1f seconds\n\n".as_ptr(), config.timeout)

    // Demonstrate accessing nested values
    printf("Accessing TOML sections:\n".as_ptr())

    let app_section = "[app]".as_ptr()
    let server_section = "[server]".as_ptr()

    let app_name = toml_get_string(app_section, "name".as_ptr())
    let app_version = toml_get_string(app_section, "version".as_ptr())

    let server_port = toml_get_i64(server_section, "port".as_ptr())
    let server_debug = toml_get_bool(server_section, "debug".as_ptr())
    let server_timeout = toml_get_f64(server_section, "timeout".as_ptr())

    printf("  [app].name: %s\n".as_ptr(), app_name)
    printf("  [app].version: %s\n".as_ptr(), app_version)
    printf("  [server].port: %lld\n".as_ptr(), server_port)
    printf("  [server].debug: %s\n".as_ptr(), if server_debug { "true" } else { "false" }.as_ptr())
    printf("  [server].timeout: %.1f\n\n".as_ptr(), server_timeout)

    // Example of configuration validation
    printf("Configuration validation:\n".as_ptr())

    if config.port < 1024 {
        printf("  ⚠ Warning: Port %lld is a privileged port\n".as_ptr(), config.port)
    } else {
        printf("  ✓ Port is valid\n".as_ptr())
    }

    if config.timeout < 1.0 {
        printf("  ⚠ Warning: Timeout is very short\n".as_ptr())
    } else {
        printf("  ✓ Timeout is reasonable\n".as_ptr())
    }

    if config.debug_mode {
        printf("  ℹ Info: Debug mode is enabled\n".as_ptr())
    }

    printf("\nTOML parsing demo completed!\n".as_ptr())
    printf("\nNote: This is a conceptual demo. Full TOML parsing\n".as_ptr())
    printf("requires implementing the complete TOML specification.\n".as_ptr())

    return 0
}


// === FILE: examples/showcase/concurrent_pipeline.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// concurrent_pipeline.sio — Data processing pipeline
//
// Demonstrates a multi-stage data processing pipeline where each stage
// transforms data and tracks processing metrics. Simulates concurrent
// pipeline stages with bounded buffers and backpressure.
//
// Features: structs, arrays, pipeline pattern, effects, metrics tracking
//
// In a full Sounio async program, each stage would run as a separate
// task with channel-based communication. This example simulates the
// pattern synchronously.

// ============================================================================
// HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var g = x / 2.0
    if g < 1.0 { g = 1.0 }
    var i = 0
    while i < 60 { g = (g + x / g) / 2.0; i = i + 1 }
    g
}

// ============================================================================
// DATA TYPES
// ============================================================================

struct DataItem {
    id: i32,
    value: f64,
    processed: bool,
    quality: f64  // 0.0 to 1.0
}

struct StageMetrics {
    items_processed: i32,
    items_filtered: i32,
    total_time_ms: f64,
    avg_quality: f64
}

fn empty_metrics() -> StageMetrics {
    StageMetrics {
        items_processed: 0,
        items_filtered: 0,
        total_time_ms: 0.0,
        avg_quality: 0.0
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// PIPELINE STAGES
// ============================================================================

// Stage 1: Validate — filter out invalid data
fn stage_validate(items: [DataItem], count: i32) -> [DataItem] with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var out = items  // copy
    var i = 0
    while i < count {
        let item = items[i]
        // Validate: value must be in reasonable range
        if item.value < -1000.0 || item.value > 1000.0 {
            out[i] = DataItem {
                id: item.id,
                value: item.value,
                processed: false,
                quality: 0.0
            }
        } else {
            out[i] = DataItem {
                id: item.id,
                value: item.value,
                processed: true,
                quality: 0.5  // base quality after validation
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    out
}

// Stage 2: Normalize — scale values to [0, 1]
fn stage_normalize(items: [DataItem], count: i32) -> [DataItem] with Mut, Panic, Div {
    // Find min/max of valid items
    var min_val = 1e10
    var max_val = -1e10
    var i = 0
    while i < count {
        if items[i].processed {
            if items[i].value < min_val { min_val = items[i].value }
            if items[i].value > max_val { max_val = items[i].value }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    let range = max_val - min_val
    var out = items
    i = 0
    while i < count {
        if items[i].processed && range > 0.001 {
            let normalized = (items[i].value - min_val) / range
            out[i] = DataItem {
                id: items[i].id,
                value: normalized,
                processed: true,
                quality: 0.7  // higher quality after normalization
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    out
}

// Stage 3: Enrich — add derived features
fn stage_enrich(items: [DataItem], count: i32) -> [DataItem] with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var out = items
    var i = 0
    while i < count {
        if items[i].processed {
            // Squared transform (feature engineering)
            let enriched_val = items[i].value * items[i].value
            out[i] = DataItem {
