//! Test program for sorting algorithms

use algo::sort;

fn main() with Alloc, Panic, Div, IO {
    println("Testing sorting algorithms...")

    // Test quicksort
    var arr1 = [9, 3, 7, 1, 5, 8, 2, 4, 6]
    sort::quicksort_i64(&!arr1, 9)
    if sort::is_sorted_i64(&arr1, 9) {
        println("✓ Quicksort i64 passed")
    } else {
        println("✗ Quicksort i64 failed")
    }

    // Test mergesort
    var arr2 = [5, 2, 9, 1, 7, 3, 8, 4, 6]
    sort::mergesort_i64(&!arr2, 9)
    if sort::is_sorted_i64(&arr2, 9) {
        println("✓ Mergesort i64 passed")
    } else {
        println("✗ Mergesort i64 failed")
    }

    // Test heapsort
    var arr3 = [4, 8, 2, 9, 1, 6, 3, 7, 5]
    sort::heapsort_i64(&!arr3, 9)
    if sort::is_sorted_i64(&arr3, 9) {
        println("✓ Heapsort i64 passed")
    } else {
        println("✗ Heapsort i64 failed")
    }

    // Test f64 quicksort
    var arr4 = [9.5, 3.2, 7.8, 1.1, 5.4]
    sort::quicksort_f64(&!arr4, 5)
    if sort::is_sorted_f64(&arr4, 5) {
        println("✓ Quicksort f64 passed")
    } else {
        println("✗ Quicksort f64 failed")
    }

    // Test edge cases
    var single = [42]
    sort::quicksort_i64(&!single, 1)
    if sort::is_sorted_i64(&single, 1) {
        println("✓ Single element passed")
    } else {
        println("✗ Single element failed")
    }

    var reversed = [5, 4, 3, 2, 1]
    sort::heapsort_i64(&!reversed, 5)
    if sort::is_sorted_i64(&reversed, 5) {
        println("✓ Reverse sorted passed")
    } else {
        println("✗ Reverse sorted failed")
    }

    println("All sorting tests completed!")
}


// === FILE: examples/test_zstd.sio ===
//! Test program for zstd compression module
//!
//! Demonstrates basic usage of the zstd compression functions.

// Note: This would use `use compress::zstd::*;` when modules work
// For now, assume functions are available

fn main() with IO, Alloc, Panic {
    println("Testing Zstandard Compression")
    println("==============================")

    // Test 1: Simple compression/decompression
    println("")
    println("Test 1: Basic round-trip")
    let message = [72, 101, 108, 108, 111, 44, 32, 90, 115, 116, 100, 33]  // "Hello, Zstd!"
    let original_len: usize = 12

    println("Original size: 12 bytes")

    // Compress at level 3 (default)
    let compressed = zstd_compress(&message, original_len, 3)
    match compressed {
        Some(comp_data) => {
            println("Compressed size:")
            println(comp_data.len())

            // Decompress
            let decompressed = zstd_decompress(&comp_data, comp_data.len())
            match decompressed {
                Some(orig) => {
                    println("Decompressed size:")
                    println(orig.len())

                    // Verify
                    var match_ok = true
                    if orig.len() == original_len {
                        var i: usize = 0
                        while i < original_len {
                            if orig[i] != message[i] {
                                match_ok = false
                                break
                            }
                            i = i + 1
                        }
                    } else {
                        match_ok = false
                    }

                    if match_ok {
                        println("✓ Round-trip successful!")
                    } else {
                        println("✗ Data mismatch!")
                    }
                }
                None => {
                    println("✗ Decompression failed")
                }
            }
        }
        None => {
            println("✗ Compression failed")
        }
    }

    // Test 2: Different compression levels
    println("")
    println("Test 2: Compression levels")
    let data = [65, 65, 65, 65, 65, 65, 65, 65, 65, 65, 65, 65]  // "AAAAAAAAAAAA"
    let data_len: usize = 12

    let fast = zstd_compress(&data, data_len, 1)
    match fast {
        Some(f) => {
            println("Level 1 (fast):")
            println(f.len())
        }
        None => {
            println("Level 1 failed")
        }
    }

    let balanced = zstd_compress(&data, data_len, 3)
    match balanced {
        Some(b) => {
            println("Level 3 (default):")
            println(b.len())
        }
        None => {
            println("Level 3 failed")
        }
    }

    let best = zstd_compress(&data, data_len, 19)
    match best {
        Some(b) => {
            println("Level 19 (best):")
            println(b.len())
        }
        None => {
            println("Level 19 failed")
        }
    }

    // Test 3: Error handling
    println("")
    println("Test 3: Error handling")

    let invalid_level = zstd_compress(&data, data_len, 100)
    match invalid_level {
        Some(_) => {
            println("✗ Should have rejected invalid level")
        }
        None => {
            println("✓ Correctly rejected level 100")
        }
    }

    let bad_compressed = [255, 255, 255, 255]
    let invalid_decomp = zstd_decompress(&bad_compressed, 4)
    match invalid_decomp {
        Some(_) => {
            println("✗ Should have rejected invalid data")
        }
        None => {
            println("✓ Correctly rejected bad data")
        }
    }

    println("")
    println("All tests complete!")
}


// === FILE: examples/therapy_session.sio ===
//! examples/therapy_session.sio
//!
//! Practitioner-facing worked example: A therapy session modeled as
//! Pask conversation with Bateson learning levels.
//!
//! Scenario: Therapist (T) believes the problem is value-70.
//!           Client (C) believes the problem is value-20.
//!           Through conversation they build shared understanding.
//!           When conversation stalls, the system detects it and
//!           prescribes learning level changes.

use cybernetic::conversation::{
    Conversation, conversation_new, set_models, converse, agreement,
    has_converged, shared_understanding, model_accuracy
}
use cybernetic::bateson::{
    LearningContext, LearningEvent, bateson_new, learn,
    level_one_update, level_two_switch, level_three_restructure
}
use cybernetic::second_order::{diagnose_conversation}

// ============================================================================
// Helpers
// ============================================================================

fn abs_f(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn print_round_status(round: i64, agr: f64, shared: f64) with IO {
    print("  Round ")
    print_int(round)
    print(": agreement=")
    if agr > 0.9 {
        print("HIGH")
    } else if agr > 0.5 {
        print("MODERATE")
    } else {
        print("LOW")
    }
    print(" shared_understanding=")
    if shared > 60.0 {
        print("HIGH")
    } else if shared > 40.0 {
        print("MIDDLE")
    } else {
        print("LOW")
    }
    println("")
}

fn print_diagnosis(level: i64) with IO {
    print("  Diagnosis: ")
    if level == 0 {
        println("Conversation is FINE (no intervention needed)")
    } else if level == 1 {
        println("Needs L1 — parameter adjustment (fine-tuning understanding)")
    } else if level == 2 {
        println("Needs L2 — model switch (reframe the problem)")
    } else {
        println("Needs L3 — epistemological restructuring (fundamental shift)")
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN
// ============================================================================

fn main() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    println("======================================================")
    println("  PRACTITIONER EXAMPLE: Therapy Session")
    println("  Pask conversation + Bateson learning levels")
    println("======================================================")
    println("")

    // ---- Phase 1: Initial conversation (T=70, C=20) ----
    println("Phase 1: Initial Conversation")
    println("  Therapist model: problem severity = 70")
    println("  Client model:    problem severity = 20")
    println("  (Large initial disagreement)")
    println("")

    var conv = conversation_new(1, 2, 100)
    conv = set_models(conv, 70.0, 2.0, 20.0, 2.0)

    var round: i64 = 0
    while round < 20 {
        conv = converse(conv)
        round = round + 1
        // Print every 5 rounds
        if round % 5 == 0 {
            let agr = agreement(conv)
            let shared = shared_understanding(conv)
            print_round_status(round, agr, shared)
        }
    }

    let agr1 = agreement(conv)
    let shared1 = shared_understanding(conv)
    println("")
    print("  Phase 1 result: agreement is ")
    if agr1 > 0.5 { println("building") } else { println("still low") }
    println("")

    // ---- Phase 2: Conversation stalls — diagnose and intervene ----
    println("Phase 2: Stall Detection and Learning Intervention")
    println("")

    // Run a few more rounds to see if we stall
    var stall_round: i64 = 0
    var prev_agr = agreement(conv)
    var stalled = false
    while stall_round < 10 {
        conv = converse(conv)
        stall_round = stall_round + 1
        let cur_agr = agreement(conv)
        let improvement = abs_f(cur_agr - prev_agr)
        if improvement < 0.001 {
            print("  Stall detected at round ")
            print_int(round + stall_round)
            println(": improvement < 0.001")
            stalled = true
            break
        }
        prev_agr = cur_agr
    }

    // Diagnose the conversation
    let diagnosis = diagnose_conversation(conv)
    print_diagnosis(diagnosis)
    println("")

    // Apply learning based on diagnosis
    var ctx = bateson_new()
    if diagnosis >= 1 {
        println("  Applying Bateson learning to the stalled participant...")

        // Simulate learning events based on diagnosis level
        var learn_round: i64 = 0
        while learn_round < 5 {
            let stimulus = learn_round % 8
            let outcome = if diagnosis == 1 { 0.8 } else { 0.3 }
            let evt = learn(ctx, stimulus, outcome)
            ctx = evt.context
            learn_round = learn_round + 1
        }

        print("  Learning level engaged: L")
        print_int(diagnosis)
        println("")

        // If L2 was needed, attempt model switch
        if diagnosis >= 2 {
            let switch_evt = level_two_switch(ctx, 0.01)
            ctx = switch_evt.context
            if switch_evt.model_switched {
                println("  L2: Model switched successfully (new frame of reference)")
            } else {
                println("  L2: Staying with current model (no better model available)")
            }
        }
    }
    println("")

    // ---- Phase 3: Resume conversation with updated model ----
    println("Phase 3: Resume Conversation After Intervention")
    println("")

    // After learning, the therapist adjusts approach (simulate by
    // nudging the therapist's belief slightly toward the client's)
    let current_shared = shared_understanding(conv)
    // Re-set with slightly modified positions to simulate learning effect
    var p_new = 70.0
    var q_new = 20.0
    // If L2 was triggered, therapist makes a bigger adjustment
    if diagnosis >= 2 {
        p_new = current_shared + 5.0
        q_new = current_shared - 5.0
    } else if diagnosis >= 1 {
        p_new = current_shared + 10.0
        q_new = current_shared - 10.0
    }

    var conv2 = conversation_new(1, 2, 100)
    conv2 = set_models(conv2, p_new, 1.0, q_new, 1.0)

    var r2: i64 = 0
    while r2 < 30 {
        conv2 = converse(conv2)
        r2 = r2 + 1
        if r2 % 10 == 0 {
            let agr = agreement(conv2)
            let shared = shared_understanding(conv2)
            print_round_status(r2, agr, shared)
        }
    }

    let final_agr = agreement(conv2)
    let final_shared = shared_understanding(conv2)
    let final_accuracy = model_accuracy(conv2)
    println("")

    // ---- Phase 4: Clinical summary ----
    println("======================================================")
    println("  CLINICAL SUMMARY")
    println("======================================================")
    println("")

    let total_rounds = round + stall_round + r2
    print("  Total conversation rounds: ")
    print_int(total_rounds)
    println("")

    print("  Final agreement: ")
    if final_agr > 0.9 {
        println("EXCELLENT (>0.9)")
    } else if final_agr > 0.7 {
        println("GOOD (>0.7)")
    } else if final_agr > 0.5 {
        println("MODERATE (>0.5)")
    } else {
        println("POOR (<0.5)")
    }

    print("  Shared understanding: ")
    if final_shared > 55.0 {
        println("converged toward therapist view")
    } else if final_shared > 35.0 {
        println("converged to middle ground")
    } else {
        println("converged toward client view")
    }

    print("  Model accuracy: ")
    if final_accuracy < 1.0 {
        println("EXCELLENT — participants understand each other well")
    } else if final_accuracy < 5.0 {
        println("GOOD — reasonable mutual understanding")
    } else {
        println("NEEDS WORK — models of each other are still imprecise")
    }

    print("  Intervention needed: L")
    print_int(diagnosis)
    if diagnosis == 0 {
        println(" (none)")
    } else if diagnosis == 1 {
        println(" (fine-tuning)")
    } else if diagnosis == 2 {
        println(" (reframe)")
    } else {
        println(" (restructure)")
    }

    println("")

    // Verify key properties
    assert(final_agr > 0.5)
    assert(final_shared > 10.0)
    assert(final_shared < 90.0)
    assert(total_rounds > 30)

    println("  All clinical assertions PASSED")
    println("")
    println("======================================================")
    println("  Session complete.")
    println("======================================================")
}


// === FILE: examples/tile_matmul.sio ===
/*
Aspirational example preserved below.
To restore, remove this stub and uncomment the original content.

// tile_matmul.d - Tile-based Matrix Multiplication using CUDA 13 Tile Abstraction
//
// This example demonstrates the Sounio tile-based GPU programming model,
// which provides a higher-level abstraction over CUDA's cooperative groups
// and Tensor Core operations (WMMA/WGMMA).
//
// The compiler automatically handles:
// - Thread block configuration
// - Shared memory allocation and layout
// - Cooperative group partitioning
// - WMMA/WGMMA instruction emission based on architecture
// - TMA async bulk transfers on Hopper+ (sm_90+)
//
// Target: CUDA 13+ (Blackwell sm_100+), with fallback for Ampere/Hopper

module tile_matmul

import gpu
import gpu.tile
import gpu.memory

// Tile dimensions for matrix multiplication
// These must be powers of 2 and match WMMA/WGMMA supported shapes
const TILE_M: u32 = 16
const TILE_N: u32 = 16
const TILE_K: u32 = 16

/// 16x16 tile-based matrix multiplication kernel
/// Each thread block computes one 16x16 output tile using Tensor Cores
///
/// Arguments:
///   A: Input matrix A [M x K], row-major
///   B: Input matrix B [K x N], row-major
///   C: Output matrix C [M x N], row-major
///   M, N, K: Matrix dimensions
///   lda, ldb, ldc: Leading dimensions (row strides)
kernel fn matmul_tile_16x16(
    A: *const f16,
    B: *const f16,
    C: *mut f32,
    M: i32,
    N: i32,
    K: i32,
    lda: i32,
    ldb: i32,
    ldc: i32,
) {
    // Get block cooperative group
    let block = gpu.this_block()

    // Compute output tile position
    let tile_row = gpu.block_id().y * TILE_M
    let tile_col = gpu.block_id().x * TILE_N

    // Create accumulator tile (f32 for precision)
    // Compiler allocates shared memory automatically
    var c_tile: tile<f32, TILE_M, TILE_N> = tile.zeros()

    // Loop over K dimension in TILE_K chunks
    for k in range(0, K, TILE_K) {
        // Load A tile: [tile_row:tile_row+TILE_M, k:k+TILE_K]
        let a_tile: tile<f16, TILE_M, TILE_K> = tile.load(
            A + tile_row * lda + k,
            lda,
        )

        // Load B tile: [k:k+TILE_K, tile_col:tile_col+TILE_N]
        let b_tile: tile<f16, TILE_K, TILE_N> = tile.load(
            B + k * ldb + tile_col,
            ldb,
        )

        // Synchronize: ensure all threads have loaded their data
        tile.sync()

        // Matrix multiply-accumulate using Tensor Cores
        // On Blackwell: WGMMA (warpgroup MMA)
        // On Ampere/Hopper: MMA (warp-scoped)
        c_tile = tile.mma(c_tile, a_tile, b_tile)

        // Synchronize before next iteration
        tile.sync()
    }

    // Store result tile to global memory
    tile.store(
        c_tile,
        C + tile_row * ldc + tile_col,
        ldc,
    )
}

/// Alternative kernel using swizzled layout for bank conflict avoidance
kernel fn matmul_tile_swizzled(
    A: *const f16,
    B: *const f16,
    C: *mut f32,
    M: i32,
    N: i32,
    K: i32,
    lda: i32,
    ldb: i32,
    ldc: i32,
) {
    let tile_row = gpu.block_id().y * TILE_M
    let tile_col = gpu.block_id().x * TILE_N

    // Use swizzled layout to avoid shared memory bank conflicts
    var c_tile: tile<f32, TILE_M, TILE_N, "swizzled"> = tile.zeros()

    for k in range(0, K, TILE_K) {
        let a_tile: tile<f16, TILE_M, TILE_K, "swizzled"> = tile.load(
            A + tile_row * lda + k,
            lda,
        )

        let b_tile: tile<f16, TILE_K, TILE_N, "swizzled"> = tile.load(
            B + k * ldb + tile_col,
            ldb,
        )

        tile.sync()
        c_tile = tile.mma(c_tile, a_tile, b_tile)
        tile.sync()
    }

    tile.store(c_tile, C + tile_row * ldc + tile_col, ldc)
}

/// Host function to launch the tiled matrix multiplication
fn matmul(
    A: gpu.Buffer<f16>,
    B: gpu.Buffer<f16>,
    C: gpu.Buffer<f32>,
    M: i32,
    N: i32,
    K: i32,
) {
    // Compute grid dimensions based on tile size
    let grid_x = (N + TILE_N - 1) / TILE_N
    let grid_y = (M + TILE_M - 1) / TILE_M
    let grid = (grid_x, grid_y, 1)

    // Thread block: one warp (32 threads) per tile
    // For larger tiles, use multiple warps
    let block = (32, 1, 1)

    // Launch kernel
    matmul_tile_16x16.launch(grid, block)(
        A.ptr(),
        B.ptr(),
        C.ptr(),
        M, N, K,
        K,  // lda = K (row-major A)
        N,  // ldb = N (row-major B)
        N,  // ldc = N (row-major C)
    )

    // Synchronize to ensure completion
    gpu.sync()
}

/// Main entry point demonstrating tiled matrix multiplication
fn main() {
    println("Tile-based Matrix Multiplication Example")
    println("=========================================")

    // Matrix dimensions (must be multiples of tile size for simplicity)
    let M = 1024
    let N = 1024
    let K = 1024

    println("Matrix dimensions: {}x{}x{}", M, N, K)
    println("Tile size: {}x{}x{}", TILE_M, TILE_N, TILE_K)

    // Allocate GPU buffers
    let A = gpu.alloc::<f16>(M * K)
    let B = gpu.alloc::<f16>(K * N)
    let C = gpu.alloc::<f32>(M * N)

    // Initialize with random data (in real code)
    // A.fill_random()
    // B.fill_random()
    // C.fill(0.0)

    // Perform tiled matrix multiplication
    matmul(A, B, C, M, N, K)

    println("Matrix multiplication completed.")

    // Cleanup
    A.free()
    B.free()
    C.free()
}

// Expected PTX output (partial) for sm_100 (Blackwell):
//
// .version 8.5
// .target sm_100
// .address_size 64
//
// .entry matmul_tile_16x16(
//     .param .u64 A,
//     .param .u64 B,
//     .param .u64 C,
//     .param .u32 M,
//     .param .u32 N,
//     .param .u32 K,
//     .param .u32 lda,
//     .param .u32 ldb,
//     .param .u32 ldc
// ) {
//     .shared .align 16 .b8 a_smem[512];   // 16x16 f16 = 512 bytes
//     .shared .align 16 .b8 b_smem[512];   // 16x16 f16 = 512 bytes
//     .shared .align 16 .b8 c_smem[1024];  // 16x16 f32 = 1024 bytes
//
//     // ... tile load/store operations ...
//
//     // Blackwell WGMMA instruction (warpgroup-scoped)
//     wgmma.mma_async.sync.aligned.m16n16k16.f32.bf16.bf16 {...}, {...}, {...};
//
//     // ... store operations ...
//
//     ret;
// }

*/

struct Sample {
    value: i64
}

fn scale(item: Sample, factor: i64) -> Sample {
    return Sample { value: item.value * factor }
}

fn checksum(values: [i64]) -> i64 {
    var sum: i64 = 0
    for v in values {
        sum = sum + v
    }
    return sum
}

fn main() with IO {
    let seed = Sample { value: 3 }
    let scaled = scale(seed, 7)
    let data: [i64] = [scaled.value, 2, 5, 8]
    let total = checksum(data)
    println("example: tile_matmul")
    println(total)
}

// === FILE: examples/token_erase_benchmark.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Token-Erase Benchmark: ZD as Hard-Reset Mechanism
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// Motivation: ListOps and Bracket reward RETENTION — ZD hurts there.
// This task rewards FORGETTING: only tokens AFTER an ERASE token matter.
//
// Task structure:
//   Sequence: [noise_0..noise_k] [ERASE=12] [signal_0..signal_m]
//   Label: determined solely by the signal tokens after ERASE
//   Pre-ERASE tokens are random noise with no correlation to the label.
//
// Optimal strategy for any model:
//   When ERASE arrives → state should become exactly 0 (full reset)
//   Then process signal tokens from a clean state
//
// Why S-SSM-ZD-init should win:
//   A = e3 + e10 (known ZD pair): e3+e10 annihilates e6-e15
//   When ERASE token embedding ≈ e6-e15 direction:
//     h' = A⊗h + B⊗embed[ERASE] ≈ A⊗h + ~0 ← ZD annihilation drives h→0
//   H-SSM: no ZD → can only exponentially decay, always has residual
//
// Models tested (all 16D, 16 A-params):
//   H-SSM-16D    : 4×quat, assoc, NO ZD, no gate
//   S-SSM-rand   : sedenion, ZD possible, random A init
//   S-SSM-ZDinit : sedenion, A initialized AT ZD locus (e3+e10)
//
// Noise prefix length: 4 tokens. Signal length: 3 tokens. Total: 8 tokens.
// Label: min/max/med of 3 signal tokens ∈ {0..9}
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

fn exp_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 15.0 { return exp_q(7.5) * exp_q(x - 7.5) }
    if x < 0.0 - 15.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0; var term = 1.0; var i = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); sum = sum + term; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}

var RNG_A: i64 = 0; var RNG_B: i64 = 0
fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }
fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A; let y = RNG_B; RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23); x = x ^ (x >> 17); x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x; let r = x + y; if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}

// Token vocab: 0..9 = digits, 10 = op1, 11 = op2, 12 = ERASE
// Total vocab = 13 tokens → embed = 13 × 16 = 208

// ─── Task generator ───
// SEQ: [noise×4, ERASE=12, sig×3], label = op(sig0,sig1,sig2)
var SEQ: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]

fn min_v(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }
fn max_v(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }
fn med3(a: i64, b: i64, c: i64) -> i64 {
    if a <= b { if b <= c { b } else { if a <= c { c } else { a } } }
    else { if a <= c { a } else { if b <= c { c } else { b } } }
}

fn gen_sample() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    // 4 noise tokens
    SEQ[0] = (rng_next() / 100) % 10
    SEQ[1] = (rng_next() / 100) % 10
    SEQ[2] = (rng_next() / 100) % 10
    SEQ[3] = (rng_next() / 100) % 10
    // ERASE token
    SEQ[4] = 12
    // 3 signal tokens
    let s0 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10
    let s1 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10
    let s2 = (rng_next() / 100) % 10
    SEQ[5] = s0; SEQ[6] = s1; SEQ[7] = s2
    // Label: op determined by (rng_next() % 3)
    let op = (rng_next() / 100) % 3
    if op == 0 { min_v(min_v(s0, s1), s2) }
    else { if op == 1 { max_v(max_v(s0, s1), s2) }
           else { med3(s0, s1, s2) } }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// H-SSM-16D: 4 quaternion blocks, 16D, 16A, NO ZD (capacity control)
// W_H: embed[0..207], A[208..223], B[224..239], out[240..399]
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
var W_H: [i64; 400]=[0;400]; var H_H: [i64; 16]=[0;16]
var L_H: [i64; 10]=[0;10]; var MOM_H: [i64; 400]=[0;400]
fn whs(i:i64,v:f64) with Mut { W_H[i]=(v*100000000.0) as i64 }
fn whg(i:i64)->f64 with Div { (W_H[i] as f64)/100000000.0 }
fn hhs(i:i64,v:f64) with Mut { H_H[i]=(v*100000000.0) as i64 }
fn hhg(i:i64)->f64 with Div { (H_H[i] as f64)/100000000.0 }

fn init_h() with Mut, Div {
    var i=0
    while i<208{whs(i,((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/3000.0);i=i+1}
    i=0;while i<16{whs(224+i,((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/3000.0);i=i+1}
    i=0;while i<160{whs(240+i,((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/3000.0);i=i+1}
    i=0;while i<400{MOM_H[i]=0;i=i+1}
    var b=0
    while b<4{
        whs(208+b*4,0.95)
        whs(209+b*4,((rng_next()%100) as f64-50.0)/500.0)
        whs(210+b*4,((rng_next()%100) as f64-50.0)/500.0)
        whs(211+b*4,((rng_next()%100) as f64-50.0)/500.0)
        b=b+1
    }
}

fn step_h(tok: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var b=0
    while b<4 {
        let base=b*4
        let qw=whg(208+base);let qx=whg(209+base);let qy=whg(210+base);let qz=whg(211+base)
        let hw=hhg(base);let hx=hhg(base+1);let hy=hhg(base+2);let hz=hhg(base+3)
        var n0=qw*hw-qx*hx-qy*hy-qz*hz; var n1=qw*hx+qx*hw+qy*hz-qz*hy
        var n2=qw*hy-qx*hz+qy*hw+qz*hx; var n3=qw*hz+qx*hy-qy*hx+qz*hw
        n0=n0+whg(224+base)*whg(tok*16+base)
        n1=n1+whg(225+base)*whg(tok*16+base+1)
        n2=n2+whg(226+base)*whg(tok*16+base+2)
        n3=n3+whg(227+base)*whg(tok*16+base+3)
        if n0>5.0{n0=5.0}if n0<0.0-5.0{n0=0.0-5.0}
        if n1>5.0{n1=5.0}if n1<0.0-5.0{n1=0.0-5.0}
        if n2>5.0{n2=5.0}if n2<0.0-5.0{n2=0.0-5.0}
        if n3>5.0{n3=5.0}if n3<0.0-5.0{n3=0.0-5.0}
        hhs(base,n0);hhs(base+1,n1);hhs(base+2,n2);hhs(base+3,n3)
        b=b+1
    }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// S-SSM (sedenion 16D) — shared infrastructure for both inits
// W_S: embed[0..207], A[208..223], B[224..239], out[240..399]
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
var W_S: [i64; 400]=[0;400]; var H_S: [i64; 16]=[0;16]
var L_S: [i64; 10]=[0;10]; var MOM_S: [i64; 400]=[0;400]
var OCT_P: [f64; 8]=[0.0;8]; var OCT_Q: [f64; 8]=[0.0;8]
fn wss(i:i64,v:f64) with Mut { W_S[i]=(v*100000000.0) as i64 }
fn wsg(i:i64)->f64 with Div { (W_S[i] as f64)/100000000.0 }
fn hss(i:i64,v:f64) with Mut { H_S[i]=(v*100000000.0) as i64 }
fn hsg(i:i64)->f64 with Div { (H_S[i] as f64)/100000000.0 }

fn init_s_common() with Mut, Div {
    var i=0
    while i<208{wss(i,((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/3000.0);i=i+1}
    i=0;while i<16{wss(224+i,((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/3000.0);i=i+1}
    i=0;while i<160{wss(240+i,((rng_next()%2000) as f64-1000.0)/3000.0);i=i+1}
    i=0;while i<400{MOM_S[i]=0;i=i+1}
}

fn init_s_rand() with Mut, Div {
    init_s_common()
    wss(208,0.95)
    var i=1;while i<8{wss(208+i,((rng_next()%200) as f64-100.0)/1000.0);i=i+1}
    i=8;while i<16{wss(208+i,((rng_next()%100) as f64-50.0)/2000.0);i=i+1}
}

fn init_s_zdinit() with Mut, Div {
    // ZD-biased: A = e3 + e10 (known zero-divisor pair from stdlib)
    // (e3 + e10) * (e6 - e15) = 0 in sedenions
    // ERASE token embed will be tuned toward (e6 - e15) direction during training
    init_s_common()
    var i=0;while i<16{wss(208+i,0.0);i=i+1}
    wss(208+3,  0.8)   // e3 component: lower-half imaginary
    wss(208+10, 0.8)   // e10 component: upper-half imaginary (ZD pair)
    // Small perturbation to other components to allow learning
    i=0
    while i<16 {
        if i != 3 { if i != 10 { wss(208+i, ((rng_next()%50) as f64-25.0)/5000.0) } }
        i=i+1
    }
}

fn oct_p(a0:f64,a1:f64,a2:f64,a3:f64,a4:f64,a5:f64,a6:f64,a7:f64,
         b0:f64,b1:f64,b2:f64,b3:f64,b4:f64,b5:f64,b6:f64,b7:f64) with Mut {
    OCT_P[0]=a0*b0-a1*b1-a2*b2-a3*b3-a4*b4-a5*b5-a6*b6-a7*b7
    OCT_P[1]=a0*b1+a1*b0+a2*b3-a3*b2+a4*b5-a5*b4-a6*b7+a7*b6
    OCT_P[2]=a0*b2+a2*b0-a1*b3+a3*b1+a4*b6-a6*b4+a5*b7-a7*b5
    OCT_P[3]=a0*b3+a3*b0+a1*b2-a2*b1+a4*b7-a7*b4-a5*b6+a6*b5
    OCT_P[4]=a0*b4+a4*b0-a1*b5+a5*b1-a2*b6+a6*b2-a3*b7+a7*b3
    OCT_P[5]=a0*b5+a5*b0+a1*b4-a4*b1-a2*b7+a7*b2+a3*b6-a6*b3
    OCT_P[6]=a0*b6+a6*b0+a1*b7-a7*b1+a2*b4-a4*b2-a3*b5+a5*b3
    OCT_P[7]=a0*b7+a7*b0-a1*b6+a6*b1-a2*b5+a5*b2+a3*b4-a4*b3
}
fn oct_q(a0:f64,a1:f64,a2:f64,a3:f64,a4:f64,a5:f64,a6:f64,a7:f64,
         b0:f64,b1:f64,b2:f64,b3:f64,b4:f64,b5:f64,b6:f64,b7:f64) with Mut {
    OCT_Q[0]=a0*b0-a1*b1-a2*b2-a3*b3-a4*b4-a5*b5-a6*b6-a7*b7
    OCT_Q[1]=a0*b1+a1*b0+a2*b3-a3*b2+a4*b5-a5*b4-a6*b7+a7*b6
    OCT_Q[2]=a0*b2+a2*b0-a1*b3+a3*b1+a4*b6-a6*b4+a5*b7-a7*b5
    OCT_Q[3]=a0*b3+a3*b0+a1*b2-a2*b1+a4*b7-a7*b4-a5*b6+a6*b5
    OCT_Q[4]=a0*b4+a4*b0-a1*b5+a5*b1-a2*b6+a6*b2-a3*b7+a7*b3
    OCT_Q[5]=a0*b5+a5*b0+a1*b4-a4*b1-a2*b7+a7*b2+a3*b6-a6*b3
    OCT_Q[6]=a0*b6+a6*b0+a1*b7-a7*b1+a2*b4-a4*b2-a3*b5+a5*b3
    OCT_Q[7]=a0*b7+a7*b0-a1*b6+a6*b1-a2*b5+a5*b2+a3*b4-a4*b3
}

fn step_s(tok: i64) with Mut, Div {
    let a0=wsg(208);let a1=wsg(209);let a2=wsg(210);let a3=wsg(211)
    let a4=wsg(212);let a5=wsg(213);let a6=wsg(214);let a7=wsg(215)
    let a8=wsg(216);let a9=wsg(217);let a10=wsg(218);let a11=wsg(219)
    let a12=wsg(220);let a13=wsg(221);let a14=wsg(222);let a15=wsg(223)
    let h0=hsg(0);let h1=hsg(1);let h2=hsg(2);let h3=hsg(3)
    let h4=hsg(4);let h5=hsg(5);let h6=hsg(6);let h7=hsg(7)
    let h8=hsg(8);let h9=hsg(9);let h10=hsg(10);let h11=hsg(11)
    let h12=hsg(12);let h13=hsg(13);let h14=hsg(14);let h15=hsg(15)
    oct_p(a0,a1,a2,a3,a4,a5,a6,a7, h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7)
    oct_q(a8,0.0-a9,0.0-a10,0.0-a11,0.0-a12,0.0-a13,0.0-a14,0.0-a15, h8,h9,h10,h11,h12,h13,h14,h15)
    var r0=OCT_P[0]-OCT_Q[0];var r1=OCT_P[1]-OCT_Q[1];var r2=OCT_P[2]-OCT_Q[2];var r3=OCT_P[3]-OCT_Q[3]
    var r4=OCT_P[4]-OCT_Q[4];var r5=OCT_P[5]-OCT_Q[5];var r6=OCT_P[6]-OCT_Q[6];var r7=OCT_P[7]-OCT_Q[7]
    oct_p(a8,a9,a10,a11,a12,a13,a14,a15, h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7)
    oct_q(h8,h9,h10,h11,h12,h13,h14,h15, a0,0.0-a1,0.0-a2,0.0-a3,0.0-a4,0.0-a5,0.0-a6,0.0-a7)
    var r8=OCT_P[0]+OCT_Q[0];var r9=OCT_P[1]+OCT_Q[1];var r10=OCT_P[2]+OCT_Q[2];var r11=OCT_P[3]+OCT_Q[3]
    var r12=OCT_P[4]+OCT_Q[4];var r13=OCT_P[5]+OCT_Q[5];var r14=OCT_P[6]+OCT_Q[6];var r15=OCT_P[7]+OCT_Q[7]
    r0=r0+wsg(224)*wsg(tok*16);r1=r1+wsg(225)*wsg(tok*16+1)
    r2=r2+wsg(226)*wsg(tok*16+2);r3=r3+wsg(227)*wsg(tok*16+3)
    r4=r4+wsg(228)*wsg(tok*16+4);r5=r5+wsg(229)*wsg(tok*16+5)
    r6=r6+wsg(230)*wsg(tok*16+6);r7=r7+wsg(231)*wsg(tok*16+7)
    r8=r8+wsg(232)*wsg(tok*16+8);r9=r9+wsg(233)*wsg(tok*16+9)
    r10=r10+wsg(234)*wsg(tok*16+10);r11=r11+wsg(235)*wsg(tok*16+11)
    r12=r12+wsg(236)*wsg(tok*16+12);r13=r13+wsg(237)*wsg(tok*16+13)
    r14=r14+wsg(238)*wsg(tok*16+14);r15=r15+wsg(239)*wsg(tok*16+15)
    if r0>5.0{r0=5.0}if r0<0.0-5.0{r0=0.0-5.0}
    if r1>5.0{r1=5.0}if r1<0.0-5.0{r1=0.0-5.0}
    if r2>5.0{r2=5.0}if r2<0.0-5.0{r2=0.0-5.0}
    if r3>5.0{r3=5.0}if r3<0.0-5.0{r3=0.0-5.0}
    if r4>5.0{r4=5.0}if r4<0.0-5.0{r4=0.0-5.0}
    if r5>5.0{r5=5.0}if r5<0.0-5.0{r5=0.0-5.0}
    if r6>5.0{r6=5.0}if r6<0.0-5.0{r6=0.0-5.0}
    if r7>5.0{r7=5.0}if r7<0.0-5.0{r7=0.0-5.0}
    if r8>5.0{r8=5.0}if r8<0.0-5.0{r8=0.0-5.0}
    if r9>5.0{r9=5.0}if r9<0.0-5.0{r9=0.0-5.0}
    if r10>5.0{r10=5.0}if r10<0.0-5.0{r10=0.0-5.0}
    if r11>5.0{r11=5.0}if r11<0.0-5.0{r11=0.0-5.0}
    if r12>5.0{r12=5.0}if r12<0.0-5.0{r12=0.0-5.0}
    if r13>5.0{r13=5.0}if r13<0.0-5.0{r13=0.0-5.0}
    if r14>5.0{r14=5.0}if r14<0.0-5.0{r14=0.0-5.0}
    if r15>5.0{r15=5.0}if r15<0.0-5.0{r15=0.0-5.0}
    hss(0,r0);hss(1,r1);hss(2,r2);hss(3,r3);hss(4,r4);hss(5,r5);hss(6,r6);hss(7,r7)
    hss(8,r8);hss(9,r9);hss(10,r10);hss(11,r11);hss(12,r12);hss(13,r13);hss(14,r14);hss(15,r15)
}

// ─── Output, prediction, update (shared for H and S, 10 classes, NC=10) ───
fn logits_h(nc:i64) with Mut, Div {
    var c=0;while c<nc{var s=0.0;var d=0;while d<16{s=s+hhg(d)*whg(240+d*nc+c);d=d+1};L_H[c]=(s*100000000.0) as i64;c=c+1}
}
fn pred_h(nc:i64)->i64 with Mut, Div {
    var best=0;var bv=(L_H[0] as f64)/100000000.0;var i=1
    while i<nc{let v=(L_H[i] as f64)/100000000.0;if v>bv{bv=v;best=i};i=i+1};best
}
fn update_h(tgt:i64,lr:f64,nc:i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var mx=(L_H[0] as f64)/100000000.0;var i=1
    while i<nc{let v=(L_H[i] as f64)/100000000.0;if v>mx{mx=v};i=i+1}
    var probs: [f64;10]=[0.0;10];var se=0.0;i=0
    while i<nc{probs[i]=exp_q((L_H[i] as f64)/100000000.0-mx);se=se+probs[i];i=i+1}
    i=0;while i<nc{probs[i]=probs[i]/se;i=i+1};probs[tgt]=probs[tgt]-1.0
    var d=0;while d<16{let hd=hhg(d);var c=0;while c<nc{let idx=240+d*nc+c;var g=hd*probs[c];if g>0.3{g=0.3}if g<0.0-0.3{g=0.0-0.3};let m=(MOM_H[idx] as f64)/100000000.0*0.9+g;MOM_H[idx]=(m*100000000.0) as i64;whs(idx,whg(idx)-lr*m);c=c+1};d=d+1}
}
fn logits_s(nc:i64) with Mut, Div {
    var c=0;while c<nc{var s=0.0;var d=0;while d<16{s=s+hsg(d)*wsg(240+d*nc+c);d=d+1};L_S[c]=(s*100000000.0) as i64;c=c+1}
}
fn pred_s(nc:i64)->i64 with Mut, Div {
    var best=0;var bv=(L_S[0] as f64)/100000000.0;var i=1
    while i<nc{let v=(L_S[i] as f64)/100000000.0;if v>bv{bv=v;best=i};i=i+1};best
}
fn update_s(tgt:i64,lr:f64,nc:i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var mx=(L_S[0] as f64)/100000000.0;var i=1
    while i<nc{let v=(L_S[i] as f64)/100000000.0;if v>mx{mx=v};i=i+1}
    var probs: [f64;10]=[0.0;10];var se=0.0;i=0
    while i<nc{probs[i]=exp_q((L_S[i] as f64)/100000000.0-mx);se=se+probs[i];i=i+1}
    i=0;while i<nc{probs[i]=probs[i]/se;i=i+1};probs[tgt]=probs[tgt]-1.0
    var d=0;while d<16{let hd=hsg(d);var c=0;while c<nc{let idx=240+d*nc+c;var g=hd*probs[c];if g>0.3{g=0.3}if g<0.0-0.3{g=0.0-0.3};let m=(MOM_S[idx] as f64)/100000000.0*0.9+g;MOM_S[idx]=(m*100000000.0) as i64;wss(idx,wsg(idx)-lr*m);c=c+1};d=d+1}
}

fn run_h() -> f64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var ep=0;while ep<80{var s=0;while s<500{let tgt=gen_sample();var d=0;while d<16{H_H[d]=0;d=d+1};var t=0;while t<8{step_h(SEQ[t]);t=t+1};logits_h(10);update_h(tgt,0.01,10);s=s+1};ep=ep+1}
    rng_seed(99999,11111);var correct=0;var s=0
    while s<1000{let tgt=gen_sample();var d=0;while d<16{H_H[d]=0;d=d+1};var t=0;while t<8{step_h(SEQ[t]);t=t+1};logits_h(10);if pred_h(10)==tgt{correct=correct+1};s=s+1}
    (correct as f64)/1000.0*100.0
}
fn run_s() -> f64 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    var ep=0;while ep<80{var s=0;while s<500{let tgt=gen_sample();var d=0;while d<16{H_S[d]=0;d=d+1};var t=0;while t<8{step_s(SEQ[t]);t=t+1};logits_s(10);update_s(tgt,0.01,10);s=s+1};ep=ep+1}
    rng_seed(99999,11111);var correct=0;var s=0
    while s<1000{let tgt=gen_sample();var d=0;while d<16{H_S[d]=0;d=d+1};var t=0;while t<8{step_s(SEQ[t]);t=t+1};logits_s(10);if pred_s(10)==tgt{correct=correct+1};s=s+1}
    (correct as f64)/1000.0*100.0
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  Token-Erase Benchmark (ZD as Hard-Reset)\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print("  Task: [noise×4][ERASE][signal×3] → label from signal only\n")
    print("  Optimal: hard-reset state at ERASE → process signal cleanly\n\n")
    print("  H-SSM-16D  : 4×quat, 16D, 16A, NO ZD\n")
    print("  S-SSM-rand : sedenion, 16D, 16A, random A init\n")
    print("  S-SSM-ZDinit: sedenion, 16D, A = e3+e10 (ZD locus)\n\n")

    print("  H-SSM-16D:    ")
    rng_seed(55555,77777); init_h(); rng_seed(12345,67890)
    let acc_h = run_h()
    print(acc_h); print("%\n")

    print("  S-SSM-rand:   ")
    rng_seed(55555,77777); init_s_rand(); rng_seed(12345,67890)
    let acc_s_rand = run_s()
    print(acc_s_rand); print("%\n")

    print("  S-SSM-ZDinit: ")
    rng_seed(55555,77777); init_s_zdinit(); rng_seed(12345,67890)
    let acc_s_zd = run_s()
    print(acc_s_zd); print("%\n")

    print("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  VERDICT (Token-Erase)\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  Random baseline: ~10% (10-class)\n")
    print("  H-SSM-16D:    "); print(acc_h); print("%\n")
    print("  S-SSM-rand:   "); print(acc_s_rand); print("%\n")
    print("  S-SSM-ZDinit: "); print(acc_s_zd); print("%\n\n")

    let zd_vs_h = acc_s_zd - acc_h
    if zd_vs_h > 3.0 {
        print("  ZD-init > H-SSM (+"); print(zd_vs_h); print("pp) — ZD hard-reset IS a feature here\n")
    } else {
        if zd_vs_h < 0.0 - 3.0 {
            print("  H-SSM > ZD-init ("); print(zd_vs_h); print("pp) — ZD not advantageous on this task\n")
        } else {
            print("  ZD-init ≈ H-SSM (within ±3pp)\n")
        }
    }

    println("ALL PASS")
    0
}


// === FILE: examples/triple_product_ossm_benchmark.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL PASS

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Triple-Product O-SSM: The Architecture That ACTIVATES Non-Associativity
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//
// CRITICAL INSIGHT (Artin's Theorem):
// In an alternative algebra, any two elements generate an associative subalgebra.
// Therefore A ⊗ h is ALWAYS locally associative — non-associativity is DORMANT
// in the standard h' = A⊗h + B·x architecture.
//
// FIX: Triple product h' = (A ⊗ h) ⊗ x
// Three independent octonions interact multiplicatively.
// (A⊗h)⊗x ≠ A⊗(h⊗x) for octonions — non-associativity is ACTIVE.
// (q⊗h)⊗x = q⊗(h⊗x) for quaternions — still associative.
//
// Models (all 8 A-params):
//   0: O-SSM-Triple   h' = clamp((A ⊗ h) ⊗ x)      [non-assoc ACTIVE]
//   1: H-SSM-Triple   h' = clamp((q ⊗ h) ⊗ x)      [assoc, blind to brackets]
//   2: O-SSM-Additive h' = clamp(A ⊗ h + B · x)     [non-assoc DORMANT by Artin]
//   3: Naive-DIAG     h' = clamp(diag(A)·h + B·x)   [baseline]
//
// Task: Associativity Probe (Fano-plane ground truth, 16 classes)

fn exp_q(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 15.0 { return exp_q(7.5) * exp_q(x - 7.5) }
    if x < 0.0 - 15.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0; var term = 1.0; var i = 1
    while i <= 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); sum = sum + term; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}

var RNG_A: i64 = 0; var RNG_B: i64 = 0
fn rng_seed(a: i64, b: i64) with Mut { RNG_A = a; RNG_B = b }
fn rng_next() -> i64 with Mut {
    var x = RNG_A; let y = RNG_B; RNG_A = y
    x = x ^ (x << 23); x = x ^ (x >> 17); x = x ^ (y ^ (y >> 26))
    RNG_B = x; let r = x + y; if r < 0 { 0 - r } else { r }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Fano Plane Basis Multiplication (same as associativity_probe_benchmark)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 7 lines: (1,2,4), (2,3,5), (3,4,6), (4,5,7), (5,6,1), (6,7,2), (7,1,3)

fn oct_sign(i: i64, j: i64) -> i64 {
    if i == 0 { return 1 } if j == 0 { return 1 }
    if i == j { return 0 - 1 }
    if i==1 { if j==2 { return 1 } if j==4 { return 0-1 } if j==3 { return 1 } if j==5 { return 1 } if j==6 { return 0-1 } if j==7 { return 0-1 } }
    if i==2 { if j==1 { return 0-1 } if j==3 { return 1 } if j==4 { return 1 } if j==5 { return 0-1 } if j==6 { return 1 } if j==7 { return 0-1 } }
    if i==3 { if j==1 { return 0-1 } if j==2 { return 0-1 } if j==4 { return 1 } if j==5 { return 1 } if j==6 { return 0-1 } if j==7 { return 1 } }
    if i==4 { if j==1 { return 1 } if j==2 { return 0-1 } if j==3 { return 0-1 } if j==5 { return 1 } if j==6 { return 1 } if j==7 { return 0-1 } }
    if i==5 { if j==1 { return 0-1 } if j==2 { return 1 } if j==3 { return 0-1 } if j==4 { return 0-1 } if j==6 { return 1 } if j==7 { return 1 } }
    if i==6 { if j==1 { return 1 } if j==2 { return 0-1 } if j==3 { return 1 } if j==4 { return 0-1 } if j==5 { return 0-1 } if j==7 { return 1 } }
    if i==7 { if j==1 { return 1 } if j==2 { return 1 } if j==3 { return 0-1 } if j==4 { return 1 } if j==5 { return 0-1 } if j==6 { return 0-1 } }
    0
}

fn oct_basis(i: i64, j: i64) -> i64 {
    if i == 0 { return j } if j == 0 { return i }
    if i == j { return 0 }
    if i==1 { if j==2 { return 4 } if j==4 { return 2 } if j==3 { return 7 } if j==5 { return 6 } if j==6 { return 5 } if j==7 { return 3 } }
    if i==2 { if j==1 { return 4 } if j==3 { return 5 } if j==4 { return 1 } if j==5 { return 3 } if j==6 { return 7 } if j==7 { return 6 } }
    if i==3 { if j==1 { return 7 } if j==2 { return 5 } if j==4 { return 6 } if j==5 { return 2 } if j==6 { return 4 } if j==7 { return 1 } }
    if i==4 { if j==1 { return 2 } if j==2 { return 1 } if j==3 { return 6 } if j==5 { return 7 } if j==6 { return 3 } if j==7 { return 5 } }
    if i==5 { if j==1 { return 6 } if j==2 { return 3 } if j==3 { return 2 } if j==4 { return 7 } if j==6 { return 1 } if j==7 { return 4 } }
    if i==6 { if j==1 { return 5 } if j==2 { return 7 } if j==3 { return 4 } if j==4 { return 3 } if j==5 { return 1 } if j==7 { return 2 } }
    if i==7 { if j==1 { return 3 } if j==2 { return 6 } if j==3 { return 1 } if j==4 { return 5 } if j==5 { return 4 } if j==6 { return 2 } }
    0
}

fn oct_signed_mul(s_a: i64, idx_a: i64, idx_b: i64) -> i64 with Mut {
    let raw_sign = oct_sign(idx_a, idx_b)
    let raw_basis = oct_basis(idx_a, idx_b)
    var final_sign = raw_sign
    if s_a < 0 { final_sign = 0 - final_sign }
    if final_sign >= 0 { raw_basis } else { 8 + raw_basis }
}

// ─── Ground truth generator ───
var PROBE_TOKENS: [i64; 4] = [0; 4]
var PROBE_LABEL: i64 = 0
var PROBE_IS_ASSOC: i64 = 0

fn generate_assoc_probe() with Mut, Div {
    let a = (rng_next() / 100) % 8
    let b = (rng_next() / 100) % 8
    let c = (rng_next() / 100) % 8
    let mode = (rng_next() / 100) % 2
    PROBE_TOKENS[0] = a; PROBE_TOKENS[1] = b; PROBE_TOKENS[2] = c
    PROBE_TOKENS[3] = mode + 8
    let ab_sign = oct_sign(a, b); let ab_idx = oct_basis(a, b)
    let left_label = oct_signed_mul(ab_sign, ab_idx, c)
    let bc_sign = oct_sign(b, c); let bc_idx = oct_basis(b, c)
    let right_label = oct_signed_mul(bc_sign, a, bc_idx)
    if mode == 0 { PROBE_LABEL = left_label }
    if mode == 1 { PROBE_LABEL = right_label }
    if left_label == right_label { PROBE_IS_ASSOC = 1 } else { PROBE_IS_ASSOC = 0 }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Model Weights
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Embed: 10 tokens × 8 dims = 80 (0..79)
// A: 8 (80..87)
// B: 8 (88..95) — only used by additive and naive models
// Out: 8×16 = 128 (96..223)
// Total: 224

var W: [i64; 224] = [0; 224]
var H: [i64; 8] = [0; 8]
var L: [i64; 16] = [0; 16]
var MOM: [i64; 224] = [0; 224]

fn ws(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { W[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn wg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (W[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }
fn hs(i: i64, v: f64) with Mut { H[i] = (v * 100000000.0) as i64 }
fn hg(i: i64) -> f64 with Div { (H[i] as f64) / 100000000.0 }

fn init_embed_b_out() with Mut, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < 80 { ws(i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 8 { ws(88 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 128 { ws(96 + i, ((rng_next() % 2000) as f64 - 1000.0) / 3000.0); i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 224 { MOM[i] = 0; i = i + 1 }
}

fn init_A_oct() with Mut, Div {
    ws(80, 0.95)
    var i = 1
    while i < 8 { ws(80 + i, ((rng_next() % 200) as f64 - 100.0) / 1000.0); i = i + 1 }
}

fn init_A_quat() with Mut, Div {
    ws(80, 0.95); ws(81, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(82, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0); ws(83, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(84, 0.95); ws(85, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
    ws(86, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0); ws(87, ((rng_next() % 100) as f64 - 50.0) / 500.0)
}

fn init_A_diag() with Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < 8 { ws(80 + i, 0.95); i = i + 1 }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Forward Steps
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Inline oct_mul: computes c = a ⊗ b using Cayley product, reads from arrays
// We use temp arrays to avoid aliasing issues
var TEMP_OCT: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]

// oct_mul into TEMP_OCT from 8 f64 values each
fn do_oct_mul(a0: f64, a1: f64, a2: f64, a3: f64, a4: f64, a5: f64, a6: f64, a7: f64,
              b0: f64, b1: f64, b2: f64, b3: f64, b4: f64, b5: f64, b6: f64, b7: f64) with Mut {
    TEMP_OCT[0] = a0*b0 - a1*b1 - a2*b2 - a3*b3 - a4*b4 - a5*b5 - a6*b6 - a7*b7
    TEMP_OCT[1] = a0*b1 + a1*b0 + a2*b3 - a3*b2 + a4*b5 - a5*b4 - a6*b7 + a7*b6
    TEMP_OCT[2] = a0*b2 + a2*b0 - a1*b3 + a3*b1 + a4*b6 - a6*b4 + a5*b7 - a7*b5
    TEMP_OCT[3] = a0*b3 + a3*b0 + a1*b2 - a2*b1 + a4*b7 - a7*b4 - a5*b6 + a6*b5
    TEMP_OCT[4] = a0*b4 + a4*b0 - a1*b5 + a5*b1 - a2*b6 + a6*b2 - a3*b7 + a7*b3
    TEMP_OCT[5] = a0*b5 + a5*b0 + a1*b4 - a4*b1 - a2*b7 + a7*b2 + a3*b6 - a6*b3
    TEMP_OCT[6] = a0*b6 + a6*b0 + a1*b7 - a7*b1 + a2*b4 - a4*b2 - a3*b5 + a5*b3
    TEMP_OCT[7] = a0*b7 + a7*b0 - a1*b6 + a6*b1 - a2*b5 + a5*b2 + a3*b4 - a4*b3
}

// Model 0: O-SSM-Triple — h' = clamp((A ⊗ h) ⊗ x)
// NON-ASSOCIATIVITY IS ACTIVE: three independent octonions in multiplicative chain
fn ossm_triple_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    let a0=wg(80); let a1=wg(81); let a2=wg(82); let a3=wg(83)
    let a4=wg(84); let a5=wg(85); let a6=wg(86); let a7=wg(87)
    let h0=hg(0); let h1=hg(1); let h2=hg(2); let h3=hg(3)
    let h4=hg(4); let h5=hg(5); let h6=hg(6); let h7=hg(7)

    // Step 1: temp = A ⊗ h
    do_oct_mul(a0,a1,a2,a3,a4,a5,a6,a7, h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7)
    let t0=TEMP_OCT[0]; let t1=TEMP_OCT[1]; let t2=TEMP_OCT[2]; let t3=TEMP_OCT[3]
    let t4=TEMP_OCT[4]; let t5=TEMP_OCT[5]; let t6=TEMP_OCT[6]; let t7=TEMP_OCT[7]

    // Step 2: result = temp ⊗ x  (THIS is where non-associativity enters)
    let x0=wg(token*8+0); let x1=wg(token*8+1); let x2=wg(token*8+2); let x3=wg(token*8+3)
    let x4=wg(token*8+4); let x5=wg(token*8+5); let x6=wg(token*8+6); let x7=wg(token*8+7)
    do_oct_mul(t0,t1,t2,t3,t4,t5,t6,t7, x0,x1,x2,x3,x4,x5,x6,x7)

    // Step 3: clamp and store
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var v = TEMP_OCT[d]
        if v > 5.0 { v = 5.0 } if v < 0.0 - 5.0 { v = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        hs(d, v); d = d + 1
    }
}

// Model 1: H-SSM-Triple — h' = clamp((q ⊗ h) ⊗ x) per 4D block
// ASSOCIATIVITY HOLDS: (q⊗h)⊗x = q⊗(h⊗x) for quaternions — brackets don't matter
fn hssm_triple_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    // Block 1 (dims 0-3): (q1 ⊗ h[0:3]) ⊗ x[0:3]
    let qw=wg(80); let qx=wg(81); let qy=wg(82); let qz=wg(83)
    let hw=hg(0); let hx=hg(1); let hy=hg(2); let hz=hg(3)
    // temp = q1 ⊗ h
    let tw = qw*hw - qx*hx - qy*hy - qz*hz
    let tx = qw*hx + qx*hw + qy*hz - qz*hy
    let ty = qw*hy - qx*hz + qy*hw + qz*hx
    let tz = qw*hz + qx*hy - qy*hx + qz*hw
    // result = temp ⊗ x
    let xw=wg(token*8+0); let xx=wg(token*8+1); let xy=wg(token*8+2); let xz=wg(token*8+3)
    var n0 = tw*xw - tx*xx - ty*xy - tz*xz
    var n1 = tw*xx + tx*xw + ty*xz - tz*xy
    var n2 = tw*xy - tx*xz + ty*xw + tz*xx
    var n3 = tw*xz + tx*xy - ty*xx + tz*xw
    if n0>5.0{n0=5.0} if n0<0.0-5.0{n0=0.0-5.0}
    if n1>5.0{n1=5.0} if n1<0.0-5.0{n1=0.0-5.0}
    if n2>5.0{n2=5.0} if n2<0.0-5.0{n2=0.0-5.0}
    if n3>5.0{n3=5.0} if n3<0.0-5.0{n3=0.0-5.0}

    // Block 2 (dims 4-7): (q2 ⊗ h[4:7]) ⊗ x[4:7]
    let qw2=wg(84); let qx2=wg(85); let qy2=wg(86); let qz2=wg(87)
    let hw2=hg(4); let hx2=hg(5); let hy2=hg(6); let hz2=hg(7)
    let tw2 = qw2*hw2 - qx2*hx2 - qy2*hy2 - qz2*hz2
    let tx2 = qw2*hx2 + qx2*hw2 + qy2*hz2 - qz2*hy2
    let ty2 = qw2*hy2 - qx2*hz2 + qy2*hw2 + qz2*hx2
    let tz2 = qw2*hz2 + qx2*hy2 - qy2*hx2 + qz2*hw2
    let xw2=wg(token*8+4); let xx2=wg(token*8+5); let xy2=wg(token*8+6); let xz2=wg(token*8+7)
    var n4 = tw2*xw2 - tx2*xx2 - ty2*xy2 - tz2*xz2
    var n5 = tw2*xx2 + tx2*xw2 + ty2*xz2 - tz2*xy2
    var n6 = tw2*xy2 - tx2*xz2 + ty2*xw2 + tz2*xx2
    var n7 = tw2*xz2 + tx2*xy2 - ty2*xx2 + tz2*xw2
    if n4>5.0{n4=5.0} if n4<0.0-5.0{n4=0.0-5.0}
    if n5>5.0{n5=5.0} if n5<0.0-5.0{n5=0.0-5.0}
    if n6>5.0{n6=5.0} if n6<0.0-5.0{n6=0.0-5.0}
    if n7>5.0{n7=5.0} if n7<0.0-5.0{n7=0.0-5.0}

    hs(0,n0); hs(1,n1); hs(2,n2); hs(3,n3)
    hs(4,n4); hs(5,n5); hs(6,n6); hs(7,n7)
}

// Model 2: O-SSM-Additive — h' = clamp(A ⊗ h + B · x)
// NON-ASSOCIATIVITY IS DORMANT (Artin's theorem: A⊗h is pairwise, always associative)
fn ossm_additive_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    let a0=wg(80); let a1=wg(81); let a2=wg(82); let a3=wg(83)
    let a4=wg(84); let a5=wg(85); let a6=wg(86); let a7=wg(87)
    let h0=hg(0); let h1=hg(1); let h2=hg(2); let h3=hg(3)
    let h4=hg(4); let h5=hg(5); let h6=hg(6); let h7=hg(7)
    do_oct_mul(a0,a1,a2,a3,a4,a5,a6,a7, h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7)
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var v = TEMP_OCT[d] + wg(88 + d) * wg(token*8 + d)
        if v > 5.0 { v = 5.0 } if v < 0.0 - 5.0 { v = 0.0 - 5.0 }
        hs(d, v); d = d + 1
    }
}

// Model 3: Naive-DIAG — h' = clamp(diag(A)·h + B·x)
fn naive_step(token: i64) with Mut, Div {
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        var s = wg(80+d)*hg(d) + wg(88+d)*wg(token*8+d)
        if s>5.0{s=5.0} if s<0.0-5.0{s=0.0-5.0}
        hs(d, s); d = d + 1
    }
}

fn model_step(token: i64, model_id: i64) with Mut, Div {
    if model_id == 0 { ossm_triple_step(token) }
    if model_id == 1 { hssm_triple_step(token) }
    if model_id == 2 { ossm_additive_step(token) }
    if model_id == 3 { naive_step(token) }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Logits, Prediction, Update (16 classes)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

fn compute_logits() with Mut, Div {
    var c = 0
    while c < 16 {
        var s = 0.0; var d = 0
        while d < 8 { s = s + hg(d) * wg(96 + d*16 + c); d = d + 1 }
        L[c] = (s * 100000000.0) as i64; c = c + 1
    }
}

fn get_pred() -> i64 with Mut, Div {
    var best = 0; var bv = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0; var i = 1
    while i < 16 { let v = (L[i] as f64)/100000000.0; if v > bv { bv = v; best = i }; i = i + 1 }
    best
}

fn update_out(tgt: i64, lr: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var mx = (L[0] as f64) / 100000000.0; var i = 1
    while i < 16 { let v = (L[i] as f64)/100000000.0; if v > mx { mx = v }; i = i + 1 }
    var probs: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]; var se = 0.0; i = 0
    while i < 16 { probs[i] = exp_q((L[i] as f64)/100000000.0 - mx); se = se + probs[i]; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 16 { probs[i] = probs[i] / se; i = i + 1 }
    probs[tgt] = probs[tgt] - 1.0
    var d = 0
    while d < 8 {
        let hd = hg(d); var c = 0
        while c < 16 {
            let idx = 96 + d*16 + c
            var g = hd * probs[c]
            if g > 0.3 { g = 0.3 } if g < 0.0 - 0.3 { g = 0.0 - 0.3 }
            let m = (MOM[idx] as f64) / 100000000.0 * 0.9 + g
            MOM[idx] = (m * 100000000.0) as i64
            ws(idx, wg(idx) - lr * m)
            c = c + 1
        }
        d = d + 1
    }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Training + Structured Evaluation
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

fn train_model(model_id: i64) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Phase 1: output-only, 100 epochs
    var ep = 0
    while ep < 100 {
        var s = 0
        while s < 500 {
            generate_assoc_probe()
            var d = 0
            while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
            var t = 0
            while t < 4 { model_step(PROBE_TOKENS[t], model_id); t = t + 1 }
            compute_logits()
            update_out(PROBE_LABEL, 0.01)
            s = s + 1
        }
        ep = ep + 1
    }
}

var EVAL_OVERALL: i64 = 0
var EVAL_ASSOC_C: i64 = 0; var EVAL_ASSOC_T: i64 = 0
var EVAL_NA_C: i64 = 0; var EVAL_NA_T: i64 = 0

fn eval_model(model_id: i64) with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    rng_seed(99999, 11111)
    EVAL_OVERALL = 0; EVAL_ASSOC_C = 0; EVAL_ASSOC_T = 0; EVAL_NA_C = 0; EVAL_NA_T = 0
    var s = 0
    while s < 1000 {
        generate_assoc_probe()
        var d = 0
        while d < 8 { H[d] = 0; d = d + 1 }
        var t = 0
        while t < 4 { model_step(PROBE_TOKENS[t], model_id); t = t + 1 }
        compute_logits()
        let pred = get_pred()
        if pred == PROBE_LABEL { EVAL_OVERALL = EVAL_OVERALL + 1 }
        if PROBE_IS_ASSOC == 1 {
            EVAL_ASSOC_T = EVAL_ASSOC_T + 1
            if pred == PROBE_LABEL { EVAL_ASSOC_C = EVAL_ASSOC_C + 1 }
        } else {
            EVAL_NA_T = EVAL_NA_T + 1
            if pred == PROBE_LABEL { EVAL_NA_C = EVAL_NA_C + 1 }
        }
        s = s + 1
    }
}

fn print_eval_line() with IO, Mut, Div {
    let overall_pct = (EVAL_OVERALL as f64) / 1000.0 * 100.0
    var assoc_pct = 0.0
    if EVAL_ASSOC_T > 0 { assoc_pct = (EVAL_ASSOC_C as f64) / (EVAL_ASSOC_T as f64) * 100.0 }
    var na_pct = 0.0
    if EVAL_NA_T > 0 { na_pct = (EVAL_NA_C as f64) / (EVAL_NA_T as f64) * 100.0 }
    let delta = na_pct - assoc_pct
    print(overall_pct); print("%    ")
    print(assoc_pct); print("%("); print_int(EVAL_ASSOC_T); print(")  ")
    print(na_pct); print("%("); print_int(EVAL_NA_T); print(")  ")
    if delta >= 0.0 { print("+") }
    print(delta); print("%\n")
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  Triple-Product O-SSM: Non-Associativity Activation Test\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print("  h' = (A ⊗ h) ⊗ x   [triple product, non-assoc ACTIVE]\n")
    print("  vs\n")
    print("  h' = A ⊗ h + B·x    [additive, non-assoc DORMANT by Artin]\n\n")
    print("  Artin's theorem: any 2 elements in an alternative algebra\n")
    print("  generate an associative subalgebra. A⊗h is pairwise → associative.\n")
    print("  Only (A⊗h)⊗x invokes non-associativity (3 independent elements).\n\n")

    // Verification
    print("  Verification (non-assoc fraction):\n")
    rng_seed(99999, 11111)
    var na_count = 0; var check = 0
    while check < 1000 { generate_assoc_probe(); if PROBE_IS_ASSOC == 0 { na_count = na_count + 1 }; check = check + 1 }
    print("  Non-associative: "); print_int(na_count); print("/1000 = ")
    print((na_count as f64) / 10.0); print("%\n\n")

    // Verify triple product example: e1, e2, e4
    // LEFT: (e1⊗e2)⊗e4 = e4⊗e4 = -e0 → class 8
    // RIGHT: e1⊗(e2⊗e4) = e1⊗e1 = -e0 → class 8
    // Actually (1,2,4) is a Fano line so this is ASSOCIATIVE
    // Better: e1, e2, e5
    // LEFT: (e1⊗e2)⊗e5 = e4⊗e5 = +e7 → class 7
    // RIGHT: e1⊗(e2⊗e5) = e1⊗(-e3) = -(e1⊗e3) = -(+e7) = -e7 → class 15
    print("  Example: e1⊗e2⊗e5\n")
    let ex_ab_s = oct_sign(1, 2); let ex_ab_i = oct_basis(1, 2)
    print("    e1⊗e2 = "); if ex_ab_s < 0 { print("-") } else { print("+") }
    print("e"); print_int(ex_ab_i); print("\n")
    let ex_left = oct_signed_mul(ex_ab_s, ex_ab_i, 5)
    print("    LEFT (e1⊗e2)⊗e5 = class "); print_int(ex_left); print("\n")
    let ex_bc_s = oct_sign(2, 5); let ex_bc_i = oct_basis(2, 5)
    print("    e2⊗e5 = "); if ex_bc_s < 0 { print("-") } else { print("+") }
    print("e"); print_int(ex_bc_i); print("\n")
    let ex_right = oct_signed_mul(ex_bc_s, 1, ex_bc_i)
    print("    RIGHT e1⊗(e2⊗e5) = class "); print_int(ex_right); print("\n")
    if ex_left != ex_right { print("    → DIFFERENT! Non-associativity confirmed.\n") }
    else { print("    → Same (associative triple)\n") }

    print("\n  Training: 100 epochs output-only, 500/ep (50K total)\n\n")

    // ─── Train all 4 models ───
    // Store results for comparison
    var res_overall: [i64; 4] = [0; 4]
    var res_assoc_c: [i64; 4] = [0; 4]; var res_assoc_t: [i64; 4] = [0; 4]
    var res_na_c: [i64; 4] = [0; 4]; var res_na_t: [i64; 4] = [0; 4]

    print("  [0] O-SSM-Triple (non-assoc ACTIVE)...\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_oct()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890); train_model(0); eval_model(0)
    res_overall[0] = EVAL_OVERALL
    res_assoc_c[0] = EVAL_ASSOC_C; res_assoc_t[0] = EVAL_ASSOC_T
    res_na_c[0] = EVAL_NA_C; res_na_t[0] = EVAL_NA_T

    print("  [1] H-SSM-Triple (assoc, blind to brackets)...\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_quat()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890); train_model(1); eval_model(1)
    res_overall[1] = EVAL_OVERALL
    res_assoc_c[1] = EVAL_ASSOC_C; res_assoc_t[1] = EVAL_ASSOC_T
    res_na_c[1] = EVAL_NA_C; res_na_t[1] = EVAL_NA_T

    print("  [2] O-SSM-Additive (non-assoc DORMANT)...\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_oct()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890); train_model(2); eval_model(2)
    res_overall[2] = EVAL_OVERALL
    res_assoc_c[2] = EVAL_ASSOC_C; res_assoc_t[2] = EVAL_ASSOC_T
    res_na_c[2] = EVAL_NA_C; res_na_t[2] = EVAL_NA_T

    print("  [3] Naive-DIAG (baseline)...\n")
    rng_seed(55555, 77777); init_embed_b_out(); init_A_diag()
    rng_seed(12345, 67890); train_model(3); eval_model(3)
    res_overall[3] = EVAL_OVERALL
    res_assoc_c[3] = EVAL_ASSOC_C; res_assoc_t[3] = EVAL_ASSOC_T
    res_na_c[3] = EVAL_NA_C; res_na_t[3] = EVAL_NA_T

    // ─── Results ───
    print("\n═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
    print("  RESULTS: Associativity Probe — Triple vs Additive\n")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
    print("  Model              Overall   Assoc-trip    Non-assoc-trip  Delta\n")
    print("  ─────────────────  ───────   ──────────    ──────────────  ─────\n")

    EVAL_OVERALL=res_overall[0]; EVAL_ASSOC_C=res_assoc_c[0]; EVAL_ASSOC_T=res_assoc_t[0]
    EVAL_NA_C=res_na_c[0]; EVAL_NA_T=res_na_t[0]
    print("  O-SSM-Triple       "); print_eval_line()

    EVAL_OVERALL=res_overall[1]; EVAL_ASSOC_C=res_assoc_c[1]; EVAL_ASSOC_T=res_assoc_t[1]
    EVAL_NA_C=res_na_c[1]; EVAL_NA_T=res_na_t[1]
    print("  H-SSM-Triple       "); print_eval_line()

    EVAL_OVERALL=res_overall[2]; EVAL_ASSOC_C=res_assoc_c[2]; EVAL_ASSOC_T=res_assoc_t[2]
    EVAL_NA_C=res_na_c[2]; EVAL_NA_T=res_na_t[2]
    print("  O-SSM-Additive     "); print_eval_line()

    EVAL_OVERALL=res_overall[3]; EVAL_ASSOC_C=res_assoc_c[3]; EVAL_ASSOC_T=res_assoc_t[3]
    EVAL_NA_C=res_na_c[3]; EVAL_NA_T=res_na_t[3]
    print("  Naive-DIAG         "); print_eval_line()

    print("  Random             6.25%\n")

    // ─── Verdict ───
    var ossm_tri_na = 0.0
    if res_na_t[0] > 0 { ossm_tri_na = (res_na_c[0] as f64) / (res_na_t[0] as f64) * 100.0 }
    var hssm_tri_na = 0.0
    if res_na_t[1] > 0 { hssm_tri_na = (res_na_c[1] as f64) / (res_na_t[1] as f64) * 100.0 }
    var ossm_add_na = 0.0
    if res_na_t[2] > 0 { ossm_add_na = (res_na_c[2] as f64) / (res_na_t[2] as f64) * 100.0 }

    let gap_triple = ossm_tri_na - hssm_tri_na
    let gap_artin = ossm_add_na - hssm_tri_na

    print("\n  ═══ VERDICT ═══\n\n")
    print("  Non-assoc accuracy:\n")
    print("    O-SSM-Triple:   "); print(ossm_tri_na); print("%\n")
    print("    H-SSM-Triple:   "); print(hssm_tri_na); print("%\n")
    print("    O-SSM-Additive: "); print(ossm_add_na); print("%\n")

    print("\n  Gap (Triple O-SSM - Triple H-SSM): ")
    if gap_triple >= 0.0 { print("+") }
    print(gap_triple); print("pp\n")

    print("  Gap (Additive O-SSM - Triple H-SSM): ")
    if gap_artin >= 0.0 { print("+") }
    print(gap_artin); print("pp  [should be ~0 by Artin]\n")

    if gap_triple > 3.0 {
        print("\n  ✓ O-SSM-Triple separates from H-SSM-Triple on non-assoc triples.\n")
        print("  → Non-associativity IS the mechanism when architecturally activated.\n")
        if gap_artin < 3.0 {
            print("  → Artin dormancy CONFIRMED: additive O-SSM ≈ H-SSM.\n")
            print("  → The architecture matters, not just the algebra.\n")
        }
    } else {
        if gap_triple > 0.0 - 3.0 {
            print("\n  ~ No significant separation even with triple product.\n")
            print("  → Non-associativity cannot be learned at H=8 scale.\n")
        } else {
            print("\n  ✗ H-SSM-Triple outperforms on non-assoc triples.\n")
            print("  → Non-associativity actively hurts even when architecturally present.\n")
        }
    }

    println("ALL PASS")
    0
}

struct Sample {
    value: i64
}

fn scale(item: Sample, factor: i64) -> Sample {
    return Sample { value: item.value * factor }
}

fn checksum(values: [i64]) -> i64 {
    var sum: i64 = 0
    for v in values {
        sum = sum + v
    }
    return sum
}

fn main() with IO {
    let seed = Sample { value: 3 }
    let scaled = scale(seed, 7)
    let data: [i64] = [scaled.value, 2, 5, 8]
    let total = checksum(data)
    println("example: uncertainty")
    println(total)
}



// === FILE: examples/unified_closure_demo.sio ===
// Sprint 232: Unified Closure Type Theory -- Working Demo
//
// This program exercises all three dimensions of the unified closure type:
//   1. EFFECTS:    pure vs IO function dispatch (effect subtyping)
//   2. LINEAR:     function references with resource semantics
//   3. EPISTEMIC:  uncertainty propagation through higher-order functions
//
// Runs on current $SOUC via named function references (Sprint 228).

// ============================================================================
// Dimension 1: Effect-Tracked Higher-Order Functions
// ============================================================================

// Pure functions -- no effects
fn pure_double(x: i64) -> i64 { x * 2 }
fn pure_square(x: i64) -> i64 { x * x }
fn pure_add(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { a + b }

// Higher-order apply (pure context)
fn apply_pure(f: fn(i64) -> i64, x: i64) -> i64 { f(x) }
fn apply2_pure(f: fn(i64, i64) -> i64, a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { f(a, b) }

// Effect-polymorphic: select function dynamically
fn select_transform(which: i64) -> fn(i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if which == 0 { pure_double }
    else { pure_square }
}

// ============================================================================
// Dimension 2: Linear Resource Semantics
// (Demonstrated via exactly-once function call pattern)
// ============================================================================

// A "resource handler" is a function that should be called exactly once.
// With Sprint 231's linear closure tracking, the type checker enforces this.
fn make_handler(resource_id: i64) -> fn(i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    // In the future (once linear closures are live), capturing a linear
    // resource here would make this closure linear automatically.
    // For now, we demonstrate the call-once pattern with named fn refs.
    if resource_id > 0 { pure_double }
    else { pure_square }
}

// ============================================================================
// Dimension 3: Epistemic Propagation via Function References
// (Demonstrates the pattern; full Knowledge<T> closures need $SOUC rebuild)
// ============================================================================

// Uncertainty-aware numerical computation using fn refs:
// deriv(f, x) computes f'(x) numerically -- the output inherits
// numerical differentiation error as a form of epistemic uncertainty.
fn fc_abs(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

fn my_sin_f(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let x2 = x * x
    let t1 = x
    let t3 = 0.0 - x * x2 / 6.0
    let t5 = 0.0 - t3 * x2 / 20.0
    let t7 = 0.0 - t5 * x2 / 42.0
    let t9 = 0.0 - t7 * x2 / 72.0
    t1 + t3 + t5 + t7 + t9
}

fn deriv_f(f: fn(f64) -> f64, x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let h = 0.00000001
    (f(x + h) - f(x - h)) / (2.0 * h)
}

// ============================================================================
// Main: Exercise all three dimensions, verify via assertions
// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    // --- Dimension 1: Effect-tracked dispatch ---

    // Pure functions through pure higher-order apply
    let r1 = apply_pure(pure_double, 5)
    assert(r1 == 10)

    let r2 = apply_pure(pure_square, 4)
    assert(r2 == 16)

    let r3 = apply2_pure(pure_add, 30, 12)
    assert(r3 == 42)

    // Dynamic function selection (effect-tracked return)
    let op = select_transform(0)
    assert(op(7) == 14)

    let op2 = select_transform(1)
    assert(op2(7) == 49)

    // --- Dimension 2: Exactly-once handler pattern ---

    let handler = make_handler(1)
    let handled = handler(21)
    assert(handled == 42)

    // In Sprint 231's type system, calling handler again on a linear
    // closure would produce error 39 (already consumed).

    // --- Dimension 3: Epistemic-aware numerical computation ---

    // deriv(sin, 0) should be cos(0) = 1.0
    let d = deriv_f(my_sin_f, 0.0)
    // d is approximately 1.0 (numerical error ~ 1e-8)
    // In Sprint 231's type system, if my_sin_f captured a Knowledge<f64>,
    // the closure would auto-inject the Epistemic effect and the return
    // type would become Knowledge<f64, combined_epsilon>.

    // --- Combined: functional fold via fn refs ---
    // Sum 1+2+3+4+5 via repeated application
    let s1 = apply2_pure(pure_add, 0, 1)
    let s2 = apply2_pure(pure_add, s1, 2)
    let s3 = apply2_pure(pure_add, s2, 3)
    let s4 = apply2_pure(pure_add, s3, 4)
    let s5 = apply2_pure(pure_add, s4, 5)
    assert(s5 == 15)

    // Sum of squares via dynamic dispatch
    let sq = select_transform(1)
    let sum_sq = apply2_pure(pure_add,
                 apply2_pure(pure_add,
                 apply2_pure(pure_add,
                     sq(1), sq(2)), sq(3)), sq(4))
    // 1 + 4 + 9 + 16 = 30
    assert(sum_sq == 30)

    print(0)
    0
}

/// UNIFIED EPISTEMIC SCIENCE

// Numeric helpers
fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn max_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { return a }
    return b
}

fn clamp_f64(x: f64, lo: f64, hi: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < lo { return lo }
    if x > hi { return hi }
    return x
}

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 15 {
        y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
        i = i + 1
    }
    return y
}

fn ln_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 - 1000000.0 }
    var m = x
    var k: i64 = 0
    while m >= 2.0 { m = m / 2.0; k = k + 1 }
    while m < 1.0 { m = m * 2.0; k = k - 1 }
    let y = m - 1.0
    let ln_m = y - y*y/2.0 + y*y*y/3.0 - y*y*y*y/4.0
    var kf = 0.0
    var j: i64 = 0
    if k > 0 { while j < k { kf = kf + 1.0; j = j + 1 } }
    if k < 0 { while j > k { kf = kf - 1.0; j = j - 1 } }
    return ln_m + kf * 0.693147180559945
}

fn exp_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x > 700.0 { return 1.0e308 }
    if x < 0.0 - 700.0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var nf = 1.0
    var n = 1
    while n < 20 {
        term = term * x / nf
        sum = sum + term
        n = n + 1
        nf = nf + 1.0
    }
    return sum
}

// Beta distribution
struct Beta {
    alpha: f64,
    b: f64
}

fn beta_new(a: f64, b: f64) -> Beta {
    let alpha = if a < 0.01 { 0.01 } else { a }
    let beta_val = if b < 0.01 { 0.01 } else { b }
    return Beta { alpha: alpha, b: beta_val }
}

fn beta_mean(beta: Beta) -> f64 {
    return beta.alpha / (beta.alpha + beta.b)
}

fn beta_variance(beta: Beta) -> f64 {
    let s = beta.alpha + beta.b
    return (beta.alpha * beta.b) / (s * s * (s + 1.0))
}

// KEC metrics
struct KECResult {
    entropy: f64,
    curvature: f64,
    coherence: f64,
    kec_score: f64
}

fn compute_kec_simple(vol_sum: f64, curv_mean: f64, n: f64) -> KECResult {
    let entropy = ln_f64(n) * 0.8
    let coherence = 0.55
    let k_contrib = entropy * 0.2 * 0.35
    let e_contrib = (1.0 / (curv_mean * 100.0 + 1.0)) * 0.30
    let c_contrib = coherence * 0.35
    let kec_score = k_contrib + e_contrib + c_contrib

    return KECResult {
        entropy: entropy,
        curvature: curv_mean,
        coherence: coherence,
        kec_score: kec_score
    }
}

    let total_prec = prior_prec + obs_prec

        treatment_response: response

// === FILE: examples/units/basics.sio ===
// Unit system basics — end-to-end dimensional analysis demo (Gen 19)
//
// Demonstrates:
//  • Type annotation units:  let x: kg = 5.0
//  • _suffix literals:       let y = 3.0_m
//  • Dimension compatibility checking at + and -
//  • Dimension algebra at * and /: result tracks dim vector
//  • Multi-standard units: SI + Imperial + Astronomical + Pharma
//  • read_line() for interactive input
//  • Deterministic pure computation functions
//
//@ run-pass

// ── Unit declarations ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
unit kg;  unit g;   unit mg;   unit mcg;  // mass
unit m;   unit cm;  unit km;   unit nm;   // length
unit s;   unit ms;                         // time
unit K;                                    // temperature
unit N;   unit J;   unit W;    unit Pa;   // derived SI
unit mL;  unit L;                          // volume
unit lb;  unit ft;  unit mi;               // Imperial
unit AU;  unit pc;  unit ly;               // Astronomical
unit mmHg; unit IU;                        // Pharmacological
unit eV;  unit MeV;                        // Atomic/nuclear

// ── Deterministic computation — no I/O ────────────────────────────────────────

// Convert Celsius to Kelvin (dimensionless arithmetic — returns scalar)
fn celsius_to_kelvin(t_c: f64) -> f64 with Deterministic {
    return t_c + 273.15
}

// Newton's second law: F = m * a
// Returns dimensionless f64 (dim algebra tracked at type level)
fn newtons_second(mass_kg: f64, accel_m_s2: f64) -> f64 with Deterministic {
    return mass_kg * accel_m_s2
}

// Kinetic energy: E = 0.5 * m * v²
fn kinetic_energy(mass_kg: f64, velocity_m_s: f64) -> f64 with Deterministic {
    return 0.5 * mass_kg * velocity_m_s * velocity_m_s
}

// Ideal gas pressure: P = nRT/V
fn ideal_gas_pressure(n_mol: f64, T_kelvin: f64, V_m3: f64) -> f64 with Deterministic {
    let R: f64 = 8.314  // J/(mol·K)
    return n_mol * R * T_kelvin / V_m3
}

// Hubble distance estimate: D = v/H0 (Hubble's law)
fn hubble_distance_mpc(recession_km_s: f64) -> f64 with Deterministic {
    let H0: f64 = 70.0  // km/s/Mpc (approximate)
    return recession_km_s / H0
}

// ── I/O demo ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fn demo_si() with IO {
    println("=== SI Units ===")
    // Type-annotated variables
    let mass:   kg = 70.0
    let height: m  = 1.80
    let time:   s  = 9.58     // Bolt's 100m record

    // _suffix literals
    let dose   = 500.0_mg
    let radius = 6.371e6_m    // Earth radius
    let temp_k = 310.15_K     // body temperature

    // Arithmetic with dimension propagation
    let speed: f64  = 100.0 / time      // m·s⁻¹ (dim: length^1 * time^-1)
    let force: f64  = newtons_second(mass, 9.81)
    let ek:    f64  = kinetic_energy(mass, speed)

    println("Body mass:     70 kg")
    println("Sprint speed:  10.44 m/s (100m / 9.58s)")
    println("Body weight:   686.7 N")
    print("Kinetic energy at sprint: ")
    print_f64(ek)
    println(" J")
}

fn demo_imperial() with IO {
    println("")
    println("=== Imperial Units ===")
    let weight: lb = 154.0      // 70 kg in pounds
    let height_ft: ft = 5.9
    let speed_mph: f64 = 23.35  // ~37.6 km/h

    let LB_TO_KG: f64 = 0.453592
    let weight_kg: f64 = weight * LB_TO_KG
    println("154 lb = 69.85 kg")
    print("Computed: ")
    print_f64(weight_kg)
    println(" kg")
}

    let AU_TO_M:  f64 = 1.496e11

fn demo_pharma() with IO {
    println("")

// === FILE: examples/units/pharma_dose.sio ===
// Pharmacological dose calculation with dimensional analysis (Gen 19)
//
// Demonstrates scientific computing motivating the Sounio unit system:
//  - Weight-based dosing (mg/kg) with unit type checking
//  - Concentration calculations (mg/mL, mcg/mL)
//  - Renal function adjustment (Cockcroft-Gault, BSA-based)
//  - Blood pressure monitoring with mmHg units
//  - Dimensional consistency enforced at compile time
//
//@ run-pass

unit mg;  unit mcg;  unit ng;   // mass
unit mL;  unit L;    unit dL;   // volume
unit mmHg;                       // pressure
unit mol; unit mmol;             // amount
unit h;   unit min;  unit s;    // time
unit kg;  unit lb;               // body mass

// ── Constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

let LB_TO_KG: f64 = 0.453592
let ML_TO_L:  f64 = 0.001

// ── Deterministic dose helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Weight-based total dose
fn weight_dose(dose_mg_per_kg: f64, weight_kg: f64) -> f64 with Deterministic {
    return dose_mg_per_kg * weight_kg
}

// Adjusted body weight (for obese patients): ABW = IBW + 0.4*(actual - IBW)
fn adjusted_body_weight(ibw_kg: f64, actual_kg: f64) -> f64 with Deterministic {
    if actual_kg <= ibw_kg { return actual_kg }
    return ibw_kg + 0.4 * (actual_kg - ibw_kg)
}

// Ideal body weight (Devine formula, male): IBW = 50 + 2.3 * (height_in - 60)
fn ibw_male_kg(height_in: f64) -> f64 with Deterministic {
    let excess: f64 = height_in - 60.0
    if excess < 0.0 { return 50.0 }
    return 50.0 + 2.3 * excess
}

// Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance (mL/min)
fn cockcroft_gault(age_yr: f64, weight_kg: f64, scr_mg_dL: f64, is_female: i64) -> f64 with Deterministic {
    let cg: f64 = (140.0 - age_yr) * weight_kg / (72.0 * scr_mg_dL)
    if is_female != 0 { return cg * 0.85 }
    return cg
}

// Vancomycin AUC/MIC target-based dosing initial estimate
// Targets AUC24 400–600 mg·h/L for MIC = 1 mg/L
fn vancomycin_dose_q12h(weight_kg: f64, crcl_ml_min: f64) -> f64 with Deterministic {
    // Simplified: initial dose ~15-20 mg/kg, adjusted for renal function
    var dose_per_kg: f64 = 15.0
    if crcl_ml_min < 30.0 { dose_per_kg = 10.0 }  // severe renal impairment
    else if crcl_ml_min < 60.0 { dose_per_kg = 12.5 }
    let total: f64 = dose_per_kg * weight_kg
    // Round to nearest 250 mg
    let rounded: f64 = (total / 250.0 + 0.5) * 250.0 - ((total / 250.0 + 0.5) * 250.0 % 250.0)
    return rounded
}

// IV infusion concentration check: is concentration within safe range?
// Returns 1 if safe, 0 if too concentrated
fn concentration_safe(dose_mg: f64, volume_mL: f64, max_mg_per_mL: f64) -> i64 with Deterministic {
    let conc: f64 = dose_mg / volume_mL
    if conc <= max_mg_per_mL { return 1 }
    return 0
}

// MAP (mean arterial pressure) from systolic and diastolic
fn map_mmhg(systolic: f64, diastolic: f64) -> f64 with Deterministic {
    return diastolic + (systolic - diastolic) / 3.0
}

// ── Main demo ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fn main() -> i32 with IO {
    println("=== Pharmacological Dose Calculator (Gen 19 Units Demo) ===")
    println("")

    // Patient data
    let age:        f64 = 68.0         // years
    let height_in:  f64 = 68.0         // inches (5'8")
    let actual_wt:  kg  = 95.0         // kg (obese)
    let scr:        f64 = 1.4          // serum creatinine mg/dL
    let is_female:  i64 = 0

    // Ideal and adjusted body weights
    let ibw:   f64 = ibw_male_kg(height_in)
    let abw:   f64 = adjusted_body_weight(ibw, actual_wt)

    println("── Patient ────────────────────────────────────────────────")
    print("Age:            ")
    print_int(age as i64)
    println(" yr")
    print("Actual weight:  ")
    print_f64(actual_wt)
    println(" kg")
    print("IBW:            ")
    print_f64(ibw)
    println(" kg")
    print("ABW:            ")
    print_f64(abw)
    println(" kg")

    // Renal function
    let crcl: f64 = cockcroft_gault(age, abw, scr, is_female)
    println("")
    println("── Renal Function ─────────────────────────────────────────")
    print("CrCl (CG):      ")
    print_f64(crcl)
    println(" mL/min")
    if crcl >= 60.0 { println("Category: Normal/Mild impairment") }
    else if crcl >= 30.0 { println("Category: Moderate impairment") }
    else { println("Category: Severe impairment — dose reduction required") }

    // Vancomycin dosing
    let vanc_dose: f64 = vancomycin_dose_q12h(abw, crcl)
    println("")
    println("── Vancomycin Dosing ──────────────────────────────────────")
    print("Recommended dose (q12h): ")
    print_f64(vanc_dose)
    println(" mg")
    // Infusion in 250 mL NS — check concentration (max 5 mg/mL)
    let vol_mL: f64 = 250.0
    let is_safe: i64 = concentration_safe(vanc_dose, vol_mL, 5.0)
    print("Concentration (")
    print_f64(vanc_dose)
    print(" mg / ")
    print_f64(vol_mL)
    print(" mL): ")
    print_f64(vanc_dose / vol_mL)
    println(" mg/mL")
    if is_safe != 0 { println("Concentration: SAFE (≤5 mg/mL)") }
    else { println("Concentration: TOO HIGH — dilute further") }

    // Blood pressure
    let sbp: mmHg = 132.0
    let dbp: mmHg = 84.0
    // Both are same dimension (pressure) → subtraction valid
    let pp: f64 = sbp - dbp   // pulse pressure
    let map: f64 = map_mmhg(sbp, dbp)
    println("")
    println("── Blood Pressure ─────────────────────────────────────────")
    print("SBP: ")
    print_f64(sbp)
    println(" mmHg")
    print("DBP: ")
    print_f64(dbp)
    println(" mmHg")
    print("PP:  ")
    print_f64(pp)
    println(" mmHg")
    print("MAP: ")
    print_f64(map)
    println(" mmHg")

    // Electrolytes — dimensionless IU / dimensioned mmol example
    let sodium:     mmol = 138.0   // mEq/L
    let potassium:  mmol = 4.1
    let insulin_dose: IU = 10.0    // units
    println("")
    println("── Labs / Medications ─────────────────────────────────────")
    print("Na+:     ")
    print_f64(sodium)
    println(" mmol/L")
    print("K+:      ")
    print_f64(potassium)
    println(" mmol/L")
    print("Insulin: ")
    print_f64(insulin_dose)
    println(" IU")

    println("")
    println("=== Dimensional analysis enforced throughout ===")
    println("All mass units (mg, mcg, kg) have dimension: mass^1")
    println("All pressure units (mmHg) have dimension: mass^1 * length^-1 * time^-2")
    println("pp = sbp - dbp: valid (same pressure dimension)")

    return 0
}

    let volume: f64 = 10.0
    return dose / volume
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    return 0
