/// Visual Example 8: Climate Model Ensemble - Color Edition
///
/// Demonstrates: Multi-model uncertainty with color-coded projections
///
/// Visual Output: Color bars for each climate model + ensemble mean
/// - Each model gets unique color
/// - Uncertainty bars show within-model variance
/// - Ensemble aggregation visualized with combined color

// ============================================================================
// ANSI COLORS
// ============================================================================

fn reset() { print("\x1b[0m") }
fn bold() { print("\x1b[1m") }
fn dim() { print("\x1b[2m") }

fn red() { print("\x1b[31m") }
fn green() { print("\x1b[32m") }
fn yellow() { print("\x1b[33m") }
fn blue() { print("\x1b[34m") }
fn magenta() { print("\x1b[35m") }
fn cyan() { print("\x1b[36m") }
fn white() { print("\x1b[97m") }

fn bg_red() { print("\x1b[41m") }
fn bg_green() { print("\x1b[42m") }
fn bg_yellow() { print("\x1b[43m") }
fn bg_blue() { print("\x1b[44m") }
fn bg_magenta() { print("\x1b[45m") }
fn bg_cyan() { print("\x1b[46m") }

// ============================================================================
// NUMERIC HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 10 {
        y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
        i = i + 1
    }
    return y
}

fn erf_approx(x: f64) -> f64 {
    let a1 = 0.254829592
    let a2 = 0.0 - 0.284496736
    let a3 = 1.421413741
    let a4 = 0.0 - 1.453152027
    let a5 = 1.061405429
    let p = 0.3275911
    let sign = if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - 1.0 } else { 1.0 }
    let x_abs = if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
    let t = 1.0 / (1.0 + p * x_abs)
    let y = 1.0 - (((((a5 * t + a4) * t) + a3) * t + a2) * t + a1) * t * exp_f64(0.0 - x_abs * x_abs)
    return sign * y
}

fn exp_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x > 10.0 { return 22026.465794806718 * exp_f64(x - 10.0) }
    if x < 0.0 - 10.0 { return 0.00004539992976248485 * exp_f64(x + 10.0) }
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var nf = 1.0
    var n = 1
    while n < 20 {
        term = term * x / nf
        result = result + term
        n = n + 1
        nf = nf + 1.0
    }
    return result
}

// ============================================================================
// EPISTEMIC VALUE
// ============================================================================

struct EpistemicValue {
    value: f64,
    variance: f64,
    conf_alpha: f64,
    conf_beta: f64
}

fn epistemic_new(value: f64, variance: f64) -> EpistemicValue {
    return EpistemicValue {
        value: value,
        variance: variance,
        conf_alpha: 1.0,
        conf_beta: 1.0
    }
}

fn epistemic_std(k: EpistemicValue) -> f64 {
    return sqrt_f64(k.variance)
}

fn epistemic_prob_gt(k: EpistemicValue, thresh: f64) -> f64 {
    if k.variance <= 0.0000001 {
        if k.value > thresh { return 1.0 }
        return 0.0
    }
    let z = (k.value - thresh) / sqrt_f64(k.variance)
    return 0.5 * (1.0 + erf_approx(z / 1.4142135623730951))
}

fn ensemble_mean_5(m1: EpistemicValue, m2: EpistemicValue, m3: EpistemicValue, m4: EpistemicValue, m5: EpistemicValue) -> EpistemicValue {
    let n = 5.0
    let mean_value = (m1.value + m2.value + m3.value + m4.value + m5.value) / n
    let within_var = (m1.variance + m2.variance + m3.variance + m4.variance + m5.variance) / n

    let d1 = m1.value - mean_value
    let d2 = m2.value - mean_value
    let d3 = m3.value - mean_value
    let d4 = m4.value - mean_value
    let d5 = m5.value - mean_value
    let between_var = (d1*d1 + d2*d2 + d3*d3 + d4*d4 + d5*d5) / (n - 1.0)

    let total_var = within_var + between_var
    return epistemic_new(mean_value, total_var)
}

// ============================================================================
// VISUALIZATION HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn print_temp_bar_colored(temp: f64, std_dev: f64, model_color: i32) {
    // Model color
    if model_color == 1 { red() }
    if model_color == 2 { green() }
    if model_color == 3 { yellow() }
    if model_color == 4 { magenta() }
    if model_color == 5 { cyan() }

    // Main value bar
    let bar_len = (temp * 20.0)
    var i = 0
    while i < bar_len {
        print("█")
        i = i + 1
    }
    reset()

    // Uncertainty extension
    dim()
    if model_color == 1 { red() }
    if model_color == 2 { green() }
    if model_color == 3 { yellow() }
    if model_color == 4 { magenta() }
    if model_color == 5 { cyan() }

    let unc_len = (std_dev * 20.0)
    i = 0
    while i < unc_len {
        print("▒")
        i = i + 1
    }
    reset()
}

    bold()

    println("                   INDIVIDUAL MODEL PROJECTIONS                   ")

    let model3 = epistemic_new(1.9, 0.0625)

    let model5 = epistemic_new(2.0, 0.01)

    // Model 1
    print("  ")
    red()
    print("Model 1 (GFDL):   ")
    reset()
    print_temp_bar_colored(model1.value, epistemic_std(model1), 1)

    println("°C")

    // Model 2
    print("  ")

    reset()
    print_temp_bar_colored(model2.value, epistemic_std(model2), 2)
    print("  ")
    bold()

    reset()

    green()
    print(epistemic_std(model2))
    reset()
    println("°C")

    // Model 3
    print("  ")

    print("Model 3 (MIROC):  ")
    reset()
    print_temp_bar_colored(model3.value, epistemic_std(model3), 3)
    print("  ")
    bold()
    print(model3.value)
    reset()
    print("°C ± ")
    yellow()
    print(epistemic_std(model3))
    reset()
    println("°C")

    // Model 4
    print("  ")
    magenta()
    print("Model 4 (IPSL):   ")
    reset()
    print_temp_bar_colored(model4.value, epistemic_std(model4), 4)
    print("  ")
    bold()
    print(model4.value)

    // Model 5

    reset()
    print_temp_bar_colored(model5.value, epistemic_std(model5), 5)
    print("  ")
    bold()
    print(model5.value)
    reset()

    cyan()
    print(epistemic_std(model5))

    println("°C")

    println("")

    // ENSEMBLE MEAN
    let ensemble = ensemble_mean_5(model1, model2, model3, model4, model5)

    bold()
    white()
    println("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━")
    println("                     ENSEMBLE MEAN PROJECTION                     ")
    println("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━")
    reset()
    println("")

    print("  ")
    bold()
    white()
    print("Ensemble:         ")
    reset()

    // Multi-colored ensemble bar
    var i = 0
    let ens_len = (ensemble.value * 20.0)
    while i < ens_len {
        let segment = i % 5
        if segment == 0 { red() }
        if segment == 1 { green() }
        if segment == 2 { yellow() }
        if segment == 3 { magenta() }
        if segment == 4 { cyan() }
        print("█")
        i = i + 1
    }
    reset()

    print("  ")
    bold()
    cyan()
    print(ensemble.value)
    reset()
    print("°C ± ")
    white()
    print(epistemic_std(ensemble))
    reset()
    println("°C")

    println("")

    // PARIS AGREEMENT ASSESSMENT
    bold()
    red()
    println("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━")
    println("                   PARIS AGREEMENT ASSESSMENT                     ")
    println("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━")
    reset()
    println("")

    let prob_1_5 = epistemic_prob_gt(ensemble, 1.5)
    let prob_2_0 = epistemic_prob_gt(ensemble, 2.0)

    print("  P(warming > 1.5°C) = ")
    if prob_1_5 > 0.90 {
        bold()
        red()
    }
    if prob_1_5 > 0.66 && prob_1_5 <= 0.90 {
        yellow()
    }
    if prob_1_5 <= 0.66 {
        green()
    }
    print(prob_1_5 * 100.0)
    print("%  ")

    bg_red()
    i = 0
    let bar1_5 = (prob_1_5 * 40.0)
    while i < bar1_5 {
        print(" ")
        i = i + 1
    }
    reset()
    println("")

    if prob_1_5 > 0.90 {
        red()
        println("    ⚠ IPCC: Virtually certain (>99%) to exceed 1.5°C")
    }
    if prob_1_5 > 0.66 && prob_1_5 <= 0.90 {
        yellow()
        println("    ⚠ IPCC: Likely (>66%) to exceed 1.5°C")
    }
    reset()
    println("")

    print("  P(warming > 2.0°C) = ")
    if prob_2_0 > 0.66 {
        bold()
        red()
    }
    if prob_2_0 > 0.33 && prob_2_0 <= 0.66 {
        yellow()
    }
    if prob_2_0 <= 0.33 {
        green()
    }
    print(prob_2_0 * 100.0)
    print("%  ")

    bg_yellow()
    i = 0
    let bar2_0 = (prob_2_0 * 40.0)
    while i < bar2_0 {
        print(" ")
        i = i + 1
    }
    reset()
    println("")

    if prob_2_0 > 0.66 {
        red()
        println("    ⚠ IPCC: Likely (>66%) to exceed 2.0°C")
    }
    if prob_2_0 > 0.33 && prob_2_0 <= 0.66 {
        yellow()
        println("    ⚠ IPCC: About as likely as not to exceed 2.0°C")
    }
    if prob_2_0 <= 0.33 {
        green()
        println("    ✓ IPCC: Unlikely (<33%) to exceed 2.0°C")
    }
    reset()

    println("")

    // FINAL MESSAGE
    bold()
    cyan()
    println("╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗")
    println("║  Multi-model ensemble quantifies structural uncertainty          ║")
    println("║  Color-coded projections show model disagreement                 ║")
    println("║  Paris Agreement targets at serious risk under RCP8.5            ║")
    println("╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝")
    reset()

    return 0
}

// ============================================================================

fn reset() { print("\x1b[0m") }

fn green() { print("\x1b[32m") }
fn yellow() { print("\x1b[33m") }

fn magenta() { print("\x1b[35m") }
fn cyan() { print("\x1b[36m") }
fn white() { print("\x1b[97m") }

fn bg_red() { print("\x1b[41m") }
fn bg_green() { print("\x1b[42m") }
fn bg_yellow() { print("\x1b[43m") }
fn bg_blue() { print("\x1b[44m") }
fn bg_cyan() { print("\x1b[46m") }
fn bg_white() { print("\x1b[47m") }

// ============================================================================
// MATH HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn exp_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x > 10.0 { return 22026.465794806718 * exp_f64(x - 10.0) }
    if x < 0.0 - 10.0 { return 0.00004539992976248485 * exp_f64(x + 10.0) }
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var nf = 1.0
    var n = 1
    while n < 20 {
        term = term * x / nf
        result = result + term
        n = n + 1
        nf = nf + 1.0
    }
    return result
}

fn max_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { return a }
    return b
}

fn min_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a < b { return a }
    return b
}

// ============================================================================
// PHARMACOKINETIC MODEL
// ============================================================================

/// One-compartment oral absorption model
/// C(t) = (ka*D/Vd) * (exp(-ke*t) - exp(-ka*t)) / (ka - ke)
fn pk_concentration(t: f64, dose: f64, vd: f64, ka: f64, ke: f64) -> f64 {
    let factor = (ka * dose / vd) / (ka - ke)
    let c_elim = exp_f64(0.0 - ke * t)
    let c_absorb = exp_f64(0.0 - ka * t)
    return factor * (c_elim - c_absorb)
}

/// Determine PK phase based on concentration and time
/// Returns: 0 = absorption, 1 = distribution, 2 = elimination
fn determine_phase(c: f64, c_max: f64, t: f64, t_max: f64) -> i32 {
    if t < t_max {
        return 0  // Absorption (rising)
    }
    if t < t_max * 2.0 && c > c_max * 0.7 {
        return 1  // Distribution (plateau)
    }
    return 2  // Elimination (falling)
}

// ============================================================================
// VISUALIZATION
// ============================================================================

fn print_concentration_bar(conc: f64, max_conc: f64, phase: i32, in_window: i32) {
    // Background for therapeutic window
    if in_window == 1 {
        bg_cyan()
        print(" ")
        reset()
    }

    // Phase color
    if phase == 0 { green() }      // Absorption
    if phase == 1 { yellow() }     // Distribution
    if phase == 2 { red() }        // Elimination

    let bar_len = (conc / max_conc * 60.0)
    var i = 0
    while i < bar_len {
        print("█")
        i = i + 1
    }
    reset()
}

fn print_phase_label(phase: i32) {
    if phase == 0 {
        green()
        print(" [ABSORPTION]")
    }
    if phase == 1 {
        yellow()
        print(" [DISTRIBUTION]")
    }
    if phase == 2 {
        red()
        print(" [ELIMINATION]")
    }
    reset()
}

// === FILE: examples/visual/10_kalman_filter_color.sio ===
/// Visual Example 10: Bayesian Sensor Fusion with Kalman Filter - Color Edition
///
/// Demonstrates: Sequential belief updates with color-coded uncertainty
///
/// Visual Output: Uncertainty reduction visualization
/// - RED: High uncertainty (low precision)
/// - YELLOW: Medium uncertainty
/// - GREEN: Low uncertainty (high precision)
/// - CYAN: Precision bars showing 1/σ²

// ============================================================================
// ANSI COLORS
// ============================================================================

fn reset() { print("\x1b[0m") }
fn bold() { print("\x1b[1m") }
fn dim() { print("\x1b[2m") }

fn red() { print("\x1b[31m") }
fn green() { print("\x1b[32m") }
fn yellow() { print("\x1b[33m") }
fn blue() { print("\x1b[34m") }
fn magenta() { print("\x1b[35m") }
fn cyan() { print("\x1b[36m") }
fn white() { print("\x1b[97m") }

fn bg_red() { print("\x1b[41m") }
fn bg_green() { print("\x1b[42m") }
fn bg_yellow() { print("\x1b[43m") }
fn bg_blue() { print("\x1b[44m") }
fn bg_cyan() { print("\x1b[46m") }

// ============================================================================
// MATH HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 10 {
        y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
        i = i + 1
    }
    return y
}

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

// ============================================================================
// EPISTEMIC VALUE (BELIEF STATE)
// ============================================================================

struct EpistemicValue {
    value: f64,
    variance: f64
}

fn epistemic_new(value: f64, variance: f64) -> EpistemicValue {
    return EpistemicValue {
        value: value,
        variance: variance
    }
}

fn epistemic_std(k: EpistemicValue) -> f64 {
    return sqrt_f64(k.variance)
}

fn epistemic_precision(k: EpistemicValue) -> f64 {
    if k.variance <= 0.0000001 { return 10000.0 }
    return 1.0 / k.variance
}

// ============================================================================
// KALMAN UPDATE (PRECISION-WEIGHTED BAYESIAN FUSION)
// ============================================================================

/// Kalman filter update: combines prior belief with new measurement
///
/// Precision-weighted mean:
///   μ_post = (τ_prior * μ_prior + τ_meas * z) / (τ_prior + τ_meas)
///   where τ = 1/σ² (precision)
///
/// Posterior precision (information addition):
///   τ_post = τ_prior + τ_meas
///   σ²_post = 1 / (1/σ²_prior + 1/σ²_meas)
///
fn kalman_update(prior: EpistemicValue, measurement: EpistemicValue) -> EpistemicValue {
    let tau_prior = epistemic_precision(prior)
    let tau_meas = epistemic_precision(measurement)
    let tau_post = tau_prior + tau_meas

    let mu_post = (tau_prior * prior.value + tau_meas * measurement.value) / tau_post
    let var_post = 1.0 / tau_post

    return epistemic_new(mu_post, var_post)
}

// ============================================================================
// VISUALIZATION HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn uncertainty_color(std_dev: f64) {
    if std_dev < 2.0 {
        green()
    }
    if std_dev >= 2.0 && std_dev < 5.0 {
        yellow()
    }
    if std_dev >= 5.0 {
        red()
    }
}

fn print_uncertainty_bar(std_dev: f64, max_std: f64) {
    let normalized = std_dev / max_std

    if normalized < 0.2 { bg_green() }
    if normalized >= 0.2 && normalized < 0.5 { bg_yellow() }
    if normalized >= 0.5 { bg_red() }

    let bar_len = (std_dev / max_std * 40.0)
    var i = 0
    while i < bar_len {
        print(" ")
        i = i + 1
    }
    reset()
}

fn print_precision_bar(precision: f64, max_precision: f64) {
    bg_cyan()
    let bar_len = (precision / max_precision * 40.0)
    var i = 0
    while i < bar_len {
        print(" ")
        i = i + 1
    }
    reset()
}

fn print_confidence_level(std_dev: f64) {
    if std_dev < 2.0 {
        green()
        bold()
        print("HIGH")
    }
    if std_dev >= 2.0 && std_dev < 5.0 {
        yellow()
        bold()
        print("MEDIUM")
    }
    if std_dev >= 5.0 {
        red()
        bold()
        print("LOW")
    }
    reset()
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN: KALMAN FILTER VISUALIZATION
// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i32 {
    bold()
    blue()
    println("╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗")
    println("║   KALMAN FILTER: BAYESIAN SENSOR FUSION VISUALIZATION            ║")
    println("║   Sequential Belief Updates with Uncertainty Reduction           ║")
    println("╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝")
    reset()
    println("")

    bold()
    magenta()
    println("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━")
    println("                    SENSOR FUSION SCENARIO                        ")
    println("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━")
    reset()
    println("")

    println("  Task: Estimate robot position from multiple noisy sensors")
    println("")
    println("  Sensors:")
    println("    1. Prior belief (uniform/uninformative)")
    println("    2. GPS measurement (low precision, σ = 5m)")
    println("    3. IMU measurement (high precision, σ = 0.5m)")
    println("    4. Lidar measurement (very high precision, σ = 0.1m)")
    println("")

    // Initial prior (uninformative)
    let prior = epistemic_new(0.0, 100.0)  // 0m ± 10m (very uncertain)

    // Sensor measurements
    let gps = epistemic_new(5.2, 25.0)     // 5.2m ± 5m
    let imu = epistemic_new(5.1, 0.25)     // 5.1m ± 0.5m
    let lidar = epistemic_new(5.05, 0.01)  // 5.05m ± 0.1m

    let max_std = epistemic_std(prior)
    let final_state = kalman_update(kalman_update(kalman_update(prior, gps), imu), lidar)
    let max_precision = epistemic_precision(final_state)

    bold()
    yellow()
    println("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━")
    println("                SEQUENTIAL BELIEF UPDATES                         ")
    println("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━")
    reset()
    println("")

    // Color legend
    print("  Uncertainty: ")
    bg_green()
    print("  ")
    reset()
    green()
    print(" Low (σ < 2m)  ")
    reset()

    bg_yellow()
    print("  ")
    reset()
    yellow()
    print(" Medium (2-5m)  ")
    reset()

    bg_red()
    print("  ")
    reset()
    red()
    println(" High (σ > 5m)")
    reset()

    println("")

    // STEP 0: Prior
    print("  [PRIOR]         μ = ")
    bold()
    print(prior.value)
    reset()
    print(" m, σ = ")
    uncertainty_color(epistemic_std(prior))
    bold()
    print(epistemic_std(prior))
    reset()
    print(" m  ")
    print_uncertainty_bar(epistemic_std(prior), max_std)
    print("  ")
    print_confidence_level(epistemic_std(prior))
    println("")

    print("                  Precision: ")
    cyan()
    print(epistemic_precision(prior))
    reset()
    print("  ")
    print_precision_bar(epistemic_precision(prior), max_precision)
    println("")
    println("")

    // STEP 1: GPS fusion
    let state1 = kalman_update(prior, gps)

    print("  [+ GPS]         μ = ")
    bold()
    print(state1.value)
    reset()
    print(" m, σ = ")
    uncertainty_color(epistemic_std(state1))
    bold()
    print(epistemic_std(state1))
    reset()
    print(" m  ")
    print_uncertainty_bar(epistemic_std(state1), max_std)
    print("  ")
    print_confidence_level(epistemic_std(state1))
    println("")

    print("                  Precision: ")
    cyan()
    print(epistemic_precision(state1))
    reset()
    print("  ")
    print_precision_bar(epistemic_precision(state1), max_precision)
    println("")

    let reduction1 = (epistemic_std(prior) - epistemic_std(state1)) / epistemic_std(prior) * 100.0
    print("                  Uncertainty reduction: ")
    green()
    bold()
    print(reduction1)
    reset()
    println("%")
    println("")

    // STEP 2: IMU fusion
    let state2 = kalman_update(state1, imu)

    print("  [+ IMU]         μ = ")
    bold()
    print(state2.value)
    reset()
    print(" m, σ = ")
    uncertainty_color(epistemic_std(state2))
    bold()
    print(epistemic_std(state2))
    reset()
    print(" m  ")
    print_uncertainty_bar(epistemic_std(state2), max_std)
    print("  ")
    print_confidence_level(epistemic_std(state2))
    println("")

    print("                  Precision: ")
    cyan()
    print(epistemic_precision(state2))
    reset()
    print("  ")
    print_precision_bar(epistemic_precision(state2), max_precision)
    println("")

    let reduction2 = (epistemic_std(state1) - epistemic_std(state2)) / epistemic_std(state1) * 100.0
    print("                  Uncertainty reduction: ")
    green()
    bold()
    print(reduction2)
    reset()
    println("%")
    println("")

    // STEP 3: Lidar fusion
    let state3 = kalman_update(state2, lidar)

    print("  [+ LIDAR]       μ = ")
    bold()
    print(state3.value)
    reset()
    print(" m, σ = ")
    uncertainty_color(epistemic_std(state3))
    bold()
    print(epistemic_std(state3))
    reset()
    print(" m  ")
    print_uncertainty_bar(epistemic_std(state3), max_std)
    print("  ")
    print_confidence_level(epistemic_std(state3))
    println("")

    print("                  Precision: ")
    cyan()
    print(epistemic_precision(state3))
    reset()
    print("  ")
    print_precision_bar(epistemic_precision(state3), max_precision)
    println("")

    let reduction3 = (epistemic_std(state2) - epistemic_std(state3)) / epistemic_std(state2) * 100.0
    print("                  Uncertainty reduction: ")
    green()
    bold()
    print(reduction3)
    reset()
    println("%")
    println("")

    // Summary
    bold()
    green()
    println("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━")
    println("                      FUSION SUMMARY                              ")
    println("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━")
    reset()
    println("")

    print("  Final position estimate:   ")
    bold()
    cyan()
    print(state3.value)
    reset()
    print(" m ± ")
    green()
    bold()
    print(epistemic_std(state3))
    reset()
    println(" m")

    let total_reduction = (epistemic_std(prior) - epistemic_std(state3)) / epistemic_std(prior) * 100.0
    print("  Total uncertainty reduction: ")
    green()
    bold()
    print(total_reduction)
    reset()
    println("%")

    let precision_gain = epistemic_precision(state3) / epistemic_precision(prior)
    print("  Precision gain:              ")
    cyan()
    bold()
    print(precision_gain)
    reset()
    println("×")

    println("")

    bold()
    white()
    println("  Key insights:")
    reset()
    cyan()
    println("    • Precision adds: 1/σ²_final = 1/σ²_prior + 1/σ²_GPS + 1/σ²_IMU + 1/σ²_Lidar")
    reset()
    cyan()
    println("    • High-precision sensors (Lidar, IMU) dominate the final estimate")
    reset()
    cyan()
    println("    • GPS provides coarse initial constraint despite low precision")
    reset()
    cyan()
    println("    • Uncertainty monotonically decreases with each fusion step")
    reset()

    println("")

    bold()
    blue()
    println("╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗")
    println("║  ✓ Kalman gain (precision weighting) visualized through color    ║")
    println("║  ✓ Information fusion shown as precision bars                    ║")
    println("║  ✓ Bayesian belief propagation made intuitive!                   ║")
    println("╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝")
    reset()

    return 0
}


// === FILE: examples/visual/11_sir_epidemic_color.sio ===
/// Visual Example 11: SIR Epidemic Model - Color Edition
///
/// Demonstrates: Disease dynamics with color-coded populations
///
/// Visual Output: SIR compartmental model over time
/// - BLUE: Susceptible population (not yet infected)
/// - RED: Infectious population (actively spreading)
/// - GREEN: Recovered population (immune)
/// - Stacked bars showing population composition

// ============================================================================
// ANSI COLORS
// ============================================================================

fn reset() { print("\x1b[0m") }
fn bold() { print("\x1b[1m") }
fn dim() { print("\x1b[2m") }

fn red() { print("\x1b[31m") }
fn green() { print("\x1b[32m") }
fn yellow() { print("\x1b[33m") }
fn blue() { print("\x1b[34m") }
fn magenta() { print("\x1b[35m") }
fn cyan() { print("\x1b[36m") }
fn white() { print("\x1b[97m") }

fn bg_red() { print("\x1b[41m") }
fn bg_green() { print("\x1b[42m") }
fn bg_yellow() { print("\x1b[43m") }
fn bg_blue() { print("\x1b[44m") }
fn bg_cyan() { print("\x1b[46m") }

// ============================================================================
// SIR MODEL
// ============================================================================

struct SIRState {
    s: f64,  // Susceptible
    i: f64,  // Infectious
    r: f64   // Recovered
}

struct SIRParams {
    beta: f64,   // Transmission rate
    gamma: f64   // Recovery rate
}

/// SIR differential equations:
/// dS/dt = -β·S·I/N
/// dI/dt = β·S·I/N - γ·I
/// dR/dt = γ·I
fn sir_derivative(state: SIRState, params: SIRParams, n: f64) -> SIRState {
    let infection_rate = params.beta * state.s * state.i / n
    let recovery_rate = params.gamma * state.i

    return SIRState {
        s: 0.0 - infection_rate,
        i: infection_rate - recovery_rate,
        r: recovery_rate
    }
}

/// Euler method integration step
fn sir_step(state: SIRState, params: SIRParams, n: f64, dt: f64) -> SIRState {
    let deriv = sir_derivative(state, params, n)
    return SIRState {
        s: state.s + deriv.s * dt,
        i: state.i + deriv.i * dt,
        r: state.r + deriv.r * dt
    }
}

/// Calculate R0 (basic reproduction number)
fn calculate_r0(params: SIRParams) -> f64 {
    return params.beta / params.gamma
}

// ============================================================================
// VISUALIZATION
// ============================================================================

fn print_population_bar(s: f64, i: f64, r: f64, total: f64) {
    let bar_width = 60.0

    // Susceptible (blue)
    bg_blue()
    let s_len = (s / total * bar_width)
    var j = 0
    while j < s_len {
        print(" ")
        j = j + 1
    }
    reset()

    // Infectious (red)
    bg_red()
    let i_len = (i / total * bar_width)
    j = 0
    while j < i_len {
        print(" ")
        j = j + 1
    }
    reset()

    // Recovered (green)
    bg_green()
    let r_len = (r / total * bar_width)
    j = 0
    while j < r_len {
        print(" ")
        j = j + 1
    }
    reset()
}

fn print_phase_indicator(i: f64, peak: f64) {
    if i < peak * 0.1 {
        cyan()
        print(" [EARLY GROWTH]")
    }
    if i >= peak * 0.1 && i < peak * 0.7 {
        yellow()
        print(" [ACCELERATION]")
    }
    if i >= peak * 0.7 && i <= peak {
        red()
        bold()
        print(" [PEAK APPROACH]")
    }
    if i < peak && i >= peak * 0.7 {
        yellow()
        print(" [DECELERATION]")
    }
    reset()
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN: SIR EPIDEMIC VISUALIZATION
// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i32 {
    bold()
    magenta()
    println("╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗")
    println("║       SIR EPIDEMIC MODEL - Disease Dynamics Visualization        ║")
    println("║       COVID-19-like Parameters (R₀ = 2.5)                        ║")
    println("╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝")
    reset()
    println("")

    // Parameters (COVID-19-like)
    let params = SIRParams {
        beta: 0.5,    // Transmission rate (/day)
        gamma: 0.2    // Recovery rate (/day, ~5 day infectious period)
    }

    let r0 = calculate_r0(params)
    let n = 1000.0    // Total population
    let dt = 0.5      // Time step (days)

    // Initial conditions
    var state = SIRState {
        s: 990.0,     // 99% susceptible
        i: 10.0,      // 1% initially infected
        r: 0.0        // No recovered yet
    }

    bold()
    cyan()
    println("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━")
    println("                     EPIDEMIC PARAMETERS                          ")
    println("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━")
    reset()
    println("")

    print("  Population (N):          ")
    bold()
    print(n)
    reset()
    println(" people")

    print("  Transmission rate (β):   ")
    red()
    bold()
    print(params.beta)
    reset()
    println(" /day")

    print("  Recovery rate (γ):       ")
    green()
    bold()
    print(params.gamma)
    reset()
    println(" /day")

    print("  Infectious period:       ")
    yellow()
    bold()
    print(1.0 / params.gamma)
    reset()
    println(" days")

    print("  Basic reproduction (R₀): ")
    if r0 > 2.0 {
        red()
    }
    if r0 > 1.0 && r0 <= 2.0 {
        yellow()
    }
    if r0 <= 1.0 {
        green()
    }
    bold()
    print(r0)
    reset()
    if r0 > 1.0 {
        red()
        print(" (EPIDEMIC)")
    }
    if r0 <= 1.0 {
        green()
        print(" (CONTROLLED)")
    }
    reset()
    println("")

    println("")

    // Find peak by simulating ahead
    var temp_state = state
    var t_sim = 0.0
    var peak_i = state.i
    while t_sim <= 100.0 {
        temp_state = sir_step(temp_state, params, n, dt)
        if temp_state.i > peak_i {
            peak_i = temp_state.i
        }
        t_sim = t_sim + dt
    }

    bold()
    yellow()
    println("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━")
    println("                EPIDEMIC TIME COURSE (0-50 days)                 ")
    println("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━")
    reset()
    println("")

    // Legend
    print("  ")
    bg_blue()
    print("  ")
    reset()
    blue()
    print(" Susceptible  ")
    reset()

    bg_red()
    print("  ")
    reset()
    red()
    print(" Infectious  ")
    reset()

    bg_green()
    print("  ")
    reset()
    green()
    println(" Recovered")
    reset()
    println("")

    // Simulate and visualize
    var t = 0.0
    var peak_reached = 0

    while t <= 50.0 {
        // Print time
        print("  Day ")
        if t < 10.0 { print(" ") }
        bold()
        white()
        print(t)
        reset()
        print(" │ ")

        // Population bar
        print_population_bar(state.s, state.i, state.r, n)

        // Numbers
        print("  ")
        blue()
        print("S:")
        print(state.s)
        reset()
        print(" ")
        red()
        print("I:")
        print(state.i)
        reset()
        print(" ")
        green()
        print("R:")
        print(state.r)
        reset()

        // Peak detection
        if state.i >= peak_i * 0.95 && peak_reached == 0 {
            red()
            bold()
            print(" ← PEAK")
            reset()
            peak_reached = 1
        }

        println("")

        // Update state
        state = sir_step(state, params, n, dt)
        t = t + 2.0  // Print every 2 days
    }

    println("")

    // Final statistics
    bold()
    green()
    println("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━")
    println("                     EPIDEMIC SUMMARY                             ")
    println("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━")
    reset()
    println("")

    print("  Peak infections:         ")
    red()
    bold()
    print(peak_i)
    reset()
    print(" people (")
    red()
    print(peak_i / n * 100.0)
    reset()
    println("% of population)")

    print("  Final recovered:         ")
    green()
    bold()
    print(state.r)
    reset()
    print(" people (")
    green()
    print(state.r / n * 100.0)
    reset()
    println("% attack rate)")

    print("  Final susceptible:       ")
    blue()
    print(state.s)
    reset()
    println(" people (escaped infection)")

    println("")

    bold()
    white()
    println("  Key insights:")
    reset()
    cyan()
    println("    • R₀ = 2.5 means each infected person infects 2-3 others")
    reset()
    cyan()
    println("    • Peak infections occur when S ≈ N/R₀ (herd immunity threshold)")
    reset()
    cyan()
    println("    • Final size depends on R₀: higher R₀ → more total infections")
    reset()
    cyan()
    println("    • Recovery (green) grows as infectious (red) declines")
    reset()

    println("")

    bold()
    magenta()
    println("╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗")
    println("║  ✓ Compartmental model dynamics visualized with stacked bars     ║")
    println("║  ✓ Epidemic phases color-coded (growth → peak → decline)         ║")
    println("║  ✓ Classic SIR model - foundation of epidemiology!               ║")
    println("╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝")
    reset()

    return 0
}


// === FILE: examples/visual/12_animated_diffusion.sio ===
/// Visual Example 12: Animated Heat Diffusion - Frame-Based Animation
///
/// Demonstrates: Terminal animation using frame updates
///
/// Visual Output: 2D heat diffusion simulation
/// - RED: Hot (high temperature)
/// - YELLOW: Warm
/// - CYAN: Cool
/// - BLUE: Cold (low temperature)
/// - Updates in place using ANSI cursor control

// ============================================================================
// ANSI CONTROL CODES
// ============================================================================

fn reset() { print("\x1b[0m") }
fn bold() { print("\x1b[1m") }
fn clear_screen() { print("\x1b[2J") }
fn home_cursor() { print("\x1b[H") }
fn hide_cursor() { print("\x1b[?25l") }
fn show_cursor() { print("\x1b[?25h") }

fn red() { print("\x1b[31m") }
fn green() { print("\x1b[32m") }
fn yellow() { print("\x1b[33m") }
fn blue() { print("\x1b[34m") }
fn magenta() { print("\x1b[35m") }
fn cyan() { print("\x1b[36m") }
fn white() { print("\x1b[97m") }

fn bg_red() { print("\x1b[41m") }
fn bg_yellow() { print("\x1b[43m") }
fn bg_cyan() { print("\x1b[46m") }
fn bg_blue() { print("\x1b[44m") }

// ============================================================================
// HEAT DIFFUSION SIMULATION
// ============================================================================

/// Simple 2D heat diffusion using finite differences
/// ∂T/∂t = α·∇²T
/// Discrete: T_new[i,j] = T[i,j] + α·dt·(T[i-1,j] + T[i+1,j] + T[i,j-1] + T[i,j+1] - 4·T[i,j])/dx²

fn get_temp(grid: [f64; 256], i: i32, j: i32, size: i32) -> f64 {
    if i < 0 || i >= size || j < 0 || j >= size {
        return 0.0  // Boundary condition: cold edges
    }
    let idx = i * size + j
    return grid[idx]
}

fn set_temp(grid: [f64; 256], i: i32, j: i32, size: i32, value: f64) -> [f64; 256] {
    var new_grid = grid
    let idx = i * size + j
    new_grid[idx] = value
    return new_grid
}

fn diffusion_step(grid: [f64; 256], size: i32, alpha: f64, dt: f64, dx: f64) -> [f64; 256] {
    var new_grid = grid
    let coeff = alpha * dt / (dx * dx)

    var i = 1
    while i < size - 1 {
        var j = 1
        while j < size - 1 {
            let idx = i * size + j
            let t_center = grid[idx]
            let t_left = get_temp(grid, i - 1, j, size)
            let t_right = get_temp(grid, i + 1, j, size)
            let t_up = get_temp(grid, i, j - 1, size)
            let t_down = get_temp(grid, i, j + 1, size)

            let laplacian = t_left + t_right + t_up + t_down - 4.0 * t_center
            let t_new = t_center + coeff * laplacian

            new_grid[idx] = t_new
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    return new_grid
}

// ============================================================================
// VISUALIZATION
// ============================================================================

fn temp_to_color(temp: f64) {
    if temp < 25.0 {
        bg_blue()
    }
    if temp >= 25.0 && temp < 50.0 {
        bg_cyan()
    }
    if temp >= 50.0 && temp < 75.0 {
        bg_yellow()
    }
    if temp >= 75.0 {
        bg_red()
    }
}

fn render_frame(grid: [f64; 256], size: i32, frame: i32) {
    home_cursor()

    bold()
    cyan()
    println("╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗")
    print("║   HEAT DIFFUSION ANIMATION - Frame ")
    print(frame)
    println("                            ║")
    println("╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝")
    reset()
    println("")

    // Render grid
    var i = 0
    while i < size {
        print("  ")
        var j = 0
        while j < size {
            let idx = i * size + j
            let temp = grid[idx]
            temp_to_color(temp)
            print("  ")
            reset()
            j = j + 1
        }
        println("")
        i = i + 1
    }

    println("")
    print("  ")
    bg_blue()
    print("  ")
    reset()
    blue()
    print(" Cold (&lt;25°C)  ")
    reset()

    bg_cyan()
    print("  ")
    reset()
    cyan()
    print(" Cool (25-50°C)  ")
    reset()

    bg_yellow()
    print("  ")
    reset()
    yellow()
    print(" Warm (50-75°C)  ")
    reset()

    bg_red()
    print("  ")
    reset()
    red()
    println(" Hot (&gt;75°C)")
    reset()
}

// Note: Array initialization workaround - Sounio doesn't support array literals yet
fn init_grid(size: i32) -> [f64; 256] {
    var grid = [0.0; 256]

    // Hot spot in center
    let center = size / 2
    var i = center - 2
    while i <= center + 2 {
        var j = center - 2
        while j <= center + 2 {
            let idx = i * size + j
            grid[idx] = 100.0
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    return grid
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN: ANIMATED DIFFUSION
// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i32 {
    clear_screen()
    hide_cursor()

    let size = 16
    let alpha = 0.1    // Thermal diffusivity
    let dt = 0.1       // Time step
    let dx = 1.0       // Spatial step

    var grid = init_grid(size)
    var frame = 0

    // Animate for 20 frames
    while frame < 20 {
        render_frame(grid, size, frame)
        grid = diffusion_step(grid, size, alpha, dt, dx)
        frame = frame + 1

        // Delay (platform-dependent - would need sleep function)
        // For now, just show frames in sequence
    }

    show_cursor()
    println("")
    bold()
    magenta()
    println("╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗")
    println("║  ✓ Frame-based animation with ANSI cursor control                ║")
    println("║  ✓ Heat diffusion from center hot spot                           ║")
    println("║  ✓ Color gradient shows temperature distribution                 ║")
    println("╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝")
    reset()

    return 0
}


// === FILE: examples/viz_3d/main.sio ===
// examples/viz_3d/main.sio — Rotating 3D tetrahedron with Phong shading
//
// Renders a colour tetrahedron spinning in real time using the
// stdlib/render/renderer3d.sio software rasterizer.
// Press ESC or close the window to exit.

use display::window::{Window, window_open, window_set_title, window_present, window_pending,
                       window_next_event, window_close}
use display::canvas::{Canvas, canvas_from_window, canvas_clear}
use display::canvas_ext::{canvas_draw_line_aa}
use display::event::{EV_CLOSE, EV_KEY_PRESS}
use render::renderer3d::{Camera3D, Light3D, Vec3f, FogParams,
                          r3d_depth_buf_alloc, r3d_depth_buf_clear,
                          r3d_project, r3d_rasterize_tri_phong,
                          r3d_rasterize_tri_cel, r3d_rasterize_tri_pbr,
                          r3d_normalise}

// ============================================================
// Rotation helpers (Y and X axis)
// ============================================================

// Taylor series accurate on [0, π/2]; combined with quadrant reduction below.
fn trig_core_cos(t: f64) -> f64 with Div {
    let t2 = t * t
    1.0 - t2 * (0.5 - t2 * (1.0 / 24.0 - t2 * (1.0 / 720.0 - t2 / 40320.0)))
}
fn trig_core_sin(t: f64) -> f64 with Div {
    let t2 = t * t
    t * (1.0 - t2 * (1.0 / 6.0 - t2 * (1.0 / 120.0 - t2 * (1.0 / 5040.0 - t2 / 362880.0))))
}

fn rot_cos(t: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    let half_pi: f64 = 1.57079632679490
    let pi: f64 = 3.14159265358979
    let two_pi: f64 = 6.28318530717958
    var a: f64 = t
    if a > two_pi { a = a - two_pi }
    if a < 0.0 { a = a + two_pi }
    if a <= half_pi {
        trig_core_cos(a)
    } else if a <= pi {
        0.0 - trig_core_cos(pi - a)
    } else if a <= pi + half_pi {
        0.0 - trig_core_cos(a - pi)
    } else {
        trig_core_cos(two_pi - a)
    }
}

fn rot_sin(t: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    let half_pi: f64 = 1.57079632679490
    let pi: f64 = 3.14159265358979
    let two_pi: f64 = 6.28318530717958
    var a: f64 = t
    if a > two_pi { a = a - two_pi }
    if a < 0.0 { a = a + two_pi }
    if a <= half_pi {
        trig_core_sin(a)
    } else if a <= pi {
        trig_core_sin(pi - a)
    } else if a <= pi + half_pi {
        0.0 - trig_core_sin(a - pi)
    } else {
        0.0 - trig_core_sin(two_pi - a)
    }
}

fn rotate_y(x: f64, y: f64, z: f64, angle: f64, out: &!Vec3f) with Mut, Div {
    let c = rot_cos(angle)
    let s = rot_sin(angle)
    out.x = x * c + z * s
    out.y = y
    out.z = 0.0 - x * s + z * c
}

fn rotate_x(x: f64, y: f64, z: f64, angle: f64, out: &!Vec3f) with Mut, Div {
    let c = rot_cos(angle)
    let s = rot_sin(angle)
    out.x = x
    out.y = y * c - z * s
    out.z = y * s + z * c
}

// Cross product → face normal
fn cross_norm(
    ax: f64, ay: f64, az: f64,
    bx: f64, by: f64, bz: f64,
) -> Vec3f with Mut, Div {
    let nx = ay * bz - az * by
    let ny = az * bx - ax * bz
    let nz = ax * by - ay * bx
    r3d_normalise(nx, ny, nz)
}

// ============================================================
// Tetrahedron geometry
// ============================================================
//
// 4 vertices in model space; 4 triangular faces.
// Vertices (regular tetrahedron inscribed in unit sphere):
//   A = ( 0,  1,  0)
//   B = ( √(8/9),  -1/3,  0)
//   C = (-√(2/9), -1/3,  √(2/3))
//   D = (-√(2/9), -1/3, -√(2/3))
//
// Vertex normals = normalised average of 3 adjacent face normals.
// Combined with per-face base colours and r3d_shade, this gives Gouraud
// shading: smooth gradients + Blinn-Phong specular that travels around.

// Cel-shaded tetrahedron: same geometry as Phong but with flat bands + silhouette ring.
fn tet_draw_cel(
    angle_y: f64, angle_x: f64,
    cam: &Camera3D, light: &Light3D,
    depth_buf: *mut i64, c: &!Canvas,
) with Mut, Div {
    let ax: f64 = 0.0;       let ay: f64 = 1.0;             let az: f64 = 0.0
    let bx: f64 = 0.942809;  let by: f64 = 0.0 - 0.333333;  let bz: f64 = 0.0
    let cx: f64 = 0.0 - 0.471405; let cy: f64 = 0.0 - 0.333333; let cz: f64 = 0.816497
    let dx: f64 = 0.0 - 0.471405; let dy: f64 = 0.0 - 0.333333; let dz: f64 = 0.0 - 0.816497

    var ra = Vec3f { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }
    var rb = Vec3f { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }
    var rc = Vec3f { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }
    var rd = Vec3f { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }
    var tmp = Vec3f { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }

    rotate_y(ax, ay, az, angle_y, &!tmp)
    rotate_x(tmp.x, tmp.y, tmp.z, angle_x, &!ra)
    rotate_y(bx, by, bz, angle_y, &!tmp)
    rotate_x(tmp.x, tmp.y, tmp.z, angle_x, &!rb)
    rotate_y(cx, cy, cz, angle_y, &!tmp)
    rotate_x(tmp.x, tmp.y, tmp.z, angle_x, &!rc)
    rotate_y(dx, dy, dz, angle_y, &!tmp)
    rotate_x(tmp.x, tmp.y, tmp.z, angle_x, &!rd)

    let scale: f64 = 2.0
    let tz: f64 = 5.0
    let va_x = ra.x * scale; let va_y = ra.y * scale; let va_z = ra.z * scale + tz
    let vb_x = rb.x * scale; let vb_y = rb.y * scale; let vb_z = rb.z * scale + tz
    let vc_x = rc.x * scale; let vc_y = rc.y * scale; let vc_z = rc.z * scale + tz
    let vd_x = rd.x * scale; let vd_y = rd.y * scale; let vd_z = rd.z * scale + tz

    let n0 = cross_norm(vc_x - va_x, vc_y - va_y, vc_z - va_z,
                        vb_x - va_x, vb_y - va_y, vb_z - va_z)
    let n1 = cross_norm(vb_x - va_x, vb_y - va_y, vb_z - va_z,
                        vd_x - va_x, vd_y - va_y, vd_z - va_z)
    let n2 = cross_norm(vd_x - va_x, vd_y - va_y, vd_z - va_z,
                        vc_x - va_x, vc_y - va_y, vc_z - va_z)
    let n3 = cross_norm(vc_x - vb_x, vc_y - vb_y, vc_z - vb_z,
                        vd_x - vb_x, vd_y - vb_y, vd_z - vb_z)

    let vna = r3d_normalise(n0.x+n1.x+n2.x, n0.y+n1.y+n2.y, n0.z+n1.z+n2.z)
    let vnb = r3d_normalise(n0.x+n1.x+n3.x, n0.y+n1.y+n3.y, n0.z+n1.z+n3.z)
    let vnc = r3d_normalise(n0.x+n2.x+n3.x, n0.y+n2.y+n3.y, n0.z+n2.z+n3.z)
    let vnd = r3d_normalise(n1.x+n2.x+n3.x, n1.y+n2.y+n3.y, n1.z+n2.z+n3.z)

    let pa = r3d_project(va_x, va_y, va_z, cam, c.width, c.height)
    let pb = r3d_project(vb_x, vb_y, vb_z, cam, c.width, c.height)
    let pc = r3d_project(vc_x, vc_y, vc_z, cam, c.width, c.height)
    let pd = r3d_project(vd_x, vd_y, vd_z, cam, c.width, c.height)

    // Face 0: A-B-C (red 220,80,60)
    r3d_rasterize_tri_cel(
        pa.x as i64, pa.y as i64, pb.x as i64, pb.y as i64, pc.x as i64, pc.y as i64,
        pa.z, pb.z, pc.z, vna, vnb, vnc, 220, 80, 60, light, depth_buf, c)
    // Face 1: A-B-D (green 80,200,120)
    r3d_rasterize_tri_cel(
        pa.x as i64, pa.y as i64, pb.x as i64, pb.y as i64, pd.x as i64, pd.y as i64,
        pa.z, pb.z, pd.z, vna, vnb, vnd, 80, 200, 120, light, depth_buf, c)
    // Face 2: A-C-D (blue 80,140,255)
    r3d_rasterize_tri_cel(
        pa.x as i64, pa.y as i64, pc.x as i64, pc.y as i64, pd.x as i64, pd.y as i64,
        pa.z, pc.z, pd.z, vna, vnc, vnd, 80, 140, 255, light, depth_buf, c)
    // Face 3: B-C-D (yellow 255,220,60)
    r3d_rasterize_tri_cel(
        pb.x as i64, pb.y as i64, pc.x as i64, pc.y as i64, pd.x as i64, pd.y as i64,
        pb.z, pc.z, pd.z, vnb, vnc, vnd, 255, 220, 60, light, depth_buf, c)
}

// PBR (Cook-Torrance GGX) tetrahedron — glossy plastic, roughness=0.28.
// Strong GGX specular highlights travel sharply across each face.
fn tet_draw_pbr(
    angle_y: f64, angle_x: f64,
    cam: &Camera3D, light: &Light3D,
    depth_buf: *mut i64, c: &!Canvas,
) with Mut, Div {
    let ax: f64 = 0.0;       let ay: f64 = 1.0;             let az: f64 = 0.0
    let bx: f64 = 0.942809;  let by: f64 = 0.0 - 0.333333;  let bz: f64 = 0.0
    let cx: f64 = 0.0 - 0.471405; let cy: f64 = 0.0 - 0.333333; let cz: f64 = 0.816497
    let dx: f64 = 0.0 - 0.471405; let dy: f64 = 0.0 - 0.333333; let dz: f64 = 0.0 - 0.816497

    var ra = Vec3f { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }
    var rb = Vec3f { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }
    var rc = Vec3f { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }
    var rd = Vec3f { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }
    var tmp = Vec3f { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }

    rotate_y(ax, ay, az, angle_y, &!tmp)
    rotate_x(tmp.x, tmp.y, tmp.z, angle_x, &!ra)
    rotate_y(bx, by, bz, angle_y, &!tmp)
    rotate_x(tmp.x, tmp.y, tmp.z, angle_x, &!rb)
    rotate_y(cx, cy, cz, angle_y, &!tmp)
    rotate_x(tmp.x, tmp.y, tmp.z, angle_x, &!rc)
    rotate_y(dx, dy, dz, angle_y, &!tmp)
    rotate_x(tmp.x, tmp.y, tmp.z, angle_x, &!rd)

    let scale: f64 = 2.0
    let tz: f64 = 5.0
    let va_x = ra.x * scale; let va_y = ra.y * scale; let va_z = ra.z * scale + tz
    let vb_x = rb.x * scale; let vb_y = rb.y * scale; let vb_z = rb.z * scale + tz
    let vc_x = rc.x * scale; let vc_y = rc.y * scale; let vc_z = rc.z * scale + tz
    let vd_x = rd.x * scale; let vd_y = rd.y * scale; let vd_z = rd.z * scale + tz

    let n0 = cross_norm(vc_x - va_x, vc_y - va_y, vc_z - va_z,
                        vb_x - va_x, vb_y - va_y, vb_z - va_z)
    let n1 = cross_norm(vb_x - va_x, vb_y - va_y, vb_z - va_z,
                        vd_x - va_x, vd_y - va_y, vd_z - va_z)
    let n2 = cross_norm(vd_x - va_x, vd_y - va_y, vd_z - va_z,
                        vc_x - va_x, vc_y - va_y, vc_z - va_z)
    let n3 = cross_norm(vc_x - vb_x, vc_y - vb_y, vc_z - vb_z,
                        vd_x - vb_x, vd_y - vb_y, vd_z - vb_z)

    let vna = r3d_normalise(n0.x+n1.x+n2.x, n0.y+n1.y+n2.y, n0.z+n1.z+n2.z)
    let vnb = r3d_normalise(n0.x+n1.x+n3.x, n0.y+n1.y+n3.y, n0.z+n1.z+n3.z)
    let vnc = r3d_normalise(n0.x+n2.x+n3.x, n0.y+n2.y+n3.y, n0.z+n2.z+n3.z)
    let vnd = r3d_normalise(n1.x+n2.x+n3.x, n1.y+n2.y+n3.y, n1.z+n2.z+n3.z)

    let pa = r3d_project(va_x, va_y, va_z, cam, c.width, c.height)
    let pb = r3d_project(vb_x, vb_y, vb_z, cam, c.width, c.height)
    let pc = r3d_project(vc_x, vc_y, vc_z, cam, c.width, c.height)
    let pd = r3d_project(vd_x, vd_y, vd_z, cam, c.width, c.height)

    let fog = FogParams { near: 12.0, far: 35.0, r: 18, g: 20, b: 30 }
    let roughness: f64 = 0.28

    r3d_rasterize_tri_pbr(
        pa.x as i64, pa.y as i64, pb.x as i64, pb.y as i64, pc.x as i64, pc.y as i64,
        pa.z, pb.z, pc.z, vna, vnb, vnc, 220, 80, 60, roughness, &fog, light, depth_buf, c)
    r3d_rasterize_tri_pbr(
        pa.x as i64, pa.y as i64, pb.x as i64, pb.y as i64, pd.x as i64, pd.y as i64,
        pa.z, pb.z, pd.z, vna, vnb, vnd, 80, 200, 120, roughness, &fog, light, depth_buf, c)
    r3d_rasterize_tri_pbr(
        pa.x as i64, pa.y as i64, pc.x as i64, pc.y as i64, pd.x as i64, pd.y as i64,
        pa.z, pc.z, pd.z, vna, vnc, vnd, 80, 140, 255, roughness, &fog, light, depth_buf, c)
    r3d_rasterize_tri_pbr(
        pb.x as i64, pb.y as i64, pc.x as i64, pc.y as i64, pd.x as i64, pd.y as i64,
        pb.z, pc.z, pd.z, vnb, vnc, vnd, 255, 220, 60, roughness, &fog, light, depth_buf, c)
}

fn tet_draw_gouraud(
    angle_y: f64, angle_x: f64,
    cam: &Camera3D, light: &Light3D,
    depth_buf: *mut i64, c: &!Canvas,
) with Mut, Div {
    let ax: f64 = 0.0;       let ay: f64 = 1.0;             let az: f64 = 0.0
    let bx: f64 = 0.942809;  let by: f64 = 0.0 - 0.333333;  let bz: f64 = 0.0
    let cx: f64 = 0.0 - 0.471405; let cy: f64 = 0.0 - 0.333333; let cz: f64 = 0.816497
    let dx: f64 = 0.0 - 0.471405; let dy: f64 = 0.0 - 0.333333; let dz: f64 = 0.0 - 0.816497

    var ra = Vec3f { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }
    var rb = Vec3f { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }
    var rc = Vec3f { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }
    var rd = Vec3f { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }
    var tmp = Vec3f { x: 0.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0 }

    rotate_y(ax, ay, az, angle_y, &!tmp)
    rotate_x(tmp.x, tmp.y, tmp.z, angle_x, &!ra)
    rotate_y(bx, by, bz, angle_y, &!tmp)
    rotate_x(tmp.x, tmp.y, tmp.z, angle_x, &!rb)
    rotate_y(cx, cy, cz, angle_y, &!tmp)
    rotate_x(tmp.x, tmp.y, tmp.z, angle_x, &!rc)
    rotate_y(dx, dy, dz, angle_y, &!tmp)
    rotate_x(tmp.x, tmp.y, tmp.z, angle_x, &!rd)

    let scale: f64 = 2.0
    let tz: f64 = 5.0
    let va_x = ra.x * scale; let va_y = ra.y * scale; let va_z = ra.z * scale + tz
    let vb_x = rb.x * scale; let vb_y = rb.y * scale; let vb_z = rb.z * scale + tz
    let vc_x = rc.x * scale; let vc_y = rc.y * scale; let vc_z = rc.z * scale + tz
    let vd_x = rd.x * scale; let vd_y = rd.y * scale; let vd_z = rd.z * scale + tz

    // Face normals (outward)
    // Face 0: A-B-C  Face 1: A-B-D  Face 2: A-C-D  Face 3: B-C-D
    let n0 = cross_norm(vc_x - va_x, vc_y - va_y, vc_z - va_z,
                        vb_x - va_x, vb_y - va_y, vb_z - va_z)
    let n1 = cross_norm(vb_x - va_x, vb_y - va_y, vb_z - va_z,
                        vd_x - va_x, vd_y - va_y, vd_z - va_z)
    let n2 = cross_norm(vd_x - va_x, vd_y - va_y, vd_z - va_z,
                        vc_x - va_x, vc_y - va_y, vc_z - va_z)
    let n3 = cross_norm(vc_x - vb_x, vc_y - vb_y, vc_z - vb_z,
                        vd_x - vb_x, vd_y - vb_y, vd_z - vb_z)

    // Vertex normals: A∈{0,1,2}  B∈{0,1,3}  C∈{0,2,3}  D∈{1,2,3}
    let vna = r3d_normalise(n0.x+n1.x+n2.x, n0.y+n1.y+n2.y, n0.z+n1.z+n2.z)
    let vnb = r3d_normalise(n0.x+n1.x+n3.x, n0.y+n1.y+n3.y, n0.z+n1.z+n3.z)
    let vnc = r3d_normalise(n0.x+n2.x+n3.x, n0.y+n2.y+n3.y, n0.z+n2.z+n3.z)
    let vnd = r3d_normalise(n1.x+n2.x+n3.x, n1.y+n2.y+n3.y, n1.z+n2.z+n3.z)

    // Project all 4 vertices to screen
    let pa = r3d_project(va_x, va_y, va_z, cam, c.width, c.height)
    let pb = r3d_project(vb_x, vb_y, vb_z, cam, c.width, c.height)
    let pc = r3d_project(vc_x, vc_y, vc_z, cam, c.width, c.height)
    let pd = r3d_project(vd_x, vd_y, vd_z, cam, c.width, c.height)

    // Fog: camera at z=20, object at z≈5±2 → depth≈13-17; fade toward background navy
    let fog = FogParams { near: 12.0, far: 35.0, r: 18, g: 20, b: 30 }

    // Face 0: A-B-C (red 220,80,60)
    r3d_rasterize_tri_phong(
        pa.x as i64, pa.y as i64, pb.x as i64, pb.y as i64, pc.x as i64, pc.y as i64,
        pa.z, pb.z, pc.z, vna, vnb, vnc, 220, 80, 60, &fog, light, depth_buf, c)
    canvas_draw_line_aa(c, pa.x as i64, pa.y as i64, pb.x as i64, pb.y as i64, 66, 24, 18)
    canvas_draw_line_aa(c, pb.x as i64, pb.y as i64, pc.x as i64, pc.y as i64, 66, 24, 18)
    canvas_draw_line_aa(c, pc.x as i64, pc.y as i64, pa.x as i64, pa.y as i64, 66, 24, 18)

    // Face 1: A-B-D (green 80,200,120)
    r3d_rasterize_tri_phong(
        pa.x as i64, pa.y as i64, pb.x as i64, pb.y as i64, pd.x as i64, pd.y as i64,
        pa.z, pb.z, pd.z, vna, vnb, vnd, 80, 200, 120, &fog, light, depth_buf, c)
    canvas_draw_line_aa(c, pa.x as i64, pa.y as i64, pb.x as i64, pb.y as i64, 24, 60, 36)
    canvas_draw_line_aa(c, pb.x as i64, pb.y as i64, pd.x as i64, pd.y as i64, 24, 60, 36)
    canvas_draw_line_aa(c, pd.x as i64, pd.y as i64, pa.x as i64, pa.y as i64, 24, 60, 36)

    // Face 2: A-C-D (blue 80,140,255)
    r3d_rasterize_tri_phong(
        pa.x as i64, pa.y as i64, pc.x as i64, pc.y as i64, pd.x as i64, pd.y as i64,
        pa.z, pc.z, pd.z, vna, vnc, vnd, 80, 140, 255, &fog, light, depth_buf, c)
    canvas_draw_line_aa(c, pa.x as i64, pa.y as i64, pc.x as i64, pc.y as i64, 24, 42, 76)
    canvas_draw_line_aa(c, pc.x as i64, pc.y as i64, pd.x as i64, pd.y as i64, 24, 42, 76)
    canvas_draw_line_aa(c, pd.x as i64, pd.y as i64, pa.x as i64, pa.y as i64, 24, 42, 76)

    // Face 3: B-C-D (yellow 255,220,60)
    r3d_rasterize_tri_phong(
        pb.x as i64, pb.y as i64, pc.x as i64, pc.y as i64, pd.x as i64, pd.y as i64,
        pb.z, pc.z, pd.z, vnb, vnc, vnd, 255, 220, 60, &fog, light, depth_buf, c)
    canvas_draw_line_aa(c, pb.x as i64, pb.y as i64, pc.x as i64, pc.y as i64, 76, 66, 18)
    canvas_draw_line_aa(c, pc.x as i64, pc.y as i64, pd.x as i64, pd.y as i64, 76, 66, 18)
    canvas_draw_line_aa(c, pd.x as i64, pd.y as i64, pb.x as i64, pb.y as i64, 76, 66, 18)
}

// ============================================================
// Main
// ============================================================

fn main() with IO, Alloc, Mut, Div {
    let W: i64 = 640
    let H: i64 = 480

    var title: [i8; 128] = [0; 128]
    title[0]  = 83   // S
    title[1]  = 111  // o
    title[2]  = 117  // u
    title[3]  = 110  // n
    title[4]  = 105  // i
    title[5]  = 111  // o
    title[6]  = 32   // space
    title[7]  = 51   // 3
    title[8]  = 68   // D
    let title_len: i64 = 9

    var win = window_open(W, H)
    window_set_title(&!win, &title, title_len)
    let depth_buf = r3d_depth_buf_alloc(W, H)

    // Tetrahedron at tz=5; camera at pos_z=20 → depth≈15, scale≈27 px/unit.
    let cam = Camera3D { pos_x: 0.0, pos_y: 0.0, pos_z: 20.0, focal: 400.0 }
    let light = Light3D {
        dx: 0.577350,   // normalised (1,1,1)
        dy: 0.577350,
        dz: 0.577350,
        r: 255, g: 255, b: 255,
        ambient: 0.22,
    }

    var angle_y: f64 = 0.6
    var angle_x: f64 = 0.3

    var running = true
    while running {
        while window_pending(&!win) > 0 {
            let ev = window_next_event(&!win)
            if ev.kind == EV_CLOSE { running = false }
            if ev.kind == EV_KEY_PRESS && ev.key == 27 { running = false }
        }

        var c = canvas_from_window(&!win)
        canvas_clear(&!c, 18, 20, 30)
        r3d_depth_buf_clear(depth_buf, W, H)

        tet_draw_pbr(angle_y, angle_x, &cam, &light, depth_buf, &!c)

        window_present(&!win)

        // Tumble: Y ~1°/frame, X ~0.4°/frame — shows all faces and specular highlights
        angle_y = angle_y + 0.017453
        if angle_y > 6.28318 { angle_y = angle_y - 6.28318 }
        angle_x = angle_x + 0.004
        if angle_x > 6.28318 { angle_x = angle_x - 6.28318 }
    }

    heap_free(depth_buf as *mut i8)
    window_close(&!win)
}

// === FILE: examples/viz_lab/main.sio ===
// examples/viz_lab/main.sio — native visual frontend smoke demo

use display::canvas::{Canvas, canvas_clear}
use display::event::{Event, EV_KEY_PRESS, EV_MOUSE_PRESS, EV_MOTION, KEY_TAB, KEY_SPACE, MOUSE_LEFT}
use viz::ir::{viz_scene_new, viz_layout_rect, viz_style_rgb, viz_add_line_chart, viz_add_uncertainty_band, viz_add_heatmap, viz_add_control, viz_add_molecule, viz_add_scalar_field, viz_add_mesh, viz_scene_set_time, VIZ_CONTROL_SLIDER, VIZ_CONTROL_TABS, VIZ_CONTROL_TOGGLE}
use viz::viz_app::{viz_app_new, viz_app_handle_event, viz_app_frame_hash}
use viz::viz_canvas::{viz_canvas_render_scene}
use viz::physchem::{molecule_h2o, scalar_field_radial}
use render::renderer3d::{Tri3D}

fn lab_canvas(w: i64, h: i64) -> Canvas with Alloc {
    let pix = heap_alloc(w * h * 8) as *mut i64
    Canvas { pixels: pix, width: w, height: h }
}

fn lab_read(c: &Canvas, x: i64, y: i64) -> i64 {
    read_i64(c.pixels, y * c.width + x)
}

fn lab_event(kind: i64, key: i64, x: i64, y: i64) -> Event {
    Event { kind: kind, key: key, x: x, y: y, mods: 0 }
}

fn main() with IO, Alloc, Mut, Div {
    var c = lab_canvas(320, 240)
    canvas_clear(&!c, 8, 12, 18)
    var app = viz_app_new(8, 12, 18)

    var scene = viz_scene_new()
    var xs: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var ys: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var vars: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 16 {
        xs[i as usize] = i as f64
        ys[i as usize] = 4.0 + (i as f64) * 0.25
        vars[i as usize] = 0.05 + (i as f64) * 0.01
        i = i + 1
    }

    let mol = molecule_h2o()
    let field = scalar_field_radial(8, 8)
    assert(mol.atom_count == 3)
    var tris: [Tri3D; 128] = [Tri3D {
        v0x: -0.35, v0y: -0.30, v0z: -2.0,
        v1x: 0.35, v1y: -0.30, v1z: -2.0,
        v2x: 0.0, v2y: 0.35, v2z: -2.0,
        nx: 0.0, ny: 0.0, nz: 1.0,
        base_r: 170, base_g: 220, base_b: 130,
    }; 128]
    viz_scene_set_time(&!scene, 2.0)
    viz_add_line_chart(&!scene, &xs, &ys, 16, viz_layout_rect(16, 16, 130, 80), viz_style_rgb(255, 140, 90))
    viz_add_uncertainty_band(&!scene, &xs, &ys, &vars, 16, viz_layout_rect(164, 16, 130, 80), viz_style_rgb(90, 190, 255))
    viz_add_heatmap(&!scene, &field.values, field.rows, field.cols, field.min_value, field.max_value, viz_layout_rect(16, 116, 110, 80))
    viz_add_molecule(&!scene, mol, viz_layout_rect(148, 168, 72, 54), viz_style_rgb(210, 220, 240))
    viz_add_scalar_field(&!scene, field, viz_layout_rect(236, 168, 64, 54))
    viz_add_mesh(&!scene, &tris, 1, viz_layout_rect(112, 104, 72, 54), viz_style_rgb(170, 220, 130))
    let slider_id = viz_add_control(&!scene, VIZ_CONTROL_SLIDER, viz_layout_rect(156, 130, 120, 22), scene.time, 0.0, 10.0)
    let tabs_id = viz_add_control(&!scene, VIZ_CONTROL_TABS, viz_layout_rect(16, 204, 108, 20), 0.0, 0.0, 3.0)
    let toggle_id = viz_add_control(&!scene, VIZ_CONTROL_TOGGLE, viz_layout_rect(236, 132, 28, 18), 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    assert(viz_app_handle_event(&!app, &!scene, lab_event(EV_MOUSE_PRESS, MOUSE_LEFT, 168, 140)))
    assert(scene.selected_node == slider_id)
    assert(viz_app_handle_event(&!app, &!scene, lab_event(EV_MOTION, 0, 216, 140)))
    assert(scene.time == 5.0)
    assert(viz_app_handle_event(&!app, &!scene, lab_event(EV_MOUSE_PRESS, MOUSE_LEFT, 98, 212)))
    assert(scene.selected_node == tabs_id)
    assert(scene.active_tab == 3)
    assert(viz_app_handle_event(&!app, &!scene, lab_event(EV_MOUSE_PRESS, MOUSE_LEFT, 244, 140)))
    assert(scene.selected_node == toggle_id)
    assert(scene.nodes[toggle_id as usize].value == 1.0)
    scene.selected_node = 0 - 1
    scene.hovered_node = 0 - 1
    scene.focused_node = slider_id
    assert(viz_app_handle_event(&!app, &!scene, lab_event(EV_KEY_PRESS, KEY_TAB, 0, 0)))
    assert(scene.focused_node == tabs_id)
    assert(viz_app_handle_event(&!app, &!scene, lab_event(EV_KEY_PRESS, KEY_TAB, 0, 0)))
    assert(scene.focused_node == toggle_id)
    assert(viz_app_handle_event(&!app, &!scene, lab_event(EV_KEY_PRESS, KEY_SPACE, 0, 0)))
    assert(scene.nodes[toggle_id as usize].value == 0.0)
    assert(app.dirty)

    canvas_clear(&!c, app.bg_r, app.bg_g, app.bg_b)
    viz_canvas_render_scene(&scene, &!c)
    app.frame = app.frame + 1
    app.dirty = false
    assert(viz_app_frame_hash(&app, &scene, &c) != 0)
    assert(lab_read(&c, 30, 30) != 0)
    assert(lab_read(&c, 20, 120) != 0)
    assert(lab_read(&c, 160, 195) != 0)

    heap_free(c.pixels as *mut i8)
    println("VIZ_LAB_READY")
}

// === FILE: examples/viz_pbpk/main.sio ===
// examples/viz_pbpk/main.sio — PK uncertainty visualization demo
//
// Two-panel display:
//   Top (y 20-210): plasma concentration C(t) with 3 nested HDI ribbons (50/80/95%)
//   Bottom (y 240-430): epistemic waterfall for key PK parameters
//
// Model: 1-compartment IV bolus  C(t) = (D/Vd)*exp(-(CL/Vd)*t)
//   D=5mg, Vd=50L, CL=10L/h → ke=0.2h^-1, C0=0.1mg/L
//   GUM uncertainty: σD=15%·D, σVd=30%·Vd, σCL=25%·CL
//   σ²(C) = (1/Vd·e^{-ke·t})²σ²D + (-D/Vd²·e^{-ke·t}·(1+ke·t))²σ²Vd + (D·t/Vd²)²·e^{-2ke·t}·σ²CL
//   (GUM first-order approximation)
// HDI bounds: median ± z·σ where z=0.674(50%), 1.282(80%), 1.960(95%)
//
// Press ESC or close to exit.

use display::window::{Window, window_open, window_set_title, window_present, window_pending,
                       window_next_event, window_close}
use display::canvas::{Canvas, canvas_from_window, canvas_clear}
use display::event::{EV_CLOSE, EV_KEY_PRESS}
use viz::coord::{CoordSystem, coord_new, coord_draw_axes, coord_draw_grid, coord_draw_frame,
                  coord_map_x, coord_map_y}
use viz::chart::{chart_uncertainty_band}
use viz::epiviz::{epiviz_waterfall}
use display::canvas_ext::{canvas_blend_pixel, canvas_draw_line_aa, canvas_sphere_shaded,
                           canvas_bloom, canvas_fxaa}
use display::canvas::{canvas_fill_rect}

// ============================================================
// Math helpers
// ============================================================

fn vpk_exp_neg(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 1.0 }
    let e1: f64 = 0.36787944117
    let ipart = x as i64
    let frac = x - (ipart as f64)
    var r = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var k: i64 = 1
    while k <= 12 {
        term = 0.0 - term * frac / (k as f64)
        r = r + term
        k = k + 1
    }
    if r < 0.0 { r = 0.0 }
    var em: i64 = 0
    while em < ipart {
        r = r * e1
        em = em + 1
    }
    r
}

fn vpk_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 20 {
        y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
        i = i + 1
    }
    y
}

// ============================================================
// PK curve + GUM uncertainty arrays
// ============================================================

fn pk_fill_arrays(
    xs: &![f64; 1024],
    med: &![f64; 1024],
    lo95: &![f64; 1024], hi95: &![f64; 1024],
    lo80: &![f64; 1024], hi80: &![f64; 1024],
    lo50: &![f64; 1024], hi50: &![f64; 1024],
    n: i64,
) with Mut, Div {
    let dose: f64 = 5.0
    let vd: f64 = 50.0
    let cl: f64 = 10.0
    let ke = cl / vd
    let c0 = dose / vd
    // GUM coefficient standard deviations
    let s_d  = 0.15 * dose
    let s_vd = 0.30 * vd
    let s_cl = 0.25 * cl
    let t_max: f64 = 24.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        let t = t_max * (i as f64) / ((n - 1) as f64)
        let ekt = vpk_exp_neg(ke * t)
        let ct = c0 * ekt
        // GUM sensitivities
        let dc_dd  = ekt / vd
        let dc_dvd = 0.0 - ct / vd * (1.0 + ke * t)
        let dc_dcl = 0.0 - ct * t / vd
        let var_c = dc_dd*dc_dd*s_d*s_d + dc_dvd*dc_dvd*s_vd*s_vd + dc_dcl*dc_dcl*s_cl*s_cl
        let sigma = vpk_sqrt(var_c)
        xs[i as usize]   = t
        med[i as usize]  = ct
        lo95[i as usize] = ct - 1.960 * sigma
        hi95[i as usize] = ct + 1.960 * sigma
        lo80[i as usize] = ct - 1.282 * sigma
        hi80[i as usize] = ct + 1.282 * sigma
        lo50[i as usize] = ct - 0.674 * sigma
        hi50[i as usize] = ct + 0.674 * sigma
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================
// VPC panel — Visual Predictive Check
// ============================================================
//
// Standard clinical PK/PD display (Bergstrand et al. 2011, pcVPC).
// Shows simulated PI outer bands (blue) + median band (red) +
// observed median (solid red) + observed outer bounds (dashed red).
//
// Reuses lo95/hi95/med arrays as 2.5th/97.5th/50th simulated percentiles.

fn vpc_draw_dashed_line(
    c: &!Canvas,
    sx0: i64, sy0: i64, sx1: i64, sy1: i64,
    r: i64, g: i64, b: i64,
) with Mut, Div {
    let dx = sx1 - sx0
    let dy = sy1 - sy0
    let steps = if dx < 0 { 0 - dx } else { dx }
    let ysteps = if dy < 0 { 0 - dy } else { dy }
    let n_steps = if steps > ysteps { steps } else { ysteps }
    if n_steps == 0 { return }
    var si: i64 = 0
    while si <= n_steps {
        // Dashed: draw 4px, skip 4px
        if (si % 8) < 4 {
            let t = (si as f64) / (n_steps as f64)
            let bx = sx0 + ((sx1 - sx0) as f64 * t) as i64
            let by_v = sy0 + ((sy1 - sy0) as f64 * t) as i64
            canvas_fill_rect(c, bx, by_v, 1, 1, r, g, b)
        }
        si = si + 1
    }
}

fn vpc_draw_panel(
    cs: &CoordSystem,
    xs: &[f64; 1024],
    lo95: &[f64; 1024], hi95: &[f64; 1024],
    lo50: &[f64; 1024], hi50: &[f64; 1024],
    med: &[f64; 1024],
    n: i64,
    c: &!Canvas,
) with Mut, Div {
    if n < 2 { return }
    var i: i64 = 0
    // Blue outer PI bands (2.5th and 97.5th)
    while i < n - 1 {
        let sx0 = coord_map_x(cs, xs[i as usize])
        let sx1 = coord_map_x(cs, xs[(i + 1) as usize])
        // lo95 band bottom (2.5th percentile vicinity ≈ lo95 band fill)
        let lo_y0 = coord_map_y(cs, lo95[i as usize])
        let lo_y1 = coord_map_y(cs, lo95[(i + 1) as usize])
        let hi_y0 = coord_map_y(cs, hi95[i as usize])
        let hi_y1 = coord_map_y(cs, hi95[(i + 1) as usize])
        // Outer PI region: from lo95 edge toward the median on each side
        if sx1 > sx0 {
            let span = sx1 - sx0
            var px = sx0
            while px < sx1 {
                let t = ((px - sx0) as f64) / (span as f64)
                let top_y = (lo_y0 as f64 * (1.0 - t) + lo_y1 as f64 * t) as i64
                canvas_blend_pixel(c, px, top_y, 60, 120, 220, 70)
                canvas_blend_pixel(c, px, top_y - 1, 60, 120, 220, 40)
                let bot_y = (hi_y0 as f64 * (1.0 - t) + hi_y1 as f64 * t) as i64
                canvas_blend_pixel(c, px, bot_y, 60, 120, 220, 70)
                canvas_blend_pixel(c, px, bot_y + 1, 60, 120, 220, 40)
                px = px + 1
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    // Red median PI band (50th percentile band)
    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < n - 1 {
        let sx0 = coord_map_x(cs, xs[j as usize])
        let sx1 = coord_map_x(cs, xs[(j + 1) as usize])
        let lo_y0 = coord_map_y(cs, lo50[j as usize])
        let lo_y1 = coord_map_y(cs, lo50[(j + 1) as usize])
        let hi_y0 = coord_map_y(cs, hi50[j as usize])
        let hi_y1 = coord_map_y(cs, hi50[(j + 1) as usize])
        if sx1 > sx0 {
            let span = sx1 - sx0
            var px = sx0
            while px < sx1 {
                let t = ((px - sx0) as f64) / (span as f64)
                let top_y = (lo_y0 as f64 * (1.0 - t) + lo_y1 as f64 * t) as i64
                let bot_y = (hi_y0 as f64 * (1.0 - t) + hi_y1 as f64 * t) as i64
                var py = top_y
                while py <= bot_y {
                    canvas_blend_pixel(c, px, py, 220, 60, 60, 85)
                    py = py + 1
                }
                px = px + 1
            }
        }
        j = j + 1
    }
    // Observed median — solid red line
    var k: i64 = 0
    while k < n - 1 {
        let sx0 = coord_map_x(cs, xs[k as usize])
        let sy0 = coord_map_y(cs, med[k as usize])
        let sx1 = coord_map_x(cs, xs[(k + 1) as usize])
        let sy1 = coord_map_y(cs, med[(k + 1) as usize])
        canvas_draw_line_aa(c, sx0, sy0, sx1, sy1, 240, 80, 80)
        k = k + 1
    }
    // Observed 2.5th + 97.5th — dashed red
    var m: i64 = 0
    while m < n - 1 {
        let sx0 = coord_map_x(cs, xs[m as usize])
        let sx1 = coord_map_x(cs, xs[(m + 1) as usize])
        vpc_draw_dashed_line(c,
            sx0, coord_map_y(cs, lo95[m as usize]),
            sx1, coord_map_y(cs, lo95[(m + 1) as usize]),
            200, 100, 100)
        vpc_draw_dashed_line(c,
            sx0, coord_map_y(cs, hi95[m as usize]),
            sx1, coord_map_y(cs, hi95[(m + 1) as usize]),
            200, 100, 100)
        m = m + 1
    }
    // Simulated data points — small blue dots at each x along the median
    var di: i64 = 0
    while di < n {
        let sx = coord_map_x(cs, xs[di as usize])
        let sy = coord_map_y(cs, med[di as usize])
        canvas_sphere_shaded(c, sx, sy, 3, 80, 140, 220)
        di = di + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================
// Main
// ============================================================

fn main() with IO, Alloc, Mut, Div {
    let W: i64 = 640
    let H: i64 = 480
    let bloom_scratch = heap_alloc(W * H * 8) as *mut i64

    var title: [i8; 128] = [0; 128]
    title[0]  = 80   // P
    title[1]  = 75   // K
    title[2]  = 32   //
    title[3]  = 85   // U
    title[4]  = 110  // n
    title[5]  = 99   // c
    title[6]  = 101  // e
    title[7]  = 114  // r
    title[8]  = 116  // t
    title[9]  = 97   // a
    title[10] = 105  // i
    title[11] = 110  // n
    title[12] = 116  // t
    title[13] = 121  // y
    let title_len: i64 = 14

    var win = window_open(W, H)
    window_set_title(&!win, &title, title_len)

    // Precompute PK arrays (constant — no sliders in this demo)
    let n_pts: i64 = 60
    var xs:   [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var med:  [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var lo95: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var hi95: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var lo80: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var hi80: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var lo50: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var hi50: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    pk_fill_arrays(&!xs, &!med, &!lo95, &!hi95, &!lo80, &!hi80, &!lo50, &!hi50, n_pts)

    // Three-panel layout: HDI band (top) | VPC (middle) | waterfall (bottom)
    let cs_top = coord_new(0.0, 24.0, 0.0, 0.14, 60, 12, 560, 140)
    let cs_vpc = coord_new(0.0, 24.0, 0.0, 0.14, 60, 168, 560, 130)
    let cs_bot = coord_new(0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 4.0, 60, 315, 560, 148)
    var confs: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    confs[0] = 950   // D  — well controlled (analytical balance)
    confs[1] = 720   // Vd — moderate uncertainty (population estimate)
    confs[2] = 780   // CL — moderate uncertainty (creatinine-based)
    confs[3] = 860   // ke — derived from CL/Vd, moderate

    var running = true
    while running {
        while window_pending(&!win) > 0 {
            let ev = window_next_event(&!win)
            if ev.kind == EV_CLOSE { running = false }
            if ev.kind == EV_KEY_PRESS && ev.key == 27 { running = false }
        }

        var c = canvas_from_window(&!win)
        canvas_clear(&!c, 18, 20, 30)

        // Top panel: HDI uncertainty band + median line
        coord_draw_grid(&cs_top, &!c, 5)
        coord_draw_axes(&cs_top, &!c)
        chart_uncertainty_band(&cs_top,
            &xs,
            &lo95, &hi95,
            &lo80, &hi80,
            &lo50, &hi50,
            &med,
            n_pts, &!c,
            80, 160, 255)

        // Middle panel: VPC (Visual Predictive Check)
        coord_draw_frame(&cs_vpc, &!c)
        vpc_draw_panel(&cs_vpc, &xs, &lo95, &hi95, &lo50, &hi50, &med, n_pts, &!c)

        // Bottom panel: parameter confidence waterfall
        coord_draw_frame(&cs_bot, &!c)
        epiviz_waterfall(&cs_bot, &confs, 4, &!c)

        // Bloom: threshold=195 highlights the bright sphere dots + median line
        canvas_bloom(&!c, bloom_scratch, 195, 160)
        // FXAA: smooth jagged edges on chart lines
        canvas_fxaa(&!c, bloom_scratch)

        window_present(&!win)
    }

    heap_free(bloom_scratch as *mut i8)
    window_close(&!win)
}


// === FILE: examples/viz_physchem_demo/main.sio ===
// examples/viz_physchem_demo/main.sio - Physico-chemistry Visual IR demo

use display::canvas::{Canvas, canvas_clear}
use render::renderer3d::{Tri3D}
use viz::ir::{
    viz_scene_new, viz_layout_rect, viz_style_rgb, viz_scene_set_time,
    viz_add_line_chart, viz_add_uncertainty_band,
    viz_add_molecule, viz_add_scalar_field, viz_add_vector_field,
    viz_add_trajectory, viz_add_spectrum, viz_add_mesh,
}
use viz::physchem::{
    molecule_h2o, molecule_rapamycin_coarse, scalar_field_radial,
    vector_field_vortex, trajectory_spiral, spectrum_absorption_demo,
}
use viz::viz_canvas::{viz_canvas_render_scene}
use viz::viz_html::{viz_html_emit_scene}

fn demo_canvas(w: i64, h: i64) -> Canvas with Alloc {
    let pix = heap_alloc(w * h * 8) as *mut i64
    Canvas { pixels: pix, width: w, height: h }
}

fn demo_read(c: &Canvas, x: i64, y: i64) -> i64 {
    read_i64(c.pixels, y * c.width + x)
}

fn main() with IO, Alloc, Mut, Div {
    var scene = viz_scene_new()
    viz_scene_set_time(&!scene, 9.0)

    let water = molecule_h2o()
    let rapamycin = molecule_rapamycin_coarse()
    let scalar = scalar_field_radial(8, 8)
    let vectors = vector_field_vortex(6, 6)
    let trajectory = trajectory_spiral(32)
    let spectrum = spectrum_absorption_demo(48)

    var t: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var mean: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var variance: [f64; 1024] = [0.0; 1024]
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 16 {
        t[i as usize] = i as f64
        mean[i as usize] = 2.0 + (i as f64) * 0.18
        variance[i as usize] = 0.04 + (i as f64) * 0.004
        i = i + 1
    }

    var tris: [Tri3D; 128] = [Tri3D {
        v0x: -0.35, v0y: -0.35, v0z: -2.0,
        v1x: 0.35, v1y: -0.35, v1z: -2.0,
        v2x: 0.0, v2y: 0.35, v2z: -2.0,
        nx: 0.0, ny: 0.0, nz: 1.0,
        base_r: 170, base_g: 220, base_b: 130,
    }; 128]

    viz_add_molecule(&!scene, water, viz_layout_rect(12, 12, 72, 60), viz_style_rgb(210, 220, 240))
    viz_add_molecule(&!scene, rapamycin, viz_layout_rect(98, 12, 112, 60), viz_style_rgb(180, 210, 160))
    viz_add_scalar_field(&!scene, scalar, viz_layout_rect(12, 92, 72, 64))
    viz_add_vector_field(&!scene, vectors, viz_layout_rect(98, 92, 72, 64))
    viz_add_trajectory(&!scene, trajectory, viz_layout_rect(184, 92, 104, 64))
    viz_add_spectrum(&!scene, spectrum, viz_layout_rect(12, 174, 160, 36))
    viz_add_mesh(&!scene, &tris, 1, viz_layout_rect(202, 12, 72, 60), viz_style_rgb(170, 220, 130))
    viz_add_line_chart(&!scene, &t, &mean, 16, viz_layout_rect(184, 174, 104, 36), viz_style_rgb(255, 150, 90))
    viz_add_uncertainty_band(&!scene, &t, &mean, &variance, 16, viz_layout_rect(12, 226, 276, 36), viz_style_rgb(90, 190, 255))

    assert(scene.molecule_count == 2)
    assert(scene.field_count == 1)
    assert(scene.vector_field_count == 1)
    assert(scene.trajectory_count == 1)
    assert(scene.spectrum_count == 1)
    assert(scene.mesh_count == 1)

    var c = demo_canvas(300, 280)
    canvas_clear(&!c, 5, 8, 12)
    viz_canvas_render_scene(&scene, &!c)
    assert(demo_read(&c, 48, 42) != 0)
    assert(demo_read(&c, 150, 42) != 0)
    assert(demo_read(&c, 24, 104) != 0)
    assert(demo_read(&c, 98, 92) != 0)
    assert(demo_read(&c, 184, 92) != 0)
    assert(demo_read(&c, 12, 174) != 0)
    assert(demo_read(&c, 238, 42) != 0)
    assert(demo_read(&c, 200, 190) != 0)
    assert(demo_read(&c, 24, 240) != 0)
    heap_free(c.pixels as *mut i8)

    viz_html_emit_scene(&scene, 300, 280)
    println("VIZ_PHYSCHEM_DEMO_READY")
}


// === FILE: examples/viz_workbench/main.sio ===
// examples/viz_workbench/main.sio - Sounio native visual workbench demo

use display::canvas::{Canvas, canvas_clear}
use viz::audit::{viz_audit_hash}
use viz::inspector::{viz_inspector_draw, viz_inspector_draw_node_highlights}
use viz::ir::{viz_scene_new}
use viz::viz_app::{viz_app_new, viz_app_frame_hash}
use viz::viz_canvas::{viz_canvas_render_scene}
use viz::viz_html::{viz_html_emit_scene}
use viz::workbench::{viz_workbench_build_scene}

fn wb_canvas(w: i64, h: i64) -> Canvas with Alloc {
    let pix = heap_alloc(w * h * 8) as *mut i64
    Canvas { pixels: pix, width: w, height: h }
}

fn main() with IO, Alloc, Mut, Div {
    var scene = viz_scene_new()
    let ids = viz_workbench_build_scene(&!scene)
    var app = viz_app_new(10, 13, 18)
    var c = wb_canvas(480, 320)

    canvas_clear(&!c, app.bg_r, app.bg_g, app.bg_b)
    viz_canvas_render_scene(&scene, &!c)
    viz_inspector_draw_node_highlights(&scene, &!c)
    viz_inspector_draw(&scene, &!c, 306, 16, 156, 146)
    app.frame = app.frame + 1
    app.dirty = false

    assert(scene.node_count >= 16)
    assert(scene.nodes[ids.slider as usize].tag == 8101)
    assert(scene.molecule_count >= 1)
    assert(scene.vector_field_count >= 1)
    assert(scene.trajectory_count >= 1)
    assert(scene.spectrum_count >= 1)
    assert(scene.mesh_count >= 1)
    assert(viz_app_frame_hash(&app, &scene, &c) != 0)
    assert(viz_audit_hash(&scene) != 0)

    viz_html_emit_scene(&scene, 480, 320)

    heap_free(c.pixels as *mut i8)
    println("VIZ_WORKBENCH_READY")
}

    let prior = Distribution::Normal(0.5, 0.1);

    print("\nEstimated coin bias: {:.3}", posterior_mean);

fn count_heads(bias: f64, n: i64) -> i64 {
    // Simple simulation: count how many times a random number < bias

        let random = (sin(i as f64 * 3.7) + 1.0) / 2.0;  // Normalize to [0, 1]
        if random < bias {

        }
    }
    return count;
